bible.translation: Lahu Bible Edited © Thailand Bible Society and Bible Society of Myanmar, 2010, 2020.

chapter.verse: Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han maˇ cawˬ leh gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa peu-eˬ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Awˬ gʼeuˆ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ hkʼa leh awˬ gʼeuˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ ceuˬ da‸ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ leh naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ Yawˇ Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw, teh‸ meh piˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ Mvuhˇ hpeu‸, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ tcuhˉ kaˍ cawˬ la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ da‸ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe teˇ cawˬ haˉ iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ da‸ sheˬ leh, iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ tcuhˉ kaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ tcuhˉ kaˍ tawˍ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Mvuhˇ naw ma, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, nyiˇ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ tawˆ la tuˬ mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ hpoˆ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼa leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Goˇ lehˍ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ, teh‸ meh piˇ leh, teˇ geh hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh iˉ shiˍ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo suhˆ cehˬ hawˆ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ la leh, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tcuhˉ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ gʼeuˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ ba la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, ha pa hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ uˉ peunˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ,

awˬ gʼeuˆ leh naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˇ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve ngaˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ leh poˬ puiˉ ve ngaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˇ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo meuˇ ve leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, uiˍ ve leh i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, laiˉ ceuˬ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, meuˇ ve leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ, uiˍ ve leh i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw yaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ leh yaˇ miˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu laiˉ ceuˬ leh, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ teh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpa‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve zuhˇ mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh mvuhˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, hkaw‸ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ hkʼa te tuˬ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo Yawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ peuˬ leh gʼaˇ jehˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ gehˇ sheˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo zuhˇ, mvuh‸, hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ sheˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ mehˇ leh te caˇ tuˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ nehˆ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ je‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh chaw yaˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼa shuˍ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ shaˉ meuˆ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ a sha‸ te‸ la ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo Eˍdenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hko lonˉ teˇ maˬ te hpanˍ leh, Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo nyi sha jaˇ leh mehˬ jaˇ ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hko oˇ ve awˬ kʼaw ji lo, a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ leh da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve suhˆ cehˬ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˍdenˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, hko hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi ve hko awˬ baˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ awˇ maˬ pehˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ lehˬ Hpiˇshanˍ teh‸ meh leh shi tawˆ ve Haˍviˇlaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
(Da‸ jaˇ ve shi, da‸ jaˇ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve yoˬ.)
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, Giˇhonˍ teh‸ meh leh Kuˇshaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ shehˆ maˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, Tiˇgeˍriˆ teh‸ meh leh Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ya‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ teh‸ meh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˍdenˍ hko hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh muiˬ caˇ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ hko oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chaw yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hko chi hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve iˉ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ cehˬ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ taˇ caˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ cehˬ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ lehˬ yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ ve maˇ da‸. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ je‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ chaw yaˇ geh yuˬ veu laˇ leh awˬ meh meh piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ lehˬ ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ meh meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ meh cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa piˇ lawˬ leh yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve nyi kuˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ awˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ shaˍ kʼaw‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nyi kuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ geh lo shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hkʼaw ve awˬ mu‸ ku, ngaˬ ve awˬ shaˍ hkʼaw ve awˬ shaˍ, chi ve hta‸ yaˇ miˇ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve pa taw yo, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, hawˉ hkʼaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ suhˍ teˇ shaˍ tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ nyi leh ya‸ taw ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Vuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ laˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ geh laˬ leh, Hko hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Hko awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve iˉ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ ka‸ taˇ htawˇ, caˇ ka‸ taˇ caˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸vuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ vuiˬ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui maˇ suh taˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ cawˬ haˉ hpaw la leh Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ chi, iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve nyi sha leh caˇ mehˬ ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ mawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ shaˉ yuˬ leh caˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ htawˇ caˍ piˇ leh, awˬ hpawˇ htawˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hpaw la leh, nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ maˉ nawˆ hpa‸ chehˆ leh teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la hpawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hko hkʼaw lo laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hawˉ hkʼaˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hko hkʼaw laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ peuˬ, teh‸ a shu kʼoˆ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ taˇ caˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ caˇ leh laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ ma chi, iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ shaˉ veu laˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ caˍ laˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ gʼa caˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve le, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Vuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ gʼa caˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha vuiˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkeu ve chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa gʼawˬ sheh toˇ leh je‸ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ leh yaˇ miˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ koˆ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ dawˆ leh, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve hkui mehˍ cu hta‸ htawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ hta‸ htawˇ, Nawˬ yaˇ hu yaˇ paw htaˇ naˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ maˇ la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh nawˬ zuh‸ gaˇ tuˬ sheˬ leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hawˉ hkʼaˆ hta‸ htawˇ, Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ miˇ ma hkawˇ na leh ngaˬ taˇ caˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ pa taw hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ pon tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ hpa‸ hawˆ hpa‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, awˍ gʼa caˇ tuˬ naˍ kʼaˍ pui hkʼoˆ lo kuiˍ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ hta‸ je‸ yuˬ te taˍ ve pa taw, je‸ lo nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdanˍ leh, yawˇ ve aw miˇ ma hta‸ Eˇva‸ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ e hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍdanˍ leh Eˇva‸ hta‸ shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ tawˉ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ co co te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ gʼa ve iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˍ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hpeh‸ tawˆ la kuiˬ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ca muiˬ caˇ tuˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ Eˍdenˍ hko hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˍdenˍ hko mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve Hkeˍruˆbenˍ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh leh, a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍdanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Eˇva‸ hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve pa taw, maˇ maw maw yawˇ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇva‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ Kaˍiˉnaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Aˍbeˍ laˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ muiˬ caˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ muiˬ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbeˍlaˆ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbeˍlaˆ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Kaˍiˉnaˆ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Kaˍiˉnaˆ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ cawˇ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, nawˬ htawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ nawˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gaˬ la peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍiˇnaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Hkeu‸, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca guiˇ-e veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbeˍlaˆ hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ Kaˍiˉnaˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Kaˍiˉnaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chi taw taw haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve le. Nawˬ nyi paˍ ve awˬ suhˍ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ, nawˬ nyi paˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ muiˬ caˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ mehˇ ve htawˇ, miˬguiˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ ti hkʼa deh‸ maˇ cawˬ leh gʼa hpaw toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve chi hehnˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ ti maˇ cawˬ leh gʼa hpaw toˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve suhˍ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Kaˍiˉnaˆ hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Kaˍiˉnaˆ hta‸ awˬ maiˉ teˇ maˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍiˉnaˆ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˍdenˍ hko mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Nawˇdaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ leh, Eˇnawˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ venˇ teˇ venˇ te leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇnawˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇnawˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Eˇraˆ yoˬ. Eˇraˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍhuˇyeˍlaˆ yoˬ. Maˍhuˇyeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍtuˉseˍlaˆ yoˬ. Maˍtuˉseˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Laˍmehˆ yoˬ.
Laˍmehˆ lehˬ, Aˍdaˆ leh Ziˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdaˆ geh lo Yaˍbaˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi lehˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ leh yawˬ hawˉ caˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yuˉbaˍlaˆ teh‸ meh leh, yawˇ lehˬ nawˍ meuˆ tinˍ hteˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˍlaˆ geh lo, Tuˇbaˍlaˆ Kaˍiˉnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ca liˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma lehˬ, Neˍmaˆ teh‸ meh ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Laˍmehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Aˍdaˆ leh Ziˍlaˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˆ laˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ.
Kaˍiˉnaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸ suhˍ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸ suhˍ chi suhˍ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍdanˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇva‸ kʼoˆ ve, Kaˍiˉnaˆ lehˬ Aˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbeˍlaˆ awˬ tan ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ Sheˍtaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍtaˆ htawˇ, Eˇno‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tanˬ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ tanˬ yehˇ hkawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍdanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ leh yaˇ miˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Chaw yaˇ teh‸ meh piˇ leh bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Aˍdanˍ lehˬ 130 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hta‸ Sheˍtaˆ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍdanˍ lehˬ 800 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ 930 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Sheˍtaˆ lehˬ 105 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Eˇnoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ 807 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ 912 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Eˇnoˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 90 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Kaˍiˇnanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ 815 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ 905 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Kaˍiˉnanˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 70 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Maˍhaˍleˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ 840 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ 910 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Maˍhaˍleˍlaˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 65 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Yaˍyehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ 830 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ 895 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yaˍyehˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 162 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Eˇnawˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ 800 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ 962 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Eˇnawˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 65 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Meˍtuˇseˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh teˇ geh 300 hkʼaw‸ te toˇ leh, awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ 365 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha geh te toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇnawˆ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve pa taw yoˬ.
Maˍtuˇseˍlaˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 187 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Laˍmehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ 782 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ 969 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Laˍmehˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 182 hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ Noˉa‸ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ paˍ chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkeu taˍ ve miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ kanˉ gʼa te caˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ Noˉa‸ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Laˍmehˆ lehˬ 595 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ 777 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Noˉa‸ lehˬ a sha‸ 500 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ, Yaˍhpehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ chaw yaˇ maˇ la leh, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ maˇ la ve pa taw,
gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca heuˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ suh puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ ha nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ ceh tiˉ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh paw la ve uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve chaw lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ leh awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ te hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Yawˇ chaw yaˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve law teh‸ shiˍ leh dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,

Ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve law, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Noˉa‸ hta‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Noˉa‸ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Noˉa‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve chaw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw leh venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ, Yaˍhpehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ nyi leh cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Noˉa‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi ve cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ hta‸ ca leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te-o. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ te keu leh, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ leh awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo suhˆ tcuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ taˍ-o‸.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ te tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ chi zuhˬ hpawˇ 300 jaˆ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 50 jaˆ leh mvuh hpawˇ 30 jaˆ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ chi ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa beh leh, teˇ jaˆ hkʼe gʼa beh zuhˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi ve hta‸ shehˆ htai‸ gʼa te leh yehˬ miˉ lonˉ htawˇ teˇ maˬ gʼa te keu ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh nawˬ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh,
ngaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh, nawˬ geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw gʼa yuˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ gʼa gu taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Noˉa‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Noˉa‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Noˉa‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ yaˇ chi ma ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh cawˬ kʼai tuˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma suhˍ ceh, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh leh,
ngaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma suhˍ ceh nawˬ geh yuˬ keu-o.

Suhˍ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˇ chi nyi awˇ chi haˉ ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hkʼa te hpanˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Noˉa‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Noˉa‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chi hkʼe iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Noˉa‸ lehˬ a sha‸ 600 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, Noˉa‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Noˉa‸ geh teˇ geh da‸ kehˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe,
to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh, ngaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh, Noˉa‸ geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve yoˬ.
Noˉa‸ a sha‸ 600 hkʼaw‸ biˇ leh ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma yehˬ miˉ hpaw leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo 40 nyi 40 haˉ mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Noˉa‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ, Yaˍhpehˆ hui leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma, yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve leh meuˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ, uiˍ ve leh i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le,
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ ceh Noˉa‸ geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
40 nyi awˬ yanˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ taˆ la leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼoˆ lo fuˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ iˉ kaˆ hoˆ beh sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ taˆ la leh, mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw lonˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ 15 jaˆ hkʼe iˉ kaˆ biˇ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ shaˉ hkʼa gʼawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Noˉa‸ leh yawˇ geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ 150 nyi hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Noˉa‸ leh yawˇ geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ haw meuˆ laˬ tcuh leh, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ yaw kʼai sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ fiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma ve yehˬ miˉ hoˆ sheˬ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o.
Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ 150 nyi hkʼa gaˬ yaw kʼai sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi suhˍ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ lehˬ Aˍraˍraˆ hkʼaw pui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ shaˬ te shaˬ yaw kʼai leh ha pa teˇ chi maˬ teˇ maˬ awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, hkʼaw uˉ tzuh teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 40 nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Noˉa‸ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hta‸ hpaw leh, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ hpehˇ peu ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ oˇ ve lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ iˉ kaˆ fiˍ kʼai peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Noˉa‸ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaˬ ma kʼaw‸ yaw kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ peu nyi ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ hoˆ beh taˍ sheˬ leh jehˇ kuiˬ ca maˇ mawˬ ve pa taw, aˉ pui kʼaˍ chi Noˉa‸ geh kʼaw‸ poˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Noˉa‸ la‸ sheh che leh aˉ pui kʼaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ kʼaw‸ law nyi peuˬ leh, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ peu nyi ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la hpawˇ gaˬ leh aˉ pui kʼaˍ chi yawˇ ve meuˇ cu hkʼaw shaˍ lonˍ hpa‸ teˇ hpa‸ htawˆ chiˇ veu laˇ leh yawˇ geh lo kʼaw‸ poˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ Noˉa‸ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa cawˇ cawˇ yaw kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ law nyi peuˬ leh, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ peu nyi ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ aˉ pui kʼaˍ lehˬ yawˇ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ la-o.

Noˉa‸ yawˇ ve a sha‸ 601 hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ goˇ lehˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Noˉa‸ lehˬ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ beh taˍ ve hta‸ hpaˆ baˬ leh nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ goˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, 27 nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ goˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Noˉa‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ leh nawˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la-o.
Nawˬ geh hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ maˇ la biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Noˉa‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Noˉa‸ awˬ to, yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Noˉa‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, da‸ kehˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hkeu piˇ-o. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ nehˬ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ te peuˬ ve hkʼe, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Miˬguiˬ chi ve cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve ceh ceh, caˬ ti ve awˬ yanˇ leh caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ, kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ leh haw ve awˬ yanˇ, mvuhˇ goˇ ve awˬ yanˇ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ ve awˬ yanˇ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw ve awˬ yanˇ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Noˉa‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Uiˍ la maˇ la leh miˬguiˬ chi ve hta‸ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ngaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ leh suhˆ hpa‸ hawˆ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ shaˍ geh teˇ geh nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa hkaw‸ caˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼa shuˍ te hpanˍ taˍ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼa maˇ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Noˉa‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ lehˬ, awˬ heˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi awˬ kaˍ lo ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˉlaˇmiˬshiˉjaw tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hta‸ ngaˬ cawˬ la piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo aˉlaˇmiˬshiˉjaw hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Aˉlaˇmiˬshiˉjaw hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Noˉa‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la taˍ ve Noˉa‸ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ leh Yaˍhpehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Haˍmaˆ lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Chaw chi ve shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Noˉa‸ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Noˉa‸ lehˬ muiˬ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˉ lawˉ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw awˬ kʼu nyi te zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ, Hkaˍnanˍ awˬ pa Haˍmaˆ gʼa mawˬ leh, Sheˍmaˆ leh Yaˍhpehˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍmaˆ leh Yaˍhpehˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ ve pa taw, aˉ po‸ lonˉ teˇ hkʼoˆ yuˬ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo te juˇ kʼo‸-e leh awˬ pa hta‸ ca beh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Noˉa‸ nawˇ la leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yaˍhpehˆ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ Hkaˍnanˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Sheˍmaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Hkaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yaˍhpehˆ hta‸uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Sheˍmaˆ ve chaw hui geh gʼa chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Hkaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Yaˍhpehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ htonˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Noˉa‸ lehˬ 350 hkʼaw‸ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ 950 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ htonˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Noˉa‸, Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ, Yaˍhpehˆ hui geh cawˬ la ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍhpehˆ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gawˇmaˍ, Maˍgawˇgaˆ, Maˍdehˇ, Yaˍgʼonˍ, Tuˇbaˍlaˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Tiˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gawˇmaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍshaˆkeˍnaˆ, Yiˇhpaˆ leh Tawˇgaˬmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍgʼonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇliˇshaˍ, Saˍpenˍ, Kuˇpaˍruˆ leh Roˇdeˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ ca te chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Haˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kuˇshaˆ, Eˇjiˇtu‸, Liˆbiˍaˇ, Hkaˍnan hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kuˇshaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Siˍbaˆ, Haˍviˇlaˍ, Shaˍbaˍtaˆ, Raˍmaˆ leh Saˍteˍhkaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Raˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍbaˆ, Deˍdanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kuˇshaˆ lehˬ, Neˍyawˇdaˆ ve awˬ pa htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ga piˇ ve pa taw, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve shaˍ bawˆ paˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ Neˍyawˇdaˆ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve shaˍ bawˆ paˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ, Eˇyehˆ venˇ, Aˍkaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ, Reˍhawˇboˆ venˇ, Kaˍlaˆ venˇ,
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ leh Kaˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yeˍsenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Luˇdanˍ, Aˍnaˍniˆ, Leˍhaˍbiˆ, Naˍtuˇhiˆ, Paˍtaˍruˇsiˆ, Kaˍtaˍhuˇliˆ leh Keˍreˍteˍ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Keˍreˍteˍ chaw hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkaˍnanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Siˉdonˍ, Heˍtaˆ,
Yeˍbuˇsiˆ, Aˍmawˇriˆ, Giˇgaˍshiˆ,
Hiˇviˆ, Aˍkiˆ, Siˇniˆ,
Aˍbaˍdiˆ, Zeˍmaˍriˆ leh Haˍmaˍtiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Hkaˍnanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Siˉdonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ, Gawˇmawˇra‸, Aˍdaˍmaˍ leh Laˍshaˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Zeˍboˍenˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Haˍmaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ chi teˇ tawn lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍhpehˆ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ Sheˍmaˆ lehˬ, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlanˍ, Aˍsuˇriˆ, Aˍhpaˍyaˆ, Luˇdaˆ leh Aˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍranˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Uˇyaˆ, Huˇlaˆ, Geˍraˆ leh Maˍshaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhpaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Sheˍlaˆ hpeh‸ leh, Sheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Heˍbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Heˍbaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Hpaˍlehˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˬ leh pehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Yuˇdanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇdanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍlaˍmawˇdiˆ, Sheˍlaˆ, Haˍsaˍmawˆ, Yeˍraˆ,
Haˍdawˇranˍ, Uˇzeˍlaˆ, Diˇkaˍlaˆ,
Awˇbaˍlaˆ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlaˆ, Sheˍbaˆ,
Awˇhpiˇraˆ, Haˍviˇlaˍ, leh Yawˇbaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇdanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Meˍshaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Seˍhpaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve teˇ tawn lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Noˉa‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ htonˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ la ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui heh ve li kiˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ chiˆ hpoˆ shaˍ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui li kiˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ te hpoˆ leh yehˬ kawˍ htaˇ suhˆ tcuhˇ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Laˬ-o‸, ngaˬ hui miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo maˇ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ kʼai tuˬ, leh ngaˬ hui da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa tuˬ, venˇ lonˉ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ca nyi la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, chaw teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ hpeh‸ leh tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ tiˉ yehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui kanˉ chi hta‸ tanˬ te gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te gʼa la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e leh, yawˇ hui tawˇ yaw da‸ ve teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ na maˇ gʼa da‸ tuˬ ca te piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve venˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, baˬ taˉ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ tawˇ yaw ve maˇ pawnˍ da‸ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Sheˍmaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ htonˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh, Sheˍmaˆ yawˇ a sha‸ 100 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhpaˍyaˆ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍmaˆ lehˬ 500 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍhpaˍyaˆ lehˬ, 35 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Seˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 403 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Seˍlaˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Heˍbaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 403 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Heˍbaˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 34 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Hpaˍlehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 430 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍlehˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Yeˍgawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 209 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yaˍgawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ 32 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Seˍruˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 207 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Seˍruˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Naˍhkawˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 200 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Naˍhkawˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 29 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Teˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ a sha‸ 119 hkʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Teˍraˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 70 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Aˍbranˍ, Naˍhkawˍ leh Haˍranˍ hui cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Teˍraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˍraˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍbranˍ, Naˍhkawˍ leh Haˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haˍranˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Lawˇ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍranˍ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ paw la ve chehˇ kuiˬ Uˉraˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ awˬ pa Teˍraˆ maˇ suh sheˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ leh Naˍhkawˍ htawˇ, awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍbranˍ ve awˬmiˇ ma lehˬ Saˍrehˇ yoˬ. Naˍhkawˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ Haˍranˍ ve awˬ yaˇ miˇ Miˆlaˍ hkaˍ yoˬ. Haˍranˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˆlaˍhkaˍ leh Iˉsaˍhkaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Saˍrehˇ lehˬ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Teˍraˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbranˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ paˍ Haˍranˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Lawˇtaˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma, Aˍbranˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍrehˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ tuˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Uˉraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Haˍranˍ venˇ lo gaˬ htaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Teˍraˆ a sha‸ 205 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ leh ngaˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai-o.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ piˇ laˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, shu hta‸ awˬ bon te piˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hkeu ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼai tcuh ve hkʼe, Aˍbranˍ tu leh kʼai ve yoˬ. Lawˇtaˍ htawˇ yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Aˍbranˍ lehˬ Haˍranˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 75 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ.
Aˍbranˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍrehˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ paˍ Lawˇtaˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lo gaˬ htaˇ, Sheˍhkenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇreˍ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ)

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbranˍ geh laˬ leh, Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ tawn ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbranˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ leh Aˍiˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ aˉ po kʼo te leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ kʼaw‸ jiˆ chehˇ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve pa taw, Aˍbranˍ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ gʼa ca hpaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍbranˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍrehˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇ tu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ chaw chi hpaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ lehˬ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ chi da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yaˇ miˇ chi da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ pa taw, Aˍbranˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ leh yawˬ, aˉ che‸, nuˇ, piˉlaˬ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Saˍrehˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve a naˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍbranˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ gʼa heuˆ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le. Chi beu‸ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍbranˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai tcuh tuˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Lawˇ taˍ htawˇ yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ Aˍbranˍ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ geh ceˇ caˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, hpu shi htawˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te jaw ve chehˇ kuiˬ leh,
yawˇ aˉ po kʼo te chehˇ taˉ jaw ve Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ leh Aˍiˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Lawˇ taˍ htawˇ, nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ leh awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ceˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ chi a ciˉ maˇ kʼehˬ ve pa taw,
Aˍbranˍ ve ceˇ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh Lawˇtaˍ ve ceˇ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ya‸ da‸ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, oˇ kaˬ lo Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw leh Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ)
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Aˍbranˍ Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve ceˇ hawˉ paˍ awˬ kaˍ lo ya‸ da‸ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hpaˆ da‸-a veuˬ. Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ teˇ hpawˇ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ law hpawˇ lo chiˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa leh Zawˇraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve hko hkʼa shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. (Chi ve lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ te luˬ piˇ sheˬ htaˇ yoˬ)
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hpaˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ maˇ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ paˇ lo ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Lawˇtaˍ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbranˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chiˇ nyi hkʼa sheˬ.
Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ chi beu‸ tu leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca toˇ nyi loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbranˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hta‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ leh Heˍbronˍ venˇ, Maˍreˍ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ lonˉ cawˬ kuiˬ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Aˍraˆhpeˍlaˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ jawˇmawˇ Aˍroˆ, Eˇlanˍ jawˇmawˇ Keˍdawˇraˆlawˇmaˍ, Gawˇyinˍ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉdaˍlaˆ hui lehˬ,
Sawˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ Beˍraˆ, Gawˇmawˇraˆ jawˇmawˇ Biˆraˍshaˆ, Aˍdaˍmaˍ jawˇmawˇ Shiˆnaˆ, Zeˍbonˍ jawˇmawˇ Sheˍmaˍbaˍ, Zawˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Beˍlaˍ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ chi ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chi beu‸ Suh ve laˇtsuhˇ gʼuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Siˆdinˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ma‸ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ jawˇmawˇ Keˍdawˇraˆlawˇmaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Keˍdawˇraˆlawˇmaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw ve chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆkaˍneˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍhpanˍ chaw, Haˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Zuˍzenˍ chaw, Kiˇriˇyaˆtenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve Eˍmonˍ chaw,
Eˇdonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Hawˇriˆ chaw, hteunˍ lonˉ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Eˇlaˆpaˍranˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui laˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, chi beu‸ Kaˍdehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Eˍmiˆsaˍpaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Haˍsaˍ sonˍtaˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ, Gawˇmawˇra‸ jawˇmawˇ, Aˍdaˍmaˍ jawˇmawˇ, Zeˍboˍyinˍ jawˇmawˇ leh Beˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Siˆdinˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh ma‸ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇlaˍ jawˇmawˇ, Gawˇyinˍ jawˇmawˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ jawˇmawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ gu chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpawˇ lo jawˇmawˇ awˇ gʼaˇ leh, teˇ hpawˇ lo jawˇmawˇ ngaˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, haˉ tcuhˇ tawˆ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh miˬ kʼoˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaw taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve awˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Sawˉdonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍbranˍ ve awˬ shaˍ paˍ Lawˇtaˍ leh yawˇ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo hpaw tawˆ la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw Maˍreˍ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ lonˉ cawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw Aˍbranˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn chi ca hto piˇ la ve yoˬ. Maˍreˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Eˇshaˍkawˆlaˆ leh Aˍneˍraˆ hui lehˬ, Aˍbranˍ hpawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ paˍ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve chaw 318 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Danˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve awˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hoˆ taˍ leh lo‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ Hawˇbaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Lawˇtaˍ leh yawˇ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, shu hpeh kʼai taˍ ve chaw leh yawˇ hui ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, Keˍdawˇraˆlawˇmaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ Sawˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, (chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve) Shaˍveˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ca ha‸ yuˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍlehnˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Aˍbranˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍbranˍ htawˇ yawˇ hkʼa gʼa taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hta‸ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ Aˍbranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ yuˬ kʼai-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍbranˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ yuˬ. Gʼo‸ hkeh teˇ caˆ ehˉ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ yuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw, Aˍbranˍ paw sha la ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼoˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kʼai taˍ ve Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ, Aˍneˍraˆ leh Maˍreˍ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa keunˍ ve hkʼe yuˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw piˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Aˍbranˍ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh uiˍ jaˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma la‸ shawnˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ shinˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ piˇ laˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ yawˇ geh gaˬ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ tawˆ-e leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ nyi leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi-o. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbranˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yonˍ ve pa taw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Uˉraˆ venˇ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ suhˉ chi hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, A sha‸ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve nuˇ ma teˇ hkeh, aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ teˇ hkeh, peuˬ leh aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hkeh leh guˇ teˇ hkeh ngaˬ geh yuˬveu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, nuˇ ma leh awˬ nu ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ jeˆ hkoˆ leh teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ jeˆ hkoˇ piˇ.
Naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbranˍ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbranˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˇ ha hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ yuˬ leh gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, a sha‸ mawˇ jaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, haiˬ jaˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ sheˬ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˇ co-e hkʼa gaˬ shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e leh naˆ ho‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jeˆ hkoˇ taˍ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve aˬ miˍ mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ teˇ dawˇ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbranˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ te leh Uˉhpaˍ raˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve,
Keˍniˆ, Keˍraˍziˆ, Kaˍdaˍmawˇniˆ,
Hiˇtiˆ, Hpeˍraˍziˆ, Yeˍhpenˍ,
Aˍmawˇriˆ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ, Giˇgaˍshiˆ, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ, chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ miˇ ma Saˍrehˇ lehˬ, yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ geh lo Haˍgaˍraˆ meh ve Eˇjiˇ tu‸ chaw awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Saˍrehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇAˍbranˍ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ hu yaˇ paw tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma chi hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ loˬ. Yawˇ geh lo ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbranˍ htawˇ Saˍrehˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Saˍrehˇ lehˬ Haˍgaˍraˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i te tcuh ve yoˬ. (Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, Aˍbranˍ yawˇ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ yoˬ.)
Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, Haˍgaˍraˆ geh zuh‸ ve pa taw, yaˇ miˇ chi yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ. Haˍgaˍraˆ lehˬ yawˇ yaˇ hu la peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍrehˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍrehˇ Aˍbranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haˍgaˍraˆ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ yaˇ hu la ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbranˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma lehˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Saˍrehˇ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ ma chi hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ leh yaˇ miˇ chi hpaw kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Shuˇraˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo, Haˍgaˍraˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Saˍrehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Haˍgaˍraˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ leh hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ chi kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma geh lo hpaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma geh lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ca kʼaw‸ te-o.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ teh‸ nawˬ gʼa meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼa shuˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hta‸, Mawˬ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ leh, awˬ lawn chi ngaˬ shu hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hta‸, Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve nanˬ bawˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nanˬbawˍ chi lehˬ Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ leh Beˍrehˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Haˍgaˍraˆ lehˬ, Aˍbranˍ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ Iˉshaˍ meˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbranˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 86 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ a sha‸ 99 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te-o.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te leh nawˬ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbranˍ lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Aˍbranˍ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ-o. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ meh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hkehˉ chaw te chehˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ gʼa shoˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo teh taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hiˉ nyi gaˬ ve kʼo, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ gʼa shoˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw paw la ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo co co taiˍ taiˍ cawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ Saˍrehˇ teh‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ kuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ Saˍraˇ teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh yawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ e hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼuiˬ yawˬ jaˇ leh, A sha‸ 100 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve chaw geh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la gʼa tuˬ sheˬ ve laˇ. A sha‸ kawˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve Saˍraˇ htawˇ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la gʼa tuˬ sheˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ shinˉ maˇ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ Iˉcaˆ teh‸ nawˬ gʼa meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ awˬ pon nawˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ Saˍraˇ geh paw la tuˬ ve nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ geh lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw paw la ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le leh, vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍyawˇ awˬ to awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 99 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh,
yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ teˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pa awˬ yaˇ leh, awˬ ceˬ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo,
awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Maˍreˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ cha chiˆ jaˇ leh yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw mui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ hui geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ geh maˇ jehˇ taˉ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ taˇ kʼai laˇ sheˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui suhˆ ceh chi awˬ hawˉ lo gʼaˇ jehˇ taˍ sheˬ. Nawˬ hui hkui sheh tsuhˇ tuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ca yuˬ shaˍ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ ca yuˬ veu laˇ shaˍ. Gʼaˇ jehˇ leh caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ miˇ ma hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ haˆ haˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh chu jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve nuˇ paˍ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˍ chiˇ te tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkaoˍmonˇ, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ leh nuˇ shaˍ awˍ chiˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ca teh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸, Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le, teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Saˍraˇ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ awˬ baˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui tawˇ yaw da‸ ve hta‸ na chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Saˍraˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ a sha‸ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Saˍraˇ hkʼawˇ gʼuiˬ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ yaˇ hu yaˇ paw tuˬ awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ yanˇ ka‸ leh kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ htawˇ a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Saˍraˇ gʼuiˬ leh, ngaˬ a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve ka‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yaˇ gʼa hu gʼa paw tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha maˇ te puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ leh laˇ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍraˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍraˇ lehˬ kawˆ ve pa taw heˍ leh, Ngaˬ maˇ gʼuiˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼuiˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tu leh Sawˉdonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh teˇ tawn gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe dawˇ ve, Ngaˬ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ chi, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ leh faˉ taˍ maˇ cawˇ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tuˬ awˬ pon maˍ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉdonˍ venˇ leh Gawˇ mawˇra‸ venˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh ya‸-e leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ, maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ ca chaˬ nyi shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ Sawˉdonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ geh chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw leh maˇ da‸ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na teˇ geh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw da‸ ve chaw ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ laˇ. Chaw da‸ ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸ laˇ.

Da‸ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ da‸ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh nawˬ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ da‸ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw ceh tiˉ suhˉ gʼa jehˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw da‸ ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ pa taw venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shanˬ tuˬ te maˇ keunˍ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo da‸ ve chaw awˇ chi ngaˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve chaw awˇ chi ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ kaˬ lo awˇ chi gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ kaˬ lo awˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw ve hta‸ nyi ma a ciˉ taˇ zuhˆ laˇ sheˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw da‸ shehˆ chi gʼaˇ ceh cawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw da‸ shehˆ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te luˬ piˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˬ. Chaw da‸ nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ ceh cawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw da‸ nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te luˬ piˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ceh nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ gaˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Teˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te luˬ piˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ Sawˉdonˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, gʼuiˇ kʼai leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ ve yehˬ lo ca haˉ la leh, hkui sheh tsuhˇ la sheˬ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui choˬ kaˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo teˇ haˉ ma chehˇ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Lawˇtaˍ lawˬ hkawˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ zuh‸ sheˬ htaˇ, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ yaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ, chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Lawˇtaˍ ve yehˬ lo laˬ leh yehˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai le. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ gʼa te tuˬ shiˍ tawˆ la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Lawˇtaˍ tawˆ-e leh yehˬ miˉ hoˆ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸. Nawˬ hui chi taw taw taˇ te laˇ sheˬ.

Nyi loˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh shiˍ veu laˇ shaˍ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ lehˬ, a ciˉ taˇ htawˇ laˇ sheˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼe te leh tawˇ yaw laˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ te piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hta‸ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, yehˬ miˉ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ tuˬ buiˆ lo‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ hpaw leh Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼawˬ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yehˬ miˉ kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ yehˬ baˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yehˬ miˉ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Venˇ chi hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ leh awˬ maˉ paˍ hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˬ laˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ leh venˇ chi hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ yawˇ maˉ paˍ te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, Venˇ chi hkʼaw haˆ haˆ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ miˇ ma leh nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh haˆ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ haˆ haˆ maˇ te ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Lawˇtaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ awˬ yaˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼawˬ leh venˇ baˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ shiˍ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e loˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo taˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo htawˇ taˇ jehˇ chehˇ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaw taˆ-e loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Lawˇtaˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe a ciˉ taˇ te tcuh laˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaw oˇ ve vuiˇ jaˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˬ htaˇ ka‸ luˬ ve sheˆ ve ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nyi sheˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo venˇ ehˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ haˆ haˆ kʼai ve kʼo, teˇ hkui ceh tiˉ gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ venˇ ehˉ oˇ ve lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpaw-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ kʼai tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te luˬ piˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ tuˬ nawˬ haˆ haˆ kʼai loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˬ ve ceh ceh ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Lawˇtaˍ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ ehˉ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Zawˇraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Lawˇtaˍ yawˇ Zawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ nyi htawˇ tawˆ la peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ leh ma‸ shiˉ ce la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Lawˇtaˍ miˇ ma lehˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpfuhˆ nyi ve pa taw, aˉ leh‸ hkuiˉ daw hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ hkʼe teˇ nyi, Aˍbraˍhanˍ teˇ na‸ tu leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hpawˇ lo yawˇ nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh lonˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ naˆ dawˇ lonˉ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ lonˉ chi ve nyiˇ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve pa taw, Lawˇtaˍ hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw pon piˇ ve yoˬ.

Lawˇ taˍ lehˬ Zawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ caˉ chehˇ tuˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Zawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaw-e leh, haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa chi lehˬ mawˇ la peuˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca heuˆ laˇ paˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Laˬ-o‸, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a pa hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ taw piˇ leh yawˇ geh ca lo‸ zuh‸-a veuˬ. A pa hta‸ cuˇ leh chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ cawˬ la piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ taw piˇ leh, awˬ viˉ ma teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pa geh ca lo‸ zuh‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ pa lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ.
