Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi awˬ viˉ ma lehˬ awˬ nyi ma geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, Aˉ nyi haˉ ngaˬ a pa geh ca lo‸ zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ puiˉ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ kʼaw‸ taw piˇ shaˍ. Peuˬ kʼo, nawˬ yawˇ geh ca lo‸ zuh‸ mehˍ. A pa hta‸ cuˇ leh oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ ka‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pa hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ kʼaw‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pa geh ca lo‸ zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ pa lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ.
Hkʼe te leh, Lawˇtaˍ ve yaˇ miˇ chi ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ pa taw yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ ma teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ paˍ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Mawˇbaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Beˍnaˍmiˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, Maˍreˍ lo tu leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Kaˍdeˍshaˆ leh Shuˇraˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Geˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Geˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Saˍraˇ hta‸ ca shiˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ heuˆ ve pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ chi awˬ paˇ lo kʼai maˇ haˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ awˬ to ka‸, yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ miˇ chi htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yoˬ, nawˬ kanˉ chi hta‸ te htaˇ, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ htawˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yaˇ miˇ chi yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ teˇ na‸ tu leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ te keunˍ maˇ te cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ tawn hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ yuˬ kʼai la puiˉ-aˆ, teh‸ dawˇ ve pa taw chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi ma ka‸ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ e caˉ yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ heuˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ-e tcuh laˇ leh, mvuhˇ hkʼoˆ miˬ hkʼoˆ ca te toˇ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ awˬ pon te laˇ tuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo kʼai htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ yawˬ, nuˇ leh awˬ ceˬ maˇ maˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chehˇ gaˇ kuiˬ lo ca chehˇ loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍraˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tsuhˇ laˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpu teˇ hinˉ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui yaˇ ehˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hta‸ pa taw, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Saˍraˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ a sha‸ mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍraˇ yaˇ hu leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ yawˇ hta‸ Iˉcaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hiˉ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yawˇ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ paw la htaˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve a sha‸ teˇ ha hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Saˍraˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ leh gʼuiˬ yawˬ tuˬ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ geh teˇ geh gʼuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi kʼo, ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ca hto piˇ taˍ ve le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ mawˇ la htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ chi uiˍ la leh cuˉ hpaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw Haˍgaˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Saˍraˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ geh leˍ guiˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ Saˍraˇ gʼa mawˬ leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ ceˬ ma chi ve leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ loˬ. Awˬ ceˬ ma chi ve yaˇ leh ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ teˇ geh awˬ shinˉ pehˬ yuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ tawˇ chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉshaˍmeˍ laˆ htawˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve nyi ma hpeh‸ bawˬ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Saˍraˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉcaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh caˇ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ yuˬ leh Haˍgaˍraˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca te toˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ peuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ suhˆ buiˇ teˇ maˬ awˬ hawˉ lo teh taˉ leh, ngaˇ chi loˬ hkʼe vuiˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca jo mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ suh-e ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ Haˍgaˍraˆ geh laˬ leh, Haˍgaˍraˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te dawˇ haˍ ve le. Taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Tu leh yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw piˇ leh, nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼai leh aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi ve geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ uiˍ la leh, Paˍranˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh, cheuˬ jaˇ ve shaˍ bawˆ paˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca shiˍ veu laˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ ka piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Hpiˇkawˇ laˆ hui Aˍbraˍhanˍ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shaˉ caˆ maˇ luˬ tuˬ hkanˍ leh ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ yeˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ leh, chi beu‸ nawˬ ca chehˇ la ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ shaˉ caˆ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai ve awˬ lawn Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, A shu teˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe ca te taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Nawˬ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ htaˇ heh‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yawˬ leh nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ teˇ kaˬ lo leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chi hkʼe te taˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi htaˇ,
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, Nanˬbawˍ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ duˇ taˍ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˬ ehˉ chi ve suhˍ hkeh hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ huiˉ maˬ chi hkʼe shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ hkʼaw ka ti‸ te da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆmaˍ lehˆ leh Hpiˇkawˇlaˆ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo ma‸ kehˇ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ ti leh co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maw chaweh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Aˍbraˍ hanˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ geh teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh nawˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Mawˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai-o. Oˇ kaˬ ngaˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ suhˆ tsuh‸ taˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ shiˍ veuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼaw hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ piˉ laˬ hta‸ sheh leh choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e shaˍ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui taˉ peuˬ kʼo, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ geh kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ leh aˉ hte‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉcaˆ kʼoˆ ve, A pa-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh suhˆ leh aˬ miˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te leh suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ leh suhˆ hpoˆ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ teh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve aˉ hte‸ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ juˆ-a teh‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, Aˍbraˍ hanˍ-oˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ nawˬ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te. Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve htawˇ, maˇ sheˉ lai leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ chiˇ nyi leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh awˬ puiˍ taˆ hkʼaw hkanˉ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ca yuˬ leh yawˇ yaˇ paˍ awˬ tan Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ ve, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve htawˇ, maˇ sheˉ lai leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ maˇ na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw hkoˆ cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh ya‸-e leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Miˆlaˍhkaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Naˍhkawˍ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ hiˉ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Aˍbraˍhanˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Uˇ yaˆ, Buˇ yaˆ, Aˍranˍ ve awˬ pa Keˍmo-eˍlaˆ,
Keˍsehˆ, Haˍzawˇ, Piˇlaˍdaˍshaˆ, Yiˆdaˍlaˆ leh Reˍbehˆka‸ ve awˬ pa Beˍtuˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ chi ve hiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ Miˆlaˍhkaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Naˍhkawˍ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Naˍhkawˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma i Ruˇmaˍ htawˇ, Naˍhkawˍ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ Teˍbaˆ, Gaˍhanˍ, Taˍhaˍshaˆ leh Maˍhkaˍ hui hta‸ paw la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Saˍraˇ a sha‸ 127 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh,
Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw suh-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tu leh, Hiˇtiˆ chaw hui geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ peˆ hawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve chaw tuˍ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ca leuˆ nyi leh, da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo, nawˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve kʼo,

Zawˇhaˍ ve yaˇ Eˇhpaˍronˍ ve miˬguiˬ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Maˆpeˍlaˆ haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ hawˇ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ chaw tuˍ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ gʼa tuˬ, keunˍ da‸ cawˇ da‸ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍronˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Hiˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve teˇ peˆ leh haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ awˬ paˆ chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo ca tuˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh Eˇhpaˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo ca tuˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ piˇ laˇ ve hpu hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍronˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve,
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, miˬguiˬ chi ve lehˬ awˇ ha hteh‸ ceh tiˉ hpfuhˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Nawˬ miˇ ma hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo ca tuˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh, tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpu 400 hteh‸ gʼaw leh Eˇhpaˍronˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Maˍreˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Maˆpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve teˇ tawn hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ leh suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve Hiˇtiˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, miˬguiˬ leh haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw geh vuiˬ taˍ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve chaw tuˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ miˇ ma ca piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ ca leh,

ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ca veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkanˍ leh ka ti‸ te tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh ngaˬ ve pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼu hawˉ lo keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceˬ paˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ geh mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw maˇ laˬ gaˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ka‸ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa shiˍ kʼo‸-e.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e laˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ chi ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ, ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ miˇ ma ca gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai tcuh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve nawˬ geh maˇ laˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve chi hta‸ nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa shiˍ kʼo‸-e, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼu hawˉ keu leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ chi hkeh hta‸ gʼa‸ veu leh Naˍhkawˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la hpawˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ nanˬ bawˍ lo iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo la ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo yawˇ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ zuh‸ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hta‸ biˇ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ awˬ bon a ciˉ te piˇ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nanˬ bawˍ chi awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, venˇ hkʼaw ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, Nawˬ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ Iˉ caˆ awˬ pon leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, Dawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve kaˍ laˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tcuh sheˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ awˬ bon te piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ bon lawˬ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˬ ka‸, Reˍbehˆka‸ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ taˆ veu laˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Naˍhkawˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nanˬ bawˍ lo ya‸-e leh, yawˇ ve aˉ moˆ kʼoˍ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kʼaw‸ taˆ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, Nawˬ ve aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ dawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ ve aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nawˬ ve ka laˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ nanˬ bawˍ lo kʼaw‸ ya‸-e leh iˉ kaˆ ca kʼaw‸ hkʼo veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hkeh le le hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa bvuhˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ca te la ve kanˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ, maˇ ga laˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ dawˬ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve shi la‸ peˍ teˇ maˬ leh, shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ a shu ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ puiˉ ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ca haˉ la hpeh‸ aw laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Naˍhkawˬ leh Miˆlaˍhkaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw chi gʼawˇ leh awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui geh ca haˉ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkui tcuhˉ teh oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh,

Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ bon te laˇ chehˇ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui ve yehˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Reˍbehˆka‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve la‸ peˍ leh la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, chaw oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ ma Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ chaw oˇ ve geh nanˬ bawˍ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, nanˬ bawˍ paˇ lo yawˇ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve chaw-oˬ, aˉ hkʼaw lo laˬ-o‸. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo huˉ chehˇ ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ chehˇ kuiˬ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi gʼawˇ leh awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh chaw oˇ ve leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkui sheh tsuhˇ tuˬ iˉ kaˆ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ htawˇ gu leh yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ sheˬ ve ceh ceh, caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ caˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo chi beu‸ kʼoˆ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ bon maˇ maˇ na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸, hpu, shi, awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma, kaˍlaˍoˆ leh piˉ laˬ maˇ maˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma Saˍraˇ a sha‸ mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ shinˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼa ti‸ te leh hkanˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ miˇ ma ca piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ taˇ ca.
Ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pon ca veu laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ geh maˇ laˬ gaˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ geh kʼai tcuh leh nawˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon, ngaˬ pa ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa ca shiˍ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh gaˬ leh, yawˇ hui yaˇ miˇ maˇ piˇ laˇ ve htawˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ chi hta‸ nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nanˬ bawˍ lo gaˬ la leh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hta‸ a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nanˬ bawˍ chi ve awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo la ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ geh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yaˇ awˬ pon nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ bon lawˬ maˇ peuˬ sheˬ ka‸, Reˍbehˆka‸ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ taˆ veu laˇ leh iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ lehˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ ve aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ chiˇ ya‸ leh, Dawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ dawˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸, Nawˬ a shu ve yaˇ miˇ le, teh‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ lehˬ Naˍhkawˍ leh Miˆlaˍhkaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ shi la‸ peˍ leh shi la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ miˇ ma ca gʼa tuˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ cawˬ leh awˬ bon te piˇ tuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼoˆ laˇ sheˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te gaˇ ve kʼo ka‸, oˇ hkʼe a ciˉ kʼoˆ laˇ sheˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ leh Beˍtuˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Kanˉ chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Reˍbehˆka‸ awˬ to choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai-o. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yaˇ paˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkui tcuhˉ teh leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yuˬ laˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ htawˇ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh gu taˍ ve caˇ tu‸ hta‸ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ yawˇ hui tu la htaˇ, Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Reˍbehˆka‸ ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ chi ngaˬ hui geh teˇ chi nyi hkʼe chehˇ taˉ piˇ sheˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui shiˍ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ gʼawˬ tiˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ geh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te kʼo yaˇ miˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na nyi shaˍ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ la naˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ yawˇ hui geh kʼai yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Yoˬ, ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Reˍbehˆka‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hta‸ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw moˍ chaw cuˇ lonˉ ve awˬ e hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Reˍbehˆka‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ kaˍlaˍoˆ ciˇ leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉ caˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve nanˬbawˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ laˬ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw ca toˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼoˆ ya‸-e leh, Oˇ kaˬ ngaˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le, teh‸ awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ paˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ uˉ nyiˉ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ te taˉ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ caˆ lehˬ Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw shiˍ lo‸-e leh yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ e suh-e leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, Keˍtuˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh Ziˆmaˍranˍ, Yoˆshanˍ, Meˍdanˍ, Meˇdiˍanˍ, Iˉshaˍbehˆ leh Shuˇ-aˍ hui paw la ve yoˬ.
Yoˆshanˍ lehˬ, Sheˍbaˆ leh Deˍdanˍ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Deˍdanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍshuˆrenˍ, Leˍtuˆshenˍ leh Lunˍmenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍ, Eˇhpeˍraˆ, Eˇnawˆ, Aˍbiˆdaˆ leh Eˇlaˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Keˍtuˇraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ geh lo paw la taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ca chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ a sha‸ 175 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ leh Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Maˍreˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw Zawˇhaˍ ve yaˇ Eˇhpaˍronˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Maˆpeˍlaˆ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ awˬ paˇ lo ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw geh Aˍbraˍhanˍ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ maˇ na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ caˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve nanˬ bawˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw Haˍgaˍraˆ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Naˍbaˍyoˆ, Keˍdaˍ, Aˍdaˆbeˍlaˆ, Miˆbaˍsanˍ,
Miˆshaˍmaˆ, Duˇmaˍ, Maˍsaˆ,
Haˍdaˆ, Teˍmaˆ, Yeˍruˇraˆ, Naˍhpiˇshaˆ leh Keˍdaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ leh, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh yuˬ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ a sha‸ 137 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.

Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw, Haˍviˇlaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Shuˇraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ gʼa chehˇ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ a sha‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍranˍ chaw, Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ, Laˍbanˍ ve awˬ viˉ ma Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, Iˉcaˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ leh, Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ yaˇ hu la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw gʼaˇ hte‸ hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ Reˍbehˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw chaw ceuˬ lonˉ nyiˇ ceuˬ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ geh maˇ cawˇ da‸ puiˉ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu teˇ gʼaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ paˍ lehˬ awˬ nyi paˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yaˇ paw tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ cehˬ kʼa paw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ shaˍ nyiˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh, awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ mvuh buiˇ-ehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsawˇ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ viˉ paˍ ve hkui kʼawˍ lehˍ hta‸ vawˆ leh tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ paw la ve teˇ yanˇ Iˉcaˆ a sha‸ 60 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ chi ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh, Iˉsawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve shaˍ bawˆ paˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo tiˉ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ gaˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ shaˍ bawˆ caˍ piˇ puiˉ ve pa taw, awˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ nawˆ shiˍ awˍ chiˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsawˇ shaˍ ca bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˍ meu‸ jaˇ leh, Ngaˬ heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ te chehˇ ve awˍ chiˇ gʼuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Eˇdonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Yaˇ paˍ uiˍ ve aˉ yaˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ piˇ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ maˇ taw laˇ, teh‸ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ awˬ meu‸ ve suh la yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ aˉ yaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ka ti‸ maˇ te laˇ sheˬ ve ceh ceh ngaˬ maˇ taw laˇ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsawˇ ka ti‸ te leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ aˉ yaˇ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Iˉsawˇ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ leh nawˆ shiˍ awˬ chiˇ gʼuiˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ htawˇ caˇ peuˬ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ aˉ yaˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉcaˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo taˇ kʼai. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ pa Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉcaˆ lehˬ Geˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma awˬ lawn ca na nyi la leh, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ la ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ yanˇ a ciˉ maw chaweh chehˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw nyi peu leh, Iˉcaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ boˆ nu chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Chi lehˬ nawˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ nyi ma teh‸ kʼoˆ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Iˉcaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ miˇ ma yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ gʼa suh la ve hta‸ dawˇ haˍ ve pa taw chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ geh ca zuh‸-e ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi hpaˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw hkʼa ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw muiˬ caˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ ha pun gʼa gʼeu‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˬ te shaˬ paw sha la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh lo yawˬ, nuˇ leh awˬ ceˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve pa taw Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ duˇ taˉ ve nanˬ bawˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ je‸ kʼaw‸ yaˆ keu leh te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Iˉcaˆ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh, Geˍraˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉcaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui je‸ duˇ keu leh te luˬ taˍ ve nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ meh piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ meh kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉ caˆ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nanˬ bawˍ kʼaw‸ duˇ leh iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Geˍraˆ chaw yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, Nanˬbawˍ chi ngaˬ hui ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Iˉcaˆ ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉcaˆ lehˬ nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve hta‸, Ya‸ da‸ ve nanˬbawˍ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉcaˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ nu ve nanˬbawˍ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ duˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve pa taw, nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Canˇ paˍ nanˬbawˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh awˬ nu ve nanˬbawˍ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ duˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve pa taw, nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Ponˬ ve nanˬbawˍ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ peuˬ. Choˬ ka‸ lo ngaˬ hui uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai leh, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉcaˆ oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo aˉ po kʼo te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ duˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ Aˍhuˇzaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Hpiˇkawˇlaˆ hta‸ shiˍ leh Iˉcaˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ laˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi bawˬ leh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ geh Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te da‸ taˍ cawˇ hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ya‸. Nawˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ htawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ca ya‸ la tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ sheˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉcaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka ti‸ te da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Iˉcaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui iˉ kaˆ tawˆ ve nanˬ bawˍ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ duˇ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve hta‸, Shaˉ caˆ nanˬbawˍ, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve venˇ hta‸ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw Beˍriˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Juˇdiˆ leh Eˇlonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Baˍseˍmaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Iˉcaˆ leh Reˍbehˆka‸ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ yanˇ Iˉcaˆ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, mehˆ maˇ mawˬ-o. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ htawˇ, Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ mawˇ la peuˬ. Maˇ maw maw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ve hkaˆ taˆ veu leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shaˍ ca bawˆ hkʼa nyi.
Shaˍ gʼa ve kʼo ngaˬ caˇ mehˬ ve awˍ chiˇ hkʼa deh‸ te leh, ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ, Iˉcaˆ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ jaˆ na taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shaˍ ca bawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ,
Reˍbehˆka‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ pa nawˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh,

Ngaˬ maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shaˍ ca bawˆ veu laˇ leh ngaˬ caˇ mehˬ ve awˍ chiˇ te veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˉ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o.
Chi beu‸ aˉ che‸ hpehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, da‸ ve aˉ che‸ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa caˇ mehˬ puiˉ ve awˍ chiˇ hkʼa deh‸ te piˇ shaˍ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, yawˇ maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ caˇ taˉ leh nawˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ geh yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve awˬ e Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ e-oˬ, Iˉsawˇ lehˬ awˬ mvuh buiˇ-ehˍ cawˬ leh ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˍ leˆ-ehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ shoˆ nyi laˇ leh ngaˬ heˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve kʼo, awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ve a‸ kehˉ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ e kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, hkeu ve oˇ ve ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ e geh yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ pa caˇ mehˬ puiˉ ve awˍ chiˇ hkʼa deh‸ te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Reˍbehˆka‸ lehˬ yawˇ geh lo teh taˍ ve Iˉsawˇ ve da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ awˬ gʼuiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh Yaˍkoˆ ve la‸ sheh leh kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ caw hawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te peuˬ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve mehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ chiˇ leh hkaoˍmonˇ yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh laˬ leh, A pa-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ pa htawˇ, Nawˬ a shu le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Iˉsawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ. Tu mui leh ngaˬ gu taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉcaˆ lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ chi ve hta‸ teˇ hkui tiˉ ca mawˬ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ ca mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉcaˆ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ paˇ neˇ lo jiˆ laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Iˉsawˇ hpeh‸ ve leh naˍ, a ciˉ shoˆ nyi shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉcaˆ yawˇ hta‸ shoˆ nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Tawˇ yaw tawˆ la ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, la‸ sheh lehˬ Iˉsawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh lehˬ, Iˉsawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼa shuˍ awˬ mvuh buiˇ-ehˍ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ awˬ pa maˇ shiˍ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-a teh‸ te htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ Iˉsawˇ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉcaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ nawˬ gu taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ ngaˬ geh yuˬ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ yawˇ geh yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve awˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ paˇ lo jiˆ laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ boˆ nu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉcaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ pe‸ hta‸ nuˬ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ve awˬ pe‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha bon na‸ piˇ ve ti mi awˬ pe‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, caˬ shiˍ caˬ hkʼa leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ maˇ pe‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te leh, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ leh, nawˬ e ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hta‸ hkeu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, bon na‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ peuˬ leh Yaˍkoˆ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsawˇ shaˍ ca bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mehˬ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ gu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh yuˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ gu veu laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Iˉcaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ a shu le, teh‸ na nyi htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Iˉsawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉcaˆ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te kʼo, ya‸ sheh htaˇ ngaˬ geh lo caˇ tuˬ gu veu laˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le. Nawˬ maˇ laˬ sheˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ peuˬ. Awˬ bon oˇ ve yawˇ geh co co cawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ leh, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Iˉ caˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ nyi paˍ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ leh nawˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ caˇ laˇ ve nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shinˉ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ-o laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉcaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh peuˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ caˬ shiˍ caˬ hkʼa leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te laˇ maˇ hpeh‸-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ yawˇ awˬ pa hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ geh awˬ bon teˇ maˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa Iˉcaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˬ pon mvuhˇ naw ma ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ awˬ pon miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ ve ti mi ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Aˉhtaw hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa hu tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ nyi paˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, Iˉsawˇ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa lehˬ suh-e la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve hta‸ Reˍbehˆka‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ Yaˬkoˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Chi beu‸ tu leh ngaˬ nyi paˍ Laˍbanˍ chehˇ kuiˬ Haˍranˍ venˇ lo hpaw-e loˬ.
Nawˬ viˉ paˍ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ jaw ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te mehˉ kʼai piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Reˍbehˆka‸ Iˉcaˆ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Hiˇtiˆ chaw hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve Hiˇtiˆ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ka‸ suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉcaˆ yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇve yoˬ. Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ taˇ heuˆ.
Nawˬ puˍ Beˍtuˍlaˆ chehˇ kuiˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ e ve awˬ nyi paˍ Laˍbanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca nyi heuˆ-e loˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ la piˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ piˇ leh chi beu‸ nawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉcaˆ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ lehˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Laˍbanˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, Aˍranˍ chaw Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Yaˍ koˆ leh Iˉsawˇ hui ve awˬ e Reˍbehˆka‸ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉcaˆ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ miˇ ma ca-e tcuh ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ htaˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh Meˍsoˇ poˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
yawˇ ve awˬ pa Iˉcaˆ lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsawˇ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve yaˇ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Naˍbaˍyoˆ ve awˬ nyi ma Maˍhaˍlaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Haˍranˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ shiˍ gʼawˆ leh uˉ gehˇ te zuh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, miˬguiˬ hta‸ te leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve go lonˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, go lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ zuh‸ chehˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chi hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo biˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ maˇ biˇ la sheˬ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ zuh‸ nawˇ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chehˇ kuiˬ chi lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le. Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ ve yehˬ miˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh, yawˇ uˉ gehˇ te zuh‸ chehˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˍ manˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ Beˍteˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. (Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Luˇzaˆ teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ)
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ leh, ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ,
ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh caˍ laˇ taw laˇ, feuˉ laˇ deh laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ haˉ pui shiˍ duˇ ti taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve awˬ bon hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hta‸ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chiˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo yawˬ shehˆ moˍ zuh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nanˬ bawˍ chi hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ dawˬ tuˬ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, uiˍ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ geh gʼa ga chiˇ jiˆ htaˇ heh‸ yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa ga buiˆ hoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ hui geh gaˬ la leh, Awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Haˍranˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Naˍhkawˍ ve yaˇ Laˍbanˍ hta‸ shiˍ-aw laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˬ, chehˇ sha ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hui geh yawˬ hawˉ la taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ mvuhˇ nyi ka‸ mvuh jaˇ chehˇ sheˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh gʼa‸ hpoˆ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ taˉ leh, maˇ ca kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ hawˉ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ laˬ leh haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ga chiˇ jiˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ maˇ gʼa, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ hui geh tawˇ yaw da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ leh oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Laˍbanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ chiˇ jiˆ leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ leh, mehˆ gʼuiˬ htawˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa ve awˬ viˉ ma Reˍbehˆka‸ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ chi gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh awˬ pa hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ behˇ kʼuˉ taˍ leh boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ htawˇ, Laˍbanˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Laˍbanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ geh lo ha pa teˇ maˬ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Laˍbanˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ga laˇ maˇ cawˇ. Nawˬ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˬ ma lawˬ gaˇ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ geh yaˇ miˇ haˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ ma teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Leˉaˍ hpeh‸ leh awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˉaˍ lehˬ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ da‸. Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Nawˬ yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ maˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ muiˬ laˇ-a, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw hta‸ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, maˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ muiˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, maˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ gʼa muiˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pon maˇ maw sheˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yaˍkoˆ Laˍbanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Nawˬ yaˇ miˇ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Laˍbanˍ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh hkehˉ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, Laˍbanˍ lehˬ yawˇ yaˇ miˇ Leˉ-aˍ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ geh shiˍ laˬ piˇ leh, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
(Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ Leˉ-aˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, Ziˆlaˍpaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.)

Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve Leˉ-aˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Laˍbanˍ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve le. Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ kanˉ te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, awˬ viˉ ma awˬ hpawˇ maˇ heuˆ sheˬ ve kʼo, awˬ nyi ma awˬ hpawˇ heuˆ ve awˬ liˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Hkehˉ caˇ ve pawehˇ chi suhˍ nyi peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ law taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ kanˉ kʼaw‸ te laˇ ve kʼo, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ htawˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ. Hkehˉ caˇ ve pawehˇ oˇ ve suhˍ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Laˍbanˍ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍ laˆ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ Biˇlaˍhaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ geh htawˇ zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Leˉ-aˍ a‸ kehˉ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Laˍbanˍ hta‸ maˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ muiˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˉ-aˍ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ maˇ ha‸ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Leˉ-aˍ hta‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˉ-aˍ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ Ruˇbenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw yawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ leh, yaˇ paˍ chi yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ paˍ chi ve hta‸ Suˉmonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yaˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hpawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Leˍviˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yaˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ yaˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ ma hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ tan te gʼa ve leh laˇ. Nawˬ hta‸ yaˇ paw la tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Biˇlaˍhaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ yaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ leh ngaˬ awˬ e hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Biˇlaˍhaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ htawˇ yawˇ geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
Biˇlaˍhaˍ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Danˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Biˇlaˍhaˍ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ hu la leh, awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ viˉ ma hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ te da‸ leh chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Naˍtaˍliˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˇaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ yaˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Ziˇlaˍpaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Ziˇlaˍpaˆ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Leˇaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ bon da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Gaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ziˇlaˍpaˆ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Leˇaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ jaˇ ve le. Chi beu‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸, Ha lehˬ shehˍ ma, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ Aˍshaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Ruˉbenˍ lehˬ ti mi lo kʼai leh a tcuhˉ leh‸ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ shaˉ veu laˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e Leˇaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Leˇaˍ geh a tcuhˉ leh‸ shiˍ ca lawˬ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Leˇaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve ka‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh sheˬ leh chi teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ve a tcuhˉ leh‸ shiˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai gaˇ sheˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a tcuhˉ leh‸ shiˍ caˍ laˇ ve kʼo, ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ Yaˍkoˆ geh zuh‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Yaˍkoˆ ti mi lo kʼai kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Leˇaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ya‸ puiˉ ngaˬ geh gʼa zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ shaˉ veu laˇ ve a tcuhˉ leh‸ shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ pa taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ Leˇaˍ geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Leˇaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Leˇaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Leˇaˍ yaˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Leˇaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve la‸ shawnˍ piˇ laˇ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ paw la taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ Zaˍbuˆlonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh yawˇ hta‸ Diˉnaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ htawˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ Laˍbanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ maˉ muiˬ leh gʼa taˍ ve ngaˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ shiˍ kʼo‸-e yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na taˍ sheˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ paw sha la peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ ma te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve ceˇ maˇ la peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ geh gaˬ la htaˇ, nawˬ geh ceˇ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ lehˬ nawˬ ve ceˇ maˇ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ yehˬ tanˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa piˇ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ piˇ laˇ tuˬ maˇ loˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe nawˬ te ve kʼo, nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh naˆ-ehˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh ga‸-ehˍ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ kaˬ lo leuˆ teh taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ gʼa cawˇ ve ceˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te taˍ ve pa taw, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, ngaˬ gʼa cawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ga‸-ehˍ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ leh naˆ-ehˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ngaˬ geh lo gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ shawˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ lehˬ ga‸-ehˍ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ awˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ leh, naˆ-ehˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ tawˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ shehˆ nyi vuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ lo ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, cawˬ taˉ ve Laˍbanˍ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve Liˆbaˍnaˍ cehˬ, luˇzaˆ cehˬ leh pfuhˇ cehˬ awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ ca tawˆ veu laˇ leh, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼeh‸ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ, aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ ca dawˬ la kuiˬ lawˇ kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo choˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ ca dawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ shawˍ ca puiˉ ve pa taw yawˇ hui lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo choˆ taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ shawˍ chaw ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ga‸ lehˍ ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ paw la ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ leh, yawˬ awˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga‸ lehˍ cawˬ ve yawˬ awˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpawˇ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa‸ peu ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te leh yawˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ kaˬ lo fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shawˍ chaw ve teˇ yanˇ, choˆ taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kʼaw ji lo awˬ shawˍ chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ dawˬ kuiˬ lawˇ kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo choˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ choˆ piˇ taˍ. Hkʼe te leh, awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ ve ceˇ hpeh‸ la leh, awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve ceˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh lo yawˬ ehˉ aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Laˍbanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui awˬ pa ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ geh hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pa ve mawˇ jeˬ deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇmaˇ te laˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi leh nawˬ pa hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ leh Leˇ-aˍ hta‸ yawˇ ceˇ hawˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kuˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te laˇ-o law. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa hta‸ puiˉ ve hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ chi pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ heˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ.

Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, Ga‸-ehˍ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ gʼa cawˇ ve ceˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, ceˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ga‸-ehˍ ve awˬ yehˇ ceh tiˉ paw la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ gʼa cawˇ ve ceˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve awˬ yehˇ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shawˍ chaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ nyi hkʼa leh, awˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ga‸-ehˍ ve leh awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸, Yaˍkoˆ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ laˇ leh, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,

Chiˇ nyi sheˬ. Awˬ shawˍ chaw chehˇ ve awˬ paˍ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, ga‸-ehˍ ve leh awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ Laˍbanˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ lo nawˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ leh ka ti‸ te ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ geh laˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ paw la kuiˬ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ leh Leˉ-aˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pa geh gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ shinˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw hkʼe shawˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ leh gʼa ve hpu hta‸ htawˇ yehˇ baˬ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa geh Gʼuiˬsha yuˬ hkʼaw‸ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Meˍsoˆpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hkʼa ca gʼa taˍ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ veu leh, yawˇ awˬ pa geh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, yawˬ mvuh nuˆ tuˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ hpaw kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Laˍbanˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Yaˍkoˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa‸ mi ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha Laˍbanˍ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ho piˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Laˍbanˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Laˍbanˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo hpeh gʼa ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ shiˍ kʼai ve le.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto taˉ laˇ leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ hkʼawˇ hpaw-e ve le. Nawˬ hpaw-e tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ awˬ pon pawehˇ te laˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼo‸-e peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ tuˬ ka‸ nawˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ laˇ. Chi lehˬ nawˬ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ gaˇ ve kʼo te laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉ nyi haˉ htaˇ nawˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ho piˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ pa hta‸ nyi ma haˍ jaˇ leh hpaw kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ kʼai ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ taˉ laˇ puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe gʼa te hpaw la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hpfuhˆ nyi-o. Nawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ yuˬ taˍ ve cawˬ kʼo, nawˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ maˇ shiˍ.

Hkʼe te leh, Laˍbanˍ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ, Leˉaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve aˉ po kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca lo‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ ca hpfuhˆ maˇ mawˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ lanˉ hkʼaw ca‸ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Laˍbanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ca hpfuhˆ nyi ve htawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ mawˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tu huˉ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ dawˇ ya‸ laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ kaˬ ka‸ ca hpfuhˆ maˇ mawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ leh ngaˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca gʼa‸ hpfuhˆ nyi la ve ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma venˇbaˆ cawˬ le.

Ngaˬ geh lo nawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼa mawˬ le. Ngaˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ la-o. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui suhˉ jehˬ laˇ piˇ.

Nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ awˬ ma teˇ hkeh ka‸ awˬ yehˇ shawˆ-e ve maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ ve yawˬ awˬ paˍ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ tiˇ caˇ jaw.

Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ pehˍ taˍ ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ka‸, ngaˬ nawˬ geh maˇ gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ jaw. Hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˉ hkanˍ shaiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu hkʼawˇ kʼai ve ceˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ mvuhˇ cha chiˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ciˍ gʼuiˬ nehˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ taˉ peuˬ. Maˇ gʼa zuh‸ ve htawˇ laiˉ pawˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe nyiˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ nawˬ geh chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ leh nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ awˬ ceˬ gʼa te taˉ peuˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ chi pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ heˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ htawˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh maˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ leh ngaˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, aˉ nyi haˉ nawˬ geh laˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Laˍbanˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ miˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ceˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ hpeh‸.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh ka ti‸ te-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh duˇ ti ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ haˉ pui shiˍ gʼawˆ hpoˆ tcuh leh haˉ pui hpoˆ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo yawˇ hui teˇ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍgaˍtaˍhaˍduˍtaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Laˍbanˍ lehˬ, Haˉ pui hpoˆ chi ve ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Giˇlaˆ teh‸ meh ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Miˆsaˍpaˍ teh‸ ka‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Laˍbanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hpaˆ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ leh ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo te taˍ ve haˉ pui hpoˆ chi ve leh duˇ ti taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve hta‸ nyi-o.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ haˉ pui hpoˆ chi ve oˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ haˉ pui hpoˆ chi ve choˬ paˉ hpawˇ lo taˇ laˬ. Haˉ pui hpoˆ chi ve leh, haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve lehˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh Naˍhkawˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo suhˉ jehˬ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, hkʼaw oˇ ve hkʼoˆ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ hui teˇ geh haˉ ve yoˬ.
Laˍbanˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ boˆ nu taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Maˍhaˍnenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ geh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai peu leh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ geh ca hpaw chehˇ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chi beu‸ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh lo nuˇ, piˉlaˬ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ ceˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma sha la tuˬ, ngaˬ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Yaˍkoˆ geh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, Ngaˬ hui nawˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ geh gaˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ chaw awˇ ha gʼaˇ shiˍ leh nawˬ geh laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ kawˆ jaˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw leh yawˇ ve nuˇ, yawˬ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˇ moˍ pehˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ moˍ moˍ hta‸ Iˉsawˇ mawˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, awˬ nu ve teˇ moˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ puˍ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh ngaˬ pa Iˉcaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na laˇ sheˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ leh ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ te laˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkanˍ tawˆ la htaˇ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Juˇ fuiˍ teˇ maˬ ceh cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ geh chaw nyiˇ moˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ maˇ na‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Yaˍkoˆ oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo,
aˉ che‸ awˬ ma 200 hkeh, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ 20 hkeh, yawˬ awˬ ma 200 hkeh, awˬ paˍ 20 hkeh,
cuˉ nyiˉ dawˬ chehˇ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ ma 30 hkeh leh awˬ yehˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, nuˇ ma peuˍ 40 hkeh leh nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 10 hkeh, piˉlaˬ awˬ ma 20 hkeh leh awˬ paˍ 10 hkeh hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh yawˇ leuˆ teh taˍ ve ceˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ te leh awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai taˍ law. Ceˇ teˇ moˍ leh teˇ moˍ awˬ kaˍ lo a ciˉ yanˉ da‸ piˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
