Shu awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ leh, Nawˬ a shu ve chaw le. Hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve le. Nawˬ gʼa‸ toˇ ve ceˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu ve le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ tuˬ feu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ceˇ teˇ moˍ peuˬ teˇ moˍ gʼa‸ kʼai tuˬ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ htawˇ, Iˉsawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ oˇ hkʼe ceh tiˉ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ ka‸, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ ngaˬ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ feu kʼai taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ nyi ma sha la leh ngaˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo feu kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ haˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Yaˍkoˆ tu leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ leh yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ behˇ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ behˇ maˇ gʼaˇ taˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yaˍkoˆ ve pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu hta‸ dawˆ piˇ leh, Yaˍkoˆ ve pfuhˍ tcuhˉ jiˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ na‸ laˇ ve ceh ceh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma meh ve le, teh‸ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Yaˍkoˆ meh ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ chaw yaˇ hta‸ ka‸ behˇ da‸ leh gʼaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸, Nawˬ ve awˬ meh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ na ve le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Peˍniˍlaˆhi teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ sheˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Peˍniˍlaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, mvuhˇ nyi htawˇ tawˆ la peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ pfuhˍ tcuhˉ jiˆ sheˬ ve pa taw, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼa deh‸ juˇ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼu hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te dawˆ heuˆ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼu shaˍ hta‸ maˇ caˇ.

Yaˍkoˆ chiˇ nyi leh, Iˉsawˇ lehˬ chaw 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh yawˇ geh laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Leˇ-aˍ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ shiˍ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˇ-aˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ shiˍ leh shu hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh leh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ awˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ behˇ kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsawˇ chiˇ nyi leh yaˇ miˇ leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ geh te toˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ ma oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˇaˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ htawˇ laˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ sheh htaˇ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ moˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ nyi ma sha tuˬ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nyi paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ geh htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ceˇ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼe taˇ kʼoˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma sha la peuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ piˇ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lawˬ hkawˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, Iˉsawˇ htawˇ la‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ lehˬ, Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ i jaˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ yehˇ ehˉ hta‸ cuˉ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ nyi tiˉ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ kʼai ve kʼo, hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai taˍ law. Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh ceˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo nawˬ geh gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh a yehˉ yehˉ gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te kʼo nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh teh taˉ laˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi taw taw awˬ bon te laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Iˉsawˇ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Suˇkoˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon chehˇ kui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ te leh oˇ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Suˇkoˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo aˉ po kʼo te leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ aˉ po kʼo te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Sheˍhkenˍ ve awˬ pa Haˍmawˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh hpu teˇ ha hteh‸ piˇ leh vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇleˍlawˇ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Leˇ-aˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Diˉnaˆ lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca guiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve Hiˇviˆ chaw Haˍmawˍ ve yaˇ Sheˍ hkenˍ lehˬ, Diˉnaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Diˉnaˆ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ gʼa tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ beˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍhkenˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa Haˍmawˍ geh laˬ leh, Yaˇ miˇ chi ngaˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ la tuˬ ca lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍhkenˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Diˉnaˆ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ceˇ ca hawˉ kʼai taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la sheˬ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te leh law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sheˍhkenˍ ve awˬ paˍ Haˍmawˍ Yaˍkoˆ geh laˬ leh awˬ lawn chi yawˇ geh ca jehˬ da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ miˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ te luˬ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Haˍmawˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sheˍhkenˍ lehˬ nawˬ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca lawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ da‸ tcuh leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬhkʼaw nawˬ hui chehˇ gaˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍhkenˍ htawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa lawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ chi ve awˬ hpfuhˇ leh la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma lawˬ gaˇ ka‸ lawˬ-o‸. Yaˇ miˇ chi ve ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍhkenˍ yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve pa taw, Yaˍ koˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Haˍmawˍ leh Sheˍhkenˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi ma piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ te leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.)
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ huiˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ Haˍmawˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sheˍhkenˍ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍmawˍ leh Sheˍhkenˍ lehˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh leh yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te tcuh piˇ-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ka‸ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ da‸ tcuh-a veuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa shuˍ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ htaˇ heh‸, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Haˍmawˍ leh Sheˍhkenˍ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ leh hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ naˬ jaˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Diˉnaˆ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Suˉmonˍ leh Leˍviˆ lehˬ, aˉhtaw teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ pfuhˇ veu leh venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Haˍmawˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sheˍhkenˍ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, Diˉnaˆ hta‸ Sheˍhkenˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve pa taw, Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ti mi hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yawˬ, nuˇ, piˉ laˬ leh venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ yawˇ hui ve yaˇ miˇ, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ Suˉmonˍ leh Leˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍ naˍniˆ chaw leh Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh lo chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw shawˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ tu leh Beˍteˍlaˆ lo ca chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Iˉsawˇ geh nawˬ hpaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ geh laˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ ca te-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ leh yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-oˬ. Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ htaiˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh, ngaˬ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ ca te tuˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ lo ngaˬ hui gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ geh cawˬ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ leh naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo duˇ tuˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ maˇ haˆ.
Yaˍkoˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Luˇzaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ viˉ paˍ geh hpaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Diˍboˇraˍ suh-e leh Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ hawˉ paˉ maˉkuˇ cehˬ hawˉ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Paˆ hawˬ kuiˬ maˉkuˇ cehˬ teh‸ meh ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ meh lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kuˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ geh awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ geh lo awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la leh, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ duˇ ti leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˍ manˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ Beˍteˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Beˍteˍlaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paw tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la leh gʼoˇ peˬ naˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Beˍnawˇni teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Beˍyaˍmenˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Raˍhkeˍlaˆ suh-e leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi beu‸ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Eˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˬkoˆ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ duˇ ti ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Raˍhkeˍ laˆ ve tuˍ hpfuh cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh Miˆdaˍlaˆ Eˍdaˍ coˇ paˇ hpawˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Ruˇbenˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i Biˇlaˍhaˍ geh ca zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ gʼa kaˇ leh nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Leˉaˍ geh paw la taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Suˉmonˍ, Leˍviˆ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, leh Zaˍbuˆlonˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Raˍhkeˍlaˆ geh paw la taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Biˇlaˍhaˍ geh paw la taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Danˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˉaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Ziˆlaˍpaˆ geh paw la taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gaˆ leh Aˍshaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Maˍreˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 180 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ
suh-e leh, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Iˉsawˇ leh Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw Eˇlonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍdaˆ, Hiˇviˆ chaw Ziˆbonˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ,
leh Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Naˍbaˍyoˆ ve awˬ nyi ma Baˍshaˍmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Aˍdaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˇhpaˆ hpeh‸ leh Baˍshaˍmaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ lehˬ, Yo-eˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇshaˆ, Yaˍlanˍ, Kawˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve Iˉsawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve ceˇ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yaˍkoˆ geh tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ceˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, teˇ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsawˇ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Aˍdaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˇhpaˆ hpeh‸ lehˬ yawˇ miˇ ma Baˍshaˍmaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ lehˬ, Yo-eˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Teˍmanˍ, Awˇmaˍyaˆ, Zeˍhpawˇ, Gaˍtanˍ leh Keˍnaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇhpaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i Tiˉmaˍnaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍmaˍlehˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yo-eˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Naˍhaˆ, Zeˍraˆ, Shaˍmaˆ leh Miˆzaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˆbonˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ, Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yuˇshaˆ, Yaˍlanˍ leh Kawˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Eˇliˇhpaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Teˍmanˍ, Awˇmaˍyaˆ, Zeˍhpawˇ, Keˍnaˆ,
Gaˍtanˍ leh Aˍmaˍlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Aˍdaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsawˇ ve yaˇ Yo-eˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Naˍhaˆ, Zeˍraˆ, Shaˍ maˆ leh Miˆzaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Baˍshaˍmaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ miˇ ma Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ geh paw la ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yuˇshaˆ, Yaˍlanˍ leh Kawˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw keuˆ tawˆ la ve Hawˇriˆ ve chaw Siˇraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Lawˇtanˍ, Shawˉbaˆlaˆ, Ziˆbonˍ, Aˍnaˆ,
Diˉshonˍ, Eˇzaˍ leh Diˉshanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Lawˇtanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Hawˇriˆ leh Heˍmanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Lawˇtanˍ ve awˬ nyi ma lehˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Shawˉbaˆlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍlaˍgʼonˍ, Maˍnaˍhaˆ, Eˇbaˍlaˆ, Sheˍhpawˇ leh Awˇnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˆbonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍyaˆ leh Aˍnaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Aˍnaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa ve piˉlaˬ hta‸ hawˉ chehˇ htaˇ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo punˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca mawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Diˉshonˍ leh Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Diˉshonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Heˍdanˍ, Eˇshaˍbanˍ, Iˉtaˍranˍ leh Hkeˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇzaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Biˇlaˍhaˍ, Zaˍgʼonˍ leh Aˍkanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Diˉshanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Uˇzaˆ leh Aˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Hawˇriˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Lawˇtanˍ, Shawˉbaˆlaˆ, Ziˆbonˍ, Aˍnaˆ,
Diˉshonˍ, Eˇzaˍ leh Diˉshanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˬ htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Diˇhaˍbaˍ venˇ yaˇ Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Beˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ yaˇ Zeˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇbaˆ, Teˍmanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ Huˆshanˍ, Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve Aˍiˆ venˇ yaˇ Beˍdiˆ ve yaˇ Haˍdiˆ, Maˍtaˍrehˆ venˇ yaˇ Saˍmaˍlaˆ, Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo chehˇ ve Yaˍhawˇboˆ venˇ yaˇ Sawˇlu‸, Aˍhkaˍbawˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlaˆhaˍnanˍ, Haˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Pawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ Meˍyaˍhaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Maˍtaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Haˍheˍtaˆbeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Iˉsawˇ geh lo ya‸ la taˍ ve Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ, Aˍlaˍvaˆ, Yeˍtehˆ, Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ, Eˇlaˍ, Piˇnonˍ, Keˍnaˆ, Teˍmanˍ, Miˆbaˍzaˍ, Maˍgaˍdeˍlaˆ leh Eˇranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ meh yuˬ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa chehˇ kuiˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ a sha‸ teˇ chi suhˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i Biˇlaˍhaˍ leh Ziˇlaˍpaˆ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh ceˇ hawˉ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui te ve maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ pa hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ mawˇ la htaˇ heh‸ yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ gʼa ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ yawˇ leuˉ leh ha‸ ve yoˬ. Chi pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ aˉ po‸ zuhˬ maˬ tawˉ feuˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ leuˉ leh ha‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ leh shawˍ baˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ mawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ shaˍ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ti mi hkʼaw caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuh‸ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve caˬ kʼa‸ lehˬ hteˇ lehˬ huˉ sheˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve caˬ kʼa‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ ga hpoˆ pui ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te leh gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ ve leh, yawˇ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ nyi bawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ chi teˇ shiˍ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ htawˇ hto piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve chi hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Ngaˬ leh nawˬ e maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh deˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ceˇ ca hawˉ tuˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo ceˇ ca hawˉ kʼai taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ awˬ pa lehˬ, Kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ viˉ paˍ hui chehˇ sha chehˇ leh naˍ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh naˍ, ca nyi taˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma ca toˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi toˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ceˇ hkʼaˬ lo hawˉ chehˇ ve nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui Dawˇtanˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, Dawˇtanˍ venˇ paˇ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ paˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ leh naˍ law nyi taˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Ruˇbenˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ tawˍ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ.

Naˬ tuˬ ka‸ taˇ te piˇ. Choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ chi ve hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ keu piˇ taˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu gaˇ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ deh taˍ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma oˇ ve hta‸ kʼehˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ nanˬbawˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nanˬbawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui awˍ caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ chaw tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh sha hawnˉ leh suhˆ tcuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼoˆ taˆ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo tu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh faˉ taˍ ve lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.

Yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hawˇ piˇ-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyiˇ chi hteh‸ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ruˇbenˍ lehˬ nanˬbawˍ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ nyi leh Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ paˍ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ chehˇ-o law. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh yawˇ hui aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa geh yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui aˉ po‸ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve nawˬ yaˇ paˍ ve aˉ po‸ maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ve aˉ po‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ yawˇ hta‸ che‸ caˇ peuˬ. Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ tzuh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha la tuˬ ga hpoˆ te piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ nyi ma sha la maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Pawˇtiˇhpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, Hiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Aˍduˆlanˍ venˇ yaˇ geh ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw Shuˇ-aˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh yawˇ hta‸ Eˇraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh yawˇ hta‸ Awˇnanˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh yawˇ hta‸ Sheˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve paw la htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ lehˬ Aˍhkaˍziˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇraˆ awˬ pon, Taˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ ve yoˬ
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇraˆ lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve pa taw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Awˇnanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ viˉ paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ viˉ paˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˇnanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ yaˇ gʼa ve htawˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ teh‸ maˇ gʼa shawˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh ca zuh‸ ve teˇ pawˆ le le yawˇ ve awˬ yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ keu piˇ. Miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo sheˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yuˬ hkʼaw‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sheˍlaˆ uiˍ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ pa ve yehˬ hkʼaw mehˇchawˇma ca te chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ Sheˍlaˆ htawˇ suh-e la ve hta‸ Yuˇda‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Taˍmaˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw la htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma htawˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ Aˍduˆlanˍ venˇ yaˇ Hiˇraˆ geh teˇ geh yawˬ mvuh ca nuˆ tuˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Taˍmaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ yawˬ mvuh nuˆ tuˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ uˉ nyiˉ teˇ maˬ yuˬ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw ceh lo ca mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi teˇ yanˇ Sheˍ laˆ uiˍ la peuˬ ve htawˇ yawˇ awˬ puˍ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ tcuh ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ uˉ nyiˉ beh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo kʼai leh, Nawˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˬ ma lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.) Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma piˇ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hkeh piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˉ che‸ ehˉ oˇ ve maˇ piˇ laˇ sheˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ, shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ piˇ taˍ laˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve mawˇ gʼa piˇ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ leh nawˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ taˉ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ leh yawˇ geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Taˍmaˍ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh uˉ nyiˉ kʼehˆ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mehˇchawˇma ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ veuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ taˉ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ pa hkʼaw‸ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ Hiˆranˍ hta‸ aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hkeh piˇ leh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Hiˆranˍ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Choˬ kaˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo mui chehˇ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Choˬ kaˬ lo meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Yuˇda‸ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ ve awˬ lawn leh, oˇ kaˬ lo meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ meh ka‸ maˇ luˬ tcuh gaˇ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ha pa shehˆ maˬ hkʼe gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma Taˍmaˍ lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, yawˇ yaˇ hu taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn shu Yuˇda‸ hta‸ ca hto piˇ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Shu yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Taˍmaˍ lehˬ kʼaw‸ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ leh juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ geh yuˬ kʼai tcuh leh, Mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ. Mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nyi-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ te ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sheˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ tcuh ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh maˇ kʼaw‸ zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Taˍmaˍ yaˇ paw yanˇ gaˬ la leh, yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paw la ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che tawˆ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma lehˬ, Chi ve teˇ gʼaˇ awˉ lawˉ tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ nyiˉ-ehˍ ve gʼo‸ hkeh yuˬ hpeh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ chi lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaw‸ sheˬ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ paw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Nawˬ awˉ lawˉ pe‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ Hpaˍrehˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼo‸ hkeh nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh taˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Zeˍraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Pawˇtiˆhpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Yoˇseh‸ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ leh, yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Pawˇtiˆhpaˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ pa taw Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Pawˇtiˆhpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ caˇ ve caˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma yawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ leh, yawˇ geh ca zuh‸ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ lawn dawˇ nyi sheˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi-o. Yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, yehˬ chi hkʼaw ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma lehˬ, teˇ nyi le le yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe tiˉ ca kʼoˆ la ve htawˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ geh maˇ ca zuh‸ piˇ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yehˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ kanˉ te tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ ma lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ tcuhˆ tiˍ taˍ leh, Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ geh ca zuh‸ la, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve hta‸ yehˬ shehˍ ma gʼa mawˬ htaˇ,

yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui-o, haˆ nyi la-o. Ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ ca teh taˍ ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw chi lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ geh ca zuh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ geh lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ shiˍ teh taˍ ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ hpeh leh jawˇmawˇ ve htawnˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Yoˇseh‸ geh chehˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve pa taw, htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ htawnˍ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw te tuˬ cawˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, htawnˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ nyi-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha Yoˆseh‸ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ chaw chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh,
yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ htawˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve a ciˉ maw la peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, zuh‸ maˆ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ nawˍ lehˍ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ kʼoˆ ma laˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw, awˬ kʼaˉ shehˆ kʼaˉ cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ te hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkui gaˬ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpa‸ naw‸ la leh awˬ veˆ veˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ naw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ ve kawˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ leh kawˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw nyiˉ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca taw piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve shehˆ kʼaˉ lehˬ, shehˆ nyi hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ te jaw ve kanˉ awˬ piˍ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ chiˇ taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ kanˉ awˬ piˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ leh, ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ-e tuˬ a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu nyiˉ hpeh veu laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ zuh‸ maˆ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh law‸ law‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ gʼa ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ htawˇ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ hpuˉ-ehˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ keu taˍ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ shehˆ shiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hta‸ leh leh ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ caˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ laiˉ ceuˬ keu taˍ leh, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˆ caˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve shehˆ shiˍ lehˬ, shehˆ nyi hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh, suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ ga hpoˆ htawˆ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼo piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ shehˆ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ paw nyi kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve pa taw, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw shehˍ hpaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve kanˉ awˬ piˍ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ-o. Yawˇ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe ponˬ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw da‸ jaˇ chu jaˇ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ suhˍ hkeh tawˆ la leh, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˉ jaˇ leh a ciˉ ka‸ nyi maˇ sha ve nuˇ ma peuˍ suhˍ hkeh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh,
awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tawˆ la taˍ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ oˇ ve suhˍ hkeh hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ zuh‸-e leh, awˬ nu ve zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ uiˍ leh da‸ ve caˬ nu suhˍ nu lehˬ, caˬ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ tiˉ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ pa taw, luˬ kʼai leh maˇ maˬ ve caˬ nu suhˍ nu kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maˬ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˬ da‸ jaˇ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve suhˍ nu hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ nawˇ la leh, yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ maˇ gʼa.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ te caˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ hui geh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Heˍbrehˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ awˬ piˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa leh, yawˇ lehˬ suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ hpeh chiˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ paˇ tcuhˆ chiˇ baˬ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ htaiˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ puiˉ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chu jaˇ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ suhˍ hkeh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˉ jaˇ leh a ciˉ ka‸ nyi maˇ sha ve nuˇ ma peuˍ suhˍ hkeh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chi taw taw cawˉ ve nuˇ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw.
Cawˉ jaˇ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chu jaˇ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hehˆ dawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve ka‸, nuˇ ma peuˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cawˉ jaˇ chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ zuh‸-e leh, awˬ shiˍ uiˍ leh da‸ jaˇ ve caˬ nu suhˍ nu caˬ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ tiˉ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ pa taw, luˬ kʼai leh maˇ maˬ ve caˬ nu suhˍ nu kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maˬ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˬ da‸ jaˇ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve suhˍ nu hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ mawˉ paˍ hui hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ maˇ gʼa, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chu jaˇ ve nuˇ ma suhˍ hkeh lehˬ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ leh, maˬ da‸ jaˇ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve suhˍ nu htawˇ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve cawˉ jaˇ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ oˇ ve suhˍ hkeh leh, chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ pa taw luˬ kʼai taˍ ve caˬ nu oˇ ve suhˍ nu lehˬ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˆtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ zuh‸ maˆ nyiˇ pawˆ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kanˉ chi hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, maˇ maw maw mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼoˆ lo awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hoˉ te tcuh-o.

Awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ yuˬ leh, caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ cawˬ ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu ngaˇ pun teˇ pun hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ-o‸.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ cawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la tuˬ ve meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˍ ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa meu‸ suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu chehˇ ve chi hkʼe ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hkʼe taw dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ gʼa te leh, ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
yawˇ ve la‸ peˍ kʼehˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ tcuhˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ shi caˆ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ boˆ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kuˬ toˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ maˇ gʼa te, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ awˬ meh suhˉ Zaˍhpaˍnaˍtaˍhpaˍnaˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ Heˍliˍpawˇliˆ venˇ yaˇ, Pawˇtiˆhpeˍ raˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍtaˍnaˆ hta‸ ka piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ca tanˬ te htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo ca toˇ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ.
Caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ cawˬ ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ shaw hpoˆ leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ca kawˬ nyi maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ maˇ gaˬ la sheˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Maˍnaˍseˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve leh, ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo lehˬ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ geh awˍ ca lawˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ geh kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ kaˬ le le lo meu‸ ve kaˆ ve cawˬ la ve pa taw, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ hkʼa gu taˍ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ teˇ maˬ le le ve hta‸ hpaw leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ le le hkʼaw lo htawˇ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ leh Yoˇseh‸ geh caˬ shiˍ ca vuiˬ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ gʼa kaˇ ve te yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui hkʼe leˇ jo baˬ taˍ ve le.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui a sha‸ gʼa te‸ tuˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh caˬ shiˍ ca vuiˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ chi gʼaˇ lehˬ caˬ shiˍ ca vuiˬ tuˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh maˇ kʼai peu. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ dawˇ hkiˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh caˬ shiˍ ca vuiˬ tuˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve pa taw yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ caˬ shiˍ hawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇ seh‸ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ cawˬ haˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve hkʼe te leh, Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw jaˆ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ lo teˇ kaˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kuiˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh, choˬ kaˬ lo caˬ shiˍ ca vuiˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh chaw jaˆ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui chaw jaˆ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ nuˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi la taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa geh chehˇ taˉ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh suh kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ sheh ngaˬ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw jaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo maˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ-o‸. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw lo keu taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe cawˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ chaˬ nyi tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ pon loˍ ve caˬ shiˍ pfuhˇ kʼo‸-e loˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ ngaˬ geh lo gʼa shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ leh, nawˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ dawˇ haˍ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Ruˇbenˍ lehˬ, Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te piˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve tiˉ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ caˉ te paˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ da‸ ve tawˇ hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ na gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui geh tawˆ kʼai leh hawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, Suˉmonˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ hpeh tsuh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ nyiˉ keu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve hpu hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw kʼaw‸ keu piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo caˇ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˬ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˉlaˬ hkʼoˆ tsuh‸ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la leh ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo haˉ tuˬ gu chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ piˉlaˬ hta‸ caˬ shiˍ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve htuˉ pui hta‸ hpeu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, htuˉ pui hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve hpu hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve hpu ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve law. Choˬ kaˬ nyi sheˬ. Ngaˬ ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw hpu oˇ ve cawˬ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Hkaˍnanˍ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh yaw laˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw jaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw jaˆ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ suh kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa geh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, chi hkʼe te shaˍ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ miˇ yaˇ awˬ pon loˍ ve caˬ shiˍ pfuhˇ leh kʼo‸-e loˬ.

Nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, chaw jaˆ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve chaw chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa te toˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸ ngeuˍ tawˆ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu yawˇ ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw hpu htiˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yoˇseh‸ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Suˉmonˍ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Chi beu‸ Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Ruˉbenˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ leh hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ kʼo, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh nawˬ geh lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ suh peuˬ leh, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ cawˬ chehˇ sheˬ leh,

yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh ngaˬ hui awˬ pon caˬ shiˍ ca kʼaw‸ vuiˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ maˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ gʼa laˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai peu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ kʼai leh nawˬ awˬ pon caˬ shiˍ ca kʼaw‸ vuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼai peu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui htawˇ maˇ kʼai taˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ maˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ mehˆ guˇ suhˍ maˇ gʼa laˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui chaw oˇ ve hta‸, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hui awˬ to awˬ lawn leh ngaˬ hui teˇ yehˬ kʼa awˬ lawn hkʼa deh‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ pa te‸ chehˇ sheˬ laˇ. Nawˬ hui geh awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ yawˇ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui la‸ haˉ tawˆ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼa meu‸ gʼa kaˆ suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ leh yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ yanˇ chi maw maˇ te shonˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, chi beuˬ lehˬ nyiˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼai taˉ leh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ law kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Suhˆ tcuhˇ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ, sha hawnˉ leh maˉ kuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
La‸ sheh hkʼaw hpu nyiˇ pun yuˬ kʼai-o. Nawˬ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve hpu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai-o. Oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ nawˇ ve pa taw, gʼa te ya‸ ve leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh chaw oˇ ve geh hteˇ lehˍ kʼai-o.

Chaw oˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, Suˉmonˍ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha te laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gʼa hpuˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ka‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui la‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh hpu nyiˇ pun yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ gaˬ leh Yoˇseh‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui geh lo Beˍyaˍmenˍ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Chaw chi ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai-o. Ceˇ teˇ hkeh tiˇ leh caˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-oˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh ya‸ nyi sha gʼuˇ awˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ lo gaˬ la htaˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw keu taˍ laˇ ve hpu oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca leh, ngaˬ hui ve piˉlaˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ka‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ geh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ hui caˬ shiˍ teˇ pawˆ ca vuiˬ la taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ haˉ kuiˬ lo gaˬ leh, ngaˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve htuˉ pui hta‸ hpeu‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu yawˇ ve hpu hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ caˬ shiˍ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ tuˬ hpu htawˇ, ngaˬ hui yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hpu chi teˇ hpaˍ keu taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Nawˬ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw hpu keu laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui piˇ laˇ ve hpu hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh Suˉmonˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hkui sheh tsuhˇ tuˬ iˉ kaˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve piˉlaˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo sha gʼuˇ awˍ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chehˇ sha laˇ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi peuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa chaw mawˇ paˍ ka‸ chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yoˬ, jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa chehˇ sha chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ chiˇ nyi leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh kʼoˆ ve chi hpaˇ yoˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha kʼaˉ jaˇ ve pa taw mehˆ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tsuhˇ leh, caˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ awˬ pon teˇ kaˬ, yawˇ awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon teˇ kaˬ leh, yawˇ geh chehˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui awˬ pon teˇ ka‸, caˇ tuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ gu piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui geh yawˇ hui awˍ maˇ mui caˇ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ leh ve teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ nyi leh yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ mui caˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ anˇ ve hkʼaw nyi da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui geh yuˬ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˇ pun gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇsehˆ yawˇ ve yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ pfuhˇ gʼaˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ doˆ piˇ-oˆ. Peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw yawˇ hui ve hpu hta‸ kʼaw‸ keu taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ nyi paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw, yawˇ ve hpu leh ngaˬ ve hpu kawˆ hta‸ keu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve piˉlaˬ gʼa‸ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui tawˆ-e leh venˇ baˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh haˆ gʼa‸ kʼai-o. Yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ mi ve teˇ yanˇ, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui lehˬ, da‸ ve awˬ tan maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hpu kawˆ hta‸ hkʼawˇ kʼai ve le. Kawˆ chi lehˬ, ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ ve kawˆ hpeh‸ leh yawˇ mawˉ nyi tuˬ cawˬ la htaˇ, kawˆ chi hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ mi ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve le. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te tuˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi jaw.

Ngaˬ hui ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw keu taˍ laˇ ve hpu nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼawˇ yuˬ tuˬ ve le.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ geh lo kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ. Kawˆ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ geh ca mawˬ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ ve htuˉ pui hta‸ chiˇ ya‸ leh hpeu‸ nyi ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh awˬ nyi paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw ca hpfuhˆ nyi leh, Beˍyaˍmenˍ ve htuˉ pui hkʼaw hpu kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve piˉlaˬ hta‸ awˬ lanˉ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ, Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve le. Ngaˬ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ mawˉ nyi leh shiˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-o, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la peuˬ. Nawˬ ve kawˆ cawˬ taˍ ve chaw ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te. Kawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa geh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ yawˇ geh jiˆ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ sheˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma a ciˉ taˇ zuhˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hkʼe taw uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸, Awˬ pa cawˬ laˇ. Awˬ nyi paˍ cawˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ leh chi ve awˬ viˉ paˍ lehˬ, suh peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ awˬ e ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh lo shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa geh tawˆ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe tawˆ kʼai kʼo awˬ pa gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ maˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍmaˇ gʼa laˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ vuiˬ tcuh laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ leh hta‸ maˇ shiˍ kʼai ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ miˇ ma Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ngaˬ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ geh lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ peuˬ hehˉ.
Chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi ve a sha‸ hta‸ hpeh ka taˍ ve pa taw, yaˇ paˍ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui yawˇ geh lo maˇ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu piˇ leh,
yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ yawˇ maˇ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ suh-e tuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ dawˇ haˍ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi ve awˬ pon hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh lo maˇ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ kʼo, ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ pa hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi ve awˬ tan nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh a ciˉ kʼo‸-e peu-o.

Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ maˇ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu leh ngaˬ pa geh ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ pa gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve tu‸ hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ geh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ taˍ.
Yawˇ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ hawˬ ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa te‸ chehˇ sheˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ jaˇ leh te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Ngaˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo jiˆ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hawˇ baˬ laˇ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yoˇseh‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo hawˇ baˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, dawˇ haˍ hpeh‸ bawˬ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ ceh tiˉ gaˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ muiˬ caˇ maˇ gʼa ve awˬ yanˇ ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ cawˬ sheˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, kʼaw‸ caˉ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo peu laˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ pa geh haˆ haˆ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ shanˍ feu laˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ peuˬ. Awˬ yanˇ maˇ jiˆ leh ngaˬ geh haˆ ya‸ la-o.

Nawˬ lehˬ Gawˍshenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve yaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ hawehˍ, nawˬ ve nuˇ, yawˬ leh nawˬ geh hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh laˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui meu‸ chehˇ kaˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ cawˬ sheˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to Yoˇseh‸ hpeh‸ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ htawˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa taˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve leh, choˬ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo haˆ haˆ shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ behˇ kʼuˉ taˍ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼuˉ taˍ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ boˆ nu leh hawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh na‸ uˉ te da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ awˬ to Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˬ shiˍ doˆ pfuhˍ piˇ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu-o.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa leh yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ tcuh-o. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa leh, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ciˇ laˬ tuˬ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai tcuh-o.

Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ ve htawˇ, nyi ma maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo caˇ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ piˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hkʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ hta‸ hpu 300 hteh‸ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ ngaˇ hkʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ pon Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, piˉ laˬ teˇ chi hkeh taˆ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ya‸ la htaˇ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon caˬ shiˍ, hkaoˍmonˇ leh awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˉ laˬ teˇ chi hkeh taˆ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa ya‸ da‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ leh kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa chehˇ kuiˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ chi beuˬ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ sheˬ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ anˇ jaˇ leh yawˇ hui kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ tuˬ Yoˇseh‸ feu laˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ dawˇ sha la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ca mawˬ da‸ taˉ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ geh hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, yawˇ awˬ pa Iˉcaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Yaˍkoˆ-oˬ, Yaˍkoˆ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ geh teˇ geh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ suh-e htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ nawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa leh yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ feu laˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca gʼa taˍ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
