Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la ve Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Ruˉbenˍ leh,
Ruˉbenˍ ve yaˇ, Haˍmoˆ, Hpeˍluˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Kaˍmiˆ,
Suˉmonˍ ve yaˇ Yeˍmoeˍlaˆ, Yaˍmenˍ, Awˇhaˆ, Yaˍhkenˍ, Zawˇhaˍ lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ yaˇ miˇ geh paw la ve yaˇ Sawˇluˆ,
Leˍviˆ ve yaˇ Geˍraˍsonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ, leh Meˍraˍriˆ,

Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ Eˇraˆ, Awˇnanˍ, Sheˍlaˆ, Hpaˍrehˆ, Zeˍraˆ, (Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ Eˇraˆ leh Awˇnanˍ hui lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw suh taˉ ve yoˬ) Hpaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Haˍmuˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Tawˇlaˆ, Hpuˇ-aˍ, Yawˇbaˆ, Shiˉmaˍronˍ,
Zaˍbuˆlonˍ ve yaˇ Saˍrehˇ, Eˇlonˍ leh Yaˍleˍ,

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Leˉaˍ Yaˍkoˆ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ geh lo Diˉnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ cawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Leˉ-aˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 33 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ziˆhpiˍonˍ, Haˍgiˆ, Shuˇniˆ, Eˇzaˍbonˍ, Eˇriˆ, Aˍroˇdiˆ leh Aˍreˍliˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yiˆmaˍnaˆ, Eˇsaˍvaˍ, Iˉsiˍviˍ, Beˍriˆyaˆ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi ma Seˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Beˍriˆyaˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍbaˍ leh Maˍlaˍhkeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Leˍaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Ziˆla paˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi hkaw‸ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ miˇ ma Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Heˍliˍpawˇliˆ venˇ yaˇ paw hkuˇ Pawˇtiˆhpeˍraˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍtaˍnaˆ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ awˬ pon Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍlaˆ, Beˍhkaˍ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ, Geˍraˆ, Neˍmanˍ, Eˇhiˆ, Roˇshaˆ, Muˆpenˍ, Huˆpenˍ leh Aˍraˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ chi awˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Danˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Huˆshenˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Naˍtaˍliˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Yaˍzeˍlaˆ, Guˇ niˆ, Yeˍzaˍ leh Shiˆlenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi suhˍ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Laˍbanˍ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Raˍhkeˍlaˆ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ ma Biˇlaˍhaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ leh, yawˇ geh teˇ geh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkaw‸ chi hkaw‸ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ, Yuˇda‸ hta‸ yawˇ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yoˇseh‸ geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Gawˍ shenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hpuˇ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ maw chaweh behˇ kʼuˉ taˍ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ sheˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ suh tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Yoˇ seh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ leh nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh gaˬ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ piˇ shaˍ.
Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ leh, nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma kanˉ te caˇ ve awˬ lawn na nyi laˇ ve kʼo,

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ ceˇ hu caˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇ seh‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˬ hawˉ caˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa leh ngaˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve ceˇ caˬ leh yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, chi beu‸ Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma kanˉ te caˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ceˇ hu caˬ hu ve kanˉ hta‸ te caˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw ca chehˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ geh lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ pa leh nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh gaˬ la peuˬ law leˇ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve Gawˍ shenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh-o. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo puiˉ jaˇ cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ leh, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ a sha‸ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ le, teh‸ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ,

Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ leh te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ ha shehˆ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, i jaˇ leh haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ shuˍ da‸, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Raˍmaˍseˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ awˬ pa, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, teˇ kaˬ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hawˇ gʼa taˍ ve hpu hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw hpoˆ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ, vuiˬ caˇ peuˬ sheˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yoˇseh‸ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˍ caˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ maˇ caˍ laˇ kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve hpu peuˬ kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh yuˬ laˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ geh cawˬ taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ, yawˬ, nuˇ leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh sheh veu laˇ leh, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ pa piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ hkʼaw‸ yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ geh kʼaw‸ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ hui ve hpu peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui geh te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to leh ngaˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ taˇ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, oˇ ve awˬ tan ngaˬ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui maˇ gʼa suh leh mvuhˇmiˬ chi gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ leh caˬ yawˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ hawˇ keu piˇ ve pa taw, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ awˬ pon vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ maˇ gʼa vuiˬ yuˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve miˬguiˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Na sheˬ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ vuiˬ taˍ peuˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon caˬ yawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh sheˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui caˬ gʼeu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, caˬ shiˍ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ ve awˇ pun lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ awˬ pon awˬ yawˇ leh, nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon dawˇ nyi laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu ngaˇ pun teˇ pun jawˇmawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ liˇ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gaˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve miˬguiˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Gawˍshenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paw sha la leh, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ chi suhˍ hkʼaw‸ chehˇ leh yawˇ ve a sha‸ 147 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ suh la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ suh-e ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ tuˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh ngaˬ ve pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu hawˉ keu leh ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ-e leh, ngaˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh awˬ paˇ lo ca tuˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ hkanˍ sheˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ leh bon chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa naˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh yawˇ hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇseh‸ laˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼaˇ kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ tu mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Luˇzaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ la sheˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo paw la taˍ ve nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ chi ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ruˇbenˍ leh Suˉmonˍ hui ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼa paw la ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ shinˉ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ hui geh gʼa kʼaw‸ pehˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tu leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo nawˬ e Raˍhkeˍlaˆ suh-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Behˍlehˍ hehnˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Eˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo tuˍ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, choˬ kaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ paˇ lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, mehˆ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ mawˬ-o. Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼuˉ taˍ leh boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ pa geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hta‸ awˬ pa ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍnaˍseˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa ve la‸ sha paˉ lo chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ i hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh pehˉ leh yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ awˬ viˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ la‸ sheh Maˍnaˍseˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ haˍ kuiˬ gʼawˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh leh ngaˬ pa Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hui ve awˬ meh lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ taˍ piˇ ve hta‸ Yoˇseh‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma maˇ sha. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ teh taˍ ve yawˇ awˬ pa ve la‸ sheh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Maˍnaˍseˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ te ve a ciˉ maˇ cawˇ sheˬ. Chi lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ taˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ awˬ pa kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceu‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ yawˇ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh uiˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceu‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ te laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ teh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve Sheˍhkenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ veu leh Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui geh bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ paˇ lo jiˆ laˬ-o‸. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hto maˍ laˇ shaˍ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.
Ruˇbenˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ miˇ ma geh ca lo‸ zuh‸ leh, nawˬ pa ve zuh‸ hpui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw yoˬ.
Suˉmonˍ leh Leˍviˆ lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ la‸ caˉ yuˬ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jehˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, nuˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui kuˇ caˆ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ baˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸-oˬ, nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh shaˍ ca che‸ caˇ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, haˉ kʼoˍ lo gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la leh zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca nawˍ piˇ maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ geh lo uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ hpeh taˍ leh, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ pa taw nyiˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve ciˬ lehˬ, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ hta‸ pa taw hpuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Zaˍbuˆlonˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo gʼa chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lehˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ jehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Siˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ lanˉ kaˍ lo zuh‸ chehˇ ve piˉ laˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ leh, hkʼaˬ ma gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ gʼa taˆ leh awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Danˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Danˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ toˇ ve chaw ce kʼai tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo law taˍ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ hkui sheh hta‸ htawˆ piˇ ve vuiˬ haiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬlehˬ nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ dawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼa caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Naˍtaˍliˆ lehˬ, nyi sha jaˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ ehˉ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ awˬ ma peuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ ve piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ga hpoˆ bawˆ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve hkaˆ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ, ceˇ caˬ leh awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ,

awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ, Yoˇseh‸ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ lehˬ, haiˬ jaˇ ve heh hpuiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ che‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, chi ve lehˬ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa bon na‸ piˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suh-e ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ Hiˇtiˆ chaw Eˇhpaˍronˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ puˍ ngaˬ pi hui geh ca tuˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Maˆpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Maˍreˍ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ Hiˇtiˆ chaw Eˇhpaˍronˍ geh vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw tuˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Saˍraˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉcaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Reˍbehˆka‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˉaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve leh haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Hiˇtiˆ chaw hui geh vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo ca tuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ yaw taˉ peuˬ leh shaˉ leh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ boˆ nu leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ pa hta‸ maw chaweh teh taˍ gʼa tuˬ, naˆ tsuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ te muiˬ te jaw ve hkʼe, Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ naˆ tsuhˇ shehˆ piˇ leh hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu htiˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve 40 nyi maw ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon 70 nyi hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ bon te leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ pa ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ Yawˇ suh-e ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e leh yawˇ gu taˉ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw ca tuˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ pa hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ la tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ taˉ peuˬ kʼo, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ pa hta‸ nawˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼai leh ca tuˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇsehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ, leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ moˍ awˬ cuˇ lonˉ te kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍtaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo suhˍ nyi chehˇ leh yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui Aˍtaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve law, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Aˍbeˍlaˆmiˆzaˍrenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh, Maˆpeˍlaˆ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Maˍreˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, Hiˇtiˆ chaw Eˇhpaˍronˍ geh Aˍbraˍhanˍ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw tuˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ tuˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ geh hkʼa kʼai taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˇseh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ leh, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Yoˇseh‸ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ pa maˇ suh sheˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe shanˍ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ geh kʼai leh yawˇ nawˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ca lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh shanˍ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe shawˍ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tawˆ la leh, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, chaw maˇ maˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ geh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ 110 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ ve awˬ yaˇ leh awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Maˍhkiˆraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui geh a ciˉ yuˬ kʼo‸-e laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh ka ti‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ a sha‸ 110 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ naˆ tsuhˇ shehˆ leh hkʼa deh‸ gu htiˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kʼawˇ kʼoˍ hkʼaw keu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸ la taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ, Suˉmonˍ, Leˍviˆ, Yuˇda‸,
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ,
Danˍ, Naˍtaˍliˆ, Gaˆ leh Aˍshaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve aw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 70 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Yoˇseh‸ leh yawˇ ve aw viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ, leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la taˍ ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve chaw teˇ puˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kʼaw‸ maˇ la leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la maˇ la leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ maˇ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ hpawˇ chehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ moˍ shawˍ leh hkeu‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ ve mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ, Piˇtonˍ leh Raˍmaˍseˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te gʼa la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve kʼo, shaˬ kʼaw‸ maˇ la ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkeu‸ jaˇ haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ yehˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ te tcuh leh, ti mi hkʼaw lo htawˇ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui hta‸ yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma Shiˆhpaˍraˆ leh Hpuˇ-aˍ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Heˍbrehˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yaˇ paw piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ paw la ve kʼo tiˇ pehˍ-o‸. Yaˇ miˇ paw la ve kʼo, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na. Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Heˍbrehˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ shuˍ. Yawˇ hui yaˇ paw tuˬ ca kuˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui maˇ gaˬ sheˬ htaˇ ka‸ yaˇ paw gʼa taˍ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, maˇ la leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paw piˇ shehˍ ma oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui geh hkʼa paw la ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ ehˉ chi da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha pa 3 maˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, po kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ maˇ lo‸ gaˬ tuˬ suhˆ tcuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yaˇ paˍ ehˉ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo cawˬ ve lo de hkʼaw faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve aw viˉ ma lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ leh nyi taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ ca hehˉ la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ geh iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo ca guiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ lo de kaˍ lo po kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ po kʼoˍ hta‸ hpaw nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yaˇ paˍ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ha kʼaˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Heˍbrehˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ paˍ ehˉ ve awˬ viˉ ma kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ paˍ ehˉ chi ve hta‸ cuˉ taw piˇ tuˬ, Heˍbrehˇ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ca kuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼo‸-e peu leh ca shiˍ veu laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yaˇ miˇ ehˉ chi gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh yaˇ paˍ ehˉ ve awˬ e hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ chi hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ pon cuˉ taw piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh cuˉ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Moˉseˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh ca guiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa te chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ chiˇ nyi leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kaˬ maˇ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh shehˇ shiˍ hkʼaw gaˆ fiˆ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, Heˍbrehˇ chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ ya‸ ve chaw geh yawˇ kʼai leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ dawˆ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te leh suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hta‸ teh taˍ ve le. Nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ shu shiˍ peuˬ law, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ca ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ Meˇdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Moˉseˍ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo mui chehˇ htaˇ, Meˉdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ Yeˍtaˍroˍ ve yaˇ miˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pa ve yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ ca taw piˇ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, Yeˍtaˍroˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ tu leh yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa geh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ awˬ pa lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui teˇ na‸ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Chi beu‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo baˬ taˉ ve le. Ngaˬ hui geh awˍ caˇ la tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Yeˍtaˍroˍ geh chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Ziˆpawˇraˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Geˍraˍshonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Ngaˬ lehˬ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ maw la leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu ceˬ te leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha geh gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ puˍ Meˇdiˍanˍ paw hkuˇ Yeˍtaˍroˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ veu leh da‸ kehˬ ve Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve yoˬ

Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, suhˆ buiˇ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Suhˆ buiˇ oˇ ve aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Chi taw taw anˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ca nyi shaˍ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, suhˆ buiˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ maˇ to‸ baˬ ve leh naˍ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suhˆ buiˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Moˉseˍ-oˬ, Moˉseˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ paˇ neˇ lo taˇ laˬ. Nawˬ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ huˉ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ nyi maˇ haˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ shiˍ ve chaw maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ piˇ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ shaˉ hkiˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw pui chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Chi lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe tiˉ gʼa te kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ kʼai leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, shehˆ nyi vuiˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ hehnˇ chaweh maˇ te piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ laˇ taˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui tawˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ maˇ gʼa tawˆ-e tuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le, Eˇjiˇtu‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lawˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ deh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh laˬ ve maˇ heˆ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ve la‸sheh hkʼaw aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu leh juˇ fuiˍ oˇ ve vuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh vuiˬ mehˍ tu hta‸ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, vuiˬ oˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh laˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui yonˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon te maˍ laˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh aˉ po‸ hawˉ lo keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ aˉ po‸ hawˉ lo keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh vaˇ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ leh hkiˬ tu‸ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ aˉ po‸ hawˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ keu leh gʼawˬ tawˆ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ hkʼe yawˇ ve la‸ sheh kʼaw‸ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ te maˍ piˇ ve anˇ tuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ yonˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve anˇ tuˬ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui yonˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ maˬ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ sheˬ ve kʼo, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw cawˍ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ nyiˉ veu laˇ leh yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ ngeuˍ baˬ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˇseˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼai peu laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ tanˬ yaw laˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, tawˇ tsuh‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, A shu teˇ gʼaˇ chaw yaˇ hta‸ maw‸ kʼaw piˇ taˍ ve le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ chaw kʼaˍ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ leh, naˍ paw pawˇ piˇ lawˬ ve le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ mawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ ve le. Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ gʼa ve lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ tawˇ yaw puiˉ la tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ leh, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh kʼai tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa yaw tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ tawˇ yaw puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ ga laˇ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ngaˬ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ tan chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe hpeh‸ leh yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ chi hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ taˍ-o‸. Chi ve hta‸ cuˇ leh anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa te maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ Yeˍtaˍroˍ geh kʼo‸-e leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ leh naˍ ca kʼaw‸ nyi tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍtaˍroˍ htawˇ, Gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw kʼai loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ geh laˬ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh leh, Eˇjiˇ tu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ hui haˉ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Ziˆpawˇraˆ lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh Moˉseˍ ve hkui sheh hta‸ yuˬ daw‸ piˇ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ geh laˬ leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh,

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍronˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui yonˍ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ la ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve a shu le. Gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hpehˇ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo tu leh shehˆ nyi vuiˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ aˬ hto‸ ma dawˇ leh chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ kʼai gaˇ ve le. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kanˉ ca kʼaw‸ te tcuh loˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ maˇ te tcuh leh jehˇ taˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve law leˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ, li kiˉ shiˍ chiˆ tuˬ awˬ pon chi gʼawˇ taˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ loˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ca gʼawˆ yuˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ gʼa jaw ve hkʼe li kiˉ shiˍ gʼa piˇ lawˬ-o‸. A ciˉ ka‸ taˇ yawnˇ tcuh. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui kanˉ te maˇ law‸ taˬsheˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ lawˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu heˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa na chehˇ tuˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ kanˉ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ te tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve, chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi gʼawˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui ca gʼa hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui gʼa ca gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ nyi le le nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa yawnˇ kʼai piˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai leh chi gʼawˇ ca gʼawˆ toˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui chi gʼawˇ gʼa chehˇ htaˇ kanˉ te gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ chi gʼawˇ maˇ piˇ ve htawˇ kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te gʼa piˇ tuˬ, kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ nyiˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chi beu‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe li kiˉ shiˍ maˇ gʼa ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi taw taw te laˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi gʼawˇ maˇ piˇ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ li kiˉ shiˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ te tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ te ponˬ te leuˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve kanˉ te kuiˬ lo haˆ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ chi gʼawˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe li kiˉ shiˍ gʼa te laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ li kiˉ shiˍ gʼa te gʼa piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ tuˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw aˉhtaw keu piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh jiˆ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi taw taw tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo peu laˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh nawˬ awˬ tan tawˇ ca yaw piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te she‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ sheˬ.
Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hkehˉ chaw te chehˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ leh, ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh, hkeu‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh tuˬ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼe ve tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tcuh leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Ruˉbenˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍnoˆ, Hpaˍluˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Kaˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Suˉmonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍmoeˍlaˆ, Yaˍmenˍ, Awˇhaˆ, Yaˍhkenˍ, Zawˇhaˍ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ yaˇ miˇ geh paw la ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉlu‸ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˉmonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍshonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ, Meˍraˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 137 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍniˆ leh Shiˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉsaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ, leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kawˇhaˆ lehˬ a sha‸ 133 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ leh Muˇsiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍranˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ nyi ma Yawˇhkeˍbehˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Aˍronˍ leh Moˉseˍ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍranˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 137 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ, Neˍhpehˆ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˇzeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˇsheˍlaˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍhpanˍ, Siˉtaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ yaˇ miˇ Naˍsonˍ ve awˬ nyi ma Eˇliˆsaˍbaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsiˇraˆ, Eˇlaˆkaˍnaˆ, Aˍbyaˍsaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, Puˇteˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon Hpiˇnaˍhaˆ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh Moˉseˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ tawˇ yaw maˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ tan tawˇ yaw shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh tuˬ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ ngaˬ te maˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh tawˇ ca yaw piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 80 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ lehˬ 83 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te maˍ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo, Moˉseˍ nawˬ Aˍronˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ baˬ peu tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve vuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo baˬ peu leh, juˇ fuiˍ oˇ ve vuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh faˍ te puiˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ hta‸ baˬ peu leh, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ vuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍronˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nyi ma heh jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nyi ma heh jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ sheˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ yawˇ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ yawˇ geh kʼai-o. Vuiˬ hpeh‸ la jaw ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ geh yuˬ kʼai-o.

Yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ hkui hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ maˇ te sheˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi ve hta‸ dawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ chi ve awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh kʼai leh kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ chi ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˍronˍ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu leh, iˉ mvuhˇ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ awˬ suhˍ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, Aˍronˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ hta‸ chiˇ leh, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ dawˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh kʼai leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo awˬ suhˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve faˍ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te gʼa ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe nyi ma heh chehˇ sheˍ leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpa lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo nanˬ bawˍ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ duˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai peu leh, chi hkʼe ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui hpeh‸ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇpiˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw lo paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la leh nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ, nawˬ ve zuh‸ bawehˇ leh zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu, hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ to, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ, Aˍronˍ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo che peu tuˬ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ che peu leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Faˍ te puiˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ ngaˬ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, paˍ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai leh Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ hpoˆ chehˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˆ kʼai leh Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ piˇ chehˇ ve paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha na yuˬ leh, yehˬ hkʼaw, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw leh ti mi hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ hpoˆ taˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ heh la leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve je‸ meu-e teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ puiˉ suhˆ naˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh je‸ meu-e hkʼaw dawˆ keu tuˬ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw dawˆ keu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ je‸ meu-e oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ puiˉ suhˆ naˆ hpeh‸ la leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ ve yoˬ.
Faˍ te puiˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, puiˉ suhˆ naˆ tawˆ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te maˇ gʼa.

Oˇ htaˇ, faˍ te puiˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇ mawˇ geh laˬ leh, Chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe nyi ma heh jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo puiˉ ma hkʼa biˇ ngaˬ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lehˬ, puiˉ ma cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw leh ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ pehˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ heˆ chi shawˉ pawˍ kʼo hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇ maw ve hawˉ yehˬ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo puiˉ ma hkʼa biˇ lo‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo htawˇ, puiˉ ma hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la leh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, vuiˇ vuiˇ taˇ kʼai, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui lehˬ shehˆ nyi vuiˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hta‸ gʼa ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, vuiˇ vuiˇ taˇ kʼai. Ngaˬ awˬ pon htawˇ bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ hkui ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ gaˬ ve kʼo, puiˉ ma chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ leh nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, nawˬ taˇ kʼaw‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ mehˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lawˬ ve hkʼe Gʼuiˬsha na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Puiˉ ma teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo puiˉ ma teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ nyi ma teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ heh la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ sheˍ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ, piˉ laˬ, nuˇ, yawˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ yanˇ hta‸ tinˍ taˍ peuˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ suh.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ca chaˬ nyi tcuh leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ suh ve awˬ lawn hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma heh chehˇ sheˍ leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼaw‸ laˉ a ciˉ hkaˆ veu leh, Moˉseˍ nawˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo baˬ peu-o.

Hkʼaw‸ laˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo gaˬ leh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaw‸ laˉ yuˬ veu leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo baˬ peu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Faˍ te puiˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ awˬ nu ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh, nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ bvuhˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma heh chehˇ sheˍ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ sheˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ ve kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw sheˍ ve hehnˇ jaˇ ve vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ce la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ ti mi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˆ hkʼaw gʼa‸ keu taˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ leh, hkawˆ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, vaˇ shiˍ ce teˍ leh suh peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh kawˆ ve jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ leh, ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ti mi hkʼaw hkʼe leˇ hpehˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw, to nuˇ to shaˆ, leh suhˆ cehˬ hawˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo vaˇ shiˍ ce la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ vaˇ shiˍ maˇ maˇ ce la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve hkʼaw vaˇ shiˍ maˇ maˇ ce la ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo cawˬ ve ti mi, chaw yaˇ, leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vaˇ shiˍ ce teˍ ve yoˬ. Ti mi hkʼaw cawˬ ve caˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lehˬ, vaˇ shiˍ maˇ ce la.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te ve cawˇ leh ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ te ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve leh vaˇ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maw maw gʼa law chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve jehˇ sheˬ leh, vaˇ shiˍ htawˇ kʼaw‸ ce la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cho‸ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ. Lawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ tzuh tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, awˬ cehˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, junˍ leh sha ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ti leh ve pa taw maˇ luˬ kʼai.

Moˉseˍ jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ kʼai leh venˇ baˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve jehˇ sheˬ leh, vaˇ shiˍ htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ ce la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma kʼaw‸ heh la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ piˇ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma heh la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te maˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ,

ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ chi hkʼe heh la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, hkʼaˬ maw maw te chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ ve kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Paˉ ce‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Vaˇ shiˍ ce la htaˇ maˇ luˬ leh cawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Paˉ ce‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ, leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ka‸ chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ jaw sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Eˇ jiˇ tu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu teˇ hpaˍ kʼai tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ, nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui bon pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸. Nawˬ hui kʼai gaˇ tehˬ ve kʼo, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ kʼai leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui-o, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Vaˇ shiˍ ce la htaˇ maˇ luˬ leh cawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ paˉ ce‸ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la leh te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve la‸ sheh che peu-o, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ htawˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ che peu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hta‸ tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ meuˆ laˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, mvuhˇ haw oˇ ve lehˬ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa biˇ meuˆ chiˇ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Paˉ ce‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Chi taw taw maˇ ve paˉ ce‸ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ htawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Miˬguiˬ chi naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, vaˇ shiˍ ce la htaˇ maˇ luˬ leh cawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˉ lehˍ ve suhˆ hpa‸ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ haˆ kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kʼaw‸ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, paˉ ce‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hkʼaw meuˆ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paˉ ce‸ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw yaˇ shoˆ nyi htawˇ nyi maˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh mvuhˇ hpe lo che peu ve teˇ yanˇ, shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ mawˬ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yehˬ baˬ lo tawˆ-e maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa teh taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼa piˇ feu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hkeh ka‸ teh taˉ maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve to nuˇ to shaˆ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ.
