Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ nawˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ leh meuˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui geh, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ lawˬ yuˬ taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Shehˍ kʼaw hkui htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ te leh, haˉ pui mawˍ geuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw sheˍ leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ ve, paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpuiˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ da‸ taˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e loˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te maˍ piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ lehˬ, anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ lawˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ tawˆ kʼai tcuh.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa chi ve teˇ maˬ lehˬ, teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ ha pa teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ha pa chi teˇ chi nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ awˬ pon yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa ca taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ maˬ lehˬ chaw maˇ maˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh caˇ maˇ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ hta‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ caˇ peuˬ law‸ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa ca taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, a ˉ che‸ hta‸ ka‸ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha pa chi teˇ chi awˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ a shu yawˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ awˬ shaˍ hkʼa te caˇ ve yehˬ teˇ maˬ le le ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ gʼa shehˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ piˬ taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh, hkʼaˇ ve gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh geh teˇ geh gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shaˍ oˇ ve awˬ tcuhˇ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Caˉ caˇ ve ka‸ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ kʼoˍ, hkui sheh, leh awˬ hkʼaw ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa piˬ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa teh taˍ. Leuˉ taˍ sheˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haˍ pi tsuh‸, hkuiˉ nuˆ tcuhˉ, juˇ fuiˍ yuˬ taˍ leh haˆ haˆ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo shehˆ taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ lehˬ awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ suhˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nyi chi ve teˇ nyi hta‸ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co Gʼuiˬsha ve pawehˇ chi hta‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tanˬ te ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve diˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi chi ve suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, diˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi leh suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui hpawnˬ da‸ leh oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi chi ve nyiˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, te caˇ te dawˬ ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, pawehˇ chi hta‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi chi teˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha paˍ 14 nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hta‸ te leh nyiˇ chi teˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hkʼa gaˬ, diˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Awˬ nyi chi ve suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw diˇ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ caˇ ve hkehˉ chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ haˆ ca taˍ-o‸.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, huˆsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ hpa‸ hta‸ yuˬleh awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hkʼoˆ lo shehˆ taˍ-o‸. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hkʼoˆ lo shehˆ taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw te luˬ shehˍ hpaˇ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ lo‸-e tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ pawehˇ chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Pawehˇ chi te ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ shehˍ kʼaw hkui gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ te leh htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇjiˇ tu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ jawˇmawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tu la leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw maˇ suh ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hui geh tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui-o.
Nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ awˬ pon ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw haˆ haˆ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu leh, aˉ boˆ yuˬ hawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui geh hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca lawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Raˍmaˍseˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Suˇkoˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ ceh tiˉ hkaw‸ shehnˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ awˬ moˍ lonˉ gʼa‸ leh yawˇ hui geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ tcuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ chiˆ caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw la‸ haˉ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ gu tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo 430 hkʼaw‸ chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
430 hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ law taˍ ve teˇ haˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chi ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ haˉ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ pawehˇ chi hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e.
Vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, pawehˇ chi hkʼaw lo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw leh, gʼaˇ ga caˇ toˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, pawehˇ chi hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e.
Yawˬ ehˉ ve aw shaˍ hta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa teh caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shaˍ hta‸ yehˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo maˇ gʼa yuˬ tawˆ-e. Awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te hteh piˇ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ pawehˇ chi ve hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ caˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ gʼa shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ htaˇ heh‸ caˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teh‸ shawˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, pawehˇ chi hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸.
Awˬ liˇ chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa ponˬ tawˆ la ve awˬ nyi chi teˇ nyi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Awˬlawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ taˇ caˇ.
Ya‸ nyi awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve Aˍbiˆbaˍlaˆ ha pa chi ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw, leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ lo‸-e piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ha pa chi teˇ maˬ hkʼaw pawehˇ chi hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui lehˬ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hpawnˬ da‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Chi ve suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui lehˬ diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh diˇ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ.

Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Pawehˇ chi lehˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ, la‸ sheh hkʼoˆ leh naˍ kʼa‸ pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh taˍ ve awˬ heˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve aw liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, pawehˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ lo‸-e piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Piˉ laˬ awˬ ma peuˍ geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve awˬ paˍ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh gʼa pa hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te gaˇ ve kʼo, piˉ laˬ ehˉ oˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ gʼa awˉ hteh piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ gʼa vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi gaˬ leh nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi ve aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, Ngaˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ nyi ma heh jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ peu laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve to nuˇ to shaˆ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ htawˇ gʼa vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ liˇ chi lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh leh ngaˬ hui ve naˍ kʼa‸ pui hkʼoˆ lo, dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ hpeh taˍ ve awˬ heˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ kʼai piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ gʼa bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ cawˬ kʼo, nyi ma luˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e la ve hta‸ hkiˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo caw toˇ tcuh leh, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi cawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ la‸ caˉ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ geh lo yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ hui geh gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh hkanˍ tcuh taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Suˇkoˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, hteunˍ lonˉ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Eˇtanˍ venˇ paˇ lo ca jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, aˬ miˍ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ, moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, aˬ miˍ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Miˆgaˍdawˇlaˆ venˇ leh Baˍlaˆseˍhponˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Piˆhaˍhiˇraˆ venˇ paˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo jehˇ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ya‸ leh caw toˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hkanˉ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tawˆ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te peuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ peuˬ ve law, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 600 maˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ ciˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, Baˍlaˆseˍhponˍ leh Piˇhaˍhiˇraˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo jehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ gʼa‸ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ jaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ deˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tuˍ hpfuh maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca suh la tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nyi-o.

Ngaˬ hui maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve hta‸ taˇ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca suh la ve a‸ kehˉ, shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Nyi ma yeˬ chaweh taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ law nyi taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu-o. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ gʼa juˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma heh la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo kʼaw‸ chehˇ sheˬ leh, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉdaw oˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw awˬ kaˍ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hpawˇ lo naˆ ho‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hpawˇ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ moˍ lehˬ, teˇ moˍ leh teˇ moˍ awˬ paˇ lo kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ meuˆ laˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ sheˬ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼo‸ pa ko taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ leh yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˍ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˆ haˆ kʼai maˇ gaˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, iˉ kaˆ kʼaw‸ hoˆ beh piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ che peu-o, teh‸ Moˉ seˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hoˆ beh sheˬ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai leh, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sha paˉ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼo‸ pa ko taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo suh hpoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yonˍ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ baˬ peuˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-o‸, nawˬ ve la‸sha paˉ la‸ sheh lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ meuˆ leh iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼo‸ pa hkʼa shuˍ cawˍ tu la ve yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ heh la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hiˉ yuˬ leh, heuˆ gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve shaˉ teˇ peu-eˍ hta‸ pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw kʼa suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, geu‸ law hkʼa shuˍ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw tuˍ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve a shu cawˬ le. Nawˬ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve a shu cawˬ le. Nawˬ hkʼa shuˍ anˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve a shu cawˬ le.
Nawˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh che ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui geh tawˆ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh nawˬ ve bon yehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo ti taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hoˆ beh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ ve awˬ viˉ ma Meˍriˆanˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tinˍ hteˆ leh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve tinˍ hteˆ leh Meˍriˆanˍ geh teˇ geh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Meˍriˆanˍ kʼa mui hkawˇ kʼa leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo shiˍ tawˆ-e leh, Shuˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ ca maˇ mawˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Maˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Maˍraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa dawˬ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ suhˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw htu keu leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ mehˬ la ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ gu na-e laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Eˍlinˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ 12 maˬ cawˬ leh tcuhˉ pui cehˬ 70 cehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo jehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Eˍlinˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tu leh Siˉnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Ngaˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve shaˍ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui chi ma ve hta‸ choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ laˬ leh meu‸ suh kaˆ suh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ ce la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ nyi awˬ pon loˍ ve hkʼe ca gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh-o. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkaw‸ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, teˇ nyi le le gʼawˆ yuˬ jaw ve a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ pun gʼawˆ yuˬ leh ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la kʼo, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ ve chi lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ceh te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ piˇ laˇ leh, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ hkaoˍmonˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ maˍ laˇ ve chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ jiˆ la tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Aˍ ronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ nyi peu leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ moˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ yawˇ hui shaˍ gʼa caˇ leh, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼa biˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kaˉ koeˍ hkʼa biˇ poˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ kʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ciˍ guiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ shiˍ ehˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, a ngeu hkʼa shuˍ paˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, Oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ caˇ law‸ ve hkʼe ceh, teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ ehˉ gʼawˆ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, chaw maˇ ve kʼo maˇ ve hkʼe, chaw i ve kʼo i ve hkʼe gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ kawˬ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ chaweh gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ leuˉ maˇ cawˬ. A ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, loˍ ve cuˆ ve maˇ cawˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ caˇ law‸ ve hkʼe ma gʼa ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hkaoˍmonˇ chi hta‸ shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon maˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ hkawˇ maˇ na leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve pa taw, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kuiˇ kʼai leh hawehˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ shawˉ le le chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ caˇ law‸ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ cha chiˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ kuiˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkaw‸ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyiˇ pun gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ geh laˬ leh awˬ lawn chi yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Shawˉ pawˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve shinˉ nyi hpeh‸ leh, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui te caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te caˇ leh, caˉ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe caˉ caˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui caˇ leuˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kuiˇ leh hawehˆ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ ya‸ nyi caˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve shinˉ nyi hpeh‸ leh gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo nawˬ hui hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼa gʼawˆ caˇ leh, gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve shinˉ nyi chi teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkaoˍmonˇ chi kʼaw‸ ce la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shinˉ nyi htaˇ hkaoˍmonˇ ca gʼawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh hkʼaˬ maw maw te chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ awˬ nyi piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, hkaw‸ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyiˇ nyi awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te toˇ. A shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, kanˉ maˇ te leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˍnaˆ shiˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ hpuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ leh, pehˇ gʼuiˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo maˍnaˆ shiˍ caˍ laˇ ve hta‸, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ maˍnaˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ hkʼaw maˍnaˆ shiˍ teˇ awˇmehˇ gʼawˆ keu leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Aˍronˍ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˍnaˆ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, maˍnaˆ shiˍ hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
(Teˇ awˇmehˇ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Senˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼo ˆpiˇ ve hkʼe awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo haˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Reˍhpiˆdenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ dawˬ tuˬ ca maˇ mawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ deˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ deˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ deˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, Ngaˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ tuˬ le. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ haˉ pui ga hpoˆ baˬ la yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai-o. Nawˬ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ yuˬ dawˆ jaw ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai-o.

Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve haˉ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haˉ hpawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˆ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Maˍsaˍ leh Meˍriˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ laˇ, maˇ chehˇ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Reˍhpiˆdenˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo huˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Huˇraˆ hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ yuˬ ya‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw kʼaw‸ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ la‸ gʼawˇ suh la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍronˍ leh Huˇraˆ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ ca chiˇ veu laˇ leh Moˉseˍ hta‸ mui tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ geh teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Moˉseˍ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇsuˆ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh oˇ ve hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve htanˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ mvuh chaweh chiˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸, Meˇdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Moˉseˍ ve awˬ puˍ, paw hkuˇ Yeˍtaˍroˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Moˉseˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma Ziˆpawˇraˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Moˉseˍ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍtaˍroˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ Geˍraˍsonˍ leh Eˇliˇzaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ lawn kʼo Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬlehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ Geˍraˍsonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Eˇliˇzaˬ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Yeˍtaˍroˍ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve Moˉseˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Moˉseˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui la‸ sheh caˉ leh tawˇ yaw da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ piˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍtaˍroˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Gʼuiˬsha chi lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍtaˍroˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ hpawnˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yeˍtaˍroˍ geh teˇ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi Moˉseˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ka‸ te leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍtaˍroˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te piˇ chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ka‸ te leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ paˇ lo ceh tiˉ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve le, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ ca tuˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ geh laˬ leh ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍtaˍroˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ te ve kanˉ chi a ciˉ maˇ cawˇ sheˍ.
Chi hkʼe tiˉ te ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to ka‸, choˬ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ hkeu‸ leh tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi lehˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ te gʼa tuˬ ve kanˉ maˇ heˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha awˬ kaˍ lo awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ kʼai piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe a sha‸ te‸ cawˇ ve leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te keunˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw leh yonˍ hpeh‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ, teˇ ha gʼaˇ, ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ, teˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ te piˇ lawˬ-o‸. A ciˉ haˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼo, nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ tcuh leh, maˇ haˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui te peuˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh nawˬ ve kanˉ a ciˉ lawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ maˇ heuˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ puˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh te puiˉ te gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ, teˇ ha gʼaˇ, ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ, teˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. A ciˉ haˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ geh yuˬ kʼai leh, maˇ haˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui te peuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh leh, Yeˍtaˍroˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve ha pa shehˆ maˬ teˇ maˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Raˍhpiˆdenˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Siˉnaˆ hteunˍ lo gaˬ la leh, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Aˉ ceˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ teh leh poˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ yonˍ la tuˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ geh ya‸ la leh, chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, ya‸ nyi leh shawˉ pawˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ tsuhˇ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui hpeh‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hkʼaw oˇ ve hkʼoˆ maˇ gʼa taˆ-e tuˬ leh, hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca htawˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh, hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ caw ko taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ naˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ Maˇ heˆ kʼo, gʼa bawˆ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ. Chaw yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te tcuh leh, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ tsuhˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Yaˇ miˇ geh taˇ zuh‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi mvuhˇ ba la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ tawˍ leh mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba la ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hoˆ taˍ leh, behˬ heh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ la leh hkʼaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw tawˆ la ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ taˆ-e chehˇ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Behˬ heh ma hkawˇ htawˇ shaˬ te shaˬ hehnˇ la ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve chaw geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui ko taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca nyi la tuˬ ca hto piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, chaw maˇ maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh laˬ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo taˆ la maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaw chi ve hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ caw ko leh, da‸ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˇ taˆ la tcuh. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, shu ceˬ shu hpfuhˆ te chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui.

Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa te.

Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hta‸, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ shehˆ co, awˇ co hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve yaˇ awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ leh awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ nawˬ hkʼe leˇmaˇ gʼa kʼoˆ guiˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shinˉ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kanˉ te caˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkaw‸ nyi cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve shinˉ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ caˬ leh, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, te‸ chiˉ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi chi ve hkaw‸ nyi hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ peuˬ leh, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ nyi chi ve teˇ nyi hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o.
Nawˬ chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ.
Nawˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa te.
Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkʼawˇ.
Shu hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.

Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa sheˉ lai. Shu miˇ ma hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma, shu ve ceˇ caˬ leh shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ maˇ gʼa sheˉ lai, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba ve, behˬheh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve, leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh vuiˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ awˬ to ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la leh, venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ moˬ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hkʼe, hpu shi yuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui.

Je‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hui ngaˬ awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˆ hkoˇ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yehˇ. Nawˬ hui haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ tcuhˇ yuˬ htawˆ ve kʼo, haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ go maˇ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, go oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui taˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ la leh gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ liˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ca te la htaˇ, awˬ miˇ ma maˇ cawˬ sheˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ maˇ gʼa shiˍ kʼai tcuh. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ miˇ ma cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ shiˍ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ miˇ ma ca ka piˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ cawˬ la ve kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve leh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ leh yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ leh maˇ tawˆ-e gaˇ ve kʼo,

awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ lo gʼa shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve naˍ paw hta‸ gʼa htaw pawnˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve yawˇ teˇ co-e yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te suh-e ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ hawˇ baˬ ve kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ponˬ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Yawˇ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ htawˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ pa hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hawˇ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ hawˇ piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ vuiˬ ka piˇ ve kʼo, awˬ ceˬ ma oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼe gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma uiˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ veu‸ tuˬ kʼaˇ tuˬ leh caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te piˇ ve kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ yuˬ leh gʼa tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ maˇ dawˇ taˍ ve ka‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ puiˉ ve kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma zuhˆ leh shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ-e leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ dawˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ nyiˉ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo hawˇ caˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hkeu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ nu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ chu-iˬ hpehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, haˉ pui shiˍ baˬ hpehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw oˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ gʼa zuh‸ taˍ leh,
hkʼaw‸ nawˉ juˇ fuiˍ htawˆ leh ya‸ kʼaw juˇ gʼa la ve kʼo, yawˇ na-e la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ naˆ tsuhˇ hpfuhˇ leh awˬ yanˇ shonˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ suhˆ taˬ yuˬ dawˆ leh awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve suh-e ve kʼo dawˆ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve maˇ suh-e ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ hpu piˇ leh vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve pa taw, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ leh, yaˇ hu chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa hteˆ heuˆ leh yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ shawˆ-e ve kʼo, gʼa hteˆ heuˆ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ ma ve awˬ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ ma meuˉ kʼo chi ma gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ suh kʼai ve kʼo, a sha‸ awˬ tan a sha‸,
mehˆ shiˍ awˬ tan mehˆ shiˍ, ciˬ awˬ tan ciˬ, la‸ sheh awˬ tan la‸ sheh, hkui sheh awˬ tan hkui sheh,
aˬ miˍ to‸ ve awˬ tan aˬ miˍ to‸ ve, hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ awˬ tan hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ, a naˍ awˬ tan a naˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ dawˆ leh yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ luˬ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ve ciˬ hta‸ dawˆ hkʼeh‸ piˇ ve kʼo, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ guˆ pehˍ ve kʼo, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ nuˇ oˇ ve haiˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, shu awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi maˇ ha‸ shaˉ leh chaw hta‸ guˆ pehˍ ve kʼo, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu yawˇ hta‸ hpu keu tcuh ve kʼo, shu hkʼaˬ ma keu tcuh ka‸ chi ma yawˇ ve a sha‸ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ oˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ guˆ pehˍ ve kʼo, awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ oˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma hta‸ guˆ pehˍ ve kʼo, nuˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ hpu 30 hteh‸ gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nanˬ bawˍ hta‸ hpaˆ baˬ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nanˬ bawˍ awˬ suhˉ duˇ leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ ko taˍ leh, nuˇ teˇ hkeh nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa shaiˍ piˇ leh, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nuˇ nyiˇ hkeh guˆ da‸ leh teˇ hkeh suh-e ve kʼo, te‸ chehˇ ve nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˇ leh nuˇ shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa ma-ehˬ gʼa pehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Suh taˍ ve nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ hkʼa ma-ehˬ gʼa pehˬ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nuˇ oˇ ve ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ haiˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve htawˇ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi maˇ ha‸ shaˉ ve kʼo, shu ve nuˇ suh-e ve awˬ tan, yawˇ ve nuˇ gʼa shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suh taˍ ve nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ shu ve nuˇ, yawˬ hta‸ hkʼawˇ leh tiˇ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hawˇ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ teˇ hkeh awˬ tan ngaˇ hkeh, yawˬ teˇ hkeh awˬ tan awˇ hkeh gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ shaiˍ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve awˬ tan yawˇ ve awˬ to hawˇ leh gʼa shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve nuˇ, piˉ laˬ, yawˬ ehˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, yawˇ geh lo awˬ te‸ te‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, teˇ hkeh hkʼawˇ taˍ ve awˬ tan nyiˇ hkeh gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ shu ve mawˇ hkʼawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la peuˬve kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve heh, maˇ heˆ kʼo a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw ceˇ hpehˇ caˍ leh, shu ve hko hkʼaw htawˇ ca lo‸ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve heh hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh gʼa shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu ve pa taw, teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ to‸ kʼai leh shu ve caˬ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ shu ve mawˇ shonˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpu maˇ kʼoˆ, mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chaw hkʼawˇ laˬ leh mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼawˇ kʼai ve kʼo, chaw hkʼawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ gʼa htaˇ, chaw hkʼawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ nyiˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ yuˬ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ shu ve mawˇ maˇ hkʼawˇ ve awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nuˇ, piˉ laˬ, yawˬ ehˉ, aˉ po‸ leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ veh da‸ leh tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ bon yehˬ lo gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ. Maˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nyiˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve nuˇ, piˉ laˬ, yawˬ ehˉ leh awˬ nu ve ceˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼaw, suh kʼai ve, naˬ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo shu hiˉ yuˬ kʼai leh shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo,

chaw oˇ ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh yawˇ shu ve mawˇ maˇ hkʼawˇ ve awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ gʼa hkanˍve yoˬ. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ, chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ yuˬ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ gʼa suh leh, kʼaw‸ shaiˍ da‸ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shu hkʼawˇ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haiˬve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ taˍ ve ceˇ awˬ pon kʼaw‸ shaiˍ da‸ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh ceˇ teˇ hkeh ngaˍ taˍ leh, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ chehˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ naˬ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo suh-e ve kʼo, ngaˍ shehˍ hpaˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˍ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh ngaˍ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca te ya‸ ve kʼo, awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ pa lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ maˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, te muiˬ te jaw ve hkʼe chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ gʼa tsuhˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Neˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve hkehˉ chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa fawˉ mehˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ la leh nawˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ mehˇchawˇma kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yaˇcuˬshi kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui geh awˬ yawˬ maˇ gʼa lawˬ yuˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ geh aˉ po‸ ca tan laˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˬ htaˇ yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ po‸ oˇ ve teˇ hkʼoˆ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma veu‸ zuh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkeu.

Nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tawˆ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu, shaˍlonˍ chu, leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nuˇ, yawˬ, teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ ma peuˍ geh suhˍ nyi ceh tiˉ gʼa teh leh hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Hpuiˇ hta‸ gʼa caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa ca kʼoˆ toˇ. Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.
Chaw maˇ ve hpawˇ chehˇ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.
Nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa nyi.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ ve nuˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, piˉ laˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh gʼa sheh hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh mawˇ taˆ maˇ gʼaˇ leh paiˍ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, piˉ laˬ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa chiˇ tu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ gʼa jaw kʼai.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ nawˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa taˍ. Te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hkʼawˇ piˇ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, la‸ shawnˍ oˇ hkʼe ve lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve hkehˉ chaw hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ gʼa te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ jaw leh, hkehˉ chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma hkanˍ haˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve ti mi hta‸ te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te caˇ. Hkʼe leˇ gʼa teh taˍ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa te caˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ti mi hkʼaw sheˆ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko, sha lonˍ hko hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ kanˉ te hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te leh gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kuˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan leh pawehˇ shehˆ pawˆ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ caˇ ve pawehˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve Aˍbiˆbaˍlaˆ ha pa hkʼaw ngaˬ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ yuˬ veu laˇ leh ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ gʼa laˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, caˬ gʼeu‸ caˬ jaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, pawehˇ teˇ maˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ nawˬ hui iˉ shiˍ shaˉ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe teˇ hkʼaw‸ shehˆ pawˆ pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ tanˇ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yehˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve shaˍ chu hta‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa teh taˍ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ e ve cuˉ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa keu caˉ caˇ.
Ngaˬ gu taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ kʼai peu tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ taˇ te. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai leh nawˬ hui hta‸ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa te luˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa dawˆ paˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ piˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui geh cawˬ ve naˬ ve gawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yaˇ shawˆ-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ kʼai piˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hiˇviˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, leh Hiˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo tiˉ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chaw maˇ la leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ te leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa uˉ peunˍ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ maˇ gʼa te.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw taˇ chehˇ tcuh. Nawˬ hui chehˇ tcuh ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui na leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kʼo, va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˍronˍ, Naˬdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 70 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ geh taˆ la-o. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, hkui tcuhˉ teh leh ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ paˇ lo gʼa jiˆ laˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ lehˬ hkʼaw paˇ lo ceh ka‸ maˇ gʼa laˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ geh kʼai lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ tiˉ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ duˇ ti ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ tiˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸tuˉ tanˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkehˇ hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ li‸ daw hta‸ yuˬ leh chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ hkehˇ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ suhˍ chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 70 gʼaˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh,

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkui sheh awˬ hawˉ lo mvuhˇ naw hkʼa shuˍ kehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, nawˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, teˇ geh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ geh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ la-o. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, haˉ pui baˉ hkʼoˆ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼai tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo law taˍ-o‸. Aˍronˍ leh Huˇraˆ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ tawˇ te da‸ tuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, moˬ lehˬ hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ moˬ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ moˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Moˉseˍ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ moˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ 40 nyi 40 haˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Tanˇ laˇ gaˇ ve chaw hui ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ pon nawˬ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ,
awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi maˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh te taˍ ve hpa,
naˆ tsuhˇ nyiˉ-ehˍ haw taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ,
kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ, naˍ manˇ hawnˉ leh sha hawnˉ,
paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ tuˬ ve shehnˉ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh lo chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon da‸ kehˬ ve aˉ po kʼo teˇ maˬ gʼa te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve aˉ po kʼo leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˍ laˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te-o.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ 2 shaw‸ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu leh mvuh hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ shi caˆ yuˬ leh hkʼa caw zuhˇ gʼa te nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ te leh ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˇ ceˍ lo gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ-o‸.
Suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw shi keu leh, ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ kʼai tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa shi keu taˍ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa yuˬ tawˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw keu taˍ-o‸.
Shi hta‸ yuˬ leh zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Shi yuˬ te taˍ ve hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ awˬ hoˆ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ,
teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ gʼa te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ gʼa hpe beh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh gʼa chehˇ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˆ oˇ ve ta kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ beh piˇ leh, ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkeˍruˆbenˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ, ta kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve hpui lawˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ leh, oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ shi caˆ yuˬ leh gʼa dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, la‸ taw kʼaw teˇ paˉ fe awˬ hkʼaˇ te taˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hkʼoˆ shi caˆ gʼa nehˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ awˬ pon shi la‸ kawˬ 4 maˬ gʼa te leh, hkui sheh 4 maˬ tcuhˉ taˍ kuiˬ lo gʼa hpeh keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
La‸ kawˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpui lawˇ hta‸ taˆ kʼai tuˬ suhˆ taˬ shi keu kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, shi caˆ nehˉ keu taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ paˇ lo gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ-o‸.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ gʼa yuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa teh taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˉ daw, awˬ kʼaˉ le‸, leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ gʼa te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ ehˉ hkaw‸ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, teˇ hpawˇ lo shehˆ maˬ gʼa te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ chi ve hkaw‸ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ tuˍ tuˍ taˍ ve lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve suhˉ veˆ shehˆ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ hkuiˉ daw chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve suhˉ veˆ 4 maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ hkaw‸ maˬ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ le le awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ tuˍ tuˍ taˍ ve teˇ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ tuˍ tuˍ taˍ ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ nawˬ piˇ taˍ leh, oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ gʼa yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ suhˍ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa te taˍ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ kawˆ faiˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sho nuˆ leh sho nuˆ keu taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ shi tiˉ gʼa yuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ leh, awˬ hkʼeun oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shi 20 cawehˬ hkʼe yuˬ leh gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te-o.

Awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ leh nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve hpa teˇ chi hkʼoˆ gʼa te chiˇ ve yoˬ. Hpa oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, hkeˍruˆ benˍ awˬ han gʼa te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 28 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpa ngaˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ gʼa tawˉ nehˉ da‸ leh, awˬ nu ve ngaˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve hpa oˇ ve awˬ meuˇ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa la‸ kawˬ gʼa tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve hpa teˇ hkʼoˆ ve hta‸ chi hkʼe ve la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve hpa teˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ chi hkʼe ve la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ gʼa te keu piˇ leh, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ ngaˇ chi maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼuˉ da‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hpa oˇ ve nyiˇ hkʼoˆ lehˬ teˇ hkʼoˆ tiˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ chi hta‸ beh tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yu leh hpa teˇ chi teˇ hkʼoˆ gʼa te chiˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 30 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpa chi ve ngaˇ hkʼoˆ teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ gʼa tawˉ nehˉ da‸ leh, awˬ nu ve hkaw‸ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa tawˉ nehˉ da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkaw‸ hkʼoˆ yuˬ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve hpa chi ve hta‸ aˉ po kʼo awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa teh keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
