Hpa chi ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ meuˇ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ gʼa te keu ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ, chi hkʼe ve la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ gʼa te keu ve yoˬ.
Kuiˇ kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ ngaˇ chi maˬ te leh, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼuˉ gʼawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ po kʼo teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Beh leuˉ taˍ ve hpa oˇ ve lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, teˇ shaw‸ hkʼe gʼa beh zuhˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo hta‸ naˆ tsuhˇ nyiˉ-ehˍ shehˆ taˍ ve yawˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ gʼa beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ baˉ gʼa yuˬ ko ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ zuhˬ hpawˇ 10 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ chi ve teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ caˉ da‸ piˇ tuˬ, juˇ ehˉ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te leh suhˆ baˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa caˉ da‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo, suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ baˉ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo, juˇ dawˆ keu kuiˬ hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa te keu leh hkʼa peu-eˬ awˇ chi maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo awˬ na hpawˇ lo htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ chi baˉ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo htawˇ, hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa te keu leh hkʼa peu-eˬ awˇ chi maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo suhˆ baˉ hkaw‸ maˬ leh,
awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo teˇ hpawˇ ve suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ tawˍ lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, la‸ kawˬ teˇ maˬ tiˉ hkʼaw shi keu hpeh‸ tuˬ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ hinˉ baˉ ve hta‸ hpu la‸ kawˬ teˇ chi hkaw‸ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, suhˆ baˉ teˇ baˉ kʼo hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh awˬ hkaˆ teˇ chi ngaˇ maˬ te-o. Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ hpawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkaˆ ngaˇ maˬ,
awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkaˆ ngaˇ maˬ, leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkaˆ ngaˇ maˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaˆ lehˬ, awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ hkaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ leh, awˬ hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ-o‸.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han cawˬ ve hpa te chiˇ-oˆ.

Shi oˍ taˍ ve Aˍhkeˇshaˍ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw awˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpa oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo, shi kʼuˉ kʼaw-eh‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh hpu la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ko taˍ ve hpa awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hpa oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ awˬ tcuhˉ kaˍ tawˍ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˆ gʼa hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo hpui lawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo teh taˍ ve hpui lawˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh yuˬ te chiˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve awˬ pon aˍhkeˇshaˍ yehˬ hkuiˉdaw ngaˇ maˬ duˇ ti leh, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi gʼa oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shi kʼuˉ kʼaw-eh‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ maˬ gʼa te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa hui gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ 3 shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ lo awˬ hkaw awˇ maˬ hta‸ suhˆ teˇ baˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa yuˬ te leh, oˇ ve hta‸ kuiˇ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw‸ laˉ keu kuiˬ mu‸ hkʼu, hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ yuˬ tuˬ hkehˇ pe le, kawˆ hkehˇ, luˉ kʼu, iˉ kaˆ keu tsuhˇ kuiˬ hkehˇ, chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ leh gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬchi ve awˬ ceˬ awˇ ceˍ lo kuiˇ yuˬ leh awˬ hkʼeh‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
suhˆ taˬ keu taˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ gʼa te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kuiˇ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa shi keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo, awˬ kʼoˍ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa 100 shaw‸ yuˬ leh gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw nyiˇ chi maˬ gʼa duˇ ti taˍ leh, awˬ hkaˆ leh kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ hpu gʼa yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo, 50 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo la‸ kawˬ teˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ chi maˬ gʼa duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo htawˇ, 50 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpawˇ lo yehˬ hkuiˉdaw 3 maˬ duˇ ti leh, 15 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ lo htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve hpa 20 shaw‸ hta‸ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw awˇ maˬ duˇ ti leh gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, hpu taˬ, kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ leh hpu kʼuˉ kʼaw-eh‸ gʼa te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hta‸ ko taˍve vanˇ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 100 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 50 shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ te keu taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve hpa yuˬ leh gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh vanˇ ko tuˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yehˇ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon tuˉ tuˬ loˍ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ ca leh nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ gʼa hto piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ ve bawehˇ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ, ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ ka‸ te leh mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ gʼa nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tuˬ, nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ, Eˇliˇshaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hta‸ nawˬ geh kuˬ yuˬ taˍo‸.
Nyi sha leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la tuˬ, nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ awˬ pon da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh htaˇ, yawˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ te piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve hpa chiˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh kuˬ yuˬ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ hui gʼa te tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve aˉ po‸ awˬ hta‸ deh tuˬ, uˉ nyiˉ leh caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpeh tuˬ ve hpaˉ ce‸, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te htaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ,
yawˇ hui lehˬ shi hkeh leh, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa te chiˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shi hkeh leh awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hpeh‸ la tuˬ gʼa te chiˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo gʼawˬ tiˉ gʼa ve aˉ po‸ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ veu‸ tuˬ ve nyi ma pui beh tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ, aˉ po‸ hta‸ hkʼa hawehˍ awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, shi hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, gʼa tawˉ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shehnˉ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ nawˬ gʼa htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shehnˉ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yaˇ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yaˇ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh gʼa htawˆ keu ve yoˬ.
La‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ca leh, Yaˍkoˆ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh haˉ pui shehnˉ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ gʼa htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haˉ pui shehnˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ awˬ meh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ te leh,
shi caˆ nyiˇ caˆ hta‸ vaw‸ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shi mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, shi hkeh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po‸ te chiˇ ve hkʼe, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ nyiˇ kʼaw‸ teh te leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ htu gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, shehnˉ shiˍ awˇ cawˆ gʼa tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ ve teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve shehnˉ, naw hpui ve shehnˉ, leh hpuˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
nyiˇ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, naw naˆ ve shehnˉ, ga‸-ehˍ ve shehnˉ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ,
shehˆ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, shi nyi ve shehnˉ, naw shi ve shehnˉ, shiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ,
awˇ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ leh, shi naw ve shehnˉ, nyi hpui ve shehnˉ, nyi naˆ ve shehnˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ hkʼaw gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, haˉ pui shehnˉ oˇ ve teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh gʼa htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma pui hta‸ beh tuˬ awˬ pon shi caˆ nyiˇ caˆ yuˬ leh aˉ caˆ hkeh hkʼa shuˍ vaw‸ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, nyi ma pui beh tuˬawˬ na paˉ, awˬ ceˍ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi caˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ caˆ lehˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve shi caˆ nyiˇ caˆ lehˬ, shi mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve chi lehˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve, awˬ hawˉ awˬ ceˍ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma gʼuˇ suhˍ paˉ hpawˇ, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve shi caˆ teˇ hpawˇ lo teˇ maˬ gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve shi la‸ kawˬ leh aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve shi la‸ kawˬ hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa caˆ yuˬ leh gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve chi lehˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma awˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ hta‸ tawˉ keu taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ lo gʼa pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hpa awˬ hkʼaw lo, Uˆrenˍ leh Tuˇmenˍ hta‸ gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve a loˍ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa tiˉ gʼa yuˬ tawˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kʼoˍ shi keu gʼa tuˬ, hpa oˇ ve awˬ kʼaw ji lo gʼa hkoˇ hpe‸ taˍ leh yeˬ chaweh gʼa kʼaw‸ tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ ci ku shiˍ leh shi ju lu ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma awˬ mehˍ meuˇ lo, aˉ ci ku shiˍ teˇ shiˍ kʼo, shi ju lu teˇ shiˍ, chi hkʼe hkʼa caw zuhˇ gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kanˉ te leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ maˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ leh, ju lu ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼa bvuhˬ la piˇ chehˇve yoˬ.
Shi mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ teˇ maˬ te leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve li‸ mehˆ gʼa htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh, yawˇ ve uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ gʼa hpeh tsuh‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ da‸ ve cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ leh ha‸ yuˬ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve naˍ kʼa‸ pui hkʼoˆ lo gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve aˉ po‸ awˬ hta‸ deh tuˬ, uˉ nyiˉ leh caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpeh tuˬ ve hpaˉ ce‸ hta‸ htawˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi sha leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma, caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpeh tuˬ ve hpaˉ ce‸ leh uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tawˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ feuˉ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh aˉ yaˇ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ, haˍ tawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa tawˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw leh maˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa veu‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ htaˇ, nawˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh, yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh yu‸-o‸.
Diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ te leh, hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ baˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ chu hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ taˍ-o‸.
Nuˇ paˍ leh yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu leh ngaˬ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hehˉ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ, leh aˉ po‸ awˬ hta‸ deh tuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpaˉ ce‸ hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ uˉ nyiˉ nyiˉ piˇ leh, uˉ nyiˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve li‸ mehˆ hta‸ nehˉ piˇ taˍ-o‸.
Naˍ manˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ aˉ po‸ feuˉ piˇ-oˆ.

Caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpaˉ ce‸ hpeh piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ lehˬ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸, hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ bawehˇ lo nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ sheh veu laˇ-oˆ. Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ suhˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ naw te leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ hpoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ leh awˬ shehˍ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu, awˬ lanˇ shiˍ nyiˇ shiˍ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cawˬ taˍ ve nuˇ shaˍ, nuˇ guiˬ kʼuˉ leh awˬ hkʼaw ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui deh chehˇ ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo gʼa ca tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ la‸ sheh taˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tawˆ hpoˆ taˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaw ve hkʼa peu-eˬ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬhkʼoˆ hpoˆ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˬ ehˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ sheh gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬ suhˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, laˬ sha paˉ la‸ ma peuˍ, hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kui hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ leh shaˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu, awˬ mehˍ tu, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu leh la‸ sha paˉ ve pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu hta‸ yuˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu teh taˍ ve diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ, naˍ manˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ, leh paˉ-ehˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ-o‸.
Caˇ tuˬ chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa keu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve nyi ma pui hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ ve nyi ma pui leh pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ awˬ pon gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ chawˇ muiˬ da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ ca tanˇ piˇ la ve teˇ pawˆ le le, nyi ma pui leh pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon teˇ kaˬ lo gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ tan paw hkuˇ te tuˬ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh kanˉ ca te ve teˇ yanˇ, veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa veu‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ yaˇ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo gʼa keu caˉ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ shaˍ oˇ ve leh hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ven baˆ hpehˇ leh aˉ yaˇ piˇ htaˇ, yehˇ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve pa taw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Shaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve pawehˇ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, teˇ nyi le le nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ leh da‸ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve da‸ kehˬ la leh, oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa htawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui gʼa tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi ve teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ hpawˇ teˇ hkeh leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, junˍ meu-e ngaˇ panˇ leh naˍ manˇ nyiˇ kaw hkaw‸ da‸ leh yawˬ ehˉ geh teˇ geh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ nyiˇ kaw gʼa tanˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ shawˉ hpawˇ tuˉ tanˇ jaw ve hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chi hkʼe gʼa te leh, bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ pa taw da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa hui gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ gʼa te tcuhˉ naw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ leh awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi gʼa oˍ taˍ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa cawˬ zuhˇ shi caˆ gʼa dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ hpawˇ lo, suhˆ taˬ keu taˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ gʼa te keu taˍ leh, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, shi caˆ nehˉ keu taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hawˉ paˉ lo gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ hta‸ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ gʼa yuˬ te leh, shi gʼa oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hpa ko taˍ ve awˬ baˬ hpawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ shawˉ le le Aˍronˍ lehˬ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ gu htaˇ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo sha hawnˉ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.

Mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la leh kawˆ faiˇ gu tuˉ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ sha hawnˉ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ ve awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ. To nuˇ to shaˆ, caˇ tuˬ leh awˬ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co, teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ shenˍ yuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ maˇ gʼa gaˬ la tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˇ lanˇ hkʼaw awˬ meh cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˇ lanˇ hkʼaw awˬ meh cawˬ leh a sha‸ 20 hkʼawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, awˬ hpfuhˇ chi gʼa keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon keu ve teˇ yanˇ, paw sha ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ gʼa keu ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui keu laˇ ve hpu chi hta‸ yuˬ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ pon gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kuiˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkehˇ pe le lonˉ teˇ maˬ leh hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Hkehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo gʼa teh taˍ leh, oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yehˇ leh yawˇ hui ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ tsuhˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ jaˇ ve muˇ raˍ ngaˇ cawehˬ, sha hawnˉ nyiˇ cawehˬ ngaˇ hkanˉ, awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve suhˆ guiˬ kʼuˉ nyiˇ cawehˬ ngaˇ hkanˉ,
hawnˉ jaˇ ve awˬ nu ve suhˆ guiˬ kʼuˉ ngaˇ cawehˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu 6 kaw hta‸ yuˬ leh,
da‸ kehˬ ve naˍ manˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ka ti‸ shaˉcaˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
hpui lawˇ leh awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,

sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, iˉ kaˆ hkehˇ pe le hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ kehˬ ve naˍ manˇ yuˬ leh gʼa pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ

Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ leh awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa htawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa yehˇ tuˬ ve naˍ manˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Naˍ manˇ chi ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le maˇ gʼa yehˇ. Chi hkʼe ve naˍ manˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te yehˇ. Chi ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hui naˍ manˇ chi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ

Chi hkʼe ve naˍ manˇ hta‸ te yehˇ ve chaw leh, paw hkuˇ maˇ heˆ ve chaw hta‸ naˍ manˇ chi shehˆ piˇ ve chaw hta‸, ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve muˇraˍ, awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve suhˆ guiˬ kʼuˉ, gaˍbaˍnunˍ leh lawˇbanˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa ma-ehˬ tsuh yuˬ leh,
da‸ jaˇ ve sha hawnˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ te-o. Sha hawnˉ oˇ ve hta‸ aˉ leh‸ gʼa hkaw‸ leh gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ meuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ teˍ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa hkaˆ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ. Sha hawnˉ chi ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te taˍ ve sha hawnˉ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ to pon maˇ gʼa yehˇ. Ngaˬ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve sha hawnˉ hta‸ te htaˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to pon yehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Huˇraˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Uˇriˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpu, shi, kuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ,
haˉ pui shehnˉ hta‸ laiˉ ceuˬ gu te ve leh suhˆ hkʼaw htawˆ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te tuˬ, Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Aˍhiˆsaˍmehˆ ve yaˇ, Aˬhawˇleˍbaˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ te gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ, ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ, leh aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ loˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
hpui lawˇ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ,
to nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkehˇ leh hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ,
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te htaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ,

naˍ manˇ leh da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve sha hawnˉ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, awˬ nyi chi ve teˇ nyi lehˬ, ngaˬ leh nawˬ hui awˬ kaˍ lo teh taˍ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi chi hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi chi teˇ nyi lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi chi hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh kanˉ te ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve kanˉ te caˇ tuˬ awˬ nyi hkaw‸ nyi cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi chi teˇ nyi hkʼaw kanˉ te ve chaw lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi chi hta‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ leh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ kaˍ lo co co taiˍ taiˍ teh taˍ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ hkaw‸ nyi ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ ngaˬ kanˉ maˇ te leh gʼaˇ jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Aˍronˍ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ te laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Moˉseˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve shi naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve shi naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍronˍ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ, naˍ vawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lawˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ shi nuˇ oˇ ve gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, Shawˉ pawˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw chi ma ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ yawˇ hui tu leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hti caˇ hti dawˬ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ haˆ haˆ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, venˇbaˆ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te leh, oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma hkʼaˬ ma heh ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ tawˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nyi ma zuhˆ ve le.

Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tiˇ pehˍ leh te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ sheˍ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ hpawˇ hpawˇ lo awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa biˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve li‸ mehˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Fa la hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve chaw kuˬ heuˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ maˇ heˆ. Ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ leh chaw kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ fa la awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la leh, shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ baˬ leh hkoˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve nuˇ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, aˬ miˍ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lawˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ meuˉ-ehˍ te geuˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw ngeuˍ keu leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ ve pa taw, chi taw taw kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te tcuh ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍronˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma a ciˉ taˇ zuhˆ laˇ sheˍ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gaˇ jaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ te laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Moˉseˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shi hkʼa cawˬ ve yuˬ tawˆ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh lo shi yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu leh nuˇ ehˉ chi tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ maˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shu kʼoˆ guiˇ gʼuiˬ guiˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Moˉ seˍ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve chaw choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw pfuhˇ leh, aˉ po kʼo teˇ maˬ le le hkʼaw ca lo‸ nyi-o. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, nawˬ hui ve awˬ chawˇ, leh nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ hui chaw shehˆ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi Moˉseˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui uiˍ jaˇ ve venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha geh taˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui shi shaˉ ho‸ te leh, oˉ kʼoˍ pui taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ bon te leh yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ a ciˉ shiˆ baˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw shiˆ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ chi beu‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ hta‸ nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ nyiˉ te tcuh ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tcuh leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh te toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma heh ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ la ve hta‸ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun maˇ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui nyi ma heh ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh te toˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ hui luˬ kʼai ve maw jaˇ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ teh taˍ-oˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ a ciˉ vuiˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo hpa aˉ po kʼo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˉ po kʼo chi ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chehˇ kuiˬ teh‸ meh piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ gaˇ ve chaw oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ le le Moˉseˍ hpa aˉ po kʼo lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hpa aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ nyi taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, hpa aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ya‸ la leh aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ moˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hpa aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ chawˇ chawˇ na‸ uˉ te da‸ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, hpa aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ lo‸-e tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ geh a shu hta‸ kʼai peu laˇ tuˬ ve nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ leh nawˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve kanˉ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ te gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai leh nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh awˬ tehˬ awˬ na maˇ kʼai tuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo a ciˉ taˇ tawˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh maˇ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peun da‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpanˍ kʼai tcuh leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ nawˬ hta‸ maw laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo nawˬ huˉ taˍ hpeh‸ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ haˉ pui kaˍ lo yuˬ keu laˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh nawˬ hta‸ beh taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve caw‸ nawˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ te hkoˇ peuˬ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ tan, haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ponˬ laˬ htaˇ bvuh‸ laˇ jaw ve li‸ mehˆ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ la-o.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ geh maˇ gʼa laˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ. Hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo htawˇ nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa ca kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ piˇ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ htawˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh Siˉ naˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ moˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpanˍ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh awˬ bon te piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nyi ma dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha, ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ, shehˆ co awˇ co htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh a ciˉ te toˇ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma heh ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve yaˇ hkʼe a ciˉ shawˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ te maˍ piˇ jaw sheˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ te maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ tuˬ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh anˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍ niˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kʼai toˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui geh shaˉ caˆ taˇ caˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui ve da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh shaˉ caˆ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ leh yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui shaˉ ho‸ maˇ gʼa te. Oˉ kʼoˍ ka‸ maˇ gʼa pui.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Aˍbiˆbaˍlaˆ ha pa hkʼaw tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ caˇ ve pawehˇ suhˍ nyi gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ ha pa htaˇ nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nawˬ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve piˉ laˬ awˬ tan yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh gʼa pa hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ piˉ laˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ pa hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ gʼa awˉ hteh piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ maˇ gʼa te laˬ.
Hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui kanˉ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Ti mi mehˇ htaˇ leh caˬ gʼeu‸ htaˇ htawˇ gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, caˬ gʼeu‸ htaˇ gʼa te tuˬ ve pawehˇ leh, hkʼaw‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ shehˆ pawˆ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼehˬ la piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui pawehˇ chi shehˆ maˬ hta‸ te chehˇ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ. Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ htaˇ, caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ.

Nawˬ hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ e ve cuˉ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ maˇ gʼa keu caˉ caˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha geh 40 nyi 40 haˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ 10 hkawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˉ hkʼoˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh na‸ uˉ te da‸ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ maˇ jawˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai maˇ haˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ geh kʼai leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ taw yaw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hpa teˇ maˬ yuˬ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ tuˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ pawˆ le le yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve hpa hta‸ yehˬ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na‸ uˉ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ te da‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hpa kʼaw‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui kanˉ te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon fuiˍ teh leh gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw kanˉ te ve chaw lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi chi hkʼaw, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ceh, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hpu, shi, kuiˇ,
awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, da‸ jaˇ ve hpu, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yuˬ te taˍ ve hpa,
nyiˉ-ehˍ haw taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ,
kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve sha hawnˉ,
paw hkuˇ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma leh nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ tawˉ keu piˇ tuˬ ve shehnˉ shiˍ laiˉ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo la‸shaˉmaˉ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ca te la ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ beh tuˬ kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬ hkuiˉ dawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ,
ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ, ko tuˬ ve hpa,
hpui lawˇ leh oˇ ve hta‸ keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ,
aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ hpui lawˇ, kawˆ faiˇ leh naˍ manˇ,
sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hta‸ keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬve naˍ manˇ, sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ko taˍ tuˬ ve hpa,
to nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kuiˇ, keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkehˇ pe le, hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ,
aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve hpa, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw leh la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo ko taˍ tuˬ ve hpa,
aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ keu tuˬ ve juˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ,
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ Moˉseˍ geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼe, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ pon awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te tuˬ awˬ pon, leh da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ te tuˬ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa tanˇ gaˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve naˍ vawˇ, la‸ peˍ, shi caˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ choˆ tuˬ hta‸ tanˬ leh hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun laiˉ ceuˬ ve yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ la ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ geh cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yuˬ te taˍ ve hpa, nyiˉ-ehˍ haw taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ gʼuiˬ kʼuˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa tanˇ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, hpu leh kuiˇ yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ la ve yoˬ. Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, suhˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hpa te chiˇ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve gʼo‸ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ leh da‸ jaˇ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma pfuhˇ leh te puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yuˬ leh hpa te chiˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma leh nyi ma pui beh tuˬ hta‸ keu tuˬ ve shehnˉ shiˍ laiˉ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve naˍ manˇ, sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nyi ma pfuhˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon a shu yawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Huˇraˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Uˇriˆ ve yaˇ Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ lehˬ kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw,
cheuˬ jaˇ ve ca liˉ paˍ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ htawˆ puiˉ te puiˉ ve chaw,
aˉ po‸ hta‸ keu tuˬve shehnˉ shiˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te puiˉ ve chaw, suhˆ hkʼaw htawˆ puiˉ ve chaw leh nyi sha ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍbiˆ saˍmehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhawˇleˍbaˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, kanˉ te paˍ, awˬ han te paˍ, suhˆ hkʼaw htawˆ paˍ, naˆ tsuhˇ shehˆ paˍ, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve hpa te chiˇ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa deh maˍ piˇ leh sheh kʼai piˇ gʼa tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ, Aˍhawˇleˍbaˆ leh awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ, Aˍhawˉleˍbaˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ leh nyi ma pfuhˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kanˉ tanˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon Moˉseˍ geh ca tanˇ la ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ shawˉ le le Moˉseˍ geh tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ loˍ ve a‸ kehˉ mawˇ awˬ leuˉ yuˬ laˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui tanˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa ha‸ yuˬ taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, loˍ ve a‸ kehˉ ka‸ maˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, puiˉ jaˇ cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˇ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh leh da‸ jaˇ ve hpa hta‸ yuˬ leh hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han cawˬ ve hpa teˇ chi hkʼoˆ te chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve zuhˬ hpawˇ 28 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ cawˬ leh hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hpa ngaˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ yuˬ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve hpa 5 hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve hpa oˇ ve awˬ meuˇ hpawˇ lo nawˉ lehˍ ve hpa la‸ kawˬ tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve teˇ hkʼoˆ lonˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ chi hkʼe ve la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ hkʼa hawehˍ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui shi kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ ngaˇ chi maˬ te leh hpa oˇ ve nyiˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kʼuˉ gʼawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hpa teˇ hkʼoˆ tiˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ beh tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh hta‸ yuˬ leh hpa teˇ chi hkʼoˆ te ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ zuhˬ hpawˇ 30 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ cawˬ leh hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpa oˇ ve ngaˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇmaˬ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve ngaˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ tawˉ nehˉ da‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˉ nehˉ da‸ taˍ ve hpa awˬ ceˍ meuˇ lo la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ chi maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ ngaˇ chi maˬ te leh hpa oˇ ve nyiˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kʼuˉ gʼawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hpa teˇ hkʼoˆ tiˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo hta‸ beh tuˬ awˬ pon, nyiˉ-ehˍ haw taˍ ve yawˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ zuhˬ hpawˇ 10 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ leh,
suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ baˉ caˉ da‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon juˇ ehˉ nyiˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ juˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo, suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ chi baˉ yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ awˬ hawˉ lo, juˇ dawˆ keu kuiˬ hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˇ chi maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo awˬ na hpawˇ lo htawˇ, suhˆ baˉ nyiˇ chi baˉ yuˬ ko leh hpu la‸ kawˬ awˇ chi maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ teˇ baˉ awˬ hawˉ lo hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo suhˆ baˉ hkaw‸ baˉ yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ hpawˇ lo, suhˆ baˉ hkaw‸ baˉ yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na hkʼa shuˍ tawˍ lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, la‸ kawˬ hkʼaw shi keu hpeh‸ tuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi pa taw, oˇ kaˬ lo suhˆ baˉ hiˉ baˉ, hpu la‸ kawˬ teˇ chi hkaw‸ maˬ cawˬ leh, suhˆ baˉ teˇ baˉ ve hta‸ hpu la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh awˬ hkaˆ teˇ chi ngaˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ hpawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkaˆ ngaˇ maˬ,
awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkaˆ ngaˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaˆ lehˬ, awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ leh, awˬ hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh leh, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa hta‸ yuˬ leh, hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpa ko tuˬ awˬ pon aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw 4 maˬ te leh, shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, shi kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ teˇ hpaˍ, hpu la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ ko tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh yuˬ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nyi sha tuˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ngaˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ te keu leh, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ ngaˇ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ lehˬ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu leh, mvuh hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ taˍ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ te leh,
awˬ hta‸ hpawˇ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼa cawˇ zuhˇ lo shi caˆ dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ te leh, ta kʼoˍ hkui sheh 4 hpawˇ ve hta‸ dawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ kʼai tuˬ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ te leh shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi la‸ kawˬ hkʼaw shi keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ hta‸ htawˇ, shi yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi yuˬ te taˍ ve hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ maˬ htawˇ,
ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ lo te nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hpe taˍ leh ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu cawˬ ve hpui lawˇ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shi oˍ taˍ leh hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo shi caˆ nehˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo la‸ taw kʼaw teˇ paˉ fe awˬ hkʼaˇ te taˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shi caˆ dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hpui lawˇ awˬ pon shi la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ te leh, hkui sheh tcuhˉ kuiˬ lo dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
La‸ kawˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpui lawˇ hta‸ taˆ tuˬ suhˆ taˬ shi keu kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, shi caˆ dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ te leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu tuˬ hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ, mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ leh hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ hta‸ shi yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˉ daw, awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, teˇ hpawˇ ve awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ shehˆ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ chi ve hkaw‸ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve suhˉ veˆ shehˆ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hkuiˉ daw chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve suhˉ veˆ awˇ maˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ chi ve teˇ maˬ le le awˬ hawˉ lo, awˬ tuˍ tuˍ taˍ ve teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ tuˍ tuˍ taˍ ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ leh,
oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ leh awˬ hkʼeun oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shi 20 cawehˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa hui cawˬ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve leh awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ shi caˆ yuˬdawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ hpawˇ lo suhˆ taˬ keu taˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ. La‸ kawˬ chi nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, shi caˆ dawˇ keu taˍ ve awˬ hawˉ paˉ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ hta‸ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ te leh shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve naˍ manˇ leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, mvuh hpawˇ 3 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ lo awˬ hkaw awˇ maˬ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ leh, kuiˇ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaw‸ laˉ keu kuiˬ mu‸ hkʼu, hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ yuˬ tuˬ hkehˇ pe le, kawˆ hkehˇ, luˉ kʼu, iˉ kaˆ keu tsuhˇ kuiˬ hkehˇ, chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇ tanˇ kuiˬ chi awˬ ceˍ awˇ ceˍ lo kuiˇ yuˬ leh awˬ hkʼeh‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
suhˆ taˬ keu taˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ yuˬ leh keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuiˇ hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw shi keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo awˬ kʼoˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kuiˇ mehˆ gʼeuˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkehˇ pe le leh hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ ko tuˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo hpa 100 shaw‸ yuˬ leh ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpa oˇ ve ko tuˬ awˬ pon, kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw nyiˇ chi maˬ duˇ ti taˍ leh, kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ 100 shaw‸ cawˬ ve hpa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo lehˬ, 50 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve hpa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo la‸ kawˬ teˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ chi maˬ duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ leh kuiˍ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo htawˇ 50 shaw‸ cawˬ ve hpa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ miˉ hta‸ te leh la‸ mehˍ hpawˇ lo kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ shehˆ maˬ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw shehˆ maˬ duˇ ti leh, 15 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve hpa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ miˉ hta‸ te leh la‸ sha hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ko taˍ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
La‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ leh kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ leh kuiˍ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu caˆ yuˬ dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ leh zuhˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve nyi sha jaˇ ve hpa yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ awˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw 4 maˬ duˇ ti taˍ leh, kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh vanˇ ko tuˬ awˬ pon loˍ cawˇ ve juˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe paw hkuˇ Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ hoˉ te leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ keu taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ te htaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Huˇraˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Uˇriˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Beˍshaˍleˍlaˆ lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍhiˆsaˍmehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhawˇleˍbaˆ lehˬ, la‸shaˉmaˉ puiˉ ve chaw, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw leh awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve hpa te chiˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon tanˇ laˇ taˍ ve shi hkʼa peu-eˬ 630 cawehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon tanˇ laˇ taˍ ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ 2,160 cawehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw 603,550 gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
La‸ kawˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ hpu 22 cawehˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, hpu 2,155 cawehˬ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve la‸ kawˬ, leh vanˇ ko tuˬ loˍ ve la‸ kawˬ 100 te ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve hpu 15 cawehˬ hta‸ hpu kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ shi keu tuˬ ve hpu taˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ laˇ ve kuiˇ lehˬ, 1,465 cawehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Kuiˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo keu tuˬ ve kuiˇ la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
vanˇ ko htaˇ loˍ ve la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, vanˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo yehˇ tuˬ loˍ ve la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh vanˇ ko htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ loˍ ve juˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ ca te htaˇ Aˍronˍ veu‸ tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh yuˬ leh te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh leh shi hkeh yuˬ leh aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ te chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shi gʼo‸ hkeh te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh geh teˇ geh keu chiˇ ve yoˬ.
La‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ te leh, gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ cawˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, shi hkeh yuˬ leh te chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ po‸ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh, shi hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ te ve hkʼa shuˍ, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nyiˇ kʼaw‸ teh te taˍ ve nyi ma pui beh tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ htu cawˬ leh awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, shehnˉ shiˍ awˇ cawˆ tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ ve teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve shehnˉ, naw hpui ve shehnˉ leh hpuˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
nyiˇ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, naw naˆ ve shehnˉ, ga‸-ehˍ ve shehnˉ leh nyiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
shehˆ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, shi nyi ve shehnˉ, naw shi ve shehnˉ, shiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
awˇ cawˆ teˇ cawˆ lehˬ, shi naw ve shehnˉ, nyi hpui ve shehnˉ leh nyi naˆ ve shehnˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ, shi mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ meh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ awˬ pon shi caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui shi mu‸ hkʼu nyiˇ maˬ leh shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ te leh, la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ nyi ma pui beh tuˬ awˬ na paˉ awˬ ceˍ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shi caˆ nyiˇ caˆ yuˬ leh la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shi caˆ oˇ ve awˬ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo shi mu‸ hkʼu nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hpeh tuˬ ve awˬ caˆ hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ awˬ ceˍ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve shi la‸ kawˬ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ awˬ paˇ cawˬ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ lo hpeh taˍ ve hpa caˆ teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui beh tuˬ hta‸ tawˉ keu taˍ ve la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ tawˉ keu taˍ ve la‸ kawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa caˆ yuˬ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nyi ma pui beh tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa ceh tiˉ yuˬ tawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po‸ oˇ ve lehˬ oˉ kʼoˍ shi keu gʼa tuˬ hkoˇ hpe‸ taˍ leh, maˇ gʼa tzuh‸ kʼai tuˬ yeˬ chaweh tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, aˉ ci ku shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh aˉ po‸ awˬ meuˇ lo tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shi ju lu ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, aˉ ci ku shiˍ teˇ maˬ kaˍ teˇ maˬ tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ paw hkuˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ deh tuˬ ve aˉ po‸ leh uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
uˉ tcuhˍ leh haˍ tawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ hkeh yuˬ leh caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpeh tuˬ ve hpaˉ ce‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shi baˉ ehˉ teˇ maˬ te leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve li‸ mehˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ shi baˉ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa caˆ yuˬ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve pa taw, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Moˉseˍ geh yuˬ laˬve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸, suhˆ baˉ, awˬ hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw leh la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ,
nyiˉ-ehˍ haw taˍ ve yawˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ, beh tuˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ko tuˬ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ,
ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ, leh keu taˆ tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ,
hpui lawˇ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ,
shi te taˍ ve kawˆ faiˇ tuˉ teh kuiˬ leh kawˆ faiˇ teˇ hpaˍ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ leh, kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ,
shi te taˍ ve sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve naˍ manˇ, sha hawnˉ, aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ ko taˍ tuˬ ve hpa,
kuiˇ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ leh hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ,

vanˇ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve hpa, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh, la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, vanˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ ko tuˬve hpa leh aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ, juˇ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te htaˇ loˍ cawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ,
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw paw hkuˇ te chehˇ htaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ chi hkawˇ keu taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa keu taˍ leh hpa hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh, aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa teh taˍ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo hpa gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkehˇ pe le hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ keu leh, bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ vanˇ gʼa ko leh, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpa gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.

Naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ ve naˍ manˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh oˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ naˍ manˇ gʼa pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ
Hkehˇ taˍ kuiˬ leh hkehˇ pe le hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼa tsuhˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa te chiˇ a‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ laˬ leh, aˉ po‸ deh piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Moˉseˍ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ tanˬ te ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa deh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ ta kʼoˍ hkʼaw keu leh, suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shi keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ta kʼoˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, hpa yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ, ko taˍ ve hpa awˬ baˬ lo teh taˍ leh,
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh hpui lawˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ tuˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, shi te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw ko taˍ ve hpa awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo htawˇ, hpa hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo teh taˍ leh, tanˇ kui oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo to nuˇ to shaˆ leh caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkehˇ pe le hta‸ htawˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo teh taˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ,
iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh hkui sheh la‸ sheh tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo vanˇ ko taˍ leh, vanˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hpa ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ lehˬ, kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ mo‸ hoˆ beh taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Moˉseˍ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo moˬ tu kʼai peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, yawˇ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo moˬ maˇ tu kʼai sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, moˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ ve ceˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh ceˇ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpaˆ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo suhˆ gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh aˬ miˍ gʼa ceh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ shaˍ, nuˇ oˉ kʼoˍ leh nuˇ chu teˇ hpaˍ gʼa yuˬ teh ve yoˬ.
