Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, nuˇ gʼuˬ tehˆ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yawˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˉ che‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve kʼo, ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ paˍ gʼa hpeh‸ leh, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ hpaˆ leh tawˆ hpoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, oˉ kʼoˍ leh awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ leh ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve kʼo, ngaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo guˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, ngaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, kʼawˍ suhˉ cheˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˉ kʼoˍ shiˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˆ suhˍ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˆ pehˬ pui leh, awˬ hkʼaw ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaw‸ laˉ yuˬ baˬ kuiˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ leh, awˬ to hta‸ shaˉ hkoˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa teˍ meu-e piˇ leh, shaˍlonˍ chu leh sha hawnˉ hkaw‸ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ meu-e oˇ ve teˇ kaˆ, shaˍlonˍ chu a ciˉ leh sha hawnˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw te ve kʼo, diˇmaˇ gʼa keu. Caˬ hkʼa meu-e hta‸ shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ leh te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ lehˬ, sho baˉ hkʼoˆ lo chiˆ meh taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, diˇ maˇ gʼa keu. Caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ da‸ leh te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ piˇ la htaˇ, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼeh‸ leh shaˍlonˍ chu gʼa ngeuˍ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ lehˬ, ha tsuh hkʼaw keu hu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ paw hkuˇ geh yuˬ kʼai-o. Yawˇ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan hkaoˍmonˇ a ciˉ hkʼeh‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve pa taw, da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, diˇ maˇ gʼa keu. Pehˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ maˇ gʼa keu.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ pawˆ le le, aˉ leh‸ gʼa hkaw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˉ leh‸ lehˬ nawˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha awˬ kaˍ lo te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Nawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼaw lo aˉ leh‸ gʼa hkaw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ)
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍlonˍ chu leh sha hawnˉ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve leh sha hawnˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nuˇ teˇ hkeh sheh veu laˇ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, nuˇ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nuˇ ma gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo yawˇ ve la‸ sheh nuˇ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo taˍ leh, nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ suhˍ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ,
awˬ lanˇ shiˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shehˍ, chi teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˉche‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ awˬ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ ma gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ gaˇ ve kʼo,

yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu, awˬ mehˍ tu, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ,
awˬ lanˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shehˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ aˉ che‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo,

yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ,
awˬ lanˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh awˬ shehˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, awˬ suhˍ leh awˬ chu hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ htawˇ, chi ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ,
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ leh, chaw chi ma ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo sheh laˬ leh, nuˇ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw la‸ naw tuˍ keu leh, da‸ kehˬ ve hpa ko taˍve gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw hta‸ htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cawˍ taˍ sheˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ,
awˬ lanˇ shiˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ shehˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh,
awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ guiˬ kʼuˉ, nuˇ shaˍ, nuˇ oˉ kʼoˍ, nuˇ hkui sheh, nuˇ gʼuˬ tehˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh,
yawˇ hui ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ hkʼaw‸ laˉ ngeuˍ baˬ kuiˬ lo gʼa ca tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ, nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh,
yawˇ ve la‸ naw awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hpa ko taˍ ve gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw hta‸ htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve nuˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, nuˇ chi hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ tawˆ-e leh, gʼa ca tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇnawˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kuiˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ naw nuˇ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼe, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa te tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ ma teˇ hkeh hta‸ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kuiˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ naw awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ leh ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve kʼo, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ awˬ ma gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kuiˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ naw awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ loˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ laˇ tuˬ shaˉ nanˉ lo kuˬ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ mawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe hteˇ lehˍ shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ leh suh taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ ca htawˇ heuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to cha‸ chiˆ kʼai leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ awˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca htawˇ heuˆ ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ka ti‸ te ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe ve venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, shu hta‸ yawˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˬ ehˉ awˬ ma maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, aˉ pui kʼaˍ nyiˇ hkeh maˇ heˆ kʼo, guˇnyiˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˆ oˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ shawˆ leh,

tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˆ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬGʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, aˉ pui kʼaˍ nyiˇ hkeh maˇ heˆ kʼo, guˇ nyiˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ awˬ pon caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, caˬ hkʼa meu-e chi ve hta‸ shaˍlonˍ chu maˇ kʼoˆ, sha hawnˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa hkaw‸.

Yawˇ lehˬ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ kaˆ hta‸ hkaˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇpiˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ chi hkʼe te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e lehˬ, paw hkuˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ keunˍ piˇ cawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ sheˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ gʼa piˇ sheˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ tanˇ laˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˇ tanˇ laˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu geh chiˇ taˍ ngaˍ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ ve, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve,
shu ve mawˇ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve hta‸ mawˬ taˍ ve ka‸, maˇ mawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ leh venˇbaˆ chi awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ shu hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, yawˇ tanˇ laˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh,

awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tanˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ maˇ gʼa suh piˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw‸ laˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ toˆ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼaw‸ pa leh, hkʼaw‸ laˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa ca yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa to‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa suh kʼai piˇ. Teˇshawˉ le le paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo suhˆ gʼa gʼawˆ keu piˇ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa to‸ chehˇ piˇ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa suh kʼai piˇ.

Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ kaˆ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh sha hawnˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ te leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, diˇ maˇ gʼa hkaw‸.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ tuˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh,

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ yaˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve hta‸ shaˍ chu hkaw‸ leh sho baˉ hkʼoˆ chiˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼeh‸ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co paw hkuˇ te tuˬ ve Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chi hkʼe gʼa te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ awˬ to te taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh,

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yuˬ laˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa htawˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ oˇ ve ngawˉ ve kʼo, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ keu caˉ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ gʼa dawˆ hkoˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ sho yuˬ te taˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu caˉ ve kʼo, mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ laˬ leh yehˇ ve kʼo, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Tanˇ tuˬ chi awˬ pon yuˬ veu laˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ, mehˍ tu hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ chu, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu,
awˬ lanˇ shiˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu leh awˬ shehˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh,
paw hkuˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˍ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve shaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ ve leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˍ oˇ ve lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ tiˉ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ tiˉ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉcaˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ te meh sheˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ hkaw‸ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa ma-ehˬ gʼa pehˬ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ geh teˇ geh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ diˇ hkaw‸ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve paw hkuˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ gʼa caˇ peuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa teh taˍ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo tanˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh ca tanˇ la ve kʼo, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw ceh tiˉ maˇ gʼa caˇ peuˬ piˇ. Shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon ka‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ teh leuˉ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ teh taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yuˬ caˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ awˬ bon maˇ gʼa ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai leh, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve chaw htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shaˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca daw‸ ve kʼo, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Moˉseˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ chu, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu leh aˉ che‸ awˬ chu hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.

Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ chu, maˇ heˆ kʼo haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ chu hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ chu oˇ ve hta‸ laiˉ ceuˬ te yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ chu hta‸ caˇ ve chaw hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˆ suhˍ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ liˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ca tanˇ la ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ chu leh nyi ma pui shaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, awˬ chu oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma pui shaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
La‸ sha paˉ ve hkui sheh lehˬ,
awˬ suhˍ yuˬ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma pui shaˍ lehˬ la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ leh, la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui sheh lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh lawˬ yuˬ taˍve mawˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ piˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ aˬmiˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ beˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shaˍlonˍ chu, leh venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh leh diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ yuˬ laˬ-o‸.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh,
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hehˉ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Aˍronˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh, haˍ pi tsuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ lo nyi ma pui beh tuˬ hta‸ hpeh piˇ leh, uˉrenˍ leh tuˇmenˍ yuˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo uˉ nyiˉ nyiˉ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe uˉ nyi oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo da‸ kehˬ ve shi baˉ yuˬ hpeh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ naˍmanˇ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, hkehˇ pe le leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo naˍ manˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼaw‸ feuˉ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw yawˇ ve la‸ naw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ, nuˇ shehˍ, awˬ lanˇ shiˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ cawˬ taˍ ve nuˇ shaˍ, nuˇ guiˬ kʼuˉ, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ kʼai leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw yawˇ ve la‸ naw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tawˆ hpoˆ leh, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, oˉ kʼoˍ shiˍ, awˬ chu leh awˬ shaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ chi ve lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Aˍronˍ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ ma peuˍ, leh la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ ma peuˍ, la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cawˬ taˍsheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu, awˬ mehˍ tu, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu, awˬ shehˍ, awˬ lanˇ shiˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ leh la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui sheh hta‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ leh shawˆ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ baˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu leh la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui sheh awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ caˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ ve nyi ma pui shaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Moˉseˍ gʼa te cawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, naˍmanˇ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬAˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe oˇ kaˬ lo mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu caˉ caˇ-oˆ. Aˉ yaˇ piˇ htaˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu tanˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ caˇ-oˆ.
Caˇ maˇ peuˬ leh cawˬ taˉ ve shaˍ leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai. Nawˬ hui hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve kanˉ chi peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ shawˉ teˇ haˉ le aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, yawˬ ehˉ lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon teˇ hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ ve nuˇ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh,

awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ geh teˇ geh to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh ya‸ la tuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw moˍ lonˉ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ ba laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, nawˬve venˇbaˆ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ geh lo awˬ suhˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw lo la‸ naw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu, awˬ lanˇ shiˍ, awˬ shehˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ shaˍ leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to pon aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ geh lo awˬ suhˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ naw awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ shiˍ leh awˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yuˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬveu laˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve aˉ che‸ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon caˬ hkʼa meu-eˬ teˇ kaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi lehˬ teˇ nyi le le gʼa te ve kanˉ maˇ heˆ)

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve nuˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh lo awˬ suhˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ leh, tuˉ tanˉ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ nuˇ chu leh yawˬ ehˉ awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh,
nyi ma pui shaˍ hkʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh,
nyi ma pui shaˍ leh la‸ sha paˉ ve hkui sheh hta‸ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve la‸sheh chiˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ba la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ aˬ miˍ hta‸ ce ya‸ la piˇ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hpoˆ kuˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Naˍdaˆ leh Aˍbiˇhuˆ lehˬ, hkehˇ pe le hkʼaw shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh sha hawnˉ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ hkʼe te tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ to‸ pehˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Awˇzeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Miˆsheˍlaˆ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍhpanˍ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ-e leh, ngaˬ hui ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo ca teh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ shu maˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ taˇ tzuh‸ suhˍ. Nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ puiˍ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ heˆ te taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa suh-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬyoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha aˬ miˍ to‸ pehˍ piˇ lawˬ ve chaw chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ chi hkʼaw taˇ tawˆ-e. Nawˬ hui tawˆ-e ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ naˍmanˇ pfuhˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo tzuhˬ dawˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ leh, awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw, awˬ leuˉ cawˬ taˍ sheˬ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e hta‸ yuˬ leh diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo yuˬ caˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo caˇ-oˆ. Awˬ leuˉ cawˬ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ peuˬ ve nyi ma pui shaˍ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ ca tanˇ piˇ la htaˇ, shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ pawˆ le le, nyi ma pui shaˍ leh hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ lawn na nyi htaˇ, aˉ che‸ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇpeuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh,

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ yuˬ caˇ ve le. Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ yuˬ laˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬve hkʼe shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ caˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ lawˬ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Moˉseˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ yawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve,
hkui kiˆ cawˬ leh caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh behˇ caˇ puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ kaˍlaˍoˆ, faˆ pehˉ leh pa taiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆoˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh behˇ caˇ puiˉ ve htawˇ, hkui kiˆ maˇ cawˬ.
Vaˍ shaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Va‸ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Yawˇ hui hkui kiˆ cawˬ ve htawˇ, caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh maˇ behˇ caˇ puiˉ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Awˬ shehˆ leh awˬ biˉ cawˬ ve ngaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ shehˆ leh awˬ biˉ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe ve ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ.
Iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ shehˆ leh awˬ biˉ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve ngaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Aˉ ceˬ, hkawˍ tawehˍ, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ, aˉ naˆkʼaˍ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˆ, ngaˆ hpu ma, va‸laˇgawˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ leh poˬ naˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve awˬ pfuhˇ ma awˬ shehˍ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo pawˆ kʼai puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬda‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, paˉ ce‸, taˉ ve le leh paˉ ce‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ loˇ kʼai puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve suh peuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Hkui kiˆ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh maˇ behˇ caˇ puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, leh hkui taw peh cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Faˆ hpiˇ, faˆ cha‸, leh pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼehˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.

Suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ maˬ maˬ, suhˆ, hpa, shaˍ guiˬ leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hkʼoˆ ce teˍ ve kʼo, mawˇ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw gʼa tuˍ keu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh mawˇ oˇ ve maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa keu taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ gʼa dawˆ hkoˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lo‸-e ve kʼo, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to ce teˍ ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Je‸ yuˬ te taˍ ve aˬ miˍ po hpeh‸ ve kʼo, aˬ miˍ po oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa dawˇ hkoˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve kʼo nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve maˇ heˆ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ ve chaw ceh tiˉ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve mawˇ yawˇ jeˬ yawˇ hkʼoˆ ce teˍ ve kʼo, mawˇ yawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mawˇ yawˇ jeˬ yawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw tiˆ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, mawˇ yawˇ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Caˇ hpeh‸ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh suh-e leh, oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.

Suh taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˬ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ yuˬ ve chaw htawˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ htawˇ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ loˇ kʼai gaˆ kʼai ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo juˇ kʼai ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo hkui sheh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve,
awˬ to i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ leh nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Chi ve lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ loˇ kʼai gaˆ kʼai ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve leh maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ gʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Caˇ hpeh‸ ve leh caˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa fuiˍ gʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, Moˉseˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hiˉnyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ gʼa shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ suhˍ gʼa sheˆ maˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ paˍ paw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 33 nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa htawˇ. Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ maˇ gʼa lo‸-e.

Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ paw ve kʼo, 14 nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ suhˍ gʼa sheˆ maˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ paw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 66 nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ paw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ miˇ paw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ yanˇ biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon teˇ hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh leh, venˇbaˆ lawˬ hpehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ pui kʼaˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo guˇ teˇ hkeh paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇmiˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ paw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ nyiˇ hkeh, maˇ heˆ kʼo guˇ nyiˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve shaˉ chuˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo a naˍ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ behˬ tawˆ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ a naˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ mvuh lehˬ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, a naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve hpuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve htawˇ, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ maˇ hpu ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ kʼai leh ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ leh dehˬ kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, veu‸ deh taˍve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ caˉ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo, yawˇ paw hkuˇ geh teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ jaˇ la chehˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ keuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve a naˍ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hpu kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, behˬ gʼuiˬ htawˇ cawˬ ve kʼo,

a naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ haw chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
A naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ te leh hkui sheh lo hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ ve kʼo,

paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ a naˍ oˇ ve biˇ kʼai leh hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.

Paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ na-e la leh hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shaˉ chuˇ tawˆ leh na-e la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
shaˉ chuˇ tawˆ kuiˬ teˇ hkʼaˇ lo hpuˉ-ehˍ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo nyi hpu ve a naˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo yawˇ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ chuˇ tawˆ kuiˬ lo hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ chaˬ nyi leh awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ maˇ hpu ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.
A naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ kʼai ve kʼo, a naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ shaˉ chuˇ hta‸ pa taw hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve a naˍ ceh hpeh‸ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ aˬ miˍ chiˆ leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hpuˉ-ehˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo,

paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la leh awˬ gʼuiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, a naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ aˬ miˍ chiˆ ve pa taw, kʼaw‸ caˉ hpeh‸ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ mvuh hpuˉ-ehˍ maˇ cawˬ leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi gaˬ htaˇ paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

A naˍ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ maˇ heˆ. Aˬ miˍ chiˆ ve pa taw naˬ chehˇ ve a naˍ ceh hpeh‸ leh, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, paˇ kaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, a naˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo,

paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ leh, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ shiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, a naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo te‸ chiˉ a naˍ maˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ shiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai leh, awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ shi ve kʼo,
chaw oˇ ve lehˬ a naˍ awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo cawˬ ve awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai leh, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo a naˍ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve a naˍ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo,

paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ mvuh hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai leh, awˬ mvuh te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, a naˍ oˇ ve na-e la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ lo hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ.
Awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ ceh tiˉ hpu ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ a naˍ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh piˬ ce ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, uˉ hkeh mvuh piˬ ce taˍ kuiˬ lo a naˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. A naˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hpuˉ-ehˍ ve a naˍ awˬ diˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo,
paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ cawˬ ve chaw, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, tzuh‸ keu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa veu‸ deh leh, oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa puiˍ taˍ. Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ gʼa beh taˍ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ, teh‸ gʼa kuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpa hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shaˍ guiˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ nawˉ-ehˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nyiˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ pehˉ kʼai puiˉ ve yawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ taˆ ve mawˇ oˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa ca yuˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa chaˬ nyi leh, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ teˇ kaˬ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi gaˬ htaˇ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ taˆ ve kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, mawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ chaˬ nyi leh oˇ ve lehˬ pehˉ kʼai puiˉ ve yawˇ maˇ heˆ ve kʼo,
mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ leh, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi leh, yawˇ taˆ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ pehˉ kʼai ve htawˇ, awˬ sheuˉ teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ pa ve kʼo, mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve mawˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ chaˬ nyi leh yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ ti hta‸ gʼa shawˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ taˆ ve kʼo, mawˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tsuhˇ nyi leh yawˇ taˆ hkʼaˇ mehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ tsuhˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mawˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, hpa, veu‸ kʼaˇ, leh shaˍ guiˬ hta‸ yawˆ taˆ ve kʼo, mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, gʼa chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo,
paw hkuˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˆ nyiˇ hkeh, htawˇ baˉ teˇ maˬ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ caˆ leh huˇsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ maˬ gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, ngaˆ ehˉ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ keu taˍ ve je‸ muˬ hkʼu hkʼoˆ teh leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve ngaˆ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, htawˇ baˉ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh, leh huˇsoˆ awˬ hpa‸ geh teˇ geh awˬ suhˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa tuˍ keu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ na-e la peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve ngaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ peu ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ leh oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa nuˆ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la leh, fa la lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e. Yehˬ baˬ lo suhˍ nyi gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ uˉ hkeh mvuh, paˇ tcuhˆ, mehˆ mvuh leh awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ hehˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ awˬ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ leh teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ awˬ ma teˇ hkeh, shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw bon yehˬ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve leh yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˬ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ htawˇ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh chaw oˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ ma peuˍ, leh hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve la‸mehˍ paˉ la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ naw tuˍ keu leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˍlonˍ chu leh awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ ma peuˍ, leh hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, chaw oˇ ve da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh,

awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ geh teˇ geh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˬ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh, shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ leh, shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ nyiˇ hkeh maˇ heˆ kʼo, guˇ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve leh shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬsuhˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ ma peuˍ, leh hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ naw tuˍ keu leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ naˍ paw, la‸ ma peuˍ, leh hkui ma peuˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ chaw oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh,
yawˇ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ na-e la peuˬ ve haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ hta‸ yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍ nanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ heh‸ yehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ)
A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yawˇ taˆ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ca nyi sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ tawˆ taˍ tuˬ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te taˍ ve kʼo, yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ tuˬve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ca nyi ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ nawˉ-ehˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nyiˉ-ehˍ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hoˆ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ taˆ ve pehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ taˆ ve haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh venˇ baˬ lo gʼa ca yuˬ kʼoˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Peuˬhkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw paˉ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ gʼa gaˆ tsuhˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼa gaˆ ce la ve maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo gʼa ca yuˬ kʼoˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yuˬ baˬ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ awˬ tan, haˉ pui shiˍ awˬ suhˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ taˆ ve kʼo,
paw hkuˇ awˬ to teˇ pawˆgʼa ca kʼaw‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ taˆ ve oˇ ve pehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpaˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yehˬ te htaˇ yehˇ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo gʼa ca yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hoˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼa lo‸-e ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw zuh‸ ve chaw, leh oˇ kaˬ lo awˍ caˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ nyi leh, yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ taˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ, yehˬshehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˆ nyiˇ hkeh, htawˇ baˉ teˇ maˬ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ caˆ leh huˇsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ maˬ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˆ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ iˉ kaˆ keu taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼoˆ teh leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ htawˇ baˉ, huˆsoˆ awˬ hpa‸, aˉ caˆ hkeh nyiˉ-ehˍ ve leh cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ngaˆ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu leh, yehˬ hta‸ suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ngaˆ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ peu piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw yehˬ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ, shaˉ chuˇ tawˆ ve, aˬ miˍ chiˆ ve, mawˇ hta‸ yawˇ taˆ ve, leh yehˬ hta‸ yawˇ taˆ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ da‸ kehˬ ve leh hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ ve nyiˍ hkʼaw maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la ve kʼo, awˬ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Awˬ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo tawˆ la ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh hkanˉ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ mui ve mui hkʼawˇ htawˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw,
maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ mui taˉ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca mui ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw htawˇ, yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ htawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ciˉ gʼuiˇ gʼa hpe‸ teˍ cawˇ kʼo, chaw oˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve mui ve mui hkʼawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Yawˇ mui taˉ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw htawˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yawˇ mui taˉ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca chiˇ yuˬ ve chaw htawˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, la‸ sheh maˇ tsuhˇ leh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa dawˆ hkoˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve hkehˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, hkehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ ve na-e la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ maˇ heˆ kʼo, guˇ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo paw hkuˇ geh gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ ngaˆ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nyiˍ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Awˬ gʼuiˬ ngawˉ taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo hpa hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh mawˇ oˇ ve maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ teˇ geh zuh‸ peuˬ kʼo, nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ ve kʼo yawˇ lehˬ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yawˇ mui taˉ ve mui hkʼawˇ leh yawˇ zuh‸ taˉ ve zuh‸ hpui htawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yawˇ zuh‸ ve zuh‸ hpui, yawˇ mui taˉ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ,
veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw geh ca zuh‸ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Yawˇ zuh‸ ve zuh‸ hpui htawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ maw chaweh awˬ suhˍ ya‸ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ jaw ve a‸ kehˉ laˬ maw ve kʼo, suhˍ ya‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui leh yawˇ mui ve mui hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve awˬ suhˍ ya‸ ve jehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo guˇ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, aˉ pui kʼaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Fa la awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ, nyiˍ hkʼaw awˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ ve chaw,
yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw leh awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ geh ca zuh‸ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve aˬ miˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ lehˬ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ heh‸, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ moˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma, haˍ htaw, haˍ pi caˆ leh uˉ nyiˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ pui shiˍ leh, Aˍzaˍseˍlaˆ awˬ pon teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ pui shiˍ chi nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa hkaˆ yuˬ nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon hkaˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve aˉ che‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍzaˍseˍlaˆ awˬ pon hkaˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve aˉ che‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, aˉ che‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Aˍzaˍseˍlaˆ chehˇ kuiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa hpehˇ peu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ,
yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh sha hawnˉ nyiˇ kaˆ yuˬ veu leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ lehˬ sha hawnˉ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hkʼoˆ gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo to‸ tawˆ la ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ hoˆ beh sheˬ ve pa taw, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ maˇ gʼa suh.
Yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, la‸ naw tuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo htawˇ suhˍ pawˆ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, aˉ che‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nuˇ suhˍ yuˬ leh hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ htawˇ ta kʼoˍ awˬ hoˆ leh ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe gʼa te ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ chi ve maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve fa la awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ. Yawˇ awˬ to pon, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ awˬ pon leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ suhˍ, aˉ che‸ suhˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve la‸ naw awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw tuˍ keu leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍzaˍseˍlaˆ awˬ pon leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve aˉ che‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ taˍ leh, venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh, venˇbaˆ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ gʼa yuˬ teh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh aˉ che‸ oˇ ve hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa ca gʼa‸ peu tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ veu leh, chaw maˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸-e leh, yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa kʼehˆ teh taˉ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ veu‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ leh chaw chi ma ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Aˍzaˍseˍlaˆ geh ca gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ, fa la lo maˇ kʼaw‸ la sheˍ htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ leh aˉ che‸ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ tawˆ-e leh aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ, awˬ shaˍ leh awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
