Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ ca tuˉ baˬ ve chaw htawˇ, fa la lo maˇ kʼaw‸ la sheˍ htaˇ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa tsuhˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co awˬ nyi chi hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi nyi gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, caˇ tuˬ ce leh te‸ chiˉ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ tuˬ gʼa ce leh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Awˬ liˇ chi teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh,
da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ liˇ chi ve hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve awˬ nyi chi hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh,
awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo sheh laˬ leh maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ liˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬsheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Kʼoˆ gaˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi beu‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te jaw ve hkʼe, to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ. Awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo maˇ heˆ leh awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ maˇ hpeh‸.

A sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ pfuhˍ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ lehˬ a sha‸ hpeh‸ leh, venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, caˇ hpeh‸ ve shaˍ leh ngaˆ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ gʼa ve kʼo, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw gʼa duˇ tuˍ ve yoˬ.

A sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ taˇ caˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ hta‸ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ maˇ hpeh‸.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve to nuˇ to shaˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ pehˍ taˍve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui chehˇ jaw taˉ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui te ve hkʼe nawˬ hui taˇ te.
Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ liˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Nawˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ taˇ te luˬ piˇ. Nawˬ e ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ.
Nawˬ pa ve awˬ nu ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ nyi ma hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ ve awˬ hawehˍ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ htawˇ nawˬve awˬ nyi ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa hpawˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo nawˬ e hpawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ ma hta‸ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ ve aˉ shuˍ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma hta‸ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma hta‸ ka‸, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ka‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ maˇ gʼa heuˆ. Yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ miˇ ma maˇ suh sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ miˇ ma ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa heuˆ.
Yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ geh nawˬ maˇ gʼa ca zuh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ.
Shu miˇ ma hta‸ nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ chawˇ chawˇ peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ miˇ maˇ kʼoˆ to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te. Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ hkʼe te leh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe taˇ te. Awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ te. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ da‸ kehˬve hkʼe nawˬ hui htawˇ da‸ kehˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ gʼa yawˆ yan leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, shinˉ nyi htaˇ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve teˇ nyi, maˇ heˆ kʼo hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, shaˍ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ peuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Caˇ maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ve shaˍ awˬ leuˉ cawˬ kʼo, shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, shaˍ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui caˬ gʼeu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, ti mi jaˇ lo cawˬ ve caˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa gʼeu‸. Sheˆ taˍ ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hko oˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸-e leh ca kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ shaˉ ve maˇ gʼa te. Ce taˉ ve awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw leh hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve mawˇ taˇ hkʼawˇ. Shu hta‸ taˇ heˍ caˇ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ka ti‸ taˇ te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na taˇ te. Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ taˇ hiˉ yuˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˉ te tcuh ve chaw hta‸ la‸ haˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ-oˆ. Haˉ taˇ hkanˍ piˇ.
Naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkeu. Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suhˉ jehˬ suhˉ taˆ piˇ kuiˬ lo hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ te-o. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na taˇ te. Paw sha ve chaw hta‸ taˇ kawˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve taˇ kʼoˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ ve hkʼe hteˇ lehˍ tawˇ yaw-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa canˇ. Teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ kuiˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw nawˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ haˆ haˆ te-o.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa ha‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ ceuˬ maˇ shuˍ da‸ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ chaw da‸ piˇ. Ti mi teˇ peˆ tiˉ hkʼaw caˬ yawˇ nyiˇ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ sheˍ. Hpa nyiˇ ceuˬ yuˬ tawˉ taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa veu‸.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ ma hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te la ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yawˬ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la leh iˉ shiˍ cehˬ ti ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ naw‸ la ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa shaˉ caˇ. Iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ sheˍ.
Awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shaˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Awˬ suhˍ cawˬ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Faˍ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh leh paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ maˇ gʼa chiˇ baˬ.
Chaw suh-e ve pa taw dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ shawˆ hkʼaw ve maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ taˇ te caˇ tcuh. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shinˉ nyi htaˇ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ hui geh taˇ kʼai. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na taˇ te.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ nawˬ hui htawˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw gʼa te cheh taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ, maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh shu hta‸ taˇ heˍ caˇ.
Cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ leh cawˇ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw, teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo,

ngaˬ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ hui geh kʼai ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw, teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hkeu ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shu miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te peuˬ ve pa taw suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ chawˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hta‸ ka‸, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ka‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ heuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te tuˬ coˇ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ heuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ya‸ taw tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gʼa gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te peuˬ ve pa taw, oˇ hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ shuˍ paˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yaˇ ehˉ cawˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ nyi paˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui te ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui taˇ te. Nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve leh, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ gʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ caˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e, awˬ yaˇ, awˬ nyi paˍ, awˬ nyi ma suh-e ve maˇ heˆ kʼo,
awˬ nu ve chaw suh-e kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼai.
Yawˇ kʼai ve kʼo, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ uˉ hkeh mvuh, paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ shawˆ hkʼaw ve hkʼaw, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ heˆ maˇ gʼa te.
Yawˇ lehˬ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ maˇgʼa te luˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, meh maˬ lanˉ, shu kaoˇ ya‸ peuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ, leh shu baˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ leh paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ puiˍ leh buiˇ keu maˇ gʼa te chehˇ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ heˆ maˇ gʼa te.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e suh-e ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ maˇ gʼa ca nyi. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Mehˇchawˇma, shu baˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ leh meh maˬ lanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ. Nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chi ve hta‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ. Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw, hkui luˬ ve chaw, chaw hpeh‸ maˇ da‸ ve chaw,
hkui luˬ la‸ luˬ ve chaw,
caw‸ kʼaw‸ ve chaw leh chaw teh‸ nehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, mehˆ teˇ paˉ tiˉ cawˬ ve chaw, hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw, awˬ tawnˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve chaw,
chi hkʼe ve Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ.
Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo maˇ gʼa laˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ca htawˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ-e ve,
maˇ heˆ kʼo, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ ca htawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la peuˬ ka‸ yawˇ iˉ kaˆ maˇ hehˉ ve kʼo, da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e htaˇ heh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la leh, da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve ceˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve ceˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Yawˇ caˇ ve kʼo cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ cawˬ leh gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ, da‸ kehˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa yuˬ caˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ yawˇ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ lehˬ paw hkuˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ maˇ heˆ ve chaw hta‸ ca heuˆ ve kʼo, da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo shu baˬ taˉ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ yawˇ geh ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa caˇ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ pi ˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˍ piˇ.
Chi hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, venˇbaˆ cawˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ ve kʼo, ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ yuˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ awˬ paˍ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ yuˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ ve, hkui luˬ ve, nyi maˇ sha ve, leh buiˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ha lehˬ leh tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, hkui luˬ la‸ luˬ ve ceˇ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh tanˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ka ti‸ te leh tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, oˇ hkʼe ve ceˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa yehˇ.
Piˉ taˍ peuˬ ve ceˇ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chi hkʼe te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve ceˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve ceˇ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe ve ceˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ cawˬ ve ceˇ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nuˇ ehˉ, yawˬ ehˉ, leh aˉ che‸ ehˉ paw la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ yehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ ma peuˍ geh suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ ma peuˍ leh nuˇ ehˉ, yawˬ ma peuˍ leh yawˬ ehˉ, aˉ che‸ ma peuˍ leh aˉ che‸ ehˉ, hta‸ teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ bon chiˇ mvuh ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ yuˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˇ cawˇ gʼa te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸, oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa caˇ peuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, bon pawehˇ te ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ te caˇ tuˬ hkaw‸ nyi cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shinˉ nyi hpeh‸ ve suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ, gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, nawˬ hui kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Bon gʼa lawˬ ve yoˬ. Shinˉ nyi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa teˇ chi awˇ nyi, mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e htaˇ gʼa tanˬ te ve yoˬ.
Teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ caˇ ve pawehˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Pawehˇ tanˬ te ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ bon lawˬ kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼai leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui bon teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼeu‸ jaw‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ tsuh‸ yuˬ leh paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ caˬ kʼa‸ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ caˬ kʼa‸ oˇ ve hta‸ shinˉ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shinˉ peuˬ teˇ nyi htaˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˬ kʼa‸ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ leh teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve geh teˇ geh shaˍ lonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi ve geh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu awˬ suhˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa teˍ caˇ. Hkaoˍmonˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te caˇ. Nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chi ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve caˬ kʼa‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ shinˉ biˇ peuˬ leh
ngaˇ chi nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˬ shiˍ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ le le hkaoˍmonˇ nyiˇ shiˍ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍve caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ gʼa yuˬ te leh, diˇ gʼa hkaw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, aˉ che‸ nyiˇ hkeh yuˬ leh gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ awˬ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Bon gʼa lawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, pawehˇ chi hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui caˬ gʼeu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, ti mi awˬ jaˇ lo cawˬ ve caˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa gʼeu‸ yuˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, sheˆ taˍ ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw leh, hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui kanˉ maˇ te leh gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Behˬ heh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ nawˬ hui gʼa hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.

Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi teˇ nyi lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ kanˉ te ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa oˇ ve teˇ maˬ kʼawˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, teˇ chi nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa ce ka leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ chi hta‸ ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ gʼa tanˬ te leh, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.

Pawehˇ chi hta‸ te chehˇ ve suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ nyi le le nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ pui leh, gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.

(Pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bon pawehˇ hpeh‸ve pa taw, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa taˍ uiˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ nyi le le hkʼa deh‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ shinˉ le le nawˬ hui tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh a shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼe Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸.)

Nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼeu‸ jaw‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ 15 nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh pawehˇ chi ve hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi lehˬ, gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve hko hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, tcuhˉ pui kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hpa‸ da‸ ve suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve pawehˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ chi hta‸ te-o. Nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co pawehˇ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw tiˉ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve bon pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ haˉ le le Aˍronˍ lehˬ kawˆ faiˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Kawˆ faiˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, shi yuˬ te taˍ ve kawˆ faiˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa nyi leh, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ gʼa tuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ chi nyiˇ panˇ yuˬ leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Hkaoˍmonˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˇ cawˆ te leh, shi oˍ taˍ ve hpui lawˇ hkʼoˆ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ chi ve nyiˇ cawˆ awˬ kaˍ lo da‸ jaˇ ve sha hawnˉ gʼa keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co, teˇ shinˉ le le hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaoˍmonˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pa lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Diˇbaˍriˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Sheˍlawˇmiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, teˇ nyi htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ya‸ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Moˉseˍ geh shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh tawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai-o. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ leh, yawˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve teh‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tcuh-o. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼo, chi hkʼe haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, chi hkʼe haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw htawˇ, gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ teˇ maˬ suh-e ve awˬ tan, a sha‸ teˇ maˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ shu hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ shu ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ te hteh piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hteh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ shu ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ te cuˉ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ te cuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ shu ve ciˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ te hkʼeh‸ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve ciˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ shu hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ kʼo, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui chaw oˇ ve hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa ti caˇ.
Nawˬ hui hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ muiˬ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉ shiˍ hko te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ti mi maˇ gʼa te. Iˉ shiˍ hko ka‸ maˇ gʼa te.

Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ yeˬ tawˆ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa gʼeu‸ caˇ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa shaˉ caˇ. Chi ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui maˇ muiˬ caˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ,
nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ suhˍ pawˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve 49 hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ gʼaw nyi taˍ-o‸.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi lo behˬ heh ma ca meuˆ toˇ tcuh-o.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˇ chi hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa hawˇ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa muiˬ caˇ. Iˉ shiˍ hko hkʼaw ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa shaˉ caˇ.
Chi ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ka‸, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ yeˬ tawˆ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa hawˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ chawˇ miˬguiˬ hawˇ da‸ vuiˬ da‸ ve kʼo, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve taˇ te da‸.
Hawˇ da‸ vuiˬ da‸ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ Juˇbiˍliˍ kʼaw‸ gaˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ shawˍ nyi leh gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Juˇbiˍliˍ maˇ gaˬ taˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Juˇbiˍliˍ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve kʼo, awˬ hpfuhˇ pawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Juˇbiˍliˍ gaˬ htaˇ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ maw te caˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shawˍ nyi leh awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ caˇ da‸ ve taˇ te. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ naw‸ la leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ leh gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe na nyi gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ ti maˇ gʼeu‸ ve kʼo aˬ hto‸ ma yuˬ caˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, laˬ tuˬ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ pon awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ cawˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hiˉ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ muiˬ caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui leh hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ muiˬ keu taˍ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ teˇ co nawˬ ve mawˇ yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ leh maˇ gʼa hawˇ caˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkehˉ chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ muiˬ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh nawˬ hta‸ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ hawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ haˍ gʼawˇ la leh yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ gʼa hawˇ cawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve shu hta‸ hawˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ paw sha la ve kʼo,
miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ vuiˬ shehˍ hpaˇ geh Juˇbiˍliˍ gaˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ shawˍ nyi leh, keunˍ da‸ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa shawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ hpu maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, Juˇbiˍliˍ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ vuiˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Juˇbiˍliˍ gaˬ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ hawˇ ve kʼo, teˇ hkʼaw‸ maˇ biˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ hkʼaw‸ hpaˆ peuˬ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, vuiˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve ka‸ yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˆ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ka‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ teˇ yanˇmaˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ hawˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ miˬguiˬ leh ti mi maˇ cawˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ gʼa caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ paˇ lo kʼaw‸ caˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ve hpu hta‸ awˬ yawˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ve hpu leh yawˇ hta‸ hawˇ piˇ ve caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ awˬ yawˬ maˇ gʼa lawˬ yuˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ to nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ hawˇ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼe maˇ gʼa shawˍ taˍ.
Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ ga caˇ paˍ hkʼe gʼa shawˍtaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ a shu yawˇ miˇ yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼe shawˍ leh maˇ gʼa hawˇ caˇ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa te piˇ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ.
Nawˬ awˬ ceˬ loˍ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ hta‸ htawˇ vuiˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hkʼe shawˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼe shawˍ leh kanˉ te tcuh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa te piˇ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ paw sha la leh, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve kʼoˆ loˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hpu cawˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ geh jehˬ da‸ leh, Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ gaˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shawˍ nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, piˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maw chehˇ sheˍ ve kʼo, awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ maˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve kʼo, awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ i tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ ga caˇ paˍ hkʼe ceh gʼa shawˍ taˍ piˇ leh, hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa te piˇ.
Yawˇ hta‸ vuiˬhkʼaw‸ piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu ve awˬ ceˬ ceh tiˉ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ chehˇ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬve shaˉ ho‸, haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw leh awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo,
awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ da‸ la tuˬ leh, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ shiˍ maˇ maˇ naw‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼeu‸ jaw‸ maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ kʼaw‸ shaˉ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, caˬ ti ve awˬ yanˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui zuh‸ mehˬ kʼa mehˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chaw ngaˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, chaw teˇ ha gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve htawˇ canˇ paˍ teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼa maˇ jaˇ leh, teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ pon caˇ law‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gʼeu‸ jaw‸ ve pa taw, caˬ piˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve kʼo,

ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gu leh maˇ na-e la puiˉ ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ, mehˆ cuˉ kʼai puiˉ ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh naˬ paˆ ku ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ yawˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon tawˆ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, nawˬ hui ti taˍ hkʼa taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui caˇ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh tawˆ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa hpaw toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ sheˍ ve kʼo chi a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun hehnˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ sho hkʼa shuˍ heh la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te hkeu‸ ve htawˇ, awˬ bon tawˆ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ tawˆ la ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ shiˍ naw‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve ka‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, chi a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun hehnˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve pa taw, ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui nyi ma heh chehˇ sheˍ ve kʼo,
chi a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun kʼaw‸ hehnˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ma‸ lonˉ keuˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ venˇ hkʼaw hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, gu leh maˇ na-e puiˉ ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ i la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu ehˉ teˇ shiˍ hkʼaw te taˍ ve awˍ hta‸ gʼa pehˬ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˍ caˇ peuˬ ve ka‸, awˍ meu‸ jaˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ sheˍ ve kʼo,
nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ chi a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun hehnˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui meu‸ jaˇ kaˆjaˇ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh baˬ keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ma‸ lonˉ keuˆ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai leh, mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu ve awˬ ceˬ ca te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ ceˬ gʼa ca te chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ leh, suhˆ hpa‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve ceh ka‸ hpaw-e gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo canˇ paˍ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe nawˬ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, canˇ paˍ maˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ nawˬ hui paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ leh, canˇ paˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ ceˬ gʼa te suh-e leh, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hehˆ dawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ leh awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve te ya‸ kuiˬ leh, awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve te ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼaw‸ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. (Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.) Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ kʼaw‸ taˍ leh venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ, Iˉcaˆ leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve gawˬ lehˍ gʼaˇ jehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ ceˬ gʼa ca te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ la tuˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve kʼo, awˬ hawˉ lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hawˉ hkʼaˆ a sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ te leh 60 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ve, teˇ gʼaˇ 50 hteh‸, - Yaˇ miˇ ma a sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ te leh 60 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 30 hteh‸, - Yaˇ paˍ a sha‸ 5 hkʼaw‸ te leh 20 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 20 hteh‸, - Yaˇ miˇ a sha‸ 5 hkʼaw‸ te leh 20 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 10 hteh‸, - Yaˇ paˍ ehˉ a sha‸ 5 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hawˉ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 5 hteh‸, - Yaˇ miˇ ehˉ a sha‸ 5 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hawˉ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 3 hteh‸, - Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ a sha‸ 60 awˬ hkʼoˆ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 15 hteh‸, - Yaˇ miˇ ma a sha‸ 60 awˬ hkʼoˆ ve teˇ gʼaˇ 10 hteh‸, chi hkʼe gʼa taˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh hpu piˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh yawˇ piˇ gʼa ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼe ceh gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve kʼo, ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ceˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hkeh hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ piˇ tuˬ ve ceˇ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼoˆ cheˆ leh, hpu gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ ceˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve hpu oˇ ve leh awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh, hkʼaˬ ma cawˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve hpu oˇ ve leh, awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ ve ti mi chiˇ a‸ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, ti mi oˇ ve hkʼaw caˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma sheˍ ve hta‸ nyi leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ yawˇ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ ve hpu ngaˇ chi hteh‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ Juˇbiˍliˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ la‸ haˉ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve kʼo, kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼa biˇ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ a ciˉ maw la htaˇ heh‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ shawˍ nyi leh awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa yawnˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ leh awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hawˇ piˇ ve kʼo, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ti mi oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ti mi teh‸ gʼa shawˍ leh paw hkuˇ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve ti mi Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo,

paw hkuˇ lehˬ, Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ shawˍ nyi leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa kʼoˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ oˇ ve hta‸ oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve hpu hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ti mi oˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpfuhˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh le le Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chi hkʼe ve ceˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ leh awˬ leuˉ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ ve kʼo, awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ nu ve chaw hta‸ hawˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw yaˇ, ceˇ leh ti mi chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, vuiˬ yuˬ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo hawˇ piˇ ve te maˇ hpeh‸.
Chi hkʼe piˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ maˇ hpeh‸. Gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh iˉ shiˍ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ leh awˬ leuˉ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ teˇ chi hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ceˇ gʼaw nyi leh teˇ chi hkeh gaˬ ve teˇ hkeh lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ awˬ to da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa nyi. Yawˇ ve ceˇ hta‸ gʼaw kʼai leh, teˇ chi hkeh gaˬ ve teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hkeh awˬ tan, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh kʼaw‸ yuˬ pa piˇ ve te maˇ hpeh‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hkeh Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Siˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkaw lo aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ-o‸.
A sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la peuˬ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ bvuh‸ yuˬ-o‸.
Chaw teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gaˬ laˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui deh kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, leh a shu yawˇ awˬ moˍ ve hto‸ chiˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo fa la gʼa te ve yoˬ. Fa la teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ gʼa caw te ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ yaˇ Naˍsonˍ 74,600 gʼaˇ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ Zuˇ-aˍ ve yaˇ Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ 5400 gʼaˇ Zeˍbuˆlonˍ Heˍlonˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍbaˆ 57,400 gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 186,400 gʼaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw awˉ lawˉ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Ruˇbenˍ Sheˍduˇraˆ ve yaˇ Eˬliˆzuˇraˆ 46,500 gʼaˇ Siˉmonˍ Zuˇriˆshaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍluˆmeˍlaˆ 59,300 gʼaˇ Gaˆ Yeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˆ 45,650 gaˇ Hkʼa peu-eˬ 151,450 gʼaˇ. Nyiˇ moˍ teˇ moˍ tawˆ kʼai tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ Ruˇbenˍ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui nyiˇ moˍ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ hpaˆ leh gʼa taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, fa la te htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ Aˍmiˇhuˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ 40,500 gʼaˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ Peˍdaˍzuˇraˆ yaˇ Gaˍmaˍleˍlaˆ 32,200 gʼaˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ Giˇdonˍniˆ yaˇ Aˍbiˆdanˍ 5,400 gʼaˇ Hkʼa peu-eˬ 108,100 gʼaˇ Shehˆ moˍ teˇ moˍ tawˆ kʼai tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te tuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Danˍ Aˍmiˆshaˍdehˆ yaˇ Aˍhiˆzaˍ 2,700 gʼaˇ Aˍshaˍ Awˇkaˍranˍ yaˇ Paˍgeˍlaˆ 41,500 gʼaˇ Naˍtaˍliˆ Eˇnanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˇraˆ 53,400 gʼaˇ Hkʼa peu-eˬ 157,600 gʼaˇ Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ ve teˇ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shenˍ gʼawˆ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, 603,550 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬLeˍviˆ chaw hui ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼawˆ yuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Deh kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ fa la te leh, kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai htaˇ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh paw hkuˇ aˉ yaˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Naˍdaˆ leh Aˍbiˇhuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve aˬ miˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Aˍronˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui paw hkuˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh, paw hkuˇ Aˍronˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tcuh-o.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te leh, paw hkuˇ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon kanˉ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw hui gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ca hiˉ te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ awˬ shenˍ gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Moˉ seˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ leh Maˍraˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Geˍraˍsonˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kawˇhaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉsaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍraˍriˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Maˍhaˍliˆ leh Muˇshiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Liˆbaˍniˆ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 7,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ moˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Leˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve kanˉ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ beh taˍ ve hpa, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ ko taˍ ve hpa,
bon yehˬ hta‸ ko taˍ ve hpa leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw ko taˍ ve hpa chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉzaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 8,600 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ moˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Awˇzeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˆzaˍhpanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve kanˉ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ, hpui lawˇ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, da‸ kehˬve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ yehˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ko taˍ ve hpa, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ hoˉ lonˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍhaˍliˆ leh Muˇshiˆ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 6,200 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ moˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Zuˆreˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve kanˉ lehˬ, bon yehˬ te tuˬ ve toˉ la‸ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ cawˆ teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ, sho cuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo fa la gʼa te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kanˉ hta‸ ca lo‸ te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve te gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, a sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Moˉseˍ awˬ shenˍ yuˬ nyi leh, chaw 22,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, a sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ tan Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve ceˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh,
a sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 22,273 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan Leˍviˆ chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ 273 gʼaˇ maˇ taˍ ve pa taw, yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˇ hteh‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw leh,
gʼa ve hpu oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh,
hpu 1,365 hteh‸ yuˬ tawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh,
bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te puiˉ la peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ aw hkʼaˇ,
a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ te leh 50 hkʼaw‸ awˬ kaˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ko taˍ ve hpa hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa beh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˆ taˬ gʼa keu taˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ kuiˬ hpui lawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ beh leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ keu taˍ ve kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taˍ ve kaw teˇ hpaˍ, leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nyiˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh piˇ leh suhˆ taˬ gʼa keu taˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa hta‸ yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ, kawˆ faiˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sho nuˆ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ baˬ tuˬ ve hkehˇ leh shaˍlonˍ chu keu taˍ ve kaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa beh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸ htiˆ leh, gʼa taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shi yuˬ te taˍ ve sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ beh leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˆ taˬ gʼa keu taˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw yehˇ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ beh leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ beh ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gʼa taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve maˇ da‸ ve awˬ meˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ leh, nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve hpa gʼa yuˬ beh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ keu kuiˬ, sho nuˆ, hkehˇ pe le leh hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ yuˬ tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa yuˬ teh ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼawˬ nawˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ yuˬ beh leh suhˆ taˬ gʼa keu taˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gu taˍ laˇ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ. Htawˇ ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve leh, kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ, sha hawnˉ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ ve naˍmanˇ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo taˇ laˬ tcuh.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui gʼa taˆ tuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa beˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu chehˇ ve hta‸ ca lo‸ nyi ve Kawˇhaˆ chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te puiˉ la peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ te leh 50 hkʼaw‸ awˬ kaˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ beh taˍ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ, shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ko taˍ ve hpa,
bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ caw ko taˍ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ, leh bon yehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˆ kʼai tuˬ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te puiˉ la peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ te leh 50 hkʼaw‸ awˬ kaˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ ve toˉ la‸, awˬ cawˆ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw,
bon yehˬ hta‸ ko taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw, sho cuˇ, leh aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ hawˉ chehˇ leh kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ, Geˍraˍsonˍ leh Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te puiˉ la peuˬ ve, a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ te leh 50 hkʼaw‸ awˬ kaˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ Awˬ shenˍ Kawˇhaˆ 2,750 gʼaˇ Geˍraˍsonˍ 2,630 gʼaˇ Meˍraˍriˆ 3,200 gʼaˇ Hkʼa peu-eˬ 8,580 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui gʼa te cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ ve chaw, leh suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fa la hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpeu‸ maˍ leh, gʼa lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te ya‸ piˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa sheˉ piˇ leh, awˬ leuˉ htawˇ ngaˇ pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ te ya‸ piˇ ve chaw oˇ ve suh-e leh, hpu oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, hpu oˇ ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ laˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, gʼa ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ cawˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ paw hkuˇ geh gʼa shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, cawˬ ve hkʼe hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ, yawˇ leh caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shaˍlonˍ chu maˇ kʼoˆ, sha hawnˉ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa keu.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa huˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ je‸ yuˬ te taˍ ve kawˆ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve je‸ meu-e htawˇ, a ciˉgʼa hkaˆ keu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ma ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ hpehˇ ya‸ leh, yawˇ ve la‸sheh hkʼaw caˬ hkʼa meu-e gʼa yuˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, hkeu ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ taˍ ve kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ taˍ leh,
chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ haˉ chawˇ maˇ te taˍ ve kʼo, iˉ kaˆ chi ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkeu ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ haˉ chawˇ ca te taˍ ve kʼo,
nawˬ lehˬ shu hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dehˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ hpo‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ chi nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hpo‸ la leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ htawˇ kʼaw‸ dehˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
