Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lehˬ hkeu ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa tsuhˇ keu ve yoˬ.
Hkeu ve awˬ gʼuiˬ tsuhˇ keu taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ taw piˇ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ,
paw hkuˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw keu piˇ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh leh,
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ gʼa taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇmiˇ oˇ ve lehˬ shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˍ hpo‸ la leh, yawˇ ve mawˇ htawˇ kʼaw‸ dehˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shu hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ maˇ ca te taˍ ve kʼo, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ leh yaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te, maˇ te ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, chaˬ nyi ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa huˉ taˍ leh, paw hkuˇ lehˬ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yaˇ miˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve tzuhˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Yawˇ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, a pehˉ meuˇ te awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa tawˆ la ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, awˬ yawˇ, awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa nuˆ. Paˇ tcuhˆ maˇ gʼa chiˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬve pa taw, uˉ hkeh mvuh leh paˇ tcuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa zuhˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw suh yehˬ lo kʼai leh yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e, awˬ nyi paˍ awˬ nyi ma suh kuiˬ lo htawˇ maˇ gʼa kʼai.
Yawˇ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ la‸ haˉ paˍ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh leh paˇ tcuhˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo guˇ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ veu leh paw hkuˇ geh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ ngaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hkʼaˬ maw te taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ shawˍ-o. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ lehˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ to da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kʼai leh,

venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ ma teˇ hkeh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, hkaoˍmonˇ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ geh teˇ geh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ ehˉ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ keu caˉ leh, la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ oˇ ve leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ ve nyi ma pui shaˍ leh hkui sheh hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ oˇ ve teˇ paˉ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ dawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ nu awˬ na ve ka ti‸ te taˍ ve cawˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa te biˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ htaˇ, awˬ hawˉ lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh awˬ bon te laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi leh gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Shu Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw bon na‸ piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ oˇ ve leh awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ lawˬ hkaw‸ maˬ, nuˇ paˍ teˇ chi nyi hkeh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon nuˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ, leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ ha‸ yuˬleh, Leˍ viˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ nuˇ lawˬ leh nuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ nyiˇ maˬ leh nuˇ awˇ hkeh piˇ leh,
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ awˇ maˬ leh nuˇ hinˉ hkeh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Iˉtaˍmaˍ hawˉ chehˇ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ leh nuˇ maˇ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼa taˆ cawˇ ve bon yehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw gʼa taˆ tuˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ yanˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ nyi teh piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ kawˆ faiˇ tuˉ teh ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa deh‸ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ, kawˆ faiˇ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ teh tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh kawˆ faiˇ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh leuˆ tawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ tsuhˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e hta‸ gʼa yuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ nu ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ gʼa yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ tcuh taˍ-o‸.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh taˍ leh,
yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon Aˍronˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh taˍ leh, teˇ hkeh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh leuˆ tawˆ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve mawˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan ngaˬ lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh,

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa laˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe Leˍviˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ 50 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve awˬ nu ve kanˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ga te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ yanˇ hkʼa biˇ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Chi ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa chi teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi awˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, teˇ chi awˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh, Siˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, chaw suh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to cha‸ chiˆ kʼai leh pawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ geh kʼai leh,
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw suh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ. Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Law taˍ sheˍ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi shaˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, pawehˇ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, chaw suh hta‸ ca htawˇ leh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo vuiˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo kʼai chehˇ leh pawehˇ chi hta‸ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve kʼo,
awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ha pa teˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ pawehˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh hkʼaˇ ve gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˇ maˇ peuˬ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa teh taˍ. To nuˇ to shaˆ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa dawˆ hteh. Awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh pawehˇ chi hta‸ maˇ te ve chaw hta‸, ngaˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, moˬ ya‸ la leh bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ moˬ oˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ baˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ oˇ ve mvuhˇ hpe lo taˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, moˬ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo fa la te leh jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ oˇ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve fa la hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ oˇ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼai.

Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ moˬ oˇ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ hkui tiˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, fa la hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ taˍ cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ law na chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ moˬ oˇ ve awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Moˬ taˆ-e ve kʼo, yawˇ hui mawˇ gu leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Moˬ oˇ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo nyiˇ nyi, teˇ ha pa, teˇ hkʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼai. Moˬ taˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ heh‸, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼai ve maˇ kʼoˆ, jehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ na yuˬ leh gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ tuˬ leh, aˉ po kʼo hpaˆ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, hpu yuˬ leh behˬ heh ma nyiˇ maˬ te taˍ-o‸.
Behˬ heh ma oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ zuhˬ chaweh te meuˆ ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo hpawnˬ laˬ tcuh-o.
Behˬ heh ma teˇ maˬ ceh tiˉ meuˆ ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ geh hpawnˬ la tcuh-o.
Behˬ heh ma hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ cheˆ cheˆ te meuˆ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo deh chehˇ ve teˇ moˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o.

Nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ meuˆ ve kʼo, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo deh chehˇ ve teˇ moˍ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o. Awˬ hkawˇ cheˆ cheˆ te meuˆ ve behˬ heh ma hkawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tuˬ meuˆ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, behˬ heh ma hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ zuhˬ chaweh gʼa te meuˆ ve yoˬ.
Behˬ heh ma oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˉ gʼa meuˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, behˬ heh ma oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meuˆ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ leh awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve teˇ pawˆ le le, nawˬ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, behˬ heh ma oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa meuˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve moˬ mvuhˇ hpe lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Siˉ naˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Paˍranˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gaˬ htaˇ, moˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˉ lawˉ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍmiˆ naˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Naˍsonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ Zuˇaˍ ve yaˇ Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Zeˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ Heˍlonˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ hpaˆ leh Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ taˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ruˇbenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Sheˍduˇraˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˆzuˇraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Siˉmonˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬZuˇriˆshaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍluˆmeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Yeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui deh kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ haˆ haˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍmiˇhuˆ ve yaˇ Eˇshiˆshaˍmaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Peˍdaˍzuˇraˆ ve yaˇ Gaˍmaˍleˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Giˇdonˍniˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆdanˍ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve chaw teˇ moˍ lehˬ, Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍmiˆshaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆzaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Awˇkaˍranˍ ve yaˇ Paˍgeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Eˇnanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˇraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve teˇ pawˆ le le, a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ chi hkʼe te tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ u hpaˇ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw Yeˍtaˍroˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇbaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ pehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Hawˇbaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ maˇ kʼai. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ taˇ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca deh tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˍ paˍ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ na‸ laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ pehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui da‸ kehˬ ve Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh yawˇ hui awˬ pon deh kuiˬ ca piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve moˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Moˉseˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu la-o. Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ deh kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, kʼaw‸ la-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ geh kʼaw‸ la-o, teh‸ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, hpeh‸ haˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkʼanˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ leh yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, shu jaˇ lo deh chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh aˬ miˍ oˇ ve suh-e ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Taˍbeˍraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˬ miˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ to‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼanˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Ngaˬ hui shaˍ gʼa caˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ tuˬ le. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui ngaˇ shaˍ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ ka‸ maˇ peuˬ. Aˉ hpehˇ shiˍ, teh hkaˉ shiˍ, shuˍ hpu nuˬ, shuˍ hpu nyi chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Maˍnaˆ shiˍ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

(Maˍnaˆ shiˍ lehˬ gʼaˆ shaweh yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ leh, hpuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ciˍ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh ce la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ leh teˍ meu-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, keu caˉ leh hkaoˍmonˇ te caˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Moˉseˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, Moˉseˍ ka‸ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkanˍ ha tcuh laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ sha ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ laˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ paw la piˇ taˍ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo, yaˇ miˇ ma yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ chiˇ toˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kanˉ piˇ taˍ laˇ ve le.
Chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon caˇ law‸ ve shaˍ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca piˇ tuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ kanˉ chi hta‸ te maˇ gʼa. Te tuˬ ka‸ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe tiˉ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh a ciˉ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ te laˇ ve hkanˍ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ-o, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo nawˬ geh huˉ tcuh taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ ya‸ la leh nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˇ ca yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Awˬ ha hpu teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa ga te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui shaˍ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shaˍ meu‸ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ chi beu‸ a‸ kehˉ gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ caˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ nyi, nyiˇ nyi, ngaˇ nyi, teˇ chi nyi, nyiˇ chi nyi ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ha pa teˇ maˬ hkʼa biˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui daw‸ naˬ jaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e gaˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkaw‸ shehnˉ hpaˆ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh shaˍ teˇ ha pa caˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ le.

Hkʼa cawˬ ve nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ caˍ piˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui caˇ law‸ tuˬ laˇ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ve ngaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ hui caˇ law‸ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh ngeh jaˇ ve leh laˇ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la, maˇ hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ na suhˍ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ paˇ lo huˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha moˬ hkʼaw ya‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Awˬ ha hpu teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼoˆ lo Awˬ ha hpu ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tawˇ yaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ maw maw maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw ve, Eˉlaˍdaˆ leh Meˍdaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo maˇ kʼai. A shu yawˇ ve fa la hkʼaw ceh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉmaˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, Awˬ ha hpu ya‸ la leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tawˇ yaw ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ ca gʼuiˇ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ te tuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ Awˬ ha hpu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tawˇ yaw ve hkʼe kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve fa la lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ piˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve kaˉ koeˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meuˆ chiˇ veu laˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ nyiˇ shaw‸ hkʼe mvuh-ehˬ poˬ laˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui leh, teˇ nyi te toˇ gaˬ law‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼe fui lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ kaˉ koeˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shu hkʼe taw gʼawˆ maˇ gʼa puiˉ ve chaw ka‸ 160 cawehˬ hpaˆ gʼawˆ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fa la awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo awˬ ku-i te huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shaˍ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸, Meu‸ jehˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shaˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Haˍzaˍroˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Kuˇshiˆ chaw yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Meˇ riˆanˍ leh Aˍronˍ yawˇ hta‸ deˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tiˉ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve laˇ. Yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tawˇ maˇ yaw laˇ leh laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
(Moˉseˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ)
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Meˇriˆanˍ hui hta‸, Ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Aˍronˍ leh Meˇriˆanˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ jiˆ kʼai leh,

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ hui geh lo ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ha hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ to maw piˇ leh, zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Moˉseˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ taˍ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ veˆ shaˉ veˆ hkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh yaw piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ deˇ haˆ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ moˬ hkʼaw lo taˆ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Meˇriˆanˍ lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ keuˆ la leh, vaˇ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ chiˇ nyi leh, Meˇriˆanˍ hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe a ciˉ taˇ tu‸ hkanˍ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Paw tawˆ la htaˇ ka‸ awˬ shaˍ teˇ hkoˇ kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ hpeh‸ tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ gu na-e piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ ve awˬ pa yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ keu piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ lo suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ca chehˇ tcuh taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ fa la lo kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Meˇriˆanˍ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo suhˍ nyi ca chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼai.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Haˍzeˍroˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Paˍranˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca kʼaw‸ deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ hkʼaw, chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Paˍranˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw chi ve teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ca jaˆ nyi peu ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ Awˬ hoˉ Ruˇbenˍ Saˍkuˇraˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍmaˍ Siˉmonˍ Hawˇriˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍhpaˆ Yuˇda‸ Yeˍhpuˇnehˇ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ Iˉgaˍlaˆ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ Nunˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇseˍ Beˍyaˍmenˍ Raˍhpuˆ ve yaˇ Paˍlaˍtiˆ Zeˍbuˆlonˍ Sawˇdiˆ ve yaˇ Gaˍdeˍlaˆ Maˍnaˍseˍ Suˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Gaˍdiˆ Danˍ Geˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Aˍmeˍlaˆ Aˍshaˍ Miˆhkeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Seˍtuˇraˆ Naˍtaˍliˆ Vaˍhpaˍsiˆ ve yaˇ Naˍbiˆ Gaˆ Maˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ Geˍlaˆ
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tuˬ Moˉseˍ kʼai tcuh taˍve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Nunˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇseˍ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ teh‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo tu leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi-o. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e loˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve leh naˍ, chaw hkʼaˬ ma chehˇ leh naˍ, yawˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve leh naˍ,
mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve da‸ leh naˍ, maˇ da‸ leh naˍ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve leh naˍ, maˇ chehˇ ve leh naˍ,

miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ leh naˍ, suhˆ tsuh de lonˉ cawˬ leh naˍ, ca jaˆ nyi-o. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe ca jaˆ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ tanˬ meh la ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Ziˇnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Reˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ ca jaˆ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ leh, Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Aˍhiˆmanˍ, Sheˍshehˇ leh Taˍlaˍmehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Aˍnaˍkenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Zawˇnaˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ tanˬ te sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe htaˇ ka‸ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ)

Yawˇ hui Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo ya‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ kʼoˍ hta‸ shaˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ oˇ ve hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ ci ku shiˍ leh maˉ nawˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shaˉ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ yuˬ ve pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ 40 nyi hkʼa gaˬ jaˆ nyi taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ, Paˍranˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui shaˉ veu laˇ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ peuˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo naw‸ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nyi sheˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, lanˇ venˇ hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ to uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Kaˍlehˆ tu la leh, Ngaˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui bawˆ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Kaˍlehˆ geh kʼai taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ca bawˆ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ heˍ hto piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ caˇ maˇ law‸ dawˬ maˇ law‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo paˉ ce‸ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍhta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa suh ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu shiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve kʼo maˇ da‸ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yeˍhpuˇnehˇ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ hui ca jaˆ nyi taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ tehˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve taˇ te. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ bawˆ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ-a teh‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hkui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼoˆ ba tawˆ la ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ chi taw taw te maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw nyi ma heh chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chaw ceu lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ ve kʼo,

yawˇ hui teˇ caˉ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ngaˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ aˬ miˍ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ceh nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ leh, nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma haˆ haˆ maˇ zuhˆ puiˉ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve, leh te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ pa awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon yawˇ hui ve yaˇ shehˆ co awˇ co htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, maˇ peˍ maˇ pa puiˉ ve nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hkʼaw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve hkʼe ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼa ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve hkʼe,

chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ leh ngaˬ te maˍ piˇ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e leh,

yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpawˇ lo caw kʼai-o, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ maw maw hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Yawˇ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kaˇ bvuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa suh leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ to heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼawˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, a sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ ka ti te taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Kaˍlehˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e.
Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu shiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui chiˇ baˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ceh gʼa suh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ chi ve hkʼaw awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gʼa te toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui suh peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve awˬ tan gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ nyi ca jaˆ nyi ve awˬ tan teˇ hkʼaw‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Choˬ ka‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tuˬ Moˉseˍ kʼai peu taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ lawn laiˉ ceuˬ heˍ hto piˇ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui suh-e ve yoˬ.
Chaw jaˆ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇsuˆ leh Kaˍlehˆ ceh tiˉ te‸ chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸, yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe kʼo aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Taˇ kʼai loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ. Nawˬ hui shonˇ ve tiˉ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw leh Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui suh-e ve tiˉ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ maˇ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui geh maˇ kʼai ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw leh Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ leh, Hawˇmaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ,
yawˇ hui te cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ha lehˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ, leh bon pawehˇ te htaˇ, nuˇ paˍ, yawˬ awˬ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve geh teˇ geh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo,
oˇ ve geh teˇ geh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon shaˍ lonˍ chu nyiˇ kaw hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ leh,
a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ kaw gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa ga tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ceˇ laiˉ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ maˇ chaweh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ htaˇ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ,
yawˇ hui te cawˇ ve awˬ liˇawˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkaoˍmonˇ te ve teˇ yanˇ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ te ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ya‸ ve,
maˇ heˆ kʼo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yehˇ kʼo,

yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, leh a pehˉ meu gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉche‸ teˇ hkeh hta‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa te ya‸ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ htawˇ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ te ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa te ya‸ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ ma teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa te ya‸ peuˬ ve kʼo, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shiˍ taˍ leh te ya‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ te ya‸ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shinˉ nyi htaˇ suhˆ ca gʼawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui suhˉ veˆ awˬ puˍ lu te leh, nawˉ-ehˍ ve hpa yuˬ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ meuˇ lo tawˉ nehˉ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chi hkʼe gʼa te veu‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui suhˉ veˆ awˬ puˍ lu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh na yuˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉzaˍhaˍ ve yaˇ Kawˇraˆ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇlaˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Daˍtanˍ, Aˍbiˆranˍ, Peˍlehˆ ve yaˇ Awˇnaˆ leh,
awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 250 gʼaˇ hui jehˬ da‸ leh, Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ te ponˬ te leuˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Moˉseˍ nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ hkʼe te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ koˆ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Moˉseˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Kawˇraˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ gaˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ tehˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo yawˇ geh laˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve hkehˇ pe le hta‸ yuˬ leh,

shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh sha hawnˉ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Te ponˬ te leuˉ jaˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Kawˇraˆ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Leˍviˆ chaw hui-oˬ na sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tcuh taˍ ve chi, i jaˇ ve kanˉ teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ lonˉ chi nawˬ hui Leˍviˆ chaw hta‸ te tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hiˉ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Aˍronˍ hta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chi lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Kawˇraˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ hta‸ ka‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui maˇ laˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ leh, choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh-e tcuh laˇ ve chi ceh ka‸ jaˇ-oˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te gaˇ sheˍ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ti mi leh iˉ shiˍ hko teˇ hpaˍ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ taˇ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸. Yawˇ hui ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ jaw, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Kawˇraˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw 250 gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo laˬ-o‸. Aˍronˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve hkehˇ pe le hkʼaw sha hawnˉ keu leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve hkehˇ pe le hkʼaw shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh sha hawnˉ keu veu laˇ leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ geh teˇ geh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kawˇraˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ cawˬ haˉ ba tawˆ la leh,
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo taˇ huˉ chehˇ. Hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo jiˆ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ la‸ haˉ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˆ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ ve pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kawˇraˆ, Daˍtanˍ, Aˍbiˆranˍ hui ve fa la paˇ lo maˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve fa la paˇ lo taˇ huˉchehˇ. Haˆ tawˆ kʼai-o. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ htawˇ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hui geh gʼa ga luˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Kawˇraˆ, Daˍtanˍ, Aˍbiˆranˍ hui ve fa la paˇ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui ve fa la gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ leh chi hkʼe ca te tcuh laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˉ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ te gaˇ leh te ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui suh yanˇ gaˬ leh suh-e ve hkʼe kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ peuˇ laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw ve awˬ ceuˬ, miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ te‸ te‸ hehˆ dawˬ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ sheˬ leh Daˍtanˍ, Aˍbiˆranˍ leh yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Kawˇraˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ te‸ te‸ ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ da‸ sheˬ leh, yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, kaw‸ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Haˆ hpaw-e loˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ka‸ miˬguiˬ hehˆ dawˬ la, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la piˇ leh, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve 250 gʼaˇ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suh kʼai peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo ca ngeuˍ baˬ tuˬ, Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve hkehˇ pe le oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, hkehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ paˇ chaweh te dawˆ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ beh tuˬ te-o. Chi lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ hkehˇ pe le oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh a ciˉpaˇ chaweh te dawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ beh tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Eˇlaˍsaˍ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ca kʼaw‸ hkʼanˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca tuˬ hpawnˬ laˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ aˉ po kʼo hkʼoˆ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ Aˍronˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve hkehˇ pe le hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ lo sha hawnˉ hkaˆ keu-o. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ haˆ ca te piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ la chehˇ leh, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, hkehˇ pe le hta‸ yuˬ leh chaw moˍ lonˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Naˬ beu‸ gaˬ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇgʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw sha hawnˉ yuˬ keu leh, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ haˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve teˇ yanˇ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e ve chaw leh, te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve chaw awˬ kaˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ meunˍ awˇ hinˉ suhˍ ha gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e ve hta‸ maˇ shawˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve mehˉ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍronˍ lehˬ Moˉseˍ geh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ lawˬ yuˬ leh, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve awˬ meh htawˆ bvuh‸ tcuh-o.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Aˍronˍ ve awˬ meh htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸.
Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ kuiˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ-o‸.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ, awˬ tuˍ tuˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ htawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi, Moˉseˍ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw awˬ tan Aˍronˍ ve awˬ meh htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve awˬ tuˍ tuˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ tuˍ tuˍ tawˆ la leh awˬ veˆ veˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ca kʼaw‸ teh taˍ-o‸. Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ suh peuˬve chaw deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ paˇ lo hkʼa kʼai ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve yaˇ, leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ hta‸ tiˉ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tcuh-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon, bon yehˬ awˬ pon leh loˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ga te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ka‸ nawˬ hui ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui geh kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ, da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa ga laˇ tuˬ Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ paw hkuˇ gʼa te leh, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo laˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ ve awˬ nu ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ ve, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh‸ shawˍ leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve awˬ nu ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇmiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve shaˍlonˍ chu, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, leh caˬ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu ca kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ la ve kʼo, hpu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ teˇ ha pa gaˬ peuˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ hpu ngaˇ hteh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ leh ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ luˬ puiˉ ve ka ti‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ miˬguiˬ pehˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ geh cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve teˇ chi pun teˇ pun mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ paˇ lo maˇ gʼa laˬ. Laˬ ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co kanˉ chi hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui geh te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve teˇ chi pun teˇ pun awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Muiˬ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, Aˍronˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ yuˬ leh tanˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui tanˇ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa keunˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ ve kʼo, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ chi pun teˇ pun maˇ tanˇ piˇ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui caˇ ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ te jaw sheˍ ve nyiˉ-ehˍ ve nuˇ ma teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh,
paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ kʼai leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nuˇ suhˍ hkʼaw la‸ naw tuˍ keu leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hpawˇ lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ peu ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ shaˍ, nuˇ guiˬ kʼuˉ, nuˇ suhˍ leh awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ paw hkuˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ htawˇ suhˆ, huˇsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ hpa‸, leh nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw gʼa baˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ fa la lo kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Nuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve chaw htawˇ, veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ htawˇ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ toˆ yuˬ leh, fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw‸ laˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui cha‸ chiˆ kʼai htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw keu yehˇ tuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw‸ laˉ oˇ ve hta‸ toˆ yuˬ ve chaw htawˇ, veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh, yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw suh hta‸ htawˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, leh suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ yuˬ leh gʼa tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi leh suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ iˉ kaˆ maˇ tsuhˇ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw suh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ maˇ tsuhˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw paˍ suh-e ve kʼo, bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ suh-e ve teˇ hkui lo‸ la ve chaw lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ hoˆ maˇ hoˆ taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Shu tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ naˬ suh-e ve chaw hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo chaw mu‸ ku leh chaw tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ meu-e oˇ ve hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼa hpaˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw suh-e ve kʼo, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, huˇsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ hpa‸ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw tuˍ keu leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh, bon yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ naˬ suh-e ve chaw, chaw suh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw, chaw mu‸ ku hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw, leh tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ ca htawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi leh suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ maˇ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ liˇ chi ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ ve chaw ca htawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ htawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ da‸ kehˬ.

Ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ maˬ gaˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Ziˇnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la leh Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Meˇriˆanˍ suh-e leh yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo, iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ hui ka‸ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ paˍ suh-e ve hkʼe kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ tuˬ le.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ laˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve laˇ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, choˬ kaˬ goˇ choˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ laˬ ve le. Choˬ kaˬ lo caˬ shiˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ leh aˉ ce ku shiˍ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, dawˬ tuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ ceh ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ yawˇ hui geh tawˆ kʼai leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ taˍ kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍronˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve haˉ hpawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ. Haˉ hpawˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ hpawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon haˉ hpawˇ chi ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ gʼa tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh haˉ hpawˇ hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼe jaw‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, haˉ hpawˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ deˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸, Meˍriˇbaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Eˇdonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ htawˇ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi leh ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo a ciˉ hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ hteˇ lehˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw maˇ kʼai. Nawˬ hui ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ dawˬ. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ tawˆ-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai tcuh maˇ hpeh‸. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼa bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ dawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, ma‸ moˍ shawˍ leh tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ nu ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Kaˍdeˍshaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Hawˇraˆ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Aˍronˍ lehˬ ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e. Yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Meˍriˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Hawˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ kʼo, Aˍronˍ nawˬ deh taˍ ve paw hkuˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ leh, Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ-oˆ. Aˍronˍ nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yawˇ hui Hawˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ gaˬ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Aˍronˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ suh peuˬ ve awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui 30 nyi hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Aˍraˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw Aˍtaˍrenˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh gʼa ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ leh oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Hawˇmaˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Hawˇraˆ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai gaˇ ve pa taw, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hpawˇ lo caw kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma luˬ leh,

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, choˬ kaˬ te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca suh-e tcuh laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui Maˍnaˆ shiˍ caˇ bvuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui geh lo awˬ taw‸ ma hehnˇ jaˇ ve vuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ maˇ vuiˬ htawˆ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Vuiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
