Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kuiˇ vuiˬ teˇ maˬ te tcuh leh, vuiˬ htawˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chiˇ nyi leh na-e la tuˬ, suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ hpeh chiˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ kuiˇ vuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Vuiˬ htawˆ ve chaw hui kuiˇ vuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh kʼaw‸ na-e la ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Awˇboˆ teh‸ koˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍbaˍrenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Zaˍrehˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo cawˬ ve Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ. (Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ)
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ bawˆ ve li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh Vaˍhehˆ venˇ lehˬ,
Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw leh Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh Beˍraˆ nanˬ bawˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nanˬbawˍ chi ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ du taˬ yuˬ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Maˍtaˍnaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tu leh, Naˍhaˍleˍlaˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Naˍhaˍleˍlaˆ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh Baˍmoˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Baˍmoˆ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ geh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ kʼai tuˬyoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e. Nawˬ hui ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ dawˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ hteˇ lehˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh Yaˍhaˆ venˇ lo laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve venˇ lonˉ Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ nu ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ ve venˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Siˉhonˍ lehˬ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ leh, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Siˇhonˍ ve Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ lo laˬ-o‸. Venˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ chi hkʼaw, Siˉhonˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼe tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍraˆ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve le. Hkeˍmoˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yaˇmiˇ teˇ hpaˍhta‸ Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Diˇbonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Naˍshenˍ venˇ lo te leh Meˍdeˍbaˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Nawˇhpaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ da‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw ca jaˆ nyi peu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui venˇ oˇ ve leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇ mi lo kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Enˍdiˆ venˇ lo laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Ziˆhpawˇ ve yaˇ Baˍlehˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼaˬ ma chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ awˬ to leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ Baˍlehˆ lehˬ Aˍmawˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Peˍtawˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve chaw moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ biˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ chaw maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ca hkeu piˇ la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve awˬ bon gʼa leh, nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Mawˇbaˆ chaw leh Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ veu leh Baˍlanˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍlanˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ya‸ puiˉ choˬ kaˬ haˉ taˉ sheˍ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Baˍlanˍ geh laˬ leh, Choˬ kaˬ nawˬ geh ca haˉ la ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍlehˆ peu laˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw teˇ moˍ tawˆ la leh, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ ca hto la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ laˬ leh a ciˉ ca hkeu piˇ la teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Baˍlanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui geh taˇ kʼai. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkeu piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍlanˍ yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui kʼo‸-e loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ laˇ ve law, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh Baˍlanˍ laˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍlehˆ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ a‸ kehˉ chaw maˇ chaweh Baˍlanˍ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Baˍlanˍ geh laˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ bon te leh a ciˉ laˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ laˬ leh chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ca hkeu piˇ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Baˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ ponˬ leuˉ maˇ hpeh‸.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ya‸ puiˉ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ haˉ taˉ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hui geh kʼai loˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ceh tiˉ nawˬ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍlanˍ yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ ciˇ leh yawˇ hui geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mawˬ leh nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh piˉ laˬ ciˇ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ leh huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ piˉ laˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ya‸ kʼaw hawˉ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Baˍlanˍ lehˬ piˉ laˬ hta‸ jaw‸ leh ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa‸ peu ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ hko nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve miˬ haˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Piˉ laˬ oˇ ve lehˬ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, haˉ hpawˇ cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh Baˍlanˍ ve hkui sheh hta‸ haˉ pui shawˆ hkʼaw sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍlanˍ piˉ laˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ kaˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ cehˍ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh awˬ nu awˬ na ca jaw kʼai kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, piˉ laˬ oˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paˍ zuh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍlanˍ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, piˉ laˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ jaw‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ piˉ laˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tcuh leh, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ jaw‸ hpehˇ laˇ ve le, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te guiˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ chaw pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ piˉ laˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Piˉ laˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ teˇ co-e ciˇ toˇ chehˇ ve piˉ laˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ chi hkʼe te laˇ jaw laˇ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍlanˍ htawˇ, Maˇ te laˇ jaw, teh‸ piˉ laˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Baˍlanˍ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo aˉhtaw yuˬ leh huˉ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlanˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ jaw‸ ve le. Nawˬ ya‸ kʼaw chi hta‸ maˇ te toˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca tawˍ taˍ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve piˉ laˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ leh shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ. Piˉ laˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te leh, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh hteˇ lehˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh piˉ laˬ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai maˇ cawˇ teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ceh nawˬ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Baˍlanˍ yawˇ hui geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Baˍlanˍ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Baˍlehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ, Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍraˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlehˆ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ ca kuˬ tcuh htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ laˬ ve le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ piˇ laˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍlanˍ lehˬ Baˍlehˆ geh teˇ geh Huˇzoˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Baˍlehˆ lehˬ, nuˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ leh, awˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ Baˍlanˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh, Baˍlehˆ lehˬ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ shiˍveu leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nyi mawˬ hpeh‸ ve Baˍmoˆbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlanˍ lehˬ, Choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ suhˍ maˬ te leh, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍlanˍ lehˬ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ leh naˍ, ca na nyi shaˍ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˉ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍlanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ suhˍ maˬ te leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Baˍlanˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍlehˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸-e leh, Baˍlehˆ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo ceh tiˉ huˉ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mawˇbaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍlanˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Baˍlehˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ, Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ hta‸ ca shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ hkeu taˍ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hkeu piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yaw hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ bon gʼa taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ laˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hkʼe gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍlehˆ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve le. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ ve law, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Baˍlehˆ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi mawˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai shaˍ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Zawˇhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ suhˍ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlanˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ shaˍ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Baˍlanˍ geh laˬ leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍlehˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Baˍlehˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo tiˉ huˉ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ baˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve awˬ lawn Baˍlehˆ na nyi htaˇ,
Baˍlanˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ziˆhpawˇ ve yaˇ Baˍlehˆ-oˬ, cho kaˬ laˬ leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca na la-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ heˍ puiˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma pa puiˉ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ, hteˇ lehˍ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha bon na‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Heh nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ neˇ pi pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpehˇ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ca te maˇ gʼa. Gʼuiˬsha te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi sheˍ teh‸ chi beu‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ che‸ pehˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tzuh‸ suhˍ leh awˬ suhˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlehˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ hkeu piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon taˇ na‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍlehˆ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai shaˍ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hkeu ve tawˇ yaw tcuh tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Peˍawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Choˬ kaˬlo ngaˬ awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ suhˍ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh nuˇ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlanˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬGʼuiˬsha heuˆ gaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh ca jehˬ da‸ tuˬ maˇ kʼai-o. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo yawˇ nyi peu leh,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ deh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa deh‸ nyi mawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kaˇ puiˉ ve Beˍraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlanˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ha hkʼaw kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve fa la teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
tcuhˉ pui cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve hko teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ti taˍ ve suhˆ hkʼaˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ ya‸ la leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ve ti mi hkʼaw awˬ yawˇ gʼa sheˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍgaˆ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ heh nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ leh, hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca nawˍ piˇ maˇ haˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Baˍlehˆ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, la‸ tsuhˆ pui tsuhˆ taˍ leh Baˍlanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ la‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ leuˉ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ nawˬ peu laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ceh tiˉ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍlanˍ lehˬ Baˍlehˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ maˇ kʼo‸-e sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn a ciˉ kʼoˆ maˍ taˉ laˇ shaˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Mehˇ shiˍ hkʼa deh‸ nyi mawˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kaˇ puiˉ ve Beˍraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlanˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˬ maˍ yiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˉ pehˍ leh, Sheˍtaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ lehˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlanˍ lehˬ, awˬ ha hkʼaw Keˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ leh, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve ngaˆ hpui ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ca bawˆ la htaˇ, nawˬ hui Keˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Baˍlanˍ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo ma‸ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a shu le.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ hpawˇ lo laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍsuˇ riˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Eˍbaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Baˍlehˆ htawˇ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Aˍhkeˇshaˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo jehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw moˍ lonˉ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Meˇdiˍanˍ yaˇ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh yawˇ ve fa la hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Aˍronˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve fa la lo kʼai leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ juˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw nyiˇ meunˍ awˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇneˍhaˆ te ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hta‸ yawˇ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co paw hkuˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˇ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ yaˇ miˇ geh teˇ geh tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Siˉ monˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Saˍluˆ ve yaˇ Ziˇmaˍriˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw Zuˇraˆ ve yaˇ, Kawˇzaˍbiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Peˍawˇ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw tiˉ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve Kawˇzaˍbiˆ hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve mehˉ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la peuˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ shenˍ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ nyi-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, a sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shenˍ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˬ koˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Ruˇbenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍnoˆ, Paˍluˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ, leh Kaˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 43,730 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Paˍluˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ Neˍmoeˍlaˆ, Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ. (Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh jehˬ da‸ leh Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ sheˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Kawˇ raˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la leh chaw 250 gʼaˇ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Kawˇraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ gʼa suh.)
Siˉmonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Neˍmoeˍlaˆ, Yaˍmenˍ, Yaˍhkenˍ, Zeˍraˆ leh Sawˉliˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 22,200 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ
Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍhponˍ, Haˍgiˆ, Shuˇniˆ, Awˇzaˍniˆ, Eˇriˆ, Aˍraˆ, leh Aˍreˍliˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 40,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍlaˆ, Peˍrehˆ, Zeˍraˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Haˍmuˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ. (Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇraˆ leh Awˇnanˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw suh taˉ ve yoˬ) Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 76,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tawˇlawˆ, Hpuˇaˍ, Yaˍshoˆ, leh Shiˉmaˍronˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, 64,300 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Zeˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Seˍrehˆ, Eˇlonˍ, leh Yaˍhaˍleˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 60,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ ve awˬceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ, Giˇlaˆ, Yeˍzeˍlaˆ, Heˍlehˆ, Aˍseˍreˍlaˆ, Sheˍhkenˍ, Sheˍmiˆdaˆ leh Heˍhpaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haˍhpaˍ ve yaˇ Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yaˇ miˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Maˍlaˍ, Nawˇ-aˍ, Hawˇgaˍlaˆ leh Tiˇraˍzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 52,700 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shuˉteˍlaˆ, Beˍhkaˍ leh Taˍhanˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Eˇranˍ lehˬ Shuˉteˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 32,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍlaˆ, Aˍshaˍbeˍlaˆ, Aˍhiˆranˍ, Sheˍhpuˇhpanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍraˍdaˆ leh Neˍmanˍ lehˬBeˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 45,600 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Huˆshenˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 64,400 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉmaˍnaˍ, Iˉshaˍviˍ leh Beˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Beˍbaˍ leh Maˍlaˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Beˍriˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˍ lehˬ Seˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 53,400 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍzeˍlaˆ, Guˇniˆ, Yeˍzeˍriˆ, Shiˆlenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 45,400 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 601,730 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ chaw awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ ve i ve hta‸ nyi leh mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw maˇ kʼo maˇ ve hkʼe, chaw i kʼo i ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nyi leh kuˇ da‸ yuˬ tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ leh Meˍraˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Liˇbaˍniˆ, Heˍbronˍ, Maˍliˆ, Muˇshiˆ leh Kawˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Kawˇraˆ lehˬ Aˍmaˍranˍ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh,
Aˍmaˍranˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw taˍ ve Leˍviˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Yawˇhkeˍbehˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍronˍ, Moˉseˍ leh Meˇriˆanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˍdaˆ leh Aˍbiˇhuˆ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve aˬ miˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

A sha‸ teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼoˆ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 23,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ shenˍ geh maˇ hkaw‸ da‸ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ pehˬ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw shenˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw shenˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ponˬ laˬ ve teˇ pawˆ Siˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ chaw shenˍ gʼawˆ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ-o.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yeˍhpuˇnehˇ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ leh Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Maˍlaˍ, Nawˇaˍ, Hawˇgaˍlaˆ, Miˇlaˍkaˍ leh Tiˇraˍzaˍ hui lehˬ Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Heˍhpaˍ, Giˇlaˆ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ kuiˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve Kawˇraˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ ve chaw maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw suh-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ meh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o ve laˇ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ pehˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ awˬ lawn chi ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa gʼa cawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ leh suh-e ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ kʼo, aˉ shuˍ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ liˇ chi ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca nyi taˉ-oˆ.
Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ htawˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Ziˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve pa taw yoˬ. Meˍriˆbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Meˍriˇbaˆ lehˬ, Ziˇ naˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Oˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
A sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-o, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ,
yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ a ciˉ leuˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Kanˉ te puiˉ ve Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ nawˬ geh shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve la‸ sheh taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tu huˉ tcuh leh, nawˬ awˬ tan ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve aˉ yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ geh gʼa ca jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ Uˇrenˍ leh Tuˇmenˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ te tcuh ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Yawˇsuˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ tan kanˉ te tuˬ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ,
Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ awˬ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, teˇ nyi le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ mvuhˇ shawˉ hpawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ geh teˇ geh, shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw hkaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ yuˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ nyi le le chi hkʼe gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa ngeuˍ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ shawˉ hpawˇ te ve hkʼe yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Shinˉ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi le le awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, shinˉ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ suhˍ hkeh yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ,
leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ kaw, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ kʼo, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw, leh yawˬ ehˉ kʼo, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi le le awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ chi ve hta‸, ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ maˬ teˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ gʼa tanˬ te ve yoˬ.
Teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ leh, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ bon pawehˇ lonˉ chi hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ bon lawˬ kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼai leh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ nyiˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo, caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ,
yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo, caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo, caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ ponˬ leh, kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi le le tuˉ tanˇpiˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬchi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui bon lawˬ kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Caˬ gʼeu‸ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, bon gʼa lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ nyiˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ,
leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ, gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ leh kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi le le tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui bon lawˬ tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ da‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, behˬ heh ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa meuˆ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ, yawˬ paˍlonˉ kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ,
leh yawˬ ehˉ kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw yaˇ venˇbaˆ ponˬ leh kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi le le tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, ha pa chi ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui bon lawˬ tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Kanˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ suhˍ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ chi ve geh teˇ geh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆpanˇ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ,
leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ ponˬ leh kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui bon lawˬ tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Pawehˇ chi ve hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.

Pawehˇ te ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ chi shehˆ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e nyiˇ panˇ,
yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh kʼo caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ panˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ leh kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nyiˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ chi nyiˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh leh, a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍteˇ chi awˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ chi teˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ chi hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ kʼawˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaw‸ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ hinˉ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh, gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ suhˍ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ chi awˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ bon lawˬ tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, leh a sha‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ paˍ suhˍ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, pawehˇ te tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ lo‸-e sheˍ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ piˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ piˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ leh,
yawˇ ve awˬ pa te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa gʼa kaˇ leh tawˍ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ hpawˇ maˇ heuˆ sheˍ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve kʼo ka‸,
yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ maˇ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mehˇchawˇma, maˇ heˆ kʼo shu baˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te taˍ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te taˍ leh,
yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ maˇ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw‸ caˉ leh ha‸ shaˉ tcuh tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la htaˇ, awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, awˬ hpawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te ve awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ kʼo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ peuˬve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai peu-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ ceuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 12,000 gʼaˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Hpiˇneˍ haˆ lehˬ, da‸ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh behˬ heh ma hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ-e leh hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Eˇviˆ, Reˍkenˍ, Zuˇraˆ, Huˇraˆ leh Reˍbaˆ hui hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ leh yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh,
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw deh chehˇ ve Moˉseˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve chaw hui hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve le.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Baˍlanˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, Peˍawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kui lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ ya kʼaw sheh ya‸ laˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ haˉ chawˇ hkʼa te jaw peuˬ ve yaˇ paˍ leh yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon teh taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo chaw suh hta‸ gʼa htawˇ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi leh suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ to leh nawˬ hui shiˍ veu laˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh, leh suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ to‸ maˇ gʼa ve shi, hpu, kuiˇ, sho leh geu‸ law teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa moˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼa tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la leh fa la lo kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ to, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve hpu shi mawˇjeˬ, ceˇ caˬ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa gʼaw nyi ve yoˬ.
Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˇ pun pehˬ leh, teˇ pun ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ pun Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve ceˇ caˬ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lon ngaˇ ha pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh,
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve ceˇ caˬ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˇ chi pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve ceˇ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ 675,000 hkeh, nuˇ 72,000 hkeh, piˉ laˬ 61,000 hkeh, yaˇ miˇ haˉ 32,000 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve ceˇ lehˬ, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ 337,500 hkeh, nuˇ 36,000 hkeh, piˉ laˬ 30,500 hkeh, leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ 16,000 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ awˬ pon 500 pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve lehˬ, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ 675 hkeh, nuˇ 72 hkeh, piˉ laˬ 61 hkeh leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ 32 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ ngaˇ ha pun teˇ pun ve ceˇ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ leh paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼa ve ceˇ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ 337,500 hkeh, nuˇ 36,000 hkeh, piˉ laˬ 30,500 hkeh, leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ 16,000 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Moˉseˍ lehˬ ceˇ leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˇ chi pun teˇ pun kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ Moˉseˍ geh kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw nyi taˍ peuˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ luˬ maˇ sheˆ law.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼa veu laˇ taˍ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun, la‸ kawˬ, naˍ vawˇ, la‸ peˍ leh kʼawˍ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve mawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ 167 cawehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ leh Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ceˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍzaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, ceˇ hu caˇ kuiˬ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Moˉseˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve, Aˍtaˍroˆ venˇ, Diˇbonˍ venˇ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ, Niˇmaˍraˆ venˇ, Heˍsaˍbonˍvenˇ, Eˇlaˍleˍ venˇ, Sheˍbanˍ venˇ, Neˍbawˇ venˇ, leh Bawˇnaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
ceˇ hu caˇ kuiˬ da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ceˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo taˇ ca chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ma‸ bawˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ huiˬ choˬ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma te luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tu leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ca jaˆ nyi tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ gaˬ taˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa tawˆ la taˍ ve a sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Keˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ leh Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui suh-e peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ te toˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Ruˇbenˍ leh Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ geh kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkawˆ leh ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ pon yehˬ te piˇ tuˬ aˬ hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ taˉ peuˬ kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, gʼuˇ suhˍ peuˍ leh ma‸ ga bawˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ taˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon venˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu piˇ taˉ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh, mawˇ jeˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ yuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ tehˬ awˬ na oˇ hkʼe te gaˇ ve kʼo, chi beu‸ choˬ kaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ gu taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ma‸ gʼa ca bawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te biˇ taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ shawˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkawˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon venˇ hta‸ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gaˆ leh Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui ca te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh ma‸ ca bawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ leh Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ ve kʼo, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ maˇ ga bawˆ laˇ ve kʼo, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ leh Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh Baˍshaˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gaˆ leh Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Diˇbonˍ venˇ, Aˍtaˍroˆ venˇ, Aˍyawˍ venˇ,
Aˍtaˍroˆshawˇhpanˍ venˇ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ, Yuˇbeˍhaˆ venˇ,
Behˆniˇmaˍraˍ venˇ leh Behˆhaˍranˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ, Eˇleˍlaˆ venˇ, Kiˇriˆyaˆtenˍ venˇ,

Neˍbawˇ venˇ, awˬ meh awˬsuhˉ kʼaw‸ meh taˍ ve Baˍlaˆmawˇnaˆ venˇ leh Siˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ tanˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Giˉlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍiˇraˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ leh, hkʼaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yaˍiˇraˆ ve hkʼaˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˇbaˆ lehˬ Keˍnaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Nawˇbaˆ venˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw‸ lo deh taˉ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa deh taˉ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Raˍmaˍseˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ to Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Raˍmaˍseˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Suˇkoˆ lo ca deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, hteunˍ lonˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Eˇtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh Baˍlaˆseˍhponˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Piˆhaˍhiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Shuˇraˆ hteunˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Hteunˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw shehˆ nyi te toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Maˍraˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tuˬ leh, Eˍlenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ leh tcuhˉ pui cehˬ suhˍ chi cehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi paˇ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Senˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˉ, Dawˇhpaˍkaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ kʼaw‸ tu leh, Aˍluˇshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve Reˍhpiˆdenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ deh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Ziˇnaˆ hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh Eˇdonˍ miˬ tcuhˉ leh, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍkaˍraˍbenˍ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍzaˍyaˍdaˍ venˇ leh Aˍzaˍmonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo leh ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh, Hawˇ raˆ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
Zeˍdaˆ venˇ, Ziˇhpronˍ venˇ, Haˍzaˍreˍnanˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Heˍzaˍreˍnanˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Sheˍhpanˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Enˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍbeˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh ya‸-e leh, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kʼawˇ ceuˬ teˇ hkoˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh awˬ nu ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh,
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa nyi pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ Siˉmonˍ Aˍmiˇhuˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍluˆmeˍlaˆ Beˍyaˍmenˍ Hkiˇsaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍdaˆ Danˍ Yawˇgaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Buˇhkiˆ Maˍnaˍseˍ Eˇhpoˆ ve yaˇ Haˍneˍlaˆ Eˇhpaˍronˍ Shiˉhpaˍtanˍ ve yaˇ Keˍmoeˍlaˆ Zeˍbuˆlonˍ Paˍnehˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˆzaˍhpanˍ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ Aˍzanˍ ve yaˇ Paˍlaˍteˍlaˆ Aˍshaˍ Sheˍlawˇmiˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˇhuˆ Naˍtaˍliˆ Aˍmiˇhuˆ ve yaˇ Peˍdaˍheˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ga nyi pehˬ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ leh yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ jaˇ venˇ ji lo cawˬ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hta‸ teˇ hinˉ shaw‸ vuiˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ lehˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ leh, venˇ jaˇ venˇ ji lo kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ ceˍ leh teˇ ceˍ awˬ kaˍ lo nyiˇ hinˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ hui lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇ hkaw‸ venˇ gʼa piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve venˇ awˇ chi nyiˇ venˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˇ chi hinˉ venˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve venˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ chaw ceuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nyi leh keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ kʼo, yawˇ ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suhˉ maˇ gʼa jehˬ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe venˇ hkaw‸ venˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ-o‸.
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo shehˆ venˇ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shehˆ venˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ-o‸.

Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ponˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve kʼo, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ aˉhtaw, haˉ pui shiˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo suhˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ leh shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh peuˬve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ canˇ leh, haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo chu-eˬ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ gʼa baˬ pehˍ cawˇ ve kʼo,
suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ gʼa jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve maˇ gʼa te.

Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hpaw la taˍ ve ponˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ lonˉ suh peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ.

Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ suh peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ponˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw tiˉ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lonˉ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ htaˇ heh‸, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ hkiˆ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ hpu kʼaw‸ htoˇ hkʼaw‸ maˇ hpeh‸.
Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ponˬ ve venˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ maˇ suh sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ hta‸ hpu ca kʼaw‸ htoˇ hkʼaw‸ maˇ hpeh‸.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve ceh ceh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸, Maˍnaˍseˍ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ leh Giˇlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Moˉseˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬviˉ awˬ nyi Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ gʼa kʼai leh, ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ i kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Juˇbiˍliˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, hawˇ taˍ peuˬ ve miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui heuˆ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kʼai leh, ngaˬ hui hpawˇ lo shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ heuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mawˇ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸. A shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ceh gʼa nyi heuˆ leh, a shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shinˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa piˇ. A shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍlaˍ, Tiˉraˍzaˍ, Hawˇgaˍlaˆ, Miˆlaˍkaˍ, leh Nawˇ-aˍ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ heuˆ leh, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui lehˬ Suˇhpaˆ, Paˍranˍ, Tawˇhpeˍlaˆ, Laˍbanˍ, Haˍzaˍroˆ leh Diˇzaˍhaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
(Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo te leh, Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ lo teˇ chi teˇ nyi gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve awˇ chi hkʼaw‸, teˇ chi teˇ ha pa, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh, Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ venˇ leh Eˍdiˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaw pui chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve fa la hta‸ hpaˆ leh gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai loˬ. Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo kʼai-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼai-o.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ te maˇ gʼa taˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hinˉ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ te laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh cheuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui htawˇ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui leuˆ laˇ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ chaw teˇ ha gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ, chaw ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ leh teˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ chawˇ chawˇ ya‸ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ya‸ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa deh‸ nyi leh hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
