Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ nyi. Hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui suhˉ jehˬ cheˆ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ cawˬ la kʼo, ngaˬ geh yuˬ laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ-e leh, kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmawˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo nawˬ hui gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ.
Chiˇ nyi hkʼa sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ-oˆ. Taˇ jo chehˇ. Kawˆ ve nyi ma ka‸ taˇ cawˬ piˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˉ lawˉ ca jaˆ nyi tcuh shaˍ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te kʼai tuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo venˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ naˍ, ca jaˆ nyi tcuh shaˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬchaw 12 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ ca jaˆ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui geh shaˉ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e.

Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼanˇ maˍ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ngaˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hui kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ mvuh leh, awˬ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve venˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te taˉ peuˬ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ chiˇ kʼai piˇ ve hkʼe, choˬ kaˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ va.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh maˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ aˬ miˍ hkuiˉ daw leh mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬpiˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, Moˉseˍ nawˬ ka‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lo gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ maˇ puiˉ sheˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Moˉseˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui chi beu‸ tu leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ma‸ maˇ gʼa ca bawˆ-e tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ ve tiˉ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pehˇ ma hkʼa shuˍ tawˆ la leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Hawˇmaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ca ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui Kaˍdeˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hui awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ awˬ na hpawˇ lo kʼai-o.
Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai-o. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca bawˆ da‸. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ shaw‸ ceh ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ngaˬ Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ caˇ tuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ yawˇ hui geh vuiˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo caw toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ chi ve awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa loˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh Eˇlaˆ venˇ, Eˇzaˍyonˍgaˍbaˍ venˇ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Lawˇtaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ taˇ ca ya‸ piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ taˇ ca bawˆ. Aˍraˆ venˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
(Aˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ awˬ to uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Eˍmenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ shu Reˍhpenˍ chaw teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˍmenˍ chaw teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hawˇriˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca lo‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.)
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, Zeˍrehˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 38 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la peuˬ ve oˇ teˇ co chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe suh kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui Aˍraˆ venˇ hta‸ hpaˍ leh Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Lawˇtaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ paˇ lo gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ ca ya‸ piˇ. Ma‸ ka‸ taˇ ca bawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
(Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve lehˬ Reˍhpenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Zaˍzuˆmehˍ chaw teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ awˬ to uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te piˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Hawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Kaˍreˍteˍ conˇ lo laˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍvenˍ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Ngaˬ hui Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ tu leh Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e loˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Heˍsaˍbonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ-o‸.

Ya‸ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Keˍdaˍmoˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Heˍsaˍbonˍ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ hkʼaˇ suh tiˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui caˇ taˉ peuˬ ve caˇ tuˬ leh, iˉ kaˆ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ shawˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Iˉsawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Siˉhonˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ heh la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ chi beu‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ loˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Siˉhonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Yaˍhaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Giˇlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha maˇ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼai.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Eˍdiˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Heˍbronˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve venˇ 60 venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ leh, taˍmeu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ maˇ ko taˍ ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍbonˍ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
(Siˉdonˍ chaw lehˬ, Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ Siˇronˍ hkʼaw teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw lehˬ Seˍniˍraˆ hkʼaw teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Giˇlaˆ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Seˍlaˍkaˍ venˇ leh Eˍdiˆ venˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

(Jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ lehˬ Reˍhpenˍ chaw hui ve awˬ leh meuˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kʼawˇ kʼoˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 9 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼawˇ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Reˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼa peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ruˇ benˍ leh Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ lehˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. (Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Reˍhpenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ ka‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍiˇraˆ chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Geˍshuˇraˆ venˇ leh Maˍkaˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ meh Yaˍiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ hkʼe meh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)
Ngaˬ lehˬ Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍhkiˇraˆ chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh leh,

Ruˇbenˍ leh Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po hta‸ te leh Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ leh, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e loˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ, nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ceˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa leh nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ ga bawˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ca bawˆ-e tuˬ ve awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te tuˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ hpeu‸ maw laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gʼa ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e tcuh laˇ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi sha jaˇ ve Leˍbaˍ nonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Pehˇ-o. Nawˬ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ loˬ.

Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chiˇ nyi peu-o. Nawˬ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼa hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ taˉ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Behˆpeˍawˇ venˇ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ leuˉ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ keu htehˍ piˇ. Kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ ve ka‸ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Peˍawˇ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chi beu‸ ca lo‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve shu hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui loˍ htaˇ ga laˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa leunˇ kʼai tuˬ, hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw paˇ lo nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kaˇ tcuh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, aˬ miˍ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te huˉ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ chi hkawˇ hta‸, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te na yuˬ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui na yuˬ cawˇ ve Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ te leh da‸ kehˬ chehˇ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸,
to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸,
miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ loˇ kʼai gaˆ kʼai puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh, ngaˇ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hpeh‸ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ lo‸-e tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼa hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Choˬ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa suh taˉ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi hta‸ hkanˍ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa leunˇ kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ taˇ te.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ ha hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.

Nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh chehˇ leh, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la peuˬ ve htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to pon hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ ceu‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa te. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw leh miˬguiˬ chi ve lehˬ, ya‸ nyi shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ la‸ sheh te taˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˆ leh haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ leh, maˇ mawˬ puiˉ, maˇ kaˇ puiˉ, maˇ caˇ puiˉ leh maˇ nuˬ puiˉ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui maˇ keuˆ maˇ paw la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, aˬ sho-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha chaw yaˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Chi taw taw uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ hpeh‸ la jaw laˇ. Chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw laˇ.
Chi beu‸ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, chaw yaˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve cawˬ jaw laˇ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ haˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ jaw laˇ. Nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, yawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve, bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve, anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te maˍ laˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇnaw ma hkʼoˆ lo bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve awˬ hkawˇ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve aˬ miˍ ha nawˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ leh, aˬ miˍ ha oˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw co co taiˍ taiˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve venˇ 3 venˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ lehˬ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Beˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼo, Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Goˍlanˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ leuˆ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ nyi te‸ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yawˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leh nawˬ hui awˬ kaˍ lo huˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ ha hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui.
Mvuhˇnaw miˬguiˬ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa te.

Shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ shehˆ co, awˇ co hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ awˇ hinˉ co hkʼa gaˬ chi hkʼe ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼe leˇ maˇ gʼa kuˬ guiˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, shinˉ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kanˉ te caˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hkaw‸ nyi cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shinˉ nyi htaˇ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve yaˇ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ gʼa jehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇ mi hkʼaw shu ceˬ te jaw taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw shinˉ nyi htaˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ gʼa chehˇ leh, da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o.
Chaw hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ.
Nawˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa te.
Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkʼawˇ.
Shu hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.

Shu miˇ ma hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkʼawˇ faˍ. Shu ve yehˬ, shu ve ti mi, shu ve awˬ ceˬ, shu ve nuˇ, shu ve piˉ laˬ leh shu ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ maˇ gʼa sheˉ lai, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼaw pui oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ htaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ aˬ miˍ ha leh moˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ hkʼoˆ lo bvuh‸ keu leh, ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la leh, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh jiˆ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw piˇ ve htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve maˇ suh ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ jaw laˇ.

Moˉseˍ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ na-e loˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ ya‸ la leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe cawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve fa la lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ te tcuh laˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te-o.
Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ gʼa chehˇ leh ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa yawˆ yan leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hta‸ gʼa leh, Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui ve co ha hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸-o‸.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh, leh naˍ kʼa‸ pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ leh,
nawˬ hui ve yehˬ miˉ leh taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ lo htawˇ bvuh‸ nehˉ taˍ-o‸.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ teˇ peˆ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ te taˍ ve venˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ ca keu taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ duˇ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui maˇ te taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko leh shaˍlonˍ hko teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa caˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa leunˇ kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh, yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Nawˬ hui teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ka ti‸ te gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ceh tiˉ ka ti‸ te-o.
Nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼe ce la leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.
Maˍsaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe, taˇ kʼaw‸ lawˇ nyi.
Yawˇ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve cawˇ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ha lehˬ dawˇ sha gʼa chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ na yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Giˇgaˍshiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw, leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw chi ve suhˍ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh shaˉ caˆ taˇ caˇ. Ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ heuˆ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ heuˆ tcuh.

Nawˬ hui heuˆ tcuh ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, la‸ haˉ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ, leh Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shu a‸ kehˉ chaw maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te biˇ la piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ awˬ hinˉ co-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ leh hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve chaw maˇ la tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ leh awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, caˬshiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, leh shaˍlonˍ chu maˇ maˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon chi hkʼa peu-eˬ na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hkʼe taw awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ maˇ paw puiˉ ve cawˬ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Naˬ ve gawˬ ve a naˍ laiˉ ceuˬ nawˬ hui geh maˇ gʼa gaˬ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ puiˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ teh‸ taˇ dawˇ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca hpaw va‸ toˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ la leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ leh, yawˇ hui luˬ peuˬ sheˆ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ-oˆ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˍ taˍ ve hpu, shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ sheˉ lai. Yuˬ ka‸ taˇ yuˬ. Nawˬ hui yuˬ ve kʼo, te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw taˇ yuˬ keu. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa canˇ leh gʼa cha‸ naˬ ve yoˬ Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ leh kʼaw‸ maˇ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇ mi oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo 40 hkʼaw‸ shiˍ caw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˍ meu‸ jehˇ tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ jaw ve maˍnaˆ shiˍ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ ceuˬ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ a sha‸ te‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw a sha‸ gʼa te‸ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
40 hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ tzuh‸ leh, nawˬ hui ve hkui sheh htawˇ maˇ hpo‸, maˇ naˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, maˉnawˆ shiˍ, aˉ ci ku shiˍ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, sho leh kuiˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe gʼa caˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ pon, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa leunˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te gʼa peuˬ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ, teˇ hpaˍ leh hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ hui nyi ma maˇ gʼa uiˍ leh, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa leunˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˬ leh aˉ ci ku taw‸ ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ caˇ jaw ve maˍnaˆ shiˍ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh tu‸ hkanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui paw sha la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ ca dawˇ.

Nawˬ hui paw sha la ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, na sheˍ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ jaˇ leh, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mvuh jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to ka‸ uiˍ jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ to‸ baˬ kʼai chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui keunˍ ve pa taw Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui haiˬ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui da‸ jaˇ leh cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui haiˬ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ gʼa te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma heh jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tanˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi choˬ kaˬ lo gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw paˇ lo htawˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ law‸ law‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo 40 nyi 40 haˉ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ hui hkʼaw chi ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo huˉ chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
40 nyi 40 haˉ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te teh taˍ peuˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma hkʼaˬ ma heh jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˬ ha ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te teh taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu leh hkoˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ 40 nyi 40 haˉ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ law‸ law‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍronˍ hta‸ ka‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ awˬ pon ka‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te teh taˍ ve venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ teˍ meu-e leh hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Taˍbeˍraˆ, Maˍsaˍ, Kiˇbaˍtoˆhaˍtaˍvaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tu leh, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, nawˬ hui Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Yawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tanˬ shiˍ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ 40 nyi 40 haˉ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ leh, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma heh ve, cha‸ chiˆ ve, leh venˇbaˆ te taˍ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ tawnˇ taˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, Nawˬ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬshiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬGʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ ve hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ suhˆ ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ geh taˆ la-o.

Nawˬ te hkoˇ peuˬ ve haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, haˉ pui baˉ awˬ suhˉ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ kʼo, ta kʼoˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ aˍhkeˇshaˍ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh ta kʼoˍ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˉ lawˇ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ ve hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ htawˆ veu leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ hui hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Yawˇ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ leh kʼoˆ laˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ chi hkawˇ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ leh ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ haˉ pui baˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ suhˆ ta kʼoˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo keu taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

(Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yaˍkanˍ chaw hui ve iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ lo tu leh, Moˇseˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Aˍronˍ suh-e leh yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ yawˇ awˬ tan paw hkuˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Guˇgawˇdaˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Yawˇbaˍtaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh paw hkuˇ te tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ gʼa te ve yoˬ.)
Awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo 40 nyi 40 haˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ te tcuh gaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ chi beu‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te-o. Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ leh nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.
Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui da‸ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw miˬguiˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nyi ma taˇ kʼaw‸ heh chehˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kawˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma pa la tuˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ ca hkʼawˇ piˇ maˇ gʼa.

Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ Yawˇ ha‸ leh, caˍ piˇ taw piˇ, feuˉ piˇ deh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh, Yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ kanˉ te-o.
Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui chaw suhˍ chi gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuhˇ jaˇ ve leh, Yawˇ kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ te maˍ laˇ ve anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ htaˇ, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ pon kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Daˍtanˍ leh Aˍbiˆranˍ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇsuhˍ lo miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ sheˬ leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, yawˇ hui ve aˉ po kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ, leh yawˇ hui ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tawˆ-e leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Yawˇ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui chehˇ jaw taˉ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ duˇ keu leh ti mi gʼa te caˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaw mvuh lawˬ naˉ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ ma nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui loˍ la htaˇ yawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ, mvuh‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ
Nawˬ hui shu hkawˇ na leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ goˇ choˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh leh nawˬ hui ve naˍ kʼaˍ pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui aˉ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ miˉ leh taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ bvuh‸ teh taˍ-o‸.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma chi ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe te-o.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa naˆ toˇ taˉ peuˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuh nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo teˇ kaˬ kʼai ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬve hkʼe, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, hkeu ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve laˇ.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kʼo, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Geˍraˍzenˍ hkʼaw hta‸ awˬ bon gʼa na‸ piˇ leh, Eˇbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hta‸ gʼa hkeu piˇ ve yoˬ.

(Hkʼaw chi ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇreˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve suhˆ tsuh de hta‸ tcuhˇ tcuhˬ maˇ vuiˇ da‸.)
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca lo‸ chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo te teh taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˇ hkʼe oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ te pui.
Nawˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ ceh tiˉ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui oˇ kaˬ gʼa kʼai leh, nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpa, leh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la taˍ ve nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ca tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui muiˬ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh gʼa mui caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ dawˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ, leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh, oˇ kaˬ lo ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ. Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ tiˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hkuiˉ zuhˬ shaˍ leh tsuh shaˍ caˇ ve hkʼe, ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nuˇ leh yawˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa caˇ.

Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ, leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa ca caˇ-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa leunˇ taˉ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la kʼehˬ la piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve shaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw tiˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkuiˉ zuhˬ shaˍ leh tsuh shaˍ caˇ ve hkʼe, shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw a sha‸ cawˬ leh, a sha‸ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ shaˍ geh teˇ geh maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Awˬ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ caˇ. Iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ha lehˬ dawˇ sha gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼoˆ teh leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui shu ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa gʼa‸ te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hta‸ taˇ gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi.

Yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˇ hkʼe oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ te pui. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te-o. Awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ keu htehˍ. Yuˬ yawnˇ ve ka‸ taˇ te.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, zuh‸ maˆ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ puiˉ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ,
nawˬ hui hta‸ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te maˍ laˇ gʼa ve htawˇ,
yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Nawˬ hui nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ maˇ ha‸ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lawˇ nyi gaˇ ve pa taw, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ yehˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o.

Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ laˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh nawˬ hui a sha‸ maˇ gʼa te‸ tuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ya‸ kʼaw maˇ gʼa ya‸ kʼai tuˬ, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ, nawˬ miˇ ma, leh nawˬve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼawˇ beˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo vuiˇ jaˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉkʼoˍ pui tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ beˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui beˬ hkawˇ taˇ na. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma ka‸ taˇ cawˬ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ hpehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw moˍ lonˉ ga hpoˆ baˬ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh chi hkʼe ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ te haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh, nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ chaˬ nyi-o. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo,
venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ kʼaw ji lo shaw hpoˆ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ-o‸. Venˇ oˇ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ gu te gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Yawˇ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw hui te ve hkʼe a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ shawˆ hkʼaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, uˉ hkeh mvuh chiˇ baˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa te.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ caˇ.
Nawˬ hui to nuˇ to shaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ, yawˬ, aˉ che‸,
hkuiˉ zuhˬ, yawˬ awˬ hteunˍ, haˇ tawˉ pehˆ, tsuh piˉ kʼaweh‸,
leh hkui kiˆ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh, caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh behˇ caˇ puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkui kiˆ maˇ cawˬ leh caˇ tuˬ maˇ geuˆ puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Kaˍlaˍoˆ, pa taiˇ hkʼe ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh behˇ caˇ puiˉ ve htawˇ hkui kiˆ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ da‸ kehˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Va‸ shaˍ taˇ caˇ. Maˇ daˬ kehˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkui kiˆ cawˬ ve htawˇ, caˇ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ a‸ tawˆ leh caˇ maˇ puiˉ. Chi hkʼe ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ taˇ caˇ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ taˇ htawˇ.
Awˬ biˉ leh awˬ shehˆ cawˬ ve ngaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ biˉ leh awˬ shehˆ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˆ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ hui caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ. Aˉ ceˬ, hkawˍtawehˍ, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˆ, ngaˆ hpu ma, kawehˆ, lo tuˬ ma, leh poˬnaˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Poˬ puiˉ ve pfuhˇ shehˍ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve pa taw nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa caˇ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve pfuhˇ shehˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˉ nawˬ hui gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, shu hta‸ hawˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ che‸ ehˉ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ e ve cuˉ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa keu caˉ caˇ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le, nawˬ hui ve ti mi hkʼaw tawˆ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ teˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ hui ve teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, leh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˆ yan hkawˇ nawˇ tuˬ chi hkʼe te tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ leh, teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ kʼai maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, chi hkʼe te-o.
Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo hpu hta‸ yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui caˇ gaˇ ve nuˇ shaˍ, yawˬ ehˉ shaˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, tzuhˬ hta‸ vuiˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ guˇ suhˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ taˇ leunˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, nawˬ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ hkʼaw ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸.

Caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ mawˇ jeˬ maˇ cawˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw, hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, shu nawˬ hui geh ca chiˇ la taˍ ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ chawˇ chawˇ hpu chiˇ piˇ taˍ ve cawˬ kʼo, hpu oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, hpu oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca hkʼaw‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jeˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ponˬ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve chaw geh cha taˍ ve jeˬ hta‸ ca hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ chawˇ chawˇ geh cha taˍ ve jeˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca hkʼaw‸.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa haˍ gʼa gʼawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu maˇ maˇ gʼa chiˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui shu geh hpu gʼa ca chiˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw ceuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu uˉ peunˍ laˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, maˇ nyi gaˇ ve taˇ te.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma loˍ kʼo chi ma ha lehˬ ha kʼa ga piˇ-oˆ.

Jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ neˇ la chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ chiˇ piˇ, maˇ ngaˍ piˇ gaˇ ve taˇ te.
