Maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe ve nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw taˇ lo‸ la piˇ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpu maˇ chiˇ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ga piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, teˇ ceuˬ le le hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ miˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yawˇ awˬ to nawˬ hta‸ hawˇ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ 6 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, hkʼe leˇ awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ maˇ gʼa hpehˇ peu.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ na‸ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yawˬ ehˉ, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa ga piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ gʼa te taˉ jaw peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ tawˆ-e tuˬ maˇ dawˇ tawˆ leh, nawˬ geh ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ gaˇ ve kʼo,

yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve naˍ paw hta‸ htaw pawnˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ teˇ co-e nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve hta‸ taˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, gʼaˇ ga caˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ pun kanˉ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nawˬ hui ve ceˇ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh le le, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ceˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te tcuh. Awˬ mvuh htawˇ maˇ gʼa nuˆ baˬ piˇ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hui geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hkeh, hkui luˬ ve, mehˆ cuˉ ve, leh awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ.

Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo tiˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hkuiˉ zuhˬ shaˍ caˇ ve hkʼe, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆbaˍlaˆ ha pa gaˬ la ve kʼo, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ ha pa tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼai leh Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw, Paˍsaˍ hkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ nawˬ hui ve nuˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui pawehˇ chi hta‸ caˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, diˇ keu taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kiˍ moˉ kiˍ chiˆ te tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa caˇ taˉ peuˬve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ chi hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tawˆ la ve hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ co-e dawˇ nawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ chi hta‸ caˇ-oˆ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw diˇ maˇ gʼa teh taˍ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ haˉ htaˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ tiˉ hkʼaw gʼa caˇ peuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa sheh kʼai leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca tiˇ pehˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve, mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼe htaˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍ hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu caˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve kʼo, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ tiˉgʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ gʼa hpawnˬ da‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ hui caˬ tanˬ gʼeu‸ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh suhˍ shinˉ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼeu‸ jaw‸ ve pawehˇ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw, yawˇ na‸ laˇ ve bon hta‸ dawˇ nyi leh, a shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼe tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw, hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˬ veu laˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa hti caˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ gʼa te jaw taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui caˬ jaw‸ peuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi gʼa kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw, hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma hui hta‸ shiˍ veu leh teˇ geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa hti caˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼai leh suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ chi hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui muiˬ taˍ vaˇ taˍ ve hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, teˇ hkʼaw‸ shehˆ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo laˬ leh, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼeu‸ jaw‸ ve pawehˇ, leh aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ca te la ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ te gʼa ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha bon na‸ laˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ-o‸. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ gʼa jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ maˇ gʼa jehˬ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ. Chi hkʼe ve la‸shawnˍ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te-o.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ maˇ gʼa yuˬ teh taˍ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa te teh taˍ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh,
awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha, maˇ heˆ kʼo mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo,
hkʼa deh‸ chaˬ nyi-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo,
chaw oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ htaˇ heh‸, yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ.

Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw moˍ lonˉ haˉ pui gʼa ga hpoˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, venˇbaˆ chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ ca cawˬ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ jeˬ awˬ lawn tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve, dawˆ da‸ ya‸ da‸ ve, shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ cawˬ leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼai leh,
paw hkuˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ gʼa ca kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui suhˉ jehˬ laˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hui suhˉ jehˬ laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, venˇbaˆ chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui geh gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui htawˇ jawˇmawˇ heuˆ gaˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ leh gʼa leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ maˇ gʼa te tcuh.

Nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon iˉ mvuhˇ maˇ maˇ hu taˍ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ca vuiˬ tcuh tuˬ ka‸ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma laiˉ gʼaˇ maˇ gʼa heuˆ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpu shi maˇ maˇ cawˬ la leh paw sha la tuˬ ka‸ yawˇ maˇ gʼa te.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw teˇ kʼoˆ gʼa bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ daw oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo gʼa teh taˍ leh, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e oˇ kaˬ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa gʼaw nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ maˇ dawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸ taˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh gʼa uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ aw hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬhkʼaw miˬguiˬ pehˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬGʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ miˬguiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ, paˇ kaˇ gʼawˇ, leh awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ teˇ hpaˍ paw hkuˇ hui hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh yawˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ Yawˇ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo laˬ leh,
oˇ kaˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ ca te la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ ka‸ awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hkʼe caˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa caˇ leh, yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ feu laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ gʼa‸ te.
Nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ. Nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, neˇ maˇ gʼa te tcuh. Maˇ gʼa mawˉ nyi tcuh.
Faˍ maˇ gʼa te tcuh. Suh peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ tawˇ na nyi ve, chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te tcuh.
Chi hkʼe te ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, neˇ te leh mawˉ nyi ve chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hkʼa shuˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ mawˬ gaˇ-o teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui suh-e la ve hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Yawˇ hui teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ maˇ kʼoˆ tcuh ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw toˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa, maˇ gʼa ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, tawˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve tawˇ maˇ heˆ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe yaw toˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shehˆ tawn te pehˬ leh, teˇ tawn le le awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼai sha laˬ sha ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te taˍ ve kʼo, maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ venˇ oˇ ve lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ maˇ heˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ venˇ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suhˆ ca hkaˆ-e leh, teˇ gʼaˇ suhˆ htu chehˇ htaˇ ceˉ ceˇ kʼehˆ tawˆ-e leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve pa taw suh kʼai ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo venˇ teˇ venˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw vuiˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, oˇ kaˬ lo venˇ shehˆ venˇ leuˆ teh taˍ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la kʼehˬ la piˇ leh, Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve venˇ shehˆ venˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. (Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw, Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.)
Te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe leˇ maˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui shu hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ taˉ leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ lo hpaw-e ve kʼo,

awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa ca shiˍ hkʼaw‸ leh, suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ suh peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve awˬ tan, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ taˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ. Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ dawˇ sha gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ yuˬ jiˆ leh shu ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ ve maˇ gʼa te.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve kʼo, shaˉ hkiˆ oˇ ve lehˬ maˇ biˇ. Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ i jaˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ htaˇ heh‸, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ luˬ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve kʼo,
yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼai leh, paw hkuˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh suhˉ gʼa ca jehˬ ve yoˬ.
Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi leh, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ shu hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ awˬ tan gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, awˬ haiˬ chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, awˬ haiˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ te haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ. A sha‸ awˬ tan a sha‸, mehˆ shiˍ awˬ tan mehˆ shiˍ, ciˬ awˬ tan ciˬ, la‸ sheh awˬ tan la‸ sheh, hkui sheh awˬ tan hkui sheh hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, shu ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇ tu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ma‸ maˇ ca bawˆ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ shu gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tawˆ la leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui ma‸ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ nuˇ piˇ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ leh, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ma‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yehˬ te taˍ peuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ. Cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ leh, yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ca suh-e puiˉ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ hko te taˍ peuˬ ve ka‸, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ maˇ gʼa shaˉ caˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ-aw laˇ. Cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ leh, yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ca suh-e puiˉ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

La‸ kʼawˍ toˆ tuˬ gu taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ-aw laˇ. Cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ leh, yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ca suh-e puiˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ heuˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ i leh kawˆ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ-aw laˇ. Cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ i kʼai piˇ leh, kawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui teˇ moˍ peuˬ teˇ moˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tuˬ ve chaw gʼa leuˆ teh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui venˇ teˇ maˬ maˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ ya‸ tuˬ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yehˬ miˉ hpaw leh la‸ caˉ ya‸ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ-o‸.
Venˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui heuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ca bawˆ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw, leh Yeˍbuˇshiˆ chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa maˍ laˇ tuˬ, leh nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui venˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ ve hkʼaˬ maw gaˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa htu baˬ piˇ. Iˉshiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ caˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ. Iˉ shiˍ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ta‸ awˬ pon loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha piˇ laˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hk’aw, shu tiˇ pehˍ taˍve chaw teˇ g’aˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui g’a mawˬ leh, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve k’o,
nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo k’ai leh, chaw suh oˇ ve venˇ hk’aˬ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ neˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ g’a shiˍ tuˬ hk’a deh‸ g’a tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hk’e te peuˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, chaw suh oˇ ve hta‸ neˇ da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hk’aw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ tcuh jaw sheˍ ve nuˇ ma haˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh,
teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ fiˍ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ cawˬ kuiˬ leh, shu teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te caˇ jaw sheˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ k’ai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo nuˇ ma haˉ ve k’awˍ peˍ hta‸ g’a awˉ hteh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo g’a k’ai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn k’o, yawˇ hui lehˬ chi hk’e ve haˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ suhˉ g’a jehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hk’oˆ, G’uiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hk’aw bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ G’uiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chaw suh oˇ ve hta‸ neˇ da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hk’aw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ ma haˉ oˇ ve awˬ hk’oˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh tsuhˇ leh chi hk’e g’a k’oˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ. A shu teˇ g’aˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ.

G’uiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hk’aw htaiˍ hk’aw‸ piˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi teˇ g’aˇ suh-e ve ngaˬ hui awˬ hk’oˆ venˇbaˆ taˇ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ g’a k’oˆ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha k’oˆ taˍ ve hk’e nawˬ hui hk’a deh‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve k’o, chaw chi hpaˇ suh-e ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hui awˬ hk’oˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
G’uiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ g’aˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ hui chaw laiˉ g’aˇ hta‸ hpeh g’a ve hk’aw,
awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui g’a mawˬ leh heuˆ gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ k’ai leh, uˉ hkeh mvuh leh la‸ shiˍ k’uˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˆ baˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hta‸ veu‸ k’aˇ awˬ suhˉ k’aw‸ htaiˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yehˬ hk’aw chehˇ taˍ leh, teˇ ha pa hk’a gaˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa aw e pon dawˇ haˍ leh g’a paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hk’e te peuˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve k’o, yawˇ hta‸ hk’e leˇ g’a tawˆ k’ai tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ g’a heuˆ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ ma hk’e shawˍ leh hawˇ caˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw teˇ g’aˇ awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ g’aˇ cawˬ leh, nyiˇ g’aˇ g’aˇ ka‸ yaˇ paˍ paw la taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hk’aˇ, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ g’aˇ lehˬ yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh paw la taˍ ve yaˇ maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ shinˉ pehˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ ve awˬ shinˉ piˇ ve maˇ g’a te.

Yawˇ maˇ ha‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ g’aˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve k’o, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ shinˉ nyiˇ pun g’a piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ pa lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ g’a taˍ uiˍ leh, yawˇ g’a keunˍ ve awˬ shinˉ g’a piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa teˇ g’aˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ haiˬ jaˇ leh hk’aˬ ma jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve k’o,
yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ hk’aw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh g’a shiˍ k’ai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ chi lehˬ, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hpu hta‸ hk’e leˇ yehˇ baˬ leh, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ g’a k’oˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui g’a baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ chi hk’e g’a te yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hk’a g’a kaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hk’a peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ g’aˇ te ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh yu pehˍ piˇ ve k’o, yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ hk’a gaˬ maˇ g’a teh taˍ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ hk’aw g’a ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn k’o, chaw hta‸ hpeh yu pehˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hk’oˆ lo G’uiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. G’uiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ g’a cha‸ chiˆ k’ai tuˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ g’a tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve nuˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa te. Hpeh yuˬ leh yawˇ geh gʼa sheh hkʼaw‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve yehˬ lo gʼa hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ gʼa‸ ca gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Piˉ laˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, hpa teˇ cheˆ cheˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve mawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ve piˉ laˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nuˇ teˇ hkeh paiˍ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa te chehˇ. Gʼa kʼaw‸ cawˍ tu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa veu‸ deh. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ htawˇ yaˇ miˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa veu‸ deh. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ hkʼoˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˆ hpui teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ngaˆ ma peuˍ mvuhˍ chehˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ yehˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ ma peuˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ.
Awˬ yehˇ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ ma peuˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa hpehˇ peu ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yehˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ te ve kʼo, koˇ caˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˍ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇgʼaˇ ce suh-e ve htawˇ, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw awˬ nu ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ maˇ gʼa ti keu. Oˇ hkʼe ti keu ve kʼo, iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nuˇ leh piˉ laˬ hta‸ teˇ ceh te leh ti mi maˇ gʼa mehˇ.
Yawˬ mvuh leh gʼo‸ hkeh hkaw‸ da‸ leh te chiˇ taˍ ve hpa hta‸ nawˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ gʼa te veu‸.
Nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ lo suhˉ veˆ awˬ han gʼa tawˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw,
maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ heuˆ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ maˇ heˆ law teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo,

yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ chi yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ te tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve hkʼawˇ zuh‸ hpui hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ nanˉ lo awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ awˬ pa lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ ka piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve law.

Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, Yaˇ miˇ chi yaˇ miˇ haˉ maˇ heˆ law, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ chi yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve hkʼawˇ zuh‸ hpui chi hta‸ nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh gʼa jaw‸ hpehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ teˇ ha hteh‸ meuˉ leh, hpu oˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, yawˇ teˇ co-e yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ oˇ ve hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe cawˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ hpawˇ lo te‸ chiˉ shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo,

yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo gʼa shiˍ kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hpawˇ maˇ heuˆ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te jaw leh, ya‸ taw tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te ve kʼo,

yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh haˉ pui gʼa baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, shu ca behˇ la htaˇ maˇ kuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, shu heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve pa taw yoˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve kʼo, hawˉ hkʼaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ lehˬ suh keunˍ ve venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ lehˬ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ca ga la paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ maˇ te sheˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ guiˇ ya‸ ve kʼo,

yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ hkehˉ caˇ hpfuhˇ 50 hteh‸ gʼa keu piˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ guiˇ ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ co-e yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ.
Chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ.
Awˬ tawnˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo, nyiˍ shawˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ.
Haˉ chawˇ yaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ maˇ gʼa shawˍ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 10 co-e hkʼa gaˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ maˇ gʼa shawˍ.
Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 10 co-e hkʼa gaˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ maˇ gʼa shawˍ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ maˇ piˇ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Peˍtawˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkeu tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Baˍlanˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Baˍlanˍ hkeu hkawˇ hta‸ bon na‸ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te piˇ, maˇ gʼa ga piˇ.

Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ taˇ shawˍ baˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ taˇ shawˍ baˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ shehˆ co teˇ co hta‸ tanˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, nawˬ hui fa la hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ to maˇ gʼa cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ-e puiˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la hpawˇ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ iˉ kaˆ gʼa hehˉ leh, mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e peuˬ htaˇ fa la hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui aˉ kʼa‸ kʼai kuiˬ hta‸ fa la awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo gʼa te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ aˉ du taˬ teˇ maˬ gʼa yuˬ toˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ kʼa‸ kʼai gaˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ leh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ yaˆ beh taˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve fa la hta‸ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te.
Shu ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ geh ca hpaw chehˇ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu.
Yawˇ chehˇ gaˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa te piˇ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ miˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh meh maˬ lanˉ maˇ gʼa te caˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe te leh gʼa ve hpu hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa tanˇ piˇ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw meh maˬ lanˉ te caˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ caˇ tuˬ, hpu, maˇ heˆ kʼo, mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ chiˇ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh awˬ yawˬ maˇ gʼa lawˬ yuˬ.

Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ chiˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ yawˬ lawˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ nawˬ awˬ yawˬ maˇ gʼa lawˬ yuˬ. Tawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, ka ti‸ oˇ ve biˇ la tuˬ te-o. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬbiˇ la tuˬ maˇ te ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ka ti‸ maˇ te ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ oˇ ve biˇ la tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ shu ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe shaˉ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉ hkʼaw lo shaˉ pfuhˇ kʼo‸-e ve maˇ gʼa te.
Nawˬ shu ve ti mi hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, caˬ shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ shoˆ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe shoˆ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, law‸ kʼawˉ yuˬ leh maˇ gʼa gʼeu‸ yuˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ baˬ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ piˇ leh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve htawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ baˬ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ piˇ leh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hawˉ hkʼaˆ oˇ ve suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ maˇ hpeh‸. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve maˇ da‸ kehˬ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe ve venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te.
Awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ gehˇ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ kanˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa te tcuh. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ jehˇ leh awˬ miˇ ma geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ chiˇ piˇ ngaˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mawˇ oˇ ve awˬ tan chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve haˉ pui mawˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yuˬ taˍ. Nawˬ yuˬ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo hawˇ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ nawˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Meˇriˆanˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ chiˇ piˇ ngaˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca yuˬ.
Yehˬ baˬ lo gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ teh taˍ.

Teˇ haˉ le le mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la ve kʼo, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ veu‸ zuh‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh gʼaˇ ga caˇ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve maˇ gʼa te.

Mvuhˇ nyi maˇ kʼehˬ sheˍ htaˇ, teˇ nyi awˬ pon yawˇ kanˉ te taˍ ve gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ gʼa shawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hpu loˍ leh gʼaˇ ga caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ maˇ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ pa awˬ e te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Te ya‸ ve chaw hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkehˉ chaw leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve maˇ gʼa te. Mehˇchawˇma hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ ve kʼo, chiˇ piˇ ve hpu oˇ ve awˬ tan yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa yuˬ teh taˍ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te jaw taˉ peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi ve ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui caˬ gʼeu‸ leh caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw hpoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui shaˍlonˍ shiˍ teˇ pawˆ shaˉ peuˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaˉ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ pawˆ shaˉ peuˬ ve kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ shaˉ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkehˉchaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te jaw taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ leh shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai ve hkʼaw, teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ zuh‸ tcuh leh gʼa jaw‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve i ve hta‸ nyi leh, keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe gʼa jaw‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ jaˇ ve awˇ chi hkʼe awˬ hkʼoˆ maˇ gʼa jaw‸. Oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ jaw‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ taˍ nehˬ piˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Caˬ naˆ chehˇ ve nuˇ maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hoˆ taˍ.

Teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ suh kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma awˬ nu ve chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ tcuh. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ viˉ paˍ miˇ ma hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ viˉ paˍ ve yaˇ teh‸ gʼa shawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve kʼo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hpawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ, yawˇ te cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ maˇ te law, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nyi paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kuˬ leh gʼa na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo,

yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai leh, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ teˇ paˉ hta‸ kʼehˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw ciˉgʼuiˇ hpe‸ keu leh, A shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ maˇ te gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ hta‸, Shu hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ baˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ da‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ ca ga piˇ ve hkʼaw, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve nyiˍ hta‸ gʼa htawˇ heuˆ ve kʼo,
yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ taˇ ha kʼaˉ chehˇ. Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼa tawˆ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui mawˇ hawˇ mawˇ pa ve hkʼaw, maˇ biˇ ve ma‸ cawehˬ shiˍ leh, maˇ cawˇ ve tehˆ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yehˇ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, biˇ ve ma‸ cawehˬ shiˍ leh, cawˇ ve tehˆ tuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yehˇ-oˆ.
Heˍ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬhkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ heuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
nawˬ hui awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ti tawˆ la taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo paw hkuˇ lonˉ te chehˇ ve chaw geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ gaˬ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ lehˬ, teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo ca hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve Aˍranˍ chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ htaˇ, chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw nawˉ yawˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ hehnˇ chaweh kanˉ nyiˉ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ca ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ leh Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ leh, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teh taˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ. Leˍviˆ chaw leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hui geh ga ha lehˬ tcuh-o.

Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ chi pun teˇ pun yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ law‸ dawˬ law‸ cawˬ tuˬ, Leˍ viˆ chaw, hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o. Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬve hkʼe, Leˍviˆ chaw, hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma hui hta‸ ngaˬ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ maˇ te ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ caˇ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ hpeh‸chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yehˬ baˬ lo maˇ yuˬ tawˆ-e. Suh peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ maˇ tanˇ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ maˇ te ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ da‸ve kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo nyi ya‸ peu laˇ leh, nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ htawˇ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ hkanˍ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ maˇ kʼo, nawˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ.

Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui geh teˇ geh, chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tanˬ lo‸-e ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa duˇ ti leh,

awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo duˇ ti taˍ-o‸.
Oˇ kaˬ lo tcuhˇ maˇ yuˬ htawˆ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ tcuhˇ yuˬ htawˆ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ maˇ gʼa te. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa hti caˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Leˍviˆ paw hkuˇ hui geh teˇ geh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Siˉmonˍ, Leˍviˆ, Yuˇda‸, Yoˇseh‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ, Geˍraˍzenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, Aˍshaˍ, Zeˍbuˆlonˍ, Danˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkeu ve hkawˇ yaw tuˬ Eˇbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te leh chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Haˉ pui, suhˆ, sho chi hkʼe ve hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼawˇ pui chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ yuˬ jiˆ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma hui hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ te piˇ ve chaw lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te leh yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ hkʼawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ shu geh hpu yuˬ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, awˬ bon chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇ leh nawˬ hui ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh ceˇ caˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ hpawˇ lo tiˉ ca lo‸ bawˆ la ve htawˇ, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve kʼo, Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, ceˇ caˬ leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ bon hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu geh gʼa ca chiˇ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu hta‸ gʼa chiˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ paˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ na yuˬ ve taˇ te. Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve ka‸ taˇ te.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇ leh nawˬ hui ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hkeu leh, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh ceˇ caˬ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, a naˍ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve caˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ goˇ jaˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve pa taw, miˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ sho hkʼa shuˍ heh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui luˬ suh sheˆ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ awˬ tan je‸ meu-e leh shehˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ hpawˇ lo tiˉ ca lo‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve htawˇ, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui geh shaˉ chuˇ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui shaˉ chuˇ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo, pawˆ lawˆ kʼuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh tzuhˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Na-e la tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tanˇ vanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hkʼe gʼa ca htaˇ shoˆ toˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ leh hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ paˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yehˬ te ve htawˇ, yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ a pehˉ meuˇ hko te taˍ ve htawˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ gʼa shaˉ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shu tiˇ caˇ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ shaˍ teˇ peˆ ka‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo sheh veu tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu nawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu yuˬ leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ law nyi chehˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui coˇ caˇ leh ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, shu ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ ka‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve hkui sheh hkʼoˆ lo naˬ jaˇ leh gu maˇ gʼa ve shaˉ chuˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yo‸. Shaˉ chuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ te leh hkui sheh lo hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ ca chehˇ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo, nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ guiˇ gʼuiˬ guiˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ ti taˍ ve htawˇ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa gʼeu‸ jaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, paˉ ce‸ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ hko te leh hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo shaˍlonˍ cehˬhkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ce kʼai ve pa taw, shaˍlonˍ chu gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo shu hpeh kʼai ve pa taw, nawˬ hui geh teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ leh caˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ baˬ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ laˇ tuˬ ve hpu cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hpu cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui luˬ suh sheˆ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa maˇ te.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha peu laˇ chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te leh, awˍ meu‸ ve, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui luˬ peuˬ sheˆ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ ve vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ leh, chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ peuˬ sheˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ pon caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve mvuh jaˇ yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ hoˆ tiˍ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Paw sha jaˇ leh ya‸ kʼaw maˇ juˇ toˇ jaw ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ hta‸ ca hoˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve pa taw paw la gehˇ sheˍ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ, leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Li‸ daw chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ leh, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ yawˆ yan ve kʼo,
Yawˇ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai maˇ gʼa ve naˬ beuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ jaw ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ leh nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw chi ve hkʼaw maˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve a naˍ leh naˬ beuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬyoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma htawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼawˬ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇ leh miˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve, suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ piˇ, leh nyi ma luˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ la tcuh piˇ gaˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ mvuhˇ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ htiˇ la tcuh piˇ gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw keu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ chiˇ hawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˬ gaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te maˍ laˇ ve naˬ beuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ piˇ laˇ sheˍ.
40 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ caw piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh hkuiˉ nuˆ maˇ tzuh‸.

Nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui chehˇ kuiˬ chi teˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh,
yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le da‸ la uiˍ la tuˬ, Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui awˬ pon suhˆ hkaˆ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼo laˇ chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ la tuˬ,
ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te laˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ choˬ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ceh tiˉ ka ti‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ nyi choˬ kaˬ lo Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, maˇ keuˆ la sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ka ti‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ taˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ, haˉ pui, hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ maˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceu, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh chi hkʼe ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, hkʼaˇ jaˇ leh awˬ taw‸ ma cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yeˬ la chehˇ ve awˬ geu hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, a shu yawˇ a loˍ hta‸ te kʼai ve ka‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ hehˉ, teh‸ ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe dawˇ ve kʼo, da‸ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, haiˬ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ to‸ baˬ leh, yawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, li‸ daw chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, li‸ daw chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkeu ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ma‸ shiˉ leh aˉ leh‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ ti caˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh te luˬ piˇ ve Sawˉdonˍ, Gawˇmawˇra‸, Aˍdaˍmaˍ leh Zeˍbonˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te piˇ ve le. Yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha chi taw taw nyi ma zuhˆ ve le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ te luˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui tcuh ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, li‸ daw chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼawˬ tawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon, maˇ heˆ kʼo hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo,
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh,

nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui chehˇ taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ puiˉ la tuˬ, leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkeu ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ leh fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh ceˇ caˬ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, nawˬ hui ve ti mi htawˇ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Yawˇ paw sha la piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ paw sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ li‸ daw chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui Yawˇ geh gʼa kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh gʼa‸ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, a shu mvuhˇ naw ma lo taˆ-e leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon ca yuˬ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh gʼa‸ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, a shu laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh ca yuˬ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ leh tawnˇ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, haiˬve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ laˇ. A sha‸ te‸ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo suh ve hta‸ nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ laˇ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh, Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ te kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui da‸ la uiˍ la leh chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve kʼo,

nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ka‸ ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo, suh ve hta‸ nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ laˇ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ teˇ ha nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬve pa taw, nawˬ hui htaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai tuˬ te maˇ gʼa-o. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai leh, nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh Awˇgaˆ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬve maˇ heˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Kawˆ ve nyi ma ka‸ taˇ cawˬ piˇ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ keu leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ biˇ leh shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ leh, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw chi ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh gʼa te gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ hpawnˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, yaˇ ehˉ leh nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw sheˍ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Moˉseˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo, moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw nawˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yeˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh maˇ chehˇ-o ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼa maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ caˇ gaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ kʼa leh shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ kʼai piˇ sheˍ ka‸, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Moˉseˍ lehˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bvuh‸ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼa maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ce taˉ tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ leh li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ bvuh‸ keu peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw chi hta‸ yuˬ leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo ca teh taˍ-oˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ma nyi ma heh leh, hkʼaˬ ma kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Chi hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸nawˉ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ la leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hui kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hpoˆ na chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi ve yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼa maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe ya‸ la chehˇ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo a ngeu diˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ, suhˆ buiˇ ehˉ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ce la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, da‸ kehˬ hteˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, da‸ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
