Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ka‸ maˇ keunˍ. Venˇbaˆ uiˍ leh nyi ma kʼaw‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe gʼa te piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa leh nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi-o. Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ na nyi-o.

Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ cawˇ ve Yawˇ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, goˇ choˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ ceˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ hta‸ hkʼa hkʼe te poˬ tuˬ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ chehˇ tcuh ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ gʼa paiˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ cuˇ. Yawˇ awˬ to shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw mvuh ve teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ti mi hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haˉ pui de lo cawˬ ve htawˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve nuˇ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, cuˉ gʼuiˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh da‸ jaˇ ve yawˬ, aˉ che‸, nuˇ, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ paw sha la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh chu jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ maˇ kaˇ jaw ve maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ ve co ha piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸la ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ leh Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, nyi ma heh leh ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ piˇ lawˬ leh hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼe to‸ tawˆ la leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ htai‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ ya‸-e leh, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ geu hta‸ htawˇ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ peuˬ maˇ leh puiˉ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve hkaˆ ce hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ tcuhˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ leh naˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw htawˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˆ piˇ tuˬ ve vuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh peu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ma‸ hta‸ pa taw venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw suh-e leh, kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ yehˬ kʼa teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw haˉ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ leh chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ to yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ hkanˍ gaˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a ciˉ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ kʼai ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ. Hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ shiˍ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hta‸ pa taw chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ suh-e leh, chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ gʼa suh-e ve le. Yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ peuˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe taw kanˇ paˆ maˇ cawˬ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ haiˬ jaˇ ve yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˇ jaˇ leh awˬ taw‸ ma cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh,
vuiˬ haiˬ awˬ taw‸ ma yuˬ te taˍve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, cawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paiˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ chu yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ga la tcuh-o. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ la tcuh-o.

Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ leh a sha‸ te‸ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, naˬ piˇ tuˬ leh gu na-e piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te gʼa ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˍ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ, ngaˬ la‸ sheh chiˇ leh hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ sheˆ leh, ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo hkaˆ ce heuˆ ve chaw leh, shu hpeh gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hta‸Yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸Yawˇ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui kaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Moˉseˍ leh Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ kʼa maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve a sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui maw maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍbaˍrenˍ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o. Neˍ bawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca nyi-o.
Nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍronˍ lehˬ Hawˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo suh-e ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ Neˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ziˇnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa mawˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw Moˉseˍ maˇ suh sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˉ ve bon na‸ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ tawˆ la leh, Paˍranˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ Yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, Yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ha cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬYawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ leh, Yawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui Yawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Moˉseˍ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ geh hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Moˉseˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ i jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa mehˉ kʼai piˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ cuˇ leh Uˇrenˍ leh Tuˇmenˍ hta‸ yehˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬve a loˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Maˍsaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh, Meˍriˇbaˆ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ paˇ lo yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ pa awˬ e, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ ga piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ tu gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Beˍyanˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ moˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ leh ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ kʼaw ji lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ pa taw meh la ve iˉ shiˍleh, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ naw‸ la ve iˉ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo da‸ jaˇ ve iˉ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ bon chi teˇ hpaˍ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ te hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ heh nuˇ awˬ hkaw hkʼe hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ leh miˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ guˆ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍbuˆlonˍ leh Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Zeˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw shu hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ leh paw sha la piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍhkaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ aw hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ la piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo kuˬ yuˬleh, da‸ ve cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw leh, shehˇ shiˍ hkʼaw gʼa ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la kʼehˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gaˆ lehˬ la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ tuˬ jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Danˍ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ paˍ haˉ hpeh‸ leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Naˍtaˍliˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼo ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ bon na‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, sho yuˬ te taˍ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ cawˬ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ moˬ hta‸ ciˇ leh laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ciˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la leh, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui hkʼe ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve htanˬ tuˬ leh nawˬ hui ve aˉhtaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Neˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ maw piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ Danˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ,
Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ ve Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ,
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn, Zawˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh, shaˍlonˍ cehˬ cawˬ ve venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ maw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maw laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo‸-e tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ Behˆpeˍawˇ venˇ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Moˉseˍ suh-e htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ teˇ ha nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ leh, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ da‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh shehˆ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Moˉseˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ tan kanˉ te tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, Moˉseˍ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ jaw sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ tcuh leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ, leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ca te maˍ piˇ ve anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ te jaw.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve meh gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, Moˉseˍ te maˍ piˇ ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ te maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ suh peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ chi beu‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e loˬ.
Ngaˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui kʼai chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Moˉseˍ geh chehˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ geh htawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ daw hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼaw tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le henˇ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui uiˍ la maˇ la leh nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸. Taˇ kawˆ. Nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shehˆ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ leh ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa teh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ma‸ gʼa ga bawˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la leh oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh, nawˬ kʼai tcuh laˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo ngaˬ hui kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Moˉseˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ geh chehˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ geh htawˇ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve chaw leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tuˬ chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Aˍhkeˇshaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, Raˍhaˆ meh ve meh maˬ lanˉ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi la tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Raˍhaˆ geh chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi la tuˬ gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la-o, teh‸ Raˍhaˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ.

Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e leh lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˉ hoˆ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ na nyi nawˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui haˆ haˆ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ me tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ taˆ-e leh, chi gʼawˇ yuˬ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Jawˇmawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˉ htawˇ hoˆsheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬYawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ maˇ zuh‸ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Raˍhaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh taˆ-e leh kʼoˆ ve,
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te fiˍ kʼai piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh Awˇgaˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh a ciˉ hkanˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e, ngaˬ viˉ ngaˬ nyi leh yawˇ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ aˬ hto‸ ma ca te la ve awˬ lawn nawˬ shu hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Raˍhaˆ ve yehˬ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ te tcuhˉ naw‸ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw hpehˇ ce piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaw taˆ-e loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, jawˇmawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ gaˬ la peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo shehˆ nyi ca va‸ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Nawˬ te tcuh laˇ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh chi ve hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ chi hta‸ hpeh taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ pa nawˬ e, nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi leh yawˇ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ keu taˍ-o‸.

Teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh gʼa suh puiˉ ve kʼo, chi lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ geh teˇ geh yehˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma ca te la ve awˬ lawn nawˬ shu hta‸ hto piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nawˬ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve htawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hta‸ nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh oˇ ve yuˬ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ jawˇmawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ca maˇ mawˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ geh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhkeˇshaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ na‸ tu leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ haˉ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui haˉ chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve,
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve mawˇ gu leh yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gaˬ jaw sheˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw shiˍ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo taˇ kʼai. Ta kʼoˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ Awˇ hpaˍlonˍ hkʼe vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ anˇ tuˬ te maˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ leh chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tuˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ te tuˬ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ Moˉseˍ geh chehˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ geh htawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ kʼai chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw huˉ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Giˇgaˍshiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇshiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉcaˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ kʼai chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw naˆ keu ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ jehˇ sheˬ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ teunˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ leh iˉ kaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ leh yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw naˆ keu ve teˇ yanˇ,

iˉ kaˆ ya‸ la chehˇ ve jehˇ sheˬ leh, Zeˍraˍtanˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍdanˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ iˉ kaˆ teunˇ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ya‸-e chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ fiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo tawˆ-e gaˬ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh,

Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ awˬ kʼaw ji, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ huˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh leh, ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ hui ca haˉ tuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo teh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh,
Nawˬ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ ca gʼawˆ taˆ veu laˇ-oˆ.

Haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˉ pui chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo,

Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ Yawˇ danˍ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ ya‸ la chehˇ ve jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw 12 ceuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve haˉ pui 12 shiˍ gʼawˆ taˆ veu laˇ leh, yawˇ hui deh kuiˬ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ leh huˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ 12 shiˍ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ hpoˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. (Haˉ pui hpoˆ oˇ ve ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ te tcuh ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo ceh tiˉ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, Moˉseˍ tawˇ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haˆ haˆ hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkanˍ tawˆ-e peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ
Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkoˇ ve lehˬ, shu awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve chaw awˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ paˇ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha te ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼe, Yawˇsuˆ a sha‸ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yawˇ suˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˆ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa 12 nyi htaˇ hkanˍ tawˆ-e leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Giˇlaˍgaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw gʼawˆ veu laˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ chi nyiˇ shiˍ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ oˇ kaˬ lo duˇ ti leh kʼoˆ ve,
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpa, Haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ kʼai ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ tawˆ la piˇ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui hkanˍ tawˆ-e peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ goˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi ve hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ paˇ lo chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Yawˇdanˍ Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hkʼaw pui teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la htaˇ, a sha‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la peuˬ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh peuˬ sheˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo paw la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ gʼa shoˍ sheˍ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo 40 hkʼaw‸ gʼa caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ mawˬ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo caw toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ gʼa shoˍ sheˍ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw awˬ suhˉ chi ve teˇ moˍ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui na-e la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ gʼa te ve ya‸ taw tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ vuiˬ chi hta‸ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Giˇlaˍgaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ hkʼe meh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Giˇlaˍgaˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ha pa oˇ ve 14 nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh, paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh hu taˍ ve sha ma hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˍnaˆshiˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ ce la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˍnaˆshiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo aˉhtaw pfuhˇ leh huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw huˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lo‸ la maˇ gaˬ tuˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ yeˬ chaweh hoˆ taˍ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ te maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ nyi teˇ pawˆ, hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa caw ve yoˬ.

Behˬheh ma yuˬ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ suhˍ caw gʼa caw leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve behˬheh ma hta‸ gʼa meuˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ tiˉ te leh zuhˬ chaweh gʼa meuˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh gʼa kuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ ce sheˬ leh, nawˬ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui ka ti‸ shaˉcaˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ lehˬ, behˬheh ma yuˬ leh oˇ ve awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ caw tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ taˍ kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ tawˇ piˇ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ta kʼoˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, behˬheh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ tawˇ maˇ piˇ ve ceh ceh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ leh venˇ hta‸ teˇ caw caw tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Yawˇsuˆ tu la leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ taˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Behˬ heh ma yuˬ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ behˬheh ma meuˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, behˬheh ma meuˆ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyiˇ nyi teˇ nyi htawˇ venˇ hta‸ teˇ caw ca kʼaw‸ caw taˉ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ na‸ tu leh ponˬ laˬ htaˇ te jaw ve hkʼe te leh venˇ hta‸ suhˍ caw caw ve yoˬ. Venˇ hta‸ suhˍ caw caw ve lehˬ chi ve teˇ nyi ceh tiˉ yoˬ.

Suhˍ caw teˇ caw gaˬ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ behˬ heh ma maˇ meuˆ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ tcuh leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ chi nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Meh maˍ lanˉ Raˍhaˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ mawˇ maˇ gʼa yuˬ. Nawˬ hui yuˬ ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ leh sho yuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon teˇ kaˬ lo gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ ce sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, chaw mawˇ, yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ, piˉlaˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ meh maˬ lanˉ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼai leh Raˍhaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa aw e, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ, leh sho yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha aw pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, meh maˬlanˉ Raˍhaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tuˬ Yawˇsuˆ kʼai peu taˍ ve chaw jaˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. (Hkʼe te leh yawˇve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ shaˍti‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ gu te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ leh mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇsuˆ geh chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo yawˇ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ tcuh ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ yuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Aˍhkanˍ lehˬ, mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw ceuˬ, Zeˍraˆ, Zaˍbaˍdiˆ leh Kaˍmiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Beˍtaˍvenˍ venˇ awˬ na paˉ lo cawˬ ve Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Yawˇsuˆ geh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼai tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Chaw nyiˇ, shehˆ hinˉ hkʼe ceh tiˉ kʼai ka‸ law‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ venˇ ehˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw shehˆ hinˉ gʼaˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve chaw 36 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ haˉ kʼoˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw nyi ma luˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo boˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jaw mawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ choˬ hpawˇ lo hkanˍ tawˆ la tcuh laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon laˇ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo ceh tiˉ maˇ chehˇ tcuh taˉ laˇ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ le.

Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tu la-o. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe boˆ chehˇ ve le.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ hui te taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, heˍ ve hkʼaw mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ geh teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui canˇ paˍ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ hkanˍ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ taˇ yuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ te luˬ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Tu la-o. Yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ leh yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ tcuh ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui mawˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ yuˬ baˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui tawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ moˍ awˬ moˍ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ tawˆ ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh, shu gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ leuˆ tawˆ tuˬ sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh shu gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ leuˆ tawˆ tuˬ sheˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ leh yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ geh teˇ geh aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ya‸ taw tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu la leh, a shu yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ moˍ awˬ moˍ te shiˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Zeˍraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shu gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shiˍ tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zaˍbaˍdiˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Zaˍbaˍdiˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hta‸ shu gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh, Aˍhkanˍ hta‸ leuˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ve chaw ceuˬ Kaˍmiˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Aˍbaˍdiˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ Aˍhkanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ faˉ taˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, hpu teˇ cawehˬ hpaˆ leh nyiˇ hkanˉ hkʼe cawˬ ve shi taˬ teˇ maˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve aˉ po‸ lonˉ teˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw duˇ faˉ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ca hpfuhˆ nyi tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma ve geh yuˬ veu laˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhkanˍ leh yawˇ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Dawˇ haˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸, lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhkanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍhkanˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ haˉ pui teˇ hpoˆ lonˉ gʼawˆ hpoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui hpoˆ oˇ ve ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼaˬ gaˬ, Dawˇ haˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸, teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Aˍiˆ venˇ lo kʼai-o. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Aˍiˆ venˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ mawˇ jeˬ leh ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui venˇ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo ca va‸ taˍ leh venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ lo hteˇ lehˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ hkʼe ngaˬ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui venˇ hta‸ vuiˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la leh venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa peuˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ-o‸. Chi ve lehˬ nawˬ hui na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍiˆ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Aˍiˆ venˇ leh Beˍteˍlaˆvenˇ awˬ kaˍ lo ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo haˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Yawˇsuˆ tu la leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Aˍiˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍiˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui deh chehˇ kuiˬ leh, Aˍiˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ ma hkanˍtaˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ ngaˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, venˇ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ, Aˍiˆ venˇ leh Beˍtaˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo ca va‸ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo teh taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ lehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw haˉ ve yoˬ.

Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ suhˆ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ hkʼa shuˍ la‸ haˉ gʼa‸ bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Shu nyiˇ hpawˇ lo va‸ taˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hoˆ bawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Yawˇ suˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kawˆ ve hkʼe te leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇshiˍ veu leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yawˇsuˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, venˇ hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ vuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍiˆ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shaw taˉ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼe leˇ hpaw baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍiˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo nawˬ ve gehˇ hta‸ che peu-o. Venˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe Yawˇsuˆ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ chiˇ ve teˇ yanˇ va‸ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ pawˆ tu la leh venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍiˆ venˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ nyi leh, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ naˆ dawˇ lonˉ mvuh naw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ bawˆ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼa taˍ peuˬ leh, venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh Aˍiˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw lo gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ya‸ la leh, Aˍiˆ venˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga bawˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍiˆ venˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ hpawˇ le le caw hoˆ taˍ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh Yawˇsuˆ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Aˍiˆ venˇ hkʼaw tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 12,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Aˍiˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ che peu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ leh ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, a shu yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ venˇ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ suhˆ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh yu pehˍ piˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ hkʼe te baˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇsuˆ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo baˬ keu piˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui shiˍ gʼawˆhpoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ haˉ pui hpoˆ chi cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Eˇbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, tcuhˇ maˇ yuˬ htawˆ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Moˉseˍ bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ htawˆ bvuh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˉ jehˬ paˍ teˉ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Geˍraˍsenˍ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ Eˇbaˍlaˆ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkeu ve hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw chi ma ve hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le ve hta‸, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, yaˇ ehˉ leh yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ leh, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆchaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ leh Aˍiˆ venˇ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Giˇbonˍ chaw hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ te piˇ tuˬ jehˬ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca leh, htuˉ pui awˬ piˍ hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve piˉlaˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkuiˉ nuˆ awˬ piˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ leh, tzuh‸ keu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, goˇ kʼai bvuh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo deh chehˇ ve Yawˇsuˆ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh shaˉ caˆ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui a shu le. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,

Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Heˍsaˍbonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hui hta‸ Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, caˇ tuˬ gu leh nawˬ hui geh kʼai peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve hkaoˍmonˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui tawˆ la gehˇ htaˇ hkaoˍmonˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ suhˉ deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nyi sheˍ. Chi beu‸ goˇ kʼai bvuh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu kuiˬ shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui tawˆ la gehˇ htaˇ awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ tzuh‸ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ya‸ kʼaw toˇ laˬ ve vuiˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh hkuiˉ nuˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ tzuh‸ kʼai peu, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ na nyi.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shaˉ caˆ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ shehˆ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh shehˆ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ Giˇbonˍ, Hkeˍhpiˇraˆ, Beˍroˆ, leh Kiˇyaˍraˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te da‸ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ sha ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon suhˆ hkaˆ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hkʼo laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Giˉbonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo ceh chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hui suhˆ gʼa ca laˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa hkʼo laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te ve lehˬ nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa suh la ve hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te laˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ suhˆ hkaˆ tcuh leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼo tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ leh Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, Aˍiˆ venˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Aˍdoˇniˆseˍdehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ, Giˇbonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Giˇbonˍ venˇ lehˬ Aˍiˆ venˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw uiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cheuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Aˍdoˇniˆseˍdehˆ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Hawˇhanˍ, Yaˍmoˆ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ Piˇranˍ, Laˍhkiˇsaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍhpi-aˍ, Eˇgaˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ Deˍbiˇraˆ hui geh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˇbonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-a veuˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ jawˇmawˇ, Heˍbronˍ jawˇmawˇ, Yaˍmoˆ jawˇmawˇ Laˍhkiˇsaˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Eˇgaˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ, Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ chi ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ shawˍ veu laˇ leh, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˇbonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Yawˇsuˆ geh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ chiˇ baˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh Giˇlaˍgaˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo tu leh teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ la‸ haˉ lo‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Beˍtawˇronˍ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍzeˍkaˍ venˇ leh Meˍkeˍdaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ Beˍtawˇronˍ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh Aˍzeˍkaˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo uiˍ jaˇ ve vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ce la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˍ pehˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tiˇ pehˍ ve a‸ kehˉ vaˇ shiˍ ce teˍ leh suh-e ve chaw maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ nyi-oˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ha pa-oˬ, Aˍjaˍlonˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ canˇ paˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ nyi leh ha pa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ ve li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo jehˇ sheˬ leh, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ mvuhˇ nyi maˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chaw yaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ piˇ ve chi hkʼe ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi ka‸ maˇ cawˬ jaw sheˍ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Giˇlaˍ gaˍ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh Maˍkeˍdaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo va‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn shu Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Haˉ kʼoˍ awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ hpfuhˆ tsuhˇ leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˍ-o‸.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui oˇ kaˬ lo taˇ chehˇ taˍ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ lo taˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ tcuh piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇsuˆ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Maˍkeˍdaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉca kʼoˆ maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Haˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hpaw leh jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh shiˍ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui haˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hpaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ jawˇmawˇ, Heˍbronˍ jawˇmawˇ, Yaˍmoˆ jawˇmawˇ, Laˍhkiˇsaˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Eˇgaˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ geh shiˍ gaˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ naˆ tinˍ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ suhˆ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh yu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇsuˆ tawˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hui lehˬ suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ ya‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpfuhˆ tsuhˇ taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ taˍ she‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Maˍkeˍdaˍ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍriˆhkoˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Maˍkeˍdaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍkeˍdaˍ venˇ lo tu leh Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍriˆhkoˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Liˆbaˍnaˍ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui caw hoˆ taˍ leh bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ ve nyiˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Geˍzaˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Hawˇranˍ lehˬ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ lo tu leh Eˇgaˍlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui caw hoˆ taˍ leh bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Eˇgaˍlonˍ venˇ lo tu leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Heˍbronˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh, venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui tiˇpehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇgaˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Deˍbiˇraˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Heˍbronˍ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ leh, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Deˍbiˇraˆ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te leh, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn lo chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te tuˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Gawˍshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te leh Giˇbonˍ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo hkʼa gaˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Giˇlaˍ gaˍ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ Haˍzawˇ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Maˍdonˍ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaˆ, Shiˉmaˍronˍ jawˇmawˇ leh Aˍhkaˍshaˆ jawˇmawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Cheˍneˍrawˆ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Dawˇraˆ venˇ paˇ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh lo maˇ kʼoˆ,

Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw leh Miˆsaˍpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo chehˇ ve Hiˇviˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shawˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo caw ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ geh pawnˇ da‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ, Meˍronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆchaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui kuˇ caˆ hta‸ gʼa tawˆ cheˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Meˍronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Siˉdonˍ venˇ leh Miˆsaˍraˆ hpawˇtaˍmenˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Miˆsaˍpaˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui gʼa‸ yuˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui kuˇ caˆ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh Haˍzawˇ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Haˍzawˇ venˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpa a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.)
Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Venˇ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍzawˇ venˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ aˬ miˍ maˇ tuˉ baˬ piˇ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ jeˬ leh, ceˇ caˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ a shu yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ te tcuh ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍlehˆ hkʼaw hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˍgaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ,
Gawˇshenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇsuˆ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hiˇviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ maˇ ca caˇ la. Awˬ nu ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ bawˆ da‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ, Deˍbiˇraˆ, Aˍnaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ Aˍcoˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˬ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te pehˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ma‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ bawˆ leh jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ te leh Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
