Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˇ venˇ hta‸ te leh Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo cawˬ ve Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ teˇ hkoˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇnyi tawˆ hpawˇ Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Behˆyeˍsiˇmoˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍhpenˍ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ leh meuˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Enˍdiˍ leh Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw, Taˍlaˍkaˆ hkʼaw, Geˍsuˇriˆ leh Maˍhkaˍriˆchaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Heˍsaˍbon jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˍgaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Eˇdonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍlehˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ shehˇ de lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ jawˇmawˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍiˆ ve jawˇmawˇ,
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ jawˇmawˇ, Heˍbronˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Yaˍmoˆ jawˇmawˇ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ jawˇmawˇ,
Eˇgaˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ, Geˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Deˍbiˇraˆ jawˇmawˇ, Geˍdaˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Hawˇmaˍ jawˇmawˇ, Aˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ,
Liˆbaˍnaˍ jawˇmawˇ, Aˍduˆlanˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Maˍkaˍdaˍ jawˇmawˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ,
Taˍpawˍ jawˇmawˇ, Heˍhpaˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Aˍhpehˆ jawˇmawˇ, Laˍshaˍronˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Maˍdonˍ jawˇmawˇ, Haˍzawˇ jawˇmawˇ,
Shiˉmaˍronˍ jawˇmawˇ, Aˍhkaˍshaˆ jawˇmawˇ,
Aˍnehˆ jawˇmawˇ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ jawˇmawˇ,
Keˍdeˍshaˆ jawˇmawˇ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Yawˇkaˍnanˍ jawˇmawˇ,
gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo chehˇ ve Dawˇraˆ jawˇmawˇ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Gawˇenˍ jawˇmawˇ,
leh Riˇraˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ 31 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ chi beu‸ mawˇ la peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ gʼa bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ sheˍ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

(Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ Shiˉloˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lo hka gʼaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gaˍsaˍ, Aˍcoˆ, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ, Gaˍtaˆ, Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Aˍvinˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Siˉdonˍ chaw hui uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Maˍraˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te leh, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ Aˍ hpehˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ,

mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˍgaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Haˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍbaˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ te leh Miˆsaˍraˆhpawˇtaˍmenˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Siˉdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve gʼa pehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kʼawˇ ceuˬ leh, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve pehˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ danˍ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh, Diˇbonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Maˍdeˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ uˉ peunˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ chaw leh Maˍhkaˍtiˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Taˍlaˍkaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ,

Yeˍhpenˍ chaw ceuˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˉ ve chaw, Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ venˇ leh Eˍdiˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve Awˇgaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ chaw leh Maˍhkaˍtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Meˍdeˍbaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍbonˍ, Diˇbonˍ, Baˍmoˆbaˍlaˆ, Behˇbaˍlaˆmonˍ,
Yaˍhaˆ, Keˍdaˍmoˆ, Maˍhpaˆ,
Kiˇriˇyaˆtenˍ, Siˆbaˍmaˍ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Zaˍyehˆsaˍhaˍ,
Behˆpeˍguˇraˆ, Piˉsaˍgaˍ hkʼaw tcuhˉ lonˉ, Behˆyeˍsiˇmoˆ venˇ,

hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ chi hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Meˇdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Eˇviˆ, Yeˍkanˍ, Zuˇraˆ, Huˇraˆ, Yaˍbaˆ hui hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Siˉhonˍ awˬ hawˉ ve jawˇmawˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ, mawˉ paˍ te chehˇ ve Baˍlanˍ hta‸ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Ruˇbenˍ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ leh Giˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Raˍbaˆ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ,
Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Raˍmaˍmiˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ leh Beˍtawˇninˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Lawˍdeˍbaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ,

Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Beˍtaˍranˍ venˇ, Beˍniˆmaˍraˆ venˇ, Suˇkoˆ leh Zaˍhponˍ venˇ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hpeh‸ leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ maˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh, jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yeˍraˆ uˉ peunˍ ve venˇ 60 venˇ,

Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ venˇ leh Eˍdiˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ ve yaˇ Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo Moˉseˍ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ leh Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ pehˬ piˇ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ shinˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ Eˇliˇzaˬ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kʼawˇ ceuˬ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ kuˇ da‸ tcuh leh, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ piˇ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ teh‸ nyiˇ moˍ pehˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ chehˇ kuiˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬawˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Yawˇsuˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Keˍnehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ, Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ ngaˬ hta‸ Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ geh kʼai taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Moˉseˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gaˬ taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chi beu‸ awˇ chi ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ a sha‸ 85 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬlaˬ htaˇ hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ leh ngaˬ te cawˇ ve kanˉ te tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ nyi ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve venˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ ngaˬ geh chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Kaˍlehˆ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, Heˍbronˍ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw, Heˍbronˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ Kaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ htaˇ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hta‸ Kiˇriˇyaˆtaˍbaˆ venˇ teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ. (Aˍbaˆ lehˬ, Aˍnaˍkaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.) Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chi beu‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lehˬ, Ziˇnaˆ hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh, Eˇdonˍ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hawˉ paˉ teˇ tawn hta‸ te leh,

Aˍkaˍraˍbenˍ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ziˇnaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Kaˍdeˍshaˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ, Heˍzaˍronˍ venˇ, Aˍdaˍ venˇ leh Kaˍkaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍzaˍmonˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh te leh, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh awˬ na hpawˇ Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ceh la kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn ve miˬ tcuhˉ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo te leh,
Beˍtawˇgaˍlaˆ venˇ, Beˍtaˍraˍbaˆ venˇ leh Ruˇbenˍ yaˇ Bawˇhanˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhkawˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te leh Deˍbiˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ caw kʼai leh Aˍduˇminˍ kʼaˍ le‸ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ lo cawˬ ve Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ caw kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Enˍseˍmehˆ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai leh, Eˍyawˇgeˬlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Heˍnonˍ yaˇ paˍ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Heˍnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ caw kʼai leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Yaˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Neˍhpaˍtawˆ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ leh Eˇhpaˍronˍ hkʼaw paˇ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Baˍlanˍ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh,
Siˇraˆ hkʼaw Hkeˍtaˍlonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yaˍrenˍ hkʼaw, Beˍseˍmaˆ venˇ, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ hkʼaw tcuhˉ lonˉ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, Shiˉkaˍronˍ venˇ, Baˍlanˍ hkʼaw, Yaˍbaˍneˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ tawn ehˉ Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Kaˍlehˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, Aˍnaˆ awˬ pa Aˍbaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Aˍnaˆ ve yaˆ paˍ Yeˍsehˇ, Aˍhiˆmanˍ, leh Taˍlaˍmehˇ chaw chi ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kiˇriˇyaˆseˍhpaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Deˍbiˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Kiˇriˆyaˆseˍhpaˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ Aˍhkaˍtaˆ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Kaˍlehˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ, Keˍnaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ leh gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh ti mi teˇ peˆ ca lawˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa Kaˍlehˆ geh piˉ laˬ ciˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Kaˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ na hpaw ve iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn, Eˇdonˍ miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kaˆzeˍlaˆ, Eˇdaˍ, Yaˍguˇraˆ,
Kiˇnaˆ, Diˆmawˇnaˆ, Aˍdaˍdaˍ,
Keˍdeˍshaˆ, Haˍzawˇ, Iˉtaˍnanˍ,
Ziˇhpaˆ, Teˍlanˍ, Baˍlaˆ,
Haˍzawˇhaˍdaˍtanˍ, Haˍzawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇawˆtaˍronˍ
Aˍmanˍ, Sheˍmaˆ, Mawˇlaˍdaˆ,
Haˍsaˍgaˍdaˆ, Heˍsaˍmonˍ, Behˆpaˍlehˆ,
Haˍzaˍsuˍlaˆ, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ, Beˍzawˇtiˍ,
Baˍlanˍ,Iˇenˍ, Aˍzenˍ,
Eˇlaˆtawˇlaˆ, Hkeˍtiˇlaˆ, Hawˇmaˍ,
Ziˇkaˍlaˆ, Maˍdaˍmaˍnaˆ, Saˍsaˍnaˍ,
Leˍbawˆ, Shiˇlaˍhenˍ, Enˍ, Riˇmonˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ nyiˇ chi kʼawˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇshaˍkawˇlaˆ, Zawˇraˆ, Aˍshaˍnaˍ,
Zaˍnawˇ, Enˍgaˍnenˍ, Taˍpawˍ, Eˍnanˍ,
Yaˍmoˆ, Aˍduˆlanˍ, Sawˇhkawˇ, Aˍzeˍkaˍ,
Shaˍrenˍ, Aˍdiˆtenˍ, Gaˍdeˍraˆ, Geˍdeˍroˍtenˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi awˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, Zeˍnanˍ, Haˍdaˍshaˆ, Miˆgaˆdaˍlaˍgaˆ,
Diˆlanˍ, Miˆsaˍpaˍ, Yawˇdaˍteˍlaˆ,
Laˍhkiˇshaˆ, Bawˇzaˍkaˆ, Eˇkaˍlonˍ,
Kaˍbonˍ, Laˍmaˍ, Kiˇtaˍleˆ,
Gaˍdeˍroˆ, Behˆdaˍgonˍ, Meˍmaˍ, Maˍkeˍdaˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi hkaw‸ venˇ hpeh‸ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Liˆbaˍnaˍ, Eˇtaˍ, Aˍshaˍ,
Yiˇhpaˍtaˆ, Aˍshaˍnaˍ, Neˍziˆ,
Kiˇlaˆ, Aˍhkaˍziˆ, Maˍreˍshaˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼawˇ venˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Aˍshoˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Aˍshoˆ venˇ, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ leh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shaˍmiˇraˆ, Yaˍtiˇraˆ, Sawˇhkawˇ,
Daˍnaˍ, Deˍbiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆsaˍnaˍ,
Aˍnaˆ, Eˇshaˍtaˍmawˇ, Aˍnenˍ,
Gawˇshenˍ, Hawˇlonˍ, Giˇlawˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi teˇ venˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍraˆ, Duˇmaˍ, Eˇshanˍ,
Yaˍnunˍ, Behˆtaˍpawˍ, Aˍhpehˆ,
Huˇtaˍ, Heˍbronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆtaˍbaˆ, Ziˆawˇyaˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼawˇ venˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇnaˆ, Kaˍraˍmeˍlaˆ, Ziˇhpaˆ, Yuˇtaˆ,
Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Yawˇkaˍdanˍ, Zaˍnawˇ,
Kaˍiˇnaˆ, Giˇbaˍ, Tiˇmaˍnaˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi venˇ cawˬ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍlaˍhuˇlaˆ, Behˆzuˇraˆ, Geˍdawˇ,
Maˍraˆ, Beˍtaˍnoˆ, Eˇlaˆteˍkonˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hkaw‸ venˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆbaˍlaˆ venˇ, Raˍbaˆ venˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ nyiˇ venˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, Beˍraˍraˍbaˆ, Miˆdinˍ, Saˍkaˍkaˍ,
Niˆbaˍshanˍ, Aˉlehˆ, Enˍgaˍdiˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hkaw‸ venˇ cawˬ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Hkʼe te leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo te leh Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Aˍhkiˆ chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ Aˍtaˍroˆ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Luˇzaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh Yaˍhpaˍlehˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo hpanˍ kʼai leh, Beˍ tawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ tawn lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Aˍtaˍroˆtaˍdaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˆmeˍtaˆ venˇ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh Taˍnaˆshiˉloˍ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍnawˇhaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍtaˍroˆ venˇ, Naˍraˍ venˇ leh Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Taˍpawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Kaˍnaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh taˆ-e leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍ renˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ, Geˍsaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ leh shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ, Giˇlaˆ awˬ pa Maˍhkiˇraˆ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ ve awˬ nu ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve Aˍbeˍ saˍ, Heˍlehˆ, Aˍsaˍreˍlaˆ, Sheˍhkenˍ, Heˍhpaˍ leh Sheˍmiˆdaˆ hui hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ hawehˍ Maˍnaˍseˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Maˍnaˍseˍ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ, Giˇlaˆ, Heˍhpaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zeˍlawˇhpaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍlaˍ, Noˇaˍ, Hawˇlaˍ, Miˆlaˍhkaˍ, Tiˇraˍzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo yawˇ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve Giˇlaˆ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Maˍnaˍseˍ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ gʼa taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui gʼa ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Aˍshaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Meˆmeˍtaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Enˍtaˍhpawˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Taˍpawˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Taˍpawˍ venˇ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Kaˍnaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼaw‸ ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ paˉ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve htawˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍchaw hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve miˬtcuhˉ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ te taˆ-e leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, Maˍnaˍseˍ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ Aˍshaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍhkaˍ leh Aˍshaˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Behˆshanˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Dawˇraˆ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Enˍdawˇraˆ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Taˍnehˆ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇsuˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ leh ngaˬ hui chaw maˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ ceh tiˉ pe‸ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui chaw maˇ jaˇ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ceh tiˉ chehˇ maˇ daw ve kʼo, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Yeˍhpenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon a ciˉ i jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Behˆshanˍ venˇ leh Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, sho te taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui hta‸kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw maˇ jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, hkʼa deh‸ htu baˬ hpawˇ baˬ leh ca chehˇ-oˆ. Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, sho iˉ mvuhˇ law hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw hpawnˬ laˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ gʼa sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw suhˍ ceuˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˬ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ ca bawˆ yuˬ leh hkʼaˬ maw maw te chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ ceuˬ ve shehˆ ha gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ca nyi piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh gʼa kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ suhˍ taw gʼa pehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo gʼa chehˇ leh, Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ suhˍ taw hkʼaˬ hkʼe te pehˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ ca nyi taˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Gaˆ, Ruˇbenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai leh hkʼa deh‸ ca toˇ nyi-o. Peuˬ kʼo, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la-o. Oˇ htaˇ, choˬ kaˬ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai leh mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca toˇ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ suhˍ taw pehˬ leh, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ htawˇ bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yawˇsuˆ geh Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇsuˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ leh Yoˇseh‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Beˍtaˍvenˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Luˇzaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Aˍtaˍroˆtaˍdaˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ te ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw lonˉ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ te ya‸ la leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve venˇ Kiˇriˆyaˆyaˍrenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆbaˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Neˍhpaˍtawˆ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Yeˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ Hiˆnonˍ yaˇ paˍ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ leh‸ cawˬ ve hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ hkʼaw hta‸ hpaˍ ya‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Enˍyawˇgeˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Enˍseˍmehˆ venˇ, leh Aˍduˇminˍ kʼaˍ le‸ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ cawˬ ve Geˍliˍlawˇ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Ruˇbenˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Bawˇhanˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Beˍteˍraˍbaˆ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ te leh, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Beˍtawˇgaˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ, Beˍtawˇgaˍlaˆ, Eˇmeˍkeˍziˆ,
Beˍtaˍraˍbaˆ, Zeˍmaˍrenˍ, Beˍteˍlaˆ,
Aˍvinˍ, Paˍraˍ, Awˇhpaˍraˆ,
Hkeˍhpaˍhaˍmawˇniˆ, Awˇhpaˍniˆ, Beˍbaˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Giˇbonˍ, Raˍmaˆ, Beˍroˆ,
Miˆsaˍpaˍ, Hkeˍhpiˇraˆ, Mawˇzaˆ,
Yeˍkenˍ, Iˉraˆpeˍlaˆ, Taˍraˍlaˆ,

Zeˍlaˆ, Heˍlaˆ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍbuˇsiˆ, Giˇbaˍ, Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi awˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ, Sheˍbaˆ, Mawˇlaˍdaˆ,
Haˍzaˍshuˍlaˆ, Baˍlanˍ, Aˍzenˍ,
Eˇlaˆtawˇlaˆ, Beˍruˇlaˆ, Hawˇmaˍ,
Ziˆkaˍlaˆ, Behˆmaˍkaˍboˆ, Haˍsaˍsuˇsaˍ,
Behˆleˍbaoˇ Shaˍruˆhenˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi shehˆ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, Enˍ, Riˇmonˍ, Eˇtaˍ, Aˍshaˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆbeˍraˆ venˇ leh Neˍgehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ, Raˍmaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ tawn lehˬ, Suˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Suˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Zaˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Maˍreˍlaˆ venˇ, Daˍbaˍsehˆ venˇ leh Yawˇkaˍnanˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kʼaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Maˍreˍlaˆ venˇ, Hkiˇsaˍlawˇtaˆ bawˍ venˇ, Daˍbaˍraˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Yaˍhpi-aˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Gaˍteˍhpaˍ, Iˉtaˍkaˍzehˍ, Riˇmonˍ leh Neˍ-aˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Haˍnaˍtonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh, Iˇhpaˍteˍlaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kaˍtaˍ, Naˍhaˍleˍlaˆ, Shiˉmaˍronˍ, Iˉdaˍlaˆ, Behˍlehˍ hehnˍ venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi nyi venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Hkeˍsuˇloˆ, Shuˆnenˍ,
Haˍhpaˍrenˍ, Siˉhonˍ, Aˍnaˍhaˍraˆ,
Raˍbiˆ, Kiˇshonˍ, Aˍbehˆ,
Reˍmehˆ, Eˇgaˍnenˍ, Eˇhaˍdaˍ, leh Behˆpaˍzehˆ,
Taˍbawˇ, Shaˍhaˍzuˇmaˍ, Behˆsaˍmehˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi hkaw‸ venˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍlaˍkaˆ, Haˍliˍ, Beˍtenˍ, Aˍhkaˍshaˆ,

Aˍlaˍmeˍlehˆ, Aˍmaˆ, Miˆsaˍlaˆ, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Kaˍraˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw leh Shiˆhawˇraˆliˇbaˍnaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Behˆdaˍgonˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Zeˍbuˆlonˍ miˬ tcuhˉ, Iˉhpaˆteˍlaˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Behˆteˍmehˆ leh Naˍyeˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Kaˍbuˇlaˆ venˇ,
Eˇbronˍ, Reˍhawˇbaˆ, Haˍmonˍ, Kaˍnaˆ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ lonˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Raˍmaˆ, Tuˇruˆ, Hawˇsaˍ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍhaˍlaˆ, Aˍhkaˍziˆ,
Uˇmaˍ, Aˍhpehˆ, Reˍhawˇbaˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˇ chi nyiˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Haˍlaˆ venˇ, Zaˍnaˍninˍ teh‸ kʼo ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hta‸ te leh, Aˍdaˍmiˆneˍkaˆ venˇ, Yaˍbaˍneˍlaˆ venˇ, Laˍkonˍ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Aˍzaˆnoˆtaˍbawˍ venˇ, Huˇkoˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Zaˍbuˆlonˍ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ziˉdonˍ, Zeˍraˆ, Haˍmaˆ, Raˍkaˆ, Geˍbaˍtaˍrehˆ, Aˍdaˍmaˍ,
Raˍmaˆ, Haˍzawˇ,
Kaˍdeˍshaˆ, Enˍdiˆ, Enˍhaˍzawˍ,
Yiˇronˍ, Miˆgaˆdaˍlaˆ, Hawˇyenˍ, Beˍtaˍnaˆ, Behˆseˍmehˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi kʼawˇ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Danˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zawˇraˆ, Eˇshaˍtawˇlaˆ, Iˉraˆmeˍshehˆ,
Shaˍlaˍbenˍ, Aˍjaˍlonˍ, Iˉtaˍlaˆ,
Eˇlonˍ, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ, Eˇkaˍronˍ
Eˇlaˍteˍkaˆ, Giˇbaˍtonˍ, Baˍlaˆ,
Jeˍhuˆ, Beˍnaˍbeˍrehˆ, Gaˍtaˍriˆmonˍ
Meˍjaˍkonˍ, Raˍkonˍ leh Yuˇpeˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ mehˉ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Leˍshanˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ shawˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍshanˍ venˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui Danˍ venˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ Hpaˍ lehˬ, Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ lawˬ ve Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Tiˇmaˍnaˆseˍraˆ venˇ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo venˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Nunˍ yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ponˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, venˇ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo cawˬ ve suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw ha‸ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca toˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve htawˇ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa te ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Shu yawˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ peuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve chaw suh peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo tiˉ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Keˍdeˍ shaˆ venˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Heˍbronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆtaˍbaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Ruˇbenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Beˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Baˍshanˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Goˍlanˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw chaw hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lo hpaw-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca la ve chaw teˇ hpa lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo shu suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ chehˇ kuiˬ venˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kawˇ haˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸, Suˉmonˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ chi shehˆ venˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ, Danˍ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve venˇ teˇ chi venˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Aˍshaˍ, Naˍtaˍliˆ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve venˇ teˇ chi shehˆ venˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ venˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon miˬguiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Kawˇhaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸,
Yuˇda‸, Suˉmonˍ, chaw hui pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Heˍbronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˆyaˆtaˍbaˆ venˇ (Aˍbaˆ lehˬ, Aˍnaˆ ve awˬ pa) hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Kaˍlehˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve hkʼaw shu ve a sha‸ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve Heˍbronˍ venˇ leh, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui paw hkuˇ Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ, Yaˍtiˆ venˇ, Eˇshaˍteˍmawˇ venˇ,
Hawˇlonˍ venˇ, Daˍbiˇraˆ venˇ,
Aˍiˆnaˆ venˇ, Yuˇtaˆ venˇ, Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ, venˇ chi kʼawˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ Giˇbonˍ venˇ, Beˍbaˆ venˇ,
Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ, Aˍlaˍmonˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, teˇ chi shehˆ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui geh venˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Geˍza venˇ, Kiˇbaˍzenˍ venˇ Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍteˍkaˆ venˇ, Giˇbaˍtonˍ venˇ,
Aˍjaˍlonˍ venˇ, Gaˍtaˍriˆmonˍ venˇ, venˇ chi awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Taˍnehˆ venˇ, Gaˍtaˍriˆmonˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve nyiˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ teˇ chi venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ geh lo, shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve, Baˍ shanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Goˍlanˍ venˇ leh Beˍshaˆteˍraˆ venˇ, venˇ chi ve nyiˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ chaw hui geh lo Kiˇshonˍ venˇ, Daˍbeˍgaˆ venˇ,
Yaˍmoˆ venˇ, Enˍgaˍnenˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍshaˍ chaw hui geh lo Miˆsaˍlaˆ venˇ, Aˍbaˍdonˍ venˇ,
Heˍlaˍkaˆ venˇ, Reˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui geh htawˇ, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Keˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ, Haˍmoˍdawˇraˆ venˇ, Kaˍtaˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve shehˆ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi shehˆ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui geh Yawˇkaˍnanˍ venˇ, Kaˍtaˍ venˇ,
Diˇmaˍnaˆ venˇ, Naˍheˍleˍlaˆ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ chaw hui geh lo Beˍzaˍ venˇ, Yaˍhaˆ venˇ,
Keˍdaˍmoˆ venˇ, Meˍhpaˆ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gaˆ chaw hui geh lo, shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Yaˍmoˆ venˇ, Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ,
Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ, venˇ chi ve awˇ venˇ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ venˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ awˇ chi hinˉ venˇ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hkʼa deh‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ kaˬ lo ca lo‸ chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ le le ve hta‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e loˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼo‸-e peu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼo‸-e tcuh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chi beu‸ paw sha jaˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui geh hpu, shi, kuiˇ, sho, ceˇ caˬ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍliˍlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui uiˍ jaˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Na sheˍ. Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍliˍlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi gʼaˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la leh, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca te taˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Peˍawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve laˇ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ te maˇ keunˍ teh‸ dawˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ cawˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui lawˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ taˇ hpfuhˆ loˬ.

Zeˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhkanˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ tcuh ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Aˍhkanˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ gʼa suhˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a sha‸ taˇ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui kawˆ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe caˉ da‸ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh ngaˬ hui awˬ kaˍ lo Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ, tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, te taˍ ve awˬ heˆ ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh dawˇ leh te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ lehˬ, teˇ nyi yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ puiˉ ve kʼo, Nyi sheˍ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, chaw teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ heˆ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ awˬ pon yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ gaˇ ve pa taw, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi hta‸ te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ leh yawˇ geh kʼai taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Hpiˇneˍhaˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh Iˉsaˍreˍla chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼa hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hto maˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ jehˬ da‸-o.

Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸, Shaˉ hkiˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇsuˆ htawˇ mawˇ la peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, na ta sheˍ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˬ bawˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te-o.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ.
Chi beu‸ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸ sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw nawˉ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ heuˆ ve kʼo,

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ leh, va teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, jaw‸ laˇ ve leh mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw aˉ chuˇ tcuhˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa tawˆ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon laiˉ ceuˬ na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ te biˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ luˬ kʼai.
Yoˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon laiˉ ceuˬ na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve chaw mawˇ chaw kehˉ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Uˇhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Naˍhkawˍ hui ve awˬ pa Teˍraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ Uˇhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma choˬ paˉ hpawˇ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ laˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Iˉcaˆ cawˬ la piˇ leh, Iˉcaˆ hta‸ Yaˍkoˆ leh Iˉsawˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ Siˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ leh, Yaˍkoˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ laˬ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw awˬ kaˍ lo ngaˬ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hoˆ beh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui kʼai chehˇ htaˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Ziˆpawˇraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Baˍlehˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍlanˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍlehˆ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yeˍriˆhkoˇ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Giˇgaˍshiˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve aˉhtaw leh hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh nawˬ hui maˇ te taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ leh shaˍlonˍ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui gaˇ ve kʼo, gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui gaˇ ve ya‸ nyi leuˆ yuˬ-o‸. Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ ngaˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi leh ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇri chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh hkawehˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te she‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yoˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ hkanˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te leh, oˇ kaˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ awˬ hawˉ lo duˇ ti ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haˉ pui shiˍ chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, haˉ pui shiˍ chi gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ chi lehˬ nawˬ hui ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇsuˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh leh, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ 110 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Gaˍshaˆ hkʼaw lonˉ awˬ na hpawˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆseˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ Sheˍhkenˍ ve awˬ pa Haˍmawˍ geh hpu teˇ ha hteh‸ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ htawˇ suh-e leh, Yawˇ hta‸ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbeˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ a shu awˉ lawˉ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˉ lawˉ gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui a ciˉgʼa ga laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Suˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Suˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw leh Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Beˍzehˇ venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw 10,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdawˇniˆbeˍzehˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo hpuˇ da‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdawˇniˆbeˍzehˆ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ ma peuˍ leh hkui ma peuˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍdawˇniˆbeˍzehˆ kʼoˆ ve, La‸ ma peuˍ hkui ma peuˍ tawˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve jawˇmawˇ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve hpui lawˇ hawˉ sheˆ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ caˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ leh, venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Kiˇriˇyaˆtaˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ leh, Sheˍshehˇ, Aˍhiˆmanˍ, leh Taˍlaˍmehˇ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Kiˇriˇyaˆseˍhpaˍ venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Deˍbiˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Kiˇriˇyaˆseˍhpaˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ Aˍhkeˍtaˆ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Kaˍlehˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Keˍnaˆ ve yaˇ Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ leh gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Kaˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍhkeˍtaˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ heuˆ da‸ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ pa geh ti mi teˇ peˆ ca lawˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Kaˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ ve awˬ puˍ Keˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo tu leh, Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˉmonˍ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Seˍhpaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍ niˆ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkeu leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui Hawˇmaˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gaˍsaˍ, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ, Eˇkaˍronˍ leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, sho yuˬ te taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui Heˍbronˍ venˇ Kaˍlehˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍnaˍkaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui lehˬ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Luˇzaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh,

chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve ya‸ kʼaw maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Hiˇtiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, Luˇzaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ ca te chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ oˇ hkʼe meh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Behˆshanˍ, Taˍnehˆ, Dawˇraˆ, Iˇbaˍlanˍ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ leh, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍzaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Kiˇtaˍronˍ venˇ leh Naˍhaˍlawˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhkawˍ, Siˉdonˍ, Aˍlaˆ, Aˍhkaˍziˆ, Heˍlaˍbaˆ, Aˍhpehˆ, Reˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ.
Aˍshaˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Behˆseˍmehˆ leh Beˍtaˍnaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo maˇ ya‸ la tcuh piˇ.

Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Heˍheˍrehˆ, Aˍyaˍlonˍ, Shaˍbaˍbenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ Sheˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Aˍkaˍraˍbenˍ kʼaˍ le‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo te leh Bawˇhkenˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ laˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ te luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui shaˉ caˆ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon hkui htiˇ poˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hpoˆ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Bawˇhkawˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ 110 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Gaˍshaˆ hkʼaw lonˉ awˬ na hpawˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ Tiˉmaˍnaˆseˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ co-e hkʼaw hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha te piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha leh Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ le le yawˇ hui ma‸ ca bawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hpawˇ maˇ chehˇ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ na oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hkawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ le le Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ leuˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh yawˇ hui hkʼanˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui te muiˬte jaw ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kʼaw‸ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui leh, haiˬve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw,
Yawˇsuˆ suh-e htaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hkʼe te piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ, maˇ na yuˬve hta‸ ngaˬ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ chiˇ a‸ piˇ sheˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ haˉ maˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ bawˆ jaw sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ma‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ bawˆ jaw sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ suhˉ chi ve te moˍ hta‸, ma‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te bawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve venˇ ngaˇ venˇ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Siˉdonˍ chaw leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw, Baˍlaˆheˍmonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ te leh Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve Hiˇviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Haˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha leh Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Hkuˇshaˍriˆshaˍtenˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hinˉ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Kaˍlehˆ awˬ nyi paˍ Keˍnaˆ ve yaˇ Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Meˍsoˇpoˇtaˍmiˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo 40 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Keˍnaˆ yaˇ paˍ Awˇtanˍyeˍlaˆ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ teˇ chi hinˉ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Beˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇhuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ la‸ mehˍ paˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ geh lo la‸ shawnˍ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
