Eˇhuˆ lehˬ awˬ viˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ cawˬ leh teˇ shaw‸ zuhˬ ve aˉ hte‸ teˇ maˬ te taˍve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ hte‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ aˉ po‸ hawˉ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ veu leh jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ chu jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhuˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ, haˉ pui htawˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Eˇgaˍlonˍ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ awˬ lawn cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tawˆ-e tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw mui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇhuˆ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ tu la ve yoˬ.
Eˇhuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo faˉ taˍ ve aˉ hte‸ hta‸ la‸ mehˍ paˉ ve la‸ sheh gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ juˆ hpehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ hte‸ awˬ viˇ ka‸ awˬ tuˇ ka‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Aˉ hte‸ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ aˉ hte‸ hta‸ hoˆ beh sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ leh, Eˇhuˆ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˉ leh tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ hkʼa deh‸ hoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ ve hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shaw taˍ leh, jawˇmawˇ tawˆ la yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ maˇ tawˆ la mawˬ ve pa taw yehˬ miˉ hpaw nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ paˍ suh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇhuˆ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haˉ pui htawˆ kuiˬ hta‸ ponˬ kʼai leh, Siˇraˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo laˬ tuˬ behˬheh ma meuˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh yawˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ leh ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ baˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo maˇ hkanˍ tawˆ-e tcuh.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve Mawˇbaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ teh taˉ piˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 80 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Shaˍgaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw 600 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ Yawˇ htawˇ ka‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhuˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Haˍzawˇ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Hkaˍnaˍniˆ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ chi ve lehˬ, Haˍyawˇshehˆgawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Siˉsaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ lehˬ, sho te taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 900 cawˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ hehnˇ chaweh uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Laˍhpiˇdoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma Deˍboˇraˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ leh Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo tcuhˉ pui cehˬ teˇ cehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo mui taˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Keˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍbiˆnonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Baˍrehˆ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gaˬ la htaˇ Deˍboˇraˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Naˍtaˍliˆ leh Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o.

Nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Siˇsaˍraˆhta‸ Kiˇshonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ bawˆgʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍrehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Baˍrehˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh kʼai ve kʼo ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ ka‸ maˇ kʼai, teh‸ Deˍboˇraˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Deˍboˇraˍ lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ Siˇsaˍraˆ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Deˍboˇraˍ tu leh Baˍrehˆ geh teˇ geh Keˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Baˍrehˆ lehˬ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw teˇ meunˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Keˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Deˍroˇraˍ htawˇ yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Keˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Heˍbaˍ lehˬ, Keˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Zaˍnaˍnenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo, aˉ po kʼo te leh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Moˉseˍ ve awˬ puˍ Hawˇbaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Keˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh tawˆ la taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍrehˆ lehˬ, Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw lo kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Siˉsaˍraˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ sho te taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 900 leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Haˍyawˇshehˆgawˇ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Kiˇshonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Deˍboˇraˍ kʼoˆ ve, Kʼai loˬ. Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ Siˇsaˍraˆ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍrehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍrehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 10,000 hta‸ shiˍ leh Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Baˍrehˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Siˇsaˍraˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Siˉsaˍraˆ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼoˆ pawˆ ya‸-e leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍrehˆ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Haˍyawˇshehˆgawˇ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Siˇsaˍraˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬ, Keˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Heˍbaˍ miˇ ma Yeˍlaˆ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Haˍzawˇ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ lehˬ, Heˍbaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Yeˍlaˆ tawˆ-e leh Siˇsaˍraˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ aˉ po hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Yeˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ faˉtaˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yaˇ miˇ yawˇ hta‸ nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ leh kʼaw‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˉ po kʼo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh, Choˬ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ laˬ mawˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, Maˇ laˬ mawˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬheuˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍlaˆ lehˬ hta tu leh juˇ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh yawˇ ve naˍ paw hkʼaw dawˆ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Juˇ oˇ ve lehˬ oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ pawnˍ tawˆ-e leh miˬguiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Baˍrehˆ lehˬ Siˉsaˍraˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yeˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, Choˬ kaˬ laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve chaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve naˍ paw hkʼaw juˇ dawˆ keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh suhˍ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Hkaˍnaˍniˆ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbenˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍbenˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hta‸ shanˬ te shanˬ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Deˍboˇraˍ leh Aˍbiˆnonˍ ve yaˇ Baˍrehˆ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ tinˍ hteˆ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Siˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ la leh, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬ hiˆ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw ve Gʼuiˬsha, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍgaˍ leh, Yeˍlaˆ hui awˬ co-e htaˇ, tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ hpanˍ toˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Deˍboˇraˍ-oˬ, nawˬ maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ awˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ la‸ caˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Hpuˉ-ehˍ ve piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ taˍ ve chaw hui, iˉ mvuhˇ an hkʼoˆ mui taˍ ve chaw hui leh ya‸ kʼaw toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Na sheˍ. Nanˍ bawˍ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Deˍboˇraˍ-oˬ, gʼuˇ suhˍ shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Aˍbiˆnonˍ ve yaˇ Baˍrehˆ-oˬ, gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ yawˇ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍhkaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ Deˍboˇraˍ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍhkaˍ leh Baˍrehˆ htawˇ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpaˆ da‸ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw laˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ geh chehˇ taˉ ve le. Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˬ awˬ moˍ hta‸ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ awˬ pon laˇ. Yoˬ, Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui laˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ tanˇ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ iˉ kaˆ law paˇ lo cawˬ ve Taˍnehˆ venˇ lo ma‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkaˍnanˍ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ ca bawˆ la ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hpu maˇ gʼa yuˬ kʼo‸-e.
Meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ te toˇ chehˇ leh, Siˇsaˍraˆ hta‸ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve Kiˇshonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ yuˬ tawˆ leh, ngaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Meˍyawˇzaˆ venˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ chehˇ leh, ma‸ maˇ ga bawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Keˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Heˍbaˍ miˇ ma Yeˍlaˆlehˬ, yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Siˇsaˍraˆ lehˬ, yawˇ geh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ dawˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hta‸ nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˆ ve kawˆhkʼaw lo, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ keu taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ hkʼaw juˇ yuˬ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ hkʼaw hta tu hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Siˇsaˍraˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ dawˆ meu-e piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇmiˇ oˇ ve hkui paˇ lo paiˍ leh suh sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Siˇsaˍraˆ ve awˬ e lehˬ, hpa ko taˍ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ haˆ haˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi taw taw naiˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˇ ca hpfuhˆ yuˬ leh pehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, nyiˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Siˇsaˍraˆ awˬ pon awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leuˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ma awˬ pon, nyi sha jaˇ ve shi caˆ leuˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo 40 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ toˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui caˬ ti ve teˇ yanˇ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw haˉ kuiˬ fa la teˇ hpaˍ te leh, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ, yawˬ, piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ka‸ maˇ teh taˉ piˇ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve ceˇ caˬ leh, aˉ po kʼo teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui geh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui leh, choˬ kaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ lo laˬ leh, Aˍbeˍsaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yawˇshaˆ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ hkʼaw ca hkʼawˇ jaw‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ tawˆ la leh, Nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve le. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hkʼa cawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawˇ ka‸, ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ te hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa tanˇ laˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ geh taˇ tawˆ kʼai laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼaw‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Giˉdonˍ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh, aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tiˇ leh awˍ chiˇ te ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˍ lawˇ ehˉ hkʼaw keu leh, awˍ chiˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˉ kuˇ cehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Shaˍ leh hkaoˍmonˇ chi ve hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼoˆ teh taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˍ chiˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Giˉdonˍ htawˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ juˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ haˉ pui awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ to‸ tawˆ la leh, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la leh kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Giˉdonˍ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. (Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi ve ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ, Aˍbeˍsaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ pa ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ leh a sha‸ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ca taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ pa Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te taˍ ve hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ka‸ dawˆ baˬ-o‸.

Hkʼaw pui chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh hta‸, nawˬ dawˆ baˬ taˍ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼoˆ hpoˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ kanˉ oˇ ve hta‸ te maˇ haˆ. Hkʼe te leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ te ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ dawˆ paˆ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼoˆ lo chu jaˇ ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chi hkʼe te ve chaw a shu le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ na da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi leh, kanˉ chi hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬYawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Giˉdonˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Yawˇshaˆ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ dawˆ baˬ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca deˇ la ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ ca gʼawˬ da‸ la ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hpawˇ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hpawˇ chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ sheˍ htaˇ tiˇ pehˍve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tehˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, dawˆ paˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi lehˬ, yawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Giˉdonˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆbaˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Dawˆ paˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hpawnˬ laˬ leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Giˉdonˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbeˍsaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ behˬheh ma meuˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˍ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yehˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ yawˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˬ mvuh hta‸ tiˉ ciˍ gʼuiˬ nehˆ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ goˇ lehˍ cawˬ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ gaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ Giˉdonˍ tu la leh, yawˬ mvuh hta‸ nehˆ taˍ ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hkehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw suhˉ keu ve teˇ yanˇ, hkehˇ teˇ maˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma a ciˉ taˇ zuhˆ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ceh tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw tcuh laˇ sheˍ. Yawˬ mvuh chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ lawˇ nyi gaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ mvuh chi goˇ lehˍ cawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ, Gʼuiˬsha oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ mvuh lehˬ goˇ lehˍ cawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh, Haˍroˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve iˉ kaˆ tawˆkuiˬ lo ca deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Mawˇreˍ hkʼaw awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw maˇ ve pa taw ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, kawˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o, teh‸ Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chaw 22,000 gʼaˇ tu kʼo‸-e leh, chaw 10,000 gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ geh lo chaw maˇ jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo shiˍ kʼai-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon chaw leuˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ geh kʼai cawˇ ve chaw ngaˬ leuˆ laˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve nawˬ geh gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ geh maˇ kʼai cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ tawˆ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve nawˬ geh maˇ gʼa kʼai, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Giˉdonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ ka‸ lawˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ iˉ kaˆ leh‸ dawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ teˇ kaˬ lo fuiˍ teh taˍ-o‸. Hkui tcuhˉ teh leh iˉ kaˆ boˆ dawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, teˇ kaˬ lo fuiˍ teh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh la‸ sheh hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ toˆ yuˬ leh, hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ iˉ kaˆ leh‸ dawˬ ve 300 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, hkui tcuhˉ teh taˍ leh iˉ kaˆ boˆ dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉ kaˆ leh‸ dawˬ ve chaw chi ve shehˆ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh teh taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve 300 gʼaˇ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ leh behˬ heh ma hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Meˇdiˍ anˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ paˉ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tu leh canˇ paˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ canˇ paˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ kawˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Hpuˇraˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ ve nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Hpuˇraˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui lehˬ, paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ maˬ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo pu ce la leh, aˉ po kʼo hta‸ htinˍ heuˆ ve pa taw, aˉ po kʼo oˇ ve miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ, Giˉdonˍ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw leh, ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkui tcuhˉ teh leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Tu lo. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ shehˆ moˍ pehˬ leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ behˬheh ma leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ te ve hkʼe te-o.

Ngaˬ hui teˇ moˍ behˬheh ma meuˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve behˬ heh ma hta‸ meuˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha leh Giˉdonˍ awˬ pon, teh‸ kuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ lehˬ, shehˍ kʼaw hkui gaˬ leh, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ pa da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, yawˇ hui yuˬ taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve shehˆ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, a shu yawˇ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hta‸ la‸ mehˍ paˉ yuˬ taˍ leh, la‸ sha paˉ lo behˬ heh ma hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha leh Giˉdonˍ awˬ pon aˉhtaw, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve shehˆ ha gʼaˇ behˬheh ma meuˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ chaw pehˍ da‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui leh, Zeˍreˍraˍ venˇ, Behˆshiˍtaˆ venˇ, Taˍboˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Meˍhawˇlaˆ i kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ guiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw, Aˍshaˍ chaw, leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hta‸ ga bawˆ la-o. Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh awˬ nu ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ, Behˆbaˍraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh shaw taˍ-o‸, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Behˆbaˍraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇ danˍ leh awˬ nu ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Awˇreˍbaˆleh Zeˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Meˉdiˍanˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh gʼa leh, Awˇreˍbaˆ hta‸ Awˇreˬbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ hpawˇ awˬ paˇ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Zeˍbaˆ hta‸ Zeˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˇreˍbaˆ leh Zeˍbaˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Giˉdonˍ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kuˬ laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve le, teh‸ Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui te peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ shawˍ nyi ve kʼo, ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Nawˬ hui Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve a ciˉ ceh tiˉ ve kanˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Awˇreˍbaˆ leh Zeˍbaˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te gʼa ve kanˉ hkʼe taw uiˍ ve kanˉ, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ te gʼa taˍ ve cawˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma gawˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 300 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ leh coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Suˇkoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ bon te leh ngaˬve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ a ciˉ caˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Meˇdiˍanˍ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍbaˍ leh Zaˍmuˍnaˍ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Suˇkoˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ gʼa caˍ piˇ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ maˇ gʼa sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˇdonˍ lehˬ, Hkʼe kʼo da‸-a. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍ naˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve aˉ chuˇ te hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ Peˍnoeˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ ca kʼaw‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Peˍnoeˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Suˇkoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ta‸ yehˬ lon ˉ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Kaˍkawˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 120,000 gʼaˇ lehˬ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh ma‸ yaˇ 15,000 gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ lehˬ Nawˇbaˆ leh Yuˇbeˍhaˆ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lon ˉ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ lo‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Meˉdiˍanˍ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa‸ yuˬ leh jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Heˍrehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Suˇkoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hpeh yuˬ leh tawˇ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw haˉ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Suˇkoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 77 gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ Suˇ koˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ sheˍ laˇ. Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ hpeh gʼa sheˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ maˇ piˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve aˉ chuˇ te hta‸ yuˬ leh, Suˇkoˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peˍnoeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu hta‸ shuˍ ve le, teh‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ e ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ, Tu leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Yeˍtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ maˇ haˆ.

Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ awˬ to ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw mawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw mawˇ te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, Zeˍbaˍ leh Zeˍmuˍnaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼoˆ taˆ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpui yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ Giˉdonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ awˬ to maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, shi naˍ vawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍ vawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpa teˇ maˬ hpe hkʼawˇ sheˬ leh, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ gʼa ve naˍ vawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, 10 cawehˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Naˬ vawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ ve, awˬ nu ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, kʼaw peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ, Meˉdiˍanˍ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ ve nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ chehˇ kuiˬ Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon va htaw taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te sho‸ sha‸ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Giˉdonˍ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw 40 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma cawˬ maˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 70 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Giˉdonˍ lehˬ, mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ suh-e leh, Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ awˬ pa Yawˇshaˆ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍbeˍsaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Giˉdonˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te piˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ e ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Sheˍhkenˍvenˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui a shu hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ uˉ peunˍ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ e ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi ve Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hpawˇ chehˇ tuˬ jehˬ cheˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu 70 hteh‸ yuˬ leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ awˬ pa ve yehˬ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ awˬ pa Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ 70 gʼaˇ hta‸ haˉ pui teˇ shiˍ tiˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇtanˍ lehˬ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve pa taw gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍhkenˍ leh Behˆmiˍlawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ lo hpawnˬ kʼai leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ Yawˇtanˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Geˍraˍzenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ huˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca kʼai ve yoˬ ceˇ. Yawˇ hui shaˍlonˍ ceh hta‸ mawˬ leh, Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ shaˍlonˍ cehˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼo, gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ gʼa ve ngaˬ ve awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˉ nawˆ cehˬ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ maˉ nawˆ cehˬ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼo, mehˬ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a pehˉ meuˇ te geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ a pehˉ meuˇ te lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ gʼa ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˉ chuˇ buiˇ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˬˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ aˉ chuˇ buiˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na jawˇmawˇ te tcuh gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ hawˉ lo ca chehˇ taˍ la-o. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ to‸ tawˆ la leh, Leˍbaˍ nonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ ceˇ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve laˇ. Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ peuˬ laˇ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ pa nawˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ a sha‸ tanˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ Meˉdiˍanˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ haˉ pui teˇ shiˍ tiˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui lehˬ, Giˉdonˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve kʼo, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ htawˇ, nawˬ hui geh ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ ve kʼo, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ tawˆ la leh, Sheˍhkenˍ leh Behˆmaˍlawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Sheˍhkenˍ leh Behˆmaˍlawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ tawˆ la leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇtanˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, Beˍraˆ venˇ lo ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ maˇ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ pa 70 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ hkʼawˇ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui hinˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Gaˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼai leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ leh pawehˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gaˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve le. Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ lehˬ a shu le. Yawˇ lehˬ Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Zeˍbuˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Haˍmawˍ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ sheh kʼai piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ma‸ moˍ shawˍ leh ma‸ ca bawˆ la-o, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Zeˍbuˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gaˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ Aˍruˆmaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ Gaˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Sheˍhkenˍ lo laˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ venˇ chi hkʼaw kʼaw‸ la tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca hpaw va‸ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ chi hta‸ ca bawˆ la cawˇ ve yoˬ. Gaˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ te puiˉ te hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ tawˆ la leh, chaw awˇ moˍ pehˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ paˇ lo va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍlaˆ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Gaˍlaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nyi loˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Zeˍbuˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍbuˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍlaˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kʼaˍ le‸ hkʼaw ya‸ la chehˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ mawˉ paˍ hui ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hpawˇ lo laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍbuˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ, teh‸ Gaˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gaˍlaˆ lehˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, Gaˍlaˆ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Venˇ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo chaw maˇ maˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ Aˍruˆmaˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Zeˍbuˍlaˆ lehˬ Gaˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ baˬ lo tawˆ kʼai tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shehˆ moˍ pehˬ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca va‸ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo tu la leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ moˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ te luˬ leh, aˉ leh‸ hkaˆ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ Sheˍhkenˍ ta‸ yehˬ lon ˉ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo hpaw va‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Zaˍlaˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ceˉ ceˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh suhˆ kʼaˉ ku-iˍ tawˆ taˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hkʼe te tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui suhˆ kʼaˉ ku-iˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ta‸ yehˬ hkuiˉ pui lo hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ Teˍbehˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ hkʼa deh‸ hoˆ peu hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu leh te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, yehˬ miˉ cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui mawˍ teˇ maˬ hpehˇ ce piˇ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkoˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ haˆ haˆ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ ma ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa suh-e ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ gaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ juˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ suh-e peuˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa ve yaˇ 70 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ haiˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Giˉdonˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇtanˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, Doˉdoˍve awˬ hawehˍ Hpuˇ-aˬ ve yaˇ Tawˇlaˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Eˇhpaˍ renˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Shaˍmiˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 23 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh, Shaˍmiˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇlaˆ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Giˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yaˍiˇraˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 30 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ piˉ laˬ 30 hkeh ciˇ ve yoˬ. Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw venˇ 30 venˇ cawˬ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yaˍiˇraˆ ve hkʼaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍiˇraˆ suh-e leh yawˇ hta‸ Kaˍmonˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha, Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha, Suˇriˆ gʼuiˬsha, Siˉdonˍ gʼuiˬsha, Mawˇ baˆ gʼuiˬsha, Aˍmonˍ gʼuiˬsha, leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ hta‸ te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ chi hinˉ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ law mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, Yuˇda‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Aˍ mawˇ niˆ chaw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆchaw,
Siˉdonˍ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw, leh Miˇdiˍanˍ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ jaw ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ jaw laˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ loˬ. Nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ laˬ leh, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, A shu awˬ hoˉ te leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ ve le. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pa lehˬ Giˇlaˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Giˇlaˆ miˇ ma lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa geh te‸ chiˉ awˬ shinˉ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, Tawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te la leh, yawˇ hui teˇ geh te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ma‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ hta‸ ca shiˍ hkʼaw‸ la leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ hui Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi bawˬ leh, ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ geh laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ hoˉawˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Miˇsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ Aˍmawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍmawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shanˍ feu laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ, Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hinˉ yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ Aˍmawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˇ kʼaw‸ shanˍ feu leh kʼoˆ ve,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ htaˬ maˇ bawˆ yuˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hteunˍ lonˉ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ, Eˇdonˍ jawˇmawˇ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇdon jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caw kʼai leh, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ tawˆ-e. Awˬ lawn kʼo, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve lehˬ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬAˍmawˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Shiˉhonˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Yaˍhaˆ venˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Siˉhonˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Yaˍboˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve Hkeˍmuˇshaˆ gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tiˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Ziˆpawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Baˍlehˆ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hui da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ tawˍ da‸ jaw. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ ca bawˆ la jaw laˇ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ, Aˍyawˍ venˇ, leh Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shehˆ ha hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ bawˆ hkʼaw‸ ve le.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui awˬ kaˍ lo, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍmawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Miˆsaˍpa venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ca ha‸ la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍyawˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Keˍraˍmenˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Miˇniˆ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ nyiˇ chi venˇ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ tinˍ hteˆ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ la ve yoˬ. Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ chi teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ pe‸ hkoˇ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yaˇ miˇ chi yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ leh gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ maˇ suh sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ca hawˬ toˇ tuˬ, awˬ yanˇ nyiˇ ha pa hkʼe piˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa htawˇ yawˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ yanˇ nyiˇ ha pa piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ hkʼa biˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa nyiˇ maˬ peuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ pa geh kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ haˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ taˉ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˇ nyi heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, Giˇlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ yaˇ miˇ pon dawˇ haˍ leh ca paˆ hawˬ toˇ ve awˬ liˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Zaˍhponˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kuˬ laˇ leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve le. Nawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa deˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca kuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo maˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca ga la ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ tanˇ leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui kʼoˆ ve, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui Giˇlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Giˇlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ i kaˆ lawˬ gʼuiˬ ta teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui i kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e maˇ gaˬ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ ca lawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Giˇlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hpeh‸ ve laˇ, teh‸ naˬ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Giˇlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸, Shiˆbawˇlehˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tcuh nyi ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tawˇ yaw maˇ pi‸ ve pa taw, Tiˆbawˇlehˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ta lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw 42,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Iˉbaˍsanˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ sheh kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 30 gʼaˇ leh yaˇ miˇ 30 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Iˉbaˍsanˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh, Beˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉbaˍsanˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zeˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇlonˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh Zeˍbuˆlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍjaˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlonˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Piˇraˍtonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hiˇleˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbaˍdonˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 40 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ hawehˍ 30 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ piˉlaˬ 70 hkeh ciˇ toˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍdonˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hinˉ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh, Aˍmaˍlehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Piˇraˍtonˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ 40 hkʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍnawˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Zawˇraˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw nawˬ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ taˇ dawˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ caˇ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve paw la ve kʼo, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa nuˆ baˬ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ na nyi. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ taˇ dawˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ caˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Maˍnawˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ peu laˇ jaw ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ peu laˇ leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve paw la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn a ciˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tcuh sheˍ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Maˍnawˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ti mi hkʼaw mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ Maˍnawˍ lehˬ, yawˇ geh maˇ chehˇ taˍ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ. Aˉ nyi htaˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ jaw ve chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnawˍ tu leh yawˇ miˇ ma hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chaw oˇ ve geh kʼai leh, Aˉ nyi htaˇ ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ la ve nawˬ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Maˍnawˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ le. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma kanˉ gʼa te tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˬ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ te awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ gʼa caˇ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa dawˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa caˇ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Maˍnawˍ maˇ shiˍ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ bon te leh a ciˉ taˇ tawˆ kʼai laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tiˇ leh awˍ chiˇ te laˇ shaˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ caˇ tuˬ gu gaˇ ve kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ gu leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Maˍnawˬ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ meh ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve le. Oˇ ve lehˬ, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ meh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Maˍnawˍ lehˬ, aˉ che‸ ehˉ leh caˬ hkʼa hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ geh taˆ-e chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Maˍnawˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ teˇpawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇnaw tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Maˍnawˍ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Maˍnawˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Sanˍsonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve uiˍ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Zawˇraˆ leh Eˇshaˍtawˇlaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Danˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ e geh kʼo‸-e leh, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ca lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ awˬ miˇ ma ca tuˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui geh kʼai ve le. Nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ ca maˇ mawˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ca lawˬ tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e maˇ shiˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Hpiˇliˇ tiˆ chaw lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ che‸ ehˉ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh kʼai leh na‸ uˉ te da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca heuˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˉ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw pehˇ teˇ hpoˆ gaˬ leh, pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ leh anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ pehˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkaˆ chiˇ veu leh, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo caˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ htawˇ caˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ caˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve suh taˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ to hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ te muiˬ te jaw ve hkʼe hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te piˇ tuˬ chaw haˉ paˍ 30 gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ geh shiˍ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui tawˇ kuˇ da‸-a veuˬ. Pawehˇ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi ve suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve hpa teˇgʼaˇ teˇ cheˆ leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ cuˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve hpa 30 cheˆ leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ 30 cuˍ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ hkʼa nyi. Ngaˬ hui na taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ tawˆ la leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ maˇ gʼa.

Awˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Sanˍsonˍ miˇ ma geh laˬ leh, Tawˇ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ beˬ na nyi-o. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ pa hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hinˉ yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ ka‸ lo kuˬ yuˬ taˍ laˇ ve law, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Sanˍsonˍ miˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh hawˬ laˬ leh, Nawˬlehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve law. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ kuˇ da‸ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ hto maˍ laˇ ve law, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Tawˇ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e hta‸ ka ngaˬ maˇ hto piˇ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te chehˇ ve suhˍ nyi ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ miˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆmaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ leh, Sanˍsonˍ zuh‸ bawehˇ hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e sheˍ htaˇ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Pehˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ mehˬ ve aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ sheˍ le. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ sheˍ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve nuˇ ma haˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh maˇ mehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ chaw 30 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ gʼa ve chaw hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ beu‸ jaˇ leh aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Sanˍsonˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ miˇ ma ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ lo‸-e tcuh.

Yawˇ koˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nyi bawˬ jaˇpeuˬ hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ leuˉ leh awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh, heh hpuiˇ 300 hkeh ca hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, heh hpuiˇ nyiˇ hkeh ve teˇ ceh te leh, awˬ mehˍ tu hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ da‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ kaˍ lo aˬ miˍ bawˇ hpeh keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve ti mi hkʼaw gʼa‸ peu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, gʼeu‸ taˍ peuˬ ve caˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, maˇ gʼa gʼeu‸ sheˬ ve caˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ aˬ miˍ chiˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi hkʼe te ve a shu le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ yaˇ, Sanˍsonˍ ve awˬ puˍ lehˬ, Sanˍsonˍ miˇ ma hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve pa taw, Sanˍsonˍ chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ paˍ ve yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw deh taˍ leh, Leˍhiˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Sanˍsonˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw 3,000 gʼaˇ Sanˍsonˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Eˇtanˍ haˉ kʼoˍ lo kʼai leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ laˬ ve yo, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ. Nawˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui aˉ caˆ hkeh awˬ suhˉ nyiˇ caˆ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Leˍhiˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ caˆ hkeh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˬ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Aˉ caˆ hkeh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ to‸ hkeu‸ taˍ ve gʼo‸ hkeh hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
