Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, piˉ laˬ paˇ kaˇ gʼawˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh chaw 1,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Sanˍsonˍ kʼa muiˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Piˉ laˬ paˇ kaˇ gʼawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ chaw 1,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ. Piˉ laˬ paˇ kaˇ gʼawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hpoˆ lonˉ te gʼawˆ hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ paˇ kaˇ gʼawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Raˍmaˆleˍhiˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ leh buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa gaˬ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Leˍhiˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Haˍkawˇraˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ oˇ ve Leˍhiˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sanˍsonˍ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, yawˇ geh ca zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sanˍsonˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, shehˍ kʼaw hkui htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ceh tiˉ oˇ kaˬ lo ca zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ tu la leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw leh shawˇ keu taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼawˬ taˆ veu leh, Heˍbronˍ venˇ coˇ paˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ Sawˇrehˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Deˍleˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw oˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ chi taw taw uiˍ ve leh naˍ, nawˬ a ciˉ beˬ na nyi-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ hpu 1,100 piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Deˍleˍlaˆ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ chi taw taw uiˍ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te leh a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Sanˍsonˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ goˇ sheˍ ve hkaˆ caˆ awˬ suhˉ suhˍ caˆ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ goˇ sheˍ ve hkaˆ caˆ awˬ suhˉ suhˍ caˆ Deˍlaˍlaˆ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ hkaˆ caˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ hpeh ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw va‸ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Sanˍsonˍ oˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ gʼo‸ hkeh hta‸ aˬ miˬ to‸ cheˆ ve hkʼe, aˉ caˆ hkeh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˬ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼaˬ lo cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa shiˍ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Deˍleˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve le. Awˬ bon te leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sanˍsonˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Shu teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yehˇ jaw sheˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Deˍleˍlaˆ lehˬ aˉ caˆ hkeh awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ hpeh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sanˍsonˍ-oˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve teˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ la‸ sheh hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, gʼo‸ hkeh hkʼa shuˍ cheˆ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Deˍleˍlaˆ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ heˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hpeh yuˬ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sanˍsonˍ kʼoˆve, Ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh suhˍ dawˇ ve hta‸ hpa chiˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw keu chiˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Deˍleˍlaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa tuˬ tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh suhˍ dawˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh hpa chiˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw keu chiˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sanˍsonˍ-oˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ pawˆ tu la leh, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ hpaˍ, hpa chiˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw shoˆ tawˆ-e peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Deˍleˍlaˆ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ ve ka‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ chi taw taw uiˍ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼoˆ laˇ sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe tiˉ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe tiˉ kʼoˆ leh te sho‸ sha‸ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, Sanˍsonˍ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Deˍleˍlaˆ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ nuˆ baˬ jaw. Ngaˬ paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ nuˆ baˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ Sanˍsonˍ yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Deˍleˍlaˆ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh lo tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve hpu yuˬ leh yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Sanˍsonˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ yawˇ ve pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu hkʼoˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh Sanˍsonˍ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh suhˍ dawˇ ve hta‸ nuˆ baˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai peuˬ.

Sanˍsonˍ-oˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ pawˆ tu la leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ dawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.

Hkʼe te leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ nyiˇ paˉ paˉ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hta‸ kuiˇ caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, caˬ gʼa geuˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh shaˬ te shaˬ kʼaw‸ zuhˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve Daˍgonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa pawehˇ te tuˬ teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ lonˉ Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve canˇ paˍ lonˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na gʼa te piˇ tuˬ, Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo huˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ sheh toˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ cawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpa hta‸ ngeh taˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hawˉ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ngaˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Sanˍsonˍ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 3,000 gʼaˇ hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sanˍsonˍ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-o, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˇ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ laˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ceh awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Sanˍsonˍ lehˬ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ teˇ maˬ vawˆ taˍ leh,

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui geh ngaˬ hta‸ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh, yeh hkuiˉ daw lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ buiˆ paˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve paiˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ htaˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zawˇraˍ leh Eˇshaˍtawˇlaˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve, yawˇ awˬ pa Maˍnawˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, Miˆhkaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hpu 1,100 mehˉ kʼai htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼawˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi sheˍ. Hpu oˇ ve chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ e kʼoˆ ve, Hkeu ve tawˇ oˇ ve nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ la tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ hpu oˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ hpu oˇ ve hkʼaw lo 200 hteh‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, ca liˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ca liˉ oˇ ve lehˬ suhˆ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te leh, hpu oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Miˆ hkaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hpeh‸ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ ca nyi toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te leh, ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ ve hpu teˇ chi hteh‸ piˇ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, veu‸ kʼaˇ leh caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ geh chehˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh leh, yawˇ lehˬ Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ. Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui chehˇ tuˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa sheˍ.

Hkʼe te leh Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ ca nyi tuˬ Zawˇraˍ venˇ leh Eˇshaˍtawˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la leh, Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw haˉ paˍ oˇ ve tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ cawˬ haˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le. A shu nawˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ ve paw hkuˇ te piˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, ngaˬ hui ca te toˇ ve kanˉ chi awˬ bon tawˆ la tuˬ naˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a ciˉ na nyi laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ kʼai leh Lehˇshaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Siˉdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ca ya‸ da‸ jaw ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Siˉdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ chawˇ ma ca te da‸.
Chaw oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ Zawˇraˍ leh Eˇshaˍtawˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Laˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui Lehˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh te‸ chiˉ taˇ ca te guiˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui haˆ kʼai leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ-a veuˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ hkiˉ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, loˍ cawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ lehˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ Zawˇraˍ leh Eˇshaˍtawˇ laˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Danˍ chaw hui ve fa la, teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Lehˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi taˉ ve chaw jaˆ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo, hpu oˍ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ-aˬ laˇ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa hkʼe te cawˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Leˍviˆ chaw chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh yawˇ hta‸ la‸ kʼawˍ caˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ htaˇ, Danˍ chaw hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ lehˬ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw jaˆ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh hpu oˍ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve 600 gʼaˇ geh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ oˇ ve gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ taˇ yaw. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh laˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve paw hkuˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te-o. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍla‸ chaw chi ma ve awˬ hkʼoˆ paw hkuˇ gʼa te ve lehˬ, leuˉ leh da‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ jaˇ leh shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ, ceˇ caˬ leh mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suh lo kʼai peu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Miˆhkaˍ ve yehˬ hta‸ a ciˉ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Miˆ hkaˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Danˍ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw moˍ lonˉ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ ve le, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ leh ngaˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ taˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma zuhˆ la leh, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ maˇ gʼaˇ taˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ te taˍve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh paw hkuˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve Lehˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Siˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te da‸ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Behˆreˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ venˇ lehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Danˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ yuˬ leh, Danˍ venˇ teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Lehˇshaˆ teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Danˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ shaˉ ho‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Moˉseˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Geˍraˍsonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Danˍ chaw ceuˬ geh paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Miˆhkaˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ gʼaˇ ca heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpaw kʼo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo ha pa awˇ maˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ beˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ leh piˉ laˬ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ yawˇ hta‸ la‸ haˉ maˇ kʼo‸-e tuˬ lawˍ hkawˉ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo shehˆ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ na‸ tu leh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ caˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la htaˇ heh‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lehˬ, Ya‸ puiˉ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ lo haˉ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, kʼo‸-e gaˇ ve htawˇ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ hkawˇ leuˉ maˇ gʼa leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ haˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˇ nyi teˇ nyi yawˇ hui mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh kʼo‸-e tuˬ gu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lehˬ, Caˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ caˇ sheˍ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ heh‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh tu kʼo‸-e tu gu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lehˬ, Nyi sheˍ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ puiˉ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ lo haˉ cawˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Choˬ ka‸ lo chehˇ taˍ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, nawˬ hui teˇ na‸ tu kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ haˉ chehˇ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ shiˍ veu leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ an hkʼa deh‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve piˉ laˬ nyiˇ hkeh cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e leh Yeˍbuˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ paˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ya‸ puiˉ choˬ kaˬ Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui ve venˇ hkʼaw ca haˉ taˉ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇ hkʼaw maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ hui ca haˉ maˇ hpeh‸.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Giˇbaˍ maˇ heˆ kʼo, Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ca haˉ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Yeˍbuˆ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e peuˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca haˉ tuˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve pa taw, venˇ kʼaw ji lo mui taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ heh hkʼaw kanˉ ca te kʼaw‸ la ve lawˇ puˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ jaw ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Lawˇ puˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw mui chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo laˬ leh, hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh, ngaˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e toˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to, ngaˬ miˇ ma, leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ pon hkaoˍmonˇ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ lawˇ puˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo ca haˉ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ venˇ kʼaw ji lo haˉ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve hkui sheh tsuhˇ taˉ leh aˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ yehˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hpoˆ dawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ chawˇ gʼa te da‸ tuˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ lawˇ puˍ oˇ ve yehˬ awˬ baˬ lo tawˆ-e leh, Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hkʼe cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ te laˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nyi loˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i leh, ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi hkʼe ve chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Hkʼe te leh Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yawˇ hui geh yuˬ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ awˬ hpawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yehˬ miˉ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo zuh‸ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Tu-o. Ngaˬ hui kʼo‸-e veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ puiˉ-o. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ teh leh yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉhtaw yuˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ teˇ chi nyiˇ tawn te tawˆ cheˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, chi hkʼe teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le. Teˇ geh hpoˆ dawˇ nyi-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ na hpawˇ Danˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo laˬve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ma‸ yaˇ awˇ shehnˉ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi taw taw haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ Leˍviˆ chaw kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ miˇ ma ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca haˉ tuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ Giˇbaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui haˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yehˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ca hpeh la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ laˬ leh, ngaˬ miˇ ma hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ cheˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ geh lo feu kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haiˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tu la leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ, maˇ heˆ ko, aˉ po kʼo lo kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ leh, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ chi pun teˇ pun lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ gʼa gu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ te tawˆ la ve Giˇbaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh, teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve le.

Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ chi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸tuˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ 26,000 gʼaˇ shawˍ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 700 gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ mvuh hta‸ ka‸ hawˉ ma bawˆ heuˆ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ma‸ yaˇ 400,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi lehˬ, Chaw hkʼa ve teˇ ceuˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ tu leh Giˇbaˍ venˇ paˇ lo ca deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, Giˇbaˍ venˇ paˇ lo chehˇ kuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉawˬ hkʼaw lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 22,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ kʼaw‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 18,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ mui taˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ Hpiˇnaˍhaˆ lehˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ tuˬ sheˍ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, gʼa jehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai loˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Giˇbaˍ venˇ paˇ lo ca va‸ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ te jaw ve hkʼe, Giˇlaˆ venˇ paˇ lo ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la leh, venˇ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ leh Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 30 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ ka‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shonˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ ve hkʼe te leh, hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e maˍ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, Baˍlaˍtaˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, venˇ paˇ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo tu la leh, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼa deh‸ leuˆ yuˬtaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ 10,000 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui shonˇ la paˇ neˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, canˇ paˍ 25,100 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ paˇ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e leh, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ paˇ lo va‸ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ heˆ te da‸ taˍ ve cawˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ naˆ dawˇ lonˉ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ,

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ htawˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 30 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ ka‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shonˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ heˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ naˆ dawˇ lonˉ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpfuhˆ nyi leh, venˇ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui shonˇ la paˇ neˇ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ponˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ moˍ awˬ kaˍ lo hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hta‸ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo hoˆ taˍ leh, Giˇbaˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 18,000 gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh Riˇmonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ hpaw taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 5,000 gʼaˇ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo tiˇ pehˍve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw 2,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 25,000 tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, Riˇmonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ hpaw taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo ha pa awˇ maˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw, yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chi hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo Beˍyanˍmenˍ chaw teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ hui geh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ ca hpawnˬ da‸ la ve chaw a shu cawˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ gaˬ la ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.)

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui awˬ pon, ngaˬ hui awˬ miˇ ma hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ca piˇ tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ heuˆ tcuh, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka ti‸ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ lo maˇ hpawnˬ gaˬ la ve a shu cawˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ la ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 12,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shanˍ piˇ leh Yaˍbehˆ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, yaˇ ehˉ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yaˇ miˇ haˉ maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui kʼai leh Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ haˉ 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Riˇmonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu leh, ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ jehˇ taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ hui ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon maˇ law‸ taˬ sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉawˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ-o. Awˬ miˇ ma maˇ gʼa sheˍ ve awˬ nu ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ hui awˬ miˇ ma hkʼa hkʼe te ca piˇ tuˬ le.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mehˉ kʼai piˇ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa gu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ bon pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ leh, Leˍboˇnaˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ leh Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.)
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui kʼai leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ-o‸.
Pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la leh, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ pawehˇ te tuˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui nyiˉ yuˬ veu leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e loˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa, maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh venˇbaˆ ca taˍ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hinˉ yuˬ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, pawehˇ te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, a shu yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ, leh a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ teˇ pawˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Eˇhpaˍraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Nawˉmi‸ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍlonˍ, Hkiˍlonˍ hui hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ Eˇliˆmaˍlehˆ suh-e leh, Nawˉmi‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ ceh cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw Awˇraˍpaˆ leh Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Maˍlonˍ leh Hkiˍlonˍ htawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Nawˉmi‸ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw gaˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Nawˉmi‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e leh ya‸ kʼaw teˇ tawn lo gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e geh ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ yehˬ kʼa awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hawˬ leh, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ maˇ kʼo‸-e gaˇ. Nawˬ geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Nawˉmi‸ kʼaw‸kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ geh kʼai gaˇ ve le. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ka laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ geh yaˇ paˍ cawˬ sheˍ hehˉ teh‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mawˇ la peuˬ. Awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ maˇ hpeh‸-o. Ngaˬ ya‸ puiˉ awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh yaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la puiˉ sheˍ ka‸, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ca law heuˆ maˇ gʼa taˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˇraˍpaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ boˆ nu taˉ leh, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ kʼuˉ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Nawˉmi‸ yawˇ hta‸kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ruˉhtaˆ-oˬ, Awˇraˍpaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw leh yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peuˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Ruˉhtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ taˇ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le, ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai leh nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ suh-e kuiˬ lo ngaˬ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ suh tuˬ yoˬ. Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ruˉhtaˆ yawˇ geh kʼai tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ Nawˉmi‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˍ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ anˇ jaˇ leh, Chi ve ma Nawˉmi‸ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Nawˉmi‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ Nawˉmi‸ teh‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ Maˍraˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, ngaˬ geh mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ leh tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ Nawˉmi‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Nawˉmi‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma Ruˉhtaˆ Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˬ tanˬ gʼeu‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Nawˉmi‸ ve awˬ hpawˇ Eˇliˇmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Bawˇzaˆ hpeh‸ leh, paw sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ Ruˉhtaˆ Nawˉmi‸ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ ti mi hkʼaw lo shu baˬ taˍ ve caˬ nu ca gʼawˆ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ caˬ nu gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬyoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼai loˬ, teh‸ Nawˉmi‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Ruˉhtaˆ tawˆ kʼai leh shu ve ti mi hkʼaw sheˆ taˍ ve caˬ nu ca gʼawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ti mi oˇ ve lehˬ, Bawˇzaˆ ve ti mi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw Bawˇzaˆ awˬ to oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ti mi hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve a shu le, teh‸ yawˇ ve kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma Nawˉmi‸ geh kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sheˆ taˍ ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ shawˉ teˇ na‸ ka‸ laˬ leh, caˬ nu gʼawˆ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ teˇ hkui gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Shu ve ti mi hkʼaw taˇ kʼai loˬ. Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ ve ti mi hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te-o.

Yawˇ hui kanˉ hkʼaˬ lo te chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼo taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ ca nyiˉ dawˬ-o‸, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Ruˇhtaˆ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi taw taw ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve le, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Bawˇzaˆ kʼaw‸yaw hkʼaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ suh-e ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ pa nawˬ e leh nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, nawˬ teˇ pawˆ kaˬ maˇ gaˬ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬbon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ gʼaˇ ca va la ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Ruˇhta‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ruˉhtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te maˇ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi taw taw na sha ve tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw sha gʼuˇ caˇ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Ngaˬ geh awˍ mui caˇ la-o, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh awˍ ca mui caˇ ve yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ yawˇ hta‸ caˇ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ awˍ chiˇ teˇ hpaˍ beˆ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˍ caˇ taˉ peuˬ leh Ruˉhtaˆ kanˉ ca te kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh-o. Caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo sheˆ taˍ ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh-o.
Maˇ law‸ sheˍ ve kʼo, caˬ kʼa‸ hkʼaw ve caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼawˬ tawˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ti mi hkʼaw sheˆ taˍ ve caˬnu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼawˆ taˍ ve caˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jaw‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, caˬ shiˍ 3 panˇ hkʼe gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh caˬ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ pfuhˇ kʼo‸-e leh yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sha gʼuˇ htaˇ caˇ leuˉ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Nawˉmi‸ lehˬ, Caˬ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ve le. A shu ve ti mi hkʼaw nawˬ ca gʼawˆ-e ve le. Nawˬ hta‸ caˬ nu gʼawˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ Bawˇzaˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw ca gʼawˆ taˍ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Nawˉmi‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw leh suh peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ, Caˬ gʼeu‸ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve ti mi hkʼaw caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ ca gʼawˆ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˉmi‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw ceh tiˉ nawˬ caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ ca gʼawˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Shu ve ti mi hkʼaw ca gʼawˆ ve kʼo, shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, caˬ gʼeu‸ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ Bawˇzaˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw lo caˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma geh ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw Nawˉmi‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yehˬ kʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca laˇ shaˍ.
Nawˬ kanˉ te chehˇ ve ti mi shehˍ hpaˇ Bawˇzaˆ chi hpaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Hkʼe te leh na sheˍ. Ya‸ puiˉ yawˇ caˬ jaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ hehˉ leh, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ awˬ hkiˇ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ caˬ jaw‸ chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ hta‸ taˇ shiˍ tcuh.

Yawˇ zuh‸ kuiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ leh, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve aˉ boˆ hta‸ yehˬ baˬ leh yawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo ca lo‸ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Ruˉhtaˆ caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Bawˇzaˆ caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˬ hpoˆ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo zuh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Ruˉhtaˆ a yehˉ jiˆ kʼai leh, aˉ boˆ hta‸ yehˬ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo lo‸ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ nawˇ la leh, yawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ a shu le, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Ruˉhtaˆ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ heuˆ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve a‸ kehˉ, chi beu‸ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ paw sha ve chaw haˉ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ heuˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Ruˉhtaˆ-oˬ, taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi cawˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ puiˉ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ naˍ, ca na nyi shaˍ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo zuh‸ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Ruˉhtaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ tu-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo Bawˇzaˆ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ tcuh piˇ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo hpe hkʼawˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ uˉ nyiˉ hpe hkʼawˇ piˇ leh, Bawˇzaˆ yawˇ hta‸ caˬ shiˍ hkaw‸ panˇ nyiˉ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ruˉhta‸ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, Ruˉhtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Ruˉhtaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ maˇ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ. Caˬ shiˍ chi ve hta‸ pfuhˇ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Nawˉmi‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ruˉhtaˆ-oˬ, kanˉ chi ve peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law taˍ-o‸. Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ ya‸ nyi kanˉ chi hta‸ maˇ te peuˬ ve ceh ceh yawˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ, shu hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˆmaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hpaˇ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo ca mui la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo ca mui ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo mui tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mui peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hpaˇ hta‸ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Nawˉmi‸ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ Eˇliˆmaˍlehˆ ve ti mi hta‸ hawˇ gaˇ ve ceˇ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ dawˇ nyi piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ vuiˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, choˬ kaˬ lo mui taˍ ve chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ vuiˬ yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ maˇ vuiˬ gaˇ ve kʼo ka‸, chi beu‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Nawˬ maˇ vuiˬ gaˇ kʼo, ngaˬ vuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ vuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Bawˇzaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ Nawˉmi‸ ve ti mi hta‸vuiˬ ve kʼo, Mawˇ baˆ chaw Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa vuiˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ vuiˬ-o. Ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ vuiˬ taˍ ka‸, ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ taˬ. Nawˬ vuiˬ-o‸, teh‸ Bawˇ zaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, mawˇ hawˇ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ leh vuiˬ paˍ hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve awˬ liˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te htaˇ heh‸, Mawˇ vuiˬ cheˆ da‸ peuˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ vuiˬ loˬ, teh‸ Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, Bawˇzaˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa mui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Nawˉmi‸ geh cawˬ ve Eˇliˆmaˍlehˆ, Hkiˍlonˍ leh Maˍlonˍ hui ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ vuiˬ yuˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Maˍlonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬvuiˬ yuˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Raˍhkeˍlaˆ leh Leˉaˍ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ awˬ pon yaˇ maˇ maˇ paw la piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ htawˇ yaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw sha jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ cuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ leh Taˍmaˍ hui ve yaˇ Hpaˍrehˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Bawˇzaˆ lehˬ Ruˉhtaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, Ruˉhtaˆ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ Nawˉmi‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hawehˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ peuˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ leh yaˇ paˍ suhˍ gʼaˇ te gʼa ve kanˉ a‸ kehˉ yawˇ leuˉ leh kanˉ te gʼa maˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hawehˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ peuˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ mawˇ la htaˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Nawˉmi‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Nawˉmi‸ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ taˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ Awˇbehˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˉmi‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui shu hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ toˇ ve yoˬ. Awˇbehˆ lehˬ, Yeˍsehˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Hpaˍrehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hpaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍronˍ yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍronˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Aˍranˍ yoˬ. Aˍranˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ yoˬ.
Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Naˍsonˍ yoˬ. Naˍsonˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Saˍlaˍmonˍ yoˬ.
Saˍlaˍmonˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Bawˇzaˆ yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Awˇbehˆ yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yeˍsehˇ yoˬ. Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ meh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Zuˇhpaˆ, Tawˇhuˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Eˇliˇhuˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yeˍyawˇ hanˍ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Haˍnaˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Peˍniˇnaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Peˍniˇnaˆ lehˬ yaˇ cawˬ leh, Haˍnaˆ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ lehˬ, teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo tu leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Hawˇhpaˍniˆ leh Hpiˇneˍhaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Eˇliˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve teˇ pawˆ le le, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Peˍniˇnaˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍnaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yaˇ hu yaˇ paw tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Haˍnaˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍnaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yaˇ hu yaˇ paw tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ ve pa taw, Peˍniˇnaˆ lehˬ Haˍnaˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh Haˍnaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ le le yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Peˍniˇ naˆ lehˬ Haˍnaˆ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te piˇ ve pa taw, Haˍnaˆ lehˬ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ lehˬ, Haˍnaˆ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, teˇ nyi htaˇ yawˇ hui caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍnaˆ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍnaˆ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Haˍnaˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh bon lawˬ chehˇ leh, Eˇliˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve meuˇ guiˬ naˇ naˇ te chehˇ ve htawˇ, awˬ hkawˇ maˇ tawˆ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˆ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ leh,
Nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw tzuhˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Nawˬ ve tzuhˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hto piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw luˬ ma hpeh‸ ve teh‸ a ciˉ taˇ dawˇ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, bon chi hkʼe te lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇ lehˬ, Gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw kʼo‸-e loˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ nawˬ geh gaˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ tawˆ kʼai leh, caˇ tuˬ kʼaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ haˍ-o.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ na‸ tu leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Haˍnaˆ geh zuh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ yaˇ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ Haˍnaˆ maˇ kʼai. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ cuˉ hpaˆ piˇ peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, oˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te leh nawˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ cuˉ hpaˆ piˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, aˉ hkʼaw lo chehˉ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Haˍnaˆ aˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ cuˉ hpaˆ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. A sha‸ 3 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh, junˍ meu-e teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ, leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇliˆ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Haˍnaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ choˬ kaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yaˇ paˍ chi Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Haˍnaˆ bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ la piˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼuiˬ yawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ hui tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh taˇ kʼaw‸ yaw chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la peuˬ.

Paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ gʼaˇ ga caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ meu‸-o. Chaw meh ma lehˬ, chi beu‸ yaˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ cawˬ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ e lehˬ, chi beu‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa leh, a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ haˍ gʼawˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ paw sha piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Je‸ meu-e hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ cawˍ tu piˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ kanˇ paˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ leh, paw hkuˇ Eˇliˆ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh lawˬ yuˬ cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui maˇ ca. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ luˉ kʼu lonˉ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, shu shaˍ caˉ taˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw beˆ gʼawˆ ve yoˬ.

Luˉ kʼu hkʼaw hkʼa nyiˉ gʼa veu laˇ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ la ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe tiˉ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh maˇ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, paw hkuˇ ve awˬ ceˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve geh laˬ leh, Paw hkuˇ hta‸ piˬ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shaˍ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ caˉ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼe te leh, shaˍ awˬ tcuhˇ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ awˬ chu hta‸ awˉ lawˉ tanˇ piˇ shaˍ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe yuˬ kʼai-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, paw hkuˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ, Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ shaˍ awˉ lawˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh lu yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ ehˉ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veuˬ deh leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ pon aˉ po‸ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hkʼoˆ tawˉ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ paˍ chi awˬ tan, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ awˬ nu ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Haˍnaˆ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ leh yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˆ lehˬ, chi beu‸ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca zuh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa kaˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve le. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn, shu ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, oˇ hkʼe taˇ kʼaw‸ te-o. Nawˬ hui awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, na sha ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ a shu suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ pa maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ uiˍ la chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ chaw yaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ Eˇliˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Hpaˍ rawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to yawˇ hta‸ maw piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼo, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ caˇ tuˬ ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve le. Eˇliˆ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ taˍ uiˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ caˇ tcuh ve le.

Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nyi loˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mawˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ mehˆ cuˉ kʼai leh dawˇ law tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ Hawˇhpaˍniˆ leh Hpiˇneˍhaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ, teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, ngaˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kanˉ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.

A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ sheˍ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh hpu leh caˇ tuˬ gʼa ca lawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon, paw hkuˇ hta‸ ga piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa ca lawˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ Eˇliˆ awˬ hawˉ chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui maˇ gʼa kaˇ. Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo htawˇ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, Eˇliˆ yawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ leh, mehˆ ka‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ mawˬ-o.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ taˍ ve kawˆ faiˇ htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh,

Eˇliˆ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ Eˇliˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ kuˬ. Ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼo‸-e leh ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw piˇ jaw ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha kuˬ chehˇ ve teh‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ tu leh Eˇliˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ kuˬ. Ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tu leh Eˇliˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼo piˇ ve, Kʼo‸-e leh ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, tawˇ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ na chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha laˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ lehˬ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ-oˬ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Tawˇ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ na chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ Eˇliˆ ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Eˇliˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ tawˍ taˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇliˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve htawˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve venˇbaˆ chi hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ tu leh, bon yehˬ ve yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Eˇliˆ hta‸ yawˇ hto piˇ maˇ haˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ htawˇ, Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ taˇ faˉ taˍ. Yawˇ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ faˉ taˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ le le hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇbaˍneˍzaˍ venˇ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhpehˆ venˇ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ hoˆ bawˆ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 4,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ tcuh laˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca taˆ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca taˆ-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Eˇliˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Hawˇhpaˍniˆ leh Hpiˇneˍhaˆ htawˇ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼaˇ hte‸ hpoˆ kuˬ ve pa taw, miˬ hiˆ la ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gaˬ la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hui gʼa shonˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ chi hkʼe teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw a shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼaw awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ma‸ bawˆ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, chi beu‸ Heˍbrehˇ chaw ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼaw ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 30,000 gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ taˍ kʼoˍ htawˇ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ kʼai leh, Eˇliˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Hawˇhpaˍniˆ leh Hpiˇneˍhaˆ htawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
