Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, oˇ ve teˇ nyi ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tu leh Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˆ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw ceˍ lo yawˇ ve mui hkʼawˇ hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ lawn dawˇ nyi leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˆ lehˬ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn Eˇliˆ hta‸ hto‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
(Eˇliˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ 98 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, mehˆ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ-o.)
Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ le, teh‸ Eˇliˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui shonˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Hawˉhpaˍniˆ leh Hpiˇneˍnaˆ htawˇ shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ taˍ kʼoˍ htawˇ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve mui hkʼawˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo an ce ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ leh chu jaˇ ve pa taw, kʼawˍ hteh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hoˉ te ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˆ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma Hpiˇneˍhaˆ miˇ ma lehˬ, yaˇ hu chehˇ leh yaˇ paw tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hui suh peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, la‸ haˉ yaˇ paw sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ leh, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ na.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hui htawˇ suh kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh tawˆ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Iˉhkaˍboˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh tawˆ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇbaˍneˍzaˍ venˇ lo te leh Aˍshoˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha Daˍgonˍ ve bon yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍgonˍ shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ Aˍshoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ cawˍ tu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ paiˍ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ leh la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ paˉ cheˆ kʼai leh, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ce taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Daˍgonˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ naˆ toˇ leh, awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ceh ngaˉ kʼoˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍshoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve Daˍgonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh teh taˍ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼai-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi, ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ chuˇ lonˉ tawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ geh bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ha pa suhˍ maˬ chehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le. Ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ feu ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa piˇ kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa piˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. La‸ shawnˍ maˇ yuˬ kʼai ve kʼo, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼoˬ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ na-e la leh aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma la‸ shawnˍ gʼa piˇ kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, shi shaˉ chuˇ awˬ han teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ leh shi faˆ cha‸ awˬ han teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ gʼa te leh gʼa piˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ chi ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve naˬ beuˬ lehˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ chehˇ ve shaˉ chuˇ leh faˆ cha‸ chi ve nyiˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ nawˬ hui te leh, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ hehˉ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Hpaˍrawˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ kʼaˍ jaˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nuˇ lawˬ maˇ gʼawˬ jaw sheˍ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ nyiˇ hkeh leh, nuˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Nuˇ ma peuˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ gʼawˬ tcuh leh, awˬ yehˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw gʼa‸ haw taˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw keu leh, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo teh taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ peu-o.

Nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hpawˇ kʼai ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve Behˆseˍ mehˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo maˇ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼoˆ gaˬ la chehˇ ve naˬ beuˬ chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve naˬ beuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nuˇ ma peuˍ nyiˇ hkeh yuˬ leh, nuˇ lawˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw gʼa‸ haw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ leh shi faˆ cha‸, shi shaˉ chuˇ awˬ han keu taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ ma oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh lehˬ Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo hteˇ lehˍ kʼai leh, kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Behˆseˍmehˆ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw caˬ gʼeu‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chiˇ nyi leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ ve ti mi lo gaˬ htaˇ, haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nuˇ lawˬ hta‸ dawˆpaˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ leh la‸ shawnˍ keu taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ hta‸ chiˇ tawˆ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve 5 gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi taˉ leh Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ awˬ pon shi shaˉ chuˇ awˬ han ngaˇ maˬ te leh, Aˍshoˆ venˇ, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ leh Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ awˬ tan Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ shi faˆ cha‸ awˬ han htawˇ te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ gʼaˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve venˇ leh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, tanˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ leh, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ca hpaw nyi ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw 70 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ a shu huˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui geh maˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yeˍrenˍ venˇ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ feu laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ca yuˬ la-o, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍrenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ ve yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh leh, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, Yaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼe chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la gaˇ ve kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha leh, Aˍshaˆ taˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha leh Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ yuˬ leh tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngeuˍ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ caˇ tuˬ ce leh, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ)

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve 5 gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ shiˍ veu laˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh laˬ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon ga lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, Behˆkaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ leh Shenˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˇ duˇ ti leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇbaˍneˍzaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui shonˇ kʼai leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw awˬ kaˍ lo htawˇ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ lehˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ ca jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Yawˇlaˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Aˍbiˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ awˬ pa hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Hpu gʼa kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ tiˉ ca leh, shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ maˇ jehˬ piˇ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ leh,

Nyi loˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mawˇ la peuˬ leh, nawˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ te ve hkʼe maˇ te. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ jawˇmawˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, ma‸ yaˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpawˇ kanˉ te tcuh leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ paˍ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh leh, teˇ hpaˍhpaˍ hta‸ chaw ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ gʼa mehˇ leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼa gʼeu‸ jaw‸ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ leh yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ hawnˉ gʼa te piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa te caˍ te taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve ti mi, a pehˉ meuˇ hko, shaˍlonˍ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ pon yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve ceˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui leuˆyuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui htawˇ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ jawˇmawˇ cawˬ la leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui kʼo ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Kiˇshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍhpiˆ, Beˍhkawˇraˆ, Zeˍyawˍ, Aˍbiˍlaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kiˇshaˆ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Sawˇlu‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hkʼe taw da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ teˇ jaˆ hkʼe mvuh ve yoˬ.
Kiˇshaˆ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh piˉ laˬ hta‸ ca nyi-o, teh‸ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Shaˍliˇshaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ piˉ laˬ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Saˍ lehnˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ca maˇ mawˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca nyi kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ca maˇ mawˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Zuˇhpaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Hkeu‸, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ aˉ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ. Ngaˬ pa lehˬ piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ haˍ leh, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ chehˇ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ kʼoˆ ve, Law sheˍ. Venˇ chi hkʼaw da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh yawˆ yan chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca na nyi shaˍ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ piˉ laˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca-e tuˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˇ lu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ geh kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa piˇ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh caˇ tuˬ ka‸ peuˬ-oˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ la‸ shawnˍ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ, Cho-e‸, ngaˬ geh lo hpu ngaˇ muˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hpu chi yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ piˉ laˬ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hto laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˇlu‸ lehˬ, Hkʼe yoˬ kʼo da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ kai-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw oˇ ve chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ venˇ lo taˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo la ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Mawˬ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ aw laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

(Aˬ sho-eˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ na nyi tuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, Ngaˬ hui mawˬ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˬ sho-eˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸, Mawˬ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇ-a‸, yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi loˬ, chi beu‸ yawˇ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haˆ kʼai loˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ nyi hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ chi beu‸ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo awˍ maˇ ca caˇ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˍ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ bon gʼa na‸ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ heh‸, hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haˆ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ venˇ hkʼaw kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍmoeˍ laˆ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Sawˇlu‸ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ ve awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ chi hpaˇ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˇlu‸ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh jiˆ kʼai leh, Mawˬ puiˉ ve chaw hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ mawˬ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ geh awˍ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ heh‸, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ ve shehˆ nyi htaˇ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, piˉ laˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui heuˆ gaˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve chaw a shu le. Nawˬ leh nawˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˇlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve yehˬ kʼa htawˇ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe yaw laˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ bawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo mui tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkehˉ chaw 30 gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˍ te paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˍ te paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve pfuhˬ teh teˇ paˉ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, Sawˇlu‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ teh piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo nawˬ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ gaˬ la peuˬ. Caˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ kuˬ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh nawˬ awˍ gʼa caˇ tuˬ, caˇ tuˬ chi ve nawˬ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi Sawˉlu‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh teˇ geh awˍ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo tu leh venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pon zuh‸ kuiˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu piˇ leh,

yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Tu loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ tu la leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ven ˇ baˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai taˍ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ teˇ hkui chehˇ taˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ shaˍ, teh‸ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu keu taˍ ve kaw hta‸ yuˬ leh Sawˉlu‸ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ heˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Zeˍlaˍzeˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍhkeˍlaˆ ve tuˍ hpfuh lo gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve nawˬ pa ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ mawˬ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ pa lehˬ piˉ laˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve a‸ kehˉ nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼai leh Taˍbawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ ehˉ 3 hkeh pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ shehˆ diˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ la‸ kʼawˍ caˉ laˇ leh, hkaoˍmonˇ nyiˇ diˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve hkʼaw pui lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ tinˍ hteˆ, cehnˍ dawˆ, lehˉ lu meuˆ leh hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui geh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh chaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe te-o.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ law taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ laˬ leh nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te kʼai tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw biˇ la ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ moˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, yawˇ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Kiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ chi hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸-oˬ ve le. Sawˉlu‸ chi tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ la-oˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˍ, a shu le. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ la-oˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh kuˬ toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve le, teh‸ Sawˇlu‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ piˉ laˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ca maˇ mawˬ ve pa taw Saˍ moeˍlaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Piˉlaˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, bon pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Miˆsaˍ paˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw leh nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shawˍ leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ku‸ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kuˬ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Maˍtaˍriˆ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Maˍtaˍriˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Kiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ aˬ laˬ hkʼe teˇ jaˆ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw chi hpaˇ yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼe ve chaw ngaˬ hui geh teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn chaw chi ma ve hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, li‸ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keh leh da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ htawˇ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ha‸ hanˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ piˇ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ha pa teˇ maˬ hkʼe gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw Naˍhaˆ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Yaˍbehˆ venˇ lo yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ laˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Naˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Naˍhaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te leh nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve la‸ sha paˉ mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, nawˬ hui geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ lawn chi ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo ca hto maˍ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ yanˇ 7 nyi pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ca ga laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ veu laˇ leh ti mi hkʼaw kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nuˇ paˍ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ tawˆ hpoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo feu kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tawˇ shanˍ feu leh kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉlu‸ leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hkʼaˇ suh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼai ve chaw lehˬ, nuˇ chi hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ ve nuˇ hta‸ htawˇ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Beˍzehˆ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 3 shehnˉ gʼaˇ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw 3 meunˍ gʼaˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ la paˇ neˇ kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Naˍhaˆ hta‸, Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shehˆ moˍ pehˬ leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ suh leh cawˬ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˬ miˇ tawˬ hkʼaˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh maˇ keunˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw a shu le. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ya‸ nyi chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Ya‸ nyi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te tcuh-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ tcuhˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, Sawˉlu‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ mawˇ la peuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ nehˬ htaˇ ka‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve cawˬ kʼo, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha leh yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ venˇbaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ve nuˇ leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh hkeh yuˬ taˍ ve cawˬ aw laˇ. Ngaˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve leh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve cawˬ jaw laˇ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ geh ngaˬ la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve cawˬ aw laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te taˍ ve cawˬ kʼo, ngaˬ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve awˬ pon awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ heˍ caˇ laˇ jaw leh, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ jaw. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh ka‸ mawˇ maˇ lawˬ yuˬ jaw, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha leh yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui huˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hkʼa deh‸ huˉ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆkʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ shaˍ.

Yaˍkoˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, Eˇjiˇ tu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇ lehˬ Haˍ zawˇ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha leh Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ Yeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, Baˍrehˆ, Yeˍ hpaˍtaˆ leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hui hta‸ peu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmonˍ jawˇmawˇ Naˍhaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi loˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lawˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ geh chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hkʼa deh‸ huˉ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ te maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ lehˬ mvuhˇ goˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ bon lawˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui jawˇmawˇ lawˬ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ awˬ bon te leh nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu venˇbaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ lawˬ ve hkʼaw venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ te peuˬ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˇ baˬ. Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.

Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh taˇ kʼai. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ puiˉ leh, ponˬ laˇ maˇ puiˉ. Aw lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ pon uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh te kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ 3,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ 2,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ geh teˇ geh Miˆmaˆ venˇ leh Beˍteˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ 1,000 gʼa hta‸ Beˍyaˬmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ geh chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo laˬ tuˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo nuˇ hkaw ca meuˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo Sawˇlu‸ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 30,000 leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 6,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Beˍtaˍvenˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Miˆmaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui haˉ kʼoˍ, haˉ hpawˇ leh nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e leh Gaˆ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kaw ˆcheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo maˇ laˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ geh lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬhkʼe te ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe haˆ maˇ gaˬ la ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Miˆmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa na nyi sheˍ teh‸ dawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve, Nawˬ te ve kanˉ lehˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ caˉ leh gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ca leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼaw nyi leh, ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ ceh cawˬ taˉ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇ liˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Miˆmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shehˆ moˍ pehˬ leh tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ moˍ lehˬ Shuˇ-aˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Awˇhpaˍraˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai leh,
awˬ nu ve teˇ moˍ lehˬ Zeˍbonˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ca liˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui hta‸ aˉhtaw leh gehˇ te yehˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ.
(Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve laˇ hpuiˇ, ceˉ ceˇ, ciˉ kʼoˆ, leh law‸ kʼawˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu shoˆ tuˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui geh gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ceˉ ceˇ leh law‸ kʼawˉ gu shoˆ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, teˇ hteh‸ hkʼe gʼa piˇ leh, laˇ hpuiˇ leh ciˉ kʼoˆ gu shoˆ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ lehˬ 2 hteh‸ hkʼe gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ maˇ heˆ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ aˉhtaw leh gehˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Miˆmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ lawn chi Yawˇnaˆ tanˍ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ.
Sawˇlu‸ lehˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Miˆgonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo aˉ ci ku cehˬ hawˉ deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

(Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve Eˇliˆ leh Hpiˇneˍhaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Iˉhkaˍboˆ awˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍhiˆtaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.) Yawˇnaˆ tanˍ tawˆ kʼai ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ lehˬ Bawˇzehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, teˇ maˬ lehˬ, Seˍneˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ lehˬ kʼaˍ le‸ awˬ na hpawˇ Miˆmaˆ venˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, teˇ maˬ lehˬ kʼaˍ le‸ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Geˍbaˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ. Yawˇ ga laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve ka‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh shaw chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ to ca maw piˇ shaˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ teˇ hkui law taˍ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ law taˍ piˇ-a.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh taˆ la tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui geh kai-a. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ kuiˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Heˍbrehˇ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui va‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Choˬ kaˬ lo taˆ la-o. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ yawˇ hui geh gaˆ taˆ-e leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ lehˬ, caˬ nyiˇ hpoˆ miˬ hkʼe hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chaw 20 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shaw chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ta‸ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬ htawˇ hiˆ la leh chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw shaw chehˇ ve Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, A shu mehˉ kʼai ve naˍ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Aˍbiˇyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Sawˉlu‸ paw hkuˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shaˬ te shaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Teˇ hkui law sheˍ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Hpiˇ liˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, awˬ chawˇ chawˇ kʼaw‸ chaw da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ pawnˇ la ve yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo ca va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ ya‸ la leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ga gʼa‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Baˍtaˍvenˍ venˇ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Sawˉ lu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ya‸ nyi caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ caˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suhˆ tsuh cawˬ kuiˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ tsuh cawˬ kuiˬ lo pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉ lu‸ hkeu ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ caˇ maˇ haˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve gehˇ tuˇ pehˇ nawˉ diˬ hkʼaw juˆ keu leh oˇ kaˬ lo ngawˉ taˍ ve pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ biˇ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le htawˇ awˬ meu‸ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ pa lehˬ, Ya‸ nyi caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve chaw hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ kanˉ te kʼo hkʼa deh‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ a ciˉ gʼa caˇ leh hkʼaˬ ma awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la peuˬ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ.

Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ canˇ paˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu yawˇ pfuhˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hkʼaˬ ma ma hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˆmaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh Aˍjaˍlonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh awˍ meu‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh bawˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve yawˬ leh nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, awˬ suhˍ geh teˇ geh caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ geh kʼai leh, Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ geh teˇ geh caˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ geh haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hpfuhˆ veu laˇ-oˆ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa‸ veu laˇ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ geh teˇ geh caˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ, nuˇ, yawˬ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ leh gʼa te caˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ hui nuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa‸ veu laˇ leh tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˇlu‸ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ te ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Hkeu‸, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˉ lawˉ na nyi shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Sawˉlu‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi a shu teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ te taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ hpawnˬ la-o.

Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ awˬ to ka‸ venˇbaˆ te taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇnaˆ tanˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ choˬ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, Uˇrenˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, Tuˇmenˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh Sawˉlu‸ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawˇ lo venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ve le, teh‸ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ a ciˉ caˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ suh tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw moˍ lonˉ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ mvuh ka‸ maˇ gʼa mehˉ piˇ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi yawˇ te peuˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh te taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ htawˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ-o. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw, Aˍmonˍ chaw, Eˇdonˍ chaw, Zawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇti‸ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ ca bawˆ ve teˇ pawˆ le le yawˇ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ leh Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ, Iˉsaˍviˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇshaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˍraˆ leh Miˇhkaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Aˍhiˆmanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pa Kiˇshaˆ leh Aˍbaˍnaˍ awˬ paˍ Neˍraˆ lehˬ Aˍbiˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co, yawˇ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ha‸ hanˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ ca pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ na sheˍ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmaˍ lehˆ chaw hui yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ chi beu‸ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chiˉ ka‸ taˇ teh taˉ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, yaˇ ehˉ, nuˇ, yawˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ leh piˉ laˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Teˍlenˍ venˇ lo kuˬ yuˬ leh gʼaw nyi ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ 200,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ ma yaˇ 10,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui ve venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw va‸ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Keˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui maˇ suh gaˇ ve kʼo, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui geh taˇ hkaw‸ chehˇ. Yawˇ hui geh tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬhkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Keˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Haˍviˇlaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Shuˉraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Aˍgaˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍgaˆ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve nuˇ, yawˬ, teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Ngaˬ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ htawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ haˉ pui shiˍ duˇ ti taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ gʼa kʼaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Sawˇlu‸ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ-o‸, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chi beu‸ nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Sawˇlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui geh yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve nuˇ, yawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te luˬ te sheˆ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Pehˇ-o, taˇ kʼoˆ loˬ. Aˉ nyi haˉ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ dawˇ i gaˇ i chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ leh,
haiˬ jaˇ ve Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ na yuˬ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, mawˆ jeˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ kʼai leh, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍgaˆ hta‸ hpeh veu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve le. Na yuˬ ve hta‸ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ, shu hta‸ neˇ pi pfuhˍ ve chaw hkʼe taw venˇbaˆ uiˍ leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw htawˇ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hkʼe taw venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ leh nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ leuˉ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa te tcuh piˇ peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sawˇlu‸ lehˬ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ gʼa‸ tcuhˆ ve pa taw, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve tzuh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve chaw hta‸ piˇ peuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, maˇ heˍ puiˉ leh nyi ma htawˇhpfuhˆnawˬhpfuhˆ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve nyi ma htawˇhpfuhˆnawˬhpfuhˆ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi teˇ pawˆ ceh kʼaw‸ taˍ uiˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼo‸-e leh, Sawˉlu‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Aˍgaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ geh lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍgaˆ lehˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve aˉhtaw lehˬ yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ yaˇ maˇ cawˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ ve awˬ e lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ Aˍgaˆ hta‸ peuˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tcuh peuˬ ve pa taw, hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ maw maw dawˇ haˍ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍsehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw geh kʼai peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chi hkʼe te hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh yuˬ veu leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yeˍsehˇ hta‸ htawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve ngaˬ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ naˍ manˇ gʼa pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ ve cheˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw ca guiˇ la ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ leh ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍsehˇ leh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te tcuh leh yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gaˬ la leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍbaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Choˬ kaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw chi hpaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ to mvuh leh awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ taˇ nyi. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui nyi ve hkʼe nyi ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ hta‸ hpawˇ ve awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ hta‸ ceh nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma hta‸ nyi ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ hta‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw chi ve hpaˇ ka‸ maˇ heˆ sheˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Shaˍmaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmoeˍ laˆ lehˬ, Chi hpaˇ hta‸ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ leuˆ yuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ suhˍ gʼaˇ hkʼa gaˬ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ leuˆ yuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yeˍsehˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ leh teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ca hawˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Yeˍsehˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw chi hpaˇ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmoeˍ laˆ Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Sawˉlu‸ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha yawˇ geh chehˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ laˇ ve kʼo, tinˍ hteˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca leh nawˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ tinˍ hteˆ maˍ laˇ kʼo nawˬ nyi ma kʼaw‸ sha la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Tinˍ hteˆ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ca leh ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ, tinˍ hteˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve, ha‸ hanˉ ve leh tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Yeˍsehˇ geh tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh, Yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ ve nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw, aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hkeh leh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh taˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ Sawˉlu‸ geh gaˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Yeˍsehˇ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha Sawˉlu‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve tinˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh hteˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha tawˆ kʼai leh, Sawˉlu‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ sha la ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Suˇkoˆ venˇ lo ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hpoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui laˬ leh, Suˇkoˆ leh Aˍzeˍkaˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Daˍmenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˍlaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸bawˆ da‸ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ choˬ paˉ coˇ paˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw Gawˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tanˬ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkaw‸ shaw‸ hpaˆ mvuh leh,
yawˇ hkʼawˆ taˍ ve kuiˇ uˉ tcuhˍ leh kuiˇ veu‸ kʼaˇ lehˬ, 40 cawehˬ hkʼe hawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ htawˇ kuiˇ beh taˍ leh, kuiˇ te taˍ ve gehˇ teˇ maˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve gehˇ tuˇ lehˬ, hpa chiˇ ve taˉ behˆ hkʼe hui cawˬ leh, gehˇ lehˬ 6 cawehˬ hkʼe hawˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ pfuhˇ leh yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gawˇliˇya‸ huˉ taˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ huiˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ venˇ yaˇ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ pa Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 8 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Shaˍmaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ leh hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ shehˆ gʼaˇ Sawˉlu‸ geh chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Daˍviˆ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo teˇ hkui teˇ hkui kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ awˬ pa ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ca ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gawˇliˇya‸ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˇ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ pawˆ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ teˇ pawˆ kuˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yeˍsehˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Sha ma hu taˍ ve teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ leh hkaoˍ monˉ teˇ chi shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai-o.

Nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ awˬ diˬ chi ve teˇ chi shiˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ ca nyi leh, yawˇ hui chehˇ sha chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸, nawˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇlaˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ tu leh, yawˬ hawˉ tuˬ ve chaw ca taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh bawˆ da‸ tuˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ yuˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, caˇ tuˬha‸ shaˉ ve awˬ hoˉ hta‸ a‸ piˇ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn ca na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˇ yaw da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ Gawˇliˇya‸ tawˆ la leh, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ deˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ na‸ uˉ te da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ htawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ ceˇ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ ka‸ maˇ keu tcuh ceˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve chaw aˬ hto‸ ma la‸ shawnˍ gʼa tuˬ ve le. Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw oˇ ve a shu le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ Eˇlaˍbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ shu hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu hawˉ chehˇ taˉ ve le. Nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ leh choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ deˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ ve le. Ngaˬ shu hta‸ tawˇ yaw da‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ leh laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ ca kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa na nyi ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ te maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te bawˆ tuˬ le. Nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ ehˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ te laˬ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, yehˬ miˉ tawˍ teˇ hkeh yawˬ hta‸ ca che‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ,

ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ leh yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, yehˬ miˉ tawˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ che‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh yehˬ miˉ tawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ jaw peuˬ. Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh yehˬ miˉ tawˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ ve hkʼe, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
