Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Hkʼe kʼo da‸-aˬ. Nawˬ kʼai loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kuiˇ te taˍ ve uˉ tcuhˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ leh, kuiˇ te taˍ ve aˉ po‸ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉhtaw lonˉ hta‸ taˆ leh, ya‸ kʼaw juˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ veu‸ jaw ve pa taw, Veu‸ kʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬleh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ ehˉ hkʼaw da‸ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ ngaˇ shiˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve miˉ chaw hkʼaw keu ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hawˉ ma hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gawˉliˉya‸ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve Daˍviˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ pfuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ, yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼuiˬ yawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ paˍ ehˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˉ du taˬ oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma te tuˬ awˬ pon le. Ngaˬ lehˬ hpuiˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuˇ suhˍ jiˆ laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ aˉhtaw leh gehˇ pfuhˇ veu laˇ leh ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˆ cheˆ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, aˉhtaw leh gehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ loˍ ve awˬ lawn, ya‸ nyi choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gawˇliˇyaˆ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve miˉ chaw hkʼaw haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ shiˍ hkaˆ yuˬ leh, Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ bawˆ hpehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve Gawˇliˇya‸ ve naˍ kʼa‸ pui hta‸ heuˆ leh, yawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ aˉhtaw maˇ cawˬ. Hawˉ ma hta‸ yehˇ leh Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ bawˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Gawˇliˇya‸ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ huˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gawˇliˇya‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˉ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ suh-e ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ leh Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shaˍrenˍ, Gaˍtaˆ leh Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kaw hpuiˇ lo te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ hui ve fa la teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gawˇliˇya‸ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gawˇliˇya‸ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yaˇ paˍ-oˇ ve a shu ve yaˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ kʼai leh ca chaˬ nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbaˍnaˍ yawˇ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ a shu ve yaˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˇlu‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ leh Daˍviˆ na‸ uˉ te da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe Daˍviˆ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ yawˇ geh ceh tiˉ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ veu‸ chehˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ leh Daˍviˆ hta‸ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ ve aˉhtaw, hkaˆ leh haˍ pi caˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ hkʼa te tcuh ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te piˇ ve pa taw, Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ leh ma‸ poˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tinˍ hteˆ, kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma maˇ sha. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ chaw awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha Sawˉlu‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe tinˍ hteˆ chehˇ leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ juˆ pehˍ shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ gehˇ nyiˇ pawˆ yuˬ baˬ hpehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ leh, Daˍviˆ geh chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve pa taw, Sawˉlu‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kawˆ la ve yoˬ
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh leh, ma‸ ca bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ ve teˇ pawˆ le le gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ puiˉ jaˇ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ leuˉ leh Daˍviˆ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ma‸ hta‸ bawˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ uiˍ Meˍraˆ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ to Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ Sawˉ lu‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ)
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Daˍviˆ leh, Jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Meˍraˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ Maˍhawˉlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍdreˍlaˆ hta‸ piˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ va htaw leh, yawˇ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ maˉ paˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ lawn chi Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hkʼe ve te‸ chiˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw haˍ chaw gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ gʼa te ve lehˬ sha ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ awˬ pon jawˇmawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ teˇ ha maˬ ceh tiˉ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, Daˍviˆ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉ lu‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw la‸ kʼawˍ toˆ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi maˇ tiˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ,

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw nyiˇ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shawˆ veu laˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ geh chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ htawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ chi teˇ pawˆ Sawˉlu‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ leuˉ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co, yawˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ le le Daˬviˆ lehˬ awˬ nu ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ma‸ bawˆ cheuˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ pa lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ kʼo, nawˬ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ leh, teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo ca va‸ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ va‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ pa geh ngaˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ shiˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ chiˇ mvuhˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ taˇ te piˇ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸ jaw. Yawˇ hkʼa te tawˆ la ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ a sha‸ tanˇ leh Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ geh shiˍ kʼai leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ kanˉ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw shonˇ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ha Sawˉlu‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve tinˍ hta‸ hteˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Daˍviˆ hta‸ baˬ hpehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ. Gʼo‸ pa hta‸ tcuhˉ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ haˉ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, Daˍviˆ ve yehˬ hta‸ ca shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ miˇ ma Miˆhkaˍlaˆ lehˬ, Ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ maˇ hpaw-e ve kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw hpehˇ ce piˇ leh, yawˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ miˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ yuˬ teh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yuˬ te taˍ ve uˉ gehˇ teˇ maˬ yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpawˇ teh leh, aˉ boˆ yuˬ beh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ chehˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ nyi tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to leh yawˇ ve ku-iˍ hta‸ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ lo taˆ veu laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ lo shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpawˇ lo aˉ che‸ awˬ mvuh yuˬ te taˍ ve uˉ gehˇ teˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ te leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve le, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ga piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ geh Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, Sawˇlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Naˍyoˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Naˍyoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca hpeh tcuh ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ shu geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Sawˉ lu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ a ciˉ maˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui htawˇ oˇ kʼa lo shu geh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ awˬ to tu leh Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Seˍkuˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve nanˬ bawˍ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ leh Daˍviˆ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le, teh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Naˍyoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, Naˍyoˆ venˇ hkʼaw kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ awˬ kʼu nyi te zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Sawˉlu‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Naˍyoˆ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ leh, nawˬ pa ngaˬ hta‸ chi taw taw tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le, ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ faˉ taˍ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve nawˬ pa hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ nyi ma luˬ puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ dawˇ hkiˉ ve pa taw yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ aˬ laˬ hkʼe kʼo gʼa suh peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Shawˉ paw kʼo ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ geh gʼa mui caˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ taˉ leh, hpa‸ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hkʼa gaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca va‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa ngaˬ hta‸ ca ve kʼo, Ngaˬ nawˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ taˉ leh Behˍlehˍ hehnˍ venˇ lo ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ a ciˉ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh chi hkʼe a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ. Maˇ heˆ leh ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ pa hta‸ gʼa te tcuh tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe taˇ dawˇ. Ngaˬ pa nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ gaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ pa nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve kʼo, a shu ngaˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto laˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ leh hpa‸ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ pa hta‸ ngaˬ na nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ dawˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ maˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ pa geh chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ geh htawˇ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ piˇ-o. Ngaˬ gʼa suh-e puiˉ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ,
ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ taˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ. Ka ti‸ chi hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ tuˬ ka ti‸ teˇ pawˆkʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo maˇ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ mehˉ kʼai ve hta‸ shu gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Leuˉ leh hpa‸ nyi gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ mehˉ kʼai ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ va‸ taˍ jaw ve haˉ pui hpoˆ oˇ ve awˬ baˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ va‸ taˍ-o‸.
Haˉ pui hpoˆ oˇ ve lo ngaˬ hkaˆ ce shehˆ maˬ bawˆ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkaˆ ce oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ choˬ hpawˇ lo ce taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼawˆ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo nawˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸, Hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo ce taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hpaw-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hpaw-e tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍ viˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ lo laˬ leh,
yawˇ mui jaw kuiˬ gʼo‸ pa paˇ lo mui ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍnaˍ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo mui leh, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh mui ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Sawˉlu‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ. Yawˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ leh teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi htawˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ. Hkʼe te leh Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Daˍviˆ aˉ nyi ya‸ nyi hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ lo maˇ laˬ ve le, teh‸ Yawˆnaˆtanˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ngaˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ leh, ngaˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ viˉ ngaˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ya‸ nyi hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ lo maˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ chaw luˬ paˍ yoˬ. Nawˬ Daˍviˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh, nawˬ e ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co, nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ gʼa te taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh, cho kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ gehˇ yuˬ leh baˬ hpehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pa lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Yawˆnaˆtanˍ tu la leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Daˍviˆ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ bawˆ peu tuˬ ve hkaˆ ce hta‸ ca nyi gʼawˆ-e lo, teh‸ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo bawˆ peu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkaˆ ce oˇ ve ce taˍ kuiˬ lo yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Hkaˆ ce nawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo taˇ huˉ chehˇ. Haˆ ca gʼawˆ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hkaˆ ce hta‸ gʼawˆ veu laˇ leh yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh Daˍviˆ ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ leh aˉ hkʼaw lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve kʼo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ va‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paˍ zuh‸ taˍ leh shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼuˉ da‸ taˍ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ a‸ kehˉ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ leh ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˆnaˆtanˍ htawˇ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Nawˇbaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve kawˆ cheˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ choˬ kaˬ laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ kanˉ tcuh laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma ca te la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ hto piˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma caˇ tuˬ cawˬ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ ngaˇ shiˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ paw hkuˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ geh awˬ nu ve hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ cawˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chi teˇ nyiˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ geh maˇ ca zuh‸ ve kʼo, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui yaˇ miˇ geh maˇ zuh‸. Ngaˬ hui yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe awˬ baˬ hpawˇ tawˆ-e leh kanˉ ca te tuˬ cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ lehˬ, leuˉ leh uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ca te toˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ leuˉ leh da‸ keh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh paw hkuˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ geh cawˬ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ gehˇ sheˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
(Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Sawˉlu‸ nuˇ hawˉ paˍ awˬ hoˉ Eˇdonˍ venˇ yaˇ Dawˇgaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Daˍviˆ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gehˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ maˬ piˇ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸ laˇ. Jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ tawˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ la‸ caˉ maˇ gʼa yuˬ tanˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ Eˇlaˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw Gawˇliˇya‸ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ htaˇ gʼa taˍ ve aˉhtaw oˇ ve ngaˬ geh cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Aˉhtaw oˇ ve hta‸ hpa hkʼa deh‸ hawˆ htiˆ leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve kʼo, yuˬ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ geh aˉhtaw chi teˇ maˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˉhtaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Chi a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai leh, Gaˍtaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkiˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˬhkiˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi ve hpaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼa mui chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve chi hpaˇ hta‸ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkiˆ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˉ hta‸ gaˆ leh, yawˇ ve paˇ tcuhˆ hkʼoˆ lo ciˉ gʼuiˇ shoˇ ya‸ la tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkiˆ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Chaw chi hpaˇ gʼuˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ geh chaw gʼuˇ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chaw gʼuˇ paˍ chi hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ca te sho‸ sha‸ la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Aˍduˆlanˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo va‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw, shu ve jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw, shu hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hoˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh chaw 400 gʼaˇ hkʼe chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ bon te leh ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e hta‸ nawˬ geh a ciˉ chehˇ tcuh taˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh teh taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo taˇ va‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo haˆ kʼai loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ tawˆ kʼai leh, Heˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ hkʼaw lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, hkʼaw pui teˇ maˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve ma‸ kehˇ ceh hawˉ mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo va‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ awˬ pon maˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ ca chehˇ leh, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ venˇ yaˇ Dawˇgaˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Mawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍhiˇtuˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ geh kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ leh Gawˇliˇya‸ ve aˉhtaw yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ paw hkuˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh Nawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw paw hkuˇ hkʼa te chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ htawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ na chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Daˍviˆ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ, aˉhtaw piˇ leh yawˇ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha geh tawˇ yaw piˇ ve le. Chi beu‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ ka‸ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw shu taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ awˬ to maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ maˇ kʼoˆ laˇ cawˇ. Yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ-oˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh yawˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ maˇ haˆ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ Dawˇgaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Dawˇgaˆ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ 85 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ ve venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Nawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh te luˬ te sheˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ gʼuiˇ tawˆ la leh, Daˍviˆ geh ca chehˇ la ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Dawˇgaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa suh ve lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Taˇ kawˆ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka‸, ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ yuˬ la chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yoˬ, nawˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui cho kaˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ka‸ gʼa kawˆjehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Kiˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ-e ve kʼo, naˬ beuˬ hkʼoˆ neˇ shaˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ veu leh Kiˇlaˆ venˇ lo Daˍviˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ ve venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh va yaw taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ gu chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Da‸ ve kehˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ choˬ kaˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca te luˬ la tuˬ gu chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Kiˇlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kiˇlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw teˇ cawˬ haˉ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ziˇhpaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍ viˆ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ chiˇ a‸ piˇ.
Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Ziˇhpaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lonˉ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Hawˉreˍsaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ pa Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te laˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ awˬ hawˉ ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ tuˬ ka ti‸ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ Hawˉreˍsaˆ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ leh, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Ziˇhpaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo Sawˉlu‸ geh kʼai leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve Haˍhkiˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma hpeh yuˬ gaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ hui ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca ga laˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ tehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ hkʼa deh‸ ca kʼaw‸ jaˆ nyi-o. Yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa mawˬ ve, leh yawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca kʼaw‸ cha nyi-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, laˆ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca nyi leh, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ hto laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa gʼa‸ yuˬ ve htawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ Ziˇhpaˆ hteunˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve Mawˇnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Mawˇnaˆ hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haˉ hpawˇ oˇ ve choˬ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haˉ hpawˇ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hoˆ la chehˇ ve pa taw, hpaw tawˆ-e gaˬ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Sawˉlu‸ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, haˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e tuˬ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Hpaˆ da‸ kuiˬ haˉ hpawˇ, teh‸ meh ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˍgaˍdiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ peuˬ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇyanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Eˍgaˍdiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 3 hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Haˇ tawˉ pehˆ haˉ hpawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo yawˬ hkawˆ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ mawˬ leh, haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼaˇ ca jehˇ tuˬ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˬ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi nawˬ awˬ pon da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ a yehˉ yehˉ gaˆ kʼai leh, Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉ po‸ teˇ peˆ nuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe gʼa te peuˬ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ nyi ma maˇ sha.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa te luˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha tawˍ taˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ htawˇ maˇ keunˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ tu leh haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˍ hto‸ ma pa taw, naw lehˬ shu hkawˇ na leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve le.

Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ dawˇ shiˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ te piˇ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw nawˬ ve aˉ po‸ teˇ peˆ yuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ ngaˬ nuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ. Chi lehˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸.

Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸ taˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve kanˉ awˬ pon nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw mawˇ hkawˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ htawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ, suh taˍ ve hpuiˇ leh hpuiˇ she hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ awˬ tehˬ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ ya‸ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi taw taw te piˇ chehˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ haiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ.
Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ hpehˇ peu piˇ jaw le. Nawˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ ve kanˉ chi awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve chi beu‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ shu maˇ gʼa leunˇ kʼai tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ htawˇ, Hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Sawˉ lu‸ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ suh-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Paˍranˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo Kaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Naˍbaˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˬ 3 hinˉ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hinˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ teh‸ meh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ nyi ma maˇ da‸ leh haiˬve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˬ mvuh nuˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ lo Naˍbaˍlaˆ geh kʼai-o.
Yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, Daˍviˆ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh dawˇ sha tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ yawˬ mvuh nuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te piˇ. Yawˇ hui Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ mehˉ.

Nawˬ maˇ yonˍ kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi-o. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ peu laˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, pawehˇ te ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ hui venˇ hkʼaw laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ piˇ laˇ hpeh‸ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ a ciˉ piˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Naˍbaˍlaˆ geh kʼai leh Daˍviˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Naˍbaˍlaˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve a shu le. Awˬ meh chi hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw. Chi beu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ laiˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ ti maˇ cawˬ leh hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ, iˉ kaˆ leh shaˍ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Naˍbaˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ve aˉhtaw pfuhˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw yuˬ pfuhˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ htawˇ aˉhtaw yuˬ pfuhˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ 200 gʼaˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo shaw chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Naˍbaˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ, Naˍbaˍlaˆ miˇ ma Aˍbiˇgeˍlaˆ geh kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ laˇ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ jaw. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ jaw.
Ngaˬ hui yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ yawˇ hui ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jehˬ da‸ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te piˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma maˇ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, shu kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na gʼa puiˉ, teh‸ Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆgeˬlaˆ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ 200 shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ punˇ, piˬ taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ ngaˇ hkeh, sha ma hu taˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ teˇ ha kʼoˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkaoˍmonˇ te taˍ ve nyiˇ ha shiˍ, piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ tsuh‸ keu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ maˇ hto piˇ.
Yawˇ piˉ laˬ ciˇ leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ ya‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ le. Yawˇ ve mawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ mehˉ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi taw ga piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ sheˍ htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆgeˬlaˆ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ haˆ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Daˍviˆ hkui paˇ lo boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, awˬ bon te leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve Naˍbaˍlaˆ hkawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh chaw luˬ paˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ peu laˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.

Nawˬ shu hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa te luˬ gaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Naˍbaˍlaˆ hkʼa shuˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ bon te leh ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ hta‸ bawˆ chehˇ leh, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ hawˉ ma hkʼaw keu bawˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te gʼawˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve awˬ bon oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ,

nawˬ shu hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve leh, nawˬ nyi ma gʼa zuhˆ peuˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi leh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo nawˬ hta‸ peu laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, chi hkʼe te laˇ ve nawˬ ve dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo haˆ maˇ ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve hkʼe kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Naˍbaˍ laˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ngaˬ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ piˇ laˇ ve la‸shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˇgeˍlaˆ Naˍbaˍlaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ gu ve hkʼe hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ piˇ.
Yawˇ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ ve na-e la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ awˬ to teˇ hkoˇ baˉ suh sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 10 nyi hkʼe gaˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Naˍbaˍlaˆ suh-e ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve awˬ tan Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh ngaˬ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca na tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh kʼai leh, Daˍviˆ nawˬ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca shiˍ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui sheh hta‸ tsuhˇ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ tu la leh, yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ ciˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ hta‸ heuˆ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ miˇ ma Miˆhkaˍlaˆ hta‸ Gaˍlenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Lehˇshaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Paˍlaˍtiˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ziˇhpaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hteunˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ lo Sawˉlu‸ geh laˬ leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬYuˇda‸ hteunˍ lonˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍhkiˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 3,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Ziˇhpaˆ hteunˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Haˍhkiˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca la ve oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca jaˆ nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ teˇ caw haˉ tu leh Sawˉlu‸ leh Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ, Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hui zuh‸ chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca nyi kʼai ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, fa la awˬ kʼaw ji lo zuh‸ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Hiˇtiˆ chaw Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ leh Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh Sawˉlu‸ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Aˍbiˆshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Daˍviˆ leh Aˍbiˆshehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Sawˉlu‸ deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ uˉ htuˆ puiˍ lo choˆ taˍ leh fa la awˬ kʼaw ji lo zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbiˆshehˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ puiˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ juˆ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ hkʼe tiˉ juˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te. Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve pa taw Sawˉlu‸ suh yanˇ gaˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha tawˍ taˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ ve gehˇ leh, yawˇ ve iˉ kaˆ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve uˉ htuˆ puiˍ lo teh taˍ ve gehˇ leh iˉ kaˆ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kaˬ maˇ shiˍ maˇ jawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ zuh‸ mehˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ nawˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Aˍbaˍnaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ kaˇ chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve le. Ya‸ sheh htaˇ ceh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, fa la hkʼaw lo‸-e taˉ peuˬ.

Aˍbaˍnaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ te. Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi loˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve gehˇ hkʼaˬ lo le. Yawˇ ve uˉ htuˆ puiˍ lo teh taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hkawˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, jawˇmawˇ-oˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ aˬ hto ma teˇ ceuˬ te‸ ya‸ ve cawˬ le.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa la tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ hkʼe dawˇ tawˆ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tcuh laˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ shinˉ maˇ gʼa tuˬ, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ca suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hkʼe ve hpuiˇ she ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca toˇ chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ-oˬ, kʼaw‸ la-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ya‸-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw gʼuˇ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve gehˇ choˬ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca yuˬ hkʼaw‸ la tcuh-o.

Ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te.
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˉ Daˍviˆ tawˆ kʼai leh, Sawˉlu‸ htawˇ yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Teˇ nyi kʼo ngaˬ Sawˉlu‸ la‸ hkʼaw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Sawˉlu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ ca leh, ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Gaˍtaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Mawˇhkaˆ yaˇ paˍ Aˍhkiˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ hpeh‸ leh teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Kaˍ meˍ laˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Naˍbaˍlaˆ miˇ ma Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo hpaw-e peuˬ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Daˍ viˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ ca-o.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ venˇ ehˉ teˇ venˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh choˬ kaˬ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ tuˬ maˇ loˬ, teh‸ Aˍhkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhkiˆ yawˇ hta‸ Ziˆkaˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ maˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Ziˆkaˍlaˆ lehˬYuˇda‸ chaw hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ha pa 16 maˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ, Geˍraˍziˆ leh Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ maw jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Shuˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Hawˉ hkʼaˇ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve nuˇ, yawˬ, piˉ laˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Aˍhkiˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkiˆ lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo ma‸ ca bawˆ-e ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo kʼai ve awˬ lawn, Yeˍraˆmaˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve awˬ lawn, leh Keˍniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ shu Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh Aˍhkiˆ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ chi hkʼe tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhkiˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ yonˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ ma‸ yaˇ shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkiˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh ma‸ gʼa ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ htawˇ, Hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te puiˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkiˆ lehˬ, Da‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ suh peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ haw paˆ hawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ moˍ shawˍ veu laˇ leh, Shuˆnenˍ venˇ paˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Uˇrenˍ hta‸ cuˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ cuˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˉ puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ geh kʼai leh ca jehˬ da‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Enˍdawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo mawˉ puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, awˬ nu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ yawˇ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh a ciˉ na nyi laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve aw ha hta‸ a ciˉ kuˬ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mawˉ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ va ca htaw na la ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ a shu hta‸ gʼa kuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ kuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ te laˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ a shu hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ ha teˇ maˬ taˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ha oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ shuˍ le, teh‸ yawˇ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha oˇ ve lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve chaw mawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ aˉ po‸ lonˉ teˇ hkʼoˆ hawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha oˇ ve Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ ve le, teh‸ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇ ti‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh maˇ kʼoˆ, zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-o. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ to leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh gʼa ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˇlu‸ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ gʼa caˇ ve pa taw gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ geh kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ a sha‸ tanˇ leh te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe a ciˉ te sheˍ. Choˬ kaˬ lo caˇ tuˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la leh kʼo‸-e gaˬ tuˬ, caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ gaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ awˍ caˇ tuˬ ga hpoˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve pa taw, tu la leh ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hu taˍ ve nuˇ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tiˇ leh awˍ chiˇ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍ monˉ hta‸ htawˇ haˆ haˆ te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ taˉ leh oˇ ve teˇ haˉ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Aˍhpehˆ venˇ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ kʼo teˇ moˍ, teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ teˇ moˍ te leh, awˬ moˍ awˬ moˍ te tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhkiˆ geh teˇ geh shu hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍbrehˇ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍhkiˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi hpaˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼa cawˇ maw peuˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu-o. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo taˇ kʼai tcuh. Aˬ muiˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ bawˆ la naˍ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve kanˉ aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ sheˍ le.

Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve lehˬ, chi hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkiˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai piˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼai tcuh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve law.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw nawˬ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ htawˇ taˇ te, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˬ kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhki ˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tcuh piˇ maˇ hpeh‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Daˍviˆ-oˬ, shawˉ paw kʼo Sawˉlu‸ geh hkʼa hpaw tawˆ la leh ngaˬ geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, teˇ na‸ tu kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Nyiˇ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Ziˆkaˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ te taw hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, Ziˆkaˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh,
yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpeh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma Aˍhiˆnonˍ leh Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hui hta‸ htawˇ shu hpeh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ dawˇ tuiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ-a teh‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Da‸ kehˬ ve ta kʼoˍ ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Aˍbiˆ maˍ lehˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbyaˍtaˍ lehˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve yawˇ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ mi tuˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai loˬ, nawˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ mi leh yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Beˍtawˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 400 hta‸ shiˍ veu leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ 200 gʼaˇ lehˬ, heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tuˬ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve pa taw oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ geh kʼai chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ leh iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˉ nawˆ shiˍ awˬ goˇ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ nyiˇ kʼoˍ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ caˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa caˇ ve shehˆ nyi gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ a shu le. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hpeh‸ leh, Aˍmaˍ lehˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chehˇ haˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve ya‸ nyi shehˆ nyi gaˬ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ te taw lo cawˬ ve Hkeˍraˍtiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, Kaˍlehˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ leh, Ziˆkaˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ hpeh‸ aw laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ka ti‸ te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ shiˍ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ gʼa veu laˇ ve pa taw ha lehˬ jaˇ leh hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ na‸ Daˍviˆ tu leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Kaˍlaˍoˆ ciˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yaˇ nehˬ 400 gʼaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ ponˬ.
Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hpeh kʼai taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ceˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa‸ veu laˇ leh, Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui lehˬ Beˍtawˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve chaw 200 gʼaˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ la tuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ geh kʼai taˍ ve chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui geh maˇ laˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ pehˬ piˇ-o. Yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ te gaˇ taˬ. Ngaˬ hui mawˇ hta‸ hkʼa ma-ehˬ gʼa pehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ taˉ ve chaw htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve chaw hui gʼa ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, chi hkʼe awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ziˆkaˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh feu piˇ leh tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ hui hiˉ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, la‸shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ jaw ve Beˍteˍlaˆ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve Raˍmaˆ, Yaˍtiˇraˆ,
Aˍyawˍ, Shiˉhpaˍmoˆ, Eˇshaˍteˍmawˇ,
Keˍmeˍlaˆ, Yeˍraˆmeˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Keˍniˆ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ,
Hawˇmaˍ, Beˍraˍshanˍ, Aˍtehˇ leh,
Heˍbronˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpa hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ maˇ suh-e leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ mi la leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˆnaˆtanˍ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ leh Maˍlaˍhkiˇshuˆ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉ lu‸ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo ma‸ bawˆ hehnˇ jaˇ la leh, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ htawˇ hkaˆ ce heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ naˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa te leh maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-o, teh‸ yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te maˇ haˆ. Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ juˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ juˆ leh Sawˉlu‸ geh teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ awˬ to, yawˇ ve yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ paˍ hui suh-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Sawˉlu‸ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ suh-e peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ suh-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve venˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawˆ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shawˉ pawˍ hkʼe teˇ nyi Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ ca gʼawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Sawˉ lu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha ma Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ leh, Behˆshanˍ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
