ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ Behˆshanˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh, Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hkʼaw aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ma‸ kehˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˉ leh Ziˆkaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw nyiˇ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh gʼuiˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ leh, yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo hpaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ suh maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˉnaˆtanˍ hui htawˇ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ suh-e ve nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shiˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ ngeh huˉ chehˇ leh, canˇ paˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ shanˬ te shanˬ yawˇ hta‸ neˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hpfuhˆ nyi leh ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
ngaˬ a shu hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ laˇ leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ suh-e tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ leh yawˇ ve la‸ kawˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ haˍ leh caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ haˆ law leˇ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬhkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve htawˇ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼa ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ maˍ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. (Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ Yaˍshaˍ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e ve yoˬ. Ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ leh Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ ca hto piˇ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ ha lehˬ tcuh.

Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ciˍ gʼuiˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, taˇ ce la piˇ, hkʼaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yiˍ lehˍ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ce taˍ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ ve htanˬ tuˬ htawˇ yawˇ taˆ peuˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve hkaˆ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ leh, Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉhtaw lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ dawˆ baˬ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, ha‸ puiˉ jaˇ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ geh te‸ chehˇ leh, teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ a‸ kehˉ gehˬ jaˇ leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ ca feuˉ laˇ leh, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ ca tcuhˉ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ paiˍ peuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ naˆtanˍ htawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo suh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ laˇ ve a‸ kehˉ uiˍ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ paiˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaw‸ yehˇ maˇ hpeh‸-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ venˇ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Kʼai loˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi htaˇ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼai-o, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Yeˍzeˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ leh Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Naˍbaˍlaˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ veu leh Heˍbronˍ venˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, ca gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Chi beu‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha‸ hanˉ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ suh peuˬ. Chi beu‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ, Aˍshaˍ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw 7 hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa 6 maˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Giˇbonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˇyaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Yaˍbaˆ leh Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo hpuˇ da‸ leh gʼuiˬ po choˬ paˉ oˇ paˉ lo mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leˍ guiˇ tcuh piˇ nyi-a veuˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ htawˇ, Te tcuh nyi, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw 12 gʼaˇ tu la leh, Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ tu la ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ moˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, nyi kuˇ hpawˇ lo aˉ hte‸ juˆ keu da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Giˇbonˍ venˇ paˇ lo ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Aˉ hte‸ miˬguiˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˇyaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Yaˍbaˆ, Aˍbiˆshehˇ, leh Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ lehˬ, hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tu leh Aˍbaˍnaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi leh, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍsaˍ heˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ. Nawˬ suh gaˇ ve laˇ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ nawˬ viˉ paˍ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpuˇ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ maˇ na. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo juˆ hkʼaw‸ peu leh, Aˍshaˍheˍlaˆ ve gʼoˇ pe‸ hta‸ heuˆ leh hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo pawnˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ oˇ kaˬ lo ceh paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ leh Aˍbiˆshehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Giˇbonˍ hteunˍ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw‸ hpuiˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍmaˍ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw chi lehˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbaˍnaˍ geh teˇ geh hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe tiˉ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ dawˇ mawˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw tawˆ la ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ-o. Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ bawˆ ve jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˇ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh teˇ sha gʼuˇ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ bawˆ da‸ ve peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼaw nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ chi kʼawˇ gʼaˇ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw Aˍbaˍnaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ 360 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ ve awˬ to hta‸ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ tu kʼo‸-e leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Daˍviˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh bawˆda‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la chehˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpawˇ lo shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ geh paw la ve Aˍnonˍ,

yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Naˍbaˍlaˆ miˇ ma Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ geh paw la ve Hkiˇlaˆ, yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Taˍlaˍ mehˇ yaˇ miˇ Maˍhkaˍ geh paw la ve Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ,
yaˇ paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Haˍgiˆ geh paw la ve Aˍdawˇniˆyaˆ, yaˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Aˍbiˆtaˍlaˆ geh paw la ve Shaˍhpaˍtiˆ,
yaˇ paˍ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Eˇgaˍlaˆ geh paw la ve Iˉtaˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ paw la taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve ma‸ moˍ hkʼaw shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Sawˉlu‸ yaˇ paˍ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i Aˍyaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Riˆsaˍpaˍ geh ca zuh‸ ve le, teh‸ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Aˍbaˍnaˍ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chaw hpfuhˆ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ pa Sawˉ lu‸, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ Daˍviˆ maˇ gʼa te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ miˇ awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ maˇ te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw maˇ haˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbaˍnaˍ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ a shu uˉ peunˍ tuˬ le. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ngaˬ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ geh gʼa shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ miˇ ma Miˆhkaˍlaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ teˇ ha maˬ yuˬ pa taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Lehˇshaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Paˍlaˍtiˆ geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Paˍlaˍtiˆ gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh, Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh yawˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh piˇ gaˇ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh awˬ nu ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hkʼa deh‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˉ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Daˍviˆ hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ shiˍ veu laˇ leh Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo Daˍviˆ geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ca maˍ piˇ shaˍ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve hkʼaw kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw Yaˍbaˆ leh Daˍviˆ ve awˬ nu ve ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ gʼa veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ geh Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼo‸-e tcuh taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbaˍnaˍ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yaˍbaˆ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve le. Aˍbaˍnaˍ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto ma pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ hpehˇ piˇ ve le.
Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, nawˬ chehˇ ve cawˬ ve, kʼai ve laˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi la ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te la ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Daˍviˆ geh tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ tawˇ shaˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Siˉraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve nanˬ bawˍ lo gʼa‸ mi leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ maˇ shiˍ.

Aˍbaˍnaˍ Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ a yehˉ gawˬ lehˍ tawˇ yaw piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ juˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍbaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˍbaˍnaˍ gʼa suh ve lehˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-o. Teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ suhˍ ya‸ ve chaw, hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw, yaˇ miˇ hkʼe ve chaw, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh ve chaw, caˇ maˇ law‸ dawˬ maˇ law‸ ve chaw cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ hta‸ Giˇbonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh Aˍbaˍnaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw tuˍ kuiˬ lo Daˍviˆ awˬ to gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hkʼa shuˍ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˍbaˍnaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ hkawˇ yaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve hkʼe gʼa te suh-e ve le.

Yawˇ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ suh-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ htaˇ yawˇ caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ caˇ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Daˍviˆ maˇ caˇ. Mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ caˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ gʼa suh ve lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˇyaˆ ve yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, la‸ sheh gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˍnaˍ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve htawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ, Baˍnaˍ leh Reˍhkaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉmaˬ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Beˍroˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Riˇmonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Beˍroˆ venˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve venˇ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Giˇtenˍ venˇ lo hpaw-e leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hkehˉ chaw hkʼe te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ 5 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ hpehˇ shoˆ-e leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hkui tcuhˉ jiˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Reˍhkaˆ leh Baˍnaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo caˬ ha chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ma lehˬ, zuh‸ muiˉ geu‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Reˍhkaˆ leh Baˍnaˍ yehˬ hkʼaw lo a yehˉ hkʼawˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ pawˆ tiˉ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ chiˇ veu leh teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ shiˍ oˇ ve a‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Ziˇkaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Sawˉlu‸ suh peuˬ ve awˬ lawn ca hto la ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca hto la ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca hto la ve awˬ pon ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw lo zuh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼai leh ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve lehˬ, leuˉ leh hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve awˬ tan, ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Reˍhkaˆ leh Baˍnaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍboˍshehˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw Aˍbaˍnaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh paˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw Daˍviˆ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw Sawˉlu‸ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo Daˍviˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ uˉ peunˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ 33 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍhta‸ shiˍ veu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ bawˆ yuˬ maˇ gʼa taˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, Nawˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la maˇ gaˬ taˬ. Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ leh hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.).

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ canˇ ve hkʼe, choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ leh tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve chaw cawˬ-aw laˇ. Cawˬ ve kʼo, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaˇ suh taˆ-e leh, mehˆ cuˉ paˍ leh hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Chi hta‸ pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ leh hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.)

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Miˆlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo te leh hawˉ yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉ maˉ leh puiˉ jaˇ ve haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ miˇ ma laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw paw la ve yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shaˍmoˍ-aˍ, Shawˇbaˆ, Naˍtanˍ, Sawˉla‸monˍ,
Iˉbaˍhaˍ, Eˇliˆshuˇ-aˍ, Neˍhpehˆ, Yaˍhpi-aˍ,
Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ, Eˇlaˍdaˆ leh Eˇliˆhpaˍlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui Reˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Baˍlaˆ Peˍraˍzinˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Baˍlaˆ Peˍraˍzinˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼawˆ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Reˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh hteˇ lehˍ taˇ ca bawˆ-e. Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo caw leh pfuhˇ cehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo ca bawˆ-e loˬ.

Pfuhˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ Geˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Geˍzaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh,
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca taˆ yuˬ tuˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlanˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ nuˇ lawˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Awˇzaˆ leh Aˍhiˆawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˇzaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo te toˇ leh, Aˍhiˆawˇ lehˬ nuˇ lawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˍ meuˆ, tinˍ hteˆ, shehnˍ hehˆ, cehnˬ dawˆ, lehˉ lu meuˆ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Naˍhkonˍ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkui sheh naˆ leˆ ve pa taw, Awˇzaˆ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˇzaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Awˇzaˆ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ paˇ lo paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw Awˇzaˆ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Peˍraˆ Awˇzaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Chi beu‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yuˬ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Eˇdonˍ chaw Awˇbehˆ ve yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve oˇ kaˬ lo ha pa 3 maˬ chehˇ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Awˇbehˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Awˇbehˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Awˇbehˆ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ ve chaw hui hkui piˍ 6 piˍ juˇ kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ nuˇ teˇ hkeh leh chu jaˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hpa teˇ hkʼoˆ yuˬ hawˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ ve hkʼe, kʼaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkʼeˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw nyi peu leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gu taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw yawˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ diˬ, piˬ taˍ ve shaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ a ciˉ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ teˇ gʼaˇ a ciˉ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ htawˇ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Sawˉlu‸ yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw gʼuˇ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ awˬ kʼu nyi te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, nawˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ taˍ nehˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hkʼaw kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ tuˬsheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ lehˬ, suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yaˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nyi loˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ceh tiˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Naˍtanˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ cho kʼai oˇ kʼai te toˇ chehˇ leh aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh ngaˬ te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ maˇ te laˇ ve le, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ na nyi jaw.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo sho‸ sha‸ ve a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, tawˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ puˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh tuˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼaw‸ te tcuh leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te laˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve kʼo, awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa uˉ peunˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtanˍ htawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ da‸ kehˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ te laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ leuˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te laˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ sheˍle. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉchi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼe ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon nawˬ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te laˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ meh co co taiˍ taiˍ uiˍ chehˇ mvuh chehˇ leh, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve ka ti‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hkʼaw ha lehˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ co co cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Daˍviˆ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ma‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo zuh‸ tcuh ve yoˬ. Aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tehˆ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw shehˆ pun nyiˇ pun hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Mawˆbaˆ chaw hui yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Zawˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Reˍhawˇbaˆ ve yaˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ suhˍ ha gʼaˇ leh, ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼawˬ chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkui sheh dawˆ hteh piˇ leh, iˉmvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ ha maˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ ca ga la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ meunˍ nyiˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ taˆ toˇ chehˇ ve shi te taˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Neˍtaˆ venˇ leh Beˍyawˇtehˇ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve kuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ jawˇmawˇ Tawˇiˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˉranˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai peu leh, yawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ bon uiˍ hkawˇ ca yaw piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Tawˇiˆ lehˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ gʼa bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ lehˬ hpu, shi, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ laiˉ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ la‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui geh gʼa taˍ ve hpu, shi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ geh gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ leh‸ lawˬ hkʼo‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ meunˍ hiˉ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ meh leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ bvuhˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˉ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, Aˍhiˇluˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˇtuˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Seˍraˍyaˆ lehˬ shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyeˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve cawˬ sheˍ laˇ. Cawˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon te piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Sawˇlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw, Ziˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ Ziˇbaˆ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇve, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ bon te piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ziˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Lawˍdeˍbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw Aˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Ziˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yawˆnaˆtanˍ ve yaˇ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ-oˬ, teh‸ kuˬ leh yawˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ pa Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ puˍ Sawˉlu‸ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ geh gʼa mui caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ suh taˍ ve hpuiˇ teˇ hkeh a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi taw taw awˬ bon te laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Ziˇbaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ti mi te leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼa gʼeu‸ jaw‸ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ geh gʼa mui caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Ziˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Ziˇbaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ chi ngaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ htaˇ Ziˇbaˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ geh mui caˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ziˇbaˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, hkui sheh nyiˇ paˉ paˉ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, jawˇmawˇ geh mui caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Naˍhaˆ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Haˍnonˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍnonˍ awˬ pa Naˍhaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ htawˇ Haˍnonˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa suh-e ve pa taw yawˇ htawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Haˍnonˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Aˍmawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ pa suh-e ve pa taw dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ maˍ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Haˍnonˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve paˇ tcuhˆ teˇ hkoˇ chiˇ baˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, hkui tcuhˉ kʼu awˬ na paˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ nuˆ baˬ piˇ leh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ya‸ taw jaˇ leh yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ la maˇ gaˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve paˇ tcuhˆ kʼaw‸ zuhˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ tuˬ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Behˆyaˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ leh Zawˍbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ, Tawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ meunˍ nyiˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ, leh jawˇmawˇ Maˍhkaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ veu leh tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Suˇriˆ chaw, Tawˇbaˆ chaw leh Maˍhkaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo bawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Suˇriˆ chaw hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ gu taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ la ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ca ga la-o. Aˍmawˇniˇ chaw hui nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ leh ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ-a veuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe te laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ haˆ leh venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Suˉriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shawˇbehˆ geh teˇ geh Heˍlanˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Heˍlanˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui bawˆ da‸ leh, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ suhˍ ha gʼaˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ awˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shawˇbehˆ htawˇ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ gaˬ la leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ, awˬ nu ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ zuh‸ kuiˬ lo nawˇ la leh, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw, ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ iˉ kaˆ hehˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve a shu hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca na nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˍlinˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh Hiˇtiˆ chaw Uˇriˇya‸ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ leh yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca shiˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ. (Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ awˬ liˇ laˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.) Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ yaˇ hu la peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la peu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ geh kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.
Uˇriˇya‸ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, Yaˍbaˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ca kʼaw‸ jehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Uˇriˇyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Uˇriˆyaˆ tawˆ kʼai leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Uˇriˇya‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo maˇ kʼo‸-e. Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ haˉ jawˇmawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ hui geh teˇ geh jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
Uˇriˇya‸ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo maˇ kʼo‸-e ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ aˉ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa chehˇ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ve yehˬ lo maˇ kʼo‸-e ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Uˇriˇya‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh, ngaˬ miˇ ma geh ca zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe ca te maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, nawˬ ya‸ nyi choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Uˇriˇya‸ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ nyi Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˍ kuˬ caˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ maˇ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Uˇriˇya‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo maˇ kʼo‸-e. Jawˇmawˇ a sha‸ shaw paˍ hui geh ca zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ piˇ leh, Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆhehnˇ jaˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tcuh-o, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Uˇriˇyaˆ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ hehnˇ jaˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Uˇriˇya‸ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Daˍviˆ hta‸ awˬ lawn ca kʼaw‸ kaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la leh nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui venˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo kʼai ve le. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkaˆ bawˆ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.

Yeˍruˆbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te suh-e ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ nawˇ leh laˇ. Yawˇ Taˍbehˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, haˉ pui mawˍ teˇ maˬ hpehˇ ce piˇ ve pa taw yawˇ gʼa suh-e ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui lanˇ venˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo kʼai ve le, teh‸ nawˬ htaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo, Nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ Uˇriˇya‸ htawˇ suh peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve Daˍviˆ geh kʼo‸-e leh, Yaˍbaˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkaˆ bawˆ hpehˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ suh-e ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ Uˇriˇya‸ htawˇ suh peuˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˍbaˆ nyi ma maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ ca kʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ canˍ bawˆ leh te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ Beˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ ca shiˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve Daˍviˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Naˍtanˍ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ teˇ venˇ hkʼaw chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nuˇ, yawˬ, maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ vuiˬ taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, paw sha paˍ ve yehˬ lo hkehˉ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Paw sha paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, hkehˉ chaw hta‸ yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ tiˇ caˍ gaˇ. Hkʼe te leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, hkehˉ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ te caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, shu ve mawˇ teˇ pun yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ pon awˇ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Naˍtanˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh leh, Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ pon maˇ law‸ sheˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyiˇ pun kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ te ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ, Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, Uˇriˆya‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hpuiˇ suh va‸ suh ve hkʼe gʼa te suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ biˇ la peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, baˬ kuiˬ lo venˇbaˆ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba kuiˬ lo hpeu‸ tawˆ la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Naˍtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve yaˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Naˍtanˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Uˇriˇya‸ miˇ ma geh paw la ve yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ naˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yaˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ. Teˇ haˉ le le yawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ geh kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ tu la tuˬ hto piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ tu la. Yawˇ hui geh te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ.

Teˇ shinˉ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ oˇ ve suh-e ve yoˬ. Hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ maˇ haˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve ka‸ yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ. Yaˇ suh peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa‸ hkʼe te kʼoˆ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tawˇ tsuh-ehˆ te da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ jawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˇ suh-oˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ tu la leh iˉ kaˆ hehˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˉ kʼoˍ puiˍ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ htaiˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ caˇ tuˬ gu tcuh leh awˍ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ te ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ. Yaˇ ehˉ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ tu la leh caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, yaˇ ehˉ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ ce leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ kʼo yaˇ oˇ ve maˇ suh-e hehˉ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yaˇ suh-e peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ ce ve ka‸ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ. Teˇ nyi kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ geh gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ miˇ ma Beˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ hta‸ nyi ma sha la tuˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la leh, yawˇ hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ leh, Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍdaˍdiˆ teh‸ ca meh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve venˇ lonˉ Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po lonˉ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ geh cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ awˬ to venˇ chi hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la-o. Venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ, teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ Miˆlaˍkonˍ lehˬ 18 cawehˬ hpaˆ hawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, shi uˉ tcuhˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, shi uˉ tcuhˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˆ gʼeu‸ tcuh ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˉ kʼoˆ, ceˉ ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ te tcuh leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ li kiˉ shiˍ chiˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Aˍmawˇniˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve Taˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Daˍviˆ yaˇ paˍ Aˍmaˍnonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, naˬ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇnaˍdaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Shaˍmaˍ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, laˆ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˍdaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ nyi kʼo, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍnonˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve awˬ nyi ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ chehˇ haˍ ve hkʼe te leh zuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ pa nawˬ hta‸ ca nyi la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ tcuh leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te caˍ te taw laˇ tcuh-o. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ngaˬ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ gu leh, ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ caˍ laˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ nawˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍnonˍ htawˇ chehˇ haˍ ve hkʼe te leh, zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi htaˇ, Aˍmaˍnonˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˍmaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ peu laˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ awˬ pon hkaoˍmonˇ te leh a ciˉ yuˬ caˍ laˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Taˍmaˍ hta‸ awˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍmaˍnonˍ ve yehˬ lo kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ ca gu piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Taˍmaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Aˍmaˍnonˍ zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ junˍ meu-e hta‸ yuˬ leh Aˍmaˍnonˍ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ awˬ pon hkaoˍmonˇ te ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ ca caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ ngaˬ geh yuˬ laˬ leh, nawˬ awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ caˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Taˍmaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Taˍmaˍ htawˇ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ yuˬ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmaˍnonˍ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼawˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ geh zuh‸ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Taˍmaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe taˇ te laˇ. Chi hkʼe cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ taˇ te-o.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh chaw chi ma gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ chiˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ ka‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Taˍmaˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve pa taw, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ geh shiˍ zuh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmaˍnonˍ lehˬ Taˍmaˍ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh, chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai-o, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ maˇ kʼai. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ ya‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve kanˉ a‸ kehˉ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍmaˍnonˍ lehˬ Taˍmaˍ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍmaˍnonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ choˬ ka‸ lo shiˍ tawˆ-e loˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ yehˬ miˉ baˬ lo ca‸ kʼoˬ leh, yehˬ miˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yehˬ baˬ lo shiˍ tawˆ-e leh, yehˬ miˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍmaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkaˆ pfuhˍ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍmaˍnonˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te laˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ nyi ma-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ hto piˇ. Yawˇ htawˇ ka‸ nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ chi taw taw hpeh‸ bawˬ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Taˍmaˍ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw piˇ. Aˍmaˍnonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ beu‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 2 hkʼaw‸ hkʼe gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆhaˍzawˍ hkʼaˆ hkʼaw lo yawˬ mvuh nuˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh htawˇ kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˬ mvuh nuˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ laˬ maˇ hpeh‸ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kuˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa kʼai maˇ hpeh‸ teh‸ ceh tiˉ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nyi paˍ Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Aˍmaˍnonˍ gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve le, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui lawˬ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Aˍmaˍnonˍ leh awˬ nu ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te leh ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ shanˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ la leh ngaˬ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe Aˍmaˍnonˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ ciˇ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo hpaw kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ nawˬ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ pawˆ tu la leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ awˬ viˉ paˍ Shaˍmaˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yawˇ nawˬ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˍmaˍnonˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ suh-e ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍ nonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ chi hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yonˍ. Aˍmaˍnonˍ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ suh-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ lehˬ, Hawˉronˍnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpawˇ lo chiˇ nyi peu leh, Chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuiˇ ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇnaˍdaˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ hkui, Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Aˍmiˇhuˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Taˍlaˍmehˇ geh hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh yawˇ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍnonˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Geˍsuˇriˆ venˇ hkʼaw shehˆ hkʼaw‸ ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍnonˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve mehˉ kʼai leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬTeˍkawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ awˬ to dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe te-o. Dawˇ haˍ htaˇ veu‸ deh ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ htawˇ taˇ puiˍ. Awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ shuˍ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.

Chi hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇmehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma loˍ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ya‸ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hka piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga hpoˆ deˇ leh, tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ lawˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ suh piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ hpawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ htawˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Kanˉ chi hta‸ ngaˬ nyi leh te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ ca te sho‸ sha‸ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ca chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ leh, chi a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tawˆ la tuˬ, nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te piˇ tuˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh kʼaw‸ yaw tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ sheˍ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ htawˇ, Yaw loˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ya‸ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ sheh nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ sheˆ kʼai leh te geh kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha awˬ to htawˇ, suh taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh tawˇ ca yaw la ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ te tcuh laˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe nawˬ te tuˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw pon laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ leh ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ na nyi shaˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ na nyi gaˇ ve hkʼe na nyi laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ na nyi ve hkawˇ hta‸ jaw kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ gʼa yaw tuˬ, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Kanˉ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ, yawˇ chi hkʼe te taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ kʼai leh Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ Daˍviˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te laˇ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Geˍsuˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ceh chehˇ taˍ leh, jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼai.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hkʼe taw awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ te leh hkui naw meuˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh htawˇ da‸ jaˇ, nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh zuhˬ leh chehˇ haˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ nuˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ pawˆ nuˆ baˬ ve nyiˇ cawehˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ leh Taˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ chi htawˇ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ sheˍ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tcuh tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ maˇ laˬ. Yawˇ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ maˇ laˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Yaˍbaˆ ve ti mi lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ti mi paˇ lo cawˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo caˬ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼai leh yawˇ ve ti miˬ hta‸ ca tuˉ baˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai leh Yaˍbaˆ ve ti mi hta‸ ca tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ geh laˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve ti mi hta‸ tuˉ baˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆ saˍlonˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ Geˍsuˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ la ve le. Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu laˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
