Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh awˬ lawn oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ciˇ tuˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ leh, yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼuiˇ toˇ tuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ ngaˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo ca huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh suhˉ ca jehˬ la ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, choˬ kaˬ oˇ kaˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve suhˉ hta‸ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve suhˉ jehˬ paˍ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ paˍ gʼa te ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh boˆ-a teh‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼuˉ taˍ leh boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh suhˉ ca jehˬ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve pa taw, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo a ciˉ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Geˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ ca kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw kʼai loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, nawˬ hui behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ teh‸ hpoˆ kuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, chaw nyiˇ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ awˬ lawn te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ leh yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Giˇlawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve, Daˍviˆ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ ve chaw maˇ la leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hpawˇ lo awˬ gʼaˇ shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Daˍviˆ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hpawˇ lo ca chehˇ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo haˆ gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui mawˇ haˆ gu-o. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te kʼo, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ choˬ kaˬ laˬ leh, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i 10 gʼaˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh taˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, venˇ jaˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ paˇ lo jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkeˍraˍtiˆ chaw leh Peˍlaˍtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ htawˇ yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ Iˆtehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai toˇ ve le. Venˇ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ geh ca chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ la ve maˇ maw sheˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh kʼo‸-e loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˆtehˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, te‸ htawˇ suh htawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe yoˬ kʼo da‸-aˬ. Gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˆtehˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Kiˇdronˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ geh teˇ geh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍbyaˍtaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi ve hta‸ teˇ nyi kʼo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Zaˍdoˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍhiˆmaˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw venˇ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e loˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ geh lo awˬ lawn teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo law taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh kʼai ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hpawˇ chehˇ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ yonˍ hpeh‸ ve awˬ chawˇ Aˍhkiˆ chaw Huˆshehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-eˬ hkaˆ pfuhˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, Daˍviˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ venˇ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ Aˍbaˆsaˍ lonˍ maˇ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ pa ve awˬ ceˬ te jaw ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆmaˆ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hpehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto laˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ chawˇ Huˆshehˇ venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ htawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hkui venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ tawn hkʼe juˇ kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Ziˇbaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Piˉ laˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, hkaoˍ monˉ nyiˇ ha shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ teˇ ha kʼoˍ, iˉ shiˍ teˇ ha shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ punˇ taˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te toˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ziˇbaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Piˉ laˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ciˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˍ meu‸ la htaˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ziˇbaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ puˍ Sawˉlu‸ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Ziˇbaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ziˉbaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Geˍraˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍmiˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ deˇ hkaˬ leh tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ paˇ lo yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, Sheˍmiˆ lehˬ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ pui gʼawˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmiˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ deˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai loˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh, Sawˉlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˇshehˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw hpuiˇ chi nawˬ hta‸ deˇ piˇ lawˬ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ yawˇ geh kʼai leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chi nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te deˇ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve kʼo, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve le, teh‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Aˍbiˇshehˆ leh Yaˍbaˆ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Aˍbiˇshehˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw chi hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ anˇ chehˇ ve le. Yaˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hkeu chehˇ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ ve awˬ tan, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ laˇ tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Sheˍmiˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui gʼawˆ baˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, heuˬ jaˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ htawˇ, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve awˬ chawˇ Huˆshehˇ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ geh maˇ kʼai ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Huˆshehˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼai hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leh yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpawˇ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ a shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa ve awˬ ceˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui geh ca zuh‸-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ awˬ pon hawˉ yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˉ po kʼo ehˉ teˇ maˬ te piˇ leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi ma gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ i teˇ hpaˍ geh zuh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ chaw teˇ meunˍ nyiˇ hinˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ya‸ puiˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ nyi ma luˬ leh heuˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve hkʼe, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ geh shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ chi ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Huˆshehˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ naˍ. Yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ na nyi shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Huˆshehˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui te cawˇ laˇ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ le, teh‸ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Huˆshehˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi teˇ pawˆ Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ maˇ da‸.

Nawˬ pa leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˬ yehˇ ehˉ mehˉ kʼai ve yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ pa lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ lehˬ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ maˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ bawˆ ve kʼo, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ pa leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cheu‸ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ to awˬ hoˉ te leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai-o.

Daˍviˆ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca hpfuhˆ nyi leh, yawˇ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ lo‸ bawˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ teˇ maˬ maˬ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw‸ paˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ shiˍ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Huˆshehˇ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˬlaˆ pe‸ laˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve pa taw, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shu maˇ na yuˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Huˆshehˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe piˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ paˇ lo maˇ gʼa haˉ chehˇ tuˬ leh, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ ca hto piˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh Aˍhiˆmaˆ hui lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ haˆ ve pa taw, Enˍyawˇgeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ la chehˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ caˉ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ mawˬ taˉ leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo nanˬ bawˍ teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca lo‸ mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ shehˍ ma oˇ ve lehˬ, nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ beh taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo caˬ shiˍ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, Aˍhiˆmaˆ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ yehˬ shehˍ ma hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ iˉ kaˆ hkanˍ leh coˇ paˉ tawˆ-e peuˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ nyi ve htawˇ, ca maˇ mawˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhiˆmaˆ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo haˆ haˆ hkanˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhiˆtawˇhpeˍlaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, piˉ laˬ ciˇ leh yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkʼaw lo te tuˬ cawˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼawˍ peˍ nyiˉ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa ve tuˍ hpfuh paˇ lo ca tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ la htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ lo gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

(Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Yaˍhaˆ awˬ tan Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍsaˍ lehˬ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍtaˍ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yaˍbaˆ awˬ e Yeˍruˆyaˍ ve awˬ nyi ma Naˍhaˆ yaˇ miˇ Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw deh tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la htaˇ, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Raˍbaˆ venˇ yaˇ Naˍhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Shawˇbiˆ, Lawˍdeˍbaˍ venˇ yaˇ Aˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍhkiˇ raˆ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Yawˉgeˍlenˍ venˇ yaˇ Baˍziˆlehˇ, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ leh heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon iˉ kaˆ kawˆ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu leh zuh‸ hpui teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon caˬ hkʼa, sha ma hu taˍ ve, nawˆ shiˍ, miˬ nawˆ shiˍ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ teˇ moˍ, teˇ ha gʼaˇ teˇ moˍ te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆ, Yaˍbaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ leh Gaˍtaˆ venˇ yaˇ Iˆtehˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ moˍ shiˍ tawˆ-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh taˇ laˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hkoˇ hpaˆ suh-e ve htawˇ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw hpfuhˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ moˍ awˬ moˍ te tawˆ-e chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te piˇ, teh‸Yaˍbaˆ, Aˍbiˆshehˇ leh Iˆtehˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe shanˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ ve shaˬ te shaˬ jaˇ la leh, bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve a‸ kehˉ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw suh maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ leh Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto‸ da‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, piˉ laˬ ciˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ suhˆ buiˇ hkʼaw hkanˉ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Piˉ laˬ oˇ ve gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpe lo deu chiˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa mawˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˉ ve le. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te taˉ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpu teˇ chi hteh‸ leh haˍ pi caˆ teˇ maˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpu teˇ hinˉ pe‸ laˇ ve htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ. Ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te piˇ, teh‸ nawˬ awˬ to, Aˍbiˆshehˇ leh Iˆtehˇ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ leh awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ te shonˇ piˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ gehˇ shehˆ maˬ yuˬ veu leh maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo deu chiˇ chehˇ ve Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve nyi ma pui hta‸ baˬ hpehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ 10 gʼaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la leh, yawˇ hui Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆbehˬ heh ma meuˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ yuˬ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve miˬ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui teˇ hpoˆ lonˉ gʼawˆ hpoˆ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ duˇ ti taˍve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ kuiˬoˇ ve hta‸ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Zaˍdoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhiˆmaˆ lehˬ, Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ ve tawˇ chi, ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ suh-e ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ tuˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇchi jawˇmawˇ hta‸ taˇ ca hto piˇ sheˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi heh‸ nawˬ ca hto piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˍdanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhiˆmaˆ lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ htawˇ yaˬ piˇ. Ngaˬ htawˇ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te gaˇ ve le. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, la‸ shawn te‸ chiˉ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhiˆmaˆ lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ka‸ yaˬ piˇ. Ngaˬ kʼai gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe yoˬ kʼo kʼai loˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Yawˇdanˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpanˍ kʼai leh, Suˍdanˍ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, venˇ taˍ meu‸ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo huˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chiˇ nyi leh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca kʼaw‸ hto la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, shaˬ te shaˬ venˇ hta‸ neˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ aw nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ, Nyi loˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yehˬ miˉ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chi ve hpaˇ htawˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca kʼaw‸ hto la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ

Venˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆmaˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca kʼaw‸ hto la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhiˆmaˆ gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la leh jawˇmawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le. Yawˇ chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Aˍhiˆmaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-eh‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˍdanˍ awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le. Yawˇ chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ tan ngaˬ gʼa suh ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ Daˍviˆ chi hkʼe dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te cawˇ ve awˬ tan, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ leh dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ ve pa taw ya‸ taw leh a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hpaw kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, venˇ hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ leh, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ-oˬ, teh‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ jawˇmawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ nyi nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ tawˍ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e leh, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ leuˉ leh ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ kʼai leh nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ ca piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ geh lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ teˇ co-e nawˬ gʼa hpuˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw ve awˬ ceuˬ a‸ kehˉ hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ tu la leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo ca kʼaw‸ mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo mui chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hpaw kʼo‸-e peuˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ deˇ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ chi beu‸ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ kawˆ leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpaw tawˆ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh kʼai peuˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ gu leh maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ kʼaw da‸ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca shiˍ hkʼaw‸ la tuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ gu leh maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ htawˇ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ awˬ tan ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui Daˍviˆ geh tawˇ kʼaw‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ shiˍ hkanˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Geˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Sheˍmiˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gʼuiˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve Ziˇbaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 15 gʼaˇ leh awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo jawˇmawˇ geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ shiˍ hkanˍ piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te piˇ ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ-a teh‸ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Sheˍmiˆ jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ nawˬ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍruˇyaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ lehˬ, Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, A shu teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ geh dawˇ hkʼaˇ lawˬ ve le. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ gaˇ ve laˇ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ, teh‸ Aˍbiˆshehˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ hawehˍ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ jawˇmawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve hkui sheh maˇ tsuhˇ, paˇ tcuhˆ maˇ chiˇ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ kʼehˆ tsuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh jawˇmawˇ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ lehˬ hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ piˉ laˬ awˬ an tcuhˉ tcuh ve htawˇ yawˇ maˇ te law.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve law. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ, nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ geh mui caˇ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ lawˬ htehˍ tuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ lawn te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Ziˇbaˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼa ma-ehˬ pehˬ yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ heuˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon da‸ jaˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Yawˇbeˍlenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Baˍziˆlehˇ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ shiˍ hkanˍ piˇ tuˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Baˍziˆlehˇ lehˬ a sha‸ 80 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, paw sha jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, jawˇmawˇ Maˍhaˍnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍziˆlehˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ maw maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve le.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ 80 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ sheˉ lai ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ-o. Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ caˇ leh mehˬ hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ-o. Shu kʼa muiˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai ve ka‸, nawˬ hta‸ ca te tu‸ laˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, chi taw taw uiˍ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ keunˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh teˇ tawn ceh ga gʼa‸ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e ve tuˍ hpfuh paˇ lo ngaˬ hta‸ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Hkiˇmaˍhanˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼa lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Baˍziˆlehˇ hta‸ boˆ nu piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍziˆlehˇ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ shiˍ hkanˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ geh laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve miˇ yaˇ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ shiˍ hkanˍ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve le. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ leh laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ pe‸ laˇ leh laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe gʼa‸ shawˍ gʼa‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ hui teˇ chi pun kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˍ nehˬ laˇ ve le. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca shiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˉ lawˉ tanˬ jehˬ da‸ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ a‸ kehˉ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ lehˬ, leuˉ leh hehnˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Beˍhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ luˬ suh sheˆ suh piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Sheˍbaˆ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ teh taˉ ve yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ hta‸ shaw tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ zuh‸-o. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e mehˇchawˇma hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Hpa‸ nyi kʼo Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸, teh‸ Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍsaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kuˬ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ tinˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Sheˍbaˆ lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui geh tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ Hkeˍraˍtiˆ chaw, Peˍlaˍtiˆ chaw leh awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍbiˆshehˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh, Sheˍbaˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Giˉbonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˬbaˆ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ veuˬ kʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ veu‸ deh taˍ leh aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo jiˆ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve aˉhtaw miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ce ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍmaˍsaˍ hta‸ boˆ nu ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh Aˍmaˍsaˍ ve paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍsaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍbaˆ yuˬ taˍ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ te. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍ baˆ yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ juˆ hpehˇ leh, awˬ gʼuˬ tehˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍsaˍ suh-e ve pa taw, Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ nyiˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ juˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hui Sheˍbaˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍsaˍ suh taˍ ve awˬ to paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Yaˍbaˆ leh Daˍviˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Yaˍbaˆ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-o, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍsaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ nyi chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw suh ku-i oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw hawˉ lo gʼawˬ baˬ leh, aˉ boˆ teˇ maˬ yuˬ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw suh ku-i oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw hawˉ gʼawˬ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le Sheˍbaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ Yaˍbaˆ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Sheˍbaˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo caw toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbeˍlaˆbehˆmaˍhkaˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Beˍhkaˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh venˇ oˇ ve lo laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ oˇ ve lo gaˬ la leh, venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ je‸ yuˬ nehˉ leh, lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve paiˍ tuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼaˇ hte‸ hkʼawˆ duˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ laˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh, Nawˬ Yaˍbaˆ yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ na chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbeˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh ca lawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ka‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve venˇ chi lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh gawˬ da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ venˇ chi hta‸ ca te luˬ la ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ chi hkʼe maˇ te taˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ hui laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍbaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui venˇ chi hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ve oˉ koˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui geh baˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Sheˍbaˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ yuˬ leh, Yaˍbaˆ geh lo baˬ peu piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve a sha‸ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve Hkeˍraˍtiˆ chaw leh Peˍlaˍtiˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdawˇranˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍhiˇluˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍvaˆ lehˬ, shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍiˇraˆ ve yaˇ Iˇraˆ htawˇ, Daˍviˆ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Giˇbonˍ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

(Giˇbonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw ceuˬ ehˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.)

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ Giˇbonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te laˇ tuˬ le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ ve kanˉ chi hta‸, hpu shi yuˬ leh kʼaw‸ gu laˇ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Sawˉluˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw hpeh chiˇ taˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te da‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve yaˇ Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍyaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Riˆsaˍpaˍ geh paw la ve Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍmawˇniˆ leh Meˍfiˆboˍshehˆ hta‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ ve yaˇ miˇ Meˍraˆ geh paw la ve Maˍhawˉlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Beˍziˆlehˇ awˬ hawehˍ Aˍdreˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw chi ve suhˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh Giˇbon chaw hui hta‸ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw chi ve suhˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma i Aˍyaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Riˆsaˍpaˍ lehˬ, meh htuˉ pui hpa yuˬ leh haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo aˉ po kʼo ehˉ teˇ maˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ yeˬ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, suh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca caˇ la tuˬ, yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Riˆsaˍpaˍ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, Yaˍbehˆ chaw hui geh Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku ca kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸-e ve yoˬ. (Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Giˇ laˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Sawˍlu‸ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ hta‸ Behˆshanˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbehˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ)
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ leh, shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw oˇ ve suhˍ gʼaˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Sawˉlu‸ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Zeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw, Sawˉlu‸ awˬ pa Kiˇshaˆ ve tuˍ hpfuh paˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ma‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ heuˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍbiˍbeˍnoˍbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ aˉhtaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ taˬ pfuhˇ taˍ leh yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve gehˇ lehˬ kuiˇ te taˍ leh, 3 cawehˬ hkʼe hawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chi teˇ pawˆ Daˍviˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ Daˍviˆ geh gʼuiˇ gaˬ la leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ laˬ tuˬ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ gaˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gawˉbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Huˇshaˆ venˇ yaˇ Diˆbeˍkaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shaˍhpaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ Gawˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yaˍiˇraˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍhaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Gawˇliˇya‸ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Laˍhkaˍmiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve gehˇ tuˇ lehˬ, hpa chiˇ ve caˉ behˆ hkʼe hui cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkui sheh la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ le le hkui naw la‸ naw 6 maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ awˬ viˉ paˍ Shaˍmaˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ chi ve awˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ Sawˉlu‸ leh awˬ nu ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ ve yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, htaˬ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh kawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh htawˇ yawˇ ve va ngaˬ awˬ pon htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ yawˇ ve naˍ paw hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ miˬ hiˆ la leh, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ tawˆ la leh yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ha leh aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yehˬ baˬ leh, yawˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkui sheh hawˉ lo naˆ ho‸ ve moˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkeˍruˆbenˍ ciˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ yawˇ juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh moˬ leh iˉ kaˆ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ce la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ tawˇ yaw leh mvuh jaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ peu leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ deˇ leh nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˍ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ leh miˬguiˬ ve aw hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma lo ya‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ vawˆ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬhta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ hpfuhˆ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ maˇ te ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ leh, caˆ muiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ ca ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh jaˇ ve hkaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ yehˇ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh maˇ gʼa tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ paiˍ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ maˇ jehˇ leh yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˆ baˬ piˇ leh yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ tu la maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve hkui sheh paˇ lo paiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ nawˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ nawˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
Mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˍ meu-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve je‸ nehˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hkʼoˆ naˆ toˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pon laˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ htaˇ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, kawˆ cheˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ yawˇ te laˇ peuˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ tuˬ yawˇ te laˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ nawˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, Daˍviˆ awˬ leh meuˇ yaw taˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yuˬ uiˍ yuˬ mvuh piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ uˉ peunˍ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ,
moˬ maˇ hoˆ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ba da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu yuˬ baˬ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ gaˇ kʼo, sho nuˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, gaˆ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Taˍhkeˍmonˍ venˇ yaˇ Yaˍshawˇbanˍ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh canˇ paˍ 800 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhawˇhiˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Doˉdoˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ lehˬ aˉhtaw hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo hpui yuˬ maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkanˍ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Haˍranˍ venˇ yaˇ Aˍgiˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Shaˍmaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍhiˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo miˬ nawˆ hko teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Shaˍmaˍ lehˬ miˬ nawˆ hko oˇ ve hkʼaw huˉ taˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkanˍ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, chaw shehˆ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍduˇlanˍ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve Daˍviˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ moˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhpenˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Daˍviˆ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ moˍ lehˬ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ leh, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo cawˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ a shu ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ taw laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai leh, nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ veu laˇ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ ngaˬ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ dawˬ ve kʼo, iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ a sha‸ tanˇ leh ca hkʼo ve chaw chi shehˆ gʼaˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ dawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˬ. Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh canˇ paˍ 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw hpehˬ leh,
yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw awˬ meh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ.

Keˍzeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ htawˇ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ hoˆ jaˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˇ shaw‸ mvuh leh gehˇ taˆ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ lu yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ juˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ htawˇ ka‸ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw awˬ meh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ga la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve chaw shenˍ ca gʼawˆ nyi-o, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼaˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh naˍ, chaw shenˍ ca yuˬ nyi-o. Ngaˬ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ ha pun kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ. A hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼaw nyi gaˇ ve le, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh te tuˬ, Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw shenˍ ca gʼawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Yaˍzaˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Hiˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇlaˆ leh Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tu leh, Danˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Siˉdonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Tuˇruˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo kʼai taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ leh nyiˇ chi nyi ponˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo gaˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ca gʼawˆ veu laˇ ve chaw shenˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la peuˬ ve chaw 800,000 leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw 500,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw shenˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ nyi ma maˇ sha ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi ve hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Gaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Ngaˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ yaw piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ shehˆ hkawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Daˍviˆ zuh‸ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ,

Gaˆ yawˇ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi shehˆ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ha pa shehˆ maˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpaw toˇ ve te gaˇ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Chi beu‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ te leh, yawˇ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 70,000 gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-a teh‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Pehˇ-o. Taˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yaˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw Aˍyawˇnaˆ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Gaˆ lehˬ Daˍviˆ geh laˬ leh, Aˍyawˇnaˆ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ ca te-o, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Gaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ pi ve hkʼe ca te tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˍyawˇnaˆ chiˇ nyi leh, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ Daˍviˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh,

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ choˬ kaˬ laˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Naˬ beuˬ hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve ca‸ jaw‸ kuiˬ chi hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍyawˇnaˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yuˬ leh nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ choˬ kaˬ lo nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo caˬ jaw‸ htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ leh, nuˇ lawˬ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ awˬ pon yehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍyawˇnaˆ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ piˇ leh, Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ peuˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ oˇ ve leh nuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpu 50 hteh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la chehˇ ve naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ mawˇ la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ aˉ boˆ hkʼaˬ ma yuˬ kaw piˇ ve htawˇ, lehˬ la maˇ gʼa.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui nawˬ awˬ pon yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ca laˇ shaˍ. Yawˇ nawˬ geh zuh‸ leh nawˬ hta‸ lehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca nyi ve yoˬ. Shuˆnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Aˍbiˇshehˆ meh ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui ca mawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇoˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ muiˬ piˇ.

Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ suh peuˬ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ miˇ ma Haˍgiˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa deˇ maˍ piˇ jaw. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ 50 gʼaˇ ca teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yaˍbaˆ leh, paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui hta‸ na‸ uˉ ca te da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ, Sheˍmiˆ, Reˍiˆ leh Daˍviˆ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ, Enˍyawˇgeˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Vuiˬ haˉ pui shiˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh jawˇmawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kuˬ piˇ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Naˍtanˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve awˬ e Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ geh kʼai leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍgiˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa shiˍ sheˍ.
Nawˬ leh nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ gaˇ sheˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o.

Chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chi beu‸ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lo‸ la leh ngaˬ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe gʼa ga kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ leh, Shuˆnenˍ venˇ yaˇ Aˍbiˇshehˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma loˍ ve le, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ Aˍdawˉniˍyaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ ve law.

Yawˇ lehˬ, nuˇ leh yawˬ maˇ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ maˇ kuˬ piˇ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ leuˆ laˇ tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ law nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ shu hpeh yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, Naˍtanˍ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve awˬ lawn shu jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆpiˇ leh, Naˍtanˍ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Aˍdawˉ niˍyaˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ nawˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve laˇ.

Ya‸ nyi yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh, nuˇ, yawˬ, teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ, paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Aˍ dawˇniˍyaˆ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hpoˆ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh nawˬve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ kuˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ te cawˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ awˬ to maˇ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ laˬ tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ lo‸ la leh, yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe,
ya‸ nyi nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh, Ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Zaˍdoˆ, Naˍtanˍ leh Beˍnaˍyaˆ hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gaˬ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh leh, Giˇhonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai-o.

Oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Zaˍdoˆ leh Naˍtanˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸ monˍ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kuˬ-o‸.

Peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍnaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ nyi ma cawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ ve hkʼe, Sawˉla‸monˍ geh ka‸ chehˇ leh, nawˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ mvuhˇmiˬ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Zaˍdoˆ, Naˍtanˍ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh jawˇmawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh leh, Giˇhonˍ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Zaˍdoˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ ve shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh, Sawˉla‸ monˍ hta‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ co zuhˬha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ hpoˆ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˉ lu meuˆ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve peuˬ la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kuˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Behˬ heh ma meuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Venˇ hkʼaw lo aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ shu hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇnaˆ tanˍ gʼuiˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ, Laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw da‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh peuˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ, Naˍtanˍ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve piˉlaˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Zaˍdoˆ leh Naˍtanˍ yawˇ hta‸ Giˇhonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa venˇ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ jaw mawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ nawˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ te laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, nawˬ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ yanˇ a‸ kehˉ mvuhˇmiˬ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui chiˇ mvuh piˇ-a veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ngaˬ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tcuh piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇnaˆ tanˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, tawˬ miˇ tawˬ hkʼaˇ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
