Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ htawˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca kʼuˉ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ mvuh ka‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ gʼa ce tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ htaˬ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ suh la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ pawˆchi hkʼe maˍ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh kanˉ te puiˉ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te-o. Nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ, Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ gaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve nawˬ htawˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh, Yeˍtaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍsaˍ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw yawˇ huiˉ maˬ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ chaˆ taˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ gawˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ taˇ te suh-e tcuh.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Giˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Baˍziˆlehˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Geˍraˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍmiˆ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Baˍhuˆrenˍ venˇ lo kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ taˇ ponˬ piˇ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ cawˇ ve nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Sawˉlaˆmonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ suh-e leh, yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw 7 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw 33 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlaˆmonˍlehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍgiˆ ve yaˇ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve awˬ e Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ca guiˇ la ve laˇ, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, ngaˬ ca guiˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ na nyi gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma na nyi gaˇ le, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la cawˇ ve nawˬ ka‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la law. Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ geh kʼai leh, Shuˆnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ Aˍbiˆshehˇ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ca lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh ca lawˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ lehˬ awˬ lawn oˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw tu huˉ leh ha‸ yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e awˬ pon kʼaw jaw teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw la‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ lo teh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. A ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma le. Ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆshehˇ nawˬ viˉ paˍ Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Aˍbiˆshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh tuˬ nawˬ ca lawˬ la ve le. Ngaˬ ve kʼaw jaw htawˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ viˉ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ leh Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ka ti‸ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍdawˇ niˇyaˆ ngaˬ geh chi hkʼe ca lawˬ la ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ pa ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo mui tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ lehˬ ya‸ nyi gʼa suh tuˬve yoˬ, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ tawˆ kʼai leh Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ paw hkuˇ Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ gaˇ sheˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, yawˇ geh teˇ geh tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇliˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ te biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍdawˇniˇ yaˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ hpawˇ maˇ chehˇ) Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca kʼuˉ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ ca na nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉ la‸monˍ lehˬ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Beˍnaˍyaˆ bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Nawˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ maˇ tawˆ la. Choˬ kaˬ lo suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Beˍnaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh ca tuˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ chi, ngaˬ leh Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ tcuh leh yawˇ hkʼawˇ te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh yawˇ a‸ kehˉ cheuˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh Aˍmaˍsaˍ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ awˬ to leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Beˍnaˍyaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ paˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Yaˍbaˆ awˬ tan Beˍnaˍyaˆ hta‸ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh leh, Aˍbyaˍtaˍ awˬ tan Zaˍdoˆ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw yehˬ teˇ maˬ te leh chehˇ taˍ-oˬ. Venˇ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo taˇ tawˆ-e.
Nawˬ lehˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Kiˇdronˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sheˍmiˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe gaˬ leh, Sheˍmiˆ ve aw ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gaˍtaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Maˍkaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhkiˆ geh ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Gaˍtaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Sheˍmiˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ ciˇ leh jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkiˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmiˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa tawˆ-e tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw hkanˍ tcuh taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ tawˆ-e ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe nawˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hkanˍ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Hkʼe te kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, Daˍviˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ co co yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ Beˍnaˍyaˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Beˍnaˍyaˆ tawˆ kʼai leh Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍlehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ, bon yehˬ leh lanˇ venˇ kawˍ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon bon yehˬ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ laiˉ kaˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ awˬ pa Daˍviˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ laiˉ kaˬ hkʼoˆ lo to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Giˇbonˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ca tuˉ tanˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh, laiˉ pawˆ tuˉ tanˇ jaw peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ, ya‸ nyi yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ a sha‸ i jaˇ sheˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ maˇ puiˉ sheˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa awˬ tan chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ, leh da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ, paw sha la tuˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ tuˬ awˬ pon bon maˇ lawˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ lawˬ ve pa taw,

nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ taˉ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw te‸ chehˇ ve chaw leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ maˇ lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ paw sha leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ zuh‸ nawˇ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw tawˇ yaw laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, meh maˬ lanˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ suhˉ te da‸ leh jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yaˇ miˇ chi ve ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ teˇ yehˬ hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nyiˇ nyi hkʼe kʼaw‸ gaˬ leh, yawˇ htawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ gʼa nyiˉ heuˆ leh, nyiˉ pehˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ ngaˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ tu la leh ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Suh taˍ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ paˇ lo iˉ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh, ngaˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ cuˉ taw piˇ-a teh‸ te htaˇ, yaˇ chi suh taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Maˇ heˆ. Te‸ chehˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Suh taˍ ve yaˇ chi lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ heˆ. Suh taˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Te‸ chehˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, te‸ chehˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Suh peuˬ ve yaˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ shu yawˇ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chehˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ chi hta‸ jeˆ hkoˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hkoˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ e teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ loˬ. Yaˇ miˇ chi ve hta‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ chi ve ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ taˇ pe‸ laˇ. Yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ nyiˇ hkoˇ jeˆ hkoˇ loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ chi hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ. Yaˇ ehˉ chi awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ e hpeh‸ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ jaˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ puiˉ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Shaˉnanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˇhawˇraˆ leh Aˍbiˇyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Caˇ lanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhiˇluˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˍ hpaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ lehˬ, Naˍtanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Naˍtanˍ ve yaˇ Zaˍdoˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆshaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Aˍbaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍdawˇniˍ ranˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 12 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shaw caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ha pa chi hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve 12 gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Benˍhuˇraˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ tawn hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Benˍdeˍkaˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Maˍkaˆ venˇ, Shaˍlaˍbenˍ venˇ, Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ, Eˇ lonˍ venˇ leh Beˍhaˍnanˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Benˍheˍsehˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍruˇboˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˇhkawˇ venˇ leh Heˍhpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Benˍaˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Taˍhpaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Dawˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhiˇluˆ ve yaˇ Baˍnaˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Taˍnehˆ venˇ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ, Behˆshanˍ venˇ, Zaˍreˍtanˍ venˇ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ te leh, Aˍbeˍlaˆmaˍhawˍlaˆ venˇ, Yoˆmanˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Benˍgeˍbaˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ, Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍiˇraˆ ve hkʼaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍgawˇbaˆ venˇ leh, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ leh kuiˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ te taˍ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ 60 venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉdoˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆnaˍdaˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Maˍhaˍnenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˆmaˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Baˍseˍmehˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Huˆsheˇ ve yaˇ Baˍnaˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍshaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Baˍloˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paˍruˇ-aˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍhkaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍ ve yaˇ Sheˍmiˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Uˇriˆ ve yaˇ Geˍbaˍ, yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Aˍmawˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ chi ve 12 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ uˉ peunˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ teˇ nyi le le loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, junˍ meu-e 150 hkʼawˍ lawˇ, cho‸ meu-e 300 hkʼawˍ lawˇ,
hkʼa deh‸ caˍ chu taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 10 hkeh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 20 hkeh, leh awˬ nu ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ, heh nuˇ, leh gʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Tiˉhpaˍtaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko leh maˉ nawˆ hko te caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼawˬ tuˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ 40,000 leh ciˇ tuˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ 12,000 cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve 12 gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ hta‸ tinˍ piˇ taˍ ve ha pa gaˬ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Loˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ hkʼaw ve junˍ leh chi gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ Eˇzaˍraˍheˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇtanˍ leh Maˍhawˇlaˆ ve yaˇ Heˍmanˍ, Kaˍlaˍkawˇlaˆ leh Daˍraˍdaˆ hui a‸ kehˉ ka‸ yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo yawˇ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, tawˇ naˉ ve tawˇ 3,000 hkawˇ leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ 1,000 puˆ hpaˆ bvuh‸ tawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ, ngaˆ, vuiˬ, leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ ka‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca na tcuh ve yoˬ.

Tuˉruˆ jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Daˍ viˆ awˬ tan Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ma‸ gʼa bawˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ te maˇ gʼa sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ pa hta‸ ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon a ciˉ ca htu laˇ tcuh-o. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kanˉ te ve gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw suhˆ htu maˇ puiˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ shanˍ feu laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo gʼawˬ ya‸ la leh hpeh tsuh‸ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ shi ya‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpui baˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hiˇranˍ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ htawˇ, kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon 1hkʼaw‸ ve caˬ hkʼa 100,000 hkʼawˍ lawˇ leh shaˍlonˍ chu 3,000 punˇ hkʼe feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hiˆranˍ leh Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 30,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ leh kanˉ te tcuh tuˬ, kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ Aˍdawˇ niˍranˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kanˉ te paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ 3 moˍ pehˬ leh, 1 moˍ ve hta‸ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ha pa teˇ maˬ kanˉ ca te tcuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ha pa 2 maˬ gʼaˇ jehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 8,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui ca hpfuhˆ duˇ tcuh leh, chaw 70,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ haˉ pui oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ taˆ hpoˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ 3,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ kawˍ tuˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ htawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ ve chaw, Hiˆranˍ ve chaw leh Geˍbaˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ pon haˉ pui shiˍ leh suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve 4 hkʼaw‸ 1 hkʼaw‸, ha pa 2 maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ bon yehˬ hta‸ tanˬ te ve yoˬ. (Chi lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve 480 hkʼaw‸ biˇ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Bon yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 60 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ leh mvuh hpawˇ 30 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw tanˬ lo‸-e ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ bawehˇ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼe hui cawˬ leh, zuhˬhpawˇ 20 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 10 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo awˬ baˬ hpawˇ a ciˉ i leh awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ a ciˉ kʼoˍ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ
Ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo, 3 htai‸ cawˬ leh mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve awˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ leh leh ve teˇ htai‸ lehˬ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. 3 htai‸ teˇ htai‸ lehˬ kʼehˬ hpawˇ 7 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon suhˆ cawˆ lonˉ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ keu leh gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ i kʼai piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ te htaˇ, hta tu dawˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ, ceˉ ceˇ htawˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ na‸ htaˇ ka‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ leh leh ve teˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve yehˬ miˉ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, 2 htai‸ teˇ htai‸ leh 3 htai‸ teˇ htai‸ lo taˆ-e tuˬ ve go te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ bon yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo nehˉ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ toˉ la‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ keu leh gʼo‸ pa awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve awˬ bawehˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ te peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ yuˬ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ teˇ tawn lo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ cawˬ leh gʼo‸ pa hta‸ keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ yuˬ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 40 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo nehˉ taˍ ve keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ shiˍ leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo kawˍ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh tuˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ leh mvuh hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ keˍdaˍ suhˆ baˉ hkʼa deh‸ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo shi oˍ taˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e kuiˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hkʼoˆ lo shi caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve Hkeˍruˆbenˍ 2 maˬ hta‸ shaˍlonˍ suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ oˇ ve 2 maˬ lehˬ, mvuh hpawˇ 10 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, nyiˇ maˬ maˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ maˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ hkʼa shuˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ maˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ cawˬ leh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ 5 shaw‸ zuhˬ ve yoˬ.
Toˍ la‸ kuˉ teˇ meuˇ leh teˇ meuˇ awˬ kaˍ lo 10 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, bawehˇ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ daw‸ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ lehˬ, gʼo‸ pa hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ gʼo‸ pa awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ, leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼawˇ taˍ ve suhˆ baˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸, yehˬ miˉ nyiˇ maˬ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ meuˇ lehˬ, aˉlaˇmiˬshiˉjaw hkʼe a ciˉ gʼawˉ-ehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ miˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ leh htawˆ taˍ ve awˬ han oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬ miˉ hta‸ shaˍlonˍ suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ leh, awˬ ceˍ awˇ ceˍ cawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hpaw puiˉ hoˆ puiˉ ve yehˬ miˉ nyiˇ maˬ htawˇ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ miˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ leh suhˉ veˆ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ leh, shi oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ bawehˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, haˉ pui shehˆ htai‸ leh suhˆ teˇ htai‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ chi ve hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve 4 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ tanˬ kawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve 10 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa 8 maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ, bon yehˬ chi ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ chi hta‸ 7 hkʼaw‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Hawˉ yehˬ chi ve hta‸ te ve 13 hkʼaw‸ maw ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw, chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ tuˬ ve yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hteunˍ lonˉ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ lonˉ chi ve zuhˬ hpawˇ 100 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 50 shaw‸, leh mvuh hpawˇ 30 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw shehˆ cawˆ cawˬ leh, teˇ cawˆ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw 15 maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ chi hkʼaw keu taˍ ve toˉ la‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mawˇ teh kuiˬ bawehˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa gaˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ shehˆ cawˆ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ miˉ leh yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceˍ awˇ ceˍ cawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hpawˇ leh teˇ hpawˇ hteˇ leh‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve yehˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw yehˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ chi ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 50 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 30 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ suhˆ baˉ hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve yehˬ hta‸, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ miˇ ma Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw awˬ pon htawˇ, yehˬ oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ maˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ kawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ te htawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ kawˍ tuˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ uiˍ chaweh te htawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ 8 shaw‸ zuhˬ leh teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ 10 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, awˬ nu ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˍ leh, keˍdaˍ suhˆ toˉ la‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ yehˬ awˬ pon, da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ awˬ pon, bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve bawehˇ lonˉ awˬ pon, ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, haˉ pui shehˆ htai‸ kawˍ leh keˍdaˍ suhˆ teˇ htai‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve cheuˬ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ Huˍranˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kuiˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ suh kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ htawˇ kuiˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸ monˍ kuˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Huˍranˍ lehˬ, kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 18 shaw‸, uiˍ ve hpawˇ 12 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve awˬ hoˆ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo, aˉ caˆ hkeh vaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ leh,
kuiˇ aˉ ci ku shiˍ nyiˇ cawˆ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo te hoˆ taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ leh, 4 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh tsuh‸ da‸ taˍ ve awˬ han htawˆ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, aˉ ci ku shiˍ nyiˇ cawˆ te nehˉ taˍ leh, aˉ ci ku shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ 200 shiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Huˍranˍ lehˬ kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. La‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ lo teh taˍ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ Yaˍhkenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ leh, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ Bawˇzaˆ, teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lawˉ bo veˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Huˍranˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 30 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 10 shaw‸ leh mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve kuiˇ iˉ kaˆ punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo, kuiˇ aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ shiˍ awˬ han nyiˇ cawˆ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi lehˬ, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 12 hkeh awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehˆ hkeh teˇ hpawˇ mawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kuiˇ punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi ve lehˬ, htu ve hpawˇ la‸ naw awˇ hkeh cawˬ leh, awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo iˉ kaˆ kawˆ hkʼe te taˍ ve yoˬ. Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ awˇ meunˍ punˇ keu daw ve yoˬ.
Huˍranˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸, leh mvuh hpawˇ 3 shaw‸ cawˬ ve kuiˇ lawˬ ehˉ 10 maˬ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Lawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ ve suhˆ baˉ yuˬ te leh,
suhˆ baˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ awˬ han leh, Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Lawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuiˇ gaˉ yaw 4 maˬ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Lawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ ceˍ 4 ceˍ lo, hkehˇ pe le teh taˍ gʼa tuˬ, kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ehˉ 4 maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ hkuiˉ dawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, hkehˇ teh taˍ tuˬ kuiˇ caˆ gʼawˉ-ehˍ te htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Kuiˇ caˆ chi ve lehˬ, lawˬ ehˉ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ shaw‸ hkʼe mvuh taˆ la leh, lawˬ ehˉ hkʼaw teˇ htu hkʼe lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ. Kuiˇ baˉ chi ve hta‸ nyi sha tuˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu mvuh ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ve gaˉ yaw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Lawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve awˇ ceˍ lo vawˆ ciˇ kuiˬ awˇ maˬ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ lawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, fe hpawˇ teˇ htu cawˬ ve kuiˇ caˆ yuˬ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw ehˉ leh kuiˇ caˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han, laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han leh tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, lawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Lawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Huˍranˍ lehˬ, lawˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkehˇ pe le 20 maˬ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Hkehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 4 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, iˉ kaˆ 800 kawˆ hkʼe keu daw ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ lawˬ ehˉ oˇ ve 5 maˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo teh taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve 5 maˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kuiˇ punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Huˍranˍ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu, hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ baˬ tuˬ, leh hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ awˬ pon jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ te tcuh ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ, Awˬ hoˆ nyiˇ maˬ, Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo te keu piˇ tuˬ ve kuiˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ, Kuiˇ aˉ ci ku shiˍ 200 shiˍ, teˇ cawˆ teˇ ha shiˍ te keu tuˬ, Lawˬ ehˉ 10 maˬ leh Hkehˇ pe le 10 maˬ, Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ leh, Oˇ ve hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ piˇ taˍ tuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 12 hkeh, Mu‸ hkʼu, hkʼaw‸ laˉ toˆ baˬ tuˬ, hkehˇ leh, awˬ nu ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ pon jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ te tcuh ve mawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸, kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Suˇkoˆ leh Zaˍreˍtanˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yawˇ danˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tsuh nyi. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kuiˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ cawehˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ ve mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, shi yuˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Tuˇ tanˇ kuiˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ tuˬ ve hpui lawˇ,
da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ teˇ chi maˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ, suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ faiˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sho nuˆ teˇ hpaˍ,

kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ, hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shiˉ gʼeu‸ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ leh da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ yehˬ miˉ hkʼaw keu tuˬ ve paˆ taˍ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve hpu, shi, leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Eˍtaˍnenˍ ha pa hkʼaw te ve Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la peuˬ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ leh bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ hpaˆ baˬ leh bon yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yawˬ leh nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh, Hkeˍruˆbenˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ lehˬ, ta kʼoˍ leh ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ keu taˆ chehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼoˆ lo beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, suhˆ taˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ)

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Moˉseˍ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍla chaw hui Eˇjiˇ tu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Sawˉla‸monˍ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ moˬ leh naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw lo chehˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ yawˇ hui hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te tcuh sheˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi jaw ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ, haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ keu taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ leh, la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ chiˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, ya‸ nyi nawˬ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la peuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ laˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Mvuhˇ naw ma chi taw taw uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ chehˇ maˇ law‸ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi ve hkʼaw nawˬ chehˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le a ciˉ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo ngaˬ hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬhui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shu hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ a ciˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ. Te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa gaˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh choˬ kaˬ nawˬ ve bon yehˬ lo laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ ve ka‸, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hkʼaw bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve, mvuhˇ goˇ jaˇ leh caˬ luˬ ve, caˬ faˆ tawˆ ve, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve, naˬ ve gawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, bon yehˬ chi hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ leh,
nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ bon yehˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve hkʼe, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ gʼa ca bawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ca bawˆ la leh, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve leh, ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpehˇ baˬ piˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ a ciˉ te piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼe hpeh‸ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Moˉseˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Sawˉla‸monˍ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon oˇ hkʼe lawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ tu la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui geh chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui geh htawˇ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ yawˇ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nuˇ 22,000 hkeh, yawˬ 120,000 hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi ma ma ve hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ceh tiˉ tuˉ tanˇ maˇ daw ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ na‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ leh yawˇ te gaˇ ve awˬ nu ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Giˇbonˍ venˇ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh laˬ jaw ve hkʼe, yawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ peuˬ. Bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve kʼo,
nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ te hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kʼo,

ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ lonˉ chi ve luˬ kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. A hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve leh bon yehˬ lonˉ chi ve hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ te ve 20 hkʼaw‸ hkʼe maw ve yoˬ.

Tuˉruˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Hiˍranˍ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ loˍ ve suhˆ leh shi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ ga ca piˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸ monˍ Hiˍranˍ hta‸ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ 20 venˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Hiˍranˍ ca nyi leh, yawˇ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ Sawˉlaˆmonˍ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ nyi paˍ-oˬ, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ tawn hta‸ Kaˍbuˍ laˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hiˍranˍ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ shi shehˆ hinˉ teˇ ha cawehˬ feu piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kanˉ nyiˉ te tcuh leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ leh lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Baˍzawˇ venˇ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ leh Gaˍzaˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

(Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Geˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ piˇ htaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.)
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ,
Baˍlaˆ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Taˍmaˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ, leh yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo venˇ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kanˉ nyiˉ te tcuh ve awˬ ceˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ awˬ ceˬ maˇ te tcuh. Yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi tuˬ, kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ 550 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ heuˆ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ leh, yawˇ te piˇ taˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ca shiˍ keu piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Miˆlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, sha hawnˉ htawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Eˇloˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Eˇzaˍyonˍgaˍbaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Hiˍranˍ lehˬ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tcuh leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ca ga te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Awˇhpiˍraˆ venˇ lo haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ kʼai leh, shi 9,920 cawehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ geh yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ haˍ jaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ na nyi tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ moˍ lonˉ gʼa‸ veu laˇ leh, sha hawnˉ, shehnˉ shiˍ leh shi hkʼa biˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ na nyi gaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ na nyi laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ ve lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ te caˍ te taw laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ ve yehˬ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve a ma‸ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ leh anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Sawˍla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ ve awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, nawˬ chi taw taw cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ yonˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh nawˬ cawˬ taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ bon uiˍ ve le. Nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ teˇ nyi le le gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ bon uiˍ jaˇ ve le.

Nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, shi 3,100 cawehˬ, sha hawnˉ leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ma piˇ ve sha hawnˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ jaw ve sha hawnˉ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
(Hiˍranˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ geh shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ, Awˇhpiˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ, leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw te ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, tinˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Suhˆ chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.)

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ ma hkʼa lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ shi 15,500 cawehˬ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa ve awˬ hkawnˍ, Aˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ laˇ ve awˬ hkawnˍ leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh shaw gʼa taˍ ve awˬ hkawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ 200 maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Htanˬ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ ve shi 6 cawehˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ ehˉ 300 maˬ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Htanˬ tuˬ ehˉ chi ve teˇ maˬ ve shi teˇ cawehˬ ngaˇ hkanˉ hkʼe yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hteunˍ lonˉ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kʼaw jaw lonˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw jaw lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ tawn hta‸ haw ciˬ yuˬ te taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve shi yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e tuˬ go hkʼeh‸ 6 maˬ cawˬ ve go teˇ maˬ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Go hkʼeh‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ htawˆ keu taˍ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ 12 hkeh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ awˬ han te keu taˍ leh, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han te keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve kʼaw jaw awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ ve kawˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ hteunˍ lonˉ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw hkʼa yehˇ ve kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpu teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ yehˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ, hpu teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teh‸ maˇ shawˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Hiˍranˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh te toˇ tuˬ ve yawˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ geh shi, hpu, haw ciˬ, maw‸ leh maw‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh paw sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ ca na la gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ geh hkʼa laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ, veu‸ kʼaˇ, la‸ caˉ, sha hawnˉ, iˉ mvuhˇ, piˉ laˬ, chi hkʼe ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 1,400 maˬ cawˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ meunˍ nyiˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, hpu teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, keˍdaˍ suhˆ teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ awˬ nu ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Tuˍraˍkiˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw laˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ ve 600 hteh‸ gʼa piˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hkeh ve 150 hteh‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh iˉ mvuhˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, Hiˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ heuˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ, Mawˇbaˆ, Aˍmonˍ, Eˇdonˍ leh Siˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma suhˍ ha gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ miˇ ma i shehˆ ha gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yawˇ hui te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ mawˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Siˉdonˍ chaw hui ve Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ma leh, Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve Miˆlaˍkonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve Hkeˍmoˆ gʼuiˬsha leh, Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve Miˆlaˍkonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼo pui leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chehˇ kuiˬ laiˉ kaˬ lo te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Sawˉla‸monˍ geh nyiˇ pawˆ laˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve htawˇ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˬ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi leh, nawˬ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te sheˍ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ co-e gaˬ htaˇ heh‸ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ he. Nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ leh, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇdonˍ chaw Haˍdaˆ hta‸ nyi ma gu piˇ leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Daˍviˆ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa peuˬ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo kʼai leh suh taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ jaw ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ chehˇ leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Haˍdaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. (Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Haˍdaˆ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ hui Meˇdiˍanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Paˍranˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca pawnˇ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Haˍdaˆ hta‸ chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ piˇ leh, caˍ piˇ taw piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍdaˆ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ la leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Haˍdaˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Taˍpaˍnehˆ ve awˬ nyi ma piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Geˍnuˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Haˍdaˆ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yaˍbaˆ hui suh kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw le. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma nyi ma maˇ sha kuiˬ cawˬ le, teh‸ Haˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Haˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Haˍdaˆ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve canˇ paˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇlaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Reˍzonˍ hta‸ htawˇ nyi ma gu piˇ leh, Sawˉla‸ monˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Reˍzonˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Zawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh,

chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ moˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Daˍviˆ Haˍdaˍ deˍzaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ htaˇ yoˬ.) Reˍzonˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇ miˍ Zeˍreˍdaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇ baoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ-e lehˬ Zeˍruˇaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ gʼa hpfuhˆ ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Miˆlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ta‸ yehˬ leh lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te puiˉ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ gʼa shiˍ leh, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇyaˆ yawˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˇyaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ 12 peˆ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpa chi ve 10 peˆ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hta‸ chaw 10 ceuˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Daˍviˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te ve lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˉ leh, Siˉdonˍ chaw hui ve Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ma, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve Hkeˍmoˆ gʼuiˬsha, Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve Miˆlaˍkonˍ gʼuiˬsha, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw yoˬ. Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ piˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ teˇ co-e kʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ 10 ceuˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ uˉ peunˍ gaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, co co taiˍ taiˍ chi hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhiˇyaˆ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yeˍyawˇ baoˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Shiˇshehˆ geh hpaw-e leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ hkʼa te taˉ ve kanˉ leh, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇbaoˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e taˍ ve Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh Yawˇbaoˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ pa Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kanˉ hehnˇ chaweh nyiˉ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kanˉ chi taw taw maˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ uˉ peunˍ ve hawˉ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇbaoˬ lehˬ, Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o‸. Oˇ htaˇ heh‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hpoˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ ka‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ piˇ cawˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ na sha ve tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Yawˇ geh teˇ geh uiˍ taˆ la leh, chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve le. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve la‸ naw lehˬ, ngaˬ pa ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi a‸ kehˉ htu jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ pa nawˬ hui hta‸ hawˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hawˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˇ taˬ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ jaw‸ ve shaˍ guiˬ caˆ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ geh kʼaw‸ hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼe maˇ te leh, yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hawˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hawˇ jaˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˇ taˬ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ jaw‸ ve shaˍ guiˬ caˆ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇyaˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ ve hta‸ chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ga hpoˆ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ suh sheˆ suh-e piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ taˍ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ. Yawˇbaoˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ chehˇ taˉ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ Aˍdawˇniˍranˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇbaoˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 180,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha tcuh kaˍ paˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh,
Yawˇbaoˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ ca bawˆ-e. Ngaˬ ve a loˍ cawˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ jaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ-e leh, Peˍnoeˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ chi hkʼe dawˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo tiˉ kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui Yawˇbaoˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe dawˇ gʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shi nuˇ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ te leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo tiˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ nyi sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shi nuˇ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ Danˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Beˍteˍlaˆ leh Danˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo paw hkuˇ te tuˬ Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw te chehˇ ve pawehˇ hkʼe ve teˇ maˬ hta‸, ha pa hiˉ maˬ teˇ maˬ, 15 nyi htaˇ te tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ te teh taˍ ve shi nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hta‸ yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo kanˉ te tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ yuˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa 8 maˬ teˇ maˬ, 15 nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ Yeˍyawˇ baoˍ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ kuiˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ-oˬ, Yawˇshiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh, chaw yaˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh leh, tuˉ tanˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi luˬ kʼai leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼaw‸ laˉ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ naw juˆ taˍ leh, Chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh teˇ hkoˇ baˉ suh kʼai leh, che taˍ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve htawˇ paˆ ce sheˬ leh, hkʼaw‸ laˉ teˇ hpaˍ sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ yawˇ awˬ pon bon lawˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve la‸sheh kʼaw‸ da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve yehˬ lo laˬ leh ngaˬ geh awˍ ca caˇ la-o. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
