Tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ geh cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hkoˇ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh kʼai leh awˍ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo te‸ chiˉ taˇ caˇ taˇ dawˬ. Nawˬ kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ taˇ te kʼaw‸ la, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve awˬ lawn leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ caˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve le, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ kʼo‸-e ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ciˇ tuˬ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh haˆ haˆ gu tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ awˬ pon piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh sheh veu laˇ leh,

yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo mui chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ leh, Nawˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬve tcuh kaˍ paˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo laˬ leh, ngaˬ geh awˍ ca caˇ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh awˍ ca caˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ choˬ kaˬ lo te‸ chiˉ taˇ caˇ taˇ dawˬ. Nawˬ laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ taˇ te kʼaw‸ la, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hkʼa shuˍ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ heˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˍ ca caˇ-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˍ mui caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve geh gaˬ la leh,
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe nawˬ maˇ te.

Nawˬ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, choˬ kaˬ lo awˍ ca mui caˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi hui ve tuˍ hpfuh paˇ lo gʼa tuˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve awˬ pon piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh ca piˇ leh, yawˇ ciˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh tawˆ la leh yawˇ hta‸ che‸ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ to ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo ce leh, piˉ laˬ leh laˇ caˬ shiˉ yawˇ ve awˬ to paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai cawˇ leh, suh taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e leh, awˬ lawn oˇ ve shu hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ che‸ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ awˬ pon piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh gu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui yawˇ awˬ pon piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh gu piˇ leh, yawˇ ciˇ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo, tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Piˉ laˬ leh laˇ caˬ shiˉ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ laˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ maˇ caˇ. Piˉ laˬ hta‸ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te piˇ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw suh oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh lo tuˍ piˇ leh, Ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ-oˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ chaw mawˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suh-e ve kʼo, tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi ve awˬ paˇ lo tuˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi ve leh, awˬ nu ve Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ. Yawˇ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo kanˉ te tuˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw maˇ heˆ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ paw hkuˇ ve aˉ yaˇ tcuhˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˇyaˆ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ yawˇ miˇ ma hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tawnˇ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ pa leh ngaˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇyaˆ geh Shiˉ lonˍ venˇ lo kʼai-o.

Yawˇ awˬ pon hkaoˍmonˇ 10 shiˍ leh, pehˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ kaw yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi-o. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo chehˇ ve Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Aˍhiˇyaˆ lehˬ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, mehˆ maˇmawˬ-o.

Yeˍyaˇbaoˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, naˬ chehˇ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ lawn ca na nyi la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ miˇ ma lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ pa leh, Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lo‸ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Aˍhiˇyaˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Lo‸ la-o. Nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te laˬ ve le. Nawˬ awˬ pon maˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼe maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo jawˇmawˇ hkʼa te peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼehˇ hkʼa shuˍ, shu toˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw lo hkʼa suh-e ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpuiˇ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˬ beu‸ ngaˆ htawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ hkui, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ paˆ hawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu hkʼa deh‸ tuˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw gʼuiˬ dawˇ htinˍ leh hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ te chehˇ ve lo cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw gʼa‸ baˬ leh, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ miˇ ma lehˬ, Tiˇraˍzaˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ hkui yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve shaˉ cheˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇ yaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ suh-e leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Naˍdaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 41 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ 17 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw Neˍmaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ laiˉ kaˬ te leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼo ka‸, oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lo hawˉ hkʼaˆ chawˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ pehˬ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te leh, meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ te ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 5 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Shiˇshehˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Sawˉla‸ monˍ te taˍ ve shi htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ kuiˇ htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te leh, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ pawˆ le le, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pfuhˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ shaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Yawˇbaoˍ leh Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ya‸ da‸ leh bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇbaoˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbiˇyaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve 18 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍbiˇyaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 3 hkʼaw‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍhkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh, yawˇ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Hiˇtiˆ chaw Uˇriˆya‸ miˇ ma hta‸ te ya‸ ve teˇ pawˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ leh Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ma‸ bawˆ da‸chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍsaˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 20 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍsaˍlehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 41 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pi lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍhkaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pi Maˍhkaˍ htawˇ, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma lonˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa te tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍshaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo chaw tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve hpu, shi, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Haˍsaˍronˍ Taˍbaˍriˆmonˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ geh Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo feu kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ chawˇ te da‸ jaw ve hkʼe, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ awˬ chawˇ te da‸-a veuˬ. Hpu, shi, chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Aˍsaˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉyonˍ venˇ, Danˍ venˇ, Aˍbeˍlaˆbehˆmaˍhkaˍ venˇ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ lehˬ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Raˍmaˆ venˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Tiˇraˍzaˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ta‸ yehˬ te chehˇ ve suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca taˆ yuˬ tcuh leh, Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Geˍbaˍ leh Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍ mawˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve hkui sheh a naˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve yaˇ Naˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆmvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve yaˇ Baˍshaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Naˍdaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbaˍtonˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ chehˇ htaˇ, Baˍshaˍ Naˍdaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 3 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Baˍshaˍ lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ awˬ tan Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇyaˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ ponˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ venˇbaˆ te leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Naˍdaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ma‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 3 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve yaˇ Baˍshaˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ leh, Tiˇraˍzaˍ venˇ hkʼaw 2 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍ reˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Haˍnaˍniˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, Baˍshaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬYeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw lo suh-e ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpuiˇ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ htawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Baˍshaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Baˍshaˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Tiˇraˍzaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍshaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍhuˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Baˍshaˍ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍshaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ venˇbaˆ te ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa‸ ca leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 26 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Baˍshaˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Tiˉraˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hkoˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Ziˇmaˍriˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Eˇlaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍzaˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo, tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Ziˇmaˍriˆ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 27 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˇmaˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍshaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Ziˇmaˍriˆ lehˬ Baˍshaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍshaˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇlaˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 27 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Ziˉmaˍriˆ Tiˇraˍzaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ 7 nyi uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇbaˍtonˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ziˇmaˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Awˇmaˍriˆ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Awˇmaˍriˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Tiˇraˍzaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve shu la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ Ziˇmaˍriˆ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e leh, hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ziˇmaˍriˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw nyiˇ moˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Giˇhaˆ ve yaˇ Tiˇbaˍniˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh gaˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Awˇmaˍriˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Awˇmaˍriˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hpawˇ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Tiˇbaˍniˆ suh-e leh, Awˇmaˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 31 hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Awˇmaˍriˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ 12 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Tiˇraˍzaˆ venˇ hkʼaw 6 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍmaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh Saˍmaˍriˆ hkʼaw pui hta‸ hpu 6,000 hteh‸ piˇ leh vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˇmaˍriˆ lehˬ, hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ caw ko leh ta‸ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui oˇ ve hawˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ yuˬ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇmaˍriˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ venˇbaˆ te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇmaˍriˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˇmaˍriˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 38 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Awˇmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼe ceh tiˉ haiˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Siˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ Eˉtaˍbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ kaˬ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hiˇleˍlaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆ hkoˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve Hiˇleˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Aˍbiˆranˍ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ leh Saˍgoˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Tiˉshaˍbiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, Te‸ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ nyiˇ, shehˆ hkʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, ciˍ gʼuiˬ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Hkeˍriˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ca va‸ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh Hkeˍriˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ leh, teˇ shawˉ teˇ haˉ le aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ leh shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve pa taw, maˇ maw maw iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve htawˇ fiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ tu leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Zaˍraˍtaˆ venˇ lo kʼai-o. Nawˬ hta‸ te caˍ te taw laˇ tuˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇya‸ Zaˍraˍtaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpeh‸ lo gaˬ htaˇ, mehˇchawˇma teˇ gʼaˇ suhˆ gʼawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ a ciˉ taw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve iˉ kaˆ ca nyiˉ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ awˬ pon hkaoˍmonˇ ka‸ a ciˉ yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Te‸ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Hkehˇ hkʼaw junˍ meu-e a ciˉ leh, kaw hkʼaw shaˍlonˍ chu a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te caˇ tuˬ chi beu‸ suhˆ ca gʼawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ peuˬ kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ gʼa meu‸ suh-e tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ pon ka‸ hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ ehˉ a ciˉ te veu laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ caˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, junˍ meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu peuˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mehˇchawˇma oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇliˇya‸ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh yawˇ hui awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, junˍ meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu maˇ peuˬ kʼai.
Maˇ maw maw mehˇchawˇma ve yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve chehˇ haˍ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ naˬ ve oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ jaˇ la leh, awˬ leh meuˇ suh sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve le. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ laˬ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon laˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ zuh‸ kuiˬ awˬ na teˇ bawehˇ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw mehˇchawˇma chi ve hta‸ nawˬ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve le. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve ka‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hkʼoˆ yawˇ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ boˆ zuh‸ sheˬ leh, Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yaˇ paˍ chi ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇliˇya‸ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve shaˉ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ gʼa la leh, kʼaw‸ te‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ e geh kʼaw‸ shiˍ ya‸ la leh, Nyi loˬ, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ kʼaw‸ te‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, mvuhˇ goˇ ve awˬ yanˇ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe gaˬ la leh, Nawˬ chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai-o. Ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Eˇliˇya‸ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw lehˬ, meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Awˇbaˍdiˆ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. (Awˇbaˍdiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ 100 gʼaˇ hta‸ nyiˇ moˍ te leh haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw yuˬ faˉ taˍ leh, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.)
Aˍhaˆ Awˇbaˍdiˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon iˉ kaˆ lawˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, caˇ tuˬ ca nyi piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hpawˇ lo zuhˇ mvuh‸ ca kʼai ve yoˬ.

Awˇbaˍdiˆ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Nawˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Eˇliˇya‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yoˬ, ngaˬ Eˇliˇya‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇbaˍdiˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa suh tuˬ, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le.

Te‸ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh hkʼaw ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na maˇ mawˬ ve awˬ lawn hkanˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve laˇ.

Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ hkui, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hta‸ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le. Jawˇmawˇ choˬ kaˬ laˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-oˬ.

Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ 100 gʼaˇ ve hta‸ nyiˇ moˍ te ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa kaˇ laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ca kʼoˆ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ve awˬ to jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Awˇbaˍdiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Awˇbaˍdiˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve law leˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ heˆ. Sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ ma Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ ve Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ 450 gʼaˇ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve paw hkuˇ 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhaˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpa hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw nyi ma heh chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Baˍlaˆ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tawˇ teˇ peu-eˍ ka‸ maˇ yaw hkʼaw‸.
Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˇya‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ ngaˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, choˬ kaˬ lo Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ 450 gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ nyiˇ hkeh sheh veu laˇ-oˆ. Teˇ hkeh Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ leh tuˉ tanˇ tcuh-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˬ miˍ taˇ tuˉ tcuh. Awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ tcuh-o. Ngaˬ htawˇ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ piˇ gʼa ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˇya‸ Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpa hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chaw maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui awˉ lawˉ tuˉ tanˇ leh nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ taˇ tuˉ keu, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh tiˇpehˍ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha geh bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo kʼaˍ hpoˆ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ la.

Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ, Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh bon lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ ve leh hehˉ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo kʼai toˇ chehˇ ve leh hehˉ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve leh naˍ. Nawˇ la tuˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kʼaw‸ kuˬ leh, te muiˬ te jaw ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ shawˆ hkʼaw leh, awˬ suhˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi suhˉ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ la.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ paˇ neˇ lo jiˆ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paˆ kʼai taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ 12 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ haˉ pui shiˍ 12 shiˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo iˉ kaˆ 12 punˇ hkʼe keu daw ve gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ maˬ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ 4 punˇ hkʼo leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ pfuhˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hkʼo pfuhˍ sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hkʼo pfuhˍ sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hkʼo pfuhˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ iˉ kaˆ nehˆ leh duˇ taˍ ve gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ leh, nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, tuˉ tanˇ taˍ ve shaˍ, suhˆ, haˉ pui, miˬguiˬ leh gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yu‸-o‸. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ ponˬ piˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kiˇshonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh oˇ kaˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇya‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, Chi beu‸ nawˬ awˍ haˆ ca caˇ-e loˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˆ awˍ ca caˇ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇya‸ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpawˇ lo nyi peu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ la leh, Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa mawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ pawˆ teˆ pawˆ yawˇ ca nyi taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Chaw yaˇ ve la‸ taw kʼaw hui ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve moˬ teˇ diˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh aˉ hkʼaw lo haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ hkui tiˉ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo moˬ biˇ taˆ la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw htawˇ meuˆ laˬ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ Eˇliˇya‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼawˬ tsuh‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhaˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇya‸ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Baˍlaˆ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tiˇ pehˍ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve kʼo, gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,

teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suhˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ awˬ hawˉ lo mui taˍ leh, Ngaˬ suh-e ve kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve co ha hta‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ suh gaˇ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe bon lawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo paˍ zuh‸ leh zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca htawˇ la leh, Tu loˬ. Caˇ tuˬ caˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tu leh nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ paˇ lo hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ shiˍ leh iˉ kaˆ teˇ kawˆ teh taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ caˇ peuˬ dawˬ peuˬ leh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ nawˍ piˇ leh, Tu-o. Caˇ tuˬ caˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw vuiˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇya‸ tu la leh, caˇ tuˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ kehˬ ve Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw lo 40 nyi gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ pon awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇliˇya‸-oˬ, nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, hkʼaw pui leh haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkoˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ. Mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ ve jehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, miˬ kʼaw‸ hiˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬ hiˆ ve hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ.

Miˬ hiˆ ve jehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ to‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ. Aˬ miˍ to‸ ve mehˉ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hkawˇ nuˇ lehˍ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇliˇya‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ aˉ po‸ yuˬ beh leh haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇya‸-oˬ, nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Suˉriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ Haˍzeˍlaˆ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Neˍshiˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Aˍbeˍlaˆmaˍhawˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Shaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ tan tcuh kaˍ paˍ te tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Haˍzeˍlaˆ la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ tawˆ-e ve chaw hta‸ Yeˍhuˆ tiˇpehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ tawˆ-e ve chaw hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw suhˍ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve chaw 12 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ shu hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh leh lo ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ kʼehˆ leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve la‸ kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo teh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Eˇliˇya‸ hkʼaˇ suh gʼuiˇ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e hta‸ ca hto piˇ taˉ shaˍ. Peuˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Kʼo‸-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tawˍ taˍ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ti mi lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˍ chiˇ hkʼa deh‸ te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ 32 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh cawˬ ve hpu, shi, yaˇ miˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ loˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Beˍhaˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hpu, shi, yaˇ miˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh peu laˇ leh, nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ leh nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˬ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ shanˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh ngaˬ te laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ shanˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍhaˍdaˆ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ chi hkʼaw ve je‸ meu-e teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ kaˆ yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Cheuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ma‸ maˇ bawˆ sheˍ htaˇ nyi ma uiˍ hkawˇ maˇ yaw. Ma‸ bawˆ peuˬ heh‸ yaw ve yoˬ, teh‸ Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆhkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Beˍhaˍdaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw tzuhˬ hpoˆ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, Canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Ya‸ nyi nawˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

A shu awˬ hoˉ te leh ma‸ shiˍ bawˆ laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. A sha‸ i sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ a shu awˬ hoˉ te tuˬ le, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi htaˇ, Nawˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ 232 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ 7,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Beˍhaˍdaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ jawˇmawˇ 32 gʼaˇ hui mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ lo‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

A sha‸ i sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˉ lawˉ lo‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Beˍhaˍdaˆ hpehˇ taˍ ve chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw ma‸ moˍ lonˉ tawˆ la chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui geh shaˉ caˆ ca caˇ la chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ te‸ te‸ hpeh yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ i sheˍ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˉ lawˉ bawˆ kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼa mawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Suˇriˆ maˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Beˍhaˍdaˆ htawˇ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ ti mi cawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai leh, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, Kʼo‸-e leh nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ-o‸. Suˇriˆ chaw hui ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve 32 gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ tan miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ hkʼe taw maˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca keu-o. Chi teˇ pawˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ma‸ bawˆ leh, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Beˍ haˍdaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, Aˍhpehˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nyiˇ moˍ pehˬ leh Suˇriˆ chaw hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ chaw hta‸ tehˆ da‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ aˉ che‸ moˍ ehˉ nyiˇ moˍ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh uˉ peunˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve ta‸ hkʼaw ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui tanˬ bawˆ da‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ 100,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Aˍhpehˆ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ paˆ teˍ leh, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ 27,000 gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ. Beˍhaˍdaˆ htawˇ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e leh, yehˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hkawˇ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh, a shu yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ peˬ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇ hui meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh leh, Aˍhaˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Beˍhaˍdaˆ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Beˍhaˍdaˆ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na chehˇ leh, Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Yoˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Beˍhaˍdaˆ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa nawˬ ve awˬ pa geh bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw mawˇ hawˇ mawˇ vuiˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpaw taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw oˇ hkʼe te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ chu-iˬ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ chu-iˬ hpehˇ piˇ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh tawˆ-e ve kʼo, laˇ caˬ shiˉ che‸ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ che‸ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ chu-iˬ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa jaˇ-ehˬ teˇ hkʼe chu-iˬ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ shu maˇ tawnˇ gʼa tuˬ te gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hpa yuˬ beh leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo ca law taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hpaw tawˆ-e ve kʼo, nawˬ yawˇ awˬ tan gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, hpu 3,000 gʼa keu tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve hpa hta‸ yehˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh taˍ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ awˬ tan nawˬ gʼa suh leh, nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve hawˉ yehˬ paˇ lo, Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Naˍboˆ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Aˍhaˆ Naˍboˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hko oˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, ngaˬ gʼawˇ caˉ ti gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hko oˇ ve awˬ tan ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh da‸ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ maˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Naˍboˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Naˍboˆ lehˬ, Hko oˇ ve ngaˬ puˍ ngaˬ pi hui piˇ taˉ laˇ ve awˬ shinˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Aˍhaˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ leh aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh, zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ miˇ ma Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ lo‸ la leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ nyi ma luˬ leh maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ Naˍboˆ ve hko hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ ca piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hko oˇ ve yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ceˇ, teh‸ yawˇ miˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Tu leh caˇ tuˬ caˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ Naˍboˆ ve hko hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve yinˉ tcuhˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ ce ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi yuˬ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Oˇ kaˬ lo Naˍboˆ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo mui tcuh-o.

Peuˬ ve kʼo, chaw haiˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Naˍboˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkeu ve yoˬ teh‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tcuh-o. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce tuˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi yuˬ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ. Naˍboˆ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo mui tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, haiˬ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ tu la leh, Naˍboˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ hkeu ve yoˬ, teh‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Naˍboˆ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍboˆ suh peuˬ, teh‸ Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ geh li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai leh, Naˍboˆ suh peuˬ. Chi beu‸ hko oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ ca yuˬ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍhaˆ teˇ cawˬ haˉ tu la leh, hko oˇ ve hta‸ ca yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Tiˉshaˍbiˆ venˇ yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, Naˍboˆ ve hko hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Hko shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, hko hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ-a teh‸ te chehˇ ve laˇ. Naˍboˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ hpuiˇ leh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, nawˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ htawˇ hpuiˇ leh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ peuˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh, Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve yaˇ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshanˍ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ leh, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ miˇ ma Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw hpuiˇ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw suh-e ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hpuiˇ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˬ beu‸ ngaˆ htawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Aˍhaˆ hkʼe taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma hkʼa kʼoˆ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ya‸ taw tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Eˇliˇya‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ caˇ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ caˇ leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˬya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo Aˍhaˆ nyi ma hkʼaˬ ma nuˇ nehˬ la peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ aw laˇ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ co-e htaˇ heh‸, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˍsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh suˇriˆ chaw hui nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍhaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Suˇriˆ chaw hui bawˆ yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ bawˆ hkʼaw‸ ve le. Venˇ chi lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh, Ngaˬ hui Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˉ lawˉ na nyi cawˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Ngaˬ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ cawˇ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hto laˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, Iˉmaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Miˆhkaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw laˇ jaw. Maˇ da‸ ve tawˇ tiˉ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼoˆ cawˇ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˆ leh Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh leh Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hkeˍnaˍnaˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Zaˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, sho yuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ leh ma‸ ca bawˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Nawˬ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ kʼai ve ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Miˆhkaˍ-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ cawˇ laˇ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve kʼo, cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh yaw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw laˇ jaw, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ leh oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e piˇ tuˬ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ ca gu piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ ha teˇ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh, Ngaˬ ca te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ca te piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhaˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ heˍ ve tawˇ yaw tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai leh yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ ca gu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ ve kʼo gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ Miˆhkaˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hta hpehˇ sheˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ha ngaˬ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ tawˇ ca yaw la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ na nyi laˇ ve tawˇ chi hta‸, nawˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ toˇ chehˇ htaˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmonˍ leh ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Yawˇshaˆ geh shiˍ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw haw taˍ leh, ngaˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ kʼaw‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hkaoˍmonˇ leh iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ la sheˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ kʼai htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ-awˍ hkʼe jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhaˆ veu‸ kʼaˇ pa leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ bawˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ awˬ hoˉ 32 gʼaˇ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ jawˇmawˇ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ bawˆ peu ve hkaˆ ce lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ veu‸ deh taˍ ve sho veu‸ kʼaˇ caˉ da‸ taˍ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ peuˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhaˆ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw mui taˍ leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hpawˇ lo nyi peu chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ sheˆ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ gaˬ htaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ciˇ toˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ hui iˉ kaˆ hehˉ kuiˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po hkʼaw tsuhˇ baˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ awˬ tan yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhaˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve 4 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍsaˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 35 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Shiˉlaˍhiˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍzuˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ pa co-e htaˇ ka‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Awˇhpiˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shi ca taˆ tuˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Eˇzaˍyonˍgaˍbaˍ venˇ paˇ lo luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve chaw hui geh kanˉ te tcuh tuˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yeˍhawˇranˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve 7 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 2 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Aˍhaˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ e Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˍziˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw ce leh naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ naˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo suh-e tuˬ naˍ, yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆzeˍbuˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, Tiˉshaˍbiˆ venˇ yaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˍziˆ hpehˇ peu taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca na nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆzeˍbuˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi tuˬ kʼai toˇ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.
Chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Nawˬ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ngaˬ hui chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ geh lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆzeˍbuˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Nawˬ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve a shu le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ veu‸ deh taˍ leh, shaˍ guiˬ haˍ pi caˆ tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ ca kuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ, ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ 50 gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la tuˬ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce la leh nawˬ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ 50 gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh leh, Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ shiˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la leh nawˬ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ sheˬve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ 50 gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Eˇliˇya‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ma‸ poˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ yawˇ hui geh kʼai-o. Taˇ kawˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe te leh, Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆzeˍbuˆ gʼuiˬsha geh nawˬ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca na nyi tcuh ve pa taw, nawˬ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Aˍhkaˍziˆ suh-e ve yoˬ. Aˍhkaˍziˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇranˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 2 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yawˇranˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˍziˆ hkʼa te taˉ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law hta‸ cuˇ leh, Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ taˆ-e piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇya‸ leh Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ teˇ tawn gaˬ leh Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ moˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Ya‸ nyi nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼoˆ da‸ cawˇ hehˉ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ moˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Ya‸ nyi nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ kʼoˆ da‸ cawˇ hehˉ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ 50 gʼaˇ htawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaˇ suh Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇya‸ leh Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ a ciˉ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ kʼehˆ leh lo‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ dawˆ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ iˉ kaˆ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ sheˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ shiˍ kʼo‸-e sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ tan tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ taˉ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ lawˬ ve chi hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ na‸ uˉ te da‸ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ aˬ miˍ ha iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo lo‸ la leh, Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law hkʼaw mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ taˆ-e sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ nyiˇ hkoˇ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇya‸ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ dawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇya‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ dawˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ coˇ paˉ lo kʼaw‸ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve 50 gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, Eˇliˇya‸ ve kanˇ paˆ Eˇliˇshehˇ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui chaw 50 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ca nyi-a veuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo ca yuˬ faˉ taˍ ve hehˉ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kʼai, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lawˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve 50 gʼaˇ lehˬ, shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ca maˇ mawˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ taˇ kʼai loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe venˇ chi lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ leh, yaˇ hu ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yaˇ shawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Hkehˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw aˉ leh‸ keu leh ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ geh yuˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ hkehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw ngeuˍ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, iˉ kaˆ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ dawˬ ve chaw maˇ gʼa suh. Yaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa shawˆ-e, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ da‸ la kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇshehˇ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ tawˆ la leh, Oˉ kʼoˍ nyiˉ paˍ-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yehˬ miˉ tawˍ awˬ ma peuˍ nyiˇ hkeh tawˆ la leh, yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve 42 gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ che‸ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼai taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
