Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve 18 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇranˍ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw 12 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa leh yawˇ ve awˬ e Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ hkʼe taw maˇ haiˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa te taˉ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ htawˇ Neˍbaˆ yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ Meˍshaˆ lehˬ, yawˬ maˇ maˇ hu taˍ leh, teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ 100,000 hkeh leh, yawˬ 100,000 ve awˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Meˍshaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˉranˍ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw teˇ cawˬ haˉ tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shawˍ hpoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve, Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ma‸ ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ awˬ to, ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh ma‸ gʼa ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ le, teh‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui vuiˇ jaˇ ve Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo ca caw bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇranˍ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Eˇdonˍ jawˇmawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui suhˍ nyi te toˇ peuˬ leh, pfuhˇ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ gʼa dawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ ve choˬ kaˬ lo yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ maˇ chehˇ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Shaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˇya‸ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Nawˬ pa nawˬ e gʼaˇ va jaw ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca na nyi-o, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui jawˇmawˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ la‸ hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve, Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ nyi ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi beu‸ tinˍ hteˆ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tinˍ hteˆ puiˉ ve chaw tinˍ hteˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ Eˇliˇshehˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Lawˬ hkʼo‸ chi ve hkʼaw gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ duˇ taˍ-o‸.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ, mvuhˇ haw maˇ meuˆ ve htawˇ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ chi ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon sha jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Nyi sha ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui bawˆ yuˬ gʼa leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ duˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui je‸ duˇ keu leh, yawˇ hui ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw nawˬ hui haˉ pui shiˍ taˆ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo iˉ kaˆ ya‸ la leh lawˬ hkʼo‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ma‸ hkʼa bawˆ puiˉ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui tu nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ kaˆ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ ba ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui bawˆ da‸ leh suh peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui ve mawˇ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gʼuiˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ti mi hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ shiˍ yuˬ leh ti mi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ti mi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, haˉ pui de lonˉ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw htawˇ je‸ duˇ keu piˇ leh, hkʼa mawˬ ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htu baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ Kiˇraˆhaˍrehˆ venˇ lonˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, hawˉ ma bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw hui caw hoˆ taˍ leh hawˉ ma bawˆ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ la paˇ neˇ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉhtaw pfuhˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 700 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ geh hpaw-e tuˬ coˇ caˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hpaw maˇ ponˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo Mawˇbaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw gʼa mawˬ htaˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ suh peuˬ. Nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ shu geh jeˬ cha taˍ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ jeˬ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve laˬ leh, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jeˬ ca shawˍ yuˬ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa ga laˇ tuˬ le. Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ geh te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Shaˍlonˍ chu keu ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ ceh cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ paˇ nawˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui geh kʼai leh, ngaˍ gʼa ve hkʼe je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼa biˇ ca ngaˍ hpoˆ taˍ-o‸.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw shaˍ chu ngeuˍ keu-o, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼo‸-e leh, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ca ngaˍ taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw shaˍ chu ngeuˍ keu ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui je‸ mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw shaˍ chu keu biˇ peuˬve teˇ yanˇ, Maˇ gʼa keu sheˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ maˬ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Maˇ cawˬ-o. Chi lehˬ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ maˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ paˍ yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, shaˍ lonˍ chu maˇ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Shaˍ chu oˇ ve hta‸ hawˇ leh, nawˬ ve jeˬ hta‸ shaiˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, hpu awˬ leuˉ ka‸ tawˆ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ Suˆnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo paw sha jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ awˍ teˇ poˬ kuˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, yawˇ Suˆnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve teˇ pawˆ le le yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve geh awˍ ca caˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ lo teˇ hkui teˇ hkui laˬ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve yehˬ awˬ na teˇ bawehˇ lo yawˇ ca haˉ la kʼo zuh‸ tuˬ ve ku-iˍ teˇ maˬ, hpui lawˇ teˇ maˬ, mui hkʼawˇ teˇ maˬ leh kawˆ faiˇ teˇ maˬ ca gu taˍ piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Suˆnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh gʼaˇ ca jehˇ tuˬ yawˇ awˬ pon gu taˍ ve bawehˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, yehˬ shehˍ ma hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ shehˍ ma gaˬ la htaˇ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon yaˇ miˇ chi te laˇ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ leh naˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ gʼa ca yaw piˇ tuˬ leh naˍ, yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na nyi-o, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa te piˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ ka‸ mawˇ la peuˬ, teh‸ Geˍhaˍziˆ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo jiˆ laˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve laˬ leh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa chiˇ guiˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ heˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nehˉ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la leh, caˬ gʼeu‸ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve ti mi hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ pa geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ naˬ jaˇ, ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ naˬ jaˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ e geh chiˇ kʼo‸-e piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ awˬ pa yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ e geh chiˇ kʼo‸-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ e lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ taˆ mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ la htaˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve suh-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ ve bawehˇ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh sheh veu laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼai tuˬ loˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼai taˉ peuˬ kʼo, haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ya‸ nyi kʼai gaˇ ve le. Ya‸ nyi lehˬ shinˉ nyi ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te ve awˬ nyi ka‸ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Piˉ laˬ hta‸ awˬ an tcuhˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Piˇ laˬ hta‸ gehˬ gʼa ve hkʼe a ciˉ gehˬ chaweh gʼa‸ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ tawˇ maˇ pe‸ laˇ ve kʼo taˇ jehˇ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, Nyi loˬ. Suˆnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ geh haˆ gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hui chehˇ sha chehˇ leh naˍ, ca na nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ chehˇ sha chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Geˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca‸ baˬ-a teh‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te. Yawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ mawˬ laˇ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ laˇ sheˬ, teh‸ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ heˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ hpfuhˆ nyi leh, Ngaˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh haˆ gʼuiˇ kʼai-o. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ na‸ uˉ taˇ te da‸ chehˇ. Yaˇ miˇ ma chi ve yehˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ chi ve hta‸ yaˇ ehˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu-o, teh‸ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teh taˉ leh maˇ kʼo‸-e, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Geˍhaˍziˆ gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo che peu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ la. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Yaˇ ehˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la mawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇshehˇ yehˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ lo zuh‸ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yehˬ miˉ hoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw, mehˆ shiˍ, leh la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ, yaˇ ehˉ ve maw‸ kʼaw‸, mehˆ shiˍ leh la‸ sheh hkʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ ehˉ kʼaw‸ lehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ tu la leh bawehˇ hkʼaw htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ taˆ-e leh, awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ te ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ tcuhˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ mehˆ hpaw la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ nyi-o, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve hkui paˇ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon awˍ chiˇ teˇ mu‸ hkʼu lonˉ te tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh leh, aˉ mo‸ kʼoˍ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pfuhˇ gʼaˇ ve hkʼe shaˉ pfuhˇ veu laˇ leh teˇ geh hkaw‸ caˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˍ caˇ yanˇ gaˬ leh, awˍ keu caˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Awˍ chiˇ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw awˬ taw‸ ma cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Caˬ hkʼa meu-e a ciˉ yuˬ veuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ htaˇ, awˬ chiˇ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw baˬ keu leh, Chi teˇ pawˆ caˇ nyi loˬ. Te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh awˍ chiˇ oˇ ve te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ, Baˍlaˍsaˍliˇshaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh lo caˬ suhˉ hkʼa yuˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ 20 shiˍ leh iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ, Caˇ tuˬ chi ve chaw 100 gʼaˇ caˇ law‸-aw laˇ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui caˇ bvuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ leuˉ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ ceˬ paˍ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui caˇ bvuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ leuˉ ka‸ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍmanˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍmanˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw yaˇ miˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh gʼa leh, Neˍmanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ ma te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ ehˉ chi yawˇ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ geh kʼai piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Neˍmanˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ ehˉ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Li‸ chi ve hta‸ yuˬ veu leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai-o, teh‸ Neˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Neˍmanˍ lehˬ hpu 30,000, shi 6,000 leh da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ 10 cuˍ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve li‸ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ hta‸ a ciˉ gu na-e piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ gʼaw nyi peuˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ leh chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ gu na-e tcuh laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, suh piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve, teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ meuˇ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le. Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Neˍmanˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Eˇliˇshehˇ yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yawˇ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ca tuˍ keu tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a naˍ na-e la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Neˍmanˍ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to tawˆ la leh ngaˬ awˬ pon yawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ ve a naˍ hta‸ htawˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Daˍmaˍsehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍbaˍnaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh Hpaˍhpaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ ve a naˍ na-e la tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa hehˉ tuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ hehˉ-e yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi a‸ kehˉ haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ te tcuh laˇ ve kʼo ka‸, nawˬ te cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, iˉ kaˆ ceh ca hehˉ leh nawˬ ve a naˍ na-e la tuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ te nyi cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Neˍmanˍ Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw 7 pawˆ tuˍ keu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ da‸ la kehˬ la leh, yaˇ ehˉ ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Neˍmanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, La‸ shawnˍ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ te‸ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Neˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. La‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ, Neˍmanˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Neˍmanˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, piˉ laˬ nyiˇ hkeh taˆ law‸ ve je‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Aw lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-o.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ pawˆ Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve Riˇmonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ law ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw kʼo‸-e loˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ Neˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Neˍmanˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ hkui hkʼe gaˬ leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ chi hkʼe dawˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Neˍmanˍ geh te‸ chiˉ maˇ yuˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve tanˇ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ geh teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ca lawˬ yuˬ taˉ shaˍ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Neˍmanˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ Neˍmanˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Geˍhaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ sheh htaˇ ceh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ moˍ gaˬ la ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ geh lo hpu shehˆ hinˉ leh da‸ ja ve veu‸ kʼaˇ nyiˇ cuˍ ca lawˬ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Neˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Neˍmanˍ lehˬ, Awˬ bon te leh hpu hkaw‸ hinˉ yuˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gaˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Neˍmanˍ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve hkaw‸ hinˉ hta‸ taˉ poˆ nyiˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa ga taˆ kʼoˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ nyiˇ cuˍ htawˇ piˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇshehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Geˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ taˉ poˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Neˍmanˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai ve le, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ kaˬ ka‸ maˇ kʼai, teh‸ Geˍhaˍziˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Chi beu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, hpu, veu‸ kʼaˇ, shaˍlonˍ hko, a pehˉ meuˇ hko, ceˇ caˬ leh awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ heˆ.

Chi beu‸ Neˍmanˍ ve a naˍ nawˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co a naˍ chi ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Geˍhaˍziˆ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, a naˍ oˇ ve yawˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ vaˇ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi a ciˉ maˇ kʼehˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo kʼai leh chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ suhˉ ca nyi tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼai loˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tuˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ htawˇ kʼai tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ leh kanˉ tanˬ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo suhˆ htu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ceˉ ceˇ kʼehˆ tawˆ-e leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh laˬ leh, Saˍla‸ lonˉ-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le. Ceˉ ceˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ shu geh ca ngaˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve ceˉ ceˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Ceˉ ceˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ lo ce ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ ceˉ ceˇ ce lo‸-e ve chehˇ kuiˬ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ tawˆ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ceˉ ceˇ oˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼoˆ lo fuˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Haˆ yuˬ tawˆ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, chaw oˇ ve haˆ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hui hta‸ jehˬ da‸ leh, yawˇ hui ca deh tuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼawˇ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh, hkʼa deh‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe tiˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ maw la peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ nyi ma luˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hpawˇ lo maˇ chehˇ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ nawˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ nyi-o. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ Dawˇtanˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai peu ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ hui Dawˇtanˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la leh, venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ tu la leh, yehˬ baˬ lo tawˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Ngaˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇliˇshehˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ chiˇ nyi leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ha iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ lo‸ bawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mehˉ cuˉ piˇ law‸-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ca nyi chehˇ ve venˇ lehˬ, venˇ chi ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ ve chaw geh ngaˬ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ bon kʼaw‸ lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw piˇ leh kʼaw‸ mawˬ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ mehˆ kʼaw‸ mawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw hpeh gʼa ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ te piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼo‸-e peu ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Suˇriˆ chaw lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ haˍ jaˇ la ve yoˬ. Piˉ laˬ oˉ kʼoˍ teˇ shiˍ ve 150 gʼa piˇ leh, guˇ hkʼehˇ teˇ panˇ ve hta‸ 9 hteh‸ gʼa vuiˬ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ga laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ geh lo ka‸ caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ cawˬ taˍ ve leh laˇ.

Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˉ nyi htaˇ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ ma chi ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, ya‸ nyi nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ leh, shawˉ pawˍ kʼo ngaˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tiˇ caˇ-a, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, aˉ nyi htaˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ca shiˍ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ htaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa tawˆ cheˆ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo ca guiˇ la ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ tcuh peu ve chaw oˇ ve Eˇliˇshehˇ geh maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ muiˬ teˇ hkui yawˇ choˬ kaˬ gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw taˇ lo‸ la tcuh. Yehˬ miˉ hkʼa deh‸ hoˆ taˍ-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ ka‸ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, jawˇmawˇ awˬ to gaˬ la leh, Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ te laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ law nyi chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, cho‸ shiˍ teˇ panˇ teˇ hteh‸, caˬ hkʼa nyiˇ panˇ teˇ hteh‸ nawˬ gʼa hawˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe ca hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha chi beu‸ la‸ haˉ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve ka‸, oˇ hkʼe ca hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa caˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkiˬ tu‸ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ baˬ lo mui taˍ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te jo mui chehˇ tuˬ ve le.

Venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa suh ve tiˉ yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo ceh jo mui taˍ ve ka‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui Suˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ka‸ yaˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui Suˇriˆ chaw deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ moˍ lonˉ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ awˬ moˍ lonˉ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ kaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ Hiˇtiˆ chaw leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui laˬ chehˇ ve hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Hkiˬ tu‸ paˍ oˇ ve 4 gʼaˇ Suˇriˆ chaw hui ve fa la paˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui fa la hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, hkʼa bvuhˆ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa mawˬ ve hpu, shi, leh veu‸ kaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ca gʼawˆ faˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui fa la teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh oˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ nyi da‸ taˍ leh, Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ maˇ cawˇ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve hta‸ law chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui venˇ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh, jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e leh, Ngaˬ hui Suˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ taˉ peuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ venˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ lo ca gʼuiˇ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw tu la leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe cuˇ yiˍ te chehˇ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ shaˍ. Choˬ kaˬ lo meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui fa la teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ ca hpfuhˆ yuˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ te‸ te‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ cuˇ yiˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ 5 hkeh piˇ leh, ca nyi tcuh-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai ve awˬ lawn ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ yuˬ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ ca gʼa‸ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo canˇ paˍ hui baˬ taˉ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Suˇriˆ chaw hui ve fa la lo gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, cho‸ shiˍ teˇ panˇ teˇ hteh‸, caˬ hkʼa nyiˇ panˇ teˇ hteh‸ te hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shaw taˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw chaw tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ ve maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ shu gʼa ga naˆ heuˆ leh naˆ pehˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ awˬ to Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ taˉ leh gʼa suh-e ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, cho‸ shiˍ teˇ panˇ teˇ hteh‸, caˬ hkʼa 2 panˇ teˇ hteh‸ nawˬ gʼa te hawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ,

a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe ca hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha chi beu‸ la‸ haˉ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve ka‸ oˇ hkʼe ca hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa caˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shu naˆ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw 7 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo ca jiˆ chehˇ taˍ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Suˆnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw 7 hkʼaw‸ ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la leh, jawˇmawˇ geh yawˇ ve yehˬ leh yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ ca kʼaw‸ lawˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Geˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ te ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ shiˍ gaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gaˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, Eˇliˇshehˇ suh taˍ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ jawˇmawˇ geh yawˇ ve yehˬ leh miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ lawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Geˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ ma chi ve yaˇ paˍ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ na nyi ve hkʼe, yaˇ miˇ ma chi ve htawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ hpaw-e hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ ve ti mi hkʼaw hkʼa tawˆ la ve caˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ hpu kʼaw‸ shawˍ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ,

yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Haˍzeˍlaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Chi beu‸ nawˬ la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ geh kʼai-o. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ leh naˍ, yawˇ hta‸ ca na nyi-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kaˍlaˍoˆ 40 hkeh hta‸ taˆ tcuh leh, Eˇliˇshehˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ geh laˬ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Haˍzeˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, nawˬ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ Haˍzeˍlaˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi tiˍ taˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Haˍzeˍlaˆ mehˆ hpfuhˇ haw jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hawˬ ve le, teh‸ Haˍzeˍlaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ pehˍ leh, yaˇ hu chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ shawˆ hkoˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te gʼa law‸ law‸ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ la tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Haˍzeˍlaˆ Eˇliˇshehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Suˇriˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍzeˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Eˇliˇshehˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ le, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ ceˇ, teh‸ yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shawˉ pawˍ gaˬ htaˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ aˉ boˆ teˇ hkʼoˆ yuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ tiˆ nehˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hoˆ piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇranˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 5 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇranˍ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ yawˇ ve a sha‸ 32 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 8 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍhaˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ gaˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhawˇranˍ lehˬ Zaˍiˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ yawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw tawˆ-e leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo hpaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Liˇbaˍnaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ hkʼa te taˉ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhaˍziˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˉranˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 12 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ yawˇ ve a sha‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ ceh gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ yaˇ miˇ Aˍtaˍliˆ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Awˇmaˍriˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, Aˍhaˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ hta‸ ca bawˆ ve yoˬ. Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui bawˆ da‸ leh, Yawˇranˍ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la leh naˆ tsuhˇ gu chehˇ htaˇ, Aˍhaˍziˆ yawˇ geh ca guiˇ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ veu leh Raˍmoˆ venˇ lo kʼai-o.
Nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ kʼo, Neˍshiˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ ca nyi-o. Yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, shu maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh,

yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ ve kʼo, haˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o, teh‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ ehˉ oˇ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ leh jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ tu la leh, Nawˬ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Yeˍhuˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ shu tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ che‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˉ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ cawˬ haˉ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˆ htawˇ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Chaw gʼuˇ paˍ oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma ca kʼoˆ la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ga hpoˆ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma loˍ ve nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ leh go hkʼeh‸ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼawˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ tcuh leh, Yeˍhuˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, Raˍmoˆ venˇ lo Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ hkaˆ ce heuˆ ve pa taw, Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw naˆ tsuhˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ tuˬ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ, hkʼa deh‸ shaˍ ti‸ te leh nyi taˍ-oˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ lehˬ naˬ ve maˇ na-e la sheˍ. Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ geh guiˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhuˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, Laˬ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ chawˇ naˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo canˇ paˍ leh naˍ, gʼa shiˍ tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca nyi tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ Yeˍhuˆ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ chawˇ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Jawˇmawˇ shiˍ gaˇ ve ceˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Kanˉ chi nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma caˉ da‸ le. Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hui geh gaˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ la mawˬ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ peu leh, ca kʼaw‸ nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Kanˉ chi nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma caˉ da‸ le. Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ-oˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hta‸ shawˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve ka‸ yawˇ hui geh gaˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ la mawˬ ve awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ la leh, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa‸ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi kʼo, Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ ciˇ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ Naˍboˆ ve ti mi paˇ lo hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ dawˇ sha ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw laˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ e Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ te keu taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui geh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la gʼa tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, Aˍhaˍziˆ-oˬ, chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Yawˇranˍ hta‸ hkaˆ bawˆ hpehˇ leh, Yawˇranˍ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Yawˇranˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Biˆdaˍkaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yawˇranˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ Naˍboˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Yawˇranˍ ve awˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍhaˆ awˬ lawn hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˉ nyi htaˇ Naˍboˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ biˇ la tuˬ Yawˇranˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ haˆ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh Naˍboˆ ve ti mi hkʼaw lo baˬ keu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Biˆdaˍkaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Beˍtaˍhaˍganˍ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ htawˇ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, Chi hpaˇ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˇbaˍlanˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Guˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ htawˇ hkaˆ ce bawˆ heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpaw-e leh, oˇ kaˬ gaˬ htaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇranˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 11 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍsaˍ beˍlaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ awˬ hkiˇ gu shawˍ leh, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw jaˆ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhuˆ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Ziˇmaˍriˆ-oˬ, nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma ca la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhuˆ chiˇ nyi leh, A shu ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ kuˬ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ve ma‸ poˍ nyiˇ, shehˆ gʼaˇ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ ca tawˆ nyi la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ ma chi ve hta‸ ca‸ ce peu-o, teh‸ ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ca‸ ce peu leh, yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ gʼo‸ pa leh iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngawˉ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ yaˇ miˇ ma oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh awˍ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˇ miˇ ma chi hta‸ ca yuˬ tuˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi yawˇ hui Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ biˇ peuˬ. Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ hkʼehˇ hkʼa shuˍ sheˆ kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca tawnˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍhuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 70 gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh lo iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ, la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui li‸ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh jawˇmawˇ te tcuh-o. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tcuh-o, teh‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ leh jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ hui ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼa, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ dawˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hpawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ ve kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 70 gʼaˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ choˬ kaˬ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ geh gaˬ la piˆ, teh‸ li‸ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve 70 gʼaˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼawˆ hu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˆ ve li‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve 70 gʼaˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ yuˬ leh hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo Yeˍhuˆ geh feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ gaˬ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn shu Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ htaˇ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ oˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo nyiˇ hpoˆ te teh taˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ kanˉ chi hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˉ da‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ ve le.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ te biˇ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ nu ve Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chawˇ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ teh taˉ piˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo, Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hui ve fa la teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ,

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, Nawˬ hui a shu le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Aˍhaˍziˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo jawˇmawˇ ma Yeˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca guiˇ tuˬ kʼai toˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve miˬ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ 42 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˬhuˆ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Reˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hta‸ la‸ sheh caˉ piˇ leh, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ hawˍ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hpawˇ chehˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼoˆ gʼawˬ taˆ piˇ leh,
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh te chehˇ ve nawˬ ca gʼa‸ nyi la-o, teh‸ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, gʼuiˬsha chi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ chehˇ tcuh taˉ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Yeˍhuˆ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ te chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.)
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi tinˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ nyi teˇ nyi tinˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo awˬ lawn kaˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gaˬ la leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh veu‸ deh tcuh piˇ tuˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Reˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw ceh tiˉ choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ choˬ kaˬ lo maˇ gʼa laˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ leh nyi taˍ-o‸, teh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhuˆ leh Yawˇnaˍdaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 80 gʼaˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ paˇ lo hkʼa deh‸ shaw tcuh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ponˬ tawˆ-e kʼo, pon tawˆ-e piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve awˬ tan gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ hkʼa deh‸ shanˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nawˬ hui lo‸-e leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ ponˬ piˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lo‸-e leh chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo gʼawˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve teˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Baˍlaˆ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ-e leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ka‸ bon yehˬ hta‸ ka‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo aˉ kʼa‸ yiˬ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ Yeˍhuˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te mehˉ kʼai piˇ ve awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ leh Danˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ te teh taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te tcuh piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 4 co-e hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ i la piˇ ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍyawˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ,
awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gaˆ, Ruˇbenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhuˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hui ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˇhkaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 28 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ ve awˬ e Aˍtaˍliˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ suh peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˆ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ shu tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ ma Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Yawˇsheˍbaˆ yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍtaˍliˆ yaˇ paˍ chi ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, Yawˇsheˍbaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍtaˍliˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsheˍbaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo 6 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ yawˇ hui hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍhaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ kuˬ tawˆ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ maw piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shinˉ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ca shaw la tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, shehˆ pun teˇ pun ceh tiˉ bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw taˉ leh,
shehˆ pun nyiˇ pun lehˬ, bon yehˬ lo laˬ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, jawˇmawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ lo laˬ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ hkawˇ na leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve gehˇ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw teˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ leh, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ sheh hta leh, Jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma Aˍtaˍliˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ bon yehˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍtaˍliˆ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Aˍtaˍliˆ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e loˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ca htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ la ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, Iˉ mvuhˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Yawˇshaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw te tuˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ awˬ to leh Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ kaˍ lo htawˇ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ Maˍtanˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw tuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, hawˉ yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo mui tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍtaˍliˆ suh peuˬ ve pa taw, chi teˇ pawˆ mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˆ a sha‸ 7 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhuˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 7 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇshaˆ lehˬYeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ yawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ loˍ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh shu Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la htaˇ shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ kanˉ te cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ hkʼa gʼa ve hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇshaˆ jawˇmawˇ te laˬ ve 20 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve ka‸, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te maˇ gʼa sheˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ gu sheˍ ve le. Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, nawˬ hui shaw gʼa ve hpu tanˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ gu gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ hpu tanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ te leh hpu tanˇ keu kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw htaw pawnˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ la‸ sha paˇ hpawˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te cawˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpa lehˬ, ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve chaw hui geh shaw gʼa ve hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw hpu tanˇ biˇ la htaˇ, shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ laˬ leh, hpu tanˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tsuh nyi ve yoˬ.
Hpu hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ ve hta‸ caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ awˬ hoˉ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ, haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ, yehˇ loˍ ve suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hpu kawˆ, shi kawˆ, behˬ heh ma, kawˆ faiˇ, leh awˬ nu awˬ na hpu shi yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, hpu tanˇ chi hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh maˇ yehˇ.
Kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ ve leh, loˍ ve suhˆ, haˉ pui chi hkʼe ve vuiˬ htaˇ tiˉ yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te paˍ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hteˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Venˇbaˆ gʼa pon tuˬ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve chaw hui geh gʼa ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ keu. Hpu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Gaˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ka‸ kʼaw‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ jawˇmawˇ te taˉ peuˬ ve Yeˍhawˇshaˍhpaˆ, Yeˍhawˇranˍ leh Aˍhaˍziˆ hui shaw hpoˆ taˉ ve hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ hta‸ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shiˍmaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˉsaˍkaˍ leh Shawˇmeˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˉzaˍbaˆ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lehˬ, Sheˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo cawˬ ve Miˆlawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ shu Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍmaˍziˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve 23 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍhuˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhkaˆ jawˇmawˇ te leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 17 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇhkaˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇhkaˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ te taˉ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ. Venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ leh laiˉ pawˆ naˆ nehˆ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇhkaˆ geh ma‸ yaˇ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 50 gʼaˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 10 maˬ, ma‸ yaˇ 10,000 hkʼe ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇhkaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 37 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇhkaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 16 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇshaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh yawˇ ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼaw Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇshaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇshehˇ naˬ jaˇ leh, suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ yawˇ geh ca guiˇ-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, Hkaˆ leh hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ ca yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ hkaˆ leh hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh,

hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ hta‸ bawˆ peu tuˬ, Eˇliˇshehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ hta‸ bawˆ peu tuˬ gu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ maˬ hpaw leh, bawˆ peu ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇshehˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve hkaˆ ce hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh Yawˇ Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ Aˍhpehˆ venˇ hkʼaw gʼa bawˆ da‸ leh, nawˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇshehˇ lehˬ, hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ jaw‸ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ shehˆ hkʼe jaw‸ peuˬ leh hpehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ ngaˇ hkʼe, hkaw‸ hkʼe jaw‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼe kʼo, Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ shehˆ pawˆ tiˉ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇliˇshehˇ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le, Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇsuh-e leh ca tuˍ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ca bawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, chaw suh ku hta‸ Eˇliˇshehˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Chaw suh ku oˇ ve Eˇliˇshehˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ daw‸ htaˇ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ kʼaw‸ te‸ la leh huˉ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇhkaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ gaˬ tcuh piˇ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hta‸ yawˇ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ leunˇ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzeˍlaˆ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ, Beˍhaˍdaˆ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ pa Yawˇhkaˆ awˬ co-e htaˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ bawˆ yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇhkaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 29 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yuˇdanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Yawˇshaˆ te ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ. Moˉseˍ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ pa awˬ e te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Te ya‸ ve chaw hta‸ tiˉ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Aˉ leh‸ lawˬ hkʼo‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Sheˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ bawˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ Yuˆteˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ oˇ hkʼe meh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ geh lo yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ca hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˆshaˆ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ teˇ cehˬ hta‸, Nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ka piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai cawˇ leh, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ oˇ ve hta‸ naˆ nehˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ ceˇ.

Aˍmaˍziˆ-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ chaw hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve pa taw, nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tiˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍmaˍziˆ maˇ na yuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhawˇshaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, lanˇ venˇ 400 shaw‸ hkʼe te luˬ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo te leh, awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, hkʼa mawˬ ve hpu shi hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇshaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh yawˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇshaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ (2) yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Iˍsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ka‸, 15 hkʼaw‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw shu hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍmaˍziˆ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a sha‸ 16 hkʼaw‸ tiˉ gaˬ sheˍ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Awˇziˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˇziˆ lehˬ Eˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 15 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 41 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Gaˍheˍhpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍmiˆtehˇ ve yaˇ Yoˇna‸ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ biˇ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˬ (2) hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
