Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ (2) hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ leh Haˍmaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ(2) uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 27 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍmaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Awˇziˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˇziˆ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 16 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 52 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍhkawˇliˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ka‸ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ yehˬ teˇ yehˬ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇtanˍ yawˇ awˬ tan mvuhˇmiˬ kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi te kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇziˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˇziˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˇtanˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 38 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ ha pa 6 maˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbehˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Iˉbaˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 4 co-e hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ biˇ la ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 39 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yaˍbehˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha pa teˇ maˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍdiˆ ve yaˇ Meˍnaˍhenˍ, Tiˇraˍzaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Shaˍlonˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Shaˍlonˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Meˍnaˍhenˍ lehˬ Taˍpaˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ hu chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ htawˇ shawˆ hkoˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 39 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Gaˍdiˆ ve yaˇ Meˍnaˍhenˍ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 10 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ, Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Meˍnaˍhenˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpu 10,000 cawehˬ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw sha ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh hpu 50 hteh‸ kʼaw‸ shaw yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Meˍnaˍhenˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Peˍkaˍhiˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 50 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Meˍnaˍhenˍ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍhiˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 2 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ, Neˍbaˆ yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Peˍkaˍ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ve ma‸ yaˇ 50 gʼaˇ shiˍ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍhiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Peˍkaˍhiˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 52 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ, Neˍbaˆ yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peˍkaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ laˬ leh, Iˉyonˍ venˇ, Aˍbeˍlaˆbehˆmaˍhkaˍ venˇ Yaˍnawˇ venˇ, Kaˍdeˍshaˆ venˇ, Haˍzawˇ venˇ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ, Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Awˇziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇtanˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 20 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Eˇlaˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇsheˍ jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Peˍkaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 2 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Awˇziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇtanˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 10 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Jeˍruˇshaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa Awˇziˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇtanˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca tanˬ bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhkaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 17 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇtanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhkaˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 16 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hui te ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, sha hawnˉ leh awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ maˇ gʼa.

(Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Eˇdonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui Eˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ca ga la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kiˇraˆ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ han teˇ maˬ nyi te leh, paw hkuˇ Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Uˇriˇya‸ lehˬ awˬ han oˇ ve hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Aˍhkaˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkaˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te peuˬ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ suhˉ oˇ ve lehˬ bon yehˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te teh taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ jiˆ teh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇ Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ nawˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chi beu‸ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ suhˉ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ceh tiˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ htawˇ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ suhˉ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tiˉ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ-o‸. Kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ piˍ chi teˇ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi tuˬ cawˬ la htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, Uˇriˇya‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve lawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ baˬ leh, hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 12 hkeh awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve, kuiˇ iˉ kaˆ punˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ yuˬ ya‸ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ, Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ laˬ htaˇ mui ve kʼaw jaw leh, jawˇmawˇ awˬ pon fuiˍ teh taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hoˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 12 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Eˇlaˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇsheˍ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ 9 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw maˇ haiˬ jaˇ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Shaˍlaˍmaˍneˍsaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Hawˉsheˍ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ la‸ caˉ ya‸ piˇ leh, teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le awˬ hkawnˍ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ Hawˇsheˍ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Sawˇ geh lo yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ ca lawˬ hkawˉ tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Hawˇsheˍ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ keu piˇ-o. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Hawˇsheˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh htawnˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hawˇseˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve 9 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Haˍlaˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Gawˇzanˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Meˍdiˆ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hawˉ lo, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ leh, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh, shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tcuh taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-oˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ va.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ ha‸ shaˉ. Gʼuiˬsha shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hui ka‸ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui te ve hkʼe yawˇ hui ka‸ gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ nyiˇ maˬ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ hui te teh taˍ leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ hui geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ceh tiˉ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ka‸ gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ te ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ, Kuˇtaˆ venˇ, Aˍvaˍ venˇ, Haˍmaˆ venˇ, leh Seˍhpaˍraˍvenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve yawˇ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo tanˬ chehˇ gehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ pehˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca che‸ pehˍ la ve awˬ lawn, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui shiˍ veu laˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ lawn ca kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Suˇkoˆbeˍnoˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Kuˇtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Neˍraˍgaˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Haˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Aˍshiˇmaˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,

Aˍvaˍ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Niˆbaˍhaˍ gʼuiˬsha leh Taˍtehˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Seˍhpaˍraˍvenˍ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Aˍdaˍmeˍlehˆ gʼuiˬsha leh Aˍnaˍmeˍlehˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui. Awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ chi hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui. Tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve ka‸ taˇ te.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon bvuh‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa leunˇ piˇ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ na yuˬ. A shu yawˇ te jaw ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Eˇlaˍ ve yaˇ Hawˇseˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 3 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 29 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍbiˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ dawˆ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ Neˍhuˆtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ Moˉseˍ te teh taˉ ve kuiˇ vuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ kuiˇ vuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ ponˬ leuˉ jaw. Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ maˇ keu piˇ.
Yawˇ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve 4 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ (Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Hawˇseˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 7 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ) Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Shaˍlaˍmaˍneˍsaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 6 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ leh, Hawˇseˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 9 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Haˍlaˍ venˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Gawˇzanˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 14 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍ hkaˍriˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ ca bawˆ la-o. Nawˬ hpu hkʼaˬ ma lawˬ kʼo chi ma keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ hpu shehˆ shehnˉ, leh shi shehˆ hinˉ keu tcuh ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ yehˬ miˉ hta‸ oˍ taˍ ve shi leh, yawˇ awˬ to yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ oˍ taˍ ve shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ yuˬ leh, Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ hta‸ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ lo tu leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Ma‸ moˍ lonˉ chi ve hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hoˉ te leh shiˍ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la htaˇ, hpa te chiˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve a ma‸ lonˉ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍbaˍnaˍ leh Aˍsaˆ ve yaˇ, mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Yawˇaˍ, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ chi taw taw nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Nawˬ hui Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ lo ceh yuˬ te taˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, teˇ hkui tiˉ hkoˇ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ tcuhˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, oˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve laˇ. Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ paˍ nyiˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ ca gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ 2,000 hkeh pe‸ laˇ tuˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ cheuˬ taˬ sheˍ. Hkʼe ka‸, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ dawˇ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, Sheˍbaˍnaˍ leh Yawˇaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Aˍraˍmiˆ hkawˇ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui na gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ taˇ yaw laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui htawˇ na chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo mui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve hkʼehˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve tzuhˇ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ tu la leh, Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ yaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Nawˬ hui jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve hkawˇ maˇ gʼa na tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.

Nawˬ hui la‸ caˉ ya‸ leh venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ peˆ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ leh a shu yawˇ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ piˇ gʼa ve cawˬ jaw laˇ.

Haˍmaˆ venˇ leh Aˍpaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo gaˬ peuˬ le. Sheˍhpaˍvenˍ, Heˍnaˆ leh Iˍvaˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo le. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ponˬ piˇ gʼa jaw le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ca dawˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, Sheˍbaˍnaˍ leh Yawˇaˍ hui a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, Shaˍbaˍnaˍ leh paw hku lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ hto piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi lehˬ tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yo‸. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ leh, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ paw maˇ gʼa ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tuˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ kaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ nyi ma taˇ luˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ geh ca jehˬ da‸ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Tiˇraˍkaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ nyi ma taˇ uiˍ chehˇ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gawˇzanˍ, Haˍranˍ, Reˍyaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ leh, Teˍlaˍsaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍteˍdenˍ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Yaˍmaˆ, Aˍpaˆ, Sheˍhpaˍvenˍ, Heˍnaˆ leh Iˍvaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh gʼaw nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi leh, ngaˬ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve yawˇ hui ve suhˆ, leh haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Saˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ guiˇ chehˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu hpeh‸ ve teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ tanˬ leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpehˇ leh tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh ca yaw maˍ laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, naˉ jaˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw cawˬ ve, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ, yawnˉ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ htu baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nanˬ bawˍ duˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa dawˬ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ naˆ fiˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ sheˍ laˇ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe te chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo meuˆ laˬ ve haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve zuhˇ leh, yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ laˬ kuiˬ, dawˇ kuiˬ te kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ naˍ hkʼawˇ htaw leh, nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw sho caˆ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ laˬ ve ya‸ kaw hkʼaˇ suh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ leh nehˉ hkʼaw‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˆ shiˍ hawˆ shiˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ hkʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo nawˬ hui caˬ ti leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼeu‸ jaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ geu tcuhˆ naˉ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, hkaˆ teˇ hkʼe ka‸ gʼa bawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. La‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, venˇ chi awˬ paˇ lo laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇ jaˇ venˇ ji lo htawˇ, ta‸ kʼoˍ gʼa duˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ chi hkʼaw gʼa lo‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ 185,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉpawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha Niˇsaˍroˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Aˍdraˍmeˍlehˆ leh Shaˍreˍzaˍ hui lo‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ chaw pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, Aˍraˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇsaˍraˆhaˍdonˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ naˬ jaˇ leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu teh taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh tuˬ ve hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ gʼo‸ pa hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, nawˬ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Heˍsaˍkiˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ, nawˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ leh, shehˆ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo nawˬ bon yehˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ 15 hkʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hta‸, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ leh, ngaˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ pa taw, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ ve shaˉ chuˇ hkʼoˆ lo maˉ nawˆ tcuhˇ yuˬ nehˉ piˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la leh, shehˆ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ngaˬ bon yehˬ lo kʼai gaˬ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ heˆ cawˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ mvuhˇ nyi naˍri‸ hta‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ 10 hkʼeh‸ jiˆ taˆ-e ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 10 hkeh‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Mvuhˇ nyi naˍri‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ 10 hkʼeh‸ jiˆ taˆ-e piˇ tuˬ te sha ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ 10 hkʼeh‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍyaˆ bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ te taˍ ve mvuhˇ nyi naˍriˍ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ 10 hkʼeh‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Baˍlaˍdanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Meˍroˆdaˆbaˍlaˍdanˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ naˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ leh la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ feu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve hpu, shi, sha hawnˉ, naˍ manˇ hawnˉ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍIˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ geh laˬ leh, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ laˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw, aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve le, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi htaˇ, Teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve, aˬ sho-eˬ nawˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa ca keu taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa ca te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po duˇ ve, leh venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te shawˍ keu ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍkiˆ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍnaˍseˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 12 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 55 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Haˍziˇbaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Heˍsaˍkiˆ te luˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ htawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve nyiˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, faˍ te ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ henˇ leh, mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw‸ sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ka‸ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hui kawˆ jaˇ law‸ law‸ ve ciˍ yanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkehˇ hta‸ tsuhˇ leh hpfuhˆ mvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ leh ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ tiˉ te laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ suhˍ teunˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ te ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Awˇzaˆ hko hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍmonˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Aˍmonˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yuˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Haˍruˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Meˍshuˉlaˍmehˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ, Aˍmonˍ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa te teh taˉ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Aˍmonˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, Aˍmonˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshiˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ hta‸ Awˇzaˆ ve hko hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇshiˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 8 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 31 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Bawˇzaˍkaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍdaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Yeˍdiˇdaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍ viˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉpeunˍ chehˇ ve 18 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Aˍzaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍhpanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ lo paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ geh kʼai leh, bon ca lawˬ la ve chaw hui geh hpu tanˇ hkʼaˬ ma shaw gʼa taˍ peuˬ naˍ, ca na nyi-o.
Shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ teˇ caˉ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ, haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ leh, loˍ ve suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa vuiˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ jaˇ leh yawˇ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ ceˇ leˇ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍhpanˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ lawn, Sheˍhpanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ lehˬ li‸ daw oˇ ve Sheˍ hpanˍ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ gʼaw nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ piˇ taˉ peuˬ.
Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ geh lo Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ pe‸ laˇ ve li‸ daw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, li‸ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Sheˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆkanˍ, Miˆ hkaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhkaˍbawˇ, shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍhpanˍ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ Aˍsaˍyaˆ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ to leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi-o. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, li‸ daw chi ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Aˍhkaˍbawˇ, Sheˍhpanˍ leh Aˍsaˍyaˆ yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ ma Huˇlaˍdaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, Haˍraˍhaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Tiˉkaˍvaˍ ve yaˇ Shaˍlunˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo teh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ)
Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui tcuh kaˍ ma oˇ ve hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Li‸ daw chi ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ gʼa gʼaw taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chi mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, li‸ daw oˇ ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw hpfuhˆ mawˬ taˍ ve li‸ daw oˇ ve teˇ daw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, ka ti‸ oˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ yehˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo cawˬ ve Kiˇdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˉ ve hkʼaw‸ laˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leuˆ teh taˍ ve Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha, mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa, leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ yawˇ Kiˉdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo yuˬ kʼai leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kʼaw‸ teˍ meu-e leh chaw tuˍ kuiˬ lo hkaˆ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Bawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ te chiˇ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo Yawˇsuˆ te teh taˍ ve neˇ hta‸ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ yaˇ Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, Tawˇhpehˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve, Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ yehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Naˍtaˍmeˍlehˆ ve yehˬ paˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Aˍhaˆ ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw Maˍnaˍseˍ te keu taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ dawˆ paˆ leh Kiˇdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ te teh taˍ ve Siˉdonˍ chaw hui ve Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ma, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve Hkeˍmoˆ gʼuiˬsha, leh Aˍmonˍ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ, leh Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo chaw mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ gʼawˆ hpoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw te teh taˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇshiˆ chiˇ nyi leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, aˬ sho-eˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ nyi leh, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yaw taˉ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ, Tuˍ hpfuh oˇ ve a shu ve tuˍ hpfuh le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh oˇ ve lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ taˉ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hpeh‸ ve yo, teh‸ Beˍtaˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ taˇ htawˇ. Yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ kuˬ hta‸ taˇ yuˬ tawˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo laˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ teˇ maˬ le le lo kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˉ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, yawˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ baˬ piˇ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo chaw mu‸ ku gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ maˇ te.
Yawˇshiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 18 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca hpfuhˆ mawˬ ve li‸ daw oˇ ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ hkʼa shuˍ, nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ leh, Moˉseˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kaˬ maˇ cawˬ jaw sheˍ. Yawˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ mehˉ sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ lehˬ,Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca ga piˇ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ paˇ lo bawˆ da‸ leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhkaˆ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇhkaˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 23 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha pa shehˆ maˬ ceh gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ yaˇ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Haˍmuˇtaˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Riˆbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ hpeh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpu shehˆ hinˉ awˇ ha cawehˬ leh shi shehˆ chi awˇ cawehˬ awˬ hkawnˍ gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍkenˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˉ leh, awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ leh, Yawˇhkaˆ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe awˬ hkawnˍ shaw yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍkenˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 11 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Ruˇmaˍ venˇ yaˇ Peˍdaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Zeˍbuˇdaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍkenˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve hawˉ chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw, suˇriˆ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw leh Aˍmonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.
Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍkenˍ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la maˇ gaˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yeˍhkawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 18 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha pa shehˆ maˬ uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Eˇlaˍnaˍtanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Neˍhuˇtaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhkawˇniˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ awˬ to Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ e, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ la‸ caˉ ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve hiˉ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ te keu taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 10,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ ca liˉ paˍ hta‸ te leh, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai leh, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ceh tiˉ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ e, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh 7,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, la‸ meuˇ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Maˍtaˍniˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˉ leh, awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍdaˍkiˆ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 21 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 11 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍraˍmiˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Haˍmuˇtaˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve 9 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw, ha pa 10 maˬ, 10 nyi htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇ baˬ lo ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ leh,
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve 11 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ha pa 4 maˬ teˇ maˬ 9 nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ peuˬ kʼai leh, meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw tawˆ-e peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hko hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, lanˇ venˇ nyiˇ maˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ paˇ lo yawˇ hui Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ hpeh gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Riˇbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ leh, sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve 19 hkʼaw‸ ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, 10 nyi htaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ, leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve kanˉ te puiˉ ve chaw leh, la‸ caˉ ya‸ la ve chaw hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh kuiˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu, sho nuˆ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ htaˇ yehˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ nu awˬ na hkʼa yehˇ ve kuiˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ te taˉ ve kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ, punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ leh lawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw tsuh nyi maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, hkʼa shuˍ-ehˬ hpeh‸ leh, mvuh hpawˇ 18 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mvuh hpawˇ 3 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, aˉ ci ku shiˍ awˬ han hkʼa biˇ te nehˉ taˍ ve awˬ hoˆ teˇ maˬ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Seˍraˍyaˆ leh yawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve Yuˇda‸ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ, ma‸ hpawˇ ceˇ leˇ te chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve chaw uiˍ hkaw‸ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Riˆbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ka‸ lo jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Shaˍhpanˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Aˍhiˆkanˍ ve yaˇ Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ piˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw Naˍtaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍmeˍlaˆ, Kaˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Neˍtawˇhpaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Taˍhuˇmehˆ ve yaˇ Seˍsaˍraˆ leh Maˍkaˍ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍzaˍniˆ hui Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Geˍdaˍliˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ha pa 7 maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Naˍtaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 10 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Eˇviˇlaˆmeˍrawˇdaˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te piˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai ve 37 hkʼaw‸, ha pa 12 maˬ, 25 nyi htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇlaˆmeˍrawˇdaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ laˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yeˍhkawˇniˆ lehˬ, htawnˍ hkʼaw‸ veu‸ deh ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve a sha‸ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve hpui lawˇ paˇ lo gʼa mui caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ piˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍdanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Sheˍtaˆ yoˬ. Sheˍtaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Eˇno‸ yoˬ. Eˇno‸ ve yaˇ lehˬ Keˍnanˍ yoˬ.
Keˍnanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍhaˍleˍlaˆ yoˬ. Maˍhaˍleˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬYaˍrehˆ yoˬ.
Yaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Eˇnawˆ yoˬ. Eˇnawˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍtuˇseˍlaˆ yoˬ. Maˍtuˇseˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Laˍmehˆ yoˬ.
Laˍmehˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Noˉa‸ yoˬ. Noˉa‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Sheˍmaˆ, Haˍmaˆ leh Yaˍhpehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍhpehˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gawˇmaˍ, Maˍgawˇgaˆ, Maˍdehˇ, Yaˍgʼonˍ, Tuˇbaˍ laˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Tiˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gawˇmaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍshaˆkeˍnaˆ, Riˇhpaˆ leh Tawˇgaˍmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍgʼonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Eˇliˇshaˍ, Taˍsuˆ, Kiˆtenˍ leh Yawˇdaˍnenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yo‸.
Haˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kuˇshaˆ, Miˆzaˍrenˍ, Hpuˇtaˆ leh Hkaˍnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kuˇshaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍbaˆ, Haˍviˇlaˍ, Saˍbaˍtaˆ, Raˍmaˆ leh Saˍteˍhkaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Raˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍbaˆ leh Deˍdanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
(Kuˇshaˆ lehˬ Neˍyawˇdaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ bawˆ paˍ awˉ lawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Miˆzaˍrenˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Luˆdenˍ Aˍnaˍmehˍ, Leˍhaˍbaˆ, Naˍtuˆhenˍ,
Paˍtaˍruˆ, Kaˍseˬluˆ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ Kaˍtawˇrenˍ hui hpeh ve yoˬ.
Hkaˍnanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Siˉdonˍ, leh Heˍtaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Giˇgaˍshiˆ chaw,
Hiˇviˆ chaw, Aˍkiˆ chaw, Siˇniˆ chaw,
Aˍvaˍdiˆ chaw, Zaˍmaˍriˆ chaw leh Haˍmaˍtiˆ chaw hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlanˍ, Aˍsuˇriˆ, Aˍhpaˍshaˆ, Luˇdaˆ, Aˍranˍ, Uˇsaˆ, Huˇlaˆ, Geˍtaˍ, leh Meˍshehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhpaˍshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Sheˍlaˆ yoˬ. Sheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Heˍbaˍ yoˬ.

Heˍbaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Hpaˍlehˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ awˬ co-e htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ moˍ yawˇ pehˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yuˇtanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇtanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍlaˍmawˇdiˆ, Sheˍtaˆ, Haˍzaˍmaˍveˆ, Yeˍraˆ,
Haˍdawˇranˍ, Uˇzeˍlaˆ, Diˇkaˍlaˆ,
Eˇbaˍlaˆ, Aˍbiˆmeˍlaˆ, Sheˍbaˆ,
Awˇhpiˍraˆ, Haˍviˇlaˍ leh Yawˇbaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmaˆ hta‸ te leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˆ, Aˍhpaˍshaˆ, Sheˍlaˆ,
Heˍbaˍ, Hpaˍlehˆ, Raˍgawˇ,
Seˍruˆ, Naˍhkawˍ, Teˍraˆ,
leh Aˍbranˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, Iˉcaˆ leh Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw 12 ceuˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍbaˍyoˆ, Keˍdaˍ, Aˍdaˆbeˍlaˆ, Miˆbaˍsanˍ,
Miˆshaˍmaˆ, Duˇmaˍ, Maˍsaˍ, Haˍdiˆ, Teˍmaˆ,
Yeˍtuˇraˆ, Maˍhi‸shaˆ, leh Keˍdaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma caˉ lehˬ Keˍtuˇraˆ hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ paˍ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ paw la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Siˆmaˍranˍ, Yoˇshanˍ, Meˍdanˍ, Meˇdiˍanˍ, Iˉshaˍbehˆ leh Shuˇaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yoˆshanˍ lehˬ Sheˍbaˆ leh Deˍdanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˇdiˍanˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇhpaˍ, Eˇhpeˍraˆ, Haˍhoˆ, Aˍbiˇdaˆ leh Eˇlaˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ lehˬ Iˉsawˇ leh Yaˍkoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˉ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇliˇhpaˆ, Reˍlaˆ, Yuˇshaˆ, Yaˍlanˍ leh Kawˇraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Teˍmanˍ, Awˇmaˍraˆ, Zeˍhpiˆ, Gaˍtanˍ, Keˍnaˆ, Riˇmaˍnaˆ leh Aˍmaˍlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Reˍlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Naˍhaˆ, Zeˍraˆ, Shaˍmaˍ, leh Miˆsaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tanˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve Siˉraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Siˇraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Lawˇtaˍ, Shawˉbaˆlaˆ, Ziˆbaoˍ, Aˍnaˆ, Diˉshonˍ, Eˍzaˍ leh Diˉshanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Lawˇtanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hawˇriˆ leh Hawˇmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Lawˇtanˍ lehˬ, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ nyi ma teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.) Shawˉbaˆlaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍvaˍ, Maˍnaˍhaˆ, Eˇbaˍlaˆ, Sheˍhpiˆ, leh Awˇnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ziˆbaoˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍyaˆ leh Aˍnaˆ yoˬ. Aˍnaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Diˉshonˍ hpeh‸ leh, Diˉshonˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍranˍ, Eˇshaˍbanˍ, Iˉtaˍranˍ leh Hkeˍraˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˍzaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Diˇlaˍhaˍ, Zaˍgʼonˍ, Yaˍkanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Diˉshanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Uˇzaˆ leh Aˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Bawˇraˆ ve yaˇ Beˍlaˆ lehˬ, Dinˍhaˍbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Seˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Teˍmanˍ venˇ yaˇ Huˆshanˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Huˆshanˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍviˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Haˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.) Haˍdaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Maˍseˍkaˍ venˇ yaˇ Saˍmaˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Saˍmaˍlaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Reˍhawˇboˆ venˇ yaˇ Sawˉlu‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhkaˍbawˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Baˍlaˆhaˍnanˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆhaˍnanˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Pawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Haˍdaˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Meˍzaˍbaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Maˍtaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Haˍheˍtaˆbeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ, Aˍvaˍ, Yeˍtehˆ,
Aˍhawˇliˆbaˍmaˆ, Eˍlaˍ, Piˇnonˍ,
Keˍnaˆ, Teˍnaˍ, Miˆbaˍzaˍ,
Aˍgaˍdeˍlaˆ leh Iˉranˍ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 12 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Siˉmonˍ, Leˍviˆ, Yuˇda‸, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ
Danˍ, Yoˇseh‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ Naˍtaˍliˆ, Gaˆ leh Aˍshaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ miˇ ma Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw Shuˉaˍ geh gʼa ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇraˆ, Awˇnanˍ, Sheˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇraˆ lehˬ, haiˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma Taˍmaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Hpaˍrehˆ leh Zeˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍrehˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Haˍmuˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Zeˍraˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ziˇmaˍriˆ, Eˇtanˍ Heˍmanˍ, Kaˍlaˍkawˆlaˆ, leh Daˍraˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Zeˍraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Kaˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhkanˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇtanˍ lehˬ, Aˍzaˍriˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Heˍzaˍronˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ, Raˍmaˆ leh Kaˍlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Raˍmaˆ hta‸ te leh Yeˍsehˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Raˍmaˆ, Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve Naˍsonˍ,
Saˍlaˍmonˍ, Bawˇzaˆ,
Awˇbehˆ leh Yeˍsehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsehˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ, A biˆnaˍdaˆ, Shaˍmaˍ,
Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ, Raˍdehˇ,
Awˇzenˍ, leh Daˍviˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Zeˍruˇaˍ leh Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ htawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Zeˍruˇaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍbiˆshehˇ, Yaˍbaˆ leh Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍtaˍ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Aˍmaˍsaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Heˍzaˍronˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Aˍzuˇbaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Yeˍroˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍshaˍ, Shawˇbaˆ leh Aˍdonˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍzuˇbaˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ Eˇhpaˍraˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Huˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Huˇraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, Uˇriˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ lehˬ Baˍzaˍleˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Heˍzaˍronˍ a sha‸ 60 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Maˍhiˇraˆ ve yaˇ miˇ (Giˇlaˆ awˬ nyi ma) hta‸ heuˆ leh, Seˍgoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Seˍgoˆ lehˬ, Yaˍiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˍiˇraˆ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ 23 venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Geˍshuˇraˆ leh Aˍranˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ 60 venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ kʼai ve pa taw, Yaˍiˇraˆ leh Keˍnaˆ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ shu yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ awˬ paˍ Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Heˍzaˍronˍ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ e caˉ Eˇhpaˍraˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Aˍshuˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍshuˇraˆ lehˬ, Teˍkawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Heˍzaˍronˍ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Raˍmaˆ, Buˇnaˍ, Awˇrenˍ, Awˇzenˍ leh Aˍhiˇyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Raˍmaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Maˍzaˆ, Yaˍmenˍ leh Eˇkaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Aˍtaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Awˇnanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˇnanˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shaˍmehˇ leh Yaˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˍmehˇ lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ leh Aˍbiˇshuˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆshuˇraˆ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆheˍlaˆ hta‸ heuˆleh, Aˍbanˍ leh Mawˇleˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˆshuˇraˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Naˍdaˆ htawˇ, Seˍlehˆ leh Aˍpenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Seˍlehˆ lehˬ yaˇ maˇ cawˬ taˉ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍpenˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Iˇshiˆ yoˬ. Iˇshiˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Shaˍshaˍ yoˬ. Shaˍshaˍve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍlehˇ yoˬ.
Shaˍ mehˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍtaˍ leh Yawˇnaˆtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍtaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ taˉ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ, Paˍlehˆ leh Zaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍshaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yaˇ miˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw Yaˍhaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ leh, Aˍtehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍtehˇ hta‸ te leh Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍtehˇ, Naˍtanˍ, Zaˍhaˆ,
Eˇhpaˍraˆ, Awˇ behˆ,
Yeˍhuˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ,
Heˍlehˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ,
Siˆsaˍmehˇ, Shaˍlonˍ
Yeˍkaˍmiˆ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Kaˍlehˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Meˍshaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Ziˇhpaˆ yoˬ. Ziˇhpaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍreˍshaˆ yoˬ. Maˍreˍshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Heˍbronˍ yoˬ.
Heˍbronˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ, Taˍpaˍ, Reˍkenˍ leh Sheˍmaˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Raˍhanˍ hpeh‸ leh, Raˍhanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Yawˍkenˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Sheˍmaˆ ve awˬviˉ paˍ Reˍkenˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Shaˍmehˇ yoˬ.
Shaˍmehˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ Mawˇnaˆ yoˬ. Mawˇnaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Behˆzeˍruˆ yoˬ,
Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Aˇhpaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh Haˍranˍ, Mawˇzaˆ leh Gaˍzehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Haˍranˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Gaˍzehˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
(Yaˍdehˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Reˍgenˍ Yawˇtanˍ, Geˍshanˍ Peˍlehˆ, Eˇhpaˍ, leh Shaˍhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Maˍkaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ nu ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh Sheˍbaˆ leh Tiˇraˍhaˍnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Maˍdaˍmaˍnaˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Shaˍhpaˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Maˍhkaˍneˍnaˍ venˇ leh Giˇbaˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Sheˍvaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ Aˍhkaˍshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kaˍlehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Eˇhpaˍraˆ geh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Huˇraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Huˇraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Shawˇbaˍlaˆ lehˬ, Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Saˍlaˍmaˍ lehˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Haˍraˆ lehˬ, Behˆgaˍdaˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kiˇriˆyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Shawˇbaˍlaˆ lehˬ, Haˍroˆ chaw ceuˬ, Maˍneˍhoˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hkoˇ,
