leh Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉtaˍriˆ, Hpuˇtiˆ, Shuˍmaˍtiˆ leh Miˆshaˍriˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Zawˇraˆ venˇ leh Iˉsaˍtawˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ).
Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Saˍlaˍmaˍ lehˬ, Neˍtawˆhpaˆ, Aˍtaˍroˆnehˆyaˍbaˆ, Zawˇriˆ leh Maˍnaˍhaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

(Yaˍbehˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tiˉraˍtiˆ, Sheˍmaˍtiˆ leh Suˇkaˍtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Keˍniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Reˍhkaˆ chaw hui hta‸ heuˆ da‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Daˍviˆ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ gʼa taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ miˇ ma Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˆnonˍ geh paw la taˍ ve Aˍnonˍ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ Aˍbiˆgeˍlaˆ geh paw la taˍ ve Daˍyeˍlaˆ, Geˍshuˇraˆ jawˇmawˇ Taˍlaˍmehˇ yaˇmiˇ Maˍkaˍ geh paw la taˍ ve Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ, Haˍgiˆ geh paw la taˍ ve Aˍdawˇniˆyaˆ, Aˍbiˆtaˍlaˆ geh paw la taˍ ve Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ, Eˇgaˍlaˆ geh paw la taˍ ve Iˉraˍrenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw Daˍviˆ 7 hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa 6 maˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ chi ve 6 gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw 43 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ leh,

oˇ kaˬ lo yaˇ paˍ laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ miˇ ma Aˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Baˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ paw la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Siˆmaˍ, Shawˇbaˆ, Naˍtanˍ leh Sawˉla‸ monˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ 9 gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉbaˍhaˍ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ, Eˇliˇhpaˍlehˆ,
Nawˇgaˆ, Neˍhpehˆ, Yaˍhpi-aˍ,
Eˇliˇshaˍmaˍ, Eˇlaˍdaˆ, Eˇliˆhpaˆlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Taˍmaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇbaoˍ yoˬ. Yawˇbaoˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ yoˬ. Aˍbiˇyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍsaˍ yoˬ. Aˍsaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yeˍhawˇranˍ yoˬ. Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍhkaˍziˆ yoˬ. Aˍhkaˍziˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇshaˆ yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍziˆ yoˬ. Aˍmaˍziˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Awˇziˆ yoˬ. Awˇziˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇtanˍ yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍhkaˆ yoˬ. Aˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yoˬ. Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Maˍnaˍseˍ yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍmonˍ yoˬ. Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇshiˆ yoˬ.
Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh Yawˇ-aˍhaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍkenˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇ niˆ leh Zeˍdaˍkiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ kʼai ve jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇyaˍkenˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Saˍlaˍteˍlaˆ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇraˆ, Peˍdaˍyaˆ, Sheˍnaˍzaˍ, Yeˍkaˍmiˆ, Hawˇshaˍmaˆ leh Neˍdaˍbiˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Peˍdaˍyaˆ lehˬ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh Sheˍmiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Zeˍruˇbaˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Haˍnaˍniˆ leh Sheˍloˍmiˆ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ Haˍshuˇbaˆ, Awˇheˍlaˆ, Beˍraˍhkiˆ, Haˍsaˍdiˆ leh Yuˇshaˆheˍsehˆ ve awˬ pa htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haˍnaˍniˆ lehˬ, Peˍlaˍtiˆ leh Yeˍshaˍyaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍshaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Reˍhpaˍyaˆ yoˬ. Reˍhpaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍnanˍ yoˬ. Aˍnanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Awˇbaˍdiˆ yoˬ. Awˇbaˍdiˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Sheˍhkaˍniˆ yoˬ.
Sheˍhkaˍniˆ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh awˬ hawehˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Haˍtuˇshaˆ, Iˉgaˍlaˆ, Baˍriˆ, Neˍriˆ leh Shaˍhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Neˍriˆ lehˬ Eˇlawˇnehˇ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ leh Aˍriˆkanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlawˇnehˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇhui lehˬ, Hawˇdaˍviˆ, Eˇlaˍsheˆ, Paˍlaˍyaˆ, Aˍkoˆ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Deˍlaˍyaˆ leh Aˍnaˍniˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hpeˍrehˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ, Kaˍmiˆ, Huˇraˆ leh Shawˇbaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shawˇbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Raˍyaˆ yoˬ. Raˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yaˍhaˆ yoˬ. Yaˍhaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Zawˇraˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍhuˆmehˇ leh Laˍhaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Huˇraˆ lehˬ, Kaˍlehˆ leh Eˇhpaˍraˆ hui geh paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Huˇraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Huˇraˆ lehˬ, Eˇtanˍ, Peˍneˍlaˆ, leh Eˇzaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇtanˍ htawˇ, Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Iˉshaˍmaˍ, Iˉdaˍhaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ leh Haˍzaˍleˍlaˆpawˇniˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Peˍneˍlaˆ lehˬ, Geˍdawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Eˉzaˍ lehˬ Huˇshaˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˍkawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍshuˇraˆ lehˬ, Heˍlanˍ leh Naˍraˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Naˍraˍ geh yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍhuˆzanˍ, Heˍhpaˍ, Teˍmeˍniˆ leh Haˍhaˍshaˆtaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshuˇraˆ lehˬ, Heˍlanˍ geh yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Zeˍrehˆ, Iˉzaˍhaˍ leh Eˇtaˍnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇzaˆ lehˬ, Aˍnoˆ leh Zawˇbeˍdaˆ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, Haˍronˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhaˍheˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw shu taˍ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ Yaˍbehˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ paw la htaˇ awˬ e gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍbehˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼehˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tu‸ kuiˬ hkanˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shuˇaˍ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Meˍhiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Meˍhiˆraˆ lehˬ, Eˇshaˍtonˍve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇshaˍtonˍ lehˬ, Behˆraˍhpaˍ, Paˍsaˍ, leh Teˍhiˇnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˍhiˇnaˆ lehˬ, Naˍhaˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Reˍkaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Keˍnaˆ lehˬ, Awˇtanˍneˍlaˆ leh Seˍraˍyaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˇtanˍneˍlaˆ htawˇ, Haˍtaˆ leh Meˍnoˍtehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˍnoˍtehˇ lehˬ, Awˇhpaˍraˆ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Seˍraˍyaˆ lehˬ, Yaˍbaˆ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ la‸shaˉmaˉ hui ve kanˉ te kuiˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ lehˬ, Iˉruˆ, Eˇlaˍ leh Naˍmaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇlaˍ lehˬ, Keˍnaˆ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhaˍleˍlaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ziˇhpaˆ, Ziˇhpaˍ, Tiˇriˆ leh Aˍsaˍreˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇzaˍraˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍtaˍ, Meˍrehˆ, Eˇhpaˍ leh Yaˍlonˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍrehˆ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ Biˆtaˍyaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh, Meˍriˆanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh, Shaˍmehˇ leh Iˉsaˍbaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍbaˍ lehˬ, Eˇshaˍteˍmawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍrehˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ma teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Yaˍrehˆ, Heˍbaˍ leh Yeˍkuˇtiˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍrehˆ lehˬ, Geˍdawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Heˍbaˍ lehˬ, Sawˇ hkawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Yeˍkuˇtaˍlaˆ lehˬ, Zaˍnawˇ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hawˇdiˇ lehˬ, Naˍhanˍ ve awˬ nyi ma hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kiˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Kaˍmiˆ chaw ceuˬ leh, Eˇshaˍteˍ mawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Maˍhkaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Siˉmonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ, Riˆnaˆ, Beˍhaˍnanˍ leh Tiˇlonˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˇshiˆ lehˬ, Zawˇ hehˆ, leh Benˍzawˇhehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍlaˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍhkaˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇraˆ, Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Laˍdaˆ, Beˍtaˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw hpa te chiˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ,
Yawˇkenˍ leh Kawˇzeˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, leh Mawˇbaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ leh Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo ca chehˇ kʼai ve Yawˇshaˆ leh Saˍraˍhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Neˍtenˍ venˇ leh Geˍdaˍraˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Siˉmonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Neˍmuˇlaˆ, Yaˍmenˍ, Yaˍriˆ, Zeˍraˆ leh Shawˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve oˬ.
Shawˇlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Shaˍlonˍ yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Miˆbaˍsanˍ yoˬ. Miˆbaˍsanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Miˆshaˍmaˆ yoˬ.
Miˆshaˍmaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍmuˇlaˆ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍmiˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 16 gʼaˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ 6 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ maˇ ve pa taw, Siˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw uiˍ la maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, Siˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍraˍshaˍbaˆ, Mawˇlaˍdaˆ, Haˍzaˍshuˍlaˆ,
Biˇlaˍhaˍ, Eˍzenˍ, Tawˇlaˆ,
Beˍbuˍlaˆ, Hawˇmaˍ, Ziˆkaˍlaˆ,
Behˆmaˍkaˍboˆ, Haˍzaˍsuˍsenˍ, Behˆbeˍriˆ leh Shaˍrenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇtanˍ, Enˍ, Riˇmonˍ, Aˍshaˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh,

awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh leh, yawˇ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍshawˇbaˆ, Yaˍmaˍlehˆ Aˍmaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˆ, Yawˇlaˆ, (Aˍseˍlaˆ, Seˍraˍyaˆ, Yawˇshaˍbiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ) Yeˍhuˆ, Eˇlawˇnehˇ, Yaˍkawˇbaˆ, Yeˍshawˇhaˍyaˆ, Aˍsaˍyaˆ, Aˍdeˍlaˆ, Yeˍsiˆmeˍlaˆ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ, (Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Sheˍmaˍriˆ, Yeˍdaˍyaˆ, Aˍlonˍ, Shiˇhpiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ) Ziˇzaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ la chehˇ ve pa taw,
yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ ca chehˇ kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo yawˬ ca hawˉ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍmaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ, awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍraˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui ve aˉ po kʼo teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Siˉmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 500 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Iˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Peˍlaˍtiˆ, Neˍriˆ, Reˍhpaˍyaˆ leh Awˇzaˬlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Ruˇbenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Ruˇbenˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa ve aw miˇ ma i teˇ gʼaˇ geh ca lo‸ zuh‸ ve pa taw, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ ve aˉ yaˇ mehˉ kʼai leh, aˉ yaˇ oˇ ve Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh jawˇmawˇ gʼa te ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Ruˇbenˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Haˍnawˇ, Paˍluˆ, Heˍzaˍronˍ leh Kaˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ laˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Gawˇgaˆ, Sheˍmiˆ,
Miˇhkaˍ, Reˍyaˆ, Baˍlaˆ leh Beˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Aˍshuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ lehˬ, Beˍraˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ruˇbenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Yeˍlaˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ,

leh Yawˇlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍmaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Aˍzaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍyawˍ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Neˍbawˇ venˇ leh Baˍlaˆmonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui ceˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ veh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ, Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍgaˍraˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ na paˉ lo cawˬ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Saˍleˍka‸ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Yawˇlaˆ hpeh‸ leh, nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Shaˍhpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍnehˇ leh Shaˍhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˇhkeˍlaˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Sheˍbaˆ, Yawˇrehˇ, Yaˍhkanˍ, Zaˍyaˍ leh Eˍbaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Huˇriˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆheˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆheˍlaˆ, Huˇriˆ, Yaˍroˍ, Giˇlaˆ, Miˇhkeˍlaˆ, Yeˍshiˆshehˇ, Yaˍdawˇ leh Buˇzaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Guˇniˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Aˍbaˍdeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Shaˍronˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
(Caˇ lanˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Yawˇtanˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ htaˇ, leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ htaˇ gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ hkʼa deh‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ 44,760 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkaˆ bawˆ ve, a htaw chaw ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ henˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Haˍgaˍraˆ chaw, Yeˍtuˇraˆ chaw, Naˍhpiˇshaˆ chaw leh Nawˇdaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ tuˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ 50,000, yawˬ 250,000, piˉlaˬ 2,000 leh canˇ paˍ 100,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Baˍlaˆheˍmonˍ venˇ, Siˉneˍraˆ hkʼaw leh Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve chaw shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpeˍraˆ, Iˉshiˆ, Eˇleˍlaˆ, Aˍzaˍ reˍ laˆ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ, Hawˇdaˍviˆ leh Yaˍdeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ leh awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Puˇlaˆ (TiˉgaˍlaˍPaˍleˍsaˍ) hta‸ hpehˇ leh yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, Haˍlaˍvenˇ, Haˍbawˇ venˇ leh Gawˇzanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍranˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ leh Meˍraˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉzaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍranˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh Moˉseˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, Meˇriˆanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbyuˇhuˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇnaˍhaˆ, Aˍsiˆshuˍ,
Buˇhkiˆ, Awˇziˆ,
Yeˍraˍhiˆ, Meˍraˍyoˆ,
Aˍmaˍriˆ, Aˍhiˇtuˆ,
Zaˍdoˆ, Aˍhiˆmaˆ,
Aˍzaˍriˆ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ,
Aˍzaˍriˆ (yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˇsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ yoˬ.)
Aˍmaˍriˆ, Aˍhiˇtuˆ,
Zaˍdoˆ, Shaˍlunˍ,
Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ,
Seˍraˍyaˆ, Yeˍhawˇsaˍdaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhawˇsaˍdaˆ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ, Kawˇhaˆ, Meˍraˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui htawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Geˍraˍsonˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Liˇbaˍniˆ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉsaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ leh Muˇshiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Liˆbaˍniˆ, Yaˍhaˆ, Ziˇmaˆ,
Yawˇaˍ, Iˉdoˍ, Zeˍraˆ, Yaˍtaˍrehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ, Kawˇraˆ, Aˍsiˇraˆ,
Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Eˍbyaˍtaˆ, Aˍsiˇraˆ,
Taˍhaˆ, Awˇyeˍlaˆ, Awˇziˆ leh Shawˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Aˍmaˍsehˇ leh Aˍhiˇmoˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˇmoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Zawˇhpehˇ, Naˍhaˆ,
Eˇlaˍbaˆ, Yeˍhawˇranˍ leh Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Yawˇlaˆ leh Aˍbiˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ, Liˇbaˍniˆ, Sheˍmiˆ, Awˇzaˆ,
Shiˆmaˍ, Haˍgiˇyaˆ leh Aˍsaˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ yuˬ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ bon yehˬ maˇ te sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇlaˆ ve yaˇ Heˍmanˍ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ teˇ moˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ te leh yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍkoˆ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍmanˍ, Yawˇlaˆ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ,
Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Yeˍhawˇranˍ, Eˇleˍlaˆ, Tawˇaˍ,
Zuˇhpaˆ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Maˍhaˆ, Aˍmaˍsehˇ
Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Yawˇlaˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Zeˍhpaˍniˆ,
Taˍhaˆ, Aˍsiˇraˆ, Eˍbyaˍtaˆ, Kawˇraˆ,
Iˉsaˍhaˍ, Kawˇhaˆ, Leˍviˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ moˍ teˇ moˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍsaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ te leh yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Leˍviˆ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsaˆ, Beˍraˍhkiˆ, Shiˆmaˍ,
Miˆhkeˍlaˆ, Baˍseˍyaˆ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ,
Eˇtaˍniˆ, Zeˍraˆ, Aˍdaˍyaˆ,
Eˇtanˍ, Ziˇmaˆ, Sheˍmiˆ,
Yaˍhaˆ, Geˍraˍsonˍ, leh Leˍviˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ shehˆ moˍ teˇ moˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍhaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ te leh yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Leˍviˆ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇtanˍ, Kiˇshiˆ, Aˍbaˍdiˆ, Maˍloˆ,
Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Aˍmaˍziˆ, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ,
Aˍsiˆ, Baˍniˆ, Sheˍmaˆ,
Maˍhaˍliˆ, Muˇshiˆ, Meˍraˍriˆ leh Leˍviˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ nu ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo sha hawnˉ leh tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Hpiˇneˍhaˆ, Aˍbiˇshaˍ,
Buˇhkiˆ, Awˇziˆ, Zeˍraˍhiˆ,
Meˍraˍyoˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ, Aˍhiˇtuˆ,
Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍhiˆmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Chi ve lehˬ, Kawˇhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Heˍbronˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ tawn hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ chi awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo cawˬ taˍ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ ve yaˇ Kaˍlehˆ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ ve venˇ Heˍ bronˍ, Yaˍtiˇraˆ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ, Eˇshaˍteˍmawˇ,
Hiˆlenˍ, Deˍbiˇraˆ
Aˍshaˍ leh Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍbaˍ, Aˍleˍmehˆ leh Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ 16 venˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ kuiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Aˍshaˍ, Naˍtaˍliˆ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇ 13 venˇ hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Meˍraˍriˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Ruˉbenˍ, Gaˆ leh Zeˍbuˆlonˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo venˇ 12 venˇ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ chi hkʼe te pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
(Awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yuˇda‸, Siˉmonˍ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui htawˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ponˬ ve venˇ Sheˍhkenˍ, Geˍzaˍ,
Yawˇkaˍmenˍ, Behˆhawˇronˍ,
Aˍyaˍlonˍ leh Gaˆriˇmonˍ, venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍneˍraˆ leh Biˆlanˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ve Gawˇlanˍ, leh Aˍshaˆtaˍroˆ venˇ,
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆ, Daˍbeˍraˆ venˇ
Raˍmoˆ leh Aˍnenˍ venˇ,
Aˍshaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ve Maˍshaˍlaˆ, Aˍbaˍdonˍ,
Huˇkoˆ leh Reˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ,
Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ve Kaˍdeˍshaˆ, Haˍmaˍnonˍ leh Kiˇriˆyaˆtenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Riˇmonˍ leh Taˍbawˇ venˇ,
Ruˇbenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ, Beˍzaˍ, Yaˍhaˆ,
Keˍdaˍmoˆ leh Meˍhpaˆ venˇ,
Gaˆchaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Giˇlaˆ, Maˍhaˍnenˍ,
Heˍsaˍbonˍ leh Yaˍrehˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Tawˇlaˆ, Hpuˇaˍ, Yaˍshoˆ leh Shiˉmaˍronˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Tawˇlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 6 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Awˇziˆ, Reˍhpaˍyaˆ, Yeˍreˍlaˆ, Iˉbaˍsanˍ leh Sheˍmeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Tawˇlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ co-e htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ nyiˇ meunˍ nyiˇ hinˉ hkaw‸ ha gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ lehˬ Iˉzaˍreˍhiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬve yoˬ. Iˉzaˍreˍhiˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Miˆhkeˍlaˆ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Yawˇlaˆ, Iˉshaˆyaˍ hui hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui miˇ yaˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ meunˍ hkaw‸ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw 87,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Beˍlaˆ, Beˍhkaˍ, leh Yeˍdaˍyeˬlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Beˍlaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˉzaˍbonˍ, Awˇziˆ, Awˇzeˍ laˆ, Yeˍriˍmoˆ leh Iˉriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw 22,034 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Beˍhkaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 9 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Zeˍmiˇraˆ, Yawˇshaˆ, Eˍleˍzaˍ, Eˇlaˍnehˇ, Awˉmaˍriˆ, Yeˍriˍmoˆ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ, Aˍnaˍtoˆ leh Aˍlaˍmehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆpuiˉ ve chaw 20,200 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍdaˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Biˇlaˍhaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, Biˇlaˍhaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ suhˍ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇshaˆ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ, Eˇhuˇdaˆ, Hkeˍnaˍnaˆ, Zeˍtanˍ, Taˍsuˆ leh Aˍhiˆshaˍhaˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw 17,200 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Suˆpenˍ leh Huˆpenˍ hui htawˇ chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Danˍ lehˬ Huˆshenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtaˍliˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yaˍzeˍlaˆ, Guˇniˆ, Yeˍzaˍ, leh Shaˍlonˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Biˇlaˍhaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, yawˇ miˇ ma i Aˍranˍ chaw geh Aˍsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Maˍhkiˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Maˍhkiˇraˆ lehˬ Huˆpenˍ leh Suˆpenˍ hui hta‸ awˬ miˇ ma ca ka piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma lehˬ, Maˍkaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Zaˍlawˇhpaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Maˍhkiˇraˆ miˇ ma Maˍkaˍ lehˬ, Peˍrehˆ leh Seˍrehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Peˍrehˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Uˇlanˍ leh Reˍkenˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Uˇlanˍ lehˬ, Beˍdanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Maˍhkiˇraˆ ve yaˇ Giˇlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ ve awˬ nyi ma Haˍmawˇleˍkehˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉshawˇdaˆ, Aˍbeˍsaˍ leh Maˍlaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
(Sheˍmiˆdaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍhiˆanˍ, Sheˍhkenˍ, Liˇkaˍhiˆ leh Aˍniˍanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shuˉteˍlaˆ, Beˍrehˆ, Eˇlaˍdaˆ, Taˍhaˉ,

Zaˍbaˆ, Shuˉteˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇzaˍ leh Eˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Gaˍtaˆ chaw hui ve nuˇ ca hkʼawˇ ve pa taw, shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te piˇ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh kʼaw‸ zuh‸ leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Beˍriˇyaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve pa taw yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ, Seˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ leh, Awˇzenˍsheˍraˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ Reˍhpaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Reˍhpaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Reˍsaˆ, Teˍlaˆ, Taˍhanˍ,
Laˍdanˍ, Aˍmiˇhuˆ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ,
Nunˍ leh Yawˇsuˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Naˍranˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ, Aˍyaˍ venˇ,

Behˆshanˍ venˇ, Taˍnehˆ venˇ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ venˇ, Dawˉraˆ venˇ, leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve yaˇ Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍshaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉmaˍnaˆ, Iˉshaˍvaˍ, Iˉshaˍviˍ leh Beˍriˇyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, Seˍraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍriˇyaˆ lehˬ, Heˍbaˍ leh Miˆlaˍhkeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. (Miˆlaˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Iˇraˍzaˍveˆ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ)
Haˍbaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍhpaˍlehˆ, Shawˇmaˍ leh Hawˇtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, Shuˇaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍhpaˍlehˆ htawˇ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Paˍshaˆ, Biˇmaˍ haˍ laˆ leh Aˍshaˍvaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shawˇmaˍ htawˇ yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Rawˇgaˆ, Yeˍhuˇbaˆ, leh Aˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hawˇtanˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Zawˇhpaˆ, Iˉmaˍnaˍ, Sheˍlehˆ leh Aˍmaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Zawˇhpaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shuˇaˍ, Haˍneˍhpaˍ, Shawˇlaˆ, Beˍriˆ, Iˉmaˍraˆ,
Beˍzaˍ, Hawˇdaˆshaˍmaˍ, Shiˇlaˍshaˆ, Iˉtaˍranˍ leh Beˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Yeˍraˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍhpuˇnaˍ, Piˉsaˍpaˍ, leh Aˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ
Uˇlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍranˍ, Haˍneˍlaˆ leh Yeˍriˇyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw 26,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 5 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ hui lehˬ, Beˍlaˆ, Aˍshaˍbeˍlaˆ, Aˍhaˍraˆ,
Nawˇhaˍ leh Raˍhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍdaˍ, Geˍraˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ,
Aˍbiˇshaˍ, Neˍmanˍ, Aˍhawˇ-aˍ,
Geˍraˆ, Sheˍhpuˇhpanˍ leh Huˆranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇhuˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Neˍmanˍ, Aˍhiˇyaˆ leh Geˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Geˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Maˍnaˍhaˆ venˇ lo gʼa ca kʼaw‸ hpaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ hpaw-e piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Awˇzaˆ leh Aˍhiˇtuˆ ve awˬ pa Geˍraˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Shaˍhaˍrenˍ lehˬ, Huˆshenˍ leh Baˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ htaˇ, Hawˇdeˍshaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh yaˇ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇbaˆ, Ziˇbiˆ, Meˍshaˆ, Maˍlaˍhkanˍ
Yuˇzaˆ, Shaˍhkiˆ leh Miˆraˍmaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ miˇ ma Huˆshenˍ geh gʼa taˉ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍbiˇtuˆ leh Eˇlaˍpaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇlaˍpaˍlaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˍbaˍ, Miˆshaˍhanˍ leh Sheˍmehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Sheˍmehˆ lehˬ, Awˇnawˇ venˇ, Lawˇdaˆ venˇ, leh awˬ nu ve venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍriˇyaˆ leh Sheˍmaˆ hui lehˬ, Aˍyaˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca chehˇ ve chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍriˇyaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhiˆawˇ, Shaˍshehˇ, Yeˍraˍmoˆ,
Zeˍbaˍdiˆ, Aˍraˆ, Eˍdaˍ,
Miˆhkeˍlaˆ, Iˉshaˍpaˆ leh Yawˇhaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍpaˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍbaˍdiˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ, Heˍbaˍ,
Iˉshaˍmeˍrehˇ, Iˉzaˍliˆ leh Yawˇbaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍmiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍkenˍ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ, Zaˍbaˍdiˆ,
Eˇleˍnehˇ, Zeˍleˍtehˇ, Eˇleˍlaˆ,
Aˍdaˍyaˆ, Beˍraˍyaˆ leh Shiˉmaˍraˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍshaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉshaˍpanˍ, Eˍbaˍ, Eˇleˍlaˆ,
Aˍbaˍdonˍ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ, Haˍnanˍ,
Haˍnaˍniˆ, Eˇlanˍ, Aˍdawˇteˍyaˆ,
Iˉhpaˍdiˇyaˆ leh Peˍneˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍrawˇhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shanˍsheˍrehˇ, Sheˍhaˍriˆ, Aˍtaˍliˆ,
Yeˍraˍshiˆ, Eˇliˇya‸, leh Ziˇhkaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Maˍkaˍ hpeh‸ leh,
yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Aˍbaˍdonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nu ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zuˇraˆ, Kiˇshaˆ, Baˍlaˆ, Neˍraˆ, Naˍdaˆ,
Geˍdawˇraˆ, Aˍhiˆawˇ, Zaˍhkaˍ
leh Shiˆmaˍ ve awˬ pa Miˆkaˍloˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ nu ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Kiˇshaˆ yoˬ. Kiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˆshu-aˍ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ leh Eˇshaˍbaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Meˍriˆbaˍlaˆ yoˬ. Meˍriˆbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Piˇtonˍ, Meˍlehˆ, Taˍraˍ leh Aˍhkaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yeˍhawˇdaˍ yoˬ. Yeˍhawˇdaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍleˍmehˆ, Aˍzaˍmaˍvehˆ, leh Ziˇmaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ziˆmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Mawˇzaˆ yoˬ.
Mawˇzaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Biˇmaˍ yoˬ, Biˇmaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Raˍhpaˆ yoˬ. Raˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍsaˍ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍzeˍlaˆ yoˬ.
Aˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 6 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍzaˍriˆkanˍ, Bawˇhkeˍruˆ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ, Seˍraˍyaˆ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ leh Haˍnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍzeˍlaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Eˇshehˆ lehˬ, Uˇlanˍ, Yuˇshaˆ leh Eˇliˆhpeˍlehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Uˇlanˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, hkaˆ bawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ leh awˬ hawehˍ 150 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw, leh bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca chehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 690 ca cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ Peˍrehˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Baˍniˆ, Iˉmaˍriˍ, Awˇmaˍriˆ, Aˍmiˇhuˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Uˇtehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ Sheˍlaˆ ve awˬceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Aˍsaˍyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve yaˇ Zeˍraˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ Yaˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍseˍnuˆ, Hawˇdaˍviˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Saˍluˆ, Yeˍyawˇhanˍ ve yaˇ Iˉbaˍneˍyaˆ, Miˇhkaˍriˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Awˇziˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍ, Iˉbaˍneˍyaˆ, Reˍlaˆ, Sheˍhpaˍriˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 956 ca cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍdaˍyaˆ, Yawˇyaˍreˆ, Yaˍhkenˍ, Aˍhiˇtuˆ, Meˍraˍyoˆ, Aˍdoˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ awˬ hoˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Maˍlaˍhiˇyaˆ, Paˍshuˇraˆ, Yeˍyawˇhanˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍdaˍyaˆ leh Iˉmaˍraˆ, Meˍshiˉlaˍmoˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Yaˍzeˍyaˇ, Aˍdeˍlaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍshehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, 1,760 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆkanˍ, Haˍshoˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Baˍbaˍkaˍ, Heˍrehˆ, Gaˍlaˍlaˆ leh Aˍsaˆ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ, Miˆhkaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍtaˍniˆ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ, Gaˍlaˍlaˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Neˍtawˇhpaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Aˍsaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Beˍraˍhkiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve bon yehˬ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Shaˍlonˍ, Aˍkoˆ, Taˍlaˍmonˍ leh Aˍhiˆmanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve aˉ po kʼo lo kʼai ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˍbyaˍsaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ Kawˇreˍ ve yaˇ Shaˍlonˍ lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hui geh teˇ geh, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ te jaw ve yoˬ. (Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ)
Meˍsheˍlaˍmehˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ htawˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 212 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh leh chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ chi ve chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ shaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬ miˉ hpe‸, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ, awˬ hawˉ, awˬ na chi hkʼe 4 maˬ cawˬ ve hkʼaw lo, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpe‸ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, suhˍ nyi teˇ pawˆ chaw pa shaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ oˇve 4 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hpeh‸ leh, kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ leh, teˇ shawˉ le le taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shaw piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, bon yehˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ yehˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le hkʼa deh‸ gʼa gʼaw nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve, junˍ meu-e, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, sha hawnˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, sha hawnˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkaw‸ da‸ ve kanˉ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ hui ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Shaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Maˍtiˇtiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ shinˉ nyi le le da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Hkawˇ yehˬ awˬ hoˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, awˬ nu ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ kanˉ cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ na lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ chaw ceuˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍlaˆ lehˬ Giˇbonˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, Maˍkaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ lehˬ, Aˍbaˍdonˍ hpeh‸ leh awˬ nu ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zuˇraˆ, Kiˇshaˆ, Baˍlaˆ, Neˍraˆ, Naˍdaˆ,
Geˍdawˇraˆ, Aˍhiˆawˇ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ leh Miˆkaˍloˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˆkaˍloˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Shiˇmanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ nu ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ
Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Kiˇshaˆ yoˬ. Kiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ yoˬ. Sawˉlu‸ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˆshu-aˍ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ leh Eˇshaˍbaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Meˍriˆbaˍlaˆ yoˬ. Meˍriˆbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Miˆhkaˍ yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Piˇtonˍ, Meˍlehˆ, Taˍraˍ leh Aˍhkaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ Yaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˍraˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Aˍleˍmehˆ, Aˍzaˍmaˍvehˆ leh Ziˆmaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ziˇmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Mawˇzaˆ yoˬ.
Mawˇzaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Biˇnaˍ yoˬ. Biˇnaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yeˍhpaˍyaˆ yoˬ. Yeˍhpaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍsaˍ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ Aˍzeˍlaˆ yoˬ.
Aˍzeˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 6 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍzaˍriˆkanˍ, Bawˇhkeˍruˆ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ, Shaˍriˆyaˆ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ leh Haˍnanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw maˇ maˇ suh-e leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˇlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ mi la leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ leh Maˍlaˍhkiˇshu-aˍ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo ma‸ bawˆ hehnˇ jaˇ la leh, Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ htawˇ hkaˆ ce heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ naˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te maˇ haˆ. Hkʼe te le, Sawˉlu‸ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ juˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ juˆ leh, Sawˇlu‸ geh teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉlu‸ awˬ to, yawˇ ve yaˇ 3 gʼaˇ, leh yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ paˍ hui suh-e peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍzaˍreˍlaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ suh-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve venˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawˆ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shawˉ pawˍ hkʼe teˇ nyi, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Giˇlaˍbawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇhui Sawˉlu‸ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬpeuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve Daˍgonˍ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yaˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,

ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh, Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ Yaˍbehˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hawˉ lo tuˍ piˇ leh, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉlu‸ gʼa suh-e ve lehˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ha hta‸ ca na nyi ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ maˇ na nyi. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬhkʼa peu-eˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw Daˍviˆ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw Sawˉlu‸ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te da‸ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍbuˆ teh‸ meh taˍ leh, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ maˇ gʼa taˬ ve awˬ lawn Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Ziˉonˍ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍruˇaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ca lo‸ bawˆ leh, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca lo‸ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ gu te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ga piˇ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Haˍhkiˍmonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍshawˇbanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ lehˬ gehˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh canˇ paˍ 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍhawˇniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Doˉdoˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Paˍdaˍmenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ti mi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ti mi oˇ ve hkʼaw huˉ taˍ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkanˍ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hpaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Aˍduˆlanˍ haˉ kʼoˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw te moˍ lehˬ, Reˍhenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Daˍviˆ lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ caw kʼo taˍ ve hkʼaw pui ehˉ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ moˍ lehˬ, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ nyi ma haˍ jaˇ leh, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo cawˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ a shu ngaˬ hta‸ ca nyiˉ taw laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai leh, nanˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ nyiˉ veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ chi hta‸ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ dawˬ ve kʼo, iˉ kaˆ chi hta‸ a sha‸ tanˇ leh ca hkʼo ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ dawˬ ve hkʼe yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˬ. Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ leh, awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh canˇ paˍ 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ hkʼaw shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw awˬ meh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ.

Keˍzeˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ htawˇ, awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Moˬ hoˆ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˇ shaw‸ mvuh leh gehˇ taˆ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ lu yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ juˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ htawˇ ka‸ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ hkʼaw, awˬ meh bvuh jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw awˬ meh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ kawˆ leh Ziˇkaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ geh cheuˬ leh yonˍ hpeh‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ ca hpaw chehˇ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, hawˉ ma maˇ kʼoˆ, la‸ mehˍ la‸ sha hkʼa shuˍ bawˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Sheˍmaˆ ve yaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍheˍzaˍ leh Yawˇshaˆ hui uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Aˍzaˍmaˍvehˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍzaˍlaˆ leh Peˍlehˆ, Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ yaˇ Beˍraˍhkaˆ leh Yeˍhuˆ, Awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ hkʼaw awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Giˇbonˍ venˇ yaˇ Iˉsaˍmaˍyaˆ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ, Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh Gaˍdeˍraˆ venˇ yaˇ Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Eˇluˆzehˇ, Yeˍriˍmoˆ, Baˍlanˍ, Sheˍmaˍriˆ leh Haˍreˆ venˇ yaˇ Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ, Kawˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ, Aˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Yawˇzaˍ leh Yaˍshawˇbanˍ, Geˍdawˇ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍyawˇhanˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇlaˍ leh Zeˍbaˍdiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Daˍviˆ geh ca hpaw chehˇ la ve ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ hanˉ leh, hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇzaˍ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ,
Miˆshaˍmaˍnaˍ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ,
Aˍtehˇ, Eˇlaˍlaˆ
Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Eˇlaˍzaˍbaˆ,
Yeˍraˍmiˆ, Maˍhkaˍnaˍnehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ hinˉ gaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ gʼa te leh teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ chaw teˇ ha gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ maˬ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ uiˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkanˍ tawˆ-e leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Daˍviˆ hpaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ laˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ laˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˬ chiˉ maˇ te laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, Aˍmaˍsehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ dawˇ pawnˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Aˍmaˍsehˇ lehˬ awˬ meh bvuh‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ 30 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ) Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ geh ca hpaw chehˇ la ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ gʼa ga bawˆ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ dawˇ hkiˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Ziˇkaˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ geh hpaw lo‸ la ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍdaˍnaˆ, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Yeˍdeˍlaˆ, Miˆhkeˍlaˆ, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Eˇliˇhuˆ leh Ziˆlaˍtehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw. Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˬ laˬ hkʼe teˇ nyi le le, Daˍviˆ geh chaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw lo‸ la tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Sawˉlu‸ awˬ tan Daˍviˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ, cheuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh hpaw lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
La‸ caˉ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw 6,800 gʼaˇ, Ma‸ hkʼeun hkʼa deh‸ henˇ taˍ ve Siˉmonˍ chaw 7,100 gʼaˇ,

Leˍviˆ chaw 4,600 gʼaˇ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ shiˍ laˬ taˍ ve chaw 3,700 gʼaˇ, Zaˍdoˆ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ma‸ bawˆpuiˉ ve yaˇ nehˬ 22 gʼaˇ, Sawˉlu‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw 3,000 gʼaˇ(awˬ nu ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui lehˬ Sawˉlu‸ hpawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.) Awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve Eˇhpaˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 20,800 gʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ kʼai taˍ ve mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw 18,000 gʼaˇ, Chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍhkaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 200 gʼaˇ, leh yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ shiˍ leh la‸ caˉ hkʼa deh‸ yehˇ puiˉ ve Zaˍbuˆlonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 50,000 gʼaˇ, Naˍtaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 1,000 gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 37,000 gʼaˇ, Ma‸ hkʼeun hkʼa deh‸ henˇ taˍ ve Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 28,600 gʼaˇ, Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve Aˍshaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 40,000 gʼaˇ, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ma‸ yaˇ 120,000 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, Heˍbronˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, chi hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo Daˍviˆ geh shehˆ nyi chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ te caˍ te taw laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Vuiˇ jaˇ kuiˬ awˬ na teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, junˍ meu-e, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˉ laˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ, lawˍ, nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh taˆ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ, tiˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, nyi ma hkʼaw ha lehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hui geh jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui nyi ma cawˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh,
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸ awˬ co-e htaˇ baˬ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca taˆ yuˬ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ Kiˇriˆyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo taˆ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ leh awˬ na hpawˇ Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ tuˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Baˍlanˍ venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Kiˇriˆyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍbiˆnaˍdaˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo teh taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, nuˇ lawˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu ve yoˬ. Nuˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Awˇzaˆ leh Aˍhiˆawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼa‸ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa nawˍ meuˆ, tinˍ hteˆ, cehnˬ dawˆ, behˬheh ma meuˆ leh kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Hkiˇdonˍ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nuˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkui sheh naˆ leˆ ve pa taw, Awˇzaˆ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˇzaˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ htawˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Paˍraˆ Awˇzaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Awˇzaˆ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yuˬ kʼo‸-e gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e. Gaˍtaˆ venˇ yaˇ Awˇbehˆ Eˍdonˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa shehˆ maˬ hkʼa gaˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ tuˬ chaw teˇmoˍ hpehˇ peu leh, yawˇ awˬ pon hawˉ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te piˇ tuˬ, Keˍdaˍ suhˆ leh la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ miˇ ma laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shaˍmo-aˍ,
Shawˇbaˆ, Naˍtanˍ, Sawˉla‸monˍ,
Iˉbaˍhaˍ, Eˇliˆshuˇaˍ, Eˇliˇhpaˍlehˆ,
Nawˇgaˆ, Neˍhpehˆ, Yaˍhpi-aˍ,
Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ, Beˍlaˍdaˆ leh Eˇliˆhpeˍlehˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui Reˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hta‸ gʼa ca bawˆ tuˬ laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Baˍlaˆ Peˍraˍzinˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Baˍlaˆ Peˍraˍzinˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼawˆ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Reˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh hteˇ lehˍ taˇ ca bawˆ-e. Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo caw leh pfuhˇ cehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo ca bawˆ-e loˬ.

Pfuhˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ Geˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Geˍzaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve awˬ meh shaˬ te shaˬ bvuhˬ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ le le Daˍviˆ hta‸ kawˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇmaˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ aˉ po kʼo teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼa taˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te tuˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ keu tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Uˇreˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 120 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍsaˍyaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw 220 gʼaˇ,
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yawˇlaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw 130 gʼaˇ,
Eˇliˆzaˍhpanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Shaˍmaˍyaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 200 gʼaˇ,
Heˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇleˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 80 gʼaˇ,
Awˇzaˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw 112 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Zaˍdoˆ, Aˍbyaˍtaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw Uˇreˍlaˆ, Aˍsaˍyaˆ, Yawˇlaˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Eˇleˍlaˆ leh Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸, choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ca yuˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ chehˇ. Te keunˍ te cawˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui maˇ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ ca yuˬ tuˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ taˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, cehnˬ dawˆ, tinˍ hteˆ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Cehnˬ dawˆ tuˬ awˬ pon leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇlaˆ ve yaˇ Heˍmanˍ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Beˍraˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ Aˍsaˆ, Kuˇshaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍtanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tinˍ hteˆ tu ˬawˬ pon leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Sheˍmiˆraˍmoˆ,
Yaˍheˍlaˆ, Uˇniˆ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ, Maˍseˍyaˆ leh Beˍnaˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shehnˍ hehˆ tuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ Maˍtiˇtiˆ, Eˇliˇhpaˍlehˆ, Miˆneˍyaˆ, Aˍsaˍyaˆ,
leh bon yehˬ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ Awˇbehˆ leh Yeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍnaˍniˆ lehˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ hkawˇ yehˬ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ leuˆyuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍraˍhkiˆ, Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ, Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ, Yeˍhiˇyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ peuˍ leh behˬ heh ma meuˆ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ Shaˍbaˍniˆ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ, Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ, Aˍmaˍsehˇ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh Eˇlaˍzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ca taˆ yuˬ tuˬ, Awˇ behˆ Eˇdonˍ ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw hui ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ taˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nuˇ paˍ suhˍ hkeh leh yawˬ suhˍ hkeh tuˉ tanˇpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, hkawˇ yehˬ awˬ hoˉ Hkeˍnaˍniˆ, leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ, aˉ po‸ awˬ hta‸ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve geh teˇ geh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa cehnˬ dawˆ tinˍ hteˆ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Sawˉlu‸ yaˇ miˇ Miˆhkaˍlaˆ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw nyi peu leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gu taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh,

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ diˬ, piˬ taˍ ve shaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ a ciˉ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ teˇ gʼaˇ a ciˉ pehˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍsaˍ hpeh‸ leh yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tinˍ hteˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍlaˆ, Sheˍmiˆraˍmoˆ, Yeˍhaˍleˆ, Maˍtiˇtiˆ, Eˇlaˍbaˆ, Beˍneˍyaˆ, Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ leh Yeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˆ lehˬ shehnˍ hehˆ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ leh Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ behˬ heh ma meuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Aˍsaˆ leh yawˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ kanˉ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hkawˇ yehˬ kʼa ve kanˉ hta‸ tanˬ te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ tuˬ yawˇ geh jiˆkʼai leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ mehˆ guˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ suhˉ jehˬ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, chaw awˬ hinˉ co-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸
Yaˍkoˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peuˬ teˇ peˆ lo ca chehˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ fawˉ mehˍ tcuh piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ htawˇ. Ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ taˇ te piˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ lawn, teˇ nyi le le shu hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ lawn hto maˍ piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ teˇ ceuˬ, yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ-o‸. Da‸ kehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ-o‸.
Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh teh taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Ti mi leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yawˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ da‸ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw a ciˉ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-a veuˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ A menˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ A menˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ te tuˬ ve Aˍsaˆ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ nyi le le kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍduˆtonˍ ve yaˇ Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi 68 gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hawˇsaˍ leh Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo awˬ hoˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ shawˉ teˇ hpeu‸ le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ piˇ taˍ ve hkawˇ yehˬ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍmanˍ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ leh awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Heˍmanˍ leh Yeˍduˆtonˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh htaˇ loˍ ve behˬ heh ma, cehnˍ, leh tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yeˍduˆtonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Daˍviˆ htawˇ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Nyi loˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ceh tiˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Naˍtanˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, cho kʼai oˇ kʼai te toˇ chehˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh ngaˬ te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ maˇ te laˇ ve le, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ na nyi jaw.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo sho‸ sha‸ ve a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, tawˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ puˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh tuˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼaw‸ te tcuh leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te laˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve kʼo, awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Sawˉlu‸ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa uˉ peunˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˍtanˍ htawˇ, Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ da‸ kehˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ te laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ leuˉ leh ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te laˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ cawˬ sheˍ le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ aˬ loˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼe ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon nawˬ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, nawˬ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te laˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ meh co co taiˍ taiˍ uiˍ chehˇ mvuh chehˇ leh, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon chi hkʼe te lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve ka ti‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ co co cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Daˍviˆ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ma‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo zuh‸ tcuh ve yoˬ. Aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tehˆ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw shehˆ pun nyiˇ pun hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Mawˇbaˆ chaw yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Zawˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Reˍhawˉbaˆ ve yaˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 1,700 gʼaˇ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 20,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼawˬ chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkui sheh dawˆ hteh piˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 100 maˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ ca ga la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ 22,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˬviˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˉ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, teˇ kaˬ le le lo Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ taˆ toˇ chehˇ ve shi te taˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Beˍtaˆ venˇ leh Beˍyawˇ tehˇ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve kuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ jawˇmawˇ Tawˇiˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai peu leh, yawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ bon uiˍ hkawˇ ca yaw piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Tawˇiˆ lehˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ gʼa bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ lehˬ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ laiˉ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, la‸ shawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw hui geh gʼa taˍ ve hpu, shi, teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
