Zeˍruˇaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ lehˬ, Aˉ leh‸ lawˬ hkʼo‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Eˇdonˍ chaw 18,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˉ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, teˇ kaˬ le le lo Daˍviˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, Aˍhiˆluˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhiˇtuˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbiˆmaˍlehˆ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Seˍraˍyaˆ lehˬ shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍnaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Naˍhaˆ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Haˍnonˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Haˍnonˍ awˬ paˍ Naˍhaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ htawˇ Haˍnonˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa suh-e ve pa taw, yawˇ htawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh Haˍnonˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yan ˇ, Aˍmawˇ niˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ pa suh-e ve pa taw, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ maˍ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ ca jaˆ nyi peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Haˍnonˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve paˇ tcuhˆ teˇ hkoˇ chiˇ baˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ hkui tcuhˉ kʼu awˬ na paˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ nuˆ baˬ piˇ leh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ya‸ taw jaˇ leh yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ la maˇ gaˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve paˇ tcuhˆ kʼaw‸ zuhˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ tuˬ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Behˆyaˍhawˇbaˆ venˇ leh Zawˇhaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ 20,000 gʼaˇ, Tawˇhaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 12,000 gʼaˇ, leh jawˇmawˇ Maˍhkaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ 1,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˍ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˍdeˍbaˍ awˬ paˇ lo jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍmawˇ niˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, shu hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ veu leh tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Suˇriˆ chaw, Tawˇbaˆ chaw leh Maˍhkaˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo bawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ Yaˍbaˆ shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Suˇriˆ chaw hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ gu taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ la ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ca ga la-o. Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ la ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ leh ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ-a veuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe te laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ Aˍbiˆshehˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ haˆ leh venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpoˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Heˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shawˇbehˆ geh teˇ geh Heˍlanˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Heˍlanˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui bawˆ da‸ leh, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ 700 gʼaˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 40,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shawˇbehˆ htawˇ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Haˍdaˍdeˍzaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ gaˬ la leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ ca bawˆ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ ma‸ moˍ teˇ moˍ shiˍ veu leh Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ Miˆlaˍkonˍ lehˬ, 18 cawehˬ hawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ lehˬ shehnˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuh hkʼoˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˆ gʼeu‸ tcuh ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˉ kʼoˆ, ceˉ ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Aˍmawˇniˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gawˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Huˇshaˆ venˇ yaˇ Siˆbeˍ kaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˇ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Shaˍhpaˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˇ maw maw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Gawˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yaˍiˇraˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍhaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Gawˇliˇya‸ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Laˍhkaˍmiˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve gehˇ tuˇ lehˬ, hpa chiˇ ve caˉ behˆ hkʼe hui cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gaˍtaˆvenˇ lo Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hkui sheh la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ le le hkui naw la‸ naw 6 maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Shaˍmaˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ chi ve 4 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍtanˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ chaw shenˍ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ Yaˍbaˆ leh awˬ nu ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai leh, chaw shenˍ ca gʼawˆ nyi-o. Chaw hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ ha pun kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ chi hkʼe te gaˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍ viˆ lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ca te tuˬ, Yaˍbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yaˍbaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo caw toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼaw, ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ 1,100,000 gʼaˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hkʼaw 470,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍbaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ chi hkʼe te tcuh laˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, Leˍviˆ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼawˆ yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ gʼa te ya‸ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Gaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ yaw piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ shehˆ hkawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gaˆ Daˍviˆ geh kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve shehˆ hkawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve le.

Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, shehˆ ha pa hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa hpaw toˇ ve teˇ gaˇ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, chaw 70,000 gʼaˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Pehˇ-o. Taˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, aˉhtaw yuˬ leh mvuhˇ hpe lo chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Chaw shenˍ ca gʼawˆ tcuh shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ Awˇraˍnanˍ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ ca te tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, Gaˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ca te ve yoˬ.
Caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ oˇ ve lo, Awˇraˍnanˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ caˬ jaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ca hpaw va‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ Awˇraˍnanˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh, Daˍviˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve chi mehˉ kʼai tuˬ, choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Awˇraˍnanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Awˇraˍnanˍ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, yuˬ leh nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Choˬ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, nuˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ ve caˬ jaw‸ kʼuˉ lu teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Daˍviˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ shawˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ gʼa piˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ gaˇ, teh‸ Awˇraˍnanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Awˇraˍnanˍ hta‸ shi 600 hteh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ bon lawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la piˇ leh, tuˉ tanˇ taˍ ve shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve vawˆ taˍ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ awˬ hpui hkʼaw kʼaw‸ keu tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve hta‸ Daˍviˆ gʼa mawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ peuˬve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Awˇraˍnanˍ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Moˉseˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chehˇ kuiˬ chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ te kuiˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ te tuˬ haˉ pui htawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ awˬ pon loˍ ve sho cuˇ te tuˬ, sho ca hpoˆ piˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve kuiˇ lehˬ, maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tsuh nyi maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Keˍdaˍ suhˆ hkʼa biˇ yuˬ veu laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Daˍviˆ chi hkʼe dawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ gʼa te tuˬ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ leh, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ leh kanˉ te hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ gʼa gu piˇ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ maˇ suh sheˍ htaˇ, loˍ cawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ca hpoˆ taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ma‸ laiˉ pawˆ bawˆ leh chaw maˇ maˇ ve hta‸ tiˉ pehˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, bon yehˬ te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa uˉ peunˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼaˇ suh hteˇ lehˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ ve, dawˇ haˍ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ.

Bon yehˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ lehˬ shi 1,000 cawehˬ leh, hpu 10,000 cawehˬ ca teh taˍ peuˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ tsuh nyi maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve kuiˇ leh sho teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ca teh taˍ peuˬ. Suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ leuˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ ca htehˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, kanˉ te paˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui dawˆ paˍ, la‸shaˉmaˉ,

leh hpu, shi, kuiˇ leh sho chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh kanˉ te puiˉ ve ca liˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ geh hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ kanˉ tanˬ te-o. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Sawˉla‸ monˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ leh, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ yehˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ kuiˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ chi beu‸ tanˬ te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˍla‸monˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Leˍ viˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ shenˍ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 38,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw 24,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tcuh leh, 6,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ ceˇ leˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ paˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
4,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh leh, awˬ nu ve awˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh hkawˇ yehˬ kʼa paˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ shehˆ moˍ pehˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Geˍraˍ sonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ moˍ, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ moˍ, leh Meˍraˍ riˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Laˍdanˍ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Laˍdanˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍheˍlaˆ, Zeˍtanˍ leh Yawˇlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Laˍdanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Sheˍmiˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Sheˍlawˇmaˆ, Haˍzeˍlaˆ leh Haˍranˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ)
Sheˍmiˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍhaˆ, Ziˇzaˆ, Yuˇshaˆ leh Beˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇshaˆ leh Beˍriˆ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ maˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ ceuˬ hkʼe ceh tiˉ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉzaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Aˍmaˍranˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ leh Moˇseˍ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Aˍronˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Moˉseˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼe ceh tiˉ shawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Moˉseˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Geˍraˍsonˍ leh Eˇlaˍzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Sheˍboeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍzaˍ lehˬ, Reˍhaˍbiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Reˍhaˍbiˆ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Iˉzaˍhaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍlawˇmiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Heˍbronˍ lehˬ, Yeˍriˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ, Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ leh Yeˍkaˍmenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Kawˇhaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Awˇzeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ leh Iˉsaˍhiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ leh Muˇshiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˍhaˍliˆ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Kiˆshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ hkʼaˇ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yaˇ miˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kiˇshaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Muˇshiˆ lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ, Eˍdaˍ, leh Yeˍraˍmoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, a sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw co co chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ yehˇ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, a sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ meh keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve,

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ gu ve, hkaoˍmonˇ te tuˬ ve junˍ meu-e hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ te ve, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ te ve, junˍ meu-e leh shaˍlonˍ chu hkaw‸ da‸ leh hkaoˍmonˇ te ve, bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa ve hpu tanˇ hta‸ gʼaw nyi tsuh nyi ve,
teˇ shawˉ teˇ hpeu‸ le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve,

Shinˉ nyi htaˇ, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ leh awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ te htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh tuˉ tanˇ ve, kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ moˍ hkʼa deh‸ pehˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍronˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Naˍdaˆ, Aˍbiˇhuˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Naˍdaˆ leh Aˍbiˇhuˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa maˇ suh sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ suh-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ moˍ shawˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te htaˇ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍdoˆ leh, Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍhiˇmeˍlehˆ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ 16 moˍ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe gʼa te ve lehˬ, Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ cawˬ maˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Iˉtaˍmaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, bon hpawˇ shinˉ hpawˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ maˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, mehˇ hkaˆ nyi leh cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Eˇlaˍsaˍleh Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ pawˆ mehˇ hkaˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Mehˆ hkaˆ cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ Leˍviˆ chaw ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ awˬ to, ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ Zaˍdoˆ, Aˍbyaˍtaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˇ meˍlehˆ leh paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Leuˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,

1) Yawˇyaˍreˆ, 2) Yeˍdaˍyaˆ 3) Haˍrenˍ, 4) Sawˉrenˍ, 5) Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, 6) Miˆyaˍmenˍ, 7) Haˍkoˆ, 8) Aˍbiˇyaˆ, 9) Yeˍshuˇaˍ, 10) Sheˍhkaˍniˆ, 11) Eˇlaˍsheˆ, 12) Yeˍkenˍ, 13) Huˇpaˍ, 14) Yeˍshaˍbaˆ, 15) Biˇlaˍgaˆ, 16) Iˉmeˍraˆ, 17) Heˍziˇraˆ, 18) Haˍhpiˇzeˍzaˆ, 19) Peˍtaˍhiˆ, 20) Yeˍzaˍkeˍlaˆ, 21) Yeˍhkenˍ, 22) Gaˍmuˇlaˆ, 23) Deˍlaˍyaˆ, 24) Maˍziˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha Aˍronˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍmaˍranˍ leh Sheˍboeˍlaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍdeˍyaˆ,
Reˍhaˍbiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍhiˆ,
Iˉsaˍhaˍ leh Sheˍlawˇmiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍhaˆ,
Heˍbronˍ ve yaˇ Yeˍriˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ, Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ leh Yeˍkaˍmenˍ,
Awˇzeˍlaˆ leh Miˆhkaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Shaˍmiˇraˆ,
Awˇzeˍlaˆ leh Miˆ hkaˍ hui ve awˬ nyi paˍ Iˉsaˍhiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zeˍhkaˍriˆ,
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍhaˍliˆ, Muˇshiˆ leh Yaˍziˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍziˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shawˇhanˍ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ, leh Iˉbaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˍhaˍliˆ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Kiˇshaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 2 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Kiˇshaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Muˇsiˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Maˍhaˍliˆ, Eˍdaˍ leh Yeˍraˍmoˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ ve chaw hta‸ mehˇ hkaˆ leh leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ, Zaˍdoˆ, Aˍhiˇmeˍlehˆ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh Leˍviˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsaˆ, Heˍmanˍ leh Yeˍduˆtonˍ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh hkawˇ yehˬ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cehnˬ dawˆ, tinˍ hteˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ, Yoˇseh‸, Meˍtaˍniˆ leh Aˍshaˍreˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Aˍsaˆ hpeh‸ leh jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le hkawˇ yehˬ gʼa kʼa ve yoˬ.

Yeˍduˆtonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ 6 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Geˍdaˍliˆ, Zeˍriˆ, Yeˍshaˍyaˆ, Sheˍmiˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ leh Maˍtiˇtiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa Yeˍduˆtonˍ hpeh‸ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw tinˍ hteˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Heˍmanˍ ve yaˇ 14 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Buˇhkiˆ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Awˇzeˍlaˆ, Sheˍboeˍlaˆ, Yeˍhiˆmoˆ, Haˍnaˍniˆ, Haˍnanˍ, Eˇlaˍtaˆ, Giˇdaˍlaˍtiˆ, Rawˇmaˆdeˍzaˍ, Yawˇshaˆbeˍkaˍshaˆ, Maˍlawˇtiˆ, Hawˇtiˆraˆ leh Maˍhaˍzoˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Heˍmanˍ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ chi ve 14 gʼaˇ leh yaˇ miˇ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw tinˍ hteˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˆ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ leh Heˍmanˍ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe na yuˬ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi ve 24 gʼaˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve tinˍ hteˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hkʼa deh‸ henˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ 288 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ve teˇ moˍ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e leh, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kanˉ gʼa te tuˬ, mehˇ hkaˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te htaˇ, a sha‸ uiˍ ve i ve, leh puiˉ ve maˇ puiˉ ve chaw maˇ pehˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kawˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Aˍsaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Kawˇraˍ ve yaˇ Meˍshaˍleˍmiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 7 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Yeˍdeˍlaˆ, Zaˍbaˍdiˆ, Yaˍtaˍneˍlaˆ,
Eˇlanˍ, Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ, leh Eˇlawˇnehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ 8 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Yeˍhawˇzaˍbaˆ, Yawˇaˍ, Shaˍhkaˍ, Neˍtaˍneˍlaˆ,
Aˍmeˍlaˆ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, leh Puˇlaˍ tehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ 6 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Awˇtaˍniˆ, Reˍhpeˍlaˆ, Awˇbehˆ, Eˇlaˍzaˍbiˆ, Eˇliˇhuˆ leh Sheˍmaˍhkiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ cheuˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, bon yehˬ shaw ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw 62 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˍshaˍleˍmiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw bon yehˬ shaw ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw 18 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Hawˇsaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ 4 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Shiˉmaˍriˆ (yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ maˇ heˆ htawˇ, awˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.)
Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Teˍbaˍliˆ leh Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hawˇsaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw ve chaw 13 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ moˍ pehˬ taˍ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa shuˍ kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa shaw tuˬ, yawˇ hui htawˇ mehˇ hkaˆ leh shaw ve yoˬ.

Sheˍlaˍmiˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ gʼa shaw leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Zaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ gʼa shaw ve yoˬ.
Awˇbehˆ Eˇdonˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ gʼa shaw leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mawˇ teh kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa shaw ve yoˬ.

Suˆpenˍ leh Hawˇsaˆ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh, Shaˍleˍhkehˆ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ gʼa shaw ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe, shaw ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ teˇ nyi ve chaw 6 gʼaˇ gʼa shaw leh, awˬ na hpawˇ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ teˇ nyi ve chaw 4 gʼaˇ gʼa shaw ve yoˬ. Teˇ bawehˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼa shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ 4 gʼaˇ gʼa shaw leh, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ paˇ lo 2 gʼaˇ gʼa shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Kawˇraˆ leh Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw tcuh tuˬ piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu tanˇ ta kʼoˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ keu taˍ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ.
Geˍraˍsonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Laˍdanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍYeˍheˍliˆ leh awˬ nu ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Laˍdanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Zeˍtanˍ leh Yawˇlaˆ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu tanˇ ta kʼoˍ leh, mawˇ keu taˍ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍranˍ, Iˉzaˍhaˍ, Heˍbronˍ leh Awˇzeˍlaˆ hui hta‸ htawˇ kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Geˍraˍsonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍboeˍlaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu tanˇ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Geˍraˍsonˍ ve awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Reˍhaˍbiˆ yoˬ. Reˍhaˍbiˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Yeˍshaˍyaˆ yoˬ. Yeˍshaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇranˍ yoˬ. Yawˇranˍ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ yoˬ. Ziˇhkʼaˍriˆ ve yaˇ lehˬ, Sheˍlawˇmiˆ yoˬ.

Sheˍlawˇmiˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa veu laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍlawˇmiˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ shu tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉlu‸, Neˍraˆ ve yaˇ Aˍbaˍnaˍ leh Zeˍruˆyaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍbaˆ hui tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍhaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Hkeˍnaˍniˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ceˇ leˇ lonˉ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, shu hta‸ suhˉ ka‸ gʼa jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Heˍbronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Haˍshaˍbiˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 1,700 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Heˍbronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Yeˍriˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 40 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Heˍbronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ gʼawˆ nyi leh, chaw chi ve teˇ moˍ lehˬ Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Yeˍriˇyaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 2,700 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Ruˇbenˍ, Gaˆ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ chehˇ ve Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ ha pa le le, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 24,000 gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, aˉ yaˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh ma‸ poˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ tu huˉ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve hkui sheh taˍ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼo ve, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ teh kuiˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ te tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ caw gu taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, shu ve awˬ suhˍ yuˬ sheˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ pa ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ laiˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve hkʼaw, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi beu‸ te chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ leh chi beu‸ choˬ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ ve chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬhui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw co co gʼa chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa chehˇ kʼai tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ pa oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ htawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ geh kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ dawˇ cheˆ leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ tanˬ te kʼai loˬ, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍviˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw yaˇ venˇbaˆ lawˬ hpehˇ kuiˬ bawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ, yawˇ gu taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chaw hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ, leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te tuˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ moˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te pehˬ keu piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te htaˇ, hpu, shi, hkʼaˬ ma yuˬ tawˆ leh yehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ faiˇ leh kawˆ faiˇ taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ te htaˇ, hpu, shi hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ,
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ kuiˬ hpui lawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te htaˇ, hpu, shi hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ,
caˉ behˆ, hkehˇ leh mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te htaˇ, shi hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ cawˇ ve leh, hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te htaˇ, hpu hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ,

Sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo mui taˍ ve hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ han hta‸ te htaˇ, shi hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, te kʼai tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te kʼai-o. Nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Bon yehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ te peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Kanˉ te puiˉ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Sawˉlaˍmonˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ leh, kanˉ te hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ. Gʼa te tuˬ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yehˬ lonˉ chi ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve yehˬ maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ lehˬ hpu, shi, kuiˇ, sho, suhˆ, shehnˉ shiˍ, leh awˬ nu loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh ca teh taˍ peuˬ.
Chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh, kanˉ chi awˬ pon tanˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ chi awˬ pon ngaˬ lehˬ, shi 100 cawehˬ, hpu 240 cawehˬ leh, awˬ nu loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ tanˇ laˇ gaˇ sheˍ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh jawˇmawˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaw‸ hpoˆ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shi 170 cawehˬ hpu 340 cawehˬ kuiˇ 620 cawehˬ, sho 3,400 cawehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve shehnˉ shiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehnˉ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ paˍ, Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍheˍlaˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ htawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw chi ma ve gʼuˇ suhˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh keunˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve deˇ deˇ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh gʼa taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hkʼa shuˍ, hkehˉ chaw hkʼe gʼa te toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai chehˇ leh, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ ve hkʼaw bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ geh gʼa taˍ ve nawˬ ve mawˇ deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ lawˇnyi leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve hkʼaw hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ chi hkʼe gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ puiˉ tuˬ a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˬ htawˇ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ te gʼa tuˬ a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi, yawˇ hui lehˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 1,000 hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ 1,000 hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ 1,000 hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hti caˇ hti dawˬ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ kʼaw‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Zaˍdoˆ hta‸ htawˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ te tuˬ, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa Daˍviˆ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Sawˉ la‸monˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Sawˉla‸ monˍ hta‸ nyi leh anˇ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ Sawˉlaˆmonˍ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Heˍbronˍ venˇ hkʼaw 7 hkʼaw‸ leh Yeˍsuˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw 33 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ mawˇ la leh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ, Naˍtanˍ leh Gaˆ hui bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve awˬ lawn leh, yawˇ awˬ to, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ bvuh keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ 1,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸

yawˇ geh teˇ geh Giˇbonˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ Moˉseˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
(Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca taˆ yuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Huˇraˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Uˇriˆ ve yaˇ Baˍzaˍreˍlaˆ te taˍ ve kuiˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ htawˇ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo to nuˇ to shaˆ 1,000 hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha Sawˉla‸monˍ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ ngaˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma lawˬ gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ jaˇ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ pa hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ te biˇ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Paw sha la tuˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ tuˬ, leh co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ bon maˇ lawˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ nawˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ cawˬ la tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ cawˬ kuiˬ Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 1,400 maˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 12,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ, hpu leh shi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ. Keˍdaˍ suhˆ teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Muˍsaˍriˍ leh Seˍliˆshaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ ve 600 hteh‸ hawˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hkeh ve 150 hteh‸ hawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, suhˆ gʼawˬ tuˬ ve chaw 70,000 gʼaˇ leh, haˉ pui dawˆ paˍ 80,000 gʼaˇ ca taˍ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ 3,600 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Tuˇruˆ jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hawˉ yehˬ te htaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ keˍdaˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hawˇ piˇ jaw ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ hawˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ tanˇ piˇ kuiˬ, teˇ shawˉ teˇ haˉ le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ leh awˬ nu da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ca te gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ maˇ gʼa taˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ yawˇ awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ te piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, haˉ pui htawˆ puiˉ ve, hpu, shi, kuiˇ leh sho chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh kanˉ te puiˉ ve leh hpa nyi, hpa naw leh nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve hpa te chiˇ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh kanˉ te piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ htu puiˉ jaˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve keˍ daˍ suhˆ, yawnˉ suhˆ, leh maˉ kuˇ suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉca feu laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ ve bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, suhˆ peuˬ maˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh kanˉ te tuˬ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ caˇ tuˬ ve caˬ hkʼa 20,000 taˆ, cho‸ shiˍ 20,000 taˆ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ 20,000 punˇ leh shaˍlonˍ chu 20,000 punˇ feu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ te tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ leh yawˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ gu chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ geh lo Huˆranˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve puiˉ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Danˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ pa lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hpu, shi, kuiˇ, sho, haˉ pui leh suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laiˉ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu leh htawˆ puiˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ hpa nyi, hpa naw leh nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te chiˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shu kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh kanˉ te tcuh-o.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve caˬ hkʼa, cho‸ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ feu laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ca htu yuˬ leh hpeh‸ tsuh‸ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇpeˍ venˇ lo shi ya‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ law yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ li‸ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa Daˍviˆ te ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shenˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ, 153,600 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, 700,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ suhˆ gʼawˬ tcuh leh, 80,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui ca htawˆ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ 3,600 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ te kuiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ leuˆ teh taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Mawˇriˆ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ leh, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw Aˍyawˇnaˆ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ bon yehˬ tanˬ te ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 60 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw tanˬ lo‸-e ve teˇ bawehˇ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ kʼehˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, mvuh ve hpawˇ 120 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo shi yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kʼaw ji ve teˇ bawehˇ hta‸ keˍdaˍ baˉ yuˬ ko taˍ leh, shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ vaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ lonˉ nyi sha tuˬ awˬ pon, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Paˍraˍvenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ laˬ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve shehnˉ shiˍ leh shi teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼo‸ pa, toˉ la‸ lonˉ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw leh yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shi yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ chi hkʼaw yehˇ taˍ ve shi hkʼa peu-eˬ 20 cawehˬ hpaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shi yuˬ te taˍ ve sho cuˇ ngaˇ hkanˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ shi yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ maˬ ve awˬ han te tcuh leh shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ teˇ maˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ cawˬ leh, toˍ la‸ kuˉ teˇ maˬ ve ngaˇ shaw‸ zuhˬ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ daw‸ da‸ chehˇ leh, awˬ nu ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ lehˬ, gʼo‸ pa hta‸ daw‸ chehˇ taˍve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hpe leh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve hpa lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ nawˉ-ehˍ, nyiˉ-ehˍ leh nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve hpa yuˬ te taˍ leh, hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ han taw ˉ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 35 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ te leh bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuh hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve awˬ hoˆ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo, aˉ caˆ hkeh vaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ leh, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve aˉ ci ku shiˍ teˇ ha shiˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ paˉ teˇ maˬ duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. La‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸Yaˍhkenˍ teh‸ meh piˇ leh, la‸ meh paˉ hpawˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ Bawˇzaˆ, teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 20 shaw‸ leh mvuh hpawˇ 10 shaw‸ cawˬ ve kuiˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 30 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 10 shaw‸ leh naˉ ve hpawˇ 5 shaw‸ cawˬ ve punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi lehˬ, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ chi nyiˇ hkeh awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehˆ hkeh teˇ hpawˇ mawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ chi ve lehˬ, htu ve hpawˇ la‸ naw awˇ hkeh cawˬ leh, awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ kawˆ hkʼe te taˍ ve yoˬ. Punˇ kʼoˍ chi hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ 600 punˇ keu daw ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, hkehˇ pe le lonˉ teˇ chi maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, bon yehˬ la‸ shaˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo ngaˇ maˬ leh, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo ngaˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ peuˬ htaˇ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ hkʼaw ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ hehˉ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, shi yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ teˇ chi maˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo la‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Shi kawˆ teˇ ha maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ teˇ chi maˬ te leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw la‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ ngaˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Shi kawˆ teˇ ha maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ kuiˬ bawehˇ leh awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Punˇ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ paˉ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Huˆranˍ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ, sho nuˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ cawˇ ve Sawˉla‸monˍ hkʼa kʼoˆ piˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ, Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ hoˆ nyiˇ maˬ, Awˬ hoˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ nehˉ tuˬ ve awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ vaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve kuiˇ caˆ nyiˇ maˬ, kuiˇ aˉ ci ku shiˍ 400 ha shiˍ, Lawˬ ehˉ teˇ chi maˬ, Hkehˇ pe le lonˉ teˇ chi maˬ, Punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ leh punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teh taˍ kuiˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ chi nyiˇ hkeh, Mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ, sho nuˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh hkʼaw‸ laˉ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ ve hkehˇ pe le teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Huˇranˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Suˇkoˆ venˇ leh Zaˍreˍdaˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, kuiˇ hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ leh te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tsuh nyi maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ loˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ tuˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ kuiˬ hpui lawˇ,
da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ, leh kawˆ faiˇ teˇ hpaˍ,
shi yuˬ te taˍ ve suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ faiˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sho nuˆ teˇ hpaˍ,

kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shiˉ gʼeu‸ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ ve yehˬ miˉ leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa Daˍviˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve hpu, shi leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍlehˬ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw yuˬ keu tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gaˬ la peuˬ ve teˇyanˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ taˆ leh bon yehˬ lonˉ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hpaˆ leh bon yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai leh, hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hawˉ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍruˆbenˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ lehˬ, ta kʼoˍ leh ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ keu taˆ chehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼoˆ lo beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meuˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Moˉseˍ Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw, Aˍsaˆ, Heˍmanˍ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hpuˉ-ehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shehnˍ leh tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh behˬ heh ma meuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ paw hkuˇ 120 gʼaˇ htawˇ huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui behˬ heh ma meuˆ, tinˍ hteˆ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve moˬ biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo bon kʼaw‸ caˉ lawˬ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ moˬ leh naˆ ho‸ve hkʼaw chehˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te tcuh jaw sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ maˇ leuˆ yuˬ jaw sheˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi jaw ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ maˇ gʼa te. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te piˇ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ nyiˇ maˬ keu taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo jiˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ chiˇ leh, bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

(Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, kuiˇ yuˬ leh bon maˍ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw teˇ maˬ te leh, bawehˇ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 5 shaw‸, leh mvuh hpawˇ 3 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, kʼaw jaw chi hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.)

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, ya‸ nyi nawˬ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ laˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ngaˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nawˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Mvuhˇ naw ma chi taw taw uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ chehˇ maˇ law‸ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo nawˬ chehˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le a ciˉ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo ngaˬ hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ shu hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ te‸ chiˉvenˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo,
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ a ciˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ. Te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, yawˇ hta‸ keunˍ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh choˬ kaˬ nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ ve ka‸, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hkʼaw, bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ hpfuhˆ leh lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve, mvuhˇ goˇ jaˇ leh caˬ luˬ ve, caˬ faˆ tawˆ ve, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve, naˬ ve gawˬ ve, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve pa taw bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe a ciˉ ga piˇ-oˆ.

Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ bon yehˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve hkʼe, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ la tuˬ, yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ gʼa ca bawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi ve hpawˇ hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ca bawˆ la leh, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve leh, ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve bon yehˬ chi hpawˇ hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi leh, choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ tu la leh, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeh‸ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ geh teˇ geh, bon yehˬ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, nawˬ ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ bon lawˬ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la leh, tanˇ taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ba chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ba chehˇ taˍve pa taw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce ya‸ la leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ba chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, nuˇ 22,000 hkeh leh, yawˬ 120,000 hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˬ hui bon yehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon gu taˍ piˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ taˍ leh, Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tu huˉ chehˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi ma ma ve hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ceh tiˉ tuˉ tanˇ maˇ daw ve pa taw yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ chiˇ a‸ ve pawehˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ te leh, Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi kʼaw‸ caˉ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui hoˆ pawehˇ hta‸ htawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi, ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, Daˍviˆ leh Sawˍla‸monˍ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve hkʼe bon yehˬ lonˉ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ kuiˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paˉ ce‸ caˇ baˬ tcuh piˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la tcuh piˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ,
yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ leh, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, choˬ kaˬ lo lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, bon yehˬ chi lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ te tcuh ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve kʼo,
nawˬ pa Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kʼo,

ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ chi ve lehˬ, chi beu‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi gaˬ ve kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve leh bon yehˬ lonˉ chi ve hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ te ve 20 hkʼaw‸ maw ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Haˍmaˆ venˇ leh Zawˇbaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, shehˇ de hkʼaw cawˬ ve Paˍmaˍraˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu shaw hpoˆ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn leh, Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn, (hkʼa deh‸ gu kawˍ leh shawˇ keu gʼa ve yoˬ).

Baˍlaˆ venˇ leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu shaw hpoˆ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teh kuiˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw leh yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kanˉ nyiˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ kanˉ maˇ nyiˉ te tcuh. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ, ma‸ poˍ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ leuˆ teh taˍ ve kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ 250 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ heuˆ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ leh, yawˇ awˬ pon te piˇ taˍ ve yehˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ maˇ keunˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hkʼa gaˬ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Sawˉla‸monˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, shinˉ nyi, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ, diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ caˇ ve pawehˇ te htaˇ, caˬ suhˉ caˇ htaˇ, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ pa Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa tuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ leuˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hkʼa deh‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ ve hta‸ te leh, awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Aˍkaˍbaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Eˇzaˍyonˍgaˍbaˍ leh Eˇlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Hiˆranˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh Awˇhpiˍraˆ venˇ lo haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ kʼai leh, 5,200,000 hpfuhˇ ve shi teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ geh yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ haˍ jaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ na nyi tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ moˍ lonˉ gʼa‸ veu laˇ leh, sha hawnˉ, shehnˉ shiˍ leh shi hkʼa biˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ na nyi gaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉla‸ monˍ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, yawˇ na nyi piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ ve lehˬ, Sawˉla‸monˍ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ te caˍ te taw laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ ve yehˬ, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve a ma‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ leh anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, nawˬ ve awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, nawˬ chi taw taw cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ yonˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh nawˬ cawˬ taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ bon uiˍ ve le. Nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ teˇ nyi le le gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ bon uiˍ jaˇ ve le.

Nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
