Yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, shi 3,100 cawehˬ, sha hawnˉ leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ma piˇ ve sha hawnˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ jaw ve sha hawnˉ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
(Hiˆranˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˇhpiˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ leh yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw yehˬ hkuiˉ daw te ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, tinˍ te ve yoˬ. Suhˆ chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa gaˬ la ve suhˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.)

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ ma hkʼa lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇ maw ma lehˬ Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, shi 15,500 cawehˬ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸ tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa ve awˬ hkawnˍ, Aˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ laˇ ve awˬ hkawnˍ, leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo shaw gʼa taˍ ve awˬ hkawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ 200 maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Htanˬ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ ve shi 6 cawehˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ ehˉ 300 maˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Htanˬ tuˬ ehˉ chi ve teˇ maˬ ve shi teˇ cawehˬ ngaˇ hkanˉ hkʼe yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hteunˍ lonˉ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve kʼaw jaw lonˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw jaw lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ tawn hta‸ haw ciˬ yuˬ te taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve shi yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e tuˬ, go hkʼeh‸ 6 maˬ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Go hkʼeh‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han teˇ hpawˇ teˇ maˬ htawˆ keu taˍ leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ hkeh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

(Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ awˬ han te keu taˍ leh, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ han te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.) Chi hkʼe ve kʼaw jaw awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hkʼaw ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ ve kawˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ hteunˍ lonˉ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw hkʼa yehˇ ve kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ jaˇ ve shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpu teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ yehˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ, hpu teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teh‸ maˇ shawˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Hiˆranˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh te toˇ tuˬ ve yawˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ geh shi, hpu, haw ciˬ leh maw‸ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh paw sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca na la gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ geh hkʼa laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ, veu‸ kʼaˇ, la‸ caˉ, sha hawnˉ, iˉ mvuhˇ, piˉ laˬ, chi hkʼe ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teh taˍ kuiˬ 4,000 maˬ cawˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 12,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo te leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hpu teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆ saˍ lehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, keˍ daˍ cehˬ teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve suhˆ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Muˍsaˍriˍ leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ hkʼa te taˉ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ ve li‸ daw, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ yaˇ Aˍhiˇyaˆ ve li‸ daw, leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉdoˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉdoˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Sawˉla‸ monˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Yawˇbaoˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e taˍ peu ve Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Yawˇbaoˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ pa Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kanˉ hehnˇ chaweh nyiˉ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kanˉ chi taw taw maˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ uˉ peunˍ ve hawˉ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o‸. Oˇ htaˇ heh‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hpoˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ ka‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ piˇ cawˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ na sha ve tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Yawˇ geh teˇ geh uiˍ taˆ la leh, chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ le. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve la‸ naw lehˬ, ngaˬ paˍ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi a‸ kehˉ htu jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hawˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hawˇ ve mawˇ taˆ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ pa lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˇ taˍ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ jaw‸ ve shaˍ guiˬ caˆ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ geh kʼaw‸ hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hkʼe maˇ te leh, yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˇ taˬ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ jaw‸ ve shaˍ guiˬ caˆ yuˬ jaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍhiˇyaˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ biˇ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ ve hta‸ chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ga hpoˆ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ suh sheˆ suh piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ taˍ ve le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ. Yawˇbaoˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ chehˇ taˉ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ kanˉ nyi paˍ awˬ hoˉ Aˍdawˇniˍranˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh kʼai peu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇbaoˍ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ ciˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 18,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha tcuh kaˍ paˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh,
Yawˇbaoˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ ca bawˆ-e. A shu yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve a loˍ cawˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkawˇ na leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ, Eˇtanˍ venˇ, Teˍkawˇ venˇ,
Behˆzuˇraˆ venˇ, Sawˇhkawˇ venˇ, Aˍduˆlanˍ venˇ,
Gaˍtaˆ venˇ, Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ, Siˇhpaˆ venˇ,
Aˍdawˇrenˍ venˇ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ, Aˍzeˍkaˍ venˇ,
Zawˇraˆ venˇ, Aˍjaˍlonˍ venˇ leh Heˍbronˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, venˇ teˇ venˇ hkʼaw ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gehˇ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍ menˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpaw la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve nuˇ shaˉ ho‸, neˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpaw la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw maˇ la ve yoˬ. Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ jaw ve hkʼe, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇbaoˍ uˉ peunˍ ve hawˉ hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆve awˬ hawehˍ, Yeˍraˍmoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍhaˍlaˆ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Maˍhaˍlaˆ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍsehˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ Eˇlaˍbaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍbiˆheˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh Yuˇshaˆ, Shaˍmaˍriˆ leh Zaˍhanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ Aˍbaˆsaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍkaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, Aˍbiˇyaˆ, Aˍtehˇ, Ziˇzaˆ leh Sheˍlawˇmiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma 18 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ miˇ ma i 60 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ 28 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, yaˇ miˇ 60 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ Maˍkaˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ Aˍbiˇyaˆ hta‸ leuˉ leh ha‸ jaˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ miˇ ma laiˉ gʼaˇ ca piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ ca hpoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Shiˇshaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ,
iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 1,200, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 60,000 leh gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, Liˇbuˆ chaw, Suˇkiˆ chaw leh Suˍdanˍ chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kawˆ leh hpaw-e tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Yawˇbaoˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬve pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Shiˇshaˆ ve la‸ hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ hteˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬve maˇ heˆ. Shiˇshaˆ ca bawˆ la ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Shiˇshaˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve leh, miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe peun da‸ kuiˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Shiˇshaˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ shi yuˬ te taˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, kuiˇ htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te leh, hawˉ yehˬ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ awˬ to bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ pawˆ le le, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, htanˬ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ htawˇ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 41 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw teˇ chi suhˍ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Naˍmaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ maˇ ca. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaoˍ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ ve li‸ daw leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉdoˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaoˍ leh Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇbaoˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍbiˇyaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ chi hiˉ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍbiˇyaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Awˇzeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Maˍhkaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍbiˇyaˆ leh Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ 400,000 cawˬ leh, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ 800,000 cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍbiˇyaˆ Zaˍmaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.
Neˍbaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ moˍ hta‸ shawˍ leh, te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve Sawˉla‸monˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh chaw maˇ jaˇ leh, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ te taˍ ve shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ tan, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˬ suhˍ hkeh sheh veu laˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve paw hkuˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ shawˉ teˇ haˉ le, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve hpui lawˇ hkʼoˆ lo hkaoˍmonˇ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ leh, teˇ haˉ le le kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ laˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˇ ca bawˆ la-o. Nawˬ hui maˇ gʼaˇ taˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo caw hoˆ tcuh leh lo‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chiˇ nyi leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ leh, cheuˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 500,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ, Yeˍshaˍnaˆ venˇ, Eˇhpaˍronˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ lehˬ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, kʼaw‸ uiˍ la maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ lehˬ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma 14 gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, yaˇ paˍ 22 gʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ 16 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍbiˇyaˆ hkʼa kʼoˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉdoˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍbiˇyaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍsaˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve suhˆ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ la yeˬ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ kawˍ leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ te-a veuˬ. Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, shawˇ hoˆ gʼa tuˬ te-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh taˍ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, da‸ la yeˬ la ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ma‸ yaˇ 300,000 leh, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw ma‸ yaˇ 280,000 cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ la‸ caˉ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ taˍ leh, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Zeˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Suˍdanˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ 1,000,000, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ 300 shiˍveu laˇ leh ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nyiˇ moˍ moˍ, Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Zeˍhpaˍtaˆ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍsaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ te gʼa ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ma‸ moˍ lonˉ chi hta‸ ca bawˆ da‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui tawˆ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Suˍdanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Aˍsaˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Geˍraˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Suˍdanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh maˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ htanˬ bawˆ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Geˍraˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve venˇ, hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu pan te leh yawˬ hawˉ caˇ chehˇ kuiˬ lo htawˇ kʼai leh, yawˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬhkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh chehˇ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ ca ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ htawˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ca leh, yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ gawˬ ve pa taw, te toˇ te laˬ ve haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ leh teˇ peˆ, venˇ teˇ venˇ leh teˇ venˇ fawˉ mehˍ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ gʼa uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma luˬ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ bawˆ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ geh chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw, leh Suˉmonˍ chaw maˇ maˇ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ la ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ chi ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa shehˆ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ htaˇ gʼa veu laˇ ve nuˇ 700 hkeh leh yawˬ 7,000 hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yawˇ hui ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve, chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hpoˆ kuˬ leh behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui chi hkʼe ka ti‸ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ ve awˬ pi Maˍkaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ te teh taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma awˬ e ve aˉ yaˇ yuˬ ce piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Kiˇdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, dawˆ paˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa Aˍbiˇyaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve 35 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 36 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo chaw tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, Raˍmaˆ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh ta‸ yehˬ lonˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu, shi, teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ geh Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo feu piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ chawˇ te da‸ jaw ve hkʼe, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ka‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸-a veuˬ. Hpu, shi chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Aˍsaˍ kʼoˆve hkʼe te leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉyonˍ venˇ, Danˍ venˇ, Aˍbeˍlaˆbehˆmaˍhkaˍ venˇ leh caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Raˍmaˆ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Baˍshaˍ Raˍmaˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ ca hpoˆ taˍ ve suhˆ leh haˉ pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ yuˬ leh, Geˍbaˍ venˇ leh Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍnaˍniˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ va. Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw pon tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Suˍdanˍ chaw leh Liˆbi-aˇ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ yaˇ maˇ jaˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ maˇ jaˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ kanˉ te ve ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ lehˬ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ma‸ gʼa bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍsaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsaˍ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍnaˍniˆ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh Aˍsaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 39 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve hkui sheh a naˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la leh, hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ cuˇ. Saˍla‸ gʼonˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˉ ca cuˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ gu taˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ shehˍ piˇ leh tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh lonˉ teˇ maˬ te leh, yawˇ suh-e ve hta‸ paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa Aˍsaˍ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ yuˬ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Aˍsaˍ bawˆ gʼa taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa ve hkui ha hta‸ gʼa‸ leh Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe yawˇ maˇ te.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ paw sha la leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ Benˍheˍlaˆ, Awˇbaˍ diˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ leh Miˆhkaˍyaˆ hui hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti kʼai tcuh leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ ca maˍ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui geh Leˍviˆ chaw kʼawˇ gʼaˇ leh, paw hkuˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Naˍtaˍniˆ, Zeˍbaˍdiˆ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ, Sheˍmiˆraˍmoˆ, Yawˇna tanˍ, Aˍdawˉniˇyaˆ, Tawˇbiˇyaˆ leh Tawˇbaˆdawˇneˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ leh Yeˍhawˇranˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw yuˬveu leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo ca gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ ca bawˆ maˇ haˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇti ˆchaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ geh lo hpu leh awˬ nu ve la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍraˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ geh lo yawˬ 7,700 hkeh, leh aˉ che‸ 7,700 hkeh gʼa‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, yawˇ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Aˍdaˍnaˆ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 300,000 gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ lehˬ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 280,000 awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ziˇhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 200,000 awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. (Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍdaˆ hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 200,000 awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ lehˬ, Yeˍhawˇzaˍbaˆ hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ yaˇ 180,000 awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, paw sha la leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ da‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ yanˇ maw la htaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ Aˍhaˆ geh ca guiˇ tuˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ leh hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ gaˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ geh ma‸ ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh, Ngaˬ hui Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˉ lawˉ na nyi cawˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ 400 gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Ngaˬ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ cawˇ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hto laˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ she‸ laˇ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, Iˉmaˍlaˍ ve yaˇ Miˆhkaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw laˇ jaw. Maˇ da‸ ve tawˇ tiˉ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼoˆ cawˇ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˆ leh Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hkeˍnaˍnaˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, sho yuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ leh ma‸ ca bawˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Nawˬ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ kʼai ve ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Miˆhkaˍ-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ cawˇ laˇ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ca bawˆ-e loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve kʼo, cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh yaw laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ hkʼe, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw laˇ jaw, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpa‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ leh oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e piˇ tuˬ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ ca gu piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ awˬ ha teˇ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai leh, Ngaˬ ca te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ca te piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhaˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ heˍ ve tawˇ yaw tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Kʼai leh yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ ca gu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ ve kʼo gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ Miˆhkaˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hta hpehˇ sheˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ha ngaˬ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ tawˇ ca yaw la ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ na nyi laˇ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ toˇ chehˇ htaˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Miˆhkaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh venˇ chi hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍmonˍ leh ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ Yawˇshaˆ geh shiˍ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw haw taˍ leh, ngaˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ kʼaw‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ leh iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ tuˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ la sheˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ Aˍhaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hui Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ kʼai htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ-awˍ hkʼe jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Aˍhaˆ veu‸ kʼaˇ pa leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ bawˆ, teh‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ mawˬ ve yeˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ bawˆ peu ve hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ veu‸ deh taˍ ve sho veu‸ kʼaˇ caˉ da‸ taˍ kuiˬ nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ peuˬ. Choˬ ka‸ lo tawˆ kʼai-o, teh‸ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍhaˆ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw lo mui taˍ leh, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hpawˇ lo nyi peu chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Haˍnaˍniˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍhuˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca ga piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te piˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ baˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, maˇ maw teˇ pawˆ ca caw nyi leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ ca piˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ suhˉ taˆ piˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw, shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ kanˉ te chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve hkʼaw shaˍ ti‸ te leh suhˉ taˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw, shu ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi ve chaw, leh shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw, leh awˬ chawˇ chawˇ ya‸ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw te-o.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ da‸ leh shaˉ nanˉ lo gaˬ la ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ leh gaˬ la ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ, suhˉ jehˬ suhˉ taˆ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui nyi ma hkʼaˬ hkʼe taˍ cawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ Aˍmaˍriˆ lehˬ, bon hpawˇ shinˉ hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te cheˆ laˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍbaˍdiˆ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te cheˆ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw te cheˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te kʼai-o. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpawˇ lo chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw, Aˍmonˍ chaw leh Muˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ pawnˇ da‸ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ la ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpawˇ lo caw laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Haˍzaˍzonˍtaˍmaˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Enˍgaˍdiˆ venˇ teh‸ ka‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ)
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ tuˬ ce leh bon lawˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi tuˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍ hpaˆ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ taˍ leh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼa.

Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hkʼaw, bon yehˬ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ chi ve lo laˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui nawˬ geh bon lawˬ htaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Aˍmonˍ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw leh Eˇdonˍ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ hpanˍ kʼai tcuh. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caw toˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ, Yaˍyeˍlaˆ, Maˍtaˍniˆ leh Aˍsaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Yeˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ laˬ chehˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ taˇ kawˆ. Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa bawˆ da‸ tuˬ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha bawˆ tuˬ ve ma‸ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ yawˇ hui Ziˇzaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ laˬ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ kʼai-o. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw gʼa hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ma‸ gʼa bawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chehˇ kuiˬ yuˬ leh law nyi taˍ ve tiˉ te-o. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇhaˆ leh Kawˇraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tu la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Teˍkawˇ venˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai-a teh‸ te chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉgʼaˇ va-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui huˉ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma hkʼaw yonˍ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ veu‸ deh ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh tcuh leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ peu kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍmonˍ chaw leh Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ bawˆ pehˍ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ lo gaˬ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ paˍ suh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, canˇ paˍ hui ve mawˇ ca gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo shehˆ nyi chehˇ leh, mawˇ gʼawˆ hpoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mawˇ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e maˇ gʼa.

Awˇ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Beˍraˍkaˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw hpawnˬ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha te laˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui Beˍraˍkaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa tinˍ hteˆ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 35 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Shiˉlaˍhiˆ ve awˬ yaˇ miˇ Aˍzuˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ paˍ Aˍsaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Haˍnaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhuˆ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Li‸ daw chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te da‸ taˉ peuˬve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Eˇzaˍyonˍgaˍbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Dawˇbaˍvaˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te da‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ te taˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yeˍhawˇranˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇranˍ lehˬ, awˬ nyi paˍ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Yeˍheˍlaˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆhuˆ, Miˆhkeˍlaˆ leh Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ piˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ venˇ uˉ peunˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍhawˇranˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nyi paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 32 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hiˉ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍhaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ leh awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ gaˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yeˍhawˇranˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhawˇranˍ lehˬ Zaˍiˇraˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Liˇbaˍnaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍhawˇranˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te teh taˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw‸ sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ Yeˍhawˇranˍ geh li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ leh nawˬ puˍ jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ hui ve hkui ha hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍhaˆ leh awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆchaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve nawˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ to htawˇ gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw naˬve a naˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, a naˍ oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ jaˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh Aˍraˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve Suˍdanˍ chaw hui paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ leh, Yeˍhawˇranˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, leh jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ paˍ leh Aˍhkaˍziˆ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw naˬ ve a naˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ a naˍ oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ jaˇ la leh, awˬ leh meuˇ yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ suh-e ve hta‸ paˆ hawˬ piˇ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh lonˉ maˇ te piˇ.

Yeˍhawˇranˍ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 32 hkʼaw‸ gʼaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 8 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ paˆ hawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ kuiˬ lo maˇ tuˍ piˇ.

Aˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ leh Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ ceh tiˉ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍhaˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ ceh gʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Awˇmaˍriˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Aˍtaˍliˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ Aˍhaˆ hkʼa shuˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ e yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍhaˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ shu dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇranˍ hta‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Haˍzaˍlaˆ hta‸ ca bawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Raˍmoˆ venˇ hkʼaw hpuˇ da‸ leh bawˆ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇranˍ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la leh naˆ tsuhˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍhaˍziˆ htawˇ yawˇ geh ca guiˇ-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe ca guiˇ-e ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍhaˍziˆ oˇ kaˬ lo Yawˇranˍ geh chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, Aˍhaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Neˍshiˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhuˆ hta‸ yawˇ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ ca te tuˬ, Yeˍhuˆ tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, Aˍhaˍziˆ geh teˇ geh ca guiˇ la ve Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍhaˍziˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Aˍhaˍziˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Saˍmaˍriˆ hkʼaw va‸ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ leh, Yeˍhuˆ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍhuˆ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˍhpaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve Aˍhaˍziˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˍziˆ ve aw e Aˍtaˍliˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ suh peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Aˍhaˍziˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇshaˆ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ shu tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ ma Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Yawˇshaˍbaˆ yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍtaˍliˆ yaˇ paˍ chi ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, Yawˉshaˍbaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍtaˍliˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇsheˍbaˆ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo 6 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ kanˉ tanˬ te yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yeˍhawˇranˍ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ ve yaˇ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ, Awˇbehˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Aˍdaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Meˍseˍyaˆ, leh Ziˇhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Eˇliˇshaˍhpaˆ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ chi ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ geh hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai leh, Leˍviˆ chaw leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Yawˇshaˆ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇyaˍ daˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ chi lehˬ, Aˍhaˍziˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ ca te la tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui shehˆ moˍ pehˬ leh, teˇ moˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw taˍ-o‸.
Teˇ moˍ lehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ shaw leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ moˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ shaw taˍ-o‸. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.

Bon yehˬ kanˉ te tuˬ loˍ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw maˇ heˆ kʼo, bon yehˬ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ lo‸-e tcuh. Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo ceh gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼa shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la tuˬ coˇ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ hkawˇ na leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve gehˇ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw teˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ leh, naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ sheh hta leh, Jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma Aˍtaˍliˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ bon yehˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍtaˍliˆ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, Aˍtaˍliˆ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e loˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ la ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, Iˉ mvuhˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw te tuˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ Maˍtanˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa te leh, Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw maˇ gʼa lo‸ la tuˬ, bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, hawˉ yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ geh teˇ geh jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˍtaˍliˆ suh peuˬ ve pa taw, chi teˇ pawˆ mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ u-peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 7 hkʼaw‸ tiˉ gaˬ sheˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 40 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Beˍraˍ sheˍbaˆ venˇ yaˇ Ziˇbiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ awˬ miˇ ma nyiˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍ viˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai tcuh leh, bon yehˬ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ hpu tanˇ ca shaw tcuh ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi hta‸ haˆ haˆ te tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui haˆ haˆ maˇ te.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve hpu tanˇ ca shaw tuˬ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼai tcuh sheˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Jawˇmawˇ ma Aˍtaˍliˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo yuˬ yehˇ ve yoˬ.)
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ te tcuh leh, bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo teh taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Moˉseˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo hpu tanˇ shaw jaw ve hkʼe, hpu tanˇ ca keu la tuˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo awˬ lawn kaˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma cawˇ leh, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw hpu tanˇ ca keu la ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi le le Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpu tanˇ ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ hpu ha‸ shaˉ paˍ geh yuˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw nyi taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo ca kʼaw‸ teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hpu tanˇ maˇ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ leh Yawˇyaˍdaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hpu tanˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ kʼaw‸ gu chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ caˉ haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ, la‸shaˉmaˉ leh ca liˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ yuˬ tawˆ leh kanˉ te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, bon yehˬ oˇ ve ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu ve kanˉ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, cawˬtaˍ sheˍ ve hpu, shi, teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ leh Yawˇyaˍdaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ loˍ ve mawˇ laiˉ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ. Yawˇyaˍdaˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍdaˆ lehˬ, a sha‸ 130 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon leh bon yehˬ awˬ pon coˇ caˇ leh kanˉ te taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ suh peuˬ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ beˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo bon maˇ ca kʼaw‸ lawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh shaˍ ti‸ ca piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, luˬ suh sheˆ suh gaˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ beu‸ jaˇ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ ve awˬ pa Yawˇyaˍdaˆ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ga piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Zaˍhkaˍriˆ suh la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mawˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ jaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo, yawˇ htawˇ hkaˆ ce heuˆ leh gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ tan, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ kuiˬ lo shu yawˇ hta‸ maˇ tuˍ piˇ.
(Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ yaˇ miˇ Sheˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍbaˆ leh, Mawˇbaˆ yaˇ miˇ Shiˇmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˉzaˍbaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ gu te ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 29 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yuˇdanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma pfuhˇ leh te ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ. Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ pa awˬ e te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh, chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ, chaw teˇ ha gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leuˆ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ geh ma‸ yaˇ 300,000 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ cheuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, gehˇ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ yehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ 100,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ hpu 1,000 cawehˬ piˇ leh ngaˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo taˇ shiˍ kʼai. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ chehˇ.

Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve leh shonˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍziˆ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hpu oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ ngaˍ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Aˉ leh‸ lawˬ hkʼo‸, lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ leh, Eˇdonˍ chaw 10,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ hpeh gʼa leh, Sheˍlaˆ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ ca‸ ce piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ haˉ hpawˇ ce suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Aˍmaˍziˆ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ leh Beˍtawˇronˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ-e leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw 3,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ ve, A shu yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa ve Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve le, teh‸ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍmaˍzi‸ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te tuˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve le. Nawˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ leh yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍhuˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yeˍhawˇshaˆ geh lo yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ca hto piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ teˇ cehˬ hta‸, Nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ka piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve ceˇ. Oˇ htaˇ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai cawˇ leh, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ oˇ ve hta‸ naˆ nehˆ sheˬ ve ceˇ.

Aˍmaˍzi‸-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve pa taw, nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tiˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍmaˍziˆ maˇ na yuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Eˇdonˍ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ ma‸ bawˆ shonˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhawˇshaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, lanˇ venˇ 400 shaw‸ hkʼe te luˬ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo te leh, awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, hkʼa mawˬ ve hpu shi hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhawˇshaˆ a‸ kehˉ 15 hkʼaw‸ gʼa chehˇ maw ve yoˬ.
Aˍmaˍziˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇ mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˬ hpfuhˆ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, shu hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ leh, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a sha‸ teˇ chi hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ tiˉ gaˬ sheˍ ve Awˇziˆ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
(Aˍmaˍziˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Awˇziˆ lehˬ Eˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.)

Awˇziˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ teˇ chi hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 52 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍhkawˇliˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ bon hpawˇ shinˉ hpawˇ ve saˍla‸ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ ca bawˆ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gaˍtaˆ venˇ, Yaˍneˍ venˇ leh Aˍshoˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, Aˍshoˆ venˇ awˬ paˇ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw, Guˇraˆbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍraˆ chaw leh Meˍniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Awˇziˆ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸, Lawˬ hkʼo‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ lehˍ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lo, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ te keu leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te keu leh, gʼuiˬ po maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ duˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, muiˬ caˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma pfuhˇ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ hko te tuˬ, leh miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ti mi te caˇ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ hu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Yeˍlaˆ leh Maˍseˍyaˆ hui gʼawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ Haˍnaˍniˆ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ 2,600 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, 307,500 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, sho uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ hpaˍ, sho veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, hkaˆ leh hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ leh hawˉ ma leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ ca piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkaˆ ce bawˆ peu tuˬ leh haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ baˬ ce kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo te teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ geh chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve pa taw, nyi ma htawˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve pa taw, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Aˍzaˍriˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ 80 gʼaˇ yawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te tuˬ ca tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
