Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Awˇziˆ-oˬ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ. Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ chi ve hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai-o. Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ lehˬ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve a naˍ teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ ve naˍ kʼaˍ pui hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Aˍzaˍriˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ ve naˍ kʼaˍ pui hta‸ hpoˆ nyi taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw haˆ haˆ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, a naˍ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ bon yehˬ lo teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇtanˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˇziˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ a naˍ cawˬ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ kuiˬ lo shu yawˇ hta‸ maˇ tuˍ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇtanˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ chi hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Yeˍruˆshaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kʼai leh sha hawnˉ maˇ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ te kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te keu leh, Awˇpaˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˇ venˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hta‸ bawˆ da‸ leh gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hkʼaw‸ ve hpu 1,000 cawehˬ, junˍ 1,000 taˆ, leh cho‸ shiˍ 1,000 taˆ gʼa keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇtanˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ chi hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e leh shu yawˇ hta‸ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍhkaˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Aˍhkaˆ jawˇmawˇ tanˬ te htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ nyiˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ chi hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hui te ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ sha hawnˉ leh awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼo‸-e tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Peˍkaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Aˍhkaˆ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh leh, teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yuˇda‸ ma‸ yaˇ 120,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ Ziˇhkaˍtiˆ lehˬ, Aˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Maˍseˍyaˆ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ awˬ hoˉ Aˍzaˍriˆkanˍ leh jawˇmawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Eˇlaˍkaˍnaˆ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ miˇ awˬ yaˇ 200,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼo‸-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Awˇdehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Yuˇda‸ chaw yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ca hpuˇ da‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu-o. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te chehˇ ve Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Meˍshiˉlaˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Beˍraˍhkiˆ, Shaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Haˍlaˍdehˇ ve yaˇ Aˍmaˍsaˍ hui htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ kʼaw‸ la ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo taˇ shiˍ laˬ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ leh, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ la paˇ neˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui chi beu‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, leuˉ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬYuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve awˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ veu laˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkuiˉ nuˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkuiˉ nuˆ tcuhˉ piˇ leh, hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ shaˍlonˍ chu shehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo caˇ law‸ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ piˇ hkʼaw‸ feu ve yoˬ. Gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh ya‸ kʼaw toˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ piˉ laˬ ciˇ tcuh leh, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍlehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Tiˉgaˍlaˆpaˍleˍsaˍ geh li‸ bvuh‸ feu leh, yawˇ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ, Aˍyaˍlonˍ venˇ, Geˍdaˍroˆ venˇ, Sawˇhkawˇ venˇ, Tiˉmaˍnaˆ venˇ leh Giˆmaˍzawˇ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi maˇ ha‸ shaˉ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Aˍhkaˆ hta‸ maˇ ga piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ kʼaw‸ te keu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Aˍsuˆriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve ka‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la ve pa taw, Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve pa taw, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ hoˆ baˬ taˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ maˬ le le hkʼaw lo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ leh, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ kuiˬ lo maˇ tuˍ piˇ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Heˍzaˍkiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 29 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ yaˇ miˇ Aˍbiˇyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Heˍzaˍkiˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ ha pa htaˇ, yawˇ bon yehˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaw leh, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ paˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te-o. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh, yawˇ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ hoˆ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw kawˆ faiˇ maˇ tuˉ leh, sha hawnˉ ka‸ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui htawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh, ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ chi beu‸ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ taˇ ponˬ kʼai piˇ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon lawˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍmaˍsehˇ ve yaˇ Maˍhaˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇlaˆ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍbaˍdiˆ ve yaˇ Kiˇshaˆ, Yeˍhaˍleˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Geˍraˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Ziˇmaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇaˍ, Yawˇaˍ ve yaˇ Eˍdenˍ, Eˇliˆzaˍhpanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍmaˍriˆ leh Yeˍreˍlaˆ, Aˍsaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ leh Maˍtaˍniˆ, Heˍmanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍheˍlaˆ leh Sheˍmiˆ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ leh, Awˇzaˍlaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kiˇdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw ca taˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, kanˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tanˬ te ve yoˬ. Hiˉ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ caˉ leh hiˉ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui hpeh‸ tuˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ lawn kaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ teh taˍ kuiˬ hpui lawˇ leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ ca hkʼaw‸ keu taˍ peuˬleh, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ awˬ lawn kaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ cawˬ haˉ kuˬ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hkeh, leh aˉ che‸ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ awˉ lawˉ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve chaw hui geh sheh kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ che‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ che‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Gaˆ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ Naˍtanˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ yehˇ jaw ve tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, behˬ heh ma yuˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tinˍ hteˆ, cehnˬ dawˆ leh behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpawnˬ laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, tuˉ tanˇ ve peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ Aˍsaˆ hui yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkui tcuhˉ teh leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ htaˇ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 70 hkeh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ 100 hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ 200 hkeh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 600 hkeh leh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ 3,000 hkeh yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ceˇ chi ma ma ve hta‸ paw hkuˇ ceh tiˉ tiˇ pehˍ maˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, Leˍviˆ chaw hui htawˇ gʼa ga tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ ve pawˇ hkuˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ. (Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ ve chaw cawˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ caˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ chu hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve kanˉ hta‸ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ tanˬ te hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve paw hkuˇ maˇ cawˬ maˇ sheˍ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa hkʼaw te cawˇ ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ te maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo maˇ hpawnˬ la ve pa taw ka‸, pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ te tuˬ jehˬ da‸ leh,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍ renˍ chaw leh Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo laˬ tuˬli‸ bvuh‸ leh kuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ chehˇ ve Danˍ chaw leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo laˬ tuˬ kuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ te tuˬ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ te ve teˇ pawˆ a‸ kehˉ chaw maˇ maˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ, li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa ponˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui hkʼe taˇ te. Yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼe nyi ma taˇ heh chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa zuhˆ tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh yawˇ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la-o.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve kʼo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hpeh kʼai taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e peu tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Zeˍbuˆlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ca kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ guiˇ gʼuiˬ guiˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍshaˍ chaw, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw leh, Zeˍbuˆlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ la htaˇ, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te tuˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh Kiˇdronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw ca baˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Ha pa oˇ ve 14 nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ taw jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉawˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ caˉ awˬ suhˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw maˇ maˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ tan yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ chaw leh Zeˍbuˆlonˍ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui pawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e leh caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ ve htawˇ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh venˇbaˆ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Heˍzaˍkiˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi Leˍviˆ chaw leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ sheh kʼai piˇ gʼa ve pa taw, Heˍzaˍkiˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui suhˍ nyi suhˍ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ te kʼai tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa pawehˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ te kʼai ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo gaˬ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 1,000 hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ 7,000 hkeh tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hinˉ hkeh leh yawˬ ehˉ 10,000 hkeh kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ maˇ maˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ la ve Yuˇda‸ chaw, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw leh awˬ nu awˬ na laˬ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ co-e htaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, chi hkʼe ve pawehˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te jaw sheˍ ve pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, oˇ kaˬ hpawnˬ da‸ la ve chaw hui hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ, da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gu teh piˇ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa te cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve, oˉ kʼoˍ pui htaˇ sheh kʼai piˇ ve leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, teˇ shawˉ teˇ hpeu‸ le tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ve nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa biˇ te kʼai gʼa tuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui awˬ pon loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, pehˇ gʼuiˬ, awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ hui geh cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ve hta‸ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ve teˇ chi pun teˇ pun leh, awˬ nu ve la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ yuˬ laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ piˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ha pa shehˆ maˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ tanˬ leh, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ htaˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Zaˍdoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Aˍzaˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ la‸ shawnˍ chi ma ma yuˬ veu laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui caˇ maˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ leuˉ ka‸ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬhkʼaw lo bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ keu leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw Kawˇnaˍniˆ hta‸ mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh leh, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Sheˍmiˆ hta‸ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ hawˉ lo kanˉ te tuˬ ve Leˍviˆchaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍheˍlaˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Naˍhaˆ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ, Yeˍriˍmoˆ, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Eˇleˍlaˆ, Iˉsaˍmaˍhkiˆ, Maˍhaˆ leh Beˍneˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw Iˉmaˍnaˆ ve yaˇ Kawˇraˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ leh, shu ca tanˇ la ve mawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ paˍ leh kʼaw‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ paˍ awˬ hoˉ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw Eˍdenˍ, Miˆnaˍmenˍ, Yawˇsuˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ leh Sheˍhkaˍniˆ hui lehˬ, kanˉ te chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ pehˬ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve a sha‸ 30 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸, a shu yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh caˇ tuˬ pehˬ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ nyi leh awˬ moˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh awˬ moˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ yanˇ hkʼa biˇ kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, caˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ bon yehˬ awˬ pon te ve kanˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw te ve pa taw yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ Heˍzaˍkiˆ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh jehˬ da‸ leh, Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la htaˇ yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ maˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ fiˍ taˍ tuˬ jehˬ cheˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ je‸ duˇ keu leh, iˉ kaˆ maˇ gʼa tawˆ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ. Miˆlawˇ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hawˉ hkaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te chehˇ-oˆ. Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ ceh tiˉcawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui hpawˇ lo Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Heˍzaˍkiˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Heˍzaˍkiˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui meu‸ suh kaˆ suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ to, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ piˇ tuˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ.

Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ponˬ piˇ gʼa jaw le. Hkʼe kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve le.

Heˍzaˍkiˆ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ve gʼuiˬsha ka‸, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Heˍzaˍkiˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ bvuh‸ feu laˇ ve li‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpaˬ maˉ piˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Heˍzaˍkiˆ ve gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ ka‸ yaw leh ho piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ bawˆ gʼa tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe shawˍ leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ guiˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ya‸ taw jaˇ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ leh awˬ nu ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw maˇ maˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Heˍzaˍkiˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Heˍzaˍkiˆ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ naˬ jaˇ leh aˬ laˬ hkʼe suh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ maˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Heˍzaˍkiˆ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, Heˍzaˍkiˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ paw sha jaˇ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ kuiˬ yehˬ lonˉ te leh, yawˇ ve hpu, shi, haˉ pui shehnˉ, sha hawnˉ, htanˬ tuˬ, leh awˬ nu awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te leh, yawˇ ve caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ, hkawˆ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ nuˇ leh yawˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ venˇ awˬ suhˉ laiˉ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Giˇhonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw shawˍ keu ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpeh‸ la ve anˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ peu laˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍzaˍkiˆ ve nyi ma hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lawˇ nyi gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍzaˍkiˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ ve li‸ daw leh, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Heˍzaˍkiˆ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ kuiˬ awˬ na paˉ hpawˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh-e htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Maˍnaˍseˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 12 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 55 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Heˍzaˍkiˆ te luˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve nyiˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Hiˆnonˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, faˍ te ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ henˇ leh, mawˉ paˍ sheˍ paˍ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te‸ ya‸ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ leh Moˉseˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Maˍnaˍseˍ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ nyi, nyi ma kʼaw‸ nuˇ la leh Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Maˍnaˍseˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ Giˇhonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo te leh awˬ na hpawˇ Ngaˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Awˇhpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼo ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ venˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ teh taˍ ve awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo yawˇ te teh taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ venˇ baˬ lo yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ lo teh taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, yawˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve awˬ lawn leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ sheˍ htaˇ yawˇ te ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve raˍsaˍvanˍ hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ paˇ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍmonˍ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 22 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ pa Maˍnaˍseˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pa oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa a‸ kehˉ ka‸ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmonˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshiˆ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 8 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 31 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 8 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ tanˬ pui ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 4 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve hkʼe chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ leh awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˍ meu-e leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼoˆ hkaˆ sheˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˍnaˍseˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Suˉmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe ca te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo htawˇ kʼai leh, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ, leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe ca te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te peuˬ leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve 8 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, Aˍzaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍhpanˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ Maˍseˍyaˆ leh Yawˇhkaˆ ve yaˇ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Yawˇaˍ hui hta‸ bon yehˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo Leˍviˆ chaw hui shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. (Hpu chi ve lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw, Maˍnaˍseˍ chaw, Yuˇda‸ chaw, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ hpu chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ gaˬ la taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ taˍ leh, bon yehˬ kʼaw‸ gu chehˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh, loˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ leh suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ vuiˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Kanˉ te paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍhaˆ leh Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Kawˇhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ leh Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa puiˉ ve yoˬ.)

Awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu te tuˬ loˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga nyi piˇ leh, te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ lanˇ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ shaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve hpu hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ, Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hta‸ ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Shaˍhpanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, li‸ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍhpanˍ lehˬ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh yuˬ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui te taˍ peuˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw ha‸shaˉ taˍ ve hpu hta‸ ngaˬ hui yuˬ tawˆ leh, kanˉ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ geh lo Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ piˇ laˇ ve li‸ teˇ daw cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, li‸ oˇ ve yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆkanˍ, Miˆhkaˍ ve yaˇ Aˍbaˍdonˍ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Shaˍhpanˍ, leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ Aˍsaˍyaˆ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ tan leh cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi-o. Li‸ chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca na nyi-o. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh li‸ daw chi ve hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve hkʼe, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ ma Huˇlaˍdaˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, Haˍraˍhaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Tiˉkaˍvaˍ ve yaˇ Shaˍlunˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.) Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui tcuh kaˍ ma oˇ ve hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Li‸ daw chi hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ gʼa gʼaw taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chi mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, li‸ daw oˇ ve hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆ saˍ lehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca mawˬ taˍ ve li‸ daw oˇ ve teˇ daw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpawnˬ laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ hkʼe ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hkʼaw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa 14 nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te tuˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te tuˬ yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ-o‸. Ta kʼoˍ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui taˆ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui te cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ shawˍ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ga piˇ gʼa tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh piˇ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ 30,000, leh nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 3,000 hkeh tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ leh Yeˍheˍlaˆ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ 2,600 hkeh leh, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 300 hkeh tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ Kawˇnaˍniˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Naˍtaˍ neˍlaˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Yeˍlaˆ leh Yawˇzaˍbaˆ hui htawˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ 5,000 leh nuˇ paˍ lonˉ 500 hkeh tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼeh‸ baˬ leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceˇ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, shaˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ piˬ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu caˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon leh Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, caˇ tuˬ kʼaw‸ gu ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, te caˇ te dawˬ yanˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, Leˍviˆ chaw Aˍsaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍsaˆ, Heˍmanˍ leh jawˇmawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍduˆtonˍ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon gu teh taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon htawˇ caˇ tuˬ gu piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui awˬ tan chaw kʼaw‸ pa shaw tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te tuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ awˬ co-e htaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo, chi taw taw uiˍ ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa te sheˍ. Awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, chi teˇ pawˆ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw, Iˉsaˍraˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ te ve Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hkʼe taw uiˍ ve pawehˇ lonˉ hta‸ maˇ te jaw sheˍ.
Pawehˇ chi ve hta‸ Yawˇshiˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve 18 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ te ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Kaˍhkeˍmeˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Neˍhkawˇ yawˇ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ ceh ngaˬ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ laˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ tawˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ tawˍ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇshiˆ lehˬ Neˍhkawˇ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Neˍhkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ veu‸ kʼaˇ peˍ leh Neˍhkawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ hta‸ hkaˆ ce heuˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸, Ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ hpaw-e laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ naˬ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼaw chiˇ ya‸ leh, awˬ nu ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chiˇ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ kuiˬ lo tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ suh ve hta‸ dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ hkawˇ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ tawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e htaˇ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve dawˇ haˍ hkawˇ chi hta‸ kʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼa mui hkawˇ chi hta‸ Dawˇ haˍ ve li‸ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇshiˆ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh yawˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma na yuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ,
yawˇ kanˉ te ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ te leh awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhkaˆ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇhkaˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 23 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha pa shehˆ maˬ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ hpu 1,00 cawehˬ leh, shi 10 cawehˬ awˬ hkawnˍ keu tcuh ve yoˬ.
Neˍhkawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇhkaˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Eˇlaˍkenˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh taˉ leh, Yawˇhkaˆ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍkenˍ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 25 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ 11 hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shiˍ mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ yawˇ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhkawˇniˆ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ 18 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha pa shehˆ maˬ leh 10 nyi uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh taˉ ve yoˬ.
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ nyiˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ te hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw hkanˍ tcuh taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Gʼuiˬsha da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ, yaˇ nehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, chehˇ sha ve chaw leh naˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve lehˬ 70 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ maˇ te taˉ ve shinˉ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬve tawˇ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Kuˇruˆ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Kuˇruˆ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ pe‸ laˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te tuˬ, kanˉ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hkʼa hpeh‸ ve teˇ gʼaˇ le le, chi beu‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh laˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kanˉ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa ca gu tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu, shi, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tanˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, pawˇ hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, leh Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa dawˇ pawnˍ piˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ awˬ pon, hpu te taˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu leh hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shi, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ leh, yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve kawˆ leh hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Miˆtaˍreˍdaˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ teˇ caˉ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Sheˍshaˍbaˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shi te taˍ ve hkehˇ pe le 30 maˬ, hpu te taˍ ve hkehˇ pe le 1,000 maˬ, awˬ nu ve hkehˇ pe le 29 maˬ, shi te taˍ ve kawˆ ehˉ 30 maˬ, hpu te taˍ ve kawˆ ehˉ 410 maˬ, awˬ nu ve mu‸ hkʼu hkehˇ 1,000 maˬ,

hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shawˍ nyi kʼo, hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve hkehˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ 5,400 maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Shaˍshaˍbaˍzaˍ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ maˇ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, Yawˇsuˆ, Neˍhaˍmiˆ, Seˍraˍyaˆ, Yeˍlaˍ yaˆ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ, Biˇlaˍshanˍ, Miˆsaˍpaˍ, Biˇgaˍveˍ, Reˍhonˍ, leh Baˍnaˍ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ la htaˇ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇzaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Saˍlaˍteˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍruˇbaˆbeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw aw hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui teˇ shawˉ teˇ hpeu‸ le, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ ve htawˇ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui teˇ shawˉ teˇ hpeu‸ le oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ hta‸ htawˇ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ te muiˬ te jaw ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ te htaˇ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh bon lawˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬhta‸ maˇ gʼa gu te sheˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˉ pui htawˆ paˍ leh la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ tuˬ hpu tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ lo feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ leh Yuˇpeˍ venˇ lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui kanˉ tanˬ te ve yoˬ. Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, Yawˇ suˆ, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, kanˉ hpawnˬ te ve yoˬ. A sha‸ 20 hkʼaw‸ hpaˆ gaˬ peuˬ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Leˍviˆ chaw Yawˇsuˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hawˇdaˍ viˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Kaˍmeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ teˇ geh te ve yoˬ. (Yawˇ hui hta‸ Heˍnaˍdaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ).

Yawˇ hui bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve behˬ heh ma hta‸ yuˬ leh huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw, Aˍsaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

A sha‸ mawˇ la peuˬ ve paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi taˍ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca pehˬ da‸ maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ka‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, Ngaˬ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui bon yehˬ te chehˇ ve hta‸ ga laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Eˇsaˍraˆhaˍdonˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, ngaˬ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍruˇbaˆbeˍlaˆ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ga laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ loˍ. Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Kuˇruˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, laiˉ ceuˬ kʼoˆ leh ho piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ piˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, tawˍ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ uˉpeunˍ chehˇ ve aw yanˇ hta‸ te leh jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍyiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ leh jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍtaˍzeˍyiˆ Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Taˍbeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˆtaˍreˍdaˆ geh jehˬ da‸ leh jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Aˍraˍmiˆ hkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ leh, gʼaw maˍ piˇ htaˇ tcuhˉ kuiˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, jawˇmawˇ Reˍhonˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍmiˍshehˇ hui htawˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ lawn jawˇmawˇ Aˍtaˍzeˍyiˆ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, la‸ ma‸ nyiˉ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Reˍhonˍ, ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍmiˍshehˇ, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Eˇrehˆ venˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ, Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Suˇsanˍ venˇ,

chi teˇ hpa hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍshuˇraˆbeˍniˆpaˍlaˆ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve pa taw, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍtaˍzeˍyiˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la leh, haiˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ chehˇ leh, maˇ maw maw kʼo peuˬ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te peuˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ve hpu yawnˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ hui ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve li‸ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ hpfuhˆ nyi sheˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, venˇ chi lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, uˉ peunˍ tuˬ hkʼa cawˇ haˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi pa taw, venˇ chi luˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te peuˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, Reˍhonˍ, ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍmiˍshehˇ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ, leh Uˉhpaˍ raˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve li‸ hta‸ shu tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh gʼaw maˍ laˇ peuˬ.

Li‸ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi tuˬ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ te leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te puiˉ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, uˉ peunˍ leh awˬ hkawnˍ shaw caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ awˬ suhˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa haiˬ tawˆ la tuˬ, kanˉ chi ve hta‸ haˆ haˆ te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Reˍhonˍ, Sheˍmiˍshehˇ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍtaˍzeˍyiˆ ve li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo haˆ haˆ kʼai leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ jehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ leh Iˉdoˍ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shaˍteˍ laˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh Yawˇzaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ hui tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Taˍtaˍnehˇ, Sheˍtaˍbawˇzaˍnehˇ leh awˬ nu ve chaw uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, Bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ gu te chehˇ ve chaw hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ htawˇ bvuh‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ geh li‸ bvuh feu leh, jawˇmawˇ ve li‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh ca nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpa lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˍ leh, awˬ hkʼoˆ lo toˉ la‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ keu chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ leh, awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ peuˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, a shu yawˇ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ leh bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve aw lawn na nyi ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ chi hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te taˉ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve hpu, shi, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Sheˍshaˍbaˍzaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e tcuh leh, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Sheˍshaˍbaˍzaˍ awˬ to Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gu maˇ peuˬ sheˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe te tcuh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve caˇ lanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ chaˬ nyi tcuh-o. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te tcuh gaˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto laˇ sheˍ, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve caˇ lanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ hpfuhˆ nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.
Meˍdiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Eˍbaˍtaˍnaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, li‸ daw teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ Yeˍ ruˆ saˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tcuh ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuh ve hpawˇ 60 shaw‸, kʼehˬ ve hpawˇ 60 shaw‸ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hta‸ ko tuˬ ve lehˬ, haˉ pui shehˆ htai‸ kawˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˆ teˇ htai‸ gʼa te kawˍ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ chi hta‸ gu te leh peuˬ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve hpu, shi, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Taˍtaˍnehˇ, Sheˍtaˍbawˇzaˍnehˇ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui taˇ te sho‸ sha‸ piˇ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬhta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ, yawˇ hui yehˇ peuˬ taˍ ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ loˍ cawˇ ve mawˇ, nuˇ, yawˬ, caˬ hkʼa, aˉ leh‸, aˬ pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui teˇ nyi le le gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ to leh ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon bon lawˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, ba‸ che peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼa juˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ tawˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ li‸ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Taˍtaˍnehˇ, Sheˍtaˍbawˇzaˍnehˇ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh gu te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ leh Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hui htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha, jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ, Daˍriˆ, Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve 6 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, Aˍdaˍ ha pa shehˆ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa bon yehˬ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ hui lehˬ nuˇ 100 hkeh, yawˬ awˬ paˍ 200 hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ 400 hkeh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw 12 ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe, aˉ che‸ 12 hkeh tiˇ leh, venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te tuˬ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha pa awˉ lawˉ teˇ maˬ 14 nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw te hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ te hpaˍ teˇ geh hpoˆ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nyi ma gu piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Eˉzaˍraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Aˍronˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, Seˍraˍyaˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍzaˍriˆ lehˬ, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ.
Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ lehˬ Shaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ lehˬ Zaˍdoˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Zaˍdoˆ lehˬ Aˍhiˇtuˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ.
Aˍhiˇtuˆ lehˬ Aˍmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Aˍmaˍriˆ lehˬ Meˍraˍyoˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ.
Meˍraˍyoˆ lehˬ Zeˍraˍhiˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Zeˍraˍhiˆ lehˬ Awˇziˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Awˇziˆ lehˬ Buˇhkiˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ.
