Buˇhkiˆ lehˬ Aˍbiˇshuˍ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Aˍbiˇshuˍ lehˬ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Hpiˇneˍhaˆ lehˬ Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve yaˇ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ lehˬ Aˍronˍ ve yaˇ yoˬ.

Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh awˬ bon gʼa taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hkʼa lawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ, bon yehˬ shaw paˍ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh teˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve lehˬ, Aˍtaˍzeˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ha pa awˉ lawˇ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼaw chehˇ henˇ chehˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ hta‸ ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw leh, leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai gaˇ ve kʼo, kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ to leh ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ 7 gʼaˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma na yuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ chaˬ nyi tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to leh ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve hpu, shi, teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu, shi, teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ awˬ pon tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, gʼa yuˬ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hpu chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nuˇ, yawˬ, caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leuˉ taˍ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ dawˇ nyi leh yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ pon yehˇ tuˬ loˍ sheˍ ve mawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ ve shaˉ nanˉ lo ca yuˬ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, tawˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ nawˬ hui geh hkʼa lawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpu 2,500 chawehˬ, caˬ hkʼa 650 hkʼawˍ lawˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ 600 gaˍlanˍ, shaˍlonˍ chu 600 gaˍlanˍ, leh aˉ leh‸ loˍ ve hkʼe gʼa ga piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma maˇ gʼa zuhˆ tuˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve chaw, bon yehˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh awˬ hkawnˍ maˇ gʼa shaw.

Eˇzaˍraˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Uˉhpaˍ raˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ gʼa maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo htawnˍ hkʼaw hpeh keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ awˬ to, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma pe‸ laˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ laiˉ gʼaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ gʼa taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Eˇzaˍraˆ geh teˇ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
Hpiˇneˍhaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Geˍraˍsonˍ, Iˉtaˍmaˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Daˍyeˍlaˆ, Daˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍhkaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Yaˍtoˆ, Paˍroˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, leh yawˇ ve chaw 150 gʼaˇ,

Paˍhaˆmawˇbaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zeˍraˍhiˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlawˇnehˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw 200 gʼaˇ, Zaˍtoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍhaˍzeˍlaˆ ve ya Sheˍhkaˍriˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 300 gʼaˇ, Aˍdenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yawˉnaˆtanˬ ve yaˇ Eˇbehˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 50 gʼaˇ, Eˇlanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍtaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍshaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 70 gʼaˇ, Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Miˆhkeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍbaˍdiˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 80 gʼaˇ, Yaˍ baˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yaˍheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Awˇbaˍdiˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 218 gʼaˇ, Baˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yawˇsiˍhpiˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍlawˇmiˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 160 gʼaˇ, Beˍbehˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw 28 gʼaˇ, Aˍzaˍgaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Kaˍkaˍtanˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh yawˇ ve chaw 110 gʼaˇ, Aˍdawˇniˆkanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇliˆhpeˍlehˆ, Yo-eˍlaˆ, Shaˍmaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ 60 gʼaˇ, (yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ heh‸ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ) Biˇgaˍveˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍkuˇtaˆ, Uˇtehˇ leh yawˇ hui ve chaw 70 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Aˍvaˍhaˍ venˇ lo duˇ keu taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ paˇ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo 3 nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo paw hkuˇ te hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hpeh‸ ve Eˇlaˍzaˍ Aˍreˍlaˆ, Sheˍmaˍ yaˆ, Eˇlaˆnaˍtanˍ, Yaˍrehˆ, Eˇlaˆnaˍtanˍ, Maˍtanˍ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, chaw chi ve kʼawˇ gʼaˇ leh, saˍla‸ Yawˇyaˍreˆ leh saˍla‸ Eˇlaˆnaˍtanˍ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Kaˍsiˍhpoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ lonˉ Iˉdoˍ geh kʼai tcuh leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ peu laˇ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha bon hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve Maˍhaˍliˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw Sheˍraˍbiˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ chi hiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ yawˇ lehˬ, Meˍraˍriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Yeˍshaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi nyiˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ 220 gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ Aˍhaˍvaˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ leh ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, caˇ tuˬ ce leh bon lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ htaˇ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ geh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ moˍ ca lawˬ veu laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, gʼa ya‸ taw jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ce leh, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ paw hkuˇ Sheˍraˍbiˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ awˬ to, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui tanˇ feu laˇ taˍ ve hpu shi leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tsuh nyi leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu - 14,050 cawehˬ, hpu kawˆ - 100 maˬ, shi - 1,468 cawehˬ, shi kawˆ - 20 maˬ, kuiˇ te taˍ ve hkehˇ pe le 2 maˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ, tanˇ taˍ ve mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui bon yehˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ kaˬ paw hkuˇ hui ve bawehˇ lo gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tsuh nyi leh, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ kʼai tuˬve hpu shi leh hkehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ maˬ teˇ chi nyiˇ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ hui Aˍhaˍvaˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ lo tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍleh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ hui shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ jehˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, 4 nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ ngaˬ hui bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, hpu shi leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ tsuh nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Uˇriˇya‸ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Meˍraˍmoˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaw geh lo Hpiˇnaˍhaˆ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw Yawˇsuˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇzaˍbaˆ leh Biˇniˍ ve yaˇ Nawˇdiˆ hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ
Mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw nyi leh tsuh nyi peu hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ 96 hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ 70 hkeh, leh aˉ che‸ 12 hkeh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ gu te tuˬ loˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ.

Kanˉ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, paw hkuˇ, leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Hkaˍnaˍniˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇ niˆ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, Hiˆtiˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ heuˆ da‸ chehˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ ve chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh leh paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ htawˇ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jo mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ jo mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, venˇbaˆ chi hta‸ pa taw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh, ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ chiˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ya‸ taw jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼa shuˍ mvuh jaˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe venˇbaˆ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ngaˬ hui ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ leh, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, shu te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve leh shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, shu ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ te piˇ leh, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve le.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ peuˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ca chehˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ gaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ tcuh piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ shawˍ nyi ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve lehˬ i jaˇ sheˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Eˇzaˍraˆ bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇlanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍhkaˍniˆ Eˇzaˍraˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ a ciˉ cawˬ sheˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka ti‸ te cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu tu te loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ Sheˍhkaˍniˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkanˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ bon yehˬ lo tu leh Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ.
Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ tuˬ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shehˆ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gaˬ la ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hiˉ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼe shawˍ taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ feu piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi, ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi nyi htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ leh Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, bon yehˬ paˇ lo hpawnˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ ka‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, hpawnˬ da‸ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi a yeˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ Eˉzaˍraˆ tu la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui chi beu‸ a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ te da‸ leh, nawˬ hui heuˆ taˍ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te tu yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Hpawnˬ laˬ ve chaw maˇ jaˇ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui choˬ ka‸ lo chi hkʼe te huˉ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸-o. Kanˉ chi ve lehˬ, teˇ nyi, nyiˇ nyi tiˉ hkʼaw te peuˬ gʼa tuˬ ve kanˉ maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve chaw cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˉ leh, kanˉ chi hta‸ te piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ teˇ gʼaˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh chaˬ nyi-o. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Aˍsaˍheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ leh Tiˉkaˍvaˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍhaˍziˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Meˍshuˆlanˍ leh Leˍviˆ chaw Shaˍbeˍtehˇ htawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hpawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui tanˬ leh chaˬ nyi ve yoˬ.
Ha pa shehˆ maˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve chaw hui ve caˇ lanˇ yuˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yeˍhawˉzaˍbaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Yaˍrehˆ leh Gaˍdaˍliˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ heuˆ taˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Iˉmeˍraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Haˍnaˍniˆ leh Zeˍbaˍdiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Eˇliˇya‸, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Yeˍheˍlaˆ leh Awˇziˆ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Paˍsuˇriˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Eˇlawˇnehˇ, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Iˉshaˍmaˍlaˆ, Naˍtaˍneˍ laˆ, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ leh Eˇlaˍsaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Sheˍmiˆ, Keˍliˇtaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Keˍlaˍyaˆ, Peˍtaˍhiˆ, Yuˇda‸ leh Eˇlaˍzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Eˇlaˍsheˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Shaˍlonˍ, Teˍlehˍ, leh Uˇriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Paˍroˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Raˍmiˆ, Yeˍziˆ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Miˇyaˍmenˍ, Eˇlaˍsaˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, leh Beˍnaˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇlanˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Yeˍheˍlaˆ, Aˍbaˍdiˆ, Yeˍraˍmoˆ leh Eˇliˇya‸ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Zaˍtoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Eˇlawˇnehˇ, Eˇlaˍsheˆ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Yeˍraˍmoˆ, Zaˍbaˆ leh Aˍziˆzaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Beˍbehˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ, Haˍnaˍniˆ, Zaˍbehˇ, leh Aˍtaˍlehˇ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍniˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Meˍsuˆlanˍ, Maˍloˆ, Aˍdaˍyaˆ, Yaˍshoˆ, Saˍlaˆ leh Yeˍraˍmoˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paˍhaˆmawˇbaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍnaˍnaˆ, Hkeˍlaˍlaˆ, Beˍnaˍyaˆ, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Beˍzaˍleˍlaˆ, Biˇniˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍrenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Eˇlaˍzaˍ, Iˉshiˆyaˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Siˉmonˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ, Maˍloˆ leh Sheˍmaˍriˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍsonˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Maˍtaˍtaˍ, Zaˍbaˆ, Eˇliˇhpeˍlehˆ, Yeˍraˍmehˇ, Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Sheˍmiˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍniˆ ve awˬceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍdehˇ, Aˍmaˍranˍ, Yuˍlaˆ, Beˍnaˍniˆ, Beˍdiˆ, Hkeˍluˆ, Vaˍniˆ, Meˍraˍmoˆ, Eˇlaˍsheˆ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Maˍtaˍnehˇ leh Yaˍsawˇ hui hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Biˇniˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Sheˍmiˆ, Sheˍlaˍmiˆ, Naˍtanˍ, Aˍdaˍyaˆ, Maˍhkanˍnaˍdeˍbehˇ, Shaˍshehˇ, Saˍrehˇ, Aˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Sheˍleˍmiˆ, Sheˍmaˍriˆ, Shaˍlonˍ, Aˍmaˍriˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Neˍbawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍlaˆ, Maˍtiˇtiˆ, Zaˍbaˆ, Zeˍbiˇnaˆ, Yaˍdehˇ, Yawˇlaˆ, leh Beˍnaˍniˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ hta‸ hta‸ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Haˍhkaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Neˍhaˍmiˆ awˬ lawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve 20 hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸, Kiˇsaˍliˆ ha pa htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Haˍnanˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ lawn leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpeh‸ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ taˍ nehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lanˇ venˇ paˆ kʼai peuˬ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ leh nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ te luˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ awˬ to htawˇ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui maˇ te. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Nawˬ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan chehˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ a ciˉ te piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Niˆsanˇ ha pa htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ ca chiˇ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw sheˍ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ dawˇ haˍ ve le. Nawˬ hta‸ nyi kʼo, chehˇ sha chehˇ ve ka‸ nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ htaˆ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ lehˬ, lu kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ha lehˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gaˇ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha geh ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼaw ‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe pe‸ laˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ puˍ ngaˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ taˍ kuiˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo a ciˉ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˇ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ma htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ paˇ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw a hkaw-anˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e tcuh taˍ ve awˬ lawn, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ lawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ awˬ pon, lanˇ venˇ awˬ pon, leh ngaˬ ve yehˬ awˬ pon loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve suhˆ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍsaˆ hta‸ bvuh‸ piˇ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ lawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼa lawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo te kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve li‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon da‸ ve kanˉ te piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸, Beˍhawˉronˍ venˇ yaˇ Saˍbaˍlaˆ leh, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw Tawˇbiˆ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma maˇ sha ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo shehˆ nyi jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma ca kʼaw‸ te la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ hto piˇ. Shehˍ kʼaw hkui gaˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ciˇ toˇ ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hkeh hta‸ ceh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve, Lawˬ hkʼo‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Cawˇ shehˍ ma gʼuiˬ tuˇ lo te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Cha‸ chiˆ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, luˬ kʼai taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ taˍ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ chaˬ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui awˬ na hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ taˆ-e leh, Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh, Jawˇmawˇ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo kʼaw‸ ya‸-e leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ chaˬ nyi kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw, Lawˬ hkʼo‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ te leh venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai ve leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma ca kʼaw‸ te la ve awˬ lawn, paw hkuˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ hto piˇ sheˍ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui mawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ te-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ga laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, kanˉ te tuˬ tanˍ gu ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Saˍbaˍlaˆ, Tawˇbiˆ, leh Aˬraˆ chaw Geˍshenˍ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ leh hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsheˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, Yawˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ, Haˍnaˍneˍ ta‸ yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Iˉmaˍriˍ ve yaˇ Zaˍkuˇraˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍseˍnaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Ngaˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te keu leh, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ tuˬ suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ te ve yoˬ.

Haˍkoˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Uˇriˇya‸ ve yaˇ Meˍraˍmoˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ. Meˍsaˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Beˍraˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ Meˍshuˆlanˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Baˍnaˍ ve yaˇ Zaˍdoˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˍkawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ kawˍ ve yoˬ. (Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu geh lanˇ venˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa ga kawˍ piˇ.)

Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ awˬ piˍ teˇ maˬ hta‸ Paˍseˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ leh, Beˍtawˇdeˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yehˬ miˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te keu leh, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ tuˬ suhˆ baˉ teˇ hpaˍ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Giˇbonˍ venˇ yaˇ Meˍlaˍtiˆ, Meˍrawˇnoˆ venˇ yaˇ Yaˍdonˍ leh, Giˇbonˍ leh Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ ve yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ shi lawˍ paˍ Haˍhaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Awˇzeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ te paˍ Haˍnanˍ lehˬ, kʼehˬ ve gʼo‸ pa teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Huˉraˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhpaˍyaˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Haˍruˆmaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍdaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ tawn lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Haˍsaˍbaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Haˍkoˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍrenˍ ve yaˇ Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ leh, Paˍhaˆmawˇbaˆ ve yaˇ Haˍshoˆ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ kawˍ leh, Aˬ miˍ tcuh kuiˬ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Haˍlawˇhehˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍlonˍ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ awˬ nu ve teˇ tawn hta‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ htawˇ gʼa ga piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haˍnunˍ leh Zaˍnaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Lawˬ hkʼo‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ, Cha‸ chiˆ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ hinˉ shaw‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍtaˍkaˍrenˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Reˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ lehˬ, Cha‸ chiˆ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ.

Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Kawˇlaˆhawˇzaˆ ve yaˇ Shaˍlunˍ lehˬ, Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, yehˬ miˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te keu ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hko lonˉ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Siˉlonˍ gʼuiˬ po hta‸ te leh, Daˍviˆ ve venˇ lo ya‸ la ve go hkʼeh‸ leh kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ tawn hta‸ Behˆzuˇraˆ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Aˍzaˍboˆ ve yaˇ Neˍhaˍmiˆ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve tuˍ hpfuh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po, leh ma‸ yaˇ hui ve yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gʼa ga kawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍniˆ ve yaˇ Reˍhonˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ tawn hta‸ Kiˇlaˆ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Haˍsaˍbiˆ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ ve teˇ tawn hta‸, awˬ nu ve Kiˇlaˆ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Heˍnaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Baˍveˍ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ tawn hta‸, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Yawˇsuˆ ve yaˇ Eˇzaˍ lehˬ, la‸ caˉ teh kuiˬ yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo te leh, lanˇ venˇ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Zaˍbiˆ ve yaˇ Baˍruˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍkoˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Uˇriˆyaˆ ve yaˇ Meˍraˍmoˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gʼa ga gu kawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ tawn hta‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ leh Haˍshoˆ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍnaˍniˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Maˍseˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍnaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ Beˍniˍ lehˬ, Aˍzaˍriˆ ve yehˬ hta‸ te leh lanˇ venˇ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Uˇzehˆ ve yaˇ Paˍlaˍlaˆ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ te leh htawnˍ yehˬ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Paˍroˆ ve yaˇ Peˍdaˍyaˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ paˇ lo te taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. (Chi teˇ tawn lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ, Awˇhpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.)
Teˍkawˇ venˇ yaˇ nyiˇ moˍ teˇ moˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ paˇ lo te taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ te leh, Awˇhpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ moˍ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Iˉ mvuhˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉmeˍraˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍdoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Sheˍkaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍlaˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Haˍnaˍniˆ leh, Zaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ hkaw‸ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Haˍnonˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Beˍraˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ Meˍshuˆlanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Shi lawˍ paˍ Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te ve chaw leh tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hui chehˇ ve yehˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ awˬ na hpawˇ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo te taˍ ve bawehˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shi lawˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Yawˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ lanˇ venˇ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇhpaˍ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Saˍbaˍlaˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ leh chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve le. Yawˇ hui venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve hehˉ laˇ. Awˬ puiˍ taˆ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ kawˍ gʼa tuˬ ve leh laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw Tawˇbiˆ htawˇ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kawˍ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui kawˍ taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ lehˬ, heh hpuiˇ pawˆ naˆ ka‸ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ kawˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te ve nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hkoˇ hkʼa gaˬ kawˍ peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ leh peuˬ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Saˍbaˍlaˆ, Tawˇbiˆ leh Aˍraˆ chaw, Aˍmonˍ chaw, Aˍshoˆ chaw hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa taˆ chehˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa ji baˬ tuˬ ve awˬ puiˍ taˆ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ sheˍ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui ya‸ nyi lanˇ venˇ kawˍ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼa ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ maˇ jawˬ sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui geh lo‸ la leh, ngaˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ngaˬ hui geh laˬ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ kawˍ maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ leh shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, nawˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ piˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui shiˍ la jawˬ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh kawˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kanˉ te tcuh leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hkoˇ hta‸ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ leh shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ lanˇ venˇ kawˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ paˉ la‸ caˉ ka taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ hkaw meuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ zuhˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hpawˇ lo kanˉ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui nuˇ hkaw meuˆ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ meu‸ keu shiˍ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ kawˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ leh shaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hui mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼehˆ zuh‸. A shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍ leh zuh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ a ciˉ maw la htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ caˬ hkʼa loˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve ti mi, a pehˉ meuˇ hko, leh ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa ca tan taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ pon awˬ hkawnˍ keu tuˬ hpu maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, shu geh gʼa ca chiˇ keu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve mawˇ ngaˬ hui ka‸ loˍ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ da‸ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu ceˬ gʼa te tcuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, shu hta‸ gʼa hawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve ti mi, a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh, Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui te puiˉ te hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ, shu ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa hawˇ piˇ tuˬ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ chi beu‸ awˬ chawˇ chawˇ hawˇ caˇ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa leh, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ cawˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ te cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, loˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ hpu leh caˬ shiˍ chiˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui baˬ taˉ-a veuˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve ti mi, a pehˉ meuˇ hko, shaˍ lonˍ hko leh yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chiˇ taˍ ve hpu, caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, naˍ manˇ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui te leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼawˬ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ hkanˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve hpa hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpi maˍ piˇ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, A menˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Aˍtaˍyeˍziˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve 20 hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh 32 hkʼaw‸ biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jaw ˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve 12 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ caˇ.

Ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa te peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ nyi ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hpu 40 hta‸ mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ geh shaw caˇ leh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw oˇ hkʼe maˇ te.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ ceh gu kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ hui geh mawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ ca lawˬ yuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gʼa ga kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve caˇ kuiˬ dawˬ kuiˬ lo, awˬ nu ve venˇ, hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lo laˬ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ 150 gʼaˇ ve hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ 6 hkeh leh gʼaˆ maˇ maˇ tiˇ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yehˇ keunˍ ve hpu hta‸ maˇ lawˬ yuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ vuiˬ gʼa taˆ hawˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Saˍbaˍlaˆ, Tawˇbiˆ Geˍshenˍ, leh awˬ nu ve ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui lanˇ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.(Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˇ hta‸ te keu maˇ peuˬ sheˍ.)

Hkʼe te leh, Saˍbaˍlaˆ leh Geˍshenˍ lehˬ, Awˇnoˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, oˇ kaˬ lo laˬ maˇ tanˇ. Ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ teh taˉ leh, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, awˇ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ kuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ka‸, Laˬ maˇ hpeh‸, teh tiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Saˍbaˍlaˆ lehˬ li‸ hpui hkʼaw maˇ keu taˍ ve li‸ 5 kʼoˆ teˇ kʼoˆ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ dawˇ nyi leh, lanˇ venˇ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Geˍshenˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ jawˇmawˇ teh‸ shawˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ awˬ to ka‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ jehˬ da‸ tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ to laˬ-o‸, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ. Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ca dawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kanˉ kʼaw‸ te maˇ gʼa tuˬ ho laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍheˍtaˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Deˬlaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ geh ca guiˇ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ leh ca va‸ taˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ca va‸ toˇ chehˇ ve chaw maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ leh, ngaˬ awˬ to gʼa ponˬ tuˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Saˬbaˍlaˆ leh Tawˇbiˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpu piˇ leh chi hkʼe te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh luˬ tu leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ tcuh tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Tawˇbiˆ leh Saˍbaˍlaˆ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ ma Nawˇdiˆ leh, awˬ nu ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.
Lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kawˍ ve 52 nyi gaˬ leh, Eˇluˇlaˆ ha pa 25 nyi htaˇ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kawˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui mehˆ hpfuhˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ ve pa taw, kanˉ chi hta‸ te peuˬ gʼa ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ la ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tawˇbiˆ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Shaˍkaˍniˆ ve awˬ maˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ maˇ yawˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ lehˬ, Beˍraˍhkiˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tawˇbiˆ te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ tuˬ, teˇ hkui teˇ hkui ngaˬ geh li‸ bvuh‸ feu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ lanˇ venˇ leh taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍhta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ kanˉ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi paˍ Haˍnanˍ leh ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Haˍnaˍniˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haˍnaˍniˆ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la htaˇ hpaw leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼo‸-e sheˍ htaˇ hoˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw ca toˇ nyi paˍ te tuˬ, kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ i jaˇ she‸ leh, yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ she‸ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve caˇ lanˇ yuˬ nyi tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ pawnˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ caˇ lanˇ yuˬ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, shu shiˍ kʼai taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ maˬ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍruˇbaˍbeˍlaˆ, Yawˇsuˆ, Neˍhaˍmiˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Raˍmiˆ, Naˍhaˍmaˍniˆ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ, Biˇlaˍshanˍ, Miˆsaˍpeˍrehˆ, Biˇgaˍveˍ, Neˍhunˍ, leh Baˍnaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ha pa oˇ ve teˇ maˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ leh, Iˉ kaˆ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gʼaw maˍ laˇ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ hta‸ li‸ daw ca yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ daw hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui geh kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, leh chaw hkawˇ nawˇ la peuˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ka‸ te leh mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇzaˍraˆ lehˬ, shu gu taˍ piˇ ve bon maˍ kui kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ huˉ taˍ leh gʼaw maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˍhtaˍtiˆ, Sheˍmaˆ, Aˍnaˍyaˆ, Uˇriˇya‸, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, leh Maˍseˍyaˆ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Peˍdaˍyaˆ, Miˆsheˍlaˆ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Haˍsonˍ, Haˍshaˍbaˆdaˍnaˆ, Zaˍhkaˍ riˆ, lehˬ Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui yawˇ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ
Eˇzaˍraˆ bon maˍ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ li‸ daw hta‸ hpeu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ tu la ve yoˬ.

Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ Eˇzaˍraˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh, A menˬ, A menˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˉ, yawˇ hui miˬ chaˆ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tu la leh, a shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw Yawˇsuˆ, Beˍniˆ, Sheˍraˍbiˆ, Yaˍmenˍ, Aˍkoˆ, Shaˍbeˍtehˇ, Hawˇdiˇyaˆ, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Keˍliˇtaˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Yawˇzaˍbaˆ, Haˍnanˍ leh Peˍlaˍyaˆ hui chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ na gʼa tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw moˍ lonˉ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma hta‸ heuˆ jaˇ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Neˍhaˍmiˆ, Eˇzaˍraˆ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ maˇ cawˇ.

Chi beu‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te tuˬ ca kʼaw‸ gu loˬ. Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸, nawˬ hui ve caˇ tuˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ nyi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ. Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh awˬ nyi oˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ, ca kʼoˆ piˇ toˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te tuˬ ca kʼaw‸ gu ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, gʼaw maˍ laˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na gʼa peuˬ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ geh cawˬ ve caˇ tuˬ, shu hta‸ ka‸ pehˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ca henˇ tuˬ, Eˇzaˍraˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh shaˍlonˍ kʼaˉ, htawˇ kʼaˉ, hpa‸ vaw kʼaˉ, tcuhˉ pui kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ ca tawˆ veu laˇ leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo te taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ kʼaˉ ca tawˆ veu laˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, bon yehˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉ kaˆ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo te ve yoˬ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo te leh, oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Nunˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ tanˬ te ve aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw te gʼaˇ le le ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ tanˬ te ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, awˬ leh ve teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ nyi le le awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ tawn peuˬ teˇ tawn hta‸ gʼaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ te leh, hiˉ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hoˆ pawehˇ te ve yoˬ.

Ha pa oˇ ve teˇ maˬ 24 nyi htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, caˇ tuˬ ce ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hpaˆ da‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shehˆ naˍriˍ hkʼe a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ chaw Yawˇsuˆ, Baˍniˆ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ, Sheˍbaˍniˆ, Buˇriˆ, Sheˍraˍbiˆ, leh Hkeˍnaˍniˆ hui lehˬ, bon maˍ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ huˉ taˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw Yawˇsuˆ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ, Baˍniˆ, Haˍshaˍbaˍniˆ, Sheˍraˍbiˆ, Hawˇdiˇyaˆ, Sheˍbaˍniˆ, leh Peˍtaˍhiˆ hui awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Tu leh nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ maˇ puiˉ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇgʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Aˍbranˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ Aˍbraˍhanˍ teh‸ kʼaw‸ pa piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Hiˇtiˆ chaw, Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw, Hpeˍraˍziˆ chaw, Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw leh Giˇ gaˍshiˆ chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ leh, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Hpaˍrawˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ te maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon nawˬ ya‸ kʼaw te pawnˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸, nawˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw kʼa pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ moˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ya‸ la leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve shinˉ nyi hta‸ ce kan tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˍ meu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma ve hkaoˍmonˇ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, haˉ hpawˇ hkaw ve iˉ kaˆ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma heh leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˬ miˬ lo shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, nyi ma haˆ haˆ maˇ zuhˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ piˇ.

Yawˇ hui shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te leh, Chi lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve le.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ piˇ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve moˍ hta‸ maˇ koˆ, aˬ miˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ maˇ yuˬ baˬ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui te cawˇ ve kanˉ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, maˍnaˆshiˍ leh iˉ kaˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve 40 hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ naw te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ tzuh‸ leh, hkui sheh htawˇ maˇ naˬ.

Awˬ nu chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Siˉ honˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Heˍsaˍbonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ ve miˬguiˬ, hpu shi hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ, shaˍlonˍ hko teˇ hpaˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe caˇ leh, chu la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆdawˇ hpfuhˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ lawˬ hkawˉ htaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸, nawˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ yaw ve htawˇ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ naˍ paw pawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ leh maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve le. Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ te luˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ tanˍ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ peuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, paw hkuˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi, leh ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa hkanˍ taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ te peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉawˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve leh nawˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ na yuˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, hkuiˇ jaˬˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ti gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉpeunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ te ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ ma‸ nyiˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ la‸ ma‸ nyiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Haˍhkaˍliˆ ve yaˇ Neˍhaˍmiˆ yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ la‸ ma‸ nyiˉ ve yoˬ.

Seˍraˍyaˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ, Paˍshuˇraˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Haˍtoˆ, Sheˍbaˍniˆ, Maˍluˆ, Haˍrenˍ, Meˍraˍmoˆ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ, Giˇneˍtonˍ, Baˍroˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ, Miˆyaˍmenˍ, Maˍziˆ, Biˇlaˍgehˇ, leh Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍzaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ, Heˍnaˍdiˆ ve yaˇ Biˇniˍ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ, Sheˍbaˍniˆ, Hawˇdiˇyaˆ, Keˍliˇtaˆ, Peˍlaˍyaˆ, Naˍnanˍ, Miˆhkaˍ, Reˍhawˇbaˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ, Sheˍraˍbiˆ, Sheˍbaˍniˆ, Hawˇdiˇyaˆ, Baˍniˆ, Beˍniˍnuˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paˍroˆ, Paˍhaˆmawˇbaˆ, Eˇlanˍ, Zaˍtoˆ, Naˍniˆ, Aˍzaˍgaˆ, Beˍbehˇ, Aˍdawˇniˇyaˆ, Biˇgaˍveˍ, Aˍdenˍ, Aˍtaˍ, Heˍzaˍkiˆ, Aˍzuˇraˆ, Hawˇdiˇyaˆ, Haˍsonˍ, Beˍzehˇ, Haˍreˆ, Aˍnaˍtoˆ, Neˍbehˇ, Maˍgaˍyaˍshaˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Heˍziˇraˆ, Meˍshaˆzaˍbeˍlaˆ, Zaˍdoˆ, Yaˍdu-aˍ, Peˍlaˍtiˆ, Haˍnanˍ, A naˍyaˆ, Hawˇsheˍ, Haˍnaˍniˆ, Haˍshoˆ, Haˍlawˇhehˆ, Piˇlaˍhaˍ, Shawˇbehˆ, Reˍhonˍ, Haˍshaˍbaˍnaˆ, Heˍseˍyaˆ, Aˍhiˇyaˆ, Haˍnanˍ, Aˍnanˍ, Maˍloˆ, Haˍrenˍ leh Baˍnaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw, bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ shinˉ nyi, maˇ heˆ kʼo, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ hui geh mawˇ ca hawˇ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui vuiˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ biˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le, ngaˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ te caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Jeˬ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le, ngaˬ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ awˬ pon hpu tanˇ hkʼa deh‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ lo ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ, teˇ nyi le tanˇ tuˬ loˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ nyi le tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ loˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ tanˇ cawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu loˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yehˇ loˍ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca tuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸, ngaˬ hui teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ mehˇ hkaˆ leh leuˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui geh lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ leh, ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu yuˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh awˬ nu ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ yuˬ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍronˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ shaw hpoˆ chehˇ htaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tanˇ taˍ ve caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, paw hkuˇ, bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ paˍ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui mehˇ hkaˆ leh leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ kʼa 10 maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ hta‸ ceh leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ shu chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍrehˆ, Maˍhaˍleˍlaˆ, Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ, Aˍmaˍziˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Awˇziˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍtaˍyaˆ,
Sheˍlaˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Yawˇyaˍreˆ, Aˍdaˍyaˆ, Haˍzaˍyaˆ, Kawˇlaˆhawˇzaˆ, Baˍroˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Maˍseˍyaˆ leh,
Peˍrehˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 600 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍshaˍyaˆ, Iˉteˍlaˆ, Maˍseˍyaˆ, Kawˇlaˍyaˆ, Peˍdaˍyaˆ, Yawˇdaˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Saˍluˆ,
Saˍluˆ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Gaˍbeˍ, Saˍlehˇ leh awˬ nu ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw 928 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˇhkaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇlaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, Haˍseˍnuˆ ve yaˇ Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇyaˍreˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍdaˍyaˆ, Yaˍhkenˍ,
ponˬ laˬ htaˇ bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ jaw taˉ ve Aˍhiˇtuˆ, Meˍraˍyoˆ, Zaˍdoˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Seˍraˍyaˆ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi 822 gʼaˇ,
Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Paˍshuˇraˆ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Aˍmaˍziˆ, Peˍlaˍliˆ, Yeˍyawˇhanˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍdaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi 242 gʼaˇ,
Iˉmeˍraˆ, Meˍshiˉlaˍmoˆ, Aˍhaˍzehˇ, Aˍzaˍreˍlaˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍmaˍsehˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ vi awˬ nyi ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ 128 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Zaˍbaˍdaˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Buˇniˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Aˍzaˍriˆkanˍ Haˍshoˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ,
bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo kanˉ nyi paˍ Shaˍbeˍtehˇ leh Yawˇzaˍbaˆ,

Aˍsaˆ, Zaˍbaˍdiˆ, Miˆhkaˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, kʼa mui hkawˇ kʼa ve awˬ hoˉ Maˍtaˍniˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Baˍkaˍbuˇkiˆ, Yeˍduˆtonˍ, Gaˍlaˍlaˆ, Shaˍmuˍ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Awˇbaˍdiˆ leh,
Leˍviˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 284 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍkoˆ, Taˍlaˍmonˍ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi 172 gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, paw hkuˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Awˇhpeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ziˇhaˆ leh Biˇshaˍpaˆ hui awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Baˍniˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Awˇziˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, kʼa mui hkawˇ kʼa hpawˇ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve Aˍsaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ moˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ gʼa kʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw Zeˍraˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Meˍshaˆzaˍbeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Peˍtaˍhiˆ lehˬ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve shaˉ nanˉ lonˉ hkʼaw, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve a ma‸ lonˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ neˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbaˆ, Diˇdonˍ, Yeˍkaˆyeˍlaˆ venˇ leh, awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jeˍshuˍ, Mawˇlaˍdaˆ, Behˆpaˍlehˆ
Haˍzaˍshuˍlaˆ, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ, leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ Ziˇkaˍlaˆ, Meˍdawˇnaˆ,
Enˍriˇmonˍ, Zawˇraˆ, Yaˍmoˆ,

Zaˍnonˍ, Aˍduˆlanˍ, Laˍhkiˇshaˆ, Aˍzaˍkaˍ leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Geˍbaˍ, Miˆmaˆ, Aiˍjaˍ, Beˍteˍlaˆ,
Aˍnaˍtoˆ, Nawˇbaˆ, Aˍnaˍniˆ,
Haˍzawˇ, Raˍmaˆ, Giˆtenˍ,
Haˍdiˆ, Zeˍbonˍ, Neˍbaˍlaˆ,
Lawˇdaˆ, Awˇnawˇ, leh La‸shaˉmaˉ lawˬ hkʼo‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui geh chehˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Saˍlaˍteˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ hui geh shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Seˍraˍyaˆ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ, Eˇzaˍraˆ, Aˍmaˍriˆ, Maˍloˆ, Haˍtoˆ, Sheˍkaˍniˆ, Reˍhonˍ, Meˍraˍmoˆ, Iˉdoˍ, Giˇneˍtonˍ, Aˍbiˇyaˆ, Miˆyaˍmenˍ, Maˍdaˍ, Biˆlaˍgaˍ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Yawˇyaˍreˆ, Yeˍdaˍyaˆ, Saˍluˆ, Aˍmoˆ, Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ, leh Yeˍdaˍyaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇsuˆ awˬ co-e htaˇ shu a‸ kehˉ aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hpawˇ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇsuˆ, Biˇniˍ, Kaˍmaˍlaˆ, Sehˍraˍbiˆ, Yuˇda‸, leh Maˍtaˍniˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍkaˍbuˇkiˆ, Uˇnoˍ leh awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ ve awˬ pa yoˬ. Yawˇyaˍkenˍ lehˬ, Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve awˬ pa yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsheˆ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve awˬ pa yoˬ.
Yawˇtaˍdaˆ lehˬ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ ve awˬ pa yoˬ. Yawˇnaˆtanˍ lehˬ Yaˍdu-aˍ ve awˬ pa yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍkenˍ paw hkuˇ lonˉ te chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Meˍraˍyaˆ Seˍraˍyaˆ Haˍnaˍniˆ Yeˍraˍmiˆ Meˍshuˆlanˍ Eˇzaˍraˆ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ Aˍmaˍriˆ Yawˇnaˆtanˍ Maˍluˇkiˆ Yoˇseh‸ Sheˍbaˍniˆ Aˍdaˍnaˆ Haˍrenˍ Heˍlaˍkehˇ Meˍraˍyoˆ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ Iˉdoˍ Ziˇhkaˍriˆ Aˍbiˇyaˆ ............ Miˆnyaˍmenˍ Piˇlaˍtehˇ Moˍdi-aˍ Shaˍmuˍ Biˆlaˍgaˍ Yawˬhawˉnaˍtanˍ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ Maˍteˍnehˇ Yawˇyaˍreˆ Awˇziˆ Yeˍdaˍyaˆ Kaˍlehˆ Saˍlehˇ Heˍbaˍ Aˍmoˆ Haˍshaˍbiˆ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ Yeˍdaˍyaˆ

Eˇlaˍsheˆ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Yaˍdu-aˍ hui paw hkuˇ lonˉ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Paw hkuˇ lonˉ leh Leˍviˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, caˇ lanˇ chi gu peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haˍshaˍbiˆ, Sheˍraˍbiˆ, Yawˇsuˆ, Biˇniˍ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ, hui awˬ hoˉ te leh, Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ moˍ awˬ moˍ te shaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Daˍviˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ve nyiˇ moˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Maˍtaˍniˆ, Baˍkaˍbuˇkiˆ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Taˍlaˍmonˍ leh Aˍkoˆ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ te leh bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍdehˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yawˇsuˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍhaˍmiˆ leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇzaˍraˆ awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ htaˇ, cehnˬ dawˆ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ, Neˍtawˇhpaˆ venˇ,
Behˆgiˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ, Geˍbaˍ venˇ, Aˍzaˍmaˍvehˆ venˇ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa puiˉ ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh lanˇ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh lanˇ venˇ hta‸ caw tcuh tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˇ cawˆ te huˉ tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇmoˍ hta‸, la‸ sha paˇ hpawˇ lo caw kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hawˇshaˍyaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo paw hkuˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Eˇzaˍraˆ, Meˍshuˆlanˍ, Yuˇda‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ leh Yeˍraˍmiˆ hui a shu yawˇ ve behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo, Aˍsaˆ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ, Miˆhkaˍ, Maˍtaˍniˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Yawˇnaˆtanˍ, hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, Shaˍmaˍyaˆ, Aˍzaˍreˍlaˆ, Miˆlaˍlehˇ, Maˍiˆ, Naˍtaˍneˍlaˆ, Yuˇda‸ leh Haˍnaˍniˆ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Daˍviˆ yehˇ jaw ve tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ chi teˇ moˍ hta‸, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ paˍ Eˇzaˍ raˆ awˬ hoˉ te ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇhui lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve venˇ lo kʼai ve go hta‸ taˆ-e leh, Daˍviˆ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo laˬ ve yoˬ.
