Awˬ nu ve teˇ moˍ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ceh kui‸ ta‸ yehˬ leh, kʼehˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸, Yeˍhaˍnaˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸, Ngaˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸, Haˍnaˍneˍlaˆ ta‸ yehˬ, Haˍmeˍaˍ ta‸ yehˬ, Yawˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, htawnˍ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nyiˇ moˍ moˍ bon yehˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh kʼai taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, behˬheh ma meuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇlaˍkanˍ, Maˍsaˍyaˆ, Miˆnyaˍmenˍ, Miˆhkaˍ, Eˇlawˇnehˇ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ, Haˍnaˍniˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍseˍyaˆ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ, Eˇlaˍzaˍ, Awˇziˆ, Yeˍhawˇhaˍnanˍ, Maˍlaˍhkiˇyaˆ, Eˇlanˍ, leh Eˇzaˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve awˬ hoˉ lehˬ, Yeˍzaˍraˍhiˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo htawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, mawˇ leh teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hpu tanˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw koˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ leh hpu tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca shaw yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh Sawˉla‸monˍ hui awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve awˬ hoˉ Aˍsaˆ hui ve awˬ co-e hta‸ te leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve awˬ moˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Zeˍruˇbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh Neˍhaˍmiˆ awˬ co-e hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ leh, bon yehˬ ha‸shaˉ paˍ hui awˬ pon, teˇ nyi le le la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ Leˍviˆ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ caˉ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ loˍ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gʼaw maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw leh Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hta‸ ca pawnˇ da‸ la tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ gʼa piˇ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ maˇ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Baˍlanˍ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hkeu ve tawˇ hta‸ bon na‸ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi ve teˇ hkaw hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui shawˍ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇlaˍsheˆ lehˬ, awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh Tawˇbiˆ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ

Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Leˍviˆ chaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ leh, bon yehˬ ha‸ shaˉ paˍ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ, yawˇ Tawˇbiˆ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˍve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍtaˍzeˍyiˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve 32 hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e chehˇve pa taw yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsheˆ lehˬ, Tawˇbiˆ hta‸ awˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ yehˇ tcuh taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, Tawˇbiˆ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ keu tuˬ, bawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ caˍ piˇ ve pa taw, Leˍviˆ chaw leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, ti mi ca kʼaw‸ te caˇ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve pa taw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ kʼo‸-e taˍ ve Leˍviˆ chaw leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa paˍ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, a peh meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ Sheˍlaˍmiˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ paˍ Zaˍdoˆ, Leˍviˆ chaw Peˍdaˍyaˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, Maˍtaˍniˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Zaˍkuˇraˆ ve yaˇ Haˍnanˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi leh, pehˬ caˍ piˇ gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ leh awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˉ laˬ hkʼoˆ taˆ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hawˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ ngaˇ leh awˬ nu ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw yuˬ laˬ leh hawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, nawˬ hui lehˬ shinˉ nyi hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ kʼaw‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ shinˉ nyi gaˬ la ve teˇ pawˆ le le venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ tcuh leh, shinˉ nyi peuˬ htaˇ heh‸ kʼaw‸ hpaw tcuh ve yoˬ. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ, te‸ chiˉ mawˇ maˇ gʼa yuˬ lo‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ lo nyi tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇ laiˉ ceuˬ ca hawˇ la ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˇ nyi mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ teˇ, nyiˇ pawˆ hkʼe lanˇ venˇ baˬ lo gʼa haˉ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe ca te haˉ chehˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hehnˇ chaweh te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, shinˉ nyi htaˇ yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te tcuh leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ maˇ, Aˍshoˆ, Aˍnonˍ leh Mawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca heuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Aˍshoˆ chaw hui ve tawˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yaw leh, ngaˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw puiˉ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ te piˇ lawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hkʼe, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hta‸ heuˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇyaˍda‸ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Eˇlaˍsheˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Beˍtaˍhawˇronˍ venˇ yaˇ Saˍbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heuˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ aˉ yaˇ leh nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ nu ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa yehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu teh taˍ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Aˍshaˍruˆ lehˬ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ 127 peˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Kaˇlaˇnaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Suˍdanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve 3 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ leh a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Meˍdiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, ha pa 6 maˬ hkʼa gaˬ pawehˇ lonˉ te leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ma paw sha ve leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Suˇsanˍ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Pawehˉ lonˉ chi hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve hko hkʼaw lo teˇ shinˉ hkʼa biˇ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hko chi ve hta‸ nyi sha tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw duˇ ti leh, hpu la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ te keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh yuˬ hteˇ leh, hpa hpu hpa naw teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ ve mui hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu leh shi ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ leh, nyi sha tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ tuˬ ve kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ shi ceh tiˉ te taˍ leh, kawˆ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ maˇ shuˍ da‸. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ dawˬ gaˇ ve hkʼe dawˬ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ma Vaˍshaˍtiˍ htawˇ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te ve 7 nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ma Vaˍshaˍtiˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Meˍhuˆmanˍ, Biˇzaˍtaˆ, Haˍbawˇnaˆ, Biˆgaˍtaˆ, Aˍbaˍgaˍtaˆ, Zeˍtanˍ, Kaˍkaˆ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ leh gaˬ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ ma geh kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ maˇ na yuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kuˬ leh na nyi chehˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kaˍsheˍnaˆ, Sheˍtaˆ, Aˍdaˍmaˍtaˆ, Taˍsuˆ, Meˍrehˆ, Maˍsaˍnaˆ, Maˍmuˆkanˍ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ chi ve 7 gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ leh jawˇmawˇ ma Vaˍshaˍtiˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ laˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ cawˇ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Maˍmuˆkanˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ma Vaˍshaˍtiˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hta‸ tiˉ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kuˬ ve htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ ma maˇ kʼai ve ceˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ leh Meˍdiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ma oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, ya‸ puiˉ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ awˬ lawn oˇ ve a shu yawˇ awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ miˇ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ ma Vaˍshaˍtiˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa laˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Tawˇ chi ve maˇ gʼa mehˉ kʼai tuˬ, Paˇ shaˇ leh Meˍdiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ li‸ daw hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu tcuh taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, keunˍ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma kʼaw‸ te tcuh-o.

Nawˬ ve tawˇ chi mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hto feu piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ paw sha ve maˇ kʼoˆ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, tawˇ chi hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Maˍmuˆkanˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ le le lo, li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te peuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Vaˍshaˍtiˍ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ ca nyi ve le.

Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh, da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ tcuh-o. Yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Heˍgehˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, awˬ hkiˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu shawˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Vaˍshaˍtiˍ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ ma te tcuh-o, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, yawˇ hui dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ chi hkʼaw, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Kiˇshaˆ, Shaˍmiˆ, Yaˍiˇraˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ htawˇ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ shaˍ ma teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ Haˍdaˍsheˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e suh-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼawˆ hu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ laiˉ gʼaˇ Suˇsanˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍtaˆ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la leh, Heˍgehˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Heˍgehˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ awˬ hkiˇ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ piˇ leh, da‸ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ yaˇ miˇ haˉ 7 gʼaˇ leuˆ teh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ hto piˇ.
Teˇ nyi le le Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te toˇ leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ ca nyi la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkiˇ gu shawˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ maw ve yoˬ. Muˇraˍ shehˍ leh nyiˉ ye‸ ve ha pa 6 maˬ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te leh, awˬ nu ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ shehˍ leh nyiˉ ye‸ ve ha pa 6 maˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu yawˇ dawˇ cawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ ceh tiˉ yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ geh gʼa kʼai leh, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Shaˍshaˍgaˍzaˆ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ awˬ meh kuˬ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼai.

Chi teˇ pawˆ Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ, Aˍbiˆ heˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ ve awˬ shaˍ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tuˬve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, Heˍgehˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe ceh yawˇ veu‸ deh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve 7 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa 10 maˬ gaˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ shi uˉ tcuhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Vaˍshaˍtiˍ awˬ tan jawˇmawˇ ma te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te tcuh leh, la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ htawˇ jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ hto piˇ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ jaw ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ka‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ Biˇgaˍtanˍ leh Teˍrehˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, hkʼawˇ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ gʼa shiˍ leh, jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍtaˆ teˇ caˉ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe cawˇ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh yu pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Jawˇmawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ lehˬ Haˍmanˍ hta‸ shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ lehˬ Aˍgaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Haˍmeˍ daˍtaˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Haˍmanˍ hta‸ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te.
Oˇ htaˇ awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˉ te hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve le, teh‸ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ hui Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Haˍmanˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Haˍmanˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ naˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mawˍdaˍkehˇ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Haˍmanˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Mawˍ daˍkehˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu ve yoˬ.

Aˍshaˍruˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve 12 hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ, da‸ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ha pa 12 maˬ teˇ maˬ 13 nyi teˇ nyi hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍmanˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍlehˬ, ngaˬ hui te chehˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shuˍ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼe leˇ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw loˍ ve hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hpu 400 shehnˉ ca keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ ve la‸ peˍ kʼehˆ leh la‸ ma‸ nyiˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ oˇ ve Haˍmanˍ hta‸ piˇ leh,
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, 13 nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Haˍmanˍ lehˬ ceˇ leˇ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu tcuh ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ ve yinˉ hkʼa deh‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ kaˬ le le lo feu kʼai ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ha pa 10 maˬ, 13 nyi gaˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇ da‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ, li‸ chi ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ chi ve Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw htawˇ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Suˇsanˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ leh Haˍmanˍ lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ leh venˇ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e. Awˬ lawn kʼo, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍtaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍ taˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ awˬ pon veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Haˍtehˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve ca nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.
Haˍrehˆ tawˆ kʼai leh hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Mawˍdaˍkehˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, Haˍmanˍ awˬ to hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw hpu hkʼaˬ ma keu laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ bvuh‸ feu taˍ ve li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ Haˍrehˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ htawˇ, yawˇ Haˍrehˆ hta‸ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍrehˆ lehˬ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ maˇ kuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ chi hkʼe teh taˍ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi hkʼe teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve shi juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hta‸ chiˇ mawˍ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve maˇ gʼa suh. Jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kuˬ laˇ ve htawˇ ha pa teˇ maˬ biˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ hkehnˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ taˇ dawˇ chehˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gu leh, nawˬ lehˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ma hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve naˍ, a shu kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suˇsanˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ce leh ngaˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Shehˆ nyi shehˆ haˉ te‸ chiˉ taˇ caˇ. Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ liˇ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬsuh keunˍ ve kʼo hkanˍ suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ tawˆ kʼai leh Iˉsaˍtaˆ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ca te ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍtaˆ caˇ tuˬ ce ve 3 nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ma ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh Jawˇmawˇ ve bawehˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo mui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍtaˆ yehˬ miˉ baˬ lo huˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve shi juˇ fuiˍ yuˬ mawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, juˇ fuiˍ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma loˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ loˍ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve ka‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo ya‸ puiˉ haˉ Haˍmanˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˍ teˇ poˬ te caˍ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Haˍmanˍ hta‸ haˆ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ gu taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ca caˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ chehˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve ka‸ ngaˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe te laˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ chi hkʼe lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ ka‸ Haˍmanˍ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ geh awˍ ca kʼaw‸ caˇ la sheˍ. Shawˉ pawˍ heh‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Haˍmanˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ ve Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mawˍdaˍkehˇ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma Zeˍrehˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma paw sha ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma taˍ uiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, leh awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ceh kuˬ leh awˍ caˍ laˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, shawˉ pawˍ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ ma geh awˍ gʼa kaw‸ caˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw Mawˍdaˍkehˇ oˇ ve hpaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve ceh ceh, ya‸ sheh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw 50 shaw‸ mvuh ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ duˇ ti taˍ ve le. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpeh chiˇ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼo, nawˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa jawˇmawˇ ma geh awˍ gʼa ca caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ, jawˇmawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve li‸ daw hta‸ ca yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve bawehˇ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ Biˇgaˍtanˍ leh Teˍrehˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ gʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ peuˬ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te piˇ sheˍ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ laˇ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hkui Haˍmanˍ lehˬ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ geh a hkaw-anˬ ca lawˬ la ve oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Haˍmanˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la tuˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ haˆ lo‸ la tcuh-o, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Haˍmanˍ lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Haˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ dawˇ nyi leh, Jawˇmawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh gaˇ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw maˇ cawˬ taˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˉ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh-o.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw lo iˉ mvuhˇ oˇ hta‸ sheh toˇ tcuh leh, Jawˇmawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve chaw hta‸ nyi loˬ, teh‸ kuˬ toˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Haˍmanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ haˆ haˆ ca yuˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo mui chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Haˍmanˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˍda‸ kehˇ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ to venˇ hkʼaw lo sheh toˇ leh, Jawˇmawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve chaw hta‸ nyi loˬ, teh‸ kuˬ toˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh leh aˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shonˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ geh awˍ ca caˇ la tuˬ, shu ca kuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ leh Haˍmanˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ geh nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ awˍ ca kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬdawˬ chehˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ma-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ ve le. Chi beu‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hkoˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe jawˇmawˇ nawˬ piˇ laˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ chi hkʼe lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˬ tuˬ shu hawˇ baˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ hawˇ baˬ laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe ceh kʼo, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Chi hkʼe te haˆ ve chaw a shu le. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve le, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬhui ve canˇ paˍ lonˉ Haˍmanˍ chi hpaˇ yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ lehˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, jawˇmawˇ leh jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw tu leh hko hkʼaw lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ Haˍmanˍ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ mui chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ, yawˇ tu leh Iˉsaˍtaˆ ve mui hkʼawˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Chaw chi lehˬ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te-a teh‸ te chehˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, Haˍmanˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hpa yuˬ beh sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Haˍbawˇnaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lo‸ la leh, Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ piˇ tuˬ Haˍmanˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ paˇ lo 50 shaw‸ mvuh ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ duˇ ti taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpeh chiˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˇ hui Haˍmanˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ lehˬYuˇda‸ chaw hui ve canˇ paˍ lonˉ Haˍmanˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Haˍmanˍ geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ taˍ ve yawˇ ve la‸ peˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼehˆ leh Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ Haˍmanˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hkui paˇ lo boˆ taˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍ gaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Haˍmanˍ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa laˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve shi juˇ fuiˍ taˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ mawˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ tu la leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, Aˍgaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Haˍmanˍ bvuh‸ feu piˇ taˍ ve li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw leh ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ma Iˉsaˍtaˆ leh Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve Haˍmanˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ leh, yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ peuˬ ve li‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tu te maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe bvuh feu piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw li‸ bvuh‸ leh yinˉ tcuhˉ feu piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ha pa 3 maˬ teˇ maˬ 23 nyi htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ hta‸ kuˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ 127 peˆ lo ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu tcuh ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh htawˇ, li‸ bvuh‸ feu tcuh ve yoˬ.

Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw bvuh‸ tcuh leh, yinˉ hkʼa deh‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo feu kʼai ve yoˬ.

Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ hkʼaw awˬ moˍ shawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ nyi lehˬ, ha pa 12 maˬ teˇ maˬ, 13 nyi htaˇ yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui shu hta‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ, teˇ na‸ htaˇ ka‸ mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ yuˬ kʼoˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ leh hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ li‸ ca yuˬ kʼoˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ leh, shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Suˇ sanˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ leh kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ ve mehˉ kʼai leh ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ka‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ha pa 12 maˬ teˇ maˬ, 13 nyi gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi chi lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ Haˍmanˍ tinˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ leh, Yuˇda‸ caw hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ tinˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ nyi htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ hkʼaw, canˇ paˍ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ moˍ shawˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca ya‸ maˇ haˆ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ 500 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Haˍmanˍ ve yaˇ 10 gʼaˇ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve 10 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Paˍshaˍdaˍtaˆ, Daˍlaˍhponˍ, Aˍsaˍpaˍtaˆ,
Pawˇraˍtaˆ, Aˍdaˍliˆ, Aˍriˆdaˍtaˆ,
Paˍmaˍshaˍtaˆ, Aˍriˆshehˇ, Aˍriˆdehˇ leh Vaˍzaˍtaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ maˇ hiˉ yuˬ.
Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw Yuˇda‸ chaw hui canˇ paˍ 500 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn, shu jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ ca hto piˇ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ. Suˇsanˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ 500 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Haˍmanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ 10 gʼaˇ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ sheˍ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍtaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍtaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ya‸ nyi te peuˬ ve hkʼe, shawˉ pawˍ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ a ciˉ piˇ-oˆ. Haˍmanˍ ve yaˇ 10 gʼaˇ hta‸ suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ leh Haˍmanˍ ve yaˇ 10 gʼaˇ hta‸ suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ hpeh chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa oˇ ve 14 nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, Suˇsanˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve canˇ paˍ 300 gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui shu ve mawˇ hta‸ maˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ.

Awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ moˍ shawˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ 75,000 gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui shu ve mawˇ hta‸ maˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, ha pa 13 nyi htaˇ yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi, ha pa 14 nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui shu hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-o. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Suˇsanˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha pa 15 nyi gaˬ htaˇ heh‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ. Ha pa 13 nyi leh 14 nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha pa oˇ ve 14 nyi htaˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te ve yoˬ.
Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ daw hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le ha pa oˇ ve 13 leh 15 nyi htaˇ kanˉ maˇ te leh jehˇ taˍ tuˬ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ha pa oˇ ve teˇ maˬ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬhta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve ha pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa pawehˇ te leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ pehˬ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ pawˆ hta‸ tanˬ leh, pawehˇ chi te ve awˬ liˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Aˍgaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Heˍmeˍdaˍtaˆ ve yaˇ Haˍmanˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, mehˇ hkaˆ leh awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍtaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬYuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ te lu‸ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve Haˍmanˍ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˆ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Puˍrenˍ pawehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Paˇshaˇ chaw hui lehˬ mehˇ hkaˆ ve hta‸ Puˇraˆ teh‸ kʼo ve pa taw, pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Puˍrenˍ pawehˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, pawehˇ chi hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co te kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍbiˆheˍlaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Iˉsaˍtaˆ htawˇ, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe pawehˇ chi hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co te kʼai tuˬ, Yuˇda chaw hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆbvuh‸ leh,
Aˍshaˍruˆ uˉ peunˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ 127 peˆ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ te chehˇ ve hkʼe, pawehˇ chi teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍtaˆ leh Mawˍdaˍkehˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe te tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ Iˉsaˍtaˆ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui li‸ daw hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ lehˬ, conˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui geh htawˇ, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Mawˍdaˍkehˇ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ caˇ lanˇ lonˉ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu tcuh taˍve yoˬ.

Mawˍdaˍkehˇ lehˬ, Aˍshaˍruˆ awˬ hawˉ ve jawˇmawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon da‸ ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Uˇzaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve Yawˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw da‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ suhˍ gʼaˇ leh yaˇmiˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ suhˍ hinˉ, kaˍlaˍoˆ shehˆ hinˉ, nuˇ teˇ hinˉ, leh piˉ laˬ ngaˇ ha cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh awˬ ceˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, shu a‸ kehˉ paw sha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ pawˆ hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi ma 3 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te peuˬ leh shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇbaˆ teˇ na‸ tu leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa te ya‸ la ve hta‸ dawˇ haˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh hpawnˬ la ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍtanˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Saˍtanˍ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma tiˉ te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ-aw laˇ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hkʼe ka ti‸ yeˬ leh da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, haiˬve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇbaˆ nawˬ geh teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ hehˉ laˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ chi beu‸ yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hkʼe kʼo yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇbaˆ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ naˬ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Saˍtanˍ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yawˇbaˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ paˍ lonˉ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Yawˇbaˆ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ti mi mehˇ chehˇ leh, piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Sheˍbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ cawˬ haˉ gaˬ la leh, ceˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼai sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa ponˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ guiˇ hto la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Nawˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ htehˆ pehˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ gʼa ponˬ leh naw hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ hto la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Hkaˍlaˍdehˇ chaw shehˆ moˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ gʼa ponˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ hto la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tawˇ yaw maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ka‸, awˬ nu ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ yehˬ hkʼaw hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ cawˬ haˉ, shehˇ de hpawˇ lo mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ leh, yehˬ hta‸ htinˍ ve pa taw, yehˬ paiˍ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa ponˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ gʼuiˇ hto la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇbaˆ tu la leh dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ paw la htaˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ suh-e htaˇ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ Yawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve htawˇ, Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸venˇbaˆ maˇ taˍ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ, mvuhˇ naw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ hpawnˬ da‸ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Saˍtanˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo gaˬ taˉ peuˬ le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ mawˬ-aw laˇ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hkʼe ka ti‸ yeˬ leh da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, hai‸ ve kanˉ htaˬ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ ve ka‸, yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca lawˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ baˆ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼo piˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍtanˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ chi beu‸ yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ, teh‸ Saˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Saˍtanˍ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Yawˇbaˆ ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo shaˉ chuˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve mawˇ gʼawˆ baˬ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ ve a naˍ hta‸ gaˆ tuˬ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼeh‸ teˇ maˬ gʼawˆ shi taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkeu taˉ leh maˇ suh-e ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ pe‸ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tcuh laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hkʼanˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, Yawˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ da‸ ve tawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ yaw.

Yawˇ baˆ ve awˬ chawˇ 3 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Teˍmanˍ venˇ yaˇ Eˇliˇhpaˆ, Shuˇaˍ venˇ yaˇ Biˇlaˍdaˆ, leh Neˍmaˆ venˇ yaˇ Zawˇhpaˆ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ geh kʼai leh dawˇ sha hkawˇ ca yaw piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui vuiˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh hawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui je‸ meu-e hta‸ mvuhˇ hpe lo hkaˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ je‸ meu-e hkʼaˆ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw leh, suhˍ nyi suhˍ haˉ yawˇ geh teˇ geh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo jo mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ leh, Yawˇbaˆ tawˇ yaw leh yawˇ paw la ve awˬ nyi hta‸ hkeu ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ paw la ve awˬ nyi hta‸ hkeu piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tanˬ hu ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ ba piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo oˇ ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ gʼaw nyi-o.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ haˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Cawˇ shehˍ ma hta‸ gʼaˇ ve mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Peuˍ tawˆ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ ba tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la maˇ gʼa tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ tui‸ kuiˬ lo paw tawˆ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve oˇ ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw paw tawˆ la ve teˇ hkui suh-e ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ e ngaˬ hta‸ tehˉ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw taˆ taˍ laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˉ taw laˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ oˇ htaˇ ka‸ suh-e ve hkʼe kʼo, chi beu‸ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve jawˇmawˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, zuh‸ muiˉ gʼa kʼa chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hpu shi hkʼa biˇ ca keu taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, zuh‸ muiˉ gʼa kʼa chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Maˇ heˆ kʼo, paw la gehˇ sheˍ ve yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ, zuh‸ muiˆ gʼa kʼa chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw gʼaˇ jehˇ taˍ leh, kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Htawnˍ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, shu kʼoˆ shu deˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw leh awˬ meh maˇ bvuhˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ponˬ ve hpehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ ve le.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, suh tuˬ ve hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ suh-e puiˉ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ a‸ kehˉ tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui suh-e leh tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw maˇ lo‸-e sheˍ ve ceh ceh, maˇ ha lehˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ faˉ taˍ leh, teˇ hpawˇ le le lo hoˆ tiˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˍ caˇ tuˬ awˬ tan, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼanˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ teh taˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Ngaˬ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ geh gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ kuiˬ maˇ mawˬ. Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ kʼai.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ tawˇ yaw ve kʼo nawˬ hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ ta‸iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸-o.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ jaw peuˬ leh, gʼaˇ nuˇ ve la‸sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ ve, gʼaˇ nuˇ ve leh gʼaˇ heuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ huˉ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ awˬ to dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ gaˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ hanˉ leh dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpeh‸ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ hkʼa nyi.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve ti mi hta‸ mehˇ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ yawˇ sheˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ jaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ leh haiˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ gʼa gʼeu‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve ciˬ hta‸ dawˆ hkʼeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ yuˬ che‸ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui suh kʼai leh yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, ngaˬ geh tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ a yehˉ nuˇ lehˍ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼa shuˍ, tawˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gawˬ lehˍ ve mvuhˇ haw ehˉ ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼoˆ meuˆ la leh, kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh tu la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ huˉ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ve htawˇ, oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa. Oˇ htaˇ gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ kehˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ ve Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ. Yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ venˇbaˆ ca ve yoˬ.
Puˇ gʼuˇ hkʼe nyiˉ ceh‸ gʼa ve je‸ yuˬ te taˍ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ Yawˇ yonˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ shawˉ paˉ te‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ htaˇ chaw maˇ shiˍ tanˇ suh-e puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ taˉ leh yawˇ suh kʼai puiˉ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ naˍ, kuˬ hkʼa nyi. Nawˬ gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, hkawehˉ ve nyi ma htawˇ, venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpeh‸ sha chehˇ ve chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ jaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ hkui tiˉ hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ maˇ gʼa chehˇ. Shaˉnanˉ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh tawˇ maˇ yaw piˇ.

Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ kaˍ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve caˬ nu hta‸ ka‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Sheˉ lai puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw yeˬ tawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ. Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw yeˬ tawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ.
Aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw aˬ miˍ tzuh‸ tawˆ la ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, Gʼuiˬ ha hpawˇ hpfuhˆ leh ngaˬ ve kanˉ chi yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ peuˬ kuiˬ leh kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ leh, ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ kʼaweh‸ te caˇ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Sha gʼuˇ htaˇ htawˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw leh, shu fawˉ mehˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ dawˇ law tuˬ cawˬ la piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ gu piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma taˇ luˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ te taˍ ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hta‸, hpa kʼaw‸ yuˬ peh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ leh, Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh kʼaw‸ gu na-e laˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇnawˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la htaˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ haiˬve awˬ ceuˬ leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ mehˇ chehˇ ve ti mi lehˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, hai ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ca ya‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo zuhˇ hkʼa ma cawˬ kʼo, nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe ma cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼeu‸ jaw‸ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ caˬ shiˍ meh la chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ mawˇ jaˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh yuˬ leh henˇ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ ha‸ yuˬ loˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yaˍ cuˍ hkʼaw keu tsuh nyi ve kʼo,
laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ hawˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ anˇ piˇ lawˬ maˇ cawˇ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce bawˆ hpehˇ laˇ leh, hkaˆ ce hta‸ shehˆ taˍ ve awˬ taw‸ ma ngaˬ ve awˬ to hkʼaw pehˉ kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve kawˆ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ paˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Piˉlaˬ lehˬ mvuh‸ hta‸ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ leh, nuˇ htawˇ mvuh‸ goˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkui maˇ cawˬ leh aˉ leh‸ maˇ hkaw‸ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ caˇ gaˇ tuˬ le. Gʼaˆ u hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpuˉ-ehˍ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ hkui cawˬ le.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ hkʼe ve hta‸ caˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ caˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ chehˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ piˇ laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ha lehˬ leh pawˆ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ shanˬ jaw.

Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ geh aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ cawˬ sheˍ le. Ngaˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw kʼaw‸ caˉ leh gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to lehˬ, kuiˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ geh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ gʼaˇ va kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ maˇ chiˇ baˬ ka‸, chi hkʼe gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti yeˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ loˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve pa taw fiˍ kʼai ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vaˇ meu-e leh a ngeu hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haw la ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kuiˬ kʼai leh goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caw toˇ chehˇ leh, shehˇ de hkʼaw suh-e ve yoˬ.
Sheˍbaˆ leh Teˍmanˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa‸ ca ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ lehˬ, fiˍ kʼai peuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo suh-e ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hui lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, kʼaw‸ dehˬ hkʼaw‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh lawˬ ve laˇ.
Maˇ heˆ kʼo, canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ laˇ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh na taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, nyi ma hta‸ heuˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hkawˇ tiˉ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw dawˇ law tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpa hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yaˇ cuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to paw sha la tu, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw ponˬ yaw leuˉ jaˇ peuˬ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ yaw loˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ ca laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, cawˇ ve hpawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ heˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve leh maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ maˇ gʼa ve chaw yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ a sha‸ te‸ ve lehˬ, kanˉ hkeu‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ, kanˉ hkeu‸ ve muiˬ caˇ paˍ,
aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ leh, gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ hta‸ law chehˇ ve kanˉ te paˍ hta‸shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ ha pa peuˬ teˇ ha pa, ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ haˉ peuˬ teˇ haˉ ngaˬ aw hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ yanˇ maw jaˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ ngaˬ hpfuhˆ zuh‸ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo hawehˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, behˬ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa‸ pfuhˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ ponˬ kʼai gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ awˬ shaˉ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca nyi la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Moˬ teˇ diˬ mehˉ kʼai ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ suh-e leh teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la-o. Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh beu‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tawˇ gʼa yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hawˉ lo teh taˍ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ leh gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ coˇ caˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ naˬ ve hkehnˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta cuˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve zuh‸ maˆ teˇ hpaˍ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve awˬ to chi hkʼaw gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, nyiˉ pehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ leuˉ leh heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw yaˇ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon chi taw taw a yeˇ uiˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa‸ nyi chehˇ ve le.
Teˇ shawˉ le le nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh, teˇ mi‸ ni‸ le le yawˇ hta‸ lawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve ciˉ gʼuiˇ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ gʼa law‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼe ceh ka‸, nawˬ teˇ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ peu taˍ maˇ gʼa ve laˇ.

Htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ka‸ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pa caw jawˬ kuiˬ awˬ maiˉ hkʼe shawˍ laˇ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon hawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ hpeh‸ ve laˇ.

Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ hpehˇ laˇ maˇ gʼa-o ve laˇ. Maˇ maw maw kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ mvuhˇ haw hkawˇ yaw ve peuˬ-oˬ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yuˬ hpfuhˆ piˇ taˬ. Da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ Yawˇ maˇ te leh chehˇ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ ve hehˉ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh kanˇpaˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hteˇ cawˇ leh da‸ kehˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha laˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, chi beu‸ nawˬ shonˇ kʼai taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ca tehˆ da‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi beu‸ teˇ hkui awˬ yanˇ yuˬ leh, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa henˇ taˉ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ.
Ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ lehˬ, ngeh jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ shiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tcuh-o. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ kuiˬ lo, lo cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Nawnˉ pehˬ hkʼaw maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸.
Iˉ kaˆ fiˍ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ yehˇ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ka‸ nawˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw lehˬ lo cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, na goˬ na gaˉ pehˍ awˬ hkeh hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui na goˬna gaˉpehˍ awˬ hkeh hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve kʼo, awˬ hkeh oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ piˇ taˍ gʼa tuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ hui gʼo‸ hkeh caˆ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve kʼo, gʼo‸ hkeh caˆ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ huˉ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ cha chiˆ kuiˬ lo yeˬ la chehˇ ve mvuh‸ leh, hko hkʼa ti chi ti lo yeˬ la chehˇ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ geu lehˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yoˬ, oˇ ve lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ lo‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ ga piˇ.
Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼuiˬ tcuh laˇ leh kʼaw‸ kuˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yoˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ jaw taˍ peuˬve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˇ te da‸ leh hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ hiˉ hkawˇ na nyi laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ piˇ leh, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jiˆ kʼai piˇ leh nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬ hiˆ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ te puiˉ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ gʼa ba tuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ve to nuˇ to shaˆ lonˉ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ htaˇ htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpe lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍsaˆ, Hkaˍtiˇlaˆ, Hkiˇmaˆ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo ve meu‸ keu shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca shiˍ maˇ peuˬ taˬ. Yawˇ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ leh meuˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ nyi maˇ mawˬ.
Yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ na nyi maˇ haˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ Raˍhaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ lonˉ hta‸ ga piˇ ve Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ca gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ te hpeh‸ te gʼa ve kanˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ ve ceh yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe ceh te gʼa leh, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tcuh laˇ ve kʼo ka‸, Yawˇ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ yonˍ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ ve ka‸, Yawˇ mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ peu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ hkʼaw tuˬ te laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ shaˉ gʼawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬYawˇ maˇ te laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ tui‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hehnˇ chaweh gʼa te tuˬ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh gʼa te piˇ tuˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ shaˉ nanˉ lo gʼa shiˍ kʼai tuˬ laˇ. A shu yawˇ htaˬ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ gʼa le.

Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi-o. A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ peuˬ.
Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ka‸ yaˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw la‸ haˉ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha oˇ hkʼe maˇ te piˇ taˍ ve kʼo, a shu te piˇ taˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi ka‸ da‸ ve maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ geh jaˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼa shuˍ ponˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Pa taiˇ hta‸ tsuh‸ yuˬ tuˬ ya‸ la chehˇ ve aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼuiˬ suh-ehˍ te leh, ngaˬ naˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ coˇ caˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve tu‸ hkanˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ hpoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ gʼa coˇ caˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Sha pehˍ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ da‸ ve mawˇ geh teˇ geh miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ya‸ da‸ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ, shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nga nyi ma luˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve le. A ciˉ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ chi hkʼe hehnˇ chaweh te laˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ-aw laˇ. Nawˬ awˬ to te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ka‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ ve a sha‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hkʼa shuˍ ngeh jaˇ ve laˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh, ngaˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ponˬ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ la‸ sheh oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ je‸ yuˬ te taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ ceh‸ leh je‸ meu-e kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw uiˍ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ mu‸ ku leh awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ te taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shaˍ leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬleh, ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ piˇ laˇ leh, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve te yanˇ hta‸ tanˬ leh, nawˬ lehˬ baˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ, hkʼawˇ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ venˇbaˆ te maˇ te ve hta‸ jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ tanˬ te ve teˇ hkui, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa ya‸ da‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te ve htawˇ, chiˇ mvuh ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ leh, ya‸ taw ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te leh da‸ la uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ, hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ geh lo shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kanˉ hkʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ paw la piˇ taˍ ve le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ suh cawˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ e gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, teˇ pawˆ tiˉ hteˇ lehˍ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e ve lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ keuˆ la jaw ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ peuˬ la paˇ neˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Maˇ maw maw ngaˬ gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ la maˇ gaˬ ve naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ ve, leh sho‸ sha‸ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ htawˇ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve laˇ. Tawˇ yaw maˇ ve chaw lehˬ, cawˇ ve hpawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ hpeh‸ aw laˇ.

Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve laˇ. Nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ maˇ gʼa tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve teh‸ shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
