Cuˇ yiˍ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh shiˍ maˇ gaˬ ve naˉ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ keunˍ ve a‸ kehˉ yawnˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ ca mawˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon i jaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma oˇ ve nawˬ yuˬ maˇ mi kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ka‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ maˇ shiˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha uiˍ ve mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui te ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ lehˬ, meuˇ ve piˇ laˬ ehˉ hta‸ paw la piˇ gʼa htaˇ heh‸, kʼaˍ ve chaw hui cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca hkawˇ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ la-o.
Nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, ya‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nyi ma yeˬ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼaw miˬguiˬ yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tawˍ da‸-o‸.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la taˉ leh mehˉ kʼai ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ, sha gʼuˇ htaˇ ba chehˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi geuˆ a‸ kehˉ ba da‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ dawˇlaw tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hkʼaw, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, nawˬ hta gʼaˇ jehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ kawˆ jehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw maˇ maˇ nawˬ hta‸ loˍ leh nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve hkʼaw, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ chiˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve teˇ maˬ tiˉ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ leh suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Yoˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, cuˇ yiˍ htawˇ nawˬ geh teˇ geh suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ dawˇ shiˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ htawˇ dawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Paiˍ la paˇ neˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ chu-eˬ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hkʼawˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw hui, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh yawˇ hui ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe a sha‸ gʼa te‸ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ htawˇ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ha tehˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ caˇ leh awˬ hkui cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve naˍ paw htawˇ tawˇ yaw hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma leh, kanˉ te tuˬ ve kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hpaˆ baˬ taˍ ve hta‸ a shu kʼaw‸ te gʼa le. Gʼuiˬsha htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu taˍ ve chaw hta‸ a shu hpehˇ tawˆ piˇ gʼa le.
Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ goˇ choˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ hpehˇ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ taˆ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍjaˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shu heˍ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw leh, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬYawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe te piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ yuˬ ce piˇ leh, htawnˍ yaˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ yuˬ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ leh, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa shuˍ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, Yawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve hkʼaw caw toˇ tcuh leh mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo ca htaˇ shoˆ toˇ leh, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼe te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ jaw taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ ka‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hkʼe taw maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yoˬ. Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heˍ hkawˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shu hta‸ gu na-e maˇ gʼa ve saˍla‸ gʼonˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ taˇ kʼoˆ loˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ chi hkʼe heˍ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ Yawˇ hpawˇ chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn nawˬshaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai leh tawˇ ca gʼaw‸ da‸ tuˬ laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ hehˉ laˇ. Nawˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ heˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ heˍ gʼa tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ faˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ yehˇ ve tawˇ pa haˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ je‸ hkʼa shuˍ paˆ hpoˆ peuˬ.
Ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tuˬ awˬ yanˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ka‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ law tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ le. Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn Yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ haˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh suh-e tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyiˇ ceuˬ lawˬ na gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ca va‸ toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ tuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ nyiˉ ceh‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ tawˇ awˉ lawˉ yaw-o. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tcuh laˇ leh, nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ hpaˍ le. Ngaˬ aˬ hto ma te ya‸ taˍ ve cawˬ le. Venˇbaˆ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve le.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ laˇ ve le.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ suhˆ hpa‸ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve chi gʼawˇ teˇ kʼa‸ hta‸ ca ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkoˆ lo hehnˇ jaˇ ve a muˆ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hkui sheh hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ juˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ peuˬ teˇ piˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ nyi taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve hkui ha hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ chaˬ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw, hpuiˇ kʼai ve suhˆ leh, pfuhˇ caˇ ve aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa ve hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ve ka‸ a sha‸ ngeh leh dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, haˆ yeˬ la leh haˆ nawˍ kʼai ve suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼe ngaˬ hui mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi laˇ tuˬve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Chaw yaˇ hkʼe maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaw, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ tawˆ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ hkʼaˬ maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hkʼa nyiˇ ha pa gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ teˇ naˬ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Teˇ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ peu leh, yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ te gʼa ve hkʼe, hkeu‸ ve haˍ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Htu baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ lehˬ, dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ la leh awˬ caˍ caˍ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ leh, suhˆ muiˉ daw oˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw suh kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ,
iˉ kaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, suhˆmuiˉ daw oˇ ve awˬ cehˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ caˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ suh-e ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh-e ve kʼo, yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬve le.
Maˇ kʼaw‸ ya‸-e ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ leh, fiˍ kʼai peuˬ ve gʼuiˬ po hkʼa shuˍ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e leh teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tu la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ nawˇ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ te tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ fuiˍ teh taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ la hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ law taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ kuˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve ngaˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ te toˇ ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ peuˬ teˇ piˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬvenˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ baˬ leh yuˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ te ya‸ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˆ mehˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ paˆ ce tuˬ ve leh, haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ jiˆ tawˆ-e tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ lehˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ luˉ chiˇ veu leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ htawˇ miˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ lehˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ chaw yaˇ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ tawˆ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ nyi maˇ sha leh suh-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ awˬ to naˬ kuiˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ jawˬ leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ jawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hkʼe maˇ kʼoˆ taˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ maˇ yaw taˬ.
Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh na ve ka‸, nawˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ faˉ taˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ven baˆ taˍ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te hpanˍ htaˇ nawˬ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve laˇ. Chaw yaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ tiˉ caˉ da‸ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ shiˍ leh ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ pa maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve uˉ hpu paˇ hpu ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh cuˇ yiˍ henˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ awˬ tan tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ nyi ma maˇ sha leh, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ hkawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ teh awˬ na da‸ kehˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ te hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ yonˍ. Yawˇ hui ka‸ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo da‸ kehˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh dawˬ keu ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ leh te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ shiˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍlehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa henˇ taˍ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ faˉ taˍ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu mvuhˇmiˬ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve naˍ paw hkʼaw kuˬ keu piˇ leh, yawˇ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼawˇ dawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo aˉhtaw law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ la‸ tsuhˆ pui te maˍ piˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, nyi ma uiˍ leh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, shu baˬ taˉ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ma‸ hpeh‸ la leh venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, maw maw gʼa paw sha chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ geh te‸ chiˉ mawˇ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ tawˆ-e gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ leh awˬ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ piˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve kʼo, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ yawˇ gʼa tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ suhˆ kʼaˉ hkʼe nawˍ kʼai leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nawˉ lehˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ maˇ meh sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ce ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, awˬ veˆ piˬ ce kʼai ve shaˍlonˍ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ leh te taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ gu leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ heˍ caˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ jaw taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ piˇ laˇ ve dawˇ sha hkawˇ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe tiˉ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ leh meu maˇ cawˬ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ ve chehˇ kui hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ka‸ nawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ htawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hiˆ maˍ laˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve hkʼe ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ gʼa leh, nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma sha hkawˇ yaw laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ ngaˬ ve a naˍ hta‸ na-e la piˇ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heu‸ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ leh awˬ mu‸ ku ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi ve hta‸ nyi taˍ leh ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yo, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ ve awˬ tcuhˉ teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ kʼehˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve hkʼaw nyi tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ paˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hta hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh nyiˉ ceh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pa caw nyi kuiˬ hkʼe shawˍ leh,
ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce bawˆ tcuhˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaˆ ce oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ laˇ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ beu‸ gʼuˇ chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ shonˇ kʼai leh choˬ kaˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hpo‸ la leh, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ htawˇ, kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ faˉ taˍ-o‸. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ chi taˇ gawˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hpawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ mehˆ gʼuiˬ tawˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ awˬ pon lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ kʼai chehˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la maˇ hpeh‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ toˇ kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ leh kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ neˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ shaˉ hkʼa deh‸ gʼawˬ maˇ gʼa-o. Ngaˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ taˉ-o. Tuˍ hpfuh ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yaw ve tawˇ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ hoˆ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Chaw mawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ hpu hta‸ pa taw yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tehˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui laˬ leh ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ laˬ hkʼe mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han lehˬ, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ shu yawˆ yan keunˍ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh huˉ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬnaˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ gʼa zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ ngaˬ pa teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve hawehˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ e leh ngaˬ nyi ma teˇ hpaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ hkʼaˬ lo cawˬ le. A shu mawˬ le.
Ngaˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ maˇ gʼa ve laˇ. Nawˬ jehˇ taˍ leh na chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nuˇ hkʼe kʼaˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ dawˇ ve le.

Nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ naˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh la piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jiˆ tawˆ-e piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ shiˉ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼa kʼaw‸ to‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw cawˬ ve kawˆ faiˇ naˆ ho‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkui sheh naˆ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve pa taw, yawˇ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ pehˍ hkʼaw naˆ keu ve pa taw, pehˍ hkʼaw yaw sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ yaw tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo va teˇ maˬ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo va teˇ maˬ htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ law chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ gʼa meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ paˇ lo law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve a naˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ kuiˇ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼawˬ tawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, suh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼa ca hpuˇ da‸-e ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ma‸ shiˉ awˬ gʼuiˬ te tsuhˇ baˬ leh, lo‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ geu leh awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ meh maˇ kʼaw‸ bvuhˬ-o. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi ve chaw hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh yaw leh dawˇ haˍ tcuh laˇ ve le.
Nawˬ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ leh, maˇ ya‸ taw ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve ka‸, kanˉ oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe heuˆ la kuiˬ cawˬ le.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬchi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te taˍ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ va htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ na laˇ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ na laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tawˍ tsuhˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hpanˍ kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo faˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ loˍ jaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ leh nawˍ kʼai suh kʼai tuˬ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tcuh tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ leh, ngaˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hta‸ ca hoˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ da‸ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ-o.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkehˉ chaw leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw hkʼe shawˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tu ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kuˬ piˇ htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ laˬ.
Ngaˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, ngaˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ pe‸ nuˬ ve hta‸ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ paˇ lo maˇ laˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ gʼuiˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ cha‸ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ
Ngaˬ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ dawˆ paiˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇnawˇ leh li‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.
Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ co co yeˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, tcuhˇ yuˬ leh haˉ pui hkʼoˆ htawˆ keu taˍ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ to chi ve hkʼaw te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ maˇ mawˬ jaw ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ peuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te dawˇ haˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ aˉhtaw hta‸ kawˆ chehˇ-oˆ. Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, aˉhtaw oˇ ve lehˬ venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu hta‸ naˬ piˇ lawˬ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tanˬ chehˇ tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ,
haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, maw maw maˇ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ uiˍ la mvuh la leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ moˬ hta‸ daw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ,
je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ hkʼa shuˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ-o.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo mehˉ kʼai leh,
yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ hui geh hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ to lehˬ, yaˇ nehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw je‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon awˬ hkui cawˬ jaˇ leh, kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw keu leh behˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw awˬ taw‸ ma hkʼa shuˍ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpe‸ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hehˆ dawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ taw‸ ma hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, vuiˬ htawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍlonˍ chu iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe ya‸ la chehˇ ve leh, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ leh pehˇ gʼuiˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe ya‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ te taˉ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa yehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, shu te taˍ ve yehˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ lawˇ hpa‸ uiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh puiˉ.
Yawˇ caˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ paw sha ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Yawˇ paw sha jaˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe caˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ leh sho te taˍ ve aˉhtaw hawˉ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kuiˇ te taˍ ve hkaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ bawˆ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ teˇ jaˆ peuˬ teˇ jaˆ ce la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve nyi ma kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ chaw yaˇ tuˉ keu ve aˬ miˍ maˇ heˆ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ, chaw chi hpaˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Chi lehˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh lawˬ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼo gaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ loˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to nawˬ hui hta‸ anˇ jaˇ, kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ htawˇ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te‸ chehˇ tcuh leh paw sha piˇ lawˬ ve le.
Yawˇ hui geh awˬ yaˇ leh awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui uiˍ la chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ gaˬ la piˇ leh yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˬ, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ yehˇ paw la chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ leh,
tinˍ hteˆ hkawˇ, lehˉ lu meuˆ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˍ taˍ leh, kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw suh-e ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ tu‸ hkanˍ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ teh taˍ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Yawˇ geh bon lawˬ ve ka‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ piˇ taˍ tuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ gʼa hpuˇ jaw laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ jaw laˇ.
Chi gʼawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˆ baˬ piˇ jaw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, je‸ meu-e hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ jaw laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Te ya‸ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ la piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a sha‸ leh kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi-aw laˇ.
Mvuh kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a shu maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ ve le.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui suh-e ve awˬ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ sha cawˬ sha puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa te suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to ka‸ chu pe‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh suh-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ hkʼa shuˍ suh-e leh, shu duˇ tuˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hawehˆ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yehˬ chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo le teh‸ nawˬ hui na nyi gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui na‸ uˉ maˇ te da‸ jaw laˇ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, gʼa ponˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
Hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh lo yawˇ hta‸ taˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ,
chaw awˬ hinˉ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa ga shiˍ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, je‸ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ a yehˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw leh ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha hkawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ heˍ hkawˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yehˇ hpeh‸ ve cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ.
Nawˬ te taˍ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon awˬ bon hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ le. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ga piˇ chehˇ ve le.
Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˇ nyi laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka kehn leh huˉ chehˇ ve pa taw maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ te maˇjaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ geh cha taˍ ve jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ teˇ hkʼoˆ ka‸ maˇ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ heuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ iˉ kaˆ maˇ taw piˇ. Awˍ meu‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ka‸ awˍ maˇ caˍ piˇ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh nawˬ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te leh hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ awˬ paˇ lo miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, nawˬ geh kawˆ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˆ ho‸ jaˇ la leh nawˬ nyi maˇ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuh jaˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuh kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ya‸ peu laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Hkʼe ka‸ nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha aˬ hto‸ ma shiˍ le. Yawˇ hta‸ moˬ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ tcuhˉ kaˍ lo Yawˇ te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, moˬ htu jaˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇ nyi maˇ mawˬ taˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui te toˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ te toˇ tuˬ, nawˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve laˇ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ luˉ chiˇ veu ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ paw sha la piˇ taˍ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na maˇ gʼa.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍve teˇ yanˇ, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ te-o. Yawˇ hta‸ canˇ paˍ hkʼe taˇ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸.
Yoˬ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve hkʼaw nawˬ Yawˇ geh gʼa kʼaw‸ la leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼa te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve shi hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸. Da‸ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai peuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw duˇ tuˍ taˍ-o‸.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve shi hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon hpoˆ taˍ ve hpu hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la leh, nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ yuˬ ce piˇ leh, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, da‸ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼanˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ hkʼanˇ leh chehˇ maˇ hpehˬ.
Yawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn Yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ te laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ. Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Yawˇ na taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, hteˇ cawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ Yawˇ geh jehˬ da‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ tiˉ Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ngaˬ gʼa‸ ca nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha maˇ chehˇ. Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ ca nyi ve ka‸, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ toˇ kʼai ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ le le hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ ka‸ la‸ sha paˉ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo maˇ suhˉ kʼai jaw.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ te kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ te.
Yawˇ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ peˍ maˇ pa puiˉ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ te gaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˉ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Yawˇ geh lo cawˬ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hta‸ maˇ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve le.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ miˬguiˬ gʼa maˇ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˬ tcuh hta‸ hkʼawˇ jiˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve yawˬ moˍ geh teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ ve piˉ laˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, jeˬ shaiˍ laˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ mehˇchawˇma ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ hui tawˍ taˍ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ca va‸ taˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, haˍ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼa shuˍ, goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ ca toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon teˇ kaˬ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ ca maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu ve ti mi hkʼaw caˬ gʼa ca gʼeu‸ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ gʼa ca shaˉ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ yawˇ hui zuh‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, te‸ chiˉ yuˬ kaw tuˬ aˉ boˆ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui kaˆ ve hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo laˬ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ pa taw nehˆ kʼai leh, haˉ hpawˇ paˇ lo kʼuˉ da‸ mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ pa maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh leh jeˬ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve haˍ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ leh gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˍ meu‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ caˬ gʼa ca gʼeu‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh a peuˇ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa nyiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ to lehˬ meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo naˬve chaw leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a muˆ maˇ taˍ piˇ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ na maˇ gʼa. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ gʼeuˆ sheh kʼai piˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui maˇ kʼai.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ tu la leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ shu ve mawˇ hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la ve hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu ve yehˬ hkʼaw ca lo‸ hkʼawˇ leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ kawˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ iˉ kaˆ luˉ chiˇ veu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw kanˉ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ te-o.
Haw la ve teˇ yanˇ vaˇ meu-e mehˉ kʼai ve hkʼe, venˇbaˆ yaˇ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ e ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ-o. Yawˇ lehˬ hawehˆ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, paiˍ taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, yawˇ mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ leh, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kanˉ te leh haiˬ ve chaw suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ paw sha la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuh‸ leh gʼeu‸ baˬ taˍ ve caˬ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ yaw ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ maˇcawˇ, teh‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ka kehn leh gʼa huˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu gʼaw gʼa le. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba maˇ gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ cawˬ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ cawˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo da‸ kehˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Ha pa ka‸ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ ba. Meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ maˇ da‸ kehˬ.
Hkʼe kʼo, hawehˆ leh pfuhˇ shehˍ ma hpeh‸ ve chaw yaˇ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ chaw yaˇ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hpfuhˇ cawˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ hkʼe ve haˍ gʼawˇ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma ga laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ hkʼe ve chaw luˬ paˍ teˇgʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ leh da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve le. Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ yaw tcuh laˇ ve le.
Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ hoˆ beh taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo ve mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ poˬ hpe poˬ la‸ kaˍ lo kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve maˇ gʼa pe‸ ce kʼai tuˬ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, tawˬ la chehˇ ve ha pa hta‸ moˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo yuˬ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkʼaˇ tawˍ piˇ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ leh naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ deˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ Yawˇ beˆ gʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh cawˇ shehˍ ma Raˍhaˆ hta‸ peuˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve vuiˬ lonˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ heˆ ehˉ ceh hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ tsuhˆ-ehˆ hkawˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ shiˍ hpeh‸ le.
Ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ maˇ jehˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ tui‸ piˇ lawˬ ve, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ shaˉ gʼawˬ tuˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh,
ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve ha tehˍ htawˇ heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ceh kʼoˆ tcuh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, haiˬ ve chaw leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ sheˍ le.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Yawˇ geh bon lawˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼa ma uiˍ jaˇ ve leh, Yawˇ gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ shaˍ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui yaw ve le.
Chi ve lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yaˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ caˇ law‸ dawˬ law‸ maˇ cawˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ sheˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e leh, yawˇ hui ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, yawˇ hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ leh, loˍ ve a‸ kehˉ ka‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa veu‸ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ a goˬ a gaˉ pehˍ hpui leh, ti mi hkʼaw cawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼe te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ yawˇ hui paw sha jaˇ leh gʼa zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ nawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ ve hkʼe, kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, mvuhˇ haw yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˆ chiˇ veu tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˆ chiˇ veu leh yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ haw oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ haw yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˆ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hpu duˇ kuiˬ hpu kʼoˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Shi hta‸ lawˍ kuiˬ htawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼaw sho hta‸ duˇ tawˆ leh, haˉ pui hkʼaw lo kuiˇ hta‸ lawˍ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca hpfuhˆ nyi leh haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ duˇ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ leh, chaw yaˇ hkui sheh maˇ naˆ jaw kuiˬ lo hpu hta‸ ca duˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh kanˉ te ve yoˬ.
Caˇ tuˬ tawˆ la kuiˬ miˬguiˬ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hta‸ pa taw kʼaw‸ htaiˍ kʼaw‸ pa la leh,
haˉ pui hkʼaw lo naw hpui ve haˉ pui shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Je‸ meu-e hkʼaw lo htawˇ shi tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Miˬ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ aˉ ceˬ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ teˇ hkeh ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ poˬ kʼai jaw.
Ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh awˬ nu haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ te toˇ jaw.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ heh jaˇ ve haˉ hpawˇ hta‸ duˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo tanˬ duˇ leh, hkʼaw hta‸ duˇ paˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw duˇ lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shehnˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ duˇ lo‸-e leh, faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba kuiˬ lo yuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo ca mawˬ hpeh‸ ve le. Ngaˬ hui shiˍ puiˉ la tuˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca henˇ tuˬ ve le.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ geh gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Cuˇ yiˍ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ hpu shi yuˬ leh vuiˬ maˇ gʼa.
Da‸ jaˇ ve shi leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ hkʼe taw awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ hkʼaˆ.
Cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ shi a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ leh, shi kawˆ leh da‸ jaˇ ve mehˆ gʼeuˆ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ leh shehnˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve shiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve shi lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca tehˆ da‸ maˇ gʼa.
Hkʼe kʼo, cuˇ yiˍ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hkʼaˬ lo le. Ngaˬ hui shiˍ puiˉ la tuˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca henˇ tuˬ ve le.
Te‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Poˬ toˇ ve ngaˆ htawˇ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, cuˇ yiˍ awˬ lawn a ciˉ ciˉ ceh gʼa kaˇ jawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ shiˍ leh, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ca tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hui cawˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ ve teˇ yanˇ,
mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ piˇ tuˬ, leh moˬ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˬ ve hta‸ gʼa te toˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca mawˬ leh, cuˇ yiˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hta‸ Yawˇ lawˇ nyi canˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chaw yaˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shiˍ puiˉ la tuˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo a sha‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.
Oˇ htaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ paw sha chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ paˇ lo yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa biˇ caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nuˇ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ cuˉ gʼuiˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ leh, haˉ pui cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ti taˍ ve ngaˬ ve shaˍlonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo jiˆ kʼo‸-e leh, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw tu huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ maˇ yaw leh, a shu yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw kuˬ hawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼaˇ va kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ ve mehˆ shiˍ hpeh‸ leh, hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ ve hkui sheh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui ve awˬ pa hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ maw maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ leh, aˉ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ ciˍ gʼuiˬ nehˆ chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yawnˇ kʼai.
Ngaˬ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ htehˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yonˍ ve awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˬ suhˍ lehˍ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ puiˉ ve ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ hoˉ te leh, kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nyi ma luˬ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ a sha‸ i ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˇ hui gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˉ tcuh piˇ leh aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.
Yawˇ hui haˍ gʼawˇ leh meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve suhˆ geu hta‸ geu‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve suhˆ paw ehˉ hta‸ gʼawˬ caˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ hkui maˇ cawˬ ve suhˆ geu hta‸ ka‸ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ heuˉ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ heuˉ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼe kuˬ toˇ chehˇ leh, suhˆ buiˇ hawˉ lo kʼuˉ da‸ zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon gʼuiˬ yawˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ cha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw ka‸ ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ moˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˇ toˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tsuhˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ coˇ caˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ taˆ lo‸ la leh, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ce la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hkʼe mehˉ kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, moˬ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hkehnˇ la kuiˬ maˇ mawˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ che‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ teˆ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ kʼai.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve aˉ po‸ kawˍ laˍ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ leh tzuh‸ suhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ je‸ nehˆ hkʼaw ca‸ tuˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ je‸ meu-e a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ. Ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ maˇ na yuˬ laˇ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu piˇ lawˬ leh, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon gu taˍ ve suh kuiˬ lo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ te maˇ puiˉ leh ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh lawˬ hkawˉ puiˉ ve luˬ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ca ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve le.
Dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hawˬ chehˇ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ leh awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh naˆ ho‸ ve gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ gʼa te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ leh, shu ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, heh hpuiˇ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ kuˬ hkawˇ hkʼe, dawˇ haˍ law‸ law‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ naˆ-ehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ. A naˍ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve awˬ to haw chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ ha lehˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw kuiˬ lo, chi beu‸ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh hawˬ ve aw hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ haˉ hta‸ peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve nyi ma hkʼaw ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ nyi tuˬ, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve le. Chaw yaˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve le.
Te ya‸ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ Yawˇ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ toˇ kʼai ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ le le ve hta‸ Yawˇ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te jaw. Shu hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ heˍ caˇ jaw, teh‸ ngaˬ hkanˍ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ hkʼaw keu tsuh nyi piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gaˇ ve, leh ngaˬve la‸ sheh hta‸ venˇbaˆ ngawˉ taˍ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ ti taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu caˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve shu miˇ ma hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ leh, yawˇ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo law taˍ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ miˇ ma lehˬ shu miˇ ma hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Chi hkʼe haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ ve moˬ naˆ ho‸ aˬ miˍ leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ca hkʼanˇ maˍ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te piˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ jaw kʼai jaw. Mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, dawˇ haˍ dawˇ tuiˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ maˇ chehˇ tcuh jaw.
Ngaˬ caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ meu‸ maˇ kaˆ jehˇ tcuh jaw.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ vuiˬ veu‸ tuˬ hpu maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˬ mvuh te taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ yuˬ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ mvuh oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉnanˉ hkʼaw gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ leh, yaˇ cu shi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa heˍ caˇ taˉ peuˬ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh lehˬ tawˆ cheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te.
Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ maˇ va jaw.
Ngaˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve ka‸ maˇ te.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ ba jaˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi sha jaˇ ve ha pa hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˆ yan piˇ tuˬ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ te jaw. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ boˆ nu jaw.
Chi hkʼe ve venˇbaˆ te ve chaw lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hui luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui suh-e tuˬ ve awˬ pon ngaˬ bon maˇ lawˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ,venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ shiˍ da‸ jaw ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬhtaˆ ka‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸, ngaˬ geh kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo maˇ haˉ tcuh jaw.
Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ faˉ taˍ jaw.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ hui deˇ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo aˉ hkʼaw lo ceh ti hkʼawˆ chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te jaw.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ na ve laˇ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ geh tawˇ ca gʼawˬ da‸ la ve chaw hui yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo,
oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo veu‸ deh taˍ leh, shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼe ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ leh, Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ mvuh chaweh chiˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ te caˇ chehˇ ve ti mi lehˬ, shu geh hkʼaw‸ yuˬ taˍ ve ti mi hpeh‸ leh
oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ caˇ leh, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ meu‸ jehˇ tcuh taˍ ve kʼo,
caˬ shiˍ leh cho‸ shiˍ awˬ tan mvuh‸ leh aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ yeˬ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ. (Yawˇbaˆ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.)
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ 3 gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍve Eˇliˇhuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. (Eˇliˇhuˆ lehˬ, Raˉma‸ chaw, Buˇzaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Baˍraˍkeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ lehˬ, Yawˇbaˆ ve awˬ chawˇ oˇ ve 3 gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ ca maˇ gʼa. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Eˇliˇhuˆ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ a sha‸ i ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le tawˇ yaw peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve 3 gʼaˇ Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ tawˇ tanˬ yaw ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ tawˇ yaw cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ hto maˍ da‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ geh laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ piˇ chehˇ ve leh, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ mawˇ la peuˬ ve pa taw, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la ve maˇ heˆ. A sha‸ mawˇ la ve pa taw, da‸ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la gʼa ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ na yuˬ tcuh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ shaˍ.
Nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ leh, nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ca chehˇ htaˇ ngaˬ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ na chehˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui shonˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ kʼo ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca mawˬ taˍ peu, teh‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le. Nawˬ hui shonˇ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, yawˇ hui tawˇ maˇ cawˬ-o. Nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ maˇ gʼa-o.
Yawˇ hui ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, ngaˬ ka‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa law chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, choˬ kaˬ lo hkʼe leˇ huˉ jo taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ cawˇ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸-o. Tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa-o.
Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gʼa ve hkʼe kʼo, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ suhˉ hkʼa biˇ keu taˍ ve shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼe ngaˬ pe‸ hkoˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw leh chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Tawˇ gʼa yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve chi hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ teˇ hpawˇ ka‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Shu hta‸ hkʼa hkʼe maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ la‸ haˉ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw cawˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yaw tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ na sha leh, ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ je‸ hkʼaw tiˉ hpeh‸ tawˆ la taˍ ve yoˬ
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te ya‸. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ laiˉ ceuˬ ca leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hkui sheh hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ le le ve hta‸ nyi taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Naw kʼoˆ ve maˇ cawˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve pa taw, aˬhto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nyi ma maˇ gʼa uiˍ la tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh kuiˬ hkʼaw Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ naˬ ve gawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, chaw yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ gu piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ htawˇ chehˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ ve chaw lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ gaˇ puiˉ. Da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ htawˇ yawˇ awˬ pon cha‸ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ cawˉ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hkʼaw ve teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca ga la leh, yawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ ca piˇ la tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ.
Ha kʼaˉ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ gʼa kʼai. Yawˇ awˬ tan kʼai tuˬ ve choˬ kaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ to lehˬ, yaˇ nehˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ maˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ kʼai tcuh laˇ. Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, tawˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kaˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh la‸ lehnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve mehˬ maˇ mehˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tawˇ yaw hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ.
Chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui gʼa dawˇ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ piˇ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ chaw heˍ paˍ teh‸ shawˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce bawˆ tcuhˉ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇbaˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui mawˬ jaw laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan hkawˇ maˇ yaw.
Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te gaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui geh te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ te ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ laˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ ve hkʼe te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve maˇ te piˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ geh gʼa taˍ ve laˇ. Miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ teh piˇ taˍ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ te‸ ve a sha‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve kʼo,
te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e leh, je‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸venˇbaˆ taˍ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh hai ˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Haˍ gʼawˇ yaˇ a‸ kehˉ paw sha ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ la‸ haˉ suh-e puiˉ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ dawˆ paiˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ maˇ yuˬ tawˆ ve htawˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ te toˇ ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ le le hta‸ gʼa‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ faˉ taˍ piˇ gʼa ve naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ leuˆ keu piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, kʼai leh ca chaˬ nyi tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼa te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, Yawˇ venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ kʼai leh, Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ tuˬ nyiˉ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te piˇ leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ Yawˇ faˉ taˍ ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ te gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ laˇ.
Nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ peuˬ laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha te ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ tawˍ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ law hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ gʼa dawˇ cheˆ tuˬ ve kanˉ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ gʼa dawˇ cheˆ tuˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le,
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi ve hkʼaw tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw haiˬ hkʼa shuˍ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ.

Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe heuˆ la kuiˍ cawˬ le. Venˇbaˆ maˇ te leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ chiˇ nyi sheˍ. Moˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma mvuh jaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ venˇbaˆ te ve htawˇ, venˇbaˆ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ heuˆ kuiˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ laiˉ pawˆ te ya‸ ve htawˇ, ya‸ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe heuˆ kuiˬ cawˬ le.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, nawˬ hkʼe ve chaw ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Nawˬ te ve da‸ ve kanˉ htawˇ yawˇ hui awˬ pon ceh tiˉ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼanˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ leh haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
