Yawˇ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ mawˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kaˇ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ mawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ law taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ ve kanˉ chi Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ taˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ a muˆ maˇ taˍ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ yaw ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ tan te leh, ngaˬ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh kʼaw‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, kʼehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shiˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hto maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Yawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ te piˇ ve yo‸.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa shuˍ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ co co awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ leh yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ma nyi ma uiˍ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, paw sha leh gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ma gʼa zuhˆ chehˇ leh, ciˬ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ga laˇ tuˬ bon lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve a sha‸ te‸ hkʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ leh, a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ laˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw ha lehˬ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hpui lawˇ hkʼoˆ lo caˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heˍ caˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ nawˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˇ gʼa sheh ya‸ laˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpa hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ taˇ dawˇ law chehˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve hpawˇ lo maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, tu‸ hkanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve saˍ la‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ lawn Yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇmvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ leh nyi taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa biˇ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca shawˍ nyi maˇ gʼa.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon moˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Moˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te jiˆ kʼai ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ tawˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, naˉ jaˇ ve laˆ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Yawˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te caˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Yawˇ heuˆ tcuh gaˇ ve awˬ ti hta‸ ca heuˆ-e tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ tawˍ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ la chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ leh, ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ diˆ vaiˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw tawˆ la ve mvuhˇ tawˍ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˬ lo te leh oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇ ve mvuhˇ tawˍ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve anˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, vaˇ meu-e hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la tuˬ tawˇ piˇ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui ve kanˉ hta‸ jehˇ taˍ piˇ lawˬ leh, Yawˇ kanˉ te chehˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw lonˉ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo meuˆ taˆ la leh, kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ shaˉ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hta‸ awˬ di‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, a ngeu kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba tawˆ la leh,
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Yawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, teˇ hkui jehˇ leh na taˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ leh moˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ba tawˆ la ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te jiˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ.
Nawˬ maˇ shiˍ taˬ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw meuˆ taˆ la leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yuˬ hpe tuˬ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ga piˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma oˇ ve hta‸ sho hkʼa shuˍ heh la piˇ tuˬ nawˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha geh tawˇ yaw da‸ tuˬ ngaˬ maˇ lawˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa piˇ tuˬ le.
Chi beu‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba da‸ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui chiˇ nyi maˇ hpeh‸. Mvuhˇ haw lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ kehˬ lehˍ shiˆ baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ lo shi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ka kehn piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui Yawˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo kʼai maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ chaw yaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ anˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ka kehn chehˇ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ shawˍ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, ngaˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ na nyi chehˇ ve nawˬ lehˬ, a shu hpeh‸ ve le.
Chi beu‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼe tu huˉ taˍ leh, ngaˬ na nyi laˇ ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍve laˇ. Nawˬ shiˍ jaˇ ve kʼo, awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hui cawˬ cawˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ cheˆ shehˍ hpaˇ a shu le. Tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ a shu gʼawˬ hteˇ taˍ ve le. Chi hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ taˍ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma yuˬ ti piˇ taˍ ve le. Miˬguiˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉpuiˍ hta‸ a shu teh taˍ ve le.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ geh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, mvuhˇ naw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw pe‸ tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hoˆ piˇ taˍ ve le.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ moˬ yuˬ beh piˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo htiˆ keu piˇ taˍ ve lehˬ ngaˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ piˇ leh, hoˆ taˍ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi fui gaˬ la kʼo pehˇ-o. Chi ve awˬ nu nawˬ maˇ gʼa kʼai. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo ceh gʼa jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ tawˆ la tuˬ tawˇ piˇ jaw laˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fui baˬ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ jaw laˇ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw ve awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ, hkʼaw pui leh lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ kʼeh kʼeh cawˬ la piˇ leh, je‸ hkʼoˆ lo cuˍ dawˆ keu taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ haiˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mehˆ hkehˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ tawˆ la chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ gaˬ jaw laˇ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ kʼai jaw laˇ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shaw kuiˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ maˍ laˇ jaw laˇ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼaˬ hui cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ. Nawˬ shiˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼaˬ lo tawˆ la ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ fui gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ gʼa-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh gʼa-aw laˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, mawˇ la peuˬ leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ htaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na oˇ hkʼe te gʼa tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ.
Vaˇ meu-e leh vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ kuiˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ lo, nawˬ ca guiˇ gaˬ jaw laˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tanˬ tawˆ la kuiˬ lo nawˬ gaˬ jaw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw tanˬ meuˆ tawˆ la kuiˬ lo nawˬ gaˬ jaw laˇ.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ aw pon a shu gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ shawˍ piˇ taˍ ve le. Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ awˬ pon a shu ya‸ kʼaw gu piˇ taˍ ve le.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve le.
Mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ tawˆ la gʼa tuˬ, goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ a shu iˉ kaˆ pfuhˍ piˇ taˍ ve le.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ leh ciˍ gʼuiˬ lehˬ, awˬ pa cawˬ-aw laˇ.
A ngeu diˬve awˬ e a shu le.
A ngeu lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ awˬ diˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, Hkiˇmaˆ meu‸ keu shiˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpeh tiˍ taˍ gʼa-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Kaˍtiˆlaˆ meu‸ keu shiˍ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve aˉ hkeh hta‸ nawˬ hpui baˬ gʼa-aw laˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, teˇ yanˇ peuˬ teˇ yanˇ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ piˇ gʼa-aw laˇ. Aˍsaˆ meu‸ keu shiˍ lonˉ leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ gʼa-aw laˇ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ.
Nawˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ yeˬ nehˆ la piˇ tuˬ, moˬ hta‸ nawˬ tawˇ piˇ gʼa-aw laˇ.
Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hta‸ nawˬ tawˇ piˇ leh awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nawˬ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ te tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ laˇ.

Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ uiˍ taˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve iˉ biˆ ngaˆ ehˉ hta‸ koˆ piˇ taˍ ve le. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˆ hpfuh kʼaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve le.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ moˬ hta‸ gʼaw gʼa leh, je‸ meu-e hta‸ awˬ diˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ,
moˬ hta‸ teˇ paˉ suhˉ tcuh leh mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ gʼa le.
Nawˬ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ leh, meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ leh,
haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw va‸ chehˇ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ leh poˬ caw chehˇ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ ve le. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ ve le.
Haˇ tawˉ pehˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ paw la ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ. Hkuiˉ zuhˬ ma peuˍ awˬ yehˇ paw la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ jaw laˇ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw awˬ yehˇ gʼa hu chehˇ leh hkʼaˬ htaˆ awˬ yehˇ paw la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ.
Yawˇ hui paˍ zuh‸ leh hkʼaˬ htaˆ teˇ yanˇ awˬ yehˇ ehˉ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo paw tawˆ la piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shi-aw laˇ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai leh maˇ kʼaw‸ la-o.
Piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe leˇ hpehˇ taˍ ve le. A shu yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh ca kʼaˆ caˇ toˇ piˇ lawˬ ve le.
Ngaˬ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw hta‸ yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ hta‸ vuiˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Kanˉ ka‸ tcuh caˇ maˇ gʼa.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, nawˉ-ehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh nuˇ hta‸ nawˬ kanˉ tcuh caˇ gʼa tuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw chehˇ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ heh nuˇ teˇ hkeh hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh ti mi mehˇ gʼa tuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ti mi kaˆ gʼa tuˬ laˇ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ nawˬ gʼaˇ va leh, hkeu‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tcuh gʼa tuˬ laˇ.
Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ caˬ kʼa‸ teˇ hpaˍ shaw hpoˆ tcuh leh, caˬ shiˍ taˆ kʼaw‸ la tcuh gʼa tuˬ laˇ.
Kaˍ laˍ oˆ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼaˬ ma diˆ vaiˇ ve le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˆ hpu ma hkʼe taw poˬ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ.
Kaˍ laˍ oˆ ngaˆ lehˬ, awˬ u teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo u baˬ taˉ leh, miˬ shaˉ lehˬ awˬ u oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ u oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ naˆ hkoˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh naˆ hkoˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ hkiˉ.
Awˬ u oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ u maˇ heˆ ve hkʼe te shawˍ leh baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ u u htaˇ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ te‸ chiˉ a muˆ maˇ taˍ.
Yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ gʼuiˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ paˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ awˬ mvuh zuhˬ la piˇ taˍ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa shuˍ pawˆ gaˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ naˍ hkʼawˇ meuˆ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve laˇ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ kawˆ puiˉ. Awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ kawˆ hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ leh, aˉhtaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ maˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ te piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ pfuhˇ taˍ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ hkʼaw awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma tu jaˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ta‸ iˉ huˉ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui naˍ hkʼawˇ meuˆ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ka‸ yawˇ hui ma‸ pe‸ nuˬ leh, ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ piˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ ceˬ lehˬ, toˍla‸ kʼuˉ hpe leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo poˬ ya‸-e tuˬ nawˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve laˇ.
Hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ awˬ hpui teh ca te chehˇ tuˬ, aˉ ceˬ lonˉ lehˬ nawˬ tawˇ piˇ hkawˇ hta‸ law na chehˇ ve laˇ.
Aˉ ceˬ lonˉ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ kuiˬ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te leh, haˉ cu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, vuiˇ kuiˬ neˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo, aˉ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, aˉ ceˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ jehˇ taˍ tuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ dawˇ nyi ve hkʼaw tawˇ gʼa yaw taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ-o.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, kʼoˆ keunˍ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve aˬ kehˉ leuˉ leh kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tu huˉ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ teh‸ nawˬ shawˍ taˍ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo taˍ leh, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo taˍ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve laˇ. Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ jaˇ tuˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ
Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve hkʼaw tu la leh, nawˬ awˬ to kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh hkʼa nyi.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ leh nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yoˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi leh yuˬ ce piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui huˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw duˇ tuˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpeh taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Beˍhaˍmoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh‸ hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ ve awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ hkʼaˬ ma kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve le.
Yawˇ ve awˬ mehˍ tu lehˬ, htawˇ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hteˇ lehˍ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve hkui sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, sho taˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼa te hpanˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, anˇ law‸ law‸ ve toˬ nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ceh tiˉ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ve mvuh‸ lehˬ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leˍ guiˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hawˉ lo zuh‸ chehˇ leh, nawˉ pehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve lo de hkʼaw ca va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuhˇ hkʼaˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Yawˇdaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼuiˬ dawˇ hehnˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ maˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ yawˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e chehˇ ve ka‸, yawˇ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ leh hpeh yuˬ gʼa tuˬ le. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ htaw sheh gʼa tuˬ le.
Leˍviˍtanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ lonˉ hta‸ nawˬ biˉ yuˬ leh biˉ gʼa-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ nawˬ aˉ caˆ hkeh yuˬ hpeh gʼa-aw laˇ.
Yawˇ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ hta‸ naw htaw sheh gʼa-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ ve paˇ kaˇ hkʼaw nawˬ biˉ yuˬ keu gʼa-aw laˇ.
Yawˇ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ laˇ tuˬ laˇ.
Yawˇ nawˬ geh jehˬ da‸ leh, co co nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te laˇ tuˬ ve ka ti‸ te laˇ tuˬ laˇ.
Aˉ hkʼaw lo hu taˍ ve ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼe, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ aˉ hkeh yuˬ hpeh taˍ gʼa-aw laˇ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ nyi guiˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gʼa-aw laˇ.
Ngaˇ ca paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ lawn tawˇ gawˬ da‸ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ tawˆ hawˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Yawˇ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ nawˬ gehˇ hkʼa biˇ ca choˆ piˇ taˍ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ nawˬ ngaˇ hta‸ juˆ tuˬ ve gehˇ yuˬ juˆ gʼa-aw laˇ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ htawˇ nyi sheˍ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ htawˇ nyi gaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ da‸ taˉ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Leˍviˍtanˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ca huˉ taˍ maˇ haˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ca yuˬ da‸ leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve a shu cawˬ le. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe te maˇ gʼa.
Leˍviˍtanˍ ve hkui sheh teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ leh hkʼaˬ ma awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ shaˍ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ hkʼeh‸ baˬ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ juˆ pawnˍ maˇ gʼa.
Kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve yawˇ ve ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve paˇ kaˇ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yuˬ ngaˉ nyi gʼa le.
Yawˇ ve caw‸ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ heh jaˇ leh, teˇ geh hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shehˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ meuˆ keu maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ teˇ maˬ hkʼa deh‸ ngawˉ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ yeˬ chaweh ngawˉ da‸ taˍ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca gʼawˬ hpaˆ maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ tcuhˍ ve teˇ yanˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la leh, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ ba lehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ha tawˆ la leh, aˬ miˍ tzuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ ce la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mu‸ hkʼu hawˉ lo aˬ miˍ ceh keu taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ shaˉ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ to‸ tawˆ la piˇ leh, yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ha tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ lo nuˇ lehˍ ve awˬ ti teˇ kaˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Sho hkʼa shu heh jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve nyi ma shiˍ htawˇ haˉ pui hkʼe heh leh, kawˆ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Haˉ pui mawˍ hkʼa shuˍ heh jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa leh kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ naˬ piˇ tuˬ te gʼa ve aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Gehˇ, hkaˆ ce leh sho taˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Sho lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon chi gʼawˇ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kuiˇ htawˇ yawˇ awˬ pon hpuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ tuˬ te gʼa ve hkaˆ ce teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ baˬ hpehˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ htawˇ, chi gʼawˇ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ taˬ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pon chi gʼawˇ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ gehˇ yuˬ juˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu hkʼeh‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, laˇ hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ je‸ hta‸ hkoˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ buiˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ lehˬ laˆ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu taˍ ve shaˍ chu hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ fuˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ toˇ kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ awˬ fuˇ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ tehˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ kawˆ puiˉ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇbaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ awˬ lawn na nyi haˆ ve nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw leh, ngaˬ shiˍ maˇ gaˬ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ tuˬ, leh nawˬ na nyi laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, shu kʼoˆ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw leh, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hkʼaw, je‸ meu-e leh hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇbaˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ peu‸ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Eˇliˇhpaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yawˇbaˆ hkʼe ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ.

Chi beu‸ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ lonˉ suhˍ hkeh Yawˇbaˆ geh yuˬ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw tawˇ maˇ yaw, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇhpaˆ, Biˇlaˍdaˆ leh Zawˇhpaˆ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇbaˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ awˬ pon bon lawˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ paw sha la piˇ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ pun kʼaw‸ cawˬ maˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇbaˆ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh ca hpawnˬ guiˇ la leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ sha hkawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpu leh shi la‸ peˍ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇbaˆ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ tawn a‸ kehˉ, awˬ leh meuˇ hpawˇ ve teˇ tawn hta‸ leuˉ leh awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ meunˍ awˇ hinˉ, kaˍlaˍoˆ hkaw‸ hinˉ, nuˇ nyiˇ hinˉ, leh piˉ laˬ teˇ hinˉ hkeh cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ suhˍ gʼaˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ 3 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ uiˍ hta‸ Yeˍmiˇmaˆ, nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Keˍziˆ leh shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Keˍreˍhaˍpoˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇbaˆ ve yaˇ miˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ paˍ hui geh teˇ geh awˬ shinˉ peh‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇbaˆ lehˬ, oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ a sha‸ 140 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suh-e ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw hui dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ maˇ te toˇ ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ henˇ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shu hpeh‸ leh, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ htaˇ awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ nawˍ kʼai. Yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve va‸ hpuiˇ shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw geh leuˆ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve le.
Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh hkunˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha leh Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui uˉ peunˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui te-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hui uˉ peunˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui yuˬ baˬ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ teh taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ shu hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Lawˬ-o‸. Lawˬ ve kʼo chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ sho juˇ fuiˍ yuˬ uˉ peunˍ leh, je‸ mu‸ hku hta‸ dawˆ meu-e ve hkʼe, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˆmeu-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkunˉhawˉhkanˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Kawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.
Kawˆ cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la leh nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw cawˬ maˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw htawˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve htanˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa leh, teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ te maˇ gʼa tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa maw maw awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Kawˆ ve cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi-o.
Tanˇ keunˍ tanˇ cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ leh Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ leh, ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ teh‸ chaw maˇ maˇ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ kaˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la htaˇ ngaˬ bon lawˬ leh, nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ law na taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˬ lo cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyi bawˬ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw leh, heˍ caˇ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˆ yan ve hkʼaw boˆ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te puiˉ tuˬ sheh kʼai laˇ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na gʼa sha tuˬ ga laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve taw hta‸ yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ te luˬ tuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ lehˬ na sha jaˇ ve htawˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ya‸ hkaˇ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chiˇ mvuh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ha kʼaˉ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ mvuh.
Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ pa taw awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Teˇ haˉ le le ngaˬ hawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve zuh‸ hpui nehˆ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve uˉ gehˇ htawˇ mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ pa taw, nehˆ jaˇ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hawˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, mehˆ shiˍ hpo‸ la leh, mehˆ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ mawˬ-o. Chi hkʼe hpehˬ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw leh, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˬ miˇ tawˬ hkʼaˇ gʼa hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te laˇ kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh tzuh‸ suhˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa te ya‸ peuˬ ve, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve, te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve canˆ paˍ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh gʼa te piˇ peuˬve kʼo,
ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh gʼa piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ taˉ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw tu la leh, ngaˬve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˇ la leh ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve kanˉ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh da‸ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇve cawˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gu shiˍ leh Yawˇ ve hkaˆ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ yawˇ gu taˍ leh aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hkaˆ ce yuˬ mawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ca leh, heˍ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ naˉ ve miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ leh, miˬ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ gaˬ peuˬ.

Chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ leh cuˉ dawˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma, ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ,
nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa dawˇ nyi tuˬ chaw yaˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ hawˉ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ nehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo teh taˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ, nuˇ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ,
ngaˆ leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ shu hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬyoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ peuˬ.
Buiˇshaˆ aˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ shu kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shu leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw teh taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui awˬ pon gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ geh laˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ chiˇ baˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ chaw teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ leunˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ te ya‸ piˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ huˉ taˍ leh, nawˬ te laˇ ve bon hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui duˇ taˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ te ve pa taw htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hui ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ leh meuˇ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shawˍ baˬ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ htawˇ, co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu la-o. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ taˇ te piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Buiˇ shaˇaˉ naˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kuˬ teh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ca va‸ taˍ ve le.
Haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ caˆ muiˬ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ lawn tawˇ uiˍ tawˆ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Sheˉ lai puiˉ ve chaw htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkeu leh chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, Ngaˬ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ na maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˉ kʼai tuˬ maˇ heˆ. Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ maˇ gʼa gaˬ taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkeu ve tawˇ, heˍ ve tawˇ leh shu hta‸ ho piˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu nyi ma naˬ tuˬ ve tawˇ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˆ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ leh, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo law taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh gʼawˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw haiˬ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te‸ chiˉ maˇ te laˇ taˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ mi‸ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw haiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te baˬ taˉ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Nawˬ mawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tu‸ hkanˍ ve leh dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ga piˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw leh, yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ ve kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ maˇ gʼa te tawˆ la tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸, Ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo poˬ kʼai-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, haiˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, da‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ hpehˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui ve hkaˆ htaw mawˍ taˍ peuˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ paˆ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ gu te maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve daˬ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ chaˬ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ ca ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ leh ma‸ shiˉ ce la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw yuˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve ha tehˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh leh, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve maw‸ kʼaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui gʼa peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ chi beu‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, naˬ jaˇ ve hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lo suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ lawˍ taˍ peuˬ ve hpu hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw hui teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ taˍ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ leh, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw leunˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Co co taiˍ taiˍ laˇ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw va‸ taˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ, hkʼaˬ maw maw biˇ sheˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaˬ maw maw uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi leh a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ ha lehˬ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ naˍ, nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Maˇ cawˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, te‸ chiˉ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ caˇ lu caˇ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw a shu gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo a shu oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa ca pui tuˬ le.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve hta‸ tiˉ te ve chaw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ leh na sha ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yaw ve chaw,
shu hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ maˇ ya‸ puiˉ ve chaw, shu awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve hta‸ maˇ ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te ve chaw, ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh puiˉ ve chaw, hkʼaˬ ma haˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ngaˍ piˇ htaˇ, awˬ yawˬ maˇ yuˬ caˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ piˇ htaˇ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ yuˬ caˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ geh cawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ hui geh gʼa chehˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ maˇ maˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ngaˬ htaˬ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ ma anˇ tuˬ cawˬ leh, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma ngaˬ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la maˇ hpeh‸.
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ geh ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ taˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ la piˇ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ dawˇ sha tuˬ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve bon law hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ nawˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ chaˬ nyi lawˇ nyi leh, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, haiˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ peuˬ. Haiˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ te toˇ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tiˉ te toˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ nyi leh ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ awˬ paˇ lo gʼa chehˇ ve kʼo canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ cawˬ zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ leh, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ hpfuhˆ kʼai htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu la-o. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ yehˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Chi teˇ co-e loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ gu taˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ, awˬ hawehˍ awˬ haˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa ma ha‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼe ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hoˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh htawˇ ngaˬ awˬ pon va htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ miˬ hiˆ la leh, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ha leh to‸ chehˇ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yehˬ baˬ leh yawˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkui sheh hawˉ lo naˆ ho‸ ve moˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Hkeˍruˆbenˍ hta‸ ciˇ ya‸ la leh, mvuhˇ haw ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ leh yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo i ˉ kaˆ chiˇ taˍ ve moˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, vaˇ shiˍ maˇ maˇ ce la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw leh uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ peu leh, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hta‸ ba la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ deˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ leh miˬguiˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ngaˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ hpfuhˆ.
Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˇ.
Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ leh, caˆ muiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ piˇ laˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa ca ve chaw hui awˬ pon, yawˇ lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ dawˇ sha tuˬ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh jaˇ ve hkaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ yehˇ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ hkʼaˇ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo, ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh maˇ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ paiˍ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼaˇ maˇ jehˇ leh gʼa‸ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˆ baˬ leh yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ tu la maˇ gaˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve hkui paˇ lo paˍ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ nawˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ nawˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ Yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
Mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˆ meu-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve je‸ nehˆ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hkʼoˆ naˆ toˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ kaˇ htaˇ la‸ haˉ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ ve hawˉ chehˇ tuˬ Yawˇ te laˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi teˇ nyi lehˬ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ awˬ nu ve teˇ haˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ yehˇ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ hkawˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi awˬ pon mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ lo yehˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ leh gʼuiˇ enˍ da‸ shehˍ hpaˇ tawˆ la ve hkʼe, mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo te leh oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve haw ve chiˆ ve awˬ shaˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca yuˬ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ biˇ jaˇ leh, a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ leh yeˬ jaˇ leh, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ leh, nyi ma hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ oˇ hkʼe gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ taˆ ve lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ cawˇ ve deˇ deˇ yoˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve shi hta‸ ca ve a‸ kehˉ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve pehˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ awˬ bon gʼa ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mawˬ maˇ gʼa. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, faˉ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ yuˬ baˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ taˇ uˉ peunˍ tcuh-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo ngaˬ biˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ leh ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ leh nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw ha lehˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui tu la leh, yeˬ chaweh huˉ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ ve pa taw yawˇ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ geh uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ bon yuˬ laˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ tuˬ bon lawˬ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ peuˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh da‸ ve awˬ meh piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ bon yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ co co cawˬ leh Yawˇ geh lo ha lehˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬleh, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh, Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkaˆ htaw mawˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ maˇ ga laˇ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ htawˇ ngaˬ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve da‸ kehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve pa taw, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw maˇ heˆ-o. Shu cha‸ leh hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve pfuhˇ tiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ha tehˍ che leh oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ponˬ laˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ paw tawˆ la gʼa tuˬ nawˬ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ hpaˆ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gaˬ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ paˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ, maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ sheˆ kʼai ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ kʼehˆ tawˆ-e leh ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ htawˇ pehˇ hawˍ hkʼa shuˍ kuiˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve hkʼaw‸ hkʼaw lehˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ goˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ha tehˍ htawˇ, maw‸ kʼaw awˬ na paˉ hpawˇ lo ngawˉ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Je‸ meu-e hkʼaw suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ moˍ ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hpuiˇ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ paˇ lo jiˆ laˬ leh, ngaˬ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ geu‸ gʼawˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kuˇ da‸ leh ngaˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ hpaˆ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Aˉhtaw la‸ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Hpuiˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ guˆ pehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o.
Yawˇ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw leh, tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, loˍ ve hkʼe gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ gʼa teh tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ lawn gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ paw la sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ.
Mvuh‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Kehˬ da‸ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po teˇ hpaˍ lo Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ awˬ suhˉ piˇ laˇ leh Yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.

Suh ve aˉ gʼui ha hoˆ beh taˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve iˉ du taˬ leh nawˬ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, nawˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ gu laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve kawˆ biˇ sheˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh nawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh cawˬ leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ teh taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo a shu taˆ-e keunˍ ve le. Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw a shu lo‸-e keunˍ ve le.
Hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ kanˉ te puiˉ ve chaw, nyi ma hpu ve kehˬ ve chaw, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve ka ti‸ maˇ ca te puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw, teh‸ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ lo‸ la tuˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˍ chaweh hpaw taˍ-o‸.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ chi a shu le. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ lo‸ la tuˬ, a sho-eˬ htaˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˍ chaweh hpaw taˍ-o‸.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ chi a shu le. Yawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ taw kuiˬ, shonˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw lehˬ, shonˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ taˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ shonˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaˇ suh a sha‸ te‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaw yawˇ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ leh ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ kʼai sheh kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve venˇ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te piˇ leh, yawˇ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ nyi leh, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ chawˇ maˇ cawˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ leh, kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma canˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ nyi sheˍ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Shonˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ gaˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh cawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw a ciˉ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇve chaw teh‸ a ciˉ shawˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi canˇ nyi leh, ngaˬve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ a ciˉ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸kʼaw maˍ laˇ leh nawˬ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ chawˇ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ jaw kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ tsuhˇ leh, nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ caw toˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yehˬ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui geh ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ te luˬ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ haiˬ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ leh ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ moˍ lonˉ ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, leh yawˇ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ lawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ leh, mvuh ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ teh taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la-o, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ taˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma taˇ zuhˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ pa ngaˬ e ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ puiˉ sheˉ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ leh ho laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Yonˍ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ gʼaˇ va-o.

Ngaˬ ve peun kuiˬ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
