Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hpawˇ lo ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui geh ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ lehˬ na sha ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ canˇ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi. Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇ naw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Da‸ kehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw chehˇ leh, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ lehˬ, Keˍdaˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteh kʼai piˇ leh, Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Keˍdaˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, hteh kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, nuˇ yehˇ hkʼe pawˆ tu la piˇ lawˬ leh Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ, nuˇ paˍ haˉ hkʼe pawˆ tu la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hta‸ ba tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ shehˇ de leh Kaˍdeˍshaˆ hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ lehˬ hkuiˉ zuhˬ awˬ ma peuˍ hta‸ awˬ yehˇ paw la piˇ lawˬ leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hpa‸ piˬ ce piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ uˉ peunˍ leh, Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa shuˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ya‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Da‸ kehˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve lehˬ teˇ hkui tiˉ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve da‸ ve awˬ bon lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ co-e cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ mehˆ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la puiˉ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ ha lehˬ tuˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon da‸ ve kanˉ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ca va‸ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh, nawˬ ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ suh-e leh tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo‸-e ve pa taw, nawˬ awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ yawˬ cawˬ tuˬ le. Suh peuˬ ve chaw nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn, yawˇ hui shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ mvuh leh, ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ gaˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ ta‸ yehˬ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ leh ngaˬ ve htanˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬtaˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw shiˍ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ awˬ pon htaw taˍ ve va awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ to nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui hta‸, nawˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ nawˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Ngaˬ kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼa hawˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ ngeh laˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ da‸ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ leh, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼuiˇ hpaw-e laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ suh peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, shu leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ shu gʼawˆ baˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Canˇ paˍ laiˉ gʼaˇ tawˇ tsuhˆ-ehˆ te da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ ve la‸ sheh hawˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi laˇ leh, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ taˇ lu tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ ya‸-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw, caˆ muiˬ ve chaw, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui awˬ pon, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ piˇ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve le.
Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇbaˆ ponˬ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ maˇ te ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha venˇbaˆ maˇ taˍ ve chaw gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ hpeu‸ maˍ ve kʼo, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ gʼa hawˬ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ goˇ htaˇ ciˍ gʼuiˬ mehˉ kʼai ve hkʼe, ngaˬve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ya‸ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ faˉ taˍ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ leh nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, loˍ kuiˬ cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼe uiˍ taˆ la ve htawˇ yawˇ hui geh gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh lawˍ hkʼe taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tcuh caˇ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve mawˬ kʼaw hkʼaw sho caˆ gʼa keu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hta‸, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Nawˍ meuˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Tinˍ hteˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ hta‸ kʼa leh, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Tinˍ hteˆ leh bvuhˬ chaweh chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hteˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ leh, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa, leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ teˇ kaˬ lo tiˉ shaw hpoˆ taˍ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ naˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ bawehˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ keu haw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o.
Yawˇ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ miˬguiˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui htawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ cawˬ ve pa taw ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve pa taw ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve maˇheˆ.
Ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ awˬ pon iˉ mvuhˇ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve pa taw ponˬ piˇ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw leh, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw pon piˇ leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ bon uiˍ hkawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ na yuˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ hui teˇ geh chiˇ mvuh-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nyi ma gʼa luˬtuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ leh, kawˆ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ dawˇ nyi-o. Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬhkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ, caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ la tuˬ ngaˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ gaˇ ve laˇ. Ha lehˬ tuˬ leh co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve laˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yaw. Heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yehˇ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh, da‸ ve hta‸ te-o. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ haiˬ te ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ tawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui suh kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ shu yawˇ hui hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ paˇ neˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ maˬ ka‸ hteh kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ haiˬ la‸ hkʼaw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ bawˆ laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ bawˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve htanˬ tuˬ leh la‸ caˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve gehˇ leh aˉhtaw hta‸ chiˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ tawˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ a ciˉ kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ jaˆ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve va‸ hpuiˇ shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˆ baˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw leˆ jaˇ leh naˆ ho‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon va htaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ awˬ pon miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ maˇ jawˬ sheˍ htaˇ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw leh, yawˇ hui duˇ taˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ponˬ laˇ ve pa taw gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, fawˉ mehˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ leh, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa shiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ ve awˬ tan haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui naˬ la gawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh, caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh, yawˇ hui pon bon lawˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ e awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ da‸ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga hpoˆ dawˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkui luˬ paˍ hta‸ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te guiˇ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ leh nyi tcuhˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw nyi guiˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ leh chaw heˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh taˇ gʼa ha lehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh taˇ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nuˇ nehˬ ve hkʼaw tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ. Gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve awˬ lawn laiˉ ceuˬ ca kʼoˆpuiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ ga hpoˆ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gawˬ lehˍ taˇ te chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˇ la leh ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu la leh ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn a ciˉ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ taˇ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh shonˇ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ hpfuhˇ haw leh ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ ve hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw, Yawˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kuˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ leh, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve nyi ma hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh yawˆ yan gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ uiˍ gaˇ uiˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ mawˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve tawˇ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ leh, heˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ te hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw lo zuh‸ taˍ leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te ve kanˉ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo biˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, hkʼaw hkʼa shuˍ mvuh jaˇ leh, nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼui hkʼa shuˍ naˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ pe‸ laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa caˇ leh nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ da‸ ve iˉ kaˆ taw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ ha‸ piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon te piˇ-oˆ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ca ya‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ taˇ te laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui paiˍ taˍ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ tu la maˇ gaˬ leh, zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve nyi ma hpeh‸ bawˬ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Maˇ da‸ ve chaw hta‸ nyi leh yawˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˍ kʼai peuˬ ve suhˆ buiˇ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui suh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh da‸ ve hta‸ tiˉ te-o. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh ca-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kanˉ te laˇ tuˬ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh law taˍ-o‸. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh paw sha la ve chaw hui hta‸ nyi leh, hpeh‸ bawˬ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ.
Dawˇ hkiˉ ve leh nyi ma zuhˆ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe ve nyi ma lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkui tiˉ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca nyi ve htawˇ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ leh te luˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, maˇ maw maw yawˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw leh da‸ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ ve hkaˆ hta‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw la‸ hkʼaw gʼa suh leh, yawˇ hui gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ htawˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh cawˬ ve a ciˉ tiˉ ve mawˇ lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw geh cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh da‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ ho-eˍ kʼai leh, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu geh ca chiˇ ca ngaˍ ve htawˇ, maˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼe leˇpiˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yawˇ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ beˆ maˍ piˇ leh, Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ paiˍ ve htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˍ tu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ mawˇ la peuˬ leh, ngaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve maw peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve da‸ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ paw‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca lawˬ caˇ toˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu hta‸ hkʼe leˇ chiˇ piˇ ngaˍ piˇ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ bon uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh da‸ ve hta‸ te-o. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh, Yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh, cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tiˉ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ ve chaw hta‸ jaˆ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo baˬ taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo gaˬ tcuh piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ laˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ leh haiˬ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ jaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Keˍdaˍ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpanˍ kʼai htaˇ, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ chehˇ-o. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca nyi ve htawˇ, ca maˇ mawˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw hta‸ tawnˇ taˍ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ maˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˆ paiˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa naˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ, a naˍ keuˆ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ pfuhˇ maˇ gʼaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ kuiˇ nuˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ caw‸ kʼaw‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
A naˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ leh, suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, naˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ leh ngaˬ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ diˆ vaiˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ, hkʼa deh‸ nyi maˇ mawˬ-o.

Ngaˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ paˇ neˇ lo jiˆ laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ awˬ pon va caw htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ho laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, naˍ paw pawˇ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh maˇ kaˇ puiˉ-o. Chaw kʼaˍhkʼe hpeh‸ leh tawˇ yaw maˇ puiˉ-o.
Ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ ve pa taw, kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ gʼa ha lehˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ paiˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh taˇ yaw tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ paiˍ la paˇ neˇ leh, naˬ jaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpeu‸ maˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬhta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chehˇ sha leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ka‸, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ tan ngaˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ ca chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ ngaˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ ca kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh, tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ yaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Da‸ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ yaw. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leuˉ leh jaˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ tuˬ biˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ shaˬ dawˇ nyi ve kʼo shaˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ maˇ lawˬ hkawˉ leh chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ she‸ ve le. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ gʼa suh-e tuˬ le. Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ leh kʼai tuˬ ve ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬve a sha‸ ngeh tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ shaˉ teˇ peu-eˬ gʼawˬ keu ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yawˇ shaw hpoˆ chehˇ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a shu gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa dawˇ law tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ taˇ te piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ yaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe tu‸ hkanˍ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ deˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw yaˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Pfuhˇ shehˍ ma hkʼa shuˍ chaw yaˇ ha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬte luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ shaˉ teˇ peu-eˬ gʼawˬ keu ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ piˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ceh nawˬ ve hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˇ tawˆ kʼai sheˍ htaˇ, ha lehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ tuˬve hta‸ngaˬ law nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Je‸ nehˆ cawˬ leh kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ teh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬhui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ puˆ Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hui kawˆ jaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ laiˉceuˬ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ca kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh venˇbaˆ lawˬ hpehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tan, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ naˍ paw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ngaˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma hkʼaw lo ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo nawˬ ponˬ laˇ ve ha lehˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ lawn chi, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw faˉ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ lawn leh, nawˬ ga laˇ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ maˇ kʼoˆ leh ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chi, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la leh ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸-o. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh, chi beu‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh, ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, shonˇ kʼai leh nyi ma luˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ geh hkʼa laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve htaiˬ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa ha‸ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬve yoˬ. Yawˇ dawˇhaˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Canˇpaˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo baˬ taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui naˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh a ciˉ gu na-e laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ gaˇ leh shu leunˇ kʼai ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ca nyi la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shu hta‸ ca kʼoˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn tawˇ tsuhˆ-ehˆ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ lehˬ naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yonˍ gʼa ve ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh. ngaˬ hta‸kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ. A menˬ.
Hkuiˉ zuhˬ lehˬ gawˬ da‸ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬnawˬ hta‸ shiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ngaˬ hawˬ chehˇ leh, mehˆ gʼuiˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai taˉ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma pe‸ hkoˇ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬchi taw taw gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law leh, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆkʼaw‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Choˬ kaˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ve nyi ma pe‸ hkoˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ Yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw leh Miˆzaˍraˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, leh ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ hpeh‸tuˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ chi taw taw gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law leh, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kaw‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh na nyi laˇ tcuhˉ taˍve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ chi taw taw gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law leh, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ leh, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ tuˬ she‸ ve le.
Nawˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ nawˬ ve bon yehˬ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ leh nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh lo peu laˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ nawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ tinˍ hteˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ chi taw taw gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law leh, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi co-e htaˇ, nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hto maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ cuˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve hkaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼaˇ va. Ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼaˇ va.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Co co taiˍtaiˍ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve ma‸ moˍ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tcuh laˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ pawˇ pawˇ hawˇ baˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ya‸ taw tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa ya‸ taw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ leunˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ te luˬ ve htawˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ haiˬ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh baˬ taˉ laˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui ve hkʼe kʼo,
awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬmeh hta‸ pa taw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve le. Tu la-o. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ca va‸ taˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ leunˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ leh, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw na sha ve tawˇ biˇ la leh, ngaˬ ve ha tehˍ lehˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve li‸ bvuh‸ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve naˬ meu‸ taˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, tawˇ yaw puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve hkʼaw lo gʼuˇ suhˍ ciˇ kʼai-o. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve hkaˆ ce lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ juˆ pawnˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve hkui paˇ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ leuˉ leh piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ muˇ raˍ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ leh, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haw ciˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve tinˍ hta‸ hteˆ leh, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw la‸ sha paˉ lo, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun veu‸ deh taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ ma huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˍ. Nawˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve awˬceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ-oˆ.
Nawˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇnawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ ma lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ shi hkeh ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh shu yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui laˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ geh lo yaˇ paˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ meh bvuhˬ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ga laˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬ hiˆ jaˇ leh hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e peuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ,
laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ taˆ la leh hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha lehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ pawˆ ka‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ Yawˇ laˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ kuiˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi la-o. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpa hta‸ ca nyi la-o.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yaw ˇ awˉ hteh leh, gehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ jehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ-o‸. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo la‸ sheh hta chehˇ-oˆ. Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬawˬ hkʼoˆ Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ Yawˇ leuˆ teh taˍ laˇ leh, Yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hui geh hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇ ve venˇ leh Yawˇve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lehˬ, mvuh jaˇ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ ve venˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ lo ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ leh, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ paw tuˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆjaˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ chehˇ htaˆ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui tuˉ li paˍ li hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn hta‸, ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le bvuhˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve pa taw,
Ziˉonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ gʼa tuˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ ca toˇ nyi leh, mvuh ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi taˍ-o‸.
Lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ nyi leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ chaˬ nyi taˍ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve co co taiˍtaiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ,
chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, paw sha ve chaw leh haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, chi hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ veˆ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yaw leh, tinˍ hteˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ ve a sha‸ lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e leh co co gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ hpfuhˇ chi hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ piˇ maˇ gʼa.

Chaw luˬ paˍ leh chaw kʼaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e ve hkʼe cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui htawˇ suh-e chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve co co taiˍ taiˍ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ cawˬ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, a shu yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˬ hkʼa shuˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, suh ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ leh paw sha la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ nyi ma taˇ luˬ.
Yawˇ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai maˇ gʼa. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo yawˇ geh lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh shu chiˇ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve htawˇ,
co co taiˍ taiˍ naˆ ho‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ hkʼa gaˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha laˬchehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ laˬ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ leh, Yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo hehnˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ Yawˇ kuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh lo shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, mvuhˇ naw ma hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍoˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬgeh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ loˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh, hkʼaw pui awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve nuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˍ meu‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nuˇ shaˍ caˇ leh, aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ dawˬ ve leh laˇ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼaw leh, jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ heuˆ gaˇ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ te ve yoˬ. Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yaw gaˇ jaˇ leh, heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw maˇ bvuhˆ puiˉ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yo‸.

Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi ve hta‸ na taˍ-o‸. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la piˇ gʼa ve tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, chiˇ mvuh hkaw ˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉpuiˉ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ tsuhˇ baˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬve venˇbaˆ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ la kehˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve ya‸ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ leh ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ leh, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ paw la htaˇ ka‸ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh ngaˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ ˬbaˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tsuhˇ hkʼa laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ vaˇ meu-e a‸ kehˉ hpu la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ hkawˇ kaˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ tcuh laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ nyi leh, ngaˬ geh cawˬ ve haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a ciˉ yuˬ baˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpu ve kehˬ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆgʼuˇ suhˍ lo taˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ ngaˬ geh lo taˇ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve htaiˍhkʼaw‸ ve awˬ bon hkʼaw tawˆ la ve ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬve a sha‸hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw puiˉ tuˬ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve na yuˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ puiˉ leh venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ maˇ chiˇ baˬ taˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ leh, nuˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ dawˇ nyi leh, nawˬ ve ha tehˍ lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve aˉ hte‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ heˍ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ a‸ kehˉ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ leuˉ leh ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ lehˬ shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ ga hpoˆ gʼuiˬ leh,
Nyi loˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ va ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ ve shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ ve chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ naˍ, nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve kanˉ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Maˇ cawˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, te‸ chiˉ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ caˇ lu caˇ leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpuˇ jaw ve kawˆ tuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆlaˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ baˬ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shonˇ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ taˇ jaw kʼai laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ho laˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh canˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ biˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼa shuˍ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ poˬ hpaw-e leh gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ vuiˇ jaˇ kuiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo poˬ hpaw-e leh, ngaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ ca te tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ hpfuh taˍ kuiˬ chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ haˆ ca te taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ tawˇ yaw da‸ ve na maˇ gʼa tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ. Venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ kaˬ le le lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ caˇ leh fawˉ mehˍ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ca va‸ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ chawˇ te da‸ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui jaw ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, suh yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ suh-e piˇ-oˆ. Suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ hui awˬ te‸ te‸ gʼa lo‸-e piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui ve yehˬ kʼa leh, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga la tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ leh, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ Yawˇ geh taˆ-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ jaˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ maˇ te gaˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve nyi ma ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ da‸ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ awˬ chu hkʼa shuˍ leˆ jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu hta‸ canˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ chu hkʼa shuˍ nuˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh teh taˉ-oˆ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw leh, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸, yawˇ hui a sha‸ teˇ hkoˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw yu keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bawˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chawˇ yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ leh, ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ jaˆ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa ya‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ caˇ lanˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ nyi, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chiˇ mvuh ve tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ peuˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gehˇ leh hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve ha tehˍ lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve aˉ hte‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo hpeu‸ maˍ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ va htaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Ngaˬ ve tinˍ leh shehnˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ nawˍ tu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ hpeu‸ maˍ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve laˇ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo suhˉ taˆ piˇ chehˇ ve laˇ.
Maˇ heˆ taˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi leh, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve leh sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ tawˆ la tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui a sha‸ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ haiˬ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paw la htaˇ ka‸ te leh, heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ vuiˬ naˆ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ taw‸ ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ ve naˍ paw pawˇ ve vuiˬ naˆ hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve naˍ paw hta‸ tsuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve ciˬ hta‸ dawˆ hkʼeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shawˍ baˬ piˇ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo shu naˆ toˇ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ goˇ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ pfuhˇ tsuh‸ aˉ lu‸ kʼuˉ kuiˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, suh kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ taˉ leh, paw la htaˇ ka‸ suh-e ve yaˇ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpawˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw lo juˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇgʼaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.

Nyi loˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ awˬ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve pa taw maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ te ya‸ kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve pa taw maˇ heˆ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu leh ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ a ciˉ nyi sheˍ. Nawˇ la leh buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ la leh, hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui ve ha tehˍ lehˬ, aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ kaˇ taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˬ yawˬ leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh yawˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai chehˇ ve Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇbaˆ yawˇ hui ve meuˇ guiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ ve pa taw, shu hpeh yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui heˍ leh shu hta‸ hkeu ve pa taw, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la leh, hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ caˇ tuˬ ca hpfuhˆ nyi toˇ chehˇ leh, caˇ tuˬ hkʼa law‸ ca maˇ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkʼanˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn bvuhˬ chaweh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ca hpaw va‸ taˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o.
Nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ kawˆ cheˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, jeˆ hkoˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ kʼaw‸ gu da‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawnˬ kʼo, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ paˆ-e la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼe te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Sheˍhkenˍ hta‸ jeˆ hkoˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suˇkoˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ chi, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve sho uˉ tcuhˍ hpeh‸ leh, Yuˇda‸ lehˬ ngaˬ ve iˉ du taˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Mawˇbaˆ lehˬ ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ keu tsuhˇ kuiˬ hkehˇ hpeh‸ leh, Eˇdonˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hkuiˉ nuˆ keu kuiˬ ta kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh gʼa kuˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, a shu ngaˬ hta‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ le. A shu ngaˬ hta‸ Eˇdonˍ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ le.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chiˇ baˬ laˇ peuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ ga laˇ ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ va‸ taˍ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ zuhˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ maw chaweh te‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa uˉ peunˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Paiˍ la paˇ neˇ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa maw maw ga hpoˆ dawˆ piˇ tuˬ she‸ ve le.

Yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui yuˬ ce piˇ gaˇ leh, heˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ hkawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nyi ma hkʼaw yawˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, yawˇ hta‸ tiˉ ngaˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ bon leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve peun kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Nawˬ hui ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve peun kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, shaˉ teˇ peu-eˬ gʼawˬ keu ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ yaˍ cuˍ hkʼaw keu tsuh nyi ve kʼo, a ciˉ ka‸ naˬ naˆ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haw a‸ kehˉ lawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ taˇ va. Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ ca hiˉ yuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ taˇ dawˇ. Nawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ la ve htawˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ taˇ va.
Kanˇ paˆ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh cawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ laiˉ pawˆ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
