Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe awˬ bon piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma nawˬ hta‸ shiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ leh, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇmvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve co ha caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ya‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ te taˍ ve chaw hui htawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ hoˆ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ gu shiˍ leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ yuˬ mawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ ca heˍ toˇ leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸ leh, yawˇ hui va hkʼaˬ lo htaw tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Va chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ te tuˬ jehˬ da‸ leh, Ngaˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh law‸ law‸ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ ca mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, anˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui gʼa naˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi leh, shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, da‸ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh ve lehˬ te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ shonˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw leh, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ nawˬ shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ lehˬ, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ gawˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ leh ka kehn chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo te leh oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ haˬ shaˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ hkuiˇ la da‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ iˉ kaˆ biˇ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mehˇ taˍ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ biˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ pa taw, miˬ shaˍ nuˇ la leh, awˬ yeˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ bon hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˬ moˍ lonˉ biˇ taˍ leh, hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ taˍ leh, ti mi hkʼaw lo caˬ shiˍ biˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca nyi la-o.
Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ taˇ hpfuhˆ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Nawˬ hui ve chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ paiˍ tcuh laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi peuˬ. Hpu lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ pa taw da‸ kehˬ la ve hkʼe, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ va yaw piˇ lawˬ leh, hawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ pfuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ naˆ toˇ tcuh leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ leh iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve yehˬ lo ngaˬ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ yawˬ ehˉ yuˬ laˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ nawˬ geh taˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ laˬ leh na taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ. Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ geh lo maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ yawˆ yan piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha tu la leh, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Pehˇ hawˍ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw kuiˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Moˬ hta‸ ciˇ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw gu taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ chawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ piˇ leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
Miˬ hiˆ jaˇ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw ve Gʼuiˬsha leh, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha laˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ ya‸ la piˇ leh, goˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ toˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ hui ve ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo pehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu oˍ taˍ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. (Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˬ hkawˆ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve le.)
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Zaˍlaˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo vaˇ meu-e kʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw uˉ tzuh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Baˍshanˍ hkʼaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaw uˉ tzuh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ chehˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve hkʼaw hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te nyi chehˇ ve le. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha co co taiˍ taiˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ awˬ meunˍ awˬ shehnˉ geh teˇ geh Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ la leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ kuiˬ lo taˆ-e leh, yawˇ geh chaw yaˇ maˇ maˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh Yawˇ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi ngaˬ hui ve awˬ vuiˬ hta‸ ga pfuhˇ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw lo gʼa juˇ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui ve hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh‸ gaˇ ve hkʼe leh‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ,
Baˍshanˍ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, tinˍ hteˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ gʼa‸ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ moˍ awˬ kaˍ lo yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ cehnˬ kʼoˍ dawˆ leh kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Shu a‸ kehˉ chaw ceuˬ i jaˇ ve Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw awˉ law ˉ peuˇ laˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Zaˍbuˆlonˍ chaw, Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh lo la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh,
ngaˬ hui awˬ pon nawˬ yehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˇ paˆ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hpu tanˇ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ lo de hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ yehˇ shiˍ toˇ chehˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Suˍdanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ la‸ sheh chiˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ciˇ toˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ lo gaˬ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve meh‸ gʼuˬ hkʼaw kʼa chehˇ leh, ngaˬ naˆ taˍ tuˬ ve miˬguiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo gaˬ peuˬ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ kuˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw heuˬ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve hkʼaw‸ hkʼaw naˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ law nyi chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ pe‸ tawˆ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn heˍ hto chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh lawˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ taw tuˬ ve taˇ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ taˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh ya‸ taw jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ viˉ ngaˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ lehˬ hkehˉ chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ lehˬshu mvuhˇmiˬ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo to‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shu nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ ce leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veuˬ deh leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ leh, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ meh‸ gʼuˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw leh, naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˬ baˇ taˇ hoˆ beh laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ leh tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ lo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hpawˇ lo a ciˉ hpfuhˆ nyi laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh taˇ ca va‸ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Shu ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Shu ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkoˇ kʼai leh dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh dawˇ sha laˇ tuˬ ve chaw hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve htawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Ngaˬ awˍ meu‸ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ taw‸ ma caˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ci ve awˬ gʼuiˬ taw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ leh yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve caw‸ kʼaw‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ mi piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ hui ve fa la teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw lo a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ cawˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ tawnˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ gʼa tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve li‸ daw hkʼaw yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ shiˆ baˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ keu taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Nga naˬ chehˇ leh dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ cawˍ tu laˇ leh a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˉ leh nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui htawˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ leunˇ.
Miˬguiˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa leh, yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh chi beu‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh, ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw leh hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai leh nyi ma luˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ geh hkʼa laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ha lehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ gaˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve peun kuiˬ leh ngaˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, haiˬ ve chaw leh shu hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ ka‸ te leh nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, shu awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ mawˇ la peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ la peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui jehˬ da‸ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh hpeh yuˬ-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ya‸ taw leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law leh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ maˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ mawˇ la leh uˉ hkeh mvuh hpu la peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ lawn hto piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ geh a ciˉ chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ dawˇ sha tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tinˍ hteˆ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tinˍ hta‸ hteˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tinˍ hteˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬlawn kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ puiˉ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo uˉ peunˍ puiˉ tuˬ nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ paw sha la piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma caw la piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇ nyi ha pa awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ti mi leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ leh, ha pa awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, paw sha ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo te leh oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma hta‸ te leh miˬguiˬ awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ uiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw lo zuh‸ baˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ leh conˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Saˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ geh lo la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui leh shu chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ nuˇ shaˉ nuˇ ve chaw leh haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ lehˬ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve shi hta‸ yawˇ gʼa piˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu yawˇ awˬ pon bon lawˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, hkʼaw pui ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo caˬ yeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ nyi cawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ lo biˇ la piˇ-oˆ A menˬ, A menˬ.
Yeˍsehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Daˍviˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ choˬ kaˬ lo peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh nyi ma hkʼaw hpu ve kehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yonˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh aˬ laˬ hkʼe mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ paw sha jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ. Awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ leh chehˇ sha puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve leh dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hpuˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyi ma uiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shi caˆ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ hawˆ taˍ leh, haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ gʼuiˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ leh, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hkawˇ na leh, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ shiˍ taˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ca maˇ mawˬ taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, awˬ leuˉ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ ca chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ te leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ peuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw hkʼe maˇ te chehˇ-o.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ shiˍ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ heh‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ leˆ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo teh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ leunˇ kʼai ve zuh‸ maˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
ngaˬ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ paˇ lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ vawˆ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ leh awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ heˆ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ sheˍ le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼaw‸ loˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma leh ngaˬ ve awˬ to gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ loˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw lehˬ, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gʼa chehˇ ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ shu hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe baˬ taˉ laˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh, nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ chehˇ taˉ peuˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ htawˇ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ca nyi la-o. Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ peuˬ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve hto‸ hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˆ htu paˍ hkʼa shuˍ ceˉ ceˇ yuˬ leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htu baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ceˉ ceˇ leh hta tu hta‸ yuˬ leh, gʼo‸ pa hta‸ dawˆ paˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui geh cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o. Hkʼaˬ maw maw chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼuiˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Yawˇ hui nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve la‸ sheh pehˉ taˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hkoˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cawˇ shehˍ maˍ lonˉ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ nawˬ dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi leh ha pa hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ nawˬ miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ piˇ leh, haw ve awˬ yanˇ leh kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo taˇ baˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Naˆ ho‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo taˇ gaˬ tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇmvuh tcuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu la leh nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ hta‸ ngaˬ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬ hiˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, miˬguiˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh maˇ gʼa yaw tuˬ leh,
haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ uiˍ gaˇ uiˍ tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na hpawˇ lo laˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taˍ ve kawˆ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngeuˍ tawˆ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui awˬ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ dawˬ peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍ koˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn shu hta‸ hto piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ taˍ uiˍtaˍ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkaˆ ce, htanˬ tuˬ, aˉhtaw leh yawˇ hui ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve le.
Yawˇ hui hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ leh, chi beu‸ suh taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ho piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ paˍ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh ponˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ lehˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo maˇ suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ ngaˬ la‸ sheh chiˇ leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ dawˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ dawˇ nyi ve pa taw, gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ zuh‸ muiˉ maˇ kʼa tcuh laˇ. Ngaˬ heuˬ jaˇ leh tawˇ yaw maˇ gʼa-o.
Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi leh, maw jaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ dawˇ nyi leh, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-o ve laˇ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ha‸-o ve laˇ. Yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇnyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ peuˬ ve laˇ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve, Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ heuˆ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi tcuh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼe taw uiˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ anˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Yaˍkoˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ mvuhˇ tawˍ leh, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ tawˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba la piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬbaˇ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ juˇ kʼai leh, naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ve hkui ha hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ kʼai leh, Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼoˆ nawˬ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hpeh‸ taˉ jaw ve anˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ,
ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ taˉ laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ faˉ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ leh yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve teˇ co-e hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, yawˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ shiˍ la leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe maˍ piˇ kʼai ve kʼo, yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ va ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw lehˬ hkaˆ pfuhˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te maˍ piˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Zoˉanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ anˇ tuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hkanˍ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼo‸ pa hkʼa shuˍ cawˍ tu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ aˬ miˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ yawˇ dawˆ hkoˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la tcuh leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh, yawˇ hui loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ piˇ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ dawˆ leh, iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ leh hkaoˍmonˇ piˇ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yehˬ miˉ hpaw tuˬ tawˇ piˇ leh,
yawˇ hui awˬ pon maˍ naˆ shiˍ ce la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ laˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw tu la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve ngaˆ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve fa la awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo hkʼa biˇ ce la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui shaˍ gʼa caˇ leh, nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve ka‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh sheˍ ve pa taw,
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ la leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te leh, yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, shaˉ teˇ peu-eˬ gʼawˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peuˬ kʼai piˇ leh, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heˍ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ laiˉ pawˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve htawˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ hkui tiˉ meuˆ laˬ leh mehˉ kʼai ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ dawˇ haˍ piˇ peuˬ ve le.
Yawˇ hui teˇ hkui teˇ hkui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo yawˇ ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Zoˉanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ puiˉ suhˆ naˆ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve ti mi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, paˉ ce‸ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Vaˇ shiˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. A ngeu hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Vaˇ shiˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve nuˇ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ mvuhˇ htehˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gʼuiˬ baˇ hoˆ beh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh, yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ lo, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ puiˉ leh, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw‸ jaˇ ve hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ yawˇ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, canˇ paˍ la‸ sheh hkʼaw suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh, yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˉ, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa nawˇ la ve hkʼe Gʼuiˬsha nawˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇseh‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ chiˇ baˬ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ maˇ leuˆ yuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh, yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, bon yehˬ hta‸ yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ leh,
yawˇ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ leh, shiˍ kʼai sheh kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ taˉ laˇ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ to naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ hta‸ caˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ to haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ yuˬ sheˆ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ sheˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ yoˬ ya‸-e chehˇ ve hkʼe Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼa tiˬ chi ti lo awˬ suhˍ teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ ya‸-e chehˇ leh, suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ to‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw leh, nawˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi beu‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ law tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ leh, ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ sheˆ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, shu tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gu taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te ve chaw hui hta‸ suhˍ pun kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve yawˬ awˬ moˍ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui kuˬ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh,
nawˬ ve awˬ to Eˇhpaˍrenˍ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ leh Maˍ naˍseˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ maw laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ caˍ laˇ leh, mehˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ keu taˍ ve kawˆ taw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ bawˆ yuˬ tcuh leh canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ maˬ yuˬ veu laˇ leh awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ti keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ te oˇ ve yeˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw naˉ chaweh lo‸-e leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ piˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma lo hkʼa gaˬ uiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ko taˍ ve hko hta‸ nawˬ hpaˆ baˬ ve le. Chi beu‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ shaˉ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh va‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ te oˇ ve hta‸ naˆ cheˆ leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpfuhˆ nyi laˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te chi ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te chi uiˍ la leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ te chi ve hta‸ tawˆ baˬ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh-o. Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Cehnˬ dawˆ tinˍ hteˆ leh, na sha jaˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ tanˬ kʼa loˬ.
Ha pa suhˉ taˆ la leh ha pa tawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, pawehˇ te tuˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ loˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te tuˬ yawˇ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve li kiˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ ya‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ dawˇ haˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼaw ngaˬ va‸ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Meˍriˇbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma na yuˬ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa pui.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui nyi ma heh leh yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma na yuˬ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve le.
Yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, kawˆ ve cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa boˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ leh pehˇ gʼuiˬ caˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ leh, gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ taˆ piˇ ve maˇ gʼa te. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa nyi.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ paˍ a sha‸ leh kʼai ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve a sha‸ leh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ la-o. Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ taˇ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ maˇ hiˆ maˇ naˇ taˇ te chehˇ-oˆ.
Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ tu la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Laˬ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te luˬ piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui jehˬ da‸ hawˍ peuˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ awˬ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇdonˍ chaw, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw, Haˍgaˍraˆ chaw,
Geˍbaˍlaˆ chaw, Aˍmonˍ chaw, Aˍmaˍlehˆ chaw, Hpiˇ liˇtiˆ chaw leh Tuˇruˆ chaw hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca pawnˇ da‸ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve Lawˇtaˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kiˇshonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw, Siˇseˍraˍ leh Yaˍbenˍ hui hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˍdawˇraˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shonˇ kʼai leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo kuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˇreˍbaˆ leh Ziˇbaˆ hui hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hiˉ yuˬ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve va‸hpuiˇ shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw leh, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hkʼe,
nawˬ ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve hehnˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai leh co co taiˍ taiˍ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Kanˇpaˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ law ve le.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma chehˇ gaˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chehˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, caˬ piˉ nehˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpui te taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ gʼa ve chaw leh, ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼai gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, goˇ jaˇ ve Baˍhkaˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ oˇ ve lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ na‸ laˬ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ leh, lawˬ hkʼo‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la leh, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ nyi gʼa chehˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo teˇ hinˉ nyi gʼa chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ngaˬ leuˉ leh huˉ taˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ na‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa ha lehˬ jaˇ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˆ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hpehˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ leh, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ laˇ leh, nyi ma taˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai maˇ gʼa ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hui ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ tu la leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nyi ya‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw gu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬve bon lawˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh taˆ-e chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ leh, da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve pa taw, dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ te ve hkʼe te gʼa ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, anˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te tcuh gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh te puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn co co taiˍ taiˍ ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Tuˍ hpfuh awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ e hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ leh, ga laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ leh ya‸ taw jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve venˇ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ caˇ lanˇ yuˬ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇ tu‸, Baˍbuˍlonˍ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ, Tuˇruˆ leh Suˍdanˍ chaw ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼe ngaˬ shawˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui htawˇ venˇ chi hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ bvuh‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼe shawˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ awˬ bon hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ la kuiˬ awˬ tcuhˆ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ kuˬ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ leh ga laˇ tuˬ lawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Suh taˍ ve chaw hui geh shu ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ leunˇ kʼai leh tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw suh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Naˉ jaˇ leh naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hehnˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ te piˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi bawˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ hoˆ tiˍ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ponˬ tawˆ-e tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ anˇ tuˬ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui tu la leh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ ve laˇ.

Tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Naˆ ho‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ve anˇ tuˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve laˇ. Luˬ peuˬ sheˆ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ nawˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te laˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan leh, ka kehn ve awˬ hkʼaw lo huˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼe taw kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le hkʼaw nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ uˉ peunˍ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ Raˍhaˍbaˆ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ nawˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ hta‸ nawˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw leh Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma kanˇ paˆ uiˍ leh hkʼaˬ ma awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve le.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh nawˬ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ gʼa ha lehˬ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ga piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ chi ma ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw jaw piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ geh cawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ leh yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa leh ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve htaiˍhkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ luˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ maˇ toˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ,
ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ tcuhˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ heˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ yeˬ chehˇ ve ha pa hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ leh, yawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ dawˆ paˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ ga hpoˆ gʼuiˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ha lehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ tuˬ nawˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve iˉ du taˬ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hta‸ naˆ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ haˆ haˆ mawˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ va‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ ngeh jaˇ leh, nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ lehˬ suh-e puiˉ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Maˇ suh-e puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ. Tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ ha‸ jaw ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkʼaˬ lo le. Nawˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo le.
Buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe taw maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ leunˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ. A menˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui hpeh‸ tawˆ la kuiˬ lo nawˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh leh, je‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hinˉ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teˇ nyi hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ kʼai peuˬ ve aˉ nyi htaˇ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hkui hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ yeˬ la leh,
awˬ veˆ veˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ goˇ kʼai ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui faˉ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ te hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui a sha‸ ngeh jaˇ peuˬ leh, tawˇ tsuhˆ-ehˆ te da‸ ve hkʼe mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, chehˇ sha puiˉ ve chaw kʼo, hiˉ chi hkʼaw‸ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ceh tiˉ yuˬ laˬ piˇ leh, maˇ maw maw ngaˬ hui suh kʼai mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ a shu gʼa leh‸ nyi jaw peuˬ ve le. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ gʼa ve hta‸ a shu shiˍ le.
Ngaˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hkʼaˬ ma ngeh jaˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, teˇ shawˇ le le nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ bon ngaˬ hui geh cawˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ shaˉ laˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nawˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ laˇ leh nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ canˇ paˍ te luˬ laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la puiˉ ve naˬ beuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ puiˉve haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ paˍ suh-e leh, chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw,
dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ nawˬ ve yehˬ paˇ lo laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve hkui sheh haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh, awˬ taw‸ ma hehnˇ jaˇ ve vuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh ve lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.
Teˇ shawˉ le le nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, teˇ haˉ le le nawˬ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ gʼa kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.
Tinˍ hteˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh ve ka‸ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma naˉ jaˇ ve le.
