Chi ve hta‸ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ na maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ la leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ uiˍ la maˇ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e leh haiˬve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Heh nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, haiˬve chaw hui hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ la da‸ la leh, Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo ti taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ leh,
mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ awˬ shiˍ naw‸ chehˇ sheˍ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸veu‸ deh taˍ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh teh taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼai maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆchehˇ taˍ leh uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ htawˇ co co taiˍ taiˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ a ciˉ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tu la leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, hkʼaˬ maw maw tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ leh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui chi taw taw kʼaˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ heh‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ naˍ paw piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ ve laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ mehˆ shiˍ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ mawˬ puiˉ ve laˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve saˍla‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ cuˬ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh laˇ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve chaw leh, nawˬ geh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gʼa henˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ piˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ a shu ngaˬ awˬ pon tu huˉ chehˇ tuˬ ve le. A shu ngaˬ hpawˇ chehˇ leh neˇhaiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ gawˬ lehˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ paiˍ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˍ tu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha laˇ leh, ha lehˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh,
te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ nyi piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui chiˇ mvuh-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh piˇ-a veuˬ.
Yawˇ ve bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve hkʼaw, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo‸-e leh, yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh piˇ-a veuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ja ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, gʼuiˬsha hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ htawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui boˆ taˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh-a veuˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ caˍ laˇ taw laˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ awˬ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ nyi yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Meˍriˇbaˆ leh Maˍsaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma heh ve hkʼe nawˬ hui ve nyi ma taˇ heh piˇ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi canˇ nyi laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ma ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh-o. Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ lawn, teˇ nyi le le shu hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ lawn hto maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ teˇ ceuˬ, yawˇ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ leh yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ-o‸.
Da‸ kehˬ shehˍ hpaˆ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ-o‸. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh teh taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, kʼaw‸ jiˆ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Ti mi leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yawˇ laˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve conˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Moˬ leh naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo aˬ miˍ to‸ kʼai chehˇ leh, yawˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ miˬguiˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ chehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo pehˇ hawˍ hkʼa shuˍ kuiˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ, yawˇ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ya‸ taw leh, gʼuiˬsha hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ leh Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ ha lehˬ tuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ leh da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ponˬ laˇ gʼa ve kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh-o. Ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Tinˍ hteˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh chiˇ mvuh-o.

Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Miˬguiˬ leh oˇ ve hkʼaw lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hta chehˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yawˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Hkeˍruˆbenˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ leh miˬ hiˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ laˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw gʼuˇ suhˍ lo oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ leh, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ yawˇ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ moˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o. Ha lehˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼa leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ laˬ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh yawˇ ve yawˬ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e loˬ. Kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e loˬ. Yawˇ ve bon hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve kʼa muiˬhkawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ laˬ tuˬ le. Da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw hui te ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shu ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ jaw kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ chawˇ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ga piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve haiˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬve bon lawˬ hkawˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ to htawˇ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ goˇ lehˍ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ dawˆ nehˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, caˇ tuˬ caˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cawˉ jaˇ peuˬ leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ leh, hkʼaˆ piˍ lo jo mui taˍ ve hkawˍ tawehˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo jo mui chehˇ ve ngaˆ hkʼe, zuh‸ taˍ ve ka‸ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa maˇ gʼa.
Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te laˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh shu hta‸ hkeu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw‸ laˉ lehˬ ngaˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ dawˬ tuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hkaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh chiˇ baˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la hpawˇ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha leh, goˇ lehˍ ve mvuh‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ tu la leh Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi ve luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ chi hta‸ ha‸ leh ha kʼaˉ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆtuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve Yawˇve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ na leh, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ maˇ paw la sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ pon bvuh‸ keu taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh,
htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ hpawnˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ ngeh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ maˇ mawˇ sheˍ htaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ yuˬ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Veu‸ kʼaˇ tzuh‸ kʼai ve hkʼe, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼawˆ baˬ leh mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ maˇ htaiˍ maˇ pa leh co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, yawˇhui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ dawˇnawˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˍ hpfuh awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh yaˇ nehˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon laiˉ ceuˬ na‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve dawˇ hkaˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma haˆ haˆ maˇ zuhˆ puiˉ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ deˇ maˍ tcuhˉ taˍ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ.
Mvuhˇnaw ma lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇnyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ je‸ meu-e hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ uiˍ la leh awˬ veˆ veˆ la ve suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ la leh suhˉ veˆ oˇ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ suhˉ veˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ cawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve da‸ ve awˬ bon yawˇ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co awˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ leh, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh awˬ me‸awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇnaw yaˇ leh yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha htaˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ paˇ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ aˉ po kʼo hkʼa shuˍ gʼawˬ hpe taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ yehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ nawˬ ciˇ toˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ nawˬ tawˇ tcuh leh, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ nawˬ yeˬ chaweh teh taˍ peuˬ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ jiˆ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ yuˬ beh taˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ lehˬ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ deˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Nawˬ tawˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon gu piˇ taˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ hoˆ beh tuˬ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ leh, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo nawˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ leh, piˉlaˬ awˬ hteunˍ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpui te leh kʼa muiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve awˬ bon biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon mvuh‸ hta‸ nawˬ yeˬ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ yeˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ lehˬ ti caˇ hkʼa caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ tuˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu cawˬ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ la piˇ gʼa ve hkaoˍmonˇ htawˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ti taˍ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼa biˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˆ ehˉ leh va‸ laˇ gawˬ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpui te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo haˇ tawˉ pehˆ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo faˆ pehˉ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ha pa hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ca toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇnyi tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e leh a shu yawˇ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca kʼaw‸ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ kanˉ ca te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi awˬhkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ leh awˬ to uiˍ ve i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆlo haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ te toˇ chehˇ leh, nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve cawˇ shehˍ ma lonˉ oˇ kaˬ lo leˍ guiˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui caˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ tawˆkʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shaˉ gʼawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ jehˇ taˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui suh-e leh yawˇ hui hpeh‸ tawˆ la kuiˬ je‸ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˉ kʼaw‸ gʼaw tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ te‸ la leh, miˬ guiˬ hta‸awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ co co taiˍ taiˍ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇmiˬguiˬ hta‸nyi leh, miˬ hiˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ htawˇ leh, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ tuˬ yawˇ geh jiˆ kʼai leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-o.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ suhˉ jehˬ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, chaw awˬ hinˉ co-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Iˉcaˆ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkehˉ chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peuˬ teˇ peˆ lo ca te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ fawˉ mehˍ tcuh piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ ya‸. Ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ taˇ htawˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hawˇ baˬ ve Yoˇseh‸ hta‸, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo peu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ ve hkui sheh leh kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la leh yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yaˍkoˆ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hta‸ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve anˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, naˆ ho‸ la piˇve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la piˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇpiˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, puiˉ suhˆ naˆ leh puiˉ ma teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ awˬ tan yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo vaˇ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ ce la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ te leh, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ leh, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ leh, awˬ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ caˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chehˇ sha cawˬ sha awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ pfuhˇ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hta‸ teh taˍ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lawˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh uˉ mehˇ maˇ maˇ peu laˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ mvuhˇ naw ma ve caˇ tuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ haˉ hpawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw hta‸ hpanˍ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇmvuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ,
Yawˇ lehˬ aw nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇmvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ da‸ jaˇ leh yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu kʼoˆ maˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a shu yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ tiˉ te ve chaw hui lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ponˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ ha lehˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬpuˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ hui htawˇ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ leh haiˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬpi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na maˇ gʼa. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui laiˉ pawˆ leunˇ kʼai leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi awˬ paˇ lo yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw kʼa suh peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yonˍ la leh, Yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼaw‸ te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬyawˇ huiˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Moˉseˍ leh Aˍronˍ hui hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ leh, Daˍtanˍ, Aˍbiˆ ranˍ leh yawˇ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˬ miˍ ce la leh, haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw paˇ lo yawˇ hui shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuh‸ hta‸ caˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ pa ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te taˍ peuˬ ve le. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo htawˇ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te taˍ peuˬ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ tu la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ piˇ tuˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh,
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Peˍawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, a sha‸ maˇ te‸ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Hpiˇneˍhaˆ lehˬ venˇbaˆ te ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh awˬ lawn chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ dawˇnawˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Meˍriˇbaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ awˬ paˇ lo, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Moˉ seˍ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve pa taw, Moˉseˍ lehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ keunˍ maˇ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ leh, yawˇ hui te ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, venˇbaˆ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇte taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh-o. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ A menˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ da‸ jaˇ leh Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˍ meu‸ jaˇ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ leh, nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw ca chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ leh, awˍ meu‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, htawnˍ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ sho caˆ hpeh taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ kanˉ te hkeu‸ jaˇ ve pa taw gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paiˍ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ leh, sho caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kuiˇ yehˬ miˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, sho taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw gʼa naˬ chehˇ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui caˇ maˇ gaˬ dawˬ maˇ gaˬ leh, suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ leh, tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ cawˇ leh Yawˇ te laˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon shu hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa hto maˍ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hu tuˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ uiˍ taˆ la ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te chehˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw leh gʼuiˬ baˇ gawˬ kʼai ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawn da‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ pehˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shehˇ de hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, goˇ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo venˇ hta‸ te leh chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ naw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve leh tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉmehˍ piˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo te toˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˬ awˬ moˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui awˬ lawn chi teˇhpaˍ hta‸ dawˇnyi leh, Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hta‸ dawˇshiˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇmvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, nawˇ la-o.
Ngaˬ ve tinˍ leh shehnˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ nawˍ tu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo hpeu‸ maˍ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Sheˍhkenˍ hta‸ jeˆ hkoˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suˇkoˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ chi, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ leh Maˍnaˍseˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve sho uˉ tcuhˍ hpeh‸ leh, Yuˇda‸ lehˬ ngaˬ ve iˉ du taˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Mawˇbaˆ lehˬ ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ keu tsuhˇ kuiˬ hkehˇ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ leh, Eˇdonˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ keu kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ kuˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, a shu ngaˬ hta‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve le. A shu ngaˬ hta‸ Eˇdonˍ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ ve le.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chiˇ baˬ laˇ peuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ bawˆda‸ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ ga laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Ta‸ iˉ taˇ chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw leh heˍ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn heˍ hto leh, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ leh bon lawˬ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ tan awˬ haiˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ tan canˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca leh suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ laˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh yawˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ venˇbaˆ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ-o‸.
Yawˇ maˇ maw maw suh-e leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yaˇcuˬshi hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma htawˇ mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chehˇ kuiˬyehˬ maˇ cawˬ ve lawˬ leh‸ paˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ca chehˇ taˬ kuiˬ yehˬ piˍ keu hkʼaw shu gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ nu ve chaw kʼaw‸ gʼa kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ gʼawˆ hu piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ shu leunˇ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ nawˇ leh yawˇ awˬ e ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ leunˇ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hkeu puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ te piˇ puiˉ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon taˇ te piˇ-oˆ.

Hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve awˬ liˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ awˬ to hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ lo‸-e piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hkʼaw lo naˍ manˇ hkʼa shuˍ lo‸-e piˇ-oˆ.
Hkeu hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ leh, haˍ pi caˆ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ leh nyi ma hta‸ hkʼa tiˍ, naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ aˉ gʼuiˬ ha mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ mehˉ kʼai la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Pfuhˇ shehˍ ma ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˇ tuˬ maˇ gʼa caˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh cawˉ jaˇ peuˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼuiˬ leh oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ shiˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬhta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ taw ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gu taˍ ve chaw hta‸ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve hkui sheh awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ taˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo mui taˍ-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ ya‸ la ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, co co taiˍ taiˍ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ chi hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve la‸sha paˉ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo chaw maˇ maˇ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shonˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ dawˬ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ leh ha lehˬ ve chaw lehˬ, shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ leunˇ tcuh laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ caˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ leunˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve htaˬ ngaˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo piˇ laˇ taˍ ve pa taw, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ gʼa kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw leh, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, aw bon na‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ paw sha la leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ piˇ ngaˍ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw leh, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ te puiˉ ve chaw gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ shu hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ mehˉ kʼai. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, shu yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chiˇ nyi taˉ leh mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve dawˇ law tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆhpawˇ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ leh,
yawˇ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ paˍ hui geh awˬ chawˇ te tcuh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw meh ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ yaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, ha lehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chi mvuh-o.
Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ,
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ nyi taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ da‸ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ htawˇ jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ aˉ che‸ hkʼa shuˍ pawˆ tu la leh, hkʼaw ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ pawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve le. Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ htawˇ jehˇ taˍ ve le.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ aˉ che‸ hkʼa shuˍ pawˆ tu la ve le. Hkʼaw ehˉ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ pawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve le.
Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ me‸awˬ hponˇ gʼa keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa keunˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ha‸pehnˇ uiˍ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇnaw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, Yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpu shi yuˬ leh te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maw‸ kʼaw cawˬ htawˇ tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ. Mehˆ shiˍ cawˬ htawˇ maˇ mawˬ puiˉ.
Yawˇ hui naˍ paw cawˬ htawˇ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ. Naˍ hkʼawˇ cawˬ htawˇmaˇ nuˬ puiˉ.
Yawˇ hui la‸ sheh cawˬ htawˇ ca htawˇ maˇ puiˉ. Hkui sheh cawˬ htawˇ maˇ juˇ kʼai puiˉ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ yaw maˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆyan ve chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui leh suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh maˇ hpeh‸-o.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha na yuˬ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve chaw hui hta‸Yawˇ ha‸shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ shiˆ baˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, te‸chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yonˍ tcuhˉ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve htawˇ ngaˬ yonˍ tcuhˉ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa tanˇ piˇ tuˬ le.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, Yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe Yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve kʼo Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ haˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ e hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍtaiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ laˇ ve htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ pehˇ ma hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chi gʼawˇ hta‸ to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ teˇ hkui tiˉ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ leh ngaˬ shonˇ la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼa te‸ chehˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ suh-e tcuh laˇ.
Ngaˬ awˬ pon bon yehˬ ve yehˬ miˉ hpaw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lo‸-e leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hpeh‸ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw ceh tiˉ lo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ kawˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.
Chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ nyi yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-a veuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw laˬ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo suhˆ kʼaˉ awˉ shi taˍ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ caw toˇ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ceh tiˉ toˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ laˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ henˇ yuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma hpu ve kehˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te da‸ kehˬ la piˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ da‸ kehˬ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ piˇ laˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh tawnˇ gʼaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˉ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ henˇ yuˬ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh a sha‸ te‸ puiˉ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ a ciˉ hpaw laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma lehˬ nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ law nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw hui lehˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ shonˇ kʼai leh je‸ meu-e hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ peuˬ leh, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ kʼaw maˇ gʼa ya‸ kʼai tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ henˇ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo taˇ gaˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha la tuˬ ve hta‸ ca ve a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Shu ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma anˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ chaw awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yaw puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ coˇ caˇ leh na yuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hto maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ leh taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Ka ti‸ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ law tuˬ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Tu‸ hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ sha la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ ve ka ti‸ ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ ngaˬ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ gʼa chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ tawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ loˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ la‸ haˉ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ va htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ leunˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, shehˍ kʼaw hkui htaˇ ngaˬ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, ngaˬ laiˉ pawˆ te ya‸ jaw peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ leh hkʼaˬ ma ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn heˍ hto chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ henˇ yuˬ puiˉ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ henˇ yuˬ puiˉ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ.

Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn heˍ hto leh shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw leh nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh laˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ shonˇ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ leh maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ law chehˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ law nyi leh, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ga laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ lawˬ na chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ shu chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu kuiˬ shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼe awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ leunˇ.
Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa law chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve le.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ leunˇ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ aw‸ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ka ti‸ htawˇ, co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ suh-e tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ biˇ ve maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ biˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ leh, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve saˍla‸ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ka‸ ngaˬ shiˍ maˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve pa taw, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve pa taw, haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve saˍla‸ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ baˬ taˉ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma mehˬ jaˇ ve le. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ gʼa ve pa taw, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ pon awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ leunˇ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ va htaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ ngaˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ pon ha lehˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ cuˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ geh lo tawˆ kʼai-o. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma taˇ luˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ ve hteˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo taˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ tiˉ law nyi chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ kanˉ te yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve shi a‸ kehˉ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ piˇ laˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ sheˉ lai leh, dawˇ law tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hpawˇ hpfuhˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ maˇ gʼa paiˍ tuˬ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, shu chiˇ baˬ taˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ.
Nawˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ htawˇ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
