Ngaˬ geh lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ cuˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ ngaˬ nawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo jiˆ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ka ti‸ htawˇ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa henˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, ngaˬ tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi leh a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ gaˇ ve canˇ paˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ htaiˍ maˇ pa puiˉ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ leh, co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa ha lehˬ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca mawˬ ve chaw hkʼe ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ ve pa taw, teˇ nyi suhˍ pawˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ paiˍ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ law taˍ leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ nawˬ geh lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ laˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ gʼa‸ ca la-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬve le.
Yawˇ lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve hkaˆ ce leh aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh gʼa chehˇ ve lehˬ, Meˍ shehˆ leh Keˍdaˍ chaw hui geh gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼe hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui geh gʼa chehˇ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ.
Cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ lawn tiˉ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼaˬ lo tawˆ la tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ zuh‸ muiˉ maˇ jo leh zuh‸ muiˉ maˇ kʼa chehˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ paˇ neˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ mvuhˇ cha maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ha pa maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ laˬ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˬ venˇ lehˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ leh, da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la tuˬ bon lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ cawˬ leh, nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ bon lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ geh lo gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ uiˍ la tuˬ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ maw jaˇ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hpawˇ maˇ chehˇ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hpawˇ maˇ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo,
yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ te‸ te‸ hehˆ dawˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui iˉ kaˆshi veu leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw tuˍ lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ dawˇ hehnˇ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw ngaˬ hui kʼa suh peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo maˇ luˬ maˇ sheˆ tcuh laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ ngaˆ htaw paˍ ve pehˍ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ ve ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Pehˍ tzuh‸ kʼai leh ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ jiˆ kʼai puiˉ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te la tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ zuh‸ maˆ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui gʼuiˬ leh, ha lehˬ ve hkʼaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ te piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ tehˬ awˬ na uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ jaˇ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ lehˬ fiˍ kʼai peuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ kʼaw‸ biˇ la piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ yawˇ sheˍ chehˇ htaˇ gʼa hawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa gʼeu‸ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Awˬ yawˇ sheˍ tuˬ pfuhˇ tawˆ-e chehˇ htaˇ gʼa hawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa pfuhˇ kʼaw‸ la piˇ lawˬ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yehˬ hta‸ maˇ te taˍ ve kʼo, te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ hta‸ maˇ shaw taˍ ve kʼo, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shaw deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hu tuˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tuˬ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve chaw htawˇ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ha‸ve chaw hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬGʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ bon hpeh‸ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ gʼa taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve hkaˆ ce hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve hkaˆ ce maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tawˍ da‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw leh, Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ nawˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la leh gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, nawˬ ve yehˬ paˇ lo ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼa shuˍ awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve hpui lawˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma fawˉ mehˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ te leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve caw‸ hta‸ chaw hpehˇ laˇ leh, mehˇ taˍ ve ti mi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shonˇ kʼai leh, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ goˇ kʼai ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mvuh‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh pfuhˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ tawnˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ la tuˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va leh, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ law nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ law chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ dawˇ uiˍ gaˇ uiˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ htawˇ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ leh shiˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ dawˇ nyi gaˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ e ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ zuh‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ htawˇ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Daˍviˆ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˇ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ teˇ maˬ ngaˬ maˇ te piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh,
ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh ca zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ gʼaˇ jehˇ leh zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ leh, Yaˍrenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh, Yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui-a veuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ geh teˇ geh bon yehˬ lo laˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo co co ca chehˇ la-o.
Nawˬ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh gʼa kuˬ chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ chiˇ baˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Daˬviˆ hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ te piˇ leh, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ leh ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo Yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ co co chehˇ leh uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ paw sha la piˇ leh, yawˇ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa shuˍ teˇ geh hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ leh hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.
Oˇ ve lehˬ Aˍronˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ, paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ te leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼoˆ lo shoˇ ya‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve naˍmanˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve lehˬ Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ ce la chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ co co te‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh bon lawˬ-o‸.
Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇnaw hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆlo chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇnaw ma leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe kanˉ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ moˬ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bawehˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, mvuhˇ haw hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ paw la ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ leh, tu nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, Yawˇ anˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ hta‸ Yawˇ te luˬ piˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ, Baˍshanˍ jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ, leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpu shi yuˬ leh te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maw‸ kʼaw cawˬ ve htawˇ tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ. Mehˆ shiˍ cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ mawˬ puiˉ.
Naˍ paw cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ. Shaˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼawˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve anˇ tuˬ te gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh mvuhˇnaw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇnyi leh ha pa hta‸ Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve la‸ sheh yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ Yawˇ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼa suh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Awˇgaˆ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shonˇ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ leunˇ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Yawˇ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ hui mui taˍ leh, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve tinˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ veu laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Ziˉonˍ venˇ awˬ lawn kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa maˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ tinˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ hteˆ puiˉ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ kʼa gʼa piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆpiˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, haˉ pui hta‸ hawehˍ jaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ca va‸ taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ cawˬ zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ tawˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te tuˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ nawˬ te tuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gu taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ peuˬ htaˆ hkʼa gaˬ te-o.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi peuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍtaˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ naˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa hpaw-e tuˬ le. Nawˬ maˇ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ gʼa hpaw-e tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve kʼo, nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ca zuh‸ taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ngaˬ poˬ hpaw-e ve maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ vuiˇ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ ca chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ leh shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ gʼa ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ paˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo cawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ hpaˍ naˆ ho‸ kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ gʼa ve maˇ kʼoˆ,

naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htawˇ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ leh naˆ ho‸ ve lehˬ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw nawˬ keu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ kawˆ keunˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ laˇ leh, shu maˇ shiˍ maˇ mawˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku uiˍ la heh la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ve li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ca dawˇ nyi maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon shiˍ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaw nyi ve kʼo, shehˇ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ geh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve kʼo, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh lo tawˆ kʼai tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ leh, nyi bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ shiˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, co co yeˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, haiˬ ve chaw leh nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ leh, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te tawˆ la tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve ha tehˍ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve vuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vuiˬ naˆ ve awˬ taw‸ ma hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo va caw htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ gʼa piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ taˇ hpeh‸ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Chiˆ jaˇ ve aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ce la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ gaˬ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Shu hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ uiˍ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ sha hawnˉ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ chiˇ taˍ ve la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, a ciˉ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teh taˍ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teh taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ maˇ gʼa te ya‸ tuˬ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ leh deˇ maˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ piˇ laˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui te ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo ca‸ ce peu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tuˍ hpfuh awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo suhˆ hkoˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ teˇ kaˬ teˇ maˬ ce taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htaw taˍ ve va hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ponˬ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon va hkʼawˇ htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ loˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo taˇ shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬve canˇ paˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, luˬ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ naˆ ho‸ ve htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu laˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ suh maw jaˇ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi leh, nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh nawˬ geh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve nyi ma nawˬ hta‸ shiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve dawˇ law tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ taˇ ca va‸ chehˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ca va‸ taˍ ve kʼo, suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e chehˇ ve chaw hui geh ngaˬ htawˇ gʼa chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le nawˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ nawˬ geh taˆ-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo toˇ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ puiˉ la tuˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, ngaˬ ve htanˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve peun kuiˬ leh ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yo‸. Gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ hawˉ lo Yawˇ chehˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼa dawˇ nyi tuˬ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˉ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh gʼawˬ keu ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ kʼai ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yehˬ baˬ leh ya‸ la-o. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ peu leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh, naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw puiˉ leh, a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼa chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Tinˍ hteˆ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ jaˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw puiˉ leh, a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, uiˍ la chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hawˉ yehˬ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo cawˬ ve nyi sha jaˇ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu laiˉ ceuˬ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve ti mi hkʼaw kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ paw la piˇ leh, awˬ meunˍ awˬ shehnˉ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ hkeh ka‸ awˬ yehˇ shawˆ-e ve maˇ cawˬ leh maˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ taˇ tawˆ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Chi hkʼe ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ.
Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn shu hta‸ hto piˇ leh, nawˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma haˆ haˆ maˇ zuhˆ puiˉ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ ve leh, nawˬ hkʼa ma awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ ga piˇ leh, paiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ cawˍ tu piˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ hkʼa te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chiˇ nyi chehˇ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ leh, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve chaw hui awˬ paˇ lo Yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui loˍ ve hkʼe Yawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ na yuˬ leh ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Teˍ hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ to nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬyoˬ.
Miˬguiˬjawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ taˇ va. Chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ hui suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ je‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ, mvuhˇ naw, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh,
mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ mehˆ mawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Paiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ chiˆ taˆ piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸Yawˇ ha‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ga piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ Yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlenˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ Yawˇ gʼaw nyi taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca tehˆ nyi maˇ gʼa taˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ chiˇ taˆ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tinˍ hteˆ leh chiˇ mvuh-o.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hta‸ Yawˇ teh taˍ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, mvuh‸ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ caˇ tuˬ piˇ leh, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ geh cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw leh, Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hui geh cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ziˉonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve miˬ tcuhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ da‸ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ caˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ miˬguiˬ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe teˇ cawˬ haˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Aˉ boˆ hkʼa shuˍ vaˇ meu-e hta‸ Yawˇ hpe hkʼawˇ leh, je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ a ngeu hta‸ Yawˇ hkaˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ vaˇ shiˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ce la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ peu laˇ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ tawˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ leh a ngeu kuiˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ Yawˇ meuˆ laˬ piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ chi hkʼe maˇ te piˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Nawˬ hui mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Mvuhˇ nyi leh ha pa-oˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Mvuh jaˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui ponˬ leuˉ maˇ gʼa.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ,
mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ leh vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, vaˇ meu-e leh moˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ haw teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, hteunˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
meuˇ ve leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ loˇ kʼai gaˆ kʼai puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ,
chaw haˉ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ awˬ nu ve awˬ meh teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ htawˇ, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ, Yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ, Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼa leh chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Ziˉonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh Yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Cehnˬ dawˆ tinˍ hteˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ ha kʼa teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh chiˇ mvuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ,
yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ,
yawˇ hui ve la‸sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo tcuhˆ jaˇ ve aˉhtaw teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ taˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ ve pawehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Nawˍ meuˆ tinˍ hteˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Cehnˬ dawˆ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Tinˍ hteˆ, lehˉ lu meuˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Na sha leh awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ jaˇ ve shehnˍ hta‸ hehˆ leh Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Chi ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve tawˇ naˉ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ puiˉ la tuˬ, da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˆ gʼa tuˬ, leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ sha tuˬ, tawˇ naˉ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, leh hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te puiˉ la tuˬ, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ haˉ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ shiˍ maˇ la piˇ leh,
faˉ taˍ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui na nyi laˇ ve haˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, cuˇ yiˍ kʼaw‸ htehˍ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan gaˇ ve nyi ma gʼa cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ leh henˇ yuˬ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ te gaˇ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ pa nawˬ e kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Da‸ jaˇ ve uˉ nyiˉ leh shi caˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ la piˇ gʼa ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ da‸ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ beˬ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hkawˇ taˇ na.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca nyi leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-a veuˬ. Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca dawˆ hpehˇ piˇ-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ dawˆ hpehˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, yawˇ suh-e tuˬyoˬ.
Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hiˉ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw biˇ la tuˬ te-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui geh laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa ma-ehˬ pehˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ geh taˇ kʼai. Yawˇ hui hta‸ vuiˇ vuiˇ jaw kʼai-o.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, teˇ hkui ka jehˇ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ htaw yuˬ gaˇ ve ngaˆ ehˉ nawˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ yawˇ awˬ pon htaw taˍ ve va lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ suh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ va caw htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˬ sha‸ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ, oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Na sheˍ. Cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh tcuh hkʼaw lo kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui te pawˆ ka‸ maˇ henˇ yuˬ-o ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ geh laˬ tuˬ kuˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ gaˬ la htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼe nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la leh, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ puiˉ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu piˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te ve kanˉ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ naˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e ve yoˬ. Chaw luˬ paˍ htawˇ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ-oˆ.
Yoˬ, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ lawˬ yuˬ-o‸.
Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ ca hpfuhˆ ve hkʼe, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca-o.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn shiˍ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ. Shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ te piˇ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te ve chaw hui hta‸Yawˇ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la leh, nawˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ leh, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, venˇbaˆ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ kʼai ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
cha‸ chiˆ leh maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te gaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ awˬ chawˇ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maw‸ kʼaw mehˬ jaˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ gaˇ ve haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼai ve kʼo, suh kuiˬ lo nawˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve chaw lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ neˇ la tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh ca guiˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ la. A sha‸ te‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la maˇ gaˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ gʼawˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ. Ngaˬ te tcuh laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ la piˇ leh uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ geh taˇ mehˉ kʼai piˇ. Oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ hpeh yu taˍ leh, nawˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ chaw yaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ gʼaˇ va.
Nawˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ dawˇ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ ve naˆ tsuhˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na-e la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ gʼa taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ hkʼaw lo caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, nawˬ ha‸ shaˉ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Awˬ pa lehˬ yawˇ ha‸ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve lehˬ, hpu shi a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ shehnˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ leh, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ ve hta‸ ca tehˆ da‸ maˇ gʼa.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ piˇ laˇ gʼa leh nawˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ shiˍ kʼai laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ yawˇ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸-e tuˬ te piˇ leh, moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ mehˉ kʼai piˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ piˇ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo toˇ kʼai hpeh‸ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ zuh‸ ve teˇ yanˇ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa zuh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ hai ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ va yaw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ te puiˉ te hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, loˍ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ chi beu‸ ka‸ ga piˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, Shawˉ pawˍ heh‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ.
Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ naˬ tuˬ taˇ te. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh tawˇ taˇ ca gʼawˬ da‸.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe ka‸ taˇ gʼa‸ te.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hta‸ canˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ hta‸ hkeu piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ leh, nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa leh, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ pa ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ kʼai piˇ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca-o. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca ve lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼa ca gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh ca-o.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve nawˬ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ leh da‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kʼaw toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ gʼuiˇ ve htawˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hkʼa henˇ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve a sha‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui kʼai ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ kʼai. Yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe taˇ gʼa‸ te.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh, nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼai-o.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa te taˉ ve ceh ceh, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui toˇ kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ leh shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa shuˍ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paiˍ ve htawˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh taˇ mehˉ kʼai piˇ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh, tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve leh chehˇ sha cawˬ sha ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ ve a sha‸ te‸ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yaw. Heˍ ve tawˇ leh na maˇ sha ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yaw.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ lehˍ nyi peu-o. Ya‸ taw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ taˇ faˉ taˍ.
Nawˬ te tuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh, gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ lehˍ kʼai-o. Nawˬ ve hkui piˍ teˇ piˍ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ya‸ kʼai tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la leh, nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shu shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu miˇ ma ve meuˇ guiˬ lehˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ chaw jaˇ leh, yawˇ boˆ nu laˇ ve htawˇ shaˍlonˍ chu hkʼa shuˍ leˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˇ ve leh naˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ suh kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo huˉ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ kʼai piˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o. Yawˇ ve yehˬ miˉ paˇ lo ka‸ taˇ kʼai.
Nawˬ kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ shiˍ da‸ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ ca keu taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu gʼa kʼai tuˬyoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ lo gʼa hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh nawˬ ve awˬ shaˍ leh awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ maˇ henˇ yuˬ taˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve saˍla‸ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ na yuˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ chaw chi ma mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ha‸ loˬ.
Awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ uiˍ la chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ heuˆ taˍ ve nawˬ miˇ ma geh ceh tiˉ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ hkuiˉ zuhˬ awˬ ma hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha leh, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te laˇ leh yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ ha‸ gaˇ sheˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw shu miˇ ma hta‸ nawˬ hkʼawˇ faˍ ve le.
Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ, htaw taˍ ve va hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, va oˇ ve hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw gʼa suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ga shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ ka ti‸ oˇ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve laˇ.

Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ chi hkʼe te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ geh kʼai leh, nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ca lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ.
Zuh‸ muiˉ taˇ kʼa chehˇ. Gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ jehˇ chehˇ.
Pehˍ hkʼaw geh taˍ ve ngaˆ leh, shaˍ bawˆ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ haˆ tawˆ kʼai loˬ.
Chaw bawˬ paˍ lehˬ piˉ gʼawˆ hta‸ nyi leh henˇ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hoˉ maˇ cawˬ. Ma‸ poˍ leh jawˇmawˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ yanˇ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ htaˇ shaw hpoˆ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw bawˬ paˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw bawˬ zuh‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ tu la tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ teˇ hkui jehˇ taˍ shaˍ. Ngaˬ la‸ sheh pehˉ leh teˇ hkui zuh‸ taˍ shaˍ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu hta‸ ca heˍ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui mehˆ shiˍ mi‸ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ heˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ kaˬ le le lo sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la leh, gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha canˇ leh nyi maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ suhˍ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma, heˍ puiˉ ve ha tehˍ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve la‸ sheh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve nyi ma, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ gʼuiˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hkui sheh, shu hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw leh awˬ chawˇ chawˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ te ve chaw, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ pa maˍ laˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Nawˬ e maˍ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ taˇ leunˇ piˇ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ hui maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ya‸ kʼaw kʼai htaˇ nawˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˍ laˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ hpeh‸ leh, shu miˇ ma beˬ laˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ponˬ laˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hkʼawˇ faˍ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ nawˬ hta‸ nyi laˇ ve pa taw, htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ nawˬ taˇ yaw piˇ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hta‸ hkaoˍ monˇ teˇ shiˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ yuˬ vuiˬ ka‸ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ shonˇ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve aˉ po‸ hkʼaw aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ beˆ htiˆ kʼai gʼa aw laˇ. Aˉ po‸ oˇ ve maˇ to‸ tuˬ hehˉ laˇ.
Nawˬ aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hkʼoˆ naˆ toˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve hkui sheh hta‸ aˬ miˍ maˇ chiˆ hehˉ laˇ.
Shu miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˍ meu‸ ve pa taw shu ve mawˇ ca hkʼawˇ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ shu hkʼe leˇ maˇ ponˬ piˇ.
Shu yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ gʼa ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ suhˍ pun gʼa kʼaw‸ shaiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa yuˬ shaiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, shu jaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ co-e awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ,
Awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ pon oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gaˇ ka‸ te la ve yoˬ.
Shu shaiˍ piˇ ve hpu hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hpu hkʼaˬ ma piˇ htawˇ, yawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ te tcuh ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ leunˇ piˇ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆlaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nawˬ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ geh cawˬ taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ nyi ma hkʼe shawˍ leh, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ-o‸.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ shu miˇ ma ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ ngaˬ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw nyi peu chehˇ htaˇ,
ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yaˇ nehˬ laiˉ gʼaˇ te toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ yehˬ paˇ lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ veu‸ deh taˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, ya kʼaw hkʼoˆ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ ya‸ kʼaw ceˍ lo law taˍ puiˉ leh, teˇ pawˆ pawˆ tcuh hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ behˇ kʼuˉ taˍ leh boˆ nu piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ leh,
Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ ca tuˉ tanˇ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Aˉ hkʼaw lo shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca tawˆ nyi la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve zuh‸ hpui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve hpa yuˬ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Muˉraˍ leh naˍmanˇ hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ teˇ geh kʼuˉ zuh‸ taˍ-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ chehˇ. Yawˇ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Yawˇ geh lo hpu htawˇ maˇ maˇ yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyiˇ shinˉ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ beˬ yuˬ leh yawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ tiˉ pehˍ kuiˬ lo sheh kʼai chehˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ leh, va hkʼaw lo‸-e chehˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, pehˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e chehˇ ve ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Chi hkʼe ve yaˇ miˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ taˇ beˬ gʼa piˇ lawˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh taˇ gʼa‸ kʼai.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ jaw peuˬ leh, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo huˉ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Na sheˍ. Cuˇ yiˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ htawˇ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo leh, ya‸ kʼaw ceh da‸ kuiˬ lo yawˇ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo htawˇ yawˇ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ puiˉ la sheˍ ve laˇ. Shiˍ puiˉ la tuˬ henˇ yuˬ loˬ. Nawˬ hui chaw kʼaˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve laˇ. Dawˇ nyi puiˉ la tuˬ henˇ yuˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve da‸ jaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ leh,
heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ leh, heˍ hkawˇ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw awˬ pon ngaˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ na sha leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw awˬ pon shiˍ sha jaˇ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hpu hta‸ ca ve a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh ca-o. Da‸ jaˇ ve shi a‸ kehˉ, shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ leh shehnˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ ca tehˆ da‸ maˇ gʼa.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ geh shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve lehˬ, haiˬ ve hta‸ canˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Caˆ muiˬve leh nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ leh heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kanˉ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ leh, gu taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ ga piˇ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teh puiˉ tuˬ ngaˬ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ ga piˇ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ca ve chaw htawˇ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ shu hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, hpu shi a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tiˉ te toˇ leh,
ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hta‸ paw sha la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ te hpanˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ paw la taˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ paw la taˍ peuˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ paw la taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ cawˬ la piˇ sheˍ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ maˇ tawˆ la piˇ sheˍ htaˇ,
laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ cawˬ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ Yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, teˇ nyi le le Yawˇ awˬ pon ha lehˬ tuˬhpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬyoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, te‸ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ca mawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw lehˬ, suh ve hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw suhˍ maˬ duˇ ti leh yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh hta‸ tiˇ leh hti caˇ hti dawˬ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ taˍ leh, hpui lawˇ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw mvuh jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai peu leh, chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ laˬ leh,
ngaˬ gu taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ ca caˇ ca dawˬ la-o.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Cuˇ yiˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai-o.
Caˆ muiˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Caˆ muiˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ maˍ piˇ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe ca te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ canˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ leuˉ leh cuˇ yiˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ hteˇ cawˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ nawˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ ve nyi ma gʼa cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ zuhˬ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve kʼo uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve kʼo, gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ nawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ma hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸, maˇ heˆ kʼo, mvuh ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo mui taˍ leh,
kanˉ te toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ laˬ-o‸.
Chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ htawˇ awˬ hkui cawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.
Chi ve lehˬSawˉla‸monˍ ve tawˇ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ ha lehˬpiˇ leh, haiˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ e hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw ca gʼa taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon te laˇ maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui loˍ ve mawˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ bawˬ ve kʼo gʼa haˍ gʼawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˉ te ve chaw lehˬ paw sha la tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu meh la ve teˇ yanˇ gʼeu‸ yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ yanˇ htaˇ zuh‸ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ faˉ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw hta‸ shu hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ shu leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, shu piˇ ve da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve chaw lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ shu hpeh yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ hkiˆ maˇ hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ yaw ve chaw lehˬ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ faˉ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, na sha ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼa gʼa ve cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
