Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ, paw sha paˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve hta‸ te ve pa taw gʼa ve awˬ bon lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ canˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw heˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shu ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ toˇ ve chaw htawˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ shaˬ yaw maˇ ve kʼo, shaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve kʼo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, da‸ ve hpu hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, shu awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ paw sha la ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve pa taw paw sha la ve maˇ heˆ.
Cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ ha lehˬ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ dawˇ kawˆ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ leh, haiˬve chaw hta‸ meuˆ chiˇ veu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Bawˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ kanˉ taˇ tcuh. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon ciˬ hkehˇ tuˬ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ awˬ pon mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ mvuhˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ suh yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ka‸ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ leh, ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬve chaw hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te ya‸ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve chaw lehˬ, tawˍ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, na sha ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ yaw ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tsuh tu yehˇ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve tsuh tu hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ maw maw awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw da‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ te ve maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ suh ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la htaˇ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw hta‸ hpeh‸ sha piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ ve chaw hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ, lawˇ hpaˍ uiˍ ve pa taw htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ htawˇ yawˇ geh teˇ geh suh-e ve yoˬ. Hpu shi hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw ceh tiˉ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui yaw ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui bon na‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ haiˬ ve chaw tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ hpeh‸ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ maˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ miˬ gawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ga shaiˍ tuˬ nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te taˍ ve kʼo leuˉ leh da‸ ve yoˬ.

Shiˍ puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ shu taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chehˇ maˇ puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ. Bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ hpu maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, coˇ caˇ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ paw sha la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ awˬ bon te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ naˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, la‸ shawnˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ tiˉ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kanˉ te ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, va‸ naˍ hkʼawˇ hta‸ tcuhˉ piˇ taˍ ve shi la‸ peˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ loˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬnyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hpu yehˇ maˇ jaˇve htawˇ, paw sha jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hpu shawˍ yehˇ puiˉ jaˇ ve htawˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Shu hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, shu nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Caˬ shiˍ shaw hpoˆ taˍ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ law chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ shu hpoˆ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˬ shiˍ yuˬ tawˆ leh hawˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ hui chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ da‸ ve kʼo, shu nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Shu luˬ kʼai tuˬ nawˬ te ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw lehˬ mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ htaˇ piˬ ce kʼai ve suhˆ hpa‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ htaˇ caˍ la chehˇ ve suhˆ hpa‸ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi te‸ chiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve lehˬ te‸ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ a sha‸ hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ shawnˍ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ shu maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Shu maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ canˇ ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ ve chaw hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ te laˇ maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ yeˬ chaweh huˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ yawˇ awˬ hpawˇ ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ te ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, awˬ mu‸ ku hkʼaw hpeh‸ tawˆ la chehˇ ve a naˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ heˍ caˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve tawˇ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve tawˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai leh, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ he‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, shu nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, shu nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ te caˇ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh hpeh‸ ve htawˇ meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ.

Kanˉ te kaiˬ ve muiˬ caˇ paˍ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi leh, awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ te shonˇ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ yeˬ chaweh huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve leh kanˉ te ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe la‸ shawnˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ te ve kanˉ cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, shu hta‸ haˆ haˆ hto piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ shu venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ lehˍ tawˇ yaw ve kʼo, cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Heˍ ve lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ dawˇ nyi leh yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ htaw hkʼa shuˍ shu hta‸ naˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ kʼaw‸ na-e la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Heˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ a sha‸ hta‸ ngeh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ ha lehˬ ve bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Heˍ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ gʼa shiˍ taˍ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ faˉ taˍ puiˉve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kanˉ te kaiˬ ve kʼo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ bawˬ ve kʼo shu ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ dawˇ haˍ puiˉ ve kʼo ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, na sha ve tawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw beˆ maˍ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ bawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ca chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ kanˉ te kaiˬ ve kʼo da‸ ve awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve lehˬ suh kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ nyi mawˬ puiˉ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ shu awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ-oˆ. Hkʼa deh‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh tawˇ yaw ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˉ te kaiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ heˍ ve hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ ya‸ taw tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ yaˇ hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ paw sha ve chaw hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ haˍ gʼawˇ yaˇ hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui paw sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ hpu shi maˇ maˇ gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ ca ho piˇ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ba chehˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ suh kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Shu geh dawˇ hkʼaˇ lawˬ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hpu hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ca gʼa ve kʼo, hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Hkeu‸ ve haˍ ve hkʼaw ca gʼa taˍ ve hpu lehˬ, nawˬ geh leuˉ leh chehˇ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ law tuˬ mehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, nyi ma htawˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve nyi ma htawˇ ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Shu da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ leh te-o. Nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, shu yawˆ yan ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ te sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, awˉ lawˉ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ tawˇ tcuh ve lehˬ, sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ na sha ve tawˇ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Maˇ henˇ yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Shu maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu taˍ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Heuˆ gaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ gʼa ve leh, hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le. Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ puiˉ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te-o. Nawˬ htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ htawˇ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, awˬ shinˉ teh taˉ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui geh gaˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Baˬ taˍ ve ti mi lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon caˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ kʼa hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ yehˬ kʼa hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ tawˇ maˇ ve pa taw ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ nyi leh yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ti mi mehˇ tuˬ nuˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nuˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ hkʼaw caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yonˍ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ heˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ gehˬ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ henˇ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw geh taˇ ca chehˇ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa, taw dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw luˬ paˍ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la maˇ gʼa ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ te ve htawˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ puiˉ. Ya‸hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve chaw lehˬ shu venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ htawˇ nawˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ geh gʼa ga ha lehˬ leh, gʼa ga dawˇ haˍ laˇ maˇ gʼa.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve yehˬ lehˬ, hai ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve yehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve htawˇ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo gaˬ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ tuˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ faˉ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ tuˬ mehˉ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve hkʼe da‸ ve awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yonˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Shaˍ ti‸ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hkui piˍ hta‸ nyi taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh te kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍve chaw lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ shiˍ maˇ la ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, gʼa lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ nyi gaˇ puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ awˬ chawˇ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Shu hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ da‸ ve kanˉ te ve kʼo, shu nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ya‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ kanˉ te kaiˬ ve kʼo nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ hu gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ mui taˍ leh tawˇ tiˉ maˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, haˍ gʼawˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ paw sha la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve awˬ meh gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ shu ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ heˍ hto ve kʼo shu hta‸ luˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve chaw lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ suh ve hta‸ ponˬ gaˇ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hta‸ nyi leh shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa.

Nawˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ puiˉ ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve shu hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve lehˬ awˬ to hta‸ chehˇ sha piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkawehˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ a naˍ diˬ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve chaw lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ awˬ lawn te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kanˉ te puiˉ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kanˉ maˇ te puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ nuˇ lehˬ yaw ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ na-e la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hehnˇ chaweh yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ leuˉ leh nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, shu cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yaw ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui da‸ ve hta‸ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hehnˇ chaweh yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ te mehˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ kʼaw‸ pehˬ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ oˇ hkʼe te maˇ gʼa.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ bon lawˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hui yuˬ laˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ Yawˇ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. A shu yawˇ te ya‸ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te faˉ taˍ gʼa tuˬ le.
Haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ maˇ te gaˇ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui geh ka‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ ca lawˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ve teˇ yanˇ gʼuiˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ yanˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ nawˍ tiˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ henˇ yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha lehˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, paw sha ve htawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw geh gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ cawˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve chaw hui geh shaˍ gʼa mui caˇ chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ te gʼa ve yoˬ.
Bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ htawˇ, haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaw ha lehˬ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Ca gʼa ve hkʼe da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ca-o. Nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca gʼa ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. A sha‸ suh piˇ lawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ maˇ kʼai.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, na sha ve tawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw hpu shi hta‸ ca ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ taˇ yuˬ caˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nawˬ a sha‸ ngeh tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬmaˇ yaw hkʼaw‸ sheˍ htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ la‸ haˉ yaw hkʼaw‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw yawˇ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ suhˍ lehˍ cawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Na sha ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ htawˇ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha piˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˍ piˇ sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Henˇ yuˬ gaˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Maˍ piˇ sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ ve lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ gʼa sheˍ htaˇ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te tawˆla piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ leh meuˇ lehˬ luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ leh hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ te chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ca gʼa taˍ ve maˇ jaˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ dawˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ gu taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh tawˇ yaw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suhˉ jehˬ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve deˇ deˇ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cawˇ ve tsuh tu leh tehˆ nyi tuˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ uˉ peunˍ paˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ suh-e puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ ve moˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve lehˬ hpu shi cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ jaw kʼai puiˉve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ leh nyi taˍ-o‸.
Caˆ muiˬ ve chaw lehˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw htawˇ nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, nyi ma uiˍ leh shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ caˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Shu maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Nawˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh uiˍ la peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸pa taw awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ shaˬ na sha ve kʼo, shaˬ na shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ la ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ awˬ pon a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ te shonˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw sheˍ htaˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yaw tawˆ la ve tawˇ lehˬ, shu awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Na sha ve tawˇ lehˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw mehˬ jaˇ leh, awˬ to awˬ pon awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te paˍ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve pa taw kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ maˇ gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law ve pa taw yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ ya‸ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ca puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ ca hkʼaiˉ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ ca te leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ heˍ caˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ maˍ laˇ leh mehˆ me‸ maˍ laˇ ve chaw hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸piˇ tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Uˉ hkeh mvuh hpu ve lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve shi uˉ tcuh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ uˉ peunˍ gʼaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, venˇ lonˉ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ tawˇ hte‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw lo hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hkʼeh‸ gʼa caˇ ve lehˬ, deˇ da‸ ya‸ da‸ ve hkʼaw lo hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ gʼa te leh, awˬ shinˉ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Hpu shi hta‸ aˬ miˬ hkʼaw lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Shu dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ nyi leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ hta‸ nyi leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ awˬ bon cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw puiˉ.
Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve lehˬ faˍ te ve hkʼe yoˬ, teh‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Shu te ya‸ laˇ ve hta‸ tawnˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ chawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ceh deˇ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ teˇ ha hkʼe jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ henˇ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te hkʼeh ve chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh suh ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yehˇ mehˉ kʼai ve yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ ve lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ tan maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ yuˬ baˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ pe‸ tawˆ la ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ jaˇ la sheˍ htaˇ haˆ haˆ hpehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpu piˇ leh chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ henˇ tcuh ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ da‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ loˍ htaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ ga da‸ ve kʼo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve htawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ le.
Te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ga shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ leh kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh, nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ chehˇ sha puiˉ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ suh kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ da‸ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ baˬ kuiˬ lo la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ maˇ jehˬ puiˉ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ bon cawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ dawˇ tuiˬ gaˇ tui‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ meuˉ caˇ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Da‸ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸yonˍ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ, tawˇ laiˉ hkawˇ maˇ yaw. Ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ maˇ yaw leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw, teh‸ shu dawˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ lawn ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ shiˍ ve, maˇ shiˍ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma cheuˬ ve shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ leh ya‸ taw tuˬ teˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve kʼo, shu kʼoˆ guiˇ gʼuiˬ guiˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe naˉ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hpawˇ chehˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve lehˬ maˇ cawˇ.
Shu geh tawˇ ca gʼawˬ da‸ ve chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ, shu jaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ awˬ hkui cawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma hehˆ dawˬ nyi gaˇ ve le.
Bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ te luˬ puiˉ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼai leh, gʼaˇ ca jehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve lanˇ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ puiˉ ve chaw maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ taˍ uiˍ piˇ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw lehˬ luˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ sheˍ htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ naˬ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ chehˇ sha la piˇ leh, nyi ma oˇ ve maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ law tuˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ henˇ yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hpuˇ da‸ gaˇ laˇ. La‸ shawnˍ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ kʼai piˇ ve kʼo, hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ mawˬ da‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉnanˉ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ peuˇ yaw ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve htawˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ yaw tuˬ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ka‸ na cawˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ shaˉ nanˉ lo laˬ leh tawˇ te da‸ la ve kʼo, mehˇ hkaˆ leh suhˉ jehˬ cheˆ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca ya‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ dawˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, luˬ kʼai tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ miˇ ma ca gʼa ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ pon dawˇ nyi piˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve maw maw maˇ yeˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi a‸ kehˉ ka ti‸ yeˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw luˬ paˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve htawˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Nyi ma ngeh ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw lehˬ awˬ chawˇ ca gʼa puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maw maw ha‸ shaˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw nawˬ tawˇ heˍ yaw ve kʼo, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu ka‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ awˬ chawˇ maˇ te gaˇ. Yawˇ awˬ chawˇ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh ca ve htawˇ, awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ leh hkʼa henˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ-o‸. Henˇ taˍ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw tawˇ hkʼa heˍ yaw ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa ponˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ ve chaw maˇ hpeh‸ la cawˇ. Awˬ ceˬ paˍ htawˇ chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ maˇ te cawˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve lehˬ, kuˬ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ bon te laˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Deˇ puiˉ hkanˬ puiˉ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ teˇ jaˆ peuˬ teˇ jaˆ ce la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e geh awˬ shinˉ laiˉ ceuˬ gʼa puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ yawˇ hta‸ cheuˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma ca piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Bawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼa meu‸ jehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Nawˬ maw maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ piˇ ngaˬ piˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ te tawˆ la ve hta‸ keunˍve hkʼe hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ga piˇ jaw ve kʼo, laiˉ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ ga piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ shu dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ ve hta‸ na leh henˇ yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ kanˉ hkʼaˇ laiˉ ceuˬ dawˇ nyi leh gu taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve ceh tiˉ biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Tuˬ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ heˍ puiˉ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o. Nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ bawˬ jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw caˇ tuˬ yuˬ keu ve ceh ka‸ maˇ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, shu deˇ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ henˇ yuˬ puiˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ leh ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te leh, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ henˇ kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼa shiˍ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na jaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tzuhˬ dawˬ maˇ ve lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw tcuh leh, chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ hta‸ kawˆ ve hkʼe, nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ca te ve chaw lehˬ suh hkʼaˇ ca ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ shu geh tawˇ ca gʼawˬ da‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ti mi mehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ ca bawˬ zuh‸ toˇ ve chaw lehˬ te‸ chiˉ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ yehˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca hkʼa nyi sheˍ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te puiˉ ve awˬ pa geh gʼa chehˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ la‸ haˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ aw laˇ. Yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ aw laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ maˇ cawˇ ve tsuh tu leh tehˆ nyi tuˬ hta‸ yehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ mawˬ puiˉ ve mehˆ shiˍ leh kaˇ puiˉ ve naˍ paw piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ zuh‸ ve tiˉ te chehˇ ve kʼo, haˍ gʼawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˉ te chehˇ ve kʼo caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mawˇ vuiˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ mawˇ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ, tiˉ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ sainˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ mawˇ vuiˬ ve awˬ lawn tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh ca yaw toˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve kʼo, hpu shi a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ nawˬ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ga shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ ca te ve kʼo, yawˇ geh cawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ yuˬ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ca gʼa taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ lehˬ, awˬ hkui cawˬ jaˇ ve htawˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ca-o. Nawˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ hkʼeun maˇ jiˇ sheˍ kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo taˇ kʼai.
Shu awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ faˉ taˍ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Tawˇ maˇ ve chaw awˬ paˇ lo taˇ ca chehˇ taˍ.
Awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hkeu ve chaw lehˬ, suh kʼai chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ kawˆ faiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ca gʼa ve hpu lehˬ, hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ mehˉ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Shu te ya‸ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ awˬ to taˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o. Yawˇ nyi leh te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ cawˇ ve tsuh tu leh tehˆ nyi tuˬ hta‸ yehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gu taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ maˇ te sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo nawˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh, ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to hkʼaw lo ca faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇ miˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve kʼo, kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui sheˉ lai leh, oˉ kʼoˍ hpu la peuˬ ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui yawˆ yan ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ, teˇ pawˆ pawˆ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ yawˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo kʼai piˇ gʼa ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ yuˬ hpfuhˆ piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇnawˇ-oˆ.
Cawˇ ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve a‸ kehˉ Yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma hkʼaw maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve nyi ma lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve hkʼaw kanˉ te ve kʼo, caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ te ve kʼo caˇ law‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ca gʼa taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ, teˇ hkui tiˉ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ suh kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te gaˇ puiˉ.
Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ kʼaw‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ maˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa taˆ mui taˍ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ ya‸ gaˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw shaˍ ti‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ gʼa henˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ kuˬ hawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve kʼo, baˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼawˇ piˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve kʼo, da‸ ve chaw ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw nyi ma luˬ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve hta‸ te hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hta‸ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ law nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh da‸ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ paw sha la piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Da‸ ve chaw hta‸ te luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ maˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ paw sha leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ hui ca gʼa taˍ ve hpu hta‸ haˆ haˆ yehˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan leh taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬpiˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ sho‸ sha‸ gaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸.
Nyi ma kʼaw‸ ve chaw ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nyi ma uiˍ ve, caˆ muiˬ ve, leh shu awˬ pon maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˉ te bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tiˉ dawˇ nyi chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ ga piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui yuˬ laˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ shu maˇ yonˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw yaw ve tawˇ hta‸ shu na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu yonˍ gʼa tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa coˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh maˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ lehˬshiˍ puiˉ ve htawˇ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ iˉ mvuhˇ maˇ maˇ ca gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ meh leh hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, da‸ ve awˬ meh hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.
Paw sha ve chaw leh haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ leh, jaw kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nawˬ paw sha ve, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ, leh co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ nawˬ ha‸ ve kʼo, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe a sha‸ te‸ cawˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ paw sha paˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shu geh hpu ca chiˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hpu chiˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ sheˍ ve kʼo, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yeˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ tuˬ pehˬ caˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nawˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw geh tawˆ kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve leh ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve nyi ma da‸ kehˬ leh na sha ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ tawˆ-e kʼo laˇ che‸ la, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ va hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ, va oˇ ve hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hko jaˇ leh, laiˉ ceuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw hui hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ te piˇ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nyiˉ caˇ leh paw sha la tuˬ te ve chaw lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Na taˍ sheˍ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ shaˍ. Yawˇ hui maˍ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va tcuh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ 30 hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ leh, da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ ca tcuh ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw leh shaˉ nanˉ lo suhˉ ca jehˬ la ve dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve taˇ te.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh tawˇ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ho piˇ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ kʼaw‸ ho piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ puiˉ, beu‸ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Nawˬ awˬ chawˇ te ve kʼo yawˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ la leh nawˬve nyi ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Shu ve jeˬ hta‸ gʼa ga shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ taˇ te.
Nawˬ gʼa ga shaiˍ piˇ maˇ gʼa kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve zuh‸ hpui hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi hui piˇ taˉ laˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ taˇ yuˬ jiˆ.
Da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve chaw ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, shu a‸ kehˉ da‸ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te keunˍ ve chaw ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw uiˍ geh caˇ tuˬ teˇ geh gʼa mui caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ a shu hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o.
Nawˬ lehˬ caˇ hkʼeh jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Yawˇ caˍ laˇ ve mehˬ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sheˉ lai jaˇ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Paw sha la tuˬ ve hta‸ uˉ hkeu‸ tcuhˉ leh taˇ gʼa‸ ca.
Nawˬ ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ naw‸ leh teˇ hkui tiˉ poˬ hpaw-e ve aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Tuˬ ve chaw geh awˍ taˇ mui caˇ. Yawˇ caˍ laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ sheˉ lai.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Awˍ caˇ la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na caˍ laˇ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ awˬ to htawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ caˇ keu taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpe‸ baˬ leh, nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ teˇhpaˍ htawˇ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ tuˬyoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ da‸ ve tawˇ taˇ ca yaw maˍ piˇ. Yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi hui piˇ taˉ laˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ taˇ yuˬ jiˆ. Yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ htawˇ taˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ suhˉ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Saˍla‸ teˇ hpaˍ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh hkʼa deh‸ henˇ yuˬ-o‸.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, yaˇ oˇ ve suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la ve kʼo ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬˬ
Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyi leh yawˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh nawˬ kʼai chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi-o.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ leh caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ zuh‸ caˇ ve tiˉ te chehˇ ve kʼo, maˇ maw maw tzuh‸ keu ve veu‸kʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa veu‸ deh tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa ve tawˇ hta‸na yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo nawˬ cawˬ la maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ ve awˬ e mawˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ, henˇ yuˬ ve, leh da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hawˇ baˬ ve maˇ te cawˇ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve awˬ pa lehˬ, ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ pa htawˇ, ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ pa nawˬ e lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ e hta‸ oˇ hkʼe ve ha lehˬ tuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬa sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Meh maˬ lanˉ leh awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, suh piˇ lawˬ gʼa ve va hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hta‸ law chehˇ leh, chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ peuˬ.
Tzuhˬ dawˬ maˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ haˍ hpeh‸ bawˬ leh shu hta‸ ca ya‸ toˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyiˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh, awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Tzuhˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ awˬ sheuˉ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha ve htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ taˇ beˬ gʼa piˇ lawˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve kʼo, tzuhˬ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ vuiˬ htawˆ ve hkʼe naˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa deh‸ ngaˉ maˇ gaˬ leh, hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi maˇ gʼa. Tawˇ ka‸ yaw maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ te toˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼoˆ taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te chehˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu ngaˬ hta‸ dawˆ laˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ jawˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ maˇ nawˇ la ve le. Ngaˬ tzuhˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ dawˬ gaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh yawˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ ca ya‸ tuˬ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ pa taw cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ da‸ jaˇ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ maˇ ca bawˆ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gʼa gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ shaˬ gʼa maˇ ve kʼo, shaˬ gʼaˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ na maˇ gʼa puiˉ. Shu awˬ lawn uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ jehˬ da‸ htaˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve kʼo, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw hta‸ shu canˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ nyi ma luˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo suhˉ taˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬve chaw hta‸ haˆ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Kanˉ chi ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ chehˇ mawˬ chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ te taˍ ve hkʼe la‸ shawnˍ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ caˇ-oˆ. Pehˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha tehˍ hkʼoˆ lo pehˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ mehˬ jaˇ ve hkʼe,
cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ co ha awˬ pon da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca-o. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ luˬ yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve haiˬ ve chaw hkʼe nawˬ taˇ te.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ paiˍ ve htawˇ, kʼaw‸ tu la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, taˇ ha lehˬ. Yawˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ ve teˇ yanˇ htawˇ, nawˬ taˇ ha lehˬ.
Nawˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Yawˇ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ naˍ, maˇ shiˍ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ taˇ dawˇ haˍ tcuh piˇ lawˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma ka‸ taˇ cawˬ piˇ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ taˍ ui ta mvuh-o. Yawˇ hui hta‸kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkui ceh tiˉ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ puiˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ aw laˇ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ paˍ hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ canˇ leh hkeu ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬ meh da‸ leh uiˍ la mvuh la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ti mi maˇ te gʼa sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ taˇ te.
Shaˉ hkiˆ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ. Shu hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ taˇ hkanˍ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ shaˍ, teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw bawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai taˉ peuˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo zuhˇ mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hko ko taˍ ve htawˇ paˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ leh dawˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh pehˉ leh hkʼa deh‸ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸.
Nawˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ geh gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw bvuh‸ yuˬ taˍ ve Sawˉla‸monˍ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ faˉ taˍ gʼa ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuh leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ naˉ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa‸ maˇ mi taˬ.
Hpu hta‸ lawˍ ve kʼo da‸ jaˇ ve hpu hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ chehˇ ve kʼo, chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ caˆ muiˬ ve hkʼaw tawˇ yaw ve taˇ te.
Da‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo mui tcuh laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ mui taˍ ve mui hkʼawˇ awˬ nu ve chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ shaˉ nanˉ lo haˆ taˇ ca gʼuiˇ hto piˇ. Nawˬ a‸ kehˉ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ca kʼaw‸ hto gaˬ la leh, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ heˆ ve kʼo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le.
Nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ leh shu ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve kʼo, cawˇ da‸ tuˬ haˆ haˆ te-o. Faˉ taˍ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ shu hta‸ taˇ hto piˇ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shu shiˍ la leh nawˬ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve lehˬ, hpu hkʼeun hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve shi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Na yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve shi la‸ peˍ leh shehnˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ va gʼa ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ cha chiˆ htaˇ gʼa dawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve htawˇ maˇ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ shiˍ ce la piˇ maˇ gʼa ve moˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw ve lehˬ, heh jaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ nuˇ la piˇ leh, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ na sha piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ loˍ ve a‸ kehˉ taˇ caˇ. Caˇ maˇ kʼo hpe‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ paˇ nawˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hui geh teˇ hkui teˇ hkui taˇ ca guiˇ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi bawˬ leh canˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve lehˬ, aˉ hte‸ leh hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve lehˬ, ciˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw awˍ caˇ ve, leh hkui luˬ paˍ ya‸ kʼaw toˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma maˇ sha ve chaw hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ htaˇ shu ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ piˇ ve, leh hkʼaw taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw aˉ leh‸ cu keu piˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ awˍ meu‸ ve kʼo caˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve kʼo taw piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ haw leh Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw meuˆ laˬ kʼo mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ ve hkʼe, teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve kʼo nyi ma gʼa zuhˆ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ maˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma geh yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo ca taˆ mui taˍ ve lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Vuiˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la ve da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ chehˇ htaˇ gawˬ lehˍ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ kawˆ gʼa dawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, kuiˇ nuˬ ve nanˬ bawˍ leh, tiˬ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Pehˇ gʼuiˬ caˇ maˇ ve kʼo maˇ da‸. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ca ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ maˇ cawˬ ve venˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ chiˇmvuh piˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ ciˍ gʼuiˬ kʼa ve, leh caˬ gʼeu‸ htaˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ ve hkʼe hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw hta‸ te‸ chiˉ luˬ tuˬ te piˇ maˇ gʼa. Poˬ caw toˇ leh teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ ca mui ve ngaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ gʼa jaw‸ maˍ piˇ leh, piˉlaˬ hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh gʼa hpeh piˇ ve hkʼe, chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ gʼa jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ na nyi laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa shuˍ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, na nyi shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ tawˇ tcuh ve kʼo, nawˬ ve hkui sheh hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ yehˇ gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼe, chaw luˬ paˍ htawˇ tawˇ naˉ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw gʼa chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve lehˬ hawˉ ma hkʼaw keu bawˆ tuˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca gʼawˆkʼaoˍ toˇ ve chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ, la‸ sheh hta‸ aˉ chuˇ piˉ chehˇ ve tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ kanˉ te tcuh ve chaw lehˬ, chaw chi ma ve hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te ya‸ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ lehˬ, hpuiˇ hpe‸ baˬ taˍ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hkʼe te ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw bawˬ ve chaw lehˬ yehˬ baˬ lo maˇ tawˆ-e gaˬ ve le. Laˇ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw laˇ.
Chaw bawˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw tiˉ hpfuhˆ zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ hkʼa shuˍ teˇ kaˬ lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ bawˬ jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw caˇ tuˬ yuˬ keu tuˬve ceh ka‸ maˇ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw bawˬ paˍ lehˬ shu hta‸ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ gʼa ve chaw suhˍ gʼaˇ a‸ kehˉ cheuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ca dawˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn ca gʼawˬ da‸ ve chaw lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hpuiˇ naˍ paw hta‸ ca yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shu hta‸ ca baˇ guiˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ kʼa guiˇ chehˇ ve chaw gʼuˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ maˇ cawˬ kʼo aˬ miˍ suh-e ve yoˬ. Shu awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ toˇ ve maˇ cawˬ kʼo, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Shiˉgʼeu‸ leh suhˆ lehˬ aˬ miˬ hta‸ to‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe, sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te ve chaw htawˇ, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve hta‸ te tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ toˇ ve lehˬ awˬ hkui cawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma hehˆ dawˬ nyi gaˇ ve le.
Heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo na sha ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ shehˆ taˍ ve suhˆ tcuhˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ na sha ve tawˇ yaw leh shu hta‸ canˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ na sha ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ taˇ yonˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw canˇ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma oˇ ve hta‸yawˇ faˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ te tawˆ la ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ va ca htaw toˇ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Shu hta‸ haˉ pui hpfuhˆ teˍ ve chaw lehˬ, haˉ pui ce teˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heˍ caˇ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ canˇ ve nyi ma gʼa cawˬ ve yoˬ. Heˍ ve tawˇ lehˬ luˬ tuˬ sheˆ tuˬ ceh tiˉ te tawˆ la gʼa ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon nyi ma taˇ uiˍ. Ya‸ nyi leh shawˉ pawˍ awˬ kaˍ lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ taˇ chiˇ mvuh.
Haˉ pui shiˍ leh shehˉ shiˍ ve naˬ naˆ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui te tawˆ la ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼe taw naˬ naˆ maˇ hehnˇ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, haiˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve htawˇ shu hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma hkʼe taw kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ.
Te ya‸ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ leh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, deˇ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ dawˆ hpehˇ laˇ ve lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ boˆ nu laˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˍ caˇ bvuhˆ taˍ ve kʼo, pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ka‸ jaw kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ meu‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ htawˇ mehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ hpui teh hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai ve ngaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve naˍmanˇ hawnˉ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ pe‸ hkoˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ leh nawˬ pa ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ leunˇ kʼai piˇ. Nawˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi hta‸ taˇ ca gʼaˇ va. Nawˬ paˇ nawˬ kui lo chehˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh la piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo ngaˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ ca ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh, jaw kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ caˉ kʼai leh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve jeˬ hta‸ ga shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ ca te ve maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tu leh a shu yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh tawˇ kuˬ yaw piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ maˇ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, teˇ jaˆ peuˬ teˇ jaˆ ce la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh ta‸ iˉ chehˇ tcuh piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ jehˇ tcuh taˍ gʼa aw laˇ. Naˍmanˇ hta‸ la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ tiˍ taˍ gʼa aw laˇ.
Sho hta‸ yehˇ leh sho hta‸ tcuhˆ la tuˬ shiˍ ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ geh teˇ gʼaˇ henˇ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve kʼo, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ ceˬ lehˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw nawˬ nyi leh gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ han lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ han hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ to hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve sheˉ lai puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw hkʼaˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon ka‸ chehˇ kuiˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ lehˬ hpu leh shi hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ liˇawˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ lawˇ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ suh law‸ law‸ dawˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve haiˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ ve nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ co co maˇ yeˬ.
Zuhˇ hta‸ gʼeu‸ yuˬ ve htawˇ, hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yawˬ hta‸ awˬ mvuh nuˆ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ te veu‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve aˉ che‸ hta‸ hawˇ leh, miˬguiˬ vuiˬ ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˉ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa‸ yuˬ ve htawˇ, gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ taˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la yeˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, caˬ yeˬ hta‸ te luˬ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, haiˬ ve chaw hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, paw sha jaˇ ve htawˇ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yaˇ nehˬ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬpiˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ nyiˉ caˇ leh paw sha la ve chaw hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve mawˇ jeˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha canˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ca beˬ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ te tcuh ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ la‸ shawnˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Paw sha ve chaw lehˬ yawˇ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ca dawˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ da‸ ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ leuˉ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ la uiˍ la kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma heh ve kʼo, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼaˇ va kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ haiˬve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maw maw gʼa uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ haˆ haˆ duˇ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ taˇ tawˍ taˍ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te-o. Nawˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˉ te kaiˬ ve chaw lehˬ caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ yehˇ baˬ ve chaw lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˆ haˆ paw sha la tuˬ te ve chaw lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ hpfuhˇ nyi ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ da‸. Suhˉ jehˬ paˍ lehˬ, i jaˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ ceh ka‸ nyi leh kanˉ te ya‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to pon ceh dawˇnyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ haˆ haˆ paw sha la tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ ca puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa haˍ gʼa gʼawˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ mawˬ puiˉ.
Maˍ piˇ tuˬ loˍ ve chaw hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬleuˉ leh da‸ ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ pa awˬ e ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ leh te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve chaw lehˬ chaw hkʼawˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to pon tiˉ ca ve chaw lehˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh a sha‸ te‸ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui maˍ laˇ ve hkʼe te kʼai cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ haˍ kuiˬ gʼawˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ ga piˇ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ shu hpoˆ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ce kʼai peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu laiˉ pawˆ maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma heh leh maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, teˇ nyi kʼo gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw uˉ peunˍve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pa hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Meh maˬlanˉ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh hpu hkʼe leˇ yehˇ baˬ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ yaˇ miˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hpu hta‸ ha‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ va htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Shu awˬ pon maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ shaˉnanˉ lo tawˇ ca te da‸ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ leh shu hta‸ deˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hta‸yonˍ leh na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ maw maw gʼa uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ awˬ pon da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe leˇ hpehˇ baˬ taˍ ve kʼo, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ce kʼai ve hta‸ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yaˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha maˇ uˉ peunˍ ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ ca ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw leh maˍ piˇ ve ceh te ve lehˬ maˇ law‸ taˬ. Yawˇ na gʼa ve ka‸ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh tawˇ yaw ve chaw a‸ kehˉ dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ hkʼa lawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ maw maw yawˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma haˆ haˆ zuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ tuˬ maˇ maˇ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw lehˬ, paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw lehˬ, shu chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw hteˇ lehˍ hto ve kʼo ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ lehˍ maˇ hto ve kʼo Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve va hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hteˇ lehˍ te laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha geh ceh tiˉ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw htawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yaˍkenˍ ve yaˇ Aˍguˇraˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ geh maˇ chehˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ geh cawˬ cawˇ ve nyi ma ngaˬ geh maˇ cawˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ henˇ jaw. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ lawn ka‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ a shu shiˍ le. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ a shu yuˬ tiˍ taˍ gʼa le. Iˉ kaˆ hta‸ hpa awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yuˬ htiˆ taˍ gʼa le. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ a shu miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ piˇ gʼa le. Oˇ hkʼe te gʼa ve chaw a shu le. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ a shu le.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ gʼa te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ chaw heˍ paˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬmaˇ suh sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍnawˬ geh nyiˇ ceuˬ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
