Heˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ baˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve ka‸, paw sha jaˇ ve chaw ka‸ taˇ hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ loˍ cawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ ceh pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ cawˬ maˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ loˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ la tuˬ yoˬ Ngaˬ haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve kʼo, shu ve mawˇ ca hkʼawˇ leh nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇmaˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ taˇ ca hto piˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo nawˬ lehˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ hkeu leh, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ jaˇ peuˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nyiˉ caˇ baˆ caˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te leh a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ve‸ geh lo awˬ yehˇ nyiˇ hkeh cawˬve yoˬ. Oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ Pe‸ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ awˬ meh meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ, goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ leh shiˉ pehˍ maˇ gʼa ve aˬ miˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ mawˇ la peuˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ htawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ htawˆ caˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ hkanˍ keunˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ shiˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
mvuhˇ hpe lo aˉ ceˬ poˬ toˇ ve, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo vuiˬ te toˇ ve, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw haw lo‸ kʼoˍ te toˇ ve leh chaw haˉ yaˇ miˇ haˉ ha‸ da‸ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ iˉ kaˆ hehˉ sheˍ leh, Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te ya‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
awˬ ceˬ paˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la ve chaw luˬ paˍ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve
haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ awˬ hpawˇ heuˆ ve leh awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ ma hpeh‸ la ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ to shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh la‸ lehnˉ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ ceuˬ lehˬ,
awˬ gʼaˇ i jaˇ ve htawˇ mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ htaˇ caˇ tuˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ puiˉ ve piˉ gʼawˆ,
awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ uiˍ ve htawˇ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpui ca te chehˇ puiˉ ve faˆ cha‸,
jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ awˬ moˍ lonˉ te chehˇ hkawˇ shiˍ ve paˉ ce‸,
la‸ sheh hkʼaw yuˬ taˍ gʼa ve htawˇ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ puiˉ ve pfuhˍ tehˉ kʼehˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ ceuˬ lehˬ,
a shu hta‸ ka‸ maˇ kawˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ
aˉ che‸, gʼaˆ hpfuh kʼaˍ leh, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve kʼo, jehˇ taˍ leh dawˇ nyi sheˍ.
Nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ ve kʼo awˬ diˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Shu ve naˍ hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca dawˇ heuˆ ve kʼo suhˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ ve kʼo, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Leˍmoeˍlaˆ ve awˬ e yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ bon lawˬ leh gʼa taˍ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ le.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh nawˬ ve hpu hta‸ hkʼe leˇ taˇ yehˇ baˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Leˍmoeˍlaˆ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ hta‸ maˇ dawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tzuhˬ dawˬ ve kʼo awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tzuhˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ suh la paˇ neˇ ve chaw leh, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tuiˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ tzuhˬ taw piˇ ve kʼo yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ yaw maˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpawˇ chehˇ leh tawˇ ga yaw piˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ tui‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ pon tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ.
Kaiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ca haˍ jaˇ ve le. Chi hkʼe ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ shehnˉ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ leh, yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ haˍ gʼawˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ da‸ ve kanˉ tiˉ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hpa te chiˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kanˉ hkeu‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ tawˆ-e leh caˇ tu‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ tu leh, yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ gu ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kanˉ pehˬ piˇ leh te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ ca nyi vuiˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve hpu hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ kaiˬ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ leh, mehˆ muiˉ naˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ kanˉ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ shaˉ laˇ miˬ te leh yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hpa te chiˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tanˇ piˇ ga piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Vaˇ meu-e kʼa ve htawˇ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ pon aˉ po‸ lehˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼawˇ zuh‸ hpui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ htawˇ awˬ meh cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, venˇ hkʼaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hpa leh haˍ pi caˆ teˇ hpaˍ te leh, tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hta‸ hawˉ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh shu yawˆ yan ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ.
Yawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ kanˉ te kaiˬ jaˇ leh, yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve hkʼe nyi piˇ ga piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ da‸ ve yehˬ shehˍ ma hpeh‸ ve ka‸, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh cheuˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ heˍ puiˉ leh luˬ kʼai mehˉ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ chiˇ mvuh keunˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, kanˉ te hkeu‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon gʼa le.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la taˉ leh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw htawˇ, awˬ hawˉ awˬ na htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te meuˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ maˬ le le laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ biˇ sheˆ. Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼaw‸ lo‸ la leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve lehˬ ca kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ heuˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma nyi ve htawˇ nyi maˇ bvuhˆ puiˉ. Ngaˬ hui ve naˍ paw htawˇ, hkʼaˬ ma gʼa kaˇ ve ka‸ kaˇ maˇ bvuhˆ puiˉ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hpeh‸ la jaw taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼo lo awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Nyi sheˍ. Choˬ kaˬ lo awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ la jaw taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hpeh‸ la jaw taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ-o. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ nyi hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kʼaw‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ yuˬ hteˇ maˇ gʼa. Maˇ cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼaw nyi maˇ gʼa.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hkʼa uˉ peunˍ taˉ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe peun da‸ ve hta‸ henˇ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍpeuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te nyi ve ka‸, mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ cuˇ yiˍ shaˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, shaˬ nawˬ geh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ shaˬ shiˍ maˇ ve kʼo, shaˬ nyi ma naˬ kuiˬ cawˬ maˇ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te piˇ leh, ha lehˬ ve kʼoˆ ve aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi hkʼe te nyi ve htawˇ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ leh, ha lehˬtuˬ awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon te laˇ maˇ gʼa ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ ngaˬ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, chi ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw yoˬ hehˉ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ pon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nyi sha ve hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, iˉ shiˍ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ ti keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hko oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆpfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼui po teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ maˇ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ lehˬ ceˇ caˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shaw gʼa taˍ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa maˍ laˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ geh awˬ miˇ ma i hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yoˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬtuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ gʼa keunˍ ve awˬ bon la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ daw nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ leh meuˇ kʼo, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn leh chaw kʼaˍ chaw buiˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ shiˍ peuˬ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve hkʼe, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ chaw kʼaˍ chaw buiˬ hpeh‸ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw luˬ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi kʼo chaw luˬ paˍ gʼa suh tuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ htawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ chi taw taw uiˍ ve htawˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Awˬ bon te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw‸ dawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ nyi kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shu leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw luˬ paˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ tuˬ ve ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ leh ngaˬ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ naˍ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ naˍ, a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi leh nyi ma luˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve htawˇ, kanˉ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ te taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ gʼa teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, cawˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ.
Nawˬ kanˉ chi taw taw te hkeu‸ taˍ ve aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.

Nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh oˉ kʼoˍ naˬ tuˬ ceh tiˉ gaˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ htawˇ, nawˬ ve nyi ma gawˬ lehˍ maˇ gʼa jehˇ chehˇ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.

Chaw yaˇ te keunˍ te cawˇ jaˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ ve caˇ tuˬ chi hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma, leh ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ,venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ paw sha la ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon da‸ ve cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh suh tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ, ti ve awˬ awˬ yanˇ leh gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ,
tiˇ pehˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼaw‸ gu na-e piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ, te luˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼaw‸ gu te ve awˬ yanˇ,
hawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh gʼuiˬ ve awˬ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve awˬ yanˇ,
awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ teˇ geh awˬ chawˇ muiˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ, leh awˬ chawˇ maˇ gʼa muiˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ, boˆ nu da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ leh maˇ gʼa boˆ nu da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ,
ca mawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh mehˉ kʼai ve awˬ yanˇ, shaw hpoˆ ve awˬ yanˇ leh gʼawˆ baˬ ve awˬ yanˇ,
tzuh‸ suhˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼaw‸ gu nehˉ ve awˬ yanˇ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ, leh tawˇ yaw tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ,
ha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ leh canˇ ve awˬ yanˇ, ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ yanˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ yanˇ, teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve pa taw, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon gʼa le.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ teh taˍ peuˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hkʼa te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ tcuh laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui te keunˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ leh, te gʼa ve hkʼe da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ca gʼa ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ shawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ htehˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te maˇ gʼa. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ la tuˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ hkʼa hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ sheˍ. Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ cawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo htawˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ maˇ peun da‸ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ka‸ gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve deˇ deˇ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ je‸ meu-e hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui je‸ meu-e hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve hkʼe, je‸ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve co ha mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ ve co ha miˬguiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ, teh‸ a shu kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui te keunˍve kanˉ lehˬ, yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te gʼa ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu kanˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ca ga piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇhpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui geh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Suh kʼai mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw te hpaˍ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve chaw hui a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ paw la jaw leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw sha la tuˬ, aˬhto‸ ma pa taw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ cawˬ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˍ meu‸ suh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh pehˉ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw gʼuˇ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Cawˇ ka‸ cawˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˇ tuˬ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve htawˇ nyi ma gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ zuh‸ maˇ gʼuˇ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te leh, mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ lawn teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ nyi hkaˇ maˇ suhˍ sheˍ leh, kanˉgʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ ca leh, a shu awˬ pon chi taw taw hkeu‸ ve hta‸ hkanˍ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve le. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ leh, ha lehˬ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ geh chehˇ leh kanˉ te ve lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ te ve a‸ kehˉ awˬ bon tawˆ la maˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ gʼaˇ paiˍ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ paiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kaˆ jaˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ chawˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ teˇ geh zuh‸ leh a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ lehˬ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te lehˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, canˇ paˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼo‸ hkeh shehˆ caˆ yuˬ vaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh lehˬ, hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ maˇ cheˆ kʼai puiˉ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yaˇ nehˬ lehˬ, shu dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve yaˇ nehˬ lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, htawnˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh jawˇmawˇ lonˉ gʼa te puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ kaˬ kaˬ lo lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ chi hkʼe ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼaˬ ma hta‸ ceh gʼa uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ te taˉ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˉ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸. Henˇ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ pon kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, cawˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ maˇ gʼa ve chaw luˬ paˍ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw sheˍ htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ka ti‸ taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ lehˬmiˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ kʼoˆ keunˍ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve tawˇ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh taˇ kʼoˆ.
Nawˬ shaˬ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ ve kʼo shaˬ maˇ da‸ ve zuh‸ maˆ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ tawˇ shaˬ yaw ve kʼo shaˬ yaw ya‸ maˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te taˍ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍ leh, biˇ la tuˬ haˆ haˆ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.
Ka ti‸ maˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, ka ti‸ te taˍ leh maˇ gʼa‸ te ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ ce lo‸-e piˇ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, te maˇ gʼa taˬ law, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hta‸ taˇ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ca te ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ tcuh ve le.
Nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ hkʼaˬ ma maˆ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ hkʼaˬ ma yaw leh awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ ma te chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kawˆ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍchehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, haˍ yaˇ gawˇ yaˇ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo taˇ anˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo kanˉ te chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ htawˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ awˬ to htawˇ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpu hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh puiˉ. Paw sha la gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼa heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ shaˬ paw sha kʼo shaˬ tawˆ-e kuiˬ maˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, paw sha ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.

Kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, caˇ law‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, caˇ maˇ law‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, zuh‸ mehˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ, zuh‸ maˇ mehˬ. Hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hpeh‸ bawˬ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, loˍ la htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpu hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kanˉ te ya‸ ve pa taw hkʼa peu-eˬ shonˇ kʼai leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ piˇ taˉ tuˬ hpu teˇ peh‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ ngaˬ hui lo‸ la htaˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ yuˬ laˬve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai htaˇ htawˇ, oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ yuˬ kʼai maˇ gʼa.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve lehˬ dawˇ nyi tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui laˬ ve hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te leh mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve, dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ ve, nyi ma zuhˆ ve, leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ chi hkʼe dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ tcuh piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, a sha‸ hkʼaˬ ma ngeh jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ te piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh yawˇ hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ ha lehˬ tcuh piˇ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ tan ha lehˬ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, cawˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ cawˬ leh co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa maˇ gʼa chehˇ leh hpuiˇ suh va‸ suh ve hkʼe gʼa te suh-e ve kʼo, paw la htaˇ ka‸ suh-e ve yaˇ ehˉ lehˬ, yawˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ bon maˇ da‸. Naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw mehˉ kʼai leh shu leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ maˇmawˬ jaw. A sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ nyiˇ hinˉ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh te‸chiˉ ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ gawˬ lehˍ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ teˇ kaˬ lo tiˉ gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ caˇ maˇ law‸.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ a‸ kehˉ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ leuˉ ve le. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, ti‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, heuˆ gaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ tawˇ shaˬ gʼawˬ da‸ kʼo shaˬ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ yaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.

Chaw yaˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve ngeh jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ awˬ pon da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ le. Yawˇ suh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ le.
Da‸ ve awˬ meh cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ suh ve awˬ nyi lehˬ, nawˬ paw la ve awˬ nyi a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Chaw suh taˍ ve yehˬ lo kʼai ve lehˬ, pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo kʼai ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ teˇ nyi kʼo gʼa suh tuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ gʼuiˬ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ mehˆ hpfuhˇ maˇ da‸ ve htawˇ, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi leh ca chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, suh ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ ve lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh laˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve gʼuiˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ chaw luˬ paˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ ve awˬ yanˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Yeunˇ hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma haˆ haˆ taˇ zuhˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chi beu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve le, teh‸ taˇ ca na nyi toˇ. Chi ve lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ maˇ heˆ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo hpu hta‸ yehˇ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh awˬ bon piˇ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha yuˬ kʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ a shu yuˬ hteˇ piˇ gʼa tuˬ le.

Nawˬ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼo, gaˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ.

Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼaw, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suh puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, da‸ jaˇ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw taˇ hpeh‸ gaˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve le.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ jaˇ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo kʼaˍ jaˇ ve chaw ka‸ taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw suh yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ suh gaˇ ve le.
Chi ve nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ awˬ ponˬ awˬ leuˉ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve kʼo uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇ 10 venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸ jaw ve chaw miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hkʼa kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ taˇ na. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ to ka‸ shu hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ jaw peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ lawˇ nyi te nyi taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ca shiˍ maˇ peuˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ le. Tawˇ chi lehˬ naˉ jaˇ leh, shiˍ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ to coˇ caˇ leh cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca leh, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ leh ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ a‸ kehˉ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve hkʼaw, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa‸ ca ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ ca maˇ mawˬ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˆ yan keunˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ miˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.

Awˬ leh meuˇ ngaˬ chi hkʼe shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw te‸ chehˇ tuˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ a loˍ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai leh cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw ceh tiˉ, cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ ka ti‸ taˇ te.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai-o. Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi hkʼe ve hkʼaw taˇ ca chehˇ taˍ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh kanˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ te tuˬ da‸ ve cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui shiˍ maˇ gaˬ.
Laˬ tuˬ ve aw yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. A shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa le.

A shu teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ te gʼa le. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ suh tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ yuˬ jiˆ hpeh‸ le. Chi lehˬ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ hui gʼa bawˆ da‸ tuˬ ve ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui heˍ ponˬ maˇ gʼa.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi htaˇ, chi hkʼe gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ leh teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh leh shu yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tuˍ hpfuh lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ te taˉ ve kanˉ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui te ya‸ chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ la‸ haˉ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ teˇ ha pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve htawˇ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ chehˇ ve kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ ve lehˬ, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, a sha‸ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ka‸ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kawˆ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Teˇ paw ˆpawˆ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw awˬ tan ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw gʼa keunˍ ve la‸ shawn hta‸ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ awˬ pon ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe te chehˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ coˇ caˇ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˇ taˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh ca ve htawˇ, ca maˇ mawˬ taˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ yawˇ hui shiˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, te‸ chiˉ peun da‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw, da‸ ve chaw leh maˇ da‸ve chaw, bon hpawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh maˇ cawˬve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw leh maˇ pui ve chaw, chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkanˍ taˍ ve chaw htawˇ, maˇ hkanˍ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve htawˇ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suh taˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ a‸ kehˉ te‸ chehˇ ve hpuiˇ lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suh peuˬ ve chaw lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ shu leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve ha‸ puiˉ ve, canˇ puiˉ ve leh sheˉ lai puiˉ ve nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui geh suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸-o.
Ha lehˬ ha kʼa te leh, a shu yawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, nawˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ miˇ ma lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve da‸ jaˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ leh te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ kʼai chehˇ ve suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te ve, dawˇ nyi ve leh cuˇ yiˍ henˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ pawˆ le le la‸ shawnˍ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ pawˆ le le ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ caˇ law‸ dawˬ law‸ cawˬ leh paw sha chehˇ ve maˇheˆ. Dawˇ puiˉ keu‸ puiˉ ve chaw htawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ yawˇ hui ka‸ bon maˇ da‸ hpeh‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ. Va hta‸ yaw ve ngaˆ leh, geu‸ hkʼaw geh ve ngaˇ hkʼe, maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hui htawˇ va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ ehˉ teˇ venˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw ka‸ tcuhˇ tcuhˬ maˇ chehˇ maˇ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ,venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca hoˆ bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw haˍ gʼawˇ ve htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ chi hta‸ pon piˇ tuˬ te gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ awˬ lawn ma dawˇ nyi.

Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hui hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ kuiˬ lo jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kuˬ heuˉ ve tawˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ la‸ caˉ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh awˬ bon te tawˆ la gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve iˉ shiˍ lehˬ da‸ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Suh peuˬ ve puiˉ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ teˇ kaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuiˇ nuˬ kʼai piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. A ciˉ ceh te ya‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ceh nyi ve ka‸, yawˇ chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ kanˉ hkʼaw tawˆ-e gaˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ taˇ kʼoˆ piˇ. Nawˬ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ yuˬ uiˍ yuˬ mvuh piˇ leh, paw sha ve chaw hui hta‸ shawˍ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ toˇ chehˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui ya‸ kʼaw juˇ toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ ve kʼo, miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh lo‸-e ve kʼo vuiˬ htawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ haˉ pui duˇ tawˆ ve kʼo haˉ pui pu teˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ suhˆ jeˆ ve kʼo ceˉ ceˇ htawˆ heuˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ceˉ ceˇmaˇ tcuhˆ leh nawˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ gu shiˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ kanˉ te ve awˬ gʼaˇ peuˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ na‸ ka‸ gu taˍ ve kʼo awˬ bon cawˬ maˇ ve yoˬ.
Vuiˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa htawˆ peuˬ ve kʼo nawˬ shaˉ hkʼaˬ ma shiˍ ka‸ hkʼe leˇ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw luˬ paˍ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ te leh awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ maˇ gʼa.
A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw ca maˇ gʼa ve chaw luˬ paˍ lehˬ, hkeu‸ leh gʼaˇ heuˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
A sha‸ iˍ sheˍ ve jawˇmawˇ leh teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ caˇ puiˉ dawˬ puiˉ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu beh tuˬ bawˬ jaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ yeˬ jaˆ teˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, maˇ maw maw yehˬ oˇ ve paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hpu maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa maˇ hpeh‸.
Baˬ kuiˬ lo jawˇmawˇ hta‸ taˇ hkʼawˇ deˇ. Nawˬ ve zuh‸ kuiˬ bawehˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh paw sha ve chaw hta‸ taˇ hkʼawˇ deˇ. Nawˬ hkʼawˇ deˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˆ ehˉ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo nawˬ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ka‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ loˍ cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo paiˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ paiˍ kuiˬ lo cawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ hoˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ ceh nawˬ law chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ gʼa ti gʼa gʼeu‸ taˉ tuˬ ve ma heˆ.

Mvuhˇ haw te toˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ e gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw ve yaˇ ehˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe a sha‸ te‸ la ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ ti keu-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hkʼa ti taˍ ve awˬ yawˇ teˇ yawˇ le le yeˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Nawˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ maw jaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw gʼa zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leuˉ leh maw jaˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ dawˇ law leh chiˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.

Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yaˇ nehˬ gʼa hpeh‸ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-oˆ. A shu yawˇ te gaˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, naˬ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yaˇ nehˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ chehˇ maˇ pi-awˍ ve haiˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.
Nawˬ a sha‸ mawˇ la leh, mvuh nyi, ha pa, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ pon awˬ gʼeuˆ nuˇ kʼai ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la htaˇ, nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ ve hkui sheh htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼeh‸ peuˬ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve naˍ paw htawˇ pawˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Shu caˬ teˍ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ kaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ ngaˆ kuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ, nawˬ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mvuh ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ya‸ kʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hpu kʼai leh, yaˇ miˇ geh zuh‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ leh meuˇ ve gʼa jehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yoˬ, nawˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hpu caˆ cheˆ kʼai leh shi kawˆ faiˇ hkoˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nanˬbawˍ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ nyiˉ chehˇ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh cheˆ kʼai leh je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkoˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ to je‸ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, nawˬ ve co ha lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hkʼa shiˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, cawˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ nyi tehˆ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ lehˬ, na sha ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh cawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hui yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hui yehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Li‸ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ ca bvuh‸ tawˆ leh maˇ peuˬ taˬ. Nawˬ gʼaw leh henˇ yuˬ maˇ ve kʼo, uˉ naw‸ nehˆ naˬ leh heuˬ ve tiˉ yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ bvuh‸ taˍ ve na sha jaˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ boˆ nu laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, mehˬ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼui‸ a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh htawˇ bvuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ leh chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ca shiˍ la-o. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼawˇ shiˍ da‸ hpaw-e veuˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ-a veuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ shaˍ naˆ ve htawˇ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬlehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼa shuˍ naˆ tawˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ leh, Sawˉla‸monˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ko taˍ ve hpa hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ shaˍ naˆ ve pa taw taˇ nyi bawˬ laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ shaˍ naˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw kanˉ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw haˉ paˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo ca hawˉ tuˬ le. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼaˇ shiˍ jehˇ piˇ tuˬ le. Awˬ nu ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo ca mawˬ tuˬ ve le.
Shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ chehˇ kuiˬ maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ. Nawˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ veu leh, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hui ve aˉ po kʼo paˇ lo ca hawˉ-e loˬ.

Hpaˍrawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ toˇ chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ awˬ paˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ awˬ ma hta‸ mawˬ leh hkʼawˇ faˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼoˆ lo hpehˇ ya‸ taˍ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha ve le. Uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼe, nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ awˬ pon shi caˆ leh hpu naˍ vawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve jawˇmawˇ zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ ngeh zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, muˉraˍ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ, Enˍgaˍdiˆ hko hkʼaw lo veˆ chehˇ ve suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.
Ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ leh hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.
Nawˉ lehˍ ve mvuh‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve zuh‸ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, htawˇ cehˬ, yawnˉ cehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Shaˍronˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˉ veˆ awˬ hteunˍ hpeh‸ leh, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve shiˍ ya‸ veˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ aˉ chuˇ buiˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve shiˍ ya‸ veˆ hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve a pfuhˉ caˉ cehˬ hpeh‸ leh, chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hawˉ lo mui taˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ htawˇ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ caˍ laˇ leh ngaˬ ha lehˬ la tuˬ a pfuhˉ caˉ shiˍ caˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ la‸ sheh ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hawˉ lo teh taˍ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ shoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ha‸ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ hkuiˉ zuhˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ, hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ baˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw jaˆ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ geh kʼai-a veuˬ.
Mvuhˇ kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ laˬ-o.
Hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo suhˉ veˆ veˆ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ti mi hkʼaw lo aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kuˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Maˉ nawˆ shiˍ htawˇ meh la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ awˬ veˆ htawˇ hawnˉ heuˍ lehˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ geh kʼai-a veuˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo va‸ chehˇ taˍ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha‸ lu diˬve mehˆ hpfuhˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maw laˇ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kaˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ veˆ veˆ chehˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ heh hpuiˇ maˇ gʼa te luˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ haˆ haˆ hpeh yuˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ ya‸ de hkʼaw lo hawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ-oˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ sheˍ htaˇ, hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ geh lo gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la-o.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca ve htawˇ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ca maˇ mawˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, venˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpuˇ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ laˇ teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼuˉ taˍ leh ngaˬ e ve yehˬ lo shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ha‸ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ hkuiˉ zuhˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ.
Tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hui hawˇ chehˇ ve muˇraˍ leh sha hawnˉ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma le.
Nyi loˬ, oˇ ve lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cheuˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ma‸ yaˇ hkaw‸ chi gʼaˇ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa‸ shaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkehnˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ bawˆ cheuˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ maˇ gʼa ca hkʼawˇ bawˆ la tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw pfuhˇ leh gʼa‸ shaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ciˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hpu oˍ taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ hkeh yuˬ te taˍ ve hpa beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve hpa yuˬ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ hta‸ ca nyi la-o. Yawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa la‸ kʼawˍ toˆ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, awˬ e piˇ taˍ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve uˉ nyiˉ yuˬ beh taˍ ve mehˆ shiˍ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma kehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo pawˆ ya‸ la chehˇ ve aˉ che‸ moˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ mvuh nuˆ peuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ hehˉ piˇ peuˬ ve yawˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpu da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ciˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ hkʼeh‸ sheˍ. Nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ lehˬ nyiˉ-ehˍ ve hpa caˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ htawˇ uˉ nyiˉ hawˉ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼe gʼawˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hinˉ maˬ cawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shiˍ ya‸ de lo kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ yaˇ cehˬ kʼa hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ maˇ htiˇ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ lehˬ muˇraˍ hkʼaw leh sha hawnˉ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la leh ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh laˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ kuiˬ, Aˍmaˍnaˍ hkʼaw, Seˍniˍraˆ hkʼaw leh, Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la-o.
Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ leh, nawˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve shi caˆ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼa ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ha‸ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve naˍmanˇ hawnˉ a‸ kehˉ awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ lehˬ pehˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha tehˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ awˬ pon pehˇ gʼuiˬ leh nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw ve awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ lehˬ faˉ taˍ ve hko, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve hko leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ shiˍ hko lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, mehˬ jaˇ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ naw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo muˉraˍ, lawˇbanˍ leh awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve awˬ nu ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, hko oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw-oˬ, ngaˬ ve hko hpawˇ lo meuˆ laˬ leh, awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ heuˍ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw haˉ paˍ yawˇ ve hko hkʼaw laˬ leh, mehˬ jaˇ ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve hko hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve muˇraˍ leh lawˇbanˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ leh, pehˇ gʼuiˬ, nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼa bvuhˆ caˇ leh hkʼa bvuhˆ dawˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ lehˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma nawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ yehˬ miˉ ca htawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ, ngaˬ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ ehˉ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ yehˬ miˉ a ciˉ hpaw laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ leh uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ hpaˍ ciˍ gʼuiˬ nehˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ baˬ taˍ peuˬ. Teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ veuˬ tuˬ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ ve hkui sheh hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ tsuhˇ taˍ peuˬ. Teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ cha‸ chiˆ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh hpaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yehˬ miˉ tu hpaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh leh la‸ naw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ muˇraˍ shehˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ yehˬ miˉ hpaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kaˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca ve htawˇ ca maˇ mawˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ nyi ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ hkawˇ maˇ gʼa kaˇ.
Venˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ leh dawˆ hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ a ciˉ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kʼaw‸ hto laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe taw da‸ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ meunˍ gʼaˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ceh cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, shi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh kʼaw‸ lehˍ cawˬ leh, aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ hkʼe naˆ tawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, shi a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw tsuhˇ peuˬ leh, iˉkaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve hko hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve meuˇ guiˬ lehˬ muˇraˍ shehˆ taˍ ve shiˍ ya‸ veˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh nyi sha leh, shehnˉ shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve la‸ kawˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ to lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve haw ciˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkui sheh lehˬ, shi hkʼoˆ teh taˍ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw lehˬ chaw jaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai ve le. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve le. Ngaˬ hui ga hpoˆ ca laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve hko lo kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hko oˇ ve hkʼaw yawˬ ca hawˉ kʼai leh shiˍ ya‸ veˆ ca chehˆ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ shiˍ ya‸ de lo yawˬ hawˉ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼe nyi sha leh, Tiˇraˍzaˍ venˇ hkʼe awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ nyi tiˍ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ Giˇlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo pawˆ ya‸ la chehˇ ve aˉ che‸ moˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ hehˉ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yaw moˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ hkʼeh‸ sheˍ. Nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ htawˇ uˉ nyiˉ hawˉ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh lo nanˇhawˉhkanˇ ma hkaw‸ chi gʼaˇ, awˬ miˇ ma i hiˉ chi gʼaˇ leh, awˬ nu ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ e ve teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ e ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nanˇhawˉhkanˇ ma leh awˬ miˇ ma i teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba la chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve chaw chi a shu le. Yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, a pehˉ meuˇ te awˬ caˍ caˍ la chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˉ ci ku cehˬ awˬ veˆ veˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ca nyi tuˬ ngaˬ hko hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Shuˆlanˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ loˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ ve le. Chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nyi gaˇ ve laˇ.

Awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, hkuiˉ nuˆ tcuhˉ taˍ ve nawˬ ve hkui sheh hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ve pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu lehˬ, puiˉ jaˇ ve la‸ shaˉ maˇ te taˍ ve awˬ han hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ keu taˍ ve kawˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ htawˇ shiˍ ya‸ veˆ hpoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkuiˉ zuhˬ yaˇ cehˬ kʼa hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ lehˬ, haw ciˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve naˍ hkʼawˇ lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼe nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼe mvuh jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa deh‸ puiˍ shawˍ taˍ ve nawˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ cawˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gʼa ngaw ngaw cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼa ma awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ htawˇ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ lehˬ, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh leh, nawˬ ve cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tcuhˉ pui shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh awˬ shiˍ ca shaˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve cuˉ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon a pehˉ meuˇ kʼoˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ shaˉ gʼawˬ ve awˬ pe‸ lehˬ, a pfuhˉ caˉ shiˍ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw htawˇ da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ ve meuˇ guiˬ leh ciˬ hkʼoˆ lo a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Ya‸ puiˉ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw ca haˉ-e veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ awˬ veˆ veˆ la peuˬ leh naˍ, ca toˇ nyi-a veuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ leh, nyi sha ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw haˉ paˍ awˬ pon, iˉ shiˍ awˬ piˍ leh awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ e ve cuˉ hta‸ dawˬ uiˍ la ve ngaˬ nyi paˍ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ boˆ nu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ a muˆ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ e ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh aˉ ci ku shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve tzuhˬ taw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ la‸ sheh ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hawˉ lo teh taˍ leh, nawˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh ngaˬ hta‸ shoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ha‸ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ a ciˉ ka ti‸ te laˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ hta‸ kʼuˉ taˍ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tu kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le. Nawˬ paw la kuiˬ, a pfuhˉ caˉ cehˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ gʼa ha‸ leh gʼa kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa ha‸. Maˇ gʼa ca kʼuˉ taˍ. Ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, suh ve hkʼe taw kanˇ paˆ uiˍ leh, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ tawˆ la piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ hkʼaˬ ma nyiˉ pfuhˍ ve ka‸ suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˬ ma piˇ ve htawˇ, vuiˬ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ nyi ma ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve cuˉ lehˬ i jaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca maˆ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ tuˬ ve le.
Yawˇ lehˬ gʼo‸ pa hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ hui hpu ta‸ yehˬ teˇ maˬ te leh yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ hui htawˇ baˉ yuˬ ko taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼo‸ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸, ngaˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍlaˍhaˍnonˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Sawˉla‸monˍ a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hko oˇ ve muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hko oˇ ve ngaˍ hpfuhˇ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hinˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve hko teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Sawˉla‸monˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hpu teˇ hinˉ gʼa chehˇ leh, muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nyiˇ ha gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ-oˬ, nawˬ hko hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kaˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ law na chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw haˉ paˍ-oˬ, awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ geh gʼuiˇ ya‸ la-o.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Awˇziˆ, Yawˇtanˍ, Aˍhkaˆ leh Heˍsaˍ kiˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇ da‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍ yaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na taˍ-oˬ. Ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ shiˍ leh, piˉlaˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ caˍ piˇ jaw ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ uiˍ leh haiˬ jaˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼawˬ ce chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui Yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve le. Nawˬ hui leuˉ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ gaˇ sheˍ ve laˇ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ lehˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma htawˇ naˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ te leh hkui taw peh lo hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ kaˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ leh naˆ tsuhˉ maˇ gu, maˇ peh piˇ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ hko leh aˉ hpehˇ hko hkʼaw cawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ leh nawˬ ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ caˆ maˇ cheˆ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi bawˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Nuˇ awˬ suhˍ, yawˬ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ, leh aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la htaˇ awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe ca te tuˬ a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ tcuh laˇ ve le.

Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ nyi gaˇ. Nawˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve sha hawnˉ hta‸ ka‸ nga‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ha pa tawˬ ha pa cheˆ htaˇ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve shinˉ nyi teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ nyi gaˇ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Ha pa tawˬ ha pa cheˆ htaˇ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ nyi gaˇ.

Nawˬ hui la‸ sheh chiˇ leh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui bon hkʼaˬ ma lawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ.

Da‸ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te puiˉ la tuˬ henˇ yuˬ-o‸. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ te-o. Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui jehˬ da‸ shaˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, vaˇ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ hpu la tuˬ ngaˬ tsuhˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼa shuˍ nyi ve htawˇ, yawˬ mvuh hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ hpu la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ hpu hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ ceh kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, chaw hkʼawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw lo yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ ga piˇ. Mehˇchawˇma hui ve tawˇ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te sho‸ sha‸ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Sho‸ hta‸ lawˍ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˍ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui gʼa jaw ve hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve venˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ te ve chaw leh yawˇ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hko hkʼaw lo te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ goˇ kʼai chehˇ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ pfuhˍ piˇ ve hko hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Goˇ jaˇ ve chi gʼawˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hkʼe, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ pa taw, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆpiˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, bon yehˬ te taˍ ve hkʼaw pui lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ mvuh ve hkʼaw pui hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ leh,

Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca henˇ yuˬ leh, Yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ toˇ kʼai-a veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ ceuˬ leh teˇ ceuˬ awˬ kaˍ lo suhˉ te da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te mehˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ laˇ hpuiˇ kʼaw‸ lawˍ leh, a shu yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ law‸ kʼawˉ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ma‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ bawˆ leh, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gu tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo toˇ kʼai-a veuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve awˬ liˇ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo hpu shi hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ ho‸ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ taˇ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ hui ve caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaw lonˉ hkʼaw ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpiˍ leh‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh,
mvuh jaˇ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpaˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw tuˍ lo‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai leh, uiˍ gaˇ mvuh gaˇ ve nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ luˬ kʼai mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ la htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpu shi yuˬ te taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ faˆ cha‸ leh poˬ naˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼawˆ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ haˉ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw va‸ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh-e puiˉ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ taˇ va. Yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ le.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇ da‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw yaˇ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ,
ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, la‸ hkʼaˇ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ,
ma‸ poˍ lonˉ leh hkunˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ caˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui a‸ kehˉ gʼa veu‸ gʼa deh ve pa taw, chi hkʼe haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ te leh sheh kʼai laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ te maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, veu‸ tu‸ kʼaˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬhta‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ taˇ te tcuh laˇ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yoˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ paiˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa kʼoˆ hkʼa te ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe, da‸ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ shu ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw lo mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe te hiˉ caˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw toˇ kʼai htaˇ chaw peh‸ ma hkʼa shuˍ oˇ kʼoˍ chiˇ leh choˬ nyi oˇ nyi te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
