Yawˇ hui ve hkui kʼawˍ lehˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ piˇ leh, oˉ kʼoˍ yiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui kʼawˍ lehˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ tuˬ ve hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, oˉ kʼoˍ choˆ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, kʼawˍ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve la‸ kawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, uˉ nyiˉ teˇ hpaˍ,
uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ hpaˍ, maˉ mo hkeh hpeh taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ,
la‸ peˍ tcuhˉ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ, naˬ hkʼawˇ hta‸ tcuhˉ tuˬ ve aw hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ,
veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, hpu guˉ pi teˇ hpaˍ,
paˇ lehˍ ve aˉ po‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, pfuhˇ hpa yuˬ te taˍ ve hpaˉ ce‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hpeh tuˬ ve pfuhˇ hpa hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ yehˇ leh, kuiˇ nuˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi sha ve uˉ hkeh mvuh mehˉ kʼai leh, oˉ kʼoˍ yiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ tan, tzuh‸ keu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ veu‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ lehˬ ya‸ taw tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼehˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo mui hawˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ i kʼai ve pa taw, yaˇ miˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ lehˬ hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˉ ga tcuhˆ tiˍ taˍ leh, Shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hpawˇ ca maˇ gʼa ve chaw teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ heuˆ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui ca caˇ ca dawˬ leh, ca veu‸ ca deh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ leh iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ la nyi sha la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw gʼa ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ leh cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, da‸ kehˬ ve chaw teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tsuhˇ hpu tsuhˇ kehˬ piˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇbaˆ leh oˇ kaˬ lo sheˆ taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ moˬ hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ leh ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ mvuhˇ cha maˇ gʼa chiˆ tuˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ piˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼa maˍ laˇ sheˍ. Hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ lehˬ miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hkʼaw pui ehˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ maˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼawˇ leh haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ti keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hko oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, aˉ po kʼo ka‸ teˇ maˬ te taˍ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ htawˇ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ meh la tuˬ law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ci jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ leh ngaˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko chi ve awˬ kaˍ lo a ciˉ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ.

A pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ chi ve da‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ te taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ aw laˇ. Chi hkʼe taw taw te piˇ taˍ ve ka‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la leh, ci jaˇ ve le.
Chi beu‸ a pehˉ meuˇ hko chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ hko chi hta‸ ko taˍ ve suhˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hpaˆ baˬ leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lo‸ caˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Hko chi awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuh‸ hkʼa biˇ yeˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ gu piˇ-o. Hko hta‸ htawˇ kʼawˇ hpfuhˆ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hko chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw lehˬ, yawˇ ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ, Yawˇ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tuˬ Yawˇ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˬ leh ti mi kʼaw‸ piˇ htehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui geh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui ceh tiˉ gʼa chehˇ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ hko lonˉ ngaˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ gaˍ lanˍ ceh tiˉ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Caˬ yawˇ teˇ chi hkʼawˍ lawˇ ti ve htawˇ, caˬ shiˍ teˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ ka‸ tzuhˬ tanˬ dawˬ leh, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ te htaˇ, tinˍ hteˆ, lehˉ lu meuˆ leh tzuhˬ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, meu‸ suh kaˆ suh-e leh, nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Suh mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ kʼoˍ chaweh ngaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suh mvuhˇmiˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ peuˬ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tiˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, Yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai taˍ ve venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˬ ehˉ leh aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˆ caˇ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ ponˬ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha haˆ haˆ laˬ leh Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe ca te la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha laˬ leh Yawˇ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ ca te la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ da‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ haiˬ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ naˇ ho‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chaw ve teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, chaw ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼaˇ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui tzuhˬ dawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ leh kawˆ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, la‸ shawnˍ piˇ laˇ gʼa ve chaw haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ponˬ piˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, goˇ lehˍ ve mvuh‸ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ hpuiˇ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha maˍ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ chiˇ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la leh, suh taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo shu chiˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve peuˬ kʼai ve maˇ heˆ sheˍ. Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ chiˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ laˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui laˬ tuˬ yawˇ tiˉ shiˆ muiˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui haˆ haˆ gʼuiˇ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ heuˬ leh, te gʼaˇ ka‸ hkui htiˇ maˇ poˬ paiˍ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ zuh‸ muiˉ maˇ jo leh, haˍ pi teˇ caˆ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ. Yawˇ hui ve hkuiˉ nuˆ ka‸ maˇ tzuh‸.

Yawˇ hui ve hkaˆ ce lehˬ tcuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve hkaˆ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui kiˆ lehˬ, haˉ pui hkʼa shuˍ heh leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gaˉ yaw htawˇ, mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law hkʼa shuˍ hpfuhˆ vaiˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh shaˍ che‸ gʼa leh kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ ga hpoˆ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ taˆ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼa shuˍ bvuhˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Naˆ ho‸ ve leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ ve lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ peuˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ suh-e ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ paˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkaw‸ maˬ cawˬ leh awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, poˬ toˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ kuˬ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ daˬ kehˬ jaˇ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, bon yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la leh, bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw tawˆ la ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh gʼa mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh poˬ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ teˇ ma‸ nuˆ chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ oˇ ve yuˬ daw‸ taˍ leh, Chi ve nawˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ daw‸ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ a shu hta‸ gʼa kʼai peu tuˬ le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai peu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai tcuh laˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh na chehˇ ve htawˇ, na gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh ca ve htawˇ, hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸, kaˇ maˇ hpeh‸, shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui kʼaˍ ve chaw, naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw leh mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ca te piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, na-e la tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ maw maw chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yehˬ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ leh mvuhˇmiˬ chi gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ca chehˇ tcuh leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ ceh mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˉ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ htu baˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve maˉ kuˇ hkuiˉ daw hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. (Suhˆ muiˉ daw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tanˬ te tuˬ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Awˇziˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Yawˇtanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍ hkaˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Reˍmaˍliˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Peˍkaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ maˇ gʼa.

Suˇriˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suhˆ cehˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ ve hkʼe kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ yaˇ paˍ Shaˍyaˍshoˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ geh kʼai-o. Yawˇ lehˬ hpa chiˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ leh jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ du du te to‸ chehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ nyiˇ maˬ hkʼe ceh ka‸ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw taˇ kawˆ, taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Nyi ma gawˬ lehˍ ta‸-o‸, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Suˇriˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ la tuˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Taˍbaˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Suˇriˆ venˇ lehˬ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ htawˇ jawˇmawˇ Reˍ senˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Laˬ tuˬ ve hkaw‸ chi ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Peˍ kaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ uiˍ ve kʼo, yeˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Aˍhkaˆ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha Aˍhkaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ geh lawˬ-o‸. Awˬ heˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, hpeh‸ tawˆ la gʼa ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍhkaˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ heˆ hta‸ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ lawˇ nyi tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ yawˇ hta‸kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ-oˬ, chi beuˬ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve lehˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ da‸. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ nawˬ te piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ.

Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yaˇ hu taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la leh, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇmaˍnoeˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ paˍ chi uiˍ la leh kanˉ te caˇ puiˉ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ lehˬ nuˇ cuˉ gʼuiˬ leh pehˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ hta‸ ho laˇ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ tanˬ pehˬ da‸ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw sheˍ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ tiˉ shiˆ muiˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ puiˉ ma teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ geh gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ pehˇ ma hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ geh poˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ haˉ hko‸, haˉ kʼoˍ haˉ hpawˇ, aˉ chuˇ de leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw chehˇ biˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ gʼuiˬ ma coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ nuˆ paˍ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve paˇ tcuhˆ leh uˉ hkeh mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yiˬ lehˍ chiˇ baˬ laˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ nuˇ ma teˇ hkeh leh aˉ che‸ awˬ ma nyiˇ hkeh ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve htawˇ,

nuˇ leh aˉ che‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cuˉ gʼuiˬ tawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ loˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nuˇ cuˇ gʼuiˬ leh pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ teˇ hinˉ cehˬ cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ maˬ lehˬ teˇ hinˉ hteh‸ hpfuhˇ ve htawˇ, hko oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuh‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
La‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw maˇ heˆ kʼo, hko oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuh‸ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ heh te caˇ jaw ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ tiˉ biˇ sheˬ ve pa taw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍhkaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Li‸ bvuh‸ tuˬ ve suhˆ baˉ teˇ maˬ ca leh suhˆ baˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Haˆ hkʼawˇ yuˬ, haˆ hiˉ yuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve li‸ mehˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ nawˬ yonˍ hpeh‸ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ Uˉriˇya‸ leh Yeˍbaˍraˍhiˆ ve yaˇ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw nawˉ maˇ maw maw, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ miˇ ma geh kʼaw‸ zuh‸ leh yawˇ yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Haˆ hkʼawˇ yuˬ, haˆ hiˉ yuˬ teh‸ meh piˇ-oˆ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve, A pa a neh‸-oˬ teh‸ maˇ kʼoˆ puiˉ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Reˍsenˍ leh jawˇmawˇ Peˍkaˍ hui hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve pa taw,

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh shiˍ laˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Uˉhpaˍ raˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ htaˇ hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ moˍ awˬ cuˇ lonˉ te lo‸-e leh, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh peuˬ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kawˆ ve cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ geh hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh gu taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yaw gaˇ ve hkʼe yaw-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa te toˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ jehˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo nawˬ taˇ kʼai. Yawˇ hui kawˆ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ taˇ kawˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ kawˆ keunˍ kawˆ cawˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, shu hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ htaw yuˬ tuˬ ve va hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw maˇ maˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paiˍ leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ va hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve pa taw, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui mawˉ paˍ leh la‸ hkʼaˇ nyi paˍ geh kʼai ve le. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, suh peuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ na nyi ve le.
Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ tehˆ nyi-o. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon te laˇ maˇ gʼa.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa te toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve leh naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa‸ keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve chi hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ.

Zeˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh Yawˇ danˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ chehˇ ve chaw leh, ca gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ vuiˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve caw‸ hta‸ dawˆ piˇ chehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve chaw hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ leh awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la peuˬ. Yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha, Co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve Awˬ pa, Gawˬ lehˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ la leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ hta‸ tanˬ leh awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha dawˆ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ leh nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Li kiˉ shiˍ yuˬ kawˍ taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ-e peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui haˉ pui shiˍ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh, yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ kawˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, htu baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan ngaˬ hui nyi sha jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ kʼaw‸ ti keu tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Suˇriˆ chaw leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ tuˬ maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ. Ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.
Teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ leh awˬ mehˍ tu hta‸ tawˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˉ kʼoˍ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ leh aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ mehˍ tu lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh shiˍ kʼai sheh kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ leh, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ ca leh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, haiˬ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuh‸ leh aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hta‸ to‸ baˬ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ to‸ tawˆ la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ naˆ dawˇ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw to‸ kʼai leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, hkʼa mawˬ ve hta‸ gʼawˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui caˇ maˇ bvuhˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍnaˍseˍ leh Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ moˍ leh teˇ moˍ bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui nyiˇ moˍ kʼaw‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca bawˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ. Ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ te teh taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ leh, mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le. Vuiˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo cawˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ le.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo shu hpeh gʼa ve chaw hkʼe, shu gʼawˬ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ. Ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hta‸ suhˆ taˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ yehˇ leh, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ luˬ yuˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ je‸ hkʼa shuˍ ya‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼoˆ lo naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ caˆ muiˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Kaˍlaˍneˍ venˇ, Hkaˍhkeˍvenˇ, Haˍmaˆ venˇ, Aˍ paˆ venˇ, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ leh Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ a‸ kehˉ shaˉ ho‸ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˬ peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ te tuˬ cawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ caˆ muiˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ leh teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpaˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ. Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˆ hpui ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh ngaˆ u hta‸ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ yuˬ gʼa ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ho laˇ tuˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ hpe. Ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ heuˉ laˇ tuˬ, maw‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ ngaˉ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ tcuh caˇ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ aw laˇ. Liˉ leu lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ aw laˇ. Suhˆ taˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ shi toˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ suhˆ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ shi toˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh chu jaˇ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hkʼaw aˬ miˍ to‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ha hpeh‸ la leh mvuh‸, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve a naˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, naˉ jaˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ leh ti mi hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ i kʼai yawnˇ kʼai leh, suhˆ cehˬ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ cehˬ cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve hta‸ yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ gʼaw gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ ca va chehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh gʼaˇ va tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon gu taˍ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ hkanˍ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˇ maw maw gaˬ kʼo, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Awˇreˍbaˆ haˉ hpawˇ paˇ lo Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui hta‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ jaw‸ hpehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇ tu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Miˆgaˍronˍ venˇ hta‸ hpanˍ laˬ leh, chi beu‸ Aˍiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Miˆmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ hpanˍ laˬ leh, Geˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw deh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Raˍmaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ Sawˇlu‸ chehˇ taˉ ve Giˇbaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍlenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ-o‸. Lehˇshaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Maˍdaˆmeˍnaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Geˍbenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Nawˇbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ la‸ tsuhˆ pui te maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suhˆ kʼaˉ hta‸ tawˆ ce ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ ce kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ leh tawˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hta‸ htu baˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ htu baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, htu baˬ peuˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˆ muiˉ daw hta‸ awˬ caˍ kʼaw‸ caˍ tawˆ la ve hkʼe, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma leh cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, gʼa kaˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh na leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Heh hpuiˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ geh gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ lehˬ aˉ che‸ geh zuh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nuˇ yehˇ leh laˇ caˬ shiˉ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ geh kʼaˆ caˇ leh, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nuˇ leh yehˬ miˉ tawˍ teˇ geh kʼaˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ geh gawˬ lehˍ zuh‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ chi gʼawˇ hta‸ tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ jaˇ ve vuiˬ paˇ lo leˍ guiˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, vuiˬ htawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ biˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ biˇ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ heˆ teˇ maˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh Aˍsuˇriˆ, Eˇjiˇtu‸, Paˍtaˍruˆ, Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ, Eˇlanˍ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ, Haˍmaˆ leh conˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hto‸ teˇ maˬ hpeh chiˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve canˇ paˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui nyiˇ moˍ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ pawnˇ da‸ leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ kʼoˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Aˍmonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkanˍ gaˬ ve iˉ kawˆ lawˬ ehˉ suhˍ maˬ hta‸ ceh teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˬ sho-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon htawˇ, tawˆ la tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ cawˬ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa muiˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ-o.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gawˬ lehˍ ve iˉ kaˆ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Da‸ ve awˬ lawn chi, miˬguiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le kaˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ geh gaˬ la ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yiˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ ve hto‸ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ taˍ-o‸. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma uiˍ ve venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, a shu yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ shawˍ leh duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shawˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Naˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve la‸ sheh deu lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ nyi da‸ leh gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi ve hta‸ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ mehˉ kʼai leh, mvuhˇ nyi ha pa htawˇ naˆ ho‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi ve leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, shi a‸ kehˉ ca haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo jiˆ tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ bawˆ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ leh, ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe, a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu hpeh gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, juˆpehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shu miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ chiˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpfuhˆ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ, Meˍdiˆ chaw hui hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpu shi hta‸ sheˉ lai ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hkaˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ nyi sha jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ caˆ muiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˉmawˉra‸ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve Aˍraˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo aˉ po kʼo te chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˬ ca hawˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la leh, hkawˍtawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpui te chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ leh, haˇ tawˉ pehˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo pawˆ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hawˉ yehˬ, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼawˬ mehˉ kʼu leh heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ peuˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, chi teˇ pawˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hpeh yuˬ leh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kanˉ te hkeu‸ jaˇ leh naˬ chehˇ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ paiˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui bawˆ gʼaˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yuˬ baˬ peuˬ.
Chi beu‸ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, ha lehˬ kʼa muiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yawnˉ cehˬ leh htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve paiˬ ve pa taw ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ htu baˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ suh taˍ peuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ shu taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ la peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hawehˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ gʼa zuh‸ leh, pfuhˇ tiˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve aˉ boˆ hta‸ gʼa kaw tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˍ tawˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma lo ce ya‸ la taˍ peuˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, shu a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw jaw ca te chehˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo jawˇmawˇ hkʼa shuˍ ca mui taˍ tuˬ dawˇ nyi taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ moˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ ca te chehˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼawˬ ce ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ.
Suh taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ leh chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ cheˇ tuˬ te piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw chi hpaˇ maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chi ve hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, chi hpaˇ maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ hpeh gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve chaw ka‸, chi hpaˇ yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ tuˍ hpfuh maˇ cawˬ. Suh taˍ ve nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ shu gʼawˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ to lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ hui geh teˇ geh, haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve jawˬ mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼa deh‸ duˇ tuˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ je‸ nehˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, hkawˍtawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ma‸ shiˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shiˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chi hkʼe te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che taˍ peuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ suh ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ jaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ lehˬ hteh kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Vuiˬ teˇ hkeh suh kʼai peuˬ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve vuiˬ teˇ hkeh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ. Vuiˬ ve awˬ u awˬ hkʼaw lo, poˬ puiˉ ve cawˇ shehˍ ma teˇ hkeh tawˆ la taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, haˍ jaˇ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hpiˇliˇtiˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍraˆ leh Kiˇraˆ venˇ lehˬ, teˇ haˉ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Diˇbonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hawˬ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Neˍbawˇ leh Meˍdeˍbaˆ venˇ awˬ pon kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ve paˇ tcuhˆ leh uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ leh, teˇ yehˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍbonˍ leh Eˇlaˍleˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kuˬ hawˬ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yaˍhaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve nyi ma lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Zawˇraˆ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh Luˇhiˆ venˇ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ hkʼanˇ leh Hawˇraˍnenˍ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Niˇnaˍrenˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ fiˍ kʼai peuˬ leh, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ pfuhˇ veu leh, mvuhˇ hkʼaˆ cehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Eˇgaˍlonˍ leh Beˍreˍlenˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Diˇbonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon leuˉ leh kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Sheˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ geh lo yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh la‸ shawnˍ te feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ hpui hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh nawˬ hui awˬ hawˉ lo a ciˉ jehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw a ciˉ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ gaˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Fawˉ mehˍ ve leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ peuˬ kʼai leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ te leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ yoˬ.)

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hkʼaˬ ma caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ leh, hkʼaˬ ma heˍ caˇ puiˉ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui caˆ muiˬ ve lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw gʼa hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kiˇ riˆhaˍrehˆ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ hui gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ jaw ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, gʼa hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ leh, Siˆbaˍmaˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuhˆ gʼuˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a pehˉ meuˇ hko oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh hteunˍ lonˉ cawˬ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ uiˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˍzaˍ venˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ Siˆbaˍmaˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Heˍsaˍbonˍ leh Eˇlaˍleˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha lehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ cawˬ.

Hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ha lehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Kiˇriˆhaˍrehˆ venˇ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui chehˇ ve heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga piˇ maˇ gʼa.
(Chi lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh teˇ na‸ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Laˬ tuˬ ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw maˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)
Chi lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lehˬ, venˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼe awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, gʼa haˍ gʼa gʼawˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˬ gʼeu‸ caˬ jaw‸ peuˬ ve ti mi hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, Reˍhpenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ yiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ shaˉ baˬ peuˬ leh, teˇ kaˬ teˇ shiˍ ceh naw‸ chehˇ taˉ ve shaˍlonˍ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼaˇ va tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˍshaˆtaˍrehˆ gʼuiˬsha ma hta‸ htawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hiˇviˆ chaw leh Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui baˬ taˉ ve venˇ hkʼa shuˍ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yeˬ jaˇ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ da‸ kehˬ ve hko teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ hko oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ shawˉ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la da‸ la leh awˬ veˆ veˆ la ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ leh gu na-e maˇ gʼa ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw gʼuiˬ baˇ lonˉ taˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe, awˬ hkawˇ duiˆ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ taˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ, mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law hkʼaw ve chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca te luˬ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ehˉtaˍyawˇpiˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ coˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, lo cehˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ ciˇ leh Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo haˆ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Shu kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇ miˬ, leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn ca kʼaw‸ kaˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Hkʼaw uˉ tzuh hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ tuˬ ve hto‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Behˬheh ma meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ law na taˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ce la ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ haw ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh nyi ya‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ meh la leh maˇ gʼa shaˉ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ kʼaˉ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa sha sha-ehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ goˇ htaˇ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ leh, mvuhˇ kaˆ htaˇ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh shu kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lo hpawnˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ moˬ hta‸ ciˇ taˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ma‸ hpeh‸ tawˆ la piˇ leh, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ teˇ venˇ leh teˇ venˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma luˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ geh maˇ kʼoˆ, mawˉ paˍ geh maˇ kʼoˆ, suh peuˬ ve chaw hui geh maˇ kʼoˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ, awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ i kʼai leh fiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ fiˍ kʼai ve pa taw kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Lo cehˬ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ goˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ goˇ kʼai leh, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu tuˬ yoˬ.
Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˇ ca shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ leh gʼa kuˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve biˉ leh geu‸ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Hpa te chiˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui htawˇ, nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cheuˬ jaˇ ve kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Zawˇnaˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh kʼoˆ piˇ haˆ ve le.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ.

Zawˇnaˆ leh Nawˇhpaˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw luˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ sheh kʼai piˇ cawˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ keu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ya‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ hpe‸ baˬ taˍ ve hta‸ naˆ leˆ toˇ chehˇ ve tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve paw sha ve chaw haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ga piˇ maˇ gʼa.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ la‸ sheh chiˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ pawˆ le le, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ lonˉ ngaˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ venˇ hta‸ Mvuhˇ nyi ve venˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te taˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ duˇ ti taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ maw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ te leh, Yawˇ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ peˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ chi hta‸ te toˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Aˍsuˇ riˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ chi ve shehˆ peˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ bon uiˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw, leh ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Saˍgonˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve Aˍshoˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ yawˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve meh htuˉ pui hpa leh hkuiˉ nuˆ kʼehˆ baˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, awˬ kʼu nyi te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍshoˆ venˇ hta‸ shu bawˆ yuˬ kʼai peuˬve teˇ yanˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ awˬ kʼu nyi te toˇ chehˇ ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ peˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hpeh gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ kʼu nyi te gʼa‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ kʼu nyi gʼa te tawˆ kʼai leh, gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ mehˉ kʼai leh nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shehˇ de hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law meuˆ laˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, kawˆ tu‸ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ ha hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇlanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai-o. Meˍdiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˬ, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ-o‸. Shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ naˬ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ diˆ vaiˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ cheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ ngaˬ nawˇ taˍ leh, kawˆcheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo, hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hpui lawˇ paˇ lo hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mui caˇ tuˬ, mui hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ hkui, Ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh, hkʼa deh‸ ca shaw nyi tcuh taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ hto la tuˬ kʼoˆpiˇ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceh te laˬ chehˇ ve leh, piˉlaˬ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ ciˇ laˬ chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca leh shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui gaˬ la peuˬ. Iˉmvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ceh te lo‸ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ paiˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ caˬ hta‸ jaw‸ ve hkʼe, shu jaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ ve tawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸hto laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ-oˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve chi hkʼaˬ htaˆ peuˬ kʼai tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Mvuhˇ htiˇ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi gaˇ sheˍ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ laˬ leh na nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Aˍraˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo ca hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve Deˍdanˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui geh laˬ ve iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw piˇ-oˆ.
Teˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˍ caˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw bawˆ pehˍ chaw pehˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Keˍdaˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Keˍdaˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkaˆ bawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo pawehˇ te chehˇ ve le.
Venˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkawˇ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Suh taˍ peuˬ ve venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve pa taw suh-e ve ma ˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkʼe ka‸ maˇgʼa bawˆ da sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve pa taw, shu hpeh yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa paˆ hawˬ chehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ geh tawˆ kʼai-o. Ngaˬ ve chaw chi ma ma suh kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ ca beˬ la.

Awˬ yanˇ chi teˇ yanˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ pon kawˆ tuˬ leh nyi ma luˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paˆ ce peuˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa gaˬ bvuhˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Kiˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ la peuˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ paˆ kʼai peuˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ la‸ caˉ teh taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw lo, la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca yuˬ tawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lanˇ venˇ paˆ-e taˍ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ, nawˬ hui dawˇ mawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼaw nyi leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ shaˉ taˍ gʼa tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ ca. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi hkʼe te tuˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ dawˇ nyi taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ka‸ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ leh, a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui gʼuiˬ yawˬ leh pawehˇ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ nuˇ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui caˇ cawˇ dawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ kʼo ngaˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Sheˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆpiˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve le. Haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ awˬ pon tuˍ hpfuh teˇ maˬ ca htawˆ chehˇ ve chi, nawˬ a shu geh a hkaw-anˬ gʼa taˍ ve le.
Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw uiˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ bawˉ shiˍ teˇ maˬ hkʼe shawˍ leh, chi a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo baˬ peu tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chi beu‸ nawˬ caˆ muiˬ chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Sheˍbaˍnaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Eˇlaˍkenˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve aˉ yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ awˬ pa hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ ve shawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ yehˬ miˉ hpaw ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hoˆ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ yehˬ miˉ hoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hpaw gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ juˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon hawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mu‸ hkʼu leh hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ sho cuˇ hta‸ kʼuˉ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ ga hpoˆ kʼuˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˆ keu taˍ ve juˇ oˇ ve kʼehˆ ce tuˬ yoˬ. Kʼuˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ ce kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Tuˇruˆ venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ jehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ hui Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Siˉdonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ chehˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸ ca vuiˬ hawˇ tcuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Siˉdonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ jaw. Yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ hu jaw, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ.
Tuˇruˆ venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e loˬ.
Venˇ chi ve lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼe ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ ve venˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ. Venˇ chi ve lehˬ, chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ ca gʼa tuˬ ve laˇ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh shu taˍ uiˍ chehˇ ve Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve a shu le.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ leh, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui-oˬ, heh ca kʼawˇ-e loˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ sheh che peu taˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, tanˇ kaˬ hkʼa te caˇ chehˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Siˉdonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve htawˇ, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

(Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw maˇ heˆ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ shu leunˇ baˬ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ peuˬ kʼai hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ lehˬ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu leunˇ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve meh maˬ lanˉ-oˬ, nawˬ ve tinˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh venˇ hkʼaw kʼai-o. Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ ve tinˍ hta‸ hteˆ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa-o.

Suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve peuˬ kʼai htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ kʼaw‸ te da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ tanˇ kaˬ te leh gʼa ve hpu teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ to pon ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui loˍ ve veu‸ tuˬ kʼaˇ tuˬ leh caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ vuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te laˇ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceˬ leh awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, paw sha ve chaw leh haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi ve luˬ kʼai sheˆkʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi goˇ kʼai leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼa peu-eˬ kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ te piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ te hpaˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ te luˬ leh, miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ hkeu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ shaˬ te shaˬ i kʼai leh a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ htawˇ i la ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ gʼa dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa tinˍ hteˆ leh cehnˬ dawˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ, chi beu‸ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˬ gaˇ-o.
Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw maˇ gʼa lo‸ la tuˬ yehˬ teˇ maˬ le le a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
