Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo huˉ taˍ leh tzuhˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ baˬ peuˬ.
Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, shaˍlonˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ pawˆ shaˉ yuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Te‸ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ gʼa kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ leh,
mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Vuiˇ jaˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ heˍ caˇ leh, shaˬ te shaˬ haiˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ leh va teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ naˆ kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa kʼa tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ ya‸ la leh miˬguiˬ chi ve hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi ve pe‸ hkoˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi ve tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tuˉ li paˍ li kʼai leh, mvuhˇ haw htinˍ hehnˇ jaˇ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼa shuˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw awˬ vuiˬ hawˇ jaˇ la leh, paiˍ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi ve paiˍ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ tu la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ hpe lo uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve kanˇ paˆ cawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo hpeh gʼa taˍ ve chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ, miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw lo haw taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha pa naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, mvuhˇ nyi htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ ba tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬˬ

Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Aˬ sho-eˬ nawˬ te tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ te biˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, haiˬ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haˍ gʼawˇ leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh lo hpaw kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, mvuhˇ cha chiˆ jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ ca bawˆ la chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ goˇ choˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ tcuh piˇ leh, moˬ lehˬ haw jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ gawˬ kʼai piˇ ve hkʼe, haiˬ ve chaw hui kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gawˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ teˇ maˬ gu tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ shiˆ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ chi gʼawˇ hta‸ nuˇ hkʼehˇ hkʼaw naˆ tuˍ ve hkʼe, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawehˇ tuˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ chiˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ awˬ hawˉ lo kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ ya‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ leh lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼaw lo hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇ lehˬ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ yeˬ leh da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ yehˬ miˉ hpaw piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh yonˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼaˇ va-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ leh lanˇ venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ kʼai sha tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hpiˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ ca leh, nawˬ hta‸ tiˉ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ. Choˬ kaˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui ca chehˇ la taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ te ya‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.

Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ gu taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ bon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui suh peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kʼaw‸ tu la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ uiˍ la kʼehˬ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ jaˇ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ hawˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui naˬ jaˇ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve htawˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ paw la piˇ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa.

Suh taˍ peuˬ ve ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ te‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ciˍ gʼuiˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi sha la piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suh taˍ peuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, yehˬ miˉ hkʼa deh‸ hoˆ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ca hpaw va‸ taˍ-o‸.

Miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shu maˇ mawˬ kuiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hkʼawˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ tawˆ la leh, miˬguiˬ htawˇ shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ yuˬ leh, htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve vuiˬ lonˉ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve cawˇ shehˍ ma lonˉ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve nyi sha jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ
Hko chi hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hko chi hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ca ya‸ la tuˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hko chi hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hko chi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh zuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la ve kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca ya‸ la chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te da‸ la-o, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ geu naw‸ yeˬ la leh, awˬ veˆ veˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ti tawˆ la taˍ ve iˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ biˇ sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hehnˇ jaˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, shu hkʼe taw luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ htawˇ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo meuˆ laˬ ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te luˬ peuˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai leh hteh kʼai peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ suhˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ te leh Eˇ jiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ biˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hui hkʼawˆ taˍ ve suhˉ veˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui tzuhˬ bvuhˆ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ leh uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Tzuhˬ bvuhˆ suh chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo naˆ nehˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, tanˬ meh la gehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ shu shaˉ caˇ peuˬ sheˬ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ, teˇ hkui tiˉ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo suhˉ jehˬ puiˉ tuˬ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ gʼa tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ leh maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tzuhˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ leh hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ na maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, shu hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hpui lawˇ hkʼoˆ lo hpe‸ hpoˆ taˍ leh, cha‸ cha‸ chiˆ chiˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ leh hkʼawˇ deˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe maˍ laˇ sheˆ laˇ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ tawˇ yaw puiˉ la gehˇ sheˍ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve leh laˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ peuˬ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ peuˬ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui hkui htiˇ gʼa poˬ toˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw leh shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ leh suh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve pa taw luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ gaˬ la taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo yeˬ jaˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo, yonˍ ve lehˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ htaˇ tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve heˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ leh suh mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ gaˬ la leh, nawˬ hui teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Ngeh jaˇ ve ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ zuh‸ leh, maˇ fe ve aˉ boˆ yuˬ kaw taˍ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kaˇ lao hkʼaw cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Peˍraˍzinˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh, Giˇbonˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw lo te toˇ peuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ gʼuiˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼuiˬ ve kʼo, leuˉ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ sheˍ.
Muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, caˬ ti tuˬ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ ti miˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ mehˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ti mi hta‸ teˇ pawˆ mehˇ leh hkʼa deh‸ kaˆ taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, caˬ hta‸ ti keu ve yoˬ. Ti miˬ awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ti keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Caˬ jaw‸ tuˬ yawˇ lehˬ suhˆ tcuhˉ pui lonˉ hta‸ yehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Keunˍ da‸ ve suhˆ taˬ hta‸ ca leh yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˬ jaw‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh te ve maˇ heˆ. Caˬ shiˍ hta‸ a yehˉ yehˉ jaw‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ suhˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve chaw ha ku-i hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ tawˍ mvuhˇ htehˆ ve leh miˬ hiˆ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼe mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˍ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ maˆ ve htawˇ, nawˇ la leh awˬ meu‸ jaˇ chehˇ ve lawˬ leh‸ paˍ leh, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa dawˬ maˆ ve htawˇ, nawˇ la leh iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ hpeh tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ hte‸ haiˬ leh maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh te chehˇ-oˆ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ gʼa dawˬ ve htawˇ, bvuhˆ suh taˍ leh hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ zuh‸ muiˉ geu‸ leh zuh‸-e tuˬ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hpeh‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hoˆ beh piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naw hui tcuhˉ kuiˬ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ ve li‸ kʼoˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ li‸ shiˍ paˍ geh yuˬ kʼai leh, a ciˉ gʼaw maˍ laˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, Yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ hpeu‸ gʼaw maˇ gʼa, teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ li‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai leh a ciˉ gʼaw maˍ laˇ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ li‸ gʼaw maˇ puiˉ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nyi ma hkʼaw tawnˇ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw mawˇ awˬ liˇ ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ka kehn piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw kʼaˍ chaw buiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui te tuˬ ve kanˉ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ hkʼawˇ te chehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ maˇ mawˬ taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ leuˉ leh uiˍ ve le. Mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, je‸ nehˆ laˇ. Te ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, te shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ hpeh‸ aw laˇ.
Chaw mawˇ hkawˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, maˇ maw maw kʼo hteunˍ lonˉ lehˬ heh lonˉ teˇ peˆ hpeh‸ la leh, heh oˇ ve htawˇ hteunˍ lonˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw lehˬ shu li‸ gʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ puiˉ la leh, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve mehˆ cuˉ paˍ htawˇ, mehˆ kʼaw‸ mawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ leh nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, shu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ maˇ jehˬ piˇ ve chaw, leh shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ leh gʼa kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˆ yan leh taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ maˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ kʼai leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ na nyi taˉ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ ca te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇ jiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˬ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ leh meuˇ kʼo gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Zawˇnaˆ leh Haˍnehˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ,
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va chehˇ ve pa taw, gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ leh vuiˬ haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˆ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˉlaˬ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hui hta‸ ca tanˇ piˇ tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ Che‸ maˇ puiˉ ve cawˇ shehˍ ma teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn dawˇ nawˇ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, li‸ kʼoˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, Yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui kaˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve ka‸ yaˬ piˇ.
Ngaˬ hui geh tawˆ kʼai leh, ngaˬ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ taˇ tsuhˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui maˇ kaˇ gaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ pe‸ hkoˇ kʼai taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hkoˇ kʼai leh, aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nanˬbawˍ hkʼaw ve iˉ ka‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yuˬ keu maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yo, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ ca kʼaw‸ va la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ te.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, gehˬ jaˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ ciˇ hpaw-e tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ chi hkʼe dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve lehˬ, cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lehˬ gehˬ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lehˬ chi a‸ kehˉ ka‸ gehˬ jaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh gʼa mawˬ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui chaw teˇ hinˉ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ hui chi ma ve hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ canˇ paˍ ngaˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ loˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpeh chiˇ taˍ ve hto‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ te‸ chiˉ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ, ha lehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpuˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa gʼa‸ ca toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw‸ la‸ mehˍ la‸ sha hpawˇ lo suhˉ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Ya‸ kʼaw choˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ hpu shi yuˬ leh oˍ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Kʼai loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh gʼawˆ baˬ tu yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui caˬ ti ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ laˬ piˇ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ la uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui caˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ gʼa leh, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ, kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ti mi mehˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve nuˇ leh piˉlaˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ luˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha pa htawˇ mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba la leh, mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ ba la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ suhˍ nyi ve awˬ gʼeuˆ teˇ nyi tiˉ ba ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu na-e piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo ka‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ leh mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ lehˬ yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo mvuhˇ haw hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh, mvuhˇ haw oˇ ve lehˬ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve pawehˇ te ve teˇ haˉ htaˇ nawˬ hui te jaw muiˬ ve hkʼe, ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ gʼa kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo, ha lehˬ ha kʼa lehˉ lu meuˆ leh kʼai chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼaˬ ma kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve leh, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ kaˇ tcuh mawˬ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo aˬ miˍ ha, moˬ, vaˇ shiˍ, leh mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh, yawˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cehnˬ dawˆ tinˍ hteˆ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ chehˇ kuiˬ gu taˍ peuˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ naˉ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ leh, suhˆ hkʼa biˇ hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha meuˆ peu laˇ ve awˬ shaˉ lehˬ suhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va ve chaw lehˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ va.

Yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ peu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve awˬ ha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ yanˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ paiˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh hta‸ che‸ gʼa taˍ peuˬ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼaˬ ma kuˬ heuˉ chehˇ ve htawˇ maˇ kawˆ ve hkʼe, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˆ ma peuˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˆ hpui hkʼoˆ lo poˬ caw chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hpu shi yuˬ leh te taˍve nawˬ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa gʼawˆ baˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ htawˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼa hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw shu oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo uˉ peunˍ puiˉ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ htaˇ ca hpfuh taˍ kuiˬ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shehˇ de hkʼaw ya‸ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ leh, yiˬ lehˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ leh naˍ paw lehˬ, ga piˇ tuˬ loˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyi chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nyi ma ngeh ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ yawˆ yan keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ dawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ tawˆ cha‸ tawˇ chiˆ tiˉ yaw leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ya‸ jaˇ leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ ga piˇ puiˉ.

Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ heˍ piˇ leh, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa tuˬ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ha lehˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ gaˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui shaˉ yuˬ tuˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh chehˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma pui hta‸ hta chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ti mi teˇ hpaˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yeˬ tawˆ la chehˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yehˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ htawˇ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ kʼaw‸ hkuiˇ la da‸ la leh, ti mi hkʼaw lo htawˇ caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo co co taiˍ taiˍ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw, gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ leh te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
(Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.)
Ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon iˉ kaˆ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ leh, ceˇ caˬ awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ ve le.

Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ca te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui shu hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve pa taw, shu oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh ma‸ bawˆ ve kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ha‸ hanˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ ca te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ caˆ caˇ taˍ ve leh ka ti‸ te da‸ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˆ yan keunˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ tsuh de lonˉ lehˬ, nawˍ kʼai peuˬ. Shaˍronˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ htawˇ, shehˇ de hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Baˍshanˍ leh Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ hpa‸ piˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ chi beu‸ tu leh ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gu leh, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ htunˉ meu-e te tuˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ chiˆ meu-e piˇ ve hkʼe, dawˆ meu-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼa shu hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Vuiˇ kuiˬ neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ kaˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸shiˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ to‸ kʼai chehˇ ve aˬ miˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve kʼo, ponˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ heˍ caˇ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ taˇ lawˬ yuˬ. Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, uiˍ la da‸ la leh yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ teˇ peˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo uiˍ la kʼehˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kawˆ chehˇ ve chaw jaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ daw nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui na maˇ gʼa ve tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui bon pawehˇ te kuiˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi-o. Hkʼaˬ ma gawˬ da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve le. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpaˆ baˬ jaw sheˍ ve aˉ po kʼo hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, kʼehˬ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui geh hkanˍ laˬ gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw luˬ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, hkui luˬ paˍ hui ka‸ pehˬ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˬ ve gawˬ ve hta‸ pa taw teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼanˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu duˇ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼe leˇ kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa, leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, mvuhˇ naw ma htawˇ lo‸ taˍ ve liˬ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suhˆ hpa‸ hkʼa shuˍ ce la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ chi beu‸ chaw hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh nuˇ leh nuˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ paiˍ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kuiˍ tcuhˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, miˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ma‸ shiˉ awˬ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, kuiˍ tcuhˇ hkʼa shuˍ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ to‸ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo co co taiˍ taiˍ taˆ-e chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo te toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hkawˍtawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha miˬguiˬ hta‸ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ htaˇ hkʼe gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ leh hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh mvuh‸ hkʼa biˇ yeˬ la leh, heh hpuiˇ leh hkawˍ tawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh kuˬ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ kʼaˆ caˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo ca zuh‸ ca jehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkawˍtawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ hpui te leh, awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo hpoˆ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ve li‸ daw hta‸ hpeu‸ gʼaw nyi-o. To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ mehˉ kʼai. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ leh, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ geh shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ leh, caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteunˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh, suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw veˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Hteunˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Hteunˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ leh Kaˍmeˍlaˆ leh Shaˍronˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hkuiˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve la‸ sheh leh, cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu hta‸, awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Taˇ kawˆ. Ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ kʼaw‸ mawˬ la leh, naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw hui kʼaw‸ kaˇ puiˉ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkui luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ la leh, kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ ve chaw kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Shehˇ de hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve shehˇ de lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, goˇ choˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ jaw ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, lo cehˬ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo, Da‸ kehˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa te toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ chehˇ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh ka‸ ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ te toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve hkʼaw kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa ha lehˬ leh, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ la‸ caˉ ya‸ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Laˍhkiˇsaˆ venˇ lo tu leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui laˬ leh hpa te chiˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui kanˉ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve yaˇ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇlaˍ kenˍ, hawˉ yehˬ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Sheˍbaˍnaˍ leh Aˍsaˆ ve yaˇ, mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Yawˇaˍ, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, aˬ hto ma pa taw jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ chi taw taw nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ yaw ve tawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Nawˬ hui Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ nawˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ lo cehˬ yuˬ te taˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ taˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, teˇ hkui tiˉ hkoˇ kʼai leh nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ tcuhˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ laˇ. Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ paˍ nyiˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ ca gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ nyiˇ hinˉ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ cheuˬ taˬ sheˍ. Hkʼe ka‸, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ dawˇ tawˆ leh nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, Shaˍbaˍnaˍ leh Yawˇaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Aˍraˍmiˆ hkawˇ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui na gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ Heˍbrehˇ hkawˇ taˇ yaw laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui htawˇ na chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve hkʼehˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve tzuhˇ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ tu la leh, Heˍ brehˇ hkawˇ yaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Nawˬ hui jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve hkawˇ maˇ gʼa na tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va-o, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.

Nawˬ hui la‸ caˉ ya‸ leh venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh a shu yawˇ ve nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh laˇ leh, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ shaw hpoˆ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ gʼa ve cawˬ jaw laˇ.
Haˍmaˆ venˇ leh Aˍpaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo gaˬ peuˬ le. Sheˍhpaˍvenˍ ve gʼuiˬsha chi beuˬ hkʼaˬ lo le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve chaw hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ponˬ piˇ gʼa jaw le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ca dawˇ guiˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ.
oˇ htaˇ, Eˇlaˍkehˍ, Sheˍbaˍnaˍ, leh Yawˇaˍ hui a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍkenˍ, Sheˍbaˍnaˍ, leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍmoˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ hto piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi lehˬ tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ leh, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ paw maˇ gʼa ve yaˇ miˇ ma hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tuˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ kaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ
Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ dawˇ haˍ ve nyi ma taˇ cawˬ piˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ geh ca jehˬ da‸ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Tiˇraˍkaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇ riˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw nawˬ nyi ma taˇ uiˍ chehˇ.
Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gawˇzanˍ, Haˍranˍ, Reˍyaˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ leh, Teˍlaˍsaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Beˍteˍdenˍ chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa.
Haˍmaˆ, Aˍpaˆ, Sheˍhpaˍvenˍ, Heˍnaˆ leh Iˉvaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh gʼaw nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ nawˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi leh ngaˬ hui lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸, Seˍnaˍ hkaˍriˆ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˍ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve suhˆ leh haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ chehˇ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve bon lawˬ htawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Saˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼuiˬ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ guiˇ chehˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ a shu hpeh‸ ve teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ tanˬ leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpehˇ leh tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh ca yaw maˍ laˇ tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, naˉ jaˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw cawˬ ve, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ, yawnˉ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ htu baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nanˬ bawˍ duˇ leh iˉ kaˆ gʼa dawˬ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ naˆ fiˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ sheˍ laˇ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve hkʼe te chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo meuˆ laˬ ve haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve zuhˇ leh, yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ laˬ kuiˬ, te kuiˬ dawˇ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn leh nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ leh nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw sho caˆ keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼaw‸ leh nehˉ hkʼaw‸, nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˆ shiˍ hawˆ shiˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ hkʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ gaˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui caˬ ti leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼeu‸ jaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ geu tcuhˆ naˉ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, hkaˆ teˇ hkʼe ka‸ gʼa bawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. La‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, venˇ chi awˬ paˇ lo laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇ jaˇ venˇ ji lo htawˇ, ta‸ kʼoˍ gʼa duˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, venˇ chi hkʼaw gʼa lo‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui deh chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ shehnˉ hiˉ meunˍ ngaˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ Seˍnaˍhkaˍriˆ Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Aˍdraˍmeˍlehˆ leh Shaˍreˍzaˍ hui lo‸ la leh yawˇ hta‸ chaw pehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍraˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Eˇsaˍraˆhaˍdonˍ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Heˍsaˍkiˆ naˬ jaˇ leh suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍmoˆ yaˇ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu teh taˉ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh tuˬ ve hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Heˍsaˍkiˆ gʼo‸ pa hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, nawˬ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kuˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Daˍviˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ chi ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ a sha‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ heˆ teˇ maˬ te maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Aˍhkaˆ te taˍ ve mvuhˇ nyi naˍri‸ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ teˇ chi hkʼeh‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ nyi naˍriˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ teˇ chi hkʼeh‸ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Heˍsaˍkiˆ na-e la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ bvuh‸ tawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ hkoˇ ceh tiˉ gaˬ sheˍ ve ka‸, ngaˬ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa kaw‸ mawˬ taˉ-o hehˉ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, chiˇ chehˇ ve hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ ngeh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ geu‸ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ che‸ naˬ jaˇ leh, teˇ haˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa htiˇ ngaˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yuˬ ngeh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ nyi chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, naˬ kuiˬ gawˬ kuiˬ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa maˇ gʼa.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, dawˇ sha gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ ve yoˬ.
Suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh peuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve hkʼe, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw ceh tiˉ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw tinˍ hteˆ leh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ nawˬ ve shaˉ chuˇ hkʼoˆ lo maˉ nawˆ tcuhˇ yuˬ nehˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ bon yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼai gaˬ tuˬ ve aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ heˆ cawˬ le, teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Baˍlaˍdanˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Meˍroˆdaˆbaˍlaˍdanˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ naˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ leh la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ feu laˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve hpu shi, sha hawnˉ, naˍ manˇ hawnˉ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ geh laˬ leh, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ laˇ le, teh‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ ve le, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼaw‸ na nyi htaˇ, Teˇ ceuˬ le le ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve, aˬ sho-eˬ nawˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa ca keu taˉ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa ca te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ, yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍyaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ maw jaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn leh chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ gu taˍ-o‸. Shehˇ de hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.

Lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ biˇ la piˇ leh, hkʼaw teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ hpiˬlehˍ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaw pui ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hpiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la leh, kʼai haˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, tawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ lawn gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˉ veˆ a‸ kehˉ gʼa chehˇ maw ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ laˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuh‸ leh suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuh‸ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yoˬ, mvuh‸ leh suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ kʼai taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, ha lehˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ-oˬ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh, ha lehˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ shu hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Tawˇ yaw-o. Taˇ kawˆ chehˇ. Yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh uˉ peunˍ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ shiˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh gʼa‸ hpoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ leh, awˬ ma peuˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a yehˉ yehˉ gʼa‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬyoˬ.

A shu teˇ gʼaˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ kawˬ nyi gʼa leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ htu nyi gʼa ve le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ iˉ kaˆ kawˆ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ gʼa leh, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuh nyi gʼa ve le.
A shu teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ gʼa ve le.
Kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te kʼai gʼa tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha a shu geh ca jehˬ da‸ la jaw le.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ teˇ jaˆ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve conˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, je‸ meu-e hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh ka‸ maˇ law‸ sheˍ. Oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ awˬ pon ka‸ maˇ law‸ sheˍ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇmehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma yuˬ tehˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ shuˍ ve nawˬ kʼoˆgʼa aw laˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpu shi yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ve maˇ heˆ.
Hpu shi yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ te maˇ gʼa ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ luˬ puiˉ ve suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ cheuˬ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ hta‸ ca leh, paiˍ maˇ gʼa ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw laˇ. Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼaˬ hkʼe tanˬ hpeh‸ la ve nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw sheˍ laˇ.

Miˬguiˬ chi ve hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, piˉ gʼawˆ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, aˉ po kʼo hta‸ mvuhˇ yeˬ hpa hpe beh ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ hpe taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ ce piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ geu hkʼa deh‸ maˇ naw‸ sheˍ ve awˬ cehˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ laˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui goˇ kʼai leh chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ tehˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ-aw laˇ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ chiˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui mawˬ chehˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu te hpanˍ taˍ ve le. Meu‸ keu shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ moˍ awˬ cuˇ lonˉ te tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ meh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, meu‸ keu shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ shiˍ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ kʼai.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ shiˍ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw sheˍ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ maˇ nuˇ leh maˇ heuˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇgʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ.
Gʼaˇ nuˇ leh heuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai puiˉ leh, yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ paiˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ naw‸ leh tu la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ heuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw juˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Vuiˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Shaˉ nanˉ lo nawˬ hui ve suhˉ hta‸ ca jehˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui tawˇ gʼa yaw tuˬ ve a hkaw-anˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui teˇ geh kʼai leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw lo suhˉ ca jehˬ piˇ-a veuˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve a shu le. Yawˇ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve a shu le. Yawˇ ve aˉhtaw lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve hkui sheh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ maˇ naˆ toˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ a shu le. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ a shu le. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ leh, awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
La‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ga da‸ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

La‸shaˉmaˉ lehˬ Nawˬ te taˍ ve la‸ meuˇ da‸ jaˇ teh‸ shi lawˍ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ gu shiˆ chehˇ ve chaw htawˇ yawˇ geh kanˉ ga paˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ chi da‸ jaˇ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve maˇ gʼa paiˍ tuˬ ka‸ sho cuˇ lonˉ hkʼa deh‸ dawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ teˇ ceˍ lo nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ tawˆ la taˍ leh, Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hui htawˇ gʼa suh-e leh, miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ leh, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ i jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve laˇ hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh meuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ je‸ meu-e oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸mvuhˇ hpe lo baˬ taˆ leh, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ hui chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw hkʼaw‸ hkʼaw goˇ leh iˉ kaˆ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ yiˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw‸ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ tawˆ la piˇ leh, lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw lo htawˇ iˉ kaˆ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shehˇ de hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shehˇ de awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ lehˬ htawˇ cehˬ, hpa‸ gʼaw cehˬ, leh shaˍlonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yiˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, hpehˇ yawˇ cehˬ, htawˇ cehˬ leh yawnˉ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te gʼa aw laˇ. Laˬ leh, a ciˉ te nyi-o.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve, choˬ kaˬ laˬ leh a ciˉ kʼoˆ hkʼa nyi. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hpeh‸ la jaw taˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ shaˉnanˉ hkʼaw hto maˍ piˇ leh, tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te hkʼa nyi. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ te hkʼa nyi. Ngaˬ hui kawˆ leh anˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te hkʼa nyi.
Nawˬ hui awˬ to leh nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh bawˆ ya‸ la tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ je‸ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ ve hkʼe, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chi hkʼe maˇ kʼoˆ taˍ. Nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Ziˉonˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve na nyi hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa.
Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼa peu-eˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ te maˇ puiˉ leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ kanˇ paˆ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ taˍ ve leh ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te kuˬ leh tawˇ yaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw leh ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ, yawˇ tanˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ law na chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw leh, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ ve a sha‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kanˇ paˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teˇ maˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ mehˆ kʼaw‸ mawˬ la tuˬ gʼa te piˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve htawnˍ hkʼaw mui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa yuˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ biˇ la peuˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ puˆ kʼa leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Heh puiˉ hkʼaw leh, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Keˍdaˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Sheˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chiˇ mvuh leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ma‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, mvuh‸ leh suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shehˇ de kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mehˆ cuˉ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ toˇ jaw sheˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ toˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve naˆ ho‸ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, kʼai haˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ hpiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ gʼuiˬsha teh‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ. Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ nyi sheˍ.
Ngaˬ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ a‸ kehˉ naˍ paw pawˇ leh mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw a shu cawˬ sheˍ le.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hui laiˉ ceuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ jaw taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ a muˆ maˇ taˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, naˍ paw cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ kaˇ puiˉ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
