Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw hpeh haw taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ na yuˬ tuˬ laˇ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ laˇ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˆ a shu le. Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ laˇ leh, ma‸ hta‸ pa taw gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ meh meh piˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ gʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui aˬ miˍ hkʼaw gʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hehnˇ jaˇ ve beˬ tuˬ lawˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸, Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ leh Saˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼe leˇ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼe leˇ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ tiˍ taˍ tuˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tcuh piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ nanˉ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui lehˬmehˆ shiˍ cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ mawˬ puiˉ. Naˍ paw cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ kaˇpuiˉ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn leh, chi beuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ lehˬ, cawˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tcuh-o.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh yonˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ jaw. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ awˬ lawn, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ga la ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chi hkʼe te maˇ puiˉ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo hpaw-e gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ pa gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ

Nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ heuˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ te pawnˍ leh, gʼuiˬ dawˆ hehnˇ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ te pawnˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ. Ngaˇ chu taˬ hta‸ meuˆ shiˉ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tu la maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hpeh‸ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ taˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ te tuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ law nyi taˍ-o‸. Chi beu‸ ka‸ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ leh, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ kʼaw‸ te pawnˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˆ la piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi bawˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ geh maˇ yuˬ laˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍ haˍ gʼawˇ gʼawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ nyiˉ te tcuh.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon sha hawnˉ maˇ vuiˬ. Nawˬ hui ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ maˇ te laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˆ mehˉ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui teˇ geh shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ loˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beuˬ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui a sha‸ tanˬ te‸ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ha‸ leh leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ piˇ leh, shehˇ de hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ taˍ ve mvuh‸ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw geh ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ nehˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ leh meuˇ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gʼa leh, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ leh awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ-aw laˇ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ. Ngaˬ maˇ kaˇ jaw sheˍ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ chaweh te hawˇ chehˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, mehˆ cuˉ leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Kuiˇ shaˉ ho‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.

Oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui lehˬ, nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo laˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Sho dawˆ paˍ lehˬ, sho hta‸ yuˬ leh aˬ miˍ chiˆ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hta tu hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ dawˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˍ meu‸, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ leh gʼaˇ heuˬ ve yoˬ.

La‸shaˉmaˉ lehˬ suhˆ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Je‸ hpu yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ awˬ hkʼaˇ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuhˇ yuˬ leh htawˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ tuˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ han hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te htawˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh htawˇ cehˬ, maˉ kuˇ cehˬ leh yawnˉ cehˬ hta‸ ca htu ve yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ maiˬ shaˆ cehˬ hta‸ ti taˍ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ suhˆ hta‸ htu leh shaˉ ho‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˉ ve suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ leh te caˇ te dawˬ ve yoˬ. Te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ aˬ miˍ ceh leh, shaˍ piˬ caˇ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ aˬ miˍ lehˬ mui taˍ leh, Hkʼaˬ ma lehˬ jaˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ tcuhˉ pui hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ htawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬve gʼuiˬsha yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaˍ jaˇ leh yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve naˍ paw mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Suhˆ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ leh awˬ chiˇ awˍ te caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shaˉ ho‸ htawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, ngaˬ lehˬ suhˆ tcuhˉ pui chi ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ leh, kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ te piˇ maˇ gʼa taˬ. Yawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Moˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ baˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ baˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma-o, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaw leh suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ leh htai hkʼaw‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ maˍ toˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ leh, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ lehˬ laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ leh, ngaˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shu kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh yaw leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ fiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ tan gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ te tcuh gaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ gʼa te leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ kawˍ tuˬ, nawˬ tawˇ gʼa piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Kuˇruˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ yuˬ ce piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaw baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ ya‸ kʼaw gu laˇ leh, hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpiˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˆ paˆ leh, sho teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˇ taw tawˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˬ kuiˬ, naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo faˉ taˍ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ maˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ loˍ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ leh naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma ve awˬ bon hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ bon oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ da‸-aw laˇ. Je‸ lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi-aw laˇ. Mu‸ hkʼu htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, Nawˬ maˇ cheuˬ law, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-aw laˇ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ ve le teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-aw laˇ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ na nyi chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Ngaˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le ve hta‸ ngaˬ hpiˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw hpeh keu taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ leh la‸ shawnˍ piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Ehˇtaˍyawˇ piˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ sho caˆ hpeh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ htawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ shehˇ de lonˉ hpeh‸ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ baˬ kuiˬ lo tawˇ yaw leh, ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ca tuˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yaw ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, suhˉ jeh kuiˬ lo hpawnˬ laˬ-o‸. Suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ taˆ toˇ leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ maˇ puiˉ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui shaˉ nanˉ lo laˬ leh kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Jehˬ da‸ tuˬ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ jehˬ da‸ loˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ a shu le. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ leh awˬ tehˬ awˬ na biˇ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Beˍlaˆ leh Neˍboˍ gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chi beu‸ piˉlaˬ hkʼoˆ tsuh‸ keu leh taˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu yuˬ leh taˆ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui paw la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui mawˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ tehˆ da‸ nyi tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve hpu shiˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh tsuh nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ te puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ ca ngaˍ leh, gʼuiˬsha teˇ maˬ te tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ taˆ kʼai leh, shaˉ ho‸ taˍ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa deh‸ ca teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, sha ho‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, teˇ kaˬ ka‸ jiˆ kʼai maˇ puiˉ. Shu yawˇ geh bon lawˬ ve htawˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ puiˉ leh, kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o.

Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ gaˬ la leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te biˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Ngaˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ nyi lehˬ vuiˇ jaˇ sheˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ bon htawˇ haˆ haˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ ya‸ la leh, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw mui taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yaˇ miˇ haˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw sheˍ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ da‸ ve nyi sha ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Haˉ pui mawˍ lonˉ yuˬ leh chi beu‸ caˬ hkʼa meu-e geuˆ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ veu‸ deh taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ lehˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ baˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ya‸ taw chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ shu gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ, hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ mui taˍ-o‸. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ ma teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ. A sha‸ mawˇ la peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hehnˇ chaweh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ ma hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ leh, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ maˇ dawˇ nyi.

Miˬguiˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ha‸ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe taw uiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ mehˇchawˇma maˇ hpeh‸ leh, yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ luˬ kʼai taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ ceuˬ chi ve nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh faˍ te chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui faˍ hkʼaˬ ma te puiˉ ve htawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ zuh‸ maˇ maˆ jaw ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo la‸ haˉ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ yehˇ chehˇ ve faˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa chehˇ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ kanˇ paˆ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ nyi paˍ hui hta‸ kuˬ leh, teˇ ha pa peuˬ teˇ ha pa hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tcuh-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve chiˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ paˇ lo mui taˍ leh, lehˬ guiˇ tuˬ ve aˬ miˍ maˇ heˆ.

Chi ve lehˬ nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hui ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ leh meuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a shu yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te.
Nawˬ hui caˆ muiˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma lehˬ, sho leh kuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ heh jaˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te taˍ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ awˬ pon te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ sho-eˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ biˇ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui hkanˍ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ lo, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ tanˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui paw sha la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw hpfuhˆ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Hpu hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa keunˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ htawˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ leh meuˇ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui la‸ haˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ aw‸ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ kʼa‸ kʼoˆ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ te tcuh ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo jiˆ laˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ pe‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui da‸ la tuˬ maˍ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh nawˬ hui kʼai cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ beˆ maˍ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ fiˍ kʼai puiˉ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo taˆ la chehˇ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ Iˉ saˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ peuˬ teh‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ kaˬ le le ca hto piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ goˇ jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve shehˇ de hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ shiˉ. Yawˇ lehˬ haˉ hpawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui awˬ pon iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haˉ hpawˇ hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ leh iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ponˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ maˇ paw la shehˍ htaˇ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ kanˉ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ tcuhˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Kanˉ te hkeu‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ tawˆ la. Ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ te gʼa ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te puiˉ la tuˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai taˍ ve yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ laˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa te tuˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ te piˇ ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Shu canˇ leh chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍnawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ peuˬ leh, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ te leh, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ shaˉ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸, Tawˆ kʼai loˬ teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, Awˬ gʼeuˆ ba kuiˬ lo tawˆ la-o, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ moˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ awˍ meu‸ leh iˉ kaˆ shiˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇ nyi leh shehˇ de lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˆ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ teˇ caˆ te pawnˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ, awˬ na hpawˇ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Siˆnenˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma-oˬ, kʼa muiˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, nawˬ htawˇ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ leh, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ paw taˍ ve yaˇ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ tuˬ ve leh laˇ. Awˬ e teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai puiˉ sheˉ ka‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ taw kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ ve chaw gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la tuˬ awˬ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hpawˇ heuˆ tuˬ hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai peuˬ leh gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo paw la taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve i jaˇ. Ngaˬ hui chehˇ kuiˬ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ suhˉ loˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ teˇ nyi kʼo nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ a shu ngaˬ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve le. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve le. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, jawˇmawˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ boˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ law gaˇ law chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nyi ma gʼa luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ peuˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ hiˉ yuˬ gʼa-aw laˇ. Haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa-aw laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh gʼa taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hiˉ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬbawˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ da‸ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, baˬ da‸ ve li‸ hkʼaˬ lo le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ caˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hawˇ baˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto ma pa taw ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve le. Ngaˬ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve leh laˇ. Tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh yaw ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ lo, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ fiˍ kʼai piˇ gʼa leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shehˇ de hpeh‸ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Suh-e ve chaw awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ naˆ ho‸ naˆ tuˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼaˇ nuˇ shaˉ nuˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ gʼa tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kʼoˆ keunˍ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma htawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ jaw‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve caw‸ hkʼo piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ tawˍ taˍ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼaw ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ keu laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkanˍ gʼaˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ zuh lehˍ teh taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ haˆ tuˬ le. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui teˇ geh shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ cawˬ kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼoˆ loˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve teh‸, a shu venˇbaˆ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ ve hpa hkʼa shu mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui toˇ kʼai chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ leh, ngaˬ geh laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui tawˆ la kuiˬ haˉ hpawˇ awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Saˍraˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh yaˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ maˇ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, Eˍ denˍ hko hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ paw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ haˆ haˆ laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ leh, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ law tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma leh miˬguiˬ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai leh, miˬguiˬ chi ve htawˇ hpuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ tzuh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve hta‸ taˇ kawˆ.

Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tu leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ te jaw ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Raˍhaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve cawˇ shehˍ ma lonˉ hta‸ peuˆ nehˆ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ nawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hpanˍ kʼai hpeh‸ tuˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ kʼaw te pawnˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ nawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ co co gʼa ha lehˬ leh, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ co co gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuh‸ a‸ kehˉ a sha‸ maˇ zuhˬ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ leh mvuhˇ naw miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, nawˬ hui leunˇ kʼai peuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ tuˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui chi taw taw kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve le. Yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, nawˬ hui geh lo gaˬ la maˇ gʼa taˬ.
Htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maw maw gʼa ponˬ tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ zuhˬ la leh, loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˍ tu piˇ leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ uiˍ taˆ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha, hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˇ la leh tu la-o. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ taw piˇ taˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ ve kawˆ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa dawˬ peuˬ. Kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ dawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ gʼawˬ leh shiˍ kʼai laˇ paˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ nyiˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ hpeh‸ ve pa taw nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa meu‸ gʼa kaˆ jehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le awˬ paˇ lo nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh paˍ zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˍ bawˆ paˍ ve va hta‸ yaw taˍ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi taˍ peuˬ.
Tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh te toˇ leh, tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ,

nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw keu piˇ taˍ ve kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ leh naˆ tiˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍvenˇ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve venˇ-oˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ-o‸. Buiˇshaˆaˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ lo‸ la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Je‸ meu-e hkʼaw tu la leh, nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui taˍ-o‸. Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ hpui baˬ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ tuˬ, hpu gʼa piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hkehˉ chaw hkʼa shuˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo oˇ hkʼe gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ hta‸ pfuhˇ leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo laˬ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa teˇ geh hpoˆ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Ziˉonˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ leh, yawˇ ve venˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve mawˇ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw haˆ haˆ tawˆ kʼai-o. Cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ htawˇ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai loˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ hui lehˬ kiˍ moˉ kiˍ chiˆ gʼa te tawˆ-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼawˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh maˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ te chehˇ ve kanˉ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh hpeh‸ la leh, shu taˍ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ maˇ maˇ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ anˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han pa taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ chaw yaˇ law maˇ shuˍ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ anˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ anˇ jaˇ leh ka kehn tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui maˇ mawˬ jaw ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh dawˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ a shu yonˍ tuˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te taˍ ve hta‸ a shu mawˬ jaw ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw yeˬ la chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ nyi leh yonˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh nyi sha ve awˬ ceuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ naˬ ve gawˬ ve leh tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ chiˇ nyi. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ cawˇ ve naˬ ve gawˬ ve leh tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ pfuhˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ ve pa taw yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw gʼa naˬ gʼa gawˬ leh, shu jaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkanˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ponˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Shu jaw‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ yuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui na-e la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ tawˬ miˇ tawˬ hkʼaˇ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ keunˍ hkanˍ cawˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shu yawˇ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hkanˍ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw. Yawˬ mvuh nuˆ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo tiˇ caˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe, yawˇ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw.

Shu yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh suhˉ jehˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ shiˍ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon yawˇ lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ heˍ ve tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw jaw leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te jaw ve htawˇ, shu yawˇ hta‸ haiˬ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh tuˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ gʼa tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gu taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ hta‸ hkanˍ pfuhˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ hkʼe leˇ tanˇ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hkanˍ pfuhˇ leh, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ bon lawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ awˬ hpawˇ maˇ heuˆ jaw sheˍ ve yaˇ miˇ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh yaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve aˉ po kʼo hta‸ uiˍ chaweh te taˍ-o‸. Aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ zuhˬchaweh te leh, yehˬhkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh duˇ tiˍ taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ laiˉ hpawˇ lo uiˍ la kʼehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu yuˬ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo chaw hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ puiˉ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, awˬ chawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve mehˇchawˇma hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ gʼa chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ hpawˇ chiˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ chiˇ baˬ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ tawˆ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ co co hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Noˉa‸ awˬ co-e htaˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ htonˍ piˇ-o teh‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ-o, teh‸ ka ti‸ kʼaw‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ leh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ paˆ-e ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ co co ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Dawˇ sha laˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ leh gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve shehnˉ shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ kawˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ, shehnˉ shiˍ yuˬ kawˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve leh, kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˬ miˍ ceh leh la‸ caˉ te tuˬ, ca liˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. La‸ caˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ hkʼa te tawˆ taˍ ve la‸ caˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Choˬ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hpu maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ laˬ-o‸. Caˇ tuˬ ca caˇ ca dawˬ la-o. Nawˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ gʼa piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, caˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ ve awˬ pon nawˬ hui ve hpu hta‸ hkʼe laˇ yehˇ baˬ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ve gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ yehˇ baˬ leh meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na yuˬ leh chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui te‸ ve a sha‸ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ co co yeˬ ve ka ti‸ te laˇ leh, ngaˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve awˬ bon oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ lonˉ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ chi beu‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kuˬ hpawnˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca pawnˇ da‸ la tuˬ gʼuiˇ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ geh bon lawˬ-o‸. Chi beu‸ yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ neˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, nyi ma awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ pa piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shuˍ. Ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ peun da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw leh dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw leh dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ nehˆ la piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo ce la ve vaˇ meu-e leh mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ti taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ awˬ pon caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ cawˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo, yawnˉ cehˬ leh hpa‸ gʼaw cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yeˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Maˇ maw maw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ-oˆ.
Shinˉ nyi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ uiˍ leh ce kan chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hta‸ ca pawnˇ chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh oˉ kʼoˍ pui tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ maˇ kʼoˆ cawˇ. Awˬ tawnˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hta‸ pawnˇ da‸ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ, teh‸ maˇ kʼoˆ cawˇ.

Chaw chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, shinˉ nyi htaˇ hkʼa deh‸ ce kan leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo,

nawˬ hui yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ cawˬ la leh da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa ve a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Shinˉ nyi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ce kan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca pawnˇ da‸ chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ piˇ laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve bon lawˬ kuiˬ yehˬ, teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca pawnˇ da‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˆ haˆ laˬ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca che‸ caˇ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mehˆ cuˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ lawˬ maˇ puiˉ ve hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ ca heˍ toˇ leh zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ caˇ maˇ bvuhˆ puiˉ ve hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te leh, a shu yawˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ ca leh dawˬ gʼa ve hkʼe dawˬ-a veuˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ lehˬ ya‸ nyi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a muˆ maˇ taˍ. Yawˇ hui suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw lo suh-e leh gʼaˇ jehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ choˬ kaˬ laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui lehˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw leh meh maˬ lanˉ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui a shu hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te leh, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh, nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve haˉ kʼoˍ awˬ paˇ lo, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ leh tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ca tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ ca te tuˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca zuh‸ tuˬ, ku-iˍ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui naˍmanˇ hawnˉ hkʼa deh‸ shehˆ leh, Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh suh ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve heu‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh sheˍ. Nawˬ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ pe‸ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ nuˇ teh‸, nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a shu le. Awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kawˆ-o ve laˇ.

Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ miˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve tawˍ tsuhˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ kʼaw duˇ leh hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hui geh htawˇ chehˇ taˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ ve a sha‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to pon tiˉ ca chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh chiˇ baˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ te kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Vuiˇ kuiˬ neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ maˇ puiˉ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te chehˇ leh, je‸ leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ha lehˬ kuiˬ ponˬ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui kuˬ gʼa ve hkʼe gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Teˇ nyi le le yawˇ hui hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ nyi mawˬ laˇ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ce tuˬ loˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui hkeu‸ ve haˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ lo ve le, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ce kan chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te leh, nawˬ hui ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve ce liˇ kan liˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi leh, nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ hui ce kan ve teˇ yanˇ, zuhˇ hpa‸ hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ boˆ taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, meh htuˉ pui hpa hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkaˆ pfuhˍ leh zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ce kan ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chi hkʼe yoˬ laˇ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve ce liˇ kan liˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve, leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸. Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˍ meu‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ leh, yehˬ kʼa maˇ cawˬ ve haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ miˉ hpaw piˇ-oˆ. Veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ feuˉ piˇ deh piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ga piˇ tuˬ taˇ leunˇ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ bon mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ba la leh, nawˬ hui ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ haˆ haˆ na-e la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ, haiˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw,
shu hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ leh ga piˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ ba la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, da‸ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, chehˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hko leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ fiˍ kʼai puiˉ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh shu nawˬ hui hta‸, Luˬ taˍ sheˆ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te shehˍ hpaˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teh‸ shawˍ leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na maˇ te ve kʼo,

ha lehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍ koˆ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yawˇ naˍ paw pawˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ tawˍ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh lo heˍ ve, haiˬ ve leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai ve htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui geh maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ heˍ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi leh te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ taw‸ ma hehnˇ jaˇ ve vuiˬ u hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ u oˇ ve teˇ shiˍ hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ ve kʼo, vuiˬ haiˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, na goˬ na gaˉ peh awˬ hkeh yuˬ te chiˇ taˍ ve hpa hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi leh te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, luˬ ve sheˆ ve ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ maˇ gʼa chehˇ. Nawˬ hui te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ kʼaw‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ te toˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ te toˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ya‸ kʼaw toˇ kʼai gʼa tuˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, naˆ ho‸ ve ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ca htaˇ shoˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ leh fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ la mawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ heˍ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve shaˉ nanˉ leh venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, da‸ ve hta‸ te gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ sha ve yoˬ.

Shu fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ aˉ po‸ hkʼa shuˍ veu‸ deh leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hkʼawˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi taˍ leh, te ya‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ leh, gʼuiˬ dawˇ uiˍ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, tu la leh mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ba chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ nawˬ geh lo cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ suhˉ teˇ nyi hta‸ ca nyi la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ teˇ geh hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo tu kʼaw‸ la leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ, shu chiˇ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ leh, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cheˆ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Mawˇ jeˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hkanˍ leh nawˬ geh gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Meˇdiˍanˍ leh Eˇhpaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ moˍ lonˉ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shi leh sha hawnˉ taˆ leh, Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Keˍdaˍ leh Naˍbaˍyoˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Moˬ hkʼa shuˍ iˉ kaˆ hkʼoˆ lo te toˇ chehˇ leh, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼa shuˍ yehˬ lo poˬ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma le.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˆ leh vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo tu kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ, te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kawˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh lo la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ veu laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ nawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hpaw taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ te ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ awˬ pon, Leˍbaˍnonˍhkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ cehˬ, yawnˉ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh lo yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkui tcuhˉ teh tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve hkui paˇ lo oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Ziˉonˍ venˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shu canˇ leh baˬ taˉ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve venˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ ha lehˬ tuˬ biˇ ve uiˍ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ e teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Kuiˇ awˬ tan shi, sho leh suhˆ awˬ tan hpu leh kuiˇ, haˉ pui shiˍ awˬ tan sho hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼo‸ pa hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ha pa htawˇ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ba laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ uiˍ ve nawˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ peuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ nyi ha pa a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba da‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve shu hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ti taˍ, te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve yehˬ kʼa lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yaw ˇve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ lawn hto piˇ tuˬ, nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve chaw leh, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆpiˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
