Dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha lehˬ la piˇ leh kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tcuh piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nawˉ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon shu Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ luˬ kʼai paˆ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, nawˬ ve ti mi hta‸ mehˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ htawˇ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ gʼa leh, gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve ya‸ taw tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ nyiˇ pun kʼaw‸ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ lehˬ co co yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw leh venˇbaˆ hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ co co yeˬ ve ka ti‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ha lehˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpawˇ heuˆ tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ hkiˇ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yawˇ teˇ yawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yeˬ tawˆ la ve hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa ponˬ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve kawˆ faiˇ hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ba tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ meh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nyi sha jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ Chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve chaw teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ Baˬ taˍ ve awˬ miˇ ma teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ meh hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸, Ha lehˬ ha kʼa la‸ kʼawˍ toˆ taˍ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ hpawˇ hkʼaˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ heuˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw haˉ yaˇ miˇ haˉ la‸ kʼawˍ toˆ peuˬ leh teˇ geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ teˇ geh ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ te tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa lawˬ hkawˉ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve venˇ hpeh‸ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, venˇ chi ve hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te laˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ jehˇ jehˇ gʼa lawˬ hkawˉ tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Yawˇ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve caˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui caˬ ti leh gʼeu‸ jaw‸ keu taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˍ gʼa caˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ keu taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ vanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh ya‸ kʼaw ca gu taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ duˇ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ hto‸ hta‸ hpeh chiˇ taˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ shiˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve chaw, leh Gʼuiˬsha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ taˍ ve chaw, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ jaˇ ve venˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha maˇ chiˇ baˬ ve venˇ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le. Da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve hpa nyi hta‸ veu‸ deh leh laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw oˇ ve a shu le. Oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ leh, yawˇ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ca hto la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ paˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ nyiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca ga la. Nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ htawˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Ngaˬ chiˇ nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ naˆ nehˆ piˇ leh, te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ yuˬ sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ bon maˇ maˇ na‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha awˬ to hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ leh ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la leh, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le. Moˉseˍ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le.

Yawˇ ve awˬ meh co co taiˍ taiˍ bvuhˬ chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo Moˉseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ naˉ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ haˇ tawˉ pehˆ hkʼa shuˍ hkui sheh naˆ yeˬ jaˇ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ hkui htiˇ maˇ poˬ.

Nuˇ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ sheˍ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ lo le. Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ lo le. Nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ lo le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ nyi bawˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Yaˍkoˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaw hpfuhˆ tawˆ-e tuˬ te laˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve le. Nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi leh kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la-o.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh nawˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ maˇ heˆ ve hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve chaw maˇ heˆ ve hkʼe shawˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ yehˬ baˬ leh maˇ yaˬ la ve le. Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼoˆ lo buiˬ chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ la-o. Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui maˇ dawˇ law jaw ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw, maˇ mawˬ jaw. Nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, nawˬ lehˬ kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw, leh nawˬ te tcuh gaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ te leh ngaˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui te taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve suhˆ hpa‸ goˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la. Nawˬ ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ lawˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hui geh tawˆ kʼai leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ je‸ nehˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh nawˬ lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi taw taw nyi ma taˇ zuhˆ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ htaˬ htawˇ, co co taiˍ taiˍ taˇ tawnˇ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ la leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ htawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh kuiˬ, da‸ kehˬ leh nyi sha jaˇ ve bon yehˬ htawˇ, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ha‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve ka‸, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ leh laˇ. Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ te leh, ngaˬ hui hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tcuh laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui bon maˇ lawˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca. Ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ.
Nyi ma heh leh a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ceh tiˉ te kʼai chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ nawˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ tiˉ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hko hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ yawˇ hui tuˍ hpfuh lo kʼai leh, suh peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ va‸ shaˍ caˇ leh, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve shaˍ gʼuiˬ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ peuˬ teh‸ shawˍ leh, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca htawˇ la tuˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ maˇ suh puiˉ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ bvuh‸ keu taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ mawˬ ve hkʼe te chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ te luˬ piˇ taˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Shaˍronˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Dawˇ haˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve chaw, leh Gaˆ leh Mehˉneˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ bon oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ na leh, ngaˬ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve pa taw, hpuiˇ suh va‸ suh ve hkʼe gʼa te suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼa meu‸ gʼa kaˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ gʼa kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui nyi ma luˬ jaˇ leh gʼa hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ yehˇ leh shu hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha, nawˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ bon hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkanˍ gaˇ ve chaw htawˇ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ awˬ suhˉ leh mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ suhˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hpanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ te taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ awˬ suhˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ suh-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le mawˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. A sha‸ teˇ ha hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ ka‸, yaˇ nehˬ ceh tiˉ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. A sha‸ teˇ ha hkʼaw‸ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve chaw suh-e ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te chehˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko te caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu awˬ pon yehˬ leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Heh hpuiˇ leh yawˬ ehˉ teˇ geh kʼaˆ caˇ leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ htawˇ nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ chi gʼawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Vuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, cha‸ chiˆ ve leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ a ciˉ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ ngaˬ ve kʼaw jaw hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hkui sheh taˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve yehˬ te laˇ tuˬ le.

Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve chaw, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw, ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ ve puiˉ ve chaw, leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nuˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo chaw hta‸ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˬ ehˉ tuˉ tanˇ leh, hpuiˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu, maˇ heˆ kʼo, va‸ awˬ suhˍ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ leh, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe te leh, oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Na sheˍ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ lehˬ, gʼoˇ peˬ maˇ naˬ sheˍ ve htawˇ yaˇ paw tawˆ la ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ kaˇ jaw mawˬ jaw laˇ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw la gʼa-aw laˇ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, yaˇ maˇ paw sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ chi taw taw gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ ve ka‸, ngaˬ maˇ paw la piˇ taˬ teh‸ taˇ ca dawˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Venˇ chi awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, chi beu‸ yawˇ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ e ve cuˉ hta‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ da‸ la uiˍ la ve pa taw ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ fiˍ kʼai puiˉ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui geh ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ e ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ taˍ leh cuˉ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ e teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chehˇ sha leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˍ geh teˇ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hkʼoˆ ciˇ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ leh aˉhtaw hta‸ cuˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te leh, hko hkʼaw lo te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ va‸ shaˍ, faˆ cha‸ shaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ teˇ geh shaw hpoˆ tuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ geh hpawnˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te puiˉ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ leh,

ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw, maˇ kaˇ jaw sheˍ ve vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai peu tuˬ yoˬ. Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ, Liˆbyaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ, Luˇdaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Tuˇbaˍ laˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, leh Aˍhkaˍyaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai peu tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ geh lo shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve hkehˇ hkʼaw keu leh bon yehˬ lo yuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ mvuhˇ, piˉlaˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ, iˉmvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼoˆ ciˇ tcuh leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw lo shiˍ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ paw hkuˇ leh Leˍviˆ chaw te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ awˬ suhˉ leh mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ suhˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw yeˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh htawˇ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ leh, shinˉ nyi gaˬ la ve teˇ pawˆ le le miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-e, choˬ kaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui tu kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ suh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hta‸ htawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ Heˍlaˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ laiˉ pawˆyaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai ve lehˬ, Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍdaˍ kiˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ maˇ keuˆ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon tcuh kaˍ paˍ te tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ. A sha‸ ka‸ i jaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ a sha‸ i jaˇ sheˍ teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ. Ngaˬ kʼai peu laˇ ve chaw hui geh kʼai leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ htawˇ taˍ leh, Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve tawˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma mawˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ kʼaˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ leh, Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ sheˍ le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ buiˬ sheˆ la paˇ neˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca te luˬ te sheˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh lanˇ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇbaˆ te ve chaw, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve chaw, leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve tawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ gʼa huˉ tuˬ ve hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ kawˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh kawˆ jaˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ga laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ, sho leh kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma ka ti‸ yeˬ puiˉ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui tanˬ heuˆ da‸ htaˇ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma nyi cha kuiˬ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve le. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ka‸ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ, maˇ te toˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ leh hkʼaw mvuh lawˬ naˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca.
Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ shiˍ lo‸ la piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve le, teh‸ maˇ na nyi. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, tcuh kaˍpaˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hawehˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Keˍdaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼai leh hkʼa deh‸ ca toˇ nyi-o. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve ponˬ laˬ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ hpeh‸ la jaw laˇ.

Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha chi, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve htawˇ, Yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˬsha awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui-aw laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ ve ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ maˇ puiˉ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ kawˆ piˇ leh hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nyiˇ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ hui chiˇ baˬ leh, pawnˍ taˍ ve punˇ kʼoˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ, shu ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ paw la taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼe te kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve le.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi taˍ leh gʼehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Nawˇhpaˆ venˇ yaˇ leh Taˍpaˍnehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ dawˇ law leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve le. Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ dawˬ gaˇ ve laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ dawˇ law leh, nawˬ hui Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve le. Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ ca dawˬ nyi gaˇ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ hui te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kawˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui. Mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ shiˍ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ leh, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ le le awˬ hawˉ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te leh da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ yawˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ, sha pehˍ hkʼaˬ ma yehˇ leh iˉ kaˆ hehˉ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ te, teh‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le. Nawˬ hui lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ shawˍ ca gaˇ jaˇ leh gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ shawˍ ca toˇ chehˇ ve piˉlaˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ shawˍ gʼa‸ htaˇ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ meuˇ la tuˬ te gʼa le. Piˉlaˬ awˬ paˍ lehˬ awˬ ma hta‸ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ shawˍ chaw yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, awˬ ma hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma te leh nawˬ hui ve hkuiˉ nuˆ tzuh‸ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui ve hkʼaw‸ hkʼaw goˇ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Shu hpeh gʼa ve chaw hkʼawˇ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Suhˆ cehˬ hta‸, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ pa yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw leh, haˉ hpawˇ hta‸, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ e yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh ngaˬ geh lo maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve pa taw, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ hpoˆ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le. Nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ga laˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve gʼuiˬsha htawˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ cawˬ le. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te‸ chiˉawˬ bon maˇ tawˆ la. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon shehˇ de lonˉ leh kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te kʼai leh, nawˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ haˉ lehˬ, yawˇ ve shi caˆ hta‸ leunˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. La‸ kʼawˍ toˆ tuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ htawˇ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ leunˇ-aw laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui ha‸ gʼa tuˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ henˇ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve ka‸, Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui htawˇhpfuhˆnawˬhpfuhˆ te chehˇ ve le. Aˍsuˇ riˆ chaw nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve hkʼe, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ taw jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ maˇ hpeh‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe maˇ ca te taˉ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ kaˬ cawˬ-aw laˇ. Aˍraˆ chaw lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw hkʼawˇ dawˆ tuˬ law chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve hkʼaw, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, ya‸ taw puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Hkʼe ka‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇsiˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ-aw laˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe ca te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi ma Yuˇda‸ chaw hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui htawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ maˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ hui htawˇ meh maˬ lanˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ nyi ma Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la gaˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve htawˇ, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw a‸ kehˉ a ciˉ hkehnˇ chehˇ sheˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve lehˬ, ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ teh‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ-o‸. Suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui peuˬ, teh‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ.

Ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇ teˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ leh chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve chaw kʼaw‸ maˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ loˍ tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve kʼaw jaw teh‸ meh piˇ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw kʼaw‸ pawnˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo tu leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ yuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shu a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ Awˬ pa teh‸ kuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hkʼe, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve pa taw, dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ gu na-e laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ga laˇ puiˉ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ coˇ caˇ leh ca taˉ ve nuˇ, yawˬ, leh yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ya‸ taw jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo zuh‸ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ la gaˇ ve kʼo kʼaw‸ la-o. Ngaˬ canˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, ngaˬ geh laˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ mehˇ sheˍ ve nawˬ hui ve ti mi hta‸ mehˇ-oˆ. Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ kaˍ lo nawˬ hui ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ taˇ ca sheˍ keu.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ to ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, aˬ miˍ oˇ ve to‸ la chehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ lo‸-e tuˬ, Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ lo gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ lo‸-e loˬ. Taˇ te guiˇ chehˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ, yawˇ ve va‸ taˍ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, tawˆ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve maˇ mehˉ kʼai sheˍ ve pa taw, meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, anˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ aˉ hte‸ yuˬ mawˍ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw oˇ ve lehˬ, va‸ hpuiˇ shaˆ hta‸ meuˆ baˬ piˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hkʼe ceh maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ peu laˇ ve mvuhˇ haw lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, hehnˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nyi loˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, moˬ hkʼa shuˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw aˉ caw law hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, aˉ ceˬ a‸ kehˉ gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw cawˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ-o‸. Maˇ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw dawˇ nyi chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Danˍ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve hko hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui-oˬ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ ve leh nawˬ hui te ve maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ juˆ pawnˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ htawˇ diˆ vaiˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Behˬ heh ma hkawˇ leh, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve aˉ po kʼo htawˇ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ luˬ kʼai leh, ko taˍ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ tzuh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa kaˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve yaˇ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te puiˉ jaˇ leh, da‸ ve hta‸ te hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ nyi peu ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ cawˬ.
Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ chiˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ poˬ hpaw-e peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma naˆ ho‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ leh ngaˬ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ paˍ leh hkaˆ taˆ paˍ hui laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo hpaw taˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun tcuhˉ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ nyi sha tuˬ naˆ tsuhˇ shehˍ taˍ ve le. Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ nyi sha tuˬ awˬ hkiˇ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ha‸ ve chaw hui nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ leh, chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ maˇ paw jaw sheˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ paw tuˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ la‸ sheh che taˍ leh, Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, venˇ hkʼaw ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca toˇ nyi-o. Tcuh hkʼaw lo htawˇ ca toˇ nyi-o. Ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh naˍ, ca caw nyi-o. Oˇ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw hta‸ ca nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˆ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui nyi ma maˇ pa. Nawˬ hui lehˬ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ puiˉ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ chi hkʼe dawˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaˍ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui maˇ heˆ heˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ nyi shaˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yo hehˉ, teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la leh yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve venˇ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve chaw hui hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te maˇ jaˇ peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh, meh maˬ lanˉ hui geh ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ peuˬ leh awˬ shawˍ chaw gaˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ awˬ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, shu miˇ ma hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ cawˇ laˇ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ cawˇ laˇ.

Yawˇ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ piˇ tuˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te luˬ tcuh. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸-o ve pa taw, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ te‸ chiˉ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui haˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh tawˇ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh tuˬ, vuiˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui na gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ, nawˬ hui ve ceˇ caˬ leh nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te ve le, teh‸ shu na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Mehˆ shiˍ cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ mawˬ puiˉ leh, naˍ paw cawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ ve chaw kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kawˆ leh ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ maˇ te chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ jiˆ kʼai maˇ gʼa tuˬ miˬ tcuhˉ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬ baˇ uiˍ taˆ la gʼa ve htawˇ, miˬ tcuhˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ponˬ kʼai maˇ gʼa.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ leh caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ bon uiˍ hkawˇ yaw tuˬ maˇ dawˇ nyi.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, da‸ ve awˬ bon chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh yuˬ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ bon chi teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, pehˍ te leh ngaˆ htaw caˇ paˍ hkʼe law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve pehˍ lehˬ chaw hta‸ htaw yuˬ tuˬ ve pehˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˆ htaw paˍ lehˬ, miˉ chaw hkʼaw ngaˆ hkʼa biˇ doˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼawˇ keu taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ leh paw sha chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ leh chu la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ leh maˇ cawˬ. Suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ga piˇ. Fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw hpeh‸ tawˆ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui lehˬ heˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ ve le.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e loˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai-o. Teˍkawˇ venˇ hkʼaw behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, Beˍtaˍkaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ awˬ heˆ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh nawˬ hui ve venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo fa la ca te la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu taˍ-o‸. Sha gʼuˇ tcuhˆ la htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hoˆ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh peuˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la yoˬ.
Hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ. Ya‸ puiˉ ngaˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇpiˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ, suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htu baˬ leh ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ-o‸. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ fawˉ mehˍ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve leh, te luˬ te sheˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Naˬ ve gawˬ ve leh, naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ chi hta‸ chaw teˇgʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shaˉ yuˬ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shaˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ yanˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ nawˬ hui te gʼa ve hkʼe chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve htawˇ, a shu na tuˬ le. Yawˇ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa-o, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ ehˉ leh chaw haˉ paˍ hui hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui ve yehˬ, ti mi, leh awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nu ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw hpu ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ gu piˇ. Maˇ keh. Da‸ chehˇ-aw, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ la chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ canˇ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ya‸ taw chehˇ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ ya‸ taw. Mehˆ hpfuhˇ ka‸ maˇ luˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw hui paiˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui htawˇ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw ceh da‸ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh chiˇ nyi-o. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ piˍ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˬ lo le. Shu hta‸ na nyi leh toˇ kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ loˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na taˍ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Ngaˬ hui maˇ na, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nyi taˍ-o‸.

Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Sheˍbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuh ˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ pa leh awˬ yaˇ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi leh awˬ chawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ leh, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ toˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, gʼuiˬ baˇ lonˉ taˆ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ deu lehˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ hui hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ peuˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ka‸ ngaˬ hui kʼai maˇ haˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ leh, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼe te kʼo meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw zuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ suh-e leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca te luˬ la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la peuˬ.
Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve naˍ, nawˬ ca chaˬ nyi-o.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kʼaˍ jaˇ ve chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, sho hkʼa shuˍ heh jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ luˬ kʼai leh maˇ heˆ heˆ ve awˬ lawn ca kʼoˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ po hkʼaw aˬ miˍ to‸ da‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chiˆ taˍ ve sho maˇ kuiˬ kʼai puiˉ. Aˬ miˍ hkʼaˬ ma chiˆ jaˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ la puiˉ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve hpu teh‸ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui kuiˬ bon yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo huˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chehˇ ve cawˬ ve, te ve dawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ choˬ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ shu kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ yonˍ.
Nawˬ hui chehˇ ve cawˬ ve, te ve dawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa-o. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ha kʼaˉ da‸-o‸.

Hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi, leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ fawˉ mehˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ. Awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ shu heˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shu mawˇ hkʼawˇ ve, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve, leh nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ canˇ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ca va‸ taˍ kuiˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ ngaˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Shiˉlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ ca nyi-o.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, venˇbaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ yaw piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon bon taˇ lawˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon nawˬ taˇ hawˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ lawˬ hkawˉ. Ngaˬ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ mawˬ laˇ.

Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ suhˆ gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ aˬ miˍ ceh ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkaoˍmonˇ te leh, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ ma, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, gʼuiˬsha ma hta‸ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ya‸ taw tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, bon yehˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ, to nuˇ to shaˆ, suhˆ cehˬ, leh caˬ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ maˇ gʼa ve aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, tuˉ tanˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ. A shu yawˇ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai leh, shaˬ te shaˬ haiˬ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, tawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ-o‸. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, chaw suh htaˇ kʼa ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ canˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo Tawˇ hpehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ te leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hui hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe ca te tuˬ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼoˆ piˇ jaw. Dawˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi jaw.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Tawˇhpehˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo Hiˆnonˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve, Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kuiˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˍ piˇ kuiˬ awˬ ti maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ da‸ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa hkehˉ caˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nuˇ hkʼehˇ hkʼa shuˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo awˬ mu‸ ku oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ suh gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve le. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ tiˉ vawˆ taˍ leh, ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ na chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon maˇ dawˇ haˍ. Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ peuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ na nyi. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Va‸ laˇ gawˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la yanˇ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Aˉ pui kʼaˍ, piˉ cuˬ nyiˉ leh meuˇ tzuh‸ suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hpaw-e tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le. Nyi loˬ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ peuˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh va hta‸ yaw peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui chi beu‸ aˬ hto‸ ma cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ sheˍ le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve ti mi leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma ngaˬ shu hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ le le, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hpu ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ. Maˇ keh. Da‸ la chehˇ-aw, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ la ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve maˇ ya‸ taw leh laˇ. Nawˬ hui a ciˉ ka‸ ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw paiˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui htawˇ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ shaw hpoˆ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ geh kuˬ hpoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ shiˍ teˇ shiˍ ka‸ maˇ naw‸ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te leh maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ nawˍ kʼai peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui jo mui chehˇ ve le. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo ca suh-e veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui Yawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve pa taw, Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ taw‸ ma taw laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve a naˍ na-e la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la. Kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Danˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ la peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ naˍ hkʼawˇ meuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nyi loˬ. Shu meuˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa leh, awˬ taw‸ ma hehnˇ jaˇ ve vuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ chi, mehˉ kʼai tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Na sheˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ chehˇ-o ve laˇ. Ziˉonˍ ve jawˇmawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ chehˇ-o laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu gʼeu‸ jaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa sheˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw naˆ tsuhˇ maˇ cawˬ laˇ. Oˇ kaˬ lo saˍla‸ gʼonˍ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ na-e la ve le.

Shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ kuˬ hawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh vuiˇ kuiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ le. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ heˍ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ biˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ awˬ paˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi hta‸ ka‸ taˇ yonˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ Yaˍkoˆ hkʼa shuˍ heˍ puiˉ leh, awˬ chawˇ awˬ paˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ shu hta‸ awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ awˬ paˆ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw. Yawˇ hui heˍ puiˉ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ te ve maˇ bvuhˆ puiˉ.
Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ te leh, heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Sho hta‸ lawˍ ve hkʼe, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˍ leh lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Yawˇ hui ve ha tehˍ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve hkaˆ ce hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, heˍ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ na sha ve tawˇ yaw da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui shu hta‸ va htaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw pui leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬyoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai peuˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ hkawˇ maˇ gʼa kaˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hpaw kʼai peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬYeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ ve le. Chi hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ a shu cawˬ le. Shu hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, ngaˬ te tcuh ve hkʼe maˇ te.
Yawˇ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ ve hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve suhˆ hpa‸ caˍ piˇ leh, awˬ taw‸ ma taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Chaw suh-e htaˇ paˆ hawˬ puiˉ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui haˆ haˆ laˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo mehˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw suh-e htaˇ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te kʼa tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ beˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw taˆ la leh, ngaˬ hui ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, tcuh hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ti mi hkʼaw hpoˆ taˍ ve nuˇ hkʼehˇ leh shu gʼeu‸ baˬ leh shaw hpoˆ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve caˬ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ uiˍ cawˇ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ uiˍ cawˇ. Paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, a shu yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ uiˍ cawˇ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma uiˍ gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tiˉ nyi ma uiˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw, Yuˇda‸ chaw, Eˇdonˍ chaw, Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw, Mawˇbaˆ chaw leh uˉ hkeh mvuh yiˬ lehˍ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hteunˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Lawˇ kiˍ yaˇ hui te ve hkʼe nawˬ hui taˇ te. Mvuhˇnaw ma lo awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Shu kawˆ ve ka‸ nawˬ hui taˇ kawˆ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo suhˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ htu baˬ leh, la‸shaˉmaˉ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ gu htawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
hpu leh shi yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve maˇ gʼa paiˍ tuˬ, sho cuˇ dawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˆ kawˆ tuˬ heh hkʼaw lo shu choˆ taˍ ve chaw awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˇ maˇ yaw puiˉ. Ya‸ kʼaw ka‸ maˇ juˇ puiˉ ve pa taw, shu gʼa chiˇ toˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ te laˇ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon htawˇ te laˇ maˇ gʼa, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh htawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
