Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ le. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˆ yan keunˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ geh lo, yawˇ hui aˬ hto‸ ma henˇ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ le.

Yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve hpu leh, Uˉhaˍzaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve shi yuˬ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chaw yaˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ te taˍ ve nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve hpa leh nawˉ lehˍ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬ hiˆ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa.

(Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ maˇ te hpanˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ ka‸ kʼaw‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ lawˇ kiˍ yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.)
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve moˬ hta‸ Yawˇ taˆ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼaw mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw hta‸ htawˇ meuˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ anˇ leh ka kehn piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ. A sha‸ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, gʼawˆ baˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha, hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ shu caw hoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw gʼa‸ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve hpa aˉ po kʼo teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Aˉ caˆ hkeh htawˇ cheˆ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve aˉ po kʼo hta‸ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ-o. Hpa yuˬ ko paˍ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ga laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ lawˬ. Chi pa taw yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai leh ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Na sheˍ. Awˬ lawn sha tanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw duiˆ-ehˍ shaˉ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ maˇ gʼa.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ gu piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh taˇ te laˇ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, nawˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw leh, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ maˇna yuˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸
Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼe hpeh‸ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi, yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe, awˬ haiˬ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi ve hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hkʼa shuˍ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ca ve htawˇ, ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ geh ca lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ chi hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ htawˇmaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ya‸ kʼaw cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ loˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ le. Ka ti‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, to nuˇ to shaˆ tuˉ tanˇ ve pa taw, luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ laˇ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ chehˇ ve shaˍlonˍ cehˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ jaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ mvuhˇ tawˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe, shaˍlonˍ hpa‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ hta‸ ti taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui te ya‸ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ sheh tawˆ-e chehˇve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve, Suhˆ cehˬ chi maˇ uiˍ tui‸ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui htu baˬ-a veuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ chi hkʼe bon lawˬ ve, Kanˇ paˆ uiˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma leh dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve kanˉ chi nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh yaw chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˍ meu‸ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ hta‸ ngaˬ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ awˬ lawn cawˬ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬhtaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ na nyi gaˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ paw sha jaˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, maˇ hteˇmaˇ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa gʼa chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ti taˍ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ geu naw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui uiˍ la leh awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh puiˉ jaˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ve yawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ gʼawˬ tawˆ-e piˇ-oˆ. Tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ shaw taˍ-o‸.

Hkʼaˬ maw maw ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ goˇ choˆ lehˍ hpeh‸ leh, ti mi hkʼaw ve mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ nawˍ kʼai chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ mawˬ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ suh kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼuiˇ-enˍ da‸ ve hkʼaw nawˬ heuˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼuiˇ enˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo ceh ka‸ nawˬ huˉ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo nawˬ huˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui na sha ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve ka‸, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ yonˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ ga hpoˆ htawˆ chehˇ ve ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ ca caˇ la tuˬ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ-o‸.
Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ti mi hta‸ naˆnehˆ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a muˆ maˇ taˍ.

Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ caˬ ti ve htawˇ, mvuh‸ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa gʼeu‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kanˉ te hkeu‸ jaˇ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ti taˍ ve caˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ naw‸ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ ve hkʼe, haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ maˍ piˇ jaw ve htawˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ka ti‸ te ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ aˉ po‸ teˇ hkʼoˆ ca vuiˬ deh tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ taˇ tsuhˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ kʼai leh aˉ po‸ teˇ hkʼoˆ ca vuiˬ deh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo kʼai leh, nawˬ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca faˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ aˉ po‸ oˇ ve hta‸ Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ca faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo faˉ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po‸ faˉ taˍ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai leh ca kʼaw‸ nyi htaˇ, aˉ po‸ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe haiˬ chehˇ sheˍ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve aˉ po‸ chi ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˉ po‸ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ hkʼa hawehˍ tawˉ taˍ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa hawehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te taˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu tuˬ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu kuiˬ je‸ mu‸ hkʼu lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ bvuhˆ suh-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ juˆ da‸ leh hkoˇ-e ve hkʼe, chaw mawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. A ciˉ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nyi ma nuˇnuˇ nehˬ nehˬ te leh, Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Naˆ ho‸ jaˇ la leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui hkui htiˇ maˇ gʼa poˬ paiˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ naˆ ho‸ kʼai sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.

Nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve awˬ pon baˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo mui chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ ya‸ la tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼawˆ taˍ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ ce kʼai peuˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hoˆ zuhˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai maˇ gaˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nyi loˬ. Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo le.

Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve chaw hui nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh uˉ peunˍ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ le. Nawˬ lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ tzuh‸ kʼai leh, shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ na nyi gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Awˬ shaˍ naˆ ve chaw lehˬ, hpu la tuˬ te gʼa-aw laˇ. Laˇ teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ mvuh ga‸-ehˍ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa gʼa-aw laˇ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te gʼa-aw laˇ.
Suhˆ hpa‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ canˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Shu miˇ ma hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo, nawˬ hui awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ le.
Mvuhˇmiˬ goˇ choˆ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, suh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ htawˇ, ga laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw sha ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ ca hkʼo tcuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ nanˬ bawˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, iˉ kaˆ hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ to kʼawˇ lehˍ te kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Nyi ma luˬ leh dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ goˇ kʼai peuˬ. Muiˬ caˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh, a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkuiˉ zuhˬ awˬ ma peuˍ htawˇ caˇ tuˬ ve zuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, paw la gehˇ sheˍ ve awˬ yehˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Haˇ tawˉ pehˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, heh hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ shaˉ gʼawˬ vaiˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, mehˆ hkʼa deh‸ nyi maˇ mawˬ-o.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ lehˬ, nawˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ, nawˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ haˉ tiˉ ca haˉ la ve hkehˉ chaw hkʼe te laˇ ve le.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ htaˇ shu hpeh gʼa ve chaw leh, ga laˇ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ chiˇ baˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ geh lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e gaˇ jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Yawˇ hui te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ geh bon taˇ lawˬ.

Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸tuˉ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve ka‸, ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ hkʼaw leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve hkʼaw suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ hpeh‸ ve leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve maˇ hpeh‸ la taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Tawˇ ca yaw tcuh taˍ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui dawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la taˬ. Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve maˇ gaˬ la taˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ heˍ toˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼawˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˍ piˇ paˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la peuˬ.

Venˇ baˬ lo ngaˬ ca tawˆ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, bawˆ da‸ leh suh taˍ ve chaw hkʼa biˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ lo‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ laˇ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ canˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ da‸ la maˇ hpeh‸ law‸ law‸ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ, aˬ hto ma pa taw ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, kʼaw‸ gu na-e laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ chiˇ baˬ laˇ-oˆ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ taˇ luˬ kʼai tcuh piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ te luˬ laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Mvuhˇ naw ma ka‸ mvuhˇ yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te puiˉ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Moˉseˍ leh Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ choˬ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˇ ceuˬ te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ hpuiˇ che‸ tzuh‸ leh ngaˆ htawˆ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˉ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geu‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve yaˇ Maˍnaˍseˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ te ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ le. A shu nawˬ hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ tuˬ le. Nawˬ hui chehˇ sha chehˇ-aw laˇ, teh‸ a shu kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ le.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ maˇ taˬ-o.

Venˇ teˇ maˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˆ hpa‸ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇ haw hkʼaw baˬ keu tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo ve shehˇ shiˍ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ la‸ haˉ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e ve awˬ e lehˬ, suh kʼehˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve hkʼaw nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma hpeh‸ bawˬ tuˬ uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ e ngaˬ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo keuˆ la piˇ ve le. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ tawˇ gʼa gʼawˬ da‸ leh, gʼa ya‸ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ hpu maˇ chiˇ piˇ jaw. Shu geh ka‸ maˇ ca chiˇ yehˇ jaw. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkeu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ te chehˇ ve kʼo, hkeu ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, tu‸ hkanˍ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ lawˬ hkawˉ ve kʼo ka‸, hkeu ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
(Awˬ na hpawˇ lo laˬ ve kuiˇ hkaw‸ da‸ taˍ ve sho hta‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˉ hteh maˇ gʼa.)

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ to‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh a ciˉ ga laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ca chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ taˇ yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na chehˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, shu geh daˬ hkʼo te leh awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ te shonˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, nyi ma hkʼaw lo beu‸ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ na-e la puiˉ ve le. Mvuhˇ goˇ yanˇ htaˇ fiˍ kʼai ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, daˬ hkʼo ca te toˇ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˉ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe ve chehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ awˬ miˇ ma taˇ heuˆ. Yaˇ ka‸ taˇ cawˬ la piˇ.
Choˬ kaˬ lo paw la ve yaˇ ehˉ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˍ piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo hpoˆ taˍ ve nuˇ hkʼehˇ hpoˆ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw nawˬ maˇ gʼa lo‸-e. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon ka‸ nawˬ taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve paw sha ve chaw leh haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chaw suh-e ve yehˬ lo kʼai leh, awˬ chawˇ ca te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. A shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e suh-e ve chaw htawˇ, nyi ma haˍ leh dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Shu hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ lo‸-e. Yawˇ hui geh ca caˇ ca dawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ taˇ ca lo‸ mui.

Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na-o. Hkehˉ caˇ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mehˉ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi taw taw ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ya‸ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te peuˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ haiˬ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ maˇ shiˍ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ na mvuhˇmiˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˇ ca paˍ maˇ maˇ hta‸ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Lawˬ hkʼo‸ haˉ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ shaˍ bawˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, te‸ chiˉ ka‸ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo mehˉ kʼai maˇ gʼa.

Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˇ pun hkanˍ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve suh taˍ ve awˬ to hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉcawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te gʼa-aw laˇ. Te maˇ gʼa taˬ. Yawˇ hui te gʼa puiˉ ve ka‸, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸, sho maˇ heˆ kʼo shehnˉ te taˍ ve naˬ meu‸ taˬ yuˬ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, nawˬ hui nyi ma shiˍ hkʼoˆ leh nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa ca te tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shehˇ de hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ ve aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo yeˬ chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ cha hkʼaˬ ma chiˆ ve htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ ve htawˇ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ. Awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ ve le. Chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ heˍ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gu na-e piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ lawˇ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw hpu ca chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ maˇ u taˍ ve awˬ u hta‸ ca mvuhˍ chehˇ ve ngaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, chaw gʼuˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve bon yehˬ lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve kʼaw jaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa baˬ taˉ ve chaw hui lehˬ, ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ meh hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hpeh‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ gu na-e laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ ho laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼai le. Chi beu‸ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ maˇ lawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ a ciˉ taˇ te laˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ tcuh laˇ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te toˇ chehˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ca hto piˇ-oˆ.
A shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ mawˇ maˇ gʼa pfuhˇ toˇ. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw mawˇ maˇ gʼa pfuhˇ lo‸ la.

A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw, mawˇ maˇ gʼa pfuhˇ tawˆ-e. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ kanˉ maˇ gʼa te. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, shinˉ nyi htaˇ venˇ chi hkʼaw mawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa yuˬ lo‸ la ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve kʼo,

yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ gʼa jaw ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa ciˇ toˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Benˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw, leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve chaw hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ leh, shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teh‸ gʼa shawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ mawˇ maˇ gʼa pfuhˇ laˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ leh, aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ ve yehˬ lo kʼai-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu te chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mu‸ hkʼu te tuˬ ve je‸ nehˆ teˇ diˬ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ maˇ da‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ je‸ nehˆ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon kʼaw‸ yehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Mu‸ hkʼu te paˍ lehˬ, je‸ nehˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh kanˉ te ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve chi maˇ cawˇ leh laˇ. Je‸ nehˆ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ,
mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ.
Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peˆ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ,
mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, awˬ haiˬ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Te maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hui haiˬ gaˇ ve hkʼe haiˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve teˇ pawˆ pawˆ hpeh‸ la jaw leh naˍ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca na nyi-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ.
Mvuh jaˇ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo vaˇ meu-e maˇ kʼa ve teˇ pawˆ pawˆ cawˬ jaw laˇ. Hkʼaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve gawˬ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ pawˆ pawˆ fiˍ kʼai jaw laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, da‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ piˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ-o. Cha‸ chiˆ ve venˇbaˆ ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ peuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Je‸ meu-e hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇhaˍ tuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi leh ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hui teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te piˇ-a veuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ tuˬ, tawˍ taˍ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ leh, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na laˇ sheˍ.

Da‸ ve hta‸ te ve pa taw gʼa ve awˬ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ce lo‸-e piˇ tuˬ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa zuhˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ sheˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ leh yaˇ suh-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e piˇ leh, yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Yawˇ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ peu laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ hawˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ce lo‸-e piˇ tuˬ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ va htaw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ nawˬ taˇ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ shonˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu teˇ maˬ ca vuiˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh,

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ca kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ chehˇ kuiˬ chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hui, maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ to, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ shiˍ jaw ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ suhˍ yuˬ sheˆ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ jaw. Dawˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi jaw.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ chi hta‸ Tawˇhpehˆ, teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hta‸, Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ kuiˬ, teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe te luˬ piˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ chawˇ chawˇ tiˇ caˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ shiˍ kʼai taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, ngaˬ vuiˬ taˍ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ leh venˇ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˆ hkoˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkoˇ kʼai peuˬ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu chi hkʼa shuˍ, kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ da‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ Tawˇhpehˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw tuˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chehˇ kuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Venˇ chi ve leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Tawˇhpehˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo meu‸ keu shiˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tawˇhpehˆ hkʼa shuˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Tawˇhpehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi hkʼaw ngaˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ lo‸-e leh,

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, venˇ chi ve leh awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yaw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸, Iˉmaˍraˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Paˍshuˇraˆ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˆ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Beˍyanˍmenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hpui hpehˇ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ Paˍshuˇraˆ teh‸ meh taˍ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇnawˬ hta‸, Teˇ kaˬ le le kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, teh‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ leh nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ canˇ paˍ la‸ hkʼaw suh-e ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍ lonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ chi hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Paˍshuˇraˆ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ to leh nawˬ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ laiˉ pawˆ heˍ piˇ jaw peuˬ ve nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh nawˬ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ Paˍshuˇraˆ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ leh ngaˬ chaw gʼuˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shonˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇnyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ pawˆ le le, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh deˇ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw-o, teh‸ dawˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw to‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gawˬ lehˍ ca chehˇ taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Teˇ kaˬ le kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui shaˉ nanˉ lo ca kʼoˆ piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ tsuhˆ-ehˆ te da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ beˬ yuˬ leh, kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve kanˉ maˇ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw, yawˇ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw lawˇ nyi canˇ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ mawˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ paw la ve awˬ nyi hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ e ngaˬ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ-oˆ.
Yaˇ paˍ paw la ve law teh‸ ngaˬ pa hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve chaw hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ naˬ jaˇ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa kaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tuˍ hpfuh hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, ngaˬ paw la taˍ ve le. Tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ suh-e tuˬ awˬ pon laˇ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Maˍlaˍhkiˆ yaˇ paˍ Paˍshuˇraˆ leh Maˍseˍyaˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ hta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ leh, chi hkʼe ca na nyi peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ tan Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˇ a ciˉ yaw laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ anˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te leh, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tcuh tuˬ leh naˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shonˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ venˇ kʼaw ji lo ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, leh naˬ beu‸ hkʼaw maˇ suh sheˍ ve nawˬ awˬ to, nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Na sheˍ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw nyiˇ caˆ teh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw leh, suh kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw chi ve nyiˇ caˆ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ-o‸.

Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, bawˆ da‸ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, chi beu‸ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui geh la‸ caˉ ca ya‸-e ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Venˇ chi hta‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Teˇ nyi le le hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ te chehˇ-oˆ. Shu heˍ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ tawˆ la piˇ leh, aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mvuh kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo nyi ya‸ peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu leh, aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Daˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼai leh,
oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Na sheˍ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Shu heˍ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Hkehˉ chaw, yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˬ taweh taˇ te. Da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˉ te kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hawˉ yehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa ciˇ toˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, hawˉ yehˬ chi ve luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve hawˉ yehˬ chi ve lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chehˇ kuiˬ chi hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chehˇ kuiˬ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ceˉ ceˇ yuˬ veu laˇ leh nyi sha ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la htaˇ, choˬ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chi taw taw uiˍ ve venˇ chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te piˇ ve le, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇshiˆ awˬ pon nawˬ hui taˇ hawˬ chehˇ. Yawˇ suh-e ve pa taw, nawˬ hui taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇ-aˍhaˆ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ paw la ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇshiˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇ-aˍhaˆ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ choˬ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ. Teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Shu yuˬ kʼai ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ gʼa suh-e leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ maˇ piˇ leh kanˉ nyiˉ te tcuh ve chaw htawˇ, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve yehˬ teˇ maˬ te shaˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ te keu peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, naˆ tsuhˇ nyiˉ-ehˍ ve yuˬ shehˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve yawnˉ suhˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ te taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ laˇ. Nawˬ pa lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le uiˍ la da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve pa taw, te‸ chiˉ sho‸ sha‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ suh-e ve hta‸ dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Suh-e peuˬ ve Piˉlaˬ hkʼa shuˍ, shu yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ baˬ lo gʼawˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, ca kuˬ hawˬ toˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Mawˇbaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ kʼai leh ca kuˬ hawˬ toˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui paw sha chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ maˇ na yuˬ. Nawˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve venˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ laˬ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui lehˬ yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ ve yaˇ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Hkawˇniˆ awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh hkʼoˆ lo tcuhˉ taˍ ve la‸ peˍ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh,
nawˬ kawˆ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ e hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ maˇ keuˆ la jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ gaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼa kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Hkawˇniˆ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkoˇ kʼai peuˬ ve je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Chaw chi lehˬ, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ tuˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.

Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ piˇ leh, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hpaˆ da‸ kʼai peuˬ ve ngaˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw kʼaw‸ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ leuˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ chaw yaˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ na ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ jaˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hkeu ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ dawˇ haˍ leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui te toˇ chehˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ, leˆ jaˇ leh naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh haiˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ yawˇ hui te piˇ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ haiˬ hta‸ tiˉ te kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve suhˆ hpa‸ caˍ piˇ leh, awˬ taw‸ ma taw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ maˇ hteˇmaˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw biˇ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Yawˇ hui dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve chaw hui hta‸, Maˇ keh. Teˇ ceuˬ le le da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ piˇ leh, haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi ve hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ maˇ yaw piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, teˇ kaˬ lo tiˉ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca va‸ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, ngaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.
Zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ca heˍ toˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Yawˇ hui zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ shu hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh Baˍlaˆ guiˬ sha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kʼai ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ puiˉ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ cuˉ leh caˬ shiˍ hkʼaˬ ma peun da‸ ve le.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ leh haˉ pui hta‸ dawˆ meu-e piˇ ve hta tu hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu ve tawˇ hta‸ ca gʼawˆ kʼaoˍ leh, Chi lehˬ ngaˬ geh gʼa ve tawˇ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ toˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe kʼoˆ leh, Chi lehˬ ngaˬ geh gʼa ve tawˇ yoˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ toˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh shu hta‸ ca heˍ toˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve zuh‸ maˆ teˇ hpaˍ ca kʼaoˍ maˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga piˇ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ le, teh‸ ca na nyi la ve kʼo, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hui ta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw, tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ yehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe na da‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ yehˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve le, teh‸ na nyi-o.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ yehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yuˬ leh vuiˇ kuiˬ lo baˬ peu tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ leunˇ kʼai maˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ ve ya‸ taw tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ shaˉ keu leh, bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ nyiˇ shiˍ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ ve yaˇ Hkawˇniˆ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ teˇmaˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ maˬ hkʼaw, kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma mawˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ da‸ jaˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ. Caˇ maˇ hpeh‸-o, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇshiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ lawn hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. (Chi ve lehˬ, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve awˉ lawˉ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ Yawˇshiˆ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ te leh, chi beu‸ nyiˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ biˇ la chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ caˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa zuhˆ tuˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ teh‸, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ bawˆ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve leh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa te leh hkehˉ caˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kawˆ faiˇ awˬ pon naˍ manˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Caˬ shiˍ htawˇ peuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Li‸ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ keu taˍ ve kawˆ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼai peu laˇ ve chaw hui geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca taw piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui geh gaˬ la tuˬ ve ma‸ lonˉ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai peu laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ oˇ ve taw piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ chi beu‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, shu hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Kawˆ chi hta‸ gʼa dawˬ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˆtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Uˉzaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ, Gaˍzaˍ, Eˇkaˍronˍ, Aˍshaˍdawˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ, Aˍmonˍ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Deˍdanˍ, Teˍmaˆ leh Buˇzaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, uˉ hkeh mvuh ngeh chaweh taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Aˍraˆ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, chaw hteunˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Ziˇmaˍriˆ venˇ, Eˇlanˍ venˇ, leh Meˍdiˆ venˇ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa dawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ htawˇ kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh hpe‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, paiˍ leh kʼaw‸ tu la maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ tuˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve ma‸ lonˉ yawˇ hui geh gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˬ gaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Maˇ dawˬ maˇ hpeh‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ awˉ lawˉ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ taˬ, teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ kuˬ heuˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ kuˬ heuˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ mvuhˇ leh miˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ bvuhˬ kʼai leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh, haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peuˬ teˇ peˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ teˇ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ tuˬ hehnˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ duˇ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo, nuˇ hkʼehˇ hpoˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ haˍ leh je‸ meu-e hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˬ hkʼe tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ kuiˬ ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve hkʼaw kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ, haˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw huˉ taˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ taˇ teh taˉ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ. Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ peu laˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
