Nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ chi hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ guiˇ tuˬ ve venˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, Shiˉlonˍ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, venˇ chi htawˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw moˍ lonˉ ngaˬ paˇ lo hpoˆ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ lo gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi hpaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ chi ve leh venˇ chi ve awˬ lawn, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ to lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te laˇ-oˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ vuiˬ chi ve nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ tu la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Mawˇreˍshaˆ venˇ yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Miˆhkaˍ tawˆ la leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, ti mi hkʼa shuˍ mehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai leh, bon yehˬ te taˍ ve hkʼaw pui chi ve lehˬ, hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ jaw ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ. Heˍsaˍkiˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ka‸, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Kiˇriˇyaˆyaˍrenˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve, Sheˍmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ Uˇriˇya‸ htawˇ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ hkʼa shuˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo, venˇ chi awˬ lawn kʼoˆ jaw ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Uˇriˇya‸ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Uˇriˇya‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ lehˬ Uˇriˇya‸ hta‸ ca hpeh yuˬ tuˬ Aˍhkaˍbawˇ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍnaˍtanˍ leh awˬ nu ve chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ geh shiˍ kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, chaw tuˍ hpfuh lo ca yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.)
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Aˍhiˆkanˍ ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ehˉ kʼaweh‸ teˇ maˬ te leh, nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ la ve Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ, Aˍmonˍ, Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, miˬguiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peˆ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ te gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh, naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ la‸ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa gaˬ taˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ, faˍ te puiˉ paˍ leh zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ puiˉ paˍ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui na yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ leh nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te ve chaw hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa muiˬ caˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hkʼaw suh-e gaˇ ve le. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ te gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ taˇ te, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha Yawˇ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ na chehˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ leh, nawˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve bon yehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maw maw choˬ ka‸ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Yawˇ hui heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ taˇ na. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw venˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui luˬ kʼai piˇ gaˇ ve le.

Yawˇ hui awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, chi beu‸ bon yehˬ leh jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
(Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Hkawˇniˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw, kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Bon yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ teh taˉ laˇ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Mawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai leh, ngaˬ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tcuh sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Heˍsaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ, Giˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Aˍzuˇraˆ ve yaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍnaˍniˆ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ leh chaw yaˇ chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ peuˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai taˍ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Hkawˇniˆ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ leh, chaw yaˇ chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ jaˇ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ ve mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh, shu hpeh kʼai taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ htaˇ heh‸, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Haˍnaˍniˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ pfuhˇ taˍ ve ehˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ dawˆ hteh leh,

chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ shu hta‸ pfuhˍ piˇ taˍ ve ehˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe te dawˆ hteh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍnaˍniˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve ehˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ dawˆ hteh gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ sho ehˉ kʼaw-eh‸ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sho ehˉ kʼaweh‸ kʼaw‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍngaˬ Haˍnaˍniˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haˍnaˍniˆ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Nawˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, nawˬ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, chi hkʼaw‸ maˇ peuˬ sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ teˇ hkʼaw‸ ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw yawˇ suh-e ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ shiˍ kʼai taˍ ve paw hkuˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Hkawˇniˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ e, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh puiˉ jaˇ cheuˬ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ li‸ chi hta‸ bvuh‸ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ chi ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ geh kʼai peuˬ ve Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍsaˍ leh Hiˇlaˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ Geˍmaˍriˆ hui hta‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te leh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Hko htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ te caˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ da‸ leh yaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ da‸ leh, yaˇ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa maˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ coˇ caˇ te-o. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui uiˍ la da‸ la ve kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ, maˇ heˆ kʼo faˍ te puiˉ ve chaw hui heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa na tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Yawˇ hui zuh‸ maˆ hkawˇ yaw laˇ ve hta‸ taˇ na.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve 70 hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ pon, ngaˬ kanˉ hkʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gu chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yoˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ leh nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui leh uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu leh hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ peu laˇ taˍ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve, Kawˇlaˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Aˍhaˆ leh Maˍseˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hui awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍ hkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hkeu da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ ve Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh Aˍhaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve lehˬ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Neˍheˍlanˍ venˇ yaˇ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Maˍseˍyaˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, paw hkuˇ Yawˇyaˍdaˆ awˬ tan, nawˬ hta‸ paw hkuˇ te tcuh laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ nawˬ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve, Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ nawˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te piˇ ve le.

Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ te chehˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hko te caˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Sheˍmaˍyaˆ awˬ lawn Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe tawˇ shanˍ feu tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Sheˍmaˍyaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ maˇ yaw piˇ ve ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw leh heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ tuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ maˍ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ li‸ kʼoˆ hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ jaˇ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ dawˇ nyi loˬ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paw gʼa-aw laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ shoˆ chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ shaˍ hpuiˇ tuˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve le.

Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi teˇ nyi ka‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ca tehˆ maˇ gʼa taˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ lo pfuhˇ taˍ ve ehˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ hpui baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Nawˬ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ leh hkʼe leˇ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi taw taw hehnˇ jaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆpiˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ve a naˍ lehˬ, na-e la maˇ gʼa taˬ. Nawˬ hui ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kʼaw‸ da‸ la maˇ gʼa taˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui ve a naˍ awˬ pon naˆ tsuhˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ lo‸ bawˆ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, hehnˇ jaˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, taˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui na-e la tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ te luˬ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw lehˬ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, shu chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve a naˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu na-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ leh, yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ maˇ la leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼe ngaˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ ca ya‸ la ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˇ kuˬ ve kʼo, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ haˆ ve le.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, haiˬ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ oˇ ve mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn chi hta‸ leuˉ leh shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Suh kuiˬ lo ponˬ tawˆ la taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼaˇ jehˇ gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh yawˇ hui geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ leh ha‸ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la mvuh la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve tinˍ hteˆ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve hkʼaw kʼaˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼeˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Saˍmaˍriˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo a pehˉ meuˇ hko gʼa kaw‸ te caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇhpaˍrenˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha geh Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon kʼa muiˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ peuˬ. Ha lehˬ kʼa muiˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo leh, hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ leh hkui luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ hu chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hawˬ leh ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hkui htiˇ maˇ gʼa poˬ tuˬ da‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ te toˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Awˬ pa hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ leh miˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ ca hto piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo laˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa chehˇ ve hko hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ sha piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ caˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Raˍhkeˍ laˆ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shu dawˇ sha la tuˬ te piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.

Taˇ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ shiˆ baˬ loˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, nawˬ te piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, canˇ paˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa tawˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ suhˇ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw ngaˬ hui nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ hui dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ chehˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa toˇ kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ chaw hui-oˬ, kʼaw‸ la-o. Nawˬ hui ve venˇ hkʼaw lo ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ la-o.

Maˇ yonˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw jo chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˉ awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ hta‸ tu ca ve hkʼa shuˍ anˇ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw pui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon na‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo muiˬ caˇ paˍ leh ceˇ caˬ hu caˇ paˍ hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Heuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ leh, awˍ meu‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˍ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa leh awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa biˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Awˬ pa awˬ e ci ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ caˇ ve pa taw, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ciˬ hkehˇ ve, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ci ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ caˇ ve chaw ceh tiˉ ciˬ hkehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, te ya‸ leh venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw ceh tiˉ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ piˍ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hpawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ bvuh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui maˍ da‸ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw mawˇ hta‸ te leh yaˇ ehˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ya‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tawnˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ tuˬ, ha pa leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ Yawˇ nawˍ tu piˇ leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui htawˇ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ tehˆ nyi gʼa leh, miˬguiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hta‸ ca mawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ heh‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chiˇ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍnaˍneˍlaˆ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ te leh, awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Gaˍrehˆ hkʼaw, Gawˇtaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ gu kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw tuˍ kuiˬ leh maˇ da‸ ve mawˇ gʼawˆ baˬ kuiˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸, Keˍdronˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve ti mi hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Iˉ mvuhˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ chi lehˬ, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ chi hiˉ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw shu hpeh haw taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ yaw ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh haw taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ chi hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh, tawˇ gʼa yaw da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ maˇ yaw piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ ve htawˇ, gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve aˉ shuˍ paˍ Shaˍlonˍ ve yaˇ Haˍnaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Aˍnaˍtoˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve ti mi nawˬ hta‸ ca na hawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ ca na hawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, Haˍnaˍmeˍlaˆ ngaˬ geh hawˉ yehˬ lo laˬ leh, yawˇ ve ti mi ca na hawˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na tawˇ yaw laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ leh, hpu teˇ chi suhˍ hteh‸ tsuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ti mi vuiˬ ve awˬ lawn chi, chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo li‸ bvuh‸ cheˆ leh hpu tsuh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, li‸ bvuh‸ cheˆ leh cuˍ dawˆ taˍ ve li‸ leh, cuˍ maˇ dawˆ taˍ ve li‸ oˇ ve nyiˇ kʼoˆ kʼoˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh,
Maˍseˍyaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Neˍriˆ ve yaˇ Baˍruˆ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍnaˍmeˍlaˆ leh awˬ nu ve shaˉ hkiˆ chi ma ve gʼuˇ suhˍ li‸ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi ma ve gʼuˇ suhˍ, ngaˬ Baˍruˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh hkanˍ tuˬ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu leh faˉ taˍ-o‸.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo yehˬ, ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ vuiˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ Baˍruˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ pa awˬ e te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ leh, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ laiˉ ceuˬ gu leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ laiˉ ceuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui te ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe awˬ bon te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, anˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ka‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ anˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Anˇ tuˬ leh kawˆ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ. Nawˬ te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ te. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ chi ve awˬ jaˇ awˬ ji lo ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, venˇ chi lehˬ canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, venˇ chi ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve htawˇ, chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ti mi oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Venˇ chi hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇ chi hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ chi hta‸ tanˬ kawˍ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ tiˉ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ keu leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Hiˆnonˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ te leh, Mawˇloˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ jaw. Dawˇ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi jaw, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ-oˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve pa taw, venˇ chi ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ taˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ leh, choˬ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui choˬ kaˬ lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ taˉ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ la tuˬ, ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw co co taiˍ taiˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve da‸ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi lehˬ, chaw yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw cawˬ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ vuiˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, vuiˬ da‸ pa da‸ ve li‸ bvuh‸ cheˆ leh, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, choˬ kaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, chi hkʼe te da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ shiˍ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui duˇ taˍ ve ta‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ da‸ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw chaw suh maˇ ve tiˉ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ chi ve leh venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu na-e piˇ leh, kʼaw‸ chehˇ sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ tsuhˇ kehˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ chi lehˬ, ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la kuiˬ leh, ngaˬ ve nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh uiˍ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, to nuˇ to shaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve ka‸ cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ maˇ chehˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha lehˬ leh kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh hkehˉ caˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ lo ca tuˉ tanˇ la chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ leh Yawˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, da‸ jaˇ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ gʼaw nyi chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh jawˇmawˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸, Ngaˬ hui ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha, teh‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ paw hkuˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ kanˉ te kʼai tuˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ. Ka ti‸ chi ve teˇ pawˆ ka‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ te tuˬ leh, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ paw hkuˇ te tuˬ, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ka ti‸ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpe lo cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ piˇ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ kaˇ-aw laˇ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ nyi bawˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teh‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ-o.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ awˬ liˇ te teh taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ leh yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ geh kʼai leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ hpeh yuˬ leh yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ leh tawˇ gʼa yaw da‸ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ jawˇmawˇ te taˉ peuˬ ve nawˬ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e htaˇ, shu sha hawnˉ tuˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ suh-e htaˇ htawˇ shu sha hawnˉ tuˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ suh peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve Laˍhkiˇshaˆ venˇ leh Aˍzeˍkaˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ hoˆ bawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ jehˬ da‸ leh,
shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw hawˉ hkʼaˆ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, chi hkʼe te tuˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw yawˇ hui nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kanˉ kʼaw‸ nyiˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ shu ceˬ te peuˬ ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Aˉ suhˆ teˇ nyi nawˬ hui nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, ngaˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ leh, shu ve awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ jeˆ hkoˇ leh, oˇ ve nyiˇ hkoˇ awˬ kaˍ lo juˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ leh, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui nuˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ca bawˆ la leh teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui venˇ chi lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇ chi hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve hteunˍ lonˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍhkaˆ chaw hui geh kʼai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ na‸ uˉ ca te da‸-o‸. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ laˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Haˍdaˍziˆmaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Jaˍyaˍnyaˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Iˉgaˍdaˍliˆ ve yaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍnanˍ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ bawehˇ chi lehˬ Shaˍlunˍ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Maˍseˍyaˆ ve bawehˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu leh Yeˍhkaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ dawˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ, Yeˍhkaˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ leh, ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ shanˍ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ maˇ gʼa te chehˇ tuˬ, ti mi maˇ gʼa te caˇ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ hko maˇ gʼa te caˇ tuˬ leh maˇ gʼa vuiˬ yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shanˍ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, hkehˉ chaw hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ caˉ chehˇ kʼai hpeh‸ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ shanˍ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui leh, ngaˬ hui ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ dawˬ jaw.
Ngaˬ hui yehˬ maˇ te chehˇ. Aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ hko, ti mi, heh, teˇ hpaˍ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui sho‸ sha‸ bawˬ leh, choˬ kaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo ca hpaw chehˇ la taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve le.

Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ dawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ, taˇ dawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ caˉ chehˇ kʼai hpeh‸tuˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ pui, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw htaˇ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ kuˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍhkaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ka ti‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇnaˍdaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, li‸ daw teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸. Yawˇsiˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ tanˬ yaw piˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Neˍriˆ ve yaˇ Baˍruˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ bvuh‸ keu tcuh ve yoˬ. Baˍruˆ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ li‸ daw teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍruˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Shu ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ lo kʼai tuˬ, a hkaw-anˬ maˇ pe‸ laˇ-o.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ ce ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ daw chi hta‸ yuˬ veu leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh gʼaw maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ naˍ, maˇ shiˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Baˍruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍruˆ lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh li‸ oˇ ve ca gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ htaˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ ce leh pawehˇ te tuˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo hpawnˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ htaˇ, Baˍruˆ lehˬ Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ, ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Geˍmaˍriˆ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍhpanˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Geˍmaˍriˆ ve yaˇ, Miˆhkaˍyaˆ lehˬ, Baˍruˆ gʼaw chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼai leh, a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve ceˇ leˇ lonˉ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ, Shaˍmaˍ yaˆ ve yaˇ Daˍlaˍyaˆ, Aˍhkaˍbawˇ ve yaˇ Eˇlaˍnaˍtanˍ, Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Geˍmaˍriˆ, Haˍnaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˆhkaˍyaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ gʼa kaˇ taˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, a ma‸ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kuˇshiˆ, Sheˍlaˍmiˆ, Naˍtaˍniˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍhuˇdiˆ hta‸ Baˍruˆ geh kʼai tcuh leh li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ ca yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍruˆ li‸ oˇ ve yawˇ hui geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, a ma‸ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mui taˍ leh li‸ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Baˍruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Baˍruˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ nyi da‸ sheˬ leh, Li‸ chi jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼa ca yuˬ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Baˍruˆ hta‸ na nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Yeˍraˍmiˆ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve laˇ, teh‸ Baˍruˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Baˍruˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍraˍmiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ leh ngaˬ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ca va‸ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hkʼaˬ lo ca va‸ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ shiˍ tcuh, teh‸ Baˍruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

A ma‸ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, li‸ daw oˇ ve hta‸ ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw teh taˉ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Yeˍhuˇdiˆ hta‸ li‸ oˇ ve ca yuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yeˍhuˇdiˆ lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ paˇ lo mui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍhuˇdiˆ li‸ gʼaw chehˇ ve shehˆ awˇ taw hkʼe peuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ shawˆ cheˆ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, li‸ oˇ ve teˇ daw hkʼa peu-eˬ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kawˆ leh dawˇ haˍ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Eˇlaˍnaˍtanˍ, Deˍlaˍyaˆ, leh Geˍmaˍriˆ hui lehˬ, li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ maˇ gʼa tuˉ baˬ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve htawˇ yawˇ maˇ na.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ to leh ngaˬ ve ceˇ leˇ Baˍruˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ, Yeˍraˍmaˍlaˆ, Aˍzaˍreˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Seˍraˍyaˆ, Aˍbaˍdeˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Sheˍlaˍmiˆ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ daw oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
li‸ daw awˬ suhˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ keu tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, li‸ daw oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, li‸ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ bvuh‸ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ nawˬ hta‸, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, Daˍviˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh taˍ ve nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ shu gʼawˆ baˬ leh, mvuhˇ cha chiˆ ve leh ciˍ gʼuiˬ nehˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍruˆ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ nu ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ kʼaw‸ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ bvuh‸ keu tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ teˇ pawˆ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ ve yaˇ Hkawˇniˆ awˬ tan, Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Sheˍlaˍmiˆ yaˇ Yeˍhuˇkaˍlaˆ leh Maˍseˍyaˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ Zeˍhpaˍ niˆ hui hta‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ ca kʼoˆ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa geh sheˍ. Kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui nawˬ hta‸ ca ga la tuˬ laˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la taˬ, teh‸ taˇ dawˇ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve kʼoˆ loˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo naˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ jiˆ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Beˍyaˍmenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ vuiˬ taˍ ve ti mi hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ, ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Beˍyaˍmenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo shaw chehˇ ve Haˍnaˍ niˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ Sheˍlaˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Iˉriˆyaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui geh hpaw-e toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hpaw toˇ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉriˆyaˆ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh leh, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hui geh shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ jaw‸ hpehˇ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, ceˇ leˇ lonˉ Yawˇnaˍtanˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ haw taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ yehˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw, awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh keu taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ca kuˬ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu nawˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve cawˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ hkʼawˇ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Yoˬ, cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ya‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw hpeh keu laˇ ve le.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ maˇ ca bawˆ la taˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ le.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇnaˍtanˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh haw laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ceh kʼaw‸ haw taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ peuˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ nyi ve hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Maˍtaˍ ve yaˇ Sheˍhpaˍtiˆ, Paˍshuˇraˆ ve yaˇ Geˍdaˍliˆ, Sheˍlaˍmiˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍhuˇkaˍlaˆ leh Maˍkaˍhkiˆyaˆ ve yaˇ Paˍshuˇraˆ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui geh kʼai leh a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ ca ya‸ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, Chaw chi hpaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ, tawˇ laiˉ ceuˬ ca yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ yaw. Yawˇ hui nyi ma luˬ tuˬ tiˉ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te-o. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Maˍlaˍhkiˆyaˆ ve nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ. Naˬ bawˍ oˇ ve hkʼaw iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ. Je‸ nehˆ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw lo yuˬ keu taˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve Ehˇtaˍyoˇpiˆ chaw awˬ tawnˇ paˍ Eˇbaˆdaˍmeˍlehˆ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Eˇbaˆdaˍmeˍlehˆ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ te ve kanˉ lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw lo yuˬ keu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ hkʼaw lo hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ cawˬ-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆpiˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ maˇ suh sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca gʼawˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ, Eˇbaˆdaˍmeˍlehˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇbaˆdaˍmeˍlehˆ hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ piˍ teˇ hpaˍ ca yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ piˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkeh hpeh leh ngaˬ geh ce peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ maˇ gʼa naˬ tuˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ piˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve la‸ kʼaˉ hawˉ nuˆ taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw gʼawˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw chehˇ tcuh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ paˇ lo kuˬ yuˬ leh, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ na nyi gaˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ taˇ faˉ taˍ. Hteˇ lehˍ hto laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ hto piˇ kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve kʼo ka‸, nawˬ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hto‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ la‸ caˉ ya‸ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ leh, venˇ chi ve hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ ve kʼo, venˇ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh nawˬ htawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui geh la‸ caˉ ca ya‸ taˍ peuˬ ve ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve, awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ ha oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui shiˍ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˆ-e chehˇ htaˇ, kʼa chehˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ je‸ nehˆ hkʼaw kʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˉ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve miˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ka‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh yuˬ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ chi hkʼe na‸ uˉ hkʼawˇ te da‸ ve awˬ lawn chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ shiˍ tcuh. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw da‸ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn gʼa shiˍ kʼo, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ da‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ ca na la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hteˇ lehˍ hto piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ka ti‸ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe ca na la ve kʼo, Htawnˍ hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ keu laˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ca na nyi la ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ ca jaˆ na chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ te maˇ gʼa.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw tiˉ haw taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼawˇ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa teˇ chi maˬ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve 11 hkʼaw‸, ha pa awˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, kʼawˇ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lanˇ venˇ paˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
(Oˇ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Naˍraˍgaˍsaˍreˍzaˍ, Saˍgaˍneˍbawˇ, Saˍseˍhkenˍ leh awˬ nu ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, venˇ kʼaw ji lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.)

Venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hko hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, lanˇ venˇ nyiˇ maˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ paˇ lo Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ hpeh gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ Riˇbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍ neˍzaˍ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ piˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai tuˬ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ leh awˬ nu ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, la‸ caˉ ya‸ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍ lonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ ca nyi leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca ga piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te piˇ. Yawˇ loˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ, Neˍraˍgaˍsaˍreˍzaˍ leh awˬ nu ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh,

ngaˬ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Shaˍhpanˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Aˍhiˆkanˍ ve yaˇ Geˍdaˍliˆ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ,

Ehˇtaˍyoˇpiˆ chaw Eˇbaˍdaˆmeˍlehˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ sho caˆ hpeh leh venˇ oˇ ve lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Raˍmaˆ venˇ lo gaˬ htaˇ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpui hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Chi hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve sho caˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hpui baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai gaˇ ve kʼo kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ maˇ kʼai gaˇ ve kʼo te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˍhpanˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Aˍhiˆkanˍ ve yaˇ Geˍdaˍliˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ Yuˇ da‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ geh ca chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te gaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ leh caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ pe‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼo‸-e peu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ piˇ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˉ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Naˍtaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍmeˍlaˆ, Kaˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Raˍhuˇmehˆ ve yaˇ Saˍraˍyaˆ, Neˍtawˇhpaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Eˇhpehˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh Maˍhkaˍ venˇ yaˇ Yeˍzaˍniˆ hui, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Geˍdaˍliˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve hkʼaw chehˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ to lehˬ, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, gawˬ lehˍ muiˬ caˇ chehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Mawˇbaˆ, Aˍmonˍ, Eˇdonˍ leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ kʼai taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Geˍdaˍliˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpoˆ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh ca chehˇ la leh, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ gʼeu‸ jaw‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh la‸ caˉ maˇ ya‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Miˆsaˍpaˍ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh laˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˍmonˍ jawˇmawˇ Baˍliˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼai tcuh taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Geˍdaˍliˆ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ yonˍ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ jawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ve le. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai leh, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Geˍdaˍliˆ lehˬ, Oˇ hkʼe taˇ te. Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve maˇ cawˇ. Iˉshaˍmeˍ laˆ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇliˆshaˍmaˍ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Naˍtaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Iˉsaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, chaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ shiˍ veu leh, Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ lo Geˍdaˍliˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Geˍdaˍliˆ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh, oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la taˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ hkʼe teˇ nyi Geˍdaˍliˆ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ,

Sheˍhkenˍ, Shiˉlonˍ leh Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw 80 gʼaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh leh paˇ tcuhˆ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ tzuh‸ suhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve caˬ shiˍ leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui geh gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Awˬ bon te leh Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ a ciˉ ca nyi la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, nanˬ bawˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw 10 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ti mi hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui faˉ taˍ ve caˬ shiˍ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh hpu teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ.
Naˬ bawˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ Baˍshaˍ ma‸ ca bawˆ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Aˍsaˍ duˇ taˍ ve nanˬ bawˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Miˆsaˍpaˍ venˇ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ te ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, Giˇbonˍ gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ mi ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui geh gʼuiˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve chaw oˇ ve 8 gʼaˇ lehˬ, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw kʼai ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ shiˍ kʼai taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉshaˍmeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ leuˆ teh taˉ ve jawˇmawˇ Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo, yawˇ hui Behˍlehˍ hehnˍ venˇ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Hkiˇmaˍhanˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kaˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, Hawˇshehˇ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh,

Ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha geh bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ lehˬ nawˬ mawˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ya‸ kʼaw maˍ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, nawˬ hui lawˬ laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ faˉ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkeu laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui nyi ma cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw laˇ ve hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ 10 nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui na nyi tcuh laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ na nyi leh, Yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa te luˬ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ sha.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ leh, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw tiˉ chehˇ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ leh, Ngaˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e shaˍ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ma‸ bawˆ da‸ ve leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve kʼo,
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve kʼo,
nawˬ hui kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve ma‸ bawˆ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ leh, nawˬ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
