Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca hpaw chehˇ tuˬ, dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼoˆ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui lehˬ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve, shu beu shu hkʼaiˉ ve leh shu hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo maˇ hpaw-e cawˇ ve awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui dawˇ leh te chehˇ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon bon a ciˉ lawˬ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ gaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hawˇshehˇ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍriˆ, Kaˍraˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh awˬ nu ve nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo taˇ kʼai, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw ngaˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, Neˍriˆ ve yaˇ Baˍruˆ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca hkʼawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇhaˍnanˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo tiˉ hpaw-e gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇhaˍnanˍ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui shiˍ hpaw-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍ danˍ awˬ to Geˍdaˍliˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Baˍruˆ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Taˍpaˍnehˆ venˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, shaˉ nanˉ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo duˇ ti-o. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ huˉ nyi tcuh taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ shiˍ laˬ leh, nawˬ duˇ ti taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh keunˍ ve chaw hui naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e keunˍ ve chaw hui ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ she shaˉ baˬ ve hkʼe, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Behˆseˍmehˆ venˇ hkʼaw ti taˍ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw lonˉ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ, Miˆgaˍdawˇlaˆ, Taˍpaˍnehˆ leh Nawˇhpaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ sheˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh lo ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ leh, ngaˬ canˇ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ baˬ taˉ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe ka‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ya‸ nyi nawˬ hui htawˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui ca chehˇ la taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve le. Ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ leh laˇ. Shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh hkeu laˇ ve hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve laˇ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ, te taˉ peuˬ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui leunˇ kʼai peuˬ laˇ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma maˇ nuˇ la sheˍ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ taˍ uiˍ. Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa hpaw-e taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo meu‸ ve kaˆ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Choˬ kaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ la taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo te muiˬ te jaw ve hkʼe, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ ngaˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la leh, paw sha la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ ma chi ve hta‸ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ shuˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ te leh yawˇ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, chi hkʼe te tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Yawˇ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yeunˇ hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ leh hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ ka ti‸ te da‸ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, gʼuiˬsha ma oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ te kʼai loˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ na taˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, te‸ chehˇ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ cawˇ naˍ, maˇ heˆ leh nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve tawˇ cawˇ naˍ, yawˇ hui hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi awˬ tehˬ awˬ na biˇ la tuˬ, shaˉ hkiˆ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve hkʼe, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Hawˇhpaˍraˆ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇsiˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, Baˍruˆ lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍruˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpaˆ baˬ leh ngaˬ ti taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ baˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to pon uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe taˇ te. Ngaˬ lehˬ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ gʼa ponˬ leh, nawˬ kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Kaˍhkeˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍhkawˇ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, A shu yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai-o.
A shu yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ hpeh leh taˆ ciˇ-oˆ. Uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ leh a shu yawˇ ve gehˇ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ-o‸. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu gʼa‸ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi chehˇ.
Gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼuiˇ maˇ ponˬ. Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo yawˇ hui hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼuiˬ lonˉ haˉ lonˉ te ya‸ la chehˇ ve chaw chi a shu le.

Oˇ ve lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ te ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tu la leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hoˆ beh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ leh venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Htanˬ tuˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve Suˍdanˍ leh Liˆbyaˇ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, hkaˆ pfuhˇ taˍ ve Luˇdiˆ ma‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tcuh-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi chi teˇ nyi lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Yawˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve aˉhtaw lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh naˆ tsuhˇ ca-e loˬ. Nawˬ hui ve naˆ tsuhˇ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ gu na-e laˇ maˇ gʼa.

Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui gʼa ya‸ taw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, nawˬ hui hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ htinˍ da‸ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Miˆgaˍdawˇlaˆ, Nawˇhpaˆ leh Taˍpaˍhehˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te leh gu taˍ-o‸. awˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui ve Aˍpiˆ gʼuiˬsha ma paiˍ ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ dawˆ baˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve yoˬ. Hkeu‸, ngaˬ hui canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa suh tuˬ, aˉ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e veuˬ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸, Tawˇ uiˍ leh te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa ve chaw, teh‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ leh te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Taˍbawˇraˆ hkʼaw lehˬ, awˬ nu ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ leh, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw htawˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui shu ceˬ ca te tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Nawˇhpaˆ venˇ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ lehˬ, chu jaˇ ve nuˇ ma haˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve pehˇ ma che‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nuˇ yehˇ hkʼe te‸ chiˉ te maˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼai. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ lehˬ vuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Suhˆ htu paˍ suhˆ tsuh de lonˉ hta‸ htu baˬ ve hkʼe, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paˉ ce‸ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ leh, ca gʼaw maˇ peuˬ taˬ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui te luˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh gʼa ya‸ taw jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Teˍbiˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍmonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hkʼa va chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ

Yawˇ hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe chaw yaˇ ca kʼaw‸ chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ hui shu ceˬ gʼa ca te chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui aˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ca kʼaw‸ te sho‸ sha‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ ceˬ gʼa te piˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ leh hkʼe leˇ hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi taw taw hehnˇ jaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ ca bawˆ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ. Awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ leh, gʼuiˬ lonˉ haˉ lonˉ te ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve venˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ beh tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ gʼuiˇ toˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ kʼai ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, deu lehˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te da‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Keˍreˍteˍ conˇ lo hpaw la taˍ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ Gaˍsaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la peuˬ. Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ maw maw gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha ve aˉhtaw-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw chaw hpehˇ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Aˉhtaw hpui hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ lo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kanˉ te tcuh taˍ ve pa taw, aˉhtaw oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe te jehˇ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, aˉhtaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Neˍbawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Kiˇriˆyaˆtenˍ venˇ leh ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ peuˬ leh, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Maˍdaˆmeˍnaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, venˇ oˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hawˇraˍnenˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Luˇhiˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw leh, Hawˇraˍnenˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˇ hui kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
A shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Hkeˍmuˇshaˆ gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaw pui leh miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ awˬ pon tuˍ hpfuh teˇ maˬ te taˍ-o‸. Maˇ maw maw yawˇ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
(Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Aˉhtaw yuˬ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ chaw pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.)

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˇ ka‸ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw sheˍ. Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, kaw teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa pa keu jaw sheˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hkui htawˇ maˇ pehˆ kʼai sheˍ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ mehˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ chaw hta‸ peu laˇ leh, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe ngeuˍ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ kaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngeuˍ baˬ leh dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw gʼa ya‸ taw ve hkʼe, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui htawˇ Hkeˍmuˇshaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼoˆ hpeh‸ le.

Mawˇbaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Cheuˬ jaˇ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ-oˆ.

Diˇbonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw mui taˍ-o‸. Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ shehˍ hpaˇ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ laˇ peuˬ.
Aˍyawˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo huˉ taˍ leh law taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˇ hpaw-e toˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e toˇ ve na nyi-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ Aˍnonˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Hawˇlonˍ, Yaˍhaˍzaˍ, Meˍhpaˆ,
Diˇbonˍ, Neˍbawˇ, Behˆdiˆbaˍlaˆtenˍ,
Kiˇriˆyaˆtenˍ, Behˆgaˍmuˇlaˆ, Behˆmeˍonˍ,
Keˍroˆ, Bawˇzaˍraˆ, leh vuiˇ kuiˬ neˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve Mawˇbaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ taw piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ. Mawˇbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hpe‸ baˬ taˍ kuiˬ lo htawˇhpfuhˆnawˬhpfuhˆ te chehˇ leh, shu ga hpoˆ gʼuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ sheˍ laˇ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw hkʼawˇ dawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hkʼe nawˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo ca chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Haˉ hpawˇ hkʼaw lo awˬ hpui ca te chehˇ taˍ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Mawˇbaˆ lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma caˆ muiˍ puiˉ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ uiˍ gaˇ uiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui nyi ma hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui caˆ muiˬ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ htawˇ, maw maw yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw leh Kiˇraˆhaˍrehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, ngaˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Siˆbaˍmaˍ venˇ yaˇ leh, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ ngaˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Siˆbaˍmaˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍzaˍ venˇ leh Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, gaˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ lo, ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo, ha lehˬ ha kʼa a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍbonˍ leh Eˇlaˍleˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Yaˍhaˍzaˍ venˇ, Zawˇraˆ venˇ, Hawˇraˍnenˍ venˇ, leh Eˇgaˍlaˆshaˍleˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Niˆmaˍrenˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ htawˇ fiˍ kʼai peuˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tawˍ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Suh-e ve chaw awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh lehˉ lu meuˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ lehˬ Mawˇbaˆ leh Kiˇraˆhaˍrehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, a shu yawˇ ve paˇ tcuhˆ leh uˉ hkeh mvuh chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ shawˆ hkʼaw leh, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ ve hkʼe, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yehˬ hkʼaw leh, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ-o‸. Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼa yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu bawˆ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Mawˇbaˆ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ leh va teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Kawˆ ve hta‸ pa taw gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve chaw lehˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ naˆ kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw gaˆ tawˆ-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Mawˇbaˆ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ.

Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Siˉhonˍ uˉ peunˍ jaw ve Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve ka‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ gaˇ puiˉ ve Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ leh hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkeˍmuˇshaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo le. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ-o laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Miˆlaˍkonˍ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui Gaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh taˍ ve le.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Raˍbaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ma‸ bawˆ hkawˇ kaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve leh awˬ nu ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, shu la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Heˍsaˍbonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Aˍiˆ venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Raˍbaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh, venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Miˆlaˍkonˍ gʼuiˬsha leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui caˆ muiˬ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la maˇ haˆ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve le.

Kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Aˍmonˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ chaw hui dawˇ nyi maˇ puiˉ-o ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ maˇ gʼa-o ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui ve cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve laˇ.

Deˍdanˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ca va‸ taˍ-o‸. Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo a ciˉ kʼaw‸ teh taˉ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ca hkʼawˇ toˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼehˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ca va‸ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui va‸ taˍ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca hpfuhˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh teh taˉ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui htawˇ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma leuˉ leh gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve kawˆ chi hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ lehˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh, hkeu tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ shawˍ tcuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ la piˇ lawˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ ve caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ ve haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ ce laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ venˇ lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hkeh Yawˇdanˍ hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ laˬ leh Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpaw tawˆ-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. A shu ngaˬ hta‸ tehˆ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇdonˍ chaw leh Teˍmanˍ chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ shu gʼawˬ tawˆ-e leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi lo hkʼa gaˬ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼa yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Eˇdonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Haˍmaˆ venˇ yaˇ leh Aˍpaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hoˆ beh la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ, naˬ jaˇ leh dawˇ maˇ tawˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ awˬ meh bvuhˬ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve venˇ lehˬ, chi beu‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ ve hawˉ yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Keˍdaˍ chaw leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ bawˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve Haˍzawˇ venˇ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve Keˍdaˍ chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve aˉ po kʼo, yawˇ hui ve ceˇ caˬ, leh aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh, Kawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Haˍzawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo hpaw-e leh ca va‸ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca te luˬ la tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ leh,
Laˬ-o‸. Gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca te luˬ piˇ-a veuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ maˇ ko taˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve kaˍlaˍoˆ leh nuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ-o‸. Uˉ hkeh mvuh ngeh chaweh nuˆ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haˍzawˇ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˇ maw maw Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve hkaˆ bawˆ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo ngaˬ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve chaw maˇ ca chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ cawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇlanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ ve kʼaw jaw hta‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo Eˇlanˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍmvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Taˇ faˉ taˍ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Maˍduˆ gʼuiˬsha htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hawˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ na leh, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ ve ka ti‸ te leh, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo caw toˇ chehˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpaw tawˆ-e loˬ. Shu gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa hpaw tawˆ-e tuˬ coˇ caˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve shaˍ bawˆ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, hkaˆ bawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, shu hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shu yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, kuˬ chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh caˬ naˆ chehˇ ve nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ha lehˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve venˇ lonˉ lehˬ, nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, shu hkʼe taw awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve goˇ kʼai leh, shehˇ de kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ anˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkaˆ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw hui-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve hkaˆ bawˆ keu-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.

Venˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nyi loˬ. Yawˇ hui la‸ caˉ ya‸ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ paiˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo caˬ ti tuˬ leh caˬ gʼeu‸ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ taˇ piˇ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ ca geu‸ hko‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw leh, Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ leh, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw venˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hpehˇ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Meˍraˍtenˍ leh Peˍkoˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te-o.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ hta tu oˇ ve hkoˇ kʼai peuˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve chi hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ jawˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw peuˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ kanˉ te tuˬ cawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve la‸ caˉ teh taˍ kuiˬ hta‸ hpaw leh, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw la‸ caˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ taˍ peuˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ hpawˇ le le hoˆ taˍ leh, caˬ ciˇ yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ lo bawˆ lo‸-e loˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh, venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Te‸ chiˉ ka‸ taˇ teh taˉ piˇ.
Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

(Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hpaw tawˆ la leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca hpaw chehˇ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hto maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.)

Hkaˆ taˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Hkaˆ bawˆ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o. Venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ ponˬ kʼai tcuh piˇ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ caˆ muiˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, venˇ jaˇ venˇ ji lo cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ leh, maˇ hpehˇ piˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼaˍ jaˇ leh kawˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ. Suh ve teˇ ceuˬ, ngaˍ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Mvuhˇ goˇ miˬ goˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw neˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve ngaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ laˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haiˬ jaˇ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ toˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh deu lehˍ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇdanˍ hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˆ la leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. A shu ngaˬ hta‸ tehˆ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ haˆ le. Jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ le.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu gʼawˬ tawˆ-e leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ ve awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˆ hpa‸ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caw bawˆ leh, awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkaˆ bawˆ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ yanˇ taˇ piˇ. Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ ponˬ piˇ. Ma‸ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo hpaw tawˆ-e loˬ. A shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e loˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui te ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ taˇ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve shi kawˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ dawˬ bvuhˆ piˇ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ leh gʼuˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, teˇ hkui ceh tiˉ paiˍ leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ ve naˬ kuiˬ hkʼaw kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon naˆ tsuhˇ ca shehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ na-e la tuˬ naˍ, maˇ shiˍ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh peuˬ. Chi beu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e veuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te luˬ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui cawˇ ve hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ maˍ laˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼo‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ hto piˇ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Meˍdiˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ nawˍ tu piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ ve awˬ tan, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ che leh, a shu yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw tcuh taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ lawˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ htawˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, paˉ ce‸ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve chaw moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la leh, moˬ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Moˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba tawˆ la leh, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh ka kehn chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ya‸ taw ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a sha‸ maˇ te‸ puiˉ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha, hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve hta tu hpeh‸ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ yehˇ chehˇ ve la‸ caˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ yehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˆ hkoˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hawˉ hkʼaˆ, yaˇ miˇ, chaw mawˇ, yaˇ nehˬ, yaˇ paˍ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ leh yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ti mi mehˇ paˍ leh yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼaw pui lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, nyiˉ ya‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui yehˇ taˉ peuˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yehˬ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ loˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Aˍraˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Miˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍshaˆkeˍnaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, gʼa ga bawˆ laˇ tuˬ hto piˇ-oˆ. Paˉ ce‸ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sheh tawˆ la-o.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Meˍdiˆ jawˇmawˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ca kuˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai leh, yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ geh gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ ca gʼuiˇ hto piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ ta hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa peuˬ leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˬ jaw‸ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ jaw‸ baˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh caˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ chi Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Ziˉonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh-o. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ chi Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh-o.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ fiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˍ meu‸ jaˇ chehˇ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ nawˇ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˬ ehˉ, aˉ che‸, leh awˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ peuˬ. Venˇ chi luˬ kʼai ve lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ uiˍ taˆ la leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ law‸ law‸ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve shehˇ de hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼawˇ yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo hpaw tawˆ-e loˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e loˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw sho‸ sha‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo gaˬ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, suh ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ peuˬ. Chi beu‸ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Taˇ law chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ peuˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Baˍbuˍlonˍ gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo naˬ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼa biˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ ca te taˍ ve htawˇ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ gawˬ kʼai tuˬ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te leh, venˇ oˇ ve lo gʼuiˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hui hpeh yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hteh kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ haiˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ yawˇ te taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ nawˇ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo dawˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ leh, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve ceˇ leˇ lehˬ, Maˍsaˍyaˆ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Neˍriˆ ve yaˇ Seˍraˍyaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Seˍraˍyaˆ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ geh Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu leh Seˍraˍyaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, choˬ kaˬ lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon chi hkʼe lawˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ venˇ chi hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, te‸ chiˉ chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bon lawˬ-o‸.
Seˍraˍyaˆ-oˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ li‸ chi gʼaw maˍ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, li‸ chi hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ hpeh tsuh‸ leh, Uˇhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu-o.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ chi kʼaw‸ tu la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Yeˍraˍmiˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo peuˬ ve yoˬ.)

Zeˍdaˍkiˆ a sha‸ nyiˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ yawˇ teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, Liˆbaˍnaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍraˍmiˆ ve yaˇ miˇ Haˍmuˇ taˍlaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw,

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼawˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇ baˬ lo ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ taˍ leh,
Zeˍdaˍkiˆ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ha pa awˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, kʼawˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ peuˬ kʼai leh, meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ venˇ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw tawˆ-e peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hko hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, lanˇ venˇ nyiˇ maˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hpawˇ lo hpaw tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ paˇ lo yawˇ hui Zeˍdaˍkiˆ hta‸ hpeh gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸baˬ taˉ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Riˇbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Zeˍda‸kiˆ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Zeˍdaˍkiˆ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ juˆ pe‸ leh, sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Zeˍdaˍkiˆ lehˬ, suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ chi kʼawˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ, hawˉ yehˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve kanˉ te puiˉ ve chaw leh, la‸ caˉ ya‸ la ve chaw hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˉ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ti mi leh a pehˉ meuˇ hko pehˬ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh kuiˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu, sho nuˆ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ htaˇ yehˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ, tuˉ tanˇ htaˇ awˬ suhˍ hkʼo yuˬ tuˬ hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ htaˇ yehˇ ve hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ nu awˬ na yehˇ ve kuiˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hpu leh shi yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shiˉ gʼeu‸ keu tuˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu, tuˉ tanˇ htaˇ awˬ suhˍ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ, sha hawnˉ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu tuˬ ve hkehˇ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Sawˉla‸monˍ te taˉ ve kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ nyiˇ maˬ, punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ, lawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh punˇ kʼoˍ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ kaˬ chiˇ piˇ taˍ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ chi nyiˇ hkeh lehˬ, hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw tsuh nyi maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Kuiˇ yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, hkʼa shu-ehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuh hpawˇ teˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, uiˍ hpawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Htu ve hpawˇ la‸ naw awˇ hkeh cawˬ leh, awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ kʼoˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ hkuiˉ daw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mvuh hpawˇ ngaˇ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, aˉ ci ku shiˍ awˬ han hkʼa biˇ nehˉ taˍ ve ta kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuiˇ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo, aˉ ci ku shiˍ teˇ ha shiˍ te nehˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, kʼawˇ chi hkaw‸ shiˍ hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Seˍraˍyaˆ, yawˇ awˬ hawˉ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ leh awˬ nu ve paw hkuˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw suhˍ gʼaˇ, ma‸ hpawˇ ceˇ leˇ te chehˇ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve chaw uiˍ hkaw‸ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Haˍmaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Riˇbaˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ shiˍ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ lanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 3,023 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve teˇ chi hiˉ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ 832 gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ te ve nyiˇ chi shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ Neˍbuˍzaˍraˍdanˍ shiˍ kʼai ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 745 gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ 4,600 gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Eˇviˇlaˆmeˍrawˇdaˆ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te piˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai ve shehˆ chi suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Eˇviˇlaˆmeˍrawˇdaˆ lehˬ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu shiˍ laˬ ve awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ taˍ uiˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw veu‸ deh ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve a sha‸ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, jawˇmawˇ ve hpui lawˇ paˇ lo gʼa mui caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ co-e, loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ piˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, chaw hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ ma gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve le. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ lehˬ mehˇchawˇma hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve venˇ lehˬ, chi beu‸ shu ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ yawˇ hawˬ leh mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ tuˬ te piˇ paˍ awˬ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, shu gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hoˆ taˍ leh, ponˬ kuiˬ ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ ca kʼaw‸ pui la-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai leh Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh yawˇ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gaˬ peuˬ, Yawˇ venˇbaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ te peuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu hpeh yuˬ leh shiˍ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ bawˆ paˍ hui gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, awˍ meu‸ jaˇ chehˇ leh, gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ canˇ paˍ la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ luˬ kʼai ve hta‸, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nyi taˍ leh, gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh, ya‸ taw jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ mawˬ. Yawˇ paiˍ ve lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha maˇ lo‸-e tcuh ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lo‸-e chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼanˇ leh caˇ tuˬ ca toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ yuˬ leh, caˇ tuˬ pa caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ nyi taˍ leh, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ nyi sheˍ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hkʼe taw maˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw taˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe hkanˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ aˬ miˍ hta‸ ce peu laˇ leh, aˬ miˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ awˬ pon va htaw taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tu‸ kuiˬ hkanˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve kʼaw‸ peˍ hta‸ hpeh yu taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ te maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi taˍ leh, gʼuiˬ yawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ lo keu taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw mehˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te laˇ maˇ gʼa. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ maˇ gʼa. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mawˇ jeˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o.

Ngaˬ la‸ sheh che taˍ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, teˇ hpawˇ le le lo chehˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼe shawˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na leh, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpeh yuˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca ga la. Paw hkuˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ ca toˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkoˇ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw yaˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ leh, yehˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nyi taˍ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve awˬ nyi haˆ haˆ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tcuh piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh, nyi ma htawˇ luˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw Ziˉonˍ venˇ hta‸ naˆ ho‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ka‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ta‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ nuˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkaˆ htaw mawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ chi hkʼaw ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ta‸ yehˬ leh hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ peuˬ maˇ leh puiˉ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸, yawˇ dawˆ paˆ laˇ peuˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ leh shinˉ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ nyi tehˆ nyi taˍ peuˬ. Ta‸ yehˬ leh lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh te‸ chiˉ hkawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ jo mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh, oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hawˬ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma htawˇ, dawˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai peuˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo paˍ suh-e chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˍ meu‸ leh iˉ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ paiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ e ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw suh-e ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te dawˇ sha laˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ chi taw taw maˇ gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ jaw sheˍ. Nawˬ gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼe peuˬ kuiˬ leh kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ law kuiˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ heˍ leh, nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ. Nawˬ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Choˬ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ leh gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, nyi sha jaˇ ve venˇ maˇ heˆ laˇ. Venˇ chi lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ peuˬ. Chi hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ ngaˬ hui law chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te peuˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ leh te luˬ laˇ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ya‸ la chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Hkanˍ maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ tu leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ-o‸. Nawˬve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ. Ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ suh-e chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ a ciˉ nyi sheˍ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ha‸ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw mawˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo paˍ suh taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw haˉ yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ chaw pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi hkʼaw, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ awˬ paˇ lo kawˆ tuˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi hkʼaw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ponˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ leh,
ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ jaw‸ hpehˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ hteh kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ ve htawnˍ hkʼaw yuˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˆ ho‸ leh kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ ve chaw suh taˍ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve htawnˍ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha maˇ na laˇ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hteˇ lehˍ toˇ maˇ gʼa leh, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo haˉ pui gʼo‸ pa ceh tiˉ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ law taˍ leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ pawˆ che‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tzuh‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve hkaˆ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ bawˆ tcuhˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hpoˆ gʼuiˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon gʼuiˬ yawˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ taw laˇ leh, hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ gui htu-iˍ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve ciˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chehˇ sha cawˬ sha ve, gawˬ lehˍ ve, leh ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, maw maw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve a naˍ leh, ngaˬ yehˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi htaˇ, hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve awˬ taw‸ ma hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve co ha gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la htaˇ, ngaˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ ba la leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ la tuˬ te jawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ ve hkʼaw ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ mui taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui boˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ ca cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Shu dawˆ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ baˬ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ tcuh laˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Htawnˍ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
