Shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ te laˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ te‸ chiˉ te tawˆ la maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui hkʼanˇ tuˬ loˍ ve le.
Ngaˬ hui te chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaˬ nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e veuˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma hpeu‸ maw piˇ leh lawˬ hkawˉ-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh venˇbaˆ te peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ laˇ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ faˉ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ moˬ hkʼa shuˍ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ geh lo gaˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼe tawˆ la tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ya‸ peu laˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ,
ngaˬ hui ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ ya‸ la tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te ya‸ kuiˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ yaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw awˬ te‸ te‸ baˬ keu laˇ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ tsuhˇ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hoˆ beh laˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Taˇ kawˆ, teh‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh ngaˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma canˇ leh, ngaˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ leh, awˬ hkʼaˇ gu chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ka‸ te leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ hkeu piˇ leh, nyi ma luˬ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shiˆ baˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve shi lehˬ, chi beu‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Bon yehˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon shi hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hpfuhˇhkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ je‸ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Heh hpuiˇ awˬ ma peuˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸shaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ lawˬ caˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ caˍ piˇ.
Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, chi beu‸ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo meu‸ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Paw sha ve chaw hui lehˬ, chi beu‸ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo ca gʼawˆ caˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo la‸ haˉ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a ngeu hkʼa shuˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chehˇ sha leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo zuh‸ taˍ leh, mehˆ hpfuhˇ naˆ-ehˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, suhˆ hkʼa shuˍ goˇ kʼai leh, awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ nehˉ taˍ peuˬ.
Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ meu‸ jaˇ leh, awˬ meu-eˇ awˬ meu-eˇ shaˉ leh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ caˉ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw aˬ miˍ ceh leh, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ to‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lo‸-e gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ yonˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, yawˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ suh tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ ca htawˇ.

Tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ ca htawˇ la, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peuˬ teˇ peˆ lo ca te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ nyi piˇ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve paw hkuˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ mawˬ law nyi chehˇ ve htawˇ maˇ gaˬ la. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui law nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ca te toˇ maˇ haˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ peuˬ leh, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˉ ceˬ a‸ kehˉ gehˬ jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hui ve hkui ha hta‸ gʼa‸ chaw laˬ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo jaˆ taˍ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ va kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ leh Uˉzaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ha lehˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ sheˍ htaˇ, gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ shu ve awˬ ceˬ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇdonˍ venˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸a ciˉ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo gaˬ taˍ peuˬ. Shu mvuhˇmiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ mehˇ chawˇma hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼa vuiˬ dawˬ leh, suhˆ gʼa vuiˬ tuˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, piˉ laˬ leh kaˍlaˍoˆ hkʼa shuˍ, shu gʼa‸ kʼai laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh heuˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ jehˇ tcuh laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui caˇ tuˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ leh a sha‸ gʼa te‸ tuˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa ca lawˬ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw chi beu‸ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ gaˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ maˇ gʼa.
Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, a sha‸ tanˇ leh caˇ tuˬ gʼa ca caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ aˬ miˍ po hkʼe chiˆ jaˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ haw chiˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ venˇ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, shu oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu shiˍ kʼai leh, hpeh chiˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ caˬ teˍ tcuh leh, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ jaˇ ve suhˆ taˆ tcuh ve pa taw, ya‸ kʼaw hteˇ lehˍ te toˇ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ mui chehˇ-o. Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼa-o.
Ngaˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼaw ha lehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui kʼaˍ hkʼeˆ ve lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ tuˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ-o. Ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nyi ma luˬ jaˇ leh, mehˆ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ mawˬ-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi maw maw baˬ taˍ laˇ ve le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ-o ve laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ geh lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ baˬ laˇ peuˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ leh meuˇ maˇ cawˬ-o ve laˇ.

Shehˆ chi hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa awˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, ngaˇ nyi htaˇ Buˇziˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve ngaˬ Yeˍsaˍkeˍlaˆ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh teˇ geh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hpaw leh awˬ ha hkʼaw ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
(Oˇ ve lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ Yeˍhkawˇniˆ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ yoˬ.)
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chiˇ nyi leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo mvuhˇ haw lonˉ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve moˬ diˬ lonˉ hkʼaw mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba chehˇ htaˇ, kuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ haw lonˉ awˬ kʼaw ji lo chaw yaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˇ hkeh hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hkeh le le mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve hkui sheh hteˇ lehˍ cawˬ leh, hkui kiˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ ve hkui kiˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Hkui kiˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ shiˆ taˍ ve kuiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ yawˇ hui ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ teˇ maˬ le le awˬ hawˉ lo chaw yaˇ ve la‸ sheh teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ hpe taˍ leh awˬ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ daw‸ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai kʼai laˬ laˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ moˍ hkʼe tiˉ te kʼai leh, choˬ hpfuhˆ oˇ hpfuhˆ maˇ te.

Yawˇ hui teˇ hkeh le le mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, la‸ sha paˉ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ lehˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lehˬ aˉ ceˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ taˍ leh, awˬ meuˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve teˇ hkeh ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hta‸ daw‸ da‸ chehˇ leh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ awˬ to hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ awˇ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo teˇ moˍ hkʼe tiˉ te kʼai ve yoˬ. Choˬ hpfuhˆ oˇ hpfuhˆ te tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kʼaw ji lo, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼe ve teˇ maˬ te toˇ chehˇ leh, aˬ miˍ ha oˇ ve hkʼaw mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ ba ve hkʼa shuˍ choˬ kʼai oˇ kʼai ve gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve awˇ hkeh hta‸ ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, gaˉ yaw awˇ maˬ yawˇ hui awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve awˇ maˬ lehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ maˬ le le shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, gaˉ yaw teˇ maˬ hkʼaw gaˉ yaw ehˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo htawˇ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo taˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ gʼa‸ taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼai htaˇ, jehˇ htaˇ, taˆ-e htaˇ yawˇ hui htawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo hpuˉ-ehˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ chiˇ taˍ leh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ nyiˇ paˉ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve aw hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ awˬ hkawˇ, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ poˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve oˉkʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui huˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, shehnˉ shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve kʼaw jaw hta‸ shuˍ ve teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw yaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve kuiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh,
Aˉlaˇmiˬshiˉjaw hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼeuˆ oˇ ve lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼeuˆ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, aw ˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ tu la-o. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ cawˍ tu laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh kʼai tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.

Yawˇ hui nyi ma heh jaˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai peu leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hpfuhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ na ve maˇ kʼoˆ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa kawˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kawˆ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ aˉ ci ku taw‸ ma awˬ moˍ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ laˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ kawˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ ve tawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui na maˇ na ve htawˇ yaˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw hpfuhˆ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ taˍ-o‸.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa shuˍ chaw hpfuhˆ taˇ te. Nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ caˍ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ caˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ ngaˬ hpawˇ lo che peu laˇ leh, la‸ sheh oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸ taˍ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
La‸ sheh oˇ ve lehˬ li‸ kʼoˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ leh, li‸ oˇ ve nyiˇ hpawˇ lo dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha k’oˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, li‸ k’oˆ chi ve hta‸ caˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hk’e te peuˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw geh k’ai leh yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hk’e te leh, ngaˬ maw‸ k’aw ngaˉ leh yawˇ lehˬ li‸ k’oˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ k’oˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve li‸ chi hta‸ caˇ leh nawˬ ve g’oˇ peˬ hk’aw biˇ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ k’oˆ ve yoˬ. Hk’e te leh, ngaˬ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ leh pehˇ g’uiˬ hk’a shuˍ mehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hk’aw‸ nawˉ G’uiˬsha k’oˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh k’ai leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ k’oˆ tcuh ve tawˇ hk’a peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca k’oˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ maˇ pawnˍ da‸ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ geh k’ai peu laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh k’ai peu laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ maˇ pawnˍ da‸ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ geh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ k’ai peu laˇ chehˇ ve hk’e k’o, yawˇ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hk’aˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ g’aˇ ka‸ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui hk’a peu-eˬ nyi ma heh jaˇ leh, na yuˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hk’a shuˍ nyi ma heh la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ haˉ hpawˇ hk’e yeˬ leh shehnˉ shiˍ hk’a shuˍ heh la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw hpfuhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha k’aw‸ k’oˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hk’a deh‸ na leh tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.

Peuˬ leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ hk’aw awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh k’ai leh, Ngaˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve G’uiˬsha k’oˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca k’oˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui na maˇ na ve ka‸ yaˬ piˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hk’aw‸ nawˉ, G’uiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ tu laˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo, Mvuhˇ naw ma hk’oˆ chehˇ ve G’uiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o, teh‸ mvuhˇ tawˍ hkawˇ hk’e bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ g’a kaˇ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ k’oˆ, miˬ hiˆ ve hk’a shuˍ bvuhˬ hehnˇ jaˇ ve gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ k’oˆ, ngaˬ g’a kaˇ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ awˬ hk’oˆ lo ya‸ la leh, G’uiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ k’ai laˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hk’e te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpa shu ceˬ te chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ, Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve Teˍlaˍbiˆ venˇ lo k’ai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo suhˍ nyi hk’a gaˬ ngaˬ g’a kaˇ g’a mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka kehn leh dawˇ maˇ tawˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi ponˍ peuˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, G’uiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ k’aw‸ yaw laˇ leh k’oˆ ve,
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ g’a k’aw‸ k’oˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ g’aˇ g’a suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ k’oˆ taˍ peuˬ hk’aw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ k’aw‸ gu tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ piˇ ve k’o, yawˇ g’a suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ suh-e ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ awˬ hk’oˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve ka‸ yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ k’aw‸ gu ve k’o, yawˇ g’a suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hk’aˇ, yawˇ suh-e ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ awˬ hk’oˆ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw da‸ teˇ g’aˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ k’ai leh shaˍ ti‸ maˇ piˇ ve k’o, yawˇ g’a suh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ g’a suh-e ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ awˬ hk’oˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw da‸ oˇ ve teˇ g’aˇ venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ g’a k’aw‸ te tuˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh yawˇ na yuˬ leh venˇbaˆ maˇ k’aw‸ te ve k’o, yawˇ g’a te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ htawˇ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
G’uiˬsha ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ jawˬ leh yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸, Tu leh lawˬ hk’o‸ lo k’ai loˬ. Oˇ kaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hk’e te leh, ngaˬ lawˬ hk’o‸ lo k’ai ve yoˬ. Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ g’a mawˬ peuˬ ve hk’e, oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ G’uiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ g’a k’aw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hk’oˆ lo boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hk’aˇ, G’uiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hk’aw lo‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ cawˍ tu laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, G’uiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hk’e k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ hk’aw lo k’o‸-e leh yehˬ miˉ hk’a deh‸ hoˆ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ aˉ hkeh hpeh tiˍ ve hta‸ g’a hkanˍ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ tawˆ-e gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw hpfuhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ maˇ g’a tuˬ, nawˬ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ ngaˬ k’aˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hk’aw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ k’aw‸ yaw laˇ leh, nawˬ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ k’aw‸ nuˇ la piˇ peuˬ hk’aw nawˉ, ngaˬ k’oˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ g’a ca k’oˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hk’aˇ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ na yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn k’o, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ k’oˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, li kiˉ shiˍ teˇmaˬ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yuˬ teh taˍ leh oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh hkʼaiˇ kuiˉ piˇ-oˆ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shu ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe shawˍ leh, li kiˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, ta‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ juˆ paˆ piˇ tuˬ ve suhˆ tcuhˉ pui teˇ hpaˍ te teh taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ leh venˇ oˇ ve awˬ kaˍ lo gʼo‸ pa ko taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ sho baˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ ko taˍ leh, nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ venˇ oˇ ve hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ taˍ-o‸ Nawˬ lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon awˬ heˆ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ zuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

390 nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ tan, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ nyi hkanˍ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ ve kʼo, la‸ sha paˉ hpawˇ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ zuh‸ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan awˇ chi nyi kʼaw‸ hkanˍ-o‸. Chi ka‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ tan, nawˬ teˇ nyi gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ shu ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸. Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ la‸ tsuhˆ pui te maˍ piˇ leh tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ shu ca bawˆ la ve peuˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ hpfuhˆ maˇ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpeh tiˍ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ caˬhkʼa, cho‸ shiˍ, nawˆ shiˍ, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ, leh sha ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ-o‸. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh hkaw‸ da‸ leh hkaoˍmonˇ te-o. Oˇ ve lehˬ, 390 nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ la‸ mehˍ paˉ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ zuh‸ chehˇ htaˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve hta‸ teˇ nyi ve nyiˇ hkanˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ lehˬ teˇ nyi ve iˉ kaˆ htawˇ nyiˇ kawˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa dawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw hkʼehˇ hta‸ gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh aˬ miˍ ceh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ gʼa chiˆ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa caˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ maˇ caˇ tcuh ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te jaw. Ngaˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ taˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ caˇ jaw. Maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ caˇ jaw, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, nawˬ nuˇ hkʼehˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ hkʼehˇ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hkaoˍmonˇ gʼa chiˆ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Yeˍruˇsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ ngaˬ i kʼai yawnˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh iˉ kaˆ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa tsuh caˇ leh, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve hkaoˍmonˇ leh iˉ kaˆ peuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, tcuhˆ jaˇ ve aˉ hte‸ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve paˇ tcuhˆ leh uˉ hkeh mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ chiˇ baˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˍ cuˍ hkʼaw keu tsuh leh shehˆ pun pehˬ taˍ-o‸.

Venˇ hta‸ shu ca bawˆ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, uˉ hkeh mvuh oˇ ve shehˆ pun teˇ pun ve hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw lo tuˉ baˬ-o‸. Teˇ pun ve hta‸ nawˬ venˇ hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, aˉ hte‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ cheˆ-oˆ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ pun hta‸ mvuhˇ haw hkʼaw baˬ peu-o. Aˉhtaw hta‸ yuˬ leh, uˉ hkeh mvuh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Uˉ hkeh mvuh a ciˉ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve aˉ po‸ hkʼaw lo htiˆ keu taˍ-o.

Oˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu-o. Aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo to‸chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo to‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ kʼaw ji lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬnu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ canˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ te jaw sheˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ leh, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ tiˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ te leh ngaˬve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ leh htu baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw shehˆ pun teˇ pun lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo naˬ gawˬ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ pun lehˬ, venˇ baˬ lo shu chaw pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ pun hta‸ mvuhˇ haw hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa‸ peu leh, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh aˉhtaw hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkʼa hpanˍ toˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo jaw kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ leh ciˍ yanˍ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui anˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬhta‸ ngaˬ i kʼai yawnˇ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˬ hui gʼa meu‸ gʼa kaˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkaˆ ce juˆ laˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui awˍ meu‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Naˬve gawˬ ve leh sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ.

Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ aˉhtaw teˇ maˬ hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, chaw yaˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˆ paˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tiˉ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼawˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo baˬ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸, yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, leh yawˇ hui ve sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa te taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍhta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬlo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui shu ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍpiˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui haiˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ shaˍti‸ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui la‸ sheh hta leh hkui sheh chiˇ htinˍ-o‸. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te taˍ peuˬ ve haiˬ ve leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ naˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ meu‸ suh kaˆ suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸, yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, suhˆ cehˬ hawˉ lo leh yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ hkʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ shehˇ de lonˉ hta‸ te leh awˬ na hpawˇ Riˇbaˍlaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬhta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa chehˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬnawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui te taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo pawehˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍpeuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ nawˬ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ nyi leh sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh yawˇ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ vuiˬ mawˇ hawˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Behˬ heh ma meuˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw lo naˬve gawˬ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ baˬ lo tawˆ-e ve chaw lehˬ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw htawˇ naˬ ve gawˬ ve leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ kawˆ leh poˬ hpaw-e ve hkʼe, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hpaw taˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve la‸ sheh gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh yawˇ hui ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu htawˇ veˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ tuˬyoˬ. Yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve hpu shi hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve mawˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gʼawˆ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, hpu shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw yoˬ. Hpu shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, biˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Hpu shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve shehnˉ shiˍ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shehnˉ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ te ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ tuˬˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ laˬ tcuh leh yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ ngaˬ nyi piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ da‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ sho‸ sha‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ choˬkaˬ lo shiˍ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve naw hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Dawˇ law tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la leh, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉnawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬlawn, nawˬ hui tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca lawˬ na tuˬ yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ htawˇ dawˇ haˍ leh paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nyi ma luˬ jaˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ leh, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ kʼaw‸ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh ve nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkaw‸ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ teˇ maˬ, ngaˇ nyi htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ teˇ cawˬ haˉ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Nga chiˇ nyi leh awˬ ha hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ paˉ ve lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ shuˍ leh, yawˇ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi hta‸ te leh awˬ na paˉ ve lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˆ taˍ ve kuiˇ hkʼe aw gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve la‸sheh hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ ca htawˇ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ hpe lo chiˇ taˆ laˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ piˇ lawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ teˇ maˬ teh taˍ kuiˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ jaw taˉ peuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo chiˇ nyi sheˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chiˇ nyi leh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo teh taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ piˇ lawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ aw laˇ. Choˬ kaˬ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬve bon yehˬ hkʼaw vuiˇ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, gʼo‸ pa hta‸ htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw teˇ maˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, awˬ hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ ca lo‸ nyi-o, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ca lo‸ nyi leh, yehˬ miˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui cha chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve nawˬ yehˬ miˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca lo‸ nyi-o, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ ca lo‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, vuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ nu ve cha‸ chiˆ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ han leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve awˬ han hkʼa biˇ te keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ suhˍ chi gʼaˇ leh Shaˍhpanˍ ve yaˇ Yaˍzaˍniˆ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ sha hawnˉ keu ve hkehˇ pe le teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, sha hawnˉ tuˉ ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ aw laˇ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ mawˬ taˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ baˬ taˉpeuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸nawˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hui chi a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, suh kʼai peuˬ ve Taˍmuˇzaˆ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh paˆ hawˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ mawˬ aw laˇ. Chi a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh yehˬ miˉ awˬ paˇ lo, chaw nyiˇ chi ngaˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo boˆ taˍ leh mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ mawˬ aw laˇ. Yuˇda‸ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh sheˍ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸ la lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh nyi ma zuhˆ tu te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe taw taw maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te leh ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw hui-oˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ cawˬ haˉ la‸ caˉ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw hkaw‸ gʼaˇ bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui geh lo da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ leh li‸ bvuh‸ tuˬ aw hkʼeun yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui laˬ leh kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ toˍ la‸ kuˉ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo jiˆ kʼai sheˬ ve yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo kʼai leh, venˇ chi hkʼaw te chehˇ taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, nyi ma luˬ leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve naˍ kʼa‸ pui hta‸ ca maiˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hkaw‸ gʼaˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai leh, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ ha kʼaˉ leh taˇ ponˬ piˇ.

Chaw mawˇ, yaˇ nehˬ, awˬ e, leh yaˇ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, naˍ kʼa‸ pui hkʼoˆ lo awˬ maiˉ cawˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ htawˇ. Choˬ kaˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ tanˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ kʼai loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw huˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hta‸ tanˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw chaw suh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Haˆ haˆ te-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe ca te chehˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍhta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆmvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ mawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve kʼaw‸ la leh, Nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ ca te taˉ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui shehnˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve kʼaw jaw teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo kʼai leh, aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ ca hkaˆ yuˬleh, venˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, bon yehˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo ca jiˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ leh, bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve toˍ la‸ kuˉ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo htawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ, gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ ca yuˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve kʼai leh gaˉ yaw teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkehˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍve aˬ miˍ hkʼaw hkaˆ keu leh shiˉ gʼeu‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ jaˇ ve hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hawˉ lo chaw yaˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ shuˍ ve la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo, gaˉ yaw awˇ maˬ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼe awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ awˬ nu ve gawˉ yaw ehˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jiˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ choˬ hpfuhˆ oˇ hpfuhˆ maˇ te leh kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai hpeh‸ leh, choˬ hpfuhˆ oˇ hpfuhˆ te tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ to, caw‸ nawˉ hkʼaˇ, la‸ sheh, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ, leh gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ awˬ ha hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve gaˉyaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh le le mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ teˇ hkeh lehˬ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, shehˆ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ, awˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ aˉ ceˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
(Yawˇ hui lehˬ Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ taˉ peuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.) Yawˇ hui mvuhˇ hpe lo taˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ,
gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hpe leh poˬ ve teˇ yanˇ htawˇ, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ jehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ poˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, gaˉ yaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui uˉ peunˍ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo tawˆ kʼai leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hpe leh mvuhˇ hpe lo poˬ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼoˆ lo jehˇ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh le le mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˇ maˬ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˇ maˬ, leh toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chaw yaˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ shuˍ ve la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ hpfuhˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Hkeˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shuˍ leh, teˇ hkeh le le awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ lehˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇve awˬ paˇ lo chaw nyiˇ chi ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬnaˬ hpeh‸ ve Beˍneˍyaˆ ve yaˇ Peˍlaˍtiˆ leh Aˍzuˇraˆ ve yaˇ Aˍzaˍniˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ leh, venˇ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ maw maw kʼo ngaˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ gʼa te chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ shuˍ leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw ve shaˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui aˬ miˍ maˇ gʼa chiˆ tuˬ, mu‸ hkʼu chi ve koˍ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo‸ la leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw maˇmaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw suh hkʼa biˇ hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na mu‸ hkʼu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˍ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma le. Nawˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇ chi hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui aˉhtaw hta‸ kawˆ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇ baˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ leh gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬyoˬ.

Mu‸ hkʼu lehˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo caˉ taˍ ve shaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, venˇ chi ve nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaˬ ve teˇ kaˬ lo ca chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Peˍlaˍtiˆ paˍ suh sheˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ leh awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca kʼaw‸ pui la tuˬ vuiˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ hkui yawˇ hui ca chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui ca chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ tawˆ la leh, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ mvuhˇmiˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma awˬ suhˉ leh dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve haˉ pui hkʼe heh ve nyi ma hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ piˇ leh na yuˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬyoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cha‸ chiˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼa pui ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo taˆ-e leh, gaˉ yaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo jiˆ kʼai sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ tu laˇ leh, shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍmvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼoˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ ha mehˉ kʼai leh,
ngaˬ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ shiˍ cawˬ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ nyi maˇ mawˬ puiˉ. Naˍ paw cawˬ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ kaˇ puiˉ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ gu htiˆ leh mehˆ muiˉ maˇ naˆ sheˍ htaˇ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Nawˬ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mawˬ piˇ law‸-o‸. Chaw hpfuhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ gu htiˆ leh yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ sheˍ htaˇ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ hkʼa shuˍ tawˆ kʼai-o.
Yawˇ hui nyi chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ hpaˆ pawnˍ leh oˇ ka‸ lo gaˆ tawˆ-e loˬ.

Yawˇ hui hpoˆ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ tawˆ kʼai-o. Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ hkʼa shuˍ mawˇ gu htiˆ leh, mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ ngaˬ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ hpaˆ pawnˍ leh gaˆ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hpoˆ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ chiˇ pfuhˇ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ shawˉ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpfuhˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te ve le, teh‸ na nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ te maˍ chehˇ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ leh shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ mawˇ pfuhˇ leh yawˇ awˬ pon shu htaw pawnˍ piˇ taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼaw gʼa gaˆ tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ beh taˍ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ pehˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ htaw yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw, yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ, leh yawˇ ve a sha‸ shaw paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ la tuˬ, ma‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, leh naˬ kuiˬ gawˬ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˍ caˇ leh iˉ kaˆ dawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ cheˇ ve hkʼaw caˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui awˍ caˇ leh iˉ kaˆ dawˬ htaˇ kawˆ cheˇ ve hkʼaw gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ chaw liˇ chaw hkʼaˇ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ awˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ chaw hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, aˬ hto ma pa taw Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ ve htawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw mawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ tcuhˇ tcuhˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve le.

Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw mawˇ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ yehˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi ve yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ kʼaw‸ jiˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, ngaˬ te tuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ yanˇ jiˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬkʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ luˬ kʼai chehˇ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gu te. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi hkʼaw ma‸ hpeh‸ la htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ ha hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, heˍ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼe ka‸, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ ha hkʼaw lo gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, heˍ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Nawˬ hui awˬ ha hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ heˍ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ leh, shu ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui gʼa chehˇ tuˬve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve caˇ lanˇ hkʼaw nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hta‸ naˬ taweh te kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh htunˉ shehˍ keu ve yoˬ.
Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ leh vaˇ shiˍ hta‸ ya‸ la piˇ leh, lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htunˉ shehˍ taˍ ve aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ leh vaˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui htunˉ shehˍ taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ leh awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ kawˍ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˉ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve paˆ ce leh nawˬ hui hta‸ teˍ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve leh, lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htunˉ shehˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve leh lanˇ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ htunˉ shehˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ da‸ la ve htawˇ, Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ la peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ dawˇ sha hkawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi sheˍ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ te hpaˍ shu awˬ hkʼoˆ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ la‸ sheh leh oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hpeh tuˬ ve maˉmo hkeh teˇ hpaˍ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ a sha‸ te‸ ve leh suh ve hta‸ gʼaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ to pon yehˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Caˬ hkʼa leh hkaoˍmonˇ a ciˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ suh keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, suh keunˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hta‸ yonˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ ve leh suh ve hta‸uˉ peunˍ gʼa ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh yehˇ chehˇ ve maˉ mo hkeh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve heˍ hkawˇ hta‸ na chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve te hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yuˬ tawˆ leh ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve maˉ mo hkeh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˆ cheˆ leh ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui heˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh, chaw da‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ naˬ tuˬ ngaˬ maˇ te piˇ gaˇ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a sha‸ gʼa te‸ tuˬ nawˬ hui maˇ ga piˇ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha leh, shu ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve heˍ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve ngaˬ geh ca jehˬ da‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬhta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.

Ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. A shu yawˇ ve nyi ma shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇleh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ geh ca jehˬ da‸ la ve chaw lehˬ ngaˬ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ kʼo chi ma kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬhta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve pa taw yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆchehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve cha‸ chiˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬhta‸ baˬ taˉ leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ geh ca jehˬ da‸ tuˬ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬyawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ shu awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw geh leuˆ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve shu hta‸ heˍ leh maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tawˇ yaw piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw geh ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh yawˇ geh ca jehˬ da‸ la ve chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, ciˍ yanˍve hta‸ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa te kʼai tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ peˆ venˇbaˆ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che leh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ gaˬ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Noˉa‸, Daˍyeˍlaˆ leh Yawˇbaˆ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh ka‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ponˬ piˇgʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ ka‸, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ ma‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve shehˆ gʼaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh ka‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Noˉa‸, Daˍyeˍlaˆ leh Yawˇbaˆ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh ka‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ceh ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hkʼaw bawˆ da‸ chaw da‸ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh naˬ beuˬ gaˬ ve, chi ve awˇ ceuˬ hta‸ peu laˇ piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ gʼa ponˬ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa ponˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ nyi-o. Ngaˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve lehˬ, cawˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ lawn maˇ cawˬ leh hkʼe leˇ te guiˇ ve maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ te lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tehˆ gʼa tuˬ le. A pehˉ meuˇ awˬ kʼaˉ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ a‸ kehˉ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ leuˉ ve le.
Awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te yehˇ hpeh‸ aw laˇ. Awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh mawˇ kʼuˉ tuˬ te gʼa aw laˇ.
Awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ to‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼaw‸ te yehˇ hpeh‸ sheˍ le.
Oˇ ve lehˬ aˬ miˍ maˇ to‸ sheˍ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ ka‸ awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Chi beu‸ awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca yuˬveu laˇ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬYeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ yuˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw teˇ pawˆ gʼa ponˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ kʼaw‸ to‸ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ beˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw paw la taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ pa lehˬ Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ e lehˬ Hiˇtiˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ paw la htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ve gʼuˇ tu caˆ hta‸ maˇ tawˆ. Iˉ kaˆ ka‸ maˇ hehˉ piˇ. Aˉ leh‸ yuˬ leh maˇ htu-iˍ tsuhˇ piˇ. Pehˉ keu hkʼaw ka‸ maˇ yuˬ htiˆ piˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh oˇ hkʼe maˇ te piˇ. Nawˬ paw la htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸. Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hpanˍ laˬ leh, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼa biˇ ngawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ suh-e tcuh.

Ngaˬnawˬhta‸ suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ hkʼe uiˍ la tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ uiˍ la leh yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ uiˍ la leh, uˉ hkeh mvuh ka‸ zuhˬ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ yehˬ kʼa ca yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ve aˉ po‸ lonˉ nawˬ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te leh, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ yuˬ leh nawˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ chu hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve aˉ po‸ feuˉ piˇ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ guiˬ hkuiˉ nuˆ tcuhˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve uˉ nyiˉ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyiˉ piˇ leh, pfuhˇ hpa yuˬ hawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shehnˉ la‸ kawˬ leh kʼawˍ peˍ pfuhˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ la‸ peˍ, naˍ vawˇ, leh da‸ jaˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ ka‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ leh, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve pfuhˇ hpa teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve junˍ meu-e yuˬ te taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ma hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaˬ ti chi ti bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ la tuˬ te laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve hta‸ nyi ma uiˍ leh, nawˬ geh hkʼa laˬve chaw hui geh ca zuh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo nyi sha tuˬ awˬ hkiˇ gu shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ ve awˬ to chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve shaˍ lonˍ chu leh sha hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇpiˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍlonˍ chu piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe nawˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, nawˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh, awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw lo hpeˆ dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi law, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼo ve, Nawˬ lehˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le awˬ paˇ lo, nawˬ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ laiˉ ka‸ te taˍ leh meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ je‸ nehˆ ngawˉ tcuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ geh hkʼa laˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ to chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, teˇ nyi le le meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ peh‸ puiˉ jaˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh kuˬ zuh‸ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ che taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ naw hta‸ Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ canˇ leh, nawˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh ve pa taw, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ka‸ nawˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te laˇ maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve meh maˬ lanˉ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇnawˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te laˇ maˇ gʼa, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le awˬ paˇ lo nawˬ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ laiˉ kaˬ te taˍ leh, meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe awˬ baˬ hpawˇ tawˆ-e leh hpu maˇ ca.
Nawˬ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ nu ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ ca te ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Meh maˬ lanˉ lehˬ shu geh awˬ hpfuhˇ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ geh hkʼa laˬve chaw hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ piˇ leh, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpu piˇ leh nawˬ geh ca zuh‸ la tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ anˇ law‸ law‸ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆchehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ ve awˬ to hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ ha‸ ve leh nawˬ canˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ geh kuˬ hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ paˇ lo hpoˆ laˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ haˉ chawˇ te leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, nawˬ haˉ chawˇ te kuiˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ leh shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ kʼu nyi baˬ taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chaw teˇ moˍ shawˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉhtaw yuˬ leh peuˆ nehˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ leh, nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸, yaˇ miˇ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ hpoˆ nyi taˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh leh, nawˬ geh laˬve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ kʼaw‸ piˇ tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai leh, gawˬ lehˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe hkanˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te htehˍ chehˇ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, Awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
