Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ e ve yaˇ miˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve aw hpawˇ leh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ canˇ ve nawˬ viˉ ma hui hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ leh nawˬ viˉ ma hui lehˬ nawˬ pa Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve yaˇ te hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ viˉ ma lonˉ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ka‸ yawˇ hui ve hkui ha hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ ve laˇ. Awˬ yanˇ teˇ hkui tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ nyi ma Sawˉdonˍ lehˬ nawˬ te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ te.
Yawˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ ve pa taw nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ga piˇ.
Yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ nyi ma heh leh ngaˬ canˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ shiˍ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ lehˬ nawˬ te chehˇ ve cha chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hkoˇ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ. Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ a‸ kehˉ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ leh yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tehˆ da‸ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ viˉ ma lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ nawˬ viˉ ma ve venˇbaˆ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ ya‸ taw chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ viˉ ma hta‸ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ leh Saˍmaˍriˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ sha la tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Sawˉdonˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Eˇdonˍ chaw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw leh nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆguiˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ a sha‸ i chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, nawˬ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ leh, co co yeˬ ve ka ti‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, nawˬ viˉ ma nawˬ nyi ma kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ gʼa ya‸ taw jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬnawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ te piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hpehˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ya‸ taw jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui na gʼa tuˬ, tawˇ pa haˉ te maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ mvuh da‸ jaˇ leh toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ fe ve aˉ ceˬ lonˉ teˇ hkeh cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˉ ceˬ oˇ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh, htawˇ kʼaˉ ehˉ teˇ maˬ htawˆ chiˇ veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hui chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ teˇ cehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo ti taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ cehˬ ehˉ oˇ ve uiˍ la leh, awˬ kʼaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo aˉ ceˬ oˇ ve geh hkʼa gaˬ mvuh taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ naˉ chaweh lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, awˬ kʼaˉ leh awˬ hpa‸ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ mvuh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nu ve aˉ ceˬ lonˉ teˇ hkeh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ geu leh awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ ceˬ oˇ ve geh peu piˇ leh, chi beu‸ gʼa chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ a‸ kehˉ, aˉ ceˬ oˇ ve geh iˉ kaˆ leuˉ leh gʼa tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve lehˬ miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ leh iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yeˬ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, da‸ jaˇ ve a pehˇ meuˇ te hpeh‸ leh awˬ hpa‸ leh awˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ naw‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe na nyi gaˇ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te chi ve te‸ chehˇ leh uiˍ la tuˬ ve laˇ. Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve aˉ ceˬ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh goˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ maˇ maˇ yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh gʼawˬ tawˆ tcuh tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hta‸ ti taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ te‸ leh uiˍ la tuˬ ve laˇ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw meuˆ laˬ htaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve nawˍ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo nawˍ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw hpfuhˆ chi teˇ hpaˬ tawˇ pa haˉ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ shiˍ leh naˍ, na nyi-o. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ geh shaˉ caˆ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ tuˬ hkanˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ, leh yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te luˬ tuˬ, aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, la‸ caˉ leh ma‸ yaˇ maˇ maˇ ca shiˍ tuˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ ve chaw hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe te kʼo, yawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ. Ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ leh hkʼe leˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ chi lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, venˇ yaˇ maˇ maˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ta‸ kʼoˍ hkʼa biˇ caw duˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ca bawˆ la ve htawˇ, bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hkʼe, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ pehˍ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh htaw yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Cheuˬ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, htawˇ uˉ tzuh lo cawˬ ve htawˇ tu teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ti keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ cehˬ oˇ ve uiˍ la leh, awˬ yawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ teˇ cehˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ mui leh gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬGʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htu baˬ leh, awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬyoˬ. Awˬ hpa‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˍ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˍ kʼai taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˉ lehˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve, Awˬ pa awˬ e ci ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ caˇ leh, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ciˬ hkehˇ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi hkʼaˬ hkʼe le.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hkʼe, tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le co ha ngaˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ pa awˬ e ve co ha maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve co ha maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te leh da‸ ve chaw teˇgʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ caˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ shu miˇ shu yaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ya‸. Awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇmiˇ hta‸ htawˇ haˉ chawˇ maˇ te.

Yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ maˇ heˍ. Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ. Shu yawˇ geh mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ca chiˇ la htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve la‸shawnˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ caˍ piˇ leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ shu hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ ve htawˇ awˬ yawˬ maˇ yuˬ caˇ. Haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te. Ya‸ da‸ jiˆda‸ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ leh, shu hta‸ tiˇpehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa maˇ te jaw ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ leh, shu miˇ shu yaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ leh, shu geh la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Buiˇshaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Shu hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ leh awˬ yawˬ yuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ maˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa suh ve lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa te ve hkʼe yawˇ maˇ te.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ maˇ caˇ. Shu miˇ shu yaˇ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ maˇ ya‸.

Shu hta‸ yawˇ maˇ fawˉ mehˍ. Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ. Shu geh la‸ shawnˍ maˇ yuˬ caˇ. Meu‸ve kaˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ caˍ piˇ leh, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ feuˉ piˇ deh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te. Shu hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ leh awˬ yawˬ yuˬ caˇ ve ka‸ maˇ te. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ pa ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ pa lehˬ shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ leh shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, awˬ pa te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan awˬ yaˇ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ yaˇ paˍ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ gʼa suh ve yoˬ. Awˬ pa te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan awˬ yaˇ paˍ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, awˬ yaˇ te ya‸ve venˇbaˆ awˬ tan awˬ pa gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ da‸ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, awˬ bon gʼa tuˬyoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼaw da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ kʼaw‸ te ve pa taw yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh haiˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ chi a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Ngaˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ cawˇ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Maˇ cawˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suh-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ suh-e ve lehˬ yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ leh baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ maˇ gʼa suh. Gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe ka‸, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha te ve kanˉ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ Maˇ cawˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬyoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ taˇ te luˬ tcuh.
Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, nyi ma awˬ suhˉ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui suh gaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ suh-e piˇ lawˬ gaˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi ngaˬ hta‸ kʼa tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬve awˬ e lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ ma peuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ awˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ yehˇ teˇ hkeh hta‸ shaˍ gʼa‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ piˇ leh, awˬ yehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw hta‸ che‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ leh hpeh yuˬve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ sho caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo sheh kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ e lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ law nyi ve htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ la mawˬ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hkeh hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh yawˇ htawˇ haiˬ jaˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ awˬ nu ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh shaˍ ca jaˆ toˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ htawˇ shaˍ gʼa‸ puiˉ jaˇ leh, chaw hta‸ che‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ laˬ ve teˇ pawˆ le le chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ bawˆ tuˬ chaw shawˍ hpoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ pehˍ htaw yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkawˆ hkʼaw keu leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ e lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ti taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ hpa‸ leh awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yeˬ jaˇ leh jawˇmawˇ yehˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ mvuh la leh moˬ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha leh, hkʼaˬ ma mvuh ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve la‸ sheh lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo meuˆ laˬ ve mvuhˇ haw lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hteh kʼai goˇ kʼai ve pa taw, aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ a pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh goˇ jaˇ ve shehˇ de hkʼaw ti taˍ ve yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ te oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ leh awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Chi ve lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ teˇ chi nyi gaˬ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve ngaˬ hta‸ ca na nyi la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hpoˆ mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆlaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ ca na la ve laˇ. Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ na nyi tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ te taˍ peuˬ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ maˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ve awˬ to yawˇ hui hta‸ maw piˇ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ha‸ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpa hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇna yuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve cha‸ chiˆ ve gʼuiˬsha, maˇ heˆ kʼo Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ da‸ tuˬ kehˬ tuˬ te tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ka‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shinˉ nyi hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te she‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬhponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa mawˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ lo‸-e piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe ka ti‸ gʼa te piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, shinˉ nyi hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ te ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼaw‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui te teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬhkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe taˇ gʼa‸ te. Yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh nawˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ taˇ te.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hui te taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teh‸ shawˍ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ co htawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ a sha‸ gʼa te‸ve yoˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ-e piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa mawˬ taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, shinˉ nyi hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui jaw ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a sha‸ te‸ tuˬ te laˇ maˇ gʼa ve maˇ da‸ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ lawn teˇ ceuˬ chi hkʼe cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuh ve hkʼaw pui leh, nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼai chehˇ ve mvuh ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma le. Hkʼe te leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Mvuh ve chehˇ kuiˬ, teh‸ meh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ te ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ te leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai chehˇ ve le.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui ca na la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ na nyi tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, suhˆ cehˬ leh haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve la‸ sheh leh ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve hteunˍ lonˉ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Siˉnaˆ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa te ˇhpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ chi beu‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ gaˇ puiˉ ve chaw leh venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te-o. Nawˬ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui-o. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe ca te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ na leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼaw da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˬ ve aw meh hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ jehˇ taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍti‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh, nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, leh nawˬ hui ve da‸ kehˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh yuˬ la tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍhkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ aw pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˉ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ te ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui te taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ maˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo nyi peu sheˍ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nyi loˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ teˇ pe‸ ceh chehˇ leh, awˬ hpa‸ nawˉ lehˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ leh goˇ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo te leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ to‸ taˆ la leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ aˬ miˍ shaˉ moˉ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ tuˉ keu taˍ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe taˇ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ tawˇ veˆ hkawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yehˇ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Chaw yaˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh, da‸ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh awˬ hpui hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ keu ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe te leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui na nyi laˇ ve kʼo, gaˬ la chehˇ ve awˬ nyi awˬ lawn sha tanˇ hta‸ pa taw hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw kawˆ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la leh, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh deu lehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu teˇ hpaˍ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Aˉhtaw teˇ taˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ leh shiˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˍ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tuˬ shiˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Aˉhtaw hta‸ la‸ haˉ yehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˆ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw keu piˇ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˍ leh shiˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Aˉhtaw chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma luˬ ve hkʼaw nawˬ hui ve nyi ma pui hta‸ hta chehˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ chehˇ ve kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw-o. Nawˬ ve la‸sheh hta-o. Aˉhtaw lehˬ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ chaw tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve aˉhtaw leh kawˆ piˇ lawˬ ve aˉhtaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ leh, hkui htiˇ poˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ aˉhtaw teˇ taˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ho piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉhtaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ ba chehˇ leh tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tcuhˆ jaˇ ve aˉhtaw-oˬ, la‸ sha paˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ lo chaw keu-o. Nawˬ hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ lo chaw keu-o.
Ngaˬ htawˇ la‸ sheh hta leh, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve peuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ ve aˉhtaw geh teˇ geh laˬ hpeh‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw nyiˇ caˆ hta‸ maiˉ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve nyiˇ caˆ caˆ hta‸ teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ tiˉ hkʼaw gʼa tanˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw ceh da‸ kuiˬ lo yehˬ hkuiˉ daw awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ ti taˍ-o‸.

Teˇ caˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui ve Raˍbaˆ venˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ beˆ maˍ piˇ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ caˆ lehˬYuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ, hkʼa deh‸ caw ko taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ beˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw ceh lo cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw awˬ heˆ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ caˆ hta‸ gʼa kʼai cawˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ hkaˆ yoˬ kʼoˍhta‸ hiˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ geh jehˬ da‸ leh, tuˉ tanˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh ve awˬ shehˍ hta‸ nyi ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ teh‸ maiˉ taˍ ve hkaˆ ce hta‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkaˆce oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ tuˬ, ma‸ bawˆ hkawˇ kuˬ tuˬ, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ paˇ lo ta‸ kʼoˍ duˇ leh je‸ kawˍ taˆ-e tuˬ leh gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ duˇ tuˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ pa taw, chi ve hta‸ yonˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ tuˬ leh, yawˇ hui shu hpeh yuˬve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆchehˇ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, huˉ taˍ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ leh maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hui ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ leh uˉ nyiˉ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸. Teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ-oˆ. Uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yuˬ baˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ lehˬvenˇ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍve ceh ceh, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw-o. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve Aˍmawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ aˉhtaw teˇ taˍ gu taˍ peuˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ leh mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ ba tuˬ, hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˍ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ ha hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ maˇ cawˇ. Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ heˍ hkawˇ tiˉ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ leh haiˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉhtaw lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ lo ce la tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˉhtaw hta‸ teh taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ kuiˬ, nawˬ hui paw la kuiˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo peu laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ suhˍ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa sheˆ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve venˇ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ gu taˍ peuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hkʼaw, nawˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw venˇbaˆ cawˬ leh, nawˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh vuiˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan-o. Nawˬ lehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ leh, mehˇchawˇma leh yaˇcuˬshi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˆ yan hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ leh, shinˉ nyi hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ, shu ve awˬ lawn heˍ hto chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ pa ve awˬ miˇ ma geh ca zuh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh nyiˉ zuh‸ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma leh awˬ shaˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ yuˬ caˇ leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍhpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ chawˇ chawˇ hta‸ hpu chiˇ piˇ leh awˬ yawˬ yuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw paw sha la tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ.
Nawˬ shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve la‸ tsuhˆ pui nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ sheˍ hehˉ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. NgaˬGʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ mvuhˇ chi miˬ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hpu hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lawˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ taˉ ve kuiˇ, tawnˇ, sho leh geu‸ law hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpu, kuiˇ, tawnˇ, sho leh geu‸ law cawˬ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw keu ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hkʼaw shiˍ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ lehˬ mawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuiˬ kʼai piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuiˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yoˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ lo aˬ miˍ ceh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kuiˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hpu lehˬ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw kuiˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuiˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi chehˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui che‸ pehˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kuˬ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh hkʼa gʼa ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, mehˇchawˇma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan. Da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh maˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ fuiˍ da‸. Da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh maˇ da‸ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ leh maˇ maˍ piˇ. Shinˉ nyi hta‸ yawˇ hui a muˆ maˇ taˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan.

Jawˇmawˇ ve kanˉ te paˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ heh hpuiˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui paw sha la tuˬ, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gʼo‸ pa hta‸ htunˉ shehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe, venˇbaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, maˇ cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ heˍ leh hiˉ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Lanˇ venˇ kawˍ puiˉ ve chaw, paˆ ce taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ gʼa ve chaw, leh ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ nga ca nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hpehˇ peu leh, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ a sha‸ i sheˍ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ leh meh maˬ lanˉ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ ma lehˬ, Aˍhawˇlaˆ meh ve yoˬ.(yawˇ lehˬ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ) Awˬ nyi ma lehˬ Aˍhawˇliˇbaˆ meh ve yoˬ.(Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.) Ngaˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ heuˆ leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍhawˇlaˆ lehˬ ngaˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ meh maˬ lanˉ kʼaw‸ te leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yawˇ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, chaw uiˍ, aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ leh, a sha‸ i sheˍ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yaˇ miˇ haˉ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve meh maˬ lanˉ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaˇ miˇ haˉ tanˬ hpeh‸ la ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh ca zuh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ jaˇ ve Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ aˉhtaw chaw pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma Aˍhawˇliˇbaˆ gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ viˉ ma Aˍhawˇlaˆ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ htawˇ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ leh awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve Aˍsuˇriˆ ma‸ poˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ ma hkʼa shuˍ haiˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, shaˬ te shaˬ haiˬ jaˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo htawˆ keu taˍ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ ma‸ ponˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ han hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veuˬ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo hpa caˆ hpeh taˍ leh, oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo nyi sha ve uˉ nyiˉ nyiˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh yawˇ geh haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve pa taw, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi bawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ ma hta‸ cha‸ naˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ cha‸ naˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ la leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yaˇ nehˬ htaˇ yawˇ hkʼa te jaw ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ piˉ laˬ hkʼe awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te gaˇ puiˉ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˇ faˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

(Aˍhawˇliˇbaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yaˇ miˇ haˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve cuˉ hta‸ kʼa guiˇ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ te gaˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.)

Chi beu‸ Aˍhawˇliˆbaˆ-oˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha naw hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw haˉ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi bawˬ jaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca hoˆ la tuˬ ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Peˍkoˆ venˇ, Shawˆ venˇ, Kawˆ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkaˍlaˍdehˇ chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ

Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ htanˬ tuˬ leh sho uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve pa taw, nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ leh te guiˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe te guiˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve naˍ paw leh naˍ hkʼawˇ hta‸ shawˆ baˬ leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yoˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh awˬ te‸ te‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh, nawˬ ve shehnˉ shiˍ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, hkʼawˇ faˍ leh te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ nyi bawˬ leh canˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ canˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ te gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼe awˬ kʼu nyi teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ meh maˬ lanˉ te leh, nawˬ ve hkʼawˇ faˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ,
nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw cha‸ chiˆ kʼai taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ viˉ ma ve hkui ha hta‸ gʼa‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ ve kawˆ ngaˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ taw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ viˉ ma ve kawˆ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ oˇ ve lehˬ uiˍ leh naˉ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ oˇ ve biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ haˍ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ leh, bvuhˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ viˉ ma Saˍmaˍriˆ ve kawˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ leh luˬ ve sheˆ ve kawˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ kawˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ gʼuiˬ hta‸ teˇ jaˆ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa dawˬ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkoˇ kʼai taˍ ve awˬ hkʼeh‸ lehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ ve cuˉ hta‸ gʼa shawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai leh, ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ haˉ chawˇ te leh hkʼawˇ faˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ tan chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Aˍhawˇlaˆ leh Aˍhawˇliˇbaˆ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ gu taˍ peuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon paw la piˇ taˍ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ te ve kanˉ oˇ hkʼe ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ sheˍ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te leh, ngaˬ teh taˍ ve shinˉ nyi hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui chaw hta‸ hpehˇ leh ca kuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ iˉkaˆ hehˉ leh awˬ hkiˇ shawˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shi caˆ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ nyi sha ve mui hkʼawˇ hkʼoˆ lo mui taˍ leh, yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hpui lawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ leh, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve sha hawnˉ leh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo laˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇmoˍ te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ la‸ kawˬ tcuhˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ nyi sha ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ haˉchawˇ haˉ paˆ te maw jaˇ peuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ leh yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve yaˇ miˇ Aˍhawˇlaˆ leh Aˬhawˇliˇbaˆ geh kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ haˉchawˇ te sheh ma leh chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ ma, teh‸ kʼoˆleh deˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ awˬ suhˍ ngawˉ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw moˍ oˇ ve yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ leh, aˉhtaw chaw hpehˇ tcuh-o. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tcuh-o.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hkʼe haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa te leh sha ti‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ leh cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ chi teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi nyiˇ gʼaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve kʼawˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ya‸ nyi hkʼaˬ nyiˇ nyi gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ ca hoˆ bawˆ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ pa haˉchi yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼoˆ teh leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ keu taˍ-o‸.
Da‸ jaˇ ve shaˍ, la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ, hkui sheh leh da‸ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve hkʼaw keu caˉ-oˆ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ yehˇ-oˆ. Suhˆ hkʼa deh‸ yuˬ keu taˍ-o‸. Iˉ kaˆ hta‸ buiˬ la piˇ lawˬ leh, awˬ mu‸ ku leh shaˍ hta‸ caˉ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve venˇ lehˬ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve htawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ tsuhˇ leh yawˇ taˆ peuˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shaˍ teˇ peˆ peuˬ teˇ peˆ beˆ tawˆ leh mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw lo tiˇ pehˍ da‸ ve cawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ faˉ taˍ gʼa kuiˬ je‸ meu-eˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo awˬ suhˍ maˇ sheˆ. Haˉ pui hkʼoˆ lo sheˆ ngawˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa kuiˬ leh nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ gʼa kuiˬ lo ngaˬ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ teh taˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve venˇ lehˬ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ to suhˆ gʼawˆ hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suhˆ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ-o‸. Aˬ miˍ hta‸ hpeuˇ piˇ-oˆ. Shaˍ gʼuiˬ hta‸ caˉ fiˍ-o‸. Awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Chi beu‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ ve kuiˇ mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ shiˉ gʼeu‸ hkʼoˆ teh leh chiˆ la piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ taˆ taˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ leh, mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ taˆ taˍ kuiˬ oˇ ve aˬ miˍ ha hkʼaw maˇ to‸ baˬ peuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ coˇ caˇ leh te ve htawˇ nawˬ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa leh‸ nyi sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ kʼaw‸ da‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

NgaˬGʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ la‸ haˉ suh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkʼanˇ, maˇ gʼa hawˬ, mehˆ gʼuiˬ maˇ gʼa tawˆ.

Nawˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ shu hta‸ taˇ kaˇ tcuh. Oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ gʼa beh, hkuiˉ nuˆ maˇ tcuhˉ leh dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ heˆ te leh taˇ te toˇ. Nawˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ taˇ beh taˍ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hui caˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ taˇ caˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hui geh na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ ngaˬ miˇ ma suh-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ leh,

nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ hto laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh oˇ kaˬ lo ca guiˇ tuˬ te gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hkʼaw cawˬ taˉ ve nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼaw a sha‸ i sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˉ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ka‸ ngaˬ te ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ beh taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hui caˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ beh, hkuiˉ nuˆ maˇ tcuhˉ, dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼanˇ maˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui pon awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve kʼo yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ chaw yaˇ-oˬ, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ, ha lehˬ kuiˬ, yawˇ hui nyi leh ca guiˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yeˬ jaˇ ve bon yehˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe te ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, awˬ lawn chi ve nawˬ hta‸ ca gʼuiˇ hto la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ yaw puiˉ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ gʼa yaw da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ awˬ pon awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ kʼai ve hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw fa la te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ hta‸ caˇ leh nuˇ cuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Raˍbaˆ venˇ hta‸ kaˍlaˍoˆ hu kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˬ hawˉ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa la‸ sheh hta leh pawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ chaw lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ka‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve pa taw,
Mawˇbaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve da‸ jaˇ ve Behˆyeˍsiˇmoˆ venˇ, Baˍlaˆmonˍ venˇ leh Kiˇriˆtaˆtenˍ venˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca bawˆ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇ miˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tcuh leh, Mawˇbaˆ hta‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tcuh piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve pa taw, Eˇdonˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Eˇdonˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˍmanˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh Deˍdanˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ tan Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Eˇdonˍ chaw hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui lehˬ, teˇ co-e yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, canˇ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca bawˆ leh shiˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hpiˇliˇtiˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, hkʼa biˇ biˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui tanˇ kaˬ te ve kanˇ paˆ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ tehˆ da‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tuˇruˆ venˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, ngaˬ chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ shiˍveu laˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ hkʼa shuˍ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ leh, nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˆ baˬ leh, haˉ pui hta‸ ceh tiˉ teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˇ ca paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve haˉ pui oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve geu‸ hta‸ hpe huˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ leh,
venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui aˉhtaw chaw pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Tuˉruˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ma‸ moˍ lonˉ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ lehˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, taˬ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ duˇ leh htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh ko taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ juˆ pawnˍ leh, nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sho taˬ yuˬ dawˆ paˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ te toˇ ve pa taw, tu la ve je‸ meu-e teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ gʼa‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve ya‸ kaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ te toˇ leh nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ paˆ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ, suhˆ, leh cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve tinˍ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˇ ca paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve geu‸ hta‸ hpe huˉ tuˬ ve haˉ pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ teh taˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tu te gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shu bawˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu tiˇ pehˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ te mui chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, maˇ kawˆ cheˇ leh chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw shiˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Venˇ chi hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ ce kʼai ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, conˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ leh, chi hkʼe luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve venˇ hkʼa shuˍ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yuˬ keu laˇ leh, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui geh chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ suh peuˬ ve chaw, leh co co taiˍ taiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ geh miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ aw pon awˬ leh meuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆlaˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ puˆ kʼa-o.

Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ chehˇve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Tuˇruˆ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve hta‸ naw nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ nyi sha jaˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼa shuˍ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Heˍraˍmonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ hta‸ suhˆ baˉ gʼeu‸ yuˬ leh, Leˍ baˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yawnˉ cehˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui yuˬ leh taˉ behˆ lonˉ te ve yoˬ. Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼeu‸ yuˬ leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ awˬ hawˉ hkʼawˇ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo haw ciˬ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw hpeh chiˇ tuˬ ve hpa hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ ve hpa yuˬ te taˍ leh, vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ nyi ve ka‸ shiˍ sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ ehˉ hkʼaw keu tuˬ ve hpa teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Kuˇpaˍruˆ conˇ lo laˬ ve nyi naˆ meuˉ-ehˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve hpa yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ gʼawˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Siˉdonˍ leh Aˍvaˆ venˇ hkʼaw laˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cheuˬ jaˇ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve puiˉ jaˇ ve la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw te toˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve sainˍ lo tanˇ kaˬ ca te da‸ la ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ, Luˇdaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Liˆbiˇ-aˇ mvuhˇmiˬhkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ ca te la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ leh uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la tuˬ te laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍvaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hta‸ shaw chehˇ leh, Gaˍ maˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve htanˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ kʼuˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ nyi sha la tuˬ te laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ leh, hpu, sho, tawnˇ leh geu‸ law teˇ hpa hta‸ nawˬ geh tawˆ ve mawˇ yuˬ pa da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ Heˍlaˍsaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Tuˇbaˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Meˍshehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ leh, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh kuiˇ yuˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ te hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve mawˇ yuˬ pa piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ leh, taˆ caˇ tuˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh ma‸ hkʼaw yehˇ tuˬ ve iˉmvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Behˆtawˍgaˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw ve piˉ laˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Roˇdeˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ haw ciˬ leh da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shehnˉ shiˍ, nyi naˆ meuˉ lehˍ ve hpa, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hpa, da‸ ve hpa, leh awˬ nu ve shehnˉ shiˍ laiˉ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ leh nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ nawˬ ve mawˇ awˬ pon junˍ, pehˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh hkʼeu hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ la piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Heˍlaˍbonˍ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh, Saˍhaˍraˆ yawˬ mvuh teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ leh nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, sho leh hkʼeu hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ laˬ leh nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la ve yoˬ.
Deˍdanˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ awˬ an te tuˬ ve hpa yuˬ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˍraˆ chaw leh Keˍdaˍ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˬ ehˉ, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˬ leh nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Sheˍbaˆ leh Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehnˉ shiˍ, shi, leh da‸ jaˇ ve hkʼeu hawnˉ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ca pa la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haˍranˍ venˇ, Kaˍnehˆ venˇ, Eˍdenˍ venˇ, Aˍsuˇraˆ venˇ leh Hkeˍlaˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ chehˇ ve toˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve hpa, nyi naˆ meuˇ lehˍ ve hpa, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hpa, awˬ sheuˉ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼawˇ tuˬ, gʼo‸ hkeh, leh aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ hpaˍ ca hawˇ keu la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw keu leh taˆ kʼo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa biˇ doˆ taˍ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ gʼawˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw gʼawˆ kʼai laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve mvuhˇ haw nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ te paˍ la‸shaˉmaˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ciˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ luˬ kʼai htaˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ kʼa chehˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve kuˬ hkawˇ, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ shu baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo kʼai peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ lo je‸ meu-e hkaˆ pfuhˍleh, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw zuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ awˬ pon a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hawˬ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo gawˬ kʼai peuˬ ve Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ tehˆ da‸ gʼa le.

Nawˬ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ paw sha la peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo luˬ kʼai taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo tuˍ lo‸-e taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve mawˇ leh nawˬ awˬ pon kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ geh teˇ geh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ mawˬ leh, anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa gaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ ve awˬ heˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Miˬguiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hkanˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ la ve hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬhta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve hkʼaw, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ gʼuiˬsha hkʼe shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ caw zuhˇ taˍ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ mui chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ gʼuiˬsha hkʼe shawˍ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ suh puiˉ leh gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, nawˬ maˇ shiˍ ve faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh nawˬ ve dawˇ puiˉ keu‸ puiˇ ve nyi ma lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ paw sha la piˇ leh, hpu shi maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ kanˉ hkʼaˇ gu puiˉ leh, awˬ yawˬ maˇ maˇ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ ma nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve le.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ nawˬ gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve pa taw,

haiˬ jaˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh, nawˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh ca gʼa taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ cawˬ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo yuˬ keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ sheˍ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ la ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ suh puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼuiˬsha maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Tuˇruˆ jawˇmawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ nawˬ lehˬ da‸ ve hpawˇ lo shu awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ hkʼaˬ ma cawˬ ve leh hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ jaˇ ve le.

Nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Eˍdenˍ hkʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, shiˉ-ehˍ ve shehnˉ shiˍ, naw shi ve haˉ pui shehnˉ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve haˉ pui shehnˉ, awˬ gʼeuˆ laiˉ ceuˬ cawˬ ve haˉ pui shehnˉ, naw naˆ ve haˉ pui shehnˉ leh hpuˉ-ehˍ ve haˉ pui shehnˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shi hkʼeun htawˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ pon te laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo te toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, nawˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tanˬ te ve teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mawˇ vuiˬ mawˇ hawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ uˉ hkeu‸ tcuhˉ leh te ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ kʼai tcuh leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve shehnˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ te toˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ awˬ to awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve hta‸ nyi ma uiˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ chaw luˬ paˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ca‸ baˬ leh, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mawˇ vuiˬ mawˇ hawˇ ve hkʼaw haiˬ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve pa taw, nawˬve oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa chiˇ nyi ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaw‸ laˉ hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa shiˍ da‸ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hkanˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ la ve hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Siˉdonˍ venˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Siˉdonˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te piˇ ve kanˉchi awˬ pon, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ leh, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ suhˍ ya‸ la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ hpawˇ le le lo shu hoˆ bawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ nyi bawˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve te ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ pawˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼa shuˍ naˬ tuˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇ mi hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬyoˬ. Yawˇ hui yehˬ hta‸ te leh, a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ ti tuˬyoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi maˬ, teˇ chi nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ciˍ yanˍve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Lawˬ kʼaˉ hkʼaw zuh‸ chehˇ ve caˬ hkehˍ lonˉ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve paˇ kaˇ hkʼaw biˉ teˇ maˬ keu laˇ leh, nawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ tcuh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve ngaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼawˬ tawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ leh ngaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shehˇ de hkʼaw ngaˬ baˬ keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ce leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬlehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˍ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ nuˇ jaˇ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼe ceh ka‸ maˇ da‸.
Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ ca peun la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ dawˆ hteh piˇ, juˆ hpehˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hui ve caw‸ hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
