Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ ve pa taw,

ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ leh nawˬ ve Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬlehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Miˆgaˍdawˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍsaˍ vanˍ venˇ leh Suˍdanˍ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ceˇ caˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ kaˬ lo te toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo te‸ chiˉ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬˬ yoˬ. Awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ chaw hpaw hkʼoˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ mvuhˇmiˬ le le lo hpaw-e leh awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, 40 hkʼaw‸ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ leh,
yawˇ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo kʼaw‸ chehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ lawn maˇ uiˍ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ peun tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw oˇ hkʼe luˬ kʼai ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va ve hkʼaˬ ma ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nyiˇ chi suhˍ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Tuˉruˆ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ ve mawˇ pfuhˇ tcuh ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ leh la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ kʼeh‸ kʼai peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ma‸yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon kanˉ te laˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui te laˇ chehˇ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la piˇ leh ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le kaˇ hpeh‸ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo Yeˍsaˍkeˍlaˆ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ yanˇ neˇ la peuˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ nyi leh, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ hpeh‸ la leh, Suˍdanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ dawˇ haˍ dawˇ tui‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw maˇ maˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, shu hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ma‸ oˇ ve hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Suˍdanˍ, Luˆdaˆ, Liˆbi-aˇ, Aˍraˍbaˆ, Kuˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˍ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ htawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Miˆgaˍdawˇlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍsaˍvanˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la leh, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu piˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ ve Suˍdanˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ la tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ leh yawˇ hui geh kʼai peu tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui paw sha chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ leh haiˬ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉhtaw hta‸ yuˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chaw suh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ fiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ hta‸ haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Meˍhpiˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ leh maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Zawˇnaˆ venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve uiˍ jaˇ ve ta‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve Peˍluˆsenˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Teˍbiˆ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu piˇ leh, Peˍluˆsenˍ venˇ lehˬ gʼa hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˍbiˆ ve lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ kʼai leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Heˍliˍpeˍliˆ venˇ leh Buˍbaˍtiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ leh, yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Taˍpaˍnehˆ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo moˬ hoˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shu hpeh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, teˇ chi teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇpeuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh aˉhtaw hta‸ yuˬ gʼa la tuˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ maˇ peh tsuh‸ piˇ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve da‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hteh kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ nu ve la‸ shehˍ teˇ paˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyiˇ paˉ paˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ awˉ hteh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, aˉhtaw yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ce kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸sheh hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ leh, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼanˇ leh suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Yoˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ la piˇ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw yawˇ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ aˉhtaw oˇ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ hpawˇ lo yuˬ mawˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa shehˆ maˬ, awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa yuˬ tehˆ maˍ tuˬ le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nyi sha ve awˬ kʼaˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, moˬ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Htawˇ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo, yawˇ hta‸ uiˍ la yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ iˉ kaˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa chehˇ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ jaˇ zuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpui te chehˇ leh, awˬ cehˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ yehˇ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha hawˉ lo jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le. Mvuh jaˇ leh awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ zuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ miˬguiˬ hkʼaw naˉ chaweh lo‸-e leh, iˉ kaˆ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve hko hkʼaw cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tehˆ da‸ maˇ gʼa. Awˬ nu ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ cehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ awˬ kʼaˉ da‸ leh nyi sha ve teˇ cehˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve hko hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe taw nyi sha ve teˇ cehˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ kʼaˉ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, nyi sha tuˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve Eˍdenˍ hko hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, htawˇ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ hkawehˉ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˬ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ shaˍ. Yawˇ mvuh la ve hkʼe nyi ma htawˇ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ haiˬ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ jaˇ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htu baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ kʼaˉ leh awˬ cehˬ hteh kʼai leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui leh lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ maˬ le le hkʼaw ce kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo mui chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ tu hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ paiˍ taˍ ve suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ca mui la leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ kaˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo te toˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa chehˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ moˬ hta‸ daw‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ uiˍ la mvuh la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa suh-e leh, suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hui geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hoˆ beh la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve suh kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˍ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo peu kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ paiˍ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ cheˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ paiˍ ve pa taw, Eˍdenˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa chehˇ ve Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve geh teˇ geh suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai leh, paiˍ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ nu ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Eˍdenˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ yawˇ hkʼe taw maˇ uiˍ maˇ mvuh. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ lehˬ Eˍdenˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw leh ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬlo suh-e ve chaw hui geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve 12 hkʼaw‸, ha pa 12 maˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaw hpeˆ toˇ chehˇ ve caˬ hkehˍ lonˉ hta‸ leuˉ leh shuˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hkui sheh lehˬ je‸ nehˆ hta‸ naˆ tu la piˇ leh, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ geu‸ hpehˇ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo gʼawˬ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu leh, nawˬ hta‸ ca caˇ la tuˬ ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve kuiˇ taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo baˬ peu tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ngeuˍ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma leh meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ beh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ moˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo va‸ taˍ leh, ha pa htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˉ pehˍ leh, nawˬ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ naˆ ho‸ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn, nawˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kaˇ jaw ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ ve hta‸ anˇ jaˇ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ ngaˬ fui ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ paiˍ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ awˬ pon kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉhtaw gʼawˬ tawˆ tcuh leh, nawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ maˬ le awˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ hta‸ te tiˬ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬlehˬ nawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kehˬ lehˍ cawˬ piˇ leh, nawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ ya‸-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ chi lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai tcuh-o.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ naˬ da‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ya‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui geh gʼa zuh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ, aˉhtaw teˇ taˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ.

Ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui hpawˇ chehˇ leh ma‸ bawˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ha‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo ya‸ la leh zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼa biˇ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh,

yawˇ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw naˉ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo paiˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve tuˬ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇlanˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼa biˇ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ shoˍ-ehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ htaˇ shu hta‸ ca ho piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui suh taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Eˇlanˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui geh zuh‸ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ yuˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ htaˇ shu hta‸ ca ho piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui suh taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hkʼe gʼa hkanˍchehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Meˍshehˆ leh Tuˇbaˍlaˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve tuˍ hpfuh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh hkʼa biˇ caw zuhˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ yuˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yawˇ hui htawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, shu taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh leh tuˍ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ. Ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa deh‸ pfuhˇ leh suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve aˉhtaw yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ hawˉ lo teh taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve htanˬ tuˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ htaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ maˇ hkanˍ yuˬ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇdonˍ htawˇ, yawˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui htawˇ chi beu‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui geh zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Siˉdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ yawˇ hui htawˇ shu hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ shoˍ-ehˬ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh, suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo ya‸-e ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma sha la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ la tuˬ te piˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh gʼa zuh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ma‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh shaw shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Canˇ paˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ju lu dawˆ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ju lu dawˆ hkawˇ kaˇ ve htawˇ a muˆ maˇ taˍ leh, canˇ paˍ yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ gʼa suh ve lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu shaˍ ti‸ piˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ na ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ na yuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ, ju lu maˇ dawˆ piˇ ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ laˬ leh venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve kʼo, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆmaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ maˇ piˇ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa suh ve awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve htawˇ yawˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆpiˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve kanˉ leh ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pfuhˇ hawˇ jaˇ peuˬ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ mawˬ gaˇ. Yawˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hai ve kanˉ hta‸baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui suh gaˇ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw da‸ teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ te ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw da‸ teˇ gʼaˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tanˬ te ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Da‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ peuˬ teh‸ dawˇ leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇhpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve ven baˆ hta‸ pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ shaˍti‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ haiˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo,

yawˇ lehˬ shu hta‸ chiˇ piˇ taˍ ve hpu awˬ tan yuˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo yawˇ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh a sha‸ te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ te ya‸ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpehˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te peuˬ ve pa taw, gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ te ve kanˉ chi maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Maˇ cawˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ da‸ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ te leh, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, da‸ ve hteˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ te ve kanˉ maˇ cawˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi maˬ, ngaˇ nyi htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw hpaw tawˆ la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh laˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ maˇ laˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ teˇ haˉ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ jawˬ ve yoˬ. Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw tuˬ kanˇ paˆ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, luˬ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui chaw maˇ la peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ hkʼaw hkaw‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve aˉhtaw hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve le.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo leh haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ca va‸ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ naˬ beuˬ gaˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ jaˇ ve pa taw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hpanˍ kʼai haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gaˬ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca nyi-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ laˬ leh nawˬ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ ca na la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ te tcuh ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ hkʼe ceh shawˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve a loˍ hkʼaˇ suh ceh tiˉ te kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon tinˍ hteˆ leh kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa maˍ piˇ paˍ hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ kaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ (tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼa biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ) tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ cuˉ gʼuiˬ hta‸ dawˬ, yawˬ mvuh te taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, chu jaˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ.

Gʼaˇ nuˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ. Naˬ chehˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ tsuhˇ maˇ gu piˇ. Hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ peh piˇ. Mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa‸ ca. Nawˬ hui yawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ caˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo caw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa ti chi ti lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ ca piˇ.
Naw hui yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ ca. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ceh tiˉ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ leh, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬlehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ caˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ to ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi kʼaw‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai taˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh gʼa‸ hpoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˬ teˇ hpa hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ leh kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ, hpaˆ da‸ kʼai taˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ leh yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw leh iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ leh, da‸ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaˆ caˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ ve kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬtuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ ca piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Mehˉ kʼai taˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ ca leh, hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw kuiˬ naˬ kuiˬ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peh piˇ leh, naˬchehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ngaˬ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chu leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ leh, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve leh yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuh‸ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve ceh tiˉnyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh puiˉ. Nawˬ hui maˇ caˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ kehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ dawˬ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ dawˬ gaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ te tiˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui naˆ nehˆ taˉ ve mvuh‸ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, nawˬ hui te tiˬ taˉ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yawˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve yawˬ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yawˬ hta‸ guˆ baˬ ca‸ baˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te tcuh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˬ teˇ hkeh le le ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ leh, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ pehˬ da‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ca piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ ti mi hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo zuh‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw pui paˇ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui loˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ bon na‸ piˇ leh mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ shiˍ naw‸ la leh, ti mi hkʼaw awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve sho caˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hpui hkʼa piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shu ceˬ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo ponˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ che‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca ho piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ guiˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Eˇdonˍ ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon awˬ leh meuˇ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍchehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaw mvuh lawˬ naˉ ve Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo hpaˍ toˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuh ve hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw suh hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpa ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬhta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ lo‸ chehˇ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve nyiˇ peˆ hta‸ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh ca hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve, hkawehˉ ve, leh canˇ ve awˬ tan ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬngaˬ hui hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai ve hta‸ nyi taˍ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh nawˬ luˬ kʼai ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi taˍ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Siˇraˆ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ leh Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma uiˍleh, Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve hkʼaw pui oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ leh lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ te luˬ te sheˆ leh hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leuˉ leh Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, kʼaˆcaˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn tawˇ yaw leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaw pui, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ leh lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh, nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hpa‸ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon iˉ shiˍ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ maw maw aˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mehˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ yawˇ sheˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui venˇ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ leh, luˬ kʼai taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ leh ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸kehˉ oˇ kaˬ lo chaw maˇ la leh, nawˬ hui yaˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˍ meu‸ suh-e piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Chaw hta‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ oˇ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, Mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ chaw hta‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ ve cawˬ ve lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ve dawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ liˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hkʼaw mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tuˬ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ heuˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ ve kanˉ lehˬ, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ pon maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa gaˬ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo nawˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ te luˬ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬhponˇ te luˬ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ yehˇ leh, ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍpiˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ piˇ law ve shaˉ ho‸ leh awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma awˬ suhˉ leh dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haˉ pui hkʼe heh ve nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ leh, na yuˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo keu laˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui na yuˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw nawˬ hui gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ piˇ lawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬteˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa meu‸ maˇ gʼa kaˆ jehˇ tuˬ, caˬ shiˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ leh ti mi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ naw‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ te ya‸ taˉ peuˬ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw nyi ma luˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te laˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon te laˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve leh, hkʼaˬ ma ya‸ taw tuˬ cawˬ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ la jawˬ la piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ laˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ve venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh leh, luˬ kʼai taˍ peuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve ti mi paˇ lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ti mi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma naˉ jaˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ti mi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te caˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ hteunˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ Eˍdenˍ hko hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ luˬ kʼai paˆ kʼai taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ, chi beu‸ chaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ leh kʼaw‸ gu da‸ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gu te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ lawˬ yuˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˬ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ luˬ kʼai taˍ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw pawehˇ te leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yawˬ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ chaw hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ jawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ mu ku hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ teˇ maˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ oˇ ve hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ maˍ laˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo goˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, awˬ mu‸ ku chi teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la hpeh‸-aw laˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi hta‸ nawˬ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ mu‸ ku chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ mu‸ ku chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ meuˆ keu laˇ leh, a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬhta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ leh, awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ caˉ da‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ mu‸ ku oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ shaˍ leh awˬ kuˇ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ, leh awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to hkʼaw lo te‸ chiˉ awˬ shaˉ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, mvuhˇ haw hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍawˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shaˉ lo‸-e leh a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo ve mvuhˇ haw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw awˬ shaˉ lo‸-e leh, yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ la leh tu huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ te gʼa law‸ law‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍlehˬ, awˬ mu‸ ku chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ goˇ kʼai peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon te‸ chiˉ dawˇ law tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaw baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ hpaw baˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo shaˉ meuˆ keu piˇ leh, a sha‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ leh, ngaˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ nu ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teh‸ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ taˍ-o‸.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ maˬ, teˇ taˬ hkʼe tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw vawˆ taˍ-o‸.
Chi hkʼe te ve aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ na nyi laˇ ve kʼo,

yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ chi hta‸ yuˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ geh teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ taˬ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ taˬ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw vawˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw vawˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ kʼai taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chaw teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ hpeh tsuh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh, chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ nyiˇ peˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Daˍviˆ hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉpeunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ leh, chaw maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo co co cawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ yawˇ hui geh co co taiˍ taiˍ teh taˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Maˍgawˇgaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Meˍshehˆ leh Tuˇbaˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Gawˇgaˆ hta‸ hkeu piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hta‸ hkeu piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve paˇ kaˇ hkʼaw biˉ yuˬ keu piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼawˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaw kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le htanˬ tuˬ leh aˉhtaw pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paˇshaˇ chaw, Suˍdanˍ chaw leh Liˆbi-aˇ chaw teˇ Hpaˍ yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, htanˬ tuˬ leh uˉ tcuhˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ na hpawˇ chehˇ ve Gawˇmaˍ leh Behˆtawˍgaˍmaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ geh chaw maˇ maˇ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hta‸ shawˍ leh hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw la htaˇ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ ve hta‸ maˇ kawˆ ve chaw hui hta‸, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ ma‸ bawˆ laˬ leh, moˬ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Gawˇgaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ lanˇ venˇ maˇ cawˬ leh gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hta‸ ca lo‸ bawˆ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ dawˇ cheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ luˬkʼai taˍ ve venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ te luˬ leh, hiˉ yuˬlu yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw laiˉ ceuˬ hkaw‸ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, chi beu‸ ceˇ caˬ leh mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh, ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ ceh da‸ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Sheˍbaˆ chaw, Deˍdanˍ chaw leh Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ tuˬ nawˬ ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shawˍ taˍ peuˬ laˇ. Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ leh ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh tawˆ-e tuˬ nawˬ dawˇ taˍ ve laˇ, teh‸ nawˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Gawˇgaˆ geh kʼai peu laˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ htaˇ,
nawˬ lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ chi beu‸ nawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ na mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo meuˆ laˬ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ ngaˬ a shu hpeh‸ ve leh nawˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ ve awˬ lawn kʼoˆ chehˇ ve maw jaˇ peuˬ. Teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, ngaˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Gawˇgaˆ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve awˬ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw miˬ hiˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˇ leh ngaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, uiˍ ve i ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ leh cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ paiˍ leh, haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ paˆ ce kʼai leh, lanˇ venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ paˆ hpoˆ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ peuˬ teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, Gawˇgaˆ hta‸ kawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ chaw pehˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Naˬ beuˬ leh chaw pehˍ da‸ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ, leh yawˇ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mvuhˇ yeˬ leh vaˇ shiˍ geh teˇ geh aˬ miˍ leh ma‸ shiˉ hta‸ ce ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te piˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve leh hkʼaˬ ma da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, Meˍshehˆ leh Tuˇbaˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ Gawˇgaˆ hta‸ hkeu piˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ lo shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve la‸ mehˍ paˉ la‸ sheh hkʼaw vawˆ taˍ ve hkaˆ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh hkʼaw vawˆ taˍ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˆ ce piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gawˇgaˆ awˬ to, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh yawˇ hpawˇ hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo paˍ suh-e leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ ngaˆ leh haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ caˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yiˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo paˍ suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Maˍgawˇgaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ keu piˇ leh, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ nyi oˇ ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, shu baˬ taˉ ve htanˬ tuˬ, hkaˆ, hkaˆ ce, gehˇ, leh iˉ du taˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ suhˆ te tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa tuˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˆ tuˉ tuˬ awˬ pon heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ca gʼawˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Suhˆ htu hkaˆ tuˬ ka‸ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui aˬ miˍ tuˉ tuˬ shu baˬ taˉ ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ luˬ yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ Gawˇgaˆ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍ laˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw toˇ paˍ hui ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ ngaˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gawˇgaˆ leh yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tuˍ piˇ leh, chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ Gawˇgaˆ ma‸ moˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸, teh‸ meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te ve 7 hkʼaw‸ maw tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa ga gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe ga te laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve ponˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, maˇ gʼa tuˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hpfuhˆ tuˍ piˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaw taˆ lawˬ ya‸ te toˇ kʼai leh, chaw mu‸ ku hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw tuˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ laˬleh Gawˇgaˆ ma‸ moˍ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo awˬ mu‸ ku oˇ ve hta‸ tuˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ awˬ mu‸ ku oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo awˬ heˆ te teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
(Oˇ kaˬ lo ma‸ moˍ ve awˬ meh yuˬ meh taˍ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.) Chi hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ gu chehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ca caˇ la tuˬ, hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo te tuˬ ve awˬ shaˍ caˇ leh awˬ suhˍ dawˬ tuˬ ve pawehˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˬ paˍ lonˉ, yawˬ ehˉ, aˉ che‸ leh chu jaˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ chu hta‸ yawˇ hui caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe caˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ bvuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ dawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve hpui lawˇ paˇ lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ shaˍ, leh ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maw piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ maw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te leh ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve leh cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ ho piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe luˬ kʼai taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ lawn chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ tcuh ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ oˇ kaˬ lo maˇ teh taˉ piˇ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ ve pa taw, chi hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ shu bawˆ yuˬ kʼai ve teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, leh ngaˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nyiˇ chi ngaˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, hkʼaw‸ suhˉ ha pa teˇ chi nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ jawˬ leh, Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, venˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yehˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ Yawˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo kuˬ yuˬ laˇ leh, kuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ caˆ leh iˉ du taˬ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi leh tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ hta‸ choˬ kaˬ lo shiˍ veuˬ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo gʼo‸ pa caw ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve tehˆ nyi tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve hkaw‸ shaw‸ mvuh leh hkaw‸ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ go hkʼeh‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, lo‸-e kuiˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, hkaw‸ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve awˬ nu paˉ hpawˇ lo ya‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve choˬ paˉ oˇ paˇ hpawˇ lo shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ paˉ shehˆ bawehˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ ve hkaw‸ shaw‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, ngaˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ nu paˉ lo, hkaw‸ shaw‸ zuhˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ chehˇ ve bawehˇ lonˉ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ ceˍ leh, gʼo‸ pa hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ ceˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

(Ya‸ kʼaw choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇmaˬ leh teˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, nyiˇ chi shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ leh teˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬve yoˬ.

Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, mvuh ve hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ leh htu ve hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa ko taˍ ve yoˬ.(Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkaw‸ shaw‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ hta‸ te leh ya‸ kʼaw oˇ paˉ hpawˇ ve bawehˇ teˇ ceˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ oˇ ve awˬ leh meuˇ hpawˇ lo lehˬ, aˉ kʼa‸ lo tawˆ-e kuiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ bawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬve yoˬ.
Ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo te leh, oˇ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ awˬ ceˍ hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa leh, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍkʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve bawehˇ ehˉ shehˆ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo haˉ pui hkʼawˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui hkʼawˇ taˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, koˇ caˉ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ chi ve lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ a‸ kehˉ a ciˉ nehˬ ve yoˬ.

A ciˉ mvuh kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo tawˆ-e ve awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw choˬ paˉ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ shehˆ maˬ, bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa, leh bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve zuhˬ hpawˇ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ lonˉ, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ leh tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo cawˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo taˆ-e tuˬ ve go hkʼeh‸ suhˍ maˬ cawˬ leh, bawehˇ lonˉ leh awˬ na hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve koˇ caˉ chi ve hta‸ te leh, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo kʼai tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ nu ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, oˇ ve htawˇ awˬ nu ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ chi hkʼaw ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve lehˬ zuhˬ hpawˇ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ leh kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo go hkʼeh‸ suhˍ maˬ cawˬ leh, bawehˇ lonˉ lehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han teˇ hpaˍ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo kʼai tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw chi ve lo hkʼa gaˬ tehˆ nyi leh, teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa lo cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, bawehˇ lonˉ, leh awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi ve zuhˬ hpawˇ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ naˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, ya‸ kʼaw choˬ paˉoˇ paˉ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi ve hkʼaw go hkʼeh‸ 8 hkʼeh‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo te leh, ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, bawehˇ lonˉ, leh awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpawˇ le le lo yehˬmiˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo htawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve zuhˬ hpawˇ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ leh kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, ya‸ kʼaw choˬ paˉ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi ve hkʼaw go hkʼeh‸ 8 hkʼeh‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ, awˬ nu ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hkiˇ shawˍ taˍve awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ, bawehˇ lonˉ, leh teˇ hpawˇ le le lo yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve lehˬ zuhˬ hpawˇ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸, leh kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, ya‸ kʼaw choˬ paˉ oˇ paˇ hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi ve hkʼaw go hkʼeh‸ hiˉ hkʼeh‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo, awˬ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ leh, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lehˬ bawehˇ lonˉ hpawˇ lo htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw hpui lawˇ awˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, teˇ hpawˇ nyiˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpui lawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ, leh kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon yuˬ laˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shaˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ chi ve awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo, oˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve hpui lawˇ awˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ choˬ paˉ coˇ paˉ teˇ hpawˇ nyiˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ teh taˍ tuˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo hpui lawˇ hiˉ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ hkʼaw awˇ maˬ leh, bawehˇ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ koˇ caˉ lo awˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ gu ve awˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw teh taˍ ve hpui lawˇ awˇ maˬ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ htawˆ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Hpui lawˇ oˇ ve teˇmaˬ le le mvuh hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸ teˇ htu, kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ htaˇ yehˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpui lawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hpui lawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ meuˇ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, la‸ taw kʼaw teˇ paˉ fe cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve shaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpui lawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo bawehˇ nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ teˇ maˬ ve yehˬ miˉ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ paˇ lo cawˬ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve teˇ bawehˇ ve yehˬ miˉ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo yehˬ miˉ htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve bawehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ leh,

awˬ na hpawˇ lo yehˬ miˉ htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve bawehˇ oˇ ve lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo‸-e leh kanˉ te tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ lonˉ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ leh, oˇ ve awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e kuiˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, mvuh hpawˇ hkaw‸ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸, leh gʼo‸ pa lehˬ shehˆ shaw‸ htu ve yoˬ.

Bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ go tcuhˉ taˍ leh, go oˇ ve kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, mvuh hpawˇ teˇ chi shehˆ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Lo‸-e kuiˬ choˬ paˉ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo yehˬ hkuiˉ daw lonˉ teˇ paˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, mvuhˇ hpawˇ hkaw‸ shaw‸,
kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ leh gʼo‸ pa lehˬ ngaˇ shaw‸ htu ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ awˇ chi ngaˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kʼaw ji ve teˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, bawehˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw lo‸-e ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, htu hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ hkaw‸ shaw‸ leh gʼo‸ pa lehˬ hiˉ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ hkʼa shuˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chi ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼaˬ ma htu ve hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, oˇ ve lehˬ hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa chi ve hta‸ awˇ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve awˬ bawehˇ ehˉ hkʼa biˇ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ bawehˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shehˆ htai‸ cawˬ leh, teˇ htai‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bawehˇ ehˉ shehˆ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na leh leh teˇ htai‸ lo cawˬ ve bon yehˬ gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ teˇ htai‸ ve gʼo‸ pa a‸ kehˉ te i la piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, awˬ bawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ tawˆ kanˬ piˇ tuˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw maˇ loˍ. Gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo ceh teh taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, bon yehˬ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, teˇ vuiˇ lo chehˇ nyi ve kʼo, awˬ hawˉ lo te leh awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼa hui-ehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ baˬ hpawˇ, bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ leh leh ve teˇ htai‸, awˬ kʼaw ji ve teˇ htai‸ leh awˬ na ve teˇ htai‸ lo taˆ-e ve go nyiˇ maˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ bawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyiˇ shaw‸ htu ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ na paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve awˬ bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ yehˬ miˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve yehˬ miˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ngaˇ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve je‸ duˇ kawˍ taˍ ve teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, miˬ chaˆ hkʼoˆ hkaw‸ shaw‸ mvuh kuiˬ lo cawˬ leh, bawehˇ kawˍ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼe mvuh cawˬ ve yoˬ. Je‸ duˇ kawˍ taˍ ve oˇ ve leh paw hkuˇ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo, nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ lonˉ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ ha shaw‸ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ suhˍ chi suhˍ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yehˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkaw‸ shaw‸ htu ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh, zuhˬ hpawˇ 112 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ hta‸ te leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ ceˍ meuˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ paˉ hpawˇ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ htawˇ teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ tehˆ nyi leh, oˇ ve ka‸ teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve bawehˇ, da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ, leh da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suhˆ baˉ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve hta‸ te leh yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ suhˆ baˉ yuˬ dawˆ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ beh taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh leh, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ leh toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ teˇ cehˬ peuˬ kʼo, to nuˇ to shaˆ ve awˬ han chi hkʼe te htawˆ keuˬ kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh le le mehˆ hpfuhˇ nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mehˆ hpfuhˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ peu taˍ ve chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ teˇ maˬ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ lo hpfuhˆ peu taˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ baˉ hkʼawˇ taˍ ve hta‸ te leh, yehˬ miˉ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa gaˬ ve gʼo‸ pa awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chi hkʼe ve awˬ han hkʼa biˇ htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˇ ceˍ hkʼa hui cawˬ ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
