Oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuh hpawˇ shehˆ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˍ kʼaw-eh‸ ve yehˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hawˉ lo teh taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh awˇ hpawˇ hpawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˆ ceh tiˉ yuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Chi ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve hpui lawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ leh, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ bawehˇ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬmiˉhpe‸ oˇ ve hta‸ yehˬ miˉ baˉ nyiˇ maˬ te hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬve bawehˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬ miˉ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, gʼo‸ pa teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo ve hkʼa shuˍ, tcuhˉ pui cehˬ leh toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ cawˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve bawehˇ yehˬ miˉ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo suhˆ baˉ yuˬ nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo tcuhˉ pui cehˬ awˬ han htawˆ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, bon yehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ tcuhˇ tcuhˬ maˇ vuiˇ da‸.
Yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, kʼehˬ hpawˇ 56 shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve nyiˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hpawˇ lehˬ, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ hta‸ daw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shehˆ htai‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ na ve teˇ htai‸ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ ve teˇ htai‸ a‸ kehˉ te i piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ lo, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi shaw‸ cawˬ leh zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ ha teˇ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ na teˇ bawehˇ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ ve bawehˇ aˬ kehˉ shaˬ te shaˬ te i kʼai taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo te jiˆ kʼo‸-e piˇ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi ve shehˆ htai‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ hawˉ teˇ htai‸ lo yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ ve gʼo‸ pa lehˬ, ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ leh, awˬ nu ve ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ na ve teˇ htai‸ lo bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hawˉ lo, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo tawˆ-e tuˬ ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ tcuhˇ tcuhˬ maˇ vuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ lo, yehˬ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, awˬ na hpawˇ lo hkʼa shuˍ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Zuhˬ ve kʼehˬ ve, leh yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ awˬ hawˉ lo, yehˬ miˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, gʼo‸ pa tanˬ cawˬ kuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ chi ve nyiˇ maˬ maˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo‸-e ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hkʼaw gaˬ taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo kʼai gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw gʼa kʼehˆ teh taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw moˍ lonˉ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo maˇ tawˆ kʼai sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, awˬ nu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa veu‸ kʼai ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ-e laˇ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve suhˆ taˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˇ ha hkaw‸ chi shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ aw na hpawˇ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ, leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, ngaˇ ha hkaw‸ chi shaw‸ zuh‸ ve gʼo‸ pa ko taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸kehˬ ve leh maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tawˍ cheˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍkʼai laˇ leh,

mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo laˬ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ bvuhˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ pa taw ba lehˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ha chi hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha leh, Hkeˍbaˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ oˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hta‸ cawˍ tu laˇ leh, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve kʼaw jaw choˬ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve hawˉ yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ leh taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ leh taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ te tcuhˉ naw‸ piˇ leh, awˬ kaˍ lo gʼo‸ pa teˇ maˬceh tiˉ hkanˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ leh, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui geh co co chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ henˇ yuˬ tcuh-o. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ pon yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ taw ve kʼo, bon yehˬ hta‸ te tuˬ gu taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Bon yehˬ chi ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han, lo‸-e kuiˬ leh tawˆ-e kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ pon gu taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Gu taˍ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ leh, gu taˍ ve hkʼe te kʼai gʼa tuˬ, awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon bvuh‸ keu taˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Bon yehˬ ve awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui oˇ ve teˇ shiˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ hta‸ tehˆ nyi htaˇ yehˇ ve suhˆ taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tehˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ, htu ve hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ shaw‸, leh mvuh hpawˇ teˇ htu cawˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ daw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkuiˉ daw chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, teˇ shaw‸ hpaˆ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ na lo kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ lo ve teˇ htai‸ a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ htu hkʼe kʼaw‸ i kʼai leh, mvuh ve hpawˇ nyiˇ shaw‸ hpaˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ ve teˇ htai‸ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ ve teˇ htai‸ a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ htu hkʼe kʼaw‸ te i kʼai piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve teˇ htai‸ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo awˇ ceˍ lo te taˍ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hta‸ leh leh ve teˇ htai‸ lehˬ hkʼa hui hpeh‸ leh, teˇ chi shehˆ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kʼaw ji ve teˇ htai‸ htawˇ hkʼa hui hpeh‸ leh, teˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo kʼaw‸ te caˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceˍ meuˇ lehˬ, teˇ htu hpaˆ hkʼe mvuh ve yoˬ.(Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo teh taˍ ve awˬ hkuiˉ daw lehˬ, teˇ shaw‸ hpaˆ kʼehˬ ve yoˬ.) Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e tuˬ ve go lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ te peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ tuˉtanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ gʼa yuˬ tuˉ tanˇ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ suhˍ gʼa hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Zaˍdoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Leˍviˆ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ tawn ve awˬ ceˍ meuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve hkʼaw, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ leh gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve nuˇ paˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Shawˉ pawˍ teˇ nyi, nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ paˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh te ve hkʼe, aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ ve kʼo, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ haˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸,
ngaˬ geh lo gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo aˉ leh‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ nyi le le te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh, nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa da‸ kehˬ piˇ leh, yehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ shinˉ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve ponˬ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa tuˉ tanˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ mvuhˇnyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hoˆ taˍ leh, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ hpaw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la taˍ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hta‸ gʼa yehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh da‸ kehˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ca caˇ la htaˇ, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hkʼaw lo‸ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ bawehˇ lonˉ hta‸ hpaˍ leh, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ chi hkʼaw lo‸-e hpeh‸, tawˆ-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ hpanˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ taˍ leh,

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa kaˇ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Bon yehˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw a shu teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ tawˆ lo‸ lo‸ gʼa te leh, a shu teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa te ve hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬchu leh awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw shiˍ lo‸-e leh, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ shaˉ. Awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e kuiˬ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ shaw ve kanˉ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw te cawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon kanˉ te piˇ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hoˉ te leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tcuh piˇ leh, venˇbaˆ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ paw hkuˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve mawˇ teh taˍ kuiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, chi lehˬ yawˇ hui gʼa tuˬ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ hkʼaw te tuˬ loˍ ve kanˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te tcuh ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Zaˍdoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te leh, awˬ chu leh awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ tanˇ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa lo‸ la leh, ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ gʼa te leh, bon lawˬ kuiˬ lo gʼa sheh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw lo‸ la lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ pi‸ hpa hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo maˇ kʼo, bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˬ mvuh yuˬ te taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa veu‸ deh.
Yawˇ hui kuiˍ maˇ gʼa tawˆ tuˬ, pi‸ hpa yuˬ te taˍ ve uˉ nyiˉ leh haˍ htaw gʼa veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˍ pi maˇ gʼa tsuh‸ taˍ.

Chaw yaˇ hpoˆ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo maˇ tawˆ kʼai sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yawˇ hui bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ htaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, da‸kehˬ ve bawehˇ hkʼaw gʼa teh taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui veu‸ deh taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, awˬ nu ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ veu‸ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ yiˬ lehˍ maˇ gʼa chiˇ baˬ. Uˉ hkeh mvuh zuhˬ zuhˬ ka‸ maˇ gʼa taˍ. Nyi sha law‸ ceh gʼa teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo lo‸-e htaˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a peuˉmeuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ gʼa dawˬ lo‸-e.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shu baˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ yaˇ miˇ haˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ve mehˇchawˇma hta‸ gʼa heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ da‸ kehˬ ve leh, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ da‸ kehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa fuiˍ da‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ leh a muˆ te da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼaˇ suh hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ gʼa jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve shinˉ nyi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw suh hta‸ htawˇ leh a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ gʼa te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e, yawˇ ve yaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ suh-e ve kʼo, htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa law taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ kʼaw‸ caˉ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, da‸ kehˬ tuˬ te ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, paw hkuˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉgʼa te ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ. Yawˇ hui loˍve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gu taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍlehˬ, paw hkuˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu awˬ suhˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tanˇ laˇ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkaoˍmonˇ te ve teˇ pawˆ le le, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve hkaoˍmonˉ teˇ diˬ paw hkuˇ hui hta‸ gʼa piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ bon yawˇ hui ve yehˬ kʼa hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ suh-e ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo to nuˇ to shaˆ che‸ pehˍ taˍ ve ngaˆ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon teˇ tawn ehˉ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ leh kʼehˬ hpawˇ hiˉ laˆ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi hkʼaw, bon yehˬ awˬ pon zuhˬ hpawˇ kʼehˬ hpawˇ 560 shaw‸ cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ teˇ peˆ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ shaw‸ kʼehˬ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi ve teˇ hkoˇ, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ awˇ laˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ tehˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve hkʼaw, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve bon yehˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, bon yehˬ chi hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ leh bon yehˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve miˬguiˬ teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve Leˍviˆ chaw hui awˬ pon gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui chehˇ tuˬ ve venˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo, teˇ chi laˆ zuhˬ leh nyiˇ laˆ kʼehˬ ve awˬ nu ve miˬguiˬ teˇ tawn hta‸, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ gaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui venˇ te chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ awˬ pon htawˇ, da‸ kehˬ ve miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, miˬguiˬ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chi ve zuhˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui pehˬ gʼa taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaˬ suh chi suh gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ chi ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa keunˍ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼaw‸ nyiˉ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve awˬ nu ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te ve maw jaˇ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve leh, shu hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ teh taˍ-oˆ. Da‸ ve hteˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te-o. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le cawˇ ve tsuh tu leh cawˇ ve panˇ kʼoˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ.

Goˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ tsuh yehˇ ve Eˇhpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼuiˬ hta‸ tsuh yehˇ ve Baˆ hta‸ gʼa hawˍ da‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkanˉ teh taˍ ve lehˬ, Hawˇmehˇ yoˬ. Teˇ Hawˇ mehˇ lehˬ Teˇ chi Eˇhpaˍ, teˇ chi baˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hkanˉ lehˬ, awˇ hawˉ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nyiˇ chi geˍraˆ, teˇ hteh‸, Hkaw‸ chi hteh‸, teˇ miˍnaˍ.

Nawˬ hui ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe gʼa te tanˇ ve yoˬ. Junˍ - hkaw‸ chi pun teˇ pun, cho‸ - hkaw‸ chi pun teˇ pun, shaˍ lonˍchu teˇ ha pun teˇ pun, (chi ve baˆ hta‸ shawˍ leh gʼa tanˇ ve yoˬ.) 10 baˆ - teˇ hawˇ mehˇ, teˇ kawˇraˆ. Yawˬ nyiˇ ha hkeh teˇ hkeh. Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ geh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ, shinˉ nyi, leh awˬ nu ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ca piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ leh, bon yehˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ tuˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lehˬ, nuˇ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˇ ceˍ, leh awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ hta‸ gʼa shehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa oˇ ve suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ tiˉ te chehˇ ve chaw, maˇ heˆ kʼo maˇ shiˍ maˇ nawˇ ve hkʼaw venˇbaˆ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon oˇ hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ ha pa, teˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ gʼa tanˬ te ve yoˬ. Suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ diˇ maˇ keu ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ tiˉ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ.
Pawehˇ te ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ leh chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te ve suhˍ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ teˇ nyi le le te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ teˇ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇnyi le le venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon aˉ che‸ awˬ paˍ teˇ hkeh gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ leh yawˬ paˍ geh teˇ geh, caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ kaw gʼa ga hkaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ, teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi htaˇ gʼa te tuˬ ve Aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ suhˍ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi le le venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, leh caˬ hkʼa meu-e leh shaˍ lonˍ chu teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo kʼai ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸, kanˉ te caˇ ve hkaw‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve hta‸ shinˉ nyi htaˇ leh, ha pa tawˬ htaˇ te ve pawehˇ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ gʼa hpaw piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve kʼoˇ caˉ lo te leh bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo gʼa huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, gʼa kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ maˇ hpeu‸ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh maˇ gʼa hoˆ taˍ.
Shinˉ nyi htaˇ leh ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te htaˇ teˇ pawˆ le le, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ paˇ lo boˆ taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Shinˉ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkaw‸ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh geh caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh le le geh yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ gʼa yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ geh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa tawˬ ve pawehˇ te htaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh, yawˬ ehˉ hkaw‸ hkeh leh yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nuˇ paˍ lonˉ leh yawˬ paˍ lonˉ geh teˇ geh caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh le le geh teˇ geh jawˇmawˇ yaˇ yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ laˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hkʼaˇ suh bawehˇ lonˉ hta‸ hpaˍ leh gʼa kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Bon pawehˇ te htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw lo‸ la taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ laˬve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hkʼaw maˇ gʼa tawˆ-e. Maˇ laˬ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo gʼa tawˆ-e ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ htawˇ gʼa lo‸ la leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ htawˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hti caˇ hti dawˬ htaˇ leh bon pawehˇ te htaˇ, nuˇ paˍ lonˉ leh yawˬ paˍ lonˉ geh teˇ geh caˬ hkʼa meu-e shehˆ panˇ gʼa yuˬ laˬ leh, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hkeh le le geh teˇ geh oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la ve chaw oˇ ve piˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ laˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo shaˍlonˍ chu htawˇ teˇ kaw gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ pon hpaw piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shinˉ nyi htaˇ te ve hkʼe, tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ tawˆ-e peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Teˇ shawˉ le le te‸ chiˉ awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ aˬ miˍ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ chi hta‸ teˇ shawˉ le le gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, teˇ shawˉ le le caˬ hkʼa meu-e teˇ cawehˬ hta‸ shaˍlonˍ chu teˇ kaw geh teˇ geh gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co gʼa te kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ liˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ ehˉ, caˬ hkʼa meu-e, leh shaˍlonˍ chu chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ shawˉ le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ kʼaw‸ te piˇ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ yawˇ yaˇ paˍ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve kanˉ te paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ ve miˬguiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ lehˬ, shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yuˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw ve ceh tiˉ gʼa hpeh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ awˬ na paˉ teˇ hkʼaˇ hteˇ lehˍ lo cawˬ ve bawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e kuiˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo shiˍkʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon da‸ kehˬ ve bawehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Bawehˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ beˆ maˍ laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo yuˬ tawˆ-e leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve tuˉ tanˬ tuˬ leh, kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ shaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ keu caˉ kuiˬ leh, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve caˬ hkʼa meu-e hta‸ gu tuˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ ve koˇ caˉ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, koˇ caˉ oˇ ve awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ awˇ hpawˇ hpawˇ lo zuhˬ hpawˇ awˇ chi ngaˇ shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ shehˆ chi nyiˇ shaw‸ cawˬ ve koˇ caˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Koˇ caˉ ehˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo, haˉ pui ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa cawˬ leh, gʼo‸ pa oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo hkʼaˇ ciˇ pehˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ laˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, bon yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ te paˍ hui hkʼaˇ ciˇ pehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw keu caˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬmiˉhpe‸ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo iˉ kaˆ tawˆ la leh, bon yehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, bon yehˬ awˬ hawˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo te leh tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hawˉ paˉ hpawˇ lo hpaˍ ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ na hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ te leh, bon yehˬ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo htaw pawnˍ taˍ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo htawˇ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ ehˉ teˇ maˬ tawˆ la chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve iˉ duˬ taˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo nyiˇ ha hiˉ chi loˬ hkʼa gaˬ tehˆ kʼai leh, ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw hkanˍ kʼai tuˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu hkʼa gaˬ naˉ ve yoˬ. Nyiˇ ha nyiˇ chi awˇ loˬ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ tehˆ kʼai leh, ngaˬ ve hkui kʼawˍ lehˬ hkʼe ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ naˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve hkʼaˇ suh nyiˇ ha hiˉ chi loˬ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ tehˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu hkʼa gaˬ naˉ ve yoˬ. Nyiˇ ha nyiˇ chi awˇ loˬ hkʼa gaˬ kʼaw‸ caˉ tehˆ kʼai leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ ve caw‸ cehˬ nyi hkʼa gaˬ naˉ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ nyiˇ ha hiˉ chi loˬ hkʼa gaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ tehˆ kʼai leh, iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve naˉ jaˇ peuˬve pa taw, ngaˬ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ. Lawehˇ kʼai ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, ya‸ kʼaw‸ juˇ kʼai maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Chaw yaˇ-oˬ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ choˬ paˉ lo suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ya‸-e leh Yawˇdanˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai peuˬ hkʼawˆ nawˉ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ chi Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ ve hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ mehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ chi hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo, laiˉ ceuˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ tuˬyoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi lehˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ mehˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Enˍgaˍdiˆ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ hta‸ te leh, Eˇneˍgaˍlenˍ lo tawˆ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo ngaˇ ca paˍ teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ leh, a shu yawˇ ve geu‸ hta‸ hpe huˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw ngaˇ laiˉ ceuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, oˇ kaˬ lo htawˇ ngaˇ laiˉ ceuˬ ve chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ po teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ la mehˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬ po oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ leh‸ gʼuiˬ po ceh hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ choˬ paˉ hpawˇ lo suhˆ cehˬ laiˉ ceuˬ ve yeˬ la leh, caˇ tuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ nawˍ kʼai leh, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ ve teˇ pawˆ ka‸ jehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la taˍ ve pa taw, teˇ ha pa le le awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˆ shiˍ hawˆ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw naˬ hta‸ gu na-e tuˬ aw pon yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ gʼa pehˬ da‸ tuˬ ve yawˇ hui ve miˬ tcuhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yoˇseh‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ nyiˇ peˆ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui pehˬ yuˬ-o‸.
Awˬ na hpawˇ ve mi tcuhˉ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te leh, Heˍtaˍlonˍ venˇ, Haˍmaˆ kʼaˬ le‸, Zeˍdiˆ venˇ,

Beˍrawˇta‸ venˇ, Siˆbaˍrenˍ venˇ, (venˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ leh Haˍ maˆ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ) leh Tiˉkonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (venˇ chi lehˬ, Hawˇranˍ miˬ tcuhˉ paˇ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ)

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ na hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo te leh, Eˇnonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍmaˆ leh Daˍmaˍsehˆ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ leh Hawˇranˍ venˇ awˬ kaˍ lo te leh, Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼaˇ suh ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ chi ve mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ leh mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lehˬ, Giˉlaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ chi lehˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve Taˍmaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Taˍmaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh, Kaˍdeˍshaˆ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, oˇ kaˬ kʼaw‸ te leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ hkʼaˇ suh kʼaw‸ te veu leh, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ lo Haˍmaˆ kʼaˬ le‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬchi ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ chi lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw leh, choˬ kaˬ lo paw la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼe gʼa shawˍ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh teˇ geh mvuhˇmiˬ gʼa tuˬ mehˇ gʼa hkaˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Shu mvuhˇmiˬ chaw htawˇ, yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw miˬguiˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ te leh, Heˍtaˍlonˍ venˇ, Haˍmaˆ kʼaˬ le‸, Eˇnonˍ venˇ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ leh Haˍmaˆ miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ gʼa taˍve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Danˍ, Aˍshaˍ, Naˍtaˍliˆ, Maˍnaˍseˍ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ, Ruˇ benˍ leh Yuˇda‸ hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu teˇ tawn ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ leh awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ gʼa cawˬ piˇ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi teˇ tawn hkʼaw cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ tawn lo, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ, kʼehˬ hpawˇ hiˉ laˆ cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve miˬguiˬ chi teˇ tawn ehˉ hta‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa tuˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ cawˬ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo awˇ laˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi ve awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve miˬguiˬ chi teˇ tawn lehˬ, Zaˍdoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, awˬ nu ve Leˍviˆ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼe cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ Leˍviˆ chaw gʼa taˍ ve miˬguiˬ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ gʼa leh, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ paˉ teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve fuiˍ teh taˍ ve miˬguiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve ka‸ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo teˇ chi laˆ cawˬ leh, awˬ na hpawˇ leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo awˇ laˆ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve teˇ tawn hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ hawˇ ve, pa ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve, zuhˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ leh kʼehˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ laˆ cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, maˇ da‸ kehˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ chaw moˍ lonˉ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ chehˇ leh miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ kʼaw ji lo, yawˇ hui venˇ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ hinˉ loˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpawˇ le le lo, ngaˇ chi hkaw‸ loˬ kʼehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ gʼa cawˬ taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Daˬ kehˬ ve miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo venˇ hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo awˇ laˆ leh nyiˇ laˆ kʼehˬ ve leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo awˇ laˆ leh nyiˇ laˆ kʼehˬ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui ti mi te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chehˇ ve hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ te caˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ tawn lo cawˬ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, zuhˬ hpawˇ kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi laˆ hkʼa shuˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇ te taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ, paw hkuˇ ve miˬguiˬ leh venˇ te taˍ kuiˬ miˬguiˬ chi ve mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve miˬguiˬ lehˬ, uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ yaˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve mvuhˇnyi tawˆ hpawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lehˬ, Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ na hpawˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw gʼa taˍ ve miˬguiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lehˬ Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve miˬguiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve miˬguiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ te leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ gʼa taˍ ve cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ, Suˉmonˍ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ, Zeˍbuˆlonˍ leh Gaˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gaˆ chaw hui gʼa taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo ve miˬ tcuhˉ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ awˬ hawˉ hawˇ Taˍmaˍ venˇ lo te leh Kaˍdeˍshaˆ iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo kʼaw‸ te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ awˬ na hpawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ miˬ tcuhˉ hta‸ te leh Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te pehˬ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpawˇ ve teˇ hinˉ loˬ cawˬ leh, taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ shehˆ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yehˬmiˉhpe‸ teˇ maˬ ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ ceuˬ ve awˬ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬna hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Ruˇbenˍ, Yuˇda‸ leh Leˍviˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Yoˇseh‸, Beˍyaˍmenˍ, leh Danˍ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Suˉmonˍ, Iˉsaˍhkaˍ leh Zeˍbuˆlonˍ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gaˆ, Aˍshaˍ, leh Naˍtaˍliˆ teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ ko taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ awˇ hpawˇ ve lehˬ, awˇ hinˉ loˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸, Gʼuiˬsha choˬ kaˬ chehˇ ve, teh‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Yawˇyaˍkenˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ tcuh leh, Yawˇyaˍkenˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ peuˬhkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw cawˬve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, hpeh‸ yuˬtaˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, yuˬveu laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇshiˍ veu laˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ nehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkiˇ awˬ na da‸ leh cuˇ yiˍ gehˬ ve chaw, chehˇ sha puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui ve li‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hkʼe shawˍ leh, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ te caˍ te taw piˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ tuˬ ka‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yaˇ nehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, Daˍyeˍ laˆ, Haˍnaˍniˆ, Miˆsheˍlaˆ leh Aˍzaˍriˆ hui htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
A ma‸ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ teh‸ awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ te gaˇ ve pa taw, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw shu caˍ laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ caˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ caˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ ve nyi ma hta‸ gu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Aˬ muiˬ nawˬ hui awˬ nu ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe taw awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, jawˇmawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ leuˆ teh taˍ ve shaw shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ lawˇ nyi-o. Gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh leh iˉ kaˆ ceh tiˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ve caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve chaw hui leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ tehˆ da‸ nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ lawˇ nyi tuˬ, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ chi nyi biˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ chehˇ sha leh awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ cawˬ ve hta‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh ceh tiˉ caˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yaˇ paˍ chi ve awˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh, da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸Yawˇ lehˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ htawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ tiˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ shehˆ hkʼaw‸ biˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Aˍshaˆpeˍnaˆ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ oˇve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ geh shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ, Haˍnaˍniˆ, Miˆsheˍlaˆ leh Aˍzaˍriˆ hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cheuˬ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kanˉ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ hkʼa na nyi ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve mawˉ paˍ leh faˍ te puiˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ teˇ chi pun shiˍ leh yaw hkʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Kuˇruˆ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa maˇ gʼa.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gaˬ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ maw leh, a ciˉ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ sha. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ leunˇ kʼai peuˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ co zuh ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui Aˍraˍmiˆ hkawˇ yaw leh jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ leh, tcuhˉ kuiˬ ka‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te laˇ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ tcuhˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ cheˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve leh, tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ kʼoˆ laˇ htaˇ heh‸ ngaˬ hui tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Naw hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve kʼo,

ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ te peuˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Laˬtuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chi hkʼe oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ heh‸, nawˬ hui zuh‸ maˆ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ puiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ shiˍ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ hto laˇ gʼa ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ ve te gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve mawˉpaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ na nyi jaw.

Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ na nyi laˇ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ gʼuiˬsha maˇ heˆ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, chaw yaˇ hui geh maˇ chehˇ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve mawˉ paˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, Daˍyeˍlaˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ a sha‸ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍroˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, mawˉ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ Aˍroˆ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍyeˍlaˆ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw jawˇmawˇ mawˉ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve awˬ lawn na nyi ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ Aˍroˆ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ teˇ cawˬ haˉ jawˇmawˇ geh kʼai leh, zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ geh a hkaw-anˬ ca lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ Haˍnaˍniˆ, Miˆsheˍlaˆ, leh Aˍzaˍriˆ hui geh kʼai leh, hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ nu ve mawˉ paˍ hui geh teˇ geh tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ Yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve teˇ haˉ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh kʼoˆ ve,
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˍ. Yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tcuhˉ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ taˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Faˉ taˍ ve leh, naˉ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸Yawˇ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo faˉ taˍ ve mawˇ hta‸ Yawˇ mawˬ chehˇ leh, Yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ puˍ ngaˬ pi hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan leh chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve Aˍroˆ geh kʼai leh, Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ ve zuh‸ maˆ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh shiˍ kʼai laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍroˆ yawˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ cawˬ haˉ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ca mawˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍyeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, mawˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆmaˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, laˬ tuˬve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hkʼa peu-eˬve hta‸ shiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chaw awˬ han lonˉ teˇ maˬ huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ leh, kawˆ law‸ law‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ lehˬ shi hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma pui leh la‸ sheh teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi leh pfuhˬ tehˉ kʼu lehˬ kuiˇ hpeh‸ leh,
yawˇ ve hkui sheh lehˬ, sho teˇ tawn leh je‸ teˇ tawn hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ chaw awˬ han lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi chehˇ htaˇ, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui shiˍ teˇmaˬ pu ya‸ la leh, chaw awˬ han lonˉ oˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ pu teˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hkui sheh hteh leh chaw awˬ han lonˉ oˇ ve paiˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, sho, je‸, kuiˇ, hpu leh shi oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ leh, oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ meuˆ baˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ la leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hto laˇ shaˍ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ aw nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ shi oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼe taw maˇ uiˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kuiˇ hkʼe ve mvuhˇmiˬ shehˆ peˆ teˇ peˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, sho hkʼe heh ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˇ peˆ teˇ peˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬyoˬ. Sho lehˬ awˬ nu ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, mvuh ˇ miˬ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw awˬ han lonˉ oˇ ve hkui sheh leh hkui naw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, sho teˇ tawn leh je‸ teˇ tawn te taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi ve lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ pehˬ da‸ kʼai ve hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ sho hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ je‸ hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkui naw teˇ hpaˍ sho teˇ tawn leh je‸ teˇ tawn hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ sho hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ je‸ hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkui sheh oˇ ve sho teˇ tawn leh je‸ teˇ tawn hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ leh teˇ ceuˬ heuˆ da‸ tcuh leh, nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, sho leh je‸ hkaw‸ da‸ maˇ gʼa ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, mvuhˇ nawˬ ma Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ teˇ peˆ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ chi ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ pu ce la leh, shi, hpu, kuiˇ leh je‸ yuˬ te taˍ ve chaw awˬ han lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ce teˍ piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, jawˇmawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ hto laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ sheˬ leh, Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼe ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve pa taw, nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chi hkʼe ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve aˉ yaˇ piˇ leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve la‸ shawnˍ maˇ maˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Baˍ buˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ paˍ awˬ hoˉ lonˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.

Daˍyeˍlaˆ lawˬ ve hkʼe, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍ goˍ hui hta‸ htawˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw lo tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpawˇ hkaw‸ chi shaw‸, kehˬ hpawˇ hkaw‸ shaw‸ cawˬ ve shi shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ teˇ maˬ te leh, Baˍbuˍloˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Duˇraˆ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ, mawˇ jeˬ ha‸ shaˉ paˍ, suhˉ jehˬ paˍ, leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo kuˬ hpawnˬ leh shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ a‸ ve pawehˇ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ kaˬ lo hpawnˬ gaˬ la htaˇ,
jawˇmawˇ ve tawˇ yaw paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, tinˍ hteˆ, lehˉ lu meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ chi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ chi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui ve chaw lehˬ, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, behˬ heh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, awˬ yanˇ chi hta‸ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ lonˉ geh kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ kaˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ chi hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve chaw hta‸ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ tuˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ te tcuh taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ hui lehˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ te. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ geh lo shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gaˬ la htaˇ, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍ goˍ nawˬ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ ngaˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ laˇ.

Behˬ heh ma meuˆ hkawˇ kaˇ kʼo, nawˬ hui shaˉ ho‸ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve chaw hta‸, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui dawˇ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to gʼa ponˬ tuˬ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ maˇ gʼa ve ka‸, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍ goˍ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh mehˆ hpfuhˇ nyiˉ-ehˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ te jaw ve aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh a‸ kehˉ suhˍ pun chiˆ jaˇ ve aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh lonˉ teˇ maˬ te tcuh ve yoˬ
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˬ miˍ bui hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu tcuh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh oˇ ve hta‸ chiˆ jaˇ tuˬ te tcuh taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw ca baˬ keu tcuh ve ma‸ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ miˍ chiˆ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ lehˬ, shu hpeh‸ tsuh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ anˇ jaˇ ve hkʼaw pawˆ tu la leh, Ngaˬ hui chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ hpeh tsuh‸ leh aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw baˬ keu ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw lo chaw awˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh ka‸ cheˆ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui teˇ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ law. Awˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh paˇ lo kʼai leh, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, Aˍbeˍdaˍ neˍgoˍ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, tawˆ la-o, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui teˇ cawˬ haˉ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-e, yawˇ hui shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca hpoˆ nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh maˇ hkeu‸ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ htawˇ aˬ miˍ maˇ to‸. Aˬ miˍ shaˉ ka‸ maˇ nuˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ peu laˇ leh, ca htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve a‸ kehˉ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hkanˍ suh ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ, Aˍ beˍdaˍneˍgoˍ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tcuhˉ tawˆ cheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ puiˉ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Shaˆdraˆ, Meˍshehˆ leh Aˍbeˍdaˍneˍgoˍ hui hta‸ Baˍbuˍ lonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw uiˍ jaˇ ve aˉ yaˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ feu ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Yawˇ te taˍ ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve hkʼaw hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ leh, zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gaˬ la htaˇ, zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ maˇ gʼa.
Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mawˉ paˍ lonˉ Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˬ-oˬ, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hto maˍ laˇ gʼa ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ a ciˉ hto maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ awˬ kʼaw ji teˇ hkʼaˇ lo suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ teˇ cehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ mvuh la leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ sheˬve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ nyi sha jaˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ law‸ ve awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpui te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ laiˉ ceuˬ iˉ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh tawˇ yaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ htu baˬ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ-oˆ. Awˬ hpa‸ leh awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ jaw‸ ce piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, suhˆ muiˉ daw hta‸ sho caˆ leh kuiˇ caˆ yuˬ hpeh taˍ-o‸. Chaw chi hpaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ciˍ gʼuiˬ ce la piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ to nuˇ to shaˆ hui geh chehˇ tcuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa ga, yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. To nuˇ to shaˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. I jaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˍ-oˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ a ciˉ hto maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇmaˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ hto laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍ laˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ meh awˬ suhˉ Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˍ-oˬ, zuh‸ maˇ oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ taˇ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˍ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve nawˬ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ leh, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh caˉ da‸ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law ve yoˬ.
Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ hpa‸ teˇ hpaˍ nyi sha jaˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ caˍ piˇ gʼa law‸ law‸ ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Haiˬve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpui te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuh jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ daw‸ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ la leh, Suhˆ cehˬ lonˉ chi hta‸ htu baˬ-o‸. Suhˆ muiˉ daw hta‸ sho caˆ leh kuiˇ caˆ yuˬ hpeh leh baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Chaw chi hpaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ciˍ gʼuiˬ ce la piˇ leh, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ yawˇ hta‸ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ taˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui geh gʼa tawˆ kʼai leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nuˇ hkʼe zuhˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa zuh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ciˍ gʼuiˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ce la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉpeunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆcawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸Yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸Yawˇ piˇ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, suhˆ muiˉ daw oˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te-o. Venˇbaˆ taˇ kʼaw‸ te. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼa kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ chi nyiˇ ha pa ponˬ kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ,
Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, venˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuh naw ma hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la leh, Jawˇmawˇ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ ve kanˇ pa hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hui geh gʼa tawˆ kʼai leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ te hpaˍ geh gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ, nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh‸ hta‸ tiˉ nawˬ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸Yawˇ piˇ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ la‸ haˉ biˇ la ve yoˬ. Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma mehˉ kʼai leh, nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Ciˍ gʼuiˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ce la leh, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ aˉ ceˬ awˬ mvuh hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkui shiˍ kʼuˉ la‸ shiˍ kʼuˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkui shiˍ kʼuˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ ponˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, Yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ leh, Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Ngaˬ chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇ naw ma ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh leh, Yawˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ haˉ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ htaˇ, Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ paˍ Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw yuˬ veu laˇ ve hpu kawˆ shi kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kawˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ gaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, kawˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kawˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ leh,
hpu, shi, kuiˇ, sho, suhˆ leh haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ tawˆ la leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa deh‸ ba da‸ jaˇ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo li‸ bvuh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, li‸ bvuh‸ chehˇ ve la‸ sheh oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ lehˬ chaw suh hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw gʼa leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸, da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ shi caˆ teˇ maˬ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo jiˆ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ li‸ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw maˇ gʼa.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ shaˬ te shaˬ kawˆ jaˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ te hpaˍ htawˇ, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te piˇ tuˬ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ, bawehˇ lonˉ hkʼaw duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, ca lo‸ nyi ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chi taw taw taˇ kawˆ.

Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ pa jawˇmawˇ lonˉ te chehˇ htaˇ, anˇ law‸ law‸ ve cuˇ yiˍ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ mawˉ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ hoˉ lonˉ te tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ leh, zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ ka‸ yuˬ tawˆ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Daˍyeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ca kuˬ tcuh-o. Nawˬ pa yawˇ hta‸ Beˍlaˍtaˍshaˍzaˍ teh‸ awˬ meh awˬsuhˉ kʼaw‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Li‸ mehˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ haˆ haˆ ca kuˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ pa Yuˇ da‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ veu laˇ taˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw Daˍyeˍlaˆ yoˬ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ geh chehˇ leh, nawˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, liˆ mehˆ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaw tcuh ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼaw maˇ gʼa.

Nawˬ lehˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ laˇ leh, nawˬ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ shi caˆ pfuhˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ mehˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼaw maˍ laˇ leh, tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ pa Neˍbuˍhkaˍneˍzaˍ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe ve jawˇmawˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve kʼo tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ taˍ uiˍ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ taˍ uiˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ te luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma uiˍ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ la leh, nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh‸ hta‸ caˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ciˬ gʼuiˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ce la ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ piˇ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve htawˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve maˇ cawˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ veu laˇ taˍ ve kawˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu dawˬ leh maˇ mawˬ puiˉ, maˇ kaˇ puiˉ, leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve, hpu, shi, kuiˇ, suhˆ, leh haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, suh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ te laˇ gʼa ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ maˇ taˍ uiˍ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ la‸ sheh oˇ ve hta‸ peu laˇ leh, li‸ mehˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bvuh‸ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ oˇ ve chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Meˍneˍ, meˍneˍ, teˍkeˍlaˆ uˆpaˍsenˍ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Meˍneˍ kʼoˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, Gʼaw nyi taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi taˍ peuˬ leh, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Teˍkeˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, Tsuh nyi taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ tsuh tu hkʼaw keu tsuh nyi leh, lawˬ jaˇ ve hta‸Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Uˆpaˍsenˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Pehˬ da‸ piˇ ve, teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇ miˬ hta‸ pehˬ leh, Meˍdiˆ chaw leh Paˇshaˇ chaw hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ lehˬ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve veuˬ kʼaˇ feuˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ shi caˆ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ, Baˍbuˍlonˍ jawˇmawˇ Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, a sha‸ hkaw‸ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ ve Meˍdiˆ chaw Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo kanˉ te tuˬ a ma‸ lonˉ 120 gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ lehˬ a ma‸ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te kʼai tuˬ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ leh awˬ nu ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh kanˉ te puiˉ jaˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ jawˇmawˇ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ nu ve a ma‸ lonˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ te ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ca maˇ mawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ te ve pa taw yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ te ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ ca maˇ mawˬ. Yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ-oˬ, nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui a ma‸ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ, leh nawˬ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ ve chaw hta‸ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkawˆ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Meˍdiˆ leh Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve tawˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa maˇ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ ve yinˉ hkʼa deh‸ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ tawˇ oˇ hkʼe piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve yehˬ awˬ na teˇ bawehˇ hkʼaw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hpawˇ lo hpaw taˍ ve yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi le le te jaw ve hkʼe, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo kʼai leh teˇ nyi shehˆ pawˆ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Daˍyeˍlaˆ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ,

yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, shehˆ chi nyi hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca lawˬ hkawˉ ve chaw hta‸, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkawˆ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ tuˬ nawˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Meˍdiˆ leh Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ liˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa maˇ gʼa, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ nyi shehˆ pawˆ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ cawˇ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ lo‸ la leh, Meˍdiˆ leh Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
