Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkawˆ hkʼaw baˬ keu piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ piˇ maˇ gʼa tuˬ, miˬ kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo haˉ pui shiˍ lonˉ teˇ maˬ hpfuhˆ tsuhˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ ve yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ hawˉ yehˬ lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ haˉ jawˇmawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ leh, zuh‸ muiˉ ka‸ kʼa maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ na‸ tu leh laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkawˆ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw lo htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ gʼa-aw laˇ, teh‸ kuˬ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Daˍyeˍlaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ nawˬ co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa che‸ caˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ hoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ te ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸Yawˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe te laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh, Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ piˇ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve miˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkawˆ hkʼaw baˬ keu tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui miˬ chaˇ lo maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ hpe lo ceh yawˇ hui hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh ha lehˬ dawˇ sha tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, Daˍyeˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˆ yan tuˬ ngaˬ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ lehˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo, yawˇ anˇ tuˬ te puiˉ ve yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ Daˍyeˍlaˆ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ li‸ bvuh‸ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ, Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ leh, Paˇshaˇ chaw Kuˇruˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, aˉ yaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ gʼa mawˬve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve chi hkʼe yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, uiˍ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ awˇ hkeh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ hkeh leh teˇ hkeh maˇ shuˍ da‸.

Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ hkeh lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ naw‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cheˆ ce sheˍ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve tu la leh, chaw hkʼa shuˍ huˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ nyiˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hta‸ shuˍ leh tu huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw nyi kuˇ shehˆ maˬ geu‸ chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la leh, Nawˬ caˇ gʼa ve hkʼe caˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hkeh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, laˇ ku-i hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve caw‸ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˆ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, oˉ kʼoˍ 4 shiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ gʼa taˍ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, to nuˇ to shaˆ awˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ leh kawˆ law‸ law‸ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve sho ciˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, naˆ nehˆ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkaw teˇ chi maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo, awˬ hkaw ehˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, aw nu ve awˬ hkaw shehˆ maˬ hta‸ te hteh piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ cawˬ leh, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kʼaw jaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Kʼaw jaw teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ lehˬ vaˇ meu-e hkʼe hpu leh, yawˇ ve uˉ hkeh mvuh lehˬ yawˬ mvuh hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kaw jaw oˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ha yuˬ te taˍ ve gaˉ yaw hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ leh, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa biˇ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Kʼaw jaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ aˬ miˍ ha teˇ dawˇ lonˉ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ leh, li‸ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ hpeu‸ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hkaw ehˉ oˇ ve tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸, ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, to nuˇ to shaˆ awˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh cawˬ taˍ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ te‸ chehˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ moˬ hkʼa caw zuhˇ hoˆ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve aw shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼai leh, yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ leh yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kawˆ jaˇ leh nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh kʼai leh, ngaˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ kuiˬ a ciˉ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Uiˍ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ chi ve awˇ hkeh lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ la tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ awˇ peˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ peun da‸ jaˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ awˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh awˬ lawn hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, kuiˇ hkui shiˍ kʼuˉ, sho ciˬ cawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ hkaw teˇ chi maˬ awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh, awˬ hkaw shehˆ maˬ hta‸ te hteh piˇ ve awˬ hkaw ehˉ oˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ shiˍ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw ehˉ oˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ, maw‸ kʼaw cawˬ leh, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ nu ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ awˬ hkaw ehˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ leh, gʼaˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hui hpawˇ lo chehˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kanˇ paˆ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve awˇ hkeh teˇ hkeh lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ awˇ peˆ teˇ peˆ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ peun da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te lu te sheˆ leh, naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ chi maˬ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peun da‸ jaˇ leh, jawˇmawˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo shehˆ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ suhˉjehˬ leh, te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ ve kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve kanˇ paˆ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh, chaw suh hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ hto piˇ.
Beˍlaˍshaˍzaˍ jawˇmawˇ te ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ Eˇlanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Suˇsanˍ venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Uˆlehˇ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo yawˬ paˍ lonˉ teˇ hkeh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkaw nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ leh, awˬ hkaw teˇ maˬ lehˬ awˬ nu ve teˇ maˬ a‸ kehˉ zuhˬ leh awˬ suhˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˬ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ guˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ ca pawˆ guˆ chehˇ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸, yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˬ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve oˇ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo aˉ che‸ teˇ hkeh gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, mehˆ shiˍ nyiˇ paˉ awˬ kaˍ lo, awˬ hkaw teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ laˬ leh, yawˬpaˍ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ guˆ hpehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˬ paˍ lonˉ ve awˬ hkaw nyiˇ paˉ paˉ hteh sheˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˬ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, aˉ che‸ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ leh, aˉ che‸ taˆ naˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ caw.

Aˉ che‸ oˇ ve shaˬ te shaˬ nyi ma uiˍ la leh, caˆ muiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkaw kʼehˆ ce sheˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ hkaw awˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ maˬ teˇ hpawˇ lo mawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, awˬ hkaw ehˉ teˇ maˬ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ uiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ shaˬ te shaˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la leh, mvuhˇ naw ma ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, bawˆ yuˬ gʼa law‸ law‸ ve awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼawˬ ce leh naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma ma‸ moˍ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ, cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo venˇbaˆ te leh, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ chi hta‸ yawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ baˬ leh, yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hkʼaw lo gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ maw maw chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬsheˍ ve le. Hkʼaˬ maw maw chaw yaˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le. Mvuhˇ naw ma ve ma‸ moˍ leh, bon yehˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ maw maw shu naˆ toˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ na nyi chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, 1,150 nyi hkʼa gaˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi chi ve maˇ peuˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, shu Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ ha hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇnyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gaˍbeˍlaˆ-oˬ, yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Uˆlehˇ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo bvuhˬ tawˆ la ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gaˍbeˍlaˆ ngaˬ geh laˬve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ-oˬ chi hta‸ shiˍ-o‸. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ chi lehˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ heh‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˍ tu laˇ leh chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ chi lehˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ heh‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkaw nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yawˬ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Meˍdiˆ leh Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ che‸ paˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Mehˆ shiˍ nyiˇ paˉ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve awˬ hkaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve hteh kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve awˬ hkaw oˇ ve awˇ maˬ lehˬ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˇ tawn pehˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ ehˉ chi ve awˇ peˆ lehˬ, ponˬ la htaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼe taw awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hai ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, hai ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ haˉ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ tu yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ nyi le le mvuhˇ shawˉ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ la‸ haˉ maˇ hpeh‸ la taˬ sheˍ ve pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ taˇ hto piˇ sheˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ leh awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh naˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ tu la leh hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ te kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ jaˇ leh dawˇ maˇ tawˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Meˍdiˆ chaw jaw mawˇ Aˍshaˍruˆ ve yaˇ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tanˬ uˉ peunˍ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve li‸ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha Yeˍraˍmiˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ 70 hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw mui taˍ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ ngaˬ Yawˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh, bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te tcuh laˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ te leh, nawˬ beˆ maˍ laˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, awˬ puˍ awˬ pi leh ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw nawˬ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ hkʼe tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ, leh awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ nawˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui maˇ na yuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ leuˉ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ la gaˬ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ daw hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ sheˍ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ gu taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ Nawˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ nyi ma taˇ kʼaw‸ zuhˆ-oˆ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ ve venˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw pui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ gu te-o.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hkʼaw te taˍ ve venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ a ciˉ nyi laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha‸oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ te la-oˆ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lawˬ ve hkʼe a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ chi lehˬ nawˬ ve venˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Daˍyeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ leh bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ gu te laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ awˬ ha hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ jaw ve Gaˍbeˍlaˆ ngaˬ geh lo poˬ ya‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve aw yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ya‸ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ shaˍ. Hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸.

Suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ suhˍ chi pawˆ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw leh nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ venˇbaˆ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve biˇ la leh, da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa piˇ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceu‸ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ tawˇ piˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, suhˍ yanˇ suhˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ yanˇ chi ponˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ leh lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkaw‸ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve leh bon yehˬ lonˉ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ gu taˍ ve luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸, iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve hkʼe awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, suhˍ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ hkoˇ peuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ bon yehˬ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

(Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Kuˇruˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve shehˆ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ, Daˍyeˍlaˆ lehˬ awˬ ha hkʼaw zuh‸ maˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve zuh‸ maˆ oˇ ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve htawˇ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ na gʼa tuˬ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo, tcuhˉ kuiˬ oˇ ve yawˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ lehˬ shehˆ shinˉ hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ shaˍ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu da‸ jaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ caˇ. Shehˆ shinˉ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ ka‸ maˇ puiˍ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ ha pa nyiˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Tiˉgeˍriˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lonˉ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh leh, shi haˍ pi caˆ tsuh‸ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ to lehˬ, shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼe awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkui sheh lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ shiˆ taˍ ve kuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, yawˇ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, chaw moˍ lonˉ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ awˬ ha oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, awˬ ha oˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh ca va‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ huˉ chehˇ taˍ leh, awˬ ha oˇ ve hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai leh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tawnˇ gʼa tuˬ maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo boˆ sheˬ leh, maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ ngaˬ hta‸ ca htawˇ la leh, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ tu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Tu huˉ leh ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ geh peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ tu la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ te leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ choˬ ka‸ lo gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve nyiˇ chi teˇ nyi gaˬ peuˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh yaˇ uiˍ Miˆhkeˍlaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ca ga la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˉ taˉ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ca kʼoˆ maˍ la ve yoˬ. Nawˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha chi lehˬ, laˬtuˬ ve aw yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve awˬ ha yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo nyi tcuhˉ taˍ leh, tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve la‸ sheh che leh, ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ hta‸ htawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve aw ha oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ te laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ cheˇ cheˇ veˆ veˆ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tu huˉ chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tawˇ yaw da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ nuˇ jaˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇhtaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ taˇ kawˆ, taˇ dawˇ haˍ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ gaˇ ve hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ nawˬ geh laˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aˬ laˇ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ nga gaˬ la taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Heˍ laˍ saˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve Miˆhkeˍlaˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kanˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ve jawˇmawˇ awˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ paw sha jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ paw sha leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ kʼehˬ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ teˇ peˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˇ tawn pehˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe taw, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ hta‸ gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ yanˇ maw la ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve co co yeˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ hpawˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ leh yawˇ geh kʼai taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ leh, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw gaˬ kʼo, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ moˍ shawˍ leh ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ gu tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve hkʼa shuˍ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ ca lo‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpeh gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, canˇ paˍ chi ma ma ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve pa taw, nyi ma uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, ma‸ moˍ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ shiˍ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, chaw maˇ maˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, nyi ma uiˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ ha hkʼaw gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw nyi ma uiˍ la leh, jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ leh bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Cheuˬ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw huˉ taˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ ma‸ moˍ hkʼa deh‸ shawˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ canˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aw nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ shonˇ kʼai leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ taˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ paw sha la tuˬ, ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui geh awˬ hkawnˍ ca nyiˉ shaw tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ shu a yehˉ gawˬ lehˍ hkʼawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ taˆ la ve Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, haiˬ jaˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ te keunˍ ve chaw maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ te leh, jawˇmawˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸. Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ nu ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ i jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ shaˬ te shaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ paw sha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ te jaw ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw yawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ leh kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ ma‸ moˍ shawˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ htawˇ, ma‸ moˍ shawˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ shu heˍ piˇ ve hkawˇ na leh shonˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ suh-e leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ geh mui leh hti caˇ hti dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ bawˆ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ veu leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw yawˇ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ.

Roˇma‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ oˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve chaw hui dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ na tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬbaˬ leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ oˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shu aˬ miˍ tuˉ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shu hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw, fawˉ mehˍ ve a ciˉ hkehnˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca ga piˇ la ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui geh hkʼawˇ lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ti ˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chi hkʼe hpehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw leh, Kanˇ paˆ uiˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha a‸ kehˉ ngaˬ uiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha leh yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha‸ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼuiˬsha oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui jaw ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ lehˬ hpu, shi, shehnˉ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ uˉ peunˍ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve aˉ yaˇ leh miˬguiˬ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ Oˇ htaˇ, Suˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ tuˬyoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ ve hkʼe, mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ ve hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ bawˆ yuˬ leh, chaw awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇdonˍ, Mawˇbaˆ leh Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ka‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, faˉ taˍ ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Liˆbiˇ-a mvuhˇmiˬ leh Suˍdanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ htawˇ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh awˬ na hpawˇ lo laˬve awˬ lawn sha tanˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa kaˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ leh chaw yaˇ laiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ leh bon yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui awˬ kaˍ lo yawˇ ve aˉ po kʼo lonˉ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ gʼa suh-e tu ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ jaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve tcuh yaˇ uiˍ Miˆhkeˍlaˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw ve kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve li‸ daw hkʼaw hkʼa bvuh‸ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh taˍ peuˬ ve chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ ve a sha‸ hta‸ gʼa leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼe awˬ gʼeuˆ ba da‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ geuˆ ba chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ve li‸ daw hta‸ hoˆ taˍ leh yinˉ hkʼa deh‸ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na gʼa tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ choˬ paˉ oˇ paˉ huˉ chehˇ ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Anˇ law‸ law‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ peuˬ kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo huˉ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ paˉ mvuhˇ naw ma lo che peu leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hkʼaw ka ti‸ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Shehˆ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ hkʼa gaˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ peuˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ na maˇ gʼa. Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te peuˬ kʼai tuˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ chi beu‸ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ te leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, 1,290 nyi maw tuˬ yoˬ.
1,335 nyi peuˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍyeˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ ka‸ awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ htawˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ tuˬ nawˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, Awˇziˆ, Yawˇtanˍ, Aˍhaˆ leh Heˍsaˍkiˆ jawˇmawˇ te leh, Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Beˍriˆ ve yaˇ Hawˇseˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hawˇseˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ teˇ pawˆ Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ loˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma lehˬ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˬ miˇ ma hkʼa shuˍ, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hawˉseˍ lehˬ Diˆnaˍlenˍ ve yaˇ miˇ Gawˇmaˍ hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve yaˇ hu la leh, yawˇ awˬ pon yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ meh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍhuˆ lehˬ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, maˇ maw maw ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍhuˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Hawˇseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gawˇmaˍ lehˬ yaˇ miˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ Lawˇruˆhaˍmaˍ teh‸ meh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, aˉhtaw, hkaˆ, hkaˆ ce, iˉ mvuhˇ leh iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Hawˇseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gawˇmaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ cuˉ hpaˆ piˇ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hu la leh, yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ paw la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ hta‸ Lawˇaˍmiˆ teh‸ meh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Hawˇseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ teˇnyi gaˬ kʼo, Nawˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍzaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw leh Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve chaw teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ e hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ miˇ ma maˇ kʼaw‸ heˆ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ heˆ-o ve htawˇ, yawˇ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te leh, meh maˬ lanˉ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ-oˆ.

Yawˇ venˇbaˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ paw la htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ goˇ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ leh suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ ve meh maˬ lanˉ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui geh ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, veu‸ tuˬ kʼaˇ tuˬ, naˍ manˇ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ngaˬ aˉ chuˇ ti keu piˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ tawˆ-e maˇ gaˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ lo ngaˬ gʼo‸ pa ko piˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hui geh yawˇ kʼai gaˬ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ tawˆ-e gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ca nyi ve htawˇ, mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hpawˇ geh kʼo‸-e shaˍ. Yawˇ geh gʼa chehˇ ve lehˬ, choˬ kaˬ gʼa chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh naˍ manˇ piˇ chehˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ. Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hpu, shi, mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh veu‸ tuˬ kʼaˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ, teˇ ha pa teˇ pawˆ, teˇ shinˉ teˇ pawˆ yawˇ te chehˇ ve pawehˇ leh, yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon yawˇ kanˉ te piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ hpaˍ leh, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko leh iˉ shiˍ hko teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hko oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ baˬ taˉ leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tanˇ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun tcuhˉ veu leh yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hkʼaˇ suh gʼuiˇ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve tawˇ yaw piˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, Aˍhkawˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hta‸ dawˇ law kuiˬ yehˬ miˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ htaˇ, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa ya‸ tuˬ ngaˬ to nuˇ to shaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ ngaˬ ve hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ Yeˍsaˍreˍlaˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ mvuhˇ yeˬ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ leh shaˍlonˍ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ ha‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Ngaˬ ve chaw maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Shu hta‸ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ ca kʼaw‸ heuˆ loˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ awˬ goˇ ca tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ htawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa ha‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ hpu teˇ chi ngaˇ hteh‸ leh caˬ shiˍ suhˍ hkʼawˍ lawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ lehˬ meh maˬlanˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ heˆ-o, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ngaˬ geh gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh yawˇ ngaˬ geh maˇ ca zuh‸ la.

Chi ve hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ maw chaweh jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw maˇ cawˬ leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ gʼa ve shaˉ ho‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha leh yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ Daˍviˆ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh, yawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬyoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ka ti‸ yeˬ ve leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui maˇ shawˍ taˍ.

Yawˇ hui ka ti‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ heˍ puiˉ ve chaw, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw, shu mawˇ hkʼawˇ ve chaw, leh haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ maˇ la leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. To nuˇ to shaˆ, ngaˆ, leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ. Ngaˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ gaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw mvuhˇ hpeu‸ nawˬ hui te ya‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉda‸ leuˉ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ e hpeh‸ ve Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui leh nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ paw hkuˇ kʼaw‸ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ shaˬ maˇ ve kʼo shaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬbaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te ve pa taw, nawˬ hui paw sha la ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui leuˉ leh venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui caˇ keunˍ caˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, gʼa meu‸ jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui yaˇ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ kʼai ve pa taw yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ te luˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, suhˆ yuˬ te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ geh hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˬ na chehˇ ve yoˬ. Suhˆ taˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui shiˍ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo, yawˇ hui tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, uiˍ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo yawˇ hui sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, suhˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˉ gʼuiˬ ha baˬ jaˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui htawˇ bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ. Dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ chaw mawˇ hkawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, Yuˇ da‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ haiˬ ve chaw taˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Giˇlaˍgaˍ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Beˍteˍlaˆ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ taˇ ca pui loˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh ka ti‸ taˇ ca te-o.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ta iˉ maˇ chehˇ puiˉ ve nuˇ ma haˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ lo yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te caˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, tzuhˬbvuhˆ paˍ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ meuˆ kʼoˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hta‸ na sheˍ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ na taˍ-o‸. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve pa taw, suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Miˆsaˍpaˍ hkʼaw leh, Taˍbawˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo htaw taˍ ve va hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Aˍhkeˇshaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo naˉ chaweh duˇ taˍ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ca va‸ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui maˇ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ la maˇ gaˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ caˆ muiˍ puiˉ jaˇ leh, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve venˇbaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui htawˇ yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh paiˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nuˇ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ loˬ. Raˍmaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ loˬ. Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ kuˬ chehˇ taˍ loˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw hui-oˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai loˬ.
Ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chiˉ ga laˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va ve pa taw, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma naˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, Yuˇda‸ htawˇ yawˇ ve naˬ kuiˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ca peun tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve naˬ kuiˬ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ che‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˬ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui te ya‸ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ baˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Tu‸ hkanˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ca la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gu na-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ peh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyiˇ shehˆ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ coˇ caˇ-a veuˬ. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ nehˆ la piˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ leh Yuˇda‸-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te laˇ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ leh, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ ve moˬ hkʼa shuˍ teˇ hkui tiˉ mehˉ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh kʼai peu leh, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ lawn leh luˬve sheˆ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ ca kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˉ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.
Giˇlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve chaw leh, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu hta‸ hkʼawˇ dawˆ tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo law taˍ ve chaw hkʼawˇ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Sheˍhkenˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo htawˇ, yawˇ hui shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-o‸, nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ da‸ la uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nyi peu ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ pawˆ le le haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ heˍ caˇ da‸ leh, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ lu yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui te chehˇ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ. Chi beu‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, venˇbaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ mawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ hkʼawˇ jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ canˇ ve nyi ma lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ ciˇ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, aˬ miˍ maˇ gu ceh piˇ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ du du te to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ pawehˇ te ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ bvuhˆ gʼuˇ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ haˉ le le yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ la maˇ la chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve oˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼa deh‸ maˇ meh da‸ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ nuˇ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ maˇ jawˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaw nyi taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ chi hta‸ htawˇ maˇ shiˍ maˇ jawˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui caˆ muiˬ puiˉ jaˇ leh, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma oˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kaw‸ la.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˆ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ choˬ kʼai oˇ kʼai tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬEˇjiˇtu‸ chaw leh Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ va htaw yuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaw yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ hkʼaˇ ya‸ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ geh bon maˇ lawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ buiˇ shaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa shuˍ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo paˍ zuh‸ taˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw hpfuhˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, te‸ chiˉ kanˇ paˆ maˇ cawˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. Kʼaw‸ ve hkaˆ ce hta‸ yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ yonˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw ve pa taw, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Behˬheh ma meuˆ loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ aˉ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ ya‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬleh, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ,
yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui jawˇmawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍmaˍriˆ chaw hui shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ te leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ maw maw shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw la‸shaˉmaˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ve maˇ heˆ. Saˍmaˍriˆ chaw hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, dawˆ meu-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬyoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hta‸ ti ve kʼo, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hta‸ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ meh la puiˉ ve caˬ lehˬ, awˍ hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ meh la ve htawˇ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, caˬ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˇ peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ leh, hkoˇ kʼai peuˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu hkʼa shuˍ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, kʼaˍ jaˇ ve piˉ laˬ awˬ hteunˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui kʼai gaˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va chehˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaw hpoˆ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ maw maw Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te kuiˬ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ maˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui awˬ pon gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ bvuh‸ piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh, shaˍ caˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve maˇ heˆ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh yawˇ hui ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui pawehˇ taˇ te chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo, nawˬ hui lehˬ meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ maw maw nawˬ hui lehˬ caˬ shiˍ, shaˍlonˍ chu leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa law‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ hkʼa caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw suh taˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve caˇ tuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui meu‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh piˇ ve hkʼe ceh hpeh‸ leh, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo gʼa yuˬ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve pawehˇ te tuˬ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ ve le.

Kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ gaˬ la leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˆ hpoˆ leh Mehˇhpiˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ duˇ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ leh yehˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo mvuh‸ leh aˉ chuˇ buiˇ hkʼa biˇ yeˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ chi lehˬ chaw gʼuˇ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh cuˇ yiˍ gʼa taˍ ve chaw chi lehˬ nyi ma maˇ biˇ ve chaw yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le hkʼaw, ngaˆ ehˉ hta‸ va htaw ve hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ va caw htaw laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tcuh kaˍ paˍ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Giˇbaˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ hkʼe, yawˇ hui dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ca mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo naw‸ chehˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ naw‸ la taˍ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Peˍawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ hui ha‸ve gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ poˬ hpaw-e leh, yawˇ hui geh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ paw la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yaˇ hu tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui yaˇ cawˬ la ve htawˇ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shu gʼa‸ yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw meh ma hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ maˇ gʼa tuˬ te piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui lehˬ Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw venˇbaˆ tanˬ te ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai peuˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ geu goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve pa taw, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la maˇ gʼa ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ cawˬ la ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ha‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa hpaw toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ chehˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve chaw leuˉ leh maˇ la ve kʼo, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leuˉ leh gʼa maˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui kuiˬ da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw kʼo chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ kawˆ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ tawˇ maˇ shaˉ maˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve ka ti‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh la leh, ti mi hkʼaw yeˬ chehˇ ve awˬ taw‸ ma cawˬ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shi nuˇ shaˉ ho‸ luˬ kʼai ve pa taw paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ oˍ taˍ ve shi hta‸ shu dawˆ paˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve hta‸ shu Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hta‸ ca tanˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, shu maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai leh gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ awˬ fuˇ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mvuh‸ leh aˉ chuˇ buiˇ yeˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ faˉ taˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ laˇ-oˆ, teh‸ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw lehˬ Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ tanˬ te ve teˇ nyi hta‸ te leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Giˇbaˍ venˇ hkʼaw ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ leh te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga hpoˆ bawˆ leh yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve pa taw gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˬ naˆ tuˬ awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ caw taˍ ve nuˇ ma haˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ehˉ kʼaweh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ leh haˍ jaˇ hkeu‸ jaˇ ve kanˉ te tcuh tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ti mi mehˇ tuˬ gʼawˬ tcuh leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ti mi kaˆ tuˬ gʼawˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ pon miˬguiˬ awˬ suhˉ hta‸ mehˇ-oˆ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ gʼeu‸ yuˬ-o‸. Chi beu‸ nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hai ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ sheˍ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ gʼeu‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui heˍ leh gʼa taˍ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve pa taw,

nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ma‸ lonˉ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, Beˍtaˍbeˍlaˆ venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ yaˇ nehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Beˍteˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, awˬceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ tanˬ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ nyi htaˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hkʼe shaˬ shawˍ taˍ kʼo, shaˬ yawˇ ngaˬ geh hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Baˍlaˆgʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ puiˉ la tuˬ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ taˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ.
Ha‸ pehnˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼawˆ yuˬ leh ngaˬ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve pa taw, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ hui gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬyoˬ. Aˍsuˉriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw ma‸ hpeh‸ la leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui pfuhˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hawˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chiˇ baˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te baˬ taˉ hpeh‸ tuˬve le. Aˍdaˍmaˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Zeˍbonˍ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ te piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ ve nyi ma lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te tcuh laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ho piˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ geh gʼuiˇ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve aˉ pui kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ geh haˆ haˆ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve yehˬ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ shiˍ kʼo‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heˍ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ paˇ lo hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yuˇ da‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, luˬ tuˬ sheˆ tuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Heˍ ve leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ shaˉ caˆ caˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw hui geh tanˇ kaˬ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw chehˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, yawˇ ve awˬ viˉpaˍ Iˉsawˇ hta‸ ya‸ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ behˇ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ behˇ da‸ leh gʼaˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ hawˬ leh, yawˇ geh awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo yawˇ geh laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ meh chi hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh, yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Ka ti‸ yeˬ ve hkʼaw hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ leh te-o. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha kanˉ te laˇ tuˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh law taˍ-o.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Haˍnaˍniˆ chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ leh, maˇ cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ paw sha jaˇ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ ca gʼa taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ ca gʼa leh paw sha la peuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, aˉ po kʼo hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ heˆ laiˉ ceuˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hui gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nuˇ paˍ lonˉ yuˬ leh tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
