Chi hta‸ pa taw, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ti mi hkʼaw hpoˆ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ awˬ miˇ ma gʼa tuˬ, Haˍranˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te leh, yawˬ gʼa hawˉ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui geh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve pa taw, suh keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw teˇ ceuˬ tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ chaw hui hta‸ chiˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hpu shaˉ hoˆ teˇ hpaˍ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nuˇ awˬ ho‸ han te taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh boˆ nu hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ htaˇ ce la ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo mvuhˇ haw meuˆ baˬ ve caˬ cuˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬlehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ve yoˬ.
Goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ leh caˆ muiˬ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ leunˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ che‸ leh, laˇ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui ve ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo law taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yehˇ ehˉ mehˉ kʼai ve yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ che‸ leh tzuh‸ suhˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ che‸ caˇ leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ ga laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ laˇ gʼa tuˬ le.
Nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ leh, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te ya‸ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ li‸ daw hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ leh, li‸ daw oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ gʼa ve htawˇ, paw la paˇ neˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ lehˬ, awˬ e ve gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw maˇ tawˆ la gaˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ ha‸ yuˬ gaˇ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ suh ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ve haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ ngaˬ meuˆ laˬ tcuh leh, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬ tuˇ leh nanˬ bawˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ fiˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le htawˇ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo suh-e peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ chiˇ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yaˇ hu ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gʼoˇ peˬ shawˆ hkoˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha geh lo kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ na yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ maˇ gʼa. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-o. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ va kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ shiˍ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma kʼaw‸ zuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon, ngaˬ lehˬ goˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ veˆ la leh, Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ leh kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ shaˍlonˍ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui awˬ pe‸ hawnˉ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ ve awˬ hawˉ lo teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hko hkʼa shuˍ nyi sha jaˇ leh, a peuˉ meuˇ hko hkʼa shuˍ awˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ meh bvuhˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ aˉ guiˬ ha baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, nyi ma hkʼaw tawnˇ taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬoˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ ve pa taw, a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve pa taw, hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Beˍtuˍlaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇlaˆ geh gaˬ la ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui a sha‸ mawˇ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui teˇ co-e maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi teˇ co-e hkʼaw, chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ pawˆ hpeh‸ la jaw laˇ.
Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ hto maˍ piˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ teˇ moˍ peuˬ teˇ moˍ awˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ moˍ caˇ maˇ peuˬ taˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve teˇ moˍ kʼaw‸ caˇ peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˇ la leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Tzuhˬ dawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui tzuhˬ te dawˬ tuˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.

Maˇ jaˇ ve paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve ciˬ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve ciˬ hkʼa shuˍ tcuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ te teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ leh, ngaˬ hui ve maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬ peuˬ. Awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ geu‸ baˬ leh, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpuˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ heuˆ tuˬ ve chaw haˉ paˍ suh-e ve pa taw dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Bon yehˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve pa taw, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ dawˇ haˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ti mi teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai peuˬ. Miˬguiˬ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai peuˬ leh, shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai peuˬ.

Muiˬ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ haˍ chehˇ-oˆ. A pehˉ meuˇ hko hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, caˬ cehˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.
A pehˉ meuˇ te leh maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai peuˬ. Awˬ nu ve iˉ shiˍ cehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai peuˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Teˇ haˉ tanˇ hkuinˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ-o.

Caˇ tuˬ ce leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, ha lehˬ tuˬ ve maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.

Awˬ yawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼaw suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Shaw hpoˆ taˍ tuˬ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Hkʼe te leh, caˬ ciˇ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai paˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve hta‸ pa taw, ceˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ pon kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, zuhˇ de leh suhˆ tsuh de teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ to‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ, nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai peuˬ.
Haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ fiˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ-oˆ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo naˆ ho‸ la chehˇ ve hkʼe, paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw leh, laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ Eˍdenˍ hko hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo lehˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui la‸ hkʼaw lo teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ shuˍ leh, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼai chehˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo pawˆ taˆ-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ leh, zuhˇ de hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui laˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le kawˆ jaˇ leh, chaw suh hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ ma‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo gaˆ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼaˇ hte‸ bawˆ laˬ chehˇ leh, la‸ mehˍ la‸ sha maˇ jaw kʼai.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ceh kʼai leh, shu ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼai. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ko taˍ tsuhˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpanˍ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Yawˇ hui venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ lo‸-e leh, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ pawˆ taˆ-e leh, chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw taˆ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ lo miˬ hiˆ la leh, mvuhˇ naw ma htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi ha pa htawˇ naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ ba ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ma‸ moˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. A shu teˇ gʼaˇ hkanˍ gʼa tuˬ le.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Caˇ tuˬ ce leh, dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ ve hkʼaw hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ ve a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ hkoˇ kʼai piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh, nyi ma dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo behˬ heh ma meuˆ loˬ. Caˇ tuˬ ce leh bon lawˬ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ tiˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Chaw mawˇ, yaˇ nehˬ, leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ kuˬ hpawnˬ-o‸. Heuˆ da‸ gehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ leh bon chi hkʼe gʼa lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ taw kuiˬ lo taˇ gaˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kʼoˆ tcuh piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh bon gʼa lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ cawˬ la leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui caˇ law‸ dawˬ law‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ caˬ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ na hpawˇ lo laˬ taˍ ve paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸, ngaˬ shehˇ de lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ keu piˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ keu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ pon, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ.

To nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuh‸ nawˉ lehˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Iˉ shiˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ iˉ shiˍ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la peuˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ leh maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, awˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ lo caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ lo a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ chu hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ te luˬ te sheˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tan, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ gʼa caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon anˇ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ngeuˍ pfuhˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ tawˇ yaw tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ha hkʼaw lo hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ paˍ awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, ngaˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo, awˬ suhˍ, aˬ miˍ, leh aˬ miˍ mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ awˬ heˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, ha pa lehˬ awˬ suhˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ htaˇ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa kuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ leh, ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼai piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ leh, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui pehˬ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ leh, yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh meh maˬ lanˉ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ pa yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Tuˇruˆ venˇ, Siˉdonˍ venˇ leh, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ ve le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ gaˇ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve hpu shi leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hawˇ piˇ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ hawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ ve Sheˍbaˆ chaw hui hta‸ teˇ caˉ kʼaw‸ hawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ leh, nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh-o.
Nawˬ hui ve laˇ hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉhtaw kʼaw‸ dawˆ leh, nawˬ hui ve law‸ kʼawˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gehˇ kʼaw‸ te taˍ-o‸. Gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve chaw htawˇ ma‸ gʼa bawˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo haˆ haˆ laˬ leh hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ tuˬ nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peu laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ gu taˍ leh, suhˉ jehˬ ve lawˬ hkʼo‸ lo gʼa ya‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ mui taˍ leh chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼeu‸ yuˬ-o‸. A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˉ ceh‸ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve pa taw, lawˬ hkʼo‸ oˇ ve hkʼaw chaw awˬ hinˉ awˬ meunˍ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi ha pa naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ ba-o.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ, ceˇ caˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ maˬ tawˆ la leh, Aˍhkeˇshaˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ nehˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, goˇ choˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la leh, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Teˍkawˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Aˍmoˆ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Uˇziˆ jawˇmawˇ te leh Yawˇshaˆ ve yaˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬ maˇ hiˆ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼe htaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha Aˍmoˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍmoˆ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw bvuhˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai leh, Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ shiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ Aˍmoˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Giˇlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh te piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, jawˇmawˇ Heˍzeˍlaˆ te taˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh jawˇmawˇ Beˍhaˍdaˆ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, Aˍvenˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw leh Beˍteˍdenˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˬ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Kiˇraˆ venˇ lo shu hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Gaˍsaˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ awˬ ceˬ hkʼa shuˍ Eˇdonˍ chaw hui hta‸ hawˇ piˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gaˍsaˍ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍcoˆ venˇ leh Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ tuˬ kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Tuˇruˆ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Eˇdonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ puiˉ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ mehˉ kʼai puiˉ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Teˍmanˍ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, Bawˇzaˍraˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Aˍmonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ suhˉ ca bawˆ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ hu ma teˇ hpaˍ ve gʼoˇ peˬ hta‸ shawˆ hkoˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Raˍbaˆ lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ ma‸ bawˆ hehnˇ jaˇ la leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, Keˍroˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ behˬ heh ma meuˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Mawˇbaˆ chaw hui lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ jawˇmawˇ leh awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui htawˇ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ aˬ miˍ ce la piˇ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jeˬ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui leh, hkuiˉ nuˆ teˇ ceh awˬ pon ceh ka‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ maˇ gʼa ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hawˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, gʼaˇ nuˇ shaˉ nuˇ ve chaw hui leh dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ naˆ tinˍ taˍ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ca‸ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ pa leh awˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hta‸ haˉ chawˇ te ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Bon lawˬ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le hkʼaw, chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ hui geh jeˬ shawˍ yuˬ taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼawˇ zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui geh nyiˉ yuˬ veu laˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, htawˇ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ mvuh jaˇ leh maˉ kuˇ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ heh jaˇve Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la leh, awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa biˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍmawˇriˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ cawˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Naˍzaˍriˆ chaw hui hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ taw piˇ leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tcuh ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ, nawˬ hui tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo naˆ tinˍ leh nawˬ hui lehˬ caˬ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ taˆ taˍ ve nuˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve chaw hui htawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Hkaˆ bawˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, huˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve chaw hui htawˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ha‸ hanˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ tawˆ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui awˬ lawn hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ na sheˍ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ leh, ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ jehˬ da‸ taˉ leh teˇ geh kʼai hpeh‸-aw laˇ.

Laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ maˇ mawˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kuˬ toˇ chehˇ-aw laˇ. Haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ-ehˉ lehˬ, teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ yuˬ gʼa sheˍ ve ceh ceh kuˬ chehˇ-aw laˇ.
Va maˇ htaw taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˆ ehˉ teˇ hkeh va oˇ ve hta‸ yaw hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Va hkʼaw lo teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ lo‸-e ve kʼo, va oˇ ve penˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ laˇ.

Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kawˆ tuˬ ve leh laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha a loˍ maˇ cawˇ ve kʼo, venˇ teˇ maˬ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ te tuˬ ve kanˉ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ kawˆ ve chaw a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ yaw ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve tawˇ shu hta‸ maˇ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ leh a shu teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Aˍshaˍdawˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hawˉ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hkʼaw teˇ geh hpawnˬ laˬ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve leh, hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ nyi-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ veu laˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te hkawˇ maˇ shiˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve yehˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ che‸ caˇ peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkui sheh nyiˇ paˉ leh naˍ paw teˇ maˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve Saˍmaˍriˆ chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ na yuˬ leh, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ kaˆ htaˇ leh mvuhˇ goˇ htaˇ chehˇ tuˬ te taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haw ciˬ yuˬ leh nyi sha tuˬ te taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ le le htawˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa deh‸ caˍ chu taˍ ve nuˇ ma peuˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve nawˬ hui Saˍmaˍriˆ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ, tawˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇnyi gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ biˉ hta‸ yaw taˍ ve ngaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, shu gʼawˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, lanˇ venˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼawˬ kʼai leh ca‸ ce ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, venˇbaˆ ca te loˬ. Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, nawˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ venˇbaˆ ca te loˬ. Nawˬ hui ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ leh, teˇ shawˉ le le tuˉ tanˇ loˬ. Shehˆ nyi teˇ pawˆ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ piˇ loˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve hkʼaw, nawˬ hui hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui yuˬ laˬ ve awˬ nu ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Nawˬ hui ti taˍ ve caˬ teˇ hpaˍ, mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hta‸ loˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ hta‸ maˇ laˬ piˇ lawˬ. Venˇ teˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, awˬ nu ve teˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ lawˬ. Ti mi teˇ peˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ ve htawˇ, awˬ nu ve teˇ peˆ hta‸ ngaˬ goˇ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ shiˉ leh gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, venˇ laiˉ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ iˉ kaˆ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ awˬ nu ve venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo iˉ kaˆ hkʼa bvuhˆ maˇ gʼa dawˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh lo maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Nawˬ hui ve caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ goˇ kʼai piˇ tuˬ, haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ ngaˬ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Paˉ ce‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve maˉ nawˆ cehˬ leh shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ baˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la jaw ve naˬ beuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve fa la teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw kuiˇ nuˬ jaˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ suh leh te‸ chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, to‸ maˇ peuˬ leh cawˬ taˉ ve suhˆ hteh hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ leh, mvuhˇ haw hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ hta‸ yawˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˬ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa maˍ laˇ shaˍ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ lehˬ paiˍ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tu la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo chiˇ baˬ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ cawˍ tu piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ venˇ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ tawˆ-e leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ venˇ lehˬ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ha gʼaˇ hpehˇ tawˆ-e leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ ceh kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui tuˬ, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ venˇ lo taˇ kʼai. Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lo kʼai leh ngaˬ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ taˇ ca. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo htawˇ taˇ kʼai. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ to‸ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ aˬ miˍ oˇ ve hta‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo suhˉ maˇ jehˬ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkiˇmaˆ leh Hkaˍtiˇlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ba da‸ jaˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw hta‸ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve chaw hui hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ luˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ te taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve nyi sha jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko hkʼaw cawˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve leh, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ hkʼaˬ ma te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, la‸ shawnˍ yuˬ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo shonˇ kʼai tuˬ nawˬ hui te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve lehˬ da‸ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a sha‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ jaw kʼai leh, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ leh, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ shaˉ nanˉ hkʼaw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh paˆ hawˬ tcuh ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh, muiˬ caˇ paˍ hui hta‸ htawˇ shu kuˬ yuˬ leh paˆ hawˬ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

A pehˉ meuˇ hko teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi hta‸ law nyi chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve le. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma da‸ ve awˬ bon te laˇ gʼa tuˬ le. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ hta‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh yehˬ miˉ tawˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˉ hkʼaw kʼo‸-e leh gʼo‸ pa hta‸ ca ngeh taˍ htaˇ vuiˬ htawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ naˆ ho‸ jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve bon pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ nyi gaˇ.

Nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ laˬ ve htawˇ, tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ caˍ chu taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te kʼa chehˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jehˇ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve tinˍ hteˆ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ maˇ na gaˇ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ fiˍ kʼai puiˉ ve iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ ya‸ la chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ te toˇ chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui te taˍ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ gʼuiˬsha, Saˍkuˆ leh Hkiˇgʼonˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa pfuhˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ oˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ hkʼaw maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, shu gʼaˇ ca va la chehˇ ve Saˍmaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.

Kaˍlaˍneˍ venˇ hta‸ ca nyi sheˍ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, uiˍ jaˇ ve Haˍmaˆ venˇ leh Hpiˇliˇtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Gaˍtaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ kʼai-o. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve laˇ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nyi oˇ ve hta‸ haˆ haˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼoˆ zuh‸ taˍ leh nuˇ shaˍ, yawˬ shaˍ caˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ yuˬ tawˆ leh tinˍ hteˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ dawˬ leh, hawnˉ jaˇ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ haˍ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ awˉ lawˇ peuˇ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa hti caˇ hti dawˬ chehˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe shaˍ ti‸ piˇ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te taˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yehˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, yawˇ hui caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ lonˉ leh, venˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ hkʼaw chaw teˇ chi gʼaˇ cawˬ taˉ ve kʼo, chaw oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ca gʼawˆ tuˍ piˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yehˬ hkʼaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ kuˬ na nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ-o, teh‸ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ta‸ iˉ chehˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ gʼa kuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, uiˍ ve yehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, i ve yehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ lehˬ, haˉ hpawˇ hkʼoˆ lo gʼuiˇ toˇ-aw laˇ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, nuˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ mehˇ-aw laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ taw‸ ma hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, cawˇ ve hta‸ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Lawˍdeˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ gʼa taˍ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, Kaˍreˍneˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la tuˬ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ma‸ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Haˍmaˆ kʼaˍ le‸ hta‸ te leh, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Aˍraˍbaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ ha hkʼaw chi hkʼe hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ ve zuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼeu‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, zuhˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˍ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa biˇ te hpanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Paˉ ce‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ hpa‸ nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ caˇ baˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, i jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ ha hkʼaw chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ to‸ baˬ chehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ htawˇ tanˬ to‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ miˍ hta‸ taˇ to‸ laˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ hui lehˬ i jaˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, Chi ve htawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ ha hkʼaw chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ leh, gʼo‸ pa teˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍmoˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh chi ve hta‸ yuˬ taˍ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ tehˆ nyi leh te taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ nyi ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉ caˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve paw hkuˇ Aˍmaˍziˆ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍmoˆ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ awˬ moˍ shawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yaw chehˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ luˬ kʼai piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yeˍyawˇbaoˬ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Yeˍyawˇbaoˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Aˍmaˍziˆ Aˍmoˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tcuh kaˍ paˍ-oˬ, pehˇ-o. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e leh, oˇ kaˬ lo bon ca kʼaw‸ maˍ-o‸. Nawˬ bon maˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Choˬ kaˬ Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw bon taˇ kʼaw‸ maˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Chehˇ kuiˬ chi lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ choˬ kaˬ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Aˍmoˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ caˇ leh bon maˍ toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ yawˬ hawˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ lo kuˬ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bon ca maˍ piˇ tuˬ kanˉ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bon maˇ gʼa maˍ piˇ tuˬ leh, hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa deˇ maˍ tuˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve pa taw, Aˍmaˍziˆ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ miˇ ma lehˬ, venˇ chi hkʼaw meh maˬ lanˉ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu pehˬ yuˬ leh, nawˬ lehˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Aˍmaˍziˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ ha hkʼaw chi hkʼe hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha oˇ ve hkʼaw, iˉ shiˍ keu taˍ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˍmoˆ-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa mawˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ shiˍ keu taˍ ve hkʼawˍ lawˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ la paˇ neˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw kʼa chehˇ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo suh taˍ ve awˬ to hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ leh, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ naˆ tinˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ, chi hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ.

Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hawˇ tuˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ ponˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ca law chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ hui ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ hawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, shinˉ nyi hkʼaˬ htaˆ peuˬ tuˬ le. Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ mawˇ hpfuhˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaˆ piˇ leh, shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˇ da‸ ve caˬ shiˍ hta‸, ngaˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ chaweh te hawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkuiˉ nuˆ teˇ ceh ka‸ vuiˬ tcuhˉ maˇ gʼa leh, shu ve jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui vuiˬ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ leh hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui te ve haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ leunˇ kʼai tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, miˬ hiˆ la leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ taˆ la taˉ leh kʼaw‸ yawn kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi lehˬ sha gʼuˇ htaˇ lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh tanˇ vanˇ htaˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ nuˆ leh meh htuˉ pui hpa gʼa veu‸ deh tuˬ ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi lehˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ meu‸ lonˉ kaˆ lonˉ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ neˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh meu‸ ve kaˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ leh iˉ kaˆ shiˉve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ meu‸ jaˇ kaˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo te leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo maˇ kʼoˆ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ ca toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ca mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, da‸ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, iˇ kaˆ shiˉ jaˇ ve pa taw maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh te paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ va chehˇ ve chaw hui leh, Danˍ ve gʼuiˬsha, Beˍraˍsheˍbaˆ ve gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tu la gaˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yehˬ hkuiˉ daw hta‸ dawˆ-oˆ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hkʼoˆ ce la piˇ-oˆ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e leh ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ lo miˬ kʼoˍ duˇ ya‸-e chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ ya‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kaˍmeˍlaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ca va‸ taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ ca leh hpeh yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hpaw-e leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo ca va‸ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ piˇ tuˬ ngaˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha miˬguiˬ hta‸ htawˇ leh, miˬ hiˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hkʼa shuˍ uiˍ taˆ la taˉ leh kʼaw‸ yaw kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ te taˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ baˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi ve hkʼa shuˍ, Suˍdanˍ chaw hui ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui hta‸ Kaˍreˍteˍ conˉ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Suˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ Kiˇraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Caˬ hkʼa hta‸ ha keu hkʼaw keu leh hkeunˉ ve hkʼe, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkeunˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ keu leh hkeunˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa suh-e tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve Daˍviˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ tuˬ awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, lanˇ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ tehˬ awˬ na biˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Caˬ ti ve awˬ yanˇ leh caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ la leh, a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ ti ve awˬ yanˇ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ ve awˬ yanˇ teˇ yanˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, mehˬ jaˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ yoˬ ya‸ la chehˇ leh, hkʼaw ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ geh teˇ geh yoˬ ya‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, luˬ peuˬ sheˆ peuˬ ve yawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ ti leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hko te leh, hko hkʼaw tawˆ ve awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ piˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ti leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼawˬ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Awˇbaˍdiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai piˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ heˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ haˉ pui yuˬ te taˍ ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ ve yehˬ lehˬ mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve yoˬ. A shu ngaˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ ce gʼa tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ aˉ ceˬ hpui hkʼa shuˍ mvuh jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo te taˍ leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ kaˍ lo cawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ ce tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw hkʼawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ ca hkʼawˇ toˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ shaˉ ve htawˇ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu yuˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui nawˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ geh teˇ geh mui caˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ va caw htaw chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ da‸ leh, Yawˇ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ Eˇdonˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ kʼo, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˍmanˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, co co awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼe leˇ huˉ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh pehˬ yuˬ ve canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ viˉ nawˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ, gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nyi taˍ leh ha lehˬ chehˇ maˇ cawˇ.
Yawˇ hui tu‸ hkanˍ leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ca hiˉ yuˬ cawˇ.

Yawˇ hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ya‸ kʼaw ceh da‸ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ hpeh yuˬ cawˇ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo maˇ chiˇ a‸ piˇ cawˇ.

Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Eˇdonˍ-oˬ, nawˬ shu hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve kawˆ hta‸ gʼa dawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ hkʼaˇ jaˇ ve kawˆ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˬ bvuhˆ taˉ leh mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa hkʼaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˍkoˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˬ miˍ lehˬ goˇ lehˍ ve mvuh‸ hta‸ to‸ baˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa te‸ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇhpaˍrenˍ leh Saˍmaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Beˍyaˍmenˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ na hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ la leh, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, Zaˍreˍhpaˍtaˆ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Saˍdiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shu ceˬ te chehˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ tawn hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ leh uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Aˍmiˆtehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lonˉ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ ca yaw piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ maˇ heˆ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Yuˇpeˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Saˍpenˍ venˇ lo kʼai tuˬ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ciˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ taˆ la leh, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ca ve yoˬ. Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ a ciˉ lawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui lehˬ taˆ taˍ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ awˬ hawˉ teˇ htai‸ lo ya‸-e leh, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ awˬ hoˉ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve le. Tu leh nawˬ ve gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, A shu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve leh naˍ, ngaˬ hui awˬ meh bvuh‸ keu leh hkaˆ yuˬ nyi shaˍ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te nyi leh, Yoˇnaˆ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkaˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve a shu hta‸ venˇbaˆ gʼa taˍ tuˬ le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo aˬ hto‸ ma te chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo laˬ ve le. Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma chaw ceuˬ le, teh‸ Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yoˇnaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Heˍbrehˇ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ mvuhˇ naw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ leh, Nawˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.(Yoˇnaˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkawˇ maˇ na leh hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ.)

Gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ shaˬ te shaˬ hehnˇ la chehˇ ve pa taw, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ kʼaw‸ gawˬ kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te laˇ tuˬ le, teh‸ Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇnaˆ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ kʼaw‸ gawˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw gʼuiˬ baˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ taˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo gaˬ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ leh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ kʼai nyi ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼuiˬ baˇ shaˬ te shaˬ hehnˇ jaˇ la chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chaw chi hpaˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hui yuˬ suh piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ-oˆ. Hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ gawˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˇ lonˉ teˇ hkeh hta‸ gu taˍ leh, Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ ngaˇ lonˉ gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw shehˆ nyi shehˆ haˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ, ngaˇ lonˉ gʼoˇ peˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh bon chi hkʼe lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo baˬ keu laˇ ve yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hkʼoˆ taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo yuˬ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hoˆ beh taˍ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ shaˉ gʼawˬ maˇ gʼa ve yoˬ. Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hoˆ beh taˍ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hawˆ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo ya‸-e leh, miˬguiˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve a sha‸ leh la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ geh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ lehˬ nawˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ geh gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ leh, ngaˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˇ lonˉ oˇ ve hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh, Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo ca hpe‸ baˬ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve hkʼe Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve venˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ leh, venˇ choˬ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo te leh oˇ hpawˇ teˇ ceˍ lo gaˬ tuˬ shehˆ nyi gʼa kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yoˇnaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ te toˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˇ chi nyi ponˬ peuˬ kʼo venˇ chi luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ caˇ tuˬ ce tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw mawˇ hta‸ te leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ, meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ Niˇnaˍveˍ jawˇmawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mui chehˇ ve kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ ya‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ kʼehˆ baˬ leh meh htuˉ pui hpa veu‸ deh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkʼaw mui taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ jawˇmawˇ leh yawˇ ve a ma‸ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ ga caˇ. Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa caˇ maˇ gʼa dawˬ.

Chaw yaˇ leh to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ meh htuˉ pui hpa gʼa veu‸ deh ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Gʼuiˬsha geh bon gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa lawˬ leh, a shu yawˇ te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ naˍ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, venˇ yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma kʼaw‸ pa leh yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe te piˇ ve hta‸ Yoˇnaˆ nyi ma maˇ sha. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ chi hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ coˇ caˇ leh Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ hui te ya‸ chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hta‸ suh-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ gʼa suh ve lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇnaˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ca jo mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo ehˉ teˇ maˬ te leh oˇ kaˬ lo mui nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yoˇnaˆ awˬ paˇ lo suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ teˇ cehˬ yeˬ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ, suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa mui chehˇ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shawˉ pawˍ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ leh suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi a ciˉ mvuh la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ve haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve mvuhˇ haw hta‸ meuˆ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve pa taw hkanˍ maˇ gʼaˇ leh suh-e gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suh-e ve lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ chi ve hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve suh la yoˬ, teh‸ Yoˇnaˆ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ chi lehˬ, aˉ nyi haˉ ceh yeˬ tawˆ la leh ya‸ nyi suh-e ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ suhˆ cehˬ ehˉ chi hta‸ maˇ gʼa ha‸ shaˉ leh, te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te piˇ taˍ ve htawˇ, suhˆ ceh ehˉ chi ve hta‸ sheˉ lai jaˇ ve law leˇ.
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lonˉ chi ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve te‸ chiˉ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ 120,000 gʼaˇ leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma sheˉ lai tuˬ ve le, teh‸ Yoˇnaˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw Yawˇtanˍ, Aˍhaˆ leh Heˍsaˍkiˆ hui jawˇmawˇ te chehˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Mawˇraˍsaˆ venˇ yaˇ Miˆhkaˍ hta‸ Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ tawˇ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Na sheˍ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la chehˇ leh, hkʼaw uˉ tzuh teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo juˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ hkʼaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼaw kuiˬ kʼai chehˇ ve pehˇ hawˍ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo kuiˬ kʼai leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw yoˬ ya‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, a shu hta‸ venˇbaˆ gʼa taˍ tuˬ le. Saˍ maˍriˆ venˇ lonˉ hta‸ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve pa taw, a shu venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve le. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ ti kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ hkʼaw luˬ peuˬ sheˆ peuˬ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw baˬ keu leh, venˇ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˆ meu-e piˇ leh bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve meh maˬ lanˉ hui hta‸ tanˇ piˇ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo dawˆ baˬ taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ awˬ hpoˆ lonˉ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpa lehˬ shaˉ ho‸ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ nu ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Miˆhkaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ hkuiˉ nuˆ maˇ tcuhˉ leh te toˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Heh hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ kuˬ toˇ chehˇ leh, kaˍlaˍoˆ ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ hkʼanˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Saˍmaˍriˆ ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kʼaw‸ na-e la maˇ gʼa taˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo gaˬ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui shonˇ kʼai ve awˬ lawn Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ hto piˇ. Nawˬ hui hawˬ chehˇ ve yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ mawˬ tcuh. Beˍtawˇhpaˍraˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, je‸ meu-e hkʼaw zuh‸ taˍ leh nawˬ hui dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ-o ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Saˍhpiˉra‸ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ kʼu nyi te leh ya‸ taw ve hkʼaw lo shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo ca chehˇ-oˆ. Zaˍnanˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˆ la haˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Beˍtaˍseˍlaˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo gʼaˇ va kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ-o ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˍroˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Laˍhkiˇsaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui venˇbaˆ te ve hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ te piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui-oˬ, Mawˍriˆsehˆ Gaˍtaˆ venˇ hta‸ chi beu‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍhkaˍziˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ gʼaˇ ca va hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Maˍreˍshaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍduˆlanˍ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw gʼa ca va‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ha‸ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ leh nawˬ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hta‸ chiˇ baˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve pa taw, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ hkʼa shuˍ a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ yiˬ lehˍ te taˍ-o‸.

A shu yawˇ ve zuh‸ hpui hkʼaw zuh‸ taˍ leh, haiˬve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve le. Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi taˍ ve haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ti mi heuˆ gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shu ve ti mi hta‸ ca yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yehˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shu ve yehˬ hta‸ ca yuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa leh mawˇ jeˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gaˬ la piˇ leh, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ kuiˬ lo nawˬ hui gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ caˆ muiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve tu‸ hkanˍ haˍ gʼawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ kʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve miˬguiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hta‸ bon taˇ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ maˍ chehˇ ve bon hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ taˇ kʼaw‸ maˍ loˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, hkeu ve awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ-o leh laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na chi hkʼe te tuˬ ve leh laˇ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ nuˇ lehˍ yaw piˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ bon kʼaw‸ maˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ tuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo law taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ na‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Tu leh kʼai loˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon gawˬ lehˍve chehˇ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw, chehˇ kuiˬ chi ve lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ leh tzuhˬ teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon yoˬ ya‸ la chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ leh heˍ puiˉ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ geh shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkawˆ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve yawˬ awˬ moˍ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ geh shaw hpoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˬ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo chaw hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw hpaw piˇ leh, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ taˉ leh tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ shiˍ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ te‸ te‸ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hkʼeh‸ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ hkʼeh‸ baˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˉ hteh piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mu‸ hkʼu hkʼaw keu caˉ tuˬ shaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˆ hpoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te chehˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ hpu piˇ gʼa ve chaw hui hta‸, Nawˬ hui gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, hpu piˇ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸, Nawˬ hui ma‸ gʼa bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ leh la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
