Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ nyi lo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ ve pa taw, awˬ ha hkʼaw hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la ve pa taw gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui te ya‸ chehˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu, kanˇ paˆ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve, leh ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma piˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ canˇ leh, cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, shu geh la‸ shawnˍ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon ceh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hpu gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon ceh hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ti mi hkʼa shuˍ mehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui htawˇ hteunˍ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw bon yehˬ te taˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw pui lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw pui hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ oˇ kaˬ lo laˬ leh,

Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai-a veuˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ca henˇ yuˬ leh, Yawˇ leuˆ laˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ngaˬ hui toˇ kʼai-a veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hkʼaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, vuiˇ kuiˬ neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Yawˇ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ laˇ hpuiˇ kʼaw‸ lawˍ leh, a shu yawˇ ve gehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ law‸ kʼawˉ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ bawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko leh, maˉ nawˆ hko hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ te piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ shaw hpoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yehˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw ceuˬ lonˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh ngaˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ kuiˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve venˇ lonˉ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ chehˇ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ lehˬ yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve le. Nawˬ jawˇmawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw laˇ. Nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ hkʼaˇ piˇ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e peuˬ ve pa taw laˇ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ, hpeˆ dawˇ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ chi beu‸ venˇ hta‸ gʼa baˬ taˉ leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ gʼa te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi ve luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ. Caˬ jaw‸ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ geh shaw hpoˆ leh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Awˬ hkaw lehˬ sho hpeh‸ leh, hkui kiˆ lehˬ kuiˇ hpeh‸ ve nuˇ paˍ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw ceuˬ maˇ maˇ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, ngaˬ geh gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve ma‸ moˍ hta‸ shawˍ-o‸. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ caw hoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ Eˇhpaˍraˆ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ paw la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo chiˇ baˬ taˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw gʼa ca chehˇ taˍ ve yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ngaˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai peu tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ la‸ caˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˇ suh-e leh cawˬ taˉ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ce la piˇ ve ciˍ gʼuiˬ leh, mvuh‸ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la chehˇ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ, shu awˬ pon awˬ bon uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va leh, chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo chehˇ taˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ ca toˇ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ, hkʼa mawˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che‸ caˇ leh tzuh‸ suhˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai leh nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˆ paˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ leh, faˍ te puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ teh taˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve haˉ pui hkuiˉ daw teˇ hpaˍ leh shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ pui tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Aˍsheˍraˆ gʼuiˬsha ma ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ gʼawˬ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na taˍ sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, tu la leh nawˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼa kaˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ leh aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ ve miˬguiˬ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ chehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ taˍ peuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shu ceˬ shu hpfuhˆ te chehˇ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai laˇ tuˬ Moˉseˍ, Aˍronˍ leh Meˇriˆanˍ hui hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Mawˇbaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Baˍlaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve awˬ lawn, leh Baˍraˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Baˍlanˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Aˍhkeˇshaˍ venˇ lo te leh Giˇlaˍgaˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ taˉ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui la htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ le. Yawˇ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve nuˇ ehˉ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ laˇ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ geh lo yawˬ ehˉ awˬ hinˉ hkeh, maˇ heˆ kʼo, maˇ jaˇ ve shaˍlonˍ awˬ chu yuˬ veu laˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ ve venˇbaˆ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ uiˍ hta‸ gʼa tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.

Maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve, ha‸ pehnˇ ve, leh nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ venˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ hkʼaw hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, na sheˍ.

Haiˬve chaw hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw ca gʼa taˍ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ maˇ cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe maˇ cawˇ ve yaˍ cuˍ hta‸ yehˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te venˇbaˆ hpehˇ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw heˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, chi teˇ hkui hta‸ tanˬ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼa meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui mawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ pfuhˇ tawˆ-e chehˇ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ha‸ shaˉ taˍ gʼa ve htawˇ, ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui caˬ ti ve htawˇ, gʼa gʼeu‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui shaˍ lonˍ awˬ chu nyiˉ yuˬ chehˇ ve htawˇ, gʼa yehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ chehˇ ve htawˇ, gʼa dawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Awˇmaˍriˆ leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ jawˇmawˇ Aˍhaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ te ve hkʼe gʼa‸ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gaˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shawˍ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ iˉ shiˍ cehˬ hkʼoˆ lo iˉ shiˍ teˇ shiˍ ka‸ ca maˇ mawˬ ve chaw, leh a pehˉ meuˇ te hkʼoˆ lo a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ ca maˇ mawˬ ve awˍ meu‸ jaˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ leh, mehˬ jaˇ ve maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shu shaˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ awˬ paˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A ma‸ lonˉ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu geh la‸ shawnˍ lawˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ geh jehˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ jaˇ leh, hteˇ jaˇ cawˇ jaˇ ve chaw hui htawˇ, mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ maˇ tawˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ taˇ yonˍ. Nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼaˇ taˇ va. Nawˬ miˇ ma hta‸ tawˇ yaw htaˇ htawˇ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ.

Chi hkʼe ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa hta‸ chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe shawˍ leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ tawˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ hkuiˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pi ma hta‸ ya‸ da‸ leh, a shu yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ law nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ nyi ma yeˬ chaweh taˍ leh law nyi tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ kuˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ paiˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui lehˬ naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te ya‸ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ ve maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ cawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ tawˆ laˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ ceuˬ chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh na nyi laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shonˇ kʼai leh, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve je‸ nehˆ hkʼa shuˍ, shu naˆ toˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ kawˍ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ kʼehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hpawˇ chi hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chi beu‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ sho-eˬ yawˇ hui te caˇ jaw muiˬ ve Baˍshanˍ leh Giˇlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkuiˇ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw shiˍ tawˆ la chehˇ htaˇ hkʼe, ngaˬ hui hta‸ anˇ tuˬ awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ te maˍ laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve htawˇ, chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh nyi ma luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Hpeh‸ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui maw‸ kʼaw me‸ taˍ leh, a shu yawˇ ve naˍ paw hta‸ hoˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Vuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui je‸ meu-e hkʼaw loˇ kʼai leh, kawˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui ve ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ shuˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ co co nyi ma zuhˆ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ naˆ tiˍ taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ tawˬ lo ya‸-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ lawn hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ve lehˬ, Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh Eˇlaˍkawˆshaˆ venˇ yaˇ Naˍhunˍ awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ Yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma haˆ haˆ maˇ zuhˆ puiˉ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ leh, venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa kʼai kuiˬ lo mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ laˬ leh, moˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve hkui sheh hawˉ lo ve je‸ meu-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve fiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ fiˍ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ti mi teˇ hpaˍ goˇ kʼai leh, Kaˍmeˍ laˆ hkʼaw htawˇ shiˉ-ehˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˉ veˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ho-eˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la leh hkʼaw pui ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo kuiˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ miˬ hiˆ jaˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngeuˍ baˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, haˉ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ da‸ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ponˬ piˇ leh, yawˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ uiˍ haˉ uiˍ la ve hkʼa shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Yawˇ suh-e piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve le. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Yawˇ hta‸ nyiˇ pawˆ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ leh goˇ kʼai peuˬ ve mvuh‸ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ lehˬ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ geh lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ leh haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ piˇ lawˬ ve htawˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ te laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ponˬ laˇ leh, yawˇ hui hpeh taˍ ve aˉ caˆ hkeh hta‸ hpui baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ te‸ chehˇ maˇ keunˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ tuˍ hpfuh duˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nyi loˬ. Hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ha lehˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ca hto la ve chaw laˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa pawehˇ te leh, nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ ca kʼaw‸ bawˆ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.

Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ-oˬ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca bawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu te leh, ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ-o‸. Ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh gu taˍ-o‸.
(Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸, aˬ sho-eˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ te luˬ piˇ sheˍ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.)

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve htanˬ tuˬ pfuhˇ taˍ leh, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ pawˆ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw lo htawˇ kʼaw‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ te gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lanˇ venˇ lo gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, lanˇ venˇ hta‸ dawˆ paˆ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hpaw baˬ sheˬ leh, hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ ma hta‸ shu hpeh yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe hpoˆ hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ jaˇ ve hkʼaw, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma pui hta‸ hta chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ hkʼaˇ pe‸ tawˆ la ve hkʼe, venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ hkʼaw gʼuiˇ tawˆ-e ve yoˬ. Taˇ gʼuiˇ hpaw-e teh‸ shu kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ nyi.
Hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ chi hkʼaw hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, nyi ma shiˍ kuiˬ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇ hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ chaw suh hkʼe hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ ehˉ hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve haˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve venˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo le. Te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, laˇ caˬ shiˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ le.
Laˇ caˬ shiˉ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ ca veu laˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon tzuh‸ suhˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkawˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, caˇ tuˬ shaˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, nawˬ hui shu geh yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ leh shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve venˇ lehˬ, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu geh hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ veu laˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ geh lo biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ caˆ hkeh jaw‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˇ toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ te toˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve aˉhtaw leh gehˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve yoˬ. Suh taˍ ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ jaˇ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ suh taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Meh maˬ lanˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ venˇbaˆ te piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ ma ya‸ taw tuˬ cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ paˉ lo jiˆ kʼo‸-e leh, Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Venˇ chi awˬ pon a shu teˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ le, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ sha tuˬ te laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Teˍbehˆ venˇ a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve laˇ. Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ lehˬ lanˇ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ, venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˍbehˆ venˇ lehˬ Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ awˬ leh meuˇ maˇ cawˬ. Liˆbyaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Teˍbehˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ le le awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve chaw uiˍ chaw mvuh teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu hpeh leh pehˬ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ htawˇ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh te paiˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw maˇ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ hpeˆ dawˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ meh la peuˬ ve maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ cehˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ ve kʼo, maˉ nawˆ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw ce lo‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la leh, nawˬ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve venˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ ca hoˆ la htaˇ, nawˬ iˉ kaˆ maˇ gʼa shiˉ tuˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa deh‸ hkʼo taˍ leh, nawˬ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ-o‸. Je‸ duˇ hpoˆ leh li kiˉ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ te hpoˆ taˍ-o‸.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ oˇ hkʼe te taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ lehˬ ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo tiˇ pehˍ ve, maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˬ miˍ chiˆ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Caˬ cehˬ hta‸ paˉ ce‸ tawˆ baˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ paˉ ce‸ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ la chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ a‸ kehˉ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, paˉ ce‸ poˬ hpaw-e ve hkʼe chi beu‸ yawˇ hui mehˉ kʼai peuˬ.

Nawˬ ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kaˆ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ gʼo‸ pa hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve paˉ ce‸ moˍ lonˉ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ hui poˬ hpaw-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ lo kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.

Aˍsuˇriˆ jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ hawˉ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ suh-e peuˬ leh, nawˬ ve hkunˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Nawˬ ve naˬ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ na-e la kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ hkʼa gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh la‸ sheh hta tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw ve chaw a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ le.
Chi ve lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍbaˍkuˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw maw tu‸ hkanˍ tcuh laˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tu‸ hkanˍ dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mawˬ tcuh laˇ ve le. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ cawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve leh maˇ cawˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ liˇ uˉ paˍ teˍ teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ te. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai leh, haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi-o. Nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui anˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kaˇ leh yonˍ maˇ hpeh‸ law‸ law‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ leh shu hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ tawˆ la chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui te gaˇ ve hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ laˇ a‸ kehˉ gʼuiˇ gehˬ jaˇ leh, meu‸ jehˇ kaˆ jehˇ chehˇ ve heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ leh vuiˇ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ aˉ ceˬ ngaˆ hta‸ gʼa‸ yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve ma‸ moˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ laˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hpeh gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga hpoˆ gʼuiˬ ve yoˬ. Ta‸ yehˬ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ je‸ yuˬ kawˍ taˆ-e leh bawˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ haw hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-o, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-o‸, nawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nawˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh haiˬ jaˇ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve le. Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve hta‸ htawˇ, nawˬ nyi maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve le.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ ngaˇ leh pfuhˇ shehˍ ma ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ shawˍ taˍ ve le.

Ngaˇ hta‸ biˉ yuˬ ve hkʼe, Baˍbuˍlonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˍ hkʼaw keu gʼawˬ toˇ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ pehˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh tuˉ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, pehˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ piˇ chehˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve aˉhtaw hta‸ yehˇ leh, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chi hkʼe ceh tiˉ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ chehˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ ta‸ yehˬ hkʼoˆ taˆ-e leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca law na taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ gʼaw gʼa tuˬ, haˉ pui baˉ hkʼoˆ lo bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn chi ve chi beu‸ la‸ haˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ sheˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ keu taˍ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ yanˇ haˆ haˆ gaˬ la chehˇ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la ve kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ gʼa bvuh‸ taˍ tuˬ ve tawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve pa taw gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ heˍ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ caˆ muiˬ puiˉ leh, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa shuˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi hkʼaˇ maˇ suh puiˉ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Bawˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bawˆ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ deˇ leh hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ maˇ heˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve pa taw, gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ maw maw nawˬ hui geh jeˬ cha taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ caˇ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve le, teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui maˇ jawˬ maˇ hkehˆ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu geh jeˬ kʼaw‸ cha leh, awˬ yawˬ htawˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ cheˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ laiˉ peˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te piˇ ve pa taw, cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui shu ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ paw sha la piˇ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, hkʼa deh‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ taw ve teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Lanˇ venˇ kawˍ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve toˉ la‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hkʼaw venˇ hta‸ kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui bawˆ yuˍ taˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, hkʼaˬ ma kanˉ te taˍ ve htawˇ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ tawˆ la. Yawˇ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve yoˬ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo iˉ kaˆ biˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve hkʼaw awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ ya‸ kʼaw hkʼa deh‸ juˇ kʼai maˇ gʼa tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ taw tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ leh ya‸ kʼaw hkʼa deh‸ juˇ kʼai gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve kawˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ taw laˇ leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve suhˆ tsuh de lonˉ hta‸ htu baˬ piˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui htawˇ chi beu‸ htu baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ ve pa taw, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ho laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te piˇ ve pa taw, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Shaˉ ho‸ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Oˇ ve lehˬ chaw yaˇ la‸ sheh te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ puiˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Shaˉ ho‸ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ gʼa law‸ law‸ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ te gʼa ve le. Chi lehˬ, tawˇ yaw maˇ puiˉ ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ suhˆ baˉ, maˇ heˆ kʼo haˉ pui baˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸, Tu loˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Shaˉ ho‸ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˍ laˇ hto laˇ hpeh‸ aw laˇ. Shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ hpu, shi hkʼa deh‸ oˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo te‸ ve a sha‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Chi ve lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˍbaˍkuˆ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ leh anˇ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ te jaw ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Eˇdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Paˍranˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo biˇ sheˆ chehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkawˇ biˇ sheˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba jaˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ tawˆ la chehˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ faˉ taˍ kuiˬ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo naˬ beuˬ hta‸ peu laˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ laˬ tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ jehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ miˬ hiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chiˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ haw chiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve hkʼaw lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkoˇ kʼai leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ juˇ kʼai jaw ve hkʼaw ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ, miˬguiˬ hkʼaw tuˍ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Kuˇshaˆ chaw hui kawˆ jehˇ chehˇ leh, Meˇdiˍanˍ chaw hui kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve lehˬ, iˉ kaˆ lawˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ lehˬ moˬ hta‸ ciˇ toˇ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ lehˬ nawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ hkaˆ leh hkaˆ ce hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ mvuhˇ htehˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ pe‸ hkoˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw pui teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ maˇ ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la leh, gʼuiˬ baˇ uiˍ taˆ la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ bawˆ peu ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ ve gehˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ nyi ha pa htawˇ jehˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw nawˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ juˇ kʼai leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ leh nawˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ hta‸ nawˬ dawˆ paiˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ toˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hta‸ hkaˆ ce bawˆ tcuhˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ baˬ kuiˬ lo haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, iˉ kaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ fuˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ leh kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve meuˇ guiˬ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ to nuˇ lehˍ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve hkui sheh htawˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh law taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˉ nawˆ shiˍ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ, shaˍ lonˍ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ naw‸ leh caˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai leh, nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw lo nuˇ teˇ hkeh ka‸ maˇ cawˬ-o ve htawˇ,
ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkuiˉ zuhˬ hkʼa shuˍ naˆ yeˬ tuˬ te laˇ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Aˍmonˍ ve yaˇ paˍ Yawˇshiˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Zeˍhpaˍniˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Zeˍhpaˍniˆ lehˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍsaˍkiˆ, Aˍmaˍziˆ, Geˍdaˍliˆ leh Kuˇshiˆ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ, to nuˇ to shaˆ, ngaˆ leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paiˍ piˇ lawˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw leh, Baˍlaˆ gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh mvuhˇ nyi, ha pa, leh meu‸ keu shiˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, Miˆlaˍ konˍ gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ laˬ ve chaw, leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca gʼaˇ va la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ te luˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ gu chehˇ leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ ca te luˬ la piˇ tuˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo ngaˬ lehˬ ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ yehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hkʼe oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw, shu mawˇ hkʼawˇ leh shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ leh a shu yawˇ ve gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca hpoˆ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍvenˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve Ngaˇ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo chaw kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo poˆ hkoˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui venˇ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ teˇ tawn lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ faiˇ teˇ maˬ yuˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw ca toˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ te chehˇ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha te‸ chiˉ maˇ te laˇ taˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ mehˉ kʼai shonˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ti chehˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa dawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ha‸ hanˉ jaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ dawˇ maˇ tawˆ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ ve awˬ nyi, moˬ fiˆ moˬ hoˆ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ leh,
ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ behˬ heh ma gʼaˇ hte‸ meuˆ chehˇ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ gaˬ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ ca htaˇ shoˆ toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te ya‸ jaˇ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui ve awˬ suhˍ lehˬ iˉ kaˆ hkʼa shuˍ ngeuˍ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ to teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ lo kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yawˇ awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ nawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, kʼaw‸ nawˇ la-o.
Suhˉ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ nawˬ hui maˇ ho-eˍ kʼai sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, kʼaw‸ nawˇ la-o.

Nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la htaˇ, Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ naˍ, maˇ shiˍ.

Gaˍsaˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍshaˍdawˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ shu gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo cawˬ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaˆ caˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca lo‸ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo hawˉ leh, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ca lo‸ zuh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Mawˇbaˆ leh Aˍmonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ve te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, Mawˇbaˆ leh Aˍmonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai leh, aˉ leh‸ miˬ kʼoˍ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa biˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mawˇbaˆ leh Aˍmonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve pa taw, chi hkʼe ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.
Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh Aˍsuˇriˆ chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, to nuˇ to shaˆ leh ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve zuh‸ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Hkawˍ tawehˍ leh aˉ naˆ kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ yehˬ hkʼoˆ lo mui taˍ leh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ shu hpaˆ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ ceh gʼaˇ va leh nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, chi hkʼe te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ dawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpanˍ kʼai ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kawˆ jaˇ leh hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo jiˆ kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ maˇ va.

Venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kuˬ toˇ chehˇ ve laˇ caˬ shiˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve heh hpuiˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ leh awˬ mu‸ ku teˇ maˬ hta‸ ka‸ mvuhˇ htiˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ teh taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ te leh, ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh da‸ ve hteˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ shawˉ le le yawˇ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tcuhˉ taˍ leh ya‸ taw hkawˇ maˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ hui ve venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ venˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ leh, ya‸ kʼaw hkʼoˆ lo gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ leh, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ leunˇ taˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ haiˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ law taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ tu leh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ law taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ ma kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leh‸ nyi tcuh tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ. Nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve hkʼaw ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ pui leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ pui la tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ vuiˇ jaˇ ve Ehˇtaˍyawˇpiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ geh lo tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ yuˬ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve htawˇ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, caˆ muiˬ leh nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve da‸ kehˬ ve hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh nyi ma nuˇnuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Cawˬ taˉ sheˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu hta‸ maˇ ya‸ puiˉ leh shu hta‸ heˍ caˇ puiˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la leh, gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ kawˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ peuˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ kawˆ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Ziˉonˍ venˇ-oˬ, taˇ kawˆ. Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ deu lehˍ taˇ hpehˇ ce taˍ, teh‸ shu Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ geh chehˇ taˍ leh, nawˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ leh, Yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hta‸ pa taw Yawˇ ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te mehˉ peuˬ leh, nawˬ geh cawˬ ve maˇ nyi sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkui kʼaw‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la piˇ leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ chehˇ taˍ ve nawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, ngaˬ te laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ htawˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ teˇ maˬ awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Shaˍteˍlaˆ ve yaˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ leh Yawˇzaˍdehˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˇ, jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˍ ve le.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ mawˬ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui caˬ maˇ maˇ ti taˍ ve htawˇ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa gʼeu‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˍ gʼa caˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ gʼa dawˬ chehˇ ve htawˇ, dawˬ maˇ law‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui veu‸ kʼaˇ gʼa veu‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, kaˆ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˇ maˇ law‸ dawˬ maˇ law‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ mawˬ laˇ.
Chi beu‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo kʼai leh suhˆ yuˬ veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon yehˬ hta‸ gu te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ ha lehˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh, oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ caˬ shiˍ maˇ maˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui caˬ shiˍ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ caˬ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo pfuhˇ keu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, caˬ shiˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ meuˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ da‸ la tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ baˬ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ yeˬ la maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve ti mi, a pehˉ meuˇ hko, shaˍ lonˍ hko, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ hui ti taˍ hkʼa taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, Yawˇsuˆ leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te tcuh ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Haˆgehˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ ve jawˇmawˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ leh shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬve hta‸ nyi ma oˇ hkʼe cawˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ gu ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe tanˬ gu ve lehˬ, Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa hkʼaw‸ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkʼaw‸ ha pa suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ nyiˇ chi teˇ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ sheˍ le. Chi beu‸ bon yehˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ kʼai peuˬ le. Chi beu‸ bon yehˬ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nyi ma taˇ luˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tanˬ gu-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw taˇ kawˆ.
Maˇ maw maw ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ, mvuhˇ naw leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, ngaˬ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve hpu shi teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo yuˬ laˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw biˇ sheˆ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve hpu shi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve deˇ deˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ tanˬ gu chehˇ ve bon yehˬ chi lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ve bon yehˬ awˬ piˍ teˇ maˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ nyi sha jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo ngaˬ leh, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ leh, Yawˇ hui hta‸ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ tcuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Haˆgehˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ na nyi-o.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ tuˬ ve shaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼaw hawˆ htiˆ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ, te meh taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ, shaˍ lonˍ chu, maˇ heˆ kʼo, caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ daw‸ ve kʼo, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ ve laˇ teh‸ ca na nyi-o, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ca na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Te maˇ gʼa taˬ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Haˆgehˇ lehˬ, Hkʼe kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ suh taˍ ve awˬ to hta‸ ca htawˇ heuˆ ve pa taw yawˇ awˬ to cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ve kʼo, caˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai ve laˇ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ kʼai tehˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Haˆgehˇ lehˬ, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le, leh yaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ cha‸ chiˆ kʼai peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ mawˬ laˇ. Nawˬ hui bon yehˬ hta‸ maˇ tanˬ gu sheˍ htaˇ,

nawˬ hui ve ti mi lo kʼai leh, caˬ shiˍ nyiˇ chi taˆ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui caˬ shiˍ teˇ chi taˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ lo, a peuˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ ngaˇ chi punˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˇ chi punˇ tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ti taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ti taˍ ve awˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ taˆ piˇ lawˬ leh vaˇ shiˍ ce la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ.

Chi beu‸ ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ nawˬ hui bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tanˬ kawˍ gʼa taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ law nyi taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui geh caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ te, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ, aˉ ci ku cehˬ, leh shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ la sheˍ ve htawˇ, chi beu hta‸ tanˬ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ha pa 24 nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha Haˆgehˇ hta‸ tawˇ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ leh mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ chi beu‸ hiˆ piˇ leh,

mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ leh iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ gʼa‸ paˍ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hpfuhˆ baˬ piˇ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ Zeˍruˇbaˍbeˍlaˆ nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo uˉ peunˍ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Paˇshaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍ ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa hiˉ maˬ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ tcuh kaˍ paˍ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Zaˍhkaˍriˆ lehˬ, Iˉdawˇ ve awˬ hawehˍ, Baˍraˍhkiˆ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca hto piˇ tuˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hkʼe taˇ te. Aˬ sho-eˬ ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.
Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ suh kʼai peuˬ.

Ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, ciˍ yanˍ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Daˍriˆ jawˇmawˇ te ve nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa teˇ chi teˇ maˬ, nyiˇ chi awˇ nyi htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ awˬ ha hkʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hkʼoˆ ciˇ taˍ leh, lawˬ hkʼo‸ hkʼaw cawˬ ve suhˉ veˆ de hkʼaw lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ lo, nyiˉ-ehˍ, hpuˉ-ehˍ, ga‸-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma te tuˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hta‸ ca chaˬ nyi tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ iˉ mvuhˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Iˉ mvuhˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ chi hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo gaˬ taˉ peuˬ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ jaˇ leh, gawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nyi ma sha tuˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, shu hta‸ ca kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mehˉ kʼai tuˬ te chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ tu‸ hkanˍ tuˬ te piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, venˇ hta‸ htawˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ uiˍ la da‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ leh, venˇ chi hta‸ yawˇ ve venˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ ha teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ nuˇ hkaw awˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ hkaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, hta tu yuˬ taˍ ve kanˉ te paˍ awˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma ca te la ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ laˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve awˬ ha teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, tehˆ nyi tuˬ ve suhˆ taˬ teˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai toˇ ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma zuhˬ, hkʼaˬ ma kʼehˬ ve hta‸ ca tehˆ nyi tuˬ kʼai toˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve geh awˬ nu ve mvuhˇ naw tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tehˆ nyi tuˬ suhˆ taˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw oˇ ve geh haˆ kʼai leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chaw yaˇ leh ceˇ caˬ cawˬ la maˇ jaˇ tuˬ ve pa taw, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw ca chehˇ maˇ daw taˬ. Lanˇ venˇ hta‸ htawˇ ca ko maˇ zuhˇ taˬ, teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ yuˬ leh ko taˍ ve lanˇ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui-oˬ, chi beu‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai tuˬ te piˇ ve chaw hui geh ngaˬ hta‸ kʼai peu laˇ leh chi hkʼe ca kʼoˆ piˇ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hta‸ ca ya‸ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ ya‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha awˬ to nawˬ hui hta‸ ma‸ bawˆ leh, teˇ pawˆ htaˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ te jaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ leh kʼa muiˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la kʼo, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh laˬ leh, Yawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui geh Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬve Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ jaˇ ve venˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo tawˆ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nu ve awˬ ha teˇ maˬ hkʼaw Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ ngaˬ hta‸ maw laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo huˉ taˍ leh, Saˍtanˍ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ Saˍtanˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Saˍtanˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ha‸ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw chi hpaˇ lehˬ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh hkʼaw yuˬ tawˆ taˍ ve suhˆ taˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Chaw chi hpaˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ lehˬ, Chi beu‸ nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ. Nawˬ veu‸ deh tuˬ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇsuˆ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ da‸ jaˇ ve uˉ nyiˉ teˇ maˬ yuˬ nyiˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ teˇ hkʼoˆ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ te tcuh taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw awˬ hoˉ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chehˇ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ-oˬ, na sheˍ. Yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, na taˍ sheˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇsuˆ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ ceˍ suhˍ ceˍ cawˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ teˇ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ li‸ mehˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw cawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko, maˉ nawˆ hko hkʼaw lo gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ jaw ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hta‸ ca nawˍ la leh,

Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa mawˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Shi te taˍ ve aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, naˍ manˇ keu taˍ ve kawˆ teˇ maˬ leh, kawˆ faiˇ suhˍ maˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ lo shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ teˇ paˉ teˇ cehˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh, Nawˬ maˇ shiˍ laˇ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-o, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Kawˆ faiˇ oˇ ve suhˍ maˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo mawˬ hpeh‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve mehˆ shiˍ suhˍ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la da‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ moˍ ma‸ cuˇ ve awˬ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ hta‸ pa taw ka‸ maˇ heˆ.

Haˍ jaˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ haˉ pui shiˍ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ chiˇ kawˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Bon yehˬ chi hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ ve le, teh‸ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpoˆ kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ maw maw bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te peuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai peu taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ hta‸ haˆ haˆ te maˇ peuˬ puiˉ ve pa taw, nyi ma luˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Zeˍruˆbaˍbeˍlaˆ awˬ hoˉ te leh bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Aˬ miˍ tuˉ teh kuiˬ teˇ paˉ teˇ maˬ lo cawˬ ve shaˍ lonˍ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le.
Naˍ manˇ ngeuˍ tawˆ kuiˬ, shi te taˍ ve naˍ manˇ caˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve shaˍ lonˍ kʼaˉ oˇ ve nyiˇ maˬ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ, teh‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ,
yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ leh naˍ manˇ pfuhˍ piˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ nyi leh, mvuhˇ hpe lo poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve li‸ kʼoˆ teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ lawn mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Zuhˬ hpawˇ nyiˇ chi shaw‸, kʼehˬ hpawˇ teˇ chi shaw‸ cawˬ ve li‸ kʼoˆ teˇ maˬ poˬ toˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ hkeu piˇ tuˬ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, li‸ kʼoˆ chi hkʼaw bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Li‸ kʼoˆ chi ve teˇ hpawˇ lo, Chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ paˉ hpawˇ lo, Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkeu ve tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh leh, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve yehˬ leh, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Hkeu ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la leh, Chi beu‸ laˬ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ chiˇ nyi-o, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi ve aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi lehˬ hkʼawˍ lawˇ teˇ maˬ hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼawˍ lawˇ chi ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, geu‸ law yuˬ te taˍ ve awˬ hoˆ teˇ maˬ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hoˆ oˇ ve yehˬ baˬ sheˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ mui chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ chi lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ jaˇ ve hta‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ ca‸ keu leh, awˬ hoˆ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ chiˇ nyi leh, ngaˆ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ geh poˬ laˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ chiˇ veu leh poˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo yuˬ kʼai ve le, teh‸ ngaˬ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yuˬ kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ te peuˬ ve kʼo hkʼawˍ lawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo teh taˍ leh, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve aw ha teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ pawˆ, kuiˇ te taˍ ve hkʼaw pui nyiˇ maˬ awˬ kaˍ lo iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ awˇ maˬ tawˆ la chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ lehˬ, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ maˬ lehˬ naˆ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ shehˆ maˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ hpuˉ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ leh, awˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ lehˬ ga‸-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ le, teh‸ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇ haw awˇ maˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ la taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Naˆ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ venˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Hpuˉ-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai leh, ga‸-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo ya‸-e ve yoˬ.

Ga‸-ehˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ ca chaˬ nyi gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ hta‸ ca chaˬ nyi tuˬ tawˆ kʼai loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpeh kʼai ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve Heˍlaˍdehˇ, Tawˇbiˇyaˆ, leh Yeˍdaˍyaˆ hui tanˇ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, Zeˍhpaˍniˆ ve yaˇ Yawˇsuˆ ve yehˬ lo kʼai-o. Chaw chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tanˇ laˇ taˍ ve hpu shi oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, shi uˉ tcuhˍ teˇ maˬ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhawˇyaˍdaˆ ve yaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ Yawˇsuˆ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ kʼaˉ le‸ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ uiˍ la da‸ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ bon yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te leh, jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kʼaw jaw awˬ paˇ lo, paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ geh kanˉ te kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Shi uˉ tcuhˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Heˍlaˍdehˇ, Tawˇbiˇyaˆ, Yeˍdaˍyaˆ leh Yawˇshiˆ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ teˇ geh hpoˆ laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ ga hpoˆ te la tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ gu te chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Daˍriˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ hkʼaw‸, ha pa kʼawˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ, awˇ nyi teˇ nyi htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Beˍteˍlaˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha geh bon lawˬ laˇ tuˬ, Shaˍreˍzaˍ, Reˍgeˍmaˍlehˆ leh yawˇ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui gaˬ la leh, paw hkuˇ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe na nyi ve yoˬ. Bon yehˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui te jaw ve hkʼe, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ gaˬ la htaˇ ngaˬ hui dawˇ haˍ leh caˇ tuˬ gʼa ce tuˬ sheˍ laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ ngaˬ geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Ponˬ laˬ peuˬ ve suhˍ chi hkʼaw‸ awˬ yanˇ hkʼaw nawˬ hui lehˬ, ha pa ngaˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ leh suhˍ maˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ dawˇ haˍ leh caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui caˇ ve dawˬ ve lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ awˬ pon ceh te chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ peuˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ chi ve hkʼa shuˍ kʼoˆ piˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ paw sha jaˇ leh, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw chaw hkʼa biˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ awˬ na, hkʼaw hkuiˉ puiˍ lo hkʼa gaˬ chaw chehˇ biˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw suhˉ jehˬ piˇ leh, awˬ chawˇ chawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ha kʼaˉ da‸-o‸.

Mehˇchawˇma, yaˇcuˬshi, haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw leh nawˬ hui geh ca chehˇ la taˍ ve hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa fawˉ mehˍ piˇ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ naˬ tuˬ taˇ te da‸, teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ heh la piˇ leh, aˬ sho-eˬ ngaˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ tawˇ yaw piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ na yuˬ piˇ.
Mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ hkʼa shuˍ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
