Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, venˇ chi hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu piˇ leh yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve ngaˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ la leh, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve venˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve hkʼaw pui teh‸ kʼaw‸ meh tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ chi hkʼaw lo chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mawˇ jaˇ peuˬ ve pa taw juˇ fuiˍ htawˆ toˇ leh, venˇ hkʼaw lo mui chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa biˇ leˍ guiˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ dawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ pon maˇ hpeh‸ la gʼa ve kanˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh,

yawˇ hui hta‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼaw yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Bon yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ kawˍ ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi beu‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ kaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve maˇ gaˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ shu geh ceˇ caˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ca ngaˍ maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ canˇ paˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw ponˬ maˇ gʼa. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ te piˇ-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, gawˬ lehˍ ve hkʼaw gʼa kʼaw‸ muiˬ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve a pehˉ meuˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ shiˍ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la leh, miˬguiˬ lehˬ awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu maˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ htawˇ maˇ maˇ laˬ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ chi hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hkeu piˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve tu‸ hkanˍ dawˇ haˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ jaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ leh awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼe nawˬ hui htawˇ da‸ ve awˬ bon gʼa piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw taˇ kawˆ. Ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ kawˆ tuˬ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ awˬ ceuˬ gaˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ chi beu‸ Yuˇda‸ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ na‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gu taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw taˇ kawˆ.

Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te loˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ tiˉ yaw da‸-o‸. Shaˉ nanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ tiˉ te leh, gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ.
Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ naˬ tuˬ taˇ te da‸. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ taˇ hkanˍ. Ngaˬ lehˬ heˍ ve tawˇ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve kanˉ, leh nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha Zaˍhkaˍriˆ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˇ ha pa, ngaˇ ha pa, suhˍ ha pa, leh teˇ chi ha pa htaˇ caˇ tuˬ ce leh te chehˇ ve pawehˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ pon ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pawehˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh dawˇ sha gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Venˇ lonˉ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Venˇ teˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ nu teˇ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hta‸, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui leh Yawˇ geh bon ca lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui geh kʼai-a veuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ kuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh Yawˇ geh bon lawˬ tuˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ geh laˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui geh kʼai gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Haˍdaˍrehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Suˇriˆ venˇ lonˉ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Haˍdaˍrehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ miˬ tcuhˉ kʼaw da‸ taˍ ve Haˍmaˍtaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇruˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yeˬ jaˇ ve ta‸ yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ te taˍ leh, hpu shi shaw hpoˆ taˍ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ geh hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw baˬ keu leh, venˇ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ, chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh kawˆ jaˇ tuˬ ve yoˬ. Gaˍsaˍ venˇ htawˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇkaˍronˍ venˇ lehˬ dawˇ law kuiˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gaˍsaˍ venˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ mehˉ kʼai leh, Aˍshaˆkeˍlonˍ venˇ lehˬ gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Aˍshoˆ venˇ hkʼaw chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ ca chehˇ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve Hpiˇliˇtiˆ chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyiˉ ya‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ hta‸ awˬ shaˍ geh teˇ geh gʼa kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ caˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. A sha‸ te‸ chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la leh, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Eˇkaˍronˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ Yeˍbuˇsiˆ chaw hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ ve chaw kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo gʼa kʼaw‸ hpanˍ toˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, ngaˬ ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ ha lehˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo piˉ laˬ ehˉ hta‸ ciˇ laˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ lawˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ kuiˬ lo yehˇ ve hkaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te luˬ te sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve jawˇmawˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ choˬ paˉ lo te leh oˇ paˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Uˉhpaˍraˆ iˉ kaˇ lawˬ hta‸ te leh miˬguiˬ awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ suhˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ taˍ ve pa taw, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve iˉ kaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ dawˇ law kuiˬ kʼaw‸ cawˬ la peuˬ ve nawˬ hui shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui-oˬ, gawˬ lehˍ cawˬ ve nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ la-o. Nawˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve awˬ tan, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon nyiˇ pun kʼaw‸ na‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ hta‸ ma‸ yaˇ ve hkaˆ hkʼa shuˍ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ hta‸ hkaˆ ce hkʼa shuˍ kʼaw‸ yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Heˍlaˍshaˆ chaw hui hta‸ bawˆ da‸ tuˬ Ziˉonˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˉhtaw hkʼa shuˍ ngaˬ yehˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ ve hkaˆ ce hta‸ bawˆ peu tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ behˬ heh ma hkawˇ bvuhˬ tawˆ la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ lonˉ geh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo taˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ma‸ bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui lehˬ, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ kuˬ toˇ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ sheˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngeuˍ pfuhˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve yawˬ hta‸ kawˆ kuiˬ dawˇ haˍ kuiˬ hkʼaw ponˬ piˇ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve shehnˉ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw awˬ gʼeuˆ ba chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha leh, hkʼaˬ ma da‸ jaˇ tuˬ ve le. Chaw haˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˬ shiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ htaˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve ti mi nawˉ lehˍ cawˬ la tuˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ leh mawˉ paˍ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ lawˬ maˇ gʼa. Zuh‸ maˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ yuˬ tawˆ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw sheh ya‸ leh, yawˇ hui piˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ htawˇ te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa shuˍ hpaw toˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hoˉ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw tu‸ hkanˍ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ hoˉ awˬ naˬ teˇ hpaˍ, leh ma‸ poˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ma‸ bawˆ gʼaˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ je‸ nehˆ hkʼaw naˆ tiˆ piˇ ve hkʼe, Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui bawˆ gʼaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ aˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼaw‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ chiˇ baˬ jaw sheˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ leh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kuˬ hpawnˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe kʼaw‸ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaw lo hpaˆ da‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa gaˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui leh yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve yehˬ lo teˇ geh kʼaw‸ hpoˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Eˇjiˇtu‸ leh Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Giˇlaˆ leh Leˍbaˍnonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ chehˇ tcuh piˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo hpanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ leh Niˍlaˆ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ fiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Aˍsuˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ nyiˉ ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Leˍbaˍnonˍ hkʼaw-oˬ, nawˬ ve htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ piˇ tuˬ nawˬ ve yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hpaw piˇ-oˆ.

Yawnˉ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, htawˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ paiˍ peuˬ ve pa taw, paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve suhˆ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ. Baˍshanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve maˉ kuˇ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteunˍ lonˉ lehˬ htu baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ. Yawˇdanˍ iˉ kaˆ lawˬ paˇ lo cawˬ ve hteunˍ lonˉ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve pa taw, laˇ caˬ shiˉ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ chehˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na sheˍ.
Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Shu tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼe te chehˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ. Yawˇ hui shaˍ hawˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Ngaˬ hui paw sha la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ.

(Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸, yawˇ hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ hawˇ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ ngaˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ lehˬ, tiˇ pehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ juˇ fuiˍ taˬ nyiˇ maˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Juˇ fuiˍ taˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve teh‸ meh piˇ leh awˬ nu ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve teh‸ meh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ha‸ shaˉ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ canˇ ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ shehˆ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, teˇ ha pa awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ ngaˬ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ yawˬ awˬ moˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh-e cawˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ suh-e piˇ-oˆ. Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai cawˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai piˇ-oˆ. Cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkeh hta‸ teˇ hkeh te luˬ te sheˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ Nyi ma cawˇ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ taˬ hta‸ awˉ hteh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ka ti‸ oˇ ve luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ hawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ te maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh tawˇ yaw laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ pe‸ laˇ-oˇ. Nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve kʼo te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ shehˆ chi hteh‸ piˇ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ shehˆ chi hteh‸ ceh tiˉ hpfuhˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca keu taˍ-o‸, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ lehˬ hpu oˇ ve shehˆ chi hteh‸ hta‸ yuˬ leh, bon yehˬ hkʼaw ca keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ lehˬ Cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve suhˆ taˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ awˉ hteh leh, Yuˇda‸ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hkʼe teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te-o. Chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ lehˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yawˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa‸ ca. Naˬ chehˇ ve yawˬ hta‸ naˆ tsuhˇ maˇ gu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ caˍ maˇ taw piˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ chu jaˇ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ caˇ leh yawˇ hui ve hkui kiˆ hta‸ hkʼeh‸ baˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ lehˬ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ma‸ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ lehˬ te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ gʼawˇ goˇ kʼai leh, yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ mehˆ shiˍ cuˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ te hpanˍ leh chaw yaˇ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,

Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ keu taˍ ve kawˆ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ dawˬ leh, tzuhˬ bvuhˆ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh te toˇ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ yuˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve awˬ nu ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, shu bawˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ hawˇ jaˇ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ ca chiˇ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼa naˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ pawnˇ da‸ leh venˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ piˇ lawˬ leh, iˉ mvuhˇ ciˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mehˆ cuˉ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteunˍ lonˉ leh caˬ meh taˍ ve ti mi hta‸ to‸ baˬ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ a‸ kehˉ maˇ gʼa uiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Daˍviˆ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leh mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ leh bon lawˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui juˆ pehˍ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ nyi taˍ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yaˇ suh-e leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui chaw oˇ ve awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ uiˍ suh-e leh dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ, yawˇ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, Mehˆgiˇdoˍ miˬ tawˬ kuiˬ lo chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Haˍdaˆriˆmonˍ gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ ve hkʼe taw awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ maˬ le le htawˇ, kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Naˍtanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yehˬ shehˍ ma teˇ gʼaˇ le le htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yehˬ shehˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ, Sheˍmiˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yehˬ shehˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ nu ve yehˬ kʼa teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ paˆ hawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ maˬ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw cawˬ ve shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ yuˬ baˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˬ meh oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ yuˬ baˬ leh, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui gaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ baˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ taˍ ve ka‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ te gaˇ ve chaw cawˬ sheˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e lehˬ, Nawˬ gʼa suh tuˬyoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, heˍ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ yaw ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa juˆ pehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼaˬve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ha hta‸ pa taw caˆ muiˬ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ te tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ Ngaˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ muiˬ caˇ paˍ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ teˇ co-e muiˬ caˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ tiˉ te laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Hkʼe te kʼo, nawˬ ve nyi ma pui hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ oˇ ve aˬ hto‸ ma le, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi piˇ ve kʼo, Awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ shu ve yehˬ hkʼaw gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Aˉhtaw-oˬ, tu la leh ngaˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˬ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh,
mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ngaˬ ve chaw shehˆ pun nyiˇ pun suh-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Hpu lehˬ aˬ miˍ hta‸ pa taw da‸ kehˬ la ve hkʼe, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw shehˆ pun teˇ pun ve hta‸ ngaˬ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Shi hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh bon lawˬ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ leh, ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, te luˬ te sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ yawˇ hui hiˉ yuˬ gʼa taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˬ lo pehˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ chi hta‸ shu bawˆ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu taˆ hpfuhˆ leh, yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ shu hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ yaˇ teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, shu ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo gʼa ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼe canˇ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ huˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw pui lehˬ, nyiˇ hkoˇ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, awˬ kaˍ lo lawˬ hkʼo‸ lonˉ teˇ maˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui oˇ ve teˇ hkoˇ baˉ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo jiˆ taˆ-e leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkoˇ baˉ lehˬ awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo jiˆ ya‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, lawˬ hkʼo‸ chi hkʼaw gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Awˇziˆ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬ hiˆ jaˇ leh nawˬ puˍ nawˬ pi hui gʼuiˇ hpaw-e ve hkʼe nawˬ hui gʼa gʼuiˇ hpaw-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ leh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, kaˆ ve leh a ngeu kʼa ve maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Naˆ ho‸ ve htawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ. Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ htaˇ htawˇ, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba lehˍ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, gawˬ da‸ jaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Iˉ kaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ, Suh ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ hkoˇ lehˬ Awˬ kʼaw ji ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ na hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Geˍbaˍ venˇ hta‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ lo cawˬ ve Riˇmonˍ venˇ lo hkʼa gaˬ, hpiˬ lehˍ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ mvuh ve venˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Beˍyaˍmenˍ taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ hta‸ te leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ cawˬ jaw ve awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ ve taˍ meu‸ hpe‸ lo hkʼa gaˬ, Haˍnaˍneˍ ta‸ yehˬ hta‸ te leh jawˇmawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ nyiˉ kuiˬ lo hkʼa gaˬ, uiˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ oˇ ve hkʼaw gawˬ lehˍ gʼa chehˇ leh, luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hpuˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼoˆ lo Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ shaˍ, mehˆ shiˍ leh ha tehˍ htawˇ kuiˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ nawˇ maˇ hteh hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˇ pehˍ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ, ma‸ bawˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve hpu shi leh veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ ve naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, iˉ mvuhˇ, lawˍ, kaˍlaˍoˆ, piˉlaˬ leh canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve ceˇ caˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ hta‸ ca bawˆ la ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ shonˇ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui leh aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ maˇ ca pui ve kʼo, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼai ve kʼo, maˇ kʼai ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ ve naˬ beuˬ oˇ ve, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, aˉ po kʼo pawehˇ te kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼai ve Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw leh awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, iˉ mvuhˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pfuhˍ piˇ taˍ ve ju lu caˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ taˍ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve li‸ mehˆ htawˆ bvuh‸ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Bon yehˬ hkʼaw teh taˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo teh taˍ ve kawˆ hkʼa shuˍ, da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw hkʼa cawˬ ve muˬ hkʼu teˇ maˬ le le lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ ca pui htaˇ yehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon hkʼa deh‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh tanˇ taˍ ve shaˍ keu caˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw lo tanˇ kaˬ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Chi lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, Maˍlaˍhkiˆ geh gaˬ la ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve le, teh‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsawˇ leh Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Yaˍ koˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ leh,

Iˉsawˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ leh, to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Eˇdonˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ gu te gaˇ ve kʼo kʼaw‸ gu te-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸, haiˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha co co taiˍ taiˍ nyi ma zuhˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ shiˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nu ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ pa hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh, awˬ ceˬ lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ taˍ uiˍ ve le. Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ leh, Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chiˇ baˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ cha‸ chiˆ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo tuˉ tanˇ leh, Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ shaˍ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mehˆ cuˉ ve, naˬ chehˇ ve, hkui hteh ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ laˇ ve chi, cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve jawˇmawˇ hta‸, chi hkʼe ve to nuˇ to shaˆ ca yuˬ piˇ hkʼa nyi. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ ve laˇ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ bon na‸ laˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hui ve bon lawˬ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve aˬ miˍ maˇ gʼa ca tuˉ tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, bon yehˬ ve yehˬ miˉ hta‸ ngaˬ ca hoˆ tcuh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma maˇ cawˇ. Ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼaˬ ti chi ti lo chehˇ ve chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ sha hawnˉ tuˉ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ tanˇ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ taˍ uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ chi te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, nawˬ hui baˬ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo tuˉ tanˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui kanˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te ve hkʼaˬ ma hkeu‸ jaˇ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼawˇ yuˬ veu laˇ ve, hkui hteh ve, leh naˬ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve yoˬ. Tuˉ tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve laˇ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ piˇ laˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te taˍ ve da‸ jaˇ ve yawˬ ehˉ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve htawˇ, heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo cha‸ chiˆ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh ngaˬ hta‸ ca tuˉ tanˇ la ve chaw lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui na yuˬ leh te cawˇ ve kanˉ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui te ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ gʼa chehˇ ve da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hkeu piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ ka‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hkeu piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ awˬ hkʼehˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ shehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui hta‸ nuˇ hkʼehˇ hpoˆ taˍ kuiˬ lo gʼawˬ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Leˍviˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ maˇ gʼa luˬ kʼai tuˬ, tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ la tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law leh, a sha‸ te‸ ve leh gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ka ti‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˆ yan chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te leh, haiˬ ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve kanˉ lehˬ, shu hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui geh kʼai leh ca henˇ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi beu‸ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ hui maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te hpanˍ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe yoˬ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ te da‸ taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te chehˇ ve le.

Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ te taˍ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ te luˬ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve bon yehˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ nu ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heuˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve kanˉ awˬ nu ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ leh yawˇ ve tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ mehˆ gʼuiˬ nehˆ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ htaˇ ka‸ heuˆ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ maˇ yeˬ ve pa taw yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka ti‸ te taˍ peuˬ ve htawˇ, ka ti‸ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ te luˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ suhˍ teˇ shaˍ tiˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ dawˇ law leh chi hkʼe te laˇ taˍ ve le. Nawˬ hui yaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ baˬ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe te piˇ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, a shu yawˇ gʼa heuˆ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸, teh‸ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui yaw ve tawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼaˇ heuˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼaˇ heuˬ piˇ lawˬ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, haiˬ ve kanˉ te ve chaw hta‸ da‸ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hkʼaˬ lo le, teh‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui na nyi chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ca chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yawˇ ve bon yehˬ hkʼaw laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yawˇ laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ hkanˍ gʼa tuˬ le. Yawˇ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, a shu te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yawˇ lehˬ hpu hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve aˬ miˍ leh, da‸ jaˇ ve sha pehˍ hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ hpu hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve ca liˉ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpu leh shi hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ lehˬ paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ yawˇ hui te jaw ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha geh yuˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Faˍ te ve chaw, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw, shu hta‸ kanˉ te tcuh leh gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ piˇ ve chaw, mehˇchawˇma, yaˇcuˬshi leh hkehˉ chaw hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve chaw, leh ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ maˇ htaiˍ maˇ pa puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Ngaˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi shaˍ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve cawˇ-aw laˇ. Maˇ cawˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te heˍ caˇ ve le, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ na nyi laˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ leh, hpu tanˇ keu kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ chi pun teˇ pun tanˇ tuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ bon yehˬ lo yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, bon yehˬ hkʼaw caˇ tuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi gaˇ ve kʼo lawˇ nyi-o. Ngaˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma yehˬ miˉ hpaw leh, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ hkʼa biˇ ya‸ la piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve caˬ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ pfuhˇ ma caˇ tcuh tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve hko hkʼaw lo htawˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hkʼa biˇ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ da‸ jaˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, awˬ nu ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸, Awˬ bon uiˍ ve chaw, teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve le, teh‸ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn Yawˇ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma tcuhˉ kuiˬ cawˬ ve le.

Ha lehˬ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ uiˍ la da‸ la chehˇ ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ka‸ lawˇ nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te piˇ mawˬ, teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo, yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˆ yan ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh bvuh‸ keu taˍ ve caˇ lanˇ li‸ kʼoˆ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw leh maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw, hkʼaˬ ma peun da‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Caˆ muiˬ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi gʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve gaˬ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cawˬ taˉ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ lo, ngaˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve kanˇ paˆ mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ tawˆ la leh, mvuhˇ nyi gʼeuˆ hkʼa shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ nuˇ hkawˆ hkʼaw hpehˇ tawˆ-e piˇ ve nuˇ yehˇ hkʼa shuˍ, gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve hkui sheh hawˉ lo cawˬ ve je‸ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ na yuˬ tuˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬve awˬ ceˬ paˍ Moˉseˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ nyi maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ pa leh awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, ngaˬ laˬ leh nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ te luˬ te sheˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ chi lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ leh Daˍviˆ ve awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ ya‸ la ve awˬ lawn bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Iˉcaˆ yoˬ. Iˉcaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma Taˍmaˍ lo paw la ve Hpaˍrehˆ leh Seˍraˆ yoˬ. Hpaˍrehˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Heˍsaˍronˍ yoˬ. Heˍsaˍronˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍranˍ yoˬ. Aˍranˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ yoˬ. Aˍmiˆnaˍdaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Naˍsonˍ yoˬ. Naˍsonˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Saˍlaˍmonˍ yoˬ. Saˍlaˍmonˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma Raˍhkaˆ lo paw la ve Bawˇzaˆ yoˬ. Bawˇzaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma Ruˉhtaˆ lo paw la ve Awˇbehˆ yoˬ. Awˇbehˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yeˍsehˇ yoˬ. Yeˍsehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ Daˍviˆ yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, Uˇriˇya‸ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ jaw ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lo paw la ve Sawˉla‸monˍ yoˬ. Sawˉla‸monˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Rawˇbaoˍ yoˬ. Rawˇbaoˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍbiˉya‸ yoˬ. Aˍbiˉya‸ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍsaˆ yoˬ. Aˍsaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yawˇsaˍhpaˆ yoˬ. Yawˇsaˍhpaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yaˍhawˇranˍ yoˬ. Yaˍhawˇranˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Awˇsiˆ yoˬ. Awˇsiˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yoˇtanˍ yoˬ. Yoˇtanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍhkaˆ yoˬ, Aˍhkaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Heˍsaˍkiˆ yoˬ. Heˍsaˍkiˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Maˍnaˍseˍ yoˬ. Maˍnaˍseˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍmonˍ yoˬ. Aˍmonˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yoˇsiˆ yoˬ. Yoˇsiˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai ve teˇ co-e htaˇ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui yoˬ.

Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yawˇ hui hta‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍhkawˇniˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Saˍlaˍteˍlaˆ yoˬ. Saˍlaˍteˍlaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Seˍruˇbeˍlaˆ yoˬ. Seˍruˇbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍbiˉoˆ yoˬ. Aˍbiˉoˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍkenˍ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍkenˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍcawˍ yoˬ. Aˍcawˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Saˍdoˆ yoˬ. Saˍdoˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Aˍhkeˍ yoˬ. Aˍhkeˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Eˇliˍoˆ yoˬ. Eˇliˍoˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Eˇlaˍsaˍ yoˬ. Eˇlaˍsaˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Maˍhtanˍ yoˬ. Maˍhtanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ Yaˍkoˆ yoˬ. Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ yaˇ lehˬ, Maˍriˆ ve awˬ hpawˇ Yoˇseh‸ yoˬ. Maˍriˆ lehˬ Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ tanˬ leh Daˍviˆ ve awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ chi awˇ co-e cawˬ ve yoˬ. Daˍviˆ hta‸ tanˬ leh Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai ve awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ chi awˇ co-e cawˬ ve yoˬ. Baˍbuˍlonˍ mvuhˇ miˬ lo shu yuˬ kʼai ve hta‸ tanˬ leh Hkri‸ ve awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, teˇ chi awˇ co-e cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ paw la ve awˬ lawn lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e Maˍriˆ lehˬ, Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ ka ti‸ te da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ maˇ heuˆ da‸ sheˍ htaˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw Maˍriˆ yaˇ hu la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh Maˍriˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ maˇ luˬ piˇ gaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ ta‸ iˉ baˬ taˉ tuˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe dawˇ nyi chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, zuh‸ maˆ mawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ Yoˇseh‸-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ miˇ ma Maˍriˆ hta‸ heuˆ tuˬ taˇ dawˇ haˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ yaˇ hu ve lehˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Yawˇ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ leh, nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ teh‸ gʼa meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ. Yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ hu la leh yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ Eˇmaˍno-eˍlaˆ meh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Eˇmaˍno-eˍlaˆ kʼoˆ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)
Yoˇseh‸ zuh‸ nawˇ la htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ paˍ maˇ paw la sheˍ ve ceh ceh yawˇ geh maˇ zuh‸. Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve paw la leh yawˇ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ teh‸ meh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ Heˍroˆ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍ lehˍhehnˍvenˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ paw la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo tu la leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Paw la peuˬ ve Yuˇda‸ hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hkʼaˬ lo le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo yawˇ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui tuˬ ngaˬ hui laˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ Heˍroˆ tawˇ chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ka‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peuˍeˬ ka‸ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ lonˉ leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ kuˬ hpawnˬ peuˬ leh, Hkri‸ hkʼaˬ lo paw la tuˬ le teh‸, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw la tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe,

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, Yuˇda‸ jawˇmawˇ hui ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ i ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hta‸ sheh kʼai tuˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hui hta‸ ta‸ iˉ kuˬ yuˬ leh, meu‸ keu shiˍ tawˆ la ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui kʼai leh yaˇ paˍ ehˉ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ca nyi-o. Yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hto laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai leh, yaˇ paˍ ehˉ chehˇ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ htaˇ, jehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Meu‸ keu shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ maˇ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ, awˬ e Maˍriˆ geh yaˇ paˍ ehˉ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ hui boˆ sheˬ leh yaˇ paˍ ehˉ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yuˬ laˬ taˍ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, shi, lawˇbanˍ, leh muˇraˍ, la‸ shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ geh maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e tuˬ, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tu loˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo hpaw-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ ca tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇseh‸ tu leh, yaˇ ehˉ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ shiˍ veu leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la tuˬ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kuˬ yuˬ peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hui yawˇ hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve teh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na nyi peuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ yawˇ shawˍ nyi leh, Behˍlehˍhehnˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo leh awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo hkʼa chehˇ ve a sha‸ nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ te leh awˬ hawˉ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ paˍ ehˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ca tiˇ pehˍ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la ve yoˬ.

Raˍmaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Raˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw hawˬ chehˇ leh, yawˇ yaˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve pa taw, shu yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yoˇseh‸ Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ Yoˇseh‸ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Tu loˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ shiˍ veu leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ ca ve chaw hui suh peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tu leh, yaˇ ehˉ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍhkeˍlaˆ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ pa jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn Yoˇseh‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ kawˆ leh oˇ kaˬ lo kʼo‸-e maˇ haˆ. Zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ leh, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ kʼai leh, Naˍzaˍrehˆ meh ve venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ hta‸ Naˍzaˍrehˆ chaw kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ tawˆ la leh kʼoˆ ve,
Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ loˬ teh‸, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo yawˇ bon maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve lehˬ, Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu taˍ loˬ. Yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ te-o, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, Yoˇhanˬ awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ mvuh te taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, yawˇ ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo shaˍ guiˬ haˍ pi caˆ tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ lehˬ, paˉ ce‸ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw ve pehˇ gʼuiˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ paˇ awˬ kui hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ leh, Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ tuˬ Hpaˍriˍsehˇ leh Saˍduˆkehˇ chaw hui maˇ maˇ yawˇ geh laˬ ve hta‸ Yoˇhanˬ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Vuiˬ haiˬ awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, gaˬ la tuˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ ve le.
Venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la-o.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw taˇ ca dawˇ, taˇ ca kʼoˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ haˉ pui shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tawˆ la hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ka‸, suhˆ cehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lo ceˉ ceˇ teh taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ ve awˬ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ le le hta‸ htu baˬ leh aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve awˬ pon, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ hta‸ yuˬ shi tuˬ ve ceh ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ keunˍ. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo caˬ hpeuˇ tuˬ vawˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve caˬ jaw‸ kuiˬ hta‸ kehˬ lehˍ shiˆ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˬ shiˍ hta‸ caˬ ciˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shaw pfuhˇ keu tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˬ cuˉ hta‸ maˇ suh puiˉ ve aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yoˇhanˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw tawˆ la leh, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma lo Yoˇhanˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ geh baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ ve laˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˆ ve, Chi beu‸ a ciˉ te laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ liˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui te cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ peuˬ leh iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ cawˬ haˉ tawˆ la htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hpaw taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe ya‸ la leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo mui la ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ la leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi lehˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, neˇhaiˬ beˬ ve lawˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, awˇ chi nyi awˇ chi haˉ caˇ tuˬ maˇ caˇ leh chehˇ peuˬ heh‸, awˍ meu‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ beˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve kʼo, haˉ pui shiˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkaoˍmonˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Chaw yaˇ lehˬ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ gʼa te‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ pa taw gʼa te‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ neˇhaiˬ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ lo shiˍ kʼai leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ ve awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo yawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve kʼo, pawˆ ce hkʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve hkui sheh haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ taˆ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw teˇ kaˬ bvuh‸ taˍ sheˍ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa beˬ maˇ gʼa lawˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ neˇhaiˬ yawˇ hta‸ mvuh jaˇ ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo shiˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼa cawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ yawˇ hta‸ maw piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui laˇ ve kʼo, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Saˍtanˍ-oˬ, kʼai loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui leh, yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ nawˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ, teh‸ li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ neˇhaiˬ yawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai leh, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ shu hpeh yuˬ ve awˬ lawn Yeˍsuˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Naˍzaˍrehˆ venˇ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Zaˍbuˆlonˍ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo, gʼuiˬ po paˇ cawˬ ve Kaˍpeˍneˍonˍ venˇ hkʼaw gaˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Zaˍbuˆlonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Naˍtaˍliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma coˇ paˉ, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui chehˇ kuiˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ-oˬ,

naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ba jaˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Suh ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh suh ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ka‸ te leh, Yeˍsuˆ bon tanˬ maˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ loˬ teh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo Yeˍsuˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Peˍtruˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Siˉmonˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Anˍdrehˍ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi nyiˇ gʼaˇ, gʼuiˬ po awˬ hkʼaw lo geu‸ hpehˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˇ ca paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chaw ca shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ geu‸ hta‸ teh taˉ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼaw‸ kʼai htaˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi nyiˇ gʼaˇ, Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ Yaˍkoˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ, awˬ pa Zeˍbeˍdehˇ geh haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw yawˇ hui ve geu‸ gu tawˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ pa hta‸ teh taˉ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo kʼai leh yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ htawˇ, teˇ kaˬ le le lo ca maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve a naˍ teˇ ceuˬ le le leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ yawˇ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ lawn Suˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a naˍ laiˉ ceuˬ naˬ chehˇ gawˬ chehˇ ve chaw, neˇ geh ve chaw, paw‸ hpeuˆ ve chaw, hkui sheh la‸ sheh suh ve chaw, chaw naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ geh yuˬ laˬ leh yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ, Deˍkaˍpawˇliˆ mvuhˇmiˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ leh, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma coˇ paˉ lo laˬ ve chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ mui taˍ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ leh awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nyi ma hkʼaw haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ haˍ gaˇ haˍ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ meu‸ ve kaˆ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui gʼa caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ shu kʼaw‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi ma hkʼaw hpu ve kehˬ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ tuˬ te ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ te ve pa taw fawˉ ve mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw shu nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve, fawˉ mehˍ ve, heˍ leh nawˬ hui awˬ lawn haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ha lehˬ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui ve la‸ shawnˍ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ la peuˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ htawˇ shu oˇ hkʼe te fawˉ mehˍ jaw ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ ve aˉ leh‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aˉ leh‸ lehˬ mehˬ ve pehˆ kʼai peuˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼaw‸ mehˬ la hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Aˉ leh‸ oˇ ve awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ ve pa taw, shu yuˬ baˬ leh, chaw yaˇ naˆ toˇ ve ceh tiˉ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve venˇ hta‸ faˉ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, kawˆ faiˇ tuˉ leh hkʼawˍ lawˇ tcuhˍ mvuh‸ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ te jaw. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, mvuh kuiˬ lo taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ shu gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve naw hui ve Awˬ pa hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve teh‸ taˇ dawˇ. Te luˬ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Te biˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, miˬguiˬ mvuhˇ naw ma maˇ luˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo li‸ mehˆ ehˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ maiˉ ehˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ luˬ maˇ mehˉ taˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo i jaˇ ve teˇ maˬ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ maˇ te leh, shu ka‸ maˇ te tuˬ maˍ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo shu a‸ kehˉ i ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ te leh, shu ka‸ te tuˬ maˍ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo uiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ leuˉ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e taˬ teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˬ sho-eˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Shu hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ. Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ moˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ hkeu ve chaw lehˬ, moˬ naˆ ho‸ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ tanˇ kuiˬ lo yuˬ laˬ htaˇ, nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ dawˇ nawˇ ve kʼo,
tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ teh taˉ leh kʼo‸-e sheˍ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ taˉ peuˬ heh‸, kʼaw‸ laˬ leh tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ tanˇ loˬ.

Nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ te ve chaw geh teˇ geh shaˉ nanˉ lo kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ huiˉ maˬ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ tuˬ haˆ haˆ te loˬ. Hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ suhˉ taˆ shehˍ hpaˇ la‸ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Suhˉ taˆ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ la‸ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw keu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, peh‸ shanˍ awˬ leh teˇ peh‸ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ shaiˍ peuˬ ve ceh ceh, htawnˍ hkʼaw lo nawˬ maˇ gʼa tawˆ kʼai taˬ.
Nawˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa te teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, yaˇ miˇ hta‸ nyi leh peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ la‸ sha paˉ ve mehˆ shiˍ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, mehˆ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼehˉ baˬ sheˍ. Awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ moˬ naˆ ho‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, awˬ hkʼeun teˇ maˬ luˬ kʼai ve lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ sheh htawˇ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, la‸ sheh oˇ ve hta‸ tawˆ baˬ-o‸. Awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ moˬ naˆ ho‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, awˬ hkʼeun teˇ maˬ luˬ kʼai ve lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ ve kʼo, baˬ da‸ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ lawn hta‸ pa taw a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te tcuh ve yoˬ. Shu baˬ taˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ca heuˆ ve chaw htawˇ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ. Nawˬ hkanˍ taˍ ve hkʼe Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa te ve yoˬ teh‸, aˬ sho-eˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ hkanˍ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ cuˇ leh taˇ hkanˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kʼaw jaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh taˇ hkanˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve hkui sheh taˍ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh taˇ hkanˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ lonˉ ve venˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh taˇ hkanˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ uˉ hkeh mvuh teˇ mvuh hpu la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, naˆ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ te maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, yoˬ kʼo yoˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo maˇ heˆ teh‸ ceh tiˉ kʼoˆ loˬ. Chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Shu nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ te luˬ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te luˬ piˇ leh, shu nawˬ ve ciˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ te hkʼeh‸ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve ciˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼeh‸ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve chaw hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Nawˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ mehˆ hpfuhˇ diˬ hta‸ shu hta laˇ ve kʼo, la‸ mehˍ paˉ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ hkʼo piˇ sheˍ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ te leh aˉ po‸ yuˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, aˉ po‸ lonˉ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ sheˍ.
Shu nawˬ hta‸ nyiˉ leh ya‸ kʼaw teˇ laˆ kʼai tcuh laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh nyiˇ laˆ kʼai-o.
Lawˬ ve chaw hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Chiˇ gaˇ ngaˍ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ htawˇ, taˇ hpfuhˆ kʼai.
A shu yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ leh, a shu yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hta‸ canˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon bon lawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui Awˬ pa ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Aw lawn kʼo, chaw haiˬ leh chaw da‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ nyi hta‸ yawˇ tawˆ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve chaw leh maˇ hteˇ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ ceh kʼaw‸ ha‸ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ hui ka‸ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ ceh awˬ chawˇ te leh na‸ uˉ te da‸ ve kʼo, shu te ve a‸ kehˉ nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te leuˉ ve le. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ka‸ chi hkʼe te ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa biˇ ve hkʼa shuˍshuˍ nawˬ hui htawˇ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Shu gʼa mawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon chaw yaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ da‸ ve kanˉ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve Awˬ pa geh nawˬ awˬ bon maˇ gʼa.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui hkʼe taˇ te. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh laˇ tuˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo maˇ kʼoˆ, behˬ heh ma meuˆ tcuh ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, shu maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ la‸ sha paˉ te ve kanˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ hta‸ taˇ shiˍ piˇ
Shu maˇ mawˬ kuiˬ lo mawˬ puiˉ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui hkʼe taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ shu gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, bon yehˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ kʼaw ceh lo maˇ kʼoˆ, huˉ taˍ leh bon lawˬ gaˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa peuˬ.

Nawˬ bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ ve bawehˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hoˆ peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, baˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa hta‸ lawˬ-o‸. Baˬ kuiˬ lo mawˬ puiˉ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa lehˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hkʼe taˇ te. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˇ maˇ maˇ yaw ve pa taw yawˇ hui bon lawˬ ve hkʼe biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼe taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui loˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ lawˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa shiˍ taˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui bon chi hkʼe lawˬ-o‸. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa-oˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ yawˆ yan te piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ ve a loˍ biˇ ve hkʼe, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ htawˇ biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ nyi loˍ ve caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, ya‸ nyi ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ.
Shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ htawˇ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ-oˆ.

Venˇbaˆ beˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ hui hta‸ taˇ kʼai piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇmiˬ,kanˇ paˆ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ nawˬ ve yoˬ. A menˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui shu ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ htawˇ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ hkʼa kʼo, nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ.

Nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ce ve teˇ yanˇ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui hkʼe mehˆ hpfuhˇ nawˍ tiˆ taˇ te. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce ve hta‸ shu gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, yawˇ hui mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi maˇ sha tuˬ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa peuˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ caˇ tuˬ ce htaˇ, oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ shehˍ leh mehˆ hpfuhˇ tsuhˇ-oˆ.

Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui caˇ tuˬ ce ve hta‸ shu maˇ mawˬ maˇ shiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu maˇ mawˬ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, shu maˇ mawˬ kuiˬ lo mawˬ puiˉ ve nawˬ ve Awˬ pa htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ taˇ shaw hpoˆ taˍ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shaw hpoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ taˆ puiˉ ve, pfuhˇ caˇ puiˉ ve leh chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼawˇ yuˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ loˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ maˇ taˆ puiˉ, pfuhˇ maˇ caˇ puiˉ leh chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼawˇ yuˬ maˇ gʼa.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve teˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ ve nyi ma htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Mehˆ shiˍ lehˬ, awˬ to ve kawˆ faiˇ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mehˆ shiˍ nyi leh shu hta‸ maˇ chaweh piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa deh‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ mehˆ shiˍ nyi leh maˇ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ naˆ ho‸ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ naˆ ho‸ kʼai ve kʼo, naˆ ho‸ ve oˇ ve lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ jawˇmawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ canˇ kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ ka‸, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ ve awˬ ceˬ ka‸, teˇ pawˆ tiˉ teˇ geh te maˇ gʼa.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼa caˇ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ pon taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼa veu‸ gʼa deh tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ to awˬ pon ka‸ taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. A sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ leh, awˬ to htawˇ veu‸ kʼaˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Mvuhˇ hpe lo poˬ toˇ ve ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi-o. Yawˇ hui lehˬ caˬ maˇ ti, caˬ maˇ gʼeu‸ leh caˬ ciˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo caˬ shiˍ maˇ pfuhˇ keu. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Dawˇ hkiˉ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ teˇ jaˆ kʼaw‸ zuhˬ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ te gʼa ve le.

Veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ pon nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te dawˇ hkiˉ ve le. Heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve shiˍ ya‸ veˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te uiˍ la ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Awˬ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ maˇ te, hkeh ka‸ maˇ gʼawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve jawˇmawˇ Sawˉla‸monˍ lehˬ, awˬ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ cehˬ hkʼe taw ka‸ maˇ gʼa veu‸ maˇ gʼa deh jaw teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ya‸ nyi te‸ chehˇ leh shawˉ pawˍ aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu tuˬ ve mvuh‸ cehˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chi taw taw feuˉ piˇ deh piˇ ve kʼo, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ feuˉ laˇ deh laˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Hkʼe te leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa caˇ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa dawˬ tuˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa veu‸ gʼa deh tuˬ, taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui loˍ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh yawˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ ca-o. Chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ htehˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shawˉ pawˍ awˬ pon shawˉ pawˍ dawˇ hkiˉ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ nyi pon teˇ nyi dawˇ haˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve lehˬ law‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa taˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ tsuh piˇ kawˬ piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ tsuh laˇ kawˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve toˉ la‸ lonˉ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh, aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍve mehˆ puˉ hta‸ nawˬ nyi chehˇ ve le.

Nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo toˉ la‸ lonˉ cawˬ taˍ ve ka‸, aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸, Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve mehˆ puˉ hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ tawˆ laˇ shaˍ teh‸ ca kʼoˆ ve le.

Heˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve toˉ la‸ lonˉ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ yuˬ tawˆ sheˍ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ve mehˆ shiˍ hkʼaw cawˬ taˍ ve mehˆ puˉ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yuˬ tawˆ tuˬ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpuiˇ hta‸ taˇ piˇ. Piˉ ko-eˍ shehnˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ va‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ taˇ ca baˬ teh taˍ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui naˆ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ che‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Lawˬ loˬ. Lawˬ kʼo gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ca loˬ. Ca kʼo mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ hta‸ htawˆ loˬ. Htawˆ kʼo hpaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, lawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Ca ve chaw htawˇ, mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yehˬ miˉ hta‸ htawˆ ve chaw awˬ pon htawˇ, yehˬ miˉ hpaw laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ caˇ tuˬ lawˬ ve kʼo, haˉ pui shiˍ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ laˇ.
Ngaˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, vuiˬ hta‸ yuˬ piˇ tuˬ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw haiˬ hpeh‸ ve ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ da‸ ve mawˇ piˇ hkawˇ shiˍ ve kʼo, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa geh hkʼa lawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Hkʼe te leh, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui shu hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkʼaˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ kʼoˍ ve yehˬ miˉ hta‸ lo‸-e loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, luˬ kuiˬ lo kʼai ve ya‸ kʼaw lehˬ kʼehˬ jaˇ leh, yehˬ miˉ hpe‸ ka‸ kʼoˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo lo‸-e ve chaw ka‸ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo lo‸-e ve yehˬmiˉhpe‸ lehˬ, maˇ kʼoˍ leh, ya‸ kʼaw ka‸ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ca mawˬ leh lo‸-e ve chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ yawˇ hui haiˬ jaˇ ve veˬ hpeh‸ ve ka‸, yawˬ awˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ deh leh nawˬ hui geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ nyi kʼo, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Aˉ chuˇ cehˬ lo a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa shaˉ jaw laˇ. Aˉ chuˇ buiˇ lo maˉ nawˆ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa shaˉ jaw laˇ.
Da‸ ve awˬ cehˬ lehˬ, da‸ ve aw shiˍ naw‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ da‸ ve awˬ cehˬ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve awˬ cehˬ lehˬ, maˇ da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ puiˉ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ da‸ ve awˬ cehˬ lehˬ, da‸ve awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ puiˉ.
Da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ ve awˬ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ le le hta‸ htu baˬ leh aˬ miˍ hkʼaw baˬ keu ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ nyi kʼo, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ teh‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼa le le lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve ngaˬ Awˬ pa ve a loˍ hta‸ te ve chaw ceh tiˉ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo bon maˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Nawˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo neˇ haiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ ve laiˉ ceuˬ te peuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ teh‸, chaw maˇ maˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Haiˬ ve hta‸ te ve chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ geh tawˆ kʼai loˬ teh‸, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kaˇ leh na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, haˉ pui hkʼoˆ lo yehˬ te ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ leh iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ leh yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htinˍ ve htawˇ, haˉ pui hkʼoˆ lo te taˍ ve pa taw, yehˬ oˇ ve maˇ paiˍ.
Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ leh maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, shehˇ shiˍ hkʼoˆ yehˬ te ve cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ leh iˉ kaˆ uiˍ taˆ la ve, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ leh yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htinˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yehˬ oˇ ve paiˍ ve yoˬ. Paiˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ bon maˍ peuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ maˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ve li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui hkʼe yawˇ maˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ paˍ hkʼe yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la htaˇ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, hkiˬ tu‸ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ te gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ nawˬ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ la‸ sheh che leh yawˇ hta‸ htawˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ la kehˬ la-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ hkiˬ tu‸ a naˍ mehˉ kʼai leh, yawˇ da‸ la kehˬ la ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ lawn chi chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ hto piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kʼai leh paw hkuˇ hta‸ nawˬ awˬ to ca maw piˇ-oˆ. Shu mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Moˉseˍ awˬ liˇ teh taˍ ve hkʼe tanˇ tuˬ ca tanˇ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Kaˍpeˍneˍonˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ ma‸ poˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ hkui sheh la‸ sheh suh leh aˉ hkʼaw lo zuh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
