Oˇ htaˇ, ma‸ poˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve yehˬ hkʼaw nawˬ lo‸ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ keunˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh tiˉ yaw ve ka‸, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ na-e la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ shu ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh, ngaˬ awˬ hawˉ lo ka‸ ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, Kʼai-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸, Laˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ laˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ paˍ hta‸ htawˇ, Chi hta‸ te-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ te ve yoˬ teh‸, ma‸ poˍ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ chi hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ yawˇ anˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Iˉsaˍ-reˍlaˆ chaw awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸ chi taw taw yonˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa mawˬ jaw sheˍ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ laˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Aˍbraˍhanˍ, Iˉcaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ hui geh hkʼa geh gʼa mui caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo yuˬ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ ma‸ poˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ yonˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ teˇ hkui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve na-e la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Peˍtruˆ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ, Peˍtruˆ awˬ miˇ ma ve awˬ e kaˆ naˬ leh zuh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ htawˇ leh, kaˆ naˬ ve na-e la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tu leh Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ te caˍ te taw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ, neˇ geh ve chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ shu Yeˍsuˆ geh shiˍ laˬ leh, yawˇ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ceh tiˉ yaw leh neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw naˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Yawˇ awˬ to ngaˬ hui ve gʼaˇ nuˇ shaˉ nuˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ taˆ leh, ngaˬ hui ve naˬ ve gawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ pfuhˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬ po coˇ paˉ lo hkanˍ kʼai-a veuˬ teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Saˍ la‸-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ lo kʼai ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve, Heh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ kʼoˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ hpe lo poˬ ve ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, zuh‸ kuiˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ taˍ kuiˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ pa hta‸ awˉ lawˉ ca tuˍ piˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ sheˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Chaw suh teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui chaw suh hta‸ tuˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yawˇ geh teˇ geh ciˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, gʼuiˬ po awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ la ve pa taw, gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼa beh hkʼa beh kʼai chehˇ htawˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca nawˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa luˬ la yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te kawˆ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tu la leh, mvuhˇ haw leh gʼuiˬ po hta‸ deˇ piˇ htaˇ, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ anˇ jaˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw le. Mvuhˇ haw leh gʼuiˬ po ka‸ yawˇ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve law teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬ po coˇ paˉ Gaˍdaˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ htaˇ, chaw tuˍ hpfuh lo tawˆ la ve neˇ geh ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ caˬ jaˇ ve pa taw, ya‸ kʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe caˉ da‸ le. Awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ka‸ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ tuˬ nawˬ laˬ ve laˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ teˇ hkui yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa cawˇ cawˇ vuiˇ ve teˇ kaˬ lo va‸ teˇ moˍ lonˉ kʼaˆ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, neˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve kʼo, va‸ moˍ lonˉ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ lo‸-e tcuh laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸, Kʼai loˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui tawˆ-e leh, va‸ awˬ moˍ lonˉ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, va‸ oˇ ve teˇ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ miˬ haˍ kuiˬ lo gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼuiˇ ya‸-e leh, gʼuiˬ po hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh kʼa suh peuˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Va‸ hawˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpaw-e leh venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, neˇ geh ve chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ lawn yawˇ hui kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai tuˬ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ kʼaw‸ ciˇ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ ve venˇ lo gaˬ la ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, zuh‸ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ zuh‸ chehˇ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh suh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shu yawˇ geh taˆ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yonˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, hkui sheh la‸ sheh suh ve chaw hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chi hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ teh‸, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ shiˍ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ chehˇ ve le.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, tawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hkawˇ a ciˉ kʼoˆ piˇ sha le. Nawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve sha laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Tu leh ya‸ kʼaw toˇ kʼai loˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve sha laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ miˬ guiˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ peuˬ leh, hkui sheh la‸ sheh suh ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tu-o. Nawˬ ve zuh‸ kuiˬ hta‸ taˆ leh nawˬ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ tu leh yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hta‸ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ leh, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ve kanˇ paˆ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ tu leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw kuiˬ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mui chehˇ ve Ma‸htehˍ meh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ, yawˇ tu leh Yeˍsuˆ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ hpui lawˇ paˇ mui caˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ leh venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui maˇ maˇ laˬ leh, Yeˍsuˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui geh teˇ geh mui caˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui ve saˍ la‸ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ leh venˇ baˆ yaˇ hui geh hkʼa geh caˇ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chehˇ sha ve chaw hui naˆ tsuhˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ maˇ loˍ. Naˬ ve chaw hui ceh tiˉ loˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ, ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ ca henˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇhanˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍsuˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ ce chehˇ ve ka‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ caˇ tuˬ maˇ ce ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, hkehˉ caˇ la ve chaw hui geh chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ chehˇ tuˬ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh yuˬ hpaˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui caˇ tuˬ ce tuˬ yoˬ.
Veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ piˍ hta‸ hpa awˬ suhˉ a shu ka‸ maˇ nehˉ jaw. Oˇ hkʼe nehˉ ve kʼo, nehˉ taˍ ve hpa lehˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ awˬ piˍ hta‸ gʼawˬ leh leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ tzuh‸ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shaˍ guiˬ htuˉ pui awˬ piˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ suhˉ a shu ka‸ maˇ keu jaw. Oˇ hkʼe keu ve kʼo, shaˍ guiˬ htuˉ pui pe‸ hkoˇ ve pa taw, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ sheˆ leh, shaˍ guiˬ htuˉ pui htawˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ suhˉ hta‸ shaˍ guiˬ htuˉ pui awˬ suhˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo keu ve kʼo, nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ maˇ luˬ kʼai teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, bon yehˬ awˬ hoˉ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi teˇ hkui ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ suh peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ laˬ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ la‸ sheh taˍ piˇ la. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yeˍsuˆ tu leh, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui geh chaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, teˇ chi nyiˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ awˬ suhˍ ya‸ leh naˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo laˬ leh yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ awˬ caˍ hta‸ htawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ ceh ngaˬ gʼa htawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ na-e la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ hpfuhˆ nyi leh yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ, Yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ na-e la piˇ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ teˇ hkui yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve na-e la ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ awˬ hoˉ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ gaˬ la htaˇ, lehˉ lu meuˆ ve chaw hui leh chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tawˆ kʼai loˬ. Yaˇ miˇ ehˉ chi suh ve maˇ heˆ, yawˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼuiˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ tawˆ kʼai tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ lo‸-e leh yaˇ miˇ ehˉ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ yuˬ hkʼa leh, yaˇ miˇ ehˉ tu la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh awˬ lawn chi, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw teˇ kaˬ le le lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ tu leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, mehˆ cuˉ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ leh, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ, mehˆ cuˉ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi hta‸ ngaˬ te puiˉ ve teh‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yonˍ ve laˇ teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yonˍ ve yoˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ teh‸, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ yawˇ htawˇ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ yonˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ mehˆ kʼaw‸ mawˬ la ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw teˇ kaˬ le le lo Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ lawn bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tawˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, neˇ geh ve chaw kʼaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shu Yeˍsuˆ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Neˇ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw kʼaˍ oˇ ve tawˇ yaw la ve yoˬ. Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ anˇ leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe ve teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ neˇ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, venˇ hkʼaˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo Yeˍsuˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. A naˍ teˇ ceuˬ le le leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ yawˬ hawˉ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yawˬ hkʼe nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ jaˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Caˬ gʼeu‸ tuˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve ka‸, gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hui a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve caˬ gʼeu‸ kuiˬ lo caˬ gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ tuˬ, Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ bon lawˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ leh, neˇ cha‸ chiˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, a naˍ teˇ ceuˬ le le leh naˬ ve gawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ gu na-e piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ kanˇ paˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tcuh yaˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ meh lehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, Peˍtruˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Siˉmonˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Anˍdrehˍ, Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yoˇhanˬ,
Hpiˇliˇpuˆ leh Baˍhtawˇlaˍmehˇ, Htoˉma‸leh awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ Ma‸htehˍ, Aˍlaˍhpehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ leh Htaˍdehˇ,
Hkaˍnaˍniˆ awˬ moˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw Siˉmonˍleh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Yuˇda‸ Iˉsaˍkaˍriˍoˆ hui yoˬ.

Tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ kʼai tcuh leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe tawˇ piˇ ve, Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo taˇ kʼai. Saˍmaˍriˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ taˇ lo‸-e.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼai-o.
Nawˬ hui kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ peuˬ teh‸, bon maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Naˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ-oˆ. Suh ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ-oˆ. Hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ la kehˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ-o‸. Nawˬ hui hkʼe leˇ gʼa ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu hta‸ hkʼe leˇ kʼaw‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve haˍ pi caˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hpu, shi, peh‸ shanˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ doˆ veu.
Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ awˬ pon miˉ chaw leh aˉ po‸ nyiˇ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ka‸, hkuiˉ nuˆ leh juˇ fuiˍ hta‸ ka‸, taˇ yuˬ kʼai. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kanˉ te ve chaw lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ gʼa cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ venˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hkʼaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lo‸-e ve maˇ kʼoˆ, A shu keunˍ ve le teh‸ na nyi leh, hkʼaˆ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui tawˆ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e htaˇ bon na‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yehˬ oˇ ve keunˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ kaˬ lo cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ maˇ keunˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ leh nawˬ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve kʼo, yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, hkui taw kʼaw hta‸ ngawˉ taˍ ve je‸ meu-e hta‸ hpi baˬ taˉ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ leh Gawˇmawˇra‸ mvuhˇmiˬ a‸ kehˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui yawˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, veˬ awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, vuiˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu hta‸ maˇ ya‸ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ, jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ moˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ jaw‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ mvuhˇ miˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ leh hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ shu yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˆ suhˍ leh buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ gʼa yaw tuˬ taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, tawˇ yaw shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui Awˬ pa ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ suh tuˬ chiˇ a‸ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ pa htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hpfuhˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Venˇ teˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ venˇ lo hpaw-e loˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lo nawˬ hui ca toˇ maˇ zuhˇ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve saˍ la‸ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceˬ htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve saˍ la‸ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ ceˬ htawˇ yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, law‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ Beˍsaˍbuˇlaˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ, maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼa beh taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ hpeu‸ tawˆ la tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Hkʼa faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, maˇ shiˍ la tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo hto laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ a yehˉ yehˉ hto laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh kuˬ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ to hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa ve htawˇ, co ha hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, co ha hta‸ ka‸ awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ moˬ naˆ ho‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo te luˬ gʼa shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kawˆ loˬ.
Jaˍ meuˇ nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ peh‸ shanˍ teˇ peh‸ hawˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Nawˬ hui ve Awˬ pa a loˍ maˇ cawˬ kʼo, teˇ hkeh ka‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo maˇ ce.
Nawˬ hui ve uˉ hkeh mvuh hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼaw nyi taˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, taˇ kawˆ. Jaˍ meuˇ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ nawˬ hui awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ laˬ ve teh‸ taˇ dawˇ. Cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˉ htaw hta‸ ngaˬ yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ paˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ pa, yaˇ miˇ leh yawˇ ve awˬ e, awˬ hkuiˇ ma leh yawˇ ve awˬ pi, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve a‸ kehˉ awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ keunˍ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve a‸ kehˉ yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ keunˍ.
A shu yawˇ ve la‸ ka hta‸ taˆ leh ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ laˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ keunˍ.
A shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ gʼa ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ shonˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ pon a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ shonˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ pa taw, shu yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, ha‸ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ pa taw shu yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, ha‸ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

I ve chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ pa taw, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ gawˬ teˇ kawˆ taw piˇ ve kʼo, taw piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬ bon a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ mehˉ taˬ teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ca maˍ piˇ tuˬ leh bon maˍ tuˬ, yawˇ htawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Hkri‸ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh,
Nawˬ lehˬ, laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yoˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa dawˇ law tuˬ sheˍ laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi tcuh ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui hkʼa gʼa kaˇ hkʼa gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ.

Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hui mehˆ mawˬ la ve, hkui luˬ ve chaw hui ya‸ kʼaw juˇ kʼai ve, hkiˬ tu‸ keuˆ ve chaw hui da‸ la kehˬ la ve, naˍ paw pawˇ ve chaw hui naˍ paw kaˇ la ve, suh ve chaw hui kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui htawˇ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ nyi ma maˇ luˬ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yoˇhanˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼo‸-e chehˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Yoˇhanˬ ve awˬ lawn chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve le. Mvuhˇ haw meuˆ leh hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ te chehˇ ve lo cehˬ hta‸ laˇ.

Maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ kʼai ve le. Nuˇ lehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve chaw hta‸ laˇ. Nuˇ lehˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve chaw hui lehˬ, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ ve hawˉ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ ca nyi tuˬ kʼai ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ laˇ. Yoˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hta‸ ca nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nyi loˬ. Nawˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu tuˬ ngaˬ ve tcuh yaˇ hta‸ nawˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, yaˇ miˇ geh hkʼa paw la ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ tawˆ la jaw. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ i ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ kanˉ te ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˬ leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ hiˉ yuˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Hiˉ yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ buiˆ da‸ leh lo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ lehˬ, Yoˇhanˬ ve awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ hto piˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui na yuˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, chaw chi lehˬ laˬ tuˬ ve Eˇliˇya‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Kaˇ tuˬ naˍ paw cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa deh‸ na-o.
Chaw chi teˇ co-e hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma yuˬ leh gʼa tehˆ maˍ tuˬ le.

Chaw chi teˇ co-e lehˬ, Nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui nawˍ meuˆ htawˇ nawˬ hui kʼaˍ maˇ hkʼeˆ. Ngaˬ hui paˆ hawˬ ve htawˇ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ haˍ, teh‸ tcuh hkʼaw mui taˍ leh awˬ chawˇ chawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yoˇhanˬ laˬ leh, maˇ caˇ maˇ dawˬ ve pa taw, Yawˇ lehˬ neˇ geh ve chaw yoˬ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu laˬ leh caˇ ve dawˬ ve pa taw, Chaw chi lehˬ, caˇ leuˉ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ leh venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve chaw yoˬ teh‸ shu kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ shu gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ kanˉ uiˍ ve maˇ maˇ te maˍ piˇ peuˬ ve venˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve pa taw, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ deˇ maˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Hkawˇraˍsenˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Behˇsehˇdaˆ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ htawˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo te peuˬ ve kanˉ uiˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Tuˇruˆ venˇ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo te ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ meh htuˉ pui hpa hta‸ veu‸ deh leh hkʼaw‸ laˉ hkaˆ pfuhˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Tuˇruˆ venˇ leh Siˉdonˍ venˇ a‸ kehˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Kaˍpeˍneˍonˍ venˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma lo hkʼa gaˬ chiˇ taˆ-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ. Nawˬ lehˬ, suh mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa ya‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo te peuˬ ve kanˉ uiˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ Sawˉdonˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo te ve hkʼe kʼo, venˇ oˇ ve lehˬ ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Sawˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ a‸ kehˉ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma miˬ naˆ ma hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ A pa-oˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw leh shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ faˉ taˍ leh, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
A pa-oˬ, chi lehˬ nawˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ. Awˬ pa maˇ heˆ kʼo, Yaˇ hpu hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yaˇ hpu leh Yaˇ hpu hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw maˇ heˆ kʼo, Awˬ pa hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ.
Kanˉ te heuˬ leh mawˇ pfuhˇ hawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ geh laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve taˆ tuˬ hta‸ taˆ leh ngaˬ geh henˇ yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ cawˬ leh, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma htawˇ gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve taˆ tuˬ taˆ sha leh, ngaˬ ve mawˇ htawˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ shinˉ nyi htaˇ heh hkʼaw hpanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ leh caˬ nu chehˆ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ mawˬ leh, Nyi-o, shinˉ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo te maˇ keunˍ te maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te chehˇ ve law teh‸, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Daˍviˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˍ meu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼaw jaw leh laˇ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh, yawˇ awˬ to ka‸ yawˇ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ka‸ caˇ maˇ keunˍ caˇ maˇ cawˇ ve, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ caˇ keunˍ caˇ cawˇ ve tanˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ caˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Peuˬ leh, shinˉ nyi htaˇ bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ shinˉ nyi ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui maˇ gʼaw jaw laˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, bon yehˬ lonˉ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ choˬ kaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, shinˉ nyi ve awˬ jawˇmawˇhpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ suh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ, Shinˉ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo shu hta‸ gu na-e piˇ cawˇ laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˬ teˇ hkeh tiˉ cawˬ leh, shinˉ nyi htaˇ yawˬ oˇ ve teˇ hkeh miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e ve kʼo, maˇ yuˬ tawˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ laˇ.
Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, yawˬ a‸ kehˉ hkʼaˬ ma awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve le. Hkʼe te leh, shinˉ nyi htaˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸, Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh che hkʼa teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve la‸ sheh che ve teˇ yanˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ la leh, awˬ nu ve teˇ paˉ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa shiˍ htaˇ, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw maˇ maˇ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn shu hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaoˍ piˇ tuˬ,yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi lehˬ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ,

Ngaˬ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nyi-o. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chehˇ piˇ leh, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ lawn buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, kuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ maˇ te. Ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ
Suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ maˇ gaˬ tcuh sheˍ ve ceh ceh, hteh kʼaˉ taˍ ve lo cehˬ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te cheˆ. Kawˆ faiˇ awˬ caˆ mvuhˇ hkʼawˇ du du te to‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˉ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui dawˇ law tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ neˇ geh taˍ ve, mehˆ cuˉ leh kʼaˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shu yawˇ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chaw kʼaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve pa taw, chaw kʼaˍ oˇ ve tawˇ yaw gʼa la leh, mehˆ mawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ anˇ jaˇ leh, Chi lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu leh naˍ leˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Chaw chi lehˬ, neˇ jawˇmawˇ Beˍsaˍbuˇlaˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui dawˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Maˇ cawˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ le le luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ cawˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve venˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yehˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yeˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Saˍtanˍ lehˬ, Saˍtanˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yeˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Beˍsaˍbuˇlaˆ hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve le. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ gʼaˇ va leh neˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ miˬ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la peuˬ.

Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ maˇ hpeh tiˍ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ a shu hiˉ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ le. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hta‸ hpeh tiˍ taˍ peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, yawˇ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hpawˇ maˇ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh maˇ gʼawˆ hpoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, gʼawˆ baˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chaw yaˇ hui te ve venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ le le leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ yaw ya‸ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ yaw ya‸ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ ka‸, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ca‸ na‸ ka‸, yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Awˬ cehˬ da‸ ve kʼo, awˬ shiˍ htawˇ da‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ cehˬ maˇ da‸ ve kʼo, awˬ shiˍ htawˇ maˇ da‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ loˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ shiˍ hta‸ pa taw awˬ cehˬ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Vuiˬ haiˬ awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui chaw haiˬ hpeh‸ ve pa taw da‸ ve tawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yaw hpeh‸ le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, maw‸ kʼaw yaw tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Da‸ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ doˆ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ doˆ taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ chaw yaˇ lehˬ, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkʼa yaw ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Saˍ la‸-oˬ, nawˬ te maˍ laˇ ve awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui mawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haiˬ leh te ya‸ puiˉ ve chaw chi teˇ co lehˬ, awˬ heˆ hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yoˇnaˆ ve awˬ heˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ chaw chi teˇ co hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ.
Yoˇnaˆ lehˬ, ngaˇ lonˉ gʼoˇ peˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shehˆ nyi shehˆ haˉ gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu htawˇ miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo shehˆ nyi shehˆ haˉ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, Niˇnaˍveˍ venˇ yaˇ hui lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ co geh teˇ geh tu la leh, chaw chi teˇ co hta‸ suhˉ taˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yoˇnaˆ bon maˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve yo‸. Nyi loˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo Yoˇnaˆ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yo‸.

Suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi htaˇ, awˬ hawˉ hpawˇ mvuhˇmiˬ ve nanˇ hawˉ hkanˇ ma htawˇ, chaw chi teˇ co geh teˇ geh tu la leh, chaw chi teˇ co hta‸ suhˉ taˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ Sawˉla‸monˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na tuˬ, miˬ guiˬ awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ kaˬ lo tu leh laˬ ve yoˬ. Nyi loˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo Sawˉla‸monˍ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Neˇ cha‸ chiˆ teˇ hkeh lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, goˇ choˆ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ca toˇ nyi leh, gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ca ve htawˇ, maˇ mawˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ tawˆ la ve ngaˬ ve yehˬ lo kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e shaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ kʼawˇ lehˍ kehˬ lehˍ hkʼa deh‸ gu shiˆ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ kʼai leh yawˇ a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu neˇ suhˍ hkeh hta‸ kuˬ veu laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui lo‸-e leh oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ hpeh‸ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh haiˬ ve yoˬ. Haiˬ ve chaw chi teˇ co htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ yawˇ maˍ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ e leh awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ gaˇ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ e leh nawˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ na‸ uˉ te da‸ gaˇ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ e leh ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ a shu le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ beˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ e leh ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi loˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ Awˬ pa ve a loˍ hta‸ hkʼa te ve chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi paˍ, ngaˬ ve awˬ nyi ma leh ngaˬ ve awˬ e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ nyi Yeˍsuˆ yehˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo ca mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh hpawnˬ la ve pa taw, yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh mui taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo huˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ tawˇ pa haˉ te leh, awˬ lawn laiˉ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yawˇ sheˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ yawˇ ca sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ yawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo ce leh, ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh gʼawˆ caˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ miˬ shaˍ paˇ kuiˬ haˉ pui de lo ce leh, miˬ shaˍ maˇ naˉ ve pa taw, teˇ cawˬ haˉ yeˬ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yeˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ geu maˇ naw‸ ve pa taw, mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la htaˇ haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ leh, nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ aˉ chuˇ de lo ce leh, aˉ chuˇ buiˇ teˇ hpaˍ uiˍ la leh awˬ yeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hoˆ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ lo ce leh awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la ve yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ teˇ ha pun, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkaw‸ chi pun leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shehˆ chi pun naw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Naˍ paw cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa deh‸ na-o teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ tawˇ pa haˉ te maˍ piˇ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ shiˍ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ kʼaw‸ htehˍ piˇ tuˬ leh yawˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ cawˬ ve chaw geh yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui nyi ve ka‸ nyi maˇ mawˬ, kaˇ ve ka‸ na maˇ gʼa ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ pa haˉ te maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve htawˇ na maˇ gʼa. Nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ maˇ shiˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui mehˆ shiˍ maˇ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, naˍ paw maˇ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ, nyi ma hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, nyi ma maˇ kʼaw‸ pa leh ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa gu na-e tuˬ, chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ ve nyi ma heh leh, yawˇ hui ve naˍ paw maˇ na gaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ mi‸ taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ gʼa mawˬ leh nawˬ hui ve naˍ paw gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ mawˬ gaˇ ve htawˇ, maˇ gʼa mawˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui kaˇ gaˇ ve htawˇ maˇ gʼa kaˇ.
Awˬ yawˇ sheˍ paˍ ve awˬ lawn tawˇ pa haˉ te maˍ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ hta‸ na sheˍ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn gʼa kaˇ leh na maˇ gʼa ve kʼo, haiˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ laˬ leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo sheˍ taˍ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo sheˍ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Haˉ pui de lo sheˍ ve awˬ yawˇ awˬ lawn lehˬ, bon hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh teˇ cawˬ haˉ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve leh fawˉ ve mehˍ ve gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ geu maˇ naw‸ leh teˇ hkui ceh tiˉ hkanˍ gʼa ve pa taw, yawˇ luˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Aˉ chuˇ de lo sheˍ ve awˬ yawˇ awˬ lawn lehˬ, bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve htawˇ, chi miˬguiˬ ve dawˇ haˍ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ leh, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, bon hkawˇ hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve pa taw, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Miˬ hkuiˇ da‸ kuiˬ lo sheˍ ve awˬ yawˇ awˬ lawn lehˬ, bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ kaˇ leh na gʼa ve chaw hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ teˇ ha pun, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkaw‸ chi pun leh teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ shehˆ chi pun awˬ shiˍ naw‸ maˇ la ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tawˇ pa haˉ kʼaw‸ te maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve heh hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ yawˇ sheˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hui zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ laˬ leh, caˬ sheˍ taˍ kuiˬ lo veˬ kʼawˍ yawˇ sheˍ keu taˉ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yeˬ yeˬ la leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, veˬ kʼawˍ htawˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve heh hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ sheˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw veˬ kʼawˍ cawˬ la ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Canˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ chi ve hta‸ te ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Veˬ kʼawˍ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ca gʼawˬ baˬ tuˬ nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ heˆ, nawˬ hui veˬ kʼawˍ cehˬ hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ ve kʼo, caˬ cehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ga gʼawˬ baˬ puiˉ-aˆ.

Caˬ gʼeuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ nyiˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ teˇ geh uiˍ la piˇ sheˍ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ kʼo, veˬ kʼawˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼeu‸ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ, awˬ kʼa‸ awˬ kʼa‸ te tsuh‸ taˍ-o‸. Caˬ shiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ve caˬ ciˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shaw keu taˍ-o teh‸ caˬ gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tawˇ pa haˉ kʼaw‸ te maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve heh awˬ hkʼaw lo sheˍ taˍ ve gʼawˇ caˉ yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ yawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ i jaˇ ve htawˇ, uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ la leh awˬ cehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ hpe lo poˬ ve ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ gʼaˇ jehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tawˇ pa haˉ kʼaw‸ te maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, diˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ diˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh hkaoˍ monˇ meu-e shehˆ hkʼawˍ lawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo keu ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˇ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ tawˇ pa haˉ te leh chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ pa haˉ maˇ te kʼo, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te maˍ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ leh tawˇ pa haˉ teˇ hpaˍ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ te hpanˍ htaˇ ka‸ faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ leh yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Heh hkʼaw sheˍ ve veˬ kʼawˍ yawˇ tawˇ pa haˉ awˬ lawn tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Da‸ ve awˬ yawˇ hta‸ sheˍ paˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ.
Heh lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve awˬ yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Veˬ kʼawˍ yawˇ lehˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ sheˍ ve canˇ paˍ lehˬ neˇhaiˬ yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ chi leh ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ.
Veˬ kʼawˍ hta‸ gʼeu‸ leh aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, miˬguiˬ chi leh ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ chi hkʼe hpehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hta‸ peu laˇ leh, shu hta‸ te ya‸ tcuh ve chaw leh haiˬ ve hta‸ te ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui yuˬ tawˆ peuˬ hkʼaw nawˉ,
aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh awˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui Awˬ pa ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tuˬ yoˬ. Naˍ paw cawˬ ve chaw hkʼa deh‸ na-o.

Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, ti mi hkʼaw faˉ taˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Mawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ mawˬ ve chaw lehˬ, kʼaw‸ gu faˉ taˍ leh, ha lehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e leh, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ti mi oˇ ve hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve piˉ ko-eˍ shehnˉ hta‸ ca ve tanˇ kaˬ paˍ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve piˉ ko-eˍ shehnˉ teˇ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ kʼo‸-e leh yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shehnˉ oˇ ve hta‸ vuiˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpehˇ keu leh ngaˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ hoˆ leh gʼawˬ yuˬ ve geu‸ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˇ ca paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geu‸ hta‸ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ lo gʼawˬ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mui taˍ leh da‸ ve ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼawˍ lawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo leuˆ keu leh, maˇ da‸ ve ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ leh ve teˇ yanˇ, chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui leh haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ pehˬ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ,
haiˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ aˬ miˍ buiˬ hpfuh awˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui na gʼa peuˬ laˇ teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Na gʼa peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ lawn henˇ yuˬ peuˬ ve li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ ve mawˇ keu taˍ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, mawˇ awˬ piˍ awˬ suhˉ yuˬ tawˆ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ pa haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ te maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui anˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi hpaˇ lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve cuˇ yiˍ leh kanˇ paˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ve le.
Yawˇ lehˬ, la‸shaˉmaˉ ve yaˇ paˍ maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ ve awˬ e lehˬ Maˍriˆ meh ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yaˍkoˆ, Yoˇseh‸, Siˉmonˍ leh Yuˇda‸ hui maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ ngaˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Hkʼe te leh chaw chi hpaˇ lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma luˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ kanˉ uiˍ ve hta‸ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ te ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ lawn bvuhˬ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh,

yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi hpaˇ lehˬ, baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve pa taw, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ uiˍ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Hpiˇliˇpuˆ ve awˬ miˇ ma Heˍroˍdiˆ awˬ lawn hta‸ pa taw, Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh htawnˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ heuˆ maˇ cawˇ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ lehˬ, Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gaˇ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ kawˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ yoˬ teh‸ mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ paw ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ pawehˇ te ve awˬ nyi kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, Heˍroˍdiˆ ve awˬ yaˇ miˇ chaw chi ma ve mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ pawehˇ te maˍ piˇ htaˇ, Heˍroˆ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hkʼa lawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, jawˇmawˇ Heˍroˆ ka ti‸ te leh hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ e maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkehˇ pe le awˬ hkʼaw keu leh pe‸ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ lehˬ dawˇ haˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh, yawˇ geh mui caˇ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ pa taw, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lawˬ ve hkʼe piˇ tuˬ yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ chaw hta‸ hpehˇ peu leh, htawnˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yoˇhanˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ ca tawˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkehˇ pe le awˬ hkʼaw keu veu laˇ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ htawˇ yawˇ ve awˬ e hta‸ ca yuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yoˇhanˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ tuˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ leh oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ-e leh, chaw gawˬ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh, miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ kʼai leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo naˬ ve gawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Choˬ kaˬ lehˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw hpeh‸ leh, mvuhˇ ka‸ hpeu‸ la yoˬ. Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˆ hkʼaw lo kʼai leh caˇ tuˬ ca vuiˬ caˇ-e tuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Yawˇ hui kʼai tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Nawˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ caˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, hkaoˍmonˇ ngaˇ diˬ leh ngaˇ nyiˇ hkeh ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ teh‸ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Mvuh‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ mui-o teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve ngaˇ diˬ leh ngaˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo chiˇ nyi leh bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ hkʼeh‸ leh awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ ve yoˬ. Caˇ leuˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ chi nyiˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼa biˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Caˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ leh yaˇ ehˉ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ kʼo, hawˉ hkʼaˆ chaw mawˇ tiˉ aˬ laˬ hkʼe ngaˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ leh, yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ coˇ paˉ lo kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, bon ca lawˬ tuˬ yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, gʼuiˬ po awˬ kʼaw ji lo gaˬ htaˇ, mvuhˇ haw hpawˇ maˇ cawˇ ve pa taw, gʼuiˬ baˇ teˇ hpaˍ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hta‸ htinˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Tanˇ hkuinˇ shehˆ naˍ riˍ ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsuˆ gʼuiˬ po hkʼoˆ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ leh yawˇ hui geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ po hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ laˬ ve hta‸ awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, Chaw ha ku yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kawˆ ve pa taw gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te-o. Taˇ kawˆ, ngaˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peˍtruˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ yoˬ kʼo, iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ geh laˬ tcuh laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ, Laˬ-o‸ teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Peˍtruˆ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw tawˆ-e leh, iˉ kaˆ hkʼoˆ ya‸ kʼaw juˇ leh Yeˍsuˆ geh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ haw hehnˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ mawˬ htaˇ, kawˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo tuˍ lo‸-e chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ cawˬ haˉ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ ve la‸ sheh che leh, yawˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ tawˆ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma te htawˇ dawˇ nawˬ dawˇ te ve le teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ haw htawˇ dehˬ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ po coˇ paˉ lo yawˇ hui hkanˍ kʼai leh Geˍneˍsaˍrehˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo gaˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ yoˬ teh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw teˇ kaˬ le le lo chaw hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh, naˬ ve gawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ geh yuˬ laˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ awˬ caˍ hta‸ ceh gʼa htawˇ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Hkʼa htawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ na-e la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo tu leh, Yeˍsuˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw chaw mawˇ hui piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ya‸ ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui la‸ sheh maˇ tsuhˇ leh caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve le.

Awˬ lawn kʼo Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o. Peuˬ leh, A shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa suh ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸, Ngaˬ geh hkʼa cawˬ ve nawˬ hui gʼa cawˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ yawˆ yan tuˬ maˇ loˍ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui te pehˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ cawˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,
Chaw chi teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve maw‸ kʼaw ngaˬ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma lehˬ ngaˬ hta‸ vuiˇ da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hui teh taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve lehˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼa deh‸ na leh shiˍ-o‸.
Maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw lo‸-e ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ maˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw tawˆ la ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ-aw laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa maˇ ti taˍ ve awˬ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ le le hta‸ gʼawˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ piˇ sheˍ. Yawˇ hui mehˆ cuˉ ve ka‸, ya‸ kʼaw maˍ piˇ paˍ te ve yoˬ. Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw lehˬ, mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw ce lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Peˍtruˆ lehˬ, Tawˇ pa haˉ chi ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui htawˇ na maˇ gʼa sheˍ leh laˇ.
Maw‸ kʼaw hkʼaw lo‸-e ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, gʼoˇ peˬ awˬ hkʼaw gaˬ leh, aˉ kʼa‸ yiˬ kuiˬ lo baˬ taˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, nyi ma hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, haiˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ ve, chaw hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve, guiˇ ya‸ ve, shu mawˇ hkʼawˇ ve, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve leh, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nyi ma hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, la‸ sheh maˇ tsuhˇ leh caˇ tuˬ caˇ ve lehˬ, chaw hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ oˇ kaˬ tawˆ kʼai leh, Tuˇruˆ leh Siˉdonˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hkaˍnanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ miˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la leh, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ ve yaˇ miˇ neˇ geh leh gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ yaw piˇ. Yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ miˇ chi ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaˇ suh gʼa‸ laˬ leh kuˬ chehˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh-o teh‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mehˉ kʼai peuˬ ve yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh laˬ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve laˬ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˍ piˇ maˇ cawˇ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hpuiˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve hpui lawˇ hawˉ sheˆ taˍ ve caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼawˆ caˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, nawˬ yonˍ ve lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ teˇ hkui yawˇ ve yaˇ miˇ na-e la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai leh Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo taˆ-e leh mui taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, hkui luˬ la‸ luˬ ve chaw, mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw, kʼaˍ ve chaw leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw naˬ laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui shiˍ veu taˆ veu laˇ leh, yawˇ hkui paˇ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw kʼaˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ yaw gʼa la ve, hkui luˬ la‸ luˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼaw‸ da‸ la leh ya‸ kʼaw juˇ gʼa la ve, mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw hui mehˆ mawˬ la ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui anˇ jaˇ leh Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ geh kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ngaˬ geh chehˇ ve shehˆ nyi gaˬ peuˬ leh, caˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui awˍ meu‸ jehˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼo‸-e tcuh gaˇ. Kʼo‸-e tcuh ve kʼo, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ hui gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Chaw chi ma ve hkʼa bvuhˆ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve, choˬ kaˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo hkaoˍ monˇ hkʼaˬ lo ca gʼa tuˬ le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui geh hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ diˬ cawˬ le teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi htaˇ, Hkaoˍmonˇ suhˍ diˬ leh ngaˇ ehˉ a ciˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ mui tuˬ yawˇ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaoˍmonˇ oˇ ve suhˍ diˬ leh ngaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htaˬ yawˇ yuˬ leh, bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼeh‸ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa bvuhˆ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, caˇ leuˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, suhˍ hkʼawˍ lawˇ hkʼa biˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Caˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ leh yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ kʼo, hawˉ hkʼaˆ chaw mawˇ tiˉ awˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ ciˇ leh Maˍgaˍdanˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui leh Saˍduˆkehˇ hui laˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma ve awˬ heˆ a ciˉ te maˍ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ, Mvuhˇ naw ma nyiˉ lehˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh mvuhˇ shawˉ htaˇ, Mvuhˇ naw ma nyiˉ lehˍ cawˬ leh moˬ hoˆ taˍ ve kʼo, ya‸ nyi mvuhˇ haw mvuhˇ yeˬ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ nyi leh shiˍ puiˉ ve htawˇ, awˬ co-e awˬ yanˇ ve awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui fuiˍ da‸ maˇ gʼa.

Haiˬ leh te ya‸ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ co-e lehˬ, awˬ heˆ hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yoˇnaˆ ve awˬ heˆ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ heˆ teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ maˍ piˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼuiˬ po coˇ paˉ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkaoˍmonˇ yuˬ kʼai tuˬ yawˇ hui leunˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ leh Saˍduˆkehˇ hui ve diˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te leh jaw kʼai-o teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ yuˬ laˬ ve pa taw chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ teh‸, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkaoˍmonˇ maˇ yuˬ laˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve le.

Chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ gaˬ sheˍ leh laˇ. Hkaoˍmonˇ ngaˇ diˬ hta‸ chaw ngaˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui awˬ leuˉ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ leh laˇ.
Peuˬ leh hkaoˍmonˇ suhˍ diˬ hta‸ chaw awˇ hinˉ gʼaˇ caˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui awˬ leuˉ hkʼaˬ nyiˇ hkʼawˍ lawˇ kʼaw‸ gʼawˆ gʼa ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ leh laˇ.
Ngaˬ hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ gaˬ ve le. Hpaˍriˍsehˇ leh Saˍduˆkehˇ hui ve diˇ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, hkaoˍmonˇ hkʼaw keu ve diˇ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Hpaˍriˍsehˇ leh Saˍduˆkehˇ hui maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇpuˆ Kehˉsaˍriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hpawˇ lo gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve, Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ a shu hpeh‸ ve teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve le.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ nawˬ hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Eˇliˇya‸ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍraˍmiˆ, maˇ heˆ kʼo Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ a shu hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve le.
Siˉmonˍ Peˍtruˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yoˇnaˆ ve yaˇ paˍ Siˉmonˍ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ lawn chi hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa nawˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ lehˬ Peˍtruˆ yoˬ. Haˉ pui chi awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ ve awˬ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ. Suh mvuhˇmiˬ ve yehˬ miˉ lehˬ, awˬ moˍ chi hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ ve shawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hkʼa hpeh taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ hpeh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hkʼa hpui hkʼa ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ hpui hkʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Hkri‸ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa hto piˇ tuˬ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ tawˇ hehnˇ chaweh piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ hta‸ tanˬ leh, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo gʼa kʼai leh, awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa suh leh, shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo gʼa kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peˍtruˆ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, chi hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa heuˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh yawˇ hta‸ deˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ hpfuhˆ nyi leh Peˍtruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Saˍtanˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpawˇ lo jiˆ kʼai-o. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon hkui htiˇ poˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ, chaw yaˇ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ gaˇ ve kʼo, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ ka hta‸ taˆ leh ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ gaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a sha‸ shonˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ awˬ pon a sha‸ shonˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve a sha‸ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa ve htawˇ, yawˇ ve a sha‸ shonˇ kʼai ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ tuˬ le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a sha‸ awˬ pon aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh pa gʼa tuˬ le.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yawˇ Awˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui geh teˇ geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, choˬ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu chi yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo laˬ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, maˇ gʼa suh teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkaw‸ nyi ponˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Peˍtruˆ, Yaˍkoˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ ceh shiˍ veu leh, mvuh ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui taˆ-e ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han pa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpu la ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ leh Eˇliˇya‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ tawˆ la leh Yeˍsuˆ geh na‸ uˉ te da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Peˍtruˆ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui choˬ kaˬ chehˇ ve lehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, choˬ kaˬ lo ngaˬ aˉ po kʼo shehˆ shiˍ te tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ pon teˇ shiˍ, Moˉseˍ awˬ pon teˇ shiˍ leh Eˇliˇya‸ awˬ pon teˇ shiˍ te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve moˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkawˇ chi hkʼe bvuhˬ la ve, Chaw chi lehˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh mehˆ hpfuhˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ laˬ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ leh, Tu-o, taˇ kawˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ chiˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ mawˬ. Yeˍsuˆ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaw oˇ ve teˇ shiˍ lo yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ ya‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, suh kuiˬ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn chi, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ taˇ hto piˇ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, Eˇliˇya‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa laˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve teˇ yanˇ
yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Eˇliˇya‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na laˬ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu te tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Eˇliˇya‸ gaˬ la peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, te gaˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu htawˇ yawˇ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ paˍ Yoˇhanˬ awˬ lawn yawˇ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ geh yawˇ hui gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh kʼoˆ ve,

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ paw‸ hpeuˆ leh gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ hkui teˇ hkui paˍ lo‸-e leh, iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui paˍ lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu laˇ htawˇ, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gu na-e piˇ maˇ gʼa teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yonˍ ve maˇ cawˬ leh nyi ma hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw chi teˇ co-e, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh hkʼaˬ maw gʼa chehˇ tuˬ sheˍ le. Nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ maw gʼa yeunˇ hkanˍ tuˬ sheˍ le. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh yuˬ laˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ neˇ oˇ ve hta‸ deˇ leh, neˇ oˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hkui yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve na-e la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Neˇ oˇ ve hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ngaˬ hui gʼa‸ kʼoˬ maˇ gʼa ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼawˇ caˉ yawˇ hkʼe hui cawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaw chi teˇ shiˍ hta‸, Oˇ kaˬ lo jiˆ kʼai-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, jiˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te maˇ gʼa ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui teˇ geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ yanˇ neˇ la peuˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Kaˍpeˍneˍonˍ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ pon a moˇ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ Peˍtruˆ geh kʼai leh, Nawˬ ve saˍ la‸ lehˬ, a moˇ maˇ keu leh laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Keu ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Peˍtruˆ yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍsuˆ tawˇ awˉ lawˉ yaw leh kʼoˆ ve, Siˉmonˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve le. Chi miˬguiˬ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu geh a moˇ shaw ve le. A shu yawˇ ve yaˇ geh laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, shu geh shaw ve laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Shu geh shaw ve yoˬ teh‸ Peˍtruˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ pa taw shu maˇ gʼa dawˇ ya‸ tuˬ, gʼuiˬ po lo kʼai leh biˉ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ca baˬ keu-o. Awˉ lawˉ gʼa ve ngaˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh maw‸ kʼaw ngaˉ hkʼa nyi. Oˇ htaˇ, hpu teˇ hteh‸ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon leh nawˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hui hta‸ ca piˇ-oˆ teh‸, Peˍtruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hkui awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍsuˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, yaˇ ehˉ oˇ ve yawˇ hui awˬ kʼaw ji lo taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui nyi ma maˇ pa leh yaˇ ehˉ hkʼe maˇ hpeh‸ la ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa lo‸-e taˬ.
A shu teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yaˇ ehˉ chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ chi hkʼe ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo ha‸ yuˬ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ yonˍ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve kʼawˍ peˍ hta‸ haˉ pui mawˍ lonˉ hpeh kʼu leh naˉ jaˇ ve laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ ce peu ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ pon da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve la‸ sheh teˇ paˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve hkui sheh teˇ paˉ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, tawˆ baˬ-o‸. Hkui sheh la‸ sheh nyiˇ paˉ paˉ cawˬ leh co co taiˍ taiˍ to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, hkui sheh la‸ sheh hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ cawˬ leh a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa lo‸-e ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ teˇ paˉ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, mehˆ shiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼehˉ baˬ sheˍ. Mehˆ shiˍ nyiˇ paˉ paˉ cawˬ leh aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve moˬ naˆ ho‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ ve a‸ kehˉ, mehˆ shiˍ teˇ paˉ tiˉ cawˬ leh a sha‸ te‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa lo‸-e ve lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ hui ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ Awˬ pa ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, yawˬ teˇ ha hkeh cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ hkeh mehˉ kʼai ve kʼo, kʼawˇ chi kʼawˇ hkeh hta‸ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo teh taˉ leh mehˉ kʼai ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ yawˇ ca nyi tuˬ yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, yawˬ oˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ ve kʼo, maˇ mehˉ ve yawˬ kʼawˇ chi kʼawˇ hkeh hta‸ ha lehˬ ve a‸ kehˉ, oˇ ve teˇ hkeh hta‸ leuˉ leh ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, yaˇ ehˉ chi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ luˬ kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ Awˬ pa nyi ma maˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh kʼai leh nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ceh tiˉ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ nawˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ nawˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ na ve kʼo, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo shehˆ gʼaˇ, tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkʼa deh‸ hkanˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ geh chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ kʼai-o.

Yawˇ hui ve hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ na ve kʼo, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ ve hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ na ve kʼo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw leh awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ shawˍ taˍ-o‸.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui hkʼa hpeh taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ hpeh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui hkʼa hpui hkʼa ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo htawˇ hpui hkʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma hawˍ da‸ leh teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ lawˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa lehˬ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lawˬ ve hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ shehˆ gʼaˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh hpawnˬ da‸ ve kʼo, oˇ kaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ kʼaw ji lo ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Peˍtruˆ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ te ya‸ laˇ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve venˇ baˆ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ tuˬ le. Suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Suhˍ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Suhˍ pawˆ suhˍ chi pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa hpehˇ piˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh hpu caˇ lanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu gaˇ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ caˇ lanˇ tanˬ gu chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ chi lanˬ hteh‸ jeˬ cha taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shu yawˇ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ awˬ to ka‸, yawˇ miˇ yawˇ yaˇ ka‸, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve mawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ hawˇ baˬ sheˬ leh shaiˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸ teh‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh awˬ ceˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh yawˇ ve jeˬ hta‸ htawˇ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hta‸ jeˬ teˇ ha hteh‸ cha taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh kʼawˍ peˍ nyiˉ leh, Ngaˬ ve jeˬ hta‸ shaiˍ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, hkui tcuhˉ teh leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˍ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ maˇ na leh, jeˬ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve hta‸ htawnˍ hkʼaw lo ca keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ca hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haiˬ ve awˬ ceˬ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve pa taw nawˬ ve jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ htawˇ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ cawˇ ve yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ nyi ma zuhˆ leh, yawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ htawnˍ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi te ya‸ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw tawˆ kʼai leh, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma coˇ paˉ lo cawˬ ve Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇ miˬ teˇ tawn lo gaˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai leh, oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve awˬ lawn teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve. Te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ hawˉ hkʼaˆ leh yaˇ miˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ peuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Chi hta‸ pa taw hawˉ hkʼaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ suhˍ teˇ shaˍ tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼaw jaw laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha caˉ da‸ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ maˇ gʼa yuˬ hpaˆ da‸ piˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te kʼo, hpaˆ da‸ ve li‸ piˇ peuˬ htaˇ heh‸, awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ-o‸ teh‸, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw Moˉseˍ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui nyi ma heh ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ tuˬ Moˉseˍ a hkaw-anˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, a shu yawˇ awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ baˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ca heuˆ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, maˇ heuˆ ve lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hkanˍ yuˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Hkanˍ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ bon gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ hkanˍ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, paw la htaˇ ka‸ awˬ tawnˇ hpeh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ tawnˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ shu yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ aw pon a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ chaw awˬ tawnˇ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve chaw lehˬ, hkanˍ yuˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ la‸ sheh taˍ leh bon lawˬ piˇ tuˬ, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shu yawˇ geh shiˍ laˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shiˍ laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ deˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh laˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ tawˍ taˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇ miˬ lehˬ, chaw oˇ hkʼe ve mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ la‸ sheh taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Saˍ la‸-oˬ, co ti‸ ha ti‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ da‸ ve kanˉ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ gʼa te tuˬ le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ lawn na nyi laˇ ve le. Da‸ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. A sha‸ te‸ kuiˬ lo nawˬ lo‸-e gaˇ ve kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te-o teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ maˬ le teh‸ yawˇ na nyi htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ taˇ te, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ taˇ hkʼawˇ, shu hta‸ maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ taˇ hkanˍ,
nawˬ ve awˬ pa aw e hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ na yuˬ leh te peuˬ. Ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ loˍ sheˍ le teh‸, kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ biˇ la gaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ kʼo‸-e leh, nawˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ leh haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ hta‸ pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve mawˇ nawˬ cawˬ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ leh nawˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ leh ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw haˉ paˍ lehˬ, tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ mawˇ jeˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, kaˍlaˍoˆ teˇ hkeh gʼo‸ naˍ hkʼawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e tuˬ ve lehˬ, paw sha ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ ve a‸ kehˉ sha ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui anˇ jaˇ leh, Hkʼe te kʼo, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ a shu gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi leh, Chaw yaˇ lehˬ chi hta‸ te maˇ gʼa. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te gʼa ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Peˍtruˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hui lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh nawˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa tuˬ ve le.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, miˬguiˬ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gu te ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve kʼaw jaw awˬ hkʼoˆ mui ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, kʼaw jaw teˇ chi nyiˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ mui leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ hta‸ suhˉ gʼa jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
