Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh a shu yawˇ ve ti mi hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ teˇ ha pun kʼaw‸ gʼa leh, co ti‸ ha ti‸ awˬ shinˉ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ chehˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ, shu awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ chehˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ, shu awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇ miˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te tuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ca tuˬ, mvuhˇ shawˉ teˇ na‸ tawˆ kʼai ve yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, teˇ nyi teˇ hteh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, kanˉ te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh jehˬ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ shawˉ aˬ laˬ hkʼe kʼawˇ naˍ riˍ htaˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai leh, tcuh hkʼaw lo kanˉ maˇ cawˬ leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ,
Nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o. Keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ teˇ yanˇ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ shehˆ naˍ riˍ hkʼe teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ aˬ laˬ hkʼe ngaˇ naˍ riˍ teˇ yanˇ yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ kʼai leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw choˬ kaˬ lo teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ ve le teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ca la ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ, Nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o teh‸, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ, hko awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh leh ca te ve chaw hui hta‸ tanˬ leh, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ca te ve chaw hui hkʼa gaˬ awˬ hpfuhˇ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ yawˇ ve mawˇ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ hpeu‸ aˬ laˬ hkʼe ngaˇ naˍ riˍ htaˇ kanˉ ca te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ le le teˇ hteh‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ca te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui shu a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve ka‸, yawˇ hui htawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ hteh‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hpu gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ca beu leh yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh leh ca te la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ naˍ riˍ tiˉ gʼa te ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ kanˉ te hkeu‸ leh mvuhˇ cha chiˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ shawˍ piˇ ve law teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ te laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Teˇ hteh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ geh ngaˬ jehˬ da‸ taˍ peuˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ ve hpu hta‸ yuˬ leh kʼai-o. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ leh leh te ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ piˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve mawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te maˇ cawˇ leh laˇ. Ngaˬ shu hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh piˇ ve pa taw nawˬ nyi ma naˬ leh laˇ teh‸, kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, shu awˬ gʼu suhˍ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Shu awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, shu awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ gʼa kʼaw‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh Yeˍsuˆ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˉ kuˬ veu leh, ya‸ kʼaw kʼaˉ lo yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,

Ngaˬ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, yawˇ gʼa suh tuˬ ve yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ suhˉ taˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve, jaw‸ ve, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, shehˆ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hui ve awˬ e leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh laˬ leh, awˬ e yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh teˇ ceuˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma heuˆ gaˇ ve le teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ na nyi htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ teˇ gʼaˇ a ciˉ mui piˇ lawˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ lawˬ ve nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ. Ngaˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ ve kawˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˬ hpeh‸-aw laˇ teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Dawˬ hpeh‸-aw teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve kawˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa dawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ gʼa mui tuˬ ngaˬ pe‸ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Ngaˬ ve Awˬ pa gu taˍ ve chaw hui ceh tiˉ gʼa mui tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ,
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tcuh yaˇ teˇ chi gʼaˇ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui ve jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ uˉ peunˍ leh, yawˇ hui ve chaw uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˉ te ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe maˇ gʼa te. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw uiˍ hpeh‸ gaˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ te gaˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve te gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ lehˬ vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, shu yawˇ awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ shu awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ laˬ leh, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve a sha‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon laˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo mui chehˇ ve mehˆ cuˉ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ awˬ paˇ lo kʼai chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸, Ta‸ iˉ chehˇ-oˆ teh‸ deˇ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ-oˆ teh‸, leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ huˉ taˍ leh yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kuˬ leh, Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ hpaw laˇ-oˆ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ htawˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ mehˆ mawˬ la leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la leh, Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw hta‸ neˇ ve Behˆhpaˍgeˍ hkʼaˆ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼai tcuh leh kʼoˆ ve,
Nawˬ huiˉ maˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ cawˬ ve hkʼaˆ hkʼaw lo kʼai-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo hpeh taˍ ve piˉ laˬ awˬ ma peuˍ leh awˬ yehˇ hta‸ teˇ cawˬ haˉ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpui leh ngaˬ geh sheh veu laˇ-oˆ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ loˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,

Ziˉonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe hto piˇ-oˆ. Nyi loˬ, nawˬ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ lehˬ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo piˉ laˬ awˬ ma peuˍ leh awˬ yehˇ hta‸ ciˇ leh nawˬ geh laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ kʼai leh, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ tcuh ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, piˉ laˬ awˬ ma peuˍ leh awˬ yehˇ hta‸ sheh veu laˇ leh, piˉ laˬ oˇ ve nyiˇ hkeh awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼawˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsuˆ taˆ ciˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw maˇ-awˍ ve a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo hkʼawˇ piˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ suhˆ hpa‸ chaw leh ya‸ kʼaw hpuiˇ lo hkʼawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼai ve chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ kuˬ leh, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ Hoˍsaˍnaˍ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hawˉ lo laˬ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ piˇ-oˆ. Mvuhˇ naw ma lo htawˇ, Hoˍsaˍnaˍ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te leh, Chi hpaˇ lehˬ a shu le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Chi hpaˇ lehˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ Naˍzaˍrehˆ venˇ yaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍsuˆ yoˬ teh‸, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo mawˇ vuiˬ mawˇ hawˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ leh, hpu pa shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve hpui lawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˉ pui kʼaˍ hawˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve mui hkʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hpfuhˆ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve yehˬ hta‸ bon lawˬ kuiˬ yehˬ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ, yehˬ chi hta‸ chaw hkʼawˇ chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la piˇ peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ hui leh hkui luˬ paˍ hui, bon yehˬ lonˉ hkʼaw yawˇ geh laˬ leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gu na-e piˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ te ve anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Daˍviˆ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ Hoˍsaˍnaˍ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kuˬ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ kaˇ-aw laˇ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ kaˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh cuˉ dawˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ nawˬ keu piˇ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼaw jaw laˇ teh‸, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh, venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh Beˍtaˍniˆ hkʼaˆ hkʼaw lo ca haˉ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la leh venˇ hkʼaw kʼaw‸ kʼo‸-e htaˇ, yawˇ awˍ meu‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw paˇ lo cawˬ ve maˉ nawˆ cehˬ teˇ cehˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, yawˇ ca nyi htaˇ awˬ hpa‸ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, nawˬ awˬ shiˍ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ naw‸ teh‸, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ oˇ ve teˇ cawˬ haˉ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ anˇ leh, Maˉ nawˆ cehˬ chi, aˬ hto‸ ma te teˇ cawˬ haˉ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui yonˍ leh nyi ma htawˇdawˇnawˬdawˇ maˇ te ve kʼo, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ chi hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui te hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, hkʼaw chi teˇ shiˍ hta‸, Jiˆ tawˆ-e leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼaw lo ca ce lo‸-e loˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve kʼo, oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon lawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa lawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ lo‸-e leh maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ hui ve awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve kanˇ paˆ gʼa leh chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve le. Kanˇ paˆ chi a shu nawˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ na nyi shaˍ. Nawˬ hui yaw hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve kanˇ paˆ gʼa leh chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ lo gʼa ve le. Mvuhˇ naw ma lo laˇ, chaw yaˇ hui geh lo laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ jehˬ da‸ leh kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma lo gʼa ve teh‸ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Hkʼe te leh nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te yawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ ve le teh‸, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ hui geh gʼa ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, chaw chi ma ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ,

Hkʼe te leh, Ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ teh‸ yawˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve kanˇ paˆ gʼa leh chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ hto laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve le. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ geh yawˇ kʼai leh, Yaˇ paˍoˬ, ya‸ nyi a pehˉ meuˇ hko awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ kanˉ ca te-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ htaˇ,
Ngaˬ maˇ kʼai teh‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ geh awˬ pa kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, yawˇ maˇ kʼai.

Yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pa ve a loˍ hta‸ te ve le teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ hui leh meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ hpaˍ, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ toˇ leh nawˬ hui geh lo laˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkawnˍ shaw paˍ hui leh meh maˬ lanˉ hui yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui chi hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve htawˇ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ yonˍ.

Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tawˇ pa haˉ hta‸ na sheˍ. Yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a pehˉ meuˇ hko te leh ti taˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkʼa deh‸ ko taˍ leh, a pehˉ meuˇ shiˍ nyiˉ kuiˬ duˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Shaw kuiˬ yehˬ mvuh ve hta‸ htawˇ te taˍ leh, hko te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˍ piˇ taˉ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shiˍ meh ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, awˬ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ hko te paˍ hui geh yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hko te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ dawˆ ve, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ a‸ kehˉ awˬ ceˬ maˇ chaweh hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh ve htawˇ, hko te paˍ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ te piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ pawˆ, Ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui yawˆ yan tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hko te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Chaw chi lehˬ, awˬ shinˉ gʼa shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Laˬ-o‸, yawˇ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui yuˬ-a veuˬ teh‸, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh, hko awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo chiˇ baˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh hko awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, hko te paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te piˇ tuˬ le teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Haiˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ te luˬ te sheˆ piˇ leh, awˬ shiˍ meh la htaˇ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ shiˍ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu hko te paˍ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ngaˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yehˬ kawˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hui baˬ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ lo kawˍ taˍ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Chi lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ anˇ tu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Li‸ hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ gʼaw jaw laˇ,
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh yuˬ tawˆ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la puiˉ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ pa haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ yawˇ hui awˬ lawn kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ gaˇ ve htawˇ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ hta‸ kawˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw chi ma ve shawˍ taˍ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, Yeˍsuˆ tawˇ pa haˉ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ te leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ awˬ pon hkehˉ caˇ tuˬ gu taˍ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkehˉ caˇ la tuˬ kuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, Laˬ-o‸ teh‸ ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼai tcuh ve htawˇ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ laˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼai tcuh leh, Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve nuˇ leh chu ve ceˇ caˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Hkehˉ caˇ la-o teh‸, kuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ heh hkʼaw kʼai leh, teˇ gʼaˇ tanˇ kaˬ ca te kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh tiˇ pehˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ leh, yawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ te luˬ leh, yawˇ hui ve venˇ hta‸ htawˇ aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkehˉ caˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kuˬ taˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ laˬ maˇ keunˍ.
Hkʼe te leh, ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ ceh da‸ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkehˉ caˇ kuiˬ lo kuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ya‸ kʼaw lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ lo kʼai leh, hkʼa mawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ, maˇ da‸ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, kuˬ hpawnˬ leh, hkehˉ caˇ kuiˬ lo chaw hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkehˉ caˇ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ ca lo‸ nyi la ve teˇ yanˇ, hkehˉ caˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ veu‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, hkehˉ caˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ veu‸ leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nawˬ choˬ kaˬ lo‸ la ve le teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yawˇ ve hkui sheh la‸ sheh hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ leh, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo baˬ keu-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, kuˬ yuˬ ve chaw maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, leuˆ yuˬ ve chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ kʼai leh, Yeˍsuˆ tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ yaw ya‸ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh Heˍroˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve, Saˍ la‸-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ kawˆ leh, shu ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ nyi ve teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ. Jawˇmawˇ Kehˉsaˍ hta‸ a moˇ keu piˇ cawˇ laˇ, maˇ keu piˇ cawˇ laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui nyi ma kʼaw‸ ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa shiˍ leh, Chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma te ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve le.
A moˇ hpu teˇ hteh‸ ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpu teˇ hteh‸ yuˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, A shu ve awˬ han, a shu ve awˬ meh cawˬ le teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Kehˉsaˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Hkʼe te leh, jawˇmawˇ Kehˉsaˍ ve mawˇ jawˇmawˇ Kehˉsaˍ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, anˇ leh yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve maˇ cawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Saˍduˆkehˇ chaw teˇ hpaˍ, oˇ ve teˇ nyi yawˇ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Saˍ la‸-oˬ, Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yaˇ maˇ cawˬ leh suh ve kʼo, awˬ nyi paˍ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ leh, awˬ viˉ paˍ awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ gʼa cawˬ piˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui geh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi suhˍ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˉ lawˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ heuˆ leh, yaˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ suh leh, awˬ nyi paˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, shehˆ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, leh suhˍ gʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, chi hkʼe teh taˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve htawˇ suh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw oˇ ve suhˍ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ heuˆ peuˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Li‸ hpu hta‸ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw nawˬ hui dawˇ ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ka piˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ te. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh ve chaw hui kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ lawn, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼaw jaw laˇ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha, Iˉcaˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha leh Yaˍkoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, suh ve chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui anˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍduˆkehˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa ve awˬ lawn Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui teˇ geh hpawnˬ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Saˍ la‸-oˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ hkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve nyi ma hkʼa peu-eˬ, nawˬ ve co ha hkʼa peu-eˬ leh nawˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ leh awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nyiˇ hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ htawˇ, awˉ lawˉ teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ gʼa ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ chi nyiˇ hkawˇ hta‸ tcuhˉ naw‸ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ na nyi ve,
Hkri‸ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve le. Yawˇ a shu ve yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Hkʼe te leh, Awˬ ha hpu Daˍviˆ hta‸ dawˇ pawnˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw yawˇ hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve le.

Awˬ lawn kʼo Daˍviˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve hkui sheh awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ taˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo mui chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍviˆ yawˇ hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh Daˍviˆ ve yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ tuˬ ve le teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ maˇ hpeh‸ leh, oˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ shu kʼaw‸ na nyi maˇ haˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hui lehˬ, Moˉseˍ ve mui kuiˬ lo mui ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa kʼoˆ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te-o. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui te ve hkʼe taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui maˇ te.
Hawˇ jaˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui tsuh‸ taˍ leh, chaw yaˇ hui ve la‸ hpeh kʼaˉ hkʼoˆ lo taˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, gu jiˆ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ a shu yawˇ ve la‸ naw meuˇ ceh ka‸ maˇ htawˇ.
Yawˇ hui hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ ceh te ve yoˬ. Li‸ hpu awˬ tawn ehˉ doˆ pfuhˇ kuiˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui uiˍ chaweh te leh, aˉ po‸ awˬ caˍ zuhˬ chaweh te ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hti caˇ hti dawˬ kuiˬ lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve mui kuiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˇ, bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve mui hkʼawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Tcuh hkʼaw lo shu yawˇ hui hta‸ yawˆ yan laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ saˍ la‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hui hta‸ saˍ la‸ teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ tcuh. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui saˍ la‸ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ awˬ pa teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai shehˍ hpaˇ teh‸ taˇ kʼoˆ tcuh. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui ve sheh kʼai shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo shu a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te ve yoˬ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˍ uiˍ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, taˍ i ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˍ i ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, taˍ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ, nawˬ hui yehˬ miˉ hta‸ hoˆ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ lo‸-e ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, lo‸-e gaˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ leh laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hkʼoˆ nawˬ hui teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo kʼai ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui a‸ kehˉ nyiˇ pun yawˇ hta‸ moˬ naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ kʼaw maˍ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkanˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te htawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, bon yehˬ lonˉ ve shi hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkanˍ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ ve chaw luˬ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ ve le. Shi uiˍ ve laˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo shi hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ uiˍ ve laˇ.

Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkanˍ ve hkʼe maˇ te htawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ hkanˍ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa te ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ ve le. Tanˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve laˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo, tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve tanˇ kuiˬ uiˍ ve laˇ.
Hkʼe te leh tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, tanˇ kuiˬ hta‸ ka‸, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ ka‸, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ka‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yo‸.
Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kʼaw jaw hta‸ ka‸, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ mui shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ka‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ i hkinˇ, hawˉ loˍ leh gʼaˆ shaweh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun yuˬ leh tanˇ piˇ ve htawˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo leuˉ leh uiˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ, hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ te ve, ha kʼaˉ ve leh yonˍ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ naw hui maˇ te. Chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ teh taˉ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kʼaw maˍ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˆ cuˉ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ puiˉ suhˆ naˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ che baˬ leh, kaˍlaˍoˆ hta‸ hehˆ dawˬ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ hkehˇ leh kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo tsuhˇ kehˬ ve htawˇ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lehˬ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh te ponˬ te leuˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ cuˉ ve Hpaˍriˍsehˇ-oˬ, hkehˇ leh kawˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo da‸ kehˬ la tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo awˉ lawˉ tsuhˇ kehˬ-o‸.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ, hpuˉ lehˍ shehˍ taˍ ve chaw tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh oˇ ve awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo nyi sha ve htawˇ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo chaw awˬ mu‸ ku leh cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ hta‸ hpawˇ chaw yaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo heˍ ve leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ, chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui ve tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gu te leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve kawˍ taˍ ve tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi sha tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ puˍ awˬ pi co-e htaˇ gʼa chehˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ maˇ heˆ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ puˍ awˬ pi te ve hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ te-o.
Vuiˬ haiˬ awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, suhˉ taˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui moˬ naˆ ho‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa geh tuˬ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ lehˬ tcuh kaˍ paˍ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ leh li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh lo peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo jaw‸ leh, teˇ venˇ peuˬ teˇ venˇ lo nawˬ hui kʼai leh fawˉ mehˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve Aˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ te leh, bon yehˬ lonˉ leh tanˇ kuiˬ awˬ kaˍ lo nawˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve aˍraˍhkiˆ yaˇ paˍ Zaˍhkaˍriˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼa gaˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo hkʼa sheˆ peuˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ suhˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ chaw chi teˇ co awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ-oˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ tiˇ pehˍ leh, nawˬ geh peu laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼaˆ ma peuˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ yehˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ toˍ la‸ kʼuˉ awˬ hawˉ lo hpoˆ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼaˬ nyiˇ pawˆ hpoˆ chehˇ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ maˇ te.
Nyi loˬ, nawˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ lehˬ, gawˬ cu gawˬ pehˆ te teh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh awˬ hawˉ lo laˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ bon uiˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸, nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yehˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ beˆ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui mawˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, yehˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ haˉ pui teˇ shiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ shiˍ maˇ cawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ shu te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo mui chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ hpeh‸ la tuˬ le. Nawˬ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ ve leh, miˬguiˬ chi awˬ yanˇ leh tuˬ ve awˬ heˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpehˬ tawˆ la tuˬ ve le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ a ciˉ hto laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw maˇ maˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pfuhˇ laˬ leh, Ngaˬ lehˬ Hkri‸ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ma‸ bawˆ ve leh bawˆ da‸-a teh‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa kawˆ cheˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve htawˇ, awˬ leh meuˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ.
Chaw teˇ ceuˬ leh teˇ ceuˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ peˆ leh teˇ peˆ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Meu‸ ve kaˆ ve leh miˬ hiˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ pa taw chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ canˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw maˇ maˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ chiˇ a‸ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ canˇ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ maˇ tawˆ la leh, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ maˇ la ve pa taw, chaw maˇ maˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ i kʼai yawnˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chehˇ ve chaw lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ chi, miˬ guiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo ca maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Daˍyeˍlaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, te luˬ te sheˆ puiˉ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo huˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, (li‸ chi hta‸ gʼaw ve chaw lehˬ shiˍ-o‸.)
oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo hpaw-e loˬ.
Yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve chaw a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo mawˇ ca yuˬ tuˬ, taˇ kʼaw‸ ya‸-e.
Heh hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ ca kʼaw‸ yuˬ tuˬ taˇ kʼo‸-e.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yaˇ hu ma leh cuˉ dawˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ cawˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa hpaw-e ve awˬ yanˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, shinˉ nyi htaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa cawˇ tuˬ bon lawˬ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ maˇ hpeh‸ la jaw sheˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve tu‸ jaˇ hkanˍ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, oˇ htaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve maˇ ngeh piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngeh piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Nyi-o, Hkri‸ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve kʼo taˇ yonˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve Hkri‸ leh maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpeh‸ ve kʼo leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ, uiˍ ve anˇ tuˬ leh awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nyi loˬ, maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui lehˬ, Nyi loˬ, yawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ka‸ taˇ kʼai. Bawehˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ka‸ taˇ yonˍ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ lehˬ mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ hpawˇ lo ba la leh mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ hpawˇ lo gaˬ ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ ve lehˬ, chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Suh taˍ ve awˬ to hkʼa cawˬ kuiˬ lo, naˬ beuˬ ngaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ mvuhˇ nyi naˆ ho‸ kʼai leh, ha pa htawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ ba. Meu‸ keu shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ mvuhˇ naw ma lo ce la leh, mvuhˇ naw ma ve kanˇ paˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu ve awˬ heˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ paˆ hawˬ leh, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, uiˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, mvuhˇ naw ma ve moˬ hta‸ ciˇ ya‸ la ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh, behˬ heh ma awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh meuˆ leh, yawˇ yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼai tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ awˇ ceˍ miˬ awˍ hpawˇ lo yawˇ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ hpawnˬ da‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hta‸ tehˆ maˍ ve tawˇ pa haˉ chi hta‸ henˇ yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ tuˍ tuˍ la leh, awˬ caˍ caˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ cha hkui yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ lehˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chi teˇ co maˇ ponˬ kʼai sheˍ htaˇ, awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma leh miˬ naˆ ma mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ maˇ mehˉ kʼai taˬ.
Awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui ka‸, Yaˇ hpu ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ ve lehˬ, Noˉa‸ ve awˬ co-e htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Noˉa‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, iˉ kaˆ maˇ htonˍ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui lehˬ caˇ ve dawˬ ve, awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ da‸ leh ka piˇ ve, chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ kaˆ htonˍ la leh yawˇ hui hta‸ poˬ chiˇ veu htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ ve hkʼe, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw nyiˇ gʼaˇ heh hkʼaw lo teˇ geh chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ teˇ geh haˉ pui mawˍ geuˆ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teh taˉ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ ve Awˬ jawˇmawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ nyi kʼaw‸ gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw shaw taˍ-o‸.
Yehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ laˬ tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw hkʼawˇ maˇ gʼa lo‸ la tuˬ yawˇ shaw taˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ-o‸.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, naw hui maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ yeˬ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu le. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ yanˇ cawˇ lehˍ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve hta‸ awˬ hoˉ te tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve awˬ ceˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve awˬ jawˇmawˇ haˆ haˆ maˇ kʼaw‸ la taˬ teh‸ yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ leh,
awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˆ leh, tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve chaw hui geh caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve kʼo,
awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve maˇ dawˇ maˇ gaˇ ve awˬ nyi, maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh,
yawˇ hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh ciˍ yanˍ piˇ leh chaw heˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ teˇ chi gʼaˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh, ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai htaˇ, naˍ manˇ maˇ yuˬ kʼai.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kawˆ faiˇ geh teˇ geh naˍ manˇ kaw hta‸ htawˇ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ haˆ haˆ maˇ laˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ zuh‸ muiˉ jo leh, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Shehˍ kʼaw hkui htaˇ gaˬ leh, Nyi loˬ, awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ laˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ca ha‸ yuˬ loˬ teh‸, shu kuˬ hkʼa laˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ tu la leh, a shu yawˇ ve kawˆ faiˇ hta‸ gu tuˉ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui ve kawˆ faiˇ suh la paˇ neˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve naˍ manˇ a ciˉ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ teh‸, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon leh nawˬ hui awˬ pon naˍ manˇ maˇ law‸ hehˉ. Naˍ manˇ hawˇ shehˍ hpaˇ geh kʼai leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ca vuiˬ-o‸ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui ca vuiˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ miˇ ma heuˆ shehˍ hpaˇ laˬ leh, gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkehˉ caˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ geh teˇ geh lo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yehˬ miˉ hoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yaˇ miˇ haˉ oˇ ve ngaˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ la leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ yehˬ miˉ a ciˉ hpaw laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shiˍ teh‸, kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ nyi hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ yanˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai-a teh‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ leh, yawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˉ ve hta‸ shuˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui puiˉ ve hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ nyi leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpu ngaˇ hinˉ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nyiˇ hinˉ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ hinˉ piˇ taˉ leh tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, hpu ngaˇ hinˉ gʼa ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ kʼai leh ca kaˬ ve pa taw, awˬ yawˬ ngaˇ hinˉ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, hpu nyiˇ hinˉ gʼa ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, awˬ yawˬ nyiˇ hinˉ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hpu teˇ hinˉ gʼa ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve hpu hta‸ yuˬ leh miˬ kʼoˍ ca duˇ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ maw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ ceˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˍ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui geh hpu caˇ lanˇ shawˍ nyi ve yoˬ.

Hpu ngaˇ hinˉ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh, awˬ yawˬ ngaˇ hinˉ hteh‸ ka‸ yuˬ veu laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpu ngaˇ hinˉ pe‸ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi-o, awˬ yawˬ ngaˇ hinˉ hteh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Da‸ ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ puiˉ leh da‸ ve awˬ ceˬ-oˬ, i ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ na yuˬ puiˉ ve pa taw, maˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ha lehˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpu nyiˇ hinˉ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpu nyiˇ hinˉ pe‸ taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nyi-o, awˬ yawˬ nyiˇ hinˉ hteh‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Da‸ ve yoˬ. Na yuˬ puiˉ leh da‸ ve awˬ ceˬ-oˬ, i ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ na yuˬ puiˉ ve pa taw, maˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ teh taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ha lehˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ htawˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpu teˇ hinˉ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ laˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ te haˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ maˇ sheˍ kuiˬ lo nawˬ gʼeu‸ yuˬ leh, nawˬ maˇ hpeuˇ baˬ kuiˬ lo nawˬ shaw hpoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ kawˆ ve pa taw, nawˬ ve hpu hta‸ miˬ kʼoˍ hkʼaw duˇ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nyi-o, nawˬ ve mawˇ nawˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Haiˬ ve leh bawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ-oˬ, maˇ sheˍ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ gʼeu‸ yuˬ leh, maˇ hpeuˇ baˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ shaw hpoˆ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve kʼo,
hpu chi ve hta‸ yuˬ leh hpu chiˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ kʼaw‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ ve hpu chi ve leh awˬ yawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, hpu teˇ hinˉ hta‸ yawˇ geh yuˬ hkʼaw‸ leh, hpu teˇ meunˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ kʼaw‸ htehˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ maˇ maˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ cawˬ ve chaw geh, yawˇ hkʼa cawˬ ve hta‸ ka‸ kʼaw‸ yuˬ tawˆ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ naˆ ho‸ kuiˬ lo baˬ keu-o. Oˇ kaˬ lo hkʼa chehˇ ve chaw hui hawˬ leh ciˬ geu‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo laˬ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ geh laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve kʼaw jaw awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ mui tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawnˬ la leh, yawˬ hawˉ paˍ, yawˬ leh aˉ che‸ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ pehˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ taˍ leh, aˉ che‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ mehˍ paˉ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ sha paˉ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ Awˬ pa geh awˬ bon gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, laˬ-o‸. Miˬguiˬ te hpanˍ htaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon gu taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo laˬ chehˇ la-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˍ meu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ awˍ caˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ taw laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ laˇ ve yoˬ, Ngaˬ chehˇ haˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ nyi laˇ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ca nyi la ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇ mawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˍ meu‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh awˍ caˍ laˇ ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le. Nawˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh iˉ kaˆ taw laˇ ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le.
Nawˬ hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le. Veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ leh veu‸ kʼaˇ feuˉ laˇ ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le.
Nawˬ chehˇ haˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh nawˬ hta‸ ca nyi la ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo i jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui te piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui-oˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ leh, neˇhaiˬ leh yawˇ ve tcuh yaˇ hui awˬ pon gu taˍ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ to‸ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e loˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˍ meu‸ ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ caˍ laˇ. Ngaˬ iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ maˇ taw laˇ.

Ngaˬ hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ feuˉ laˇ. Ngaˬ chehˇ haˍ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca nyi la teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˍ meu‸ ve, iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve, hkehˉ chaw hpeh‸ ve, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve, chehˇ haˍ ve, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh, nawˬ hta‸ maˇ ga laˇ ve hkʼaˬ htaˆ le teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo i jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ te piˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ te laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ ciˍ yanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Nyiˇ nyi peuˬ kʼo, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ peh tuˬ, shu chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ hui lehˬ, Kaˍyaˍhpaˆ meh ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ ve shaˉ nanˉ lo hpawnˬ da‸ leh,
hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ leh tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Chaw chi ma ve duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ, pawehˇ te ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ te teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Beˍtaˍniˆ hkʼaˆ hkʼaw hkiˬ tu‸ paˍ Siˉmonˍ ve aˉ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ htaˇ,

yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve naˍ manˇ hawnˉ keu taˍ ve hpuˉ-ehˍ ve haˉ pui kaw teˇ maˬ yuˬ laˬ leh, hpui lawˇ paˇ lo Yeˍsuˆ mui caˇ chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ naˍ manˇ hawnˉ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma te awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hta‸ yehˇ baˬ ve le.
Naˍ manˇ hawnˉ chi ve hta‸ awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ chaweh hawˇ leh haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ hui hta‸ pehˬ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ chi hta‸ shiˍ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te sho‸ sha‸ piˇ ve le. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ te laˇ peuˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Naˍ manˇ hawnˉ chi ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ laˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ tuˍ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon yawˇ gu taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ chi, miˬguiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo ca maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ miˇ chi hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yuˇda‸ Iˉsaˍkaˍriˍoˆ meh ve teˇ gʼaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui geh kʼai leh,
Nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma pe‸ laˇ tuˬ le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpu shehˆ chi hteh‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ teˇ hkui hta‸ tanˬ leh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ, da‸ ve awˬ yanˇ hta‸ Yuˇda‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo diˇ maˇ keu ve pawehˇ awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ Yeˍsuˆ geh laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, aˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon hkʼaˬ lo teˇ kaˬ gu tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve le teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw oˇ ve hpaˇ geh kʼai leh, Saˍ la‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ yanˇ neˇ la peuˬ. Nawˬ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui geh teˇ geh Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ hta‸ ngaˬ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ ceˇ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ tcuh ve hkʼe awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ te leh, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ca gu ve yoˬ.
Mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ geh hpui lawˇ paˇ lo yawˇ mui caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui caˇ chehˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ laˇ teh‸ teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ geh teˇ hkehˇ tiˉ hkaˆ caˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ lawn bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ gʼa kʼo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ chiˇ a‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve maˇ paw la ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ awˬ pon da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ shehˍ hpaˇ Yuˇda‸ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ laˇ teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yoˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui caˇ chehˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ yuˬ leh bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh yawˇ hkaoˍmonˇ hta‸ hkʼeh‸ leh, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ yawˇ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yuˬ leh caˇ-oˆ. Chi lehˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ to yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Kawˆ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ yuˬ leh bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ chi hta‸ dawˬ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi lehˬ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa tuˬ, chaw maˇ maˇ awˬ pon ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ngaˬ Awˬ pa ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ suhˉ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa dawˬ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh yawˇ hui kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ kʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui tawˆ-e leh Shaˍlonˍ hkʼaw lo kʼai ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ya‸ puiˉ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw nyi ma luˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˬ hawˉ paˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˆ pehˍ leh, yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˆ da‸ leh teˇ kaˬ teˇ hkeh hpaw kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Peˍtruˆ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw shu hkʼa peu-eˬ nyi ma luˬ htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ luˬ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ya‸ puiˉ gʼaˆ hpfuh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ htaˇ, nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Peˍtruˆ lehˬ, Nawˬ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ gʼa suh ve htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ chiˇ baˬ taˬ teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh kʼai leh, Geˍseˍmaˍniˆ meh ve teˇ kaˬ lo gaˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo bon ca lawˬ htaˇ, nawˬ hui choˬ kaˬ lo mui taˍ-o‸ teh‸, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, Peˍtruˆ leh Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yawˇ shiˍ veu ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ nyi ma dawˇ haˍ jaˇ, sho‸ sha‸ jaˇ la leh,
yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ nyi ma dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve suh la yoˬ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ geh teˇ geh shaw taˍ-o‸.

Peuˬ leh, yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ a ciˉ kʼai leh, yawˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ miˬ chaˇ hkʼoˆ boˆ sheˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, kawˆ chi hta‸ ngaˬ ponˬ kʼai hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ponˬ kʼai tcuh laˇ-oˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Nawˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui geh yawˇ kʼaw‸ la leh, yawˇ hui zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, Peˍtruˆ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Teˇ naˍ riˍ ceh ka‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh shaw taˍ maˇ hpeh‸ laˇ.
Nawˬ hui beˬ ve lawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ bon lawˬ leh shaw taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai leh, Ngaˬ pa-oˬ, kawˆ chi hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ dawˬ leh ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ teh‸, bon kʼaw‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼaw‸ la htaˇ, yawˇ hui zuh‸ muiˉ geu‸ jaˇ ve pa taw zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ teh taˉ leh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ yawˇ lawˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ bon kʼaw‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui geh yawˇ kʼaw‸ la leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa leh gʼaˇ jehˇ chehˇ sheˍ laˇ. Nyi loˬ, chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, chaw haiˬ hui ve la‸ hkʼaw lo chiˇ a‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.
Tu, kʼai-a veuˬ. Nyi loˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ paˇ lo gaˬ la peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ tawˇ yaw chehˇ htaˇ, tcuh yaˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yuˇda‸ meh ve teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ leh, aˉ htaw pfuhˇ leh suhˆ taˬ taˆ ve chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ htawˇ yawˇ geh teˇ geh laˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ tcuh peu laˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ heˆ chi hkʼe te tuˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve, Ngaˬ boˆ nu ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ yawˇ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ tiˍ taˍ-o‸.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh teˇ cawˬ haˉ kʼai leh, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ boˆ nu ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Awˬ chawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ dawˇ taˍ leh laˬ ve hkʼe te-o teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ vawˆ leh yuˬ tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ geh chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve aˉ htaw gʼawˬ tawˆ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hta‸ chaw leh, naˍ paw cheˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ ve aˉ htaw hta‸ awˬ hpui awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ keu-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˉ htaw hkʼa yehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, aˉ htaw hta‸ pa taw luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ chi nyiˇ moˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸ ngaˬ geh peu laˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ Awˬ pa geh lawˬ maˇ gʼa teh‸ nawˬ dawˇ ve laˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe lawˬ ve kʼo, chi hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve Li‸ hpu teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te biˇ la tuˬ le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ hui lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ ca hpeh yuˬ ve hkʼe aˉ htaw leh suhˆ taˬ teˇ hpaˍ yuˬ veu laˇ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ca hpeh la ve laˇ. Teˇ nyi le le bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkaw lo ngaˬ mui taˍ leh maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ hpeh yuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui ve li‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh hpaw-e ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo, paw hkuˇ lonˉ Kaˍyaˍhpaˆ geh yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Peˍtruˆ lehˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ ve shaˉ nanˉ awˬ paˇ lo ko taˍ kuiˬ teˇ kaˬ hkʼa gaˬ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh a ciˉ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai leh, awˬ lawn chi awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ lo‸-e leh shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh jehˬ da‸ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, yawˇ awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ca ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ maˇ tu la leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ ve htawˇ, jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hui shaˉ hkiˆ ca maˇ mawˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ htaˇ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Chi hpaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, shehˆ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ te gʼa ve yoˬ ceˇ teh‸, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ tu la leh, Nawˬ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ yaw hkʼaw‸ ve laˇ. Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ lawn aˬ hto‸ ma shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve le teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ ta‸ iˉ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Paw hkuˇ lonˉ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ yoˬ laˇ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yoˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, chi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo chaw yaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, Kanˇ paˆ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo mui leh, mvuhˇ naw ma ve moˬ hta‸ ciˇ ya‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ paw hkuˇ lonˉ yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ tzuh‸ suhˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui aˬ hto‸ ma shaˉ hkiˆ kʼaw‸ loˍ sheˍ le. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ le teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yawˇ lehˬ suh keunˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ pfuhˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ chu-eˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ hta leh kʼoˆ ve, Hkri‸-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ a shu dawˆ laˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Peˍtruˆ lehˬ, shaˉ nanˉ awˬ paˇ lo ko taˍ kuiˬ awˬhkʼaw hpawˇ lo mui chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ htawˇ Gaˍliˍlehˇ chaw Yeˍsuˆ geh chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Peˍtruˆ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ leh, Nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh, Peˍtruˆ ko taˍ kuiˬ yehˬ miˉ awˬ baˬ lo tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceˬ ma teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ mawˬ leh, Chi hpaˇ lehˬ, Naˍzaˍrehˆ chaw Yeˍsuˆ geh chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, oˇ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ leh, Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ maˇ maw maw gaˬ leh, oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ Peˍtruˆ geh laˬ leh, Nawˬ htawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ tawˇ yaw ve hkawˇ hta‸ na ve ceh ka‸, ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ hkeu leh, Chaw oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ cawˬ haˉ gʼaˆ hpfuh bvuhˬ la ve yoˬ.
Gʼaˆ hpfuh maˇ bvuhˬ sheˍ htaˇ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ chiˇ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ Peˍtruˆ dawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh gʼaˇ hte‸ hawˬ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ htiˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ jehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ hpeh peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ sheh veu leh, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ Piˉla‸ ve la‸ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ shehˍ hpaˇ Yuˇda‸ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ shu suhˉ taˆ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh, hpu oˇ ve shehˆ chi hteh‸ hta‸ paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh kʼaw‸ yuˬ laˬ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe caˉ da‸ le. Nawˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼaˇ nawˬ nyi-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpu oˇ ve hta‸ bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˬ keu taˉ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼawˍ peˍ ca nyiˉ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, Hpu chi lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, hpu tanˇ geh hkaw‸ da‸ maˇ cawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui jehˬ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tuˍ piˇ tuˬ, hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ ve miˬ guiˬ teˇ peˆ hta‸ vuiˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ miˬguiˬ oˇ ve teˇ peˆ hta‸ Awˬ suhˍ miˬguiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, tcuh kaˍ paˍ Yeˍraˍmiˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ hpfuhˇ kʼoˆ cheˆ taˍ ve, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hpu shehˆ chi hta‸ yuˬ leh,
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ laˇ ve hkʼe, mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ ve miˬguiˬ teˇ peˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui vuiˬ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ huˉ chehˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ miˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ yoˬ laˇ teh‸ na nyi ve yoˬ. Yoˬ, nawˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe yoˬ teh‸, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ awˬ lawn yawˇ hui shaˉ hkiˆ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ maˇ kaˇ laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ lehˬ tawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ maˇ yaw hkʼaw‸ ve pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Pawehˇ oˇ ve hta‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw chi ma ve nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ hpehˇ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve Baˍraˍbaˆ meh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ htaˇ, jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ hui awˬ pon a shu hta‸ hpehˇ tcuh gaˇ le. Baˍraˍbaˆ hta‸ laˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ laˇ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve pa taw yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ mui chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma yawˇ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe shanˍ piˇ ve, Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ya‸ nyi yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ zuh‸ maˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ peuˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu piˇ ve yoˬ.
Baˍraˍbaˆ hta‸ lawˬ yuˬ leh Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw chi ma ve hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, Chaw chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ hpehˇ tcuh gaˇ le teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ na nyi htaˇ, Baˍraˍbaˆ hta‸ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ lehˬ, Hkʼe te kʼo, Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te tuˬ le teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yawˇ hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ loˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw le. Yawˇ haiˬ ve aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te ve le teh‸ na nyi htaˇ, Yawˇ hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ loˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui leuˉ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kʼaw‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ lehˬ, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, shu duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te tawˆ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ iˉ kaˆ yuˬ leh chaw awˬ moˍ lonˉ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ la‸ sheh tsuhˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chaw chi teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ taˇ gaˬ la piˇ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui te-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ ngaˬ hui leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ gaˬ la piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon Baˍraˍbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ piˇ leh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ jaw‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ tuˬ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hawˉ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ kʼai leh, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ta‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ geh hpawnˬ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ ve aˉ po‸ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ leh, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma yawˇ hta‸ deh piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˉ chuˇ te hta‸ yuˬ leh shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼe te gʼa‸ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ la‸ sha paˉ ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw lo, lo taˬ teˇ taˬ vawˆ taˍ tcuh leh, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh kʼoˆ ve, Yuˇda‸ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ bon uiˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh kʼoˆ guiˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hta‸ ciˉ gʼuiˇ hpe‸ pfuhˍ leh, lo taˬ oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ yuˬ leh yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ dawˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼehˆ baˬ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ feuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ sheh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Siˉmonˍ meh ve Kuˇreˍneˍ venˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ nyiˉ leh Yeˍsuˆ ve la‸ ka hta‸ taˆ tcuh ve yoˬ.
Gawˇlaˍgawˇtaˆ meh ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ meh oˇ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, oˉ koˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼaˇ ve naˆ tsuhˇ hkaw‸ taˍ ve a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ taw piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ leh‸ nyi sheˬ leh maˇ dawˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ keu peuˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kuˇ da‸ leh yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pehˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui oˇ kaˬ lo mui leh yawˇ hta‸ shaw taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chaw chi lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ Yeˍsuˆ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve li‸ yawˇ hui bvuh‸ leh, yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo nehˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh chaw hkʼawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, la‸ sha paˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, la‸ mehˍ paˉ teˇ gʼaˇ, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ keu taˍ ve yoˬ.
Kʼai chehˇ laˬ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ leh, a shu yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hiˆ leh kʼoˆ ve,
Bon yehˬ lonˉ hta‸ te luˬ leh shehˆ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ te gʼa ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ponˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ kʼo, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui lehˬ, li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ leh awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ guiˇ gʼuiˬ guiˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve, Shu hta‸ yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ maˇ gʼa. Yawˇ lehˬ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la piˇ sheˍ. Oˇ htaˇ heh‸, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cuˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼui sha ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸ teh‸, yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ geh teˇ geh la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ keu taˍ ve chaw hkʼawˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw tcuhˆ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ shehˆ naˍ riˍ hkʼa gaˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ hpawˇ shehˆ naˍ riˍ hkʼe gaˬ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh te leh, Eˇliˆ, Eˇliˆ, laˍmaˍ saˍbaˆtaˍniˍ teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ lehˬ, Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ laˇ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ tawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ htaˇ, Chi hpaˇ lehˬ, Eˇliˇya‸ hta‸ kuˬ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ cawˬ haˉ gʼuiˇ kʼai leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ mvuhˬ teˇ maˬ hta‸ yuˬ leh, ci ve awˬ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tuˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, lo taˬ hta‸ choˆ leh, yawˇ hta‸ taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Taˇ te sheˍ. Eˇliˇya‸ yawˇ htaˬ ca htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ la tuˬ leh naˍ, nyi taˍ shaˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kuˬ leh shaˉ cheˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ bon yehˬ lonˉ ve hpaˬ kaˍ lehˬ, awˬ na te leh awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ nyiˇ hkoˇ tzuh‸ sheˬ ve yoˬ. Miˬ hiˆ leh, haˉ pui teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkoˇ sheˬ ve yoˬ.
Tuˍ hpfuh teˇ hpaˍ hpaw sheˬ leh, suh taˍ peuˬ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ awˬ to kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ hui tuˍ hpfuh hkʼaw lo tawˆ la leh, da‸ kehˬ ve venˇ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ma‸ poˍ leh yawˇ geh Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ shaw chehˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬ hiˆ ve leh hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ htaˇ, yawˇ hui kawˆ jaˇ leh, Chi hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha ve yaˇ hpu teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ kaˬ a ciˉ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo yaˇ miˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ htawˇ chehˇ leh nyi taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la htaˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai leh yawˇ hta‸ te caˍ te taw piˇ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, Maˍriˆ Maˍgaˍdaˍlaˆ, Yaˍkoˆ leh Yoˇseh‸ ve awˬ e Maˍriˆ leh, Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ hui ve awˬ e, chi teˇ hpaˍ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ la htaˇ, Aˍriˆma‸htehˍ venˇ yaˇ Yoˇseh‸ meh ve paw sha paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ geh kʼai leh, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ to hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ piˇ tuˬ jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ to hta‸ yuˬ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, da‸ kehˬ ve hpa hpu yuˬ htiˆ sheˬ leh, haˉ pui htawˆ taˍ ve,
yawˇ ve tuˍ hpfuh awˬ suhˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo keu taˍ ve yoˬ. Tuˍ hpfuh awˬ hkʼoˇ meuˇ lo uiˍ jaˇ ve haˉ pui teˇ shiˍ hta‸ hpfuhˆ tsuhˇ taˉ leh kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo Maˍriˆ Maˍgaˍdaˍlaˆ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Maˍriˆ teˇ gʼaˇ, tuˍ hpfuh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ vuiˇ maˇ neˇ kuiˬ lo mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Pawehˇ te tuˬ gu ve awˬ nyi peuˬ leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ nyi htaˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui leh Hpaˍriˍsehˇ teˇ hpaˍ jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ geh hpawnˬ kʼai leh kʼoˆ ve,
Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw chi teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te‸ chehˇ htaˇ, Shehˆ nyi peuˬ kʼo ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ yuˬ leh, Yawˇ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ teh‸, chaw chi ma ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa ca kʼoˆ piˇ tuˬ, shehˆ nyi hkʼa gaˬ tuˍ hpfuh oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shaw taˍ tuˬ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˉ lawˉ heˍ ve a‸ kehˉ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ heˍ ve lehˬ, leuˉ leh jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Piˉla‸ lehˬ, Nawˬ hui geh shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Kʼai leh nawˬ hui te gʼa ve hkʼe, hkʼa deh‸ te leh shaw tcuh-o teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui kʼai leh, tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ shu hpaw maˇ gʼa tuˬ haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ yinˉ tcuhˉ sheˬ leh, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shinˉ nyi teˇ nyi peuˬ leh, suhˍ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi mvuhˇ htiˇ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, Maˍriˆ Maˍgaˍdaˍlaˆ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Maˍriˆ teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ tuˍ hpfuh hta‸ ca nyi ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ miˬ hiˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo ya‸ la leh haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ sheˬ leh, haˉ pui shiˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han lehˬ, mvuhˇ tiˉ po-e‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ htawˇ vaˇ meu-e hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpu ve yoˬ.
Shaw shehˍ hpaˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ kawˆ jaˇ ve pa taw cheˇ jaˇ leh, chaw suh hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. La‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ ve Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ ca nyi la ve ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ choˬ kaˬ maˇ chehˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ teh taˍ kuiˬ lo ca nyi la-o.

Haˆ haˆ kʼo‸-e leh, suh kuiˬ lo yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ ca hto piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼuˇ suhˍ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ lo yawˇ kʼai peuˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ sheˍ. Nyi loˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kawˆ ka‸ kawˆ, ha lehˬ ka‸ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ cawˬ haˉ tuˍ hpfuh lo tu leh, awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ tuˬ gʼuiˇ kʼo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ca ha‸ la leh, Awˬ bon uiˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ ve hkui sheh hta‸ ca vawˆ taˍ leh yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Taˇ kawˆ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ca hto piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, shaw shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e leh, hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui lehˬ, awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ hui geh hpawnˬ da‸ leh jehˬ da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui hpu maˇ maˇ piˇ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hui zuh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ ca hkʼawˇ yuˬ la ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui shu hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ te‸ chiˉ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ beˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yawˇ hui hpu oˇ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, shu yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ bvuhˬ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ oˇ ve teˇ chi teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ lo kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ yonˍ.
Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hui geh jiˆ laˬ leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh nawˬ hui kʼai leh, chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ ve awˬ la‸ gʼawˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ca te-o. Awˬ pa, Yaˇ hpu leh da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu awˬ meh awˬ hawˉ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ na yuˬ leh te tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Miˬguiˬ chi awˬ yanˇ leh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ Iˉsaˍyaˆ ve li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Nyi loˬ, nawˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu taˍ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ ve tcuh yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ peu kʼai ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ gu taˍ loˬ. Yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ te-o teh‸, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la leh baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa gʼa tuˬ, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve baˆtiˆsaˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ Yoˇhanˬ geh kʼai ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ leh, Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ lehˬ, kaˍlaˍoˆ awˬ mvuh te taˍ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, caw‸ cehˍ nyi lo shaˍ guiˬ haˍ pi caˆ tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Paˉ ce‸ leh heh puiˉ hkʼaw ve pehˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ yawˇ caˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ bon maˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ a‸ kehˉ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ lehˍ te leh yawˇ ve hkuiˉ nuˆ caˆ hta‸ hpui tuˬ ve ceh ka‸ maˇ keunˍ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ Naˍzaˍrehˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo Yeˍsuˆ tawˆ la leh, Yawˇdanˍ gʼuiˬ ma awˬ hkʼaw lo Yoˇhanˬ yawˇ hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ iˉ kaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ cawˬ haˉ tawˆ la htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hpaw leh Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ aˉ pui kʼaˍ hkʼe yawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ ya‸ la ve hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ha‸ jaˇ ve ngaˬ ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, mvuhˇ naw ma lo awˬ hkawˇ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Teˇ cawˬ haˉ Awˬ ha hpu yawˇ hta‸ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo gʼa‸ peu ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo awˇ chi nyi chehˇ leh, Saˍtanˍ yawˇ hta‸ beˬ ve lawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ teˇ hpaˍ geh chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ loˍ ve hta‸ ga piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yoˇhanˬ hta‸ shu hpeh yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Yeˍsuˆ Gaˍliˍlehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ lo laˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ maˍ piˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ yanˇ biˇ la peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ peu. Venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ leh ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ yonˍ loˬ teh‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gaˍliˍlehˇ gʼuiˬ po paˇ lo Yeˍsuˆ kʼai chehˇ htaˇ, Siˉmonˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Anˍdrehˍ gʼuiˬ po awˬ hkʼaw lo geu‸ hpehˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ ngaˇ ca paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ suh laˬ-o‸. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chaw ca shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ teˇ cawˬ haˉ geu‸ hta‸ teh taˉ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ a ciˉ kʼaw‸ kʼai htaˇ, Zeˍbeˍdehˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ Yaˍkoˆ leh yawˇ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yoˇhanˬ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw geu‸ gu tawˉ chehˇ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ cawˬ haˉ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼaˇ ga caˇ paˍ hui geh awˬ pa Zeˍbeˍdehˇ hta‸ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo teh taˉ peuˬ leh, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui Kaˍpeˍneˍonˍ lo taˆ-e leh maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hui maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ maˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ teˇ hkui yawˇ hui ve bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo neˇ cha‸ chiˆ geh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Naˍzaˍrehˆ chaw Yeˍsuˆ-oˬ, nawˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe caˉ da‸ le. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ laˇ tuˬ nawˬ laˬ ve laˇ. Nawˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ deˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Ta‸ iˉ chehˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai-o teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Neˇ cha‸ chiˆ lehˬ, chaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ hpeˆ dawˇ tcuh leh, awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ anˇ leh kʼoˆ ve, Chi ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Maˍ piˇ ve chi lehˬ, awˬ suhˉ teˇ ceuˬ law leˇ. Neˇ cha‸ chiˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ tawˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hui na yuˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ cawˬ haˉ Gaˍliˍ lehˇ mvuhˇ miˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ hui bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai leh, Yaˍkoˆ leh Yoˇhanˬ geh Siˉmonˍ leh Anˍdrehˍ hui ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Siˉmonˍ awˬ miˇ ma ve awˬ e kaˆ naˬ leh zuh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ lawn Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui teˇ cawˬ haˉ hto piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ laˬ leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve la‸ sheh hta‸ vawˆ leh tu la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve kaˆ naˬ ve na-e la leh, yawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ te caˍ te taw piˇ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ nyi kʼehˬ peuˬ leh mehˆ muiˉ naˆ la paˇ neˇ htaˇ, naˬ ve gawˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, neˇ geh ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ geh shiˍ veu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Venˇ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yehˬmiˉhpe‸ awˬ paˇ lo hpawnˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
