Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw awˬ bon chi awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui gʼa lo‸ la leh gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law leh, ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ la ve yoˬ.
Yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve hta‸ pa taw da‸ ve hta‸ te puiˉ la ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve hta‸ te puiˉ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui dawˇ law puiˉ la ve hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Dawˇ law puiˉ ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngeuˍ keu laˇ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ nuˇ jaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw haiˬ hui awˬ pon Hkri‸ hkanˍ suh ve yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw awˬ pon hkanˍ suh tuˬ ve chaw ca haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Teˇ pawˆ pawˆ chaw da‸ awˬ pon hkanˍ suh haˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ yaˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ, Hkri‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon hkanˍ suh leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ ve hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ maw laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hkanˍ suh ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ la peuˬ ve kʼo, Yaˇ hpu te‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha lehˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ la peuˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ lo‸ la leh, venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw suh ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ venˇbaˆ te peuˬ ve pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˇ taˍ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo venˇbaˆ cawˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, venˇbaˆ maˇ taˍ sheˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Aˍdanˍ hta‸ tanˬ leh Moˉseˍ ve awˬ co-e hkʼa gaˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ te ya‸ ve lehˬ, Aˍdanˍ te ya‸ ve hta‸ maˇ shuˍ da‸ htawˇ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Aˍdanˍ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te ya‸ ve oˇ ve lehˬ hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ shuˍ da‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ ve pa taw, chaw maˇ maˇ gʼa suh ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon ka‸, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve awˬ bon ka‸, chaw maˇ ve awˬ pon leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ maˇ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ teˇ ya‸ ve hta‸ pa taw hpeh‸ la ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ shuˍ da‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ te ya‸ ve ka‸, suhˉ jehˬ leh ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, te ya‸ maˇ ve ka‸, hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ leh, te ya‸ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw suh ve teˇ ceuˬ uˉ peunˍ ve kʼo, maˇ jaˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ka‸, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa ve chaw hui lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw te‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo leuˉ leh gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te ya‸ ve hta‸ pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, co ha gʼa te‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, chaw maˇ maˇ venˇbaˆ yaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ na yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, chaw maˇ maˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ ve jiˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ la tuˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ lo‸ la ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ venˇbaˆ maˇ la ve teˇ kaˬ lo awˬ bon leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ maˇ la ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, suh ve hta‸ cuˇ leh uˉ peunˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Awˬ bon maˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼaw‸ kʼai tuˬ sheˍ laˇ. Maˇ kʼai taˬ.
Ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ hpawˇ suh peuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kʼaw‸ te‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Ngaˬ hui Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ peuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, yawˇ suh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.

Hkʼe te leh, baˆtiˆsaˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ htaˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh suh leh tuˍ taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ lehˬ, Awˬ pa ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ pa taw suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui htawˇ te‸ la leh chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui yawˇ geh teˇ geh suh ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui yawˇ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te leh, venˇbaˆ ve awˬ to luˬ kʼai tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ piˍ lehˬ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh peuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Suh peuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ tawˆ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh suh ve kʼo, yawˇ geh teˇ geh te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ lehˬ, suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ ve pa taw, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ suh leh, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ ve teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkanˍ suh ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpawˇ teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ hkanˍ suh leh, yawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui htawˇ venˇbaˆ hpawˇ suh peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hpawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve teh‸ shawˍ taˍ-o‸.
Venˇbaˆ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ, nawˬ hui suh puiˉ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇ baˆ hta‸ taˇ uˉ peunˍ tcuh.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haiˬ ve awˬ pon la‸ caˉ hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ taˇ a‸ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ ve chaw hui hpeh‸ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ pon la‸ caˉ hkʼe yehˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ a‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ bon awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.
Hkʼe te leh hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ leh awˬ bon awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te tuˬ laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ to yawˇ hta‸ a‸ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui na yuˬ chehˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ te ve kʼo, gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, na yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ te ve kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ venˇbaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ jaw htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ na yuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ tawˆ la peuˬ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ceh dawˇ pawnˍ puiˉ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ hui shiˍ hpeh‸ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ te tuˬ leh, haiˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ haiˬ ve hta‸ te tuˬ a‸ piˇ jaw ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ te tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ maˇ hpeh‸.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te ve pa taw, awˬ bon hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa le. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon ya‸ taw tuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ leh meuˇ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ponˬ tawˆ la peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve pa taw, naw hui da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Awˬ bon oˇ ve awˬ leh meuˇ lehˬ, co ti‸ ha ti‸ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, venˇbaˆ te leh gʼa ve awˬ hpfuhˇ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼe leˇ pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ bon lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ yawˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. (Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ paˍ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ geh hpeh ka taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ awˬ hpawˇ suh peuˬ ve kʼo, awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ awˬ miˇ ma gʼa ponˬ peuˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ maˇ suh sheˍ htaˇ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca heuˆ ve kʼo, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te shehˍ ma teh‸ shu yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ suh peuˬ ve kʼo, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ponˬ peuˬ ve pa taw, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ca heuˆ ve htawˇ, yawˇ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te shehˍ ma maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ hui Hkri‸ ve awˬ to geh teˇ geh suh peuˬ ve pa taw, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui heuˆ da‸ peuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la tuˬ, venˇ baˆ te gaˇ ve nyi ma teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ te gaˇ ve nyi ma oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ pa taw nawˇ la ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ponˬ peuˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeh tiˍ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui suh taˉ peuˬ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui kanˉ te ve lehˬ, bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ piˍ awˬ hawˉ lo te ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve nyi ma awˬ suhˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ le. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ taˇ sheˉ lai teh‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, sheˉ lai ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ venˇbaˆ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ pa taw awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa leh, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo sheˉ lai ve laiˉ ceuˬ te tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ lehˬ suh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ gaˬ la htaˇ, venˇbaˆ te‸ la leh ngaˬ suh ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ co ha gʼa te‸ tuˬ ve teh‸ dawˇ ve ka‸, ngaˬ awˬ pon suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo venˇbaˆ lehˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa leh, ngaˬ hta‸ heˍ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, oˇ ve hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ htawˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh, da‸ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ suh tuˬ te laˇ ve laˇ. Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ taˬ. Venˇbaˆ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ, venˇbaˆ lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ suh tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, venˇbaˆ hkʼaˬ ma haiˬ jaˇ ve hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, co ha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, venˇbaˆ vuiˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ te ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca dawˇ maˇ tawˆ. Ngaˬ te gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ te leh, ngaˬ canˇ jaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ te gaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te ve kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh maˇ da‸ ve oˇ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ awˬ to te ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ awˬ to chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve hta‸ te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ htawˇ, da‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te maˇ puiˉ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ te gaˇ ve ka‸ maˇ te. Maˇ te gaˇ ve awˬ haiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˇ te gaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ to oˇ ve hta‸ te ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve venˇbaˆ te ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ da‸ ve hta‸ te gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ haiˬ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo tiˉ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ liˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ chi teˇ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh kʼai tuˬ ka‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ hpeh‸ bawˬ jaˇ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ suh piˇ lawˬ puiˉ ve awˬ to chi awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu ponˬ laˇ tuˬ le.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ponˬ laˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ cawˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ cawˇ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi beu‸ ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo co ha te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo leh, suh ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ hpehˇ laˇ peuˬ.

Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ pa taw, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh te maˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ peuˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, venˇbaˆ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui awˬ to cawˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ to cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ kʼai leh, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, suh ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, co ha te‸ ve leh dawˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ canˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo maˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, chehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ.
Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve chaw hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ tehˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Hkri‸ ve Awˬ ha hpu maˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ Hkri‸ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Hkri‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve kʼo, awˬ to lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw suh peuˬ ve htawˇ, co ha lehˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui suh puiˉ ve awˬ to hta‸ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ geh jeˬ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh a sha‸ te‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh awˬ to te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui co ha gʼa te‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu shiˍ kʼai sheh kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kawˆ tuˬ, awˬ ceˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui awˬ yaˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbaˆ a pa-oˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma geh teˇ geh shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh awˬ shinˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa caˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ teˇ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ tehˆ nyi maˇ keunˍ ve teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hpanˍ taˍ te taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ tuˬ, dawˇ law jaˇ leh law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, hpanˍ taˍ te taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ te maˇ gʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ chehˇ gaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh shehˍ hpaˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ pa taw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hpanˍ taˍ te taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ te ve hta‸ gʼa ponˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ponˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ hui dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ hpanˍ taˍ teˍtaˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, teˇ geh hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh, teˇ geh tu‸ jaˇ hkanˍ jaˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ha hpu ve awˬ bon hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa peuˬ ve ngaˬ hui htawˇ, awˬ yaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ la leh, awˬ to chi htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui law chehˇ htaˇ, nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve kʼo, kʼaw‸ dawˇ law tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ law tuˬ sheˍ le.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui maˇ mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve kʼo, oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve hta‸ Awˬ ha hpu ga laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui bon hkʼaˬ hkʼe te lawˬ cawˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ shiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ hkʼanˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui awˬ pon lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hkʼanˇ ve lehˬ, tawˇ yaw maˇ tawˆ leh hkʼanˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nyi ma hta‸ ca nyi shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui awˬ pon Awˬ ha hpu lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa ha‸ ve chaw hui awˬ pon, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ yawˇ te tawˆ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬ sha yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ shiˍ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yaˇ uiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha te ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hpawˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, a shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ponˬ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu geh teˇ geh hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ a shu venˇbaˆ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve teh‸ a shu suhˉ taˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Hkanˍ suh shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ yoˬ. Yawˇ hkanˍ suh ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ, suh kuiˬ lo yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sha paˉ lo chehˇ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon lawˬ hkawˉ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Hkri‸ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, a shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ hpaˆ laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve, kawˆ tuˬ ve, aˉ hte‸ aˉ htaw, chi teˇ hpaˍ laˇ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Nawˬ awˬ pon teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ hui tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ ve yawˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shu shawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pa taw, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui leuˉ leh gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ la tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ,

kanˇ paˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, naˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ hpaˆ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ ngaˬ yonˍ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ heˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ leh, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ nyi ma haw haw chiˆ chiˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma htawˇ, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh awˬ lawn chi hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui awˬ pon, ngaˬ awˬ to Hkri‸ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ leh hkeu ve hta‸ hkanˍ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ gʼa ve maˇ kʼoˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hui ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ puˍ lonˉ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ shawˍ kʼo, Hkri‸ htawˇ yawˇ hui ve chaw ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ chehˇ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ bon uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A menˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ luˬ kʼai ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw awˬ tehˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Iˉcaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ nawˬ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ shawˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Kʼoˆ gaˇ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hui ceh tiˉ yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Nehˉ hkʼaw‸ chi teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ htaˇ, Saˍraˇ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Reˍbehˆka‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa Iˉcaˆ hta‸ heuˆ leh yaˇ hu chehˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ maˇ paw la sheˍ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ da‸ ve kanˉ ka‸ maˇ da‸ ve kanˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa te sheˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha chaw yaˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve lehˬ, kanˉ te ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, kuˬ yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ chaw hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ shu gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, awˬ e hta‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve,
Awˬ viˉ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nyi paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yaˍkoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ leh Iˉsawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ canˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ Moˉseˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Ngaˬ awˬ bon te piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ bon te piˇ leh, ngaˬ ha kʼaˉ piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Heuˆ gaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon te piˇ ve hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw jawˇmawˇ Hpaˍrawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hpeu‸ tawˆ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve awˬ meh bvuhˬ kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ bon te piˇ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ te piˇ leh, nyi ma heh piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ heh piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, aˬ hto‸ ma te Gʼuiˬsha venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ taˍ laˇ sheˍ le. Yawˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ a shu tawˍ taˍ gʼa tuˬ le teh‸ nawˬ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw le. Te taˍ ve mawˇ lehˬ, te shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸, Aˬ hto‸ ma te ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ laˇ.

Mu‸ hkʼu te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, mu‸ hkʼu te tuˬ ve je‸ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Je‸ teˇ diˬ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve awˬ pon yehˇ tuˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ shiˍ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ pon yehˇ tuˬ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ shiˍ hta‸ yawˇ te hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ maw piˇ tuˬ leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ awˬ pon gu taˍ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ leh yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le.

Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ tuˬ ve awˬ pon awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ gu taˍ ve, yawˇ ha kʼaˉ ve mu‸ hkʼu teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ hkʼaˬ ma maˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le.

Yawˇ hkʼa kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve muˬ hkʼu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ kuˬ yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Hawˇseˍ li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, maˇ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸, Nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍyaˆ htawˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ awˬ lawn bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ leh kʼoˆ ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ ve htawˇ, chaw a ciˉ ceh tiˉ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ haˆ haˆ te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ teh taˉ laˇ ve kʼo, Sawˉdonˍ venˇ hkʼe ngaˬ hui hpeh‸ leh, Gawˇmawˇra‸ venˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ cawˬ le. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ ca ve htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa peuˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, yonˍ leh gʼa ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ca ve htawˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te biˇ maˇ gʼa.
Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, yonˍ ve hta‸ maˇ cuˇ leh kanˉ hta‸ ceh tiˉ cuˇ ve pa taw yoˬ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Nyi loˬ. Chaw yaˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ tuˬ ve haˉ pui leh, paiˍ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ Ziˉonˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kawˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa yonˍ ve chaw lehˬ maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shu hkui htiˇ poˬ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui htawˇ hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ. Iˉsaˍ reˍlaˆ chaw hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui shiˍ leh te ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ leh, a shu yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ te ve pa taw, yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo maˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼa yonˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Hkri‸ lehˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ te leh piˇ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ bvuh‸ taˍ ve lehˬ, Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo a shu taˆ-e tuˬ le. Naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo a shu ya‸-e tuˬ le teh‸ nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ dawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

(Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ hta‸ ca shiˍ ya‸ la tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo a shu taˆ-e tuˬ le. Hkri‸ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ tuˬ, naˉ jaˇ kuiˬ lo a shu ya‸-e tuˬ le teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.)

Hkʼe te leh, yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve le. Tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ neˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸, nawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. (Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.)

Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ ve maw‸ kʼaw hkanˍ yuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo yonˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ lehˬ nyi ma hkʼaw yonˍ ve pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la leh, maw‸ kʼaw hkanˍ yuˬ ve pa taw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa yonˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw peun da‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ ve Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa kuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ bon hkʼa biˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼa kuˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te kuˬ tuˬ le. Yawˇ awˬ lawn maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te yonˍ tuˬ le. Maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te gʼa kaˇ tuˬ le.

Chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼai tcuh ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve hkui sheh lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma nyi sha jaˇ ve le teh‸ Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍyaˆ kʼoˆ ve, Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ a shu yonˍ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh yonˍ ve lehˬ, gʼa kaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Gʼa kaˇ ve htawˇ, Hkri‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ shu hto laˇ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa kaˇ leh laˇ. Gʼa kaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve awˬ hkawˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo bvuhˬ kʼai leh, yawˇ hui ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ, gaˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ na nyi ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui maˇ shiˍ leh laˇ. Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve, Mvuhˇmiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkawehˉ tuˬ ngaˬ te leh, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍyaˆ htawˇ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ ca ve chaw hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn maˇ na nyi ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn shiˍ piˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ lawn yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Maˇ na yuˬ leh tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ puiˉ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ, teˇ nyi tanˇ vanˇ ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh che law taˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ na nyi ve, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ laˇ. Maˇ baˬ taˉ taˬ. Ngaˬ htawˇ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpeh‸ leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Beˍyaˍmenˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve, yawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ baˬ taˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve,

Jawˇmawˇ-oˬ, nawˬ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ yawˇ hui duˇ baˬ peuˬ. Ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ taˉ leh, ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ tuˬ yawˇ hui ca chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve le. Baˍlaˆ shaˉ ho‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkui tcuhˉ maˇ teh ve chaw suhˍ hinˉ gʼaˇ ngaˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ teh taˍ sheˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chi beu‸ awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw a ciˉ cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw leuˆ yuˬ ve kʼo, kanˉ te ve hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸. Kanˉ te ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼo, awˬ bon oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ bon maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui ca ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa. Leuˆ yuˬ ve chaw hui ceh tiˉ gʼa leh, maˇ leuˆ yuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, nyi ma heh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ zuh‸ muiˉ jo ve nyi ma maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ mawˬ puiˉ ve mehˆ shiˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ kaˇ puiˉ ve naˍ paw maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Daˍviˆ htawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui ve hti caˇ hti dawˬ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ pon pehˍ htaw taˍ ve, va htaw taˍ ve, ce lo‸-e tuˬ paˆ te taˍ ve leh, yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ cawˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ tuˬ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui mehˆ maˇ mawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hui ve caw‸ htawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˇ ka‸ kʼaw‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ na nyi ve, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, paiˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ hkui htiˇ poˬ ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ taˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui ya‸ ve jiˆ ve hta‸ pa taw buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ya‸ ve jiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ paw sha la piˇ lawˬ leh, yawˇ hui shonˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ paw sha la piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hkʼa biˇ lo‸ la htaˇ, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hkʼaˬ ma kʼaw‸ paw sha la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ ve le.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, kanˉ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kanˉ chi ve hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve lehˬ, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hkawehˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ la leh, yawˇ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ baˬ taˍ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ yaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ la ve kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Awˉ lawˉ tanˇ piˇ ve hkaoˍmonˇ awˬ tcuhˇ teˇ diˬ ehˉ da‸ kehˬ ve kʼo, hkaoˍ monˇ teˇ diˬ lonˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ ka‸ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ geu teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ leh, nawˬ hui shaˍlonˍ awˬ hteunˍ ve awˬ kʼaˉ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, shaˍlonˍ meuˇ cehˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˉ da‸ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ geh awˬ tcuhˇ hta‸ gʼa caˇ ve kʼo, tawˆ baˬ taˍ ve awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ nyi ma taˇ uiˍ.
Nawˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ ve kʼo, chi hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ awˬ geu hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, awˬ geu nawˬ hta‸ kanˬ chiˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ cehˬ hta‸ gʼa caˉ da‸ tuˬ, awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˆ baˬ peuˬ teh‸, nawˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw tawˆ baˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nyi ma taˇ uiˍ. Kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ shaˍlonˍ meuˇ awˬ kʼaˉ hta‸ maˇ teh taˍ piˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ teh taˍ laˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh yawˇ hehnˇ chaweh te ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Paiˍ taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hehnˇ chaweh te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ chehˇ taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ maˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ htawˇ tawˆ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, maˇ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve kʼo, awˬ cehˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ liˇ maˇ heˆ htawˇ, shaˍlonˍ cehˬ awˬ hteunˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ tawˆ yuˬ leh, shaˍlonˍ meuˇ cehˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ ve kʼo, shaˍlonˍ meuˇ awˬ kʼaˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve shaˍlonˍ meuˇ cehˬ hta‸ leuˉ leh kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa cuˇ tuˬ, faˉ taˍ ve awˬ lawn chi nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lo‸ la maˇ biˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ nyi ma heh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Ponˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la leh, Yaˍkoˆ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, chi ve lehˬ yawˇ hui geh ngaˬ te tuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬ sha ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve lehˬ, awˬ puˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ yuˬ hkʼaw‸. Yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hta‸ yawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ.
Nawˬ hui awˉ lawˉ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui ha kʼaˉ ve hta‸ gʼa ve pa taw, yawˇ hui htawˇ ha kʼaˉ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hui maˇ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo haw tiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, hkʼaˬ ma naˉ jaˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha suhˉ taˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu ka‸ ca dawˇ maˇ gaˬ. Yawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu ka‸ ca maˇ mawˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve nyi ma hta‸ a shu shiˍ ve le. Yawˇ hta‸ a shu maˍ piˇ jehˬ piˇ jaw ve le.
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ awˬ bon te piˇ jaw ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le lehˬ,
yawˇ lo laˬ ve, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw cawˬ la ve leh, yawˇ awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ naw hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ to lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve, da‸ kehˬ ve leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ-oˆ. Chi lehˬ, nawˬ hui te keunˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi miˬguiˬ yaˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh taˇ kʼai. Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ jaˇ ve, nyi ma cawˇ jaˇ ve leh biˇ jaˇ ve a loˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ leh fuiˍ da‸ gʼa tuˬ, nyi ma awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ pa leh, chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ lawn dawˇ keunˍ dawˇ cawˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh taˇ dawˇ. Gʼuiˬ sha lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ pehˬ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, dawˇ keunˍ dawˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe ceh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ lawn dawˇ nyi-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ hkʼeun maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼeun oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kanˉ te ve maˇ shuˍ da‸.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui chaw maˇ ve htawˇ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ caˉ da‸ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ peun da‸ ve yoˬ. Bon maˍ paˍ te tuˬ ve awˬ bon gʼa ve kʼo, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hkʼe bon maˍ paˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.
Ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te tuˬ ve awˬ bon gʼa ve kʼo, ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, maˍ piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o.

Shu hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te-o. Shu hta‸ pehˬ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa maˇ chaweh pehˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hoˉ te ve chaw lehˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ leh te-o. Ha kʼaˉ piˇ ve chaw lehˬ, ha lehˬ ha kʼa te leh ha kʼaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui ha‸ ve lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cha‸ loˬ. Da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ-o‸.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ha‸ da‸ ve hkʼe teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ da‸-o‸. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˇ taˍ uiˍ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ shu hta‸ taˍ uiˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Coˇ caˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ taˇ nuˇ piˇ. Nyi ma pfuhˇ leh Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.
Dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve hkʼe pehˬ piˇ ga piˇ-oˆ. Hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ na‸ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ taˇ hkeu piˇ. Na‸ piˇ ve ceh tiˉ te-o.
Ha lehˬ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ-o‸. Hawˬ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh hawˬ-o‸.

Teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma htaˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Uiˍ gaˇ mvuh gaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ dawˇ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh awˬ chawˇ te-o. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve teh‸ taˇ dawˇ.
Shu haiˬ ve te laˇ htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ awˬ haiˬ taˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ tiˉ te tuˬ dawˇ nyi taˍ-o‸.
Te hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui puiˉ ve hpeh‸ ve hkʼe chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ te chehˇ-oˆ.

Ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ te ya‸ laˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui taˇ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ. Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ leh te hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ piˇ-oˆ. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˉ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ awˍ meu‸ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ caˍ piˇ-oˆ. Iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve kʼo, taw piˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ ya‸ taw jaˇ leh mehˆ hpfuhˇ haw tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ taˇ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ. Da‸ ve hta‸ cuˇ leh haiˬ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, uˉ peunˍ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui cawˬ taˍ ve kanˇ paˆ teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpfuhˆ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tawˍ taˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Haiˬ ve hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ gaˇ laˇ. Da‸ ve hta‸ te-o. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ Gʼuiˬ sha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ haiˬ ve hta‸ te ve kʼo, kawˆ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ aˉ htaw hkʼe leˇ pfuhˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ haiˬ hkʼa te ve chaw hui hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma htawˇ, dawˇ sha hpeh‸ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui a moˇ ka‸ keu piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh kanˉ chi ve hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ piˇ keunˍ piˇ cawˇ ve hkʼe piˇ-oˆ. A moˇ shaw ve chaw hui hta‸ a moˇ keu piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hkawnˍ shaw ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ hkawnˍ keu piˇ-oˆ. Kawˆ keunˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ-oˆ. Yawˆ yan keunˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.

Jeˬ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ pfuhˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ da‸ ve jeˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te biˇ peuˬ.

Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ gʼa te, chaw hta‸ maˇ gʼa tiˇ pehˍ, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkʼawˇ, shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa sheˉ lai teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu cawˬ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la ve yoˬ.
Ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ awˬ haiˬ maˇ te. Hkʼe te leh, ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te biˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, chi beu‸ awˬ yanˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui zuh‸ nawˇ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˉ lawˉ yonˍ gehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ a‸ kehˉ, chi beu‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ leuˉ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ neˇ la peuˬ.

Mvuhˇ hpeu‸ awˬ yanˇ peuˬ la paˇ neˇ leh, mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ deh-a veuˬ.

Ha lehˬ tuˬ te ponˬ te leuˉ leh tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh te ponˬ te leuˉ ve, shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ leh hkawehˉ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ te. Mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw htaˇ te keunˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te-a veuˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ veu‸ deh-o. Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai tuˬ te‸ chiˉ taˇ gu taˍ.
Yonˍ ve nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, dawˇ hkʼaˇ maˇ hawˍ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn yawˇ geh tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ awˬ pon ha‸ yuˬ ve taˇ te.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ caˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yonˍ ve nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh hta‸ ceh tiˉ caˇ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ caˇ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ caˇ ve chaw hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa te. Maˇ caˇ ve chaw htawˇ, caˇ ve chaw hta‸ venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa taˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ peuˬ.

Shu ve awˬ ceˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve nawˬ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw le. Yawˇ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa‸ kʼoˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ jawˇmawˇ hta‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, jawˇmawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, jawˇmawˇ yawˇ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ nyi nyi hta‸ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yoˬ teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ nyi ma hkʼaw hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ cheˆ loˬ.

Awˬ nyi hta‸ taˍ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ caˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh caˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ Gʼuiˬ sha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh caˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ caˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo caˇ tuˬ ce leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon te‸ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. A shu htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon suh ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui te‸ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon te‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui suh ve htawˇ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon suh ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh te‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, suh ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve mawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh peuˬ ve chaw hta‸ ka‸, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hta‸ ka‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ, Hkri‸ hkanˍ suh leh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve le. Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hkui tcuhˉ teh leh, maw‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ le le Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ taˇ kʼaw‸ taˍ da‸. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ leh te ya‸ tuˬ ngaˬ maˇ te-o teh‸, nawˬ hui dawˇ cheˆ taˍ loˬ.

Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ shiˍ leh yonˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve teh‸ yawˇ shawˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ pon cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi gʼa dawˇ haˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ taˇ te luˬ piˇ. Yawˇ awˬ pon htawˇ Hkriˬ hkanˍ suh taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ awˬ pon da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ tuˬ taˇ cawˬ piˇ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve, dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve leh, ha lehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ awˬ pon chi hkʼe kanˉ te ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh, chaw yaˇ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ tuˬ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ uiˍ la mvuh la tuˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te kʼai-a veuˬ.

Caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ hta‸ taˇ te luˬ piˇ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, caˇ ve hta‸ pa taw shu hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ ve kʼo, caˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ te ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Shaˍ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ te ve htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, maˇ te cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ to leh Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ceh tiˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. A shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ venˇbaˆ maˇ taˍ ve pa taw, ha lehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma htawˇ dawˇ nawˬ dawˇ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ caˇ ve kʼo, yonˍ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ leh caˇ ve pa taw, nyi ma hkʼaw suhˉ taˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Yonˍ ve hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ te leh, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hui gʼaˇ nuˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ da‸ la uiˍ la tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ te piˇ-a veuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ htawˇ yawˇ awˬ to nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ te. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui hkʼaiˉ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la peuˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ hkʼa bvuh‸ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ leh Li‸ hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ sha ve hta‸ gʼa ve pa taw, dawˇ law tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ htaˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ, yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ leh dawˇ sha piˇ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬ sha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh hkawˇ teˇ hkawˇ tiˉ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, Hkri‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ pon Hkri‸ lehˬ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, awˬ puˍ lonˉ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ yeˬ la tuˬ leh,

yawˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ pa taw buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, Hkri‸ lehˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Chi hta‸ pa taw, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ ve awˬ meh hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yawˇ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ-o‸, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ sheˍ ve, Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Iˉsaˍyaˆ htawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼoˆ ve, Yeˍsehˇ ve awˬ geu lo awˬ caˍ caˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yawˇ tawˆ la leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw, dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui biˇ la tuˬ, dawˇ law tuˬ cawˬ la piˇ ve Gʼuiˬ sha lehˬ, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ dawˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ le le biˇ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve chaw, shiˍ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ biˇ ve chaw leh, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ maˍ da‸ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ yonˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve paw hkuˇ te tuˬ Gʼuiˬ sha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh, li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼe Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui na yuˬ tuˬ, tawˇ yaw leh kanˉ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ heˆ leh anˇ tuˬ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh te ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ lawn te‸ chiˉ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ ca kʼoˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ te leh Iˇluˇriˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼa caw zuhˇ Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ peuˬ.

Yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hta‸ shu te taˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ te tuˬ, Hkri‸ ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw sheˍ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ shu maˇ hto piˇ jaw htawˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ lawn maˇ gʼa kaˇ jaw htawˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ maˇ gʼa gaˬ la tuˬ laiˉ pawˆ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ lehˬ, mvuhˇmiˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te kuiˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ leh, laiˉ hkʼaw‸ nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ laˬ gaˇ jaˇ ve pa taw,

Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui geh ca guiˇ taˉ tuˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui geh teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ jaw awˬ chawˇ te da‸ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve lo nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ peu kʼai laˇ tuˬ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ, chi beu‸ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo ngaˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍhkaˍyaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ mawˇ jeˬ pehˬ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa ga piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa ga piˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, co ha hpawˇ Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui htawˇ gʼa ve kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, kanˉ chi hta‸ ngaˬ te peuˬ leh, la‸ shawnˍ chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nawˬ hui geh te leh Saˍpenˍ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la htaˇ, Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, Awˬ ha hpu ve ha‸ da‸ pehnˇ da‸ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hui la‸ hkʼaw ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ leh, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ gʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Hkri‸ yaˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon bon ga lawˬ laˆ mehˍ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ pa taw ha lehˬ ha kʼa nawˬ hui geh gʼa gaˬ la tuˬ leh, nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa tuˬ, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ bon gʼaˇ hte‸ ga lawˬ laˇ-oˆ teh‸, nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.
Keˍcheˍ venˇ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ga piˇ shehˍ ma hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ hui ve awˬ nyi ma Hpiˉbeˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh lo ngaˬ kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ yaˇ hui te keunˍ ve hkʼe, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi leh yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ loˍ ve htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ ga piˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ ka‸ ga laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve kanˉ ga te ve Piˇkiˇlaˆ leh Aˍkuˉlaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ a sha‸ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon hkanˍ suh taˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ceh tiˉ chiˇ mvuh ve maˇ heˆ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawnˬ da‸ chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Aˍsiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Hkri‸ yaˇ awˉ lawˉ hpeh‸ la ve ngaˬ ha‸ ve Eˇpehˇnehˆ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ pon kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve Maˍriˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ geh htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ jaw ve, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Aˍdawˇniˆ leh Yuˇniˆ hta‸ ka‸, ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, tcuh yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuhˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ Hkri‸ yaˇ maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ Hkri‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha‸ ve Aˍpaˍliˆ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Hkri‸ ve kanˉ te ve Uˇraˍbaˍ leh ngaˬ ha‸ ve Saˍtaˍhkuˆ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Hkʼa deh‸ lawˇ nyi peuˬ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ Aˍpeˍleˍ hta‸ ka‸, Aˍriˇtawˇbuˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve Heˍroˍdiˍoˍ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Naˍkiˍsuˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon kanˉ te chehˇ ve Taˍruˇhpehˇnaˆ leh Taˍruˇ hpawˇsaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve ngaˬ ha‸ ve Peˍraˍsiˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve Ruˇhpuˆ leh ngaˬ ve awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ shawˍ taˍ ve, yawˇ ve awˬ e yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Aˍsoˍkaˍreˆ, Hpaˍleˍgoˍ, Heˍraˍmeˍ, Paˇrawˇbaˆ, Heˍraˍmaˆ leh, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Hpiˇlawˇluˆ, Yuˇliˆ, Neˍruˆ leh Neˍruˆ ve awˬ nyi ma Awˇloˍpaˆ leh, yawˇ hui geh chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo boˆ nu da‸ leh la‸ sheh caˉ da‸-o‸. Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ peuˬ ve maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ hawˍ ve, hpaˆ da‸ tuˬ te puiˉ ve, shu ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi leh jaw kʼai-o teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Hkri‸ awˬ pon kanˉ te ve maˇ heˆ. A shu yawˇ ve gʼoˇ peˬ awˬ pon ceh kanˉ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, na sha ve tawˇ leh chiˇ mvuh ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh, da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui na yuˬ puiˉ ve awˬ lawn lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ leh, nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ maw maw kʼo, dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve hkui taw kʼaw awˬ hawˉ lo Saˍtanˍ hta‸ naˆ nehˆ sheˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ Tiˆmoˉseˍ leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ Luˇkiˆ, Yaˍsonˍ leh Sawˇsiˇpaˍtaˆ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, li‸ chi bvuh‸ shehˍ hpaˇ Teˍraˍtiˆ yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawˇ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ha‸ yuˬ leh caˍ laˇ taw laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gaˍyuˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw hpu ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ Eˇraˍtuˆ leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Kawˍtuˆ htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ leh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ lawn ngaˬ bon maˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve bon hkawˇ chi lehˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ chi lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ faˉ taˍ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la peuˬ.

Chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yonˍ leh na yuˬ tuˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ Gʼuiˬsha tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, faˉ taˍ ve oˇ ve chi beu‸ tawˆ la peuˬ leh, tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui ve li‸ hta‸ pa taw faˉ taˍ ve oˇ ve hta‸ chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo co co taiˍ taiˍ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ Pawˇlu‸ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, tcuh yaˇ te tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui Kawˇrenˍhtuˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Suˇtenˍ, li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw da‸ la kehˬ la peuˬ. Teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ ve chaw hui, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ meh hta‸ hkʼa kuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ geh teˇ geh Hkri‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa peuˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw, tawˇ yaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, shiˍ puiˉ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui biˇ la peuˬ.
Hkri‸ awˬ lawn ngaˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve hkʼe cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve hta‸ law chehˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ yawnˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ geh nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ gʼa te da‸ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw da‸ ve hawˍ da‸ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ moˍ shawˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ te leh, dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ Hkaˍlawˇiˆ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ lehˬ Pawˇlu‸ ve chaw yoˬ, Ngaˬ lehˬ Aˍpawˇlu‸ ve chaw yoˬ, Ngaˬ lehˬ Keˍhpaˆ ve chaw yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ Hkri‸ ve chaw yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ lehˬ hpaˆ da‸ pehˬ da‸ taˍ ve leh laˇ. Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh ve leh laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Pawˇlu‸ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ ve leh laˇ.
Kaˍliˇpuˆ leh Gaˍyuˆ, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ baˆtiˆsaˬ maˇ piˇ ve pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ peuˬ teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸.
(Saˍteˍhpanˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi awˬ hkʼoˆ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hta‸ baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ dawˇ nawˇ.)

Awˬ lawn kʼo, baˆtiˆsaˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon Hkri‸ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuh peu laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tcuh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ htaˇ, Hkri‸ ve la‸ ka kanˇ paˆ maˇ gʼa yawnˇ kʼai tuˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ uiˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ yaw leh maˍ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, la‸ ka awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, la‸ ka lehˬ ngaˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa chehˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te luˬ leh, shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui ve shiˍ puiˉ ve hta‸ ngaˬ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hkʼaˬ lo le. Li‸ bvuh‸ paˍ hkʼaˬ lo le. Chi beu‸ awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ lawn laiˉ ceuˬ shiˍ leh tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ paˍ hkʼaˬ lo le. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, miˬguiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ yaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ shu shawˍ ve ngaˬ hui maˍ piˇ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ lawˬ leh, Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw hui lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ca ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ hui lehˬ, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh ve Hkri‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn bon maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ pon hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve gʼaˇ uiˍ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Miˬguiˬ hpawˇ hta‸ shawˍ kʼo, kuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui maˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve chaw hui ka‸ maˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hui htawˇ maˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ya‸ taw piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Cawˬ taˍ hpeh‸ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te mehˉ tuˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ, shu shawˍ baˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui awˬ pon cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve, da‸ ve kehˬ ve leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ nyi ma uiˍ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ca maˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, na sha jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ yaw leh cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ ca maˍ la ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ chehˇ htaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ leh, yawˇ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ chehˇ htaˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh kawˆ jaˇ cheˇ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa yeˬ tuˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ tuˬ,

ngaˬ tawˇ yaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, bon maˍ laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh beˬ yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Awˬ ha hpu chehˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Biˇ la peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi miˬguiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Luˬ kʼai mehˉ kʼai tuˬ ve miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ka‸ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ faˉ taˍ ve leh naˉ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˍ ve yoˬ. Cuˇ yiˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon, miˬguiˬ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ chi hta‸ chi miˬguiˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ. Yawˇ hui shiˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ve Awˬ jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui awˬ pon yawˇ gu taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mehˆ shiˍ maˇ mawˬ jaw, naˍ paw maˇ kaˇ jaw leh, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo maˇ dawˇ shiˍ jaw ve yoˬ, teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ca nyi leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve naˉ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ ca nyi ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve nyi ma maˇ heˆ kʼo, chaw yaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu maˇ heˆ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ a shu ka‸ shiˍ maˇ hpeh‸.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬ sha ngaˬ hui hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lo laˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ bon oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ maˍ laˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ha hpu maˍ laˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Co ha hpawˇ awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ htaˇ, co ha hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Co ha hpawˇ maˇ dawˇ pawnˍ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Co ha hpawˇ ceh tiˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ gʼa ve pa taw, yawˇ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ.
Co ha hpawˇ dawˇ pawnˍ ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw oˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ maˇ gʼa.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ a shu shiˍ ve le. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Hkri‸ ve nyi ma cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, co ha hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ maˇ hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ hpawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ caˉ da‸ ve chaw leh, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ ve chaw hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, heh ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ caˍ laˇ. Cuˉ gʼuiˬ ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui hta‸ taw laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ ka‸, nawˬ hui heh ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ maˇ gʼa sheˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ miˬguiˬ hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkawehˉ da‸ leh, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ chehˇ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ ve chaw yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Ngaˬ Aˍpawˇlu‸ ve chaw yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve ceh ceh, nawˬ hui miˬguiˬ yaˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Aˍpawˇlu‸ lehˬ a shu le. Pawˇlu‸ htawˇ a shu le. Nawˬ hui gʼa yonˍ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ kanˉ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ htawˇ a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ti taˍ leh Aˍpawˇlu‸ iˉ kaˆ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yeˬ la uiˍ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ti shehˍ hpaˇ leh iˉ kaˆ pfuhˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ uiˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yeˬ la uiˍ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ uiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ti shehˍ hpaˇ leh iˉ kaˆ pfuhˍ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ te taˍ ve hkʼe, teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ti mi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yehˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼe yehˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hta‸ ngaˬ te taˍ peuˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼaw‸ caˉ te ve hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ le le shaˍ ti‸ te cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, teh taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ teh taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ shi, hpu, haˉ pui shehnˉ, suhˆ, zuhˇ, chi gʼawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ te ve kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ kanˉ te taˍ ve hkʼe tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ htaˇ, aˬ miˍ lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve kanˉ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le ve kanˉ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ aˬ miˍ oˇ ve lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ caˉ te ve kanˉ yeˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ aˬ miˍ to‸ baˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve awˬ bon lehˬ shonˇ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ to htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ hta‸ te luˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ bon yehˬ oˇ ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˇ heˍ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ chi miˬguiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ la tuˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi miˬguiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, yawˇ hui cuˇ yiˍ te chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ hpeh yuˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ kaˬ kʼaw‸ bvuh‸ taˍ sheˍ ve, Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma taˇ uiˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Pawˇlu‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Aˍpawˇlu‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Keˍhpaˆ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ ve leh suh ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve leh awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Hkri‸ ve hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve naˉ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ shawˍ taˍ laˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ laˇ ve lehˬ, i jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ ka‸ suhˉ maˇ jehˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ to ya‸ kuiˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ dawˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, suhˉ taˇ taˆ sheˍ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ gaˬ la htaˇ naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yawˇ te leh, chaw yaˇ ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hpeu‸ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, a shu yawˇ keunˍ ve hkʼe chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ bvuh‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ leh Aˍpawˇlu‸ hta‸ nawˬ hui henˇ yuˬ jawˬ yuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ tawˇ pa haˉ te maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui te tuˬ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu hta‸ peun da‸ tuˬ a shu nawˬ hta‸ te laˇ ve le. Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa taˍ ve maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ aˬ hto‸ ma cawˬ le. Gʼuiˬsha geh gʼa taˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha geh maˇ gʼa ve hkʼe te leh aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve le.

Chi beu‸ lehˬ, nawˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh peuˬ leˇ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ, nawˬ hui paw sha la peuˬ leˇ. Ngaˬ hui maˇ heˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui uˉ peunˍ gʼa ve law leˇ. Nawˬ hui awˬ tehˬ awˬ na uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, tiˇ pehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ suhˉ taˆ peuˬ ve chaw hui hkʼe, Gʼuiˬ sha lehˬ ngaˬ hui tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ leh meuˇ htaˇ maw piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon teh taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui leh chaw yaˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyi guiˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ awˬ pon cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve ka‸, nawˬ hui lehˬ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
