Ya‸ nyi hkʼa gaˬ, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Moˉseˍ ve li‸ hta‸ gʼaw ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ hpa beh taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve kʼo, beh taˍ ve hpa oˇ ve hta‸ yehˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ Awˬ ha hpu hpeh‸ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve Awˬ ha hpu chehˇ ve teˇ kaˬ lo ponˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, mehˆ hpfuhˇ maˇ beh leh, mehˆ gʼeuˆ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui kʼaw‸ ba piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha hpu hpeh‸ ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la leh yawˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve pa taw, kanˉ chi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nyi ma maˇ luˬ,

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh ya‸ taw tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Heˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui maˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ cawˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui maˍ chehˇ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ lehˬ beh taˍ ve kʼo, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve chaw hui awˬ pon ceh tiˉ beh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hpeh‸ ve Hkri‸ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ, maˇ yonˍ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa ba tuˬ, chi miˬguiˬ ve gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ naˆ ho‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ to awˬ lawn bon maˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn leh, ngaˬ hui Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui bon maˍ ve yoˬ.

Naˆ ho‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ ba laˇ peuˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkri‸ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ shu gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼeuˆ ba piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve kanˇ paˆ chi lehˬ, ngaˬ hui lo tawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬ sha geh lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ teh‸, hpeu‸ maw piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve mawˇ chi lehˬ, je‸ mu‸ hkʼu awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, teˇ hpawˇ le le lo nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, hoˆ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve htawˇ, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ heˆ.
Fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, ga laˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu dawˆ baˬ laˇ ve htawˇ, luˬ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ heˆ.
Yeˍsuˆ ve te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ ve te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve suh puiˉ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon suh tuˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo suh ve teˇ ceuˬ kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo lehˬ, te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui htawˇ yonˍ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve pa taw, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ lawˬ leh, nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ chehˇ tcuh laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la ve hkʼe, shu yawˇ hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nyi ma maˇ luˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ luˬ kʼai chehˇ ve htawˇ, co ha hpawˇ lehˬ teˇ nyi peuˬ teˇ nyi awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve i jaˇ lawˬ jaˇ ve tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ca tehˆ nyi maˇ gʼa ve uiˍ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, mawˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui nyi ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui nyi ve yoˬ. Mawˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ hkui tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ mawˬ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ cawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ

Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve aˉ po kʼo chi luˬ kʼai ve kʼo, la‸ sheh maˇ te ve, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo co co taiˍ taiˍ cawˬ ve, Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˉ po kʼo chi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hkʼanˇ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve ngaˬ hui ve yehˬ hta‸ veu‸ deh gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe gʼa veu‸ deh ve kʼo, awˬ kʼu nyi gʼa chehˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Aˉ po kʼo chi awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, hawˇ ve mawˇ pfuhˇ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ veu‸ deh gaˇ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Suh puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ gʼa hehˆ dawˬ tuˬ, veu‸ kʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui veu‸ deh gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ hui hta‸ gu laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ngaˬ hui awˬ bon chi hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ ka‸ Awˬ ha hpu pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ma yeˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui te kʼai chehˇ ve lehˬ mehˆ shiˍ mawˬ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ to chi hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh leuˉ leh chehˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ to hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬ sha nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hui coˇ caˇ leh te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ htaˇ te ve hkʼe, da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Hkri‸ ve suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ kʼaw jaw gʼuˇ suhˍ lo gʼa gaˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ shiˍ leh, nawˬ hui htawˇ nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ nyi ma hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ dawˇ nyi leh awˬ hta‸ hpawˇ ceh tiˉ nyi ma uiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui gʼuˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon gʼuˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nyi ma biˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ pon biˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh shiˍ kʼai sheh kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hkanˍ suh ve pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ suh peuˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ cheˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon maˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ pon hkanˍ suh leh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon hkanˍ suh ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, chaw yaˇ hui shu hta‸ shawˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ shawˍ taˍ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ hta‸ chaw yaˇ hui shawˍ taˍ ve hkʼe ceh shawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe maˇ kʼaw‸ shawˍ taˍ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ, Awˬ piˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai peuˬ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸ shu yawˇ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh, miˬguiˬ yaˇ yawˇ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ taˍ. Shu yawˇ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ ve awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ loˬ teh‸, Hkri‸ ve awˬ tan te leh ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ jaw htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha geh teˇ geh kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼe leˇ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve yoˬ. teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ lehˬ cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi lehˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ nyi hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui kanˉ te ve hta‸ shu venˇbaˆ taˍ maˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hkui htiˇ poˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ te.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˉ te paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ shu shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ. Gʼaˇ hte‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ ve, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve, dawˇ tui‸ gaˇ tui‸ ve, haˍ jaˇ ve,
dawˆ laˇ jaw‸ laˇ ve, htawnˍ hkʼaw keu laˇ ve, shu duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te ve, kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve, maˇ gʼa zuh‸ ve leh, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ.
Da‸ kehˬ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve, shiˍ puiˉ ve, dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve, shu awˬ pon da‸ ve hta‸ te ve, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ ve, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ha‸ ve, hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ maˍ piˇ ve,
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ ve, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ la‸ sha paˉ la‸ mehˍ paˉ vawˆ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo,

awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa ve maˇ kʼoˆ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, shu chiˇ mvuh laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, shu hkʼaiˉ laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve chaw hkʼe, shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ shawˍ laˇ ve htawˇ, hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hta‸ shu maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, shu hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Suh paˇ neˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, tiˇ pehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ.

Dawˇ haˍ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Haˍ gʼawˇ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ paw sha la piˇ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, teˇ ceuˬ le le cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Kawˇrenˍhtuˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ faˉ taˍ leh, hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ i ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ i jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ha‸ laˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ caˉ da‸, taˇ pawnˇ da‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te caˉ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Awˬ gʼeuˆ lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te awˬ chawˇ te da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.
Hkri‸ lehˬ Beˍleˍlaˆ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Yonˍ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ yonˍ ve chaw geh hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ le.

Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ shaˉ nanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te cawˇ da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Ngaˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh, yawˇ hui geh ngaˬ te toˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la leh yawˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ chehˇ taˍ-o‸ teh‸ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ htawˇ, Maˇ htawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ paˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to leh nyi ma hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kawˆ leh yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve kehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ-a veuˬ.
Nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ te ya‸, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ maˇ te leh, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ heˍ caˇ ve maˇ te.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh kʼo teˇ geh suh tuˬ, te‸ kʼo teˇ geh te‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve awˬ ceuˬ htawˇ ngaˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ca kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ hui gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo bawˆ da‸ tuˬ cawˬ leh, awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma luˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Tiˇtuˆ gaˬ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Tiˇtuˆ gaˬ la ve pa taw ceh tiˉ dawˇ sha la ve maˇ heˆ. Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh gʼa veu laˇ ve dawˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui dawˇ sha la ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, ngaˬ awˬ pon nyi ma pfuhˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ leuˉ leh ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ngaˬ bvuh‸ laˇ ve li‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw, oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ hpeh‸ bawˬ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ ngaˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ bawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, li‸ oˇ ve lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ hkui ceh tiˉ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ haˍ piˇ lawˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ gʼa shonˇ kʼai tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ve dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, hpeh‸ bawˬ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ haˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ te tawˆla piˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Nawˬ hui coˇ caˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hteˇ ve awˬ lawn kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ law tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma pfuhˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ ma te tawˆ la ve le. Kanˉ chi hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peu.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, te ya‸ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ pon maˇ heˆ. Te ya‸ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw awˬ pon ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui dawˇ sha la peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui dawˇ sha gaˇ sha peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, Tiˇtuˆ ha lehˬ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui leuˉ leh ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ nyi ma sha la piˇ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn chiˇ mvuh ve hkawˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ laˇ peuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Tiˇtuˆ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ lawn chiˇ mvuh ve hkawˇ yaw taˍ ve lehˬ hteˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ na yuˬ leh, kawˆ ve cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ nawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˉ leh ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ bon hkʼaˬ hkʼe na‸ piˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve maˇ maˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, biˇ sheˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hui mawˇ jeˬ maˇ maˇ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui puiˉ ve hpeh‸ ve hkʼe tanˇ piˇ peuˬ. Puiˉ ve hpeh‸ ve hkʼe tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui hkʼaˇ yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ sheˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve awˬ bon chi teˇ ceuˬ gʼa te tuˬ, a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ-oˆ teh‸, yawˇ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui dawˇ law ve a‸ kehˉ ka‸ yawˇ hui te ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ awˉ lawˉ htaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ka‸ a shu yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ tanˬ te ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ te peuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, yonˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ yaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ nawˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ te taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ bon uiˍ ve kanˉ chi teˇ maˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, tawˇ piˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu coˇ caˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ htaˇ, nawˬ hui ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˬ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ paw sha chehˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve hta‸ hkanˍ leh, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui paw sha la ve yoˬ.

Chi awˬ lawn ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ shaˍ. Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ nawˬ hui te gaˇ leh te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, aˉ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˬ hui tanˬ te laˬ ve hkʼe chi beu‸ te peuˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chi lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui te puiˉ te hpeh‸ ve hkʼe te peuˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ve maˇ heˆ. Te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Kanˉ chi hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon sha leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon haˍ jaˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ te gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui awˬ leuˉ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui loˍ ve cuˆ ve hta‸ ga piˇ leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ nawˬ hui loˍ ve cuˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ leuˉ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ ga laˇ leh, hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Maˇ chaweh gʼawˆ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ awˬ leuˉ maˇ cawˬ leh, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼawˆ yuˬ ve chaw lehˬ loˍ ve cuˆ ve maˇ cawˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ nyi ma pfuhˇ ve hkʼe, Tiˇtuˆ htawˇ nyi ma pfuhˇ la tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te piˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ nawˬ hui geh laˬ ve yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve hta‸ pa taw, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hui kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve kanˉ chi hta‸ ga te tuˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui geh teˇ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi hta‸ te ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la leh, shu hta‸ ga piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, maˇ jaˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw leh pehˬ piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu venˇbaˆ maˇ gʼa taˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ, chaw yaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ htawˇ keunˍ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ hui dawˇ taˍ leh te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ geh teˇ geh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ hui kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi chi teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ laiˉ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo laiˉ pawˆ lawˇ nyi peuˬ leh, yawˇ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ yonˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ leuˉ leh nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Tiˇtuˆ awˬ lawn lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi chi nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ peu laˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui ha‸ pehnˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui chiˇ mvuh ve hkawˇ yaw ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ te-o.
Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve kanˉ awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ ga piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu hta‸ ga piˇ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ chaw hui hta‸ hto piˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Aˍhkaˍyaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, aˉ nyi hkʼaw‸ htaˇ ka‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui maˇ-awˍ ve hta‸ nawˍ piˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve lehˬ, kanˉ chi awˬ hkʼaw hkʼe leˇ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ tuˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh laˬ leh, nawˬ hui maˇ gu maˇ hehnˇ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ya‸ taw ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ bon uiˍ ve kanˉ chi teˇ maˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te peuˬ taˍ laˇ tuˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui geh peu kʼai cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ chi piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ nyiˉ te ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ leh, ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. A ciˉ ceh tiˉ sheˍ ve chaw lehˬ, a ciˉ ceh tiˉ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Maˇ chaweh sheˍ ve chaw lehˬ, maˇ chaweh gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe tanˇ piˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ haˍ leh te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa te ve hta‸ pa taw te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ha lehˬ ha kʼa tanˇ piˇ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ teˇ ceuˬ le le cawˬ law‸ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ le le maˇ chaweh piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yawˇ maˇ chaweh sheˍ peuˬ. Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ piˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yawˇ sheˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ awˬ yawˇ ka‸ caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ ka‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ yawˇ piˇ leh maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui maˇ chaweh piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui paw sha la tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ pa taw shu Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ awˬ pon te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu hta‸ ga piˇ ve kanˉ chi lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ loˍ ve hkʼe hkʼa biˇ ga piˇ ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ, shu Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ maˇ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ htawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Shu hta‸ ga piˇ ve kanˉ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ leh awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ ka‸, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui maˇ chaweh tanˇ piˇ ve pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve awˬ bon na‸ laˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ca kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o.

Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ awˬ to lehˬ, Hkri‸ ve nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, yawˇ ve nyi ma da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ lehˍ taˍ leh, ngaˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ ngaˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ yaˇ te ve hkʼe te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve teh‸ shawˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ te maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chi taw taw nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa te maˍ laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve htawˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ma‸ bawˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ma‸ bawˆ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve la‸ caˉ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ta‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve la‸ caˉ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ tawˍ taˍ tsuhˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui yuˬ baˬ hpaˆ baˬ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ maˬ le le hta‸ ngaˬ hui hpeh yuˬ leh, Hkri‸ hta‸ na yuˬ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui na yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ biˇ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi sheˍ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to Hkri‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ shawˍ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ Hkri‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui htawˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hui hta‸ aˉ yaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ awˬ pon pe‸ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkʼe te leh, aˉ yaˇ chi awˬ lawn ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa cawˇ cawˇ kʼoˆ maˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ ngaˬ te gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇ ve li‸ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ leh hehnˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ to chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ teh‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ htawˇ chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ teh‸, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ piˇ-oˆ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui awˬ to yawˇ hui hta‸ tehˆ da‸ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui te maˇ haˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ tehˆ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ shuˍ da‸ ve hta‸ nyi ve pa taw, yawˇ hui cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ ponˬ kʼoˆ leuˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kanˉ te kuiˬ pehˬ laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ pehˬ laˇ ve kanˉ te kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ pehˬ laˇ ve kanˉ te kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e taˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve kanˉ te kuiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te ponˬ te leuˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ nawˬ hui geh hkʼa gaˬ awˉ lawˉ ca maˍ la ve lehˬ ngaˬ hui yoˬ.

Shu te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te ve hkʼe te leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ hte‸ ca kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ la maˇ la ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ pehˬ laˇ taˍ ve kanˉ te kuiˬ htawˇ leuˉ leh uiˍ la kʼehˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ coˇ paˉ lo hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ gʼa maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu kanˉ te kuiˬ lo shu te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui ca kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ ve chaw lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ nyi ma uiˍ leh kʼoˆ loˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ awˬ pon Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve chaw hta‸ ceh tiˉ Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ a ciˉ bvuh‸ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ law ve yoˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nawˬ hui a ciˉ yeunˇ hkanˍ laˇ sheˍ.

Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ sheˉ lai ve hkʼe, ngaˬ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheˉ lai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yaˇ miˇ haˉ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hta‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ peuˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, vuiˬ lehˬ heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Eˇva‸ hta‸ beˬ yuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ luˬ kʼai leh, Hkri‸ hta‸ da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ mehˉ kʼai puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui geh laˬ leh, ngaˬ maˍ ve Yeˍsuˆ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ maˍ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Yeˍsuˆ teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ lawn maˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui gʼa peuˬ ve awˬ ha maˇ heˆ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ha hta‸ gʼa ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ peuˬ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˇ heˆ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ ve law.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, uiˍ ve mvuh ve tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ ve teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ maˇ puiˉ ve htawˇ, cuˇ yiˍ hpawˇ ngaˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe puiˉ ve yoˬ teh‸, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ nehˬ piˇ lawˬ leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ yuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ venˇbaˆ te ve leh laˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon kanˉ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ geh hpu hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ yuˬ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ ve hkʼe yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ leh teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ loˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ maˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo laˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hkʼa loˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ ngaˬ te taˍ leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ htawˇ ngaˬ te tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkri‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ chi hkʼe nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸, Aˍhkaˍyaˆ mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tawˍ taˍ maˇ gʼa.
Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw le. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ ha‸ ve pa taw laˇ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ la htaˇ ngaˬ te chehˇ ve hkʼe, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ htawˇ kʼaw‸ te kʼai tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe te leh, heˍ puiˉ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, anˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Saˍtanˍ ka‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe te ve kʼo, anˇ tuˬ uiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, Yawˇ hui kanˉ te ve hkʼe, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ shaˍ. Ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ dawˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe dawˇ ve ka‸, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ a ciˉ yaw hpeh‸ tuˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼe ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ sheˍ.
(Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ tcuh laˇ leh kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe, nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ chaweh te leh kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ awˬ lawn nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ htawˇ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.)
Nawˬ hui cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa yeunˇ hkanˍ ve law.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ hiˉ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ caˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ hta ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ oˇ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, ya‸ taw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ awˬ lawn hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ haˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ haˆ ve yoˬ. (Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hkʼe ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Yawˇ hui Heˍbrehˇ chaw hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Ngaˬ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. (Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, chaw gʼuˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.) Shu a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ kanˉ te ve yoˬ. Shu a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Gʼaw maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ dawˆ laˇ jaw‸ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaw ve yoˬ. Suh paˇ neˇ ve ka‸ laiˉ pawˆ ngaˬ cawˬ jaw ve yoˬ.
Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ngaˬ hta‸ shehˆ chi kʼawˇ hkʼe jaw‸ laˇ ve, ngaˇ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ.

Shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ gawˇ taˬ jaw‸ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ leh, haˉ pui baˬ laˇ ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ. Shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ luˬ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ. Teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa chehˇ jaw peuˬ.

Laiˉ pawˆ ngaˬ ca te toˇ jaw peuˬ. Iˉ kaˆ lawˬ hta‸ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, Chaw hkʼawˇ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, venˇ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kawˆ tuˬ cawˬ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa hpuˇ jaw peuˬ.

Kanˉ te hkeu‸ leh heuˬ jaˇ ve, laiˉ pawˆ maˇ gʼa zuh‸ ve, awˍ meu‸ ve leh iˉ kaˆ shiˉ ve, laiˉ pawˆ caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve, kaˆ ve leh veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ chi ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon dawˇ haˍ dawˇ hkiˉ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, teˇ nyi le le ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ tiˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ nuˇ leh laˇ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ kʼai ve kʼo, ngaˬ maˇ hpeh‸ bawˬ leh laˇ.
Ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ gʼa yaw ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ceh, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ heˍ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ bon uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ hpeh yuˬ tuˬ, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ Aˍreˍtaˆ awˬ hawˉ ve mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ lehˬ, Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ hta‸ shaw tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˉ puˍ lu awˬ hkʼaw keu leh, lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˉ ehˉ awˬ hpe‸ lo ngaˬ hta‸ hpehˇ ya‸-e laˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, mvuhˇmiˬ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ tuˬ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ leh awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo maw laˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ shaˍ.

Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ ve teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ htaˇ mvuhˇ naw ma shehˆ htai‸ teˇ htai‸ hkʼa gaˬ chiˇ taˆ-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ to taˆ-e ve leh naˍ, awˬ ha ceh tiˉ taˆ-e ve leh naˍ, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.)
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Paˍraˍdiˇsuˆ lo chiˇ taˆ-e ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. (Awˬ to taˆ-e ve leh naˍ, awˬ ha ceh tiˉ taˆ-e ve leh naˍ, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ. Gʼuiˬsha ceh tiˉ shiˍ ve yoˬ.)
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸ kʼoˆ maˇ keunˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ shaˍ. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn maˇ heˆ kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ to awˬ lawn nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ gaˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ te ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chi nyiˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ awˬ lawn maˇ gʼa dawˇ nyi tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ to awˬ lawn nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ.

Uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ leuˉ leh maˇ gʼa taˍ uiˍ tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ aˉ chuˇ teˇ maˬ tcuhˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Aˉ chuˇ chi lehˬ, Saˍtanˍ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ awˬ to hta‸ leuˉ leh maˇ gʼa taˍ uiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ chuˇ chi hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ shehˆ pawˆ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ ve awˬ bon lehˬ, nawˬ awˬ pon law‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ kaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve kanˇ paˆ biˇ la ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gʼa cawˬ taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ leuˉ leh nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkri‸ awˬ pon gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ laˇ ve, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve, tu‸ jaˇ hkanˍ jaˇ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ peuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh laˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve tcuh yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ chehˇ.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ te maˍ laˇ peuˬ. Awˬ heˆ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ te maˍ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hu ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ taˍ uiˍ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ taˍ uiˍ ve, aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ le. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hu ve, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kuiˬ chi hta‸ a ciˉ hpehˇ laˇ-oˆ.

Shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ nawˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ chi beu‸ ngaˬ gu taˍ leh, chi teˇ pawˆ ka‸ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa hu tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ ca ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ca ve yoˬ. Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ pa awˬ e awˬ pon mawˇ jeˬ gʼa shaw hpoˆ taˍ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ pa awˬ e teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon mawˇ jeˬ gʼa shaw hpoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve co ha awˬ pon ngaˬ ve mawˇ jeˬ gʼa peuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to gʼa luˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ha lehˬ ha kʼa te tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ la ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼa i kʼai tuˬ ve leh laˇ.
Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hu ve htawˇ, ngaˬ cuˇ yiˍ te leh heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ gʼa ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui chehˇ kuiˬ lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼai tcuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ ngaˬ heˍ yuˬ ve leh laˇ.

Tiˇtuˆ nawˬ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ leh, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ geh kʼai tcuh ve yoˬ. Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ ve leh laˇ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ taˍ leh kanˉ te ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ tiˉ toˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui awˬ to awˬ pon kʼaw‸ yaw hkʼaw‸ chehˇ ve teh‸ nawˬ hui chi maw maw dawˇ chehˇ ve leh laˇ. Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui uiˍ la yeˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui maˇ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ htawˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve, hkawehˉ da‸ ve, nyi ma zuhˆ ve, pehˬ da‸ hpaˆ da‸ ve, hkʼaiˉ da‸ ve, hkʼawˇ deˇ ve, nyi ma uiˍ ve leh, duiˆ-ehˍ shaˇ-ehˍ te ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hta‸ nyiˉ ya‸ laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ htawˇ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ, cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ te ve, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve leh, te ponˬ te leuˉ ve hta‸ te ve chaw laiˉ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ maˇ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa dawˇ haˍ jaˇ tuˬ yoˬ hehˉ teh‸ dawˇ hkiˉ ve yoˬ.

Chi teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ ve lehˬ, shehˆ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ ti cawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo shehˆ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ ca guiˇ la htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ venˇbaˆ te ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, te ya‸ chehˇ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Hkri‸ ngaˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh tawˇ yaw chehˇ ve leh naˍ teh‸, nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ gaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ ponˬ piˇ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ te tuˬ, Hkri‸ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ lehˬ awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo gʼa hkanˍ suh ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh te‸ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ-aw laˇ, maˇ yeˬ chehˇ laˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ tehˆ nyi lawˇ nyi sheˍ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, lawˇ nyi ve hta‸ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, Hkri‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ chehˇ.
Lawˇ nyi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui lehˬ hkanˍ gʼa ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law ve yoˬ.

Haiˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Lawˇ nyi ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkanˍ gʼa peuˬ ve teh‸ ngaˬ hui tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. ngaˬ hui hkanˍ maˇ gʼa ve chaw hta‸ shuˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ te maˇ hpeh‸. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hui te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui da‸ la biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hehnˇ chaweh maˇ gʼa yehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve aˉ yaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ uiˍ la yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Da‸ la biˇ la piˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ sha gaˇ sha cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ taˍ-o‸. Cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, ha‸ pehnˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo boˆ nu da‸ leh la‸ sheh caˉ da‸-o‸.

Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ ve pehnˇ ve leh, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve Pawˇlu‸ leh ngaˬ geh chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gaˍlaˍtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ geh lo gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ hta‸ pa taw hpeh‸ la ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ leh yawˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ pa taw hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, haiˬ ve chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ awˬ to chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.
Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ haˆ haˆ baˬ taˉ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ anˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ cawˬ tehˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te laˇ leh, Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ yuˬ hpfuhˆ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve bon hkawˇ ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve kʼo, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ shaˍ. Nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ peuˬ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve bon hkawˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve kʼo, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ ngaˬ te ve laˇ. Chaw yaˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ngaˬ ca ve laˇ. Chaw yaˇ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ngaˬ ca chehˇ sheˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ geh lo tawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ tcuh laˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ geh lo ngaˬ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Shu ngaˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve pa taw gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui kaˇ jaw ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh, luˬ kʼai tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui teh taˉ laˇ ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ nyi ma pfuhˇ jaˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ ve chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo a sha‸ ngaˬ hkʼe ceh ve chaw maˇ-awˍ ve a‸ kehˉ Yuˇda‸ awˬ liˇ hta‸ ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ maˇ paw la sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ,

yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu awˬ lawn ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ chi, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu ngaˬ hta‸ yawˇ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, chaw yaˇ geh ngaˬ ca jehˬ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ tcuh yaˇ maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ htaˇ tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ taˍ ve, Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh ngaˬ maˇ kʼai. Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Daˍmaˍsehˆ venˇ lo kʼaw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, shehˆ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Keˍhpaˆ geh ngaˬ ca guiˇ-e tuˬ Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo kʼai leh, yawˇ geh teˇ chi ngaˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ nyi paˍ Yaˍko hta‸ maˇ heˆ kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu tcuh yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ maˇ mawˬ.
(Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ heˍ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)
Oˇ ve hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Suˇriˆ leh Kiˇliˇkiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo ngaˬ kʼai ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw sheˍ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ laˇ jaw ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, oˇ htaˇ yawˇ te luˬ chehˇ ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ chi beu‸ bon maˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, kʼoˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, teˇ chi awˇ hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, ngaˬ Tiˇtuˆ hta‸ shiˍ veu leh, Baˍnaˍbaˆ geh Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lo teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ te peuˬ ve kanˉ leh chi beu‸ te chehˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe leˇ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ yawˇ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. (Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kʼai ve Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ, Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, shu yawˇ hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ tcuh.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve ponˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ jaˆ nyi leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ ceˬ te tcuh laˇ tuˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ka‸, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ heˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui geh lo hkʼawˇ lo‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve hkawˇ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ na.

Awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ htehˍ laˇ. (Yawˇ hui awˬ hoˉ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ dawˇ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ nyi.)

Yawˇ hui te‸ chiˉ maˇ htehˍ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha Peˍtruˆ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.
(Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ Peˍtruˆ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ aˉ yaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.)

Ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma yeˬ jaˇ ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ, Yaˍkoˆ, Keˍhpaˆ leh Yoˇhanˬ hui lehˬ, Baˍnaˍbaˆ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ la‸ sha paˉ la‸ sheh caˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, awˬ chawˇ te da‸ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui geh kʼai leh, yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw hui geh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ da‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ, chi teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ hui lawˬ hkawˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ ngaˬ htawˇ te gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Keˍhpaˆ lehˬ, Anˍtiˆawˍ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ te maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ mehˆ hpfuhˇ tawˍ da‸ taˍ leh deˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yaˍkoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ htaˇ, Keˍhpaˆ lehˬ, buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh awˍ caˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw teˇ moˍ hta‸ yawˇ kawˆ ve pa taw, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ leh, awˬ chawˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Yuˇda‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ te ve pa taw, Baˍnaˍbaˆ ka‸ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh hteˇ lehˍ maˇ kʼai ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ Keˍhpaˆ hta‸ ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve ka‸, Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ nawˬ maˇ te leh buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ te ve kʼo, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ te tuˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ nyiˉ te ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, paw la htaˇ ka‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ngaˬ hui Yuˇda‸ chaw hpeh‸ ve ka‸, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve pa taw maˇ heˆ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ, Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ ngaˬ hui yonˍ taˍ peuˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui ca chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui venˇbaˆ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˆ la ve kʼo, Hkri‸ lehˬ venˇbaˆ awˬ pon kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve leh laˇ. Chi hkʼe maˇ heˆ taˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hpaˆ baˬ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ gu te ve kʼo, ngaˬ te ya‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo gʼa te‸ tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpawˇ lo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ suh ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ te‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ to maˇ heˆ, Hkri‸ ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ngaˬ a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ leh ngaˬ awˬ pon yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ peuˬ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ ngaˬ yonˍ ve pa taw te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ ngaˬ baˬ taˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la gʼa ve hkʼe kʼo, Hkri‸ suh ve lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve Gaˍlaˍtiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh ve hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve htawˇ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ heˍ gʼa ve le.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe ceh tiˉ na nyi gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ve lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ te ve hta‸ pa taw laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw laˇ.
Nawˬ hui chi taw taw cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh laˇ. Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh nawˬ hui tanˬ te taˍ ve ka‸, chi beu‸ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ cuˇ leh te peuˬ piˇ tuˬ ve laˇ.
Chi taw taw tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼe leˇ hkanˍ peuˬ ve leh laˇ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve teh‸ ngaˬ maˇ dawˇ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui hta‸ Awˬ ha hpu pe‸ laˇ leh nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo anˇ tuˬ te tawˆ la shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te ve laˇ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui kaˇ leh yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ te ve laˇ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ-o‸.

Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ Li‸ hpu shiˍ taˍ mawˬ taˍ leh, Nawˬ hta‸ pa taw chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Liˬ hpu lehˬ awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yonˍ puiˉ ve Aˍbraˍhanˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ bon gʼa ve yoˬ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ maˇ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw co ha gʼa te‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te ve chaw lehˬ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ gʼa te kʼai tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Suhˆ cehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gʼa hkanˍ suh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Hkri‸ lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lo laˬ ve hkeu ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ bon Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la leh, yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chaw yaˇ hui gʼa hpuˇ gʼa mawˬ jaw ve tawˇ pa haˉ ngaˬ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ shaˍ. Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te leh li‸ hkʼa deh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, chaw yaˇ hui te ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve ka‸, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ baˬ taˉ maˇ hpeh‸. Kʼaw‸ htehˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ te maˇ hpeh‸.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ leh yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, laiˉ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ Hkri‸ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˇ ha shehˆ chi hkʼaw‸ gaˬ htaˇ, yawˇ piˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ leh te luˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ shinˉ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼo, ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ caˉ da‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ awˬ shinˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Ka ti‸ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ ve ceh ceh, te ya‸ te jiˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ tawˆ la tuˬ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ htehˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ cawˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬ sha lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ cawˇ da‸ leh tawˍ taˍ ve laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe maˇ heˆ taˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, piˇ taˍ ve awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, co ha te‸ piˇ lawˬ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw, yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa tuˬ, Li‸ hpu lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ venˇbaˆ awˬ hawˉ lo teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve oˇ ve maˇ gaˬ la sheˍ htaˇ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo hpeh taˍ leh shaw taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ leh, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ la tuˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ Hkri‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la peuˬ ve pa taw, nyi ha‸ shaˉ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ yuˬ peuˬ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Hkri‸ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ to tiˉ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, Yuˇda‸ chaw leh Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ ceˬ leh ponˬ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Hawˉ hkʼaˆ leh yaˇ miˇ maˇ cawˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ Hkri‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ shinˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ, awˬ ceˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ peun da‸.
Awˬ pa tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, yaˇ ehˉ lehˬ shaw shehˍ hpaˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo hpeh taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, awˬ yanˇ biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ geh paw la leh, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo paw la ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo peu laˇ leh, Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, Aˍbaˆ A pa-oˬ teh‸ kuˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸. Nawˬ lehˬ awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ pa taw awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve gʼuiˬsha teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo nawˬ hui awˬ ceˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ kʼo Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe ka‸, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼo‸-e ve le. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo aˬ hto‸ ma te nawˬ hui awˬ ceˬ kʼaw‸ te gaˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ awˬ nyi, ha pa, awˬ tcuhˉ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ ce kan chehˇve law leˇ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼaˇ na te ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ hehˉ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te ya‸ laˇ jaw.
Ngaˬ awˬ to naˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ gʼa maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ to naˬ ve chi lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon hkanˍ haˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ te, ngaˬ hta‸ maˇ baˬ taˉ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui ha lehˬ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ chi beu‸ hkʼaˬ lo mehˉ kʼai ve le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ve mehˆ shiˍ hta‸ kʼehˉ tawˆ leh ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe kʼo, pe‸ laˇ peuˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ kʼoˆ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ la ve laˇ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon gʼaˇ hte‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve htawˇ, da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ dawˇ law leh te ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon nawˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ awˬ bon te piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui dawˇ law ve pa taw, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ baˬ hpawˇ lo chehˇ tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon shu nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ awˬ bon te laˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ceh tiˉ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ngaˬ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Hkri‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ chehˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ lawn dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve pa taw, chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ gaˇ leh, ngaˬ kʼoˆ hehnˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ kaˇ laˇ. Ngaˬ hta‸ hto laˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ ma ve yaˇ hpeh‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ awˬ ceˬ ma maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceˬ ma ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ hta‸ pa taw paw la ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceˬ ma maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo paw la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ tehˆ nyi leh henˇ yuˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve Haˍgaˍraˆ yoˬ. Yawˇ yaˇ paw la piˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ awˬ pon paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Haˍgaˍraˆ lehˬ, Aˍraˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve Siˉnaˆ hkʼaw hpeh‸ leh, chi beu‸ cawˬ taˍ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo cawˬ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ venˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ ma maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw chi hkʼe bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Yaˇ maˇ paw jaw ve chaw meh ma-oˬ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Yaˇ paw tuˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve yaˇ miˇ-oˬ, ha lehˬ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ hpawˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, awˬ hpawˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ a‸ kehˉ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ cawˬ maˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Iˉcaˆ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ hta‸ pa taw paw la ve yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chi beu‸ ka‸ oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Li‸ hpu hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve le. Awˬ ceˬ ma leh yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceˬ ma ve yaˇ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ ma maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ paˍ geh teˇ geh awˬ shinˉ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ maˇ heˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ ceˬ ma ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ ceˬ ma maˇ heˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ awˬ pon Hkri‸ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ. Hkʼe te leh, hkʼa deh‸ yeˬ chehˇ leh, awˬ ceˬ pfuhˇ ve ehˉ kʼaweh‸ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ taˇ kʼaw‸ pfuhˇ-oˆ.
Na sheˍ. Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve kʼo, Hkri‸ lehˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ bon te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ shaˍ. Oˇ hkʼe ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼa na yuˬ leh gʼa te ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa dawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkri‸ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ kʼai peuˬ. Awˬ bon hta‸ nawˬ hui shonˇ kʼai peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo law chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ shoˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yonˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼuiˇ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa na yuˬ tuˬ, a shu nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve le.
Nawˬ hui nyi ma chi hkʼe hpfuhˆ kʼai tuˬ beˬ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lo laˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Diˇ a ciˉ ceh tiˉ ka‸ hkaoˍmonˇ teˇ diˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ciˇ la piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ dawˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui ka‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ dawˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te laˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ chehˇ sheˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ sheˍ le. Oˇ hkʼe maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, la‸ ka hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hkui htiˇ poˬ paiˍ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ shawˆ baˬ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ ve chi, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai tuˬ awˬ pon taˇ yehˇ. Ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ ceˬ te da‸-o‸.
Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸-o‸ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ che‸ caˇ da‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ gʼa te luˬ da‸ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh nawˬ hui maˇ kʼai taˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ heh‸ hkehnˉ leh, Awˬ ha hpu htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ hta‸ heh‸ hkehnˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ tanˬ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai ve kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo maˇ kʼaw‸ chehˇ.
Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la peuˬ. Kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve, cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ te ve, peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te ve,
shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve, neˇ te ve, canˇ da‸ ve, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve, shu ve mawˇ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve, nyi ma zuhˆ ve, tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve, hpaˆ da‸ guiˇ da‸ ve, awˬ moˍ pehˬ da‸ ve,

hkawehˉ ve, tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve, ha lehˬ tuˬ te ponˬ te leuˉ ve, chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e teh‸, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Awˬ ha hpu ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve, ha lehˬ ve, dawˇ sha ve, dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve, ha kʼaˉ ve, shu awˬ pon da‸ ve hta‸ te ve, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve,
nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ gʼaˇ puiˉ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa te teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ maˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ hkʼa caˉ da‸ ve chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve a loˍ leh sheˉ lai ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ geh la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ pehˍ peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo te‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ da‸ tuˬ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hkawehˉ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui baˬ taˉ-a veuˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ venˇbaˆ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ kʼaw‸ da‸ la tuˬ, nawˬ hui co ha hpawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ htawˇ, beˬ ve lawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ gʼa kʼai tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ to shaˍ ti‸ te-o.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ hta‸ ga pfuhˇ da‸-o‸. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Hkri‸ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui te biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te‸ chiˉ te maˇ puiˉ ve ka‸, ngaˬ lehˬ, cheuˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ heˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, a shu yawˇ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tehˆ nyi-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, shu te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ awˬ to te taˍ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ yawˇ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ vuiˬ hta‸ gʼa pfuhˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Bon hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa henˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ maˍ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ pehˬ piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Taˇ dawˇ ya‸. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te maˇ hpeh‸. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ yawˇ sheˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ sheˍ ve kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ sheˍ ve kʼo, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo co ti‸ ha ti‸ hta‸ gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Da‸ ve hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ nuˇ leh te-a veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui nyi ma maˇ luˬ ve kʼo, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ hui gʼa gʼeu‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Te hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon da‸ ve hta‸ te-a veuˬ. Yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon leuˉ leh da‸ ve hta‸ te-a veuˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to ngaˬ ve la‸ sheh nawˬ hui hta‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve li‸ mehˆ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ ve hta‸ nyi-o.

Awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi sha tuˬ te gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ guiˬ meuˇ gʼa shoˍ tuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyiˉ leh te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ ve la‸ ka hta‸ pa taw fawˉ ve mehˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ te ve ceh tiˉ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui awˬ to ka‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa biˇ na yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ve awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ ngaˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve la‸ ka awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ tuˬ maˇ heˆ. La‸ ka oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw miˬguiˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon suh peuˬ leh, ngaˬ htawˇ miˬguiˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suh baˬ taˉ peuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ shoˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ. Chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la ve awˬ liˇ chi awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ leh ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ya‸ nyi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hta‸ taˇ kʼaw‸ sho‸ sha‸ laˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve awˬ to hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ maiˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ

Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, Eˇfeˇsu‸ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ leh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ yeˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ li‸ chi teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, co ha hpawˇ awˬ pon mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ le le, Hkri‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ na‸ laˇ peuˬ.

Miˬguiˬ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ leh, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ kehˬ ve chaw leh, ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve awˬ bon ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ hpu ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa peuˬ. Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ ve awˬ bon uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ ve yoˬ.
Cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la tuˬ yawˇ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ lehˬ faˉ taˍ ve ka‸, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ. Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh chi hkʼe te tuˬ yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, awˬ yanˇ biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha tcuhˉ da‸ caˉ da‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ tcuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui htawˇ awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la peuˬ. Yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ.
Hkri‸ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ dawˇ law taˍ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ ve awˬ pon, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui htawˇ, nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ ve awˬ lawn ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ leh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ yonˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ maiˉ taˍ peuˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa biˇ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ, chi beu‸ ka‸ yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chi lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui chiˇ mvuh tuˬ ve awˬ pon yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ yonˍ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ bon lawˬ htaˇ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve Awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ, dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma leh hpeu‸ maˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, dawˇ law tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve leh hkʼaˬ ma awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ dawˇ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ hui hkʼa yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ ve ka‸, ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha te htaˇ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ jaˇ hehnˇ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Kanˇ paˆ oˇ ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo yawˇ hta‸ mui tcuh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ, jawˇmawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, awˬ meh hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ca‸ na‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yawˇ uiˍ jaˇ mvuh jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo Gʼuiˬsha teh taˍ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ hkʼa caˉ da‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ to yoˬ. Hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ biˇ ve hkʼe, hkʼa peu-eˬ kʼaw‸ biˇ la tuˬ yawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, te ya‸ kuiˬ leh venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo suh chehˇ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui miˬguiˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.
