Oˇ htaˇ, mvuhˇ hpe lo ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ka‸ nawˬ hui kʼai ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te ve awˬ ha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh chehˇ leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te ve pa taw, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ te gaˇ ve hkʼe te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui te ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw,
venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui suh taˍ ve htawˇ, Hkri‸ geh hkʼa geh yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ la piˇ peuˬ. (Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa peuˬ.)
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ geh hkʼa geh ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ leh, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw mvuhˇ naw ma ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ geh mui tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ bon hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬ sha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˇ nawˬ hui te ve pa taw gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa uiˍ tuˬ, kanˉ te ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ te taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te kʼai tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha gu taˍ peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hpeh‸ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Hkri‸ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ la‸ sheh te ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ awˬ moˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa pawnˇ da‸. Awˬ bon gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ka‸ nawˬ huiˬ maˇ caˉ da‸. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ law kuiˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui lehˬ, Hkri‸ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw awˬ paˇ neˇ lo gaˬ la peuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ hpeh‸ la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ kaˍ lo ko taˍ ve gʼo‸ pa hta‸ yawˇ hpaˆ baˬ peuˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ leh tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ la leh, cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

La‸ ka hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ awˬ pon htawˇ yawˇ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve pa taw, canˇ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ laˬ leh, nawˬ hui vuiˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, neˇ kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ piˇ-oˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui chaw nyiˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Awˬ pa geh kʼai tuˬ, ya‸ kʼaw cawˬ taˍ peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu mvuhˇmiˬ ve chaw maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸. Hkehˉ chaw ka‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸. Chi beu‸ nawˬ hui lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui geh teˇ mvuhˇ miˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ chehˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo tcuh yaˇ hui leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ leh, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ to lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ ceˍ kʼaweh‸ ve haˉ pui shiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ yehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ caˉ da‸ taˍ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ kehˬ ve bon yehˬ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yawˇ lehˬ, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ yuˬ leh yehˬ oˇ ve hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ pon htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ gʼa kaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui awˬ pon ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ a ciˉ bvuh‸ laˇ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼaw chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Hkri‸ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve awˬ lawn, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ piˇ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ kehˬ ve tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, chi hkʼe yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Yuˇda‸ chaw hui geh teˇ geh awˬ shinˉ gʼa caˇ ve, yawˇ hui geh awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ hpeh‸ la leh, piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh gʼa ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve awˬ bon ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ pe‸ laˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ chi shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ te tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ chi hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ te laˇ ve hta‸ pa taw gʼa ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve biˇ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ shu a‸ kehˉ i ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, awˬ bon chi yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Peuˬ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la biˇ la chehˇ ve awˬ lawn chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ka‸, awˬ bon chi hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw faˉ taˍ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ pa taw mvuhˇ hpe lo chehˇ ve uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ chi beu‸ shiˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, oˇ htaˇ yawˇ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, miˬguiˬ maˇ te hpanˍ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ te ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh, yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw, maˇ kawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui nyi ma maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi hta‸ pa taw, Awˬ pa mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hkui tcuhˉ teh leh bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬ guiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve chaw ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yawˇ yehˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ lawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ,
nawˬ hui yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw Hkri‸ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ yeˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ geu tcuhˆ naˉ leh awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ yeˬ ve pa taw, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh teˇ geh Hkri‸ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hkʼaˬ ma kʼehˬ ve, hkʼaˬ ma zuhˬ ve, hkʼaˬ ma mvuh ve leh hkʼaˬ ma naˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui htawˇ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon ka‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ shiˍ maˇ gaˬ ve Hkri‸ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ awˬ pon ka‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe shiˍ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve biˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve kanˇ paˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lawˬ ve leh dawˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh yawˇ maˇ chaweh te laˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, co co taiˍ taiˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon htawnˍ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ ve ngaˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ceh tiˉ te kʼai-o.

Hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˍ nehˬ ve, nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ ve, nyi ma dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ yeunˇ hkanˍ da‸ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai-o.

Aˉ caˆ hkeh hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ pa taw hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ cawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.
Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui dawˇ law kuiˬ teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ cawˬ tuˬ yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ cawˬ leh, Awˬ ha hpu teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ, baˆtiˆsaˬ teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ chehˇ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hkʼaˬ ma pe‸ laˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ bon chi ma gʼa peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Yawˇ lehˬ mvuh kuiˬ lo taˆ-e ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ yawˇ hpeh veu leh, chaw yaˇ hui hta‸ la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ piˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ taˆ-e ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ teˇ htai‸ lo yawˇ ya‸-e taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ kʼoˆ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Ya‸-e ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ biˇ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, mvuhˇ nawˬ ma hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ taˆ-e ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, shu awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ ve awˬ to uiˍ la yeˬ la piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

La‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ tcuh yaˇ te tuˬ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ bon maˍ paˍ te tuˬ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ paˍ te tuˬ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ paˍ te tuˬ, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te tuˬ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ shiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ taˍ leh, uiˍ la peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ biˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ hui htawˇ biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe uiˍ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui yaˇ ehˉ maˇ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ leh, la‸ lehnˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ cuˇ yiˍ te leh heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ maˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuhˇ haw meuˆ chiˇ veu ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ choˬ hpawˇ oˇ hpawˇ meuˆ chiˇ veu gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hkʼa biˇ biˇ uiˍ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve pa taw, awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la chehˇ leh, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ to oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ tcuhˉ hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ pa taw, teˇ tawn leh teˇ tawn caˉ da‸ taˍ leh, awˬ hkʼeun teˇ maˬ peuˬ teˇ maˬ a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ cawˬ ve hkʼe te ve pa taw, awˬ to oˇ ve uiˍ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ leh shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ te ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui taˇ kʼaw‸ te. Yawˇ hui dawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nyi ma heh leh te‸ chiˉ maˇ shiˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui shiˍ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ kʼai leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ caˉ da‸.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ya‸ taw puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ te gaˇ jaˇ leh, peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te tuˬ yawˇ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Hkri‸ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe gʼa henˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh, Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh gʼa henˇ taˍ ve kʼo, haiˬ ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ piˍ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Nyi ma awˬ piˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˉ da‸ leh, ya‸ kʼai tuˬ te puiˉ ve sheˉ lai ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ suhˉ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha hpanˍ taˍ ve nyi ma awˬ suhˉ hta‸ veu‸ deh-o.

Hkʼe te leh, heˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ le le a shu yawˇ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui lo chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ceh tiˉ yaw da‸-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ caˉ da‸ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui nyi ma zuhˆ ve htawˇ, venˇbaˆ taˇ te. Mvuhˇ nyi maˇ kʼehˬ sheˍ htaˇ, nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ mehˉ kʼai piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Neˇhaiˬ kanˉ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hta‸ a hkaw-anˬ taˇ piˇ.
Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ jaw ve chaw taˇ kʼaw‸ hkʼawˇ loˬ. Loˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ ga piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, a shu yawˇ ve la‸ sheh yehˇ leh da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te-o.

Nawˬ hui ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ peu-eˬ ka‸ taˇ tawˆ la piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ tuˬ, shu loˍ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ ve tawˇ ceh tiˉ yaw leh, shu hta‸ uiˍ la yeˬ la piˇ puiˉ ve da‸ ve tawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yaw-o.
Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ taˇ dawˇ haˍ piˇ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yinˉ tcuhˉ taˍ laˇ peuˬ

Shu hta‸ nyi ma naˬ ve, shu hta‸ beu‸ ve, shu hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve, shu hta‸ deˇ da‸ ya‸ da‸ ve leh, shu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te gaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ htawˇ baˬ taˉ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ da‸ ve hta‸ te da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha kʼaˉ da‸-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ da‸-o‸.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ te ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te-o.

Hkri‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-o. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ veyoˬ.

Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve, cha‸ chiˆ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ve leh, shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ yaw da‸ ve ceh ka‸ taˇ te. Hkri‸ yaˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ maˇ keunˍ ve yoˬ.
Cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh baˇ da‸ gʼuiˬ da‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ, tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ maˇ keunˍ. Chiˇ mvuh ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yaw-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw leh, shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shinˉ maˇ gʼa ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Shu ve mawˇ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve chaw lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve chaw hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yaw leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa heˍ yuˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hui awˬ hkʼoˆ gaˬ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te da‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui awˉ lawˉ htaˇ naˆ ho‸ lehˍ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ gʼeuˆ yaˇ hkʼe te kʼai-o. (Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ gʼeuˆ ve awˬ shiˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.)
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ la tuˬ te-o.
Awˬ shiˍ maˇ naw‸ ve, naˆ hoˆ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ te. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, kanˉ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, baˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui tawˇ yaw ve ceh ka‸ ya‸ taw tuˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ kuiˬ hta‸ hpeu‸ tawˆ la piˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ pa taw hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ htawˇ, awˬ gʼeuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve chaw-oˬ, nawˇ la-o. Suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tuˬ la-o. Hkri‸ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba laˇ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe dawˇ ve te ve hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸. Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hui hkʼe taˇ te. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hui hkʼe te chehˇ-oˆ.
Chi beu‸ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ haiˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, awˬ yanˇ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ leh hkʼa deh‸ yehˇ-oˆ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve a loˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
A pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve taˇ te. Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, te ponˬ te leuˉ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Awˬ ha hpu hkʼa biˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Chiˇ mvuh ve tawˇ hkawˇ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ leh co ha hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ da‸-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh-o.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ pon Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ.
Hkri‸ hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hawˉ lo teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hawˉ lo nawˬ hui chehˇ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ moˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, awˬ hpawˇ htawˇ awˬ miˇ ma ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ to hpeh‸ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve hkʼe, awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Hkri‸ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ moˍ hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ha‸-o‸.

Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ, iˉ kaˆ tsuhˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Hkri‸ lehˬ bon hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ ve awˬ to chiˇ a‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ aˬ hto‸ ma te Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ kehˬ piˇ le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, da‸ kehˬ ve, ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve, awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ moˍ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ moˍ oˇ ve yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ chiˇ a‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon tsuhˇ kehˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ha‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ to hta‸ canˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ caˍ piˇ taw piˇ leh, hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ moˍ hta‸ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw hawˉ hkʼaˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˉ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, teˇ suhˍ teˇ shaˍ tiˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi lehˬ, naˉ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ leh yawˇ ve awˬ moˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le htawˇ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ha‸-o‸. Awˬ miˇ ma htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve awˬ pa awˬ e ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le nawˬ awˬ pon da‸ leh, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo co zuhˬ ha zuhˬ cawˬ tuˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o.
(Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ awˉ lawˉ teˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.)
Awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ taˇ te. Nawˬ hui yaˇ hu duˬ hu ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ maˍ laˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ leh sheh kʼai-o.

Vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Hkri‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼe, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ kawˆ cheˇ leh nyi ma teˇ hkʼaˇ tiˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo na yuˬ-o‸.
Shu mehˆ mawˬ kuiˬ ceh te ve leh, chaw yaˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ceh te ve teˇ ceuˬ taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, nyi ma pfuhˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬ sha ve a loˍ hta‸ te-o.
Chaw yaˇ awˬ pon ceh te ve maˇ heˆ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon te ve hkʼe, ha lehˬ, ha kʼa te-o.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, da‸ ve hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shu vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ponˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe kʼaw‸ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ chehˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui kawˆ tuˬ taˇ te. Yawˇ hui ve Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ leh nawˬ hui ve Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, shu ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ nyi ve teh‸ shiˍ chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Neˇhaiˬ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui veu‸ deh leh pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸,

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ gʼa tawˍ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˇ paˆ cawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi beu‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ naˆ ho‸ ve hta‸ uˉ peunˍ chehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ hpe lo chehˇ ve haiˬ ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa tawˍ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, haiˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui yeˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ huˉ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve la‸ caˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ-o‸.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui ve caw‸ cehˍ nyi hta‸ tsuh‸ taˍ leh, nyi ma hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nyi ma pui hta‸ htanˬ tuˬ veu‸ deh leh,
cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ tuˬ te hpeh‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw gu taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hkuiˉ nuˆ tcuhˉ ve hkʼe tcuhˉ leh huˉ taˍ-o‸.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, haiˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ bawˆ laˇ ve aˬ miˍ to‸ chehˇ ve hkaˆ ce teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ gʼa tuˬ, htanˬ tuˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ ve hkʼe, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸.
Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve sho uˉ tcuhˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ taˍ leh, Awˬ ha hpu ve aˉ htaw hta‸ pfuhˇ taˍ-o‸. Aˉ htaw oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ ve leh lawˬ hkawˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ te leh, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo bon lawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe bon lawˬ tuˬ awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ nuˇ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ leh shaw chehˇ-oˆ.
Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve faˉ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon htawˇ bon lawˬ-o‸.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve awˬ pon ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ tan te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, sho caˆ hpeh taˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˍ piˇ keunˍ ve hkʼe, nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ-o‸.

Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ leh hkʼaˬ hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui htawˇ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tuˇhkiˆ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ yeˬ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ leh, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ pe‸ laˇ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ha‸ tcuhˉ taˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ geh awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ leh Tiˆmoˉseˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Hpiˇliˇpiˆ venˇ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Teˇ pawˆ le le ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ bon lawˬ htaˇ, teˇ pawˆ le le ha lehˬ ha kʼa bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ teˇ nyi te leh chi beu‸ hkʼa gaˬ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ bvuhˬ kʼai tuˬ nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh teˇ geh awˬ chawˇ te ve pa taw, ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ tanˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ kanˉ oˇ ve hta‸ te peuˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ yonˍ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ lawn ngaˬ chi hkʼe dawˇ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma dawˇ nawˇ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ puiˉ tuˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ leh pehˬ puiˉ fuiˍ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ shaˬ te shaˬ uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ piˇ leh yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw gʼa ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ nawˬ hui hkʼa biˇ cawˬ leh,
Hkri‸ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ pon da‸ ve kehˬ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon ka‸ ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ gʼa hpuˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ bvuhˬ kʼai piˇ lawˬ ve law teh‸, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ awˬ pon ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ jawˇmawˇ lonˉ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ ta‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve pa taw, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ-awˍ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma yeˬ leh, nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yawˇ hui maˇ kawˆ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkawehˉ ve leh ya‸ da‸ gaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Hkri‸ awˬ lawn bon maˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve hta‸ tawˆ la tuˬ dawˇ law leh bon maˍ ve yoˬ.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ lehˬ, cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ gʼa yaw hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve awˬ pon ngaˬ choˬ kaˬ lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸, da‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ law leh maˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ shiˍ leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon maˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkawehˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo Hkri‸ awˬ lawn bon maˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hteˇ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ. Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve hta‸ leuˉ leh tu‸ hkanˍ jaˇ la tuˬ yawˇ hui dawˇ taˍ leh, tanˬ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon maˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, hkʼaˬ hkʼe le. Heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo Hkri‸ awˬ lawn shu bon maˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ awˬ lawn shu bon maˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ha lehˬ leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ htawˇ kʼaw‸ ha lehˬ tuˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui bon lawˬ ve leh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Awˬ ha hpu ga laˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve chi awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ dawˇ law leh heuˆ gaˇ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ ngaˬ maˇ gʼa ya‸ taw leh, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ chi beu‸ htawˇ ngaˬ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve hkʼa deh‸ cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ te‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, suh ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ Hkri‸ hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Hkri‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ suh ve kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ pon awˬ yawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ to te‸ chehˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, suh ve leh te‸ ve, hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa leuˆ yuˬ tuˬ leh naˍ maˇ shiˍ.
Oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ kaˍ lo ngaˬ chehˇ leh dawˇ maˇ tawˆ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ kʼo‸-e leh Hkri‸ geh chehˇ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi lehˬ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ gʼa chehˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon leuˉ leh awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chi hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ ve pa taw, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui uiˍ la leh ha lehˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui leuˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼa te hkʼa dawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ gaˬ la leh nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ taˍ leh, dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ tiˉ taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hui teˇ geh gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ kawˆ. Maˇ kawˆ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ heˆ chi ve nyiˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui gʼa luˬ gʼa sheˆ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha lo laˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui gʼa ve awˬ bon lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ, yawˇ awˬ pon gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ gʼa bawˆ da‸ ve leh nawˬ hui gʼa bawˆ da‸ ve, teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, Bawˆ da‸ ve chi, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ leh, chi beu‸ htawˇ ngaˬ te chehˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ gʼa ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ chawˇ te ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu hta‸ dawˇ nyi leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve kʼo,
ngaˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ ve biˇ la tuˬ chi hkʼe te-o. Nawˬ hui nyi ma teˇ shiˍ tiˉ, ha‸ da‸ pehnˇ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ leh, nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ taˍ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ leh nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ a shu yawˇ awˬ to a‸ kehˉ shu hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ-oˆ.
A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ taˇ dawˇ nyi. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, shu hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ dawˇ nyi-o.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ nyi ma taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ taˍ-o‸.
Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ vawˆ taˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ maˇ dawˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ kʼehˆ teh taˉ leh, awˬ ceˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ deh leh, chaw yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ tehˬ ve hta‸ shu gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ taˍ nehˬ leh, suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ na yuˬ ve yoˬ. Suh ve oˇ ve lehˬ, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yuˬ uiˍ yuˬ mvuh piˇ leh, awˬ meh hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ meh yawˇ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa chehˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ meh awˬ hawˉ lo hkui tcuhˉ gʼa teh tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, maw‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ le le shaˉ hkiˆ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ, leuˉ leh chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, kawˆ ve cheˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui te gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ leh te gʼa tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼanˇ ve leh tawˇ kʼaw‸ shaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ taˇ te.

Oˇ hkʼe maˇ te ve kʼo, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, shu hta‸ maˇ ya‸ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Nyi ma kʼaw‸ ve leh nyi ma hpfuhˆ puiˉ ve chaw chi teˇ co awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve, Gʼuiˬ sha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Co ha te‸ piˇ lawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui vawˆ taˍ leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ ba ve hkʼe miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chaw chi teˇ co hta‸ nawˬ hui ba piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi gaˬ kʼo, ngaˬ nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ chi hkʼe cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ gʼuiˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve htawˇ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, tanˇ tuˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hta‸ ngeuˍ baˬ ve htawˇ ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ hui htawˇ ha lehˬ leh, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ, maˇ maw maw Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nyi ma taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ geh maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ pon da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ ca leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ca ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Tiˆmoˉseˍ lehˬ awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼaˬ ma da‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ pa geh teˇ geh kanˉ te ve hkʼe, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ bvuhˬ kʼai tuˬ yawˇ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, shu ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ cawˬ haˉ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw ngaˬ awˬ to nawˬ hui geh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Eˇpaˍhpawˍdiˆ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tcuh cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te leh ngaˬ geh teˇ geh bon hpawˇ ve ma‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui ve tcuh yaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ loˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ka‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ma haˍ jaˇ leh, yawˇ naˬ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ maˇ maˇ dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh kʼaw‸ la tcuh ve yoˬ.

Suh paˇ neˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ naˬ jaˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ha kʼaˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ leuˉ leh maˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve a ciˉ hkehnˇ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh haˆ haˆ kʼaw‸ la tcuh ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ pa taw, ha lehˬ ve hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸. Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo loˍ ve cuˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te biˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ ve a sha‸ tanˇ leh, Hkri‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve pa taw, yawˇ aˬ laˬ hkʼe suh ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh ve teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ teˇ pawˆ peuˬ teˇ pawˆ ngaˬ bvuh‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ awˬ pon hkeu‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui yeˬ la tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hpuiˇ hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, haiˬ ve kanˉ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ baˬ shawˆ baˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ te-o.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬ sha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui leh, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma uiˍ kuiˬ cawˬ leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ va ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va gaˇ kʼo, hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ va tuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hiˉ nyi gaˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Beˍyaˍmenˍ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ leh, Heˍbrehˇ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo paw la ve Heˍbrehˇ chaw hpeh‸ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ Hpaˍriˍsehˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te jaw ve awˬ lawn hta‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ ngaˬ fawˉ mehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ lehˬ venˇbaˆ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ yawˬ teˇ hpaˍ, Hkri‸ hta‸ ngaˬ ha‸ ve pa taw, shonˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ shonˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shonˇ baˬ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa leh, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lo laˬ leh, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ htawˇ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ dawˇ law ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ka‸, yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ka‸ shiˍ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ,

yawˇ ve tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ geh teˇ geh hkanˍ leh, yawˇ suh ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ shonˇ baˬ leh, chiˇ baˬ peuˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, chi beu‸ ka‸ ngaˬ gʼa peuˬ, maˇ heˆ kʼo chi beu‸ ka‸ ngaˬ biˇ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ngaˬ hta‸ vawˆ yuˬ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ htawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa vawˆ yuˬ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaˇ suh ngaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ vawˆ yuˬ peuˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ponˬ laˬ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ leunˇ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo cawˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ la‸ sheh che yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ mvuhˇ naw ma lo taˆ-e tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼa‸ yuˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la peuˬ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma oˇ hkʼe taˍ-a veuˬ. Nawˬ hui nyi ma oˇ hkʼe maˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn oˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa gʼa‸ mi taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh hteˇ lehˍ kʼai-a veuˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ te ve hkʼe nawˬ hui htawˇ te-o. Ngaˬ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh te kʼai chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ nyi-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ hto laˇ peuˬ leh, chi beu‸ ka‸ mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaw‸ hto laˇ ve hkʼe, Hkri‸ ve la‸ ka hta‸ canˇ paˍ te chehˇ ve chaw maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve gʼoˇ peˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ya‸ taw cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma uiˍ ve yoˬ. Miˬguiˬ hpawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ oˇ kaˬ lo tawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui law chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ tcuh tuˬ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve yawˇ ve awˬ to hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ pa laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ ha‸ leh ngaˬ nyi ma haˍ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍoˬ, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ hpeh‸ leh ngaˬ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma hawˍ da‸ la tuˬ, Eˇvawˇdiˆ leh Suˇtuˆ hta‸ ngaˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te jaw ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ-oˬ, nawˬ htawˇ yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ huiˉ maˬ ka‸, Kaˍleˍmeˍ teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸, co ti‸ ha ti‸ li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuh‸ taˍ ve, ngaˬ geh kanˉ te ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ ka‸, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ bvuhˬ kʼai tuˬ te jaw ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui nyi ma da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ awˬ lawn hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ. Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui bon lawˬ ve, lawˬ hkawˉ ve leh chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hkʼa lawˬ gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lo laˬ ve, chaw yaˇ hui ca dawˇ maˇ gaˬ ve dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma leh nawˬ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Hteˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, yawˆ yan keunˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ, nyi sha ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, shu ve awˬ lawn da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ gʼa kaˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ, chiˇ mvuh keunˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o.
Ngaˬ geh nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ gʼa ha‸ yuˬ leh, gʼa kaˇ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te-o. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ htawˇ, nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ ve pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ tuˬ ya‸ kʼaw maˇ cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ cawˬ leh kʼoˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa hpuˇ da‸ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ngaˬ shiˍ la peuˬ.

Haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, paw sha jaˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hkanˍ puiˉ la peuˬ. Caˇ bvuhˆ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, meu‸ ve kaˆ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, paw sha ve maˇ kʼoˆ, haˍ gʼawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te hkanˍ tuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ shiˍ la peuˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ awˬ shaˉ pe‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te puiˉ te hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ chawˇ te laˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hpiˇliˇpiˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ tanˬ maˍ gehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai htaˇ, piˇ ve leh ha‸ yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ceh tiˉ ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ moˍ ka‸ chi hkʼe maˇ te ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ Hteˇsaˍlawˇniˆ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ loˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui ngaˬ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ nyiˇ pawˆ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ ngaˬ ca ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ naw‸ maˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ bon gʼa maˇ tuˬ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ ngaˬ ca ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ teˇ ceuˬ le le hkʼa law‸ cawˬ leh, awˬ leuˉ ka‸ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Eˇpaˍhpawˍdiˆ geh nawˬ hui feu laˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. La‸ shawnˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ shaˉ hawnˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh ha‸ yuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ ka‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui hkʼa loˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa biˇ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Leuˉ leh jawˇmawˇ Kehˉsaˍ ve hawˉ yehˬ hkʼaw chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tiˆmoˉseˍ ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Kawˇlawˇsehˇ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hui leh, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ yeˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ li‸ chi teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve hta‸ pa taw htawˇ, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law ve chi awˬ lawn awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ maˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ kaˬ le le lo awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la uiˍ la chehˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa shiˍ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la leh uiˍ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa shiˍ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui geh teˇ geh kanˉ te ve, ngaˬ hui ha‸ ve Eˇpaˍhpaˍraˆ geh nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Hkri‸ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh,
Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui yonˍ leh ha‸ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ nyi hta‸ tanˬ leh, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Co ha hpawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh dawˇ pawnˍ dawˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa biˇ biˇ shiˍ tuˬ ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe shiˍ ve kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui te kʼai leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la tuˬ leh, leuˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ maˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma yeˬ leh yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ tuˬ, nawˬ hui kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon htawˇ ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh ngaˬ hui awˬ shinˉ caˇ keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ te laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Awˬ pa hta‸ nawˬ hui chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ pa lehˬ, naˆ ho‸ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ leh, yawˇ ha‸ ve Yaˇ hpu ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tcuh laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ hpu oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hpeh‸ leh, hpanˍ taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yaˇ kaoˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ leh miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, mawˬ hpeh‸ ve leh mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, kʼaw jaw teˇ hpaˍ, jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh kanˇ paˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ pa taw leh yawˇ awˬ pon te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ sheˍ htaˇ ka‸, yawˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ to hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ leh hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, suh kuiˬ lo awˉ lawˉ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ cawˬ tuˬ Awˬ pa nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh,

la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo sheˆ ve yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma hpawˇ yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ chi beu‸ lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ awˬ to hkanˍ suh ve pa taw, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ cawˇ da‸ hawˍ da‸ piˇ lawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui da‸ kehˬ ve chaw, venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh, shu kʼoˆ kuiˬ yaw kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ jiˆ leh, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ taˍ leh yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ chi hkʼe chiˇ a‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma awˬ hawˉ lo cawˬ taˍ ve, hkʼa hpanˍ taˍ ve te‸ chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve shu maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ htawˇ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ ngaˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ ve tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hkʼa cawˬ taˍ sheˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve awˬ to awˬ pon ngaˬ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve awˬ to teh‸ kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼa biˇ shiˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ ve hkʼe, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ chi Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ teˇ co peuˬ teˇ co faˉ taˍ leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ yawˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw hui awˬ pon tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ chi, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn, Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Hkri‸ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui bon maˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh hkʼaw chiˇ a‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ leh, cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yehˇ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve awˬ pon ngaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ pe‸ laˇ leh ngaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ htawˇ coˇ caˇ leh te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, Lawˍdiˍkiˆ venˇ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Hkri‸ hta‸ caˇ da‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼa deh‸ na gʼa leh shiˍ puiˉ ve cuˇ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve cawˬ leh teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ te ve yoˬ.
Awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
A shu teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, na sha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ tuˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ awˬ to nawˬ hui geh maˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma nawˬ hui geh cawˬ leh, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ te chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui yonˍ yeˬ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ gʼa mawˬ ve pa taw ha lehˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ peuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼai chehˇ-oˆ.

Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ geu gʼa tcuhˉ naw‸ taˍ leh gʼa uiˍ la yeˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui yeˬ chaweh chehˇ taˍ leh, oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw chiˇ mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ-oˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ tawˇ hkawˇ leh tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve heˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yehˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa hpeh yuˬ veu tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ Hkri‸ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Chaw yaˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve biˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ Hkri‸ ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui biˇ la peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ. Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, la‸ sheh te ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Hkri‸ ve awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ a loˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh tuˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui yonˍ ve pa taw, baˆtiˆsaˬ hkanˍ ve oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ geh teˇ geh nawˬ hui kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, te ya‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, suh taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui te ya‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa laˇ peuˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve la‸ ma‸ oˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hta‸ keu ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ yuˬ baˬ ve yoˬ.

Uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ caˉ hta‸ yawˇ yuˬ baˬ sheˬ leh, oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shu gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. La‸ ka hta‸ pa taw awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, pawehˇ te ve awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, ha pa cheˆ ve awˬ nyi awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, shinˉ nyi awˬ lawn maˇ kʼoˆ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hkawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.
Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gaˬ la tuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, A shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ nehˬ lehˍ gʼa taˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ gʼa pui ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ceh tiˉ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui te ve teˇ hpaˍ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve ka‸ nyi ma uiˍ chaweh te ve yoˬ. Awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼaˇ va ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa lu yuˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ maˇ caˉ da‸. Oˉ kʼoˍ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ uiˍ la chehˇ leh, uiˍ la ve oˇ ve lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh lo laˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ to lehˬ, awˬ tcuhˉ awˬ caˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw caˉ da‸ taˍ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ biˇ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh suh taˍ peuˬ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma te miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hkʼe nawˬ hui te chehˇ sheˍ ve le.
Taˇ ca vawˆ, taˇ ca leh‸, taˇ ca htawˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw nawˬ hui te chehˇ sheˍ ve le.

Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve awˬ ceuˬ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hui teh taˍ leh maˍ piˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

A shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ dawˇ tawˆ leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma taˍ nehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ to hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ sheˉ lai ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ tuˬ te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ca-o. Hkri‸ lehˬ, oˇ kaˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sha pa mui chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve taˇ te. Mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui suh peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ hui ve co ha te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Hkri‸ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha awˬ hkʼaw lo faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve co ha te‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, Hkri‸ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui htawˇ yawˇ geh teˇ geh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ-o‸. Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve, cha‸ chiˆ ve hta‸ te ve, peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te ve, haiˬ ve hta‸ te ve leh, shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, shaˉ ho‸ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ gaˬ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui htawˇ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te jaw ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ lehˬ nyi ma zuhˆ ve, beu‸ jaˇ ve, shu hta‸ naˬ tuˬ te gaˇ ve, shu hta‸ hkʼaiˉ ve leh, cha‸ chiˆ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ.
Teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ taˇ heˍ da‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ chaw awˬ piˍ hta‸ ka‸, chaw awˬ piˍ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ kʼehˆ baˬ peuˬ leh, chaw awˬ suhˉ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ peuˬ.
Chaw awˬ suhˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ te hpanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, shiˍ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Heˍlaˍsaˆ chaw leh Yuˇda‸ chaw maˇ cawˬ. Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw leh awˬ guiˬ meuˇ maˇ shoˍ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Chaw hteunˍ leh Saˍkuˍsiˆ chaw maˇ cawˬ. Vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ leh ponˬ ve chaw maˇ cawˬ. Hkri‸ lehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh, nawˬ hui da‸ kehˬ ve leh yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ deh-o. Ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve, shu awˬ pon da‸ ve hta‸ te ve, nyi ma taˍ nehˬ ve, nyi ma nuˇ nuˇ nehˬ nehˬ ve leh, nyi ma dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ veu‸ deh-o.

Teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ yeunˇ hkanˍ da‸-o‸. Teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ taˍ da‸ kuiˬ cawˬ kʼo, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ da‸-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬ sha nawˬ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ venˇbaˆ hpehˇ da‸-o‸.
Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ veu‸ deh taˍ-o‸. Ha‸ pehnˇ ve lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ biˇ la tuˬ hpeh tsuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ ve dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo uˉ peunˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Chi hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ pon, awˬ to teˇ to tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ ve bon hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve Hkri‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Chiˇ mvuh ve tawˇ hkawˇ, kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ leh co ha hpawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kʼa muiˬ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˍ da‸ leh shaˍ ti‸ piˇ da‸-o‸. Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ hui hkʼa te ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, tawˇ yaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ meh awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te-o. Yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ miˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ hpawˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh taˇ te.
Yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ pa awˬ e ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve hta‸ Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, yawˇ hui nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ taˇ te.

Vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve nawˬ hui ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ-o‸. Shu gʼa mawˬ kuiˬ ceh te ve leh chaw yaˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ceh te ve taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Nyi ma taˍ hkʼaˇ teˇ hkʼaˇ tiˉ te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo na yuˬ-o‸.
Nawˬ hui kanˉ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve teˇ ceuˬ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ awˬ pon te ve maˇ heˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon te ve hkʼe nyi ma pfuhˇ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.
Nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shinˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui Jawˇmawˇ Hkri‸ awˬ pon kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ te ve maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, chaw yaˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ nyi.

Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui htawˇ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh keunˍ da‸ cawˇ da‸ ve hkʼe ceh te piˇ-oˆ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Bon lawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shaw chehˇ leh, chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ.

Hkri‸ ve tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ hui gʼa kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui pon yehˬ miˉ hpaw laˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon htawˇ bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ ve tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve awˬ pon ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ keunˍ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ kʼoˆ maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve awˬ pon ka‸ bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi leh te-o. Awˬ yanˇ hta‸ vuiˬ hkʼaw‸ leh hkʼa deh‸ yehˇ-oˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa yaw hkʼaw‸ cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ, nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu awˬ pon cawˇ da‸ leh na sha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yaw leh, aˉ leh‸ hkaw‸ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tuˇhkiˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ leh, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ tuˬ, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ hui chehˇ kuiˬ lo laˬ ve, ka ti‸ yeˬ leh ngaˬ hui ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Awˍneˍsiˍmuˆ hta‸ htawˇ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, choˬ kaˬ lo hkʼa hpeh‸ la ve awˬ lawn hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve Aˍriˍtaˍhkuˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Baˍnaˍbaˆ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Maˍku htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. (Maˍkuˆ awˬ lawn ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸.)

Yuˇtuˆ meh ve Yeˍsuˆ teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yuˇda‸ chaw hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ geh teˇ geh Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ pon kanˉ te chehˇ ve lehˬ, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ maˇ maˇ dawˇ sha la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ leh, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve Eˇpaˍhpaˍraˆ htawˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la leh hkʼa deh‸ yeˬ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui awˬ pon hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, Lawˍdiˍkiˆ venˇ leh Heˍraˍpawˇliˆ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ ma coˇ caˇ leh te ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ yawˇ awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ha‸ jaˇ ve saˍ la‸ gʼonˍ Luˉka‸ leh Deˍmaˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Lawˍdiˍkiˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Noˍhpaˆ leh yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw lo hpawnˬ da‸ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Li‸ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼaw peuˬ kʼo, Lawˍdiˍkiˆ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ gʼaw tcuh-o. Lawˍdiˍkiˆ chaw hui gʼa ve li‸ hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui gʼaw-o.
Aˍhkiˇpuˆ hta‸ htawˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh nawˬ gʼa taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ awˬ to nawˬ hui hta‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa hkanˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui geh awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Pawˇlu‸, Siˍlaˍnuˆ leh Tiˆmoˉseˍ hui lehˬ, Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hteˇsaˍlawˇniˆ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ li‸ chi teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh leh, ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw kanˉ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ pa taw kanˉ hkeu‸ ve hta‸ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ dawˇ law ve pa taw nyi ma yeˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui maˍ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ lehˬ, tawˇ hkawˇ ceh hpeh‸ leh nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˇ paˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yonˍ yeˬ jaˇ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ tuˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ka‸ Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ka‸ henˇ yuˬ leh te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, bon hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaˇ ve htawˇ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu pe‸ laˇ ve ha lehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo bon hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui lehˬ, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍhkaˍyaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve yonˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ leh Aˍhkaˍyaˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ lawn teˇ kaˬ le le lo bvuhˬ kʼai ve pa taw, oˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ laˇ ve awˬ lawn shu kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, te‸ chehˇ ve leh awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon kanˉ hta‸ nawˬ hui te hpeh‸ tuˬ, shaˉ ho‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui baˬ taˉ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh kʼaw‸ hpfuhˆ kʼaw‸ la ve awˬ lawn hta‸ htawˇ, shu kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Suh kuiˬ lo Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ ve yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu mvuhˇ naw ma lo ya‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui law chehˇ ve awˬ lawn htawˇ, shu kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ hpu oˇ ve lehˬ, gaˬ la tuˬ ve nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ponˬ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Yeˍsuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh laˬ ve lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, Hpiˇliˇpiˆ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve leh maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ ca maˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ, gʼa tawˍ da‸ tuˬ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui lehˬ dawˇ ya‸ te ya‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, cha‸ chiˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, heˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh leh chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve hkʼe ceh ngaˬ hui maˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ngaˬ hui maˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ lawˇ nyi laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ngaˬ hui maˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, shu nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hui shu hta‸ chiˇ mvuh piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui sheˉ lai leh maˍ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui geh maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw geh maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ hui geh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ hui maˇ ca.
Awˬ e teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ ehˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ ceh tiˉ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ, ngaˬ hui ve a sha‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ gaˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ha‸ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la peuˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui kanˉ te ve hkʼaˬ ma hkeu‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬ sha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa hkeu‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ kanˉ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui te laˇ ve lehˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve leh venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ka‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ pa teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te piˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ te laˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ keunˍ ve hkʼe ceh te tuˬ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ leh yawˇ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ laˇ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui maˍ laˇ ve Gʼuiˬ sha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw yaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hkʼe nawˬ hui shawˍ taˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Gʼuiˬ sha ve tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shawˍ taˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yuˇda‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬ sha ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui henˇ yuˬ jawˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ chaw hui ve la‸ hkʼaw lo tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ nawˬ hui ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ hkʼaw lo tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ka‸ tiˇ pehˍ leh, ngaˬ hui hta‸ htawˇ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ maˇ te ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ngaˬ hui maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ Yuˇda‸ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ biˇ la tuˬ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬ sha nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hkʼa biˇ gaˬ la peuˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ mawˬ gaˇ jaˇ leh gʼaˇ hte‸ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ to nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ hpaˆ da‸.
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, nawˬ hui geh laiˉ pawˆ laˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Saˍtanˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ, ha lehˬ kuiˬ leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ aˬ hto‸ ma le. Nawˬ hui yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ ngaˬ hui ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve ha lehˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui maˇ gʼa shiˍ maˇ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw hkanˍ maˇ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ Aˍhtenˍ ven awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ yeˬ leh awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ tuˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hkanˍ maˇ gʼa ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe yonˍ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ ngaˬ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Beˬ shehˍ hpaˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ beˬ yuˬ leh, ngaˬ hui kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ la puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ haˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ Tiˆmoˉseˍ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la leh, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ lawn, ha lehˬ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ leh, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui htawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn ka‸, yawˇ hto laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui dawˇ haˍ jaˇ ve leh tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw dawˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui yeˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬ sha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui ha lehˬ tuˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ tuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ maˇ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa kʼaw‸ mawˬ da‸ leh, nawˬ hui yonˍ maˇ biˇ sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ biˇ la tuˬ, tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ venˇ ngaˬ hui bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui geh ngaˬ hui laˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hui pon ya‸ kʼaw gu taˍ laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui htawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ da‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la maˇ la tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ te laˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, yawˇ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ leh awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te keunˍ ve leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa te cawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ hui geh gʼa henˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ te kʼai sheˍ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve kanˇ paˆ awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui gʼa da‸ gʼa kehˬ tuˬ, chi lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.
Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le da‸ ve kehˬ ve leh yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve awˬ miˇ ma hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ heuˆ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve buiˇ shaˆ aˉ naˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe taˇ te.

Kanˉ chi teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ maˇ gʼa te ponˬ te leuˉ leh maˇ gʼa te ya‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ pe‸ laˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, chi hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, cha‸ chiˆ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chi hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui hta‸ yawˇ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu pe‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ da‸ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ da‸ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ.

Awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh yawˇ hui hta‸ ha‸ maˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, awˬ baˬ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ tuˬ leh nawˬ hui chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa ca cuˇ tuˬ,
ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ laˇ peuˬ ve hkʼe, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ leh a shu yawˇ te kuiˬ hta‸ te leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to la‸ sheh kanˉ te tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, dawˇ law kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ dawˇ haˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa dawˇ haˍ tuˬ, suh peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ shiˍ piˇ lawˬ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ suh leh kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh yawˇ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ cuˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, suh peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ geh teˇ geh kʼaw‸ shiˍ veu laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
