Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe hto laˇ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suh peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ gʼa gaˬ tuˬ maˇ heˆ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, tawˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hkawˇ bvuhˬ chaweh kuˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ htawˇ bvuhˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo suh peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˉ lawˉ te‸ tu la tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve ngaˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ hpe lo Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ geh hkʼa geh moˬ cawˬ kuiˬ lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ taˆ-e laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ hui dawˇ sha la tuˬ, tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼoˆ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸-o‸.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ leh awˬ tcuhˉ awˬ yanˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn nawˬ hui hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ chaw hkʼawˇ laˬ ve hkʼe Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇmiˬ gawˬ la peuˬ leh ngaˬ hui te‸ chiˉ dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ teh‸, shu kʼoˆ da‸ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yaˇ paw tuˬ naˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ naˬ jaˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe, luˬ ve sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ teˇ cawˬ haˉ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ponˬ kuiˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui naˆ ho‸ ve hkʼaw lo maˇ chehˇ ve pa taw, awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw hkʼawˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ hui geh gaˬ la tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ awˬ gʼeuˆ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ hpeu‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, naˆ ho‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ caˉ da‸.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui zuh‸ muiˉ taˇ kʼa chehˇ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ shaw chehˇ leh shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-a veuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ zuh‸ muiˉ kʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Tzuhˬ dawˬ bvuhˆ ve chaw hui htawˇ, tanˇ hkuinˇ htaˇ dawˬ bvuhˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ mvuhˇ law‸ kʼaw hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ chehˇ-a veuˬ. Yonˍ ve leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ nyi ma pui hta‸ htanˬ tuˬ hkʼe veu‸ deh leh, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve dawˇ law ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve sho uˉ tcuhˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ taˍ-a veuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hui hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ fuiˍ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui te‸ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, suh ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ geh teˇ geh gʼa te‸ chehˇ tuˬ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon hkanˍ suh peuˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve hkʼe, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ uiˍ la yeˬ la tuˬ te da‸-o‸.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te leh, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh shaˍ ti‸ pe‸ laˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˆ yan-o.
Yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui hta‸ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ chehˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Kanˉ maˇ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma i puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ-oˆ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˬ chaweh taˍ-o‸.

Shu haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ te laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ bon lawˬ tcuhˉ taˍ-o‸.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe te tuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ pon Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬ sha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ ha hpu ve aˬ miˍ hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ.
Shu Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ taˇ te.
Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi-o. Da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍ-o‸.
Haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.

Dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo da‸ la kehˬ la piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma, co ha leh awˬ to biˇ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe te laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ-o‸.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo boˆ nu da‸ leh la‸ sheh caˉ da‸-o‸.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ li‸ chi gʼaw maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ngaˬ cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Pawˇlu‸, Siˍlaˍnuˆ leh Tiˆmoˉseˍ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve Hteˇsaˍlawˇniˆ Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ li‸ chi teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh cawˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ la maˇ la chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ha‸ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ la chehˇ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe chiˇ mvuh keunˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve leh tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ leh yonˍ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.

Hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha hteˇ lehˍ suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ heˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hui hkanˍ chehˇ leh, mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ keunˍ da‸ tuˬ yawˇ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui geh teˇ geh aˬ miˍ awˬ gʼeuˆ ba jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ,

chi beu‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ fawˉ mehˍ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui geh teˇ geh gʼaˇ jehˇ piˇ tuˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ htaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hehnˇ chaweh kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ nyi htaˇ chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ ka‸, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ ka‸ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ leh, co co taiˍ taiˍ luˬ ve sheˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Oˇ ve teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ leh, yonˍ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ anˇ leh chiˇ mvuh tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui yonˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui htawˇ oˇ ve teˇ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chi hkʼe bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve awˬ bon hta‸ nawˬ hui keunˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa dawˇ law ve hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa te ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui te peuˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui bon lawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon uiˍ jaˇ maˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe, nawˬ hui hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ meh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ leh, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui htawˇ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ ngaˬ hui gʼa hpawnˬ da‸ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui taˇ dawˇ hkiˉ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la peuˬ teh‸, awˬ ha awˬ hkʼaw lo shu gʼa mawˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, shu kʼoˆ chehˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui li‸ chi hkʼe bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ shu kʼoˆ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui nyi ma sho‸ sha‸ ve taˇ cawˬ piˇ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka‸ maˇ gʼa heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ nyi oˇ ve maˇ gaˬ sheˍ gʼuˇ suhˍ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpfuhˆ kʼai ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ la tuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve, luˬ ve sheˆ ve awˬ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, gʼuiˬsha teh‸ shu hkʼa kʼoˆ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ tawˍ taˍ leh, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ a‸ kehˉ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ taˍ uiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve bon yehˬ lonˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo mui taˍ leh, yawˇ awˬ to Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh chehˇ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ hto laˇ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ dawˇ nawˇ leh laˇ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ, chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe tawˍ taˍ chehˇ ve awˬ lawn nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chi beu‸ ka‸ baˬ kuiˬ lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ tawˆ kʼai ve ceh ceh, oˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ tawˍ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Tawˍ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ kʼai peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇbaˆ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ chaw oˇ ve hta‸ meuˆ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ ya‸ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ laˬ ve lehˬ, Saˍtanˍ te taˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ cuˇ leh laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, shu hta‸ heˍ yuˬ tuˬ awˬ heˆ leh anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ,

luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ gʼa tuˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ yehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ leh, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suhˉ taˆ piˇ tuˬ,
maˇ heˆ heˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui yonˍ tuˬ awˬ pon dawˇ ya‸ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ gaˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬ sha hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ gʼa chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui yonˍ ve pa taw, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ.

Oˇ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui maˍ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha cuˇ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ chi hkʼe te ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon te ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, yeˬ chaweh chehˇ taˍ-o‸. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ yaw laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa maˍ laˇ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍo‸.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ to leh ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ dawˇ sha la piˇ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ leh da‸ ve tawˇ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw co co taiˍ taiˍ dawˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo haˆ haˆ bvuhˬ kʼai leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ gʼa ve hkʼe, teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon bon lawˬ-o‸.
Te ponˬ te leuˉ ve chaw leh haiˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve la‸ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ htawˇ bon lawˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yonˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ yeˬ la piˇ lawˬ leh, haiˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ hpawˇ htawˇ nawˬ hui te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui ve nyi ma lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh Hkri‸ ve nyi ma yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ nawˬ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ meh awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui geh nawˬ hui gʼa henˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh maˇ kʼai leh te‸ chiˉ kanˉ maˇ te ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui te ve hta‸ nawˬ hui henˇ yuˬ leh te cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui kanˉ maˇ te leh hkʼe leˇ chehˇ taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.
A shu teˇ gʼaˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ piˇ leh ngaˬ hui caˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa hkeu‸ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ kanˉ gʼaˇ hte‸ te ve yoˬ.

Shu caˍ laˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa caˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe te ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ hui ngaˬ hui hta‸ henˇ yuˬ tuˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ pon ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaˇ chi hkʼe te teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui geh chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hui nawˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe tawˇ piˇ taˍ peuˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ kanˉ maˇ te gaˇ ve kʼo, awˍ taˇ caˍ piˇ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, bawˬ jaˇ leh, shu ve kanˉ hta‸ ca sho‸ sha‸ piˇ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to kanˉ te‸ chiˉ maˇ te ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui chi hkʼe tawˇ piˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te leh, a shu yawˇ ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ caˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, da‸ ve hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ taˇ nuˇ piˇ.
Li‸ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui bvuh‸ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ maˇ na yuˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ hta‸ tawnˇ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ te.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, canˇ paˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hta‸ taˇ shawˍ taˍ. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Dawˇ sha piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ cawˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh chehˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ ngaˬ awˬ to nawˬ hui hta‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ bvuh‸ ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hui shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ bvuh‸ ve la‸ meuˇ lehˬ, chi hkʼe cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha leh, ngaˬ hui ve dawˇ law kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve yaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ ve Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ Maˍkeˍdawˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, Eˇfeˇsu‸ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ chehˇ taˉ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Peun da‸ ve yonˍ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa maˍ piˇ tuˬ, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, kaˇ puiˇ kaˇ lao teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ kʼoˆ leh peuˬ kuiˬ leh kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa taˍ uiˍ tuˬ nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon htawˇ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chehˇ tcuh taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha pe‸ laˇ ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ ceh tiˉ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui ha‸ pehnˇ ve cawˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Ha‸ pehnˇ ve chi lehˬ, da‸ kehˬ ve nyi ma, venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve nyi ma leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yonˍ ve nyi ma, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn hta‸ ceh tiˉ tawˇ yaw da‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ maˍ paˍ te gaˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe kʼoˆ chehˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ.
Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh hteˇ lehˍ te kʼai htaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui awˬ pon awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ teh taˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw, maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan te ve chaw, venˇbaˆ te ve chaw, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw, bon liˇ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan ve chaw, awˬ pa awˬ e hta‸ dawˆ ve chaw, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve chaw,

haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw, hawˉ hkʼaˆ chawˇ hawˉ hkʼaˆ peh‸ ve tzuhˆ ve hta‸ te ve chaw, chaw hta‸ hkʼawˇ yuˬ ve chaw, heˍ ve chaw, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo heˍ ve chaw leh, cawˇ ve maˍ hkʼaˇ hta‸ heh‸ hkehnˉ ve chaw, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ teh taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ taˍ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ hawˍ da‸ ve yoˬ. Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kanˉ chi hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ leh ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ ponˬ laˬ htaˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve, yawˇ hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ ve leh, hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ maˇ shiˍ leh maˇ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te ve pa taw, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve yonˍ ve leh ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ geh teˇ geh, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ htawˇ, ca kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo laˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, cawˇ jaˇ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ha‸ yuˬ cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ lehˬ shu a‸ kehˉ venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ jaˇ ve hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ shu a‸ kehˉ venˇbaˆ uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo co ti‸ ha ti‸ gʼa tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon ngaˬ lehˬ, henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Co co taiˍ taiˍ uˉ peunˍ ve Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ, maˇ luˬ maˇ sheˆ puiˉ leh, chaw yaˇ mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.

Ngaˬ yaˇ Tiˆmoˉseˍ-oˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ shu Gʼuiˬsha awˬ tan te leh, nawˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yonˍ ve hta‸ vawˆ taˍ leh, venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ pon ma‸ bawˆ loˬ.
Venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ baˬ taˉ ve pa taw, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ luˬ kʼai ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui yonˍ ve nyi ma htawˇ luˬ kʼai peuˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, Huˍmeˍnehˇ leh Aˍleˍsaˍduˆ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn henˇ yuˬ tuˬ, Saˍtanˍ ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ peuˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˉ lawˉ teˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ chi hkʼe awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ hkawˉ ve, bon lawˬ ve, shu awˬ pon bon lawˬ ve leh chiˇ mvuh ve teˇ hpaˍ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon te-o.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, dawˇ sha leh nyi ma gawˬ lehˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ yawˆ yan leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, a sha‸ te‸ hpeh‸ tuˬ hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh jawˇmawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon htawˇ oˇ hkʼe te-o.
Oˇ hkʼe te ve lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬ sha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ yawˇ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha leh chaw yaˇ awˬ kaˍ lo awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ, yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn oˇ ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tuˬ awˬ pon, ngaˬ lehˬ bon maˍ paˍ leh tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yonˍ ve leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. (Ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, heˍ ve maˇ heˆ. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.)

Hkʼe te leh, teˇ kaˬ le le lo chehˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma zuhˆ ve leh tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ kehˬ ve la‸ sheh chiˇ leh bon lawˬ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve leh nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, keunˍ da‸ cawˇ da‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ deh ve hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Uˉ hkeh mvuh hpeˇ ve, shi hkʼeun tcuhˉ ve, piˉ ko-eˍ shehnˉ tcuhˉ ve leh, awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ veu‸ deh ve hta‸ ngaˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ.
Ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui te keunˍ ve hkʼe, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tcuhˉ taˍ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ taˍ leh, ta‸ iˉ gawˬ lehˍ chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo henˇ yuˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.
Yaˇ miˇ lehˬ, shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, hawˉ hkʼaˆ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ piˇ. Yawˇ ta‸ iˉ gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Aˍdanˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ te hpanˍ leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Eˇva‸ hta‸ te hpanˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Aˍdanˍ hta‸ heˍ gʼa ve maˇ heˆ. Yaˇ miˇ hta‸ heˍ gʼa leh, yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve te ya‸ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ ve, ha‸ pehnˇ ve, da‸ kehˬ ve leh nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ ve kʼo, yaˇ paw ve pa taw yawˇ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ te ve kanˉ hta‸ ca ve chaw lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ hta‸ ca ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ cawˇ tehˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, venˇ baˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw, awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve chaw, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ puiˉ ve chaw, nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve chaw, te keunˍ te cawˇ ve hta‸ te ve chaw, hkehˉ chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw leh, maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw leh, shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ dawˆ da‸ ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw, shu hta‸ tawˇ maˇ gʼawˬ da‸ puiˉ ve chaw, hpu hta‸ maˇ sheˉ lai puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ leh, yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa deh‸ te tuˬ maˍ gʼaˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ uˉ peunˍ maˇ gʼaˇ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te nyi ha‸ shaˉ gʼa tuˬ le.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ suhˉ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ nyi ma uiˍ la mvuh la leh neˇhaiˬ ve ciˍ yanˍ kuiˬ lo ce lo‸-e tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ baˬ hpawˇ chehˇ ve chaw mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ da‸ ve awˬ meh cawˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, shu hkʼaiˉ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ leh, neˇhaiˬ va htaw taˍ ve hta‸ yaw tuˬ yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, dawˇ yeˬ gaˇ yeˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ha tehˬ nyiˇ maˬ cawˬ ve chaw, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸.
Da‸ ve kehˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo, hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ peuˬ ve yonˍ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ yonˍ yeˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ awˉ lawˉ lawˇ nyi sheˍ. Lawˇ nyi peuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ taˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ kʼo, ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ te tcuh cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ga piˇ shehˍ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, dawˇ yeˬ gaˇ yeˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ca hkʼaiˉ ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸, shaˍ ti‸ cawˬ ve chaw leh teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ gʼa cawˬ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ uˉ peunˍ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ga piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te ve chaw hui lehˬ, da‸ ve awˬ meh gʼa ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma ka‸ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Maˇ maw maw nawˬ geh laˬ tuˬ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ haˆ haˆ maˇ gaˬ la kʼo,

Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ kʼa awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ hkʼe te keunˍ te cawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa shiˍ tuˬ, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yehˬ kʼa oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ moˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ moˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ hkuiˉ daw leh awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan leh oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tcuhˉ kuiˬ naˉ jaˇ tehˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ htawˇ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ pfuhˇ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ Awˬ ha hpu shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ peuˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ. Yawˇ awˬ lawn awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ bon maˍ piˇ peuˬ. Miˬguiˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ peuˬ. Awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ taˆ kʼo‸-e peuˬ.

Awˬ ha hpu lehˬ, chi hkʼe hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, heˍ puiˉ ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ leh, neˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Heˍ puiˉ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ neˇhaiˬ cuˇ leh oˇ hkʼe maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ sho chiˆ ngawˉ piˇ leh hkeu‸ kʼai peuˬ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ maˇ gʼa heuˆ da‸ leh, caˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa caˇ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, yonˍ ve leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ shiˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha te hpanˍ taˍ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ da‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, hkʼaˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ gʼa baˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, bon lawˬ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ da‸ peuˬ kehˬ peuˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ ve kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve da‸ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ nawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, yonˍ hkʼaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, nawˬ te kʼai chehˇ ve da‸ ve maˍ hkʼaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ caˇ chehˇ dawˬ chehˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
A pi kʼu teˇ hpaˍ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve kaˇ lao teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ taˇ na. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ la tuˬ, nawˬ awˬ to hkʼa deh‸ te jawˬ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ te jawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ bon a ciˉ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ hkawˇ chi lehˬ, cawˇ jaˇ leh awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ha‸ yuˬ cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law tcuhˉ taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ leh kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon leuˉ leh Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ shu hta‸ tawˇ piˇ leh maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Nawˬ yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ maˇ gʼa te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve, yonˍ ve leh da‸ kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ lehˬ yonˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon henˇ kuiˬ jawˬ kuiˬ hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, shu hta‸ Li‸ hpu gʼaw maˍ piˇ ve, awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ ve leh maˍ piˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ coˇ caˇ leh te chehˇ taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ la‸ sheh taˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ tan te leh yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ piˇ taˍ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ yehˇ leh te-o mehˍ.
Nawˬ kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo uiˍ la mvuh la chehˇ ve hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mawˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma pfuhˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o.

Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shaˍ ti‸ te leh, chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Chaw mawˇ hta‸ deˇ maˍ piˇ ve taˇ te. Awˬ pa hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ. Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼe shawˍ taˍ-o‸.
Chaw mawˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ e hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh, yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸, da‸ kehˬ ve nyi ma hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼe shawnˍ taˍ-o‸.
Ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ-oˆ.

Mehˇchawˇma lehˬ, awˬ yaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo awˬ hawehˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, yaˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ a shu yawˇ yehˬ hkʼaw ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ leh, awˬ pa awˬ e awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ bon kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˉ lawˉ teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe ha‸ shaˉ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ chehˇ taˍ ve mehˇchawˇma lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ leh, tanˇ hkuinˇ tanˇ vanˇ htaˇ lawˬ hkawˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon lawˬ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ha lehˬ tuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ ca ve mehˇchawˇma lehˬ, yawˇ te‸ chehˇ ve htawˇ, suh taˍ peuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, mehˇchawˇma hui ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ oˇ hkʼe tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, leuˉ leh a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hkʼaw ve chaw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ ha‸ shaˉ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, maˇ yonˍ ve chaw a‸ kehˉ haiˬ ve yoˬ.
A sha‸ hkaw‸ chi hkʼaw‸ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ meh hta‸ mehˇchawˇma ve caˇ lanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ bvuh‸ keu.

Awˬ hpawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ heuˆ jaw ve, da‸ ve kanˉ te ve yoˬ teh‸ shu shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve, awˬ yaˇ awˇ duˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ ve, hkehˉ chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui ve hkui sheh hta‸ tsuhˇ piˇ ve, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ ve leh, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ te ve mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ ve kʼo, caˇ lanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuh‸ keu-o.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ caˇ lanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh taˇ bvuh‸ keu. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui Hkri‸ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˉ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ve ka ti‸ hta‸ yawˇ hui te luˬ ve pa taw, ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui teˇ yehˬ peuˬ teˇ yehˬ lo kʼai leh, bawˬ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Bawˬ ve ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ hui tawˇ maˇ leh, kʼoˆ maˇ keunˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve shu te kuiˬ hta‸ ca sho‸ sha‸ piˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yaˇ nehˬ hpeh‸ ve mehˇ chawˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ hpawˇ kʼaw‸ heuˆ tuˬ, yaˇ paw la piˇ tuˬ leh, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ kʼa hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, canˇ paˍ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ ka‸ mehˇ chawˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ya‸ kʼai leh, Saˍtanˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai peuˬ.

Yonˍ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to yawˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ lehˬ, ga piˇ paˍ maˇ cawˬ ve mehˇchawˇma hpeh‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, awˬ vuiˬ chi Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ taˇ gaˬ piˇ.

A shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te ve awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyiˇ pun yawˆ yan cawˇ ve yoˬ. Bon maˍ ve leh shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh yawˆ yan cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Caˬ shiˍ naˆ chehˇ ve nuˇ maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ nawˬ maˇ gʼa hoˆ taˍ. Peuˬ leh, Kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, gʼaˇ hpfuhˇ gʼa cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ, maˇ heˆ kʼo shehˆ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ taˇ na.
Venˇbaˆ te tcuhˉ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ deˇ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve kʼo, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ kawˆ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ fuiˍ maˇ pehˬ leh, shu ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ maˇ nyi ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te-o teh‸, Gʼuiˬsha leh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
A shu hta‸ ka‸ aˉ yaˇ haˆ haˆ taˇ piˇ. Awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu chaw teˇ hpaˍ venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ caˉ da‸. Nawˬ awˬ to da‸ lehˍ kehˬ lehˍ chehˇ taˍ-o‸.
Chi hkʼaw‸ nawˉ iˉ kaˆ ceh tiˉ taˇ dawˬ. Nawˬ ve gʼoˇ peˬ awˬ pon leh, nawˬ teˇ hkui teˇ hkui naˬ chehˇ ve awˬ pon, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ ka‸ a ciˉ dawˬ-o‸.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la leh, suhˉ jehˬ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ maˇ tawˆ la sheˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ faˉ taˍ gʼa tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui maˍ piˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ tuˬ, shu vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ gʼa hpeh‸ chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˆ yan keunˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hawˉ lo gʼa chehˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hpeh‸ la peuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te maˇ cawˇ. Yawˇ hui awˬ pon leuˉ leh kanˉ hkʼa deh‸ te cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui oˇ hkʼe te ve teˇ yanˇ, ha‸ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, awˬ bon gʼa ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ maˍ piˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, peun da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo,

yawˇ lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ leh, te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ shiˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ na da‸ leh, tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn tawˇ gʼawˬda‸ ve hta‸ ceh tiˉ yawˇ te gaˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Oˇ hkʼe te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hkawehˉ da‸ ve, deˇ da‸ ya‸ da‸ ve, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve, shu awˬ lawn haiˬ ve hta‸ ca dawˇ ve leh,

da‸ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tawˆ la puiˉ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve pa taw awˬ yawˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ tehˬ kʼoˆ kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve kʼo, awˬ yawˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ngaˬ hui lo‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, te‸ chiˉ maˇ yuˬ laˬ leh, ngaˬ hui tawˆ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ htawˇ, te‸ chiˉ yuˬ kʼai maˇ hpeh‸.
Hkʼe te leh, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ leh veu‸ tuˬ kʼaˇ tuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ yoˬ.

Paw sha la gaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ beˬ ve, va htaw taˍ ve leh, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸ te luˬ puiˉ ve sheˉ lai ve laiˉ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ce lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Sheˉ lai ve oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chaw yaˇ hta‸ luˬ kuiˬ sheˆ kuiˬ lo kʼa piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, hpu hta‸ sheˉ lai ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, haiˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, hpu hta‸ sheˉ lai ve hta‸ pa taw, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˉ leh, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ juˆ pawnˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve teˇ ceuˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, nyi ma yeˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ, awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh hkʼa deh‸ kʼai-o.

Yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve, da‸ ve bawˆ da‸ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ bawˆ da‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Co ti‸ ha ti‸ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍ-o‸. Oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ leh, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ ve shaˉ hkiˆ nawˬ hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ a sha‸ te‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, jawˇmawˇ Poˍtiˆ Piˉla‸ gʼuˇ suhˍ da‸ ve shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ ya‸ kuiˬ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te kʼai-o.

Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hpeh‸ leh, jawˇ mawˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ Jawˇmawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ ceh tiˉ co co taiˍ taiˍ a sha‸ te‸ chehˇ leh, a shu teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ awˬ paˇ lo kʼai maˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ jaw leh, mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh kanˇ paˆ yawˇ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.

Chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw sha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ nyi ma maˇ gʼa uiˍ tuˬ leh, luˬ puiˉ sheˆ puiˉ ve mawˇ jeˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼa dawˇ law tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ hui gʼa ha lehˬ tuˬ awˬ pon awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ pe‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ceh tiˉ gʼa dawˇ law tuˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu hta‸ awˬ bon te piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve kanˉ maˇ chaweh te tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, shu hta‸ pehˬ piˇ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ chaweh piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yeˬ ve a sha‸ te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ vawˆ taˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui da‸ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ cawˬ tuˬ ve awˬ pon, da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaw hpoˆ taˍ-o‸ teh‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Tiˆmoˉseˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hta‸ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸. Cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, maˇ heˆ heˆ ve cuˇ yiˍ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼe leˇ kʼoˆ guiˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ leh tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.
Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve cuˇ yiˍ oˇ ve hta‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkanˍ yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, yonˍ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ hui geh awˬ bon cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw co ha gʼa te‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ lawn kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh ya hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, ngaˬ ha‸ ve yaˇ Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Bon lawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ dawˇ nawˇ leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui lehˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ awˬ pon kanˉ te ve hkʼe ngaˬ htawˇ kanˉ te ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ ve mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, teˇ nyi teˇ haˉ le le ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ mawˬ gaˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve biˇ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ yonˍ ve chi lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ nawˬ ve awˬ pi Lawˇiˆ leh nawˬ ve awˬ e Uˇniˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ leh, chi beu‸ nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ nawˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ la‸ sheh taˍ ve pa taw nawˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ gu ceh ve hkʼe hkʼa deh‸ gu ceh tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui hta‸ kawˆ puiˉ ve nyi ma pe‸ laˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve nyi ma, ha‸ pehnˇ ve nyi ma leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ gʼaˇ puiˉ ve nyi ma yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ pon shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tuˬ taˇ ya‸ taw. Yawˇ awˬ pon htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ pa taw htawˇ taˇ ya‸ taw. Gʼuiˬsha geh kanˇ paˆ gʼa taˍ ve hkʼe, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ awˬ pon gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh hkanˍ-o‸.

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ dawˇ law taˍ ve hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ hui hta‸ kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui kanˉ te ve hta‸ pa taw yawˇ chi hkʼe te laˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ ve awˬ bon oˇ ve lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ pe‸ laˇ leh, ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ tawˆ la ve hta‸ pa taw, chi beu‸ awˬ bon oˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te luˬ leh, co ha te‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh maˇ luˬ maˇ sheˆ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸, ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la piˇ lawˬ peuˬ.
Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ chi awˬ pon bon maˍ paˍ, tcuh yaˇ leh, saˍ la‸ te tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ chi hkʼe gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ maˇ ya‸ taw. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ yonˍ chehˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ hkʼa chiˇ a‸ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ gʼa ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yonˍ ve leh ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ geh gʼa kaˇ taˍ ve, da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ leh te kʼai-o.
Ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ nawˬ cuˇ leh, nawˬ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ laˇ peuˬ ve, da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ-o‸.
Aˍsiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ hpfuhˆ baˬ taˉ peuˬ ve teh‸ nawˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, Hpuˍgeˍluˆ leh Heˍraˆmoˇgenˍ ka‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˇneˍsiˉhpawˍ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ laiˉ pawˆ dawˇ sha la piˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ sho caˆ hpeh taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ya‸ taw.
Yawˇ Roˉma‸ venˇ lo gaˬ la ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ hta‸ mawˬ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ ca ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh lo ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Eˇfeˇsu‸ venˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo htawˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ ma ga laˇ peuˬ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ yaˇ-oˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ laiˉ gʼaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ ngaˬ geh gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ, shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve da‸ ve ma‸ yaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ ngaˬ geh teˇ geh tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ yuˬ-o‸.

Ma‸ yaˇ te chehˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ ve ma‸ poˍ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te gaˇ ve pa taw, a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼaˉ tiˍ hawˆ tiˍ taˍ tuˬ yawˇ maˇ te.
Gʼuiˇ da‸ ve pawehˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe maˇ gʼuiˇ ve kʼo, shu yawˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ yoˬ teh‸ maˇ shawˍ piˇ.
Kanˉ te hkeu‸ ve muiˬ caˇ paˍ lehˬ, awˬ shiˍ hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa caˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ puiˉ tuˬ cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hkʼe, Daˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve, suh kuiˍ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la peuˬ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, chaw haiˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ hta‸ shu hpeh taˍ laˇ leh, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ shu hpeh taˍ maˇ gʼa.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve oˇ ve geh teˇ geh co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Tawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ geh teˇ geh suh ve kʼo, yawˇ geh teˇ geh gʼa te‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ ve kʼo, yawˇ geh teˇ geh gʼa uˉ peunˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ baˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ baˬ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ka ti‸ maˇ ye‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ lehˬ ka ti‸ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ yawˇ chiˇ baˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ. Tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn tawˇ maˇ gʼa gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ, Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, kaˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui hta‸ te luˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ awˬ to yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, gʼaˇ hte‸ coˇ caˇ leh te-o. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ ya‸ taw tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼe leˇ kʼoˆ guiˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan ve nyi ma shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la leh,
yawˇ hui maˍ piˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, kuiˇ ve behˬ ve hkʼaw kuiˬ uiˍ la kʼehˬ la ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo Huˍmeˍnehˇ leh Hpiˇlehˆ ka‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, hpeh‸ la peuˬ teh‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ kʼoˆ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ya‸ kʼai peuˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ ve yonˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ hpfuhˆ baˬ piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve yeˬ ve awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ leh, yinˉ chi hkʼe tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ pfuhˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Uiˍ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpu hkʼeun shi hkʼeun ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Suhˆ leh je‸ te taˍ ve awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼeun teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve awˬ pon yehˇ leh, teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ pon yehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ a shu yawˇ awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo yuˬ baˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yehˇ hpeh‸ ve da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ hkʼeun hpeh‸ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ ve, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼeun hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yaˇ nehˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ sheˉ lai puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ jaw kʼai-o. Da‸ kehˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ kuˬ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ, yonˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh, cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai-o.

Cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ leh, te‸ chiˉ tcuhˉ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ jehˬ da‸ ve hta‸ ka‸ jaw kʼai-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe jehˬ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ te tawˆ la ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ ceˬ lehˬ, deˇ da‸ ya‸ da‸ ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸. Yawˇ lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ te ve chaw, maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw leh, yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ tawˍ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw htawˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui shiˍ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui venˇbaˆ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha te piˇ tuˬ leh naˍ, maˇ shiˍ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, neˇhaiˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hui hta‸ neˇhaiˬ hpeh yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve va awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hui gʼa ponˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo haˍ jaˇ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw, hpu hta‸ sheˉ lai ve chaw, caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve chaw, nyi ma uiˍ ve chaw, maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw, awˬ pa awˬ e hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw, shu ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw, maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw,

shu hta‸ maˇ ha‸ puiˉ ve chaw, shu ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ hpehˇ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw, shu hta‸ hkʼaiˉ puiˉ ve chaw, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ puiˉ ve chaw, haiˬ jaˇ ve chaw leh, da‸ ve hta‸ canˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, shu hta‸ chiˇ a‸ piˇ puiˉ ve chaw, shu shaˍ ti‸ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, nyi ma uiˍ jaˇ ve chaw leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ ha‸ leh miˬguiˬ ha lehˬ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ve htawˇ, oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ yawˇ hui chiˇ baˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ jaw kʼai-o.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e leh, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ gʼa ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇ baˆ maˇ maˇ pfuhˇ taˍ leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ sheˉ lai ve laiˉ ceuˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ sheh kʼai chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ shu maˍ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na chehˇ ve ka‸, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ la puiˉ.

Yaˍneˍ leh Yaˍbeˍ hui Moˉseˍ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve hkʼe, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ luˬ kʼai peuˬ leh, yawˇ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw oˇ ve nyiˇ gʼaˇ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la ve hkʼe, chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ lawn htawˇ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ tawˆ la tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ maˍ piˇ ve, ngaˬ te ve, ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve, ngaˬ yonˍ ve, ngaˬ dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve, ngaˬ ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh ngaˬ nyi ma yeˬ ve, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ taˍ peuˬ.

Anˍtiˆawˍ venˇ, Iˇkawˇniˆ venˇ leh Luˇtaˍraˆ venˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve leh tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ taˍ peuˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ ve kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan gaˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Haiˍ ve chaw leh heˍ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˬ te shaˬ haiˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui shu hta‸ heˍ leh, shu htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ heˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, nawˬ gʼa henˇ leh hkʼa deh‸ gʼa yonˍ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ a shu geh gʼa henˇ taˍ peuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nawˬ yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ htaˇ ka‸ da‸ ve kehˬ ve Li‸ hpu hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Li‸ hpu oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ cuˇ yiˍ pe‸ laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve Awˬ ha hpu dawˇ pawnˍ piˇ ve hta‸ pa taw cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw lehˬ, hkʼaˬ hkʼe te leh biˇ ve chaw leh, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ pon gu taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ, Li‸ hpu lehˬ maˍ piˇ ve, venˇbaˆ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve, kʼaw‸ da‸ la piˇ ve leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te tuˬ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon Li‸ hpu lehˬ awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, te‸ chehˇ ve chaw hui leh suh peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ ve Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ ve leh yawˇ uˉ peunˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ cuˇ leh nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ chi hkʼe pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Bon hkawˇ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ cawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o. Deˇ maˍ piˇ leh shaˍ ti‸ piˇ-oˆ. Dawˇ zuhˬ gaˇ zuhˬ ve leh maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ hui lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na yuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, aˬ hto‸ ma teˇ ceuˬ awˬ lawn ka‸ kaˇ gaˇ puiˉ leh, a shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve hkʼe maˍ laˇ ve saˍ la‸ maˇ chaweh hta‸ yawˇ hui geh chehˇ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ gʼa na tuˬ yawˇ hui hpfuhˆ kʼai leh, kaˇ puiˇ kaˇ lao hkawˇ hta‸ na leh awˬ hkʼaˇ suh kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ maˍ ve kanˉ hta‸ te chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ te chehˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ ka‸ tanˇ tuˬ hkʼe tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ gʼa hkanˍ leh, ngaˬ gʼa kʼo‸-e ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ jaˇ ve bawˆ da‸ tuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ bawˆ da‸ peuˬ. Gʼuiˇ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ leh hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ gʼuiˇ peuˬ. Yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hkʼa deh‸ vawˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Chi beu‸ lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve shi uˉ tcuhˍ ngaˬ awˬ pon ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ nyi oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ ve cawˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, shi uˉ tcuhˍ oˇ ve ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ kʼaw‸ tawˆ la tuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ geh haˆ haˆ laˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ coˇ caˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Deˍmaˆ lehˬ chi miˬguiˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ leh, Hteˇsaˍlawˇniˆ venˇ lo kʼai peuˬ. Kaˍreˍkeˍ lehˬ, Gaˍlaˍtiˆ mvuhˇ miˬ lo kʼai leh, Tiˇtuˆ lehˬ Daˍlaˍmaˍtiˆ mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai peuˬ.
Luˉka‸ teˇ gʼa ceh tiˉ ngaˬ geh chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Maˍkuˆ hta‸ ka‸ shiˍ veu laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ngaˬ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ ga laˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tuˇhkiˆ hta‸ Eˇfeˇsu‸ venˇ lo ngaˬ kʼai tcuh peuˬ.

Nawˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, Taˍroˇaˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo Kaˍpuˆ geh ngaˬ teh taˉ ve aˉ po‸ zuhˬ ma hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, li‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, leuˉ leh shaˍ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve li‸ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yuˬ veu laˇ-oˆ.
Ca liˉ paˍ Aˍleˍsaˍduˆ lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ haˍ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te laˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Nawˬ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ maˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ tawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ to awˬ pon ngaˬ awˉ lawˉ teˇ pawˆ gʼa yaw hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hpawˇ lo maˇ chehˇ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ piˇ lawˬ.

Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ lehˬ bon hkawˇ hkʼa biˇ maˍ piˇ leh, buiˇshaˆaˉnaˆ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ gʼa kaˇ tuˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ geh chehˇ leh awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, haiˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ ponˬ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ ve mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇ miˬ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A men.
Piˇkiˇlaˆ leh Aˍkuˉlaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Awˇneˍsiˉhpawˍ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ hui hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui hta‸ hto piˇ-oˆ.
Eˇraˍtuˆ lehˬ, Kawˇrenˍhtuˆ venˇ lo chehˇ taˉ ve yoˬ. Taˍroˆhpeˍ teˇ gʼaˇ naˬ leh, ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ Meˍleˍtuˆ venˇ hkʼaw lo teh taˉ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ kaˆ yanˇ maˇ gaˬ sheˍ htaˇ nawˬ haˆ haˆ gaˬ la tuˬ coˇ caˇ-oˆ. Uˇbuˇluˆ, Puˇdeˍ, Liˇnuˆ, Kaˍlawˉduˆ leh awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼa peu-eˬ nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ ka‸ nawˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ceˬ leh Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve yaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ ve Tiˇtuˆ hta‸ li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ uiˍ la maˇ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la tuˬ awˬ pon tcuh yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, maˇ heˍ puiˉ ve Gʼuiˬsha aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve co ti‸ ha ti‸ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te ve yoˬ. Co ti‸ ha ti‸ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ yanˇ cawˇ ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ hta‸ tawˇ pe‸ laˇ leh chiˇ a‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ maˍ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe, loˍ sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kʼaw‸ gu kʼaw‸ te leh, teˇ venˇ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ Keˍreˍteˍ conˇ lo chehˇ tcuh taˉ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw leh, awˬ miˇ ma teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ gʼa hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ hui awˬ lawn shu kʼoˆ kuiˬ yaw kuiˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, awˬ liˇ da‸ leh, shu ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mawˇ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve pa taw, venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. A shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te ve chaw, nyi ma ngeh ve chaw, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw, shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ dawˆ da‸ ve chaw leh, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkehˉ chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, da‸ ve hta‸ nyi ma cawˇ ve chaw, nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve chaw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw, da‸ ve kehˬ ve chaw leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ gʼaˇ puiˉ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shu hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ hpeh‸ leh, gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, maˍ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ yeˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu hkawˇ maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼe leˇ ca kʼoˆ puiˉ ve chaw leh, heˍ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ guiˬ meuˇ shoˍ ve chaw teˇ moˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo chi hkʼe ve chaw leuˉ leh cawˬ maˇ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ gʼa hoˆ taˍ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ, hpu shi mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ awˬ pon, maˍ piˇ maˇ keunˍ ve hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yehˬ kʼa teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo sho‸ sha‸ tuˬ te ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Keˍreˍteˍ chaw hui lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ heˍ ve chaw, haiˬ ve to nuˇ to shaˆ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve chaw leh, caˇ ponˬ caˇ leuˉ ve chaw bawˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve tawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Yuˇda‸ ve kaˇ puiˇ kaˇ lao teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ baˬ taˉ ve chaw hui tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa na yuˬ leh, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la tuˬ,
yawˇ hui hta‸ hehnˇ chaweh maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Nyi ma hkʼaw da‸ kehˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon, awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ da‸ kehˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ cha‸ chiˆ ve chaw leh maˇ yonˍ ve chaw hui awˬ pon, da‸ kehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hui ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ leh yawˇ hui ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, cha‸ chiˆ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui te ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ ve hkʼe te ve yoˬ. Shu yawˇ hui hta‸ cha‸ naˬ ve chaw, maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw leh, da‸ ve kanˉ te tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ hui hta‸ a ciˉ ka‸ yehˇ maˇ hpeh‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve yonˍ hkʼaˇ hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ.
Chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shaˍ ti‸ cawˬ ve chaw, dawˇ yeˬ gaˇ yeˬ ve chaw, nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve chaw, yonˍ ve, ha‸ pehnˇ ve leh nyi ma yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, chaw mawˇ ma teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, te ve dawˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo keunˍ ve hkʼe te ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Shu hta‸ hkʼaiˉ puiˉ ve chaw leh, a pehˉ meuˇ gʼuiˬ dawˬ ponˬ dawˬ leuˉ ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸. Da‸ ve hta‸ maˍ piˇ ve chaw gʼa hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, a sha‸ i ve yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ leh awˬ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ puiˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hui maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve chaw, da‸ kehˬ ve chaw, a shu yawˇ ve yehˬ hta‸ ha‸ shaˉ puiˉ ve chaw, nyi ma da‸ ve chaw leh, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ hpawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ la tuˬ htawˇ, yawˇ hui maˍ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ maˇ hpeh‸.
A sha‸ i ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ nyi ma taˍ puiˉ tuˬ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ hkʼa deh‸ piˇ-oˆ.
Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ awˬ to hkʼa deh‸ te maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Maˍ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo hteˇ lehˍ te leh, dawˇ yeˬ gaˇ yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Shu venˇbaˆ taˍ kuiˬ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, da‸ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ ve chaw lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ te‸ chiˉ hkʼaiˉ maˇ hpeh‸ leh, gʼa ya‸ taw tuˬ yoˬ.
Shu vuiˬ taˍ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve mawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, maˇ gʼa te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa deh‸ gʼa chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ pa Gʼuiˬsha ve maˍ piˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkiˇ shawˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ hui te hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon lehˬ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ tuˬ awˬ pon tawˆ la peuˬ.

Awˬ bon oˇ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ chi hkʼe maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve sheˉ lai ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ baˬ taˉ tuˬ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ ca‸ na‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui lehˬ, nyi ma taˍ puiˉ ve, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ te puiˉ ve leh, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ tuˬ ka‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve uiˍ jaˇ da‸ jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ tawˆ la tuˬ ve awˬ bon uiˍ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon da‸ ve kehˬ ve chaw teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve awˬ to tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw oˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te gaˇ jaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ leh deˇ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nawˬ hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan maˇ gʼa te tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ te-o.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, jawˇmawˇ leh uˉ peunˍ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ leh yawˇ hui ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon gu taˍ hehnˇ taˍ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

A shu hta‸ ka‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ maˇ gʼa kʼoˆ. Tawˇ maˇ gʼa gʼawˬ da‸. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ taˍ leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˆ yawˆ yan yan te tuˬ ka‸, yawˇ hui hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nawˇ piˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ ngaˬ hui htawˇ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve chaw, maˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve chaw, ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ ve chaw, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ sheˉ lai leh ha lehˬ tuˬ laiˉ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te kʼai ve chaw, shu hta‸ hkawehˉ leh naˬ tuˬ te ve chaw, shu ngaˬ hui hta‸ canˇ leh, ngaˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ canˇ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ jaw ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, yawˇ chaw yaˇ hta‸ ha‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ tawˆ la ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve kanˉ te ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha kʼaˉ ve hta‸ pa taw htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ suhˉ teˇ pawˆ paw la ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve tsuhˇ hkʼa laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, awˬ suhˉ kʼaw‸ gu te laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ paˍ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yawˇ cuˇ leh, oˇ ve nyiˇ ceuˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ hkʼa biˇ ngeuˍ pfuhˍ laˇ veyoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, co ti‸ ha ti‸ hta‸ dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui yawˇ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Tawˇ hkawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ yonˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve chaw hui lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ gʼaˇ hte‸ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, cuˇ yiˍ maˇ cawˬ ve jehˬ da‸ cehˇ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ caˉ peuˬ teˇ caˉ shawˍ nyi ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ lawn tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, jaw kʼai-o. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ leh, hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ moˍ pehˬ da‸ hpaˆ da‸ tuˬ te ve chaw hta‸ teˇ pawˆ nyiˇ pawˆ hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ taˇ kʼaw‸ te.
Chi hkʼe ve chaw lehˬ, nyi ma a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ hteˇ leh, venˇbaˆ te chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ shiˍ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ suhˉ taˆ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Aˍteˍmaˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Tuˇhkiˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ geh peu laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Niˇkawˇpaˍliˆ venˇ lo ngaˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ tuˬ coˇ caˇ leh laˬ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ kaˆ ve awˬ yanˇ htaˇ venˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ shiˍ pa Seˍnaˆ leh Aˍpawˇlu‸ hta‸ haˆ haˆ peu laˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ huiˉ maˬ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ te‸ chiˉ ka‸ maˇ gʼa loˍ tuˬ hkʼa deh‸ ga piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ te kʼai hpeh‸ tuˬ maˍ piˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe te ve kʼo, loˍ jaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ga piˇ hpeh‸ leh, awˬ shiˍ naw‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ geh chehˇ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ pon htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ leh, ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tiˆmoˉseˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te ve ha‸ ve Hpiˇleˍmonˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ,
awˬ nyi ma Aˍpiˆ leh ngaˬ huiˉ maˬ geh teˇ geh bon hpawˇ ma‸ yaˇ te ve Aˍhkiˇpuˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo hpawnˬ da‸ ve Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, li‸ chi bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ yonˍ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ha‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ gʼa kaˇ ve pa taw,
nawˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ bon lawˬ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ngaˬ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ bon lawˬ ve lehˬ, shu geh teˇ geh nawˬ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui cawˬ taˍ ve da‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ nawˬ shiˍ maˇ la tuˬ awˬ pon ngaˬ lawˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ nyi paˍ-oˬ, nawˬ ve ha‸ pehnˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ ha lehˬ dawˇ sha jaˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hta‸ pa taw Hkri‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve nyi ma awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, nawˬ te keunˍ te cawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ awˬ pon nawˬ hta‸ tawˇ piˇ tuˬ, Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ha‸ hanˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve htawˇ, ngaˬ oˇ hkʼe maˇ te.
Chaw mawˇ hpeh‸ leh, chi beu‸ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ awˬ pon htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ taˍ ve ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, ha‸ pehnˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, co ha hpawˇ ngaˬ paw la piˇ taˍ ve, ngaˬ ve yaˇ Awˍneˍsiˍmuˆ awˬ pon ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
(Yawˇ lehˬ, ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ awˬ pon awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve htawˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ bon cawˬ tehˬ ve yoˬ.)
Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ peu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ chi hkʼe peuˬ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, ngaˬ ve nyi ma shiˍ hta‸ nawˬ geh peu laˇ ve hkʼe yoˬ.
Ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ htawnˍ hkʼaw gʼa chehˇ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ nawˬ ve awˬ tan te leh ngaˬ awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ geh chehˇ tcuh gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ bon te laˇ ve lehˬ, gʼa te ve pa taw te ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ leh, te gaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo te ve teˇ ceuˬ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, nawˬ geh a hkaw-anˬ maˇ gʼa ve ceh ceh, ngaˬ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ te gaˇ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yawˇ nawˬ geh hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chehˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ yanˇ gʼa hpaˆ da‸ ve yoˬ hehˉ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi teˇ pawˆ nawˬ geh kʼaw‸ chehˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ ceˬ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hkʼe chehˇ piˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ htawˇ chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ nawˬ shawˍ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ-o‸.
Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, jeˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ cawˬ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ ve jeˬ hkʼe shawˍ taˍ-o‸.
Ngaˬ Pawˇlu‸ lehˬ, jeˬ oˇ ve hta‸ shaiˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ awˬ to bvuh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ awˬ to nawˬ ve co ha ngaˬ hta‸ shaiˍ laˇ cawˇ ve awˬ lawn ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ.
Awˬ nyi paˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ nawˬ geh awˬ bon teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hkri‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ ngaˬ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ yonˍ ve pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve a‸ kehˉ ka‸ nawˬ te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ awˬ pon chehˇ kuiˬ a ciˉ gu taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui bon lawˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh teˇ pawˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ geh teˇ geh htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ taˍ ve Eˇpaˍhpaˍraˆ lehˬ, nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ geh teˇ geh kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ Maˍkuˆ, Aˍriˍtaˍhkuˆ, Deˍmaˆ leh Luˉka‸ hui htawˇ, nawˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ nawˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ laiˉ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo laiˉ pawˆ tawˇ yaw piˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ peuˬ. Awˬ shinˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, Yaˇ hpu oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, sha hpa‸ laˬ hpa‸ htaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ hpu lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ hta‸ ba tawˆ la leh, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, yawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Kanˇ paˆ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, hkʼa cawˬ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ leh ga piˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chaw yaˇ ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ tsuhˇ baˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, mvuh kuiˬ lo chehˇ ve kanˇ paˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo yawˇ mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui da‸ ve awˬ meh cawˬ ve a‸ kehˉ yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve awˬ meh lehˬ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, yawˇ lehˬ yawˇ hui a‸ kehˉ uiˍ leuˉ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Yaˇ hpu yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ ve Awˬ pa hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ jaw le. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, Ngaˬ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ pa hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ ngaˬ ve yaˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ jaw le.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, yaˇ uiˍ hta‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ peu laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui loˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ ve tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tcuh leh, yawˇ ve awˬ ceˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ ha hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ tcuh ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yaˇ hpu ve awˬ lawn chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ ve kʼaw jaw co co taiˍ taiˍ yeˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ nawˬ uˉ peunˍ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ ha‸ leh, aˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve hta‸ canˇ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw nawˬ ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, nawˬ ve awˬ chawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve a‸ kehˉ, lehˬ ve naˍ manˇ nawˬ hta‸ yawˇ pfuhˍ laˇ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ nawˬ miˬguiˬ hta‸ te hpanˍ taˍ leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ htawˇ nawˬ ve la‸ sheh te hpanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ luˬ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ veu‸ kʼaˇ hkʼe piˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Aˉ po‸ lonˉ hta‸ lo‸ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ lo‸ leh kʼaw‸ pa piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ leh, nawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw‸ htawˇ maˇ peuˬ maˇ leh, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, Nawˬ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ve hkui sheh awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ taˍ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ ve la‸ sha paˉ lo mui chehˇ-oˆ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ jaw le.
Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa caˇ tuˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon kanˉ te tuˬ, tcuh taˍ ve awˬ ha teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui gʼa kaˇ taˍ peuˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa jiˆ tawˆ-e tuˬ, tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ leuˉ leh hkʼa deh‸ na yuˬ-o‸.

Mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ tcuh ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ cawˇ ve pa taw, tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te ya‸ leh maˇ na yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ keunˍ da‸ ve hkʼe yawˇ ciˍ yanˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, uiˍ jaˇ ve htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve chi hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼaˬ hkʼe te ponˬ hpeh‸ tuˬ le. Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve awˬ lawn chi awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼoˆ taˍ leh, gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, Awˬ lawn chi awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, ngaˬ hui hta‸ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, awˬ heˆ leh anˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˇ paˆ uiˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hkʼe da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ pehˬ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hui geh teˇ geh shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ chehˇ ve, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ la tuˬ ve miˬ guiˬ chi hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui awˬ hawˉ lo yawˇ teh taˍ ve maˇ heˆ.

Li‸ hpu teˇ kaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ chi hkʼe shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ dawˇ nyi tuˬ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le. Nawˬ chaw yaˇ ve yaˇ hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ tuˬ, chaw yaˇ ve yaˇ lehˬ aˬ hto‸ ma hpeh‸ ve le.
Nawˬ yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo a ciˉ ceh tiˉ nehˬ piˇ leh, da‸ ve awˬ meh leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ, shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼe nawˬ yawˇ ve oˉ kʼoˍ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ ve hkui taw kʼaw awˬ hawˉ lo nawˬ teh taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ teh taˍ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo maˇ teh taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ hawˉ lo awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ teh taˍ ve hta‸ chi beu‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ gʼa mawˬ sheˍ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hawˉ lo a ciˉ ceh tiˉ nehˬ piˇ leh, suh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve pa taw, da‸ ve awˬ meh leh awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ, shi uˉ tcuhˍ hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ hkʼawˆ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ pon suh ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ kuiˬ lo shiˍ kʼai ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ leh sheh kʼai piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ yawˇ te piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hta‸ pa taw awˬ ceuˬ chi hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ leh, yawˇ da‸ piˇ kehˍ piˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hui hta‸ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yawˇ maˇ ya‸ taw.
Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ ve awˬ meh ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ awˬ kʼaw ji lo ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ gʼaˇ va tuˬ yoˬ. Peuˬ leh teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ, ngaˬ leh Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ pe‸ laˇ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ pfuhˇ ve pa taw, yawˇ htawˇ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ pfuhˇ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, yawˇ suh ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve neˇhaiˬ hta‸ te luˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ,
suh ve hta‸ kawˆ ve pa taw, te‸ chehˇ ve teˇ co-e awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ ceˬ gʼa te chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ pfuhˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ laˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na kʼoˆ kʼo, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ ga piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon laˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ leh ka ti‸ yeˬ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ leh, chaw yaˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa tuˬ awˬ pon yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ gʼa hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve leh beˬ ve lawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ jaw peuˬ ve pa taw, beˬ ve lawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ga piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo kuˬ yuˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ngaˬ hui geh hkʼa geh gʼa ve, da‸ ve kehˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui yonˍ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tcuh yaˇ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ yeˬ leh na yuˬ puiˉ ve hkʼe, Yeˍsuˆ htawˇ yawˇ hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yehˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yehˬ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve hkʼe, Yeˍsuˆ htawˇ Moˉseˍ a‸ kehˉ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ keunˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yehˬ teˇ yehˬ le le lehˬ, te shehˍ hpaˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ te shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ lehˬ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ hkʼa kʼoˆ maˍ tuˬ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ tuˬ awˬ pon, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw, awˬ ceˬ ve kanˉ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ ka ti‸ yeˬ leh na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
