Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Hkri‸ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ yaˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ka ti‸ yeˬ leh na yuˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui htawˇ, nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, dawˇ law ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha lehˬ leh nyi ma uiˍ tuˬ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui lehˬ yehˬ oˇ ve teˇ yehˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Ya‸ nyi yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo,
heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi leh nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma taˇ heh piˇ.
Oˇ kaˬ lo nawˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi hui ngaˬ hta‸ lawˇ nyi canˇ nyi leh, awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ ngaˬ te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve yo.

Hkʼe te leh, chaw oˇ ve teˇ co hta‸ ngaˬ nyi ma zuhˆ leh kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ ya‸ kʼai chehˇ leh, ngaˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ teh‸ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Yawˇ hui lehˬ ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e teh‸, nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkanˍ taˍ peuˬ, teh‸ da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve leh maˇ yonˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ te-o. Chi hkʼe ve nyi ma lehˬ, nawˬ hui leh te‸ chehˇ ve, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ piˇ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ nyi ma maˇ gʼa heh kʼai tuˬ, ya‸ nyi teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ nyi le le nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸-o‸.
Awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ htaˇ ka‸ ngaˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ ve hkʼe, awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ nyi ma hkʼa deh‸ yeˬ taˍ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui Hkri‸ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, Ya‸ nyi yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te laˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ nyi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma taˇ heh piˇ.
Gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve htawˇ nyi ma zuhˆ tuˬ te ve chaw hui lehˬ, a shu le. Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo Moˉseˍ sheh tawˆ la ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ yoˬ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Awˇ chi hkʼaw‸ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ a shu hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve le. Venˇbaˆ te leh, heh puiˉ hkʼaw lo paˍ suh-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e teh‸, a shu hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ ve le. Maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ hui maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw maˇ gʼa lo‸-e ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, yawˇ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ cawˬ sheˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ maˇ gʼa lo‸-e puiˉ-aˆ teh‸ nyiˬ hui teˇ geh dawˇ hkiˉ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ gʼa kaˇ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui htawˇ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui gʼa kaˇ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ yonˍ ve pa taw, yawˇ hui awˬ pon awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ.

Ngaˬ hui yonˍ peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e teh‸ nyi ma zuhˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hkanˍ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ te hpanˍ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ te taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ kanˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ leh, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼaˇ jehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, suhˍ nyi teˇ nyi awˬ lawn Li‸ hpu teˇ kaˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo, Yawˇ hui lehˬ, ngaˬ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ gʼa lo‸-e, teh‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ ka‸ ha lehˬ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ peuˬ ve chaw hui maˇ na yuˬ ve pa taw yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa lo‸-e ve htawˇ, gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ cawˬ ve pa taw,

Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ awˬ nyi teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ tinˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ yanˇ maw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Daˍviˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ya‸ sheh bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Ya‸ nyi yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui nyi ma taˇ heh, teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ tinˍ taˍ ve awˬ nyi oˇ ve lehˬ ya‸ nyi yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Yawˇsuˆ lehˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e piˇ lawˬ peuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ nyi hta‸ Gʼuiˬ sha kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hkʼe te leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon gʼaˇ jehˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ kanˉ te peuˬ leh gʼaˇ jehˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ ve gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te peuˬ leh gʼaˇ gʼa jehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, gʼaˇ jehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa lo‸-e tuˬ, ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ hte‸ te-a veuˬ. Hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, shu maˇ na yuˬ leh paiˍ ve hkʼe, ngaˬ hui htawˇ teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ paiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ leh kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ viˇ nyiˇ hpawˇ cawˬ ve aˉ htaw hkʼa peu-eˬ a‸ kehˉ tcuhˆ leh, nyi ma leh co ha hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ mu‸ ku awˬ tcuhˉ leh awˬ caw paw hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, juˆ pawnˍ leh pehˬ da‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ leh heuˆ gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ, fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ puiˉ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼa hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ faˉ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ. Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ kʼu nyi hpeh‸ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ mawˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui uiˍ jaˇ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui yonˍ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ-a veuˬ, Paw hkuˇ lonˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ hkʼa gaˬ lo‸-e peuˬ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu Yeˍsuˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ beˬ ve lawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ venˇbaˆ maˇ te.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸, loˍ ve awˬ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ga laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ bon hta‸ ka‸ gʼa tuˬ, nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bon uiˍ ve kʼaw jaw awˬ paˇ lo ngaˬ hui jiˆ kʼai-a veuˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo leuˆ yuˬ taˍ ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ te tuˬ, chaw yaˇ hui awˬ tan leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, venˇ baˆ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon la‸ shawnˍ leh tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui awˬ to htawˇ gʼaˇ nuˇ puiˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, maˇ shiˍ ve chaw leh ya‸ kʼai ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ hui ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui gʼaˇ nuˇ puiˉ ve pa taw, chaw yaˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve hkʼe, a shu yawˇ ve venˇ baˆ awˬ pon htawˇ yawˇ hui gʼa tanˇ piˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ a shu yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ aˉ yaˇ chi hta‸ yuˬ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Aˍronˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kuˬ yuˬ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui hta‸ htawˇ Gʼuiˬsha gʼa kuˬ yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Hkri‸ lehˬ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ taˍ uiˍ leh paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ ca te yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ ngaˬ ve Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ nyi ngaˬ nawˬ ve Awˬ pa hpeh‸ la peuˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu teˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve, Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ veawˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, suh kuiˬ lo yawˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ laˇ puiˉ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ leh mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon lawˬ leh lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yawˆ yan puiˉ, na yuˬ puiˉ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, Yaˇ hpu hpeh‸ ve htawˇ tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ na yuˬ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ shiˍ la ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ biˇ la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa na yuˬ ve chaw hui awˬ pon yawˇ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ paw hkuˇ lonˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn chi ngaˬ kʼoˆ tuˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui haˆ haˆ na maˇ gʼa puiˉ ve pa taw, tcuhˉ kuiˬ kʼaoˍ maˍ laˇ tuˬ haˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ chi maw maw gaˬ peuˬ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi ve kʼo, nawˬ hui lehˬ shu hta‸ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ cawˇ ve htawˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ awˬ lawn lonˉ ma teˇ hpaˍ, shu nawˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ loˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ. Heh ve caˇ tuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui caˇ maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, cuˉ gʼuiˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˬ cawˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, cuˉ gʼuiˬ hta‸ dawˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, yaˇ ehˉ hpeh‸ chehˇ sheˍ ve pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ shiˍ puiˉ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, heh ve caˇ tuˬ lehˬ, chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ mawˬ ve kaˇ ve jawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ puiˉ la tuˬ laiˉ pawˆ te jawˬ ve pa taw, da‸ ve leh maˇ da‸ ve hta‸ fuiˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkri‸ ve awˬ lawn awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ teh taˉ leh, uiˍ la biˇ la tuˬ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai-a veuˬ. Suh taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ,

baˆtiˆsaˬ awˬ lawn maˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, la‸ sheh taˍ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, suh ve chaw hui kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼo, co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ pon suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ ceh tiˉ taˇ kʼaw‸ kawˍ chehˇ-oˆ.
Gʼuiˬsha a hkaw-anˬ pe‸ laˇ ve kʼo, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ hui teh taˉ leh awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ ve, mvuhˇ naw ma ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ gʼa leh‸ nyi peuˬ ve leh, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ gʼa peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ,
Gʼuiˬsha ve da‸ jaˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ tuˬ ve teˇ co ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼa leh‸ nyi peuˬ ve htawˇ,

yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ luˬ kʼaw‸ kuiˇ kʼai ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ hta‸ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˇ tuˬ te maˇ hpeh‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui ka‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo kʼaw‸ hta‸ pehˍ leh, yawˇ hta‸ shu mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ ya‸ taw tuˬ te piˇ ve yoˬ.

Miˬguiˬ lehˬ, laiˉ pawˆ laˬ ve mvuhˇ yeˬ gʼuiˬ hta‸ gʼa chaw‸ leh, muiˬ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon awˬ bon cawˬ ve gʼawˇ hpa‸ mvuhˬ naweh leh awˬ shiˍ awˬ nu hta‸ cawˬ la piˇ lawˬ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha na‸ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, miˬguiˬ oˇ ve aˉ chuˇ leh mvuh‸ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ yeˬ la ve kʼo, awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, baˬ taˍ leh hkeu ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ gaˬ kʼo, aˬ miˬ tuˉ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve htawˇ, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ jaˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ, htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ nawˬ hui te taˍ ve kanˉ leh, Hkri‸ yaˇ hui hta‸ ga piˇ taˍ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ, chi beu‸ ka‸ nawˬ hui chi hkʼe te chehˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha‸ pehnˇ ve chi Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon nawˬ hui hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ leunˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Dawˇ law taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ biˇ la tuˬ ve awˬ pon, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ le le awˬ leh meuˇ hkʼa gaˬ chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ gʼaˇ hte‸ te tuˬ ve hta‸ ngaˬ heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, a yehˉ yehˉ taˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ ve leh yeunˇ hkanˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, nawˬ hui htawˇ te-o.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ ka ti‸ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hkʼaˇ yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkanˍ taˍ ve lehˬ, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na bon na‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na maˇ la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ leh hkanˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbraˍhanˍ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law taˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼe yawˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ awˬ to a‸ kehˉ uiˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh hkanˍ ve awˬ liˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te peuˬ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha htawˇ, yawˇ dawˇ cheˆ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ pa puiˉ ve awˬ lawn, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ gʼa taˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ leuˉ leh hkʼa deh‸ maˍ piˇ gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ to hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ te ve yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ, chi nyiˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw ngaˬ hui ponˬ kuiˬ lo hpaw lo‸ la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cawˬ taˍ ve dawˇ law taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ tuˬ, ngaˬ hui hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Maˇ pa puiˉ ve chi nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ heˍ maˇ hpeh‸.
Dawˇ law ve chi lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma awˬ pon yeˬ leh maˇ jiˆ kʼai puiˉ ve sho kʼuˉ kʼaweh‸ hkʼe hpeh‸ leh, hpaˬ kaˍ nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ paw hkuˇ lonˉ hpeh‸ la leh, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ lo‸-e taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ chi teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Saˍlehnˍ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hpeh‸ leh, mvuh jaˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Aˍbraˍhanˍ bawˆ pehˍ taˉ leh kʼaw‸ la chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍ dehˆ yawˇ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ leh bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ htawˇ, yawˇ hkʼa gʼa taˍ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ chi pun teˇ pun yawˇ hta‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve awˬ meh chi lehˬ, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Saˍlehnˍ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Tcuhˉ kuiˬ kʼo, dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve teˇ ceuˬ ve hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ hpeh‸ ve teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ pa awˬ e maˇ cawˬ, awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ leh, yawˇ ve a sha‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ awˬ leh meuˇ maˇ cawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma uiˍ jaˇ ve hta‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, bawˆ da‸ kuiˬ lo gʼa veu laˇ ve mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ hta‸ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun piˇ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ te tuˬ aˉ yaˇ gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ chi pun teˇ pun shaw yuˬ tuˬ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui geh gʼa shaw yuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ maˇ heˆ htawˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ geh yawˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun gʼa leh, ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ yawˇ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Uiˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, i ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn chi ve hta‸ tawˇ gʼawˬ da‸ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Suh puiˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, chi beu‸ teˇ yanˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ. Te‸ chehˇ ve teh‸ yawˇ awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, oˇ ve teˇ yanˇ teˇ chi pun teˇ pun hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve yoˬ.
Shu geh teˇ chi pun teˇ pun ha‸ yuˬ ve Leˍviˆ teˇ gʼa htawˇ, Aˍbraˍhanˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ chi pun teˇ pun piˇ taˍ peuˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ lehˬ Aˍbraˍhanˍ hta‸ hpuˇ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ, Leˍviˆ lehˬ yawˇ ve awˬ puˍ lonˉ Aˍbraˍhanˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo chehˇ taˍ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Leˍviˆ chaw hui paw hkuˇ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍraˍlaˆ chaw hui lehˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Oˇ htaˇ, Leˍviˆ chaw hui paw hkuˇ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw yaˇ hui biˇ la gʼa ve hkʼe kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma te awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la tuˬ loˍ sheˍ ve le. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, paw hkuˇ oˇ ve lehˬ, Aˍronˍ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ heˆ. Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw hkuˇ te ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ pa ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ htawˇ gʼa pa ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi teˇ hpaˍ Li‸ hpu hkʼaw kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ tanˇ kuiˬ lo kanˉ maˇ te jaw.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, Yuˇda‸ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ oˇ ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ paw hkuˇ gʼa te tuˬ ve awˬ lawn Moˉseˍ te‸ chiˉ maˇ kʼoˆ taˍ.
Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tawˆ la peuˬ ve pa taw, paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ kʼaw‸ pa peuˬ ve hta‸ leuˉ leh hkʼa deh‸ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la ve lehˬ, awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ yawˇ paw hkuˇ awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˇ ve pa taw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˇ luˬ maˇ suh puiˉ ve a sha‸ te‸ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ awˬ lawn chi hkʼe shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ Maˍlaˍhkiˆsaˍdehˆ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, co co taiˍ taiˍ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ htaˇ piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ leh te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve pa taw, tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha teh taˉ ve yoˬ.

(Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ka‸ biˇ la piˇ maˇ gʼa.) Hkʼe te leh, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ leuˉ ve dawˇ law tuˬ cawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼaw‸ pe‸ laˇ ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law tuˬ chi hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui lehˬ Gʼuiˬsha geh lo jiˆ kʼai hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, hkanˍ taˍ ve maˇ cawˬ ka‸, paw hkuˇ te tuˬ aˉ yaˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ aˉ yaˇ gʼa ve lehˬ, hkanˍ taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ leh gʼa ve yoˬ. Hkanˍ taˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hkanˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ leh hkanˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, da‸ leuˉ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ chi hta‸ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, paw hkuˇ maˇ maˇ gʼa cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ kanˉ te maˇ hpeh‸.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve pa taw, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yawˇ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh Gʼuiˬsha geh jiˆ laˬ ve chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ pon lawˬ hkawˉ tuˬ, yawˇ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ te‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lehˬ, chi hkʼe ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ hta‸ loˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, da‸ ve kehˬ ve, ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve, cha‸ chiˆ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ ve, venˇ baˆ yaˇ hui hta‸ hpaˆ da‸ taˍ ve leh, mvuhˇ naw ma mvuh ve a‸ kehˉ Gʼuiˬ sha yawˇ hta‸ chiˇ taˆ piˇ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ lehˬ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu paw hkuˇ lonˉ hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, awˉ lawˉ htaˇ a shu yawˇ ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ chaw yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ve venˇ baˆ awˬ pon, teˇ nyi le le tanˇ tuˬ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.

Chaw yaˇ hui lehˬ, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ puiˉ ve htawˇ, paw hkuˇ lonˉ te tuˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ laˬ ve hkanˍ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ biˇ jaˇ ve Yaˇ hpu teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ aˉ yaˇ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve awˬ lawn uiˍ ve lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Chi hkʼe ve paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo chehˇ ve Kanˇ paˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ ve kʼaw jaw la‸ sha paˇ lo mui taˍ leh,

awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ lo, kanˉ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, chaw yaˇ te ve maˇ heˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha te taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ le le lehˬ, la‸ shawnˍ leh tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yawˇ hui hta‸ leuˆ teh taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, paw hkuˇ lonˉ chi teˇ gʼaˇ htawˇ, tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ yawˇ gʼa cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ lehˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ taˍ ve hkʼe kʼo, yawˇ paw hkuˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh te leh, la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hui cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ bon yehˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han leh aˉ gʼuiˬ ha ceh hpeh‸ ve bon yehˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Moˉseˍ lehˬ aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te-a teh‸ te ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ chi hkʼe maˍ piˇ ve, Hkʼaw pui hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hta‸ maw laˇ peuˬ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ te tuˬ shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi beu‸ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, da‸ leuˉ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ pon awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼe, yawˇ gʼa taˍ ve kanˉ htawˇ da‸ leuˉ ve yoˬ. Aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ oˇ ve da‸ leuˉ ve le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, da‸ leuˉ ve ka ti‸ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼoˆ teh taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teˇ maˬ biˇ ve hkʼe kʼo, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ maˇ loˍ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ venˇbaˆ taˍ leh kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teˇ yehˬ leh Yuˇda‸ teˇ yehˬ hta‸ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ ngaˬ teh taˍ piˇ tuˬ ve awˬ nyi gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hui ve awˬ puˍ awˬ pi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ la‸ sheh gʼawˬ leh Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo sheh tawˆ la ve teˇ nyi htaˇ, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hkʼe maˇ heˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh yawˇ hui maˇ kʼaw‸ te. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ hui hta‸ teh taˉ ve yoˬ teh‸, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ teˇ yehˬ hta‸ ngaˬ te piˇ tuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo keu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ bvuh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ leh, yawˇ hui htawˇ ngaˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ shiˍ-o‸ teh‸, mvuhˇmiˬ yaˇ chawˇ chawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi maˇ kʼoˆ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ maˍ piˇ da‸ tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo i jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ te leh uiˍ jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ ngaˬ hta‸ shiˍ tuˬ yoˬ.
Ngaˬ yawˇ hui ve ya‸ kuiˬ jiˆ kuiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha kʼaˉ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ, teh‸ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˉ lawˉ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ hta‸ awˬ piˍ hpeh‸ la piˇ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Maw jaˇ leh piˍ kʼai peuˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ lehˬ, mehˉ kʼai paˇ neˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ leh, miˬguiˬ hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve da‸ kehˬ ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ hta‸ te taˍ leh, awˉ lawˉ teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo kawˆ faiˇ taˍ kuiˬ, hpui lawˇ leh, tanˇ taˍ ve hkaoˍmonˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Chehˇ kuiˬ oˇ ve teˇ tawn hta‸ da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hpaˬ kaˍ nyiˇ maˬ teˇ maˬ awˬ hkʼaw hpawˇ lo, da‸ kehˬ jaˇ ve chehˇ kuiˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ tawn cawˬ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo shi oˍ taˍ ve sha tuˉ tanˇ kuiˬ leh, shi hkʼa caw zuhˇ oˍ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ta kʼoˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ. Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, maˍnaˆ shiˍ keu taˍ ve shi mu‸ hkʼu, awˬ tuˍ tuˍ ve Aˍronˍ ve juˇ fuiˍ leh, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ liˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve haˉ pui baˉ teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ta kʼoˍ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve hkeˍruˆbenˍ nyiˇ maˬ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hoˆ hta‸ beh taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ chi beu‸ kʼoˆ maˇ tanˇ sheˍ.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chi hkʼe te peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, paw hkuˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve kanˉ hta‸ te tuˬ, aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ lo‸-e chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nyiˇ tawn teˇ tawn awˬ hkʼaw lo paw hkuˇ lonˉ teˇ gʼaˇ ceh tiˉ lo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ awˬ to awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw yaˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ awˬ pon maˇ kʼoˆ, tanˇ piˇ tuˬ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh, teˇ hkʼaw‸ teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ gʼa lo‸-e ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ tawn cawˬ chehˇ sheˍ ve ceh ceh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e tuˬ ve ya‸ kʼaw maˇ pawnˍ sheˍ teh‸, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn chi lehˬ, chi teˇ co-e awˬ pon tawˇ pa haˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo la‸ shawnˍ leh tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ tanˇ piˇ chehˇ ve htawˇ, la‸ shawnˍ leh tanˇ tuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui la ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Awˬ ceuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, caˇ tuˬ dawˬ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, tsuhˇ baˬ ve laiˉ ceuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ to hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ leh kʼaw‸ gu hteˇ ve awˬ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ ceh tiˉ teh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Pawˇ hkuˇ lonˉ te leh da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ te laˇ tuˬ awˬ pon Hkri‸ gaˬ la htaˇ, leuˉ leh uiˍ jaˇ biˇ jaˇ ve aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ hpanˍ kʼai leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ kʼaw‸ lo‸-e tuˬ maˇ loˍ. Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, la‸ sheh te taˍ ve maˇ heˆ, miˬguiˬ chi hta‸ caˉ da‸ ve ka‸ maˇ heˆ.

Da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ lo‸-e ve teˇ yanˇ, aˉ che‸ leh nuˇ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ lo‸-e ve maˇ heˆ. Yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ yuˬ lo‸-e ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui co co taiˍ taiˍ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ te ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, aˉ che‸ leh nuˇ paˍ ve awˬ suhˍ ka‸, nuˇ ma haˉ hta‸ tuˉ tanˇ ve hkʼaw‸ laˉ ka‸, awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ hpawˇ maˇ da‸ maˇ kehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ tuˬ te gʼa ve kʼo,

Hkri‸ ve awˬ suhˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo suh taˍ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ piˇ leh, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha awˬ pon kanˉ te hpeh‸ tuˬ, chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hkʼaˬ ma te gʼa tuˬ le. Yawˇ lehˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ te‸ chehˇ ve Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ cuˇ leh, awˬ kuiˉ awˬ haiˇ a ciˉ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ ve awˬ to Gʼuiˬ sha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ hawˉ lo te ya‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ponˬ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, Yeˍsuˆ hkanˍ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, kuˬ yuˬ taˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve co co taiˍ taiˍ ve awˬ shinˉ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ awˬ pon awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ shinˉ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon li‸ bvuh‸ teh taˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ cawˬ ve kʼo, awˬ shinˉ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na suh peuˬ ve hta‸ awˉ lawˉ gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ shinˉ piˇ tuˬ awˬ pon li‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ suh peuˬ htaˇ heh‸ awˬ shinˉ pehˬ piˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬ shehˍ hpaˇ te‸ chehˇ ve ceh ceh, bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe awˬ shinˉ pehˬ piˇ maˇ hpeh‸ sheˍ.
Awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ teˇ maˬ ka‸, awˬ suhˍ maˇ yehˇ leh tanˬ te laˬ ve maˇ heˆ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo piˇ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ le le Moˉseˍ chaw chi ma ve hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, nuˇ ehˉ awˬ suhˍ leh aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ hta‸ iˉ kaˆ hkaw‸ da‸ leh, nyiˉ-ehˍ ve yawˬ mvuh leh huˇsoˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve mvuh‸ teˇ tsuh‸ hta‸ yehˇ leh, li‸ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Awˬ suhˍ chi lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ leh oˇ kaˬ lo yehˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ htawˇ, oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh hpeh‸ pfuhˍ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, aˬ laˬ hkʼe awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ awˬ suhˍ yuˬ leh tsuhˇ baˬ ve yoˬ. Awˬ suhˍ sheˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ kʼo, venˇbaˆ hpehˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ tuˬ, chi hkʼe ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa te ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ tuˬ, leuˉ leh da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa yehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Hkri‸ lehˬ chaw yaˇ la‸ sheh te taˍ ve da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na ve chehˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han ceh hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ yawˇ chehˇ taˍ tuˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo yawˇ lo‸-e taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ maˇ heˆ ve hta‸ yuˬ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ hkʼaw‸ le le lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Hkri‸ lehˬ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ yawˇ awˬ to laiˉ pawˆ gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve maˇ heˆ.

Oˇ hkʼe gʼa tanˇ piˇ ve kʼo, miˬguiˬ te hpanˍ htaˇ ka‸ tanˬ leh, yawˇ laiˉ pawˆ gʼa hkanˍ suh tuˬ yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo venˇbaˆ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ, awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ yanˇ chi awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ tawˆ la ve yoˬ.
Chaw yaˇ hui lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ suh leh, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ Hkri‸ lehˬ, chaw maˇ maˇ ve venˇbaˆ hta‸ hkanˍ pfuhˇ tuˬ, teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ yawˇ awˬ to tanˇ piˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ nyiˇ pawˆ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la htaˇ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ maˇ caˉ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ya‸ la leh, yawˇ hta‸ dawˇ law chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ lehˬ, gaˬ la tuˬ ve da‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ ve aˉ gʼuiˬ ha ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ tanˇ tuˬ hta‸ ceh tiˉ tanˇ piˇ ve lehˬ, awˬ paˇ lo jiˆ kʼai ve chaw hui hta‸ biˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Yawˇ hui biˇ la ve hkʼe kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ yawˇ hui tanˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ tanˇ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Oˉ kʼoˍ pui la ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, teˇ pawˆ da‸ peuˬ kehˬ peuˬ ve hkʼe kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve teh‸, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma hkʼaw maˇ kʼaw‸ dawˇ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, teˇ hkʼaw‸ peuˬ teˇ hkʼaw‸ venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ la ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nuˇ paˍ awˬ suhˍ leh aˉ che‸ awˬ suhˍ lehˬ, venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ maˇ hpeh‸ taˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Hkri‸ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo ya‸ la htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Gʼuiˬsha-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ tanˇ tuˬ leh la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve maˇ heˆ. Nawˬ ngaˬ awˬ pon awˬ to gu taˍ peuˬ.
Aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh, venˇbaˆ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ ha lehˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Oˇ htaˇ ngaˬ kʼoˆ ve, Nyi loˬ, lo‸ taˍ ve li‸ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ awˬ lawn bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Awˉ lawˉ htaˇ yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Tanˇ tuˬ leh la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, aˬ miˍ tuˉ tanˇ ve tanˇ tuˬ leh venˇbaˆ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ maˇ heuˆ gaˇ leh maˇ ha lehˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ. (Tanˇ tuˬ chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.)
Nyi loˬ, nawˬ ve a loˍ hta‸ te tuˬ ngaˬ laˬ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ yeˬ piˇ lawˬ tuˬ, awˉ lawˉ peuˇ ve teˇ maˬ hta‸ yawˇ baˬ taˉ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ yawˇ ve awˬ to teˇ pawˆ ceh tiˉ tanˇ piˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui da‸ la kehˬ la peuˬ.
Paw hkuˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, teˇ nyi le le tanˇ kuiˬ lo huˉ taˍ leh, venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ maˇ gʼa ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tanˇ piˇ tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ venˇbaˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa tuˬ, co co taiˍ taiˍ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ maˬ tiˉ ve hta‸ tanˇ piˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sha paˉ lo mui taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ oˇ kaˬ lo mui taˍ ve lehˬ, yawˇ ve canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ve hkui taw kʼaw hawˉ lo, Gʼuiˬsha taˍ piˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ law chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, tanˇ tuˬ teˇ maˬ tiˉ ve hta‸ tanˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ la kehˬ la peuˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ co co taiˍ taiˍ biˇ la piˇ peuˬ.
Da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu htawˇ ngaˬ hui hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo yawˇ kʼoˆ ve,

Awˬ yanˇ oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yawˇ hui hta‸ te tuˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Ngaˬ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ hui ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo keu piˇ leh, yawˇ hui ve nyi ma dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ ngaˬ bvuh‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Peuˬ leh, Yawˇ hui ve venˇbaˆ teˇ hpaˍ leh haiˬ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ kʼaw‸ dawˇ nawˇ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ teh‸, da‸ ve kehˬ ve Awˬ ha hpu kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, venˇbaˆ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼaw‸ loˍ.
Hkʼe te leh, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ te leh lo‸-e hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui lo‸-e ve lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon hpaˬ kaˍ hta‸ yehˬ baˬ taˍ leh, co ha te‸ ve ya‸ kʼaw awˬ suhˉ teˇ caˆ yawˇ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon te pawnˍ taˍ laˇ ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui cuˇ leh lo‸-e ve yoˬ. Hpaˬ kaˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ to hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve yehˬ teˇ yehˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ uiˍ jaˇ ve paw hkuˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ngaˬ hui cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ taˍ ve haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ mehˉ kʼai htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, ngaˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ laˇ leh da‸ kehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to hta‸ tsuhˇ baˬ laˇ peuˬ ve pa taw, ngaˬ hui hkʼa biˇ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ tehˬ awˬ na nyi ma awˬ tawˬ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ geh jiˆ lo‸-e veuˬ.
Ngaˬ hui hkanˍ yuˬ taˍ ve dawˇ law ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hiˆ hiˆ naˇ naˇ maˇ te leh, yeˬ chaweh vawˆ taˍ-a veuˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ka ti‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve yoˬ.
Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ ha‸ pehnˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, da‸ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te tuˬ, shu hta‸ dawˇ nyi leh awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ-a veuˬ.

Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ teˇ geh hpawnˬ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ peuˬ. Nawˬ hui oˇ hkʼe taˇ te. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ nyi oˇ ve teˇ nyi gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve pa taw, leuˉ leh awˬ gʼaˇ piˇ da‸ chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ leh ha‸ yuˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, a shu yawˇ ve a loˍ awˬ hkʼaˇ suh venˇbaˆ kʼaw‸ te ve kʼo, venˇbaˆ awˬ pon tanˇ tuˬ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve suhˉ jehˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, canˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi ma zuhˆ jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, law taˍ tuˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Moˉseˍ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ te ya‸ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ nyiˇ gʼaˇ maˇ heˆ kʼo shehˆ gʼaˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, shu yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ leh tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve Yaˇ hpu hta‸ naˆ tiˍ taˍ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ da‸ kehˬ piˇ lawˬ ve ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ ve teh‸ shawˍ leh, awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ Awˬ ha hpu hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh hkʼaˬ ma hehnˇ jaˇ ve ciˍ yanˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ keunˍ ve teh‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ ve le.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, Kʼaw‸ te hkʼaw‸ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, ngaˬ ve kanˉ yoˬ. Ngaˬ kʼaw‸ shaiˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve tawˇ teˇ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi hkʼe kʼoˆ shehˍ hpaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo ce lo‸-e tuˬ ve lehˬ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ laˬ ve awˬ nyi awˬ haˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Oˇ htaˇ, nawˬ hui awˬ gʼeuˆ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yeunˇ hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ hte‸ gʼa bawˆ da‸ ve yoˬ.

Shu mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, fawˉ mehˍ laˇ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, nawˬ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, oˇ hkʼe gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh teˇ geh nawˬ hui nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa hkanˍ jaw ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui ha kʼaˉ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, shu nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ hta‸ hiˉ yuˬ lu yuˬ ve htawˇ, nawˬ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh da‸ jaˇ ve, maˇ mehˉ puiˉ maˇ luˬ puiˉ ve mawˇ jeˬ nawˬ hui cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ baˬ taˉ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw la‸ shawnˍ uiˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te leh, yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma hta‸ nawˬ hui loˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, laˬ tuˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ maˇ law chehˇ leh maˇ maw maw gaˬ la tuˬ yoˬ.

Ngaˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw co ha gʼa te‸ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jiˆ kʼo‸-e ve kʼo, ngaˬ yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ maˇ heˆ, teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, ngaˬ hui lehˬ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ jiˆ kʼo‸-e leh luˬ kʼai sheˆ kʼai ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ. Ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui ve co ha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui dawˇ law taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na gʼa tuˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui maˇ mawˬ sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tehˬ awˬ na cawˬ taˍ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, ngaˬ hui hkʼa deh‸ deh‸ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Aˍ sho-eˬ htaˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ yonˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ pa taw sha hpa‸ laˬ hpa‸ htaˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui gʼa mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, maˇ mawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve hta‸ ka‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa shiˍ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbeˍlaˆ lehˬ, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Kaˍiˉnaˆ ve tanˇ tuˬ a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve tanˇ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ha‸ yuˬ ve pa taw, yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ awˬ lawn shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, Aˍbeˍlaˆ suh peuˬ htawˇ, yonˍ ve oˇ ve hta‸ pa taw yawˇ tawˇ yaw chehˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.

Eˇnawˆ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma lo yuˬ taˆ-e ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ yuˬ taˆ-e ve pa taw, shu yawˇ hta‸ ca maˇ mawˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ maˇ yuˬ taˆ-e sheˍ htaˇ, Yawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ nyi hkʼaˇ suh ve yoˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬ sha shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw yaˇ lehˬ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha geh jiˆ kʼai ve chaw lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha cawˬ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ hta‸ ca ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ bon piˇ ve hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ gʼa yonˍ ve yoˬ.

Noˉa‸ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, maˇ hpeh‸ la sheˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hto piˇ maˍ piˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˆ yan ve awˬ hkʼaw lo na yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve yehˬ yaˇ kʼa yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ gʼa ponˬ tuˬ, yawˇ haw lo‸ kʼoˍ te ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˇ miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ suhˉ taˆ leh, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ awˬ shinˉ gʼa tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lo kʼai tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, hkʼaˬ lo gʼa kʼai tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ shiˍ htawˇ na yuˬ leh kʼai ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ gʼa tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo, shu mvuhˇmiˬ hkʼaw ca chehˇ ve chaw hkʼe yawˇ hkehˉ chaw te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ geh teˇ geh mvuhˇmiˬ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa tuˬ ve Iˉcaˆ leh Yaˍkoˆ hui geh aˉ po kʼo teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ chehˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha kawˍ taˍ te taˍ ve, awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ yeˬ jaˇ ve venˇ hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ law chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Saˍraˇ htawˇ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, yaˇ hu ve awˬ yanˇ leh peuˬ ve htawˇ, yawˇ yaˇ hu gʼa ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ka ti‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, ka ti‸ yeˬ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, mawˇ jaˇ leh suh paˇ neˇ ve hawˉ hkʼaˆ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ maˇ maˇ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo cawˬ ve meu‸ keu shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ maˇ jaˇ leh, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ pfuhˍ paˇ lo cawˬ ve shehˇ shiˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ gʼaw maˇ gʼa htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chaw chi teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo suh ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hui hta‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa sheˍ htawˇ, awˬ ceuˬ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ vuiˇ kuiˬ lo yawˇ hui gʼa mawˬ leh ha lehˬ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo chehˇ htaˇ, shu mvuhˇ shu miˬ lo hkehˉ chaw hkʼe hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe kʼoˆ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yawˇ hui gʼa tuˬ ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ca chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, yawˇ hui hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui tawˆ la ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ hui kʼo‸-e tuˬ awˬ yanˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ hui dawˇ law taˍ ve mvuhˇmiˬ lehˬ, oˇ ve a‸ kehˉ da‸ ve mvuhˇ naw ma mvuhˇmiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, shu kʼoˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ ya‸ taw. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui chehˇ tuˬ awˬ pon venˇ hta‸ yawˇ gu taˍ peuˬ.
Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ yuˬ leh tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo nawˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaˇ cawˬ la tuˬ yoˬ teh‸, ka ti‸ gʼa taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ ve hta‸ tanˇ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ chaw yaˇ hta‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ puiˉ ve hta‸ yawˇ yonˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Tawˇ pa haˉ kʼoˆ ve kʼo, suh kuiˬ lo yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ hta‸ yawˇ kʼaw‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Iˉcaˆ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Yaˍkoˆ leh Iˉsawˇ hta‸ awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ gʼa tuˬ ve awˬ bon na‸ piˇ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Yaˍkoˆ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, suh la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yoˇseh‸ ve yaˇ paˍ nyiˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ bon na‸ piˇ leh, yawˇ ve juˇ fuiˍ awˬ meuˇ awˬ hkʼoˆ boˆ taˍ leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve yoˬ.

Yoˇseh‸ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ ve a sha‸ leh la paˇ neˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tawˆ kʼai tuˬ ve awˬ lawn hto piˇ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ mu‸ ku hta‸ hkʼaˬ hkʼe te tuˬ ve awˬ lawn yawˇ tawˇ piˇ taˉ ve yoˬ.

Moˉseˍ ve awˬ pa awˬ e lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Moˉseˍ paw la peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, ha pa sheh lehˇ hkʼa gaˬ yawˇ hta‸ faˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yaˇ paˍ oˇ ve lehˬ awˬ hkiˇ awˬ nganˇ da‸ jaˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ gʼa mawˬ leh, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ huiˉ maˬ maˇ kawˆ.
Moˉseˍ lehˬ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, yawˇ uiˍ la ve teˇ yanˇ htaˇ, Hpaˍrawˇ yaˇ miˇ ve awˬ yaˇ paˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ hkanˍ gaˇ.
Teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ yanˇ venˇbaˆ awˬ hkʼaw ha lehˬ chehˇ ve a‸ kehˉ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ yaˇ awˬ duˬ teˇ hpaˍ geh hkʼa geh gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ yawˇ leuˉ leh heuˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkri‸ awˬ pon gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo cawˬ ve da‸ jaˇ ve mawˇ jeˬ a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve teh‸, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ gʼa tuˬ ve la‸ shawnˍ hta‸ yawˇ chiˇ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve hta‸ yawˇ maˇ kawˆ leh, Eˇjiˇtu‸ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, mawˬ maˇ hpeh‸ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ mawˬ taˍ ve hkʼe te leh, yawˇ nyi ma yeˬ ve yoˬ.
Yaˇ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te luˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ gʼa htawˇ tuˬ, Moˉseˍ yawˇ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Paˍsaˍhkaˍ pawehˇ te leh awˬ suhˍ hpeh‸ pfuhˍ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ goˇ lehˍ ve miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ hta‸ juˇ kʼai ve hkʼe, Laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ nyi hta‸ hkanˍ kʼai ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Eˇjiˇtu‸ chaw teˇ hpaˍ oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hkanˍ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kʼa suh peuˬ ve yoˬ.
Yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Iˉsaˍreˍlaˆ chaw hui Yeˍriˆhkoˇ venˇ hta‸ suhˍ nyi caw peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, lanˇ venˇ paˆ ce ve yoˬ.
Meh maˬ lanˉ Raˍhaˆ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw maˇ na yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ geh maˇ gʼa luˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, jaˆ nyi shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ ha lehˬ ha kʼa ha‸ yuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ aˬ hto‸ ma gʼa kʼaw‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ sheˍ le. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Giˉdonˍ, Baˍrehˆ, Saˍsonˍ, Yeˍhpaˍtaˆ, Daˍviˆ, Saˍmo-eˍlaˆ leh Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ lawn ca kʼaoˍ maˇ peuˬ taˬ.

Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼaˇ ve, hteˇ lehˍ cawˇ lehˍ uˉ peunˍ ve, Gʼuiˬsha ve ka ti‸ tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa taˍ ve, laˇ caˬ shiˉ ve maw‸ kʼaw hta‸ hoˆ taˍ ve,

hehnˇ jaˇ ve aˬ miˍ hta‸ shiˉ pehˍ gʼaˇ ve, aˉ htaw la‸ hkʼaw gʼa ponˬ ve, awˬ gʼaˇ nuˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ ve hta‸ gʼa ve, ma‸ bawˆ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ gʼaˇ uiˍ la leh, shu mvuhˇ miˬ ve ma‸ yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa‸ kʼoˬ ve yoˬ.

Yaˇ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, suh kuiˬ lo a shu yawˇ ve chaw kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, hehnˇ jaˇ ve fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, leuˉ leh da‸ ve kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, shu ponˬ piˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ hkanˍ yuˬ.
Chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te leh dawˆ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, sho caˆ hpeh leh htawnˍ hkʼaw keu taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ.

Shu haˉ pui baˬ ve, liˉ leu gʼeu‸ cheˆ ve leh, aˉ htaw chaw pehˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve yoˬ. Haˍ gʼawˇ jaˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ, fawˉ ve mehˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ leh, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ yawˇ hui gʼa hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, yawˬ guiˬ kʼuˉ aˉ che‸ guiˬ kʼuˉ hta‸ veu‸ deh leh, teˇ kaˬ peuˬ teˇ kaˬ lo yawˇ hui gʼa hpaw toˇ ve yoˬ.
Yawˇ hui lehˬ, heh puiˉ hkʼaw leh hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lawˬ hkʼoˆ lo, miˬ kʼoˍ haˉ kʼoˍ hkʼaw lo ca chehˇ toˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui da‸ ve pa taw, miˬguiˬ chi yawˇ hui hta‸ maˇ keunˍ.
Chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ, yawˇ hui yonˍ ve teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ ve htawˇ, ka ti‸ piˇ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ gʼa sheˍ.

Aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ pa taw le teh‸ kʼoˆ kʼo, chaw oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui geh teˇ geh maˇ heˆ kʼo, yawˇ hui biˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ gʼa sheˍ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ ngaˬ hui awˬ pon da‸ leuˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gu taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ shehˍ hpaˇ chi taw taw maˇ leh, moˬ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ngaˬ hui hta‸ caw zuhˇ chehˇ taˍ ve pa taw, tawˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ sheˬ leh, hawˆ taˍ ve venˇ baˆ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ kʼehˆ baˬ taˉ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ pon gu taˍ laˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ hta‸ nyi ma yeˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼuiˇ kʼai-a veuˬ.

Gʼuiˇ kʼai chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ nyi taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ awˬ hkuiˉ puiˍ tanˬ te leh biˇ la piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ awˬ gʼuˇ suhˍ teh taˍ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ pa taw, ya‸ taw ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ dawˇ leh, la‸ ka hkʼoˆ lo hkanˍ suh peuˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ chi beu‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve kʼaw jaw la‸ sha paˉ lo mui chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ gʼa nuˇ leh, nyi ma maˇ gʼa luˬ tuˬ, venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui ve la‸ sheh awˬ hkʼaw lo chi taw taw hkʼa mvuhˇ hkʼa na te leh tawˍ taˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ dawˇ nyi-o.
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, venˇbaˆ hta‸ gʼa tawˍ da‸ bawˆ da‸ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, nawˬ hui ve awˬ suhˍ sheˆ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ jaw sheˍ.

Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ pa maˍ piˇ ve hkʼe, yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ kʼoˆ maˍ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui leunˇ peuˬ laˇ. Yawˇ kʼoˆ ve, Ngaˬ yaˇ paˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ hkʼe leˇ taˇ dawˇ. Yawˇ nawˬ hta‸ deˇ maˍ laˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, nyi ma taˇ luˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ yawˇ ha‸ ve chaw hta‸ maˍ piˇ leh, yawˇ ha‸ yuˬ ve yaˇ paˍ teˇ gʼaˇ le le hta‸ jaw‸ maˍ piˇ ve yoˬ, teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Yawˇ maˍ laˇ ve hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ-o‸. Yaˇ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ pa te piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ te laˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ pa maˇ maˍ piˇ ve yaˇ paˍ a shu teˇ gʼaˇ cawˬ le.
Yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ maˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve hkʼe nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui yaˇ awˬ tehˬ ma hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ yaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, ngaˬ hui hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ awˬ pa teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ ngaˬ hui yawˆ yan ve yoˬ. Chi a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh, co ha hpawˇ ve Awˬ pa awˬ hawˉ lo ngaˬ hui chehˇ leh co ha gʼa te‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui lehˬ a shu yawˇ nyi ma cawˇ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui hta‸ teˇ tcuhˉ teˇ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo ceh maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, yawˇ da‸ ve kehˬ ve hkʼe ngaˬ hui htawˇ da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ, ngaˬ hui awˬ pon da‸ ve hta‸ yawˇ dawˇ leh maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˍ laˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ ve maˇ heˆ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ ceh tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, maˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ yuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ kʼo, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo dawˇ sha gaˇ sha ve awˬ shiˍ naw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh deu lehˍ te chehˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ chiˇ leh, awˬ gʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ ve hkui tcuhˉ kʼu teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ awˬ gʼaˇ cawˬ la piˇ-oˆ.
Hkui sheh luˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ awˬ tcuhˉ maˇ gʼa jiˆ kʼai leh na-e la tuˬ, nawˬ hui ve hkui sheh awˬ pon ya‸ kʼaw hteˇ lehˍ gu taˍ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, da‸ la kehˬ la tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ tuˬ maˇ kʼoˆ, gʼaˇ hte‸ te-o. Da‸ ve kehˬ ve maˇ cawˬ ve chaw a shu teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ gʼa mawˬ.

Nawˬ hui shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸. Maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ maˇ gʼa puiˉ-aˆ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ sho‸ sha‸ laˇ tuˬ, hkʼaˇ ve awˬ geu tawˆ la leh, chaw maˇ maˇ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ htawˇ te laˇ puiˉ-aˆ.

Awˍ teˇ poˬ ceh tiˉ gʼa caˇ tuˬ awˬ pon, yaˇ uiˍ ve aˉ yaˇ hta‸ hawˇ baˬ ve Iˉsawˇ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te leh Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ maˇ yawˆ maˇ yan ve chaw, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ maˇ gʼa cawˬ tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ hkʼa deh‸ taˍ-o‸.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ Iˉsawˇ lehˬ na‸ piˇ ve awˬ bon hta‸ kʼaw‸ heuˆ gaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, baˬ taˉ ve hta‸ yawˇ gʼa hkanˍ ve teh‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ. Mehˆ gʼuiˬ ya‸ la ve awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ gʼaˇ hte‸ ca ve htawˇ, kʼaw‸ dawˇ hpfuhˆ tuˬ awˬ yanˇ maˇ kʼaw‸ cawˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, la‸ sheh htawˇ gʼa ve, aˬ miˍ to‸ ve, naˆ tawˉ naˆ ho‸ ve leh, mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ la ve hkʼaw teˇ shiˍ lo nawˬ hui laˬ ve maˇ heˆ.
Hkʼaw oˇ ve teˇ shiˍ lo behˬ heh ma meuˆ ve awˬ hkawˇ leh tawˇ yaw ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼa kaˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, yawˇ hui hta‸ tawˇ maˇ gʼa kʼaw‸ yaw laˇ tuˬ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, To nuˇ to shaˆ ka‸ hkʼaw oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa daw‸ ve kʼo, haˉ pui baˬ pehˍ-o‸ teh‸, tawˇ piˇ taˍ ve hta‸ yawˇ hui hkanˍ maˇ gʼa.
Oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ gʼa mawˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, kawˆ tuˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve pa taw, Ngaˬ kawˆ cheˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, Moˉseˍ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui laˬ ve lehˬ, Ziˉonˍ hkʼaw hkʼoˆ lo laˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼaw oˇ ve lehˬ, te‸ chehˇ ve Gʼuiˬsha ve venˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ ve Yeˍruˆsaˍlehnˍ, ca gʼaw maˇ peuˬ ve mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ hui ha lehˬ ha kʼa hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ,

mvuhˇ naw ma ve caˇ lanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ meh bvuh‸ taˍ ve yaˇ uiˍ teˇ hpaˍ hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ suhˉ jehˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh lo, biˇ la peuˬ ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hui ve co ha teˇ hpaˍ cawˬ kuiˬ lo,
ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ awˬ suhˉ awˬ pon awˬ kaˍ te shehˍ hpaˇ Yeˍsuˆ geh lo leh, Aˍbeˍlaˆ ve awˬ suhˍ tawˇ yaw ve a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh da‸ ve tawˇ hta‸ yaw ve, pfuhˍ taˍ ve awˬ suhˍ geh lo nawˬ hui laˬ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, tawˇ yaw laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ hta‸ maˇ na ve chaw maˇ gʼa hpeh‸ tuˬ, shaˍ ti‸ taˍ-o‸. Awˬ lawn kʼo, miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo shaˍ ti‸ piˇ sheh hpaˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yawˇ hui maˇ na ve pa taw maˇ gʼa ponˬ ve kʼo, mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ chehˇ ve shaˍ ti‸ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hkawˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui maˇ na ve kʼo, leuˉ leh ponˬ maˇ hpeh‸.

Oˇ htaˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ hkawˇ miˬguiˬ hta‸ hiˆ piˇ ve yoˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ ka ti‸ cawˬ taˍ ve lehˬ, Miˬguiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ ve awˬ hkʼoˆ ka‸, mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ htawˇ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ yawˇ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Teˇ pawˆ kʼaw‸ hiˆ piˇ tuˬ sheˍ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve lehˬ, hiˆ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ yeˬ chehˇ tuˬ, hiˆ piˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yuˬ baˬ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ gaˇ ve yoˬ. Hiˆ piˇ gʼa ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, te hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, hiˆ piˇ maˇ gʼa ve mvuhˇmiˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-a veuˬ. Yawˆ yan puiˉ kawˆ puiˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve hkʼe yawˇ hta‸ oˉ kʼoˍ pui-a veuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui ve Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, to‸ baˬ chehˇ ve aˬ miˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi ha‸ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.

Hkehˉ chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ tuˬ taˇ leunˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ hkehˉ chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui maˇ shiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo mvuhˇ naw ma tcuh yaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ jaw ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui lehˬ, htawnˍ hkʼaw chehˇ ve chaw hui geh teˇ geh chehˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ shawˍ taˍ leh, yawˇ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui htawˇ awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ pfuhˇ taˍ ve hta‸ pa taw, fawˉ mehˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ.

Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ heuˆ da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. Awˬ hpawˇ awˬ miˇ teˇ hpaˍ maˇ hteˇ maˇ cawˇ ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh taˇ kʼai. Awˬ lawn kʼo, guiˇ ya‸ ve chaw leh haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ciˍ yanˍ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Hpu hta‸ sheˉ lai ve teˇ ceuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo taˇ cawˬ piˇ. Nawˬ hui hkʼa cawˬ taˍ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi hkʼaˇ suh chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, Ngaˬ nawˬ hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ maˇ hpaˆ, hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ maˇ baˬ teh‸ Gʼuiˬsha kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, ngaˬ hta‸ ga laˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ leh, ngaˬ te‸ chiˉ kawˆ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ. Chaw yaˇ ngaˬ hta‸ aˬ hto‸ ma te laˇ hpeh‸ tuˬ le, teh‸ nyi ma ha‸ hanˉ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpa hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ-oˆ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, nawˬ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tawˇ hkawˇ maˍ laˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui dawˇ nyi leh, yawˇ hui yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ henˇ yuˬ leh te-o.
Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ lehˬ, aˉ nyi, ya‸ nyi leh co co taiˍ taiˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ hpeh‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Maˇ heˆ heˆ ve awˬ ceuˬ teˇ hpaˍ shu laiˉ ceuˬ ca maˍ la ve awˬ hkʼaˇ suh nawˬ hui taˇ kʼai. Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ bon hta‸ pa taw nyi ma yeˬ ve kʼo, da‸ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Caˇ tuˬ ce kan ve hta‸ pa taw nyi ma yeˬ tuˬ ve maˇ heˆ. Caˇ tuˬ ce kan ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ yehˇ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, oˇ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bon maˇ gʼa.
Ngaˬ hui tanˇ kuiˬ teˇ maˬ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Aˉ po kʼo bon yehˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo kanˉ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tanˇ kuiˬ chi teˇ maˬ lo gʼa caˇ tuˬ a hkaw-anˬ maˇ cawˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw hkuˇ lonˉ lehˬ venˇ baˆ hpehˇ tuˬ ve tanˇ tuˬ awˬ pon to nuˇ to shaˆ ve awˬ suh hta‸ yuˬ leh, da‸ kehˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo lo‸-e peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, awˬ to oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ hui ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ baˬ lo aˬ miˍ tuˉ baˬ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ Yeˍsuˆ htawˇ, yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ hta‸ pa taw chaw yaˇ hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ tuˬ, lanˇ venˇ yehˬ miˉ awˬ baˬ lo yawˇ hkanˍ suh ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh ngaˬ hui htawˇ, shu maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve hta‸ yawˇ hkanˍ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, ngaˬ hui hkanˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, deh kuiˬ awˬ baˬ lo yawˇ geh tawˆ kʼai-a veuˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui chi miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo yeˬ ve venˇ maˇ cawˬ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, awˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˬ la tuˬ ve venˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui dawˇ law leh ca chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, Yeˍsuˆ hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ hkʼaˬ htaˆ ka‸ chiˇ mvuh ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ ceuˬ tanˇ piˇ-a veuˬ. Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve lehˬ, ngaˬ hui ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo tawˆ la ve tawˇ hkawˇ teˇ hpaˍ yawˇ ve awˬ meh hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Da‸ ve hta‸ te ve teˇ ceuˬ leh shu hta‸ mawˇ jeˬ pehˬ piˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ taˇ leunˇ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, chi hkʼe ve tanˇ tuˬ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha nyi ma cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ teˇ hpaˍ ve hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ hui awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ hui te ve kanˉ awˬ lawn Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ gʼa kʼaoˍ maˍ piˇ tuˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve co ha hta‸ yawˇ hui hkʼa deh‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui chi hkʼe nyi ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ leh ha lehˬ ha kʼa te hpeh‸ tuˬ, yawˇ hui ve hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na-o. Hkʼe maˇ heˆ kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ pon awˬ bon te‸ chiˉ maˇ cawˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ pon bon lawˬ laˇ-oˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ ve shiˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, ya‸ kuiˬ maˇ cawˬ teh‸ ngaˬ shiˍ taˍ ve yoˬ. Teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ da‸ ve hta‸ tiˉ te gaˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ nawˬ hui geh haˆ haˆ gʼa kʼaw‸ la hpeh‸ tuˬ ve, bon lawˬ laˇ tuˬ leuˉ leh ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ lehˬ, yawˬ hawˉ shehˍ hpaˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Co co taiˍ taiˍ ka ti‸ shaˉ caˆ te tuˬ yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ sheˆ leh, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la piˇ ve yoˬ.

Dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ te shehˍ hpaˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve a loˍ hta‸ nawˬ hui te gʼa tuˬ, da‸ ve teˇ ceuˬ le le nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo biˇ la tuˬ ngaˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ lawˬ ve yoˬ. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ cuˇ leh yawˇ mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyi ma cawˇ ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo te chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ co co taiˍ taiˍ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ ngeh ve li‸ teˇ kʼoˆ bvuh‸ feu laˇ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ gʼaˇ pe‸ laˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh na yuˬ tuˬ ngaˬ nawˬ hui hta‸ lawˬ hkawˉ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi Tiˆmoˉseˍ hta‸ shu hpehˇ hkʼa peuˬ ve teh‸ shiˍ-o‸. Yawˇ haˆ haˆ gaˬ la ve kʼo, ngaˬ htawˇ yawˇ geh teˇ geh laˬ leh nawˬ hui hta‸ gʼa mawˬ da‸ tuˬ yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve awˬ hoˉ hkʼa peu-eˬ leh Hkri‸ yaˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ hto piˇ-oˆ. Choˬ kaˬ lo chehˇ taˍ ve Iˉtaˍliˍ chaw teˇ hpaˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ dawˇ nawˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ tawˇ shanˍ feu laˇ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ geh awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ. A menˬ.
Ngaˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha leh Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve awˬ ceˬ Yaˍkoˆ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hpaˆ da‸ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw teˇ chi nyiˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ lo dawˇ sha ha lehˬ tuˬ cawˬ piˇ-oˆ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, beˬ ve lawˇ ve laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ ve teˇ yanˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui yonˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, lawˇ nyi ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ, nawˬ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui teˇ ceuˬ ka‸ maˇ yawnˇ kʼai leh, teˇ ceuˬ le le awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ hpeh‸ la tuˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma biˇ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te-o.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ cuˇ yiˍ maˇ biˇ ve kʼo, Gʼuiˬsha geh lawˬ-o‸. Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ, maˇ deˇ leh chaw hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ maˇ chaweh hkʼe leˇ piˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, cuˇ yiˍ lawˬ ve chaw hta‸ ka‸ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo lawˬ-o‸. Nyi ma htawˇdawˇnawˬdawˇ taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nyi ma htawˇ dawˇ nawˬ dawˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, laˇ tsuhˇ gʼuiˬ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw meuˆ leh gʼuiˬ baˇ taˆ taˆ ya‸ ya‸ te ve hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ hkʼe ve chaw lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha geh yawˇ teˇ ceuˬ ceuˬ gʼa tuˬ ve teh‸ taˇ dawˇ.
Yawˇ lehˬ, nyi ma nyiˇ shiˍ cawˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ maˇ yeˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Shu awˬ hawˉ lo chehˇ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ ha lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.

Paw sha ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ maˇ cawˬ ve chehˇ kuiˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo gʼa chehˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ htawˇ ha lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ, mvuh‸ veˆ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ nyi tawˆ la leh, haw jaˇ chiˆ jaˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, mvuh‸ lehˬ nawˍ kʼai goˇ kʼai ve yoˬ. Awˬ veˆ ka‸ piˬ kʼai ce kʼai leh, nyi sha ve awˬ ceuˬ ka‸ mehˉ kʼai ve yoˬ. Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, paw sha ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ te chehˇ ve kanˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo luˬ kʼai mehˉ kʼai tuˬ yoˬ.

Beˬ ve lawˇ ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ da‸ htaˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve chaw lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, lawˇ nyi ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ hkanˍ gʼaˇ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, co ti‸ ha ti‸ shi uˉ tcuhˍ hta‸ yawˇ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ. Shi uˉ tcuhˍ oˇ ve lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ yawˇ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve yoˬ.

Venˇbaˆ beˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, Gʼuiˬsha ngaˬ hta‸ beˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ teh‸, teˇ gʼaˇ ka‸ taˇ kʼoˆ. Awˬ lawn kʼo, haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ beˬ maˇ hpeh‸. Haiˬ ve te tuˬ Gʼuiˬsha chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ ka‸ maˇ beˬ.
Hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, a shu yawˇ sheˉ lai puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, venˇ baˆ te tuˬ yawˇ hta‸ heˍ yuˬ beˬ yuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Oˇ htaˇ, sheˉ lai puiˉ ve nyi ma lehˬ, yaˇ hu ve hkʼe yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hu la leh, venˇbaˆ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ htawˇ, uiˍ la biˇ la ve teˇ yanˇ, suh ve teˇ ceuˬ hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, taˇ dawˇ ya‸.

Da‸ ve awˬ bon hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, biˇ ve la‸ shawnˍ hkʼa peu-eˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo chehˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ ve Awˬ pa geh ya‸ la ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ maˇ pa puiˉ. Yawˇ ve awˬ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo aˉ gʼuiˬ ha ka‸ maˇ cawˬ.

Hpanˍ taˍ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo ngaˬ hui lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ naw‸ la ve iˉ shiˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ, yawˇ a loˍ cawˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh ngaˬ hui hta‸ paw la piˇ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ lawn chi hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Shu tawˇ yaw ve hta‸ hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ. Tawˇ haˆ haˆ taˇ yaw. Nyi ma haˆ haˆ taˇ zuhˆ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, chaw yaˇ nyi ma zuhˆ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve hteˇ ve cawˇ ve hta‸ tawˆ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, cha‸ chiˆ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ leh, haiˬ ve hta‸ te ponˬ te leuˉ ve hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ baˬ taˉ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve co ha hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ puiˉ ve, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw ti taˍ ve bon hkawˇ hta‸ nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo ha‸ yuˬ-o‸,
Nawˬ hui lehˬ, bon hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ leh te ve chaw hpeh‸ piˇ-oˆ. Kaˇ ve chaw ceh tiˉ taˇ hpeh‸ piˇ. Kaˇ ve chaw ceh tiˉ hpeh‸ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ heˍ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Tawˇ hkawˇ oˇ ve hta‸ gʼa kaˇ leh maˇ te ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, mehˆ gʼeuˆ awˬ hkʼaw lo a shu yawˇ ve mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi ve chaw hta‸ shuˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, yawˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nyi peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ tawˆ kʼai leh, yawˇ awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼaˬ hkʼe cawˬ ve hta‸ teˇ cawˬ haˉ leunˇ kʼai ve yoˬ.

Chaw hta‸ ponˬ piˇ ve, biˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nyi tcuhˉ taˍ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, kaˇ leh leunˇ kʼai ve chaw maˇ heˆ. Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, yawˇ na yuˬ leh te ve chaw hpeh‸ ve pa taw, yawˇ hkʼa te ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ.

Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ hta‸ yawˇ hkʼa deh‸ te ve teh‸ dawˇ htawˇ, yawˇ ve ha tehˍ hta‸ maˇ gʼaˇ ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ heˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve lehˬ hkʼe leˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ cha‸ chiˆ ve maˇ cawˬ leh da‸ kehˬ ve oˉ kʼoˍ pui ve awˬ liˇ lehˬ chi hkʼe yoˬ. Yaˇcuˬshi leh mehˇchawˇma teˇ hpaˍ gʼa tu‸ gʼa hkanˍ ve teˇ yanˇ, yawˇ hui hta‸ nyi ha‸ shaˉ leh, a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ miˬguiˬ ve cha‸ chiˆ ve teˇ hpaˍ maˇ gʼa ngawˉ tuˬ gʼa faˬ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ ve ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, chaw yaˇ mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ taˇ nyi.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, shi la‸ peˍ tcuhˉ leh da‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ leh, maˇ da‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ hui nyiˇ gʼaˇ nawˬ hui ve hpawnˬ da‸ kuiˬ lo lo‸ la htaˇ,

da‸ ve veu‸ kʼaˇ veu‸ deh ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui nyi leh kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Da‸ ve mui kuiˬ chi hta‸ mui-o. Peuˬ leh haˍ yaˇ gʼawˇ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve, Oˇ kaˬ lo huˉ taˍ-o‸, maˇ heˆ kʼo, Ngaˬ ve hkui paˇ lo mui taˍ-o‸ teh‸ nawˬ hui kʼoˆ ve kʼo,
nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ peuˬ teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ pehˬ da‸ fuiˍ da‸ leh, haiˬ ve dawˇ hkʼaˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo shu hta‸ suhˉ jehˬ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Ngaˬ ha‸ ve awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ na sheˍ. Yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ awˬ hkʼaw lo paw sha la tuˬ, haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve miˬguiˬ yaˇ hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha leuˆ yuˬ ve maˇ heˆ laˇ. Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ ha‸ ve chaw hui hta‸ yawˇ ve mvuhˇmiˬ piˇ tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve hkʼe, yawˇ hui lehˬ mvuhˇmiˬ awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui lehˬ haˍ ve gʼawˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ te ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui hta‸ fawˉ mehˍ leh suhˉ jehˬ tuˬ shaˉ nanˉ lo gʼawˬ kʼai ve chaw hui lehˬ, paw sha ve chaw hui maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Nawˬ hui gʼa taˍ ve da‸ ve awˬ meh hta‸ maˇ shawˍ maˇ caˆ kʼoˆ chehˇ ve chaw hui lehˬ, paw sha ve chaw hui maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ ha‸ ve hkʼe, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw hui hta‸ ha‸-o‸ teh‸, Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ. Hkunˉ hawˉ hkanˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ chi hta‸ nawˬ hui te biˇ ve kʼo, da‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui te peuˬ.
Shu mehˆ hpfuhˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui nyi chehˇ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te chehˇ leh, nawˬ hui te ponˬ te leuˉ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ teh‸, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ ve.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkʼaˬ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, awˬ liˇ teˇ maˬ hta‸ ceh te ya‸ ve ka‸, hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ya‸ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ taˇ te teh‸ kʼoˆ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, Shu hta‸ taˇ tiˇ pehˍ ka‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ maˇ te htawˇ shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve kʼo, awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ te ponˬ te leuˉ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Ponˬ piˇ ve awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ cuˇ leh, nawˬ hui hta‸ suhˉ gʼa jehˬ tuˬ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui tawˇ yaw ve maˇ kʼoˆ, kanˉ te ve maˇ kʼoˆ, hkʼa deh‸ te-o.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, shu hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve chaw teˇ gʼaˇ suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ htaˇ, Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ ha kʼaˉ piˇ. Ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼaˇ veyoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, Ngaˬ lehˬ yonˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ htawˇ, kanˉ maˇ te ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le. Yonˍ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, yawˇ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ hpeh‸-aw laˇ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ veu‸ kʼaˇ maˇ cawˬ leh, teˇ nyi pon teˇ nyi caˇ tuˬ maˇ cawˬ ve kʼo,

nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Dawˇ sha ve awˬ hkʼaw lo kʼo‸-e loˬ. Nawˬ awˬ to hta‸ lehˬ la piˆ, bvuhˆ la piˆ teh‸ kʼoˆ piˇ ve htawˇ, yawˇ hui awˬ to pon loˍ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ piˇ ve kʼo, aˬ hto‸ ma awˬ bon cawˬ le.
Oˇ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, kanˉ maˇ te ve kʼo, yonˍ ve oˇ ve suh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ kʼoˆ ve, Nawˬ lehˬ yonˍ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ lehˬ kanˉ te ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ tuˬ yoˬ. Kanˉ maˇ te leh, nawˬ yonˍ ve maˍ laˇ-oˆ. Ngaˬ lehˬ, kanˉ te ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, ngaˬ yonˍ ve nawˬ hta‸ maˍ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬsha teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ yonˍ ve leˇ. Nawˬ yonˍ ve lehˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Neˇ teˇ hpaˍ htawˇ yonˍ leh kawˆ cheˇ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Maˇ dawˇ nyi puiˉ ve chaw-oˬ, yonˍ leh kanˉ maˇ te ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, te‸ chiˉ awˬ bon maˇ cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hkʼa deh‸ shiˍ gaˇ laˇ.
Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ pa Aˍbraˍhanˍ lehˬ, yawˇ ve yaˇ paˍ Iˉcaˆ hta‸ tanˇ kuiˬ hkʼoˆ tanˇ ve teˇ yanˇ, kanˉ te ve pa taw yawˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Yawˇ te ve kanˉ geh hkʼa geh yonˍ ve ka‸ cawˬ leh, kanˉ hta‸ pa taw yawˇ yonˍ ve biˇ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Aˍbraˍhanˍ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ yonˍ ve pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ hta‸ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw teh‸ shawˍ taˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ taˍ ve Li‸ hpu tawˇ hkawˇ chi teˇ hkawˇ biˇ la ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼoˆ ka‸, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ chawˇ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ yonˍ ve hta‸ pa taw ceh tiˉ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ. Kanˉ ka‸ te ve hta‸ pa taw hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve hta‸ nawˬ gʼa mawˬ ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, Raˍhaˆ meh ve meh maˬ lanˉ teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, tcuh peu ve chaw hta‸ ha‸ yuˬ leh, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ya‸ kʼaw teˇ caˆ hta‸ kʼo‸-e tcuh ve pa taw, kanˉ te leh hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ la ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo co ha maˇ cawˬ kʼo suh ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, yonˍ ve teˇ ceuˬ htawˇ kanˉ maˇ te ve kʼo, suh taˍ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui laiˉ gʼaˇ maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ taˇ te. Awˬ lawn kʼo, maˍ piˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, shu a‸ kehˉ leuˉ leh suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui shiˍ chehˇ ve yoˬ.

Awˬ lawn kʼo, ngaˬ hui hkʼa peu-eˬ laiˉ ceuˬ te ya‸ ve yoˬ. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ, yawˇ tawˇ teˇ pawˆ ka‸ maˇ yaw ya‸ jaw kʼo, yawˇ biˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ leh, awˬ to teˇ to hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ gʼaˇ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Iˉ mvuhˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼaˇ tuˬ yawˇ ve maw‸ kʼaw awˬ hkʼaw lo sho caˆ keu ve kʼo, yawˇ awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ ngaˬ hui gʼawˬ caw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ nyi sheˍ. Uiˍ jaˇ ve haw lo‸ kʼoˍ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ mvuhˇ haw lonˉ meuˆ kʼai ve htawˇ, haw lo‸ kʼoˍ gʼa‸ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, i jaˇ ve caˉ behˆ ehˉ hta‸ yehˇ leh, yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe haw lo‸ kʼoˍ lonˉ hta‸ suhˉ caw piˇ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Chi hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ ha tehˍ lehˬ, awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo i jaˇ ve awˬ hkʼeun hpeh‸ ve htawˇ uiˍ jaˇ ve awˬ lawn teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ tawˇ uiˍ tawˇ mvuh yaw puiˉ ve yoˬ. I jaˇ ve aˬ miˍ lehˬ, uiˍ jaˇ ve heh puiˉ hkʼaw hta‸ to‸ baˬ gʼa ve hta‸ nyi sheˍ.

Ha tehˍ lehˬ, aˬ miˍ hkʼe hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo, ha tehˍ lehˬ venˇbaˆ ve mvuhˇmiˬ htawˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ hui ve awˬ to hkʼa peu-eˬ hta‸ cha‸ chiˆ tuˬ te ve yoˬ. Nyi ma awˬ hkʼaw lo haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ maˇ maˇ hpehˇ tawˆ la piˇ leh, shaˬ te shaˬ maˇ la tcuhˉ taˍ ve yoˬ. Moˬ naˆ ho‸ lehˬ, ha tehˍ hta‸ aˬ miˍ tuˉ piˇ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, to nuˇ to shaˆ, ngaˆ, loˇ kʼai gaˆ kʼai puiˉ ve awˬ ceuˬ, iˉ kaˆ hkʼaw chehˇ ve awˬ ceuˬ, teˇ ceuˬ le le hta‸ chaw yaˇ meuˇ la tuˬ te gʼa leh, te meuˇ taˍ peuˬ ve yoˬ.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chaw yaˇ lehˬ, ha tehˍ hta‸ meuˇ la tuˬ te maˇ gʼa. Ha tehˍ lehˬ, ta‸ iˉ maˇ chehˇ puiˉ ve haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Suh piˇ puiˉ ve awˬ taw‸ ma htawˇ, yawˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Ngaˬ hui ha tehˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh ngaˬ hui ve Awˬ pa hpeh‸ ve Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh ve yoˬ. Peuˬ leh, Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ ho‸ awˬ han hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ te hpanˍ taˍ ve chaw yaˇ hta‸ ngaˬ hui ha tehˍ hta‸ yehˇ leh kʼaw‸ hkeu piˇ sheˍ ve yoˬ.
Maw‸ kʼaw teˇ maˬ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo, chiˇ mvuh ve hkawˇ ka‸, hkeu ve hkawˇ ka‸ tawˆ la ve yoˬ. Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi hkʼe te maˇ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Gʼuiˬ tuˇ teˇ maˬ tiˉ awˬ hkʼaw lo mehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ leh hkʼaˇ ve iˉ kaˆ teˇ geh tawˆ la tuˬ laˇ.

Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, maˉ nawˆ cehˬ hta‸ shaˍlonˍ shiˍ naw‸ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. A pehˉ meuˇ te hta‸ maˉ nawˆ shiˍ naw‸ hpeh‸-aw laˇ. Oˇ hkʼe naw‸ maˇ hpeh‸ ve hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ, hkʼaˇ ve gʼuiˬ tuˇ lehˬ, mehˬ ve iˉ kaˆ hta‸ tawˆ la piˇ maˇ hpeh‸.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo, cuˇ yiˍ cawˬ leh shiˍ puiˉ ve chaw a shu le. Chaw oˇ ve lehˬ, cuˇ yiˍ maˍ yiˍ cawˬ ve hkʼe, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo, da‸ ve awˬ liˇ awˬ hkʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ te leh, yawˇ ve kanˉ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ hpeu‸ maˍ piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, nawˬ hui hkawehˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ moˍ shawˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ gaˇ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, nawˬ hui a shu yawˇ awˬ to hta‸ chiˇ uiˍ chiˇ mvuh leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ gʼawˬ hkʼaˆ ve taˇ te.
Chi hkʼe ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, mvuhˇ naw ma lo ya‸ la ve cuˇ yiˍ maˇ heˆ. Miˬguiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ, awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ ve cuˇ yiˍ leh, neˇhaiˬ ve cuˇ yiˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ lawn kʼo, hkawehˉ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ leh, nyi ma uiˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ moˍ shawˍ da‸ pehˬ da‸ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve kʼo, sho‸ sha‸ ve awˬ ceuˬ leh haiˬ ve awˬ ceuˬ hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.

Mvuhˇ naw ma lo ya‸ la ve cuˇ yiˍ lehˬ, awˉ lawˉ da‸ ve kehˬ ve, hkʼaw‸ nawˉ cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ ve, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve, na yuˬ puiˉ ve leh, ha kʼaˉ ve teˇ ceuˬ ka‸, da‸ ve awˬ shiˍ ka‸, hkʼa biˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Htawˇ hpfuhˆ nawˬ hpfuhˆ te ve nyi ma leh, heˍ ve nyi ma maˇ cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Cawˇ da‸ hui da‸ tuˬ te ve chaw hui lehˬ, dawˇ sha ve awˬ hkʼaw lo sheˍ leh, hteˇ ve cawˇ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo canˇ da‸ ve leh ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve teˇ hpaˍ aˬ hto‸ ma pa taw tawˆ la ve le. Nawˬ hui awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ te gaˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ to awˬ hkʼaw lo bawˆ da‸ chehˇ ve hta‸ pa taw tawˆ la ve maˇ heˆ laˇ.

Nawˬ hui heuˆ gaˇ jaˇ ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, shu hta‸ tiˇ pehˍ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui shu mawˇ shu jeˬ hta‸ sheˉ lai ve hkʼe maˇ gʼa ve pa taw, shu hta‸ ya‸ da‸ jiˆ da‸ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui maˇ lawˬ ve pa taw nawˬ hui maˇ gʼa.
Nawˬ hui lawˬ htawˇ maˇ gʼa. Awˬ lawn kʼo, nawˬ hui awˬ suhˍ awˬ shaˍ hpawˇ nyi hkʼaˇ suh tuˬ ceh te gaˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui lawˬ ya‸ ve yoˬ.

Haˉ chawˇ haˉ paˆ te shehˍ ma hta‸ shuˍ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, miˬguiˬ awˬ liˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, Gʼuiˬsha ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ laˇ. Miˬguiˬ awˬ liˇ hta‸ awˬ chawˇ te gaˇ ve chaw hkʼaˬ ve teˇ gʼaˇ maˇ kʼoˆ, Gʼuiˬsha ve canˇ paˍ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Li‸ hpu awˬ hkʼaw lo bvuh‸ taˍ ve, Ngaˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo yawˇ keu laˇ ve co ha hta‸ yawˇ sheˉ lai jaˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve tawˇ chi lehˬ, hkʼe leˇ bvuh‸ taˍ ve teh‸ dawˇ ve laˇ.

Yawˇ lehˬ awˬ bon leuˉ leh piˇ ve yoˬ. Li‸ hpu hkʼaw bvuh‸ taˍ ve hkʼe, Gʼuiˬsha lehˬ nyi ma uiˍ ve mvuh ve chaw hui hta‸ tawˍ taˍ leh, nyi ma nuˇ nehˬ ve chaw hui hta‸ awˬ bon piˇ ve yoˬ teh‸ bvuh‸ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Chi hta‸ pa taw, Gʼuiˬsha uˉ peunˍ ve awˬ hawˉ lo hkʼa deh‸ chehˇ-oˆ. Neˇhaiˬ hta‸ tawˍ taˍ-o‸. Nawˬ hui lo yawˇ hpaw tawˆ-e tuˬ yoˬ.

Gʼuiˬsha geh jiˆ laˬ-o‸. Hkʼe te kʼo, yawˇ nawˬ hui geh jiˆ laˬ tuˬ yoˬ. Venˇbaˆ yaˇ hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve la‸ sheh hta‸ tsuhˇ hpu tsuhˇ kehˬ-o‸. Nyi ma nyiˇ hkʼaˇ dawˇ ve chaw hui-oˬ, nawˬ hui ve nyi ma hta‸ da‸ la kehˬ la piˇ-oˆ.

Nyi ma hkʼaw tu‸ hkanˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ chehˇ-oˆ. Paˆ hawˬ kehˇ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui gʼuiˬ yawˬ ve lehˬ, nyi ma hkʼaw dawˇ haˍ leh hkʼanˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ hpeh‸ la piˇ-oˆ. Nawˬ hui ve ha lehˬ tuˬ lehˬ, dawˇ haˍ tuˬ hta‸ kʼaw‸ pa piˇ-oˆ.
Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha mehˆ gʼuˇ suhˍ nyi ma nehˬ lehˍ taˍ-o‸. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ chiˇ taˆ laˇ tuˬ yoˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ taˇ hkʼaiˉ da‸. Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi hta‸ hkʼaiˉ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, venˇbaˆ taˍ ve maˇ kʼoˆ, yawˇ lehˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ hkʼaiˉ leh venˇbaˆ taˍ ve chaw hpeh‸ ve yoˬ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ ve kʼo, nawˬ lehˬ awˬ liˇ tawˇ hkawˇ hta‸ na yuˬ shehˍ hpaˇ maˇ heˆ. Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ hta‸ nawˬ venˇbaˆ taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.

Awˬliˇtawˇhkawˇ teh taˍ shehˍ hpaˇ leh suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ tiˉ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ lehˬ, ponˬ piˇ tuˬ ka‸, te luˬ tuˬ ka‸ kanˇ paˆ cawˬ ve yoˬ. Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ awˬ paˇ awˬ kui chehˇ ve chaw awˬ hkʼoˆ venˇ baˆ taˍ ve chaw-oˬ, nawˬ lehˬ hkʼaˬ hkʼe ve chaw le.

Nawˬ hui teˇ hpaˍ hpaˍ kʼoˆ ve, Ya‸ nyi shawˉ pawˍ ngaˬ hui venˇ teˇ venˇ venˇ lo teˇ hkʼaw‸ ca chehˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Oˇ kaˬ lo tanˇ kaˬ te leh, awˬ yawˬ gʼa tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Chi hkʼe kʼoˆ ve chaw hui-oˬ, hkʼa deh‸ dawˇ nyi sheˍ.
Shawˉ pawˍ hkʼaˬ hkʼe hpeh‸ la tuˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ shiˍ. Nawˬ ve a sha‸ aˬ hto‸ ma hta‸ shuˍ da‸ le. Teˇ hkui tiˉ gʼa mawˬ taˉ leh, mehˉ kʼai ve iˉ kaˆ shaˉ hta‸ shuˍ da‸ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui kʼoˆ cawˇ ve lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬ sha nyi ma cawˇ ve kʼo, ngaˬ hui a sha‸ te‸ leh, chi hkʼe oˇ hkʼe te tuˬ yoˬ teh‸ kʼoˆ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Ya‸ hkʼaˇ, chi beu‸ nawˬ hui nyi ma uiˍ leh caˆ muiˬ puiˉ ve yoˬ. Nyi ma uiˍ ve chi hkʼe ve hkʼa peu-eˬ lehˬ haiˬ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, da‸ ve hta‸ te tuˬ shiˍ taˍ htawˇ maˇ te ve chaw lehˬ, yawˇ awˬ pon venˇbaˆ hpeh‸ ve yoˬ.
Chaw paw chaw sha teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, chi beu‸ na sheˍ. Tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼoˆ lo gaˬ la tuˬ ve hta‸ pa taw, gʼaˇ hte‸ kuˬ hawˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Nawˬ hui ve mawˇ jeˬ lehˬ kuiˇ kʼai peuˬ. Nawˬ hui ve veu‸ kʼaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ htawˇ pfuhˇ shehˍ ma caˇ peuˬ.

Nawˬ hui ve hpu shi htawˇ yawˇ caˇ peuˬ. Yawˇ caˇ ve oˇ ve lehˬ, nawˬ hui venˇbaˆ te ve hta‸ shaˉ hkiˆ hkanˍ leh, aˬ miˍ hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ nawˬ hui ve awˬ shaˍ hta‸ caˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Awˬ leh meuˇ ve awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ awˬ pon, nawˬ hui mawˇ jeˬ shaw hpoˆ taˍ peuˬ.

Na sheˍ. Nawˬ hui ve ti mi hkʼaw caˬ gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ heˍ leh awˬ hpfuhˇ maˇ piˇ ve pa taw, awˬ hpfuhˇ oˇ ve kuˬ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Caˬ gʼeu‸ shehˍ hpaˇ hui ve kuˬ hkawˇ htawˇ, hkʼa peu-eˬ awˬ hkʼoˆ uiˍ shehˍ hpaˇ Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve naˍ paw awˬ hkʼaw lo geh peuˬ.
Nawˬ hui miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo paw sha jaˇ leh nyi hkʼaˇ suh htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ te taˍ peuˬ. Tiˇ pehˍ ve awˬ nyi awˬ pon nawˬ hui lehˬ, a shu yawˇ ve nyi ma hta‸ hu leh gu taˍ peuˬ.
Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw hta‸ nawˬ hui suhˉ taˆ leh tiˇ pehˍ peuˬ. Yawˇ nawˬ hui hta‸ maˇ tawˍ taˍ.

Chi hta‸ pa taw, awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ gaˬ la htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ yeunˇ hkanˍ chehˇ-oˆ. Muiˬ caˇ paˍ lehˬ, miˬguiˬ ve awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ ve awˬ shiˍ hta‸ gʼa tuˬ yawˇ law taˍ ve yoˬ. Mvuhˇ yeˬ awˉ lawˉ laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ leh, awˬ leh laˬ ve teˇ yanˇ hkʼa gaˬ, yawˇ yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law taˍ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui htawˇ, yeunˇ hkanˍ leh law taˍ-o‸. Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la tuˬ ve awˬ yanˇ gaˬ la paˇ neˇ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui nyi ma yeˬ chehˇ-oˆ.
Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ hta‸ teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ taˇ taˍ da‸. Nyi-o, Suhˉ jehˬ shehˍ hpaˇ lehˬ, yehˬ miˉ awˬ paˇ lo huˉ chehˇ taˍ peuˬ.

Awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ meh hta‸ peun leh maˍ laˇ ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve hta‸ gʼa hpuˇ htaˇ, yawˇ hui yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve nyi ma cawˬ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui henˇ yuˬ jawˬ yuˬ-o‸.

Yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve chaw hui lehˬ, awˬ bon uiˍ ve yoˬ teh‸ ngaˬ hui kʼoˆ ve yoˬ. Yawˇbaˆ yeunˇ hkanˍ puiˉ ve awˬ lawn hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa kaˇ peuˬ. Jawˇmawˇ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ dawˇ taˍ ve hkʼe te piˇ leh, yawˇ hkʼaˬ ma ha‸ leh ha kʼaˉ puiˉ ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa mawˬ peuˬ.

Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, a ciˉ ka‸ taˇ hkanˍ. Tawˇ chi lehˬ uiˍ jaˇ ve teˇ hkawˇ yoˬ. Mvuhˇ naw ma hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, miˬguiˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, awˬ kaˍ awˬ nu ve awˬ ceuˬ hta‸ maˇ kʼoˆ, chi teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ cuˇ leh taˇ hkanˍ. Nawˬ hui suhˉ jehˬ ve hta‸ maˇ gʼa hkanˍ tuˬ, nawˬ ve tawˇ hkawˇ lehˬ, yoˬ ve kʼo yoˬ, maˇ heˆ ve kʼo maˇ heˆ teh‸ ceh tiˉ kʼoˆ loˬ.
Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ tu‸ chehˇ hkanˍ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hta‸ bon lawˬ piˇ lawˬ-o‸. Chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ ha lehˬ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ hta‸ kʼa muiˬ chiˇ mvuh piˇ lawˬ-o‸.

Nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ naˬ chehˇ gawˬ chehˇ ve laˇ. Yawˇ lehˬ, Hkri‸ yaˇ awˬ moˍ awˬ hoˉ chaw mawˇ teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ kuˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ. Yawˇ hui lehˬ, Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ ve awˬ meh hta‸ cuˇ leh, chaw naˬ oˇ ve hta‸ naˍ manˇ shehˍ peuˬ hkʼaw‸ nawˉ, yawˇ awˬ pon bon lawˬ cawˇ ve yoˬ.
Yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo bon lawˬ ve teˇ ceuˬ lehˬ, chaw naˬ hta‸ na-e la piˇ leh, Jawˇ mawˇ Yeˍsuˆ yawˇ hta‸ tu la piˇ tuˬ yoˬ. Yawˇ venˇbaˆ cawˬ ve kʼo, yawˇ ve venˇ baˆ hta‸ hpehˇ hkʼa piˇ tuˬ yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, nawˬ hui na-e la tuˬ, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ venˇbaˆ kʼaoˍ maˍ da‸ leh, teˇ gʼaˇ leh teˇ gʼaˇ awˬ pon bon lawˬ-o‸. Hteˇ ve cawˇ ve chaw bon lawˬ ve lehˬ, kanˇ paˆ cawˬ maˇ jaˇ ve yoˬ.
Eˇliˇya‸ lehˬ ngaˬ hui hkʼa shuˍ shuˍ chaw yaˇ hpeh‸ ve htawˇ, mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ tuˬ yawˇ bon gʼaˇ hte‸ lawˬ htaˇ, shehˆ hkʼaw‸ leh ha pa hkaw‸ maˬ hkʼa gaˬ miˬguiˬ hkʼoˆ lo mvuhˇ yeˬ maˇ laˬ.
Teˇ pawˆ yawˇ bon kʼaw‸ lawˬ htaˇ, mvuhˇ naw ma lehˬ mvuhˇ yeˬ kʼaw‸ laˬ piˇ leh, miˬguiˬ htawˇ awˬ shiˍ kʼaw‸ naw‸ la ve yoˬ.
Ngaˬ awˬ viˉ awˬ nyi teˇ hpaˍ-oˬ, nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ hteˇ ve cawˇ ve ya‸ kʼaw hta‸ ya‸ kʼai leh, chaw teˇ gʼaˇ gʼaˇ yawˇ hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve kʼo,

venˇbaˆ yaˇ teˇ gʼaˇ ya‸ kʼaw ya‸ kʼai chehˇ ve hta‸ kʼaw‸ shiˍ hkʼaw‸ veu laˇ ve chaw oˇ ve teˇ gʼaˇ lehˬ, suh kuiˬ lo co ha teˇ maˬ hta‸ htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ piˇ leh, venˇ baˆ maˇ ve hta‸ yawˇ beh taˍ peuˬ teh‸, yawˇ hta‸ shiˍ piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve tcuh yaˇ Peˍtruˆ yoˬ. Hpaˆ da‸ leh, Poˍtuˆ, Gaˍlaˍtiˆ, Kaˍpaˍdawˇkiˆ, Aˍsiˆ leh Beˍtuˇniˆ mvuhˇmiˬ teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo ca chehˇ kʼai peuˬ ve chaw teˇ hpaˍ hta‸ ngaˬ li‸ bvuh‸ laˇ ve yoˬ.

Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ hta‸ na yuˬ leh, yawˇ ve awˬ suhˍ nawˬ hui hta‸ pfuhˍ piˇ tuˬ, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ leuˆ yuˬ taˍ leh, Awˬ ha hpu nawˬ hui hta‸ da‸ piˇ kehˬ piˇ peuˬ. Awˬ bon awˬ shinˉ leh dawˇ sha gaˇ sha tuˬ nawˬ hui awˬ hkʼaw lo maˇ la piˇ-oˆ.

Ngaˬ hui ve Jawˇmawˇ Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ ve Awˬ pa Gʼuiˬsha hta‸ chiˇ mvuh-o. Yawˇ ha kʼaˉ puiˉ jaˇ ve hta‸ pa taw, ngaˬ hui chaw awˬ suhˉ hpeh‸ la leh, te‸ chehˇ ve dawˇ law kuiˬ cawˬ la ve yoˬ. Dawˇ law kuiˬ oˇ ve lehˬ, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ suh kuiˬ lo kʼaw‸ te‸ tu la ve hta‸ pa taw cawˬ la ve yoˬ.

Hkʼe te leh, ngaˬ hui Gʼuiˬsha ve awˬ shinˉ caˇ shehˍ hpaˇ teˇ hpaˍ hpeh‸ la ve yoˬ. Maˇ luˬ puiˉ, maˇ cha‸ chiˆ puiˉ, maˇ pehˆ puiˉ ve awˬ shinˉ oˇ ve hta‸ mvuhˇ naw ma hkʼoˆ lo nawˬ hui awˬ pon yawˇ ha‸ shaˉ taˍ ve yoˬ.
Awˬ leh meuˇ teˇ nyi htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ hkʼa tawˍ lehˆ hpeu‸ maˍ laˇ htaˇ hkʼa gaˬ, nawˬ hui hkʼa yonˍ ve chaw hui hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha yawˇ ve kanˇ paˆ hta‸ cuˇ leh ha‸ shaˉ chehˇ ve yoˬ.
Hkʼe te leh, chi beu‸ teˇ hkui teˇ yanˇ awˬ hkʼaw lo, tu‸ ve hkanˍ ve leh lawˇ nyi ve laiˉ ceuˬ hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa hpuˇ da‸ ve htawˇ, ha lehˬ chehˇ-oˆ.

Aˬ miˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo shi hta‸ lawˇ nyi ve hkʼe, tu‸ hkanˍ ve chi teˇ hpaˍ lehˬ nawˬ hui yonˍ ve nyi ma hta‸ lawˇ nyi tuˬ yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve nyi ma lehˬ, luˬ puiˉ sheˆ puiˉ ve shi a‸ kehˉ awˬ hpfuhˇ hkʼaˆ jaˇ ve yoˬ. Nawˬ hui yonˍ yeˬ ve kʼo, Yeˍsuˆ Hkri‸ kʼaw‸ ya‸ la ve teˇ yanˇ, chiˇ mvuh ve, awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ leh, taˍ uiˍ taˍ mvuh ve hta‸ nawˬ hui gʼa tuˬ yoˬ.

Yawˇ hta‸ nawˬ hui maˇ mawˬ jaw htawˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ ha‸ chehˇ ve yoˬ. Chi beu‸ yawˇ hta‸ maˇ mawˬ htawˇ, nawˬ hui yawˇ hta‸ yonˍ ve awˬ hkʼaw lo awˬ me‸ awˬ hponˇ uiˍ jaˇ leh, ca kʼoˆ maˇ peuˬ ve ha lehˬ tuˬ nawˬ hui geh cawˬ ve yoˬ.
Nawˬ hui yonˍ ve pa taw, nawˬ hui ve co ha htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve hta‸ gʼa ve yoˬ.
Htaiˍ hkʼaw‸ ve chi hta‸ Gʼuiˬsha ve tcuh kaˍ paˍ hui hkʼa deh‸ na nyi leh ca nyi peuˬ. Gʼuiˬsha nawˬ hui hta‸ awˬ bon pe‸ laˇ tuˬ ve awˬ lawn, aˬ sho-eˬ htaˇ ka‸ yawˇ hui bon maˍ peuˬ.

Tcuh kaˍ paˍ oˇ ve teˇ hpaˍ awˬ hkʼaw lo, Hkri‸ ve Awˬ ha hpu kanˉ te chehˇ ve yoˬ.
